functions.name: ThunkToThumb
functions.signature: int ThunkToThumb(int arg1, code * arg2, int arg3, int arg4)

functions.name: std_ConstructArray
functions.signature: void * std_ConstructArray(void * base, void (*ctor)(void *), u32 elemSize, u32 count)
functions.summary: Runs a constructor callback once per element of a raw array, advancing by elemSize and stopping after count elements; returns the array base, never the callback result. This is the helper every array-of-objects constructor in the binary was compiled down to.

functions.name: std_RunTerminateHandler
functions.summary: C++ terminate path: fetches the lazily created terminate-state object, invokes the installed handler (or the built-in default at obj+8 when none is installed), then calls the no-return runtime abort routine 0x11C810.

functions.name: maybe_std_AllocRuntimeBlock
functions.summary: Allocates one 0x88-byte block through Mem_Alloc and clears its first byte. The terminate-state holder (0x00100102) stores the result at its +0x1C field.

functions.name: std_Abort
functions.summary: Low-level CRT abort entrypoint in thumb mode; invokes the core runtime abort handler func_0011C810 without returning.

functions.name: maybe_std_GetTerminateState
functions.summary: Lazily creates the CRT terminate-state record: allocates 0x20 bytes, stores the default terminate handler 0x001000FD at +8, clears the remaining fields and attaches the 0x88-byte scratch block from 0x001000BA; returns the cached record.

functions.name: std_tolower
functions.summary: ctype tolower: returns c+0x20 when the locale ctype mask for c has bit 4 (the 'upper' class) set, otherwise c. Used by the Squirrel native that lowercases a script string.

functions.name: std_toupper
functions.summary: ctype toupper: returns c-0x20 when the ctype mask has bit 3 (the 'lower' class) set and c is not 0xDF (Latin-1 sharp s, which has no single-byte uppercase), otherwise c.

functions.name: std_ThrowNarrowRange
functions.signature: void std_ThrowNarrowRange(const char* msg, int len)
functions.summary: Fixed-kind variant of the narrow throw helper: builds the [msg, msg+len) range and throws it with this entry's own literal.

functions.name: std_ThrowNarrowRangeEx
functions.signature: void std_ThrowNarrowRangeEx(const char* msg, int len, void* kind, void* typeinfo)
functions.summary: Parameterised C++ runtime throw helper: builds the [msg, msg+len) range in a local exception object and throws it with the caller-supplied kind/typeinfo and a fixed per-function literal.

functions.name: std_ThrowWideRange
functions.signature: u32 std_ThrowWideRange(const u16* msg, u32 len, void* kind, void* typeinfo)
functions.summary: Throws/format-checks a UTF-16 range for the basic_string<wchar_t> layer: builds the two-byte-stride range end (msg + len*2 - 2) and returns the formatted length or 0xFFFFFFFF when the range did not fit.

functions.name: std_ThrowNarrowFixed
functions.summary: Throw helper for a single already-built message object: wraps it in a one-element range and throws without a following cleanup call.

functions.name: std_ThrowNarrowRange2
functions.signature: void std_ThrowNarrowRange2(const char* msg, int len)
functions.summary: Byte-for-byte twin of 0x0010018A with a different fixed literal: the same narrow range throw reporting a different error class.

functions.name: maybe_std_ThrowWideRange2
functions.signature: void maybe_std_ThrowWideRange2(const u16* msg, u32 len)
functions.summary: Wide-character twin of 0x00100272: builds a two-byte-stride range over the message, throws it through std_vprintf_flags1, and returns 0xFFFFFFFF when the formatted length does not fit in len.

functions.name: std_FormatPutStringNarrow
functions.signature: void std_FormatPutStringNarrow(FormatStream* stream, const char* text, u32 precision)
functions.summary: Writes a narrow (char) string into a printf-style format sink, honouring the field precision and updating the remaining-width and written-count fields; each byte is handed to the sink's putc callback.

functions.name: std_PrintfFormatInt32
functions.signature: void std_PrintfFormatInt32(FormatStream* stream, int conv, va_list* ap)
functions.summary: Formats a 32-bit signed/unsigned decimal integer (%d/%u/i) for the printf core: extracts the value from the va_list, builds the sign/space/plus prefix, converts digits and emits them through the shared padding writer.

functions.name: std_PrintfFormatInt
functions.signature: void std_PrintfFormatInt(PrintfStream* out, int conv, s64 value)
functions.summary: Emits one integer conversion for printf: writes the decimal digits of the 64-bit value into the stream buffer at out+0x24, chooses the sign prefix from the stream flags (minus / plus / space) and hands it to the padding writer. Used by the %d/%i/%u family; conv == 0xf5 skips sign handling.

functions.name: std_strtol
functions.signature: long std_strtol(const char* s, char** endptr, int base)
functions.summary: strtol: skips leading ctype-space bytes, consumes an optional '+'/'-', delegates the digits to 0x002FF91A, restores *endptr = s when no digit was consumed, sets errno (via 0x002FF9C4) to 2 (ERANGE) on overflow and negates the magnitude for '-'. Returns the value in the low half of the Ghidra u64.

functions.name: std_PrintfFormatHex64
functions.signature: void std_PrintfFormatHex64(FormatStream* stream, int conv, u32 hi, u32 lo)
functions.summary: Formats a 64-bit value as hexadecimal (%x/%X), building digits from the 64-bit hi:lo pair and emitting the selected '0x' prefix plus zero padding.

functions.name: std_PrintfFormatHexArg
functions.signature: void std_PrintfFormatHexArg(FormatStream* stream, int conv, va_list* ap)
functions.summary: va_arg wrapper for the hex formatter: fetches a 32-bit argument from the va_list and delegates to std_PrintfFormatHex64 with a zero high word.

functions.name: std_strtoul
functions.signature: unsigned long std_strtoul(const char* s, char** endptr, int base)
functions.summary: strtoul: same skip/sign/errno front end as strtol but it saves and restores errno around the conversion and negates the magnitude for a leading '-', which is exactly the strtoul unsigned-wraparound contract.

functions.name: std_strtodThunk
functions.signature: double std_strtodThunk(const char* text, char** end)
functions.summary: Eight-byte pass-through trampoline into std_strtod (push {r4,lr}; bl std_strtod; pop {r4,pc}) that leaves all argument registers untouched, so it is an alternate entry point to the double parser rather than atof (which would clear the end pointer).

functions.name: std_mbstowcs
functions.signature: int std_mbstowcs(u16 * dst, const u8 * src, u32 maxChars, mbstate * state)
functions.summary: Converts a multibyte byte string (current locale encoding) into a 16-bit wide-character buffer, one character per call to the locale decoder, stopping at the terminating NUL or after maxChars characters, and returns the number of wide characters stored.

functions.name: std_mbrlen
functions.signature: int std_mbrlen(const char* s, int n, mbstate_t* ps)
functions.summary: C89 mbrlen: measures how many bytes of a multibyte sequence are consumed, using the caller's mbstate and returning -2 for an incomplete sequence and -1 for an illegal one.

functions.name: std_mbrtowc
functions.signature: int std_mbrtowc(u16* pwc, const char* s, int n, mbstate_t* ps)
functions.summary: C99 mbrtowc: decodes one multibyte character into a wide character using the current locale's converter, returning the bytes consumed, 0 for a null character, -2 for an incomplete sequence and -1 (setting errno EILSEQ) for an invalid one.

functions.name: std_qsort_internal_quicksort
functions.signature: void std_qsort_internal_quicksort(void* base, u32 arg2, size_t count, size_t size, int (*cmp)(const void*, const void*))
functions.summary: The recursive half of the C library qsort: median-of-three quicksort over byte-sized elements with an explicit 32-entry stack, swapping whole elements with 4-byte-word copies when both pointers are aligned and byte copies otherwise, recursing only into partitions larger than 10 elements.

functions.name: std_qsort
functions.signature: void std_qsort(void* base, size_t count, size_t size, int (*cmp)(const void*, const void*))
functions.summary: qsort entry point: for 10 elements or fewer it runs the inlined insertion sort (shifting each element while the comparator says it is smaller), otherwise it hands the array to the quicksort at 0x001006F0.

functions.name: std_strncat
functions.signature: char* std_strncat(char* dest, const char* src, int count)
functions.summary: Appends src to the NUL-terminated string in dest, copying at most count bytes and always writing a terminator when the budget runs out. This is the Thumb CRT strncat used all over the model/UI code.

functions.name: std_strstr
functions.signature: char* std_strstr(const char* haystack, const char* needle)
functions.summary: strstr: returns a pointer to the first occurrence of needle in haystack (haystack itself for an empty needle) or NULL. Naive restart-at-next-character loop.

functions.name: std_MemCmp
functions.signature: int std_MemCmp(const void* s1, const void* s2, size_t n, u32 alignMask)
functions.summary: Optimized CRT block memory comparison; performs 32-bit word comparison when word-aligned and byte-by-byte comparison otherwise.

functions.name: std_wcsncpy
functions.signature: u16 * std_wcsncpy(u16 * dst, const u16 * src, int count)
functions.summary: Copies at most count wide characters and zero-fills the remainder: once the source NUL is copied the source pointer stops advancing, which is exactly the wcsncpy contract.

functions.name: std_wcsncat
functions.signature: u16* std_wcsncat(u16* dest, const u16* src, int count)
functions.summary: Wide-character strncat: finds the end of dest, appends at most count wide characters from src and terminates the result.

functions.name: std_Utf16CompareN
functions.signature: int std_Utf16CompareN(const unsigned short* left, const unsigned short* right, int count)
functions.summary: Compares two UTF-16 strings for at most `count` code units and returns the difference of the first differing unit (0 at the end of `left`). Used by the script/text layer to compare wide-character names with a bounded length.

functions.name: Str_WcsPbrk
functions.signature: wchar_t* Str_WcsPbrk(const wchar_t* str, const wchar_t* accept)
functions.summary: Scans a 16-bit null-terminated wide string for the first occurrence of any character from a given accept set.

functions.name: Str_WcsStr
functions.signature: wchar_t* Str_WcsStr(const wchar_t* haystack, const wchar_t* needle)
functions.summary: Finds the first occurrence of wide substring needle in wide string haystack.

functions.name: std_RunPreinitArray
functions.summary: Calls every entry of the CRT pre-initialiser table (0x00799C94..0x0079AA18). Each slot stores an offset relative to its own address, so the runner adds the slot address to the word before calling it - the position-independent form of .preinit_array/.init_array used by the statically linked C++ runtime.

functions.name: std_operator_delete_array
functions.summary: operator delete[] for arrays of class objects: destroys the elements through the array cookie (size at p-8, count at p-4) using 0x00100BE0 and then releases the allocation with 0x0010F69C.

functions.name: std_destroy_range
functions.signature: void* std_destroy_range(void* first, void (*dtor)(void*), size_t elemSize, int count)
functions.summary: Destroys an array of class objects backwards (i = count-1 .. 0 calling dtor(first + i*elemSize)) and returns first-8, the allocation pointer behind the 8-byte array cookie. This is the 4-argument form the compiler emits for every array destruction; 239 call sites.

functions.name: std_GetErrno
functions.summary: Retrieves current thread errno value from the thread-local storage errno pointer returned by __aeabi_errno_addr.

functions.name: std_SetErrno
functions.summary: Stores err into the C library errno cell. Called by the soft-float and libm routines when they detect a domain/range error, so the value is what the caller sees in errno afterwards.

functions.name: std_FormatPutStringNarrowDispatch
functions.summary: Chooses how to emit a narrow %s argument: if the stream is in byte mode it writes the bytes verbatim, otherwise it converts the multibyte text to wide characters first.

functions.name: std_FormatSinkPutNarrow
functions.signature: void std_FormatSinkPutNarrow(void* sink, const u16* src, int count)
functions.summary: Copies a UTF-16 run into a narrow printf sink: converts each unit through the locale codec, stops at the terminator or the sink's hard limit, and when the width budget would be exceeded flushes, pads with PadZero/PadSpace, emits the already-converted bytes through the callback at sink+4 and charges the budget.

functions.name: std_FormatPutMultibyteAsWide
functions.signature: void std_FormatPutMultibyteAsWide(FormatStream* stream, const char* text, int count)
functions.summary: Emits a multibyte string to a wide-character sink: a first pass counts characters with mbrtowc (honouring precision in characters, not bytes) and a second pass converts and writes each wide character.

functions.name: std_FormatPutStringWide
functions.signature: void std_FormatPutStringWide(FormatStream* stream, const u16* text, u32 precision)
functions.summary: Writes a wide (UTF-16) string into a wide printf sink, honouring precision and updating width/count fields; the mirror image of std_FormatPutStringNarrow.

functions.name: std_PrintfFormatOctal64
functions.signature: void std_PrintfFormatOctal64(FormatStream* stream, u32 conv, u32 hi, u32 lo)
functions.summary: Formats a 64-bit value as octal (%o), including the alternate-form leading '0' and zero padding.

functions.name: std_PrintfFormatOctalArg
functions.signature: void std_PrintfFormatOctalArg(FormatStream* stream, u32 conv, va_list* ap)
functions.summary: va_arg wrapper for the octal formatter: fetches a 64-bit argument and splits it into high/low words for std_PrintfFormatOctal64.

functions.name: std_strtod
functions.signature: double std_strtod(const char* s, char** endptr)
functions.summary: strtod: skips ctype-space, handles '+'/'-', calls the floating-point scanner 0x00101026, sets *endptr back to s when nothing was consumed, sets errno = 2 (ERANGE) on overflow and negates for '-'.

functions.name: std_SetLocaleCategory
functions.summary: CRT helper that initializes or applies default locale category settings by invoking func_006740E4 with category ID 12.

functions.name: std_isspace
functions.summary: ctype isspace: returns bit 0 of the locale ctype mask, the whitespace class - the exact predicate the strtol/strtoul/strtod front ends use to skip leading blanks.

functions.name: std_PrintfFormatSpecialFloat
functions.signature: void std_PrintfFormatSpecialFloat(FormatStream* stream, u32 flags, int conv, int sign)
functions.summary: Emits the three-character special float spellings (inf/INF/nan/NAN) for the printf core, adjusting the width by the sign character and honouring the uppercase flag.

functions.name: std_FormatSinkPutString
functions.signature: u32 std_FormatSinkPutString(void* self, const u16* src, int length)
functions.summary: Entry point of the format character sink: dispatches to the locale-converting writer (0x00100C6C) when the sink's +0x14 selector is zero and to the direct wide writer (std_FormatPutStringWide) otherwise, always reporting success.

functions.name: std_strtod_core
functions.signature: double std_strtod_core(const char* digits, char** endptr, int arg3)
functions.summary: The actual decimal/hex floating-point scanner behind strtod: accumulates the mantissa and binary exponent and scales with the soft-float double helpers, returning the double; the wrapper 0x00100E88 applies the sign and errno.

functions.name: std_StrtofCore
functions.signature: float std_StrtofCore(FloatResult* result, const char* digits, const char* exponent, int exp2)
functions.summary: Turns the already-scanned decimal digit string plus its decimal exponent into a float: builds the 64-bit mantissa, normalises it, scales by the power of ten, applies the current rounding mode and stores the 32-bit result, setting ERANGE when the value overflows.

functions.name: std_Strtod
functions.signature: double std_Strtod(const char* text, char** end, int* status, ScanCtx* ctx)
functions.summary: The C library strtod: reads sign, digits, decimal separator (from the locale block), "0x" hex floats and an exponent through the ctx getc/ungetc callbacks and returns the parsed double, updating the end pointer and the conversion status.

functions.name: std_ParseHexFloat
functions.signature: int std_ParseHexFloat(char* buf, char** end, u16* out, ScanCtx* ctx, int pos, u32 flags, int len)
functions.summary: Parses the significand of a hexadecimal float literal ("0x1.8p3") into a double and applies the binary exponent; returns the number of characters consumed or -2 on a malformed literal.

functions.name: std_ParseInfNan
functions.signature: int std_ParseInfNan(u32 lo, u32 hi, int* endpos, int* scanctx, int pos, u32 bits, int len, int ch)
functions.summary: Recognises the textual 'inf', 'infinity' and 'nan(...)' forms in strtod and fills the result's float bits (infinity plus optional sign, or a quiet NaN with the parenthesised payload skipped).

functions.name: std_uninitialized_copy
functions.signature: void* std_uninitialized_copy(void* dst, const void* src, size_t stride, int count, void (*ctor)(void*, const void*))
functions.summary: Copy-constructs count elements from src to dst: calls the element constructor for each pair and advances both pointers by the stride, returning dst. The compiler's uninitialized_copy loop for non-trivial element types.

functions.name: std_vec_delete_from_cookie
functions.summary: Readable-C fragment of the vector-delete helper: destroys the elements of an array using the size/count pair stored immediately before the array (the ARMCC array cookie) and leaves the raw deallocation to the caller.

functions.name: maybe_Thunk_Call00100F04
functions.summary: Eight-byte Thumb thunk: `push {r4,lr}; bl 0x100F04; pop {r4,pc}`. The callee is itself a two-argument wrapper (`movs r1,r0; movs r0,#0xc; blx 0x3007B8`) that passes the original argument on with a leading 0xC, and 0x3007B8 has no readable body, so neither the thunk nor its target can be identified.

functions.name: Engine_Initialize
functions.summary: One-time engine bring-up: initialises the heap system (InitHeaps), then lazily creates and wires every global subsystem singleton (resource caches, renderer, sound, task pool, input) using the repeated 'init-flag + aligned size + allocate + construct' pattern.

functions.name: std_RunInitArray
functions.summary: Calls every absolute function pointer between the two bound words at 0x0079AA18 and 0x0079AA1C. In the retail image both bounds hold the same value, so the list is linked empty - it exists for libraries that register static constructors into it at link time.

functions.name: maybe_Os_InitStringRecord
functions.summary: Fills a record obtained from 0x300308(0, 0x04000027) with two built-in strings: field +4 gets the first getter's result plus one (skipping a length or prefix byte) and field +0xC gets the second getter's result. The old 'Time' label was unsupported - nothing in the body reads a clock.

functions.name: Os_RunLateBootSetup
functions.summary: Last step of ResetVector: brings up the SDK synchronisation layer (0x001076A8), resets the committed memory size (0x00104510(0)), creates the application heap (Mem_InitializeMainHeap(0)) and finalises the allocator (0x0010742C).

functions.name: Mem_InitializeMainHeap
functions.summary: Creates the application heap: marks the heap block ready, publishes the heap descriptor at 0x007E790C, then asks 0x00107B54 to reserve heapSize (rounded down to 8) bytes with permission word 0x300 and alignment/type 0xF. On success it maps the block (0x00119BA8/0x0010DD58/0x00119E1C) and returns 0; a non-zero return means the reservation failed.

functions.name: Engine_InitializeSubsystems
functions.summary: Runs the fixed ordered list of subsystem initialisers (OS/runtime, display, task pool, time step) that must follow heap setup; called from Engine_Initialize.

functions.name: Snd_StreamManager_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the streamed-audio manager: advances the five fade records (f_1AB0 bitmask, f_1AB4 array), updates all stream slots and voices through Snd_StreamSlot_UpdateAll and Snd_StreamVoice_Update, flushes the texture uploads it owns and releases finished ones, then retires an expired handle at f_60.

functions.name: Mem_InitAllocatorState
functions.summary: The one-time allocator-state reset: it clears the allocator descriptor, initialises the pool/block allocators and records the extended-memory probe result.

functions.name: maybe_Os_IpcSendResultState
functions.summary: Calls the locked IPC send helper 0x00107E9C and normalises its Result to a two-valued state: 1 when the result is non-negative, 2 when it is negative. It is a status wrapper, not an update-mode getter.

functions.name: Engine_DispatchFrameCallbacks
functions.summary: Frame callback dispatcher: runs up to four registered {fn,arg} callbacks from each of the global frame-begin/render/frame-end arrays, between the semaphore lock/unlock and the runtime-state guards.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetFramePeriod
functions.summary: Stores one value in two fields of the context (+8 and +0x14) and then resets both timing helpers 0x107894 and 0x107880. The two helpers are shared with the allocator init path, so they are general counters rather than a frame clock, and 'Frame' is a guess.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_Channel_InitFields
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Fs_Channel_InitFields(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises one transfer channel of the large cache/heap object: stores the channel pointer at +0xE114, initialises the wait event at +0xE118 (Os_LightEvent_Init) and submits a 0x2000-byte staging buffer with mode 0x11 and handle -2 through Gfx_CommandBuffer_Submit; returns 1. Called from Engine_Initialize and InitHeaps.

functions.name: SaveWork_Container_BaseCtor
functions.summary: Base constructor of the 0xE3C8-byte party/save work singleton at *0x007BE308: installs the base vtables 0x007602B4 / 0x007602CC, constructs the embedded 0xFF-slot and 31-member sub-arrays, runs Save_InitPartySnapshot and Ui_PartyStatus_InitMemberData, and returns self.

functions.name: Fs_CacheSet_Initialize
functions.summary: Builds the whole streaming-resource cache: allocates per-category slot pools and buffers for every pack category (sound, cmn_cache, weapon, PL_256/400, F_/B_ motion, sound, model, UI) and registers them in the named-table at the end.

functions.name: maybe_Engine_SubmitFrameEntries
functions.summary: Frame step: pumps the sound voice list (maybe_Snd_UpdateVoiceList), then, when the global 0x007AE18C is set, calls vtable +0x20 on every object in the self->f_54..f_58 array (8-byte stride) with the fixed frame arguments (0x3F, stack buffer, 0x100, 10). Called once from Engine_Initialize; the queued object class is not identified.

functions.name: Gfx_ReleaseRenderContext
functions.summary: Releases the frame's display channel (Pack_HandleTable_Get on the caller handle followed by Gfx_ReleaseDisplayChannel) and destroys the renderer object stored at self->f_18 through its vtable slot +4, clearing the pointer. Part of the engine teardown path.

functions.name: Fs_MountDefaultArchives
functions.summary: Lazily mounts the built-in archives once: initialises the archive device, opens the system file handle, registers the default mounts (name,size) and aborts through 0x118924 on failure.

functions.name: Fs_UnmountDefaultArchives
functions.summary: Undoes Fs_MountDefaultArchives: closes the event/device handles and clears the mounted flag.

functions.name: Mem_SetCommittedSize
functions.summary: Grows or shrinks the committed part of the linear heap through svcControlMemory, then records the new size. Growing uses memory operation 3 (commit) with permission 3, shrinking uses operation 1 (free) with permission 0; size must be 4 KiB aligned, otherwise the previous result is returned unchanged.

functions.name: Mem_CommitFreeRegion
functions.summary: Commits everything the process may still use: takes the FCRAM size (0x0010439C), subtracts the reserved block (0x001043AC), clamps the committed size to 2 MB via Mem_SetCommittedSize, and then commits or frees the remainder page-aligned so that 0x007AEA7C holds the base and the length of the committed region.

functions.name: Mem_ResizePageBlock
functions.summary: Grows or shrinks the global page-granular memory block: when the size changes it maps the delta (0x1053D0 with flags 0x10003/3) or unmaps it (flags 1/0), then stores the new base/size pair at 0x7AEA7C. Rejects unaligned sizes and cross-64K resizes with 0xE0E01BF2.

functions.name: Fs_CacheSet_UpdateEntries
functions.summary: Per-frame cache-set update: walks the entry lists, sorts them by the 0x84 priority byte, applies pending visibility transitions through the entry vtable (+0x10/+0x14), releases unloaded entries (+0xC/+0x28) and merges the done-list.

functions.name: Fs_CacheSet_BeginEvict
functions.summary: Asks every currently loaded cache entry to prepare for eviction (entry vtable slot +0x18).

functions.name: Fs_CacheSet_ReleaseEntries
functions.summary: Releases cache entries that are no longer visible: unloads them (vtable +0x14), clears the visible/pending bytes, destroys the object (+0xC) and frees it (+0x28) until the done-list is empty.

functions.name: Fs_CacheSet_EndEvict
functions.summary: Second eviction phase: calls entry vtable slot +0x1C on every loaded entry (commit/discard prepared evictions).

functions.name: Fs_CacheSet_Flush
functions.summary: Third eviction phase: calls entry vtable slot +0x20 on every loaded entry (final flush of cached blocks).

functions.name: Fs_CacheSet_Shutdown
functions.summary: Destroys all remaining cache entries: unlinks each block from the free list, detaches its buffer, releases the underlying allocation (0x10F6CC) and empties the set.

functions.name: Gfx_Display_Initialize
functions.signature: void Gfx_Display_Initialize(GfxDisplay* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Initialises the dual-screen display: allocates 2-3 framebuffer/wave buffers per screen, four 0x200x0x200 and 0x100x0x200 render targets, the GPU shared block and the frame-timing counters.

functions.name: Gfx_Display_Shutdown
functions.summary: Releases everything Gfx_Display_Initialize allocated: the shared block, the six per-screen buffers, the two 0x100000 target buffers and the two mapped regions.

functions.name: Gfx_Display_PresentFrame
functions.signature: void Gfx_Display_PresentFrame(GfxDisplay* self, u32 flags, u32 timestamp)
functions.summary: Frame presentation: waits for the vsync deadline, DMA-copies the finished framebuffer lines (0x400 stride x 0xF0 rows) to the visible buffer, then swaps the active buffer index.

functions.name: Gfx_InitDefaultTexture
functions.summary: Creates the engine's 16x16 default texture: stores the renderer handle from cfg+4, opens the graphics/OS session, allocates 16x16x1 storage through the renderer callback, registers it with Fs_MountByName and marks the slot valid.

functions.name: Gfx_ReleaseDefaultTexture
functions.summary: Releases the default texture created by 0x00104ED8: unmounts it with Fs_UnmountByName, runs the renderer object's virtual destructor on the handle at +0x10, frees the OS resource and clears the valid flag, handle and owner pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_InitDisplay
functions.summary: One-shot display bring-up called from Engine_Initialize: records the current lock depth, queries the display timing with 0x00107298 and, when a display is present and the lock was taken, registers the 0x3000-byte command buffer at 0x007E4000 (Gfx_InitializeCommandBuffers) and selects display mode 10 (Gfx_SetDisplayMode). Sets the 'initialised' flag 0x007AE724 and returns 1, or 0 when the display check fails.

functions.name: Input_Initialize
functions.summary: Initialises the input state object: verifies the three global pad/touch/timer records are constructed (asserting through 0x10009C), then binds the pad and touch sub-states.

functions.name: Gfx_ReleaseRenderer
functions.summary: Tears the renderer down: clears the 'initialised' byte, and if the session was owned it releases the session (Gfx_IsChannelReady / 0x10C534), shuts the global state down and frees the frame buffers at 0x7E7DE0.

functions.name: maybe_Engine_InitRecordPair
functions.summary: Constructor for a pair of 0xE8-byte records: stores the id in the header word, initialises the record at +4 and the one at +0xEC with 0x108C00, and returns the object base (the +0xE8/-0xEC arithmetic cancels out because 0x108C00 returns its argument).

functions.name: maybe_Os_GetDefaultLocaleString
functions.summary: Returns a pointer into the built-in string area, or 0 when an override name is supplied and resolves through 0x10540C. Its sibling 0x105280 does the same for a second string, and 0x102828 stores both into one record. Which strings they are (locale? region? font?) is not visible.

functions.name: maybe_Os_GetRegionString
functions.summary: Second built-in string getter, structurally identical to 0x105238 but reading the second literal pair and testing 0x6949D8+0x1052A4. Returns 0 when an override name resolves through 0x10540C.

functions.name: Gfx_GetRenderContext
functions.summary: Lazily creates and returns the process-wide 0x1F8-byte render/graphics context singleton (guard g_001053B4, instance g_001053B8).

functions.name: Os_WaitFlagByte
functions.summary: Spins (sleeping between polls) until the byte flag at self+0xE3C5 becomes non-zero.

functions.name: maybe_Os_ClearThreeWords
functions.summary: Zeroes the three words at the given pointer and returns that pointer unchanged. The callee 0x10B258 is `mov r1,#0; mov r2,r1; mov r3,r1; stm r0,{r1,r2,r3}; bx lr`, a three-word zero store - there is no flag and no wait anywhere in the function.

functions.name: Snd_StreamSlot_UpdateAll
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the six banks of streamed-audio slots (6 x 0x20 slots of 0x24 bytes at +0x110). For every slot whose state bits are set it validates the slot's pack handle, completes or cancels the pending async transfer, releases the pack record and adjusts the busy counters.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_StreamVoice_UpdateFragment
functions.summary: Ghidra mis-split: this entry is the tail of the ARM streamed-voice routine 0x00105584, so the C shown is the stop/fade/async-transfer part of that routine rather than an independent function.

functions.name: Snd_StreamVoice_Update
functions.summary: Drives one streamed-audio voice for a frame: consumes the 64-entry command ring at +0x1848 (start / set-buffer / stop / fade / delay), submits pack-streamed chunks into the voice's two buffers, advances the fade timer at +0x1a54 and runs the nine-state machine at +0x1a50.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ReleaseFinishedUploads
functions.summary: Reaps completed uploads: for each of the four queues it walks the live-slot bitmask, releases the finished block through 0x0010EF64/0x0010F044 under the renderer monitor, returns the slot to the free list and records the completion.

functions.name: maybe_Os_SetRuntimeFlag
functions.summary: Small one-shot hook: takes the runtime lock object at 0x007AE4A0 through 0x00111D50 and sets the byte at 0x007AE49D to 1. The flag owner is not visible, so the exact runtime state it announces is unknown.

functions.name: maybe_Os_GetInitPhase
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the global byte at 0x7AE939 is zero and 2 otherwise. 0x1146F0 reads that byte (`ldrsb r0,[r0,#1]`) and 0x114700 sets it to 1, so it is an initialisation/phase flag, not a thread property.

functions.name: maybe_Os_OwnerTable_Init
functions.summary: Initialises an owner/handle container: stores the caller vtable, chains seven 0x30-byte nodes through func_00109558, puts vtable 0x007821C8 on the last node and default-constructs five 0x10-byte records at +0x34.

functions.name: Os_SequenceTask_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a task/sequence object: initialises three intrusive list heads, installs the task vtables (0x007824E0 then 0x0075CACC), sets the state fields (+0x21=3, +0x85/+0x86=0, +0x87=1, +0x24=-1, +0x29=0xFF) and names it 'SequenceTask' (clamped to 31 characters).

functions.name: maybe_Fs_SetTransferPriority
functions.summary: Enables or disables the twelve transfer channels listed in the object's +0x20..+0x50 fields using the 5-bytes-per-mode table at 0x0072D710, and when the mode reaches 4 arms the bulk transfer (0x0010E5D8) with the pair at +0x10/+0x14 or cancels it (0x0010E64C).

functions.name: Os_CloseHandleIfOpen
functions.summary: Closes the remembered kernel handle once (svc CloseHandle) and clears the stored handle.

functions.name: Fs_OpenGlobalFile
functions.summary: Lazily opens the data file whose name and archive live at 0x7354B5 / 0x7AF904: waits for the runtime, takes the name length with 0x11CCA0 and calls the open-by-name routine 0x1192C0, returning the SDK error code.

functions.name: Fs_Initialize
functions.summary: Brings up the filesystem subsystem: waits for runtime init, opens the "fs:USER" service session, stores the archive/file handles, initialises the intrusive list and flushes one system-info query.

functions.name: maybe_Os_InitTimeoutBase
functions.summary: One-time init of the global timing record at 0x007AEA48: stores 10x the tick period returned by 0x0010BE98 as a 64-bit value at +0x18, sets the 'have time source' byte at +1 when 0x0010BE20 succeeds, and sets the 'usable' byte at +0 when either is set. Called once from the graphics init path.

functions.name: Fs_UnmountByName
functions.summary: Looks up a mounted archive by its 8-byte device name (text before ':' or 8 chars) in a 32-entry mount table and unmounts it, releasing the mount object.

functions.name: Fs_MountByName
functions.signature: u32 Fs_MountByName(const char* name, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Opens a service/archive handle for a named mount and registers it in the mount table (0x10B6D4); on any failure closes the temporary handle and reports through 0x11ED40.

functions.name: Os_ReentrantLock_Acquire
functions.summary: Reentrant lock acquisition: if the current thread id (TPIDRURO) differs from the recorded owner it runs the slow path (0x10BD34), then records the owner and increments the recursion count.

functions.name: maybe_Os_CacheBootQueryWord
functions.summary: Caches one word in the global 0x007AF8E4: if it is still zero, calls the svc 0x21 wrapper 0x0010B210 and stores the returned word. Runs first in Os_InitMemoryManager, so the word is created during memory-manager bring-up.

functions.name: maybe_Os_GetLockDepth
functions.summary: Asserts that bit 0 of the global lock object's +4 word is set (calling 0x0010009C otherwise) and returns the object's first word.

functions.name: Os_InitMemoryManager
functions.summary: Memory-manager boot entry: caches the boot parameter, opens the SDK session, measures the free FCRAM window, sets up thread-local storage, and finally hands the 48 MB (0x03000000) application heap size to 0x0010BDB0. Reached from ResetVector through 0x00113420.

functions.name: Mem_ComputeLinearHeapRange
functions.summary: Finds how much of the FCRAM linear heap the application may use: walks svcQueryMemory downwards from 0x0FFFF000 in 4 KiB steps until the block that contains 0x0E000000 is found, then records the range [0x0E000000, top) in the range descriptor at 0x007F2B88.

functions.name: Snd_OpenDspService
functions.summary: Opens the DSP service session and initialises its state block: waits for the runtime, resolves the "dsp::DSP" service name (0x0072FBC0) through srvGetServiceHandle, stores the handle, clears the service tables and registers the wait list entry.

functions.name: maybe_Os_WaitSyncObject
functions.summary: Waits on the global synchronisation object: validates the eight wait-slot words at 0x007E7978, spins on the semaphore 0x007AEA10 (sleeping 1,000,000 ticks), then dispatches the queued Gfx_IpcCmd120000 request, clears the pending byte and signals the semaphore.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_InitDspTimeouts
functions.summary: Initialises the DSP state block at 0x007AEA00: sets the two default period values (+0x1C/+0x20), writes 0xFF into the two 16-bit fields at +4/+6, issues the DSP IPC command 0xC2 and, when it succeeds, sets the ready byte at +3.

functions.name: Os_ShutdownSyncPrimitives
functions.summary: Tears down the synchronisation primitive: flushes the wait object, closes the kernel handle (svc 0x23), stores the final tick and releases the global spinlock.

functions.name: maybe_Os_ShutdownSyncObject
functions.summary: Tears the global sync object down: closes every registered handle through 0x0011C814, unlinks the node at 0x007E79D8, issues svc 0x23 (svcCloseHandle) for the pending handle and clears the state word under the exclusive-access lock at 0x007AEA10.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_InitChannelQueue
functions.summary: Initialises a channel record: stores the handle, initialises the two sub-objects (0x10C4B8 twice), sets the sentinel -1 in the queue slot, links the shared object returned by 0x1125BC (a plain getter for the global at 0x7E7DE0) and sets the state words (+0x40 = 1, +0x48/+0x4C = -1).

functions.name: Gfx_InitializeCommandBuffers
functions.signature: void Gfx_InitializeCommandBuffers(void* base, u32 size, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Registers the two 0x1000-byte GPU command buffers at base and base+0x2000, maps the shared memory block and stores the display timing block.

functions.name: Gfx_ShutdownGlobalState
functions.summary: Tears the GPU state down once: if the running flag is set it takes the state lock, calls the named Gfx_ShutdownChannel, releases the lock, marks the state dead (-1), closes the two kernel handles and clears the flag.

functions.name: Os_SendIpcRequest1
functions.summary: Sends one request to the game's main IPC service: fills the thread command block with the fixed header from 0x1127A4 (0x00060040 = command 6, one normal parameter) and the parameter 6, issues `svc 0x32` (svcSendSyncRequest) and returns the result word, initialising the runtime first when needed.

functions.name: Os_CheckHandleClosed
functions.summary: Closes a handle if the 'pending close' flag is set and reports the stored status: returns the handle value on failure, 0 after a successful close.

functions.name: Os_CreateEvent
functions.summary: Creates a named kernel event once: waits for the runtime to be ready and registers the event with 0x1192C0; sets the created flag on success.

functions.name: Os_IpcSendSyncRequestCmd21
functions.summary: Issues an IPC round trip with command header 0x00210000 (command 0x21, no parameters): writes the header into the thread's TLS block at +0x80, takes the session handle from the global 0x007AEAB0, executes svc 0x32 (SendSyncRequest) and returns the reply word at TLS+0x84 on success.

functions.name: Snd_Initialize
functions.summary: One-shot bring-up of the sound subsystem: waits for the runtime, creates the stream context (maybe_Snd_InitStreamContext), then initialises the channel buffers, the voice/system state (Snd_InitSystemState) and registers the DSP command blocks, finally setting the ready flag.

functions.name: Snd_Shutdown
functions.summary: Flag-guarded shutdown of the sound runtime: releases the DSP block, flushes pending commands, stops the voice group, releases the channel objects and tears down the stream context.

functions.name: Snd_OpenService
functions.summary: Opens the sound service session (result stored in the 0x007F2358 service block at +0xC) and starts the worker thread with Os_CreateThreadWithStack (entry 0x0010BDF4, 0x228-byte stack); a negative handle is reported through 0x00118100.

functions.name: Os_ListAppendNode
functions.signature: int Os_ListAppendNode(OsListNode* node, unsigned int key)
functions.summary: Appends `node` to the intrusive circular list rooted in the global at 0x1077FC, holding the list lock (0x117E50/0x117ED0), and stamps the caller key into node+0xc.

functions.name: Os_IpcCommand2
functions.summary: Submits the fixed request 0x00010002 (command 2, one normal parameter with value 0x20) to the session handle at 0x007AF900 and returns the first response word. Non-negative results are the service's answer; a negative value is the IPC result code.

functions.name: maybe_Os_SetThreadPriorityMode
functions.summary: Maps a small mode word onto the scheduler/GPU helpers: 0 -> helper(3) plus Gfx_LockedIpcCmd3E0080(0), 1 -> helper(2) plus Gfx_LockedIpcCmd3E0080(1), 2 -> helper(1) only; other values are ignored.

functions.name: Gfx_UpdateDisplayState
functions.summary: One frame step of the GPU display-command state machine: if the pending byte at 0x7AE954 is set it stops the current sequence, advances the state, notifies the registered callback (+0x38), then either waits for readiness or sends the request and restores the flag.

functions.name: Gfx_UpdateDisplayStateB
functions.summary: Variant of the display-command frame step used when a new command block must be acquired: selects a free/busy block with Svc_QuerySessionInfoLocked, re-sends through Svc_RequestWithRetry or waits and sends through Svc_WaitReadyAndSendRequest, then restores the pending flag.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_IsDisplayStateReady
functions.summary: Returns true when the display state machine reports state 1 from 0x0010CC10; Engine_DispatchFrameCallbacks tests it as the first gate before running the frame step.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_IsDisplayStateActive
functions.summary: Returns true when either display state source (0x0010CC20 or 0x00113A00) is non-zero; Engine_DispatchFrameCallbacks tests it immediately after 0x00107AD4 as the second frame gate.

functions.name: maybe_Mem_QueryMemoryMode
functions.summary: Lock-protected service query (request 0x0301/0x11) whose reply is normalised to 1 or 2 and stored as the allocator's memory-mode word.

functions.name: Mem_MapSharedBlock
functions.signature: int Mem_MapSharedBlock(u32 type, u32 size, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Reserves and maps one shared-memory block: lazily opens the service session at 0x007AE910/0x007AE920, requests a block of `size` bytes with request 0x00010040, keeps the returned handle, records the two capability bits from the reply, closes that session, selects the block type and then maps it with request 0x00020080 before handing the mode and both returned words to maybe_Os_OpenServiceHandle.

functions.name: Gfx_WaitSyncSubmit
functions.signature: int Gfx_WaitSyncSubmit(u32 arg1, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Waits for the graphics/display state machine to leave its transient states and submits a command, retrying on the busy result codes with a 10-tick sleep; returns the submit result.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_WaitSyncSubmitNoLock
functions.signature: int maybe_Gfx_WaitSyncSubmitNoLock(u32 request, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Lock-free inner half of Gfx_WaitSyncSubmit: first waits for the display/IPC state to leave the transient values (it sets state 9 and spins), then sends the request through Svc_SendRequest2, retrying on the 0xC8A0CC02 / 0xE0A0CC08 / 0xC8A0CFF0 busy results with a 10,000,000-tick sleep between attempts; returns the final result.

functions.name: Os_IpcSendByteLocked
functions.summary: Sends one byte/integer through the IPC helper maybe_Os_IpcSendByte while holding the scheduler lock, and returns its result.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_HandleVBlank
functions.summary: Display/vblank event handler: takes the display lock, sends the request word, and when the frame-done bit 0x20 is clear re-arms the display state and submits a 0x1000-byte command block through maybe_Gfx_ServiceDisplayTransfer.

functions.name: Fs_Task_Create
functions.summary: Creates and registers an asynchronous file task: allocates the 0xB0-byte task object, copies its name, hashes it, inserts it into the pool's balanced tree and starts it.

functions.name: Container_HashTableInsert
functions.signature: void* Container_HashTableInsert(Container* table, const void* key, u32 value)
functions.summary: Inserts a key (and optional value) into the engine hash table, growing/rehashing the bucket array when the load factor is exceeded and returning the stored bucket.

functions.name: Gfx_ReleaseSubObjects
functions.summary: Releases the seven per-screen sub-objects (color/depth buffers at 0xC/0x3C/0x6C/0x9C/0xCC/0xFC/0x12C) of the display object.

functions.name: Gfx_WaitFrameInterval
functions.summary: Enforces the frame-rate limit: computes the elapsed ticks since the last frame and busy-waits the remaining interval, then records the new timestamp and marks the frame started.

functions.name: Fs_Cache_SetHandleArray
functions.signature: FsHandleArray* Fs_Cache_SetHandleArray(FsHandleArray* self, u32* handles, u32 count, void* allocator)
functions.summary: Wraps a fixed list of block handles (count u32 values) in a small owning object that copies them into a newly allocated array.

functions.name: Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool58
functions.signature: FsSlotPool* Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool58(FsSlotPool* self, int bufferSize, int slotCount, void* bufferAlloc, void* slotAlloc)
functions.summary: Creates a two-level cache pool: slotCount 0x58-byte slot records from one allocator plus a bufferSize*slotCount data area from another, and records the slot count in the first record.

functions.name: Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool58Into
functions.signature: FsSlotPool* Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool58Into(FsSlotPool* self, u32 bufferSize, int slotCount, u32 buffer, u32 totalSize, void* slotAlloc)
functions.summary: Same 0x58-byte slot pool as 0x108624 but into an externally supplied data buffer (no second allocation).

functions.name: Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool54
functions.signature: FsSlotPool* Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool54(FsSlotPool* self, u32 bufferSize, int slotCount, void* bufferAlloc, void* slotAlloc)
functions.summary: Creates the 0x54-byte-record variant of the cache pool (buffer plus slot array, both allocated).

functions.name: Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool54Into
functions.signature: FsSlotPool* Fs_Cache_CreateSlotPool54Into(FsSlotPool* self, u32 bufferSize, int slotCount, u32 buffer, u32 totalSize, void* slotAlloc)
functions.summary: 0x54-byte-record cache pool over an externally supplied data buffer.

functions.name: Input_UpdateButtonMasks
functions.summary: Converts a raw HID button snapshot into three engine bitmasks (held, newly pressed, newly released) using the 19-entry mapping table, and forwards them to the input event handler.

functions.name: Input_UpdatePadState
functions.signature: void Input_UpdatePadState(InputState* self, InputPad* pad, PadSnapshot* snap)
functions.summary: Reads the analog stick / circle-pad state, converts the raw axis values to the engine's 16-bit range and merges the digital button edges into the input state.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_InitE8Record
functions.summary: Initialises one 0xE8-byte record: clears the ten leading words, then memsets the two 0x60-byte buffers at +0x28 and +0x88. Returns the record. Called twice back to back by the engine-startup record-pair constructor.

functions.name: maybe_Sys_InitCommandRings
functions.signature: void maybe_Sys_InitCommandRings(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, int padMask)
functions.summary: Initialises a render-session object: fills two 256-entry command rings with their entry pointers, starts each ring's mixing state and gfx command ring (one per 3DS screen), stores the screen parameters and then builds the 16-button pad mapping from the pad table at +0x35C.

functions.name: maybe_Input_UpdatePadStateThumb
functions.signature: void maybe_Input_UpdatePadStateThumb(int mode, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8)
functions.summary: Thumb-mode copy of the pad-mask mapping block that also appears at the end of maybe_Sys_InitCommandRings: maps the raw button masks through the 16-word table into three output words and posts them through func_0010E8D0.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_ShutdownEngine
functions.signature: void maybe_Snd_ShutdownEngine(void* engine, u32 arg2, u32* mask, int count)
functions.summary: Stops the sound engine: marks f_358/f_348, waits on and closes the session handle at f_344, releases the command buffer at f_340, then walks a caller-supplied bitmask and releases each set 0x1C-byte voice record at f_24 + i*0x1C.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_UpdateVoiceList
functions.summary: Per-frame retirement step: advances the three-slot ring at self+0x2C3C, unlinks finished records (state 4) from +0x2C40, pushes them to the free list and frees the block, then drains the two command rings at +0x790/+0x2000 and requeues or releases their records.

functions.name: Gfx_ReleaseDisplayChannel
functions.summary: Closes a display/GPU channel: waits for the pending close (svc 0x24), marks both liveness bytes, signals the event flag, clears the channel handle with svc 0x23 and releases the embedded command buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_MapResourceFormat
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_MapResourceFormat(u32 kind, u32 arg2, u32 format, u32 size)
functions.summary: Maps a resource format id (0x100..0x105) to its GPU alignment/flag value and allocates the resource through the matching channel object.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_DispatchVramRegionRequest
functions.summary: Picks the VRAM region that contains the requested address (region 0x20000 = 0x1F000000..0x1F2FFFFF, region 0x30000 = 0x1F300000..0x1F5FFFFF) and forwards the request to that region's allocator: 0x10E66C for the two direct regions and the virtual slot +4 of the object at 0x7AE61C+0x14 for the middle one. It returns nothing, so the old 'GetMemoryRegion' name was wrong.

functions.name: Gfx_SetDisplayEnable
functions.summary: Enables or disables the display: when the request differs from the current channel state it either switches the display to mode 10 (disable) or commits the pending mode (enable).

functions.name: maybe_Snd_StreamManager_ServiceSlots
functions.signature: void maybe_Snd_StreamManager_ServiceSlots(void* self, u32 arg2, int count)
functions.summary: Services the stream manager's pending slot batch under the shared mutex: walks the bitmask at self+0x2C, and for every set bit with a live 0x1C-byte entry at self+0x24 completes its stream/object, releases the channel and bumps the completed counter at +0x70.

functions.name: SaveData_ResetSaveWork
functions.summary: Resets the save data working buffer at GameWork+0x24A98: clears item ownership bitmask (+0x4B30, 0x168 bytes), field trigger bitmask (+0x5418, 0x64 bytes), and visited past place flags.

functions.name: Mem_AllocAligned_2
functions.signature: void* Mem_AllocAligned_2(u32 size, void* heap, u32 align)
functions.summary: Aligned heap allocation: rounds the request, allocates size + align + 8 bytes so an 8-byte header can hold the original pointer, and returns the aligned payload. It is the single allocator used by nearly every constructor in this batch.

functions.name: Gfx_SwapFrameBuffers
functions.signature: void Gfx_SwapFrameBuffers(GfxDisplay* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Swaps the display's double-buffer index and resets the just-retired 0x4C-byte buffer record so the next frame starts with an empty queue.

functions.name: Gfx_ReleaseBufferRecord
functions.summary: Releases a 0x4C-byte buffer record: frees its f_18 block array (f_20 * 0x1C bytes) and clears all counters.

functions.name: Gfx_InitBufferRecord
functions.signature: void Gfx_InitBufferRecord(GfxBufferRecord* self, u32 size, u32 buffer, int count, u32 blockPtr)
functions.summary: Initialises a 0x4C-byte buffer record: sets the 0x300-byte header size, stores the buffer/size, resets the queues and allocates the count*0x1C block array.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GetVramRegionSize
functions.summary: Returns the size of a VRAM region: 0x180000 for region 0x20000 and 0x280000 for region 0x30000 when the extended-memory query 0x11981C succeeds, otherwise 0x300000; 0 for any other region.

functions.name: Gfx_InitializeContext
functions.summary: Brings up the whole GPU context: stores the 400x240 / 320x240 screen geometry, calls the driver to allocate the 0x10000-byte command buffer, sets up the shared-memory blocks and registers every GPU state (blend, depth, cull, texture units).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetFrameReadyFlag
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetFrameReadyFlag(GfxDisplay* self, FrameRecord* rec, u8 value)
functions.summary: Stores the value in the frame record's +0x11 byte and, while the display state is 0x300, takes the GPU lock (0x001197FC), executes the command list and releases it (0x0011980C).

functions.name: maybe_Applet_AckSuspendState
functions.summary: Acknowledges the applet suspend/transition state: when the active slot block 0x007E7780->f_A0 exists it takes the 0x007EF0B0 lock, clears f_12 when f_11 is clear, or marks the current 0x1C-byte slot entry ready and sets f_18, then unlocks.

functions.name: Gfx_CopyFramebuffer
functions.signature: void Gfx_CopyFramebuffer(u32 dstType, u32 src, u32 dst, int rows, int format)
functions.summary: Copies a framebuffer rectangle between the CPU and the LCD controllers: handles the four pixel formats (0x8051/0x8056/0x8057/0x8D62), the 0x400 line stride and the alternating 0x14C buffer parity.

functions.name: Applet_WaitIfSuspended
functions.summary: Blocks while the applet suspend flag (0x007E7780+0x11) stays set: waits on the runtime event 0x00113700, and if a 64-bit timeout is configured at +0x178/+0x17C it compares svcGetSystemTick against the deadline and tail-calls the timeout callback at +0x170.

functions.name: Engine_GetMemoryManager
functions.summary: Lazily constructs the 0x37C-byte process-wide memory and resource-list manager singleton at BSS 0x007F4F1C (*0x007BE2F0), writes its pointer to *outPtr, and returns outPtr.

functions.name: Pack_HandleTable_Get
functions.summary: Lazily creates and returns the global pack-handle table: allocates a zeroed singleton, constructs its twenty 0x28-byte handle entries at +0x18 and caches the pointer.

functions.name: Snd_ReleaseChannelSlot
functions.summary: Releases one of the owner's four channel slots: derives the slot index from the pointer, and when the corresponding bit of the 4-bit mask is set it stops the channel (Snd_FadeChannelToGain(channel, 0)) and clears the bit.

functions.name: Anim_Sequence_CtorBase
functions.summary: Base constructor of the engine's keyed animation/timeline object: installs the vtable, clears the state, initialises the inline 4-element key array and sets the default state id.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ConvertTextureBlock
functions.signature: int maybe_Gfx_ConvertTextureBlock(int width, int height, int decodeNow, unsigned int size)
functions.summary: Builds a texture decoder object, feeds it a 0x28-byte block header, optionally converts one block and returns width*0x20 + height*0x18 + blockIndex, i.e. a tile-format byte size.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SubmitValueCommand
functions.summary: Stores the value at +0x10 of the record and submits {value} with command header 0x0B0501C8 through Gfx_IpcCmd861.

functions.name: Fs_RegisterMountByName
functions.signature: u32 Fs_RegisterMountByName(const char* name, u32 object, u8 arg3, u8 arg4)
functions.summary: Registers an open archive in the 32-entry mount table under its 8-byte device name; returns the 'already mounted' / 'table full' sentinel on failure.

functions.name: Gfx_CreateChannel
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_CreateChannel(GfxChannel** out, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7)
functions.summary: Creates a GPU channel object: gets a command-buffer slot, allocates the 0x130-byte channel, opens the command buffer and submits the initialisation request.

functions.name: Os_SendIpcParam
functions.signature: int Os_SendIpcParam(unsigned int* request, unsigned int request2)
functions.summary: Thin `svcSendSyncRequest` wrapper for the main IPC service: stamps the fixed header from 0x10B9BC (0x08620040 = command 0x0862, one normal and one translate parameter) plus the caller's parameter into the thread command block, issues `svc 0x32` and returns the result word.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetFrameTimeBudget
functions.summary: Stores the requested frame interval (in ticks) into the global frame-timing record at 0x007F2644, recomputes the derived 1000/tick value on top of the existing base, and optionally copies the five timing words to the caller.

functions.name: Gfx_ShutdownChannel
functions.summary: Shuts the GPU/display channel down: releases the command slots, closes the kernel handle (svc 0x23), signals and resets the frame event, releases the GPU interrupt and the session, and clears the "channel open" flag. Returns 0 when it actually shut down.

functions.name: Gfx_OpenGpuChannel
functions.summary: Opens the GPU service session and its three command buffers: creates the event, allocates the 0x1000-byte blocks, initialises the four channel queues and sends the open request.

functions.name: Os_AcquireSharedSession
functions.summary: Acquires the process-wide shared service session once; on failure reports through 0x11ED40.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_InitFrameBuffers
functions.signature: int maybe_Gfx_InitFrameBuffers(void* set, unsigned int size)
functions.summary: One-shot display-buffer setup guarded by the flag at 0x007AEA70: allocates `size` bytes, copies the 0x2b0-byte command block into the set and derives the five sub-buffer pointers at 0, 0xa8, 0x108, 0x158 and 0x238.

functions.name: Gfx_FreeFrameBuffers
functions.summary: Closes the five display handles stored at indices 0,2,4,7,9, destroys the mutex at +0x2b, closes the last IPC handle and clears the one-shot init flag at 0x7AEA70.

functions.name: Input_ReadTouchState
functions.summary: Samples the touch panel: issues the touch IPC query, computes the pressed/released edges against the previous sample and scales the calibration values.

functions.name: Input_ReadPadState
functions.summary: Samples the buttons/circle pad: reads the raw state, stores it in the snapshot and derives the held, newly-pressed and newly-released masks.

functions.name: Input_SetPadMode
functions.summary: Stores the raw pad mode in +0x38 and the normalised mode (0,1,2; anything else 0) in +0x70.

functions.name: Gfx_IsChannelReady
functions.summary: Returns true when the GPU/display channel state machine is in state 4 (ready for a frame).

functions.name: Gfx_ShutdownChannelLocked
functions.summary: Locked wrapper around the GPU channel teardown: takes the monitor at 0x007EF0E8, calls the named Gfx_ShutdownChannel, releases the monitor and returns 0.

functions.name: Gfx_SetDisplayMode
functions.summary: Switches the display/GPU channel to another mode (8..0x20): validates the mode, shuts the previous channel down, re-opens it with the new timing and publishes the result code.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_WriteChannelEntry
functions.signature: void maybe_Snd_WriteChannelEntry(char* obj, unsigned int value, unsigned int extra)
functions.summary: Writes a halfword at +2 and (when the object's first byte is non-zero) a word at +4, then, if the driver's slot byte at 0x7F2C3C is set, mirrors the word there and calls the channel field setter 0x118D00 with the fixed context 0x7EF414. Dead code: nothing branches to it.

functions.name: Gfx_InitChannelRecord
functions.signature: void Gfx_InitChannelRecord(GfxChannelRecord* rec, u32 id, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Initialises a channel record: stores the id at +0 and the owner at +4, initialises the sub-object at +0xC (0x10C4B8) and sets its state word to 1 with the two queue slots at -1.

functions.name: Svc_Ndm_AcquireService
functions.summary: Reference-counted acquire of the 'ndm:u' session: on first use it waits for the runtime, resolves the service name at 0x007418E4 ('ndm:u') and opens the handle into 0x007B00E8, then increments the user count.

functions.name: Snd_InitSystemState
functions.summary: Initialises the global sound-system state block once: sets the 'open' flag, stores the default gains (1.0f at +4/+8/+0xC/+0x10 and +0x28/+0x2C), zeroes the per-voice and per-channel tables, allocates the mixing critical sections, then queries the output mode from the audio service and keeps it as 0 = mono, 1 = stereo, 2 = surround in self[3].

functions.name: maybe_Snd_StopVoiceGroup
functions.summary: Stops and resets one voice group: releases the stream context 0x7F2C3C through 0x112E18, invalidates the four channel ids at +0x4C..+0x4F and clears the active byte.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_ProcessPendingStreams
functions.summary: Handles pending stream stops: when the queue object at 0x007AEA98 has bits set that are not yet acknowledged it signals the completion event at +8, marks the busy flags and drives the stream context through 0x001132DC.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_BeginFrame
functions.summary: Frame prologue for one of the IPC-backed stream contexts: when the queue flags allow it, sets the completion event, publishes the current buffer pointer from 0x7EF3C4 + 0xC0, clears the two dirty flags, executes a data-synchronisation barrier and takes the mutex at +8.

functions.name: Svc_SendRequestIpc
functions.summary: Generic IPC request stub: primes the thread's kernel command buffer with the 0x20000-header descriptor and performs svc 0x32 (SendSyncRequest), returning the reply word.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_InvokeCallbacks
functions.summary: Invokes the two registered per-frame callbacks of the object at 0x7AE954 (slots +0x40/+0x44 with their context words +0x80/+0x84), after a conditional call to 0x1139A0. The object's owner is still unnamed, so the Gfx prefix is a guess.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ResetStateBlock
functions.summary: Clears the 28 state/counter words of the global block at 0x7AE954 (fields +0xC, +0x10...+0x3C and their +0x4C...+0x88 partners) after re-initialising its owner with 0x114398. It is the reset half of the same object whose callbacks 0x10CB30 invokes.

functions.name: Os_ListRemoveNodeIfPresent
functions.summary: Removes a node from a global doubly-linked list under the global monitor, tolerating nodes that are not in the list.

functions.name: Os_InsertListNodeByKey
functions.summary: Inserts a node into the global ordered list at 0x007AE954 (head +4, tail +8) sorted by the 32-bit key at node+0x10, under the monitor at 0x007E793C, patching both link directions.

functions.name: Os_CloseIpcSession
functions.summary: Closes the SDK session whose handle lives at 0x007AF0D8 with svcCloseHandle (svc 0x23) and resets the slot to its 'closed' marker. Returns the handle that was open, or the fixed 'not open' result 0xE0A0CFF8 when there was nothing to close; a negative close result is reported through 0x00118924.

functions.name: Svc_WaitReadyAndSendRequest
functions.signature: int Svc_WaitReadyAndSendRequest(u32 cmd, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Waits for the service/session to become ready and then sends the caller's request: queries the session info, polls the status command 0x90040 with 10 ms sleeps, runs the setup/close hooks once ready and finally issues the request through Svc_SendRequest3.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ServiceDisplayTransfer
functions.signature: int maybe_Gfx_ServiceDisplayTransfer(u32* outA, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int* outB, u32* outC, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8)
functions.summary: Display-transfer state machine: repeatedly submits Gfx_TransferGpuBuffer, waits out the transient GSP status codes (1, 0xA-0x12, 0x40/0x41), maps the final code to an engine display state and drives the enable/disable transitions through Gfx_IpcCmd50100.

functions.name: Svc_QuerySessionInfoLocked
functions.signature: void Svc_QuerySessionInfoLocked(u32 kind, u8* outByte, u32* out0, u32* out1, u32* out2)
functions.summary: Queries the session/service info for `kind` under the scheduler lock, asserts on failure and copies the byte plus three words into the caller's optional outputs.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcLockedQuery
functions.summary: Takes the display driver lock, issues the GPU IPC command 0x1010000 with one argument and releases the lock, returning the reply word.

functions.name: Svc_RequestWithRetry
functions.signature: int Svc_RequestWithRetry(u32 req, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Sends a four-argument service request under the lock and retries while the service answers with one of the three 'try again' codes (0xC8A0CC02 / 0xE0A0CC08 / 0xC8A0CFF0), sleeping 10 time units between attempts and asserting on a hard error.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_StartGpuWorkerThread
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_StartGpuWorkerThread(u32 namePtr, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Starts the shared GPU/service worker: creates three kernel objects in globals 0x7EDFA4.., substitutes the two handles supplied by the caller, initialises the 0x7AF0B4 event and starts thread 0x00113F2C with a small argument block.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_WaitForDisplayStateE
functions.summary: Selects display state 0x0E through 0x001139F0 and then polls Gfx_IpcCmd2B0000 with 10 ms sleeps until the GPU IPC answer is no longer one of the three transient codes 0xC8A0CFF0 / 0xE0A0CC08 / 0xC8A0CC02.

functions.name: Gfx_WaitForDisplayState5
functions.summary: Waits for a display-state request to complete: waits for the GPU IPC channel to be idle, requests display state 5, then polls Gfx_IpcCmd190040(state), unlocking the scheduler and sleeping between polls until the result leaves the transient codes; maps 'already in requested state' (0xC8A0CFFC) to 0.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcLockedSend2
functions.summary: Sends a two-word request on the GPU IPC channel with the scheduler lock held and returns the reply.

functions.name: Gfx_WaitForIpcIdle
functions.summary: Waits for the GPU IPC command queue to go idle: after the optional 0x400/0x200 capability queries it calls the 3-state helper and polls Gfx_IpcCmd3B0040(argument) with 10 ms sleeps until the answer leaves the three busy/error codes (0xC8A0CFF0, 0xE0A0CC08, 0xC8A0CC02), then negotiates the display mode.

functions.name: Os_IpcSend2Get2
functions.signature: int Os_IpcSend2Get2(u32 value0, u32 value1, u32* out1, u32* out2)
functions.summary: Sends the fixed IPC request 0x00020080 (command 0x80, two normal parameters) to the session at 0x007AF0D8 and copies two response words out of the thread command buffer. Used while mapping a shared block (see 0x00107B54), where the two words are the mapped base address and size.

functions.name: Os_IpcSendGetHandle
functions.signature: int Os_IpcSendGetHandle(u32* outHandle, u32 value0, u32* out2, u32* out3)
functions.summary: Same svcSendSyncRequest shape with request 0x00010040 (command 0x40, one normal parameter). Besides two plain words it copies the handle the kernel placed at command-buffer +0x94 into *outHandle, i.e. this is the 'allocate and hand me the kernel object' request of the SDK memory path.

functions.name: Svc_SendRequest2
functions.signature: u32 Svc_SendRequest2(u32 word, int arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Sends a two-word request through svc 0x32 and returns the reply word.

functions.name: Svc_SendRequestArg
functions.signature: int Svc_SendRequestArg(u32 service, u32 cmd, u16* out)
functions.summary: Sends a request with a service id and command index, returning the 16-bit reply through out.

functions.name: Svc_SendRequestByte
functions.summary: Sends a one-byte request through svc 0x32 and returns the reply word.

functions.name: Os_IpcSendCommandWord
functions.summary: Sends one 32-bit parameter to a service: writes the fixed request header 0x00550040 and the value into the thread-local IPC buffer (TLS+0x80/+0x84), issues svc 0x32 (SendSyncRequest) on the handle at 0x007AF0D8 and returns the response word (or the raw Result when it is negative).

functions.name: Svc_SendRequestWord
functions.summary: Sends a one-word request through svc 0x32 and returns the reply word.

functions.name: Os_EnsureIpcSessionOpen
functions.summary: Makes sure the SDK session described by 0x007AF0BC is open: if the open flag is set it retries svcSendSyncRequest until it succeeds (resetting the handle on failure and re-opening it once), otherwise it opens the session by name with 0x001192C0(handle, name, strlen(name), 0). Errors are fatal and reported through 0x00118924.

functions.name: Fs_SubmitAsyncTransfer
functions.signature: int Fs_SubmitAsyncTransfer(void* self, void** handle, u32 transfer, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Submits one asynchronous transfer through the object's vtable slot +8 and, when that fails while a handle was produced, releases the half-built handle (0x00114CF0); returns the transfer status.

functions.name: Container_ForEachPair
functions.summary: Iterates a key/value container and dispatches every entry to the owner object's vtable slot +0xc; returns 0 as soon as an entry cannot be read and 1 after the whole map was walked.

functions.name: Snd_QueueWaveCommand
functions.signature: void Snd_QueueWaveCommand(u32 arg1, u32 waveAddress, u32 waveLength)
functions.summary: Queues a 'set wave data' command on the sound engine: allocates a six-word command node, tags it 0x31, stores the caller's buffer address and length, links it into the submit chain and flushes the queue.

functions.name: Snd_ReleaseAllChannels
functions.summary: Destroys every channel object of the engine (0x18 records of 0x5c bytes), rebuilds the three 128-entry parameter tables and drains the pending command queue before the engine stops.

functions.name: Snd_SetVoiceLoop
functions.signature: void Snd_SetVoiceLoop(SndVoice * voice, int restart, u32 rate, float startPos)
functions.summary: Programs a voice's sample-loop window: converts the caller's rate and start position into a loop length (at least one sample), stores start/length/end, and switches the voice into the "loop prepared" state; with restart == 0 the existing loop is torn down first.

functions.name: Container_NameMap_Find
functions.signature: void* Container_NameMap_Find(Container* map, const char* name)
functions.summary: Looks up a string key in the engine's name map and returns the stored pointer, or NULL when absent or equal to the map's sentinel.

functions.name: Mem_Heap_FindFreeBlock
functions.signature: int Mem_Heap_FindFreeBlock(MemHeap* heap, int size, int align, u32 flags)
functions.summary: First-fit allocator over the heap's free list: aligns the request, finds the smallest suitable block, splits it when there is room and moves the remainder onto the free list.

functions.name: Container_List_ApplyA
functions.summary: Invokes a visitor (0x115108) on every node of the intrusive list rooted at self+0x80.

functions.name: Container_List_ApplyB
functions.summary: Second visitor variant over the same intrusive list, using the detach-and-notify helper 0x1150FC.

functions.name: Gfx_CommandBuffer_Release
functions.summary: Releases an async command/transfer buffer: closes its kernel handle if it is still open and frees the 8-aligned block.

functions.name: Gfx_CommandBuffer_Submit
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_CommandBuffer_Submit(GfxCommandBuffer* self, u32 heap, u32 size, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Submits an asynchronous command/transfer: allocates an 8-aligned size-byte buffer, builds the request descriptor and sends it on the object's handle, keeping the buffer for the completion callback.

functions.name: std_RbTree_EraseNode
functions.summary: Erases one node from an intrusive red-black tree: transplants the node's parent/left/right links (handling the two-child case), calls the rebalancing helper with the node colour, then restores the tree header's leftmost/rightmost/root links.

functions.name: std__Rb_tree_insert_and_rebalance
functions.signature: void std__Rb_tree_insert_and_rebalance(RbTreeNode* header, int insert_left, RbTreeNode* x, RbTreeNode* p)
functions.summary: libstdc++ red-black tree insertion: links the new node x below p, sets its colour/flag byte, calls the rebalance helper, then repairs the header's leftmost/rightmost child pointers. This is the insertion primitive behind every std::map/std::set in the game.

functions.name: Os_QueueHasNewData
functions.summary: Returns whether a producer/consumer queue has unread data: enters the kernel critical section and compares the two 16-bit indices f_6c/f_6e, with the usual fault path on a failed enter.

functions.name: Container_RemoveSmallSetEntry
functions.signature: void Container_RemoveSmallSetEntry(u32 owner, int element, Container* set)
functions.summary: Removes one of at most four tracked elements: derives the index from the element address relative to the container's +0xA8 array (magic divide by 0x11), requires index < 4, tests the matching bit of the 4-bit occupancy mask at +0x2CC, hands the slot back to the pool with Mem_PoolDestroy, clears the bit and decrements the live count at +0x2D0.

functions.name: Os_QueueHasNewDataAlt
functions.summary: Variant of Os_QueueHasNewData that reads both indices inside the critical section and compares f_6a with f_6e. The same three callers use both functions to test two different queues.

functions.name: maybe_Container_ResetObject
functions.summary: Placeholder: Ghidra marks this address `missing_function` and no readable body exists, so nothing about the function is known beyond the first pass's guess. The name is kept only so the address stays covered.

functions.name: Save_InitPartySnapshot
functions.summary: Clears and defaults the 0xc8b0-byte party snapshot used by save/load: 31 actor state blocks of 0x200 at +0x1830, 54 20-byte records at +0x5630, inventory arrays and checksum fields at +0xe0d8..+0xe0f0.

functions.name: SaveData_ResetAllSaveData
functions.summary: Full save data reset: calls Save_BuildSectionList, resets save header, wipes party member containers, and calls SaveData_ResetSaveWork.

functions.name: Ui_DestroyRootSingleton
functions.summary: Shutdown hook: fetches the lazily created UI root singleton and, when it exists, calls the destructor stored just before it ((vtable+4), with the pair at -8/-4).

functions.name: Mem_AllocAligned
functions.signature: void* Mem_AllocAligned(u32 size, MemHeap* heap, u32 alignment)
functions.summary: Allocates size bytes with the given alignment from an engine heap: asks heap->vtable->alloc for (size+alignment+10) rounded down to 4 bytes, aligns the result with an unsigned division by alignment, and stores the heap pointer plus the untouched raw pointer in the two words before the returned block so it can be freed.

functions.name: Container_InitList
functions.summary: Creates the sentinel node of an intrusive doubly-linked list (0x28-byte node from 0x115F74), points the node's prev/next at itself, zeroes the list count and stores the list in the global at 0x007AED40. Returns 0 on success and -1 when the node allocation fails.

functions.name: Gfx_InitRegisterTables
functions.signature: void Gfx_InitRegisterTables(GfxState* state, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Builds the GPU's static register tables inside the state block: copies the global register table, expands the 0xbd-terminated id lists into bitsets and fills the per-format value/valid arrays with 0x3c00 / 0x3f000 / 0x800 / 1 / 0.

functions.name: Gfx_InitPipelineState
functions.summary: Initialises the fixed-function GPU state block at renderer_base+0x30EC: 16 four-word attribute records (float bit patterns 0x1503/0x1406/0x8006 converted to PICA200's 24-bit float format), 16 vertex-attribute strides, default depth/blend registers (0x1E00, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFF, 0xFFFFFF) and a 0x40-byte zeroed table at +0x828.

functions.name: Gfx_InitCommandLists
functions.summary: Initialises the two renderer command-list objects (0x78-byte and 0x1CC-byte variants created by 0x116430/0x116368) and rebinds them into the global at 0x007AF07A-style context slot; old objects are torn down through 0x115DCC/0x1164C8 before being replaced.

functions.name: Gfx_InitRenderQueue
functions.summary: Stores the queue object in a global and creates its backing store with 0x1165B0 (a 0x348-byte array of 16 slots x 0x18 bytes plus 16 texture references). Returns 0 on success and -1 after calling the deallocation callback when the store cannot be created.

functions.name: Gfx_InitSubsystems
functions.summary: Stores the subsystem set in a global and runs the four subordinate initialisers attached at +4, +8 and +0xC (0x115F4C, 0x115E5C, 0x11C5E8, 0x115E70). Always returns 0.

functions.name: Gfx_RegisterResource
functions.signature: void Gfx_RegisterResource(u32 key, GfxResource* res, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Inserts a 0x44-byte resource record into a 32-bucket hash table (buckets at 0x007E7780, next pointer at +0x40), keeping each bucket sorted by key, and updates the current-range globals at 0x007E8320/0x007E8324 from the record's base/size fields.

functions.name: Gfx_UnregisterResources
functions.summary: Removes the given keys from the 32-bucket resource table, dropping the cached 'current resource' pointers, calling the resource destructor callback and the block-free callback for each match, and lowering the cached minimum address.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GetVramRegionEnd
functions.summary: Returns the inclusive end address of a VRAM region: 0x1F2FFFFF for region 0x20000 and 0x1F5FFFFF for region 0x30000, and 0 for any other value. The real entry is 0x11099C - the seed at 0x1109A0 starts mid-function, which is why the readable C shows a flag input it never sets.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GetVramRegionBase
functions.summary: Returns the base address of a VRAM region: 0x1F000000 or 0x1F180000 for region 0x20000, 0x1F300000 or 0x1F380000 for region 0x30000, 0 otherwise; the extra 0x180000 appears when the extended-memory query 0x11981C succeeds (the same 0x180000 that the region-size getter adds). The real entry is 0x1109D8 - 0x1109DC is a mid-seed.

functions.name: Gfx_PushPipelineCommand
functions.summary: Appends one 0x1C-byte command to the renderer's pending command array (record type 1), fills in the destination address/size from the current cursor, submits it through 0x116104 and advances the queue counters; if this was the last pending command it starts a new frame via 0x116104.

functions.name: Gfx_WaitForVBlank
functions.summary: Blocks until the GSP frame counter changes for the requested screen: 0x400 (top) and 0x402 (both/top+bottom) poll the per-screen counters at context+0x154/0x158 and release the CPU with 0x113700; other values wait for 0x119388.

functions.name: Gfx_QueueFrameCommand
functions.signature: void Gfx_QueueFrameCommand(u32 opcode, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7)
functions.summary: Thunk that forwards seven words to Gfx_QueueCommand, appending one command record to the renderer's command ring. Called once per frame by the display update at 0x10AD60.

functions.name: Mem_InitRangeAllocator
functions.signature: void Mem_InitRangeAllocator(u32* desc, u32 base, u32 size)
functions.summary: Initialises a simple bump/range descriptor: zeroes the six bookkeeping words, then stores base at +0 and base+size at +4 - the allocator used for the application heap window measured by Mem_ComputeLinearHeapRange. The critical section at +0xC is (re)initialised every call.

functions.name: Gfx_OnVBlankTop
