functions.summary: Top-screen VBlank interrupt handler: invokes the registered callback with display id 0x400 and advances the frame counter at context+0x154 modulo 0x7FFFFFFF.

functions.name: Gfx_OnVBlankBottom
functions.summary: Bottom/sub-screen VBlank interrupt handler: invokes the registered callback with the 0x402 display id (global 0x110DBC) and advances the second frame counter at context+0x158 modulo 0x7FFFFFFF.

functions.name: Snd_ResetMixingState
functions.summary: The mixing-unit reset: it re-initialises the +0x2C critical section, resets the voice tables and sets volume/pan/gain defaults.

functions.name: Snd_InitMixingState
functions.signature: void Snd_InitMixingState(SndMixState* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: The mixing-state initialiser: it stores the caller's two table pointers, clears the counters/gain pairs and initialises the +0x38 critical section.

functions.name: Gfx_InitCommandRing
functions.signature: void Gfx_InitCommandRing(GfxCommandRing* ring, u32 capacity, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Initialises a lock-protected command ring: stores capacity and the caller tag, resets the two atomic counters and read/write cursors under ldrex/strex, sets both 'ready' halfwords from the current system tick, and obtains the initial tick from 0x111288.

functions.name: Gfx_PopCommandRing
functions.summary: Removes one entry from the command ring: takes the lock (svc 0x24), validates the ring's result word, reads the word at the read cursor, advances it modulo capacity, decrements the pending count and wakes a waiter; returns 1 when an entry was produced and 0 when the ring is empty.

functions.name: std_VectorInsertU32
functions.signature: void std_VectorInsertU32(u32 ** vec, u32 * pos, const u32 * value)
functions.summary: std::vector<u32>::insert: with spare capacity it shifts the tail right with memmove and stores the new word; otherwise it doubles the capacity and copies both halves into a fresh block.

functions.name: std_VectorInsertU32Copy
functions.signature: void std_VectorInsertU32Copy(u32 ** vec, u32 * pos, const u32 * value)
functions.summary: A second, instruction-identical instantiation of std::vector<u32>::insert; two translation units emitted their own copy, so the game contains both.

functions.name: std_memmove
functions.signature: void * std_memmove(void * dst, const void * src, u32 bytes)
functions.summary: memmove: copies bytes in whichever direction is safe (backwards when the regions overlap and dst > src) using 4-byte words with a byte tail, and returns dst.

functions.name: std_strncpy
functions.signature: char* std_strncpy(char* dst, const char* src, int n)
functions.summary: newlib strncpy: copies at most n bytes from src to dst, using the usual word-at-a-time zero-byte test when both pointers are aligned, stops after copying the terminating NUL and zero-fills the remainder of the n-byte destination.

functions.name: Buffer_ResetDoubleBuffer
functions.summary: Resets a double-buffered object cache: zeroes both 0x84-byte halves, clears the two counters and marks the third slot empty (-1).

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_InitFromReader
functions.signature: int maybe_Svc_Object_InitFromReader(void* self, Reader* reader, int poolCountA, int poolCountB, u32 arg5, u32 capacity, int wantData)
functions.summary: Initialises a service object (vtable 0x00780EAC) from a random-access reader: reads the 0x28-byte archive header, validates the capacity for poolCountA*0x20 + poolCountB*0x18 bytes, builds the two block pools at +0xB8/+0xF4, registers the reader in a five-way category slot and sends the service init request.

functions.name: Gfx_GetCommandSlot
functions.summary: Allocates the next command slot: asserts the slot table is marked ready (deliberately trapping), publishes the slot pointer into the global Gfx state, allocates a node from the command queue and releases the monitor.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd803
functions.signature: int Gfx_IpcCmd803(u32* session, u32* out, u32 arg3, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d, u32 e, u32 f, u32 g, u32 h, u32 i, u32 j)
functions.summary: IPC client stub for command 0x0803 (8 normal + 4 translated parameters) to the GPU service: fills the thread-local request buffer at TPIDRURO+0x80 and returns the service result, copying back two output words. Called by the renderer at 0x504378/0x505058 and by the SDK at 0x10B524/0x10B830.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd861
functions.summary: IPC client stub for command 0x0861 (1 normal + 2 translated parameters) to the GPU service; used to push a single dword (typically a GPU/interrupt selector) and return the service result.

functions.name: maybe_Save_CompleteAsyncRead
functions.summary: Completes an asynchronous save/load request: passes the five request fields at +0x14..+0x24 to Save_AsyncReadWorker and then stores state 5 in the shared work object 0x007B00E0, the worker's completion marker.

functions.name: Gfx_WaitGpuInterrupt
functions.summary: Waits for a GPU interrupt by issuing the GPU service command 0x40000 (via 0x117B18) and converts the usual 'would block' result 0xFFFFF9 into a normal return while asserting on real errors.

functions.name: Gfx_ReleaseGpuInterrupt
functions.summary: Issues GPU service command 0x30000 and, on success, clears the cached interrupt counters at 0x7B2D08+4/+8; the 0x19/0xF9610C02 'already clear' results are tolerated.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_InitTailArm
functions.summary: ARM tail entry of the service-object initialiser: entered with live r4/r6..r10, it stores the pool pointers/counts into the object at unaff_r4, initialises the two block pools and critical sections, sends the service init request and maps the result to a category code. Only the tail survives in the decompilation.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_InitTailThumb
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Svc_Object_InitTailThumb(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Thumb twin of the service-object initialiser tail: byte-swaps the leading argument into the +0x50 field, stores the pool pointers/counts (including the arg4>>2 count) into unaff_r4, initialises the two block pools and critical sections and sends the service init request.

functions.name: Os_LightEvent_Init
functions.summary: Nintendo CTR SDK nn::os::LightEvent::Initialize: initializes the embedded LightLock at lightEvent+4 to 1 via 0x00117C40 and atomically sets lightEvent->state (+0) to -2 (CLEARED_STICKY, manual reset) when isManualReset != 0 or -1 (CLEARED_ONESHOT) when 0.

functions.name: maybe_Save_BeginLoad
functions.summary: Prepares the save work for the next read: sets state 2, clears the 0x2A0-byte loaded-data area and the 0xE3C0/0xE3C4/0xE3C5 flags, and re-initialises the futex at +0xE118 depending on its -1/-2 state.

functions.name: Os_MutexLock
functions.summary: Blocking lock acquire on a two-state lock word: -1 becomes 0 and -2 becomes 1, each transition guarded by hasExclusiveAccess and the kernel arbitrate syscall.

functions.name: Os_InitCriticalSection
functions.summary: Initialises one recursive critical section: clears the owner thread and the recursion counter at +4/+8. 32 call sites, always right after an object has been zeroed or allocated, and always paired with Os_CriticalSectionEnter (0x00117E50) / leave (0x00117ED0).

functions.name: Os_CloseHandleAndUnlink
functions.summary: Closes a kernel handle and removes its block from the owning list: when the block is linked it either just drops the link (no waiter) or waits for the pending operation, unlinks it via 0x11E7A4 and finally closes the handle with `svc 0x23`.

functions.name: Os_InitThreadLocalStorage
functions.summary: Fills in the thread-local block of the calling thread: points the TLS table at +0x5C/+0x64/+0x68 at the per-thread storage, publishes the TLS destructor table, and resolves the per-thread data pointer (0x001000B8) so that thread-local destructors can run at thread exit.

functions.name: Os_CreateThreadWithStack
functions.signature: int Os_CreateThreadWithStack(u32* out_handle, OsThreadParams* params, u32 entry, u32 arg4, int stack_top, u32 stack_size, u32 priority, int detached)
functions.summary: Creates a detached or joinable OS thread: computes the aligned stack top from the caller-supplied stack region, writes the thread argument block, then calls svcCreateThread (0x1112A0) with entry/arg/stack/priority and optionally patches the stack chunk header.

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_AcquireService
functions.summary: Reference-counted acquire of the process-wide 'cfg:u' session: on first use it resolves the service name, opens the handle into 0x007AF0F8 and marks the session open, then increments the user count under the global config monitor.

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_ReleaseService
functions.summary: Releases one user of the config sessions: kind 0 decrements the cfg:u count and closes that handle at zero, kind 1/2 dispatch to the cfg:s / cfg:i close helpers.

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_EnsureService
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cfg_EnsureService(u8* kindOut, u32 second, u16* resultOut)
functions.summary: Makes sure one of the three config sessions is usable: tries the refcounted cfg:u acquire, then cfg:s, then cfg:i, writing which one succeeded (0/1/2) to kindOut; that kind is the same value the release dispatcher 0x0011212C consumes.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelFilterParams
functions.signature: void maybe_Snd_SetChannelFilterParams(u32 unit, u16* unitA, u16* unitB, u32 flags, ...)
functions.summary: Writes the caller's u16 filter/pan words into the sound-unit record (unitA[0x17], [0x22]..[0x2B] and beyond) and pushes them to the command stream through the sound filter setters; the 18-byte Thumb decompilation is damaged (in_CY, overlapping varargs), so the argument list and record layout are unreliable.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Cfg_ReleaseServiceU
functions.summary: Releases one reference to the cfg/session service: decrements the user count at 0x007AF0EC+8 under the config monitor and, when it reaches zero, closes the handle in 0x007AF0F8 with svcCloseHandle and resets it to the sentinel. Identical to the kind==0 arm of 0x0011212C.

functions.name: maybe_Os_CallFinalizers
functions.summary: Runs the eight registered shutdown hooks of the table at 0x7E79B8 once, then clears the 'initialised' byte at 0x7AEA02. The hooks are per-module shutdown callbacks of one driver, not object finalisers, and the driver is still unnamed.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetUnitFlagBit
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_SetUnitFlagBit(unsigned int handle, unsigned int enable, unsigned int unitIndex)
functions.summary: Read-modify-write of a per-unit flag bit: builds the mask 1<<(enable+unitIndex), compares it with the cached mask at 0x7AEA0C, sends the new state through the command-0x15 stub 0x11874C and updates the cache. Returns 0xC8A0A7F8 (already in that state / no session) instead of resending.

functions.name: Hid_DispatchPadReport
functions.signature: void Hid_DispatchPadReport(HidCalibration* cal, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d)
functions.summary: Dispatches a raw pad report to one of three calibration/decoding paths depending on the report-type byte at +0xC (0 = 0x11FBCC, 1 = 0x11A810 circle-pad, 2 = 0x11A914 touch/other), passing the two pairs of 16-bit axis values.

functions.name: Os_SendIpcQuery6
functions.signature: int Os_SendIpcQuery6(unsigned int* out0, unsigned int* out1, unsigned int* out2, unsigned int* out3, unsigned int* out4, unsigned int* out5)
functions.summary: Queries the service for six related values in one request (request id 0xA0000) and copies them out of the thread command block; the six results are used to size the six regions that 0x10BFB0 carves out of the shared buffer.

functions.name: Hid_ReadPadState
functions.summary: Reads one pad snapshot from the HID service (0x11ABB8) into out_state, computes the newly-pressed / newly-released masks against the previous state, applies the circle-pad calibration and returns 1 when a report was produced, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd60040
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0006 with one translated parameter; returns the service result or the output word on success.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd140040
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0014 with one translated parameter; returns the service result or the echoed output word.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_InvalidateChannelObjects
functions.summary: Marks all 24 channel slots unused: for each of the 24 pointers in the table at context+0x18DC it takes the object at +0x68 and stores 0xFFFF into that object's 16-bit field at +0x6C. The callee 0x11EE6C is exactly `mvn r1,#0; strh r1,[r0,#0x6c]; bx lr`, so this is an invalidate loop, not a release.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_ResetChannelUnits
functions.signature: void maybe_Snd_ResetChannelUnits(unsigned char* block, unsigned char value)
functions.summary: Fills a 12-byte parameter block with the given byte, then clears the filter-info halfword (+2, stride 0x14) and the filter-coefficient halfword (+0x2A, stride 0x34) of unit 0 and unit 1 and re-submits both through Snd_SetChannelMaskedFields and maybe_Snd_SetChannelDescriptor. The state pointer comes from the getter 0x1129F4 (the global at 0x7F2BA0).

functions.name: Snd_ResetChannelUnitsInPlace
functions.summary: Clears the filter-info halfword (+2, stride 0x14) and the filter-coefficient halfword (+0x2A, stride 0x34) of unit 0 and unit 1 directly in the caller's channel state and pushes both zeroed records to the command stream through Snd_SetChannelMaskedFields and maybe_Snd_SetChannelDescriptor.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_ResetChannelUnitsToDefault
functions.summary: Restores both units to the default value 0xFFFF: writes it to the filter-info field at +0 (stride 0x14) and the filter-coefficient field at +0x28 (stride 0x34), then re-submits both through 0x118E58/0x118FD4.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_GetCommandBlock
functions.summary: Forwards the command-block getter 0x001129F4 and returns its result; the readable C shows `result = func_001129F4(); return result;`, so this is a getter, not a flush.

functions.name: Snd_EnsureStateInitialised
functions.summary: The sound-state lazy-init guard: it initialises the +0x34 critical section and sets the flag byte exactly once.

functions.name: Snd_InitChannelState
functions.summary: Resets a full sound-channel state block to its defaults: writes the two unit records and the per-unit DSP words through the named Snd setters, clears the filter/pan/ADPCM bytes, seeds the volume pair (-1 / 0x7F) and arms the enable flags.

functions.name: Snd_RestoreChannelState
functions.summary: Re-applies a saved channel state to the driver context 0x007EF414: gain, per-unit gain/active/ADPCM state for both units, pan, format, length, output select, rate, volume and level, then clears the saved pending word at +0x2C.

functions.name: Snd_SetOutputMode
functions.summary: Stores the speaker configuration byte at +2 of the sound state and forwards the mode to the mixing layer under the global sound lock; returns 0 when the lock cannot be taken.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_InitStreamContext
functions.summary: Creates or attaches the streaming context: opens the kernel handle at *ctx if absent, tags it through maybe_Snd_SetUnitFlagBit, queries the unit count (0x00112384) into ctx[1], sets the 0x2000 transfer buffer, resets the 24 channel objects and restores channel/unit defaults on the re-init path. Returns 0 or a Horizon error code.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetupChannelBuffers
functions.summary: One-time layout of the stream buffers: optionally uploads the 0x1080-byte wave buffer, asks the driver for the buffer count/size through two queried commands, splits the shared region into 24 blocks of 0xC0, 24 of 0xC and 24 of 0x20 bytes, stores the six pointer arrays and finally latches the double-buffer index into +0x1322.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_TeardownStreamContext
functions.summary: Tears a streaming context down: sends stop request 2 with mode 1 or 3, waits for the transfer-done flag, clears the active byte f_4C7, releases the 0x1080-byte sample buffer when asked, closes the handle (svcCloseHandle) and returns the cached error at ctx[1].

functions.name: Os_InitSrvClient
functions.summary: Brings up the srv client at boot: initialises the memory manager, then opens the "srv:" port (name string at 0x00741AD8) with a retry loop that keeps retrying while the result is 'session closed', and finally sends the srv handshake request (0x00107800) once. Returns the last result code.

functions.name: Os_WaitRuntimeReady
functions.summary: The runtime-ready wait: it initialises the wait objects once, polls the service completion word and caches the ready state.

functions.name: Svc_IpcCmdB0000
functions.summary: Parameterless IPC request with header 0x000B0000 on the session handle at 0x7AF900; on success it copies the second reply word (TLS+0x88) to *out and returns the first (TLS+0x84).

functions.name: Gfx_InitDrawState
functions.summary: One-shot initialisation of the shared GPU draw-state object: opens the gsp::Gpu session, publishes the handle, clears the 28-word state block at 0x007A1C40 and installs it as the singleton's f_1c, then starts the IPC worker.

functions.name: Gfx_WriteHwRegs
functions.signature: void Gfx_WriteHwRegs(u32 addr, u32 value, u32 count)
functions.summary: Writes GPU hardware registers through the GPU service: obtains the session handle from the thread-local GSP state and calls 0x1196B0, which issues command 0x00010082.

functions.name: Gfx_QueueCommand
functions.signature: void Gfx_QueueCommand(u32 queue_id, u32 opcode, u32 arg3, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d, u32 e)
functions.summary: Appends a 0x1C-byte command to one of the two renderer command queues kept in thread-local storage, writes the six parameter words, issues a data-synchronisation barrier and sets the entry's valid/pending bit with an ldrex/strex.

functions.name: Os_IsInHeapRange
functions.summary: Returns 1 when addr lies inside either the main heap or the second (linear/VRAM) heap range, otherwise 0; used by the debug/assert path to decide whether a pointer is a real allocation.

functions.name: maybe_Os_SignalAndClose
functions.summary: If the runtime object exists, wakes its waiting thread and then sends the close/notify request (svc 0x32 wrapper); part of the service-call bracketing shared with 0x10CDE0/0x10D430.

functions.name: Gfx_WriteHwRegsWithMask
functions.signature: void Gfx_WriteHwRegsWithMask(u32 addr, u32 value, u32 mask, u32 count)
functions.summary: Writes GPU hardware registers with a bit mask through the GPU service by calling 0x11979C, whose command header is 0x00020084 (GSPGPU WriteHWRegsWithMask).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ExchangeSlotValue
functions.summary: Atomically exchanges one of seven 32-bit slots at +0x10 of the draw-state object (singleton 0x007AF178->f_1C) under that object's monitor and returns the previous content; slot >= 7 is ignored and returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_InitInterrupts
functions.summary: Clears the caller's flag byte, then, when the incoming zero flag allows it, arms three interrupt sources through 0x00113A40(3) and programs the locked command 0x3E0080.

functions.name: Os_IsSessionRunnable
functions.summary: Returns 1 only when the service session is open and its status word has both the connected (0x20000000) and ready (0x10000000) bits set.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ProcessFrame
functions.summary: Per-frame service loop of the graphics/audio IPC library: services the retrace and should-close callbacks, handles a command from the 0x0079C000 command ring (kinds 2/5/8/9, 8/9 call Snd_SetMasterEnable) or runs the render state machine (modes 0..4) over the callback table at 0x007AE954.

functions.name: Os_ServiceThreadProc
functions.summary: Service-thread body: builds a three-word handle table, then loops waiting on inter-thread handles with svc 0x18/0x19 and dispatching through Os_MutexLock, Os_SignalSemaphore, Os_InvokeCallbacks and the Gfx IPC commands.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetSuspendState
functions.signature: void maybe_Snd_SetSuspendState(unsigned int suspend, void* state)
functions.summary: Level-triggered suspend/resume switch: when the stored flag at state+3 is set it clears it and calls Snd_RequestResume, otherwise it sets the flag and calls Snd_RequestSuspend; the two 'already in that state' results 0xD8A02A05/0xD9001BF7 are accepted and a negative result goes to the error reporter.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd50100
functions.summary: Thin wrapper that submits one 32-bit value as command 0x00050100 through Gfx_IpcCmd4B00C2Call(7, ...).

functions.name: Gfx_LockedIpcCmd3E0080
functions.summary: Runs the GPU IPC command 0x3E0080 under the global scheduler lock: acquires the lock, takes the service handle, invokes Gfx_IpcCmd3E0080(handle, arg1), asserts on a negative result and unlocks.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_DispatchTwoRecordRequest
functions.summary: Builds a two-entry, 0x10-byte-stride request array through std_ConstructArray(type 0x00119838), initialises it and dispatches it with the caller's request value through 0x00119B44/0x00119C30 before returning the result. The readable C stops at the array construction because Ghidra marks the std_ConstructArray blx as noreturn.

functions.name: Svc_SendRequest3
functions.signature: int Svc_SendRequest3(u32 sessionHandle, int commandWord, u32 payload)
functions.summary: Sends one raw IPC request on the given session handle: writes the fixed header 0x002C0044 and three payload words into the calling thread's IPC buffer (TLS+0x80), the descriptor commandWord<<14|2, then issues svc 0x32 (SendSyncRequest) and returns the reply word. It is the terminal 'send it' step of the session layer; the caller decides the command word.

functions.name: Svc_QuerySessionInfo
functions.signature: int Svc_QuerySessionInfo(u8 commandByte, u8 * out0, u32 * out1, u32 * out2, u32 * out3)
functions.summary: Sends a one-byte command (header 0x00050040, command 0x05, one normal parameter) and copies the four reply words TLS+0x88..+0x94 into the caller's four outputs; the session layer uses it to poll a session's state before sending a request.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd1010000
functions.summary: IPC stub with header 0x01010000 (no parameters) to the same session as the other GPU stubs; returns the result and writes the byte at TLS+0x88 to *out.

functions.name: Svc_SendRequest4
functions.signature: u32 Svc_SendRequest4(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, int descriptorWord, u32 payload)
functions.summary: Sends one raw IPC request with four payload words (header 0x001F0084 = command 0x1F, two normal + four translated words), descriptor arg3<<14|2, then svc 0x32 and returns the reply. The four-word sibling of Svc_SendRequest3.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd3B0040
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x003B with one byte parameter and one translated parameter; returns the service result or the echoed value.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd2B0000
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x002B (no parameters) to the shared GPU session; returns the service result or the TLS output word.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd190040
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x0019 with one translated parameter; returns the result or the echoed value.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd4F0080
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x004F with two normal parameters; returns the result or the first output word.

functions.name: Svc_PollStatusFlags
functions.summary: Refreshes a pair of one-byte status flags: queries commands 0x3B and 0x3C, ORs both reply bytes into 0x7AF0DC, and when the 0x13 command returns 0xC9405001 it acknowledges with the 0x3D command.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_CommandRing_Reserve
functions.signature: u32* maybe_Snd_CommandRing_Reserve(u32* ring, int count, u32* out)
functions.summary: Reserves count contiguous free words in the sound command ring used by Snd_QueueCommandBuffer, tracking the ring read/write positions across the wrap and returning a pointer to the free run (or 0).

functions.name: maybe_Svc_IpcStubFragment
functions.summary: Not a function start: the bytes here are the continuation of the IPC stub in front of it (store a byte at (arg2>>1)+0x10, svc 0x32, read the reply at (arg2>>1)+4). Kept only so the coverage table has an entry for this address.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CommandListWorker
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_CommandListWorker(u32 arg1, u32 mask, int count, u32* d, int header, int* state)
functions.summary: Normalises a command-list state counter modulo 8 and validates the list header/count before copying command payloads; the decompiler hit bad instruction data at the first branch, so only the header check is trustworthy.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_ThumbFragment
functions.signature: void maybe_Svc_ThumbFragment(u32 arg1, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d)
functions.summary: Not a function start: the decoded bytes are a byte-swap idiom (rev of arg1, then stores of d at +0 and c at +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24/+0x28 of the swapped pointer) belonging to the routine that begins before this address. Kept only for coverage bookkeeping.

functions.name: Mem_PoolDestroy
functions.signature: void Mem_PoolDestroy(Pool* pool, u32 block, u32 count, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Empties a pool: walks its four sublists, detaches every chunk through the chunk callback 0x0011B034, then re-initialises the pool descriptor and marks it reset (f_86=1).

functions.name: Snd_FadeChannelToGain
functions.summary: Starts (or stops, when gain <= 0) a channel: stores the ramped gain, marks the channel dirty, inserts it into the mixer's priority list (0x11FD1C when the channel has an owner at +0x10) and calls the channel's vtable start slot; a stopped channel goes through the vtable stop slot instead.

functions.name: Fs_ArcHeader_Parse
functions.summary: Parses a three-section archive header: checks the 'CGRP' magic and a size field in 0x01000000..0x01000100, resolves the three sub-blobs and returns pointers to their payloads (+8 past each header word).

functions.name: Os_WorkQueue_Push
functions.signature: u32 Os_WorkQueue_Push(WorkQueue* q, int wait, u32 arg3, int* node)
functions.summary: Publishes the next work item on a queue: reserves a free node, and while none is free drains the completion queue (folding the finished item id into q->f_178/f_188), links the node at the tail, then either tries a non-blocking push or waits on the queue's send primitive; returns the sequence number or 0.

functions.name: Os_WorkQueue_Drain
functions.summary: Discards every pending completion of a work queue: pops each finished node with Os_QueueTryPop, stores its item id in q->f_178, walks to the tail of the node chain and records the last in-flight id, clearing it when it matches q->f_184.

functions.name: Os_QueuePopUntilId
functions.summary: Blocks on the queue embedded at owner+0xB4 and pops entries until the one whose id field equals the requested id arrives, refreshing the owner's current-entry fields +0x178/+0x184/+0x188/+0x18C and clearing them when the last entry is popped.

functions.name: std__Rb_tree_rebalance_for_erase
functions.signature: void std__Rb_tree_rebalance_for_erase(RbTreeNode* z, RbTreeNode* header, RbTreeNode* leftmost, RbTreeNode* rightmost)
functions.summary: libstdc++ red-black tree erase fix-up: handles the red-leaf case, the single-child splice case and the two-children case (find successor, copy colour, rotate with 0x11B9B0) so the tree invariants and the header's leftmost/rightmost pointers remain valid.

functions.name: std__Rb_tree_rebalance
functions.summary: libstdc++ red-black tree rebalancing after insertion: recolours parent/uncle/grandparent and performs the left/right rotations through 0x11B9B0 until the root is black again.

functions.name: Save_BuildSectionList
functions.summary: Builds the save-snapshot block list: walks the 0x274C-byte handler table at self+0x34, invokes each handler, chains the returned blocks into a list with a running id and pushes the head through Os_QueueTryPush.

functions.name: maybe_Queue_SubmitEntry
functions.summary: Appends a buffer entry to the owner's submission chain, publishes it with a memory barrier and either pushes it to the OS queue or the ring buffer, then assigns and returns the next sequence number.

functions.name: Container_NewListNode
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x28-byte list node from the global block allocator at 0x007AE8EC and zeroes all ten words; returns NULL when no allocator is installed or the allocation fails. The real function starts at 0x115F74 (the batch seed is 4 bytes late).

functions.name: Gfx_AdvanceCommandList
functions.summary: Consumes the next entry of the active GPU command list: bumps the read cursor under the renderer lock, invokes the list's completion callback when the last entry (or an end marker) is reached, and restarts the DMA through 0x116104.

functions.name: Mem_CommitAllocation
functions.summary: Allocator slow path after a free block was split: stores the remainder size in the block trailer, returns the unused tail through 0x1193AC, sets the allocated flag 4 and clears the heap scratch begin/end words.

functions.name: Gfx_ExecuteCommandList
functions.summary: Drains the pending GPU command array: for every record from the read cursor to the write cursor it dispatches on the record type (0 = texture copy, 1 = surface fill, 2 = textured quad/blit, 3/4 = display transfer) to the corresponding 0x11C86C/0x11F28C/0x11C8A0/0x11C880/0x11C8C0 hardware command builder.

functions.name: Gfx_NewCommandList
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises a 0x1CC-byte command-list object: 0x2600 default words, a 0xFFFFFC18 sentinel, zeroed state and eight 0x44-byte slot descriptors (stride 0x44) tagged with the capacity argument.

functions.name: Gfx_NewCommandListSlot
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises a 0x78-byte single-slot command-list object (0x2600 defaults, 0xFFFFFC18 sentinel, one 0x44-byte descriptor at +0x74 tagged with the argument).

functions.name: Gfx_FreeCommandList
functions.summary: Releases a command-list buffer: compares the list's slot address against the bound slot, calls the release callback with the target address/size and clears the three bookkeeping words.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_NewRenderQueue
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises a 0x348-byte render-state queue: 16 slots, each with a 0x18-byte and a 0x10-byte descriptor; the texture/handle words at +0x188/+0x18C/+0x194 are cleared and a 0.5f is stored at +0x288 in each 0xC-byte tail. Returns 0 when the allocator hook is null.

functions.name: std_RingBuffer_Push
functions.signature: void std_RingBuffer_Push(BufferQueue* queue, unsigned int value)
functions.summary: Blocking push into a bounded producer ring: waits on the "not full" semaphore while the write index equals the capacity, stores the value, advances the write index and signals the consumer; a separate counter guards concurrent callers.

functions.name: Container_NameMap_FindNodePair
functions.signature: void Container_NameMap_FindNodePair(void* outNodePair, void* tree, const void* hashAndNameKey)
functions.summary: Searches an RB-tree keyed by (u32 hash, char name[0x20]): finds the lower-bound node for hashAndNameKey->u32_00, scans equal-hash nodes comparing the 0x20-byte label at entry + 0x1C (0x00123660), and writes {matchedNodeOrEnd, lowerBoundHint} to outNodePair.

functions.name: Os_InitMainThreadTls
functions.summary: Prepares the thread-local storage for the main thread (0x00111EB0 then 0x00111EFC) and returns the default application heap size 0x03000000 (48 MB) that the caller hands to the heap setup.

functions.name: Container_ResizeArray
functions.summary: Resizes an inline array to count 4-byte elements: destroys the old storage through the virtual at +0x10, allocates count*4 bytes from heap self[0xB] and zeroes the whole buffer with an unrolled 8/4/2/1-word pattern.

functions.name: Actor_LoadParams
functions.summary: Copies the 0x50-byte parameter record for actor id self->f_768 from the world actor table into the instance fields at +0x30..+0x78.

functions.name: std_memcpy
functions.signature: void * std_memcpy(void * dst, const void * src, u32 bytes)
functions.summary: memcpy: copies bytes with an unrolled 32/16/8/4/2/1-byte ladder, loading eight words at a time while more than 0x20 bytes remain; returns the end of the destination in the second return register.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ReleaseCommandBuffers
functions.summary: When the list's 'owns buffers' bit (byte +4, bit 0) is set, releases the three buffer pairs (+0x58/+0x34, +0x60/+0x3C, +0x64/+0x40) through 0x116DA4. That helper is `cmp r2,#0; bxeq lr; ...`, i.e. it does nothing when the size is zero, which is exactly how a (pointer, size) release behaves.

functions.name: maybe_Game_ApplyValueToHandle
functions.signature: void maybe_Game_ApplyValueToHandle(u32 arg1, u8 recordIndex, int* handle, u32 value)
functions.summary: Game data layer: if the caller holds a live handle, resolves the record for the given index through the data manager (0x0011BAC0) and, unless that record is still in state 1, writes the value into the handle's object (0x0011B530).

functions.name: Pack_ApplyToLoadedHandles
functions.summary: Pushes a value into every live handle of a streamed slot - the two buffers at +0x34/+0x3C, the pack-backed one at +0x40 and each 0x14-byte record of the bitmap table at +0x7C - but only when the corresponding pack record reports type 2.

functions.name: maybe_Os_SendIpcCmd0863Request
functions.summary: Builds the request block with 0x117098 and sends the fixed command 0x0863 through 0x11DED4, writing the reply to *out. The old 'ServiceInit' label was unsupported: the header 0x08630000 carries no parameters and nothing in the body mentions a service initialisation.

functions.name: maybe_Os_AssertAndGetState
functions.summary: Asserts that *object is non-zero (routing to 0x11ED40 with 0xE0A046DB otherwise) and then returns the second word of the global at 0x7AEA38. It proves the pointer is non-null but tests no readiness, so the old 'object ready' wording was already dropped.

functions.name: Save_AsyncReadWorker
functions.summary: Asynchronous save/load read worker: waits on the work event, reads length-prefixed records through Fs_ReadRecordBlock, and drives the shared work state at 0x007B0080/0x007B00E0 until the request is complete or times out.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_BlitWorker
functions.summary: Walks the 32-bit occupancy bitmap of a render/surface table (bitmap at +0x80, count at +0x88, records at +0x7C stride 0x14) and re-submits every live record whose flags (+0x11) clear bits 0x18 and whose first word is non-zero (0x11B530).

functions.name: maybe_Os_LookupParamEntry
functions.summary: Reads a 0x40-byte parameter header through the chunked table reader, searches its four 0x10-byte entries for type byte 0 and unpacks the two 12-bit fields plus payload word; falls back to the 0x400-offset scan and finally to the fixed 0x800/0x800/1.0 defaults.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd90000
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0009 with no parameters; returns the service result or the TLS output word.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd20000
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0002 with no parameters; returns the service result or the TLS output word.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd40000
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0004 with no parameters; used as the 'wait for GPU interrupt' request (0x111BAC).

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd30000
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0003 with no parameters; used as the 'acknowledge/release interrupt' request (0x111BEC).

functions.name: Os_LockSemaphore
functions.summary: Blocks until the semaphore/lock word at *lock becomes 0, then atomically sets it to -1; when the count is positive it arbitrates through 0x11CC10 (svcArbitrateAddress) until the state word is free.

functions.name: Os_TryLockSemaphore
functions.summary: Attempts to take the semaphore: if the state is 1 it enters the waiting path, decrements/negates the counter under ldrex, and only arbitrates when the count becomes positive; returns the owner/state pointer.

functions.name: Os_EventSetAll
functions.summary: Signals an event/light-lock: atomically negates the counter, and when it had waiters (old value != -1 and the new value > 0) wakes them with the kernel synchronisation call 0x11CC10.

functions.name: Os_SemaphoreAcquire
functions.summary: Blocks until the semaphore count is positive, then atomically decrements it; waiters are registered with the kernel wait call so a release wakes exactly one of them.

functions.name: Os_SemaphoreRelease
functions.summary: Releases `count` units of a semaphore (clamped at the capacity), then signals the kernel so a waiting thread can proceed; returns the previous count.

functions.name: Snd_LockSystemMonitor
functions.summary: Locks the sound system's monitor: calls the sound-system accessor 0x5177DC, adds 0x34 to the returned object and falls into the monitor-lock body at 0x117E50. Its mirror 0x51864C adds the same 0x34 and branches to the monitor unlock 0x117ED0, which is what proves the pair.

functions.name: Os_LockMonitor
functions.summary: Enters a recursive monitor: when the calling thread is not the owner it blocks in the kernel wait (0x11E614) and records the new owner, then increments the recursion count.

functions.name: Os_UnlockMonitor
functions.summary: Recursive monitor release used at the end of locked sections: takes the monitor lock, and when the state byte f_76 is not 2 it marks the monitor contended, releases the raw lock (0x00117ED0) and waits on the semaphore at +100; otherwise it clears f_76, decrements the recursion count at +8 and, when that reaches zero, clears the owner at +4 and wakes all waiters (Os_EventSetAll).

functions.name: Os_AcquireSemaphore
functions.summary: Waits until the semaphore's counter is positive, then increments it atomically; used to claim one of the engine's counted resources.

functions.name: Os_ReleaseSemaphoreAll
functions.summary: Waits for the resource to be free, negates the counter and wakes every waiter by arbitrating with 0xFFFFFFFF until the state reaches -1.

functions.name: Os_ReleaseSemaphore
functions.summary: Decrements the semaphore count (or moves a negative count towards zero) atomically and signals the address arbiter with -1 when the last user releases it.

functions.name: Os_SignalSemaphore
functions.summary: Negates the semaphore counter and immediately wakes all waiters through the arbiter, without first waiting for the counter to reach a positive value.

functions.name: maybe_Os_CheckSemaphoreResult
functions.signature: void maybe_Os_CheckSemaphoreResult(u32 result, u32 arg2, OsSemaphore* syncObject, char* pendingFlag)
functions.summary: Result filter for a synchronisation primitive: when the object's +0x14 bit 0 is clear and the caller's pending flag is unset it maps result class -1 to the assert handler 0x1188EC and then runs the completion helper 0x11C814; otherwise only the classes -7 (invalid) and 1 (success) are accepted, everything else goes to the assert path.

functions.name: Os_InitEventFlag
functions.summary: Initialises an event/flag object: takes the kernel lock (svc 0x24), validates the handle, then marks the object as initialised. Called from the shutdown path 0x11F764.

functions.name: Os_RunTlsDestructors
functions.summary: Runs the thread-local destructors for the thread that has just finished: walks the 16 destructor slots, and for each slot that is both present in the thread's mask and non-null it calls destructor(thread->slot[i]). Called by the thread trampoline immediately before svcExitThread.

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_CloseServiceS
functions.summary: Drops one user of the lazily opened 'cfg:s' session; when the count reaches zero it closes the handle in 0x007B2CFC and restores the cached handle word into 0x007AF0F8.

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_CloseServiceI
functions.summary: Drops one user of the lazily opened 'cfg:i' session; at zero it closes the handle in 0x007B2CF8 and copies the cached handle into both 0x007AF0F8 and 0x007B2CFC.

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_OpenServiceS
functions.summary: Reference-counted open of the 'cfg:s' session: on first use it opens the service handle into 0x007B2CFC and publishes it as the current config handle, then increments the user count; the 'already open' error code is passed through.

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_OpenServiceI
functions.summary: Reference-counted open of the 'cfg:i' session: on first use it opens the handle into 0x007B2CF8, copies it into the two current-handle slots and increments the count.

functions.name: Os_InitializeOnce
functions.summary: Classic one-shot initialisation with a published state: the first caller atomically flips the flag from 0 to 1, initialises the global object 0x007EF0A4 and then stores its address in the flag (state 2); every other caller sleeps 1 ms until the flag reaches 2. Returns the published pointer/state.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd10082
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_IpcCmd10082(u32 buffer, int size, u32 addr)
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0001 with 2 normal + 2 translated parameters, used to feed a memory range (buffer/size/address) to the GPU; command 0x00010082 is GSPGPU's register/block write request.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_QueryChannelInfo
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_QueryChannelInfo(unsigned int command, unsigned int in, unsigned int size, unsigned short* outCount)
functions.summary: Forwards a channel query to the driver when the session at 0x7AEA08 is open; when it is not, writes 0 to *outCount and returns the 'no session' code 0xC8A0A7F8. The actual IPC goes through 0x11EBD8, which submits a buffer descriptor with command 0x10.

functions.name: maybe_Hid_GetEventObject
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Hid_GetEventObject(HidObject* object, u32* out, u32 defaultValue, u32 b)
functions.summary: Stores its third argument in *out, then, if the object owns a session handle at +8, sends command 0x0C through 0x0011EC40 and lets it overwrite *out with the reply. Always returns the constant 0xC8A0A7F8, so the return value carries no information.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd130082
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_IpcCmd130082(u32* session, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0013 with 2 normal + 2 translated parameters; used to configure a shared buffer (a/b/c are address, size and offset).

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd120000
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0012 with no parameters; returns the result or the TLS output word.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd170040
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0017 with one translated 16-bit parameter (typically a display/lcd selector).

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd160000
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU-service command 0x0016 with no parameters; returns the service result and copies the 0x8C output word to *out.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_IpcCmd15
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_IpcCmd15(unsigned int* session, unsigned int unitFlag, unsigned int unitIndex, unsigned int c)
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x15 (header 0x00150082 = two normal + two translated words): stores a/b/c in the thread IPC buffer and returns the reply. Its only caller uses it as the write half of a read-modify-write over a per-unit flag mask.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_FlushChannels
functions.summary: Per-frame flush of the active channel bank: if the 'active' byte at 0x7AEA00 is set, reconfigures the two unit records through 0x11E9C4, runs the eight registered flush callbacks of the table at 0x7E7998, clears the flag and finally sends the per-session teardown command 0x20.

functions.name: Os_InvokeCallbacks
functions.summary: When a pending-event bit is set, invokes up to eight registered callback slots and, if the pending byte is still set, waits for the runtime event to drain, sends the close request and clears the pending flags.

functions.name: maybe_Os_WaitIpcTransferDone
functions.summary: Waits for an asynchronous IPC transfer to finish: under the global monitor 0x007E7A70 it polls the completion object at 0x007AEA24, sleeps while the status is the 0xD0401834/busy value, then retires the record with 0x0011CC7C and re-sends it through Svc_SendRequestBuffer128; re-arms the wait object when the record is not in state 2 or 5.

functions.name: Mem_InitBlockPool
functions.signature: void Mem_InitBlockPool(Pool* self, int blockBytes, int usedBytes, int totalBytes, int align, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Turns a raw buffer into a pool of fixed-size blocks: computes the aligned block stride, the block count and the first/last block addresses, then links every block into a singly linked free list and records head/tail. No allocation happens here - the caller supplies the memory.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelLevel
functions.summary: Stores a 16-bit value in the channel block's field at +0xBC and sets bit 0x10000 of the second dirty word at +0xC0. The field is channel-wide (no unit index) and sits right after the two per-unit records; its meaning is still unknown, so the 'level' reading stays a guess.

functions.name: Snd_SetUnitActive
functions.signature: u32 Snd_SetUnitActive(ChannelBuffer* context, int unit, u16 active)
functions.summary: Publishes the per-unit enable flag of the current sound channel: stores `active` in the halfword at channel+0x28+unit*2 and sets dirty bit 0x100 (unit 0) or 0x200 (unit 1) so the driver re-reads it. Returns 0 when the driver lock is not held.

functions.name: Snd_SetChannelRate
functions.signature: unsigned int Snd_SetChannelRate(ChannelBuffer* context, unsigned int rate)
functions.summary: Writes a channel's 16-bit rate field (+0x22), clamped to 0x8000, and marks that field dirty (bit 0x80000000) in the channel block's flag word. The 0x8000 ceiling is the DSP's 32 kHz sample clock, which is what identifies the field as a rate rather than a volume.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelFormat
functions.summary: Stores a 16-bit value in the channel block's field at +0x18 and sets dirty bit 0x8000000. Snd_InitChannelState publishes 1 here and the restore path replays the saved state byte +1, so it is one of the channel-state fields; that the field is a sample format is still an inference.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelGain
functions.summary: Stores a float in the channel block's field at +0x04 and sets dirty bit 0x10000. The value is a VFP single (Ghidra dropped it as in_s0); Snd_InitChannelState publishes 1.0f, so it is a gain-like scalar rather than an address.

functions.name: Snd_SetChannelLength
functions.signature: unsigned int Snd_SetChannelLength(ChannelBuffer* buf, unsigned int length)
functions.summary: Writes a channel's loop length: clamps the value to 0x7FFF, stores it as a halfword in the channel block and sets the 0x20000000 update bit.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelAdpcmState
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Snd_SetChannelAdpcmState(ChannelBuffer* context, int unit, u16 value)
functions.summary: Stores a 16-bit value in the per-unit halfword at channel+0x24+unit*2 and sets dirty bit 0x40 (unit 0) or 0x80 (unit 1); any other unit index writes the field without a dirty bit. Returns 0 when the driver lock is not held.

functions.name: Snd_SetChannelMaskedFields
functions.signature: unsigned int Snd_SetChannelMaskedFields(void* buf, int index, unsigned short* info)
functions.summary: Copies a mask-selected set of fields from a descriptor into one 0x14-byte channel record (bit0 one halfword, bit1 one word, bit2 five halfwords) and sets the dirty bit 0x400 for unit 0 or 0x800 for unit 1.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetUnitGain
functions.signature: void maybe_Snd_SetUnitGain(ChannelBuffer* context, int unit, float gain)
functions.summary: Stores a float in the per-unit field at channel+0x08+unit*4 and sets dirty bit 0x1000000 (unit 0) or 0x2000000 (unit 1). Snd_InitChannelState publishes 1.0f for both units, so these are per-unit gain scalars, not loop information.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelDescriptor
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_SetChannelDescriptor(ChannelBuffer* buf, int index, unsigned short* info)
functions.summary: Copies a mask-selected descriptor into one 0x34-byte channel record of the +0x10A4 table (bit0 one halfword at +0x56, bit1 five words at +0x5C..+0x6C, bit2 twelve halfwords at +0x5A..+0x86) and sets the dirty bit 0x1000 for channel 0 or 0x2000 for channel 1.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelPan
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_SetChannelPan(ChannelBuffer* context, unsigned short pan)
functions.summary: Writes the halfword at +0x16 of the channel block and sets dirty bit 0x4000000.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelVolume
functions.summary: Stores a 16-bit value in the channel block's field at +0x10 and sets dirty bit 0x8000. Snd_InitChannelState publishes 2 here and the restore path replays the saved state word f_32, so it is a channel-state field; the volume reading is still an inference.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelField1A
functions.summary: Writes the 16-bit field at +0x1a of the current channel block and marks it dirty (bit 0x10000000), returning 1 on success and 0 when the driver is not ready. Same channel lookup as the Snd_SetChannel* setters; which logical field +0x1a is, is not proven.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetChannelOutput
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_SetChannelOutput(ChannelBuffer* context, unsigned int outputSelect)
functions.summary: Writes the channel's output/bus selector (value must be < 2) at +0x1e and marks it dirty (bit 0x40000000).

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd50100Query
functions.signature: int Gfx_IpcCmd50100Query(u32* out, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x00050100 (4 normal parameters): sends a/b/c, returns the service result and copies the 0x8C output word to *out.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmdC0080
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x000C with two normal parameters; returns the service result or the echoed first word.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GetQueueStatus
functions.summary: Reads the pending byte at +1 of the per-thread queue object selected by index (the TLS+0x5C array) - a command-list busy predicate. 0x11F720 supplies the TLS base.

functions.name: maybe_Os_StoreThreadLocalValue
functions.summary: Allocator shim: passes the per-thread block (0x0011F730), the global at 0x007418D0 and the two arguments to the OS command-0x08 helper 0x0011F65C.

functions.name: Snd_RequestSuspend
functions.summary: Asks the runtime to suspend: if the runtime predicate 0x11F20C holds it sends command 0x16 with mode 0, and on success clears the runtime object's +0x30 flag; otherwise it returns the cached 'not initialised' code.

functions.name: Snd_RequestResume
functions.summary: Counterpart of Snd_RequestSuspend: if the runtime predicate holds it sends the parameterless resume command (0x17) and on success sets the runtime object's +0x30 flag.

functions.name: maybe_Engine_InitIpcWorker
functions.summary: Brings up an IPC worker block: clears the state words, creates or reuses the handle at f_2C, initialises its event, queries the IPC state flags, sends the unit/status request, installs the 0x1000-byte transfer buffer (0x0011E6F8) and the completion callback, then creates the worker thread 0x0011F3C0 with this block as argument and releases the monitor.

functions.name: maybe_Os_DestroyThreadLocal
functions.summary: At thread exit, fetches the thread-local object (0x0011F20C) and destroys it with 0x0011F730 followed by 0x0011F698.

functions.name: Gfx_WriteHwRegsBlock
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_WriteHwRegsBlock(u32* session, u32 addr, u32 value, int count)
functions.summary: Sends a GPU register write block: 2 normal + 2 translated parameters, count encoded as ((count<<14)|2), through command 0x00010082.

functions.name: Snd_SendIpcSuspend
functions.signature: unsigned int Snd_SendIpcSuspend(unsigned int* session, unsigned int value, unsigned char mode)
functions.summary: IPC stub for driver command 0x16 (header word 0x00160042): stores the mode byte, the value and a zero word in the thread-local block, sends svc 0x32 and returns the reply.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_IpcCmd19
functions.summary: Parameterless IPC request with header 0x190000 (command 0x19) on the session word passed in; returns the reply word. Its caller uses it as the final notification before closing the session.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmdB0040Session
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_IpcCmdB0040Session(unsigned int* session, unsigned char value)
functions.summary: Sends GPU-service command 0x000B (header 0x000B0040, one translated parameter) on the session handle passed in and returns the reply word. Its only caller is Gfx_EnsureGpuSession, which passes the gsp::Gpu handle it just opened.

functions.name: Gfx_WriteHwRegsMasked
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_WriteHwRegsMasked(u32* session, u32 addr, u32 value, u32 mask, int count)
functions.summary: Sends a masked GPU register write: 2 normal + 2 translated parameters plus the count packing, through command 0x00020084 (GSPGPU WriteHWRegsWithMask).

functions.name: Gfx_WaitGpuEvent
functions.signature: int Gfx_WaitGpuEvent(u32* arg1, u32* b, u8* c, int d, u32* e, int* f, int mode)
functions.summary: Waits for a GPU service reply: selects the event object (0x11F758 or 0x11F804), takes the scheduler lock, polls 0x11F9CC (command 0x000D) with timeout handling, unlocks and returns the reply, optionally signalling the event via svc 0x23.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd4B00C2Call
functions.signature: int Gfx_IpcCmd4B00C2Call(u32 mode, u32* buf, int size, int arg4, int b, u32* out)
functions.summary: Takes the scheduler lock and issues GPU command 0x004B (3 normal + 2 translated parameters, built by 0x11F810) with the caller's buffer; asserts on failure and releases the lock.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SetMasterEnable
functions.summary: Switches the driver's global output on/off: enable (arg 0) requires the ready predicate 0x0011E9B4 and arms the stream through 0x00118814; disable (arg non-zero) requires the current flag and stops it through 0x0011ECC0; the flag byte at 0x007AE910+4 is then updated.

functions.name: Os_GetTimeSnapshot
functions.summary: Copies the eight words produced by Os_QueryTime (0x0011F5C0) into the caller's 8-word buffer - a thin public wrapper around the OS time query.

functions.name: maybe_Os_WaitSharedBlock
functions.summary: Waits on the handle stored in *state with svcWaitSynchronization1 (svc 0x24), asserts on a negative result, then re-opens the SDK session with Os_EnsureIpcSessionOpen.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmdF0100Query
functions.signature: int Gfx_IpcCmdF0100Query(u32 arg1, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d)
functions.summary: Issues GPU command 0x000F (4 normal parameters) and returns the byte result written by the service; asserts on failure.

functions.name: Svc_WaitForStatusUntilDeadline
functions.signature: u32 Svc_WaitForStatusUntilDeadline(u32 handle, u32 deadline_lo, u32 deadline_hi, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Polls the status command 0x90040 under the scheduler lock and returns 1 as soon as its reply byte is set, or 0 once the 64-bit deadline (with a 3x margin) has passed; sleeps through 0x11CC94 between attempts.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SubmitIpcCommand430040
functions.summary: Flushes the pending GPU callbacks (two inner entries of Os_InvokeCallbacks at 0x00118814), submits IPC command 0x430040 through Gfx_IpcCmd430040 and aborts through 0x00118924 on failure.

functions.name: Os_UnlockScheduler
functions.summary: Releases the scheduler/GPU lock taken by 0x1143C8/0x119BA8: restores the saved event word, signals the owner with svc 0x23 if needed, and drops the thread priority with svc 0x14.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_WaitGpuEventLoop
functions.summary: Polls the transfer command in a loop: each pass calls Gfx_TransferGpuBuffer with the context at 0x00119F7C, invokes the registered callback (table 0x00119F84, slot +0x48) when the returned event differs from the expected one, and ends on error or when the third stage reports the requested event.

functions.name: Gfx_Cmd400042Call
functions.summary: Takes the scheduler lock and issues GPU command 0x0040 (2 translated parameters) through 0x11FA58, then releases the lock and returns the result.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd3F0040Call
functions.summary: Takes the scheduler lock, calls 0x11FAA4 (GPU command 0x003F), asserts on failure and releases the lock.

functions.name: Gfx_ReadGpuBuffer
functions.signature: int Gfx_ReadGpuBuffer(u32 id, u32 flags, u32 size, u32 offset, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 deadline_lo, u32 deadline_hi)
functions.summary: Reads a GPU buffer through IPC command 0x000C0104 under the scheduler lock: rejects offsets above 0x1000, zeroes the request when either size or offset is empty, releases the session handles when the flag 0x10000 is set and retries on the busy status 0xC8A0CC02 until the deadline.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd420080
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU command 0x0042 with two normal parameters; returns the result or the echoed first word.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd90040
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU command 0x0009 with one translated parameter; returns the service result and copies the 0x88 output byte to *out.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd430040
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU command 0x0043 with one translated parameter; returns the result.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd3E0080
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU command 0x003E with two normal parameters; returns the result or the echoed word. Used by the scheduler lock helper 0x1143C8.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmdB0040
functions.summary: IPC stub for GPU command 0x000B with one translated parameter; returns the result and copies the 0x88 output byte.

functions.name: Gfx_WriteGpuBuffer
functions.signature: int Gfx_WriteGpuBuffer(u8* arg1, u8* b, u8* c, int size, u8* data, int* out)
functions.summary: Submits a GPU buffer write through IPC command 0x000E0080 under the scheduler lock, replacing null arguments with stack temporaries and returning the service status.

functions.name: Gfx_TransferGpuBuffer
functions.signature: int Gfx_TransferGpuBuffer(u32* arg1, u32* b, u8* c, int size, u32* d, int* out, u32 e, u32 f)
functions.summary: Submits a GPU buffer transfer through IPC command 0x000D0080 under the scheduler lock, substituting stack temporaries for null arguments and retrying on the busy status with the 3x timeout; when the caller already holds the current event it forwards to Gfx_WaitGpuEvent instead.

functions.name: maybe_Hid_UpdateCalibration
functions.summary: When the calibration slot at 0x007AF0DC is active, reads the current calibration id with IPC command 0x13 and, if the reply is 0xC9405001, acknowledges it with command 0x3D.

functions.name: Hid_CalibrateCirclePad
functions.signature: int Hid_CalibrateCirclePad(u16* out, u16* raw, int arg3, int b, int deadzone, int scale)
functions.summary: Converts raw circle-pad samples to calibrated signed axis values: applies the per-axis min/max calibration (from the calibration blob at 0x11A8xx), clamps to the dead-zone and writes the two results to *out.

functions.name: Hid_ReadCalibratedPad
functions.signature: u32 Hid_ReadCalibratedPad(u32 reader, u32* outState, int count, u8* arg4, u8* b, u8* c)
functions.summary: Reads one pad sample from the HID reader and applies the stored calibration: it acquires the pad state, scales the raw analogue values through the calibration block and writes the normalised result to outState.

functions.name: maybe_Hid_ThumbReader
functions.summary: Mis-seeded Thumb entry inside the HID reader: the real prologue is before this address, so the decoded body (Ghidra's literal 'return 0x4C') is not the function. The surrounding code reads HID shared memory and 0x11AD3C is the pad reader.

functions.name: Mem_PoolInit
functions.summary: Initialises a pool descriptor once: initialises its four sub-buffer entries, sets the initialised flag, clears the count and installs the sentinel begin/end pointers.

functions.name: Container_ListAppend
functions.summary: Appends a node to an intrusive list: splices it after the current tail (0x11AE18) and patches the list head/tail (0x11FE24).

functions.name: Snd_Channel_Release
functions.summary: Releases one channel object: unlinks and frees its parameter list, recomputes the volume/pan of each remaining sub-voice, and returns all recycled list nodes to the pool.

functions.name: Snd_ChannelList_ReinsertByPriority
functions.summary: Moves a channel between the mixer's priority buckets: unlinks it from the channel list and re-links it under the bucket index derived from its volume+pan priority byte, saturated to the eight priority levels.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_CalcVolumePan
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_CalcVolumePan(SndChannel* channel, unsigned int left, unsigned int distance, int distance2)
functions.summary: Reconstructed 3D sound attenuation: computes the listener-to-source distance from the channel's position fields, compares the squared distance against the roll-off range and derives the left/right volume pair written through the two out pointers; also advances the channel's sub-voice state.

functions.name: maybe_Hid_NormalizeCirclePad
functions.signature: int maybe_Hid_NormalizeCirclePad(int axisX, int max, int axisY, int value)
functions.summary: Circle-pad vector normalisation: subtracts the deadzone from one axis, builds the squared magnitude with the other axis, takes the integer square root (0x11CD80) and scales both components by 0x80, writing the two s16 results through caller registers and returning the radius.

functions.name: maybe_Mem_PoolInitFragment
functions.summary: Mis-seeded Thumb entry decoded inside the pool-initialiser routine: the body is character-for-character the Mem_PoolInit prologue (four sub-buffer inits, the f_59 flag, the sentinel pointers), so it is a duplicate fragment rather than a function of its own.

functions.name: maybe_Hid_SetVibration
functions.summary: Programs a vibration pattern: keeps the larger of the two float arguments at +0xB8 and the other at +0xBC, stores the pattern at +0xC0 and zeroes the phase counter at +0xC4; 0x11CBD4 snaps both floats to the hardware range.

functions.name: Snd_QueueCommandBuffer
functions.signature: void Snd_QueueCommandBuffer(CommandBuffer* self, u32 size, u32 flags, int* out)
functions.summary: Reserves `size` words in a command ring, links the new command node into the submit queue, bumps the sequence number and advances the write pointer (wrapping at the ring end).

functions.name: maybe_Os_EnsureInitialized
functions.summary: Placeholder: Ghidra marks this address `missing_function` and no readable body exists, so nothing about the function is known beyond the first pass's guess. The name is kept only so the address stays covered.

functions.name: Snd_QueueObjectCommand
functions.summary: Queues a type-9 sound command carrying the value from the target object's vtable slot +0x20 plus a caller-supplied subtype byte, links it into the engine's command chain and returns the sequence number.

functions.name: Gfx_LoadDefaultState
functions.summary: Writes the renderer's complete default GPU state: a long list of (register, value) pairs for the PICA200 pipeline (texture units, combiners, depth, fog, lighting, stencil), plus 0x100-byte and 0xE00-byte coefficient tables allocated from the frame heap and 0xBD per-channel lookup entries.

functions.name: Gfx_UpdateTextureBindings
functions.summary: Rebuilds the 16-slot texture binding table from the render state: for each slot it either points at the default texture record, marks the slot dirty, or resolves the current texture through 0x123458 and records its address/size, handling the 0x1400/0x1401/0x1406/0x140B format classes.

functions.name: maybe_Mem_FreeThroughCallback
functions.summary: Releases one heap block through the registered deallocator: if the global slot at 0x7AE9FC is non-null it clears the slot and calls it with (0,0,0,0,0,block), then tail-calls 0x11CC28. The container destructor 0x11EE0C calls it on its two heap members, which is what identifies it as a free.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdCopyTexture
functions.summary: Dispatch stub for command-list type 0: forwards the recorded parameters to 0x11F12C, which builds the texture-copy GPU command.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBlitTexture
functions.summary: Dispatch stub for command-list type 3: forwards to 0x11F518, which builds the textured-blit GPU command.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdUploadTexture
functions.summary: Dispatch stub for command-list type 1: forwards to 0x11F21C, which builds the texture upload/fill GPU command.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdSetTextureRegion
functions.summary: Dispatch stub for command-list type 4: forwards to 0x11F35C, which builds the texture-region/format GPU command.

functions.name: Os_QueueTryPop
functions.signature: unsigned int Os_QueueTryPop(OsQueue* queue, unsigned int* out)
functions.summary: Non-blocking pop: if the ring holds an entry it copies the value out, advances the read index (wrapping), decrements the count and signals the producer; returns 1 on success and 0 when empty.

functions.name: Os_QueueTryPush
functions.signature: unsigned int Os_QueueTryPush(OsQueue* queue, unsigned int value)
functions.summary: Non-blocking push: stores the value at the write index when the ring is not full, advances the index (wrapping), bumps the count and signals the consumer; returns 1/0.

functions.name: Os_QueuePopBlocking
functions.summary: Blocking pop: waits on the queue's semaphore until an entry is available, then pops it exactly like 0x11C8E0 and returns the value.

functions.name: Mem_PoolAllocNode
functions.summary: Pops one node off the object pool's free list (pool+0x24), increments the live count (pool+0x2C) under the pool monitor (pool+0x30) and, when the pool flag bit 0 is set, relocates the node into the pool window via 0x00118B28; returns NULL when the pool is exhausted.

functions.name: Game_GetDataManager
functions.summary: One-shot lazy creation of the process-wide game-data context that owns the master tables (monsters, items, text, maps); every 0x63xxxx table lookup takes it as its first argument.

functions.name: Os_ThreadEntry
functions.summary: Entry point of every created thread: sets up the thread-local storage, calls the two function pointers the thread was started with (start->callback(start->arg) then start->main(arg)), runs the thread-local destructors, and finishes with svcExitThread (svc 9).

functions.name: std_memmove_backward
functions.signature: void std_memmove_backward(void* dst_end, const void* src_end, u32 size)
functions.summary: newlib memmove's backward copy path: moves size bytes from src_end-size to dst_end-size, copying 16-byte blocks then 8/4/2/1-byte tails, for overlapping ranges where dst > src.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CallNoOpStub
functions.summary: Thunk that calls 0x115E68 with argument 0. 0x115E68 is an empty 8-byte function (`mov r0,r0; bx lr`), so this is a call to a no-op/default implementation - the old 'FinalizeSubsystem' reading is not supported by the body.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_Init
functions.summary: Constructor of an open-addressing hash map: stores the vtable, seeds the three bucket heads with the 0xfffff000 empty sentinel and default-constructs the 31 initial 8-byte slots.

functions.name: maybe_Os_IpcCmd0863
functions.summary: Sends the fixed command 0x0863 (header 0x08630000: no normal and no translated parameters) on the session in *handle, and on success copies the reply word at TLS+0x88 to *out and returns the status word at TLS+0x84.

functions.name: maybe_Os_GetCurrentThreadHandle
functions.summary: Replaces *out with a thread handle queried through command 0x0B on the driver session, closing the previous handle with svc 0x23 (svcCloseHandle) first and aborting through 0x0011ED40 when the query fails.

functions.name: maybe_Os_ComputeDeadline
functions.signature: void maybe_Os_ComputeDeadline(float* now, u32* base, u32* out, u32 request)
functions.summary: Converts the current system tick and a packed timeout field into a 64-bit deadline using the 1e6 scaling constants shared with the save worker.

functions.name: maybe_Os_ScanParamBlocks
functions.summary: Fallback scan for a parameter entry: reads sixteen 0x40-byte blocks from offset 0x400 through Os_ReadChunkedTable, looks for a word whose low byte is 0xFE, unpacks the two 12-bit fields and the two payload words into out and returns 0; returns 0xC8810FEF when nothing matches.

functions.name: maybe_Os_IpcSession_PollAsyncState
functions.summary: Polls the driver session at 0x007B2D08: reads the state bytes of the object at session+0xC, returns 0 or one of 0xF9610C02 / 0xC8A10C01 / 0xC8A10C0D / 0xC8810FEF depending on the state and pending counter, and re-issues command 0x19 when the counter is positive.

functions.name: Hid_ApplyDeadzone
functions.summary: Turns raw circle-pad axis shorts into direction bits: scales both axes by 0x28/0x91, compares them with the dead-zone at 0x0011E548+0x20 and ORs the up/down/left/right masks (0x01000000..0x08000000) into the button word.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Ir_CloseService
functions.summary: Closes the shared ir:USER session opened by 0x00122200: sends the 0x00020000 close command, closes the shared-memory handle, releases the session handle, unmaps the shared memory and clears the open flag.

functions.name: maybe_Os_WaitSemaphore
functions.summary: Counted semaphore wait with owner hand-off: while the counter is negative it decrements and arbitrates through 0x11CC10, and when the count turns positive it flips the sign back and returns; the positive branch flips the sign and returns immediately.

functions.name: Mem_MapPages
functions.signature: int Mem_MapPages(MemPageBlock* block, unsigned int size, unsigned char flags)
functions.summary: Allocates a page-aligned range for the block (Mem_AllocAddressRange) and maps it with svcMapMemoryBlock (svc 0x1F), recording the flags and marking +0x18 mapped.

functions.name: Os_ListRemoveNode
functions.summary: Unlinks a node from an intrusive circular list under the list lock and clears the node's links and payload words.

functions.name: Os_MapSharedMemory
functions.signature: void Os_MapSharedMemory(OsSharedMem* mem, u32 addr, u32 size, u32 mode, u32 perm)
functions.summary: Registers a shared-memory mapping on a descriptor: if the descriptor has no mapping yet and addr/size are 0x1000-aligned it asks the OS for the mapped address (0x0011126C), stores the handle at +0x14, the address at +8 and the size at +0xC, and raises the assert path 0x00118100 on failure. Ghidra dropped the mode/perm arguments, which the callers still pass.

functions.name: Os_CloseHandle
functions.summary: Closes a kernel handle: cancels the pending operation when one is armed (non-waiting handles just drop their state), notifies the owner (0x1181A8) and finally closes the handle with `svc 0x23`.

functions.name: Os_CloseHandleSimple
functions.summary: Closes a handle word and resets it to the 'empty' sentinel; returns the old handle or the 'nothing to do' code.

functions.name: maybe_Ipc_OpenSessionAndSend
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Ipc_OpenSessionAndSend(unsigned int* handleOut, unsigned int name, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4, int value, unsigned int flags, int third)
functions.summary: Opens the service session stored at *handleOut on first use (name resolution 0x0011CCA0 + create 0x001192C0), then either packs three range checks into the handle word (flags bit 0x20000) or sends the request through the shared command path 0x0011EAB4 while holding the 0x007AEA10 semaphore. Returns the handle or an error code.

functions.name: maybe_Ipc_OpenSessionTailFragment
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ipc_OpenSessionTailFragment(int pad, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Not a real function entry: a Thumb fragment that Ghidra seeded mid-routine inside 0x0011E940. It repeats the session-open tail (lock 0x001180B0, send via 0x0011EAB4, signal 0x007AEA10) and the 0x01000000/0x08000000/0x04000000 range masks, with unaff_/in_ registers for everything else.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_IpcCmd1100C2
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Svc_IpcCmd1100C2(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Sends command 0x1100C2 on the global session object 0x007AEA00 after taking the 0x007AEA10 semaphore (waiting in 0x0011CC94) and releases it afterwards; returns 0xC8A0A7FC when the session is not connected.

functions.name: Svc_IpcCmd70040
functions.summary: Minimal IPC stub: header 0x00070040 (command 0x07, one normal parameter), session handle taken from *session, svc 0x32, reply word returned.

functions.name: Svc_IpcCmd1100C2Read
functions.signature: int Svc_IpcCmd1100C2Read(int* session, u32 arg2, int b, u16 c, u16 d, u8* out)
functions.summary: Sends command 0x11 with three normal and two translated parameters (header 0x001100C2) and copies the reply byte at TLS+0x88 to *out; returns the reply word at TLS+0x84.

functions.name: Svc_IpcCmd20040
functions.signature: int Svc_IpcCmd20040(int* session, u16 value, u8* out)
functions.summary: Sends command 0x02 with one normal parameter (header 0x00020040) and copies the reply byte at TLS+0x88 to *out.

functions.name: Svc_IpcCmdD0082
functions.signature: u32 Svc_IpcCmdD0082(u32* session, u32 firstWord, u32 bufferAddress, int size)
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x0D with two normal and two translated parameters (header 0x000D0082): packs count<<14|0x402 as the translated-buffer descriptor, stores the address and count, sends svc 0x32 and returns the reply word.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_IpcCmd20
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Snd_IpcCmd20(unsigned int* session, unsigned char value)
functions.summary: Sends command 0x0020 (header 0x00200040, one translated parameter) on the session handle passed in and returns the reply word. Both call sites are the channel-flush pair (0x00118788, 0x0011ECC0), which pass the handle stored at 0x007AEA00+8 - the same context the unit-flag setter uses.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_SendIpcBuffer
functions.signature: int maybe_Snd_SendIpcBuffer(unsigned int* session, unsigned int value, unsigned int zero, unsigned int address, unsigned short size, unsigned short* outSize)
functions.summary: Submits a buffer descriptor: header 0x001000C0 (command 0x10, three normal parameters), then it temporarily overwrites the thread's two translated-descriptor words at +0x180 with size<<14|2 and the address, sends svc 0x32, restores both words and copies the reported size back.

functions.name: Svc_IpcCmdC0040
functions.signature: int Svc_IpcCmdC0040(int* session, u32 value, u32* out)
functions.summary: Sends command 0x0C with one normal parameter (header 0x000C0040) and copies the reply word at TLS+0x88 to *out.

functions.name: Svc_IpcCmd10040
functions.signature: int Svc_IpcCmd10040(int* session, u16 value, u16* out)
functions.summary: Sends command 0x10 with one normal parameter (header 0x00100040) and copies the reply halfword at TLS+0x88 to *out.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_FlushChannelsOnStop
functions.summary: The 'stop' entry of the channel flush: clears the active byte at 0x7AEA00, and if a flush is pending submits the final unit configuration (0x11E9C4), runs the eight registered callbacks of the table at 0x7E7998, clears the pending byte and sends the session command 0x20.

functions.name: Svc_SendRequestBuffer128
functions.summary: IPC request with a 0x80-byte inline payload: copies the caller's buffer into the thread command block after the 0x10800 header and issues svc 0x32, returning the reply word.

functions.name: Mem_HeapAlloc
functions.signature: void* Mem_HeapAlloc(MemHeap* heap, unsigned int size, unsigned int alignment, unsigned int low, unsigned int high, unsigned int flags)
functions.summary: General heap allocation used by the whole game: forwards the request bounds to the allocator, carves a block with the requested size/alignment and counts the live allocation.

functions.name: Container_ObjectDtor
functions.summary: Base-class destructor of the refcounted object family: installs the base vtable, releases the two heap-owned members at +0x0C and +0x10 through the registered deallocator 0x11C814, then walks the singly linked node list at +0x10 clearing each node's two words, and returns self.

functions.name: Snd_UpdateChannelState
functions.summary: Commits one sound channel's pending updates: each dirty bit (matrix, gain, mode, loop points, ADPCM parameters, wave data) calls the matching Snd_SetChannel* writer, then recomputes the mix command size and clears the dirty mask.

functions.name: Gfx_SetTextureSource
functions.signature: void Gfx_SetTextureSource(u32 handle, u32 src, u32 size, u32 format, int flags)
functions.summary: Builds and queues a GPU texture-source command: fills a 0x1C-byte record with type 0, handle, source address/size, format word and flags, then pushes it through 0x123360.

functions.name: Gfx_SetTextureSourcePair
functions.signature: void Gfx_SetTextureSourcePair(u32 handle, u32 src, u32 size, u16 x, u32 arg5, u32 b, u32 c, u16 y)
functions.summary: Builds and queues a two-coordinate GPU texture command (record type 2) with the handle, source/size and the two 16-bit coordinates, then calls 0x123360.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetTextureFill
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetTextureFill(u32 src, u32 size, int enable, u32 color)
functions.summary: Queues PICA200 surface commands on the GPU message queue at 0x007B0070+0x58: optionally a type-5 record carrying the source/size, then a type-1 record with the fill colour.

functions.name: Gfx_SetTextureRegion
functions.signature: void Gfx_SetTextureRegion(u32 handle, u32 src, u32 size, u32 x0, int y0, u32 x1, int y1, u32 fmt)
functions.summary: Queues a rectangular texture-region command (record type 4): packs the two 16-bit coordinate pairs and the format word into the 0x1C-byte record and calls 0x123360.

functions.name: maybe_Engine_IpcWorker
functions.summary: Worker thread body of the 0x34-byte IPC request ring initialised by 0x00119498: waits on the worker event, pops one record (with an exclusive-access index update), dispatches it through the callback table at worker+0x10 and, for record type 1, signals the waiting thread; exits when the stop byte at worker+0x77 is set.

functions.name: Gfx_SetTextureBlit
functions.signature: void Gfx_SetTextureBlit(u32 handle, u32 dst, int x, u32 src, u32 size, int y, u32 fmt)
functions.summary: Queues a textured blit command (record type 3) with handle, destination, source/size and two 16-bit coordinates, then calls 0x123360.

functions.name: Os_QueryTime
functions.signature: void Os_QueryTime(OsTime* out, u32 arg2, int mode)
functions.summary: Queries the current system time into eight words, then normalises the packed date flags: empty fields become -1 and the flag bits are split out of the values.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_IpcCmd17
functions.summary: Parameterless IPC request with the 0x0017xxxx command header (Ghidra printed the literal as an address into 0x00170000): writes the header into the thread command buffer, sends it with svc 0x32 and returns the response word.

functions.name: maybe_Os_IpcCmd08
functions.signature: uint32_t maybe_Os_IpcCmd08(uint32_t* session, uint32_t word1, uint32_t word2, uint32_t word3)
functions.summary: Generic IPC request helper: fills TLS+0x80 with header 0x00080082 (command 0x08, two normal + two translated words), stores the three payload words, issues svc 0x32 and returns the TLS+0x84 reply.

functions.name: Gfx_IpcCmd1A0000
