functions.summary: Second target-count helper: counts units in the four battle groups plus the ally container that match the action's target mode (vtable+0xac, values 0/1) and are selectable, excluding units with state 10. Used to size/validate target lists.

functions.name: Battle_QueueGroupAction
functions.summary: Builds a combined action for up to four party units - first pass prefers units that are active and not already acting, second pass fills the rest - and inserts it at the current action index with action id 0x2D through Battle_InsertActionSlot.

functions.name: Battle_QueueAbilityAction
functions.signature: void Battle_QueueAbilityAction(BattleManager* self, uint32_t arg2, BattleAction* action)
functions.summary: Queues a spell/skill action: reads the ability id (vtable+0x7c), resolves its data through 0x18C184, copies the data flags to the unit, then chooses the action id from the ability's category byte (+0x298: 6,7,8,9,10,0xb) or the default 0x1f/0x20. Also emits the special 0x30/0x31/0x32/0x2e variants for healing/revive/status abilities.

functions.name: Battle_QueueAbilityActionVariant
functions.signature: void Battle_QueueAbilityActionVariant(BattleManager* self, uint32_t not, BattleAction* action)
functions.summary: Queues the action for an ability record from the second ability table (0x0018C1B8): resolves the ability id through vtable +0x78, applies the record to the unit and queues action 4 or 5 depending on record byte +0xEB, falling back to 0x25/0x26 for invalid records.

functions.name: Battle_ResetLineupState
functions.summary: Resets the battle line-up bookkeeping (counters f_c0/f_c4/f_cc/f_d0/f_d4/f_d8/f_dc/f_e0 to 0xffff/0, flags f_f2/f_129, f_148) and then calls 0x16D438 to (re)spawn the unit entry effects. Used when the battle line-up changes or a battle is initialised.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_NotifyInit
functions.summary: Sends initialization event type 1 to the gimmick controller state machine at +0xE4 if non-null.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UpdateActionScene
functions.summary: Presentation state machine for the current battle action: driven by the state word at +0x134 (0xB0F/0xB43/0xB47 sentinels) it waits for the acting unit to become idle, spawns the hit effect at the unit's node, picks the model/animation by unit id and advances the camera/scene state; returns 1 while frames are still needed.

functions.name: Battle_CheckUnitsCondition
functions.signature: int Battle_CheckUnitsCondition(BattleManager* self, uint32_t mode, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Battle-condition query used by the state machine: mode 4 compares the two values, mode 5 asks the world, mode 6/7 require every unit in the four groups to pass a state test, mode 8 returns the world flag at +0x4252.

functions.name: Battle_QueueUnitListAction
functions.signature: void Battle_QueueUnitListAction(BattleManager* self, uint32_t arg2, BattleUnit** outUnits)
functions.summary: Collects up to eight targetable units from the +0x4260 list (active, allowed to act, no disabled state 8/10) into the caller's array and queues action 0x2F with the source unit computed by 0x0016815C.

functions.name: Battle_HasPendingAction
functions.signature: u32 Battle_HasPendingAction(Battle * battle, ActionRecord * record, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Scans the staging action array from the current index for a record belonging to the given actor whose action id is still valid, and reports whether one exists.

functions.name: Battle_SelectActionTargets
functions.signature: int Battle_SelectActionTargets(BattleManager* self, BattleUnit** out, int groupIndex, uint32_t arg4, uint32_t arg5)
functions.summary: Chooses the concrete target(s) of an action: dispatches on the action's target-mode virtual +0xa4 (single, one group, all, self, random) and range checks via +0xb0, then fills out[8..] with the selected unit pointers and returns the count. This is the routine behind every 'who gets hit' decision.

functions.name: Battle_CollectGroupTargets
functions.signature: uint32_t Battle_CollectGroupTargets(BattleManager* self, BattleAction* action, BattleUnit* source, int groupIndex)
functions.summary: Collects the units of one group (work+0x428C + groupIndex*0x1C) that match the source's target mode (unit vtable+0x10/+0x18) into action+0x20 and returns their count; when the group's first unit is valid it becomes the action's primary target, and with no primary target the walk repeats over all four groups.

functions.name: Battle_FinishBattleScene
functions.summary: Shuts down the battle presentation: tells the battle scene object to hide/animate out, creates its closing popup, calls the scene vtable+0x2C and closes the battle target window.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_DetachCurrentActor
functions.summary: Calls the current battle actor's vtable+0x28 (a no-argument teardown slot) and hides the battle target window at battleWork+0x431C. Called at the start of BattleScene_AttachPrimaryUnitModels, i.e. it detaches the previous actor presentation before the models are re-attached; it touches no scene state.

functions.name: Battle_UpdateActorModels
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the battle scene's actor-model set (Event_ActorModels_Update on the set at self+0x35C with the frame counter at self+0x304); when the battle work has a current actor (+0x4320) whose +0x404 byte is set, it also pushes state 8 into the object at self+0xE4 through vtable+0x14. Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SetControllerState8
functions.summary: When the battle scene object at (work+8)->+0x5C +0x4320 exists and its +0x404 flag is set, switches the manager's controller (f_E4 vtable +0x14) to state 8 and returns 1; otherwise returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ScanUnitIntro
functions.summary: Battle presentation scan at state 0xBF5: walks the battle groups/units, tests each unit with func_00632694 and vtable+0xE8(status), and pushes a message for status ids 8 and 0x90 while advancing the group cursor; finishes after group 4.

functions.name: Battle_SelectTargetsThunk
functions.summary: Register-preserving thunk to Battle_SelectActionTargets, used where the caller has already placed the arguments in r0-r4.

functions.name: Battle_QueueCommandMenuEntries
functions.summary: Builds the command entries the battle menu consumes: for every valid unit of the party list, the all-unit list and the four group lists it pushes action 0x28 (row) and 0x33 (group header) with a descending priority starting at 100 (0x557/0x55C for the group variant).

functions.name: Battle_RebuildUnitActions
functions.signature: void Battle_RebuildUnitActions(Battle * battle, ActionRecord * record, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Rebuilds the staging action array: copies it to the backup, clears the staging copy, then removes every record whose key equals the given actor (clearing its five sub-records and decreasing the live count) and compacts the remaining non-empty records upwards.

functions.name: Battle_QueueCommand0x00
functions.summary: Pushes battle command 0: when the unit's vtable +0xE8 reports state 0x7D the same entry is pushed twice (the following action lands one slot later), otherwise once; the turn-order priority is computed identically for both.

functions.name: Battle_BuildTargetSlots
functions.summary: Fills one of the battle's 16-byte target-slot records with the units that satisfy the current action's target pattern: it iterates all four groups, computes each unit's remaining HP/effect amount through 0x495E04/0x490994/0x488638/0x491E3C, sets the selection flags (bit 1 = invalid, 2 = dead, 4/8/0x10 = status), and writes the chosen pattern index into the slot. Called from the attack sequence (0x173CD0/0x173D04).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_BuildTargetSlots_Continuation
functions.summary: Not a function: the second half of Battle_BuildTargetSlots (0x001723E8). The prologue at 0x001723E8 pushes {r0,r4-r8,sb,sl,fp,lr} and reserves 0x560 bytes of stack, and nothing pops before 0x00172698; the code here keeps using that frame (sp+0x550, live r4/r5) and the real epilogue is at 0x00172EC4. Ghidra split the function at this address, so the 'dispatch table' reading and the halt_baddata body are both artefacts.

functions.name: Battle_BuildTargetSlotsForCommand
functions.signature: uint32_t Battle_BuildTargetSlotsForCommand(BattleManager* self, BattleAction* action, BattleUnit** out, int groupIndex, int mode, uint8_t arg6, char* arg7)
functions.summary: Same target-slot construction as Battle_BuildTargetSlots but scoped to one group and command mode (4/5/other): it runs the ability/item range test, sets the per-unit selection flags, then dispatches the resulting table through 0x100906 with a pattern-specific callback (g_001734c4..d4).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_AreAllUnitsDefeated
functions.signature: uint32_t maybe_Battle_AreAllUnitsDefeated(uint32_t arg1, void* target, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when `target` is in status 0x9A and no live battle unit (vtable +0x10 == 0) in the 4x26 lists at +0x428C is in status 0x9B.

functions.name: Battle_SelectTargetsMode8
functions.signature: void Battle_SelectTargetsMode8(Battle* battle, u32 arg2, u32 group, u32 output)
functions.summary: Mode-8 target-selection entry: forwards to Battle_SelectActionTargets(battle, out, groupIndex, 8) and then default-constructs the four 8-byte target descriptors with the 0x005906C0 constructor. Reached only through the mode table at 0x00726B18 (no direct callers).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SelectCommandTarget
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_SelectCommandTarget(void * action, u32 u32, u32 u322)
functions.summary: Picks the default target for a battle command: switches on commandId (1, 0x27, 0x39, 0x3D, 0x43, 0x44, 0x45, 0x47, 0x4A, 0x4E), walks the command's unit group and stores the first accepted unit into action+0x20.

functions.name: Battle_SelectTargetsMode6
functions.signature: void Battle_SelectTargetsMode6(uint32_t self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, BattleUnit** out)
functions.summary: Thin wrapper that selects targets with fixed target-mode 6 (all-enemies style) via Battle_SelectActionTargets(0x170D4C).

functions.name: Battle_QueueFirstUnitAction
functions.summary: Finds the first active unit in the four group lists and queues action 0x55E for it through a small descriptor, returning immediately after the first match.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UpdateStateCallbacks
functions.signature: uint32_t maybe_Battle_UpdateStateCallbacks(BattleManager* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Dispatches the manager's per-state callbacks on the phase byte (+0x2F0): vtable +0x1A4 when both phase counters agree, +0x1A0 for state +0x103 and +0x19C for state 3.

functions.name: Battle_SelectTargetsMode2
functions.signature: void Battle_SelectTargetsMode2(uint32_t self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, BattleUnit** out)
functions.summary: Thin wrapper selecting targets with fixed target-mode 2 (single-target) through Battle_SelectActionTargets.

functions.name: Battle_WriteActionSlot
functions.signature: void Battle_WriteActionSlot(BattleManager* self, BattleAction* action, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4, int subIndex, uint8_t arg6)
functions.summary: Non-shifting sibling of Battle_InsertActionSlot: writes an action descriptor directly into the current action slot (f_124) and sub-record `subIndex` without moving the other slots. Used when the state machine fills a slot that was already reserved.

functions.name: Battle_SelectTargetsMode5
functions.signature: void Battle_SelectTargetsMode5(uint32_t self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, BattleUnit** out)
functions.summary: Thin wrapper selecting targets with fixed target-mode 5 (single ally / all allies) through Battle_SelectActionTargets.

functions.name: Battle_SelectTargetsMode4
functions.signature: void Battle_SelectTargetsMode4(uint32_t self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, BattleUnit** out)
functions.summary: Thin wrapper selecting targets with fixed target-mode 4 (self) through Battle_SelectActionTargets.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_StartActionSequence
functions.summary: Starts the visual/sequence part of an attack or ability action: resets the effect/track objects, picks the first non-empty battle group and a random unit, then drives the model animation list and sets the state to the 'running' constant when done.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UpdateActionSequence
functions.summary: Continuation of the battle action-sequence state machine: the state at self[0x4D] starts at 0xB7B, scans the four battle unit lists (+0x428C) for the first non-empty one, picks a random unit through the battle RNG, sets the primary target self[0x51] and drives the target/hit stages, finally moving the unit's secondary state machine (+0x14) to 5/6/7.

functions.name: Battle_SpawnResultPopupEntry
functions.summary: Battle-end step: on the first call (timer f_134 = 0xBBB) it branches on the battle result code f_128 - code 1 builds the result descriptor and posts it through Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnActorSpanEntry, code 2 additionally sets f_f9 first. Both branches post the same popup entry.

functions.name: Battle_FinishCommandPhase
functions.summary: Closes the command phase: confirms the unit commands (0x0016C740), rebuilds every group unit's descriptor, clears the action slots, then moves the battle actor to state 8 or 3 depending on vtable+0x18C and the self[0x4A]/+0xF6 flags. Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ClearActionSlots
functions.summary: Resets the four 0x58-byte slot records at self+0x150 (zeroing the id/flag words and clearing the 0x38-byte tail) and then refills one slot per active party member through Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionSlots.

functions.name: Battle_CheckUnitCommandCondition
functions.summary: Looks up which of the four stored command slots (f_fd, f_100, f_103, f_106) matches the given command id and evaluates its condition via Battle_CheckUnitsCondition(0x170A0C) with the slot's two parameters. Returns the last evaluated result.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CollectActionTargets
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_CollectActionTargets(Battle* battle, u32 arg2, u32** selection)
functions.summary: Takes the 8-slot target-marker selection array: spawns the primary entry's action effect (vtable+0x80 + Gfx_Scene_SpriteCtx_Init + Actor_SpawnEffectBlock), collects up to four further units whose data id (+0x768) differs from the primary's into slots 1..4, computes the minimum Battle_CalcTurnOrderPriority over them and pushes the command-queue entries (event ids 0x11/0x12/0x13/0x32).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RebuildUnitActionsFromSlot
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_RebuildUnitActionsFromSlot(Battle* battle, void* record, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Copies the battle action staging table into the live table: for each unit it reproduces five 0x8C-byte action slots (fields +0x68..+0x7E, the 0x88.. words and +0x2C0..+0x2C6) from battle->f_E8 into battle->f_EC, then clears and compacts entries of the live table.

functions.name: maybe_Field_UpdateEffectSlots
functions.summary: Walks the 0x50x5 field slot table at self+0xE8 and, for each live slot (state 1..0x19, flags set), either dispatches the slot callback or retires it through Ui_CmdQueue_PushWidgetCommand.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_TriggerEvent4
functions.summary: Dispatches event type 4 to the gimmick controller state machine at +0xE4.

functions.name: maybe_SlotTable_CommitAndRetire
functions.signature: void maybe_SlotTable_CommitAndRetire(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Commits the 0x50x5 slot table: clears the +0x2B0..+0x2EC bookkeeping words, copies every 0x2C8-byte row (5 sub-slots of 0x8C) from f_E8 to f_EC, resets the copied source rows to -1 sentinels/state 6, then retires committed rows whose member is in state +0xE4==5 or whose state byte at +0xB108 is 7 or 8.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseSubObjects
functions.summary: Releases the two optional child objects at +0xE8 and +0xEC and clears the pointers (each freed with the engine deleter 0x10F69C).

functions.name: Battle_InitUnitActionArrays
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises the two 80-record action tables (0x2c8 bytes each): every record gets five cleared 0x8c-byte per-member sub-records with the empty-action sentinel 0xffffffff and the default state (6/0/1).

functions.name: Battle_PurgeStaleActors
functions.signature: void Battle_PurgeStaleActors(Battle * battle, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Walks the actor list at +0x110 and drops every entry whose vtable slot +0x30 reports 'finished' or whose action id is no longer valid, unlinking it through vtable slot +0xc.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ReleaseSubObject
functions.summary: Releases the optional sub-object at +0xE4: calls its vtable slot +8 (stop) and then slot +0xC(obj, 0) (reset/clear). Called only from window/menu teardown paths.

functions.name: Battle_QueueCommand0x16
functions.signature: void Battle_QueueCommand0x16(void* queue, u32* action, u32* out)
functions.summary: Pushes battle command 0x16: same body as 0x00169D1C but with the byte table at 0x00175C18, deriving two flag words and appending through Battle_CommandQueue_PushEntry with mode 7.

functions.name: Battle_CheckCommandCondition
functions.summary: Evaluates the battle manager's stored command: for command id 2 it answers the fallback flag f_F3, otherwise it asks Battle_CheckUnitsCondition(self, f_106, f_108, f_107) and answers 1 on success or f_F3 when the check fails.

functions.name: Battle_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle object: installs the vtable pair at +0/+0xb4, empties the actor list at +0x10c/+0x110, sets the 'no actor' sentinel and default-constructs the four 0x58-byte slot records at +0x150.

functions.name: Battle_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor of the battle manager: reinstalls the base vtable, destroys the optional child dispatcher at self[0x39], frees the command list through Battle_FreeCommandList and unlinks the manager from its owner's doubly linked list.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SetMode
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_SetMode(void* battle, int* action, u32 mode, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Notifies the game-data manager (0x0063CDA0) and then calls the action object's vtable slot +0x54. The switch on the mode value has six cases that are all empty in the readable C, so the per-mode work is unverified and only the dispatch shape is known.

functions.name: Event_TriggerListenerCallback
functions.signature: void Event_TriggerListenerCallback(u32 context, int* listener, u32 eventId)
functions.summary: Evaluates event state for eventId via func_0018C184 and invokes virtual callback +0x54 on listener if flag is set.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SetDistanceRate
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_SetDistanceRate(void* battle, int* action, u32 distance)
functions.summary: Converts a distance into a rate (distance / action->vtable+0x94, times 100.0f), scans the eight 0xC-byte float ranges returned by 0x0063CDA0 for the band containing it, then calls the action's vtable slot +0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UpdateUnitCommandSlots
functions.summary: Calls vtable +0x1C on every active party member (battle work +0x4260 list), refreshes a data-manager table (func_0063CDA0) and then calls the unit's vtable +0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_FinalizeUnitAction
functions.summary: Before finishing a unit's turn (vtable +0x54) it compares two record bytes (+0xDE/+0xE0) and rolls the battle RNG when they differ; in the extra phase it updates the data-manager record instead.

functions.name: maybe_Game_GetDataRowFloatField
functions.summary: Returns the float at +0xA0/+0xA4/+0xA8 (selected by index 0..2) of the first row of the data table reached through Game_GetDataManager()->f_0->f_81C, plus the float offset passed in s0; other indices return the raw default constant. Ghidra dropped the float return, so the readable C looks like a void query.

functions.name: Field_CheckZonePoint
functions.signature: uint64_t Field_CheckZonePoint(uint32_t arg1, FieldActor* actor, uint32_t arg3)
functions.summary: Tests whether an actor is inside a named field zone/trigger volume: compares the actor's current height/position against the zone's point list, walks the actor's zone links and returns a packed (string, bool) result whose string is 'ZONEFALSE'/'ZONETRUE'. Debug text mentions 'ZonePoint'.

functions.name: Ui_CampMenu_Setup
functions.signature: void Ui_CampMenu_Setup(UiCampMenu* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Builds the camp menu screen: creates the 'win_camp_main' and 'win_camp_text' layouts, links them into the root list, wires the pager (0x1DAA24) and sets the initial cursor/selection state.

functions.name: Ui_UpdateWindowClose
functions.signature: void Ui_UpdateWindowClose(UiWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Per-frame close step of a layout window: updates the layout animation pair, and when the layout reports open without the 'closing' bit set plays the close command (0xC or 0xB depending on the object variant) and sets the child flags; otherwise advances the command queue.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_UpdateWindowOpen
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_UpdateWindowOpen(UiWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Per-frame update slot of a window reached through vtable 0x00729A24: updates the child widget at self+0x2D8, advances the command queue at self+0x120 and, unless bit 2 of f_174 is set, pushes pane animation 99 when the child prompt reports its first choice confirmed (state byte self+0x320=4) or animation 100 otherwise (state byte=5).

functions.name: Ui_UpdateWindowState
functions.summary: State machine of a layout-backed window: dispatches on the sub-state from 0x632860 and either plays an SE and starts a layout animation, completes back to the parent window, or creates the child sub-object.

functions.name: Ui_UpdateWindowConfirm
functions.signature: void Ui_UpdateWindowConfirm(UiWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Confirm/cancel variant of the window tick: when the layout reports mode 1 and the stored event-command id at +0x320 is not -1 it triggers that command and sets the child flags; otherwise it advances the command queue.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_UpdateSubSlot
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_UpdateSubSlot(UiLayout* self, u32 p1, int p2)
functions.summary: Updates active sub-slot state and animates layout component transitions based on field 0x174 bitmask and slot index 0x15C.

functions.name: Ui_UpdateChildObject
functions.summary: Ticks the window's optional child object at +0x324. When the child reports done it is destroyed, the command queue is advanced and either event command 9 is triggered or the window plays animation 0x65; otherwise the child's own update virtual runs.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_TriggerEventCommand
functions.summary: Window step that fires a script event: ticks the widget at self+0x2D8 and, when it has finished, calls Event_OnTriggerCommand on the event state (work+8 -> +0x6C) with the command byte stored at self+0x320, then requests step 0x0D.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CreateScreenSystem
functions.summary: Constructor of a 0x328-byte field screen object: installs root vtable 0x7584E4 plus child vtables for a text-only window (0x759388), two UI objects (0x762028/0x761FC4) and a 0x1DB550 helper, and stores the owner/revision pair at +0x11C/+0x120.

functions.name: maybe_Field_DestroyNpcActionObject
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the large field NPC-action object: releases the child at +0x324, destroys the embedded message page and a chain of embedded sub-objects, then frees the block.

functions.name: Text_SetupDualLayers
functions.summary: Binds the two main and two null text layers (txt_l1, txt_l2, null_txt_l1, null_txt_l2) into a widget's text system.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NpcActionDestroyThunk
functions.summary: Two-call deleting thunk: destroys the embedded sub-object with the base destructor and frees the allocation.

functions.name: maybe_Field_InitNpcAction
functions.summary: Caches the speed at +0x2C, plays the NPC's action animation pair (packed literals 0x74736F4C / 0x0074754E) on the actor at +0x28 and sets its grid state to 2.

functions.name: Field_NpcUpdateMoveState
functions.summary: NPC movement-state update: once the actor has waited long enough it evaluates the tile under its position and sets movement state 0 (walk), 2 (blocked), 3 (slow) or 9 (turn).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_SetupVtable
functions.summary: Builds the NPC action object through Gfx_ObjectDesc_Ctor4, installs its class vtable 0x00758598 and clears the parameter word at +0x2C.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_DeleteSubComponent
functions.summary: Destroys and deallocates a layout sub-component by invoking its destructor func_00193E40 and calling operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Field_NpcCheckPlayerDistance
functions.summary: Checks whether the NPC is close enough to the player to start an action: runs the sight check (0x17843C), sets the actor to the 'aware' movement state 4, accumulates the distance accumulator f_30 and switches to movement state 2 once it exceeds g_0017785c.

functions.name: Field_SetupNpcActionScript
functions.summary: Builds an NPC action object from script data: reads the action, appear, disappear and notice tables, allocates the action entries and installs the NPC-action vtable.

functions.name: Field_SetupEnemyAi
functions.summary: Parses the enemy AI parameter tables into an actor: collision size, walk/stop and back-off rates, rush/chase speeds and wait/escape weights.

functions.name: Field_NpcCheckSight
functions.summary: NPC perception test: returns 1 when the actor can see the player (or another actor) this frame. It checks the actor's enable/awareness flags, distance, the view cone (Field_IsPointInActorViewCone at 0x178DD0) and, for actors with the 'group sight' bit, compares the nearest group member positions.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_FindEntry
functions.summary: Look up an entry by key and hash in the global hash map g_00178878, traversing collision bucket chains.

functions.name: Field_NpcMoveTowardTarget
functions.summary: Moves an NPC one step toward its current move target: clamps the direction vector to g_00178af4, asks the level collision system (0x2E7F08) whether the position is free, and sets movement state 1 (move) or 2 (blocked), with an extra 'path blocked' state 4 when the path object is active.

functions.name: Monster_SetupEcology
functions.signature: void Monster_SetupEcology(Actor* self, const void* ecoTable, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Applies monster ecology parameters to an actor: spawn/ecology chance plus main and sub colony setup from the ecoRn/ecoCh/ecoCoMain/ecoCoSub table entries.

functions.name: Field_IsPointInActorViewCone
functions.signature: u32 Field_IsPointInActorViewCone(Actor* self, float* point, int allowHeightCheck, int scaleRadius)
functions.summary: Tests whether a world point lies inside an actor's sight cone: it checks the height band (+0x308), the radius (+0x304, optionally scaled by +0x2FC), the angle against the facing vector using the cosine threshold at +0x300, and if everything matches queues an event through the 0x002E7F08 curve manager. Returns 1 when the point is visible.

functions.name: maybe_Map_RefreshLevelGrid
functions.summary: Cached-revision refresh: compares self->f_31C with the revision counter at 0x007A36E4+8 and, when they differ, rebuilds the shared 0x98-byte UI object and forwards the new revision to 0x0017C9E4(object+0x9C, self->f_31C), then stores it.

functions.name: Map_UpdateGridCallback
functions.summary: Trampoline callback that refreshes the current map-grid level instance with Map_UpdateGridInstance and returns 1 so the caller keeps it registered.

functions.name: Map_UpdateGridInstance
functions.summary: Refreshes the instance of the current level in a map grid: when the level revision changed it lazily creates the 0x98-byte grid object, resolves the level's placement record with Map_FindRecordById, asks the record for its transform (vtable +0x14), computes the object transform and submits it (vtable +8).

functions.name: Map_ComputeObjectTransform
functions.signature: void Map_ComputeObjectTransform(MapObject * obj, int mode, MapVec3 * outPos, MapVec3 * outDir)
functions.summary: Composes an object's world position and facing: copies its local position, looks up the referenced locator/rotation record, multiplies the two quaternions and optionally scales the result by the record's factor for mode 3.

functions.name: Field_ApplyNpcActionState
functions.signature: void Field_ApplyNpcActionState(Actor* self, const u8* state)
functions.summary: Copies a 12-byte NPC action state into the actor and dispatches on the action id: idle/run/wait use the movement helpers, while operation actions create opeJo/opeFr objects and send the matching actor notification.

functions.name: Field_NpcUpdateFacing
functions.signature: void Field_NpcUpdateFacing(NpcBehavior* self, int mode, uint32_t arg3)
functions.summary: NPC facing update: reads the world's 2D/3D mode (work+8 -> +0x3C values 1 and 4) and the extra flag at +0x44, sets or clears the two direction bytes f_36/f_37 of the actor at self+0x60, then forwards the command to the scene-node children.

functions.name: Map_PlaceObject
functions.summary: Places an object on the level grid: computes the two transforms with Map_ComputeObjectTransform, ensures the shared map service exists and inserts the instance through Map_AddInstance, storing the resulting node at object+0x31C.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SetEncounterParams
functions.summary: Assembles encounter/combat parameter block from actor state: parses strings 'shortRange' and 'battle'.

functions.name: Field_NpcPlayGesture
functions.summary: Plays the NPC's current gesture/emote: switches on the desired gesture byte (+0xaa) and creates the matching one-shot action object (gesture, sleep, ecstacy, mimic, frog-jump) with names taken from strings 'Gesture', 'Sleep', 'Ecstacy', 'Mimic', 'FrogJump'. Also resets the action state afterwards.

functions.name: Field_NpcPlayAnimation
functions.signature: void Field_NpcPlayAnimation(NpcBehavior* self, uint8_t animId, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Plays an animation on the NPC's linked actor: looks up the actor action record at the current table index/slot (+0x26c/+0x2b4) and forwards animId to the animation object's 0x28C7B4 setter.

functions.name: Field_NpcGetActionAnimId
functions.summary: Resolves the animation/action record for the NPC's current action slot and writes its id into out->f_C; when the table index is valid it advances the slot cursor (wrapping over the entry count) and reads the animation id.

functions.name: Field_ApplyMovementFlags
functions.signature: void Field_ApplyMovementFlags(Actor* self, u32 mode, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Writes an actor's movement mode and derived flags: selects walk/stop and back-off settings from the parameter table and updates the movement state.

functions.name: Field_NpcApplyActionResult
functions.summary: Applies the result code at +0x325 of a finished NPC action: result 1 runs the finish virtuals and sets movement state 2, result 2 runs the alternate finish and sets state 2 with the alternate flag.

functions.name: Field_NpcPlayActionAnim
functions.signature: void Field_NpcPlayActionAnim(FieldActor* actor, uint32_t primaryId, uint32_t fallbackId)
functions.summary: Plays the animation for an NPC action: if the actor has a gesture/action track (f_58/f_11c) and the named action exists (0x641628), uses primaryId, otherwise falls back to fallbackId. Both paths call the actor's vtable+0x84.

functions.name: Field_Npc_RemoveFromLinkedSlot
functions.signature: void Field_Npc_RemoveFromLinkedSlot(NpcBehavior* self, uint8_t animId, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: For NPC behaviour states 1/2, resolves the linked action slot (object at work+8->+0x4C, row f_26C, column f_2B4, stride 0x2AF*4 + 0x1C) and calls Actor_RemoveHandleFromSlots(slotObject, self, animId).

functions.name: Field_NpcApplyAction
functions.summary: Applies a parsed NPC action record: copies its 16 words (speed, animation, move flags, object ids) into the NPC object, resolves the animation object (0x2D71AC) and the action record for the current table (0x62D5DC/0x62D65C), and for flag 1 spawns the 'moveSt' action; for the paired record it spawns 'movePa'. Flag 0x40 ends the action.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NpcFinishAction
functions.summary: Field-scene-node virtual that ends an NPC action: for state bytes 1/2 it resolves the node's action slot through the game work and removes the node from the owner's handle slots (maybe_Actor_RemoveHandleFromSlots(record, node, 3)), then releases the node's effect slots unconditionally.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_AllocSlotNode
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_AllocSlotNode(u32 heap, int desc, u32 p3, u32 size)
functions.summary: Allocates a layout slot node using allocator func_00336A38 and initializes its circular link pointers and default attributes.

functions.name: Field_NpcActionDestroy
functions.summary: Destructor tail for the NPC action object: unlinks it from its intrusive list, runs the scene-object destructor and frees the block.

functions.name: Mem_ResizeRecordArray
functions.summary: Resizes the array's backing store to g_0017AF70 records of 8 bytes: frees the old buffer (0x10F69C), stores the capacity in +0xC and reallocates with 0x10F6EC(capacity*8, tag, 4).

functions.name: Container_SortRecordsAsc
functions.summary: Sorts the 8-byte record array at self+8 (count at self+0x10) in ascending order with the comparison function func_0071428C.

functions.name: Container_SortRecordsDesc
functions.summary: Sorts the 8-byte record array at self+8 in descending order with the comparison function func_007143A8.

functions.name: Shop_BuildFilteredItemList
functions.signature: void Shop_BuildFilteredItemList(ItemList* out, u32 actorId, int filterIndex)
functions.summary: Builds an 8-byte-per-entry item list for the given actor and filter: collects owned inventory items and current-area shop items whose ids fall in the item ranges and pass the selected filter callback.

functions.name: Shop_BuildFilteredItemListByParty
functions.signature: void Shop_BuildFilteredItemListByParty(ItemList* out, u32 actorId, int filterIndex)
functions.summary: Party-scoped variant of Shop_BuildFilteredItemList: filters the actor's own inventory and the area shop into the same 8-byte list format.

functions.name: Party_BuildActorIndex
functions.signature: u32* Party_BuildActorIndex(u32* out, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Builds the global actor-id -> party-slot reverse index at 0x007C6E7C: for slots 0..0x1E it reads the id from bag+i+4 and stores the slot under that id; also initialises the small output descriptor.

functions.name: Mem_FreeRecordArray
functions.summary: Destructor for the record array above: installs the released-state vtable, frees the backing store when present and returns the array.

functions.name: Model_GetFaceTableRow
functions.summary: Returns the 8-byte face-table row for a face index: runs the one-shot constructor guarded by 0x007A350C and returns 0x007C33E8 + index*8. It is the face-table twin of Svc_GetTableRow (0x001D5F74), which does the same for the frame table.

functions.name: Ui_FadeWindow_Setup
functions.summary: Builds the full-screen fade overlay: loads the 'win_fade' layout into the widget at self+0x138 (0x1D85EC) and starts its open animation (0x29126C with 1).

functions.name: Ui_Layout_ResetAnimSlot
functions.summary: Resets animation state for layout node by calling virtual method +0x2C on field 0x98 and clearing animation channel at +0x138.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_StopAllAnims
functions.summary: Stops active UI layout animations by calling animation controller helper func_0060E7FC.

functions.name: Ui_Bar_StartFadeIn
functions.summary: Starts the fade-in transition on a UI slider/bar widget; enables render visibility bit on node 0x1C8 and initializes timer fields.

functions.name: Ui_Bar_GetClampedValue
functions.summary: Computes the clamped integer display value for a UI bar widget by clamping float value f_194 and converting via VectorFloatToUnsigned.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_PauseAnim
functions.summary: Pauses current UI layout animations by invoking the animation controller helper func_0060E7FC.

functions.name: Ui_Bar_StartFadeOut
functions.summary: Starts the fade-out transition on a UI slider/bar widget, updating rate parameters and resetting transition flags.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_ResumeAnim
functions.summary: Resumes or updates active UI layout animations by calling animation controller helper func_0060E7FC.

functions.name: Ui_Bar_SetAlphaVariant
functions.summary: Sets an alternative alpha fade mode on the UI bar widget with transition flag 0x199 set to 1.

functions.name: Ui_Bar_UpdateVisibility
functions.summary: Checks the current widget value against threshold g_0017be98 and sets the visibility flag on node +0x138 accordingly.

functions.name: Ui_CreateFadeWindow
functions.summary: Constructor for the fade overlay object: allocates the base object, initialises its intro/outro child lists and colour-transform block, installs the fade vtables and stores the caller's screen mode at +0x128.

functions.name: Ui_FadeWindow_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor for the fade overlay created by Ui_CreateFadeWindow: releases the embedded transform/widget (0x291220, 0x1A6768), runs the layout destructor (0x1D8C2C at -0x138) and frees the block (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_RegisterActor
functions.signature: uint32_t Ui_RegisterActor(void* holder, void* actor, void* actorB, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Registers a pair of actors in a UI actor-slot holder: packs the two actor ids into holder+0xC/+0xD (0xFFFFF800 sentinel when an actor is missing), sets the initial delay 0xFFFFFFF, bumps the use counter at +0x10, binds the holder through the named Ui_ActorSlot_BindActor on the game work's +0x58 block and decrements the remaining-life counter at +0xF. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RegisterActorVariant
functions.signature: uint32_t maybe_Ui_RegisterActorVariant(UiActorHolder* holder, UiActor* actor, uint32_t extra, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Registers a single actor in a UI actor slot: packs the actor handle into holder+0xC, fills +0xD/+0xE, increments the use count and binds the slot through Ui_ActorSlot_BindActor.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the engine's small Ui_Object base: runs Ui_Object_DtorBody (0x17C334) and then frees the block. It is the base vtable's deleting-destructor slot, not a per-class helper.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorBody
functions.summary: Destructor body for the small engine object base: releases the embedded heap block at +0x14 when the object owns it, resets the vtable/id word at +4 and returns self for the deleting-destructor caller.

functions.name: Gfx_CalcQuadVertices
functions.signature: float* Gfx_CalcQuadVertices(float* dst, const float* v1, const float* v2, const float* v3)
functions.summary: Generates 2D quad vertex coordinates from 3 corner points and computes transformed bounding coordinates.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DestroyChildren
functions.summary: Destroys every node of the intrusive child list at self+0x20/+0x24 by dispatching vtable+0x0C on each child, then marks the object's +0x92 released byte. It is the shared child-list teardown of the small Ui_Object base.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorPooledA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a pooled object: installs the vtable, drains the intrusive child list at +0x20 calling each node's vtable+4 (deleting destructor), releases the optional child at +0x88 through vtable+0xC, unlinks the list at +0x24/+0x28, destroys the list at +8 when the flag at +0x18 is set, clears the pool slot 0x007B4D68[(u16 at +4) & 0x3FF] and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_BindAnimFromCommand
functions.summary: Binds one animation to a UI widget: takes the widget's text-command record, resolves the named animation through func_0062AB3C on the game work, attaches the animation pane descriptor (0x00747874) with vtable+0x34 and installs the animation data with func_001A6210; falls back to a default animated object when the command carries no name.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ObjectDestroyThunk2
functions.summary: Deleting thunk for a small UI object: destroys the embedded sub-object and frees the block.

functions.name: Map_FindRecordById
functions.summary: Looks up a record by id in the level/area table: returns the table's own +0xC block when it matches, otherwise the first of the five fixed sub-records (+0x30/+0x54/+0x78/+0x9C) whose id equals the argument; falls back to 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CreateMapCursor
functions.summary: Creates the UI object a menu window owns: allocates 0x280 bytes from the UI heap, builds it from the definition at self+0xE0 with Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, stores it at self+0xDC and activates it through vtable+0x24. Only runs when the 2D-field mode gate (world+0x3C==2 and 0x62AD40(world)+4!=0) passes.

functions.name: Sound_PlayMenuSeByMode
functions.signature: void Sound_PlayMenuSeByMode(u8* initFlag, u32 mode, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Lazily creates the shared sound-work singleton (0x10B2C4 constructor, 0x1EB0 bytes) and plays a UI sound effect selected by `mode`: 0 -> 0x21, 1 -> 0x23, 2 -> 0x22, 5 -> stop 0x21, 6 -> stop 0x22. Other modes play nothing.

functions.name: Map_AddInstance
functions.signature: uint32_t Map_AddInstance(MapTable* table, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3)
functions.summary: Adds one instance to the level table: allocates the next handle from the table's wrapping counter (+0xE4) and, if a live container exists, inserts the instance through 0x17C9F8. Returns the handle (or the 'invalid' constant when the container is absent).

functions.name: maybe_Container_AddInstanceWithHandle
functions.summary: Inserts an instance into a container table when the table is enabled (f_e0 == 1) or kind < 5: reserves a free slot, stores a generation-wrapped handle from f_e4 (wrapping against the limit at *(u32*)0x007A8B40 + 4), then registers the object with 0x0017C9F8.

functions.name: Ui_Callback_Dispatch48
functions.summary: Invokes virtual callback method at offset +0x48 on the sub-object stored at container + 4 if non-null.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DestroyMapCursor
functions.summary: Tears down a world-map cursor/marker record: unless the record is the closing one it releases its embedded 0xC-byte node, and when the map overlay has reached its target it removes the cursor's handle from the world-map object (via Ui_List_ReleaseEntries) and clears it.

functions.name: Ui_MapCursor_Ctor
functions.summary: Map-cursor constructor: stores the caller vtable, clears the two position/selection words at +4/+8 and default-constructs five 0x24-byte cursor slots at +0xC through 0x00619A8C.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_Destroy
functions.summary: Shutdown wrapper for the world-map object: runs the destructor body (0x17CF60) and then frees the object with 0x10F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_Destructor
functions.summary: Destructor body of the world-map screen: releases the four resource handles (f_8, f_C, f_D8, f_DC) through the resource manager, unlinks its intrusive list nodes and clears the map-object pool.

functions.name: Math_GetGlobalTransformA
functions.summary: Initializes and returns the global 3D transformation matrix/vector pair stored at g_0017d0a8, performing one-time initialization.

functions.name: Ui_SetupWindowAnimations
functions.summary: Loads the window's two idle animations ('anim01' and 'anim_01') into +0x120 and +0x124, one from the widget's animation list and one from its timeline.

functions.name: Ui_VisitWidgets
functions.signature: void Ui_VisitWidgets(Widget* root, int arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Walks the intrusive child list at root+0x120 and calls the layout callback 0x0053CD1C for each visible child whose vtable type is not the cached one, threading the accumulator through arg2+4.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_Teardown
functions.summary: Partial teardown used when the world map is rebuilt: stores the new vtable, destroys the layout node at +0x124 through 0x3E04BC/0x1D8C2C and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_UpdateShipIcon
functions.signature: void Ui_WorldMap_UpdateShipIcon(UiWorldMap* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3)
functions.summary: Places the ship/vehicle icon on the world map: reads the current map node and its per-map offset/scale tables from the world-map data (0x66B7C0/0x66B724/0x66B5D8/0x66B738/0x66B91C) and forwards the resulting 2D point to Ui_MapShipIcon_Update (0x3A7C4C). Also applies the map's rotation offset to the five marker objects.

functions.name: Ui_SelectPage
functions.summary: Selects one of the five page actors of a pager widget: highlights the matching actor (0x292B48(actor, i==page)), copies its transform into +0x98..+0xa4, stores the page index in +0xa8 and notifies the parent through 0x621358/0x628464.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_Setup
functions.signature: void Ui_WorldMap_Setup(UiWorldMap* self, WorldMapParams* params, uint16_t* ids)
functions.summary: Full world-map screen setup: loads ui_map_pack.bxon, ui_map_param.bxon and ui_map_ship_location.bxon from the pack, finds the 0x5AE map record, copies the map's label/flag arrays, builds the ship/continent mesh objects and applies the mode-specific text/animation settings.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_LoadModels
functions.summary: Loads the world-map geometry and effect resources: opens the 'world_map/<id>.arc' archive (variant 0x61/0x62), instantiates the five continent/segment meshes listed in the map record and registers them with the render manager.

functions.name: Ui_ReleasePageActors
functions.summary: Releases every non-null page object of a pager: calls Ui_ReleasePageActorSlots once for each of the five pointers at self+0x48..+0x58.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_SetDisplayMode
functions.summary: Switches the world map between the normal view and the dimmed/disabled view: toggles the render option on the map mesh (0x6216B0) and restores the saved overlay state when leaving mode 0xFF.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_Load
functions.summary: Loads the world-map UI resources for the current map: builds "ui/map/%s" and "ui/map/world_map_%c_%s.pack" names, loads them through the pack/resource manager and swaps the handles into +0x44/+0x5c.

functions.name: Ui_UpdatePageSelection
functions.summary: Party-status pager update: when the page index self+0xA8 is below 10 it looks up the page actor and stores its +0x9F4 value in the global at 0x007A9A90; then either enables the party-status display and refreshes the map-window icons, or applies the page highlight.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_LoadVariant
functions.signature: void Ui_WorldMap_LoadVariant(WorldMap* self, int arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Alternate world-map loader that also toggles the map's cursor/visibility state through func_00621644 and func_00621324 before loading the same ui/map resources.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_LoadVariant2
functions.signature: void Ui_WorldMap_LoadVariant2(WorldMap* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Third world-map loader variant; loads the ui/map resource pair and updates the map handles without the cursor toggles of Ui_WorldMap_LoadVariant.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_CreateSmallAction
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x28-byte action object with Actor_ActionBase_Ctor and submits it into a container slot when the actor's +0x40 counter is above 3; a render node is created first when the actor's flags have the low bits set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_WorldMap_CodeFragment
functions.summary: Not a function: a 2-byte-aligned address inside ARM code that Ghidra decoded as Thumb. The disassembly resynchronises at 0x0017F5B4 with an explicit '.arm' directive and then decodes real ARM (b, bl 0x6731EC, vmov.f32/vsqrt.f32/vmla.f32 on [r4,#0x98]/[r4,#0x9c]/[r4,#0xac]), so everything Ghidra reports here is garbage. The region sits between Ui_WorldMap_LoadVariant2 (0x0017EDE0) and Ui_WorldMap_ReleaseResources (0x0017FBB4).

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_ReleaseResources
functions.summary: Releases everything a loaded world map owns: clears the display flag, frees the five mesh slots, the extra mesh at +0x60, the render-target slot and the two layout/state objects, then marks the map unloaded.

functions.name: Ui_ApplyPageHighlight
functions.summary: Sets the highlight flag on the pager's current page actor, clears it on the other four and updates the parent window's cursor state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_WorldMapMarker_Init
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_WorldMapMarker_Init(u32* out, u32 id, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises one world-map marker record: stores the id, registers the 0x10-byte sub-object, fills the position/scale fields with the -4096 (0xFFFFF000) sentinel, sets the flag bytes at +0x88..+0x90 and copies the default table from work+0x27CB4.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_DestroyThunk
functions.summary: Small shutdown wrapper: destructs the world-map object (0x17FE68) and frees it through 0x10F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_DestructorBody
functions.summary: Destructor body for the alternate world-map object layout (vtable g_0017FF50): releases the mesh handle, the extra object and five sub-handles, then walks the embedded layout/controller chain to its base.

functions.name: Field_RegisterNpcActions
functions.summary: Registers NPC action handlers from the action table, creating the nut/flw action objects and attaching them to the NPC.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_FindEntryB
functions.summary: Finds an entry in the global hash map g_001802e0 matching the specified key and hash code.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ResetPageFlag
functions.summary: Clears the pager flag +0x2A3 when the event-slot test 0x00636AFC on the event state reports 0 (no script trigger running).

functions.name: Field_CreateEffectSprite
functions.signature: void Field_CreateEffectSprite(FieldObject* self, int* arg2, int* arg3)
functions.summary: Attaches a sprite child to a field object: merges the caller's point/rect records into a sprite descriptor, takes the world's 2D mode into account and adds the child through Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild, storing the handle at +0x29c.

functions.name: Field_CreateCollisionSprite
functions.summary: Creates the field object's collision proxy: builds the rectangle from the caller's point list, allocates a 0x68-byte sprite (0x4C65A0) and a 0xa4-byte collision object named 'collision' (0x4C3B50), then registers both through 0x5F4F34/0x5F4E94.

functions.name: maybe_Field_UpdateObjectHandle
functions.summary: Forwards an update to the object selected by self->f_29C: sets busy byte +0x2A3, invokes maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_ApplyAttribute(obj+0x3C, arg2, 0xFFE0), and clears busy byte on success.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_ApplyModelSettings
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_SceneObject_ApplyModelSettings(void * self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Applies a scene object's model settings: sets the model size, refreshes the object handle, resolves the object's actor record by id and stores it at +0x22C, then updates the actor's movement state.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_Refresh
functions.summary: Lightweight per-frame refresh of a field scene object: advances the animation (0x005E780C), re-applies the actor movement state derived from +0x246 (mode 2 when set) through 0x005E7848, then re-selects the animation entry / resets the animation when the flags at +0x29F and +0xB8 are both set.

functions.name: maybe_Field_RegisterNamedActorsA
functions.summary: Registers an actor for every entry added to the object's name table since the last call: with the world flag at (work+8)+0x44 clear and the table at +0x248 present, it walks entries f_2AC+1..f_2B0, skips entries whose first word is not positive, resolves the relative name pointer at entry+4 through the object-manager map lookup 0x0033D99C((work+8)+0x58, name) and calls Ui_RegisterActor(resolved, self, 0). Then stores the last index in f_2AC.

functions.name: Field_SpawnObject
functions.summary: Initialises a map object from a placement record: copies position/direction, resolves the model pair, and sets up the animation/attach sub-objects.

functions.name: Field_SpawnObjectVariant
functions.signature: void Field_SpawnObjectVariant(MapObject* self, PlacementRecord* rec, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Fuller map-object spawn path: additionally selects an alternate position/orientation row from the 0x18-byte variant table and stores the variant index.

functions.name: Field_SpawnObjectCompact
functions.summary: Initialises a map object from the compact placement form (three shorts at +2/+4/+6 plus a model pair), used for simple props and NPCs.

functions.name: Field_Gadget_TriggerCommand10
functions.signature: int Field_Gadget_TriggerCommand10(FieldObject* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Triggers the field gadget command for this object: plays SE 9, issues gadget command 10 with the object's id through the named Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand on the event state (work+0x6C), and on success resets the object's animation; on failure clears the busy flag f_2A3.

functions.name: Field_StartObject
functions.summary: Starts a spawned map object: applies its position/rotation, selects animation 1, clears the pending state and, when a model offset is present, queues it for the scene graph.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_AllocSlotNodeB
functions.signature: u32* Ui_Layout_AllocSlotNodeB(u32 heap, int desc, u32 p3, u32 size)
functions.summary: Allocates a secondary layout slot node via func_00335CA8 and initializes fields 0x8B through 0x90 with default attributes.

functions.name: Field_Object_DeletingDtorWithUiChild
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor template for a field object that owns an embedded Ui_Object at +0x254: stamps the class vtable supplied in r1, runs the Ui_Object destructor body on self+0x254, then the shared Field_Object base teardown and frees the block.

functions.name: Field_Object_DtorBodyWithUiChild
functions.summary: Non-deleting half of 0x18130C: stamps the class vtable, destroys the embedded Ui_Object at +0x254 and runs the Field_Object base teardown, without freeing. Used for field objects embedded in a larger allocation.

functions.name: Field_RegisterActorActions
functions.summary: Registers the actor's turn and movement actions (rTurn/mTurn, move, talk) by building the corresponding action objects from the action table.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_Register
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_SceneObject_Register(FieldSceneObject* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Marks a field scene object registered (f_264) and, when it is visible and enabled, hands its transform to the field renderer.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_FindEntryC
functions.summary: Finds an entry in the global hash map g_0018183c matching the specified key and hash code.

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeId9
functions.summary: Lazily creates the shared 0x1EB0-byte sound manager on first use and then plays sound effect id 9 on every call.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CheckObjectState
functions.signature: bool maybe_Field_CheckObjectState(FieldObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the value the event-state getter 0x00636AFC reads from work->f_8->f_6C; when that value is zero it also invokes the object's virtual +0xC4 before returning. It returns a value (Ghidra's bool is right).

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_Release
functions.summary: Teardown half of a scene-object pair: if the handle at +0x384 (self+900) is valid it queries 0x005F708C and clears the fade range; then it destroys the object found through 0x003F422C(self+0x370) via its vtable slot +0x88 and finally releases the object with 0x005F58BC.

functions.name: Field_Actor_SetPendingAction
functions.summary: Clears pending action state at 0x264, and if flag is non-zero, triggers actor action sequence via func_005F5DA8 and sets 0x265.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_UpdateBalloon
functions.summary: Re-places a field object's balloon billboard: resolves the balloon entry for the object id through the named Field_FindNpcBalloonEntry, scales the object's balloon size by 0.3/0.5/1.0 depending on its balloon mode byte (+0x313), places it at the object position and then shifts the child nodes by +/-0.8 in Y when the visible state changed.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_ApplyParam
functions.summary: Value-applying half of the same scene-object pair: same handle/fade prefix, then, when the object found through 0x003F422C(self+0x370) exists and its +0x51 byte is clear, calls its vtable slot +0x84 with the value and forwards the value to 0x005F6000(self, value).

functions.name: Field_UpdateEffectParams
functions.signature: void Field_UpdateEffectParams(Actor* actor, const EffectParams* params)
functions.summary: Updates an attached effect's parameter block: on first use creates the effect handle, then writes the four colour/alpha floats (0x5b8..0x5c4) and notifies the effect list after adjusting the effect's timing fields.

functions.name: Field_Actor_CreateSprite
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_CreateSprite(FieldActor* self, uint32_t arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Creates the actor's billboard/sprite representation: picks the sprite definition for the actor's type, allocates the 0x70-byte sprite, attaches it and optionally creates the 'collision' proxy.

functions.name: Model_SetupObject
functions.signature: void Model_SetupObject(void * self, void * primary, void * fallback)
functions.summary: Chooses the model/attachment record from the primary or fallback reference, reads its model id and copies the record's transform and scale onto the object before marking it set up.

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateModel
functions.summary: Per-frame model update for a field actor: resolves its object handle by type (0x001C8EDC), runs the actor's vtable +0xD0 step, switches on the model's kind (0x212/0x215/0xAB...) to apply the ground/effect offset, then updates the animation transform and the collision position.

functions.name: Model_Equip_UpdateActorEquipment
functions.summary: Refreshes the actor's visible equipment: resolves the model set (0x1C7EA4 / 0x35EB98), updates both equipment rows through 0x40BA94/0x4062F0-style calls, then applies the accessory slots (Model_Equip_ApplyAccessorySlots 0x40AE18), grip state (0x40B748) and final model refresh (0x40AC10).

functions.name: maybe_Field_CreateActorResourceSet
functions.summary: Builds a 28-byte resource-set descriptor (flags 0x10, 0x0E, count 5, enabled) for the actor id returned by vtable+0xCC, allocates the 0xC0 resource-set block at self+0xE2 if absent and initialises it with Fs_ResourceSet_InitFromRecord from data-manager +0x3E4.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_PlayIdleAnimation
functions.summary: Plays the animation named by the global name table g_007A3C6C indexed by the actor's state byte f_313, falling back to entry 0 when that name is missing; then, when the actor's height f_374 is set, recomputes the instance transform (0x0066A244) and corrects the height through 0x005F7784 before clearing the three loop bytes at f_160+0x550..0x556.

functions.name: Field_Object_ReleaseSpriteResource
functions.summary: Releases the object's sprite/model resource: if the packed handle at +0x370 is still registered in the global handle table and the manager exists, calls manager vtable+0x40 with category 4 and then clears the object's model through Field_SpawnObject_ApplyRecord(self, 0).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_UpdateStandPosition
functions.summary: Picks a stand point/rotation for a field object: with a rail table at self+0x314 it copies the current rail point's position and rotation; otherwise it probes up to ten random offsets around the target node at self+0x318, keeps the first collision-free spot and writes it to +0x328..+0x33C.

functions.name: Field_Actor_CreateBillboard
functions.summary: Creates the actor's floating billboard/marker (name plate, quest icon or damage text): fills the 0x224-byte descriptor with colour/scale/font fields, allocates it, registers it with the actor and stores the handle at +0x370; also rebuilds the billboard's rotation matrix.

functions.name: maybe_Field_UpdateLocationGrid
functions.summary: Re-registers a field actor in the shared spatial grid: calls 0x005E78CC, re-applies the placement record when the manager flag +0x51 is clear, looks the actor's cell up by position (+0x258) and releases it when missing, then sets the actor state to 6.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_PlayByNameB
functions.summary: Second emission of the field-actor animation method: plays g_007A3C6C[self->f_313] with the entry-0 fallback, then fixes the height through 0x0066A244/0x005F7784 and clears the three bytes at f_160+0x550..0x556. Same body as 0x00182A28.

functions.name: Field_UpdateCullingFlag
functions.summary: Per-actor distance culling: runs the base node culling update, then (when the field UI mode byte and the actor flags allow it) compares the squared distance to the position of the scene node at work+0x48 with the actor threshold at +0x25C and sets/clears bit 1 of the culling word at +0x50.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SetEmoteState
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SetEmoteState(FieldGimmick* self, u32 p1, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Resolves emote/balloon state index from field 0x380 or table g_001835a8 based on field 0x313, then applies state via func_005F7F78.

functions.name: maybe_Field_RegisterNamedActorsB
functions.summary: Same registration pass as 0x00180B94 for a second table: with the world flag at (work+8)+0x44 clear and the table at +0x314 present, it walks entries f_354+1..f_358, skips entries whose first word is not positive, resolves the relative name pointer at entry+4 through 0x0033D99C((work+8)+0x58, name) and calls Ui_RegisterActor(resolved, self, 0). Then stores the last index in f_354.

functions.name: Field_SpawnObject_ApplyRecord
functions.summary: Applies a spawn record to a field object: reads five transform blocks from the record (position, rotation, scale, colour) into the object's +0x68..+0xd8 fields and hands the record's model name to the object's vtable slot +0x84.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_GetTypeParam
functions.summary: Returns one of the consecutive ids 0x54E..0x55D selected by the object type (5, 6, 0xB, 0xE, 0xF, 0x14, 0x15, 0x17, 0x21, 0x22), with two cases (0x17, 0x22) that look the object's model id (obj->f_160->f_120) up with 0x0063E2BC and shift the answer by one depending on the record's type byte (0/10 and 13).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_ReleaseSpriteResourceB
functions.summary: Second sprite/model release path: same packed-handle test, but calls manager vtable+0x3C with category 4 and then applies the manager's byte at +0x88 through Field_SpawnObject_ApplyRecord.

functions.name: Field_SpawnObjectRecordA
functions.signature: void Field_SpawnObjectRecordA(FieldObject* self, uint32_t* rec, uint32_t owner)
functions.summary: First of three placement-record layouts: copies position/rotation words rec[0..5] and scale rec[7] into the field object, resolves the NPC talk-balloon entry, builds the sprite child descriptor (with the 'defaultTalk' string) and creates the model plus the actor sprite. The layout starts the transform at rec[0] (the other variants start at rec[4]/rec[8]).

functions.name: Field_SpawnObjectRecordB
functions.signature: void Field_SpawnObjectRecordB(FieldObject* self, int* rec, uint32_t owner)
functions.summary: Second placement-record layout (transform at rec[4..9], model/colour at rec[0xd..0x10]): copies the transform, creates the two text/sprite children and the model, then sets the animator/shadow set. Same record group as Field_SpawnObjectRecordA, shifted by four words.

functions.name: Field_SpawnObjectRecordC
functions.signature: void Field_SpawnObjectRecordC(FieldObject* self, int* rec, uint32_t owner)
functions.summary: Third placement-record layout (transform at rec[8..13], colour/type at rec[0x15..0x17], quest flags at rec[0x1e]/0x56/0x57): same model/sprite/scale resolution as the A and B variants, plus two extra sprite children and the field actor sound. Called once per record by the scene object-table spawner.

functions.name: Field_Object_ApplySpawnRecord
functions.signature: void Field_Object_ApplySpawnRecord(FieldObject* self, int* rec, int arg3)
functions.summary: Applies a spawn record to an existing field object: copies position, rotation, model ids and the mode byte (+0x313), rebuilds the rotation, updates the follow point, creates the sprite via Field_Actor_CreateSprite, optionally creates the billboard (Field_Actor_CreateBillboard) and finishes by playing the actor sound for the mode.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ReleaseEffectHandle
functions.summary: Field-scene-node virtual: releases the attached effect object at +0x388 through its vtable+4, clears the pointer, invalidates the paired handle word at +0x384 (0xFFFFFFFF) and also runs the base effect-slot release.

functions.name: Field_Actor_CheckTargetMatch
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_CheckTargetMatch(FieldActor* self, u32 p1, int targetRecord)
functions.summary: Checks whether the entity handle in targetRecord matches the actor's bound handle at 0x2B4 and stores the boolean result in field 0x266.

functions.name: maybe_Field_RegisterNamedActorsC
functions.summary: Damaged third copy of the 0x001835AC registration pass: the same 0x28-byte name-table loop over +0x314 with the f_354..f_358 cursor and the same 0x0033D99C + Ui_RegisterActor calls, but Ghidra lost r4/r5 and mis-decoded the prologue as a coprocessor move.

functions.name: Field_LoadNpcIeResources
functions.signature: int Field_LoadNpcIeResources(FieldManager* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Loads the NPC interaction tables "npc_ie.bxon" and "book_ie.bxon" into the field manager, caching the two pack handles and matching the entry whose event id is 0xf4 or 0x46.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SpawnObjectRecordD
functions.summary: Tail of the field object spawn routine: fills the actor's f_364/f_368/f_36C, applies the model and sprite, copies the record's flags into f_310..f_34C and finishes with the actor sound.

functions.name: Field_CreateActorData
functions.signature: void* Field_CreateActorData(u32 id, const void* desc)
functions.summary: Constructs a field actor data block through 0x00336A38 for the given id/descriptor and fills the defaults (vtable at +0, -1.0f, flags, colours); returns the interior pointer at -0x2B0.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ObjectDestroyThunk
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor thunk of a field object: invokes Field_Object_DtorWithHandle (0x00184CB4) and frees memory with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_Object_DtorWithHandle
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor body of the field-object base: stamps vtable 0x7588B4, releases the object's registered field-object handle (self[0xDC]) through the Field_ObjectManager at work+8->+0x54, then destroys the embedded UI objects and the Field_SceneObject base. It deliberately has no operator-delete call; the derived deleting destructors add it.

functions.name: Party_FindMemberByActor
functions.summary: Finds the party slot whose actor id matches and asks the window to show that member.

functions.name: Ui_PartySelectWindow_Setup
functions.summary: Initialises the party-select window panes, then selects and shows the pane for the current party count (1..12).

functions.name: Ui_DialogRoot_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a dialog-root UI object: runs the UI object base constructor, installs the dialog vtable and default-constructs the twelve 0x50-byte child windows at +0x4c.

functions.name: Ui_DialogRoot_DeletingDtorAlt
functions.summary: Second deleting-destructor variant for the dialog-root layout: reinstalls table 0x0075DC34, destroys the twelve 0x50-byte children at +0x4C, runs the UI base destructor and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_DialogRoot_DtorAlt
functions.summary: Non-freeing complete-object destructor paired with 0x00184E84: reinstalls table 0x0075DC34, destroys the twelve 0x50-byte children at +0x4C and runs the base destructor, leaving the block to the caller.

functions.name: Field_LoadNpcTables
functions.signature: void Field_LoadNpcTables(FieldNpcTables* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Loads the three NPC/IE tables (npc_list.bxon, npc_ie.bxon, book_ie.bxon) from the area pack and stores each validated 0xF4/0x46 table plus its resource handle in the field NPC container.

functions.name: Field_SetRegion
functions.summary: Switches the active field region: dispatches the region id through 0x63D1B0, then loads 'param_region/<id>.pack' and stores the resulting region-pack handle in the field global container.

functions.name: Field_ResetNpcTables
functions.summary: Clears the NPC table container: resets the id byte to 0xFF and releases the four stored handles (table, pair, second table, area pack) by writing the null handle encoding and dropping the references.

functions.name: Field_ReleaseNpcData
functions.summary: Full release of the field NPC data: resets the table handles (0x185550) then releases the four nested resource handles at +0x1C and returns the base pointer.

functions.name: Script_ParseAssignmentExpression
functions.signature: void Script_ParseAssignmentExpression(ScriptCompiler* comp, uint32_t* lhs, uint32_t mode)
functions.summary: Assignment/ternary expression parser of the Squirrel compiler: handles '=' (0x3d) and '?' (0x3f) including the short-jump fixups for the ternary branches, brackets/parentheses around the value, and emits the assignment opcode plus line-info records. Recurses into itself for nested assignments.

functions.name: Script_ParseBitwiseExpression
functions.summary: Bitwise operator parser: loops over '&' (0x26), '^' (0x5e) and '|' (0x7c), calls the next-level expression parser through the compiler's operator table (comp->f_18/f_10/f_8) and emits the bitwise opcode (0x12 with sub-op 0/3/2).

functions.name: Script_ParseUnaryExpression
functions.summary: Unary prefix parser: while the current token is 0x10f (unary operator, e.g. '-'/'!'/'~'/'++'), parses the operand recursively, emits the unary opcode (0x2c) and patches the line info; otherwise falls through to the binary expression parser (0x186B28).

functions.name: Script_ParsePostfixExpression
functions.summary: Postfix expression parser: handles member access '.' (0x2e), indexing '[' ... ']' (0x5b/0x5d) and calls '(' ... ')' (0x28/0x29). For calls it counts the arguments (opcode 6 with the arg count), for indexing it emits the index opcode (0x21/0x1/0xe), and for member access it resolves the field name through the compiler table. Also inserts line-break records when a newline appears inside brackets.

functions.name: Script_ParseBitwiseAnd
functions.summary: Bitwise-AND level of the Squirrel compiler: parses the higher-precedence equality level (Script_SqCompiler_EqExp) and, while the next token is '&', pushes opcode 0x12 with sub-op 0.

functions.name: Script_ParseBitwiseAndXor
functions.summary: Bitwise-AND/OR-expression level of the Squirrel compiler: two loops, one consuming '&' and one consuming '^', each parsing an operand through the compiler's operator table and pushing opcode 0x12 with sub-op 0/3.

functions.name: Script_ParseBinaryExpression
functions.summary: Squirrel expression parser for the binary/bitwise level: first parses a bitwise expression, then loops on the comparison/equality keyword tokens (0x10E, 0x118, 0x137), emitting the corresponding stack opcodes (0x2B, 0x29, 0x2A) through maybe_Script_Compiler_PushStackOp and recursing on the right-hand side.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_FunctionExp
functions.summary: Parses a Squirrel 'function name(a, b = 1) : (locals) { ... }' expression: creates the function object, binds each parameter (with optional default value), declares the optional local names and then compiles the body statement.

functions.name: Script_ParseStatementList
functions.summary: Statement-list/block parser of the Squirrel compiler: parses statements until the terminator token, accepts ';' or ',' as separators and dispatches the keyword/expression handlers.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InitHeader
functions.summary: Initializes window title and header text from string template g_001874e8 and enables the header render node at +0x78.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_Expect
functions.signature: void Script_SqCompiler_Expect(SqCompiler* self, SQObjectPtr* outToken, int expectedToken)
functions.summary: The compiler's 'expect this token' primitive: if the current token differs from expectedToken it builds the Squirrel error text "expected '%s'" (token name) or "expected '%c'" (single char) through the inlined Error2 path (sprintf into the 0x100-byte compiler error buffer, then the longjmp/raise helper), then always advances the lexer. The special case (token==0x136 TK_CONSTRUCTOR, expected 0x102 IDENTIFIER) is the grammar's permission to read a constructor as an identifier. The 8-byte outToken slot is filled with the literal object only to keep the compiler's constant pool alive across the Error2 throw path.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_Factor
functions.summary: Primary-expression parser of the Squirrel compiler: dispatches on the current token to local/outer/identifier lookups (with the 'cannot delete a local' / 'invalid constant [%s.%s]' errors), 'this' and 'constructor', numeric/string literals, array '[..]', table '{...}', class, function and lambda literals, unary - ! ~ ++ --, and parenthesised expressions; each alternative leaves one value target on the funcstate target stack. It is the bottom of the precedence chain and also the place where a statement 'expression expected' is produced.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_EmitBinaryExp
functions.signature: void Script_SqCompiler_EmitBinaryExp(SqCompiler* self, u8 opcode, void (*subExpr)(SqCompiler*), u32 subExprFlags, u8 operatorByte)
functions.summary: Shared body of the binary-operator precedence levels: advances the lexer, parses the right operand with the supplied lower-level parser, pops the two value targets from the funcstate target stack (SQFuncState::PopTarget 0x001BE454), pushes the result target (0x001BCE5C) and emits one 8-byte SQInstruction {_arg1=left, op=opcode, _arg0=target, _arg2=right, _arg3=operatorByte} via SQFuncState::AddInstruction (0x001BDD50). The caller supplies only opcode + operator byte, which is why every arithmetic level shares this one function.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_EqExp
functions.summary: Equality/relational expression level: parses one shift-level expression (PrefixedExpr 0x00186150 and the inlined multiply/add/shift loops) and then folds a chain of ==, !=, <, >, <=, >= operators (and the inlined <<, >>, >>> BITW cases), emitting ARITH/BITW/CMP/EQ/NE instructions through Script_SqCompiler_EmitBinaryExp. Returns as soon as the next token is not a comparison operator.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_Compile
functions.summary: Top-level compile driver: creates the root SQFuncState named 'main' (0x001BE56C ctor), registers 'this' as local 0 and 'unknown' as the source name, then loops Script_SqCompiler_Statement until end of file or a stray '}', enforcing 'end of statement expected (; or lf)' between statements. It finishes the function with a RETURN instruction (opcode 0x13) and copies the resulting closure into outClosure; on a lexer/compile error it reports through the compiler's longjmp error path.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_MulExp
functions.summary: Multiplicative precedence level: parses a prefixed expression (0x00186150) and then loops over '*', '/' and '%' calling Script_SqCompiler_EmitBinaryExp with opcode ARITH and the next-level parser; the loop is the only operator group it accepts, so it is the isolated MultExp of the grammar (the other levels were inlined into their callers).

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_PlusExp
functions.summary: Additive precedence level: parses a prefixed expression, then folds the multiplicative group (*, /, %) by delegating to Script_SqCompiler_MulExp through the compiler's static level table, then loops over '+' and '-' emitting ARITH instructions. Equivalent to upstream PlusExp with MultExp inlined at the start.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_ShiftExp
functions.summary: Shift precedence level: after the inlined multiply/add levels it loops over '<<', '>>' and '>>>' (tokens 0x128/0x129/0x132) and emits BITW instructions with selectors BW_SHIFTL=4, BW_SHIFTR=5, BW_USHIFTR=6. This is the last level before EqExp in the precedence chain.

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_CommaExp
functions.summary: Comma (sequence) expression: parses one full expression with 0x00185720, then while the token is ',' drops the previous value target from the funcstate stack, advances the lexer and recurses. Used for expression lists that keep only the last value (for-loop increment clauses, parenthesised comma expressions).

functions.name: Script_SqCompiler_Statement
functions.summary: The compiler's statement parser: one huge switch over all statement keywords - block, local declaration/assignment, expression statement, if/else, while, do/while, for, foreach, switch/case/default, break/continue (with the "'break' has to be in a loop block" checks), return, function declaration, class declaration (synthesising the @INDEX@/@ITERATOR@ metamethods), try/catch/throw and yield. It maintains the SQFuncState stack size/scope depth and emits the corresponding jumps and instructions.

functions.name: Script_SqValueList_GetItem
functions.signature: int Script_SqValueList_GetItem(SqValueList* self, u32 arg2, int index, SQObjectPtr* out)
functions.summary: Element accessor for the Squirrel value list: tests whether slot index of the value array is the tagged null (0x01000001) and, if not, copies it into the caller's SQObjectPtr; returns whether a value was copied.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_Attach
functions.summary: Attaches a scene graph node and all its child components to the active scene graph, updating child transformation links.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_Release
functions.summary: Decrements reference counter on scene graph node; when the counter reaches zero, invokes virtual destructor and deallocates memory.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_DetachChild
functions.summary: Detaches and releases child node pointer at field 0x1C, decrementing the child reference count and destroying it if zero.

functions.name: Script_SqValueList_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the Squirrel value-list holder: installs vtable 0x007589F4, clears the two link/refcount words and default-constructs the single 8-byte SQObjectPtr at +0x2C. Byte-identical twin of 0x0018BE68, i.e. the two template copies emitted for two different owners.

functions.name: Script_SqValueList_CtorB
functions.summary: Second, byte-identical constructor of the Squirrel value-list holder (same vtable 0x007589F4, same single 8-byte SQObjectPtr at +0x2C): the 'B' copy emitted for the other owner.

functions.name: maybe_Script_SqValueList_Dtor
