functions.summary: Destructor of a refcounted value-array holder: installs vtable 0x007589F4, unlinks itself from its owner (0x00245C40), releases the refcounted block at +0x1C and, when it was the last reference, resets every 8-byte element to the shared null value and releases the old one; then destroys the element array through std_destroy_range with the refcount release 0x001BF798 and installs the base vtable 0x0075A728.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_AttachSingleChild
functions.summary: Attaches a single-child scene graph node to the active scene and updates parent linkage.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_DetachSingleChild
functions.summary: Detaches single child at field 0x18, decrementing its reference count and invoking its destructor if zero.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_DtorBase
functions.summary: Base destructor for GfxNode objects; unlinks from parent node at offset 0x14 and releases child reference at offset 0x18.

functions.name: maybe_Spell_ResolveRecordRef
functions.signature: void maybe_Spell_ResolveRecordRef(SpellRecordRef* out, u32 spellId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Builds a spell record reference: stores the low byte of the spell id at out+0 and the SpellRecord pointer from 0x0063CFC8(dm, spellId) at out+4. Callers then read the description message id (+0x290) or the MP cost (+0x2EC) from that pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Skill_ResolveRecordRef
functions.signature: void maybe_Skill_ResolveRecordRef(SkillRecordRef* out, u32 skillId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Builds a skill record reference: stores the low byte of the skill id at out+0 and the SkillRecord pointer from 0x0063D018(dm, skillId) at out+4. Callers then read the description message id or the MP cost (+0xEE) from that pointer.

functions.name: Container_SortIdsByName
functions.summary: Insertion-sorts a u16 id array by display name using Container_CompareIdNames.

functions.name: Container_CompareIdNames
functions.signature: u32 Container_CompareIdNames(u16* arg1, u16* b, u16* arg3)
functions.summary: Compares two ids by their resolved name records; returns 1 when a sorts after b and 0 otherwise, with missing records sorting last.

functions.name: Text_BuildFallbackGlyphList
functions.summary: Builds and sorts the fallback glyph table: fills the inline array with 118 consecutive character codes 0x0AA3..0x0B19 and sorts them with the shared id comparator.

functions.name: Text_GetLayoutStats
functions.summary: Lazily builds the text-layout object (vtable 0x7829CC), then walks every entry and writes four counters: entry count, entry count from the layout page, empty-span count and total non-empty spans.

functions.name: Text_GlyphCache_Compact
functions.signature: void Text_GlyphCache_Compact(TextGlyphCache* cache, int lo, int hi)
functions.summary: Compacts the 255-entry text glyph cache: removes every entry equal to the current sentinel, shifts survivors down with memcpy and zero-fills the tail.

functions.name: Text_GlyphCache_FindOrInsert
functions.summary: Looks a three-word key up in the text glyph/metric cache; on a hit it refreshes the entry's use counter and returns it, on a miss it compacts the cache, inserts the new entry and returns the default weight 1.

functions.name: maybe_Text_InitLineCache
functions.signature: void maybe_Text_InitLineCache(TextLine* lines, const TextLine* source)
functions.summary: Resets 255 text-line records (0x18 bytes each) and then copies the first 0x11 bytes of each record from a source template: it re-initialises the message-line cache from a template rather than merely clearing it.

functions.name: Text_ResolveStyleBlock
functions.summary: Resolves a 16-word text style block: fills the 7-wchar name at +4 from party member 0 when empty, refreshes level (+0x38) and three global bytes (+0x34/+0x3D/+0x3E), allocates the formatted name buffer and returns whether anything changed. maybe_Text_UpdateStyleParams calls it before 0x00613F14 applies the block to the text object.

functions.name: maybe_Text_BuildLayoutSpanA
functions.signature: void maybe_Text_BuildLayoutSpanA(void* self, const TextEntry* entry, u32 word0, u32 word1)
functions.summary: Text-layout span builder: a 552-byte routine with a push {r4-r8,lr} prologue that fills a stack span record, guarded by style < 7 and a non-empty span, before calling the text layout helpers. Ghidra truncates it after the first call, so only the shape is known.

functions.name: Text_InitStringRef
functions.signature: void Text_InitStringRef(TextRef* out, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 textId)
functions.summary: Fills a three-word text reference: two caller-supplied words plus the resolved handle from func_0051BB08(textId, 0xE, -1).

functions.name: Pack_FindRecordByIndex
functions.summary: Resolves an index into the global record table: lazily creates the 0x98-byte table object (vtable g_0018D1C0), looks the index up with 0x63DBA4 and returns the record pointer (adding the stored self-relative offset).

functions.name: Ui_IsMode
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the global UI mode byte at world+0x2d1f8 equals mode, treating mode 3 as "3 or higher".

functions.name: maybe_Field_SetModeValue
functions.summary: Stores an int at bag+0x8760 and, when the new value is 0, clears the 0x108-byte state block at bag+0x8630 first via 0x00111498.

functions.name: maybe_Text_BuildLayoutSpanB
functions.signature: void maybe_Text_BuildLayoutSpanB(void* self, const TextEntry* entry, u32 word0, u32 word1)
functions.summary: Second layout-span builder of the text renderer: validates the style id, copies the two span words into a 0x84-byte stack record and fills the layout fields, same family as 0x0018CEA4. The decompiled body is truncated at a mis-marked wcslen call.

functions.name: maybe_Party_RemoveMember
functions.summary: Removes an entry from a 20-slot array of 0x98-byte records by shifting the following records down, then clears the last record's 0x84-byte block and its four flag words.

functions.name: maybe_Party_CompactSlotTable
functions.signature: void maybe_Party_CompactSlotTable(void* table, const u32* removeList)
functions.summary: Clears every 0x98-byte record of the 20-slot table whose index appears in removeList and compacts survivors.

functions.name: Party_InitMemberSlots
functions.summary: Initializes the 20 party member slot records (stride 0x98) by zeroing each slot with func_00116AE0 and resetting member status flags.

functions.name: Party_ClearMemberSlot
functions.summary: Clears a single party member slot record by zeroing 0x84 bytes and resetting status flags at +0x88, +0x8C, +0x90, +0x91.

functions.name: Text_SpanHasContent
functions.signature: bool Text_SpanHasContent(const TextEntry* entry, const u32* span)
functions.summary: Returns true when the entry's style id is below 7, its first 16-bit field is non-zero and the two words of the second span are not both zero.

functions.name: Party_ResetSlotState
functions.summary: Resets character attribute parameters at offsets 0x38..0x74 and clears the member record via Party_ClearMemberSlot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BuildListEntries
functions.summary: Walks a 0xC-byte-stride record table obtained with func_0063F0B8(work, tableId) and for each row builds a 0x84-byte text/icon record: copies the 7-character name with std_wcsncpy, takes the icon byte through func_00149814/func_00158F94, measures the glyph run and centres it horizontally.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowRecord
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowRecord(u8* out, const u8* id, u32 mode, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Builds one 0x84-byte name+count+icon row record: resolves the name through the game tables, applies the three-entry override table, measures the text, picks a count via Item_PickRandomByCategory and copies the record to the output.

functions.name: Text_SetArgsFromCharacterLook
functions.signature: void Text_SetArgsFromCharacterLook(CharacterLook* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Fills the text format arguments for a character profile: arguments 2 and 3 get the look record and its +0x3C field, arguments 7..12 get the six appearance-part names resolved from the character pack (each with its own +1/+4/+0x17/+0x67/-0x69/+0x61 bias), and argument 13 gets +0x4A.

functions.name: Ui_ApplyCharacterLookParamsEx
functions.summary: Pushes a character's appearance ('look') parameters into message arguments: sets arg 3 from look+4, formats f_34/f_38 into the two string slots of the message formatter and sets args 7..13 by mapping the look fields f_36/f_39/f_37/f_3A/f_3B/f_3C through Pack_FindRecordByIndex with their category base offsets (1, 4, 0x17, 0x67, -0x69, 0x61), then passes the extra word f_12.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PickWeightedKeyValue
functions.summary: Picks a weighted-random slot from a four-entry key and returns a random value inside that slot's range: Math_WeightedRandomIndexDefaultRng(key, 4, 0) chooses the slot, the two range accessors 0x0015FA90/0x0015D13C give its first and last index, and the game RNG at (work+8)+0x98 is reduced modulo (last-first+1) and added to first.

functions.name: Math_RandomPercent
functions.summary: Returns a random value in 0..99. 0x0051B1FC pulls the next value from one of the two RNG states in the game work (+0xC8 when stream==0, +0xE0 otherwise) and 0x0011CD80 is the idivmod helper; the remainder (r1) is what comes back. Nothing here counts or sizes list slots.

functions.name: maybe_Data_SelectRecordIdByWeight
functions.summary: Random weighted pick between two record ids: draws a random float (0x0051B1FC + VectorSignedToFloat, scaled by g_0018E2A4/g_0018E2A8) and compares it with three floats read from the records named by spec[1]/spec[3] to choose spec[0], spec[3], the constant 6, or a value produced by maybe_Party_FormatStatValue.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PickWeightedStepIndex
functions.summary: Picks a weighted-random index inside the object's [f_a, f_b] range: it builds the fixed weight table {0, 400, 200, 150, 100, 50, 40, 10}, zeroes every entry outside the range, calls Math_WeightedRandomIndexDefaultRng(table, 8, 0) and clamps the result back into [f_a, f_b].

functions.name: Party_BuildStatusPanelData
functions.summary: Builds the 0x40-byte text block of one party-status row: appends the character name and the level/HP/MP runs to the text buffer at work+0x50+200, then copies the finished 16-word block to *out (the caller stores it into its layout struct).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IsMenuOpen
functions.summary: Returns 1 only when the UI root singleton has an active object (0x00383A80) and the menu query 0x0062A38C on the save work is non-zero. Window visibility code uses the answer to pick its dimmed row alpha.

functions.name: maybe_Party_GetPairSlotId
functions.summary: Maps an unordered pair of slot indices to a compact id: triangular mapping (1,2)->0x0C through (4,5)->0x15, with special handling for 0 and 6.

functions.name: Item_PickRandomByCategory
functions.summary: Picks a random owned item from the 0xa4.. id range whose data category matches, walking backwards through category values when none is available.

functions.name: maybe_Party_RemoveDuplicateIds
functions.signature: u8 maybe_Party_RemoveDuplicateIds(u32 list, u32 unwantedId, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Fills a 6-byte working list with indices 0..5, optionally erases every occurrence of one unwanted ID, and compacts remaining entries in place.

functions.name: maybe_Party_FormatStatValue
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Party_FormatStatValue(u32 charaWork, u32 statKind, u32 level)
functions.summary: Turns numeric character stat into its display value: branches on stat kind, scales level through float constants, and compacts ID list with 0x0018EB44.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SetOwnerAndDispatch
functions.summary: Attaches a UI widget to its owner: stores the owner/layout word (owner->f_AC) at self+0x70, makes self+0x6C point at self and dispatches through self->f_4C->f_18. The jumptable at 0x0018F310 is lost, so the rest of the routine is unknown.

functions.name: Ui_EffectHandleList_ReleaseAll
functions.summary: Releases every instance in a UI 2D-effect handle list: walks the count at +0x18, validates each packed handle (index in the low 11 bits, generation above) against the global handle table, resolves the object and destroys it.

functions.name: Field_Effect_SetAlphaAll
functions.summary: Iterates over active effect handles in list self->f_18 and applies the specified alpha value to each effect instance.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ReleaseTrackedHandles
functions.summary: Walks the tracked-handle list and, for every entry whose generation still matches the global registry and whose object exists, calls 0x5F5B94(handle, 3) and marks the slot released.

functions.name: Ui_EffectHandleList_EnableAll
functions.summary: Mirror of the release function: resolves every handle in the same UI effect list, calls the 'show/on' entry point on the object and finally sets the list's enabled flag at +0x1C.

functions.name: Field_Effect_StopAll
functions.summary: Stops playback of all active field visual effects by triggering stop flag 1 and resetting alpha to 0 on each instance.

functions.name: maybe_Field_AsyncOp_Init
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_AsyncOp_Init(u32 * op, u32 u32, u32 u322)
functions.summary: Initialises an async-operation record: stores the state word at +0, sets the ready byte at +4 and default-constructs two 8-byte sub-records at +8 with element ctor 0x00625BE0.

functions.name: Ui_BeginAsyncLoad
functions.signature: void Ui_BeginAsyncLoad(AsyncLoadOwner* self, int kind, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Starts one of three UI async-load operations (kind 1/2/3, each with its own vtable) on the owner: allocates the 0x18-byte token, initialises it, stores it at self+0xC, marks self+0x11 active and pauses the UI child screen; on failure it releases the child screen instead.

functions.name: Ui_PollAsyncLoad
functions.summary: Polls the async-load token at self->f_C: on completion or failure it copies the result bytes into f_14/f_18, frees the token through vtable+4, clears the busy/state bytes f_10/f_11 and releases the loading child screen.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CreateGimmickSystem
functions.summary: Constructor of a 0x9C58-byte field scene system: installs vtable 0x00782234, lazily creates the shared 0x37C memory block at 0x007BE2F0, allocates the object, initialises two Os_LightEvent instances and constructs a 400-entry array of 0x40-byte components with ctor 0x001CFF84.

functions.name: Fs_IsArcOrTestShader
functions.summary: Returns true when the archive entry name contains ".arc" or "nw_testshader"; used to skip/route container entries during a directory walk.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DeleteSub
functions.summary: Destroys and frees a UI widget sub-object by invoking destructor func_005799D4 and calling operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_EnsureEntrySelected
functions.summary: Small window helper: asks the window to ensure its current entry is visible, then fetches the bound list object through vtable+0x58 and selects the entry encoded in self->f_98 (high half) on it.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_SelectLayerSubEntry
functions.summary: Fetches the widget's sub-controller via vtable +0x58 and, when non-null, selects entry subId | ((u32)self->u16_28 << 16) through Ui_List_SelectEntryById.

functions.name: Ui_Part_ConfirmWithSe1
functions.summary: Confirm wrapper used by the skill-panel handlers: when the part has not been initialised yet (f_14 == 0) and the argument is non-zero it lazily creates the sound work and plays SE 1, then always tail-calls the shared handler 0x0029126C(self, arg2).

functions.name: Ui_StartLayoutAnimations
functions.signature: void Ui_StartLayoutAnimations(UiWidget* self, int animA, int animB)
functions.summary: Starts up to two layout animations on the widget using the packed key (layer<<16 | index) expected by 0x1A6680.

functions.name: Text_SetupDualLayersDefault
functions.summary: Variant of Text_SetupDualLayers that binds the same txt_l1/txt_l2 and null_txt_l1/null_txt_l2 layers but resets the layer handles to the defaults first.

functions.name: Ui_Object_CtorWithPriority
functions.summary: Common window-base constructor fragment: runs Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x0018FF74 and sets the default draw priority at +0x4C to 10.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorSub
functions.summary: Destructor matching the shared window-base constructor 0x0018FF58: runs the UI base destructor 0x001A6768 (which releases the child ring and returns the block to the UI allocator) and then frees this object with 0x0010F6CC. Every window class that uses 0x0018FF58 has this two-call destructor.

functions.name: Ui_ItemList_RemoveItem
functions.summary: Removes itemId from the screen's two u16 selection lists, decrements the remaining-count field and recalculates the derived stats.

functions.name: Member_RemoveItemAtSlot
functions.summary: Removes the item in inventory slot `slot` of a party member (24 u16 ids at member+0xEC). An equipped slot is unequipped first, the slot is set to 0xFFFF and the member's stats are recalculated; an unequipped slot shifts the later ids down and clears the last one.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_ClampStatSigned
functions.summary: Retrieves maximum stat boundary via virtual method +8 on unit and clamps value between 0 and maximum.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_ClampStatUnsigned
functions.summary: Retrieves maximum unsigned stat boundary via virtual method +8 on unit and clamps value.

functions.name: Item_CanAddOneMore
functions.summary: For the item in a member inventory cell (+0xEC): reads the per-item stack limit (+0x45) and returns whether the held count plus one stays within it.

functions.name: Ui_ItemList_RemoveMatching
functions.summary: Scans the screen's item list and removes every entry accepted by func_003AA574.

functions.name: Party_Member_ClearEquipSlots
functions.summary: Blanks a party member's six equipment-slot bytes at +0x11C (all set to 0xFF) and refreshes the member's text cells and font record.

functions.name: Party_Member_EquipInventorySlot
functions.signature: u32 Party_Member_EquipInventorySlot(void* member, int invSlot, int equipSlot, int refreshStats)
functions.summary: Equips the item at member inventory slot invSlot (member+0xEC+invSlot*2) into equipment slot equipSlot (0..5 at member+0x11C..+0x121), handling 2H/dual-wield weapon/shield conflicts via 0x00191470, recalculating stats, and returning 1 on success or 0 if invalid.

functions.name: Party_Member_UnequipSlotAndRefresh
functions.summary: Unequips equipment slot `equipSlot` of a party member and refreshes the derived state: returns 1 when something was actually unequipped, in which case it also re-compacts the inventory (func_00191E3C) and recalculates the member's stats.

functions.name: Text_CopyLayoutWithOffset
functions.summary: Snapshots the current text layout, subtracts the block's own origin from the ten exported 16-bit coordinates and stores the shifted 0xEA-byte copy back over +0x1DC.

functions.name: Party_Member_AddExp
functions.summary: Adds experience points to party member (+0xDC), clamps to EXP cap 9,999,999 (0x0072739C), checks level growth table (0x0063E7F8), increments level (+0xD8), triggers Party_Member_RecalculateStats (0x0019201C), and fires story/progress event work+0x24A98 vt[8](0x20D).

functions.name: Party_Member_ApplyPageContent
functions.signature: void Party_Member_ApplyPageContent(void* self, const void* src, int mode)
functions.summary: Applies one page of a party member record: resets the page glyph/width tables, copies the layout block and typing state from src, runs the text layout pass, and then reconciles the member's 24 inventory slots at +0xEC against the static id table 0x00190F10 - matching slots are removed (or un-equipped through 0x00191470) and re-marked 0xFFFF.

functions.name: Text_Page_BuildAtOffset
functions.signature: void Text_Page_BuildAtOffset(TextPage* self, int offset, const u16* posDelta)
functions.summary: Builds the page's 0xEA-byte layout block at an arbitrary pen position: starts from the current coordinates, adds the optional 10-short delta, copies the two glyph arrays and writes the resulting run.

functions.name: Actor_GetEquipAppearanceType
functions.summary: Maps a member's equipped items to an appearance type: reads the two equipped item ids (slots 0 and 1), maps the first item's category byte (+0x29) to 1..15 and bumps it by one when both items share the category; returns 0xFF when nothing is equipped and 0 for the special actor ids 8 and 0x1E.

functions.name: Party_Member_MoveInventoryToBag
functions.summary: Empties a party member's 24-slot inventory into the item bag: walks the used slots from the top down, unequips and recalculates the member for slots that are equipped, shifts the remaining ids left so the array stays compact, and adds every id to the bag at work+0x24ACC with ItemBag_AddItemCount(bag, id, 1).

functions.name: Text_Page_ExportLayout
functions.summary: Copies the page's render state into a caller-supplied run: pen position (+0xDC), the four coordinates at +0x1C8..+0x1D8, the 0x78-byte glyph array at +0x122, the 0x1C-byte array at +0x1A2, the eight colour words at +0xEC..+0x108 and the cell-flag bytes at +0x11C..+0x121. Pure field copy, no calls except memmove.

functions.name: Party_Member_UnequipInventorySlot
functions.summary: Removes inventory slot index invSlot (0..23) from any of the member's six equipment slots (member+0x11C..+0x121) that reference it (setting them to -1 and clearing paired 2H/dual-wield off-hand +0x11D when needed), returning 1 if unequipped or 0 if not equipped.

functions.name: Party_ValidateEquipment
functions.summary: Re-validates the six quick-equipment slots at +0x11c, dropping entries whose item is no longer owned and recalculating stats.

functions.name: Text_Page_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a text page: clears the glyph arrays (30 and 20 entries) to 0xff, stores the new style byte and reinitialises the page's line/offset state.

functions.name: Party_Member_InitFromMasterRecord
functions.signature: void Party_Member_InitFromMasterRecord(PartyMember* member, int charaId, int* nameBlock, int* record)
functions.summary: Initialises a party member structure from master character data: copies the 7-character name wchar array to member+0xCA, equips default items, compacts inventory, and invokes Party_Member_RecalculateStats (0x0019201C).

functions.name: Party_Member_ApplyInventoryRecord
functions.signature: void Party_Member_ApplyInventoryRecord(void* member, const u8* args)
functions.summary: Fills a party member's 24 u16 inventory slots (+0xEC) from a party record: computes the page count through the text layout, saves and restores the layout state, blanks the six equipment slots (+0x11C), then copies each supplied item id into the next inventory slot - clearing the text cell of a slot first when func_006292A4 reports it as equipped - and finally refreshes the member's text page.

functions.name: Member_SetItemAtSlot
functions.signature: void Member_SetItemAtSlot(PartyMember* member, int slot, u16 itemId)
functions.summary: Writes an item id into inventory slot `slot` of a party member (member+0xEC + slot*2): when the slot is currently equipped it unequips it first through Party_Member_UnequipInventorySlot, then stores the id and, if anything was unequipped, refreshes the derived data (0x00191E3C) and recalculates the member's stats.

functions.name: Member_SwapInventorySlots
functions.signature: u32 Member_SwapInventorySlots(PartyMember* first, int slotA, PartyMember* b, int slotB)
functions.summary: Swaps the item ids in two party-member inventory slots (member+0xEC + slot*2): unequips either slot first when it is equipped, exchanges the two u16 ids, then refreshes both members and recalculates the stats of whichever member had something unequipped. Always returns 1.

functions.name: Party_Member_RecalculateStats
functions.summary: Full party member stat recalculation pass: recalculates max HP (+0x10), max MP (+0x12), base attack (+0x1A), defense (+0x1E), agility (+0x22), deftness (+0x26), charm (+0x2A), magical might (+0x2C), magical mending (+0x30), walks 60 skills (+0x129C) and 40 spells (+0x1274), and recalculates equipment modifiers.

functions.name: Party_Member_LearnSkillOrSpell
functions.signature: u32 Party_Member_LearnSkillOrSpell(PartyMember* member, u32 id, u8* outLearned, u16* arg4)
functions.summary: Learns a new spell or skill: checks if the id is already in the member's 40-spell (+0x1274) or 60-skill (+0x129C) array, appends to the first available slot (0xFF), and triggers stat recalculation.

functions.name: Party_Member_InitEquipSlots
functions.summary: Initialises the member's 6 equipment index slots (+0x11C) and resets active combat state pointers.

functions.name: Party_Member_RecalcStatsFromCommand
functions.signature: void Party_Member_RecalcStatsFromCommand(void* self, u32 arg2, int command)
functions.summary: Recalculates party member stats on specific menu/story command: walks active party members and triggers Party_Member_RecalculateStats.

functions.name: Item_MarkOwnedVariants
functions.summary: For the given item id and each of its variant ids (base from func_0066C368, count at record+0x10) sets the corresponding bit in the 2880-bit per-item ownership mask at saveWork+0x4B30.

functions.name: maybe_Text_DecodeName
functions.summary: Copies a 0x84-byte text record, decodes it through the text/font throw path and stores the two result bytes into out[0]/out[1].

functions.name: Text_Style_Decode
functions.summary: Decodes a packed 0x84-byte text-style record into the style object's fields, validating it through the shared text error routine first.

functions.name: Text_Style_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises a default text style object: zeroes the counters, constructs the embedded font-name field and sets the seven-character default name.

functions.name: Item_Equip_CheckRequirements
functions.summary: Validates equipment compatibility and attribute requirements for the specified item against character parameters.

functions.name: Party_RecalcAllMembersStats
functions.summary: Unconditionally recalculates combat stats for all party members in the active party list.

functions.name: Party_ValidateEquipmentNames
functions.signature: void Party_ValidateEquipmentNames(Actor* self, int command, int arg3)
functions.summary: Re-applies every party member's font record and, when the equipment-change command 0x211 arrives with a non-zero flag, additionally revalidates all six equipment slots of all 31 members: for each slot it looks up the item record of the equipped id and clears/refreshes the member's name cells when the record changed.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_ResetTurnState
functions.summary: Resets turn status fields 0x0F through 0x1D to zero and clears temporary combat modifier flags.

functions.name: Text_StyleList_Insert
functions.summary: Inserts a fresh default style at the given index of the five-entry style list: shifts the following 0x44-byte records down and writes the new default record into the freed slot.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_ApplyStatusEffects
functions.summary: Checks status effect resistance flags at offsets 0x2BF1 and 0x2BF2; triggers virtual status applicator if below threshold.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_InitFourTripleByteSlots
functions.summary: Writes four 3-byte 0xFF records into the caller object at +0x9750 (the 4x3 temp array built at sp is copied there); returns nothing.

functions.name: Party_List_InsertBlankRecord
functions.summary: Shifts the party-member record block at +0x944C up by one 0x60-byte slot and writes a freshly built default member record (0x192780, 7-wchar empty name from 0x007BE72C) into the freed position at +0x96EC.

functions.name: maybe_Party_ShiftRecordSlots
functions.summary: Inserts a 0x44-byte record into the five-slot array at +0x92F4: it first checks the record at +0x92F4 for the 0xFF/-1 sentinels (and measures the string at +0x92FC), then memcpy's the new record into the shifted slot, or appends it at +0x9404 when the list is full.

functions.name: Ui_PartyList_InsertMember
functions.summary: Stores a member record in the party list: with fewer than eight members it writes the 0x5D-byte record into the next free 0x60 slot, otherwise it shifts the list up and overwrites the last slot.

functions.name: maybe_Text_UpdateStyleParams
functions.summary: Rebuilds a text object's style from its cached copy: copies the 16 style words at self+0x8668..+0x86A4 into a local TextStyleBlock, resolves it with Text_ResolveStyleBlock and applies the result to the object through 0x00613F14.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CellGrid_InitSlots
functions.summary: Initializes 16 pre-allocated display cell slots at +0x8BC4 (stride 0xB8) using std_memcpy from default slot templates.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_InitTransform
functions.summary: Initialises a 0x24-byte transform/rectangle on the stack via 0x006722C4; control flow truncated by halt_baddata().

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Calc_DamageTable
functions.summary: Unverified battle routine: readable body truncated by halt_baddata(); 56-byte Thumb function in battle command region.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CopyPartyData
functions.summary: Copies the 0x2E-word party/battle blocks from +0x8C7C down to +0x8BC4 and then stores the incoming 0x2E-word record at +0x923C.

functions.name: Battle_Action_FindSlot
functions.summary: Scans action queue buffer between offsets 0x944C and 0x974C for the next available battle action slot.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_ExecuteBranch
functions.summary: Unverified battle action branch: readable body truncated by halt_baddata(); 64-byte Thumb function following action-slot search at 0x0019368C.

functions.name: SaveData_PartyContainer_Reset
functions.summary: Resets the party roster container in save data: marks member slots empty and zeroes roster size.

functions.name: SaveData_PartyContainer_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for the save data party roster container: sets vtable and installs member list pointers.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ApplyModeFlags
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_ApplyModeFlags(UiWindow* self, int mode, u32 arg3, u32 workSel)
functions.summary: Applies a mode to two object flag bytes: mode 5 sets self+0x48, modes 1 and 2 set self+0x49 from the world flag at (work+8)+0x44, every other mode does nothing. The mode itself is never stored.

functions.name: Ui_ActionPane_Init
functions.signature: UiActionPane* Ui_ActionPane_Init(UiActionPane* self, u32 actionId, u32 arg3, const char* name, u8 arg5)
functions.summary: Initialises an action-pane object: installs the vtables, copies the command/name string (bounded to 15 bytes), and stores the action id, owner and style byte.

functions.name: Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init
functions.signature: GfxObjectDesc* Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init(GfxObjectDesc* self, u32 kind, u32 id, const char* name, u8 mode, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Base initialiser for every named game object descriptor: installs the descriptor vtable pair (0x00193E24/0x00193E28), copies up to 15 bytes of the asset name into the inline buffer at +8, NUL-terminates it and stores kind, id, mode and flags.

functions.name: Ui_CreateWindowById
functions.signature: UiWindow* Ui_CreateWindowById(uint32_t [2] out, int layoutId, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Window factory: allocates g_00193F10 bytes from the UI heap, constructs the window object with 0x167764 for the requested layout id (0xFF means the default 0x11), registers it with the UI manager and binds it to the gold window/owner.

functions.name: Ui_DestroyWindowById
functions.summary: Destructor for the window created by 0x193E58: installs the released vtable g_00193F50, unregisters the window object from the UI manager and frees the handle.

functions.name: Script_GetIntTable1
functions.summary: Returns an integer from the first of the three parallel script integer tables, creating/populating the table on first use.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceList_Attach
functions.summary: Registers a graphics resource in one of the engine's sorted resource lists: builds the three-word key from the current render context, inserts the node, unlinks it from the previous list and marks it busy.

functions.name: Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueA
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueA(GfxResDesc* self, const char* key)
functions.summary: String-keyed lookup in the resource descriptor's hash map at self->[0x90]+0x94: hashes the key (0x0011CCA0), asks the map (0x00659668) for an index and returns the u32 value stored in the parallel array at +0x90, or 0 when the key is absent. One of four identical per-table getters.

functions.name: Container_RemoveFromGlobalList
functions.summary: Removes an object from the global registry vector g_uniqueIdPoolTable, shifts the tail down, unlinks its +0x60 node through func_005647F8 and clears the object's f_E4 flag.

functions.name: Gfx_SetGlobalBoolFlag
functions.summary: Writes the global boolean at 0x001942FC from the second argument. A one-line setter for a render/UI feature flag; the flag is read elsewhere to gate an optional drawing pass.

functions.name: Script_GetIntTable2
functions.summary: Second of the three parallel script integer-table getters; same code as Script_GetIntTable1 with a different table id.

functions.name: Script_GetIntTable3
functions.summary: Third of the three parallel script integer-table getters; same code as Script_GetIntTable1 with a different table id.

functions.name: Fs_IsBchPath
functions.summary: Returns true when the given path contains the model suffix ".bch".

functions.name: Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueB
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueB(GfxResDesc* self, const char* key)
functions.summary: Same string-keyed getter as 0x001941D4 but on the descriptor's hash map at +0x7C and its value array at +0x78; returns 0 when the key is missing. Used for the second of the four resource tables.

functions.name: Container_AddUniqueId
functions.signature: void Container_AddUniqueId(u32 id, u32 arg2, u32 * vec)
functions.summary: Appends an id to a global vector unless it is already present: scans the caller's range and the global registry, and grows the vector (doubling through std_memmove) when it is full.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelResource_FindValueByName
functions.summary: Resolves a name inside a model resource set: strlen(name) then trie lookup in self->f_90 (+0xAC) and returns the u32 stored in the parallel array at +0xA8, or 0 when the trie reports 0xFFFF (not found).

functions.name: Gfx_ModelResource_FindTextureIdByName
functions.summary: Same lookup as 0x00194588 but over the resource set's second name table (trie at +0x58, values at +0x54); used to map a texture name such as "sky_cloud" to its texture id.

functions.name: Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueC
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueC(GfxResDesc* self, const char* key)
functions.summary: Third variant of the descriptor getter, using the hash map at +0x40 and the value array at +0x3C. Returns 0 for a missing key.

functions.name: Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueD
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResDesc_GetValueD(GfxResDesc* self, const char* key)
functions.summary: Fourth variant of the descriptor getter, using the hash map at +0x4C and the value array at +0x48. Returns 0 for a missing key; it is the table used by the layout/pane code.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for 3D sound emitter object; unbinds audio voice at +0x18, finalizes emitter base, and frees heap memory.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_InitFromDesc
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite2D_InitFromDesc(SpriteActor* self, const SpriteDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Creates the 2D sprite/animation node described by a table entry: resolves the sprite type (0x0066A7B8/0x0062C388/0x0062C3B0), stores the key fields, allocates the animation instance with Mem_AllocAligned and Anim_Instance_ApplyTemplate, attaches the mesh with 0x005E7650, sets the model size (Field_SceneObject_SetModelSize) and publishes the shared node (0x0029E41C). This is the duplicate of the ARM routine at 0x001A4E78 used by the Thumb-compiled mini-game module.

functions.name: Sound_Listener_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for audio listener component; releases 3D audio listener state via func_0028E6C4 and frees memory.

functions.name: Ui_BindGaugeParts
functions.summary: Binds the gauge's fill and outline layers (gauge/out) and registers the gauge update callback.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWidget_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a composite UI widget: releases its three embedded layout/animation references, runs the base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_ActionWindow_Setup
functions.summary: Sets up the action window: configures the scroll pane, initialises the six-slot action list and selects the first/last visible command.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_UpdateBuffer
functions.summary: Updates audio streaming buffer progress; evaluates poll callback +0x10 and increments stream playback statistics.

functions.name: Ui_UnlinkWidgetNode
functions.signature: void Ui_UnlinkWidgetNode(UiWidget* node, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Removes a widget from its intrusive doubly-linked list (patches the neighbours' next/prev), marks the node unlinked and notifies the screen manager's vtable slot +0xC.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateTick
functions.summary: State handler wrapper: calls the named Ui_Widget_Update (0x001DAD58) and returns 1, i.e. 'still running'. Same shape as the other one-line handlers around 0x0019E45C.

functions.name: Shop_BuyItem
functions.signature: u32 Shop_BuyItem(Shop* self, int itemIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Buys the selected shop item: reads its price, subtracts the price from the party's gold, updates the shop slot state and moves the window to the success state.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_SetState7
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Panel_SetState7(void* self, const void* desc)
functions.summary: Step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 with the descriptor block at desc+0x520, and once the widget reports ready asks the controller at self+0x3574 for state 7 through vtable+0x14 and commits it with vtable+0x10. Always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_ActionWindow_Destroy
functions.summary: Destroys the action window: drains the pending action queue, releases both scroll/list sub-objects and tears down the pane hierarchy.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_SetState0
functions.summary: Step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests state 0 on the core at self+0x3574 and commits it. Always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_SetState7B
functions.summary: Step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests state 7 on the core at self+0x3574 and commits it. Always returns 1.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderQueue_PushPass
functions.summary: Appends render pass parameters at passDesc + 0xD8 to the queue and invokes virtual render command +0x54 with pass index 0x2C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ActionWindow_Reset2
functions.summary: Reset variant of the shared window template: drains the pending children, re-links the embedded node, resets the base parts, sets the sub-widget state to 1 and raises the flag at +0xBC8.

functions.name: Shop_CanAfford
functions.signature: u32 Shop_CanAfford(Shop* self, int itemIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Checks whether the party can pay for the selected shop item and moves the window to the affordable/unaffordable state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_OnInputSelectEntry
functions.summary: UI window input/step entry: on confirm (mask 0x142) it resolves the selected row, runs that row's action node, refreshes the embedded message window's status text at +0x3120 and writes the selected entry's value into the number text at +0x316C; mask 4 advances to controller step 7, mask 1 forwards the three pointer arguments to the list widget at +0xBC8.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ActionWindow_InitSlots
functions.summary: Builds the six battle-action slots: sets the window mode 0x2F, sizes the list container from a byte field, builds six entries through Ui_ListData_BuildEntries, then fills each slot's icon/style bytes from the five global flag lookups (Flag_GetGlobalIndexed 0..4).

functions.name: Ui_Panel_SetStateConditional
functions.summary: Step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests state 5 when the prompt was confirmed and self+0xC14 is clear, or raises the busy bytes +0x134/+0x135 and requests state 0 when it is set, or requests state 7 on cancel.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemDetail_Setup
functions.summary: Fills the detail pane of an action window: sets message argument 5 from the selected entry (self->f_3570->f_51C), installs the format string through the message-format singleton *0x007AC834, copies party member 0's stats and status block into a local buffer for argument 6, and finally shows the pane with Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindowRoot_Ctor
functions.summary: Construction-into-memory of the message-window root object: installs the root vtable, constructs the member pair at +0x3574 with its own vtable, back-links it to the root and default-constructs the eight 0x18-byte window slots of the root's state sequence.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseMessageWindowRoot
functions.summary: Releases the message-window root: clears the pending flag, drops the resource handle at +0xD99, destroys the embedded controller at -0x3664 and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ScreenSystem_Rebuild
functions.summary: Rebuilds the 0x328-byte screen-system object when the requested mode byte is 8: releases the old object through the UI core, allocates a new one, runs maybe_Field_CreateScreenSystem(block, self+0x1C), creates its parts and activates it; on failure the new block is released and the slot at self+100 is cleared.

functions.name: Gfx_Texture_ReleaseBinding
functions.summary: Unbinds and releases active GPU texture slot if bound flag 0x2C is set, invoking texture release callback.

functions.name: Ui_CreateMessageWindow
functions.summary: Constructor of the message-window object: builds the 0x2BC32C base, initialises the line buffer and palette, creates the font/resource handles (0x293A00) and the text-layout helper, then returns the adjusted base pointer.

functions.name: Ui_DestroyMessageWindow
functions.signature: void Ui_DestroyMessageWindow(UiMessageWindow* self, uint32_t vtable, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor of the message window: releases the font handle at +0x64, resets the string pointers/vtables to g_00196400..008, unlinks the line lists and destroys the 0x2BC734 base.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_TogglePage
functions.summary: Switches the message window between its two pages (f_140 1<->2) when there is more than one result page, plays the matching layout animation (4/0) and updates the pager widget.

functions.name: Text_UpdateCursorBlink
functions.signature: void Text_UpdateCursorBlink(UiMessageWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Advances the message-window cursor blink timer: once the accumulated time passes the threshold it cycles each of the four line cursors to its alternate glyph animation (0x53/0x54/0x55) and reloads the next blink interval.

functions.name: Text_LayoutLines
functions.summary: Rebuilds the four visible text lines starting at firstLine: stops the old animations, measures each glyph through the font manager (0x66B0E4/0x635EB98) and starts the per-line fade/scroll animations; finally stores the visible line count in +0x148.

functions.name: Ui_List_GetSelectedRow
functions.summary: Returns the currently selected row record of a list widget: when the 'has selection' byte at list+0x14 is set it asks vtable slot +0x44 for the cursor index and returns list + index*60 + 0x1B; NULL otherwise.

functions.name: Text_ApplyGlyphStyle
functions.summary: Chooses the animation/colour for the current glyph class (0x10 = selected, 2 = normal, 4/8 = dimmed) and starts it on the line, then advances the two-entry style toggle.

functions.name: Ui_SetupPagerTextLayers
functions.summary: Binds a pager widget's text layers: four left columns, four right columns and the level-text layer, wiring each to its layout slot.

functions.name: Ui_Pager_InitTextLayers
functions.signature: void Ui_Pager_InitTextLayers(u32* pager, u32 mode, u32 arg3, u32 initial)
functions.summary: Initialises the four text layers of a pager: for each of the four layer handles (arg1[1..4]) it registers the layer with the text system (0x001A6680) and applies the default text id/colour from the global 0x00197198 via 0x001A629C, then runs the layer class initialiser 0x003D2E2C. Called from Ui_SetupPagerTextLayers.

functions.name: Gfx_Shader_BindUniformBuffer
functions.summary: Binds shader uniform parameter buffer using shader table func_00641C28 and commits uniform registers via func_001A6680.

functions.name: Text_InitLineStruct
functions.summary: Zero-initialises a message-line record (six words plus flags), installs the default style word and resets the glyph-animation slot.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_UpdatePager
functions.summary: Updates the message page's pager: lays out the lines, counts party members, sets the page/line counters and shows/hides the icon_next and icon_prev buttons.

functions.name: Ui_Pager_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the message pager: runs the UI object base constructor, installs the pager vtable, stores the owner and default-constructs the four 0x3c-byte page records at +0x50.

functions.name: Ui_Pager_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the pager: installs the derived vtable from 0x00197490, destroys the four 0x3C-byte layer blocks at +0x50 (element destructor 0x00197494, 4 elements), then chains to the UI base destructor 0x001A6768 and frees the object (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Text_ReleaseLineObjects
functions.summary: Releases the two optional objects owned by a text line (at +0xC and +0x14) through their virtual destructor slot +4.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Scene_Create
functions.summary: Builds the field 2D scene for a scene transition: stores the scene name, allocates the 0x23B4-byte field object (func_005E4A70) and the 0x3008-byte 2D scene, then hands the Field2D manager, the Field_ObjectManager, the FX manager, the event state and the save work to Field2D_Scene_InitSpawnPoints; the previous objects are released through their vtable+4 first.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BuildStatusList
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_BuildStatusList(void* self, int* ids, u32 arg3, int count)
functions.summary: Fills a UI list from up to 8 ids (stops at -1): each entry becomes {id, u16 value from work+id*0x8C+0x2AAF4}, then stores the count at +0x6C and notifies the list vtable.

functions.name: Field2D_Scene_BuildFromFieldWork
functions.summary: Adapter called by Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene6 at scene state 11: resolves the active 2D scene context (work+0x88 -> +8) and calls Field2D_Scene_BuildFromMapData with the scene object at fieldWork+0xC and the three bytes at +9/+0xA/+0xB.

functions.name: Field2D_Scene_UpdateFromFieldWork
functions.summary: Second half of the same adapter pair: called by Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene6 at scene state 12 and forwards the same field-work fields to Field2D_Scene_UpdateLayers, which refreshes the 2D scene layers.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_UpdateCursorAndSprite
functions.summary: Per-frame scene-flow step: ensures the shared UI object exists, and when screen transitions are not blocking updates the selection cursor (Field_Gimmick_UpdateSelectionCursor) and always advances the 2D sprite state (Field2D_Sprite_UpdateState) for self->f_C.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_Ctor
functions.summary: One-shot constructor of a 0x37C-byte field scene object: lazily allocates the backing block through 0x0011FE8C/0x0011CFAC, zeroes it, installs the vtable, sets the 0xFF/0 defaults and constructs the eight 8-byte sub-records at +0x2C.

functions.name: Field_ReleaseResources
functions.summary: Teardown helper: virtual-destroys the two optional owned objects at +0x14 and +0xC (slot +4 of each vtable) and returns self; called from Field_DestroyScene as the field's member-release pass.

functions.name: Container_FixedVector_Push16
functions.summary: Push-back for a 16-byte-element vector with an 8-element inline buffer: inserts at the end when there is room (shifting the tail with memcpy), otherwise grows by doubling and copies the inline and heap halves into the new block.

functions.name: Text_ProcessControlTag
functions.summary: Consumes one message control tag from the tag buffer: shifts the pending queue, then dispatches on the tag id (1 = party member, 2 = word dictionary, 3 = character name, 0xB/0xD/0xE = item/word references) and registers the resolved string in the text dictionary slot 5 via 0x1F076C.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_Setup
functions.summary: Builds the item/equipment window from its BFLYT panes: win_dougu_party1/dougu1/fukuro1/sort/sort2/sort3/how/num/hand/party2/hp1/dougu2/fukuro2 plus the pager and HP gauge, and binds the sort/selection callbacks.

functions.name: Gfx_Material_ApplyParameters
functions.summary: Applies material shader constant buffers and texture parameters to GPU state, copying cached material attributes.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipmentWindow_SetItemCode
functions.summary: Takes the caller's already-prepared item record and, when it is valid, decodes it with 0x0066C2DC and stores the resulting u16 code in the UI core word at +0x94; called from Ui_EquipmentWindow_HandleInput.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ClosePaneIfOpen
functions.summary: If the window's child pane is currently open, closes it: resolves the pane, checks the open flag, pops the pane, clears the pane-active flag and runs the post-pop fix-up.

functions.name: Ui_MenuUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame menu update: invokes the screen's per-frame callback, decays the repeat timer, polls the input/action object, then runs the callback dispatch, text blink, detail refresh and pane update.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_Release
functions.summary: Releases the item window's major sub-widgets: the party pane group (0x2B20AC), the list pane (0x4E3EB4) and the item-detail window (0x29126C).

functions.name: Ui_Window_CloseCurrentPane
functions.summary: Closes the window's current pane: updates the pane widget at +0x1084, and if the object reference is the only variant it pops one pane and calls the pane virtual, otherwise it pops panes up to the default id and releases the object reference at +0x10D0.

functions.name: Mem_Pool_InitPoolA
functions.summary: Initializes aligned memory chunk allocation pool by calculating block stride via func_0011FE8C and aligned division func_0011CFAC.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_FindItemIndex
functions.summary: Finds the row index of an item in the equipment window: scans the 0x120-byte row records (+0xC stride) matching the item id and flag, then asks the row pager for the display index; returns the fallback constant when not found.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_Confirm
functions.summary: Confirms the highlighted item: scrolls the active list to the selected row (0x6E57E4), raises the cursor event flag and restarts the row animation.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_UpdateInput
functions.summary: Input handler for the item window: handles cancel (hide detail), the sort/how popup, confirms the selected row (0x4482F0/0x294378) and updates the pager highlight.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentList_HandleInput
functions.summary: Handles the equipment screen's selection input: on the scroll bit it refreshes the highlighted member row and the status-panel character field, on the 0x102 bits it writes the member name into message argument 3 and calls the item-detail pane virtual.

functions.name: Ui_Window_PopPaneAndReleaseRef
functions.summary: Pops the window's panes up to the default pane id and releases the object reference at +0x10D0. It is exactly the non-first-variant branch of Ui_Window_CloseCurrentPane.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentList_Scroll
functions.signature: void Ui_EquipmentList_Scroll(EquipmentScreen* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Scrolls the equipment list with wrap-around (negative -> last row, past the end -> 0), keeps the two visible columns in sync and refreshes the selected-entry message; pops the pane when the close bit is set.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_Update
functions.summary: Main per-frame update of the item/equipment window: handles tab switching, cursor repeat, the detail popup, the sort popup and the item-use animation, and pushes the current item name into the shared text dictionary.

functions.name: Mem_Pool_InitPoolB
functions.summary: Initializes secondary aligned memory allocation pool by computing 16-byte aligned chunk boundaries and configuring allocator.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentList_UpdateLayout
functions.summary: Refreshes the equipment screen's two lists after a cursor/selection change: scrolls the member list by the pending delta, picks the f_654 or f_5f4 pane depending on which party slot the cursor is on, recomputes the row from f_F2C, and scrolls the chosen list to the clamped row.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_UnequipSelectedItem
functions.summary: Unequips the selected equipment slot: walks the actor equipment list backwards, clears each non-cursed slot with func_001901F4 and rebuilds the equipment window.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_NavigateLists
functions.summary: Navigates between the equipment window's lists: moves the cursor across party slots and the item list, plays the corresponding selection animations, updates the message text from the table and scrolls the visible list into view.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenDetail
functions.signature: void Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenDetail(UiEquipmentWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Opens the item-detail sub-window with the standard 'open' animation: binds the detail widget at +0x1084 to the window and starts the animation sequence (0x6D7508/0x6D7630).

functions.name: Ui_Window_AdvancePageState
functions.summary: Advances the window's paging state: refreshes the layout widget at +0x1A8, then, while the page counter f_1164 is below 1, pops the page panes (Ui_Window_PopPane) or decrements the repeat counter f_1168 (reloading 3 when the shared window flag is set).

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenDetailEx
functions.signature: void Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenDetailEx(UiEquipmentWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Opens the item-detail pane of the equipment window with the alternate animation descriptor (0x00729ACC+0x60/+0x64) and the item list at arg2+0x11C; unlike Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenDetail it neither clears +0x1BC nor dispatches the callback.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_UseSelectedItem
functions.summary: Handles 'use/equip selected item' in the item window: confirms the row, resolves the item name, plays the success/error animation (0x19 = success, 0x18 = failure) and stores the resulting item id in the shared UI state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_UpdatePaneState
functions.summary: Per-frame pane/gauge update: when flag bit 2 of +0x1BC is set it pops the pane at +0x120; otherwise it sets the gauge at +0x930 from the three bytes at +0x1BE..+0x1C0 when bit 0 is set, and pushes the pane when bits 1/8 are set.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_ConfirmEquipSlot
functions.summary: Confirm handler for the equipment-slot list: resolves the highlighted item, plays anim 0x20 with a message pair when the item is flagged (bit 8), otherwise inserts the item name into the line text and plays anim 0x1E/0x1F.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_UseItemLogic
functions.summary: Item-use decision logic: checks whether the selected item is usable/equippable in the current context (0x66BC84/0x66C724/0x66C5A8/0x66C184/0x6293E8), and either plays the success animation or falls back to a plain confirm.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_ConfirmItemList
functions.summary: Confirm handler for the owned-item list of the equipment window: same item-record lookup and line-text insert as the slot handler, but always plays anim 0x1E/0x1F and uses the shared descriptor at 0x729ACC.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_SelectItem
functions.summary: Selects the current row: confirms the row through 0x1905E4, plays the 0x14/0x15 selection animation and updates the shared item-name slot; used by the row-press path.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_RefreshDetail
functions.summary: Rebuilds the equipment window's detail side: resolves the highlighted item through Ui_EquipmentWindow_FindItemIndex, reads its name, walks the two intrusive lists (+0xEC0/+0x9EC), plays the list-move sound helpers and marks the detail pane's dirty flags (+0x1C/+0x1D/+0x18) so it redraws.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_PlayAnim
functions.summary: Clears the window's per-frame state, resolves animId through 0x2BBAD0 and starts that layout animation on the item window (0x1DAB30/0x6D7508/0x6D7630).

functions.name: Ui_Panel_ResetAndPush
functions.summary: Resets the panel's 16-word status block, runs the generic pane reset (0x001DAB30), then pushes the panel's own pane descriptor (0x006D7508 with the vtable pair from g_0019BDC0) and clears the 'pane active' flag. Called by the equipment-detail screen and every window that re-opens itself on top of the pane stack.

functions.name: Ui_ItemMenu_CreateRoot
functions.summary: Creates the root object of the item/equipment menu screen (0x390 bytes): installs the root vtable and builds the embedded cursor, list, pager, detail and animation sub-objects used by the win_dougu_* panes.

functions.name: Ui_ItemMenu_DestroyRootThunk
functions.summary: Shutdown wrapper: runs the item-menu root destructor (0x19C164) and frees the object with 0x10F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_ItemMenu_DestroyRoot
functions.summary: Destructor of the item-menu root: stops the animation controller, releases the three cursor handles, tears down the sub-object chain (0x1DB5D0, 0x1A6768, 0x4E3FC0, 0x22A984, 0x44835C, 0x214F20, 0x2B2130, 0x36B514) and frees the object.

functions.name: Monster_SetupEcologyForId
functions.summary: Resolves the actor through the handle table, calls Monster_SetupEcology with the actor's spawn block and applies action 0x0B with the monster id.

functions.name: Field_Actor_LoadEmotionSlots
functions.summary: Binds the four facial-emotion sub-objects of an actor: looks each of the four ids in the global table 0x0019C78C up in the actor's face table (vtable+0x2C), stores them in out[1..4], initialises the expression group (vtable+0xC with 0) and attaches the 'emotion_love' animation via 0x003E00CC. Used when a scripted talk needs the love/emotion pose.

functions.name: maybe_Script_ResolveTwoIds
functions.signature: void maybe_Script_ResolveTwoIds(ScriptCtx* ctx, u32 id1, u32 id2)
functions.summary: Resolves two ids through the shared id table and writes the two objects to ctx+4/+8; the table is created lazily on first use.

functions.name: Gfx_ObjectDesc_Ctor4
functions.signature: void Gfx_ObjectDesc_Ctor4(GfxObjectDesc * desc, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Constructor for the type-4 object descriptor: runs the shared descriptor initialiser, installs the type-4 vtable and stores the caller's second word in the descriptor's +0x28 field.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_DeleteSubComponentB
functions.summary: Destroys and frees a layout sub-component via destructor func_00193E44 and operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_JumonWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_JumonWindow_InitPanes(UiJumonWindow* self, int arg2, int arg3, int layout)
functions.summary: Registers the panes of the party spell (jumon) window with the layout registrar using the literal layout group 'win_jumon_party1' and formats a '%0F0s0'-style text binding.

functions.name: Ui_JumonWindow_UpdateInput
functions.signature: void Ui_JumonWindow_UpdateInput(void* self, int arg2, int arg3, int input)
functions.summary: Per-frame input handler of the jumon/spell pane: feeds the direction state at +0x164 through 0x001A60A0, and on confirm writes the cursor result (Party_GetMemberIdAtCurrentPage) into the state record at +0x11C and pushes the sub-pane with Ui_JumonWindow_PushSubPane; the +0x134 bit 2 path writes the cancel state instead.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_ExecuteSubSlotAction
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_ExecuteSubSlotAction(UiLayout* self, u32 p1, int p2)
functions.summary: Dispatches layout action callback from function table self->f_13C for sub-slot index 0x160 when flag 0x20 is clear.

functions.name: Ui_Window_PopChild
functions.summary: Pops one child from the window's child stack: releases the top entry (0x0010EBD8), decrements the depth, invokes the entry's callback/thunk (with the vtable-offset convention at +0x140/+0x144), and finally notifies the new top child (0x001A5F9C) that it is active again. Used when closing a sub-dialog.

functions.name: Ui_DialogRoot_Init
functions.summary: In-place initialiser of the dialogue-root object: installs the root vtable (0x758EA4), registers the cursor controller, constructs the layout child at +0x44 and links the two intrusive lists at +0x414/+0x424. The allocating factory Ui_DialogRoot_Create (0x006D6F84) allocates the 0x594-byte object and calls this.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelNode_Dtor
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PanelNode_Dtor(void* self, u32 vtable, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Destructor: installs the class vtable in word 0 and the shared UI base vtable 0x00759388 at +0x578, unlinks three intrusive list node pairs, releases the owner sub-objects (0x00184EC0 then the -0x44/-0x120 adjustments) and frees the panel.

functions.name: Ui_PanelNode_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a panel node: clears the open byte, sets state 0x13, asks the owner (vtable+0x14) for slot 1 and clears the two list fields.

functions.name: Field_InitSceneObjects
functions.summary: Allocates and initializes the scene's object tables for a loaded area: map data, actor list, collision grid and effect slots.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithEmote
functions.summary: Closes a talk session on a message window: releases the window's line objects (f_8C), finishes the talk transition on the shared talk handle at self->f_B0+0x146 and invalidates the 2D field character bound at f_88.

functions.name: Field_ApplySceneFade
functions.summary: Applies the scene's fade/visibility mode to the screen state: switches the fade helper at f_78 to the wanted mode, updates the transition controller fields, resets the screen state through Field_ResetScreenState and clears the fade-in-progress bit of device+0x1346.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_Update
functions.summary: Central update of the UI scene-transition object: on a state change it stops the previous scene (0x001C839C, resets two sound streams through 0x005F9828), tears down the per-scene objects (0x001DA344, 0x001D5440, 0x001C987C, 0x002566C8, 0x003977D0) and then dispatches on the scene kind at +0x14 (2 = field, 3 = battle, 7 = menu) to start the matching subsystem. Called by every scene handler wrapper.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ShowTalkData
functions.summary: Opens the message window for a talk/monster record: resolves the speaker's name and style from the record id, sets the window mode and background music, and switches the scene flow into the message state.

functions.name: Ui_Window_Hide
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_Hide(UiSceneFlow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 workSel)
functions.summary: Hides the scene's message-window layer: marks the layer byte +0x4D (through the object at self[0xB0]) as 0xFF and asks the message system to clear the current message state (Ui_MessageWindow_ShowFieldData side of the call with work+8).

functions.name: Gfx_RenderPass_IsEnabled
functions.summary: Virtual method stub in render pass vtable returning 1 to indicate the pass is enabled.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithTalkData
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithTalkData(UiMessageWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Ends the currently displayed talk: stops the talk-data player, hides the message window through the UI manager and releases the cursor/balloon objects.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseAndReleaseCutscene
functions.summary: Message-window close path: notifies the overlay helper 0x001DBB34 through the scene-transition manager, releases the cutscene message and camera at self+0x70 (Cutscene_ReleaseMessageAndCamera / Cutscene_Teardown) and finishes the UI-core transition with the message id at f_b0+0x146.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithBalloon
functions.summary: Closes the balloon variant of the message window: finishes the window transition on the record at (+0xB0)+0x146 through Ui_SmithMenu_FinishTransition and releases the variant widget held at self+0x84.

functions.name: Ui_Message_ApplyArgRecord
functions.signature: void Ui_Message_ApplyArgRecord(UiMessageText* self, MsgArgRecord* argument, int arg3, int context)
functions.summary: Applies one message-argument record: for types other than 7 it writes the type into the per-slot byte array at work+0x2A4E6+id, copies the whole record into the text object's argument block (+0x10C) and rebuilds the character models for the new type.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ShowSimple
functions.summary: Starts a simple message in a message window: stores the record word in wnd->f_b0->f_136 and sets state 7, style 2 and field 6, then continues into code Ghidra cannot decode. The three callers (Field_ShowSimpleMessage, StatusWindow_UpdateState, LoadDiveMapJump) all use it to show text.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Render_DispatchBranchA
functions.summary: Unverified graphics dispatch branch: readable body truncated by halt_baddata(); 108-byte Thumb function in 0x19Exxx rendering region.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Render_DispatchBranchB
functions.summary: Unverified graphics dispatch branch: readable body truncated by halt_baddata(); 124-byte Thumb function following 0x0019EBC0.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithCharacter
functions.summary: Closes the character-bound variant of the message window: rebinds the displayed character record for the widget at self+0x5C through FieldScene_RebindCharacter and then finishes the window transition on the record at (+0xB0)+0x146.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseAll
functions.summary: Full teardown of all message sub-systems: releases the balloon, gauge, layout, nameplate and talk widgets, unloads the game-common pack and notifies the UI manager.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithCursor
functions.summary: Message-window close: clears the cursor state (core+0x14 -> +0xC, slot 8 with 0), fires cutscene commands 1 and 2, releases the pager widgets and returns the window handle self+0x8C.

functions.name: Field_Effect_BuildDescA
functions.summary: Builds and initializes the visual effect descriptor at self->f_50 by calling maybe_Field_EffectDesc_Build, returning 1.

functions.name: Field_SetScreenFadeFlag
functions.summary: Sets the screen-fade bit: calls the scene's virtual slot 0xC and ORs bit 2 into the screen-state byte at device+0x1346, the same bit Field_ApplySceneFade clears when the fade finishes.

functions.name: Field_Effect_IsActive
functions.summary: Virtual method in effect instance vtable returning 1 to report active playback status.

functions.name: maybe_BattleActor_ShowStateEffect
functions.summary: Battle-actor effect/state display: fills the request record at self+0xB0 (type 6, count 1, id 6, effect id from +0xB2 or 0x13), builds the transform/anchor record, marks the anchor at +0x48 as mode 7 and calls Battle_Unit_UpdateEffectAnchors; then touches the bag/save block (work+0x24A98), updates the actor's sound handle and sets state 0x10.

functions.name: Field_Effect_CanInterrupt
functions.summary: Virtual method in effect instance vtable returning 1 to indicate effect can be interrupted or skipped.

functions.name: Ui_Window_OpenScene
functions.summary: First-time start-up of the scene: if it has not been opened yet, queries the pack/manager state (0x00124FA0/0x00645608) and, when the scene is not already active, brings up every subsystem - message system (0x00610118), scene object (0x001C71B4), UI core (0x006F229C/0x006260B4), 2D layer (0x002D6B80), item list (0x00284474/0x001E6C58) and the input/camera helper (0x0035F640) - then marks itself opened.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_Step1
functions.summary: State-handler stub: runs the scene-flow update 0x0019E45C and reports 1 ('handled, stay in state'). One of seven identical stubs used as virtual state entries.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithCutscene
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithCutscene(UiMessageWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Closes a message window that owns a cutscene: ends the cutscene object at +0x70 (Cutscene_Close), sends cutscene commands 1 and 2, parks the child group 1 of the widget at +0x54 and notifies the UI core.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithInput
functions.summary: Message-window close that also re-enables input: clears the cursor state, closes the cutscene, resets the movie mode, fires cutscene commands 1 and 2, re-enables the input handler at core+0x14+0x10 and releases the pager widgets.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ChildScreen_DisableSubC
functions.summary: One-line wrapper: calls the child-screen sub-object at Ui_GetCore()->f_14->f_C through its virtual +8 with 0, i.e. clears/disables it.

functions.name: Battle_SetupUnitFromMonsterData
functions.summary: Copies a monster/battle data record (species id, palette bytes and ~50 u16 statistics) into the unit's monster sub-struct at self+0xB0, resolves the species link through the current context table and derives the AI/behaviour flags (+0x14a) from the species record.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithScene
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithScene(UiMessageWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Closes a message window that owns a sub-scene: releases the scene object at +0x5C (maybe_Gfx_Scene_Release), clears the choice handler at core+0x14 and parks the child group 1 of the widget at +0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseAndNotifyCharacter
functions.summary: Second close path of the message window: notifies the 2D field character handler (Field2D_OnCharacterChanged) with the window owner and message id, then releases the cutscene message/camera at self+0x70, tears the cutscene down and finishes the UI-core transition. Identical to 0x0019EA58 except for that first notification.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_WaitClose
functions.summary: Scene-flow state that waits for the opened windows to close: runs the update, and while a window is still open (Ui_IsAnyWindowOpen 0x00217374) it stays in this state; when everything is closed it clears the two 'opening' flags and falls through to the next state. Prevents a new scene from starting while a dialog is up.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithWindowOnly
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithWindowOnly(UiMessageWindow* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Smallest close variant: only asks the text manager to hide the window (0x625E00), leaving sub-widgets to their owners.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_SyncState
functions.signature: u32 Ui_SceneFlow_SyncState(UiSceneFlow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 workSel)
functions.summary: If the desired and current scene state differ (+0x45 vs +0x44) it copies the state, stops the previous scene (0x001C839C), resets the two sound streams (0x005F9828) and tears down the 2D layer (0x002566C8/0x003977D0). Lightweight variant of SceneFlow_Update used when no scene switch is needed.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_ApplyFade
functions.summary: Runs the scene-flow update and then applies the pending fade/screen effect through the fade routine on self->f_84; returns 1 to keep the state active.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_OnOpen
functions.summary: Scene-flow open step: applies the transform at self+0xB0+0x130 and, when the state carries a style other than -1, rebinds the 2D layer and resets its render mode. The readable body is empty (Ghidra dropped it).

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_Step2
functions.summary: State-handler stub identical to 0x0019F020: run the scene-flow update and return 1. Kept as a separate symbol because it is referenced by a different vtable slot.

functions.name: Field_Effect_IsLooping
functions.summary: Virtual method in effect instance vtable returning 1 to indicate looping mode is supported.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_TeardownAll
functions.summary: Full teardown of a UI scene: shuts down every subsystem in dependency order - scene object (0x003602E8/0x00360720), 2D screen (0x003DB8A8/0x003DBD60), effect group (0x00256A58), message window (0x001D6B84), camera (0x0035E4C8), item list (0x002388D0/0x002387BC/0x00238798), scene manager (0x001D51E0), UI core (0x001C967C), 2D layer (0x00397984), battle HUD (0x0020FC08), text/message system (0x00610784), item UI (0x001E7C48), input helper (0x001F3598) - then hides the four UI layers with 0x0019FD24(self,1..4,0) and releases the shared resources.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithGauge
functions.summary: Closes the gauge variant of the message window: clears the gauge/jockey panel held at self+0x80 (Ui_JockeyPanel_Clear) and then finishes the talk transition on the shared talk handle at self->f_B0+0x146.

functions.name: BattleActor_ShowActionEffect
functions.summary: Shows one of the battle actor's action-effect sprites from a 6-byte argument record (kind, two sprite params, u16 id): chooses the sprite kind, copies the params into the sprite fields, resolves the message text (instant or delayed) and sets the actor state byte to 0x0E.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_SetLayerVisible
functions.signature: void Ui_SceneFlow_SetLayerVisible(UiSceneFlow* self, int layer, int visible)
functions.summary: Shows or hides one of the four UI layers: if the cached flag at +0xC0+layer differs it asks the UI core (0x006F1DF8) for the layer object and either registers the layer with its stored colour/size triple (0x001EC9A8) or removes it (0x001ECD08/0x001EC504), then caches the new flag. Called four times by the scene teardown and by the 2dcmn pack loader.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithPage
functions.summary: Message-window close: closes the cutscene, fires cutscene commands 1 and 2 and releases the pager widgets through 0x00625FD8. It is the minimal variant of the close family.

functions.name: SceneFlow_TryCommitTransition
functions.summary: One-shot commit of a pending scene transition: while nothing is loading (sound player idle, no pending pack data, loading screen neither active nor finished) it stamps the loading-screen colour from +0x3C/+0x3D, clears the global render flag, stops the sound player and marks byte +6 = 1 as committed; returns 1 either way.

functions.name: Field_Effect_BuildDescB
functions.summary: Alternative visual effect descriptor builder for secondary particle/model attachments, invoking maybe_Field_EffectDesc_Build.

functions.name: BattleActor_ShowFixedEffect
functions.summary: Fixed-id variant of the battle action effect: always uses effect id 0x406, sprite kind 7 and actor state 0x0F, copies the 0x406 id into the local sound struct, asks the item/effect manager for 0x406 and plays the text by id.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_Step3
functions.summary: Third identical scene-flow state stub: update and return 1.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_Step4
functions.summary: Fourth identical scene-flow state stub: update and return 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CloseWithNameTag
functions.summary: Message-window close: clears the cursor state, fires cutscene commands 1 and 2 and tears down the name-tag renderer at self+0x80 through 0x002F5868.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene6
functions.summary: Scene-transition handler for scene slot 6: when the state machine reaches state 9 and the scene system reports slot 6 ready (0x0036175C(self->f_60,6)), it commits that slot (0x00360254), resets the render mode, configures the message/fade layer, and advances the state. Otherwise it falls through to the shared state advance 0x001A04A4.

functions.name: Input_GetButtonState
functions.summary: Combines three pad queries (ids 1, 2 and 3 from 0x6336B8 — typically trigger, repeat and hold) into one button mask for the owning window.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_AdvanceState
functions.summary: Per-frame state advance shared by all scene handlers: ticks the two timers, then switches on the state byte (+0x1D) to run the entry actions of each phase (fade-in, wait for load, show windows, idle, fade-out) using the UI core and the sound/fade helpers, and finally increments the state. Every OpenSceneN handler calls this before its own scene-specific step.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_Step5
functions.summary: Fifth identical scene-flow state stub: update and return 1.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene2
functions.summary: Scene-transition handler for scene slot 2: at state 9 it checks 0x0036175C(self->f_60,2), commits the slot, applies the scene's camera/fade descriptor (+0x114/+0x116/+0x117) and the sound state, then lets the shared advance run. This is the 'enter field scene 2' step of the flow.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_OpenSceneField
functions.summary: Scene handler for the field variant (no fixed slot id): at state 9 it resets the render mode, configures the camera from the scene descriptor, binds the field scene object ids and pushes the message/fade descriptor.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene5
functions.summary: Scene-transition handler for scene slot 5: at state 9, when 0x0036175C(self->f_60,5) reports the slot ready, it commits it, sets the 2D mode and the message descriptor, resizes the field object (maybe_Field_ResizeObject 0x001EB390) and advances the state.

functions.name: Ui_Window_CloseDefault
functions.summary: Triggers window close animation by invoking virtual method +0xC on window controller self->f_14 with mode 1.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene0
functions.summary: Scene-transition handler for scene slot 0: at state 9 it commits slot 0 (0x0036175C/0x00360254), initialises the battle/scene 2D layer (0x0020713C with the descriptor at +0x146/+0x94), sets the draw mode and starts the fade; the most common entry point of the flow.

functions.name: Field_ResetScreenState
functions.summary: Re-applies the screen fade/visibility configuration after a scene change: from the scene mode byte +0x3D it sets the fade-enable (device+0x133C), black-out (+0x133D) and HUD-hide (bit 4 of +0x1346) flags, then resets the fade colour/offset floats and one per-slot table entry to 0xFFFF.

functions.name: Ui_Scene_AdvanceState
functions.summary: Runs one tick of a UI scene object: updates the fade timers, and when the key/state conditions allow it closes the current sub-view, saves the previous state and moves to state 0x13 before ticking the scene vtable.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_StopUiStream
functions.summary: 28-byte forwarder: fetches the game work and calls 0x005F972C on the object at work+0x10.
