functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_AdvanceCutscene
functions.summary: Scene-flow step for states 9/10/11: calls Ui_SceneFlow_AdvanceState, then for state 9 starts the cutscene (Cutscene_Init / Event_OnCutSceneCommand / Cutscene_ApplyLayerFlags); for other states it loads the world-map models and advances the state counter.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_CommitScene
functions.summary: Commits the prepared scene: initialises the scene sprite set and the scene object, calls the event callbacks, loads the world-map models and advances the flow counter at +0x1D while storing the incoming halfword at +0x20.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene4
functions.summary: Scene-transition handler for scene slot 4: at state 9, when the slot is ready, commits it and sets up the camera/message descriptor with the four mode bytes at +0x120/+0x124, resets the render mode and advances.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene3
functions.summary: Scene-transition handler for scene slot 3: at state 9, when the slot is ready, commits it, looks the scene's 2D graphic set up through 0x0063EFB0 (index at self->f_B0+299) and binds it with 0x006103AC, then configures the camera (0x002F587C) and advances.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_NotifyCore
functions.summary: Fetches the UI core singleton and passes it to func_0062688C - a one-call notification hook.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_TeardownObjects
functions.summary: Releases the scene's runtime objects in the order effect -> item list -> scene manager -> camera -> 2D layer (0x0035F870, 0x005F9828 on two streams, 0x001C987C, 0x001C9568, 0x001C849C, 0x001C7DE8, 0x001C70F8, 0x001C7694, 0x003615A8). Returns 1; used as the 'close scene' step.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_Apply2dCommonPack
functions.summary: Loads/keeps the shared 2dcmn.pack set for the current scene mode: shows the matching UI layer (1/2/3/4) and, when the pack is not loaded in this mode, asks the pack manager to load '2dcmn.pack', binds it to the 2D screen and runs the scene continuation.

functions.name: Ui_Hud_HideSequence
functions.summary: Step-driven HUD hide used when a full-screen message/menu opens: hides the cursor, waits for the layout animation, sets the render flag, unloads the common pack and finally clears the ten HUD element flags at +0x114..+0x11D.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_Release2dCommonPack
functions.summary: Counterpart of the 2dcmn.pack loader: releases the item list, message window, 2D screen and scene system, unloads the shared 2dcmn.pack when it is still mounted and resets the layer render modes.

functions.name: Ui_Hud_ShowSequence
functions.summary: Step-driven restore of the HUD after a full-screen overlay (the mirror of Ui_Hud_HideSequence 0x001A27B0): advances the state at f_18 through the five UI/pack steps and finishes by setting all ten HUD element flags f_114..f_11D back to 1 and re-enabling the cursor.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_SetOwner
functions.summary: Re-parents a UI object: stores the new owner at +0x28, then notifies the object at +0x10 through vtable+8 and clears its active flag through vtable+0xC(0).

functions.name: Field_DestroyScene
functions.summary: Tears down a field scene: releases actors, models, effects and map data, then clears the scene's own state.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ShowFieldData
functions.summary: Opens the message window for a field message record: appears the speaker, picks the text id from the field/monster tables (with per-scenario overrides), sets the window style and background music and moves the scene into the message state.

functions.name: Field_DeleteScene
functions.summary: Deletes a scene object: calls Field_DestroyScene and then releases the scene descriptor itself.

functions.name: maybe_Event_PollScriptState
functions.summary: 32-byte poll: calls the event-slot test 0x00636AFC on the event state (work+8->+0x6C) and discards the answer.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_InitFromTableA
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite2D_InitFromTableA(SpriteActor* self, const SpriteDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Initialises a field 2D-sprite actor from a placement descriptor: resolves the sprite type/atlas through the scene object manager (0x0066A7B8/0x0062C388/0x0062C3B0), copies the placement fields, allocates the animation instance and applies the template (0x002D1304), then creates/attaches the sprite mesh and sets its model size. Called when a field placement of sprite type is spawned.

functions.name: maybe_SpriteActor_DispatchAction
functions.summary: Per-frame dispatch: reads the current field actor, and when its state is not 0x0D and the field UI mode is 5 it plays action sequence 0x0D for the rectangle built from self+0x298, otherwise queues gadget command 0x0C with the sprite id.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_DeletingDtorA
functions.summary: Shared deleting destructor of the 2D sprite family: installs the class vtable, unlinks the embedded node (func_0017C330), destroys the attached scene object 0x24C bytes back with Field_Object_DtorBase and frees the object. The vtable comes in as an argument, so one body serves several classes.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_CreateMeshA
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite2D_CreateMeshA(SpriteActor* self, const void* size)
functions.summary: Creates the 2D sprite mesh: builds a 200x120 rectangle/uv descriptor (0x0031A48C with mode 0), then creates the sprite mesh through Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh (0x0031A394) with the 'sprite' material name and attaches it to the actor (0x005E7650). Sets the sprite's draw order to 10.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_UpdateTouchAndIsBusy
functions.summary: Advances the object's touch state machine one step and reports whether the touch sequence is still running: it returns 0 only once the phase byte has reached its terminal value 5 (release sent).

functions.name: Gfx_CreateMultiSpriteEffect
functions.summary: Builds the eight-sprite layered effect used for glows/shadows around an actor: takes the shape descriptor, creates the colour animator, then for i = 0..7 resolves the frame id and per-sprite transform and adds a child sprite at self+0x298+i*0x48 with flags 0xFFE.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_RefreshTouchInfo
functions.summary: Rebuilds the sprite's touch record (kind 2) from its position and mesh id and caches the six fields at self+0x4D8..+0x4E0; returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteWidget_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a 2D sprite widget: runs the sprite base constructor, installs the primary vtable and its +0x9C secondary, then default-constructs the eight 0x48-byte animation slots at +0x298.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_DtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the first 2D-sprite mesh variant: re-installs the two class vtables (0x00758FC0 then the base 0x0075D55C), destroys the eight 0x48-byte mesh entries at +0x298, unlinks the object from its parent list, runs the shared Field_Object_DtorBase and frees the block.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_CreateMeshB
functions.summary: Second sprite-mesh creator: builds a 200x120 rectangle with mode 1 / material 0x29 (0x0031A48C), creates the mesh via Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh with the 'sprite' name and attaches it. The resulting mesh has no draw-order override, unlike CreateMeshA.

functions.name: SpriteActor_UpdateTouchAndPosition
functions.summary: Per-frame touch and position step: returns 1 while an event is running ((work+8)+0x6C non-zero); when the sprite's state byte is 4 it advances the embedded Field_Object2D touch state, returns 1 if the touch query is still busy, and otherwise submits the sprite position to the current field actor (0x005F34F0 + Gfx_Actor_BuildTransformFromPosition). Returns 0 when nothing was done.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_RefreshTouchInfoB
functions.summary: Rebuilds the sprite's secondary touch record (kind 0x0A) from its position and mesh id and caches the six fields at self+0x3B8..+0x3C0; it first drops stale objects of the touch class through Ui_DestroyObjectsOfClass.

functions.name: Gfx_CreateQuadSpriteEffect
functions.signature: void Gfx_CreateQuadSpriteEffect(void* self, const void* desc)
functions.summary: Builds a four-quad sprite effect: creates the sprite from the descriptor's model ids, plays its animation, then creates one child sprite per corner rectangle (desc->f_1C f_10..f_26) into self+0x298+i*0x48.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_TriggerGadget
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite2D_TriggerGadget(SpriteActor* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 workSel)
functions.summary: Fires the sprite's gadget command: sets the state byte +0x3C4 to 0xFF (idle) and triggers command 0x13 with the actor's trigger id through Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand (0x00256678) on work+0x6C.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlotCtor_vt1A448C
functions.summary: Overlay-slot widget constructor (vtable 0x001A448C): base-constructs through 0x001A5A60, installs the primary and +0x9C secondary vtable, then default-constructs four 0x48-byte child objects at +0x298.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_DtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the second 2D-sprite mesh variant: installs the class and base vtables, destroys the four 0x48-byte mesh entries at +0x298, unlinks the intrusive node, runs the shared base destructor and frees the object. Same template as 0x001A3F24 with a different element count.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_UpdateDrawPos
functions.summary: Recomputes a 2D sprite's screen rectangle: takes the sprite size from its model record, divides by 8, adds the actor's +0x78/+0x7C draw offset, builds the transform through 0x0031A658 and, when the debug flag +0x29D or 0x00669B98 allows it, submits the rectangle for drawing.

functions.name: maybe_Actor2D_UpdateAnimationState
functions.summary: Per-frame actor state update: refreshes the model record, returns while the active byte at +0x29B is clear, switches the actor to state 4 through vtable+0x40 when +0x29D is set, otherwise plays the shared default animation (0x00725B08) and freezes the animator on its last frame.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CreateMapObject
functions.summary: Creates map object from definition ID: allocates 0x16C object and resolves model definition records.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_Refresh
functions.summary: Sprite refresh fragment: the 260-byte Thumb routine is only recovered as a call to the balloon anchor updater (Ui_Balloon_UpdateAnchorPosition, 0x0062AE90) plus 'return 0'; the rest of the body is missing, so what it actually refreshes is unknown.

functions.name: Field_CreateActor
functions.signature: void Field_CreateActor(Scene* scene, const u16* def)
functions.summary: Creates a field actor from a script definition record, initialising its transform, model and action state before adding it to the scene.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_PlayIdleAnim
functions.summary: Starts the sprite's idle animation when nothing else is playing: if the two state bytes f_29B/f_29D are clear it plays the id from g_001A4CD0 through Anim_PlayByIdForActor and marks f_29B, otherwise it tells the object to finish state 4.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_AllocSlotNodeC
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_AllocSlotNodeC(u32 heap, int desc, u32 p3, u32 size)
functions.summary: Allocates a tertiary layout slot node via func_0028E630 with tag 0x4000000C and configures default link offsets.

functions.name: Field_Object_DeletingDtor

functions.name: Ui_Object_ReleaseChildList

functions.name: maybe_Battle_DestroyObjectList

functions.name: Script_ObjectPtr_Clear

functions.name: Script_ObjectVector_Push

functions.summary: Allocates the next local-variable slot (0x14-byte record with a null name and empty value) and returns its index, raising 'internal compiler error: too many locals' once the function needs more than 255 slots.

functions.name: Script_Compiler_FreeLastFunction
functions.summary: Destroys and frees the most recently created 0xF4-byte function object at the top of the array at +0xE0 and decrements its count.

functions.name: Script_Compiler_UpdateStackSize
functions.summary: Raises the recorded maximum stack depth to the current slot count and raises 'internal compiler error: too many locals' past 255 slots. Second entry point of the tail of 0x001BDBC4.

functions.name: Script_Compiler_CreateFunction
functions.summary: Allocates a 0xF4-byte script function object, initialises it (0x001BE56C) with the compiler as owner, and pushes it on the compiler's function list at +0xE0. Returns the new object.

functions.name: Script_ObjectVector_PushCounted
functions.summary: Appends a script object to the 0x14-byte record vector at +4 (tag/pointer/three payload words), taking a reference, and returns the index the record was stored at.

functions.name: Script_Registry_GetByKey
functions.summary: Thin wrapper for 0x001BD000 that looks up or creates the registry entry for a script object key and returns the entry pointer.

functions.name: Script_ObjectVector_Pop
functions.summary: Pops the top record of the 0x14-byte record vector at +4 (the index taken from the int stack at +0x10), releasing the reference it held, and returns the record index.

functions.name: Script_Function_Init

functions.name: Script_Function_Destroy
functions.summary: Full destructor of the script function object: frees every compiler vector it owns (int, 8-byte object, 0x14-byte record and 0x10-byte table vectors) and releases the remaining script object references.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_DeleteSize78

functions.name: Script_Generator_Release
functions.summary: Releases a generator's saved operand stack array and drops its closure reference.

functions.name: Script_ObjectPtr_Assign

This is Squirrel's SQObjectPtr::operator= and is the single most used helper in the game code.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Vertex_DecodeNormals

functions.name: Ui_ItemScreen_HandleInput
functions.summary: Input handler for the item screen: forwards the stick direction to the row list, refreshes the highlighted row and, on confirm, checks whether the item can be used/sold and can be afforded, then sets the price/owned message arguments and hands over to the quantity or commit handler.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemScreen_HandleCursorInput
functions.summary: Handles the item screen's input bits: on bit 1 it forwards the cursor triple, on bits 0x102 it recomputes the cursor offset from the row/page size and selects the entry, and on bit 4 it resets the cursor to 0xFF.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemScreen_MoveCursor

functions.name: Ui_ItemScreen_SelectQuantity
functions.summary: Quantity selection for the item screen: takes the chosen count from the screen state, clamps it against the owned count, updates the icon count and the price message argument 6, then commits the selection.

functions.summary: Item-screen step handler: if the page scroll is finished it chains to maybe_Ui_ItemScreen_ShowSelectionResult with the context flags cleared; otherwise it writes screen command 10, reactivates the screen and returns the default handler pair from the 0x00729554 table (+4/+8).

functions.name: Ui_ItemScreen_ConfirmEntryEx

functions.summary: Loads 'chara_skeletal_param.bxon', verifies that the file's root record is the expected 0x37 (skeletal-parameter) type, then stores its handle in +0x18 and releases the previously stored one.

functions.name: Field_CreateActorFromId
functions.summary: Creates a field actor from an id: allocates the actor, applies the enemy AI and action setup and returns the new actor handle.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DetachAndDestroy
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_DetachAndDestroy(int owner, int * widget, int * arg3)
functions.summary: Removes a widget from its owner's per-kind slot list (owner + widget->kind*0xC + 0x24) with 0x001235A4 and then invokes the widget's deleting-destructor slot +0x60.

functions.name: Field_AttachObjectFromHandle
functions.signature: int Field_AttachObjectFromHandle(FieldWork* self, u32 handle, u32 tag)
functions.summary: Resolves a generation-tagged handle in the field object registry (g_007B80C0, generation = handle>>11), rejects objects flagged busy (+0x42), calls the object's virtual +0x10 and appends it to the pending field list at self+0xD58+tag*0xC. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: Field_AttachSlotObject
functions.summary: Attaches an object to the current slot (index f_D70) of the field owner: calls the object's vtable+0x10 (bind) and copies its transform from +8 into the slot record. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: Field_ObjectManager_RegisterByClass
functions.summary: Links a field object's intrusive list node (fieldObj+8) into the per-class bucket at fieldObjMgr + 0x9C + fieldObj->s8_34 * 0x0C and invokes fieldObj->vt[+0x64](fieldObj).

functions.name: Field_UpdateDrawList
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the field draw list: ticks every object in the +0xD74 list, broadcasts suspend/resume to the two attached objects and the ten slot lists, collects the visible camera-facing objects, sorts them by distance and toggles their visibility mask.

functions.name: Effect_CreateInstanceWithDefaults
functions.signature: int Effect_CreateInstanceWithDefaults(void* self, unsigned int position, unsigned int target, int kind)
functions.summary: Creates one effect instance (0x2F4 bytes) with a default configuration block, applies the kind, gives it a unique serial number and stores the instance and its handle in the owner.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_CreateFromVariantTable
functions.summary: Creates a 2D effect (0x42C-byte instance) from a variant record: builds the 0x17-field effect config, takes the model/variant bytes from the CharacterRecord table 0x63EB94 indexed by the actor portrait id, selects blend/mode bytes from the game state (+0x3C mode, +0x2E2F6 flag) and allocates the instance; the creation tail is lost to halt_baddata.

functions.name: maybe_Field_MapActorTypeToModelKind
functions.signature: int maybe_Field_MapActorTypeToModelKind(u32 fallback, int type, int subtype)
functions.summary: Pure mapping switch from an actor type id (4..0x1E) plus a subtype to a small kind code (1..0xD for the plain types, 0x2F/0x35..0x3A/0x47/0xA5/0xBE for the type+subtype pairs); unknown combinations return the fallback value.

functions.name: Field_NotifyAttached20
functions.summary: Same broadcast as 0x001C70F8 but for virtual slot +0x20.

functions.name: Field_GetActorModelSetIndex
functions.signature: unsigned int Field_GetActorModelSetIndex(int actorKind, int arg2, int arg3, int context)
functions.summary: Maps an actor/vehicle kind id to the model or animation set index used when spawning that actor, with a few ids only valid in particular field modes (ship/wagon/battle).

functions.name: Field_GetActorAnimSetIndex
functions.signature: unsigned int Field_GetActorAnimSetIndex(int actorKind, int arg2, int arg3, int context)
functions.summary: Second, offset-by-one mapping from actor kind to the animation/skeleton set (same table as the model set but shifted by one slot), used together with Field_GetActorModelSetIndex when loading an actor.

functions.name: Field_DetachSlotObjectA
functions.summary: Detaches the object stored in member f_20: unbinds it through vtable+0x10, copies it back into slot f_D70, and releases the corresponding handle f_124.

functions.name: Field_DetachSlotObjectB
functions.summary: Same detach as 0x001C824C but for the second attached object at f_1C and its handle f_120.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DispatchToGroupedChildren
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_DispatchToGroupedChildren(int self, u32 msg, u32 group, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Broadcasts a message to a widget's children: the two direct children at +0x1C/+0x20 when group is 'all', then each of the ten 0xC-byte child groups at +0x24, calling virtual slot +0x38 on every element.

functions.name: Field_NotifyAttached1C
functions.summary: Same broadcast family but for virtual slot +0x1C.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ClearSlotListsAndSwapTag
functions.summary: When *enable is set, walks the ten 0xC-byte slot records at self; then flips the double-buffer tag at +0xD70 to (tag+3)%2 and destroys whatever is still queued in that buffer's list at +0xD58 (virtual +8).

functions.name: Field_FlushSlotSubLists
functions.summary: Flushes all three intrusive lists of one 0xC-byte slot record (+0x24, +0x9C and the list at +0x128/+0x12C) by moving every idle object into the active field list at self+0xD58+tag*0xC.

functions.name: Field_FlushObjectList
functions.summary: Walks an intrusive list and, for every object whose busy byte +0x42 is clear, calls virtual +0x10 and appends the object to the active field list at self+0xD58+tag*0xC.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ResourceHandle_AcquireType1
functions.summary: Resolves a resource id through the global handle table at 0x7B80C0 and, when the entry exists with bit 0x40000000 set, allocates a 0x3C-byte wrapper (ctor 0x0031B4F0), appends it to the owner's list at +0xD74 and returns wrapper[7]; returns -0x40 when the id cannot be resolved.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceHandle_AcquireType2
functions.signature: int Gfx_ResourceHandle_AcquireType2(GfxOwner* owner, unsigned int resId)
functions.summary: Acquires the larger resource type: for an id whose object carries flag 0x20000000 it allocates a 0xE0-byte sprite-animation bank, initialises it with the id, registers it in the owner's handle list and returns the stored handle.

functions.name: Model_CreateAttachmentA
functions.summary: Creates an attachment node on a model: allocates 0x228-byte node, initializes via func_00212A78, and links into model part list at +0x170.

functions.name: Field_BindAttachedObjects
functions.summary: Promotes ready pending attachment handles on a field object into active slots: resolves generation-checked handles (0x007B80C0) at self+0x120/+0x124 into self+0x1C/+0x20 once vt[+0x34]() is ready, and transfers ready nodes from the ten pending lists (self+0x128+i*0xC) to active lists (self+0x24+i*0xC).

functions.name: Field_CreateRenderObject
functions.signature: int Field_CreateRenderObject(FieldOwner* owner, u32 charaId, int variant, int mode)
functions.summary: Creates the 2D sprite render object that draws one character/model id: looks the id up in the character table (func_0063EB94) and the party-member record (func_0035EB98) to pick the frame id and anim set, fills a 60-byte descriptor: party members (record flag 0x10 clear) take frame id and palette from the portrait record, while the others get one of the fixed frame ids 0x1DB/0x208/0x1EC/0x1C chosen by `mode` and no palette; then allocates 0x208 bytes from the owner's heap, creates the sub-object with the 0x00782234 sprite vtable and links it into the owner's list at +0x128. Returns the object's handle word.

functions.name: Field_CreateActorObjectModel
functions.signature: int Field_CreateActorObjectModel(void* self, unsigned int actorId, int variant)
functions.summary: Creates the render object for a field actor id: fills the actor configuration from the data manager, takes the animation-set index for the id and allocates the object through the aligned heap.

functions.name: Field_GetObjectHandleA
functions.signature: unsigned int Field_GetObjectHandleA(FieldObjectTable* object, unsigned int index, int validate)
functions.summary: Returns handle slot A for an index below 0xF4 from the field object table (array at +0x68), validating it with the standard packed-handle idiom (bucket table 0x7B80C0, generation compare) and optionally the object's virtual is-alive check; returns 0xFFFFF800 when invalid.

functions.name: Field_GetObjectHandleB
functions.signature: unsigned int Field_GetObjectHandleB(FieldObjectTable* object, unsigned int index, int validate)
functions.summary: Reads the paired ('B') object handle for an index from the field object table, returning the invalid handle 0xFFFFF800 when the index is out of range or the handle does not resolve.

functions.name: Field_DetachObject
functions.summary: Removes object from the field's attached-object list (head/tail at +0xD74/+0xD78): calls virtual +0x14, unlinks the node and finally calls virtual +4 (delete). Returns 1 when found or when object is null.

functions.name: Field_CreateActorRenderObject
functions.signature: int Field_CreateActorRenderObject(FieldOwner* field, unsigned int modelId)
functions.summary: Creates the larger (0x730-byte) field actor object: fills the render/appearance descriptor from the model id and allocates the object.

functions.name: Model_CreateAttachmentB
functions.summary: Creates second kind of model attachment node: allocates 0x230-byte node, initializes via func_003D4974, and links into model part list at +0x170.

functions.name: Field_NotifyAttachedIdle8
functions.summary: While the view work is idle (f_D84 < 1) it broadcasts virtual slot +8 to the +0xD74 list and slot +0x18 to the attached objects and the ten slot lists.

functions.name: Field_ShutdownSlots
functions.summary: Shuts the field owner down when it is active: detaches the two slot objects, drains the two 0xC-byte slot arrays and the ten +0x24 lists (calling vtable+8 on every entry), releases the handle at +0x18 and clears the active flag.

functions.name: Field_AdvanceSlotTimers
functions.summary: Advances the view work one step: applies the pending rewind request (f_D80), decrements the timer f_D84, re-binds the attached objects (0x001C8584 + maybe_Field_BindAttachedObjects) and broadcasts slot +0x14.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_WidgetWithTenChildren_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a UI widget: base-initialises through 0x004712D0, installs vtable 0x007598B0, stores descriptor->+4, seeds the float sentinel 0xFFFFF000 and default-constructs ten 0xC-byte child elements at +0x24 with std_ConstructArray.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SlotOwner_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a ~0xD80-byte field object that owns three arrays of ten 0xC-byte entries (at +0x24/+0x9C/+0x128), two more entries at +0xD58, two intrusive list nodes at +0xD78 and a pack handle at +0x18; it first runs the base Field_ShutdownSlots teardown.

functions.name: Object_MarkReleased
functions.summary: Releases the child object at +0x10 when the owner lookup still resolves, then marks the child dead by setting its byte +0x25D.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenViewEntry_Reset
functions.summary: Resets one screen-view collection entry: releases the shared row list (0x001E4B4C), destroys and nulls the child object at +0x10, clears the state words and seeds the slot id from 0x001C9DEC.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_CreateVariant
functions.signature: void maybe_Effect_CreateVariant(void* owner, u32 effectId, int variant)
functions.summary: Creates one or more effect instances from effect ID: resolves variant table and calls Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Record_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a small UI record: calls the base constructor 0x001E4B98, overwrites the vtable with 0x007598C0, clears the words at +0xC/+0x10 and the bytes at +0x14/+0x15/+0x19, sets the u16 at +0x16 to 0xFFFF and the byte at +0x18 to 0xFF.

functions.name: Ui_List_DestroyTwoPools
functions.summary: Destroys two adjacent pools of ten 0x50-byte list entries at self+0x70 and self+0x3B8 by calling the entry destructor 0x003DFEC4 on each.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_UpdateBillboard
functions.summary: Projects a UI overlay anchor into screen space: adds the animated offset at +0x6E0..+0x6E8 to the local offset, projects it, writes the quad position at self->f_30 (+0x1C/+0x20/+0x24 and the +0x44 flag), then applies a per-slot parallax offset for slots 0 and 1.

functions.name: Ui_Balloon_BindParts
functions.summary: Binds a speech balloon's layout: attaches the four panes from the static table at 0x007A89A4 via vtable+0x34 and then binds the two balloon text parts at self+0x13 (part 0) and self+0xE5 (part 1) with Ui_Balloon_BindWinParts.

functions.name: Ui_PanelCtor_vt1CA2EC
functions.summary: Constructor stub for a large UI panel: installs vtable 0x001CA2EC on the object returned by Ui_Object_CtorBase and default-constructs two 0x348-byte children at +0x4C.

functions.name: Ui_Balloon_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the balloon widget: releases the two 0x348-byte record objects at +0x4C, runs the UI base destructor and frees the balloon.

functions.name: Ui_Balloon_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the balloon widget: releases its two 0x348-byte records at +0x4C and runs the UI base destructor.

functions.name: Math_Random_InitState
functions.signature: void Math_Random_InitState(RandomState* rng, uint32_t key0, uint32_t key1)
functions.summary: Seeds a 6-word random state: calls 0x00113590 to build {key0, key1, 0x6C078965, 0x5D588B65, 0x00269EC3, 0} on the stack and stores that block at rng+8. The two constants 0x6C078965 and 0x5D588B65 are the MT19937 initialisation multipliers.

functions.name: Math_RandomChanceBelow
functions.summary: Returns non-zero when a random fraction of the object's random state is at or below the given threshold - a probability roll used to decide whether a random effect occurs.

functions.name: Math_IntToFloat
functions.summary: Converts the saturated integer returned by 0x51B1FC(valueBlock+8, INT_MAX) to float and returns it in s0 (VectorSignedToFloat).

functions.name: Math_DivideIntByCount
functions.summary: Returns 0x51B1FC(valueBlock+8, INT_MAX) / (count+1) using the integer divide helper 0x11CD80; the result is left in r0/r1 by the divide routine.

functions.name: Math_RandomRange
functions.signature: int Math_RandomRange(void* rng, int low, int high)
functions.summary: Rolls a random integer in [low, high] from the 64-bit random state at rng+8: advances the state with the shared step 0x0051B1FC(state+8, 0x7FFFFFFF), takes the remainder modulo (high-low+1) and adds low.

functions.name: Actor_ApplyModelPartCodes
functions.signature: void Actor_ApplyModelPartCodes(ActorModel* self, unsigned char* partRecord, ModelDescriptor* descriptor)
functions.summary: Copies the visible model-part codes of a record into the actor's part table: record type 2 sets the 'has parts' byte +0x744, type 4 the part +0x745, type 5 the part +0x746, type 6 the u16 at g_001CA5D8 (self+0x748) and type 8 the part +0x74A. For any other type it asks the descriptor's virtual getters (+0x78/+0x7C/+0x80) for the code and falls back to 0xFF (none) when all three are unset.

functions.name: Model_AdvanceAnimFrames
functions.summary: Advances a character's animation by N frames, clamping to the remaining length; when the clip reaches its end it clears the state flags and runs the end-of-animation effects (state reset, callback, sub-system notifications).

functions.name: maybe_Model_ApplyAttachPointParam
functions.summary: Chance-based model parameter application: for a character model (type 0x5A) it copies the actor's parameter block, finds the entry labelled type 5, rolls 1..100 through the game RNG and stores value in the model's parameter slot when the entry's float is at or below the roll.

functions.name: maybe_Model_UpdateAttachPoints
functions.summary: Ghidra could not decode this entry: after one read of the battle 3D-mode byte (work+8->+0x5C +0x4244) the body is halt_baddata() plus 16 removed unreachable blocks. The bytes are probably inline data or a misidentified entry.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_HasSpecialModelPart
functions.signature: int maybe_Actor_HasSpecialModelPart(ActorModel* self, int slot, int offset)
functions.summary: Predicate over the actor model's part record: true when the part is visible (virtual +0x10), (f_39D & 0x56)==0 and either the part code at +0x74A is 0x54 or the part letter at +0x745 is 'A'/'B'/'C'.

functions.name: Actor_ApplyVariantRecord
functions.summary: Selects one of the three 0x20-byte variant blocks of a model source (flags at source+0xB0F7 / source+0xB0F9 choose block +0xB108, +0xB128 or +0xB148) and applies it through virtual +0x178 together with the source pointer; stores `source` at self+0x740. When the source has no variant data (byte +0x10 == 0) it only stores the pointer.

functions.name: Battle_ActionModel_ApplyPartParams
functions.summary: Copies the ~30 part parameters (scale, blend, offsets, colours) from the character/model parameter record resolved by 0x0063E5C8 into the action model's f_30..f_DC fields; when randomizeScale is set (descriptor+0x1D) the first scale is multiplied by RNG[0x50,100]/100. Called once from Battle_ActionModel_InitFromDescriptor, so it is a setup copy, not a per-frame update.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_AdjustHeightParam
functions.summary: Adds delta to the s16 at self+0x36, clamped to [0, s16 at self+0x32], skipped when the global UI-busy flag or self byte +0xF1F is set; the delta is zeroed when virtual +0xE8(self,0x73) returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Model_IsSpecialState
functions.summary: Unit-model predicate used by Battle_CheckUnitsCondition modes 6/7, which require every unit of each of the four 26-unit groups to return 1: 1 when the model is visible, its f_39D flags (mask 0x56) are clear, and either the part code at +0x74A is 0x54 or the part letter at +0x745 is 'A'/'B'/'C'; 0 otherwise. Template copy of 0x001CA7E4.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_FindAndStartType9A
functions.summary: Scans the battle party list at battleWork+0x4260 for the first unit for which the kind test Ui_TextLayout_IsTypeAccepted(unit, 0x9A) succeeds, then calls that unit's vtable+0x120(unit, 0x9A, 1) to start the state; if the unit's class chain reaches g_playerBattleActorClass it also hides the unit's attachment.

functions.name: maybe_Model_SetupFromTypeId
functions.summary: Model refresh for one type id: resolves the actor's model id, for characters rolls the 1..100 parameter into self+0x28C, then re-binds up to 32 sub-model slots through their virtual +0xE8/+0xE4 pair; for type 0x116 it stores the difference between the model height and the row's +0x28 value.

functions.name: Battle_AddStateFlags
functions.signature: void Battle_AddStateFlags(void* self, unsigned int flags, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Adds state flag bits to a battle actor and, for bit 8 (visible/revive), also notifies the actor's model and plays the associated effect - unless the battle mode byte says it is paused.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_SetComponentFlag
functions.summary: Walks the 32 component slots at self+0xE9C: components whose virtual +0xE8 accepts `component` get the +0x134 then +0x120 calls, and a second loop asks every remaining component through +0xF4, falling back to +0x11C.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_QueryChildSlotState
functions.signature: int maybe_Actor_QueryChildSlotState(ActorModel* self, u32 arg2, int slotMask)
functions.summary: 20-byte fragment that scans the 32 child-object slots at self+0xE9C and returns the last non-zero result: for each non-null slot it calls virtual +0xF4 and, when that returns 0, virtual +0x11C.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_UpdateComponents
functions.signature: void maybe_Actor_UpdateComponents(void* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned * int arg4)
functions.summary: Updates all 32 components: for each active component it queries the two state virtuals (+0x18 / +0x10) and puts the ones that need it into the run state (+0x30), unless the global mode byte forbids it.

functions.name: Model_BuildUiFilterRecord
functions.summary: Builds a 12-byte filter record on the stack (leading 0xFF, the u16 at self+0x768 and the byte at self+0x74A, plus three values fetched by id 0xDF/0x7D/0x7C through the owner's vtable +0xE8 when owner[4] is set) and hands it to Ui_FilterIdListByRecord(work+0x90, record).

functions.name: maybe_Actor_SetTwoParameters
functions.signature: void maybe_Actor_SetTwoParameters(ActorModel* self, int first, int second)
functions.summary: Resets the model (virtual +0x11C, clears the byte at +0x39D) and then writes two display values through virtuals +0x3C/+0x40; a value of -1 means 'keep the current value', read back through +0x94/+0x9C.

functions.name: maybe_Model_ApplyParameterBlock
functions.signature: void maybe_Model_ApplyParameterBlock(Model* self, int frame, int stateValue)
functions.summary: Applies a model-parameter block: resolves the record id stored at self+0x1DA through the data manager and copies the block with Model_CopyParamBlock; for its two entries (types 0/1) it checks the current frame against 0.5/0.25 of the entry duration and, when the battle RNG roll (1..100) is within the entry probability, records the supplied state id at self+0x3A5.

functions.name: Actor_NotifyComponentEvent
functions.summary: Sends one event id to every component that accepts it: loops the 32 slots at self+0xE9C, gates on virtual +0xE8(eventId), then calls +0x134 and +0x120(eventId,1). Event 0x5A also clears the actor word at +0xE94.

functions.name: Actor_ResetComponents
functions.summary: Resets the actor model's components: resets the model slots (Actor_ResetModelSlots), clears the state word at +0xE94 and, when the actor is active, runs the release virtual (+0x11C) of all 32 component pointers at +0xE9C.

functions.name: Actor_IsPartCode
functions.signature: int Actor_IsPartCode(ActorModel* self, u32 code code)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the actor is visible, (f_39D & 0x56)==0 and the part code at +0x74A equals `code`; 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Battle_IsUnitKindShownInMemberUi
functions.signature: u32 Battle_IsUnitKindShownInMemberUi(int unit, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns whether a battle unit's kind id is one of the six kinds the member-status UI lists: it resolves the unit's packed model id (f_768) to its parameter block and tests the 16-bit kind against 100, 0x7B, 0x7C, 0x74, 0x83 and 0x84.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_PlayEventSe
functions.summary: Maps an actor event code to a sound effect and plays it on the handle at self+0x110: codes 2/3 -> SE 0x1B, 0x90 -> 0x1C, 8/9 -> 0x28. The handle is validated against the field object registry, and 2/3 is skipped when 0x00669250 reports id 0x1C.

functions.name: Field_Actor_QueryFlag7ByModelHandle
functions.summary: Queries state flag 7 of an actor's packed model handle: returns 1 when the global 'field flags disabled' byte at work+0x27C57 is clear, otherwise resolves the packed handle in actor+0x110 through the generation-checked handle table (entry index = (handle >> 10) & mask, generation = handle >> 11, entry stride 8) and asks func_005E7848(entry, 7, 0); returns 0 when the handle is stale.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_FindComponentByEvent
functions.summary: Walks the 32 component slots of an actor looking for the one whose handler accepts the event id, then resolves the object stored in that component's handle field +0x110 before forwarding the call.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_EnterMirroredState
functions.summary: Reads the signed value through virtual +0x94, stores its negation through +0x3C, applies arg2 through +0x15C, calls +0x17C, clears the word at +0x118, enables feature 0 through +0xE4 and disables it through +0x120, then calls +0x50(self,0). Returns 1.

functions.name: Battle_ActionModel_UpdateUnitVisibility
functions.signature: int Battle_ActionModel_UpdateUnitVisibility(int * actionModel, int count, int slotArg, int arg4)
functions.summary: Keeps the battle unit models in sync with the action list: when units were added it walks all 0x121 unit ids, releases the ones whose parameter block is flagged visible and whose row alpha is non-zero, applies the optional parameter block, then re-lays out or advances the sequence.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_TogglePartVisibility
functions.summary: Compares the current value from virtual +0x1C with `visible` and, when they differ, enables feature 0x50 through +0xE4 (visible) or disables it through +0x120 (hidden), then clears the word at +0x118.

functions.name: maybe_Model_ApplyParamType6
functions.signature: void maybe_Model_ApplyParamType6(void* self, unsigned int recordId, int value)
functions.summary: Chance-based model parameter application for parameter type 6: gated on the record's +0x303 byte, it copies the actor's parameter block, finds the entry labelled type 6, rolls 1..100 and stores value when the entry's float is at or below the roll.

functions.name: maybe_Model_ApplyParamType4
functions.summary: Chance-based model parameter application for parameter type 4: for a character model it copies the parameter block, finds the entry labelled type 4, rolls 1..100 and stores value in the model's parameter slot when the entry's float is at or below the roll.

functions.name: maybe_Model_ApplyParamBySelector
functions.signature: void maybe_Model_ApplyParamBySelector(void* self, int selector, void* record)
functions.summary: Selector-driven model parameter application: when the caller record is active it copies the parameter block and, for entries of type 2 or 3 whose selector row passes its +0xDC test, rolls 1..100 and stores the record in the parameter slot when the entry's float is at or below the roll; selector 0x18 additionally latches the pending byte at +0xD16.

functions.name: Actor_RegisterChildObject
functions.summary: Registers a child object in the actor's 0x20-entry slot array at self+0xE9C: takes the first empty slot, or the first slot whose object reports idle through virtual +0x14, and stores the pointer there.

functions.name: Battle_Model_FindAttachmentGridSlot
functions.signature: void Battle_Model_FindAttachmentGridSlot(int unit, int * out, u32 partId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Locates the grid cell of a model attachment: it finds the part id in the unit's 0x12-byte part list, then scans the model's 0x2E-by-6 attachment-id grid for that index and writes the column and row into out->f_68 / out->f_6C.

functions.name: Battle_ActionModel_InitFromDescriptor
functions.signature: void Battle_ActionModel_InitFromDescriptor(int * self, int descriptor, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises a battle action model from its descriptor: resets the transform block at +0x20, applies the base model setup, forces slot state 1, copies the part index, binds the owner and sets the two 'special form' flags when the parameter block matches 0x001CC3E8.

functions.name: Battle_ActionModel_CreateBase
functions.summary: Creates and initialises the battle-action model instance: allocates through Actor_StatusBlock_Init, stamps g_battleActionModelVtable, builds the sub-panel at +0x23C, writes the 0xFF/-1 sentinels and allocates the 0x80-byte scratch at +0x5AC; returns the object base (sub-block minus 0x8F0).

functions.name: Actor_ReleaseChildSlotsAndFree
functions.summary: Destructor tail: installs the vtable at g_001CC4D4, clears the child counter at +0xE98, zeroes the 0x20 child slots at +0xE9C (memset 0x80), runs the base teardown 0x27A7F0 and frees the object with the operator delete at 0x10F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_AdjustValue
functions.summary: Adjusts the gauge value shown by a party-status panel: clamps the delta to the panel range, writes the new value, refreshes the bar/colour, and when the value reaches 0 plays the empty-bar virtual and notifies the member record.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_NotifyModelChanged
functions.summary: Asks 0x001CDA78 for the current model/state value and forwards it to the target through virtual +0xEC.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_QueryInteraction
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Actor_QueryInteraction(int* self, int id)

functions.name: Actor_ApplyVariantRecordB

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_ResetValue
functions.signature: void Ui_PartyStatus_ResetValue(UiPartyStatusPanel* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 context)

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_AddMPPreview

functions.name: Actor_ReleaseLinkedModelAttachments

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ClassifyAnimState

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_SetValue

functions.summary: Sets a party-status panel to an absolute value: resolves the party member from the panel's member index (+0x1DA) through the member-record accessor, clears that member's 0x3FF status bits, pushes the value through the panel's vtable slot +0x3C and clamps the passed limit into the panel short at +0x36 (1..the panel max at +0x32).

functions.name: maybe_Actor_HandleSpecialEvent
functions.signature: void maybe_Actor_HandleSpecialEvent(int* self, int eventId, unsigned int event)

functions.name: maybe_Actor_TestStateTableValue
functions.summary: Tests whether a state word at self+fieldOffset is 1, or delegates to virtual method at +0xB4 if negative (-1); returns 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Actor_ResetVariantSlot
functions.summary: Selects one of the three 0x20-byte variant blocks from the model flags (b0F7 -> index 0, else b0F9 -> index 2, else 0) after the shared pre-call 0x002789A0, and resets it to [0]=1, [1]=[2]=-1.

functions.name: Actor_ReleaseAndFree

functions.name: Menu_RefreshUnitSlotFlags
functions.signature: void Menu_RefreshUnitSlotFlags(u32 self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyStatus_CacheCostume
functions.summary: One-shot cache for the battle party panel: on the first call it resolves the member record for panel->f_768 (party-member getter 0x0035EB98) and copies the member's equipped-costume byte (+0xE5) to panel+0xB18A, then sets the cached flag at +0xB189.

functions.name: Actor_ResetSlotTable
functions.summary: Clears the four 0x20-byte slot records to their empty sentinels (1, -1, 0xFF, 0xFFFF) and then calls the actor's vtable +0xBC reset hook.

functions.name: Actor_SpawnEffectBlock
functions.signature: void Actor_SpawnEffectBlock(Actor* self, unsigned int effectId, unsigned int extra)
functions.summary: Spawns an effect at an actor's attached node: fills the 0x34-byte default transform/colour block from the global defaults, resolves the actor's +0x110 handle through the generation-checked table, builds the spawn transform with Battle_Effect_ComputeSpawnTransform and creates/updates the instance through Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_PlayHookSe
functions.summary: Validates the actor's +0x110 handle, calls Field_Actor_SetMotionState on the linked object and then posts sound effect 0x2F on it.

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_ApplyValue
functions.summary: Writes the panel's current gauge value back into the member record (clamped to the record maximum), and stores the selected status-icon index/value pair for the record, or resets both when the special bit is clear.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ShouldSkipUpdate
functions.summary: Actor-frame predicate over four virtual queries: tests virtual +0x170, the +0xE8(0x7D) feature, the byte at self+0xB148 against the type byte at self+0xB108, and virtual +0x184 (falling back to f_3A==5). Returns the combined 'run the update' result.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_IsActiveState
functions.summary: Composite activity predicate: returns 0 only when vtable+0x10 is false, vtable+0x14 is true, vtable+0xD8 is false and the unit is neither type 10 nor type 8; every other combination returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_IsStateAnimAllowed
functions.summary: Checks battle/actor status code from func_00639FA8, returning 0 for exclusionary states 0x12, 0x14, 0x17, 0x18, 0x1C and 1 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_UpdateAnimState
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Actor_UpdateAnimState(int* self, u32 arg2, int whether)
functions.summary: Steps the actor's animation state machine for state ids 0x5C/0x5D: in 0x5C it switches to 0x5D once the current frame passes half the clip (vtable+0x90/+0x94) and returns 2; in 0x5D with frame > 1 it switches back to 0x5C and returns 3; otherwise it resets the animation (vtable+0x3C/+0x120/+0x15C) and returns 1.

functions.name: Battle_ActionModel_PruneAndLayoutUnits
functions.signature: u32 Battle_ActionModel_PruneAndLayoutUnits(int * self, int count, u32 arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: The attachment-less variant of the unit sync: releases visible units that satisfy 0x0048E490, then either scrolls the list by the current count or advances the sequence, unless the global 'hold layout' byte is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyStatus_ClearFlag10
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PartyStatus_ClearFlag10(UiPartyStatusPanel* party, u32 value, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Clears status bit 0x10 on the selected member record and forwards value to the panel gauge through vtable +0x3C.

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_CommitValue
functions.signature: void Ui_PartyStatus_CommitValue(UiPartyStatusPanel* party, u32 old, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Commits a gauge change: when the target value differs it clears the member flag 0x80, resets the icon index and animates the bar through vtable +0xE4/+0x120/+0x178, with the 'value > 0x120' special case.

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_RefreshIcons
functions.summary: Refreshes the party-status icon row from the member record's status bits (poison/curse/sleep/special): calls the icon virtual +0xE4 with the matching icon ids, selects the bar mode from the member slot and copies the extra status value when bit 7 is clear.

functions.name: Actor_CreateStatusInstance
functions.summary: Creates the large per-actor party-status instance: runs the base constructor Actor_StatusBlock_Init, stamps g_partyStatusVtable, initialises the embedded text layout at +0x23C and the 0xA7FC..0xA899 sentinels, then runs the vtable +0xBC reset and the eight-slot default loop. Returns the object base (sub-block minus 0x8F0).

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_DeleteDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the party-status panel: runs the base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_Reset
functions.signature: void Ui_PartyStatus_Reset(PartyStatusPanel* party, int arg2, int arg3, int context)
functions.summary: Destructor/base reset of the party-status panel: reinstalls the vtable 0x759ad0, clears the record's status bits and releases the attached gauge objects.

functions.name: Ui_MovieWindow_Create
functions.summary: Creates the 'win_movie' layout window for the movie player and hands it to the movie controller.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyWorldFlag
functions.summary: Copies the default into self+0x27C, overrides it with the event-state byte at (work+8)->+0x6C->+0x960 unless self+0x278 forces zero, and applies the result to the sub-object at self+0x138 through 0x0029126C(...,1) or (...,0).

functions.name: Ui_MovieWindow_UpdateLayout
functions.summary: Updates the movie window layout: ticks the three sub-animations at +0x184/+0x1D4/+0x228, adds the per-frame offset (input-dependent) to f_27C clamped to 0..3 and sets the animation frame, then switches the window state from the movie idle flag.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MovieWindow_InitBase
functions.summary: Initialises a window/movie base object: writes the type tags, self-links the two intrusive list heads at +0x11C/+0x12C and constructs the embedded animation objects with the shared anim ctor.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MovieWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the movie window: reinstalls class table 0x00758C0C, releases the three layout references, destroys the embedded object chain and the base object, then frees the window.

functions.name: maybe_Math_EulerAnglesToVector
functions.signature: void maybe_Math_EulerAnglesToVector(float* out, float angleX, float angleY, float angleZ)
functions.summary: Builds a rotation from three axis angles (three sin/cos/sqrt blocks with the axis constants at 0x007E7018/24/30) and writes the resulting first basis vector (3 floats) to out.

functions.name: Math_QuatMultiply
functions.signature: void Math_QuatMultiply(float* out, float* left, float* b)
functions.summary: Multiplies two quaternions (four floats each) and writes the product back through the first argument.

functions.name: Mem_AllocAlignedFromObject
functions.signature: void* Mem_AllocAlignedFromObject(MemOwner* owner, unsigned int size, unsigned int alignment)
functions.summary: Allocates `size` bytes with the caller-supplied alignment from the heap embedded in `owner+4`.

functions.name: Ui_KyoukaiSelectWindow_BuildSlotList
functions.summary: Builds the nine-entry boundary-selection list of the kyoukai (map-boundary) window: it walks the flag bytes plus a global 3x9 bit table to decide which of the nine entry kinds are available, pushes each entry as (index | page<<16, label id) and then shows/hides the nine anim references accordingly.

functions.name: Ui_KyoukaiSelectWindow_Refresh
functions.summary: Computes the four availability flags for the boundary-selection window (argument present, 0x0066B8B0 state, and two global/index byte tests) and rebuilds the list through 0x001CEECC.

functions.name: Ui_SetupKyoukaiSelectWindow
functions.summary: Builds the kyoukai (skill-board) selection window: binds the base and null text layers and creates the select lists win_kyoukai_select3..7.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AnimRefWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: In-place constructor of a window-like object: base ctor, vtable from the literal pool, then eight chained 0x50-byte Ui_AnimRefList members (+0x4C..+0x2CC), a trailing value and a -1 sentinel.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DungeonPlaceWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the dungeon-place window: releases the seven 0x50-byte layout parts and the node member, runs the base destructor and frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonPlaceWindow_Create
functions.summary: Creates the 'win_dungeon_place' layout for the dungeon/place-name window and copies the placement transform into the window.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ModelSelect_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a four-panel screen: ticks the owner's vtable slot, formats the selected index (f_11C->f_125 + 1) into the shared UI manager text at +0x848, sets the sprite at +0x13C, then updates and toggles the visibility of the four panels at +0x188/+0x314/+0x4A0/+0x62C.

functions.name: Ui_ModelSelectWindow_UpdateChildren
functions.signature: void Ui_ModelSelectWindow_UpdateChildren(void* self, void* out, void* ctx, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Update pass of the model-select window: runs the generic animated-children update, then walks the secondary child ring at +0x7BC and appends every enabled child (skipping the kind whose virtual +8 returns the marker constant 0x007AE8A0) to the command through 0x0053CD1C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_FourSlotAnimWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a four-slot animation-window container: installs vtable 0x759D5C, self-links three list heads, then constructs four consecutive Ui_AnimWindow instances (0x18C stride) under the 0x0076D180 base and returns the base-adjusted pointer.

functions.name: Ui_ModelSelect_DeleteThunk
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the model-select window: runs the destructor at 0x1CFDC0 and frees the object with 0x10F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_ModelSelect_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the model preview selector: unwinds the four preview slots and their node members and releases the layout references.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitComponentRecord
functions.summary: Copies a 0x2A-byte gimmick component descriptor into a record, seeding the id fields to 0xFFFF/0xFF and choosing between the two initial state ids 0x18 and 5 based on descriptor byte +0x24.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_AcClient_OpenSession

functions.summary: Open/re-check of a service session: on the first call it validates or creates the handle at conn+0x18 (svcCloseHandle 0x23 for a stale one, 0x0012038C to create), queries the 512-byte state through 0x0050175C and sends it with 0x005016CC; success sets conn+0x9C54 and returns 1, otherwise it stores the nn::Result in errorOut/reasonOut.

functions.name: Fs_FileRequest_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a file-request object: stores the flags at +0x4C, installs the embedded list head at +0xC/+0x44.. and starts the 0x1000-byte / 0x10-aligned transfer context through the shared 0x10EAB0 initialiser.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_SingletonCtor
functions.summary: Lazy one-time construction of the engine's 0x37C-byte global UI/service singleton at g_007BE2F0 (vtable 0x00782928): zeroes the block, installs the vtable and returns the nested sub-object at +0x33C; the once flag is cleared after construction.

functions.name: Fs_Request_Build
functions.signature: void Fs_Request_Build(u64* out, FsRequest* req, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Builds and issues an async file request from the request's path fields (f_1C/f_20/f_24): fills the 0x655xxx request block, calls the low-level open (0x502490), polls (0x655398), flushes the GPU cache (0x6BA35C/Gfx_GpuState_Invalidate), optionally waits for the service and returns the 64-bit result cookie.

functions.name: Fs_ReportFatalError
functions.summary: Builds a 0xF80-byte 3DS CTR SDK nn::err::FatalErrInfo structure on the stack (0x0051CBF8), stores the failed nn::Result code resultCode at +0x04, initializes the err:f IPC session (0x0051BA34..0x0051CD28), and submits the fatal error via 0x0051CC68.

functions.name: Fs_AsyncIo_Register
functions.summary: Reserves an async-IO slot: queries the free-slot state, marks the per-object slot byte, installs the embedded list head at +0xC and initialises the 0x1000/0x10 transfer context. Returns whether the slot was obtained.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_IsFeatureAvailable
functions.summary: Two-step availability gate: returns 1 only when both IPC queries succeed. The two callees are the CTR IPC wrappers for command ids 0x08170000 and 0x08180000, each of which returns one response byte; which service or feature they query is still unknown.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ApplyRecordTransform
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Actor_ApplyRecordTransform(void* self, void* record)
functions.summary: Applies a placement record's transform to an actor's model instance: validates the actor's linked node and its count, then builds the matrix from the record's position/rotation (or drops the model when the record has no geometry) and writes it with Gfx_ModelInstance_SetMatrix, clearing the two pending flags at +0x286/+0x287.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_StreamRequest_MarkComplete
functions.summary: Marks stream request at self+0x14 complete (byte +0x284 = 1) when owner matches self+0x18 and request reports finished via func_00659318 or flag +0x288.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_StreamRequest_Release
functions.summary: Releases a stream request node: checks completion via func_00659318, invokes func_0055DA70 on active request, unlinks intrusive list pointers, and frees node.

functions.name: Ui_Slot_ResetDefaults
functions.summary: Resets a pooled UI slot: releases the child at +0x60 through vtable +0x38, sets alpha 0xFF and frame 4, and copies the two default 3-float vectors.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ReleaseHeader
functions.summary: Unlinks an intrusive list node and frees the owning object.

functions.name: Ui_EmotionWindow_Init
functions.summary: Sets up the emotion (expression) window: binds the four emotion name slots through the layout interface and loads the 'emotion_sleep' layout animation.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_PlayVariantAnimation
functions.summary: Selects vector/param entry from table at 0x00725830 indexed by child byte +0xAA, passes it to child virtual +0x84, and triggers state transition +0xB4(2, 1).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_CtorAppear

functions.name: Object_DtorThunkA

functions.name: Math_QuatRotateVector

functions.summary: Per-frame orientation of an effect part toward a target: computes the unit direction from the object's world position to the tracked node at self+0x28, builds the rotation, calls Gfx_EffectPart_SetDirection and counts down self+0x2C, notifying the node when the timer expires.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_CtorNotice

functions.summary: Constructor of the 'notice' field-NPC action object (0x54 bytes, vtable 0x00759F44): sets the two timers 0.4/0.8 at +0xC/+0xD, the two vectors from 0x007E7030/0x007E7000, clears +0x14 and +0x51 and sets +0x52 = 7.

functions.name: Object_DtorThunkB

functions.name: ViewWork_Reset

functions.summary: Tears down the field talk-mode camera/overlay work: releases the view handle, recomputes the look-at from self+0x1618, drops the two UI row lists, rebuilds the shared 0x37C block and clears the camera/view state bytes.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_UpdateScreenEntries
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the per-screen view entries: walks the two screen blocks (0xABC apart) and updates each entry's transform, copying the resulting basis vectors.

functions.name: Camera_ApplyWorkEntries
functions.summary: Builds and applies the camera work entries for the view work: for each of the 0x20 candidate slots it tests visibility, resolves the indexed handle, fills the camera setup record and calls Camera_SetupFromRecord, registering the resulting path.

functions.name: Camera_ApplyWorkEntriesDefault
functions.summary: Applies default camera work parameter block to view work; mirror companion of Camera_ApplyWorkEntries (0x001D15AC) for default layout slots.

functions.name: Gfx_InitScreenViews
functions.signature: void Gfx_InitScreenViews(void* self, int view, int record)
functions.summary: Initialises the per-screen view state: resets the handles, sets the default screen mask, determines whether both 3DS screens are in use and builds the first view records.

functions.summary: State-entry helper on the object at self: clears +0x15D0, arms a 3.0f timer in +0x15D4, and when the deadline at +0x15E0 is below f_4C sets f_50=1 and copies f_44 into +0x15D4; a set byte at +0x15DC also applies the default camera/layout entries, and the step ends with f_29=1/f_28=0.

functions.name: Gfx_ResetScreenViews
functions.signature: void Gfx_ResetScreenViews(void* self, unsigned int viewId, char* mode)
functions.summary: Resets both 3DS screen view blocks and their view entries, re-applies the default view and initialises the layout state for the given mode.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ApplyToActorsInRadius
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_ApplyToActorsInRadius(FieldWork* scene, float* centre, int filter)
functions.summary: Walks the field actor list (work+8->+0x54, class list 4) and for every actor within the squared radius of the position (and, when filter is 0, not in state 2) calls 0x005E7848(actor,2,0) and the actor's virtual +0x98; called from the slide-window play-in/play-out paths.

functions.name: Gfx_UpdateScreenViewTargets
functions.summary: Resolves the parameter block's four view ids against the current screen block and, for each view that passes the +0x16D test, updates its camera target list through maybe_Camera_UpdateTargetList; returns 1 when at least one view was updated.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_UpdateFollowPosition_2
functions.signature: void maybe_Camera_UpdateFollowPosition_2(CameraWork* cam, float* out, u32 flags, u32* extra)
functions.summary: Advances the follow camera for one frame: adds delta to timer at +0x574, walks visible target slots, and adds lateral/vertical RNG offset.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_UpdateFollowPositionEx
functions.signature: void maybe_Camera_UpdateFollowPositionEx(float dt, u32 flags, float arg3, float* out)
functions.summary: Second entry point of camera follow update at 0x001D1FC4 caused by decompiler mid-function split artifact.

functions.name: Gfx_ResetViewHandles
functions.signature: void Gfx_ResetViewHandles(void* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Clears the view manager's handles and state flags on both screen blocks and invalidates the current view handle.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ComputeActorScreenPosition
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ComputeActorScreenPosition(float* out, void* arg2, void* record, void* camera, void* arg5)
functions.summary: Computes a camera-relative placement point for an actor: takes the camera record's rotation/position (f_8C..f_A4), the model height for the actor id from the data manager and the bytes at arg2+0x32/+0x33, then writes a 3-float point clamped by Camera_FindEntryCoveringPosition.

functions.name: Gfx_UpdateActorsInViewCone
functions.signature: void Gfx_UpdateActorsInViewCone(void* arg1, const float* position, const float* direction)
functions.summary: Walks the field actor list (list id 4) and, for actors of class 0x7C3684 that pass the state checks, measures the distance and the angle between the given direction and the offset; every actor inside the radius and cone receives a vtable+0x38(0x1B, 0) update call.

functions.name: maybe_Field_DetachActorsInRadius
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_DetachActorsInRadius(ViewWork* viewWork, float* centre, int filter)
functions.summary: Walks the field actors around a position and detaches the matching ones: asks Field_AttachSlotObject for the actor's slot and, when that succeeds, decrements the view-entry counters +0x15E0/+0x15E4 (state-2 actors use +0x15E4), then clamps the entry height; called from the talk-camera release path.

functions.name: Gfx_SetActiveScreen
functions.summary: Switches which of the two 3DS screens is active by toggling the flags on both screen blocks and refreshing the layout.

functions.name: Camera_ApplyScreenViewTransforms
functions.summary: Walks the active view-entry lists of the field object manager and, for every entry of render-object class 0x007C3684 that is not in state 2, resolves its state through 0x00669250 and applies the interpolated transform to the two screen views.

functions.name: Gfx_ApplyScreenViewFades
functions.summary: Applies the parameter block's fade settings to the screen views it names: for each of the four view ids at params+0x48 (0x0FFFFFFF = end) it resolves the view in the current screen block and calls Gfx_ScreenView_ApplyFadeParams on both view objects (+0x54 and +0xB10), skipping views whose +0x16D byte is set.

functions.summary: Places self at self+0x24 units along the horizontal direction from the camera (work+0x54+0x1C, position f_9C/f_A0/f_A4) towards the player (work+0x74, f_B0..f_C4): normalises the XZ delta, scales it, stores the result in self+0x14/0x18/0x1C and marks self+0x28 = 1.

functions.name: Camera_UpdateWorkPath
functions.signature: unsigned int Camera_UpdateWorkPath(void* self, int index, unsigned int target, float* output, float* output2)
functions.summary: Advances one camera-work entry along its path: interpolates the current position toward the next key with a random jitter, applies the entry's rotation offset and returns whether the entry is still running.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_UpdateWorkPathEx
functions.summary: Camera path state machine helper that branches on Gfx_Scene_DrawSpriteVariant and updates screen marker offsets.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_ResetScreenEntries
functions.summary: Releases the three per-view entry blocks at self+0x54, self+0xB10 and self+0x15F4, then re-registers every actor node (class 0x007C3684, state != 2) whose slot entry flag is still clear by calling 0x005E7848(node, 2, 0).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ReleaseScreenEntries
functions.summary: The list-walk half of 0x001D4200: walks the two lists (0x001C7AD0/0x001C7560, filter 4) until the 0x007C3684 class sentinel and releases each node with 0x005E7848(node, 2, 0) when its slot flag is clear.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_UpdateTargetList
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Camera_UpdateTargetList(CameraWork* cam, int targetId, CameraTargetRecord* rec)

functions.name: Svc_GetTableRow

functions.name: Model_SetFaceId

functions.name: Field_ExitTalkMode

functions.name: Field_SetupTalkParams
functions.signature: void Field_SetupTalkParams(void* self, void* actor, void* record, unsigned char* params)

functions.name: maybe_Field_Talk_SetupFromRecord

functions.name: Field_ResetTalkState

functions.name: Field_HandleMapJump

functions.name: Field_EffectDesc_Build

functions.name: maybe_Field_ObjectCtor

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_ReadThreadEntry

functions.name: Ui_Object_DeleteThunkPlain

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorPooledB

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_CreateSpriteMesh
functions.summary: Creates engine sprite mesh named 'sprite' for UI widget and links into widget draw hierarchy.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_IsTouchActive
functions.summary: Advances the widget's touch record at +0x4D8 through Field_Object2D_RunTouchTransition and reports whether it has not reached the finished state 3.

functions.name: Gfx_CreateMultiSpriteEffectB
functions.summary: Second copy of the eight-sprite layered effect builder: same colour animator, same i = 0..7 child loop into self+0x298+i*0x48, only the constant addresses differ.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_RefreshTouchInfo
functions.summary: Rebuilds a widget's touch record (kind 4) and copies it plus the resolved frame-table row fields into self+0x4D8..+0x4F4; returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlotCtor_vt1D71DC
functions.summary: Overlay-slot widget constructor (vtable 0x001D71DC): base-constructs, installs the vtable pair and default-constructs eight 0x48-byte children at +0x298.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_Dtor
functions.summary: Widget destructor: installs the widget vtable 0x00759FBC and then the base vtable 0x0075D55C, destroys the eight 0x48-byte span entries at self+0x298, unlinks the intrusive node and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ApplyPaneAnimation
functions.summary: Looks up an animation id in the lazily created shared table (func_00643504), notifies the widget's pane table at +0x138 through Ui_Widget_FindPaneAndNotify with the shared parameter block, then switches the pane state with func_0029126C.

functions.name: Ui_PartyHpGauge_UpdateAll
functions.summary: Per-frame tick of the party HP gauge window: bumps the animation counter, notifies the parent window and advances each of the four member sub-windows that are currently enabled.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Backdrop_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a full-screen UI backdrop object: creates it through 0x001D8B6C, installs vtable 0x0075A07C, sets up the two intrusive list heads at +0x11C..+0x134 and default-constructs four 0x260-byte children at +0x138.

functions.name: Ui_PartyHpGaugeWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the party HP gauge window: releases four inner widgets, destroys the four 0x260-byte member slots, installs the base vtable, unlinks three list pairs, then runs the base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_CreateEffectOnCommand

functions.summary: Thin widget hook: broadcasts Field_SceneNode_NotifyChildrenUpdate and then forwards the widget to its own virtual slot +0x84 with the global pointer 0x007BE72E (an update/reset argument). The virtual target is still an unrecovered jump table, so reset-versus-mode-set stays open.

functions.name: Ui_CursorIcon_SetWordType

functions.signature: void Ui_CursorIcon_BindAnims(UiCursorIcon* self, void* layout, int paneIndex, u32 animSet)

functions.name: Ui_SetupCursorIcons
functions.summary: Loads the cursor icon set (default, word2, word3 and keyboard icons) and binds them to the widget's cursor handles.

functions.name: Ui_Cursor_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the UI cursor: stamps vtable 0x75A184, destroys the three 0x50-byte cursor-icon animation parts at +0x4C, runs the Ui_Object base destructor and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Cursor_ApplyColorToNodes

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AnimObject_Ctor

functions.name: Gfx_ClearBgLayerMask
functions.summary: Clears the global 2D background layer visibility mask at device+0xF68, i.e. hides every BG2D layer at once; used when an overlay takes over the screen.

functions.name: Field_HandleMapJumpEvent

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StatusWindow_Dtor

functions.name: Ui_MessagePair_SetPanels

functions.summary: Binds a UI control to a pane slot: stores control at self+0x34, caches control->vt[+0x0C](control) at self+0x28, clears self+0x2C and self+0x30, and invokes self->vt[+0x14](self, 0).

functions.name: Ui_MessagePair_Bind
functions.signature: void Ui_MessagePair_Bind(UiMessagePair* self, UiText* left, UiText* right)
functions.summary: Cheap variant of 0x001DAA24 that only stores the two text objects and links their owner nodes, without touching the work allocator.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_Update
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_Update(UiWidget* widget, const UiUpdateArgs* args, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Generic per-frame widget update: forwards the tick to the bound controller, handles the pending-sound/transition timer, polls the input flags and dispatches one of the widget's virtual state handlers.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_Decode
functions.summary: Decodes one message page: walks the page's per-character opcode records (0x00..0x13 = line breaks, glyph/font switches, text-argument slots, wait, auto flags), applies each to the window, then formats and submits the page's text block.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_Dtor
functions.summary: Base destructor of the message-page object: hides the current page window, retags the object to its base vtable and unlinks the two embedded list nodes.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Movie_IsEndedOrPlayable
functions.summary: Movie-controller predicate: returns 1 when the controller has latched its end flag f_1F, or when Gfx_Movie_IsPlayable(arg2) says the requested movie can play; 0 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Anim_SetStateId
functions.summary: Switches an animation object to another state: when the previous state word, its flag bit or the stored id is set it resets the object through 0x001DBC30 first, then stores the new state id at self+8.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Movie_RestoreDefaultValue
functions.summary: Reads default parameter from movie player sub-object at self->f_c+0xAB0 via func_00500084 and restores it with func_004FFB34.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_GetCurrentFrameIndex
functions.summary: Returns the current frame index of the movie controller: uses the cached frame at +0xACC when no explicit frame is set, otherwise converts the presentation time from the movie handle at +0xAB0 and returns time-1, clamped at 0.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_UpdateFlash
functions.summary: Advances a full-screen flash overlay: samples the two-value track, writes the colour into device+0x12F0..+0x1300 and, after two frames without change, tears the overlay down and restores the default colour/size.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_PlayByName
functions.signature: void Gfx_Movie_PlayByName(MoviePlayer* self, const char* movieName, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Starts movie playback by resource name: lazily creates the movie manager, formats the 'movie/%s' path and hands it to Gfx_InitRenderDevice to start the stream.

functions.name: Gfx_InitRenderDevice
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_InitRenderDevice(int device, int mode, u8 flags, u32 config)
functions.summary: Initializes a render device: reserves the frame/display buffers, sets the mode and flag bytes and installs the renderer reset routine.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_UpdateStateMachine
functions.summary: Advances the movie controller: when a request is pending and neither the latched end flag nor the suspend flag is set, it asks maybe_Gfx_Movie_IsPlayable for the player and starts playback (0x001B7340) before marking f_1F; then it runs Gfx_Movie_UpdatePlayback and, when 0x0062AFCC reports completion, clears f_1C/f_20 (or latches f_1D).

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_Shutdown
functions.summary: Shuts a screen overlay/flash effect down: if it owns a render object (self+0x0C) it resets the renderer, releases the object, clears the field and restores the device's default overlay colour/size; if the 'resources loaded' bit (+0x10 & 1) is set it also runs the painter teardown and clears the bit.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_SetMode
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Movie_SetMode(MovieCtrl* self, int mode, u32 arg3, int current)
functions.summary: Updates movie playback mode byte at self->f_1E; if the mode changes and player is active (f_1F set), restarts playback with func_001B7334. Returns 1 if mode changed, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_ValidationWorker
functions.summary: Thread body of the text NG-word filter: while the enable byte (worker+4) is set it takes the monitor at worker+0x444, consumes one queued request (flag bit 0 = validate all, bit 1 = validate one), runs Text_NgWord_ValidateAll or Text_NgWord_ValidateOne with the filter state at worker+0x10, stores the result/error bytes at worker+0xC/0xD, drops the request and sleeps 1,000,000 ticks when idle.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_MoviePlayer_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the movie-player object: installs the two class vtables (0x007804BC / 0x0078112C), releases the read-request block at +0x454, destroys the embedded sub-objects at words 4 and 5 and frees the player.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for service object: invokes maybe_Svc_Object_Shutdown (0x001DC080) and frees memory with func_0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_Shutdown
functions.summary: Two-stage teardown of an object that owns a thread handle, a critical section and a service object: closes the handles under the CTR SVC locks, releases the sub-object at +0x18, resets the vtable to 0x007804BC and finishes with the critical-section base destructor.

functions.name: maybe_SvcObject_StartPendingState
functions.summary: Checks if child at self+0x28 is idle via func_006289AC, and if pending work flags at +0x24C or +0x248 are set, switches child to state 1 with func_005E7848.

functions.name: Field_NpcNutAction_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Field_NpcNutAction_Ctor(void* storage, void* npc, void* actionList, const char* tag, u32 slot)
functions.summary: Constructor of the NPC idle ('nut') action object (0x2C bytes): runs Field_ActorAction_CtorBaseA and installs vtable 0x0075A4EC, the actor animation-timer class.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorThunkC
functions.summary: Minimal deleting destructor: installs the shared base vtable through 0x00193E44 (which stores 0x00758AE0) and frees the object with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_StartAnimTimer
functions.summary: Starts the idle animation on the actor at self+0x28, records the clip length from actor+0x320 as the target time in self+0x30, zeroes the accumulated time at self+0x34 and writes the float pi/2 (0x3FC90FDB) into actor+0x158.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_UpdateAnimTimer
functions.summary: Accumulates dt into +0x34 while the global pause byte is clear, and once the accumulated time passes the target (+0x30) - or the actor's +0x344 loop flag says stop - calls 0x005E7848(actor, 1, 0) to advance the actor action.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorNutActionCtor
functions.signature: void* maybe_Field_ActorNutActionCtor(void* self, Actor* actor, void* actionList, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the field actor action class used for the 'nut' action: runs the shared actor-action base constructor, installs vtable 0x0075A520 and sets the default 0.26f at +0x30 with 0 at +0x34.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorThunkD
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor: destroys the Ui layout sub-object base through 0x001B7DB0 and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC. It is slot +0x38 of vtable 0x0075A4EC, the class constructed by Field_NpcNutAction_Ctor.

functions.name: Message_SetArgTextById
functions.summary: Resolves the message text for the id stored at +0x11 in the message table and installs it as message argument slot 5.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListEntry_SyncSprite
functions.summary: Refreshes the sprite of one list entry: in the normal game path it redraws the sprite part f_11 by name, in the alternate path it hides it (mode 5), then advances the list state machine at work+8->+0x90 for that same entry id.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessage_ApplyScreenShakeId
