functions.summary: Applies a screen-shake / effect id to the panel message window: on change it records the new id, seeds the duration from 0x001DC6C8, resolves the effect record and scans the window's 0x20-entry byte list for the first entry whose check passes.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_Build
functions.summary: Builds one message page from a command byte: selects the corresponding window/line table (0..7 and 0x1b), computes the visible line range, splits the text into seven rows and pushes the finished page record to the window.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_ExecuteCommand
functions.signature: void Ui_MessagePage_ExecuteCommand(UiMessagePage* self, char* cmd, char* arg3)
functions.summary: Executes the inline control codes of a message line: creates/destroys the small 0x164 icon text box for codes 0/0x13-0x16, advances the page for code 1, handles ruby/glyph-metric for code 9, line advance for 0x0a, the second metric table for 0x10, and icon/payment commands for 0x11-0x16.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessagePage_DecodeSkillCommand
functions.summary: Pulls the next command byte from the page's message stream, mirrors the resulting u16 list into the two linked text rows, then scans it for the first skill the current party member can unlock and stores it at f_20A.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessage_SmoothScreenPos
functions.summary: Spring-smooths the panel message window's on-screen position toward a target: it computes the delta and its squared length, integrates the acceleration with a 30-unit cap and the 0.00044/0.0333 damping terms, and passes the result to the camera matrix helper 0x00649E30.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessage_UpdateScreenShake
functions.summary: Adds the panel message window's screen shake: it integrates a decaying shake clock (120-frame period, -0.02 damping, -1 clamps) and applies the resulting offset to the camera basis through 0x00649E30/0x00649D64.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessage_UpdateScreenPos
functions.summary: Second position pass for the panel message window: it lerps toward the anchor stored in the attached sub-object (+0x39C -> +0x1D8) with a 15-unit step and 0.0667 rate, falling back to the raw delta when the target is closer than one unit.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_ReleaseSubWindows
functions.summary: Releases the eight optional sub-windows of the message window (icon box, ruby box, name plate, cursor, etc.) according to their 'present' flags.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessage_ResolveTargetPos
functions.signature: void Ui_PanelMessage_ResolveTargetPos(PanelMessageCamera* self, int animId, int secondary)
functions.summary: Resolves the panel-message camera's target position: it scans the 0x1C-byte animation records for the one whose u16 id matches the pending command id at +0x20A and derives the target bytes from the record's fields, taking the sign of +0x37A and the +0x3B5 flag into account.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindow_LoadPanels
functions.summary: Loads the 3D panel message window: reads panel_text.bxon plus the per-character portrait panels (hero, camus, veronica, sena, sylvia, rou, martina, graig, ex_sena) and the icon/line-icon conversion tables, then creates the cursor, line-icon and prize sub-windows.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindow_Update
functions.summary: Main per-frame update of the panel message window (the window that pops up over battle panels): drives the anchor/screen-position smoothing, page scrolling, sub-windows and the open/close tweens.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: UiPanelMessageWindow* Ui_PanelMessageWindow_Ctor(UiPanelMessageWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 vtable)
functions.summary: Constructor of the 3D panel message window: seeds the 14 text slots with the 'not set' sentinel 0xfffff000, builds the four node members and the base window, then loads the panels.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindow_CtorEx
functions.summary: Second constructor of the 3D panel message window, used for the 'wide/two-line' variant (mode 0x13); after construction it applies the two values pointed to by a2 to the sub-window at +0x30.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessage_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the panel message window: runs Ui_PanelMessage_Dtor (0x001E04C8) and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessage_Dtor
functions.signature: void* Ui_PanelMessage_Dtor(UiPanelMessageWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor of the panel message window: destroys the sub-window at +0xF0, releases the ten text objects at +0xE0..+0xE9 through the UI heap, then unwinds the ~20 embedded member blocks and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorComponent_RefreshVisualA
functions.summary: Field actor component hook: when the UI overlay mode byte (work+8->f_48+0x27F) is outside 1..4 it calls the field-2D visual/speed update on the world actor with flag 1 and then resets the owner actor's animator state (actor->f_B8->f_FC). Same 136-byte body as 0x001E0B90 with 0 instead of 1.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ApplyStickInput
functions.summary: While the actor is not busy (f_1C5 clear) this reads the player's movement vector through the named Input_ReadDigitalMoveVector and, in game modes 1-4, snaps it to the dominant axis and doubles the step; the resulting X/Y step is added to the actor's movement delta at +0xC4/+0xC8. With a zero vector it just plays the idle animation.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorComponent_RefreshVisualB
functions.summary: Twin of 0x001E0990 with flag 0: outside UI overlay modes 1..4 it triggers the field-2D visual update on the world actor and resets the owner actor's animator state (actor->f_B8->f_FC).

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_CreateRun
functions.summary: Creates the run/walk movement action: allocates through Actor_Action_InitDescriptor, installs vtable 0x0075A590 and the sub-object vtable 0x00782524, copies the literals 'Run' and 'Walk' into the two name buffers and sets state byte +0x17 to 1.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor that first stores the vtable passed in r1, then runs the shared actor-action base destructor and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC. It is the sub-object destructor slot of the Field actor-move task.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_Unregister
functions.summary: Deactivates the movement task: sends the task's receiver descriptor (built by 0x00642280) through the global receiver list scan (class mask 0x40000040, id 0x7C503C), clears the task's active byte +0x2C and plays the actor's idle animation for state 0.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_Begin
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_ActorMove_Begin(FieldActorMoveTask* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Task start: enables the owner's camera visibility (flag 1), resets owner->f_B8->f_FC through 0x002D0E84, calls 0x005F4F9C(owner, 0), then initialises the task fields (f_2C=0, f_30/f_34 from g_001E0E90, f_38=0xFF, f_39=0).

functions.name: Field_ActorMove_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame move-task update: when idle it samples the stick, snaps it to one of the eight map directions and starts a move; while moving it validates the destination cell against the map grid and either keeps the task registered or aborts and unregisters it.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_End
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_ActorMove_End(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: End hook of the field actor move task: triggers the field-2D visual update with flag 0, resets the owner's animator state and freezes the scene object on the last animation frame (Field_SceneObject_SetAnimatorLastFrame). Mirror of 0x001E0E20.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_Register
functions.summary: Re-registers the task's receiver descriptor in the global receiver list and then applies the pending direction offsets self+0x30/self+0x34 to the actor's +0xC4/+0xC8 fields (movement step).

functions.name: Field_ActorMove_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the field actor-move action: runs Actor_Action_InitDescriptor, installs vtable 0x75A5C4, clears the state and seeds the default timer pair.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Primary deleting destructor of the Field actor-move task: runs the shared actor-action base destructor and then releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC. It is the slot-0 dtor of vtable 0x0075A5C8, next to maybe_Field_ActorMove_Begin/End/Update.

functions.name: Field_ActorMove_InitDirection
functions.summary: Initialises the move task's direction: sets the default heading, reads the actor's base speed from the movement vtable (+0x68/+0x6C), projects the combined input vector through the actor matrix, normalises it into f_40..f_48 and pushes the result to the 2D part.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_OnMoveEvent
functions.summary: Handles movement event callbacks: sets flag self+0x52 on event 0xC and flag self+0x51 on event 0xD.

functions.name: Field_ActorMove_Integrate
functions.summary: Integrates the stored direction and speed into the actor position each frame (with the slower factor when f_51 is set), turns the actor towards the direction and finishes the move through the actor action helper once the motion reports arrival.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_Cancel
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_ActorMove_Cancel(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Cleanup hook: calls the owner actor's virtual +0x88 (flush) and, when actor->f_234 is set, triggers the field-2D visual update with flag 0 and resets f_234->f_B8->f_FC. Byte-identical to 0x001E1A7C.

functions.name: Field_ActorJumpTask_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the 'Jump' field-actor action task: allocates through the shared action base (0x294C34), installs vtable 0x75A5F8, stores the four-character task name "Jump" (immediate 0x706D754A) into the fixed-string member at +0x2C and clears the state/vector fields.

functions.name: maybe_Object_DeletingDtorWithVtable
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor that installs the vtable passed in, runs the shared empty base destructor 0x00294C88 and frees the object through the virtual deleter 0x0010F6CC. The class is unknown, so the name only records the shape.

functions.name: Field_Actor_BeginStep
functions.summary: Starts a field-actor step: re-enables the actor's movement animation, records the current time and the actor's facing matrix so the step can be interpolated, and clears the actor's pending step flag.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_ClampDirection
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Actor_ClampDirection(FieldActorMoveTask* self, float* dir, float* outLen)
functions.summary: Normalises the combined field move vector and rotates it into the actor's current facing frame (live camera/actor matrix at work+0x74, or the saved copy at +0x60 when the task flag +0x70 is set); returns the length through outLen.

functions.name: Model_AddNodePositionDelta
functions.summary: Adds a per-frame position delta to a node (x += s2, y += s1*s0, z += s3*s0 from the soft-float registers) and commits it with 0x005F5F54; returns 1 so it can serve as an animation task callback.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_SetDirectionTarget
functions.summary: Applies direction vector from self+0x30 to model node at self+0x28 via virtual method +0x84, and clears target active flag at +0x311.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_SetDirectionTargetAlt
functions.summary: Applies alternate target vector from self+0x44 to model node at self+0x28 via virtual method +0x84, and sets target active flag at +0x311 to 1.

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateBehaviour
functions.summary: Chooses and ticks the actor's next behaviour (idle, walk, run or turn) from the distance to its goal, the map-section range and the actor flags, and stops the task when the chosen behaviour reports failure.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_EndBehaviour
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Actor_EndBehaviour(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Field actor behaviour end hook: flushes the owner (virtual +0x88) and, if actor->f_234 is set, triggers the field-2D visual update with flag 0 and resets f_234->f_B8->f_FC. Byte-identical to 0x001E1534.

functions.name: Field_ActorWalkTask_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the walk/run field-actor behaviour task: action base 0x294C34, vtable 0x75A62C, two fixed-string members seeded with "Run" (0x006E7552) and "Walk" (0x6B6C6157), state 1, and a four-word default vector at +0x20.

functions.name: maybe_Object_DeletingDtorWithVtableB
functions.summary: Second copy of the shared scalar deleting destructor: installs the vtable passed in, runs the shared empty base destructor 0x00294C88 and frees the object through the virtual deleter 0x0010F6CC. Same body as 0x001E160C.

functions.name: maybe_PartyPanel_SelectCurrentSlot
functions.summary: For current slot index f_E5 (< 10), updates tween position, transitions panel to state 5 via func_001E3BEC, and rebuilds slot objects.

functions.name: maybe_Message_SetArgTextPair
functions.summary: Installs one text argument and two label strings into the message-argument store (argument 5 plus the two 0x00707C1C label slots) and clears the 0x40-byte scratch block.

functions.name: Ui_PanelState_Enter16
functions.summary: Enters sequence state 0x10: cancels any running panel action, calls the shared state setter 0x001E3BEC(self,0x10,0,0,0), rebinds the panel slot and installs the duration pair from the 0x0072A944 table (+0x48/+0x4C).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelRow_DrawPane
functions.summary: Draws one panel row as a single-pane composite: builds a one-element argument block containing the row itself and passes it to Ui_CompositeWindow_DrawPanes(self+0x38, block).

functions.name: maybe_PartyPanel_UpdateCounter
functions.summary: Advances a panel counter: increments the 16-bit value at +0x22C, clamps it against bag slot 0x0C (read with func_0066B0F8, written back with maybe_Field_SetStat(0x0C, ...)), refreshes the icon/animation state through 0x001E3BEC/0x001E3C70 and counts down +0x234.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelRow_ResetAnimationState
functions.summary: Clamps row timer at +0x228 based on signed delay at +0x18A, updates visibility, resets pending flag at +0x234 to -1, and stores position pair.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelRow_ResetAnimationStateB
functions.summary: Compact variant of 0x001E1EC8: stores visibility into self+0x94, resets flag +0x234 to -1, and copies coordinates without timer clamp.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelState_Enter11Or0E
functions.summary: Panel-state transition: waits for the slot action at self+400 and the list model, then enters state 0x11 (selecting the row and binding the slot) when a slot is selected, or state 0x0E with a -1 countdown when none is; both branches copy the timer pair from 0x72A944.

functions.name: Ui_PanelState_Enter0B
functions.summary: Enters sequence state 0x0B: calls the shared state setter 0x001E3BEC(self,0xB,0,0,0), rebinds the panel slot and installs the duration pair from 0x0072A944 (+0xA0/+0xA4).

functions.name: Ui_PanelState_Enter0EOr10
functions.summary: Cancels any running panel action and enters panel state 0x0E with the +0xB8/+0xBC duration when the pending card id f_234 is 0, otherwise state 0x10 with the +0x48/+0x4C duration; both branches rebind the slot control, and the 0x0E branch clears f_234 to -1.

functions.name: maybe_Message_StorePosPairB
functions.signature: void maybe_Message_StorePosPairB(MessageArgRecord* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Commits the view (child-screen sub-object +0x1C, virtual +0xC with 1) and unconditionally copies the second position pair of the global 0x0072A944 (+0x98/+0x9C) into the record's +0x30/+0x34.

functions.name: maybe_Message_StorePosPairBIfPromptNotConfirmed
functions.signature: void maybe_Message_StorePosPairBIfPromptNotConfirmed(MessageArgRecord* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Stores a position pair into the record's +0x30/+0x34: when the referenced prompt is absent or not in state 1 it commits the view and uses the second pair (0x0072A944+0x98/+0x9C), otherwise it uses the first pair (+0/+4).

functions.name: maybe_PartyPanel_CreateSlotObject
functions.summary: Creates the panel's optional 0x30-byte slot sub-object on demand (checked first through the game-work test at +0x24A98), binds it with Ui_SubObjectHost_Ctor and registers it in the panel's notification list at f_4C.

functions.name: Ui_PanelState_Enter09ForRow
functions.signature: void Ui_PanelState_Enter09ForRow(UiPanelSequence* self, u32 arg2, int row, u32 argument)
functions.summary: For the current row index (f_106 < 3) it reads the 0x20-byte row record from the panel's row table, stores the row's id byte into f_234, updates the row data (0x001E3C70), plays the model change animation (0x004776F0/0x00477444) and enters sequence state 9 with that id.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessagePanel_AdvancePage
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_MessagePanel_AdvancePage(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Page turn of a message/text panel: when a previous page is still shown (f_234>0) it ends it with state 0x13, rebinds the text control and stores the page-end position pair; otherwise it commits the cursor and stores the text-start pair (0x24/0x25 versus 0x26/0x27 of 0x72A944).

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessage_UpdatePrices
functions.summary: Writes the ten price/digit displays of the shop or prize window, scaling each by the current digit place (1, 10 or 100) and by the row's unit price.

functions.name: maybe_Message_StorePosPairAIfViewReady
functions.signature: void maybe_Message_StorePosPairAIfViewReady(MessageAtom* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Asks the view object's virtual +0x3C with 0 and, only when it reports success, copies the first position pair of the global 0x0072A944 (+0/+4) into the record's +0x30/+0x34.

functions.name: maybe_PartyPanel_EnsureSlotObjects
functions.summary: Lazily creates the party panel's shared 0x1EB0 helper object, then refreshes the panel: rebuilds the animation sequence, re-binds the slot controls and updates the panel's BGM request.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Panel_StartStep
functions.summary: Starts one panel step: waits out the delay at +0x224, tells the UI manager the current member index through bag work, sets the slot tween timings (0x1E/10/10) on the gauge at +0x128 and raises the anchor object's +0x94 flag.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Panel_FinishStep
functions.summary: Completes one panel step: ticks the +0x19C effect, plays cue 0x3A/0x3B when +0x1B0==0x37, and once the done sentinel and the cue report finished it re-binds the next member on the slot gauge and restarts the step at state 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessagePanel_AdvancePageEx
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_MessagePanel_AdvancePageEx(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Second page-turn variant: the same prompt/page logic as 0x1E2688 with the paused test inverted and an extra flush of the pending +400 sub-object before storing the text-start pair.

functions.name: maybe_PartyPanel_RefreshRowAvailability
functions.summary: Lazily creates the panel's 0x30-byte sub-object (type 0x2F), then re-evaluates the row: compares the bag count with the row's quantity scale (x1/x10/x100 from the byte at +4, gold cap 0x0098967F) and pushes the matching row state (+3/+4) with the bound control.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelState_Enter11OrEIdle
functions.summary: Reuses the 0x11/0x0E panel-state entry (0x001E21D8) and then replaces the duration pair with 0x0072A944+0x40/+0x44, i.e. the same transition with the alternate (idle) duration.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelState_ResetSequence
functions.summary: Resets the panel sequence: releases the card slots at self+0x4C through 0x00379400, clears the running flag f_60 and installs the default duration pair from 0x0072A944+0x30/+0x34.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Panel_Notify
functions.summary: Vtable trampoline: asks the UI core's text object whether it has content and, if so, lazily creates the 0x1C-byte singleton at 0x007F52B8 and calls 0x0019F4F0 on its second word. The frame argument arrives in r3 only, which is why Ghidra shows a void function.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelState_AdvanceFromModelA
functions.summary: Advance-to-state-0x11 variant A: once the +0x19C effect and the panel action have finished it stops the model loop at +0x194, enters state 0x11, rebinds the slot and copies the two timers from g_001E3274.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelState_AdvanceFromModelB
functions.summary: Advance-to-state-0x11 variant B: when the +0x1B4 effect and its flags allow it, it plays the model loop, enters state 0x11, rebinds the slot and copies the two timers.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a message panel to its default placement: restarts the transition on the embedded view at +0x19C and copies the default position pair from the shared panel table 0x0072A944 (+0x70/+0x74) into the panel's +0x30/+0x34.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelState_SetDurationFromSlot
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PanelState_SetDurationFromSlot(UiPanelSequence* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 argument)
functions.summary: Chooses the panel-sequence duration: when the bound slot at f_198 reports 'ready' (0x0062F694 == 1) it re-registers the card slots and uses the short pair 0x0072A944+0x30/+0x34, otherwise it sets the 5-frame wait in f_224 and the long pair +0xB0/+0xB4.

functions.name: maybe_PartyPanel_UpdateHighlight
functions.summary: Updates one shop/party slot panel: advances its animation state, plays SE 5 or starts cue 0x39 at state 0x28, and when the item id changes refreshes the payout gauge and icon through Item_LookupRecord.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_ResetEx
functions.summary: Extended panel reset: restarts the 3D sub-view at +0x194 through Ui_Anim_PlayChange2, re-applies the shared row data with message id 0xE9E and copies the default position pair from 0x0072A944 (+0x50/+0x54) into +0x30/+0x34.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Window_RestoreEntryState
functions.summary: Resets a message-window entry to its 'no message' state (ids 0 / 0xFFFF / 0) when the current entry object is missing, then, if f_230 is a valid index into the record table at f_10 (count +0x60, relative array +0x58->+0x24, stride 0x20), rebuilds the 0x80-entry local record buffer and copies the shared 2-float pivot from 0x0072A944 into self+0x30/+0x34.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelState_AdvanceFromModelC
functions.summary: Advance-to-state-0x11 variant C: gated by the +0x1B4 effect and the panel action, it stops the model loop, enters state 0x11, rebinds the slot and copies the two timers from g_001E3B3C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelState_SetDurationForCard
functions.summary: Releases the overlay handle at f_1B4 and picks the sequence duration pair from 0x0072A944+0x80 when the card id f_240 is 0x2E, or +0x88 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Message_StorePosPairBIfPromptConfirmed
functions.signature: void maybe_Message_StorePosPairBIfPromptConfirmed(MessageArgRecord* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Stores a position pair into the record's +0x30/+0x34: when the referenced prompt is in state 1 it commits the view and uses the second pair (0x0072A944+0x98/+0x9C), otherwise it uses the first pair (+0/+4).

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeWithWorkInit
functions.summary: Generic SE-once-with-lazy-manager helper: creates the shared 0x1EB0-byte sound manager when the caller's once flag is set and then plays seId through it.

functions.name: Ui_PanelState_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a panel sequence: ticks the auxiliary object at +0x24C, drives the state object at +0x248 to completion, waits for the bound slot (Ui_Widget_Update + the 0x0062F680 gate) and finally dispatches the handler at f_30/f_34.

functions.name: Ui_PanelState_RebindSlot
functions.summary: If the panel object exists, binds its +0x1E18 widget to this sequence's +0x1CC block and marks the panel loaded (f_94 = 1).

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the poker (casino) mini-game window: builds the four preview/text sub-windows, then loads poker_hand.bxon, poker_msg.bxon, poker_param.bxon, poker_double_up.bxon and the coin itembox layout for this table index.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the poker window.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_Dtor_2
functions.signature: void* Ui_PokerWindow_Dtor_2(UiPokerWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor of the poker window: destroys the sub-window at +0x248, releases the object at +0x100 and unwinds the member chain back to this-0x0c.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_InitTripletTable
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_InitTripletTable(int owner, int* desc, u32 arg3, u8 count, int arg5)
functions.summary: Rebuilds the owner's three-entry sub-table: destroys the old array, constructs three 0x10-byte entries, resolves each entry's two ids through maybe_Script_ResolveTwoIds and copies its flag byte, then stores arg3 and count at +0x30/+0x31.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SubTable_ReleaseEntries
functions.summary: Destroys a three-element array of 0x10-byte sub-entries with element destructor 0x00295660, frees the block and clears the table (pointer +0, state bytes +4/+5 = 0/0xFF). The same array is built by maybe_Gfx_InitTripletTable (0x001E4A40).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SubTable_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a small object that owns a three-entry sub-table: installs vtable 0x0075A694, clears the state bytes at +4/+5, destroys the three 0x10-byte sub-entries behind the pointer at +8, frees that block and clears the pointer. Returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Container_FixedArray_Remove
functions.summary: Removes the head element of an inline 0x58-byte slot array: releases the element at +8 through 0x00306A9C, moves the following 0x58-byte block down over +4 and zeroes the count at +0x5C; returns the removed element pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipMenu_ApplySelection
functions.summary: When the confirm prompt is accepted and the member index is below 0x1F, equips item self->f_46 into slot self->f_54 through Party_Member_EquipInventorySlot, marks self->f_59 and refreshes the attached model, then switches the window state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipMenu_SelectItem
functions.summary: Handles item selection for a member: checks equipment ranges 0xA4..0x9BF / 0xB19..0xB1C, tests member usability with func_0066C1A8, consumes bag copies, and switches the window to states 0xC..0x15.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_MoveCursor
functions.signature: void Ui_PokerWindow_MoveCursor(UiPokerWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Moves the poker card/deck cursor left or right with wraparound, scrolling the row view and updating the highlight through 0x001D809C.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_Confirm
functions.summary: Handles confirm on the poker screen: validates the selected card against the hand, checks the coin balance, and branches into win/lose/insufficient-funds results with their messages.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_HandleBet
functions.summary: Bet step of the poker window: when the bet dialog is not finished it selects slot 0xFF; otherwise it clears the dialog state, pops the bet window and installs the next handler pair.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_SetSelectedItem
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_SetSelectedItem(PokerWindow* self, int cardIdx, int value)
functions.summary: Selects the prize/card item at the given index: reads the card list through func_0063DD38, resolves the item with Item_LookupRecord, writes self->f_46/f_4c/f_50 and message argument 5, and updates the two UI number fields.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_Close
functions.summary: Closes the poker window: clears the dialog state, pops the window stack, clears the card text and installs the closed handler pair.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CardPanel_SetHandState
functions.summary: Chooses the card panel's hand state: when the bound slot query (0x0062F694) returns 1 it installs the +0x8/+0xC pair and state 4, otherwise the +0x10/+0x14 pair and state 5; then rebinds the slot.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_ConfirmBet
functions.summary: Confirm step of the bet: copies the caller's handler pair, clears the dialog state, pops the bet window and binds the card text for the selected value.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_UpdateInput
functions.signature: void Ui_PokerWindow_UpdateInput(void* self, int arg2, int arg3, void* context)
functions.summary: Input stage of the poker window: forwards direction-pad input to the card grid, and on confirm pops the window stack, resolves the selected card slot, removes it from the member's inventory, adds the stored card and advances the equip selection.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_Payout
functions.signature: void Ui_PokerWindow_Payout(UiPokerWindow* self, u32 amount, int* row)
functions.summary: Pays out the poker win: subtracts the stake from the score, opens the coin-gain message and updates the displayed balance.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_StoreCard
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_StoreCard(PokerWindow* self, int cardIdx, int arg3, int context)
functions.summary: Damaged Thumb fragment: the surviving calls store the chosen card/item id and price into the window state, look the item up and set message argument 5.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_ConfirmTail
functions.summary: Tail half of the poker confirm logic that Ghidra split out of 0x001E53F8: the frame is lost (self survives only as unaff_r4), so only the shared result code - coin/price lookups, Message_SetArg and the window-stack pops - is readable.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_Cancel
functions.summary: Handles cancel/back on the poker screen: for confirm it pushes the current selection, for back it abandons the hand and returns to the previous table.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_AdvanceSelection
functions.summary: Selects next poker window step based on ready query func_0062F694 on self+0x2218, branching between card selection and slot selection.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_HandlePayout
functions.summary: Payout step of the poker window: when the payout dialog has finished it computes the coin amount (rows x 6 minus the consumed entry), either shows the result or returns to the bet handler, then pops the window stack.

functions.name: Ui_PrizeWindow_Init
functions.summary: Shared initialiser of the medal/casino prize windows: creates the coin-gain window and the 0x26c message object, then shows the initial state.

functions.name: Ui_CardPanel_UpdateState
functions.summary: Per-frame card-panel update: waits for the bound slot at +0x3C (Ui_Widget_Update + the 0x0062F680 gate) and then dispatches the current hand-state handler stored at self+4/self+8 through its jump table.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_SelectSlot
functions.summary: Selects a poker card slot: slot <= 0x1E stores the slot index, clears the pending result and writes the member name (record+0xCA) into message argument 2; a larger slot finishes the round by committing the card count and issuing commands 10 and 0xB.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_BindCardText
functions.signature: void Ui_PokerWindow_BindCardText(PokerWindow* self, int visible, int value)
functions.summary: Binds the currently drawn card to the window: toggles the card pane visibility, sets its value and, when the id is an equipment item, writes the card's name text.

functions.name: Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: UiMedalPrizeWindow* Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_Ctor(UiMedalPrizeWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u8 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor of the mini-medal prize window: builds the shared prize base, loads medal_prize_msg.bxon and picks the two text pages for the current medal count.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoPrizeWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: UiCasinoPrizeWindow* Ui_CasinoPrizeWindow_Ctor(UiCasinoPrizeWindow* self, u32 prizeId, u32 arg3, u8 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor of the casino prize window: loads casino_prize_msg.bxon, looks the prize row up in the casino table, applies the localized id and shows it.

functions.name: Ui_PrizeWindow_Dtor
functions.signature: void* Ui_PrizeWindow_Dtor(UiPrizeWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor of the prize window: releases the three gfx/text objects at +0x38/+0x3C/+0x40 through the UI heap, then releases the member ref at +0xD0, tears down the sub-object and frees the window.

functions.name: Fs_IsPtclPath
functions.summary: Returns true when the given path contains the particle suffix ".ptcl".

functions.name: maybe_ListNode_DeletingDtorA
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor: installs the caller's vtable in word 0, runs the shared base destructor 0x005799D4 (which reinstalls base vtable 0x00782714 and unlinks self+8 from a doubly-linked list) and then operator delete 0x0010F6CC. The concrete class is not recoverable from this body.

functions.name: Event_RebuildIdSet
functions.summary: Rebuilds the byte set of quest/event ids from the save-work state: for every id 0..0x59 it queries the bag/event sub-object at work+0x24A98 and appends the id when its mode is in 2..6. The incremental counterpart Event_UpdateIdSet (0x001E7660) keeps the same set up to date.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageArgs_LoadCharacterModels
functions.summary: For each character id in [self+4, self+8) looks the character record up and registers the entry's four model ids (+0x12/+0x14/+0x16/+0x18) with the UI object manager, gated by kind 1/8. This is message-argument model preloading, not text drawing.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_FilterIdListByRecord
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_FilterIdListByRecord(void* self, const u8* filter)
functions.summary: Filters a byte list of model/object ids in place: for each source byte it resolves the record via func_0063D338 and appends the id to [self+0x6C, self+0x70) when the record is kind 2 and matches the five-byte filter record (id pair plus attribute byte). The source list lives at self+4..self+8.

functions.name: maybe_Item_GetFirstValidVariant
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Item_GetFirstValidVariant(unsigned int arg1, unsigned int id)
functions.summary: Returns the first of an entry's four alternative ids (+0x12/+0x14/+0x16/+0x18) that still exists in the current save (0x0035F110), or 0xFFFF when none does.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ObjectTable_RegisterListEntries
functions.summary: Walks the type-8 entries of a UI list, looks each character up, compares entry+0x1C with the work byte table and registers the entry's model handles through the manager vtable+8 / Engine_ResourceNode_CtorBase.

functions.name: Event_UpdateIdSet
functions.signature: void Event_UpdateIdSet(void* self, u32 id, int mode)
functions.summary: Keeps a sorted byte set of ids in sync with a mode: modes 2..6 append the id (growing the vector), any other mode removes it, and the change is then forwarded both to the bag sub-object's virtual slot (work+0x24A98) and to the event-state listener at +0x6C.

functions.name: maybe_Event_ActivateFlagAndClearSlot
functions.summary: Puts flag `id` into state 2 of the quest/event id set and, when the data-manager record for that id has type 3 or 8, clears the associated bag slot through the save work's vtable+8.

functions.name: Menu_ProcessEntryQueue
functions.signature: void Menu_ProcessEntryQueue(int queue, u32 type, u32 id)
functions.summary: Drains the pending-entry byte queue of a menu: for each queued id it resolves the record and, when the record matches (type, id), either re-enables the row (command 8) or pushes it as a disabled entry (command 7) and appends it to the list at work+0x10->+0xA4; the special type 0xE3 clears matching rows in all 0x5A slots.

functions.name: maybe_Event_UnlockFlag39IfProgress
functions.signature: void maybe_Event_UnlockFlag39IfProgress(void* idSet, u32 learnedId, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Sets quest/event flag 0x39 to state 1 when it is still unset (0 or 0xFF), the learned id is 0x1AB, the bag word at +0x31C4 is not 0x278 and the bag byte 0x1E is above 10. Called from Party_Member_LearnSkillOrSpell.

functions.name: maybe_Event_UnlockFlag39IfMemberHasId
functions.signature: void maybe_Event_UnlockFlag39IfMemberHasId(void* idSet, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Sets quest/event flag 0x39 to state 1 when it is still unset and party member record 7 carries id 0x1AB in its 60-entry u16 id list at +0x122. The only caller is the script native CheckSkillPanelOpenedQ590.

functions.name: Menu_FindQueuedEntryId
functions.signature: u8 Menu_FindQueuedEntryId(int queue, u32 type, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Scans the pending-entry byte queue and returns the first id whose record matches the requested type (falling back to the record's secondary type field), or 0xFF when none matches.

functions.name: Item_OnAcquired
functions.summary: Post-acquisition hook: walks the pending item list and, for every entry of kind 1 whose record id equals the new item, registers the record with the UI manager (state 8 when already shown, 7 otherwise), optionally adds it to the entry set at +0xA4 and removes the entry from the pending list.

functions.name: maybe_Event_AdvanceFlagState7To8
functions.signature: void maybe_Event_AdvanceFlagState7To8(void* idSet, u32 flagId, int arg3, int context)
functions.summary: State rule: when quest/event flag `flagId` is in state 7, move it to state 8 through Event_UpdateIdSet. Called from Field_InitSceneObjects and maybe_Ui_List_RemoveEntryById.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_InvokeRecordCallback
functions.summary: Looks a record up by id in the lazily created layout table (singleton vtable 0x00782990, lookup 0x0063EFB0), remembers the id in widget+0x6E and calls the record's own function pointer at record+0x60.

functions.name: Ui_CursorIcon_SetSortMark
functions.signature: void Ui_CursorIcon_SetSortMark(UiCursor* self, int mode, u32 label)
functions.summary: Switches the small sort/order cursor between its two icons (layout ids 0x15 and 0xf1) depending on the sort direction and writes the label text next to it.

functions.name: Ui_RowList_DrawPage
functions.summary: Draws one page of a row list: fills the alternating row-index table, clamps the cursor into the visible window, scrolls the list to it and pushes the page record to the parent window.

functions.name: Menu_Senreki_BuildListEntry
functions.signature: void Menu_Senreki_BuildListEntry(MenuSenrekiWindow* self, unsigned int arg2, int* counter)
functions.summary: Builds one entry of the battle-record (senreki) list: bumps the caller's counter, binds the row record s_menu_senreki_record to the pane at self+0x30 via 0x1D85E4, appends the row list node at self+0x9C to the list at self+0x48 (0x1235A4) and points the list tail at self+0xA8.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_CreateItemModelFromRecord
functions.summary: Applies one input event to a window: pops the sub-pane when the event's cancel bit is set and then creates/attaches the item model at self+0x30 from the event's three geometry fields (+0x16/+0x17/+0x18).

functions.name: Container_StringMap_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the string-map container: allocates the header, installs g_stringMapBase, builds the sub-container, links the self-referencing list and fills the twelve 0xFF index slots.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Senreki_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor body of the battle-record window: stores the passed vtable, installs the generic UI vtable 0x00759388 at self+0x118, re-links three intrusive-list sentinel pairs and tears down the sub-object at self+0xC; returns the base at -0x30.

functions.name: Container_StringHashMapInsert
functions.signature: int* Container_StringHashMapInsert(int table, char* key, int value)
functions.summary: Inserts a string key into the engine's string hash map, duplicating the key, growing the bucket array and returning the stored entry.

functions.name: Container_BuildStringMap
functions.signature: u32 Container_BuildStringMap(u32* self, u32 count, int flags)
functions.summary: Builds a string hash map of the requested size, allocating the bucket array and inserting each source string through Container_StringHashMapInsert.

functions.name: Effect_List_DestroyAll
functions.summary: Destroys a tree/map of effect entries: iterates the red-black tree at f_C, frees every 0x10-byte entry body and the tree itself, then releases the still-active effect and clears the active flag.

functions.name: Script_LazyCreateHelperObject
functions.summary: Lazily creates a 0x14-byte helper object owned by self (vtable 0x00780278), stores the value at +0xC and the back-pointer at +0x10, and returns the cached object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RowData_ComputeChangeFlags
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_RowData_ComputeChangeFlags(u8 * out, const void * rowData)
functions.summary: Fills a 3-byte update descriptor for one row record: out[0] = the record's layer/value byte at +0x10, out[2] = 'record +8/+0xC differ from the cached work values at +0x2D418/+0x2D41C and record +0x320 is set', out[1] = 'changed or +0x320 clear'.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopItemList_Restore
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ShopItemList_Restore(UiShopItemList* shop, int context, int arg3, int flags)
functions.summary: Shop item-list step handler: if the page scroll is finished it chains to Ui_ShopItemList_ConfirmEntry with the context flags cleared; otherwise it writes screen command 0x1E, reactivates the screen and returns the default handler pair from 0x007295C0. Its twin 0x001E93E0 is identical except for command 0x1F and the 0x10100 confirm flag.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopItemList_Open
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ShopItemList_Open(UiShopItemList* shop, int context, int arg3, int flags)
functions.summary: Shop item-list step handler: when the page scroll is finished it chains to Ui_ShopItemList_ConfirmEntry with the confirm flag 0x10100 set; otherwise it writes screen command 0x1F, reactivates the screen and returns the default handler pair from 0x007295C0.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_HandleInput
functions.signature: void Ui_ShopItemList_HandleInput(UiShopItemList* shop, int screen, int arg3, u8* flags)
functions.summary: Input handler of the shop item list: drives the row cursor and page, toggles the list mode between 1 and 2, refreshes the quantity/price columns and delegates the confirm to the shop entry handler.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_MoveCursor
functions.summary: Moves the cursor in the shop item list: page-wraps the row cursor (page size 0xB), updates the visible row and scrollbar and, on confirm, hands over to the price/quantity handler.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_SelectQuantity
functions.summary: Quantity spinner handler of the shop item list: forwards the event to the spin control at screen+0x1E08 (vtable +0x3C), stores the control's current quantity in shop[5], shows price*quantity in the number pane via Ui_SetNumberTextPane1, and on the confirm event (0x102) calls Ui_ShopItemList_ConfirmEntry; on cancel it returns the default pair from 0x007295C0.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_BeginBuy
functions.summary: Shop purchase step: on confirm it calls maybe_Shop_BuyItemToBag(itemId, count, price, flags); on success it switches to command 0x1D, refreshes the row list and the item-list mode, and on failure/for the other input it switches to command 0x1E.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopItemList_ConfirmBuy
functions.summary: Confirm step of shop purchase: retrieves selected item row and scroll position from category list (+0x236C or +0x23CC), resolves item, and triggers placement and list refresh.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_OpenList
functions.summary: Opens the shop list: resets the row list, seeds the selection (id 0xFFFF, offset -1, count 1) and stores the first handler pair.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_State_SetState24
functions.summary: State entry of the same state machine as 0x001C0DE4: fills the transition record with invalid defaults, advances the active child of the manager at +0x1E7C, sets state index 0x18 and copies the two-word target out of 0x007295C0+4.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_ConfirmEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_ShopItemList_ConfirmEntry(void* shop, int screen, char* flags)
functions.summary: Confirm handler of the shop list: rejects out-of-stock entries (flag 8), asks Shop_GoldWouldExceedCap when buying, and selects command 0x1A (stock), 0x1B/0x1C (single/multi buy) or 0x27 (gold cap), then copies the new command words into the shop state.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds every pane of the weapon/armour shop window (win_bukiya_*) and links them into the window's pane list.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DeactivateSubPanel
functions.summary: Resets the sub-panel node at +0x1D0, inserts it into the window's list at +0x110 and broadcasts flag 0 (hide/close) to its children.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_UpdateScroll
functions.signature: void Ui_ShopItemList_UpdateScroll(UiItemScreen* self, int mode, int arg3, int context)
functions.summary: Scrolls the shop item list by one page: rebinds the message text from the table, asks the row model for the row count and then calls the up or down page helper pair for the requested mode.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_HideCurrentChild
functions.summary: Hides the window's current child subtree unless it is the embedded pane at self+0x168: it asks 0x001D86CC for the current child and, when that is neither null nor the built-in pane, broadcasts visibility flag 0 to it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ResetListsAndShowPane
functions.summary: Resets the window's list heads (0x001EA614), re-links the two embedded panes at +0x1D0 and +0x1FDF0 into the child ring, hides the first and shows the second.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DetachChildEx
functions.summary: Variant of the detach pair for the shop list pane at self+0x244C: refreshes the pane (0x001EA614), re-links the owner (0x00123594) and broadcasts message 0 to the pane's children.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_ResetListsA
functions.summary: Resets the shop window's item/price lists: unlinks the four intrusive ring heads at +0x22AC/+0x230C/+0x2384/+0x23E4, hides the group at +0x2294, re-links the row pane at +0x244C and broadcasts visibility flag 1 to it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_ResetListsB
functions.summary: Second shop-list reset: re-initialises the four ring heads at +0x22AC/+0x230C/+0x2384/+0x23E4, shows the two result panes at +0x236C/+0x23CC and re-links the row pane at +0x244C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_ResetListPanes
functions.summary: Resets the shop item list before it is opened: re-initialises the list cursor at +0x1E7C, clears the two text layers, re-links the intrusive lists at +0x22AC/+0x230C and the row pane at +0x244C, then applies the item-list mode. Called only from Ui_ShopItemList_OpenList.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_CreateSubObjects
functions.summary: Creates and chains the large sub-object graph of the weapon-shop screen (item list, gold box, sort panel, party rows) and returns the composed object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_DeleteThunk
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor thunk of the shop-window family: calls the complete-object teardown thunk 0x001EB17C (which reaches the D1 body at 0x001EB180) and then frees the object with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_DtorBody
functions.summary: Complete-object (D1) destructor body of the shop window: reinstalls every sub-object table, re-links the list sentinels, tears down the embedded gold window, two-column list, three-row text and item rows, and finishes with the base destructor. The free is done by the thunk at 0x001EB16C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ReleaseAttached
functions.summary: Releases the window's auxiliary object at +0x10: calls Ui_Window_ReleaseResources on it, releases it through 0x0010F6CC (ref-counted release) and clears the pointer.

functions.name: Field_Screen_Recreate
functions.summary: Recreates the field screen object: releases the old 0x6C0-byte instance (Ui_Window_ReleaseResources + free), allocates a new 0x6C0 block from the field heap and constructs it with Ui_FieldScreen_Init.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Small deleting destructor of the shop-window family: installs vtable 0x0075A78C, releases the auxiliary object at +0x10 through Ui_Window_ReleaseResources and frees the window. It is not the full teardown - the complete-object body at 0x001EB180 tears down the gold window, the two-column list and the item rows.

functions.name: Sound_InitPlayers
functions.summary: Initialises the sound system's player/voice slots: allocates the per-voice structures and registers the audio callbacks.

functions.name: Sound_InitSystem
functions.summary: Top-level sound system initializer: calls the player-slot setup and starts the audio thread/callback pump.

functions.name: Sound_CommandQueue_Push_2
functions.signature: u32 Sound_CommandQueue_Push_2(int self, u32 command, int arg3)
functions.summary: Pushes one command into the sound player's 0x40-entry ring buffer at self+0x1848: it records the sequence/key value, optionally starts the sequence through 0x0010E438 with a fade computed from the sample rate, and tags the entry with command 5/4/6/2 plus the id.

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeById
functions.signature: u32 Sound_PlaySeById(SoundSystem* self, u32 seId, int streamId, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Plays a sound effect: reserves a free voice slot, looks the sound up in the sound table, positions/attenuates it in 3D, sets its volume and pan and starts the DSP voice. Returns the new encoded voice handle (0xE0000000 | counter<<12 | slot).

functions.name: Snd_PrepareBgmStream
functions.signature: unsigned char Snd_PrepareBgmStream(SndPlayer* player, unsigned int soundId, unsigned int bankId, unsigned int resourceKey)
functions.summary: Prepares one BGM stream: if a different sound is already prepared it releases it, looks the sound up in the sound table, finds a free stream slot among four and starts the stream on it.

functions.name: Snd_RequestBgmPlay
functions.signature: unsigned char Snd_RequestBgmPlay(SndPlayer* player, unsigned int soundId, float volume)
functions.summary: Queues a BGM play request: records the sound id and volume in the 64-entry request ring, applies the volume to the current stream when one is already prepared, and kicks the player if the ring was empty.

functions.name: Sound_SetTrackGainByHandle
functions.signature: u8 Sound_SetTrackGainByHandle(SoundSystem* self, u32 handle, float gain)
functions.summary: Sets the gain of a sound *track* addressed by its encoded handle: it validates the handle nibble 0xE and its slot, checks that the stored handle still matches, picks the fader through bit 0x10 of the track flags, stores the scaled gain and sends it to the DSP.

functions.name: Sound_InitChannelTable
functions.signature: void Sound_InitChannelTable(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises the 165-entry sound channel table: zeroes the header, then for every id below the work's sequence count fills a 0x24-byte channel record with the sequence pointer, the 16-bit id and the resolved data pointer.

functions.name: Sound_RequestBgmById
functions.signature: void Sound_RequestBgmById(int self, u32 songId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves a BGM song id to its two u16 variants (normal / alternate, selected by self+8) and forwards the request to 0x001ECF70.

functions.name: Snd_StopPendingBgm
functions.summary: Stops the currently pending BGM stream: when one is prepared it releases the stream object, clears the slot and invalidates the pending id.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Voice_IsActive
functions.summary: Queries whether the sound stream/voice referenced behind self+0x38 is currently active by calling its virtual method +0x14.

functions.name: Sound_SetStreamVolumeByHandle
functions.signature: u8 Sound_SetStreamVolumeByHandle(SoundSystem* self, u32 handle, u32 volume, int reset)
functions.summary: Applies a volume to the stream behind a sound voice handle, optionally resetting the stream position first; returns 1 when the handle is valid.

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeFromTableById
functions.signature: void Sound_PlaySeFromTableById(SoundSystem* self, u32 handle, int seId, u32 argument, u32 argument2, u32 argument3)
functions.summary: Resolves a sound id to its category and plays it: for seId 0 it uses category 0x1A (only when the sound system is enabled), otherwise it looks the SE record up through Game_GetDataManager/0x0063EF40 and uses the record's byte at +3; then calls Sound_PlaySeFromTable with the handle and extra arguments.

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeFromTable
functions.signature: u8 Sound_PlaySeFromTable(void* self, u32 handle, int tableIndex, int direction, u32 category, u32 argument)
functions.summary: Table-driven sound-effect player: indexes the 4-byte entry table hanging off the data manager record (GameWork+0x28C, count at record+0x60), rejects out-of-range indexes and entries with no sound id, derives the volume/pan from the direction (self+0x1AB4..0x1AC0) and the category bitmask g_001EC98C, and plays the result through the shared sound player.

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeByChannelRef
functions.signature: void Sound_PlaySeByChannelRef(int self, u32 seId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Plays a sound effect on a reference-counted channel: it maps the SE id to a channel byte, increments that channel's 16-bit reference count and, on the first reference, builds the 'rom:/sound/...' path and starts the SE stream.

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeOnChannel
functions.signature: void Sound_PlaySeOnChannel(int self, int channel, int flush)
functions.summary: Same reference-counted SE start as 0x001EC9A8 but with the channel already resolved; the flush flag additionally commits the sequence (0x005EAEB4).

functions.name: Sound_AllocateVoiceSlot
functions.summary: Allocates a voice slot for a message voice: it maps the voice id, checks the channel refcount, finds the stream object, reserves one of the two slot buffers at self+0x74 and queues the 0xE0000000-tagged playback command with its priority and type flags.

functions.name: Sound_StopSeChannel
functions.signature: u32 Sound_StopSeChannel(int self, u32 seId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Releases one reference on the channel a SE id maps to; when the count reaches zero it clears the six 32-bit 'voice active' masks, flushes the sequence and stops the stream.

functions.name: Sound_StopSeChannelEx
functions.signature: u32 Sound_StopSeChannelEx(int self, u32 channel, int flush)
functions.summary: Channel-explicit variant of 0x001ECD08: decrements the reference count, clears the active-voice masks for that channel and optionally flushes the sequence.

functions.name: Sound_StopVoiceBySeId
functions.signature: void Sound_StopVoiceBySeId(int self, u32 seId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Maps a SE id to its voice entry and releases it through 0x001ED4FC, using the normal/alternate u16 selector at self+8.

functions.name: Sound_Bgm_Request
functions.signature: void Sound_Bgm_Request(SoundBank* self, u32 index, u16 priority)
functions.summary: Requests one BGM/sound entry by index (0..0xa4): increments the entry's use counter, clears its finished flag, resolves the sound group resource and queues the playback.

functions.name: Sound_ReleaseFinishedVoices
functions.summary: Reclaims finished voices: walks the voice-slot bitmask, frees the streams of slots whose voice has ended, clears their bits and updates the per-category counters.

functions.name: Sound_UpdateVoicePosition
functions.signature: void Sound_UpdateVoicePosition(SoundSystem* self, u32 arg2, int mode)
functions.summary: The 3D voice position update: it builds the inverse listener matrix and writes attenuation/pan into the active voice slot.

functions.name: Sound_ReleaseVoiceSlot
functions.summary: Releases one reference on a 0x24-byte voice record; when the last reference goes it stops the underlying SE channel and, if that failed, marks the record with flag 4 and bumps the pending counters.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_InitWaveBlock
functions.summary: Initialises the 0x50-byte sound block at self+0x1AB4: clears the caller's offset word, zero-fills the block and stores the float 1.0 (0x3F800000) as its first word - a default volume/gain of 1.0.

functions.name: Sound_LoadSoundGroup
functions.summary: Builds the sound-group resource name ('sound_usr_%s' or 'sound_usr_%s_bcgrp') for a sound entry and loads that group through the archive system.

functions.name: Snd_SetBgmVolume
functions.signature: unsigned char Snd_SetBgmVolume(SndPlayer* player, int fade, float volume, float fadeTime)
functions.summary: Sets the BGM volume, fading over the requested number of frames: applies the volume to both channel handles through 0x116DA4, remembering the last value so repeated calls are free.

functions.name: Snd_StopVoiceByHandle
functions.summary: Stops the voice behind an encoded handle (releasing its stream) and clears the "3D positioned" flag on the slot.

functions.name: Sound_StopVoicesByCategory
functions.signature: void Sound_StopVoicesByCategory(int self, int category, int arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Stops every voice of one category: forces the selected slot's reference count to 1 and releases it, then walks channels 2..0xA4 and releases the ones whose parameter block says they belong to the other category.

functions.name: Sound_ReleaseVoicesByOwner
functions.signature: void Sound_ReleaseVoicesByOwner(SoundSystem* self, unsigned int ownerId)
functions.summary: Releases every voice slot owned by `ownerId`: walks the four 0x280-byte groups of 0x14-byte voice entries, and for each live entry whose +0x10 equals ownerId clears the entry, clears its bit in the in-use bitmap at self+0x80, decrements the three counters at +0x88/+0x8C and +0xA0(group) and calls 0x11AE20 to compact the slot.

functions.name: Sound_ReleaseFileSlot
functions.signature: void Sound_ReleaseFileSlot(SoundSystem* self, u32 index, u32 arg3, u32 overrides)
functions.summary: Releases an entry of the sound file cache: stops its sequence player, clears the 0x13C-byte slot, clears the occupancy bit and decrements the use counter.

functions.name: Sound_StopHandleWithFade
functions.signature: u32 Sound_StopHandleWithFade(SoundSystem* system, u32 handle, float fadeTime)
functions.summary: Stops a sound by handle: masks the handle with the system's enable byte, scans the 0x40-entry handle table at +0x1848 and, on a match, clears the entry and releases it; if the BGM state byte at +0x1A50 is 6 it moves it to 7 and fades the channel from +0x44 to the given gain through Snd_FadeChannelToGain.

functions.name: Sound_SetVoiceGainByHandle
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SetVoiceGainByHandle(SoundSystem* self, u32 handle, float gain)
functions.summary: Sets the gain of a voice identified by its encoded handle and returns 1 on success; the most-used volume helper for sound effects (25 call sites).

functions.name: Snd_ApplyPendingBgmVolume
functions.signature: unsigned int Snd_ApplyPendingBgmVolume(SndPlayer* player, float volume)
functions.summary: Applies the pending volume to the current BGM channel when the player is in one of the active/paused states, clamps it at zero and records the 'volume applied' state.

functions.name: Sound_System_Teardown
functions.summary: Shuts down the sound system when the 'active' bit (self+4 & 1) is set: releases the effect list at f_1A9C, the 0x14-byte track array at f_7C, the voice at f_78, stops the stream (0x542580 Sound_System_Teardown of N_034), clears the global 0x1EE21C and frees the owned buffer at f_14.

functions.name: Sound_FadeOutSequence
functions.summary: Starts a fade-out on the sequence that is currently in the 'playing' state: schedules the fade length from the soft-float seconds argument and moves the sequence state from 1 to 3.

functions.name: Sound_AllocFileSlot
functions.summary: Allocates a free sound-file slot: finds a clear bit in the inverted occupancy mask at f_1AA4, marks it, bumps the slot counter, calls Sound_SequencePlayer_Init on the 0x13C-byte slot record, stores the encoded handle (0x5E900000 | sequence<<8 | slot) at record+0x14 and returns it.

functions.name: Sound_SetVoicePan
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SetVoicePan(SoundSystem* self, u32 handle, float pan)
functions.summary: Sets the pan of a sound voice: validates that the system is enabled, that the handle is an SE handle (handle>>28 == 0xE) and that the voice slot still matches the handle, then stores the float pan at voice+0xCC.

functions.name: Snd_RequestBgmStop
functions.signature: unsigned char Snd_RequestBgmStop(SndPlayer* player, float fadeTime)
functions.summary: Queues a BGM stop/fade request: starts the fade-out on the current channel (or the secondary one when in state 6), writes a type-3 entry into the player's request ring and kicks the player.

functions.name: Snd_ReleaseBgmChannels
functions.summary: Clears every queued stop request, releases the secondary stream object and fades the secondary channel out, invalidating its id.

functions.name: Snd_SetAllVoiceVolume
functions.signature: void Snd_SetAllVoiceVolume(SndPlayer* player, int onlyAux, float volume)
functions.summary: Applies a volume to every active voice of the player: walks the voice bitmap, filters by the type byte at +0x11 and calls the gain setter (Snd_FadeChannelToGain) on each matching live channel until the player's voice count is exhausted.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_FadeTimer_Get
functions.summary: Returns a BGM fade time window: while a fade is pending it triggers the fade (UI core +0x1C slot, Sound_GetPlayer, 0x001EE018) and returns the short window from 0x72BD64, otherwise the default window from the same global table.

functions.name: maybe_Message_StorePosPairC
functions.signature: void maybe_Message_StorePosPairC(MessageAtom* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: When the view object's virtual +0x24 query succeeds, copies the pair at 0x0072BD64+8/+0xC into the record's first two words.

functions.name: maybe_Message_StorePosPairD
functions.signature: void maybe_Message_StorePosPairD(MessageAtom* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: When the view object's virtual +0x30 query succeeds, copies the pair at 0x0072BD64+0x18/+0x1C into the record's first two words.

functions.name: Sound_RestoreBgm
functions.summary: Restores the background music after a jingle/stream interruption: when the one-shot stream at sound+0x158 has finished it re-enables the UI sound slot, re-requests the default field BGM (id 0x5A) and copies the two-word default result to *out.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_CreateChildWindows
functions.signature: u32* Ui_Screen_CreateChildWindows(u32* out, UiScreen* screen, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates the two window objects attached to a screen (the 0x198-byte simple window and a 0x16c-byte embedded part) and stores them at out[2]/out[3].

functions.name: Gfx_Resource_ReleasePair
functions.summary: Releases the two gfx resources owned by a small holder object and returns the holder.

functions.name: Container_RawBytePush
functions.summary: push_back on a raw byte buffer with no inline storage: appends at the cursor when below the end, otherwise shifts the last byte and calls the grow helper 0x00111378.

functions.name: Ui_MessageArg_SetText
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageArg_SetText(void* msgArg, const void* srcTextObj)
functions.summary: Copies up to 0xFE wide characters from (const wchar_t*)(srcTextObj + 2) (or L"" when srcTextObj == NULL) into msgArg's 0x200-byte wide-string buffer at msgArg + 0x04 and copies srcTextObj->u32_414 (or 0) into msgArg->u32_204.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_SetVisible
functions.summary: Shows or hides a whole widget subtree: sets the visibility bit on the widget, on every child in its list and on the three sibling panes, hiding the last four only when the widget is being hidden.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_BindPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_BindPanes(UiMessageWindow* self, const PaneRefs* refs, void* layout)
functions.summary: Copies the pane reference block into the window, resolves the "win_left" pane and looks up the numbered "name_d%d" panes that make up the speaker-name row.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ApplyNameAnim
functions.summary: Applies the resolved speaker/name string to the name pane through the layout animation and switches the eleven name-row anim entries so that only entry 0 is shown (entries 1..10 are cleared).

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DrawTwoChildNodes
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_DrawTwoChildNodes(void* self, u32 chain, void* cmd, void* entry)
functions.summary: Appends the two child nodes of a widget to a draw list in the right order: draws the +0x38 child first when present, then appends the +0x34 node through 0x0053CD1C, redraws the +0x38 child and restores the saved target byte. Returns immediately when the +0x34 child has its enable bit clear.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_SetFourTexts
functions.summary: Pushes up to four (index, text-object) pairs into the panel's text slots, skipping the slots that have no object.

functions.name: Gfx_PostEffect_ApplySlot50
functions.signature: void Gfx_PostEffect_ApplySlot50(void* node, u32 chain, void* cmd)
functions.summary: When the effect object at node->f_50 exists and its +0x44 enable bit is set, appends it to the render command list through 0x0053CD1C, temporarily exposing the chain word at +4 as the command-list scratch field f_60C.

functions.name: Gfx_PostEffect_ApplySlot3C
functions.signature: void Gfx_PostEffect_ApplySlot3C(void* node, u32 chain, void* cmd)
functions.summary: Same as 0x001F0510 for the effect object at node->f_3C: when its +0x44 enable bit is set it appends the effect through 0x0053CD1C using the f_60C scratch field.

functions.name: Gfx_PostEffect_ApplyFourSlots
functions.signature: void Gfx_PostEffect_ApplyFourSlots(void* node, u32 chain, void* cmd, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Applies up to four effect objects (f_40, f_44, f_48, f_4C) in order, each only when its +0x44 enable bit is set, through the same 0x0053CD1C append and f_60C scratch field.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AnimSlotSet_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a 0x414-byte per-line animation set: seeds five (value, -1) pairs, clears the eleven words at +0x34 (+0x54 for the AnimRefList), constructs the Ui_AnimRefList at +0x54 and eleven 0x50-byte animation entries at +0x6C.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_ReleaseLayoutRefs
functions.summary: Tears down a panel's layout references: destroys the eleven 0x50-byte Ui_LayoutRef entries at +0xA4 and releases the single ref at +0x54, returning the released ref.

functions.name: Ui_StoreActorReferenceInManager
functions.summary: Resolves the current actor reference (Actor_ResolveReferenceObject) and stores it in the shared UI manager's field at +0x214.

functions.name: Message_SetArg
functions.signature: void Message_SetArg(int index, u32 value, int isString)
functions.summary: Stores one message argument: value arguments are written straight into the 0x108-byte slot of the message-argument table, string arguments go through the string-copy helper first.

functions.name: Message_FormatArgSlotPool_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the formatted-message argument-slot pool: installs vtable 0x0075B3BC and default-constructs the sixteen 0x108-byte argument slots immediately after the vtable word. Ui_Core_Init allocates the 0x1084-byte block, and the pool is the object behind the *0x007AC834 slot singleton that Message_FormatArgSlot_Reset clears.

functions.name: Message_FormatArgSlotPool_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the formatted-message argument slot pool: installs vtable 0x0075B3BC, clears the global pool pointer 0x007AC834, destroys the sixteen 0x108-byte slots at +4 and frees the block.

functions.name: Gfx_Resource_Recreate
functions.summary: Recreates a gfx resource after the render device was reset: releases the old texture/buffer, rebuilds the resource for the current device and re-applies the pending upload.

functions.name: Gfx_Resource_SetModeFlags
functions.signature: void Gfx_Resource_SetModeFlags(GfxResource* self, u8 mode, u8 flags)
functions.summary: Stores a resource's mode byte at self+0xC and a global flags byte at block+0x2D546 after lazily creating the shared resource block.

functions.name: Ui_TitleScreen_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the title screen: initialises the logo/text members, loads title_text.bxon and title_msg.bxon, and creates the prompt window.

functions.name: Ui_TitleScreen_Dtor
functions.signature: void* Ui_TitleScreen_Dtor(UiTitleScreen* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor of the title screen: clears the global title pointer, releases the three owned objects and destroys the embedded 3D object.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ResourceHandle_Release
functions.summary: Releases a 3-word handle: when handle[0] is non-null it calls 0x001A6680(handle[0], handle[1], &literal) and then writes -1 into handle[2] to invalidate it.

functions.name: Ui_TitleDemo_Init
functions.summary: Builds the title-screen demo/attract object: three embedded animation nodes and the 0xde4-byte player are constructed, then the whole graph is started.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TitleDemo_SetupPartyUnits
functions.summary: Prepares the party status and battle units for the title demo screen; initialises demo layout and triggers demo BGM.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TitleDemo_StartDemoScene
functions.summary: Starts title demo playback: sets up animation sequence, configures bottom screen rectangle via 0x006262D4, and commits demo BGM.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TitleDemo_ReleaseHandles
functions.summary: Releases UI handles allocated during the title demo scene before returning to title state.

functions.name: Ui_TitleDemo_Update
functions.signature: void Ui_TitleDemo_Update(UiTitleDemo* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Per-frame step of the title demo: starts it on the first frame (Ui_HandleSet_ValidateAndConvert on +0x1C); once the player reports finished it re-initialises the demo (Ui_TitleDemo_Init) and frees the two demo player handles through the UI core, otherwise it releases the three registered user-callback records.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_Ctor
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_Ctor(UiRecipeBook* self, u32 kind, u32 arg3, int argument)
functions.summary: Constructor of the recipe-book object: stores vtable 0x75B3CC, loads the training message tables, builds the recipe-book entries/state and fills the party entries and trailing UI lists.

functions.name: maybe_Message_FormatTextArg
functions.signature: void maybe_Message_FormatTextArg(int text, int arg2, int arg3, int context)
functions.summary: Thumb message-argument formatter: walks the 8-byte argument-table entries (u16 tags at +4/+6, 0xFF terminator) and applies the font/colour variant of the matching tag. This is message text code, not item code.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Sequence_DeleteThunk
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor thunk: calls the sequence destructor Ui_Sequence_Dtor and then the free helper 0x0010F6CC. The real arguments reach the callee in r5/r6, so only the destructor+free shape is certain.

functions.name: Ui_Sequence_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the UI sequence/panel object: runs the confident Ui_Sequence_Dtor and frees the block with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_Sequence_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the wide sequence/panel object: installs the class vtable, releases the two leading members, then unlinks and releases about twenty embedded list and text members in order, and finally tears down the +0x1C member chain.

functions.name: Ui_HandleSet_ValidateAndConvert
functions.summary: Checks that all twelve referenced layout handles are loaded and then converts each one to the resolved object, marking the set as validated.

functions.name: Ui_LoadLayoutByIndex
functions.summary: Loads the layout resource selected by index (0..8; 0x1B is mapped to 8) from the nine ids at self+0x30..+0x50, resolves it through the lazily built 0x98-byte resource table and 0x00124E5C, attaches it (Gfx_ResourceList_Attach) and returns the object's handler word.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Array_DestroyThunk
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Array_DestroyThunk(u32 array, void* elementDtor, u32 arg3, u32 count)
functions.summary: Damaged 24-byte Thumb thunk that tail-calls std_destroy_range with its base pointer and element size taken from the caller-saved registers r5/r6; Ghidra lost both arguments, so only the call target is trustworthy.

functions.name: Script_TriggerEventObject
functions.signature: bool Script_TriggerEventObject(char* name, int id, u32 value)
functions.summary: Looks a named event object up in the script event registry, triggers it with the id/value and returns whether it was found.

functions.name: Script_TriggerEventObjectSlot
functions.signature: u32 Script_TriggerEventObjectSlot(int owner, int slot, int value)
functions.summary: Triggers the script event object registered in a specific slot: resolves the slot through the registry globals, invokes the object's trigger entry and returns the event result.

functions.name: Ui_HandleSet_Init12
functions.summary: Builds the twelve resource handles of a UI layout set (nine row layouts plus three shared parts) by formatting their names and creating each object.

functions.name: maybe_Save_SetMinBytes
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Save_SetMinBytes(u32 index, int value, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Writes a 9-byte persistent block back to work+0x2D385 only when the incoming byte is smaller than the stored one; returns whether it wrote.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_EntryInitThumb
functions.summary: Thumb twin of 0x001F2994: stores the record kind at +0, clears +1 and default-constructs four 9-byte elements at +4 with element ctor 0x00563590; its first two stores are still lost through unaff_r5/unaff_r6.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_EntryInit
functions.summary: Entry initialiser: stores the record kind at +0, clears the flag byte at +1 and default-constructs four 9-byte elements at +4 through 0x00563590.

functions.name: Ui_HandleSet_ClearAll
functions.summary: Releases and invalidates all twelve handles of the set (nine at +4, three at +0x28) by writing the free generation tag, then destroys the two 4-word arrays.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenViewEntry_ResetShort
functions.summary: Short reset of one screen-view collection entry: releases the shared sub-table and clears the collection counter, leaving the rest of the entry (including its child object) untouched.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ScreenViewEntry_Create
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ScreenViewEntry_Create(int owner, int effectId, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Creates screen-view collection entry: builds three-entry 0x10-byte table and links into owner buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PooledRecord_ResetB
functions.summary: Allocates a record from the UI pool via func_001E4B98, clears word at +0xC, and assigns vtable pointer 0x0075B3EC.

functions.name: Script_RegisterSystemObjects
functions.summary: Registers the three built-in script objects: allocates and constructs the 0xB4-byte render-pass object, the 0x88-byte system-string object and the 0x88-byte UI system object, and inserts each into the script hash table.

functions.name: Recipe_CanCraft
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the player owns enough of every material listed by the recipe, 0 otherwise - the 'can I forge this?' test used by the smith/recipe screens.

functions.name: maybe_Save_GetBlockByteEquals3
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Save_GetBlockByteEquals3(u32 index, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Returns whether the persistent byte at work+0x2D385+index equals 3 (the 'fully unlocked/upgraded' recipe state used by the forge screen).

functions.name: maybe_Item_GetStockLevel
functions.signature: void maybe_Item_GetStockLevel(void* result, u32 itemId, int need, void* context)
functions.summary: Compares the required amount of a forge material with three fields of its data-manager record (f_F, f_B and the byte at +7) and writes a 0..3 availability class plus the effective amount into the caller's result record (3 = enough from the first field, 2 = from the second, 1 = only from the byte field, 0 = not enough). Ui_RecipeBook_BuildVariantList uses the classes to build the variant list.

functions.name: maybe_Work_BuildRecordSelector
functions.signature: void maybe_Work_BuildRecordSelector(u8* out, int value, int flags)
functions.summary: Damaged fragment: writes the larger of two limits at out+8 and fills four type bytes (2/0/2) from the flags argument, forcing the 'any' marker when flags is 0; the decompiled body ends in halt_baddata.

functions.name: SaveSlot_GetRecordField10
functions.signature: u32 SaveSlot_GetRecordField10(u32 slot, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the +0x10 field of the save-slot record that the game-data table returns for the slot index; the save-slot window prints it as a number next to the slot.

functions.name: SaveSlot_GetDisplayByte
functions.signature: u8 SaveSlot_GetDisplayByte(int slot, int arg2, int arg3, void* context)
functions.summary: Reads one byte of the per-slot value block at work+0x2D38A for the given save-slot index; the save-slot window prints it as a number in the slot's label.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_RegisterVariant
functions.summary: Registers one of the four variant entries of an item/recipe record with the shared UI registration call: resolves the record through the item table, advances four u16 words per variant index (0..3) and calls func_0035EBB0(work, id, byte, 0).

functions.name: SaveSlot_GetStateByte
functions.signature: u8 SaveSlot_GetStateByte(int slot, int arg2, int arg3, void* context)
functions.summary: Reads the per-slot state byte at work+0x2D385+slot (0xFF = slot unused); IsClearTrainingTrial and the save-slot window both treat 0xFF as no data.

functions.name: Work_GetRecordU16At
functions.signature: u16 Work_GetRecordU16At(u32 id, int index, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns one of the four 16-bit fields of the data-manager record for the given id: index 0/1/2/3 selects byte offsets 0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC.

functions.name: maybe_Save_ClampMinByte
functions.summary: Lowers the byte at (save work+0x88ED)+5+index to value when value is smaller and returns whether it changed; same 11-byte block as maybe_Save_SetMaxByte, written back only when a byte actually changed.

functions.name: Work_GetRecordByteAt
functions.signature: u8 Work_GetRecordByteAt(u32 id, int index, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the byte at +2 of the 4-byte group selected by index (0..3) in the same data-manager record.

functions.name: maybe_Save_SetMaxByte
functions.signature: void maybe_Save_SetMaxByte(int index, u32 value, int update)
functions.summary: Copies the 11-byte save-work block at (work+0x24A98)+0x88ED to the stack, raises the byte at index to value when it is larger (0xFF always writes) and writes the block back. The block is the per-save-slot state block read by SaveSlot_GetStateByte (work+0x2D385+slot) and SaveSlot_GetDisplayByte (+0x2D38A+slot).

functions.name: maybe_Save_TestProgressMask
