functions.signature: u32 maybe_Save_TestProgressMask(u8 mask, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Tests a bit mask against the progress byte at bag+0x88F7; the recipe-book refresh uses masks 1/2/4.

functions.name: Flag_GetGlobal1
functions.summary: Returns whether the global flag byte at work+0x27509 (index 1 of the flag block based at 0x27508) is set.

functions.name: Save_OrBlockBits
functions.summary: ORs a mask into the last byte of the 9-byte persistent block at work+0x2D385 (reads the block, ORs the byte at +0x2D38F, writes it back).

functions.name: SaveSlot_IsUsed
functions.signature: int SaveSlot_IsUsed(int slot, int arg2, int arg3, void* context)
functions.summary: Returns true when the per-slot state byte at work+0x2D385+slot is not 0xFF, i.e. the save slot holds data; the save-slot window uses it to choose between the empty icon and the slot's value label.

functions.name: maybe_Game_GetFlag275A4
functions.summary: Returns whether the byte at GameWork+0x275A4 is non-zero. It gates the recipe-book mode sync/refresh and is also read during party-roster init; what the flag means is still unknown.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateA
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateA(u32 layer, u32 owner, u32 value)
functions.summary: First of two 4-layer ownership tables sharing lock 0x007C8668 (table 0x007C8698): keeps the owned-layer count, stores the owner word for the layer and a second caller-supplied value, ignoring no-op changes.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateB
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateB(u32 layer, u32 owner, u32 value)
functions.summary: Second of the two 4-layer ownership tables sharing lock 0x007C8668 (table 0x007C8674): byte-identical to copy A, keeps the owned-layer count and stores the owner word and caller-supplied value for layer 0..3.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateC
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateC(u32 layer, u32 owner, u32 value)
functions.summary: Updates one slot of a 4-layer ownership table: under lock 0x007C865C, when the slot's owner word changes to/from 0 it adjusts the global owned-layer count, then stores the owner word and the caller-supplied value for layer 0..3. Copy C shares its lock with copy D.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateD
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateD(u32 layer, u32 owner, u32 value)
functions.summary: Fourth copy of the 4-layer ownership-table update (table 0x007C86BC, lock 0x007C865C): adjusts the owned-layer count when the owner word changes to/from 0, then stores the owner and the caller-supplied value for the given layer.

functions.name: Sound_RefreshPendingBgmVolume
functions.summary: Re-applies the pending BGM volume when it changes: reads the sound singleton (0x006F1DF8), picks field +0x58 or +0x64 depending on flag bit 2, clamps values >= 0x9E to 0xFF, compares with the cached key state[4] and calls Snd_ApplyPendingBgmVolume when they differ.

functions.name: Snd_StopPausedBgm
functions.summary: Stops the BGM stream that was paused for a menu/loading screen: fetches the active player through 0x6F1DF8 and calls Snd_StopPendingBgm on it.

functions.name: Snd_RequestEncounterSound
functions.summary: Selects and requests the sound for an encounter/battle: looks the battle id up in two game tables (0x0063CC1C then 0x0063D9BC), and only when the resulting id differs from the one the sound player is currently using does it stop the old sound (0x001EE220) and request the new one (0x001EC1D0). The id is a small table value (< 0x9E) and is played back through the sound player's request queue, so this is the battle BGM / monster battle sound selection, not a script-level call.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_ApplyCategoryBgmState
functions.signature: void maybe_Sound_ApplyCategoryBgmState(u32 arg1, u32 category, int soundId)
functions.summary: Routes a sound by category: looks the id up in the sound table (func_0063F1E0), finds the 2-byte {category, mode} row and applies the mode - 1 stops the pending BGM (Snd_StopPendingBgm + 0x001EE220), 2 does nothing, anything else applies the pending volume through 0x001EE018; categories 3/4 default to mode 2 when no row matches.

functions.name: Snd_CommitPendingBgmId
functions.summary: Commits a queued BGM id: compares it with the current and pending stream ids, chooses between 'request play' and 'request stop', then clears the pending flags.

functions.name: Sound_ResolveFieldBgmId
functions.signature: void Sound_ResolveFieldBgmId(BgmState* state, const BgmRecord* record)
functions.summary: Resolves the background-music track for a map/scene record: picks the day/night or field variant from the record's bytes, honours the player's music setting and stores the chosen track id in the state.

functions.name: Snd_ApplyEncounterSound
functions.signature: void Snd_ApplyEncounterSound(SoundPlayer* snd, u32 battleId, int force)
functions.summary: Applies the sound of an encounter: looks the battle record up (0x63F1E0), compares its sound/BGM id (f_33) with the player's current id and, when they differ (or when force is set and the record's f_3A/f_39 flags allow it), stops the current effect and calls Snd_RequestBgmPlay with the record's id.

functions.name: Snd_ResolveSceneBgmId
functions.signature: void Snd_ResolveSceneBgmId(SndBgmRequest* request, unsigned short* sceneInfo)
functions.summary: Resolves which BGM should play for a scene: looks the scene/field id up in the sound tables, walks the per-zone entries and their story/time-of-day conditions, and stores the first matching sound id (or 0 = silence) into the request.

functions.name: Snd_PlayBgmById
functions.signature: void Snd_PlayBgmById(SndBgmRequest* request, unsigned int soundId)
functions.summary: Starts a BGM id directly: if it differs from the playing and pending ids it requests the play (or resumes the pending stream when it matches), then clears the pending flag.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ResetPair
functions.summary: When the ownership check 0x00630B04(self, self+0x980) succeeds, resets the two child widgets at +0x930 and +0x8E0 (stop the shake tween, set the frame, snap the value).

functions.name: Ui_BalloonWindow_BindLayout
functions.summary: Loads the "hud_balloon" layout into the balloon window's sub-widget slot and enters the sub-widget, so the balloon can be shown.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Scene_Dtor
functions.summary: Teardown of a UI object that owns several child lists: checks the two state flags, releases the render node through its virtual +0x2C, destroys the sub-lists at +0x8E0/+0x930, empties the two pools at +0x138 and refreshes the overlay billboard.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Balloon_SetAnchorVectors
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Balloon_SetAnchorVectors(UiBalloon* self, float* from, float* to, u32 slotId)
functions.summary: Validates balloon slot via func_00630B04 and passes from/to 3D coordinate vectors to func_001CA02C on self+0x138.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Balloon_BindActorHandle
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Balloon_BindActorHandle(UiBalloon* self, u8 slot, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, * u32* handle)
functions.summary: Stores the slot index in self+0x839 and sets self+0x838=1 when the passed handle resolves in the field object registry, then tail-calls 0x00100B74 with arg3.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindowCtor_vt1F4358
functions.summary: The composite-window constructor for vtable 0x1F4358: it allocates, builds two intrusive lists, chains the panel ctor and two AnimRefLists and returns the outer pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DtorChain
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a widget with a long relative member chain: releases two panes, an object array and the list heads, and returns the enclosing pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Balloon_GetSeIdForSlot
functions.summary: Retrieves balloon sub-object for specified slot via virtual method +0x60 and maps its +0x110 attribute using func_005F5818; returns 0 if slot is empty.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Balloon_GetSeIdForLeader
functions.summary: Specialized version of 0x001F43E0 querying slot 0 (leader) via virtual method +0x60 and returning mapped attribute from func_005F5818.

functions.name: Ui_Balloon_SpawnAtAnchor
functions.signature: void Ui_Balloon_SpawnAtAnchor(UiBalloonUi* ui, int type, BalloonTarget* target, int count, u32 flag, float delay)
functions.summary: Shows a balloon over an actor: computes the anchor's clamped screen position, picks the balloon sprite/frame for the requested type and hands it to the balloon manager together with the count and delay.

functions.name: Ui_Balloon_SpawnByCount
functions.signature: void Ui_Balloon_SpawnByCount(UiBalloonUi* ui, int count, u32 arg3, BalloonTarget* target, u32 flag, u32 delay)
functions.summary: Shows a balloon for a count: plain balloon for zero/negative counts, otherwise the counted variant with the type chosen from the target's flag.

functions.name: Ui_Balloon_SpawnForMember
functions.signature: void Ui_Balloon_SpawnForMember(UiBalloonUi* ui, int count, PartyMember* member, int skipFlag, u32 seId, u32 delay, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Shows a balloon over one party member, inserts the bookkeeping entry into the balloon list and plays the matching sound effect.

functions.name: Ui_Balloon_UpdateForMember
functions.signature: void Ui_Balloon_UpdateForMember(UiBalloonUi* ui, u32 count, PartyMember* member)
functions.summary: Refreshes the balloon over a party member: either updates the plain balloon or re-runs the counted balloon, stopping the member's effect when it is not active.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_Update
functions.summary: Large per-frame update of the battle UI: consumes the queued input state, tests the 16 party/target slots through the ui::State predicates, resolves the acting member (func_0035EB98) and the current RNG roll, and dispatches to the slot reset/select, balloon and target-list helpers of the battle UI module. Returns the UI's done flag.

functions.name: Battle_IsActionQueueIdle
functions.summary: True while the battle has nothing to do: if no actor is running an action (battle work+0x4320 empty) it returns true, otherwise it defers to Actor_IsIdleAndQueueEmpty on the current actor.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_StartBalloonForMember
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Ui_StartBalloonForMember(u32 ui, s16* textId, int argument, PartyMember* member, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Starts a balloon/message on a party member, applies the member state and (for the item state 0x74) the item effect, then refreshes the balloon list entry.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnSoundBalloon
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_SpawnSoundBalloon(BattleBalloonUi* ui, int count, PartyMember* member, u32 delay, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Plays SE 0x12B and, unless the UI busy flag is set, resets the member's displayed value with the count; when delay is zero it then shows the type-9 balloon at the member's anchor.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_LayoutBalloons
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_LayoutBalloons(float* outPos, PartyMember* member, int arg3, int flag)
functions.summary: Computes where a member's balloons go: counts the member's active slots, averages their anchor positions (single slot: use the anchor itself), lerps the result toward the camera focus and writes the 3-float position, returning it to the caller.

functions.name: Model_GetAttachmentWorldPosition
functions.signature: void Model_GetAttachmentWorldPosition(float * out, u32 arg2, int attachment, u32 arg4, u32 partId)
functions.summary: Computes the world position of a model attachment point: it resolves the attachment's node record, looks the node up by name in the model, reads its local transform, rotates the offset by the model's orientation and adds the model position.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_HideMemberBalloons
functions.summary: Clears the balloon flag on every visible member slot (unless the UI is in hidden mode) so the balloons disappear for this frame.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_UpdateMemberBalloons
functions.summary: Updates one battle member's balloon row: takes the id pair from the object's own vtable (+0x48 and +0x60), resolves it with 0x00632760(world+0x5C,...), then compares it against the four actor lists (world+0x5C+0x4298) and the monster/actor tables (0x0063FD24, 0x0063E5C8), storing the mode byte at self+0x494.

functions.name: Battle_QueueBattleMessage
functions.signature: void Battle_QueueBattleMessage(void* self, u32 msgId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructs and enqueues a battle dialogue message with parameters into the battle message queue.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_SpawnBalloonTypeC
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_SpawnBalloonTypeC(BattleBalloonUi* ui, u32 count, PartyMember* member, int skipFlag, u32 delay, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Resets the member's displayed value, appends a type-5 bookkeeping record for (member, count) to the balloon list at ui+0xBC, plays SE 0x1E and, unless skipFlag is set, shows the type-0xC balloon at the member's anchor. The old 'Cancel' label was an unverified reading of balloon type 0xC.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_ResetBalloonSlots
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_ResetBalloonSlots(void* self, const u8* spec, const int* ids, int count)
functions.summary: Clears the 16 dword balloon slots at self+0x70..0xAC and refills them with the non-null unit ids; when spec[3] asks for two or more rows it first copies the ids into a 0x68-byte temporary and picks them through the battle RNG 0x001CA474(world+0x4218, 0, n-1).

functions.name: Battle_Ui_GetBalloonAnchor
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_GetBalloonAnchor(float* out, PartyMember* member, int slot, int flag, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Computes the world position a battle balloon should float above: takes the member's record (virtual +0x40) or the module default, uses the member's f_9C/f_A4 base position and offsets it per balloon slot, then converts it with the shared 3D-to-screen transform helpers.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_UpdateFinishedBalloons
functions.summary: Walks the balloon UI's 32 effect entries and, for the finished ones, plays the completion sound (0x1A/0x1B) through the balloon helper depending on the entry state.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_CanSelectBalloonSlots
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Ui_CanSelectBalloonSlots(void* self, const char* spec, void* slotList, void* units, int unitCount)
functions.summary: Validates the current balloon selection: counts the 16 occupied slots at +0x1C and walks them, rejecting candidates whose slot/row test fails or whose unit does not report battle state 8/10; returns 1 when the request is acceptable, 0 otherwise. It never writes a selection.

functions.name: Actor_EnsureActionState
functions.signature: u32 Actor_EnsureActionState(Actor* actor, u32 arg2, int actionId)
functions.summary: Makes sure an actor is playing the wanted action: returns 1 when it already is, otherwise starts that action and returns the result.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_StartBalloonForSlot
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Ui_StartBalloonForSlot(BattleBalloonUi* self, s16* textId, u32 slot, u32 argument, int argument2)
functions.summary: Starts a balloon on the member in the given slot: resolves the member, applies the text, updates the balloon list and handles the state-0x79 (item) case.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_DismissLeaderBalloon
functions.summary: Dismisses leader balloon: retrieves slot 0 via virtual +0x48, sets completed flag +0x108 = 1, clears active flag +0xB0F9, and increments instance counter.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Balloon_GetSeIdForMemberSlot
functions.summary: Retrieves party member balloon using func_001F9B58(self, slot, 0) and resolves attribute word +0x110 with func_005F5818; returns 0 if absent.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Balloon_GetSeIdForEvent
functions.summary: Retrieves event balloon through virtual method +0x4C and maps attribute +0x110 via func_005F5818; returns 0 if absent.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_PlayMemberSound
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_PlayMemberSound(void* self, int state, PartyMember* member, u32 seId, int argument)
functions.summary: Plays the sound that belongs to a party member's battle state: maps the state codes (-1, 0, -3, -4, -5, -9, -0xB, -0x11, -0x19, -0x1A) to a small set of SE ids (0x129, 0x12A, 0x158 ...) and plays them, with a separate branch when the battle flag at work+0x4244 is set.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloon
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloon(u32 owner, int textId, BattleUnit* member, int useAnchor)
functions.summary: Spawns the balloon effect for one member: remaps the text id to 0x46B when the member is in the item state (0x79), computes the anchor from the member model node and creates the 2-D effect instance through Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloonEx
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloonEx(BattleBalloonUi* self, int textId, int member, int* out)
functions.summary: Variant of 0x001F7E10 that walks all sixteen member slots, averages/uses their anchor positions and spawns the balloon effect for each valid member when the battle work's +0x4244 flag is set.

functions.name: Battle_QueueAction
functions.signature: void Battle_QueueAction(BattleUnit* actor, u32 actionRef, u32 actionId)
functions.summary: Queues a battle action for a unit: builds the action record (with the unit's slot and instance counter) and inserts it into the battle action list.

functions.name: Battle_QueueActionEx
functions.summary: Queues a fully populated battle action record for a unit (the variant used by skills/items that need the whole parameter block).

functions.name: Battle_Ui_ResetBalloonSlotsEx
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_ResetBalloonSlotsEx(void* self, const u8* spec, int first, int idsBase, int count)
functions.summary: Same 16-slot wipe as 0x001F6D64, then filters the unit ids: a negative 'first' picks one id through the battle RNG, otherwise only entries whose virtual +0xD4 equals 'first' (or the random pick) are kept before the slots are filled.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_GetMemberAnchor
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_GetMemberAnchor(u32* out, PartyMember* member, int mode, u32 arg4, u32 member2)
functions.summary: Returns the on-screen anchor of a member's balloon: mode 0 delegates to 0x001FA480, modes 1/2 take the cached offsets at member+0x37/+0x40, and the point is converted to screen space with the shared transform helpers.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_FindTargetSlot
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_FindTargetSlot(BattleBalloonUi* self, const u8* filter, int* outSlot, int argument, int* outObj, int argument2)
functions.summary: Scans the battle unit list at battlework+0x4260 for the first entry that matches the filter record (bytes +1/+2) and whose virtual queries pass, then returns the entry and its slot index through the out pointers.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_GetFirstRowParam
functions.summary: Retrieves row 0 via virtual row accessor +0x48 and returns its attribute word at +0x110.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_StartBalloonForAll
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Ui_StartBalloonForAll(BattleBalloonUi* self, s16* textId, int slot, u32 argument)
functions.summary: Starts a balloon on every member (or one member when a slot is given) and refreshes the balloon list entry for each of them.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CollectModelChildren
functions.summary: Walks the container's slots through vtable +0x48 and registers every idle child that has a live model (f_10 == 0 and func_00279C14 != 0) with the model list at self[0x48B]+0x35C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_GetFirstRowKind
functions.summary: Returns kind byte +0x10 of row 0 retrieved through virtual method +0x48, or 0 if row is missing.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_PlaySeForEvent
functions.summary: Plays the sound for a battle UI event: events -4/-0x19 play the id 0x12A+7, events -5/-0x1A play the same id but return whether it actually started, and every other event plays 0x12A; when the battle flag work+0x4244 is set some events are suppressed.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_MarkRowsFlag
functions.summary: Marks UI screen dirty (self+0xD2 = 1) and sets flag byte +0x108 = 1 on all rows returned by virtual method +0x48 up to count from func_00630DC8.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_SpawnBalloonTypeCForSlot
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_SpawnBalloonTypeCForSlot(BattleBalloonUi* self, u32 count, u32 slot, int skipFlag, u32 delay, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Slot-indexed twin of 0x001F6CAC: resolves the member through vtable +0x48(self, slot), resets its displayed value, queues the type-5 record, plays SE 0x1E only when the member's f_10 flag is set, and spawns the same type-0xC balloon at its anchor.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Balloon_InterpolateAnchor
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Balloon_InterpolateAnchor(void* self, int mode, int flag, u32 argument)
functions.summary: Resolves the balloon target object through virtual +0x40, chooses an anchor source by mode (mode 0 asks virtual +0x74, modes 1/2 use the cached float pairs at +0xDC/+0x100) and interpolates the three floats into the target's +0x9C/+0xA0/+0xA4 using the alpha in s0 (shown as in_s0).

functions.name: Battle_ActionModel_AnyUnitMarkerPending
functions.signature: u32 Battle_ActionModel_AnyUnitMarkerPending(ActionModel* model, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Returns 1 as soon as one of the sixteen action slots still holds a unit whose marker flag is set (byte at unit+0x5E0+index) and whose action record (func_0063E05C row) is not flagged done (f_45 == 0); the battle UI uses it to decide whether it may advance.

functions.name: maybe_PartyGroup_GetSlotActor
functions.summary: Virtual accessor (the derived class's override: it starts by calling the base class's own vtable+0x60 slot) that returns the actor/balloon object for member `slot`: it prefers the slot-0 object's group (same f_10) and rejects states 8/10, then falls back to self[slot+4] (cleared when its state queries fail) and finally to self[slot+0x1C] through the linked-object helper; 0 when slot > 0xF.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_GetOrCreateBalloon
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_Ui_GetOrCreateBalloon(BattleBalloonUi* self, int slot, u8* outFlag)
functions.summary: Retrieves active balloon for slot verifying virtual methods +0xD8, +0x10, and +0x14, or instantiates a new instance via BattleUnit_GetLinkedModelByIndex (0x00277D28).

functions.name: Model_GetAttachmentPositionByIndex
functions.signature: void Model_GetAttachmentPositionByIndex(float * out, u32 arg2, int model)
functions.summary: Companion of 0x001F624C: reads the attachment node selected by the model's f_A0 index, applies the 3x4 matrix at 0x001F9D2C and adds the model position to produce the attachment's world position.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_SetupChildModelVariants
functions.summary: Template twin of 0x001F94C4: sweeps the container's slots and, for every idle child with a live model, calls BattleScene_SetupUnitModelVariant(list at self[0x48B]+0x35C, child, variant).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_GetActorStateId
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_Ui_GetActorStateId(void* balloonUi, u32 slotIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 0x00669250(...) when the battle 3D-mode byte (work+0x5C+0x4244) is 1 and the self vtable+0x40 slot yields a non-null sub-object, otherwise the 'none' sentinel 0xFF.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_CalcPartyModelCenter
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_CalcPartyModelCenter(float* out, void* party, u32 attachment, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Counts the non-null members of the 16-slot party model array, gets each model's attachment world position (or the slot actor through maybe_PartyGroup_GetSlotActor) and writes the centre of the resulting bounds to *out.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_GetMemberAnchorScreen
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_GetMemberAnchorScreen(BattleBalloonUi* self, char* anchor, int flag, u32 argument)
functions.summary: Converts a member/slot anchor record into a screen-space position for battle balloons, handling the three anchor modes of this module through the widget virtuals.

functions.name: Model_MirrorPositionFromTarget
functions.summary: Positions one model relative to another: it takes the position delta between two model objects and, depending on the target's flags, applies it negated (with an optional y override) after normalising through 0x005736A0 and 0x005F5F54.

functions.name: Model_SetDirectionToTarget
functions.summary: Turns a model to face a reference point: computes the delta from the virtual +0x3C object position to the model position, normalises it with 0x005736A0 and applies it with 0x005F5F54 using the y constant 0x001FA47C.

functions.name: Battle_OrientActorAndGetGroupMidpoint
functions.summary: Computes the 3D midpoint/direction across the active opposing units in the action sequence's 16 unit slots (+0x70), orients the acting unit model through Gfx_EffectPart_SetDirection and writes the resulting world position to outPosVec3. Used by the battle actor action, name popup and member-anchor code.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SpawnEventBalloon
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_SpawnEventBalloon(void* self, int* event, int argument, u32 argument2)
functions.summary: Spawns the balloon that belongs to a UI/field event record: picks the balloon type from the event id through the 0x7B-offset table and finally queues it with Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnFromTable.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_CancelBalloon
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_CancelBalloon(BattleBalloonUi* self, int mode, int when)
functions.summary: Cancels a battle balloon: notifies the balloon element through vtable+0x3C and, when it is not in 'counted' mode and still active (vtable+0x68), clears it with vtable+0x5C(0).

functions.name: Battle_GetUnitModelSizeIf3D
functions.signature: float Battle_GetUnitModelSizeIf3D(const void* self, int unitModelId)
functions.summary: When BattleScene ((work+8)->f_5C) is in 3D mode (u8_4244 == 1), delegates to BattleScene_CalcUnitModelSize(self->f_122C, unitModelId) (0x00607650) and returns the unit model scale in VFP s0; otherwise returns 0.0f.

functions.name: maybe_BattleParty_ApplyMemberStateFlags
functions.signature: void maybe_BattleParty_ApplyMemberStateFlags(void* group, void* paramTable, void* actor, int playerLane)
functions.summary: For a living actor, walks the 28 per-slot flags of the parameter table (+0x1A + j*2 + lane) and applies the matching behaviour: attachment show/hide at j=0/1, queue action 0x1C and register the actor in the group's 32 slots at j=6, and set states 0x29/0x15 at j=0x11/0x12.

functions.name: FieldParty_CalcGroupCenterPosition
functions.summary: Computes the point the camera/leader should look at for a group of party actors: the single member's position when only one is active, otherwise the bounding-box centre of the members, converted to world space and adjusted by the leader's height.

functions.name: Battle_SyncLinkedActorsState76
functions.summary: Iterates active units in the action sequence's 16 battle slots (+0x70) carrying battle state 0x76 or 0x11B while otherActor->u16_B18C == 0x76, clears u16_B18C to 0xFFFF, syncs the HP percentage, resets the idle animation and calls vt[+0x98](actor, 1.0f, 0.1f).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_CheckRowsReady
functions.summary: Iterates over all rows via vtable +0x48: for each visible row (f_10 == 0) with a model (func_00279C14), checks func_00604424; returns 0 if any check fails, 1 if all pass.

functions.name: FieldParty_CalcGroupBoundsCenter
functions.summary: Computes the axis-aligned centre of the positions of all members of a party group (min/max of the actor X and Z fields scaled by a constant blend factor).

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_PlayMemberItemSe
functions.signature: int maybe_FieldParty_PlayMemberItemSe(void* group, void* actor, int slot)
functions.summary: Plays a sound id for a party member: resolves the member from the actor's character id, reads the equipped item of the given hand (func_006292F0), and plays the SE stored in that item's data row (f_be); when no item is equipped it falls back to the monster/character row's f_aa sound.

functions.name: FieldParty_UpdateStateMachine
functions.summary: Large state machine that advances a party-group sequence (waiting for menu/field mode flags, spawning member join/leave effects) one state per call and returns whether the sequence finished.

functions.name: Model_SyncRotationToAttachment
functions.summary: Copies the rotation of the model's attachment onto the object and re-aims it: when the model's type tag is 0x76 (or the alternate global tag) and the cached tag differs, it shares the rotation triple at +0x9C and applies the normalised direction.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Row_AttachPairedSlots
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Row_AttachPairedSlots(void* self, void* actorA, void* actorB, const void* params, float scale)
functions.summary: Attaches the paired slot/icon graphics of a message or battle row: reads the short ids and flags from the row descriptor, attaches the pair through func_00398744/func_0039881C, adds the FieldParty attachment slots and, in 3D mode, plays the 0x42 animation once.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_GetSlotField110
functions.summary: Returns the +0x110 word of the slot object selected by the caller's index: 0x001F9B58 is a bounds-checked 16-slot getter (cmp r1,#0x10 / movhs r0,#0 / bxhs lr, array at self+0x10) that also runs three virtual checks on the slot. The 4-byte thunk at 0x001FC7E8 only zeroes the third argument.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_ApplySlotAndLayoutBalloons
functions.signature: void maybe_FieldParty_ApplySlotAndLayoutBalloons(PartyGroup* group, int mode, int target, int slot)
functions.summary: Applies a formation slot through the group's virtual +0x40, resets the +0x54 state when mode is 0, and when the group has more than one live member (16-slot array at +0x1C) re-runs Battle_Ui_LayoutBalloons for the group. Used both by battle formation setup and the field talk update.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_CheckMemberSelectable
functions.signature: int maybe_Menu_CheckMemberSelectable(void* partyGroup, int slotIndex, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Veto predicate used by the field-party member action: returns 0 only when the battle 3D-mode byte is 1, the group's vtable+0x40 slot is non-null and 0x0066A2BC() == 0; otherwise 1.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_BuildMemberIdRecord
functions.signature: void maybe_FieldParty_BuildMemberIdRecord(void* group, u32 flags, int extra)
functions.summary: Builds the party group's 9-word member-id record (flag word plus up to eight slot ids) from the 16 live slots at group+0x1C, clears the f_79 flag of the actors found in the four battle unit lists at +0x428C, and submits the record through the group's virtual +0x60.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_BuildMemberIdRecordAlt
functions.signature: void maybe_FieldParty_BuildMemberIdRecordAlt(void* group, u32 flags, int slot)
functions.summary: Second form of the member-id record builder: same 16-slot scan and record layout, but the per-slot id comes from group virtual +0x4C(group, slot) and the record is pushed through the global window object at 0x001FCE08.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SpawnActorNamePopup
functions.summary: Resolves the acting unit through self->vt[+0x48](self,0), reads the message id from row 0x85 of the message table (0x0063E05C(*Game_GetDataManager(), 0x85), field +0x4E) and queues a battle message popup anchored to that unit via Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnFromTable(self->f_122C + 0xBC, &desc, 1).

functions.name: maybe_Actor_QueueEquipmentMessage
functions.signature: void maybe_Actor_QueueEquipmentMessage(void* owner, int slot, void* actor)
functions.summary: Asks the actor's equipment interface for the piece in a slot, maps it to a message id through Ui_LookupMapValueById and enqueues a battle-style message entry for the actor. The only caller, maybe_FieldParty_ApplyAttachmentSet, passes the three attachment slots 0x20/0x21/0x22, so it is the field party's equipment-message queueing path, not a battle-only one.

functions.name: FieldParty_AddAttachmentSlot
functions.signature: int FieldParty_AddAttachmentSlot(PartyGroup* group, int owner, Actor* actor, void* arg4, short duration, int type)
functions.summary: Adds an attachment record for an actor to the group's 32-entry attachment table: if the actor is already present its remaining time is extended, otherwise a new 0x7c-byte entry is created and the parameter block copied.

functions.name: Battle_Message_PushActorTypeMessage
functions.summary: Pushes a battle message for the actor obtained through group vtable+0x48: message 0x7C when the actor accepts text type 8, otherwise 0x82 when it accepts type 10, else no message.

functions.name: maybe_Model_SyncAttachmentPose
functions.summary: Per-frame attachment/pose sync for a party/actor group: if the candidate model's type is 0x76 or 0x11B and it is present in the group's slot array (+0x1C..), it runs func_001FC370; if the model is type 0x79 it runs Model_SetDirectionToTarget. Called from every field/battle update loop.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_ApplyAttachmentSet
functions.signature: void maybe_FieldParty_ApplyAttachmentSet(PartyGroup* group, void* paramTable, Actor* actor, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Applies attachment flags from parameter table across party member actor model instances in the field.

functions.name: FieldParty_MoveActorTowardTarget
functions.signature: void FieldParty_MoveActorTowardTarget(PartyGroup* group, int mode, int useSlot, int slot)
functions.summary: Moves the selected member actor a step (in_s0) toward a target point chosen from the group centre, a formation offset or a stored offset, then marks the actor's position dirty.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_PlayMemberVoiceId
functions.signature: unsigned maybe_FieldParty_PlayMemberVoiceId(void* work, Actor* actor, void* arg3, int force)
functions.summary: Chooses and plays a sound id for an actor from its category code: -0x13/-0x14 play 0x15C, -4/-0x19 play 0x131, -5/-0x1A play 0x132, -0x12 is silent and other values play 0x129/0x12A depending on whether the actor is a party member; positive categories also branch on param byte +0x26 and force.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_SelectMemberVoiceById
functions.signature: void maybe_FieldParty_SelectMemberVoiceById(unsigned arg1, Actor* actor, void* arg3, int force)
functions.summary: Second variant of the member sound selector: chooses 0x15C/0x15A/0x15D for the character categories and, when not forced, reads the sound id from the character record (u16 at +200) fetched by the actor's character id; always ends by playing the chosen id.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_PlayCommonSe
functions.summary: Three-instruction sound request: gets the shared sound player and plays SE 300 with no arguments.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_PlayStateSe
functions.signature: void maybe_FieldParty_PlayStateSe(int* self, int model, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Plays a one-shot SE/voice for a model that entered state 0x76 or 0x11B, using the 32-entry bookkeeping table at self+0xB1 (stride 0x1F: model, count, already-played byte) so each model plays once; the SE id comes from the record's +0x5A or defaults to 0xA0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_ApplyRowCondition
functions.summary: Iterates over all rows via vtable +0x48: for each visible row (f_10 == 0) with an active model, invokes func_00604B14(self[0x48B], row, arg2).

functions.name: maybe_Menu_CheckActorActionable
functions.signature: int maybe_Menu_CheckActorActionable(void* partyGroup, int slotIndex, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Veto predicate: returns 0 when the battle 3D-mode byte is 1, the group's vtable+0x40 slot is non-null and 0x00669324() != 0xFF; otherwise 1.

functions.name: Battle_QueueActionMessage
functions.signature: void Battle_QueueActionMessage(void* self, u32 actionId, u32 targetId)
functions.summary: Enqueues an action/skill execution announcement into the battle message queue.

functions.name: Battle_QueueUnitMessageIfStatusChanged
functions.signature: void Battle_QueueUnitMessageIfStatusChanged(void* self, void* unit, u32 statusId)
functions.summary: Checks if a unit status changed and enqueues a notification message into the battle message queue.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ResetUnitModelSlotStates
functions.summary: Battle-wide reset pass: walks the battle party list (+0x4260) and the four lists at battle+i*0x1C+0x4298, and for every unit that is still present sets model slot states 0x75/0x76/0x77/0x11B and clears the two dwords at unit+0x237/+0x238.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_AdvanceMemberCursor
functions.summary: Shared base-class step: counts the 16 active slot pointers at self+0x1C, and in state 0x144B walks the slot cursor at self+0x490, waiting on each slot's vt[+0x14]/vt[+0x10] and spawning an event balloon per slot; returns 1 once every slot is done and resets the cursor.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SelectSlotByRecordId
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SelectSlotByRecordId(void* self, u32 recordKey, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Shared screen method: scans up to 0x55F rows from the data-manager lookup 0x0063FD24 for the first row whose +0x147 word equals the given key and selects that index (or 0xFFFF) through the screen's virtual slot +0xD8.

functions.name: maybe_Item_ApplySpecialModelParams
functions.summary: Sets up the 3D model that represents an item record in a menu: for one group of ids (2, 0x76, 0x11B, 0x79, 0xC2, 0xF6, 0x75) it resolves the display actor stored at itemRecord+0x110, then copies the shared layout row 0 via the pane virtuals +0xA4 (with 5) and +0xA0 (3-float vector from row+0x18..0x20); for the other record kind it only re-triggers the actor when ids 0x79/0x7A/0x13 are involved and the field-preview flag work+0x27C57 is set. The first guess described it as a boolean 'has any of these ids' but the function returns nothing and its job is to push model/layout parameters.

functions.name: FieldParty_CalcFormationPosition
functions.signature: void FieldParty_CalcFormationPosition(void* group, int mode, int useSlot, int slot)
functions.summary: Builds a formation transform for one party-group member: takes the member's position, rotates it by the group matrix, then offsets it by the group centre (computed from the active member count) or by the stored offset vector selected by mode.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_UpdateSlotTypeFlags
functions.summary: For each of up to 8 members and each of the 7 attachment slots, stores whether the member accepts the slot's type id (0x00630CDC lookup + type test) into the 8x7 flag table at (base+0x1F2), and marks the slot used through vtable+0x120; the base register (group+0x400) is lost, so the absolute offsets are approximate.

functions.name: FieldParty_CalcMemberWorldPosition
functions.signature: void FieldParty_CalcMemberWorldPosition(PartyGroup* group, int mode, int slot)
functions.summary: Computes a member's world position: takes the member transform, applies the group origin offsets (0x574044) and adds the mode-specific offset vector (0x574224).

functions.name: FieldParty_ClearSlotTypeFlags
functions.summary: Clears every set attachment-slot flag of the party group: for each member slot it walks the seven u16 ids at group+0x1E4 and, for each set flag byte at group+0x1F2, disables that attachment on the member (virtual +0xE4) and clears the byte.

functions.name: FieldParty_InitFromParams
functions.summary: Initialises a party group from a parameter block: copies the ids, offsets and flags, adopts the leader actor, snapshots the leader's position when the battle/menu mode flag is set, and clears the runtime arrays.

functions.name: FieldParty_ResetMemberSlot
functions.summary: Resets one group member slot: clears the embedded list/vector at +0x50 and marks the slot absent in the global lookup table.

functions.name: FieldParty_AttachMemberSlot
functions.signature: int FieldParty_AttachMemberSlot(PartyGroup* group, int slot, Actor* actor, int keepEffects)
functions.summary: Attaches an actor to a group member slot, clears or re-adds its special attachment category (0x5E/0x5F) and plays the group's join sound when not in menu mode.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_GetMemberRideObject
functions.signature: void* maybe_FieldParty_GetMemberRideObject(void* group, void* actor, int locator)
functions.summary: Returns an actor's ride/mount sub-object when it has one; otherwise, for an active actor with fewer than two battle party slots, it fills a locator transform and returns a pointer to that stack buffer, so callers must copy it immediately.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_CompactMemberList
functions.summary: Party-group fix-up: compacts the eight member ids in place (keeping only ids for which the group's virtual +0x48 returns an object), then scans the compacted members and stops at the first that is not selectable (virtual +0x28 returns 0, or +0xD8/+0x10 report a pending state), flags group+0xD2 and member+0x108, and may queue action 0x14. Returns 1 when such a member was found.

functions.name: FieldParty_UpdateActorAttachments
functions.signature: unsigned FieldParty_UpdateActorAttachments(PartyGroup* group, short* cmd, int slot, * Actor* actor, unsigned flags, int arg6, int arg7, int arg8)
functions.summary: Applies one attachment/effect command (descriptor ids -5..-3 and positive ids) to an actor: resolves the actor handle, sets the category flag, spawns the effect or plays voice, and updates the actor's position through the group formation.

functions.name: Sound_WaitForHandleOrTimeout
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaitForHandleOrTimeout(void* owner, float dt, u32* handle)
functions.summary: Per-frame wait used by cutscenes and battle sequences to hold the script until a sound/voice handle has finished: accumulates dt into the float timer at owner+0x1234 and returns 1 (resetting the timer to 0.0f) once the timer reaches 1.0f or the handle reports stale, otherwise 0.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_CtorBase
functions.summary: The shared base constructor of every UI screen: sets up the two intrusive list heads, installs vtable 0x002001EC, seeds the float sentinels and 'no selection' ids, chains the sub-object constructor 0x002BB828 and default-constructs 32 0x7C-byte slot records.

functions.name: Menu_ResolveEntryHandler
functions.signature: unsigned Menu_ResolveEntryHandler(MenuState* self, Actor* actor, int entryId)
functions.summary: Chooses the handler for a menu entry: rejects ids 3/4/0x254 while a battle flag is set, and otherwise routes to the equipment-requirement handler when the entry links to a record of type 6, to the mode-1 variant when the menu is in mode 1, and to the default (return 1) otherwise.

functions.name: Menu_CalcEquipStatValues
functions.signature: unsigned Menu_CalcEquipStatValues(MenuState* self, int slot, unsigned mode)
functions.summary: Computes the six displayed stat values for a menu page: reads the base stats from the character table, applies the focused equipment slot's modifier, folds the pairs into the two totals used by the status page and refreshes the skill-row availability and the stat widget.

functions.name: Menu_BuildTargetActorSet
functions.signature: unsigned long long Menu_BuildTargetActorSet(MenuState* self, Entry* entry, TargetSet* outSet)
functions.summary: Builds the 16-slot set of actors an entry targets: clears the slots and then, depending on the entry's target type (all / single / random / count), fills them from the selected actor, from the entry dispatch result or from the unit list, returning the battle work's actor-set pointer (+0x4238).

functions.name: Menu_SelectRecipeRow
functions.signature: void Menu_SelectRecipeRow(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Chooses the list row for the current menu page: an override index wins, otherwise the type tags 8/10 select the last rows, otherwise it evaluates the per-row predicate 0x002053CC over 0x2D rows and keeps the previously selected 2-byte pair when it still matches.

functions.name: Menu_ApplyEquipmentStatRequirements
functions.signature: u32 Menu_ApplyEquipmentStatRequirements(int self, int stats, u32 itemId)
functions.summary: Evaluates up to five requirement ids listed at record+0x54 against the equipment query and either keeps or zeroes the sixteen-word stat block, depending on the record's mode byte at +0x15F.

functions.name: Menu_CollectActorsForList
functions.signature: void Menu_CollectActorsForList(MenuState* self, unsigned* handles, int count, int count2)
functions.summary: Fills the two 64-entry actor lists of the selection window: first the actors resolved from the caller's handle table, then the active actors of the four party sub-lists, split by whether they already belong to the current group.

functions.name: Menu_UpdateSelectionPage
functions.signature: unsigned Menu_UpdateSelectionPage(MenuState* self, unsigned* out, unsigned handle, unsigned count1, unsigned count2, int mode)
functions.summary: Evaluates the menu's entry selection page: builds the candidate list, resolves the current entry, applies the page/limit rules and writes the chosen actor and sub-slot back to the caller.

functions.name: Menu_ApplyEquipmentStatRequirementsB
functions.signature: u32 Menu_ApplyEquipmentStatRequirementsB(int self, int stats, u32 itemId)
functions.summary: Second requirement-list variant: evaluates up to five requirement ids stored at record+0x4A against the equipment query and, depending on the record's mode byte at +0x15F, either returns success or zeroes the caller's sixteen-word stat block.

functions.name: Menu_DispatchEntryAction
functions.signature: int Menu_DispatchEntryAction(MenuState* self, Entry* entry, u32 actor, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Reads two mode bytes for the entry (0x0063FA60(model)[self->f_434*0xB + entry->f_68] and the 0x12-byte record from 0x0063FE6C at +0x10/+0x11) and dispatches: value pairs 0/1/2/3/4/5/6 select maybe_Menu_ApplyEntryAction(...,index,mode), while type 3 goes to maybe_Menu_BuildCandidateList; a global override at g_00203BF0 wins if it is not -1.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ApplyEntryAction
functions.signature: unsigned maybe_Menu_ApplyEntryAction(void* self, int entry, int actor, unsigned mode, int arg5)
functions.summary: Selects the action a menu entry applies to its target set: counts the entry's 16 target slots, resolves the entry's linked actor, builds the target actor set (Menu_ResolveEntryHandler / Menu_BuildTargetActorSet) and hands the chosen command to func_0038A664, with a random tie-break; large parts of the body are decompiler bad-instruction regions.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_FindActorInListByType
functions.summary: Walks an intrusive list and returns 1 as soon as an entry reports type 0x9C; Ghidra lost the list head/tail registers (unaff_r4/unaff_r5) and prints a bogus arg1*0x2002, so only the type test and the loop shape are real.

functions.name: Menu_LocateSkillGridCell
functions.signature: void Menu_LocateSkillGridCell(int self, int srcEntry, int dstEntry, u32 skillId)
functions.summary: Maps a skill/command id to its (row, column) cell in the menu grid, records the cross-cell relation in f_84 and then resolves and applies the entry's handler chain.

functions.name: Menu_UpdateSkillRowAvailability
functions.signature: void Menu_UpdateSkillRowAvailability(int self, int availability, int mode)
functions.summary: Fills the six per-row availability words of the skill window by comparing each row's record level fields with the current character level and the 0x006456C4 handler result.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_AdvanceListCursor
functions.signature: int maybe_Menu_AdvanceListCursor(MenuState* self, int entryList, unsigned actor, unsigned mode)
functions.summary: Per-page cursor step: case 0 advances the modulo-6 cursor at self+0x438 through empty entries, case 3 dispatches the selected row through Menu_ResolveEntryHandler/Menu_BuildTargetActorSet; the other cases are decompiled as bad instructions.

functions.name: Menu_EvalEntryCondition
functions.signature: unsigned char Menu_EvalEntryCondition(MenuContext* ctx, int entry, int arg3, int condition)
functions.summary: Evaluates the availability condition of a menu entry: a switch over 0x23 condition ids covering party size, actor classes, HP/MP ratios, equipment and "any member has item/skill", using the party and battle helpers and falling back to the entry's own type check.

functions.name: Menu_FindLinkedActorByModelId
functions.signature: void Menu_FindLinkedActorByModelId(void* self, void* entry, u32* out)
functions.summary: Finds the battle actor whose model/character id (node+0x1DA) matches the entry's id, prefers the caller's current actor when it fits, filters out actors already in the given state (8/10) and stores the pick in out[1], choosing randomly when several match.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_BuildCandidateList
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Menu_BuildCandidateList(MenuState* self, int entryTable, int filter, int list)
functions.summary: Counts the non-null entries of the 16-slot table at entryTable+0x20, then scans the self+0x0 or self+0x100 pointer array applying filter vtable+0x18 (filter 0) or vtable+0x10 (filter 1) and filling up to 0x40 records of 0xC bytes on the stack.

functions.name: Menu_TestEntryCondition
functions.signature: unsigned char Menu_TestEntryCondition(MenuState* self, int entryTable, int index)
functions.summary: Tests the per-entry condition byte at entryTable+0x205+index*2: case 1/2 compare the actor's HP/MP ratio with the threshold, case 3 tests a status bit, later cases count party members, and it returns whether the entry is usable.

functions.name: Menu_SetOwnerActor
functions.signature: void Menu_SetOwnerActor(int self, int actor, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Binds a menu/skill window to the actor whose model it displays and caches that actor's type byte from the parameter record.

functions.name: Menu_ResolveSelectedEntryActors
functions.summary: Resolves the currently selected grid cell to its record and, for the three special party-command ids, also to the three party actors that should be highlighted, storing them in the entry.

functions.name: Battle_ActionModel_InitSubPanel
functions.summary: Initialises the battle action model's embedded sub-panel at self+0x200: runs the layout-state defaults, writes the 0/-1 sentinels (f_228..f_250, f_37e/f_37f = 0xFF, f_380 = -1), fills 0x11A bytes at f_264 with 1 and clears the two 0x100-byte scratch buffers at self and self+0x100; returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_InitSlotTables
functions.summary: Resets the menu's large slot tables at self+0x158: fills 0x1F entries with 0xFF, then clears 0x9D3 four-byte entries (0xFFFF / 0) and the 0x1F stride-100 slot records plus the 4x8 paginated records to their defaults.

functions.name: Battle_InitWork
functions.summary: Initialises the battle work: lazily creates its 0x194-byte, 15-state sequence sub-object (vtable 0x0075A888, per-state ctor 0x006C4350) and then sets up the shared unit list at +0x4254, the five 0x40-byte party slots at +0x1C, the four 0x1C-byte unit lists at +0x428C and the 3D/2D unit model tables at +0x4330/+0x47A0.

functions.name: FieldScene_RebindCharacter
functions.summary: Resets the field actor slots and then tells the Field2D manager that the displayed character record changed, so all 2D field models are rebuilt for the new character.

functions.name: Menu_ForEachActorCall148
functions.summary: Calls virtual slot +0x148(arg2) on every valid actor of the four menu actor lists.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_Init
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_Init(GfxScene* self, u32 mode, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises one scene render path: clears the five per-frame flags (+0x423C/+0x423D/+0x423E/+0x424F/+0x4D74), creates the scene sub-objects, then either the 3D path (+0x4330) or the 2D path (viewport init + the action arrays at +0x47A0).

functions.name: BattleScene_SpawnMonsterUnit
functions.signature: void* BattleScene_SpawnMonsterUnit(void* battleScene, u32 groupSlot, u32 monsterId, void* ownerUnit, int skipLimitCheck)
functions.summary: Spawns a monster/reinforcement unit into battle formation group groupSlot (battleScene + 0x428C + groupSlot*0x1C): checks group/size capacity via 0x0020B100 and monster record 0x0063EEAC, creates the unit via Model_CreateActorModel, registers it in 3D (+0x4330) or 2D (+0x47A0) battle lists, links it to ownerUnit, and returns the unit pointer (or NULL).

functions.name: BattleScene_GetUnitModelVariant
functions.signature: u8 BattleScene_GetUnitModelVariant(int scene, u32 modelId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the model variant byte (0x9E or 0x9F) that a battle-scene unit should use, selected by a per-scene boolean table.

functions.name: Menu_InitFromParams
functions.signature: void Menu_InitFromParams(MenuState* self, int mode, Param* parameter, unsigned char* flags)
functions.summary: Initialises the menu/battle command state from an event/talk parameter block: stores the mode flags, selects the window object, resolves the actor record and resets the entry lists and counters.

functions.name: Battle_ReleaseSceneDisplay
functions.summary: Tears down battle unit visual objects and display models from BattleWork: branches on mode byte +0x4244 to release the 3D unit model table (self+0x4330) or 2D unit model table (self+0x47a0) via 0x001690FC, and releases unit actor slots f_431c, f_4320, and f_4324.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ApplySelectedCharacter
functions.summary: Applies a character selection: switches the field status window (work+8->+0x88) to character id and re-attaches the menu actor models of self. Ui_SceneFlow_OpenScene0 calls it with the scene record's character byte.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateSubObjects
functions.summary: Creates the scene's two helper sub-objects (and, in 3D mode, the extra 0x2d4- and 0x268-byte objects), linking the effect object to its emitter.

functions.name: maybe_Party_Hero_RemapSpellEntries
functions.summary: On the hero (party index 0) replaces each of the six spell entries 0xBB..0xC0 with 0x9C through 0x00190270, clears member+0x12E0/+0x12E2 to 0xFF and recalculates the member's stats.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_RemoveActorAttachments
functions.summary: Walks the actor list at world+0x4260 and the four lists at +0x428C; for every actor whose u16 tag (g_00207DE8) equals g_00207DE4 it calls vtable+0xE4(actor, tag, 1), and when the actor's monster-table value (+0x103) is at most 0x001CA474(world+0x4218,1,100,0) it also calls vtable+0x50(actor,1,0).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_BuildEffectList
functions.summary: Rebuilds the effect/command entries shown for the currently inactive battle actors: counts them, allocates a table, fills one 0x10-byte record per actor from the item/spell records and sorts it with std_qsort before freeing the scratch copy.

functions.name: Menu_GetActorByIndex
functions.summary: Returns the actor at a flat index across the global list followed by the UI list at work+0x427c.

functions.name: Menu_FindSlotForEntry
functions.signature: u32 Menu_FindSlotForEntry(MenuState* self, u32 entryId, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Searches the four list columns for one that accepts the given entry (delegating to the per-column check 0x0020B100) and returns the first matching column index, or 0xFFFFFFFF when no column takes it.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ApplyActorModelPattern
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_ApplyActorModelPattern(MenuState* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: When f_424A is set, walks the four actor lists and for every slot record with a non-zero pattern id applies it to the actor's model through vtable +0xA0, copies the companion value into the model's +0x12/+0x16, then asks the scene transition controller (work+0x74) to refresh.

functions.name: Model_CreateActorModel
functions.signature: int* Model_CreateActorModel(int owner, int modelId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates the model instance used by a field actor, resolving the model resource and initializing the render/attachment state.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_Shutdown
functions.summary: Shuts the scene down: hides every child drawable, releases either the composite/sub-object set or the battle scene models depending on the mode byte, releases the six helper objects and resets the per-scene state.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ClaimFreeSlotForId
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_ClaimFreeSlotForId(void* self, u32 id, u32 arg3, u32 stack)
functions.summary: If the id is not already in the five 0x40-byte slot records (+0x4C..+0x14C), claims the first free record (bytes +0x0C/+0x0D == -1 and u16 id +0x0E == 0xFFFF), stamps the id into it, clears +0x08, sets +0x10 = -1 and finally refreshes the entry's icon through maybe_Menu_UpdateItemIcon.

functions.name: Menu_CreateEntryObjects
functions.summary: Creates the menu's per-entry objects (0x68 of them) on the +0x4308 list and initialises the metadata block at +0x56C4.

functions.name: Party_BuildMemberList
functions.summary: Builds the list of party member ids for the party/status screen: first the members that match the availability condition, then the rest, up to 0x1f entries.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_AdvanceStartupGate
functions.summary: Two-phase local scene start gate that always returns 1: before +0x423D is set it probes the two UI-core sub-objects through their virtual +0x34 readiness calls, then resets the field actor slots with Field_ResetActorSlots and raises +0x423D; afterwards it waits for the 0.633 s timer (0x3F222222) and reports renderer reason 0xE (or 8 when +0x424E is clear) through the renderer at +0x10.

functions.name: maybe_Party_SetSelectedMember
functions.signature: void maybe_Party_SetSelectedMember(void* party, u8 member, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Stores the selected member index at self+0x24A and bumps the bag counter at +0x30 (unless it is -1) through 0x00612D40.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CloseScreen
functions.summary: Closes the screen: calls the view object's virtual +0x28 twice (once with 1, once with 0,1), then advances the screen state machine to state 0xD and returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RunTargetSelection
functions.summary: Initiates target-selection request in combat: resolves hero/actor pair and invokes Battle_SelectTargetsThunk.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_UpdateModelFadeIn
functions.summary: Drives the fade-in of the displayed party's 3D models: waits until all four sub-groups report ready, advances the fade step counter up to 3, and averages the per-actor fade values through the actor virtual +0x24/+0x18 calls.

functions.name: Menu_Slot_StoreActorId
functions.signature: void Menu_Slot_StoreActorId(MenuState* self, unsigned actorId, unsigned arg3, unsigned stack)
functions.summary: Stores a character id into the first free of the five 0x40-byte slot records (or keeps an existing match) and notifies the item-icon layer when the battle flag is set.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_AttachToColumn
functions.signature: int Battle_Unit_AttachToColumn(void* self, int column, unsigned slot, unsigned entry, unsigned flags, int immediate)
functions.summary: Attaches a resolved battle unit to a battle column: picks the 3D (+0x4330) or 2D (+0x47A0) scene by work+0x4244, resolves the unit from list+0x428C+column*0x1C, rejects when the party would exceed 8 members, then binds it through the scene helpers or plays SE 0x15B.

functions.name: Menu_Actor_PlayUiAnimation
functions.signature: void Menu_Actor_PlayUiAnimation(void* self, u32 anim, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: Plays a UI animation on the menu's actor controller (self->f_4320->f_204): enables the controller, runs vfunc+0x74 and forwards the animation parameters to func_002DFDE8.

functions.name: Menu_SetSelectedActorId
functions.signature: void Menu_SetSelectedActorId(MenuState* self, int actorId, unsigned arg3, unsigned stack)
functions.summary: Stores the selected actor id in the menu state (+0x4208, 0xFF clamped to 0) and, in 3D mode, applies it as the animation id of the scene sprite group when the group's object is of class 4 and its +0x38 is 2.

functions.name: Menu_CloseWindow
functions.summary: Closes a menu window: clears its display state, sends the close notification with the window parameters, stops the associated message UI and releases the window object.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ResumeActorAnimations
functions.summary: Menu helper: loops the four battle unit lists (work+0x5C+0x4254, accessor 0x002AB62C) and for each unit whose vtable+0x10 is 0 reads vtable+0x90/+0x94 and, when 0x003CE464() > 1, calls vtable+0xE4(unit, 1).

functions.name: Menu_DispatchWindowModeCommand
functions.signature: u32 Menu_DispatchWindowModeCommand(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Translates the current menu display mode (byte at f_442C, overridable through f_4244) into a window command code and sends it to the child object's virtual +0x18; the two 'paired' modes collapse to codes 5/6.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_CheckActorAnimationDone
functions.summary: Returns true when the menu actor with the given id has finished its animation: it scans the four party lists, keeps entries whose f_E74 bit 0 is set, matches the actor resolved by Monster_LookupRecord (f_D4 == actorId), compares the record frame counter f_102 with the threshold in the constant block and updates a per-actor retry counter at work+0x2D54C.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_IncrementUnitCounters
functions.summary: Walks the four 0x1C-stride battle unit rings at battleWork+0x4298..+0x42EC; for every live unit (virtual +0x10 non-zero) whose flag word +0x39D has none of 0x46 set, increments the capped u32 per-unit counter at saveWork+0x3AE4+id*4 (id = unit+0x1DA & 0xFFFF, cap 99999).

functions.name: Menu_CheckSlotSelectable
functions.signature: u32 Menu_CheckSlotSelectable(MenuState* self, int column, u32 entryId, int extra, int skip)
functions.summary: Decides whether an entry may be put into a list column: enforces the global column limits (9/0x1B), compares the current occupancy of the column with the entry's window slot, reads the entry's f_9E/f_9F flags and may create the missing window before returning 1/0.

functions.name: Menu_IsSlotBudgetExceeded
functions.signature: bool Menu_IsSlotBudgetExceeded(void* self, u32 entryType, int limit, int count)
functions.summary: Returns true when the entry type's slot budget (8/7/6/4 depending on type and menu mode) would be exceeded by limit+count, after counting the matching actors in the four battle unit lists.

functions.name: Menu_ResetSlotRecords
functions.summary: Resets the five 0x40-byte slot records (and the trailing field at +0x154) to their empty values, releasing each record's sub-object first.

functions.name: Party_CalcAverageLevel
functions.summary: Returns the average level of the active party members as a float in s0: walks the ring at +0x4260/+0x4264, resolves each member record (0x0035EB98 on node+0x768), skips inactive members (0x0062917C) and divides the summed level (member+0xD8) by the count; 0.0f when nobody is active.

functions.name: Menu_CountPartyActors
functions.summary: Returns the total number of actors in the party list and the guest/second list.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_PickRandomPartyActor
functions.summary: Collects up to 16 valid battle actors into a local array and returns one at random (or 0 when none qualify). When context+0x10 is 0 it scans the four unit lists at battle work +0x4298+i*0x1C requiring virtual +0x18; otherwise it scans only the party list at +0x4260 requiring both +0x18 and +0x24, then rolls the battle RNG for the final index.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CreateSlotObject
functions.summary: Resets two UI-core sub-controllers through vtable+0x1C, allocates a 0x3C4-byte object, constructs it with func_001E0024(obj,-2), stores it into the global slot table at 0x4204+slot_offset and runs its vtable+0x14.

functions.name: Ui_CloseScreenIfChildDone
functions.summary: Per-frame close check for a screen: polls the sub-screen object at +0x4204 through its vtable slots +8 and +0xC and, once it reports finished, plays animation 0xD on the screen's animation handle and switches the two UI context layers off (vtable +0x28 with 1, then 0/1). Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_FindActorSlot
functions.summary: Looks an actor id up in the panel's five 0x40-byte slot records (id fields +0x4C/+0x8C/+0xCC/+0x10C/+0x14C) and returns into the found-slot handling; values matching none of the five are ignored.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_UpdateItemIcon
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_UpdateItemIcon(MenuState* menu, unsigned actorId, unsigned slot, unsigned index)
functions.summary: Refreshes one item icon/slot record of a menu page: it walks the menu's five-slot id chain (+0x4E/+0x8E/+0xCE/+0x10E/+0x14E), builds the icon name from the inline 'it_0001' sheet literal and rebuilds the slot record through Menu_ItemIcon_LoadPack / Menu_IconModel_Release.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_UpdateSkillIcon
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_UpdateSkillIcon(MenuState* menu, unsigned actorId, unsigned skillId, unsigned slot)
functions.summary: Refreshes a skill icon/command entry: builds the skill icon name from the inline 'sk_0155'/'sk_0034'/'sk_0104' sheet literals and updates the five-slot id chain (+0x4D/+0x8D/+0xCD/+0x10D/+0x14D) and the slot record through Menu_SkillIcon_LoadPack / Menu_IconModel_Release.

functions.name: Menu_MeasureAverageActorWidth
functions.summary: Measures four actor-group records at self+0x4298: for each one it walks the actor list summing the two u16 sizes at +0x3E/+0x42 of every live node, counts the group's widget children (Ui_Widget_CountChildren at self+0x428C) and returns the average width (sum of sizes / total children, or the raw sum when the count is < 1) in s0.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_MeasureAverageActorWidthTail
functions.summary: False function entry: 0x0020C08C is inside Menu_MeasureAverageActorWidth (0x0020BFF0), not a function start. The 'thirty Gfx_EffectParams_Create calls' in the readable C are Ghidra decoding the middle of the measure loop; do not merge this address as an independent routine.

functions.name: Menu_MeasureActorHeight
functions.summary: Measures the displayed party's height: walks the actor list (head self+0x4260, cursor self+0x4264), and for every node that passes virtual +0x24 and +0x18 adds the two u16 sizes at node+0x3E and node+0x42 through 0x0048E2C0/0x0048F154 and converts the sum to float in s0.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_FindFreeSlotRecord
functions.summary: Scans the five 0x40-byte slot records at self+0x4C for an empty one (id bytes 0xFF/0xFF and third id 0xFFFF) and returns its index, or 0 when all five are occupied.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_CloseWindowRestoreBgm
functions.summary: Closing step of a menu window: restores the menu BGM category through Sound_SetBgmForCategory, notifies the UI core layout and switches the menu controller (f_10 vtable +0x18) to state 13. Always returns 1.

functions.name: Menu_AssignActorToFreeSlot
functions.signature: void Menu_AssignActorToFreeSlot(MenuState* self, unsigned actorId, int target, unsigned stack)
functions.summary: Places an actor in the first free one of the panel's five 0x40-byte slots: if the id is not already in one of the five slots it computes the display value (special cases id 1 and 0x4D, the latter flipping the battle RNG), resolves a -1 target and writes actorId/target/value into the first empty slot.

functions.name: Gfx_BuildDisplayList
functions.summary: Builds a GPU display list: appends the command stream through the 0x003D13C4 writer and flushes it to the renderer.

functions.name: Menu_FindActorByHandle
functions.summary: Returns the actor in the four menu lists whose handle matches the given handle, or 0.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_BuildMemberMask
functions.signature: unsigned maybe_Battle_BuildMemberMask(void* self, unsigned actorIndex, int includeInactive)
functions.summary: Builds the party-member bitmask for a battle action: walks the four unit slots at battleWork+0x4254, accumulates 1 << actorBit (0x00639B74) for live, non-hidden units and remembers actorIndex's bit, then builds the usable-slot mask and verifies that none of the 0x59 slots is set.

functions.name: Menu_ClearActorUiFlag
functions.summary: Clears the UI flag byte at +0x94 of the window object registered for this menu state.

functions.name: Menu_InsertPartyActors
functions.signature: void Menu_InsertPartyActors(MenuState* self, char first, char b, char c, char d)
functions.summary: Inserts up to four party actors at the front of the menu's party list in the requested order: for i=3..0 it resolves each id through the list lookup (0x2AB698), moves the matching node to the list head and finally refreshes the menu model, the unit slot flags and the battle target windows.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_MeasureUnitListColumn
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_MeasureUnitListColumn(float* out, void* battleWork, int column)
functions.summary: Measures one battle-unit list column: walks the 0x1C-byte list at battleWork+column*0x1C (fields +0x428C/+0x4298/+0x429C), projects each unit's model attachment with Ui_ProjectModelAttachmentToScreen, and returns out[0] = the horizontal centre of the column and out[1] = its highest extent (120-y, clamped to 80) so the enemy-list window can place its rows.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_ApplyUnitActorAttachments
functions.summary: For each of the four battle unit lists (+0x428C + i*0x1C) and each unit in it, walks the party actor list (f_4260/f_4264), resolves 0x00639E94(actor, unit) and, when the result is not 0xFFFF, calls the actor's vtable +0x120 with it.

functions.name: Field_FindActorEntryByModel
functions.summary: Returns the actor's appearance entry: looks up the actor record by id, reads its model-variant flags byte and scans the 0x38-byte entry table at record+0x3c for the entry whose +0x30 matches, falling back to the record itself.

functions.name: Text_GetRecordString
functions.summary: Returns the label/text string of the currently selected record: it follows the record's f_28 reference through the relative-offset string table and returns the shared empty string when the slot is empty.

functions.name: Menu_HasMultipleEntries
functions.summary: Returns true when more than one list column accepts the entry id.

functions.name: Menu_Item_InitEffectParams
functions.summary: Sets up the item sub-menu's effect parameters: picks the message/window type for the selected item, plays the category BGM, then registers the 0x4D78 effect-parameter set (ids 6/8/0/0x19/7/2/0x2F) used by the cursor animation.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ClearPendingFlagA
functions.summary: Menu handler-table slot: resets the list at self+0x4D78 with Menu_ResetListAndRelease and clears the byte at self+0x423D.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CloseScreenIfFlag
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_CloseScreenIfFlag(UiScreen* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Drains the screen's pending list, and when the flag at self+0x4DE2 is set it notifies the child screen (func_002D24BC) and advances the state machine to state 0xD through virtual +0x18; always returns 1.

functions.name: Menu_BuildEffectCommandList
functions.signature: u8 Menu_BuildEffectCommandList(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Builds the at most three 'effect command' entries shown next to the selected recipe: it reads the 6-byte entries of the selected record's effect table and stores (entry id, source id, kind 1 or 2) into the three slot arrays at 0x4E78/0x4E8C/0x4E92.

functions.name: Ui_ProjectModelAttachmentToScreen
functions.signature: void Ui_ProjectModelAttachmentToScreen(u32 * out, u32 arg2, int model)
functions.summary: Projects a model attachment point to 2D screen space for balloon/window anchoring: it resolves the model's packed handle to its object, builds the attachment matrix, adds the base offsets and runs the camera projection, caching the result on the model record.

functions.name: Menu_SetEntryDisplayMode
functions.signature: void Menu_SetEntryDisplayMode(int self, int mode, int recordId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Maps the selected record's kind (100, 0x82, 0x80, 0x76/0x81, 0x74) to the 3..7 display mode stored at f_4201 and mirrors it into the active sub-window's f_F0.

functions.name: Menu_Status_InitEffectParams
functions.summary: Sets up the status/equipment page's effect parameters: resets the cursor id (f_4211 = 0xFF), registers the page's cursor/row effect ids plus the shared InitCursorEffectParams set, and starts the category BGM.

functions.name: Menu_UpdatePendingList
functions.summary: Menu screen step: loads the frame delta from self->f_10->f_10 into s0, drains the pending-request list at self+0x4D78 through maybe_Menu_DrainPendingList, and when the flag byte at self+0x4DE2 is set notifies self->f_10 via virtual +0x18 with argument 1; returns 0.

functions.name: Menu_SelectPartyPair
functions.signature: void Menu_SelectPartyPair(MenuState* self, u32 first, u32 second, int selected)
functions.summary: Selects two actors of the party list (source and target of an item/skill) and stores their ids in the four selection slots: resolves both ids in the 0x4254 list, compares their handles, calls the list's virtual +0x18/+0x24, writes selected into f_4318..f_431B and marks the menu state f_424C as 'selection made'.

functions.name: Menu_ResetSlotRecord
functions.summary: Resets one 0x40-byte menu slot record to empty, releasing its sub-object if it was in use.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_PartySlots_NotifyChanged
functions.summary: Slot-change notification for the battle party/target-marker table: forwards to maybe_Menu_OnSlotChanged and, when the battle work is in 3D mode (+0x4244), refreshes the actor's slot with 0x0020B990 and builds a 4 x 8-byte record array filled with 0xFF.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_InitScreenState
functions.summary: Initialises the screen state: resolves the field object from self+0xC, sets its +0x76 mode flag from self+0x4244 when the byte at self+0x424B is clear, marks self+0x424A, then enables the view and advances the state machine to state 0xD.

functions.name: Field_ResetActorSlots
functions.summary: Clears the field scene's five 0x40-byte actor slots (releasing each icon model first), invalidates the slot ids and the selected id (+0x154 = 0xFF), shuts the scene down and rebuilds the party list.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_SetUnitEntryValue
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_SetUnitEntryValue(void* self, u32 index, u32 value)
functions.summary: Looks up the battle unit at index in the battle party/unit list at self+0x4254 and forwards a packed value to its UI controller virtual +0xB0. The six callers are all battle/field slot refreshers (Battle_Equip_UpdateWeaponSlot/ArmourSlot, Battle_Ui_InitSlots, FieldParty_Ui_RefreshMemberSlot), so the value most likely identifies the entry/slot shown on that unit.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_WriteEffectStateByte
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_WriteEffectStateByte(MenuState* self, u8 value, int offset)
functions.summary: Stores one byte at self+offset and then appends the standard four-entry menu effect-parameter block (8/10, 0/0x6F, 7/0, 2/0) to the menu's effect owner at self+0x4D78.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ClearPendingFlagB
functions.summary: Menu handler-table slot: resets the list at self+0x4D78 with Menu_ResetListAndRelease and clears the byte at self+0x423D.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_CloseWindowRestoreBgmIfFlag
functions.summary: Drains the pending list, then, only when flag +0x4DE2 is set, restores the menu BGM category, notifies the UI core layout and switches the menu controller to state 13. Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_InitEffectParamsBase
functions.summary: Base effect-parameter initialiser for a menu page: clears f_424A and, only when sub-menu flag f_4E6F is set, registers the 0x13/0x15/0x14 effect ids, runs Menu_InitCursorEffectParams and starts the category BGM. The cursor draw-step ids 9/10 are added only by the companion 0x0020F330.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ClearPendingFlagC
functions.summary: Menu handler-table slot: resets the list at self+0x4D78 with Menu_ResetListAndRelease and clears the byte at self+0x423D.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CloseScreenIfFlagAlt
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_CloseScreenIfFlagAlt(UiScreen* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Drains the screen's pending list, and when the flag at self+0x4DE2 is set it notifies the child screen (func_002D24BC) and advances the state machine to state 0xD through virtual +0x14; always returns 1.

functions.name: Menu_UpdateSelectionWindow
functions.summary: Updates the multi-member selection window: builds the per-selection objects, refreshes the actor list and closes the window when the selection completes.

functions.name: Menu_InitCursorEffectParams
functions.signature: void Menu_InitCursorEffectParams(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Configures the six effect parameters of the cursor/selection animation, choosing parameter id 0x3F or 0x3E from the selected record's character code ('X', '[', 'b', 'e').

functions.name: Menu_InitPageEffects
functions.summary: Page setup for a menu page: picks the page id (f_442C, or f_489C in 2D mode), requests the page's BGM category and creates the page's effect parameters - 8/5 normally, or 8/10 + 0/0x3C + 7/0 + 2/0 for page 2, which also raises f_423E.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ClearPendingFlagD
functions.summary: Menu handler-table slot: resets the list at self+0x4D78 with Menu_ResetListAndRelease and clears the byte at self+0x423D.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CloseScreenIfFlagB
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_CloseScreenIfFlagB(UiScreen* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Drains the screen's pending list, and when the flag at self+0x4DE2 is set it notifies the child screen (func_002D24BC) and advances the state machine to state 0xD through virtual +0x14; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CloseScreenOnButton
functions.summary: Per-frame screen tick: func_0066D1C0(core) scans the UiCore's two 8-slot resource tables for a slot whose resource byte +0x78 is 4; when one is found it re-binds the scene-flow slot resources and requests animation 9 (the back/close clip) on the screen's animator. Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_InitBaseEffectParams
functions.summary: Creates the five shared effect parameters (0x13/0x15/0x14/9/10) on the menu effect owner after resetting the cursor id f_4211 to 0xFF, flushes them through 0x003D1144 and requests the category BGM from f_4200.

functions.name: Menu_ResetCursorField
functions.summary: Resets the menu cursor field to 0xff (no selection).

functions.name: Menu_UpdatePendingListB
functions.summary: Second copy of the menu screen step at 0x0020DB40: frame delta from self->f_10->f_10, drain the pending-request list at self+0x4D78, and notify self->f_10 via virtual +0x18 with 1 when self+0x4DE2 is set; returns 0.

functions.name: Event_AnyUnitFlagSet
functions.signature: bool Event_AnyUnitFlagSet(int ctx, u8 mask, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Tests whether any unit whose parameter record has kind 0x74 has any of the given flag bits set at +0xF22, scanning four actor-slot rings.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ResolveActorTarget
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Menu_ResolveActorTarget(MenuState * self, u32 u32, u32 u322)
