functions.summary: Computes the default target for an actor about to be placed in a panel slot: builds a large (0x2F8-byte) scratch record from the actor id and the battle selection value and returns the resulting target index.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_InitEffectParamsWithCursor
functions.summary: Page effect-parameter initialiser that registers the 0x13/0x15/0x14 effect ids, the two cursor draw-step ids 9/10, finishes the parameter set with func_003D1144, sets f_4211=0xFF and starts the category BGM. The 9/10 pair distinguishes it from the base variant 0x0020E628.

functions.name: Menu_ResetCursorField2
functions.summary: Resets the menu cursor field to 0xff (second copy).

functions.name: Menu_UpdatePendingListC
functions.summary: Third copy of the menu screen step at 0x0020DB40: frame delta from self->f_10->f_10, drain the pending-request list at self+0x4D78, and notify self->f_10 via virtual +0x18 with 1 when self+0x4DE2 is set; returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_SumPartyStats
functions.summary: Adds up two per-member character-record values (+0xC4 and +0x100) for every active battle actor into self+0x56B4/+0x56B8, then tears down the battle unit lists and the two action-slot blocks before re-applying the entry attachments.

functions.name: Menu_OpenMessageWindow
functions.summary: Opens the description message window for the selected entry: resets the list state, picks the message table by the menu flag and wires it through func_006133B4/0x00613F54 or func_00612CA0, then pushes the text-window requests 0x101..0x104 for the four optional panels.

functions.name: Menu_CloseMessageWindows

functions.name: maybe_Object_DtorThunkG

functions.name: Menu_Camp_ApplyParamToSlots

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_ForwardSlotEvent

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsHaveHandle
functions.summary: Returns 1 when 0x0017BB7C succeeds on the selected channel word of all three camp slots (slot[i]+4 for channel 0, slot[i]+8 for channel 1), 0 as soon as one fails. The predicate is a real return value, not a dropped one.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsHaveLayout
functions.summary: Returns 1 when 0x0066BDE8 succeeds on the +0x138 sub-object of all three camp slots' selected channel, 0 as soon as one fails. Byte-identical to 0x00215D28 and 0x0021632C.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsReady
functions.summary: Returns 1 when virtual +0x34 reports ready for both channels of all three camp slots, 0 as soon as one reports not ready.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsHaveLayoutB
functions.summary: Second copy of the three-slot layout check: 0x0066BDE8 on the +0x138 sub-object of each slot's selected channel, all three must succeed. Byte-identical to 0x00215C60 and 0x0021632C.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_ForwardSlotEventB
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_Camp_ForwardSlotEventB(void* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Second copy of the slot-block forwarder: tail-calls 0x0060E7FC(self+4, arg2, arg3). Byte-identical to 0x00215B98, 0x00216064 and 0x00216130.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_SetSlotParam
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_Camp_SetSlotParam(void* self, int channel, unsigned int value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one value into the +8 or +0xC word of each of three 0xC-stride records (channel selects which), using the two-word setter Ui_Bar_StartFadeIn(record.field, value).

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsVisible
functions.summary: Returns 1 when virtual +0x24 reports visible for both channels of all three camp slots, 0 as soon as one reports hidden.

functions.name: Menu_Camp_GetMaxSlotState
functions.summary: Returns the largest state value among the three camp slots: walks slots 2, 1, 0, reads the per-channel word (slot+8 or slot+0xC), clamps it with Ui_Bar_GetClampedValue and keeps the maximum low byte.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsEnabled
functions.summary: Returns 1 when virtual +0x30 reports enabled for both channels of all three camp slots, 0 as soon as one reports disabled.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsHaveLayoutC
functions.summary: Third three-slot layout check: 0x0066BD8C on the +0x138 sub-object of each slot's selected channel, all three must succeed. Same body as 0x00215C60/0x00215D28/0x0021632C except that it calls 0x0066BD8C instead of 0x0066BDE8.

functions.name: Ui_DetachChildrenKeepRefs
functions.summary: Releases the references to the six child objects at +8/+0xC/+0x14/+0x18/+0x20/+0x24 with the non-clearing handle release 0x0021F8D0, so the window stops tracking them but keeps the raw pointers.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_ForwardSlotEventC
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_Camp_ForwardSlotEventC(void* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Third copy of the slot-block forwarder: tail-calls 0x0060E7FC(self+4, arg2, arg3). Byte-identical to 0x00215B98, 0x00215D84 and 0x00216130.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_SetSlotParamB
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_Camp_SetSlotParamB(void* self, int channel, unsigned int value)
functions.summary: Writes one value into the selected channel word of all three camp slots through 0x0017BD1C(slotWord, value). A sibling of maybe_Menu_Camp_SetSlotParam (0x00215DEC), which uses Ui_Bar_StartFadeIn for the same loop.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_ForwardSlotEventD
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_Camp_ForwardSlotEventD(void* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Fourth copy of the slot-block forwarder: tail-calls 0x0060E7FC(self+4, arg2, arg3). Byte-identical to 0x00215B98, 0x00215D84 and 0x00216064.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_SetSlotParamC
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_Camp_SetSlotParamC(void* self, int channel, unsigned int value)
functions.summary: Writes one value into the selected channel word of all three camp slots through 0x0017BDC8(slotWord, value). Same loop as maybe_Menu_Camp_SetSlotParamB but a different setter.

functions.name: Ui_DetachChildren
functions.summary: Destroys and clears the six children at +8/+0xC/+0x14/+0x18/+0x20/+0x24 (release helper 0x0021F8B8 followed by storing 0 into each field).

functions.name: Menu_Camp_ApplySlotState
functions.signature: void Menu_Camp_ApplySlotState(void* self, unsigned int state)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one state value into both channels of all three camp slot objects: for i in 0..2 it calls slot[i]->vt[0x1C](slot[i], 0, state) and then (slot[i], 1, state).

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsHaveLayoutD
functions.summary: Fourth copy of the three-slot layout check: 0x0066BDE8 on the +0x138 sub-object of each slot's selected channel, all three must succeed. Byte-identical to 0x00215C60 and 0x00215D28.

functions.name: Menu_TalkParty_Teardown
functions.summary: Tears down the talk-party window: releases the layout/animation objects and the notification list, frees the owned sub-panels (f_94/f_B8/f_98/f_9C/f_A0/f_A4) through the generic object release, then rebuilds or clears the remaining sub-panels depending on the flag pair passed in.

functions.name: Ui_SetCurrentMapFlag
functions.summary: Stores a byte in the UI work block at +0x27CB4 and notifies the previous map/UI state when it changes: it first flushes the pending handler at +0x94 and then runs the standard global guard block before writing.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateCursor
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_UpdateCursor(UiWindow* window, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int mode)
functions.summary: Refreshes a menu window's cursor: applies the input repeat, queries the attached list's count and current index through three vtable slots, clamps the index into +0x7C (0xFF when the list is empty or invalid) and then probes up to three cursor cells for a match.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_Camp_CheckSlotsHaveLayoutE
functions.summary: Thumb copy of the three-slot layout check (0x0066BDE8 on each slot's +0x138 sub-object). The readable body is damaged - the loop counter and the self pointer arrive as unaff_r5/unaff_r6 and the channel as in_r3 - so only the callee and the 3-iteration bound are trustworthy.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_TalkParty_WaitPanels
functions.summary: Waits until the 24 embedded sub-panels at self+0x1C report done; then, once a button is pressed or the wait timed out, closes the field UI core (func_002D2440 plus the +0x1C object's virtuals) and creates the map cursor when self+0x9C is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ReleaseGfxResources
functions.summary: Releases the four renderer resources a UI window holds at +0xCC/+0xD0/+0xD4/+0xD8 (each dropped with kind 0/8/0xF/9 and then freed), clears the shared +0x94 handle and lazily creates the 0x7C-byte message-window helper at +0x98.

functions.name: Ui_UpdateWindowParts
functions.signature: void Ui_UpdateWindowParts(Window* self, int part, int mode)
functions.summary: Rebuilds one window part: dispatches on the part kind to the per-window setup helpers, recreates the child widgets and refreshes the layout state.

functions.name: Ui_DimBackgroundFadeIn
functions.summary: Enables the dimming overlay that sits behind a menu, fading it in over the 0.8 s constant in the literal pool (ctx->[0x14]->[0x10] vtable +0x44 with (1, 0xFF)).

functions.name: Ui_DimBackgroundFadeOut
functions.summary: Removes the menu dimming overlay, fading it out over the same 0.8 s constant (vtable +0x44 with (0, 0xFF)).

functions.name: Ui_DimBackgroundNow
functions.summary: Turns the dimming overlay on immediately (same setter, 0.0 s fade) for cases where the transition must not be animated.

functions.name: Ui_UndimBackgroundNow
functions.summary: Turns the dimming overlay off immediately (0.0 s fade), the non-animated counterpart of 0x002172C4.

functions.name: Ui_IsAnyWindowOpen
functions.summary: Answers 'is a menu window currently occupying the screen?': it scans the 24 window pointers at self+0x1C and returns 1 as soon as one is present and not finished; if all 24 are free it still returns 1 when func_001A0464 on the global UI state is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ReleaseOverlay
functions.summary: Releases the optional child object held at self+0xC8 through its virtual slot +4 and clears the pointer - the standard 'release optional member' idiom.

functions.name: Ui_TalkParty_GetLayout
functions.summary: Returns (creating on first use) the talk_party.bxon layout of the conversation window: it validates the cached layout handle at +0xE0, resolves the layout by name, keeps the pane-array node and returns the pane block at node+0x58+0x20.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_TalkParty_CreatePanel
functions.signature: void maybe_Menu_TalkParty_CreatePanel(void* self, u32 index, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Creates (or tears down) one talk-party sub-panel by index: destroys the old slot, then allocates and constructs the concrete class for that index (text, shop, choice, face, casino prize, message select, ...).

functions.name: Menu_TalkParty_ReleasePanel
functions.summary: Destroys the talk-party sub-panel at `index` (slot f_1C + index*4, vtable +4), notifies the layout manager (func_001A1774 kind 8) and, in game mode 2 for panels other than 3, refreshes the UI-core window.

functions.name: Ui_TalkContent_GetLayout
functions.summary: Same lazy layout getter as 0x0021740C but for talk_content.bxon, caching it at +0xEC with its smart handle at +0xF0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RebuildParts
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_RebuildParts(Window* self, const u8* desc, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Rebuilds a window's part list from a layout descriptor: releases the previous parts (f_CC/f_D0) and recreates them with the 0x002F7528/0x002F7590 part builder.

functions.name: Menu_TalkParty_Load
functions.summary: Loads the talk-party script package (param/talk_party/talk_party_%s.pack) for the current talk id and starts its script.

functions.name: Menu_TalkParty_LoadEx
functions.summary: Extended loader of the talk-party window package: runs the same literal/call sequence as 0x002181F8 (layout resolve, pack load, resource registration) with an additional validation of the resolved pack record against self->f_E0>>0xC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ReleaseChildAndRequestMode
functions.summary: Window dismissal hook: frees the embedded child object at f_C4, and when the layout at f_94 has its auto-close byte +0x8D set and requested is 0, raises the global screen-switch request flag at 0x007A9A90 and highlights the window's page.

functions.name: Ui_TalkWindow_ReleaseResources
functions.summary: Partial teardown of the conversation window: stops the two animated parts (+0x94 via 0x0017FBB4, +0xA0 via 0x0022858C), zeroes the layout pointer at +0xE4 and releases the three page/user-data members at +0xE8/+0xF0/+0xE0.

functions.name: Menu_TalkParty_ReleaseAll
functions.summary: Releases every talk-party sub-resource: the 24 sub-panels, the layout objects and the animation handles.

functions.name: Ui_TalkWindow_Ctor_2
functions.signature: int Ui_TalkWindow_Ctor_2(void* self, TalkWindowDesc* desc, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int b)
functions.summary: Constructor for the talk/message window object: stores id parameters, invokes embedded sub-object constructor func_0022091C(self+3), zeroes 0x60 bytes at +0x10, and initializes 0x18 animation state bytes to 0xFF.

functions.name: Ui_TalkWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the conversation window: installs vtable 0x0075BBCC, runs the resource release 0x0021849C, releases the three trailing smart handles and frees the object.

functions.name: TalkParty_ResolveActorHandle
functions.summary: Resolves an entity handle through global table 0x007B80C0 and validates that its RTTI class inheritance chain matches g_actorTalkPartyClassToken (0x007C43D8).

functions.name: Menu_TalkParty_IsActive
functions.signature: int Menu_TalkParty_IsActive(void* talkPartyWindow, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Talk-party liveness predicate: returns 1 when the window field self+0x2E8 is not -1, the game work exists and the field event-scene validity test 0x00636AFC(work+0x6C) is non-zero; otherwise 0.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ShowOverrideA
functions.summary: Show override of a field scene-object class: calls the base Field_SceneObject_Show(self) and returns self. The readable C file continues into the next function because Ghidra merged a split symbol.

functions.name: maybe_Actor2D_ResetIfRegistered
functions.summary: If the two-key field-actor table lookup 0x00629A24(work+0x24A98, *(u16*)(work+0x27C5C), actor+0x298) finds the actor, calls actor virtuals +0x40 and +0x58 with the argument 4 and clears actor+0x288 and actor+0x2D8.

functions.name: Actor2D_ApplyStateAnimFlags
functions.signature: void Actor2D_ApplyStateAnimFlags(Actor2D* actor, int state, u32 arg3, u32 thread)
functions.summary: Selects the animation/state index for a 2D actor: looks up a per-state byte table (g_00218a90), stores it in f_2e8 (or falls back to f_2e9 when the table says -1), and then enables/disables the draw flag f_238 on the paired child objects f_204/f_208 for every other slot. If the state's sprite id resolves to a 'talking' record (f_2f0) it forces state 0 first.

functions.name: Menu_TalkParty_HandleCommand
functions.summary: Dispatches a talk-party window command: 0 resets the spans through Actor2D_StopAnimAndResetSpans(self,0), 6 runs the idle-span reset, and 2/3 drive the child animator's +0x14 slot with 1/0.

functions.name: TalkParty_ApplyMessageParams
functions.summary: Applies scene message parameter block to TalkPartyWindow: copies message[0..0x15] fields, sets anim flags, and attaches child sprites.

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateWithAnimInstanceA
functions.signature: void Actor2D_CreateWithAnimInstanceA(Actor2D* actor, const Actor2DSpriteRecord* record)
functions.summary: Initialises a 2D sprite actor from a 16-bit record: maps record[0xD] (0xE9/0xEA/0xEB) to the anim-state id f_2EC, copies the position/size/colour fields, creates an anim instance (0x178 bytes) from the 'sprite' template and applies it, then builds the actor's two sprite spans (f_24C and f_29C) with their colour (FCol) animators and finishes with the state anim flags. The A variant clears the layer byte f_2E9 to 0xFF and uses span flags 0x400/0x800.

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateWithAnimInstanceB
functions.signature: void Actor2D_CreateWithAnimInstanceB(Actor2D* actor, const Actor2DSpriteRecord* record)
functions.summary: Same 2D sprite-actor initialisation as 0x00218EA8 for the same record layout, but stores layer/priority byte 2 in f_2E9 and gives the two sprite spans the 0x100/0x200 flag pair instead of 0x400/0x800.

functions.name: Actor2D_SelectFacingCommand
functions.signature: int Actor2D_SelectFacingCommand(Actor2D* actor, int stateValue, const u32* patternPair, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Compares an incoming pattern pair against the actor's two span pattern words (f_250 / f_2A0) to decide which side of the sprite faces the camera (f_2EA = 0/1), maps that plus the actor state f_2EE (2/3) onto the gadget command id 5 or 6 (stored in f_2E8) and sends it to the field gadget manager. If no command was ever selected (f_2E8 == -1) it instead resets the actor through 0x00219764.

functions.name: Actor2D_StopAnimAndResetSpans
functions.summary: Stops the sprite actor's current action: releases the anim instance at f_B8 (Anim_Instance release), tells the scene that the previous gadget state f_2EC ended, disables update through vtable+0x40/+0x58 (argument 4), clears the span flags f_288/f_2D8 and unregisters the actor id f_298 from the scene manager before releasing the vtable+8 handle.

functions.name: Actor2D_InitSpanGroupB
functions.signature: Actor2D* Actor2D_InitSpanGroupB(void* owner, int meshSpec, u32 not, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Creates the second sprite-span group of a 2D actor: builds the span object with func_0028E630(owner, &ctx, 0x4000000C), installs g_actor2DSpanGroupClassDesc plus its +0x9C sub-vtable, seeds the span count/sentinel at +0x298 with 0x0FFFFFFF, initialises the handle and colour/scale defaults and returns the enclosing actor (object-0x29C).

functions.name: Actor2D_DeletingDtor_2
functions.signature: void Actor2D_DeletingDtor_2(void* self, unsigned int vtable)
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a 2D actor: installs the vtable, points the outer back-pointer at self+0x9C, tears down the embedded object 0x29C bytes back through func_0028E6C4 and frees the block.

functions.name: Actor2D_ResolveHandle
functions.summary: Resolves an entity handle through global table 0x007B80C0 and validates that its RTTI class inheritance chain matches g_actor2DHasPatternClassToken (0x007C489C).

functions.name: Actor2D_HasPatternResource
functions.signature: u32 Actor2D_HasPatternResource(Actor2D* actor, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the actor's secondary pattern byte f_320 is set (not 0xFF) and the scene's resource table (func_00636AFC on the scene work object) can resolve an entry for it - i.e. the pattern the actor wants to show actually exists.

functions.name: Actor2D_ValidateStateResource
functions.signature: void Actor2D_ValidateStateResource(Actor2D* actor, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 thread)
functions.summary: When the actor is in state 1 it maps the sub-state f_327 (1..5) to one of five hard-coded ids (0x9C6..0x9C9, 0x9DF) and asks the resource table whether that id is present; if the lookup succeeds the actor is put back into the 'none' state (f_326 = 0, f_327 = 0xFF).

functions.name: Actor2D_ReapplySpanPatterns
functions.summary: Re-applies the actor's current sprite pattern to every span: re-runs the state->pattern selection (0x00219C48) and then writes the pattern index f_274 and the two pattern words f_27C/f_2D0 into both colour/anim objects of each of the f_250 spans.

functions.name: Actor2D_DispatchEvent
functions.signature: void Actor2D_DispatchEvent(Actor2D* actor, int eventId, u32 event)
functions.summary: Event entry point of a 2D actor: event 0x0F first refreshes the front/back facing state, then the event is broadcast to all registered listeners (func_005E754C walks the listener list calling vtable+0x2C) and finally forwarded to the optional attached animator at f_270 (vtable+0x38).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ShowOverrideB
functions.summary: Second copy of the field scene-object show override: calls the base Field_SceneObject_Show(self) and returns self; its readable body was merged with Actor2D_ResetPartsIfIdle (0x00219BCC).

functions.name: Actor2D_ResetPartsIfIdle
functions.signature: void Actor2D_ResetPartsIfIdle(Actor2D* actor, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 thread)
functions.summary: If the part id stored at +0x2C8 still resolves to a live object, stops its animation and update and clears the part bookkeeping fields +0x2B4 and +0x308.

functions.name: Actor2D_SetPatternForState
functions.signature: void Actor2D_SetPatternForState(Actor2D* actor, int state, u32 arg3, u32 thread)
functions.summary: Stores the state index in f_326 and looks up the two bytes belonging to it in a per-state table (g_00219ccc): the first becomes the sprite pattern index f_274, the second a secondary pattern byte which falls back to the previous value f_321 when the table contains -1. States 2..5 are downgraded to 0 when the id at f_328 is flagged in the character table.

functions.name: Actor2D_OnStateNotify
functions.summary: State notification handler of a 2D actor: state 0 re-evaluates the front/back facing, state 6 resets the attachment parts, states 2/3 switch the first child object (f_4c) between two sub-modes via vtable+0x14, and every state is forwarded to the optional animator at f_270 (vtable+0x84).

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateFromParamA
functions.signature: void Actor2D_CreateFromParamA(Actor2D* actor, const Actor2DParam* creation)
functions.summary: Constructor-style initialisation of a 2D sprite actor from a creation record: copies the character/pattern ids, resolves the character table, converts the three Euler angles into the actor's rotation quaternion, builds the 8-slot sprite-span chain, creates the mesh object and attaches the colour (FCol) animators.

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateFromParamB
functions.signature: void Actor2D_CreateFromParamB(Actor2D* actor, const Actor2DParamB* creation)
functions.summary: Same 2D-actor initialisation as 0x00219D5C but for a different (0x1A-based) record layout; additionally it either takes the bounding box from the record or queries the model resource (func_0063F530) and derives the span extents from it.

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateFromParamC
functions.signature: void Actor2D_CreateFromParamC(Actor2D* actor, const Actor2DParamB* creation)
functions.summary: Third 2D-actor constructor variant: same record layout as 0x0021A03C but it also re-seeds the transform of all sub-spans (f_250 entries, f_230[i]) with the initial offsets f_300..f_324 before creating the span box.

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateFromParamD
functions.signature: void Actor2D_CreateFromParamD(Actor2D* actor, const Actor2DParamB* creation)
functions.summary: Fourth 2D-actor constructor variant, identical to 0x0021A03C except that it scales the record's positions by 0.5 (g_0021ac98) and uses its own constant block for the fallback span box.

functions.name: Actor2D_UpdateFacingToTarget
functions.signature: void Actor2D_UpdateFacingToTarget(Actor2D* actor, Actor2DHandle* handle, u32 passed)
functions.summary: Turns the actor's 2D sprite to front or back depending on where its target is: computes the normalised direction from the actor position (f_9c..f_a4) to the target, dot-products it with the actor's forward vector, and tells 0x0021B22C to play the 'Open_Back' state when the target is behind, 'Open_Front' otherwise.

functions.name: Actor2D_SelectFacingCommandEx
functions.signature: int Actor2D_SelectFacingCommandEx(Actor2D* actor, int actionId, const u32* patternPair)
functions.summary: Derived-class twin of 0x00219610: clears the facing byte f_322 to 0xFF, compares the incoming pattern pair with f_27C/f_2D0 to set it to 0 or 1, maps state f_326 (2/3) + facing onto command id 5/6 in f_320, fires scene event 9 when the actor has no pattern yet (f_2C7) and finally sends the command through the field gadget manager.

functions.name: Actor2D_SetOpenFacingState
functions.signature: void Actor2D_SetOpenFacingState(Actor2D* actor, int backFacing, int immediate)
functions.summary: Plays the actor's 'open' state: stores the facing flag in f_322, sends the animation name 'Open_Front' or 'Open_Back' to the animator (vtable+0x84), disables update, clears f_2B4 and f_308, stops the current action (vtable+0x98, optionally releasing it / sending the scene event), unregisters the actor id f_2C8 from the scene list and releases the vtable+8 handle.

functions.name: Actor2D_CtorBase
functions.signature: int Actor2D_CtorBase(void* self, Actor2DDesc* desc, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int b)
functions.summary: Base constructor of the 2D actor/sprite family: allocates the object, installs the class vtable g_actor2DNodeClassDesc (plus its +0xD4 second half), clears the slot-state word to 0x0FFFFFFF, creates the Actor2D handle reference and fills the default draw/colour parameters (0xFF/0xFF/0xFF, 0xBF, 0xFFFF, mode 4).

functions.name: maybe_Actor2D_HandleObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of an Actor2D-derived object with an Actor_HandleRefEx sub-object at +0x2CC: stamps the primary/secondary vtables, runs the Actor_HandleRefEx base body, the Actor2D_EffectNode body on self and frees.

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateSpriteMesh
functions.signature: void Actor2D_CreateSpriteMesh(Actor2D* actor, const void* spriteParams)
functions.summary: Creates the actor's single 200x120 'sprite' render object: sets up the sprite anim instance for the scene node (func_005F2B54), builds a 200x120 mesh request through func_0031A48C and creates it with Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh (func_0031A394) using the literal 'sprite', then stores it in f_B8, marks f_129 = 10 and registers it with the scene node.

functions.name: Actor2D_UpdateTouchAndIsBusy
functions.summary: Advances the 2D actor's touch state machine one step and reports whether the touch sequence is still running (0 only at the terminal phase 5).

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateEightSpans
functions.signature: void Actor2D_CreateEightSpans(Actor2D* actor, const SpanRecord8* rec)
functions.summary: Builds the eight sprite spans of a 2D actor: copies the base ids/position from the record, sets the ground position (func_005F34F0/func_005F36E0), then creates eight 0x48-byte child spans at self+0x298 with func_00335A6C, each with its own colour block computed by func_0047AF94/func_0047B314, and finally resets the f_204 span array.

functions.name: Actor2D_RefreshTouchInfo
functions.summary: Rebuilds the 2D actor's touch record (kind 7) from its position and mesh id and caches the six fields at self+0x4D8..+0x4E0; returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlotCtor_vt21B7A4

functions.name: Model_AttachSlot_InitResource
functions.signature: u32 Model_AttachSlot_InitResource(void* attachSlot, const void* attachDesc)
functions.summary: Replaces any active 0xC0-byte Effect_Instance at attachSlot->f_158, initializes a new resource set from (*0x007BE310)->f_3E4 via Fs_ResourceSet_InitFromRecord (0x0030B120) and optional variant load (0x0030AFF4), copies the 0x35-byte attachDesc into attachSlot+0x15C, and returns 1 on success.

functions.name: Model_Attach_SpawnEffect
functions.signature: void Model_Attach_SpawnEffect(ModelAttachSlot* slot, const u32* effectParams, u8 variant)
functions.summary: Spawns the effect attached to a model part: copies the 0x12-byte local parameter block from the slot (f_120..f_154), overlays the five caller words and the variant byte and hands the combined record to func_002239F4 (maybe_Effect_CreateAttached2).

functions.name: maybe_Actor_UpdateModelIfReady
functions.summary: Per-frame scene-object tick: when the object owns a model (word +0x56) and 0x00641960 reports the referenced parts idle, it re-dispatches its own vtable+8 update; always returns 1.

functions.name: Model_Attach_PlayAnimation
functions.summary: Plays an animation on an attached model part: only for character-owned parts (f_5C == 1) with a live render node it builds the animation request, resolves it with func_00633E24, stores whether the animation loops in f_525, applies it to the model (func_003BF14C) and starts it on the node (vtable+0x14). Returns 1 when the animation was started.

functions.name: Model_UpdateAttachMatrix
functions.summary: Recomputes the attachment matrices from the model's bone transforms and uploads them to the renderer.

functions.name: Model_ReleaseResource
functions.summary: Releases a model's resource binding: if a resource entry is set and no span is still using it, it either releases the entry or re-applies it, then restores the default appearance fields from the model defaults.

functions.name: Model_Attach_ReleaseChainResources
functions.summary: Root-only cleanup of an attachment chain: releases the root's and every child's model resource, and releases each child's effect/anim resource at +0x55C when the owner asks for it; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Transform_CopyThunk
functions.summary: Sixteen-byte vtable thunk: 'push {r4,lr}; bl 0x00574428; pop {r4,pc}'. The callee copies twelve floats (a 3x4 transform) from src to dst with two vldmia/vstmia pairs and returns dst-0x20.

functions.name: Model_Attach_UpdateRoot
functions.summary: Per-frame update entry for a root attachment: updates its timed rotation (0x002222C4), recomputes the attach matrix (0x00223E08), resets the child state when the render node is live, applies the effect resource and finally updates all children (0x002242AC). Returns 1.

functions.name: Actor_StepAnimation
functions.signature: void Actor_StepAnimation(Actor* actor, int delta, int mode)
functions.summary: Advances an actor's animation by 'delta' frames: the target frame is the current clip's blend start (slot->f_18 when it has a next clip, otherwise -1.0), the part models whose bind flags are clear are refreshed, and the action-sequence player at f_55c is advanced by the same delta when the actor owns one.

functions.name: Model_Attach_UpdateChildren
functions.summary: Per-frame update of every attached part of a character model: for each child it advances the timed rotation, recomputes its attach matrix and, when the child has an active animation (f_555), stops/starts the node animation (vtable+0xC/+0x14) and clears its fade timer.

functions.name: Model_Attach_UpdateChildrenRoot
functions.summary: Root guard for the child update: when the slot is the chain root (f_654 == 0) it forwards to Model_Attach_UpdateChildren and always returns 1.

functions.name: Actor_Model_ApplyByNameWithParts
functions.signature: u32 Actor_Model_ApplyByNameWithParts(ActorModel* self, u32 name, int flags)
functions.summary: Applies a named model set to an actor: builds the model name into a local buffer (0x11142C/0x100990), looks the entry up (0x641738) and binds it, then sets the swing/cape/face-off part flags from the model's part table and updates the related effect/parts. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: Model_Attach_ResetTransform
functions.summary: Resets an attachment's transform: when the sample list is enabled (+0x58A) every queued sample is refreshed, and when the transform is dirty (+0x598) the default orientation constant 0x007E7110 is rebuilt, applied through Model_Attach_ComputeWorldMatrix and pushed to the front-end before the flag is cleared.

functions.name: Model_Attach_PlayNamedAnimation
functions.signature: u32 Model_Attach_PlayNamedAnimation(ModelAttachSlot* slot, void* animRequest, int force)
functions.summary: Plays an animation clip on the attached model resource: when the model is loaded and (force or the owner is idle) it either restarts the default clip through func_003BEFA4(model,1) or resolves the requested animation with func_00633E24 and plays it on the model; returns the play result.

functions.name: Model_Attach_ResetTransformB
functions.summary: Same transform reset as 0x0022486C without the sample-list part: rebuilds the default orientation from 0x007E7110, applies it through Model_Attach_ComputeWorldMatrix, pushes it and clears +0x598.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_UpdateTrailTransform
functions.summary: Per-frame update of trail/ribbon object: computes orientation quaternion from target direction and writes node scale.

functions.name: Model_Attach_UpdateAnimationFrame
functions.signature: void Model_Attach_UpdateAnimationFrame(ModelAttachSlot* slot, u32 frame, u32 forwarded)
functions.summary: Sets the animation time of every attached part: adds the incoming frame to the part's clip offset (from the animation table entry at f_4F0->f_C*0x2C, or a global default), applies it with func_003BF390/func_003BF35C/func_003BF3C0 when the two loop flags f_524/f_525 are clear, and updates the part's effect resource (func_002A90B0).

functions.name: Model_AttachSlot_ShowIfHidden
functions.summary: Makes an attach slot visible again if it is currently hidden and the parent slot's visibility flags allow it; sets the visible flag +0x10.

functions.name: maybe_Model_AttachAdvanceTimer
functions.summary: Advances the attach slot's transition clock: when the state sequence at self+0x58 reports no active transition it stores the delta at self+0x68, adds it to the accumulated time at self+0x60 and increments the frame counter at self+0x64; then it always dispatches state change 1 through 0x006C47BC(&self->f_58, 1, 0).

functions.name: Model_AttachSlot_Show
functions.summary: Attaches a model slot to the render device: moves the slot's transform node list into the device's visible list at device+0x2A4+slot*0x0C and the accessory node into device+0x328/+0x334/+0x340 depending on the slot kind.

functions.name: Model_AttachSlot_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of an attach slot: releases everything through Model_AttachSlot_ReleaseAll, drops the resource set at +0x4F0 and the skeleton/handle at +0x11C, and nulls the remaining pointers.

functions.name: Model_AttachSlot_HideIfVisible
functions.summary: Hides an attach slot if it is currently visible: calls the detach routine and clears the visible flag +0x10.

functions.name: Model_Attach_SetFadeRange
functions.signature: void Model_Attach_SetFadeRange(ModelAttachSlot* slot, s32 start, s32 end)
functions.summary: Sets the attachment's fade/alpha range: stores the start/end in +0x5BC/+0x5C0/+0x5C4 (keeping the previous value in +0x5B4/+0x5B8), falls back to the -1.0 constant when the end is negative, then recurses into every child of the +0x6B0 list.

functions.name: Model_SetNodeColorRecursive
functions.summary: Sets the node colour: when the node's type byte +0x5C is 1 and it has a target at +0x11C, the three floats of `rgb` are scaled by g_00225D60 and quantised into bytes +0x74/+0x75/+0x76, and the two words at +0x5E8/+0x5EC are updated. Then recurses into every child node of the list at +0x6B4.

functions.name: Model_ReleaseAnimation
functions.summary: Releases the animation resource held at +0x4F0 (when present) and resets the animation player at +0x58 to its default clip.

functions.name: Gfx_MeshObject_Init
functions.signature: void Gfx_MeshObject_Init(u32 self, int source, int descriptor)
functions.summary: Initialises a renderable mesh/scene object: copies the 5-word source transform, allocates the object through 0x002D97E8, builds its two intrusive child lists, chains the shared member initialiser and default-constructs three 0x30-byte children.

functions.name: Model_DeletingDtor
functions.signature: void Model_DeletingDtor(ModelObject* self, unsigned int vtable)
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for a 3D model object: restores vtable, unlinks four intrusive child lists, calls shared model teardown func_002650C4, and frees memory via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Model_DtorBase
functions.signature: void Model_DtorBase(ModelObject* self, unsigned int vtable)
functions.summary: In-place non-deleting destructor for a 3D model object: restores vtable, unlinks four intrusive child lists, and calls shared model teardown func_002650C4.

functions.name: maybe_Pack_DecodeResource
functions.signature: void maybe_Pack_DecodeResource(int pack, u32 offset, u32 size, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Large pack-resource decode/initialise routine (0x538 bytes): allocates through the CRT memory helpers, initialises a critical section and submits GPU commands, with the UUUU marker in the globals.

functions.name: Ui_Object_ReleaseChild
functions.summary: Destroys the optional child object stored at self+4 through its vtable slot 4 and clears the pointer; the whole body is the null guard plus that call, so every window destructor uses it to drop its one owned child.

functions.name: Os_SharedBuffer_TryBeginWrite
functions.summary: Begins writing into a shared 0x200-byte buffer under a monitor lock: succeeds only when the owner is enabled and no write is already in progress, in which case it copies the source, flips the state bytes and returns 1.

functions.name: Actor_InitBoundsCheck
functions.signature: void Actor_InitBoundsCheck(ShadowFootprint* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises the footprint/check record owned by self+0x28: copies the world flag (work+0x44) into f_49, clears f_48/f_40/f_44, takes f_2C from owner->f_2A8 when it is negative or 0x0062898C(owner) says so, copies the owner's vtable+0x88 value into f_3C when owner[0xA9] is set, and finally calls Actor_UpdateBoundsCheck.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateBoundsCheck
functions.summary: Recomputes the four corners of an actor's walkable footprint from the level cell size and the owner position, then walks each corner back toward the centre while Field2D_MapChip_CanWalkDirection reports the cell blocked.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_FollowIndexUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the follow camera: accumulates the hold timer, when it expires toggles the mirror flag through the owner's virtual +0x90 and asks maybe_Camera_FollowSelectNext for the next follow index, then compares the current grid delta (f_78/f_7C) with the target to derive a turn direction for the owner's +0xC4/+0xC8.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_FollowSelectNext
functions.summary: Moves the follow-camera selection to the next usable entry: reads the candidate table at self->f_28->f_248, clamps/wraps the index at self+0x2C according to the direction byte self+0x3C, notifies the owner through vtable +0x8C and returns whether the index changed.

functions.name: Field_NpcMoveAction_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Field_NpcMoveAction_Ctor(void* storage, void* npc, void* actionList, const char* tag, u32 slot)
functions.summary: Constructor of the NPC 'move' action object (0x54 bytes): builds the ActorAction base through Field_ActorAction_CtorBaseA, installs vtable 0x0075C378 and seeds the movement defaults (-1, copied global pair, zeroed state fields).

functions.name: Object_DtorThunkH
functions.summary: Minimal deleting destructor: runs the shared sub-object destructor 0x00193E44 and then operator delete 0x0010F6CC. The concrete class is not recoverable from this body, which is what the 'Object' wording says.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ReleaseBoundsCheck
functions.summary: Two-call body: maybe_Field_RegisterNamedActorsB(self->f_28) followed by maybe_Ui_LayoutGroup_Build(self). Both callees are themselves unproven, so neither the 'release' nor the 'bounds' part of the name can be checked.

functions.name: maybe_Model_SetNameStringVariant
functions.summary: When pending flag self+0x52 is set, selects animation name string ('Walk' or table string) based on child byte +199 and passes it to child virtual +0x84, then clears flag.

functions.name: Actor_InitStateController
functions.summary: Initialises a controller: world flag into f_51, defaults from g_002275D0 into f_34/f_38, zeros f_30/f_48/f_50/f_52, copies owner f_328/f_32C/f_330 into f_3C/f_40/f_44, then dispatches on owner byte f_C7 - 0 calls owner vtable+0x6C and installs callback g_002275D4, 1 calls vtable+0x68, installs g_002275DC and hides/resets the owner when f_260 is set - and finishes with owner->f_158 = g_002275E0.

functions.name: Actor_OnStateEvent
functions.signature: u64 Actor_OnStateEvent(ActorStateController* controller, int eventId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Event hook on the controller: event 4 raises f_30 to 1, events 1 and 2 copy the world flag (work+0x44) into f_51; anything else is ignored. Returns (eventId, controller) which is just the register pair.

functions.name: Actor_CheckInteractionRange
functions.summary: Talk-range gate of the field actor: checks the actor's interaction target is inside the summed capsule radii and the actor's facing cone, plays the idle/talk animation and accumulates the interaction timer f_38; returns 1 once the timer lies inside the actor's f_348 window.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateApproachMove
functions.summary: Per-frame movement of a scripted actor: runs the arrival check when the flag is set and notifies the field/camera plus spawns the effect, otherwise steers the actor toward the cached target with the configured speed.

functions.name: Actor_EndStateController
functions.signature: void Actor_EndStateController(ActorStateController* controller, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Tears the controller down: when owner->f_260 is set it disables the owner's camera visibility and resets ->f_B8->f_FC, then sets owner->f_158 to g_00227C50 - the mirror image of the values 0x002274B0 installs.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CreateRenderNodeD
functions.summary: Allocates and initializes derived render node variant D, linking it into actor action class registry.

functions.name: Object_DtorThunkI
functions.summary: Second minimal deleting destructor: runs the shared sub-object destructor 0x00193E44 and then operator delete 0x0010F6CC. The concrete class is not recoverable from this body.

functions.name: Actor_CheckInteractionDone
functions.summary: Reports whether an actor interaction has finished: 1 when there is no interaction or its object says 'not running', otherwise the caller-supplied timeout value stored at +0x20.

functions.name: Ui_DrawSpriteById
functions.summary: Emits one sprite draw request: builds the descriptor (white, opaque, texture resolved from the UI atlas with 0xE1 as fallback), stores the sprite id and submits it through maybe_Ui_Sprite_Draw.

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_DrawByName
functions.signature: void Ui_Sprite_DrawByName(Ui_Sprite* sprite, const char* name)
functions.summary: Resolves sprite resource by name from the global UI sprite manager singleton (0x007BE310) via func_0063D384 and submits it to generic sprite draw path func_002283FC with default flags.

functions.name: Ui_SpritePart_Create
functions.summary: Creates a sprite part for a UI object: releases any previous part at +4, allocates a 0x1E4-byte part from the UI core heap (func_003BEDFC), inserts it into the window through the core part factory 0x0021F738, marks it as sprite f_94 = 1, applies the draw mode and, when the owner has a draw descriptor f_C, fills the 0x3F2 mask/rect fields for it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SpritePart_SetParams
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SpritePart_SetParams(void* spritePart, u32 valueA, u32 valueB, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Setter on a UI sprite part: stores the two arguments in spritePart+0x38/+0x3C and then notifies the UI core with the fixed id 0x10 (0x001A1774(work+8, 0x10, 1)).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SpritePart_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame fade/timer update of a UI sprite part: re-resolves the sprite when its name changed, counts down the blink timer, fades f_24 toward -1 and hides the owner's button / clears the UI list when done.

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_Draw
functions.signature: void Ui_Sprite_Draw(Ui_Sprite* sprite, const UiDrawRecord* rec)
functions.summary: Draws one UI sprite from an explicit draw record: picks one of the sprite's three draw targets from the sprite mode and the record's flip/vis flags, applies the record, sets the scale and toggles the 2D layer, then restores it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DeactivateAttachedWidget
functions.summary: Hides the attached child widget at owner+4 (Ui_TitleWindow_SetButtonVisible(child, 0)) and clears the child's active byte +0x94. No resource is freed.

functions.name: Ui_SpritePart_CreateFromDesc
functions.summary: Second sprite-part factory: releases the old part, allocates a 0x1C8-byte part from the UI core heap, registers it through 0x0021F738, then applies the description via func_00240980/func_00240900 and the sprite setup helpers.

functions.name: Ui_TextPart_Create
functions.signature: void Ui_TextPart_Create(Ui_SpriteOwner* owner, const char* text)
functions.summary: Creates a text part for a UI object: allocates a 0x18C-byte part on the UI core heap, registers it and applies the text string through func_003E105C.

functions.name: Ui_Part_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the Ui_Part sub-object: calls the destructor body 0x00228838 (which reinstalls vtable 0x0075C3E0, releases the sprite/effect handles and destroys the embedded object at +0x2C) and then operator delete 0x0010F6CC. It is slot 1 of the very vtable 0x0075C3E0 whose slot 0 is that destructor body.

functions.name: Ui_Part_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the Ui_Part sub-object: reinstalls its own vtable 0x0075C3E0, releases the three sprite handles at +0x04/+0x08/+0x14 and the effect handle at +0x34, clears a UI flag, destroys the embedded object at +0x2C and frees the enclosing allocation (returns the adjusted pointer).

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_Create
functions.summary: Builds the skill panel: plays the 'effect0' animation sequence on seven pane groups (func_0053D604), then binds the six panes 'txt_skill', 'txt_pane', 'txt_title', 'txt_panel_r', 'txt_panel2_r' (and one more) through func_003A7420 and installs the text widget with func_003E00CC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_NotifyAfterLoop
functions.summary: Calls the notification virtual +0x2C on the widget at self->f_98. The 'eleven-step loop' in the readable C is an empty counter loop (Ghidra lost the loop body), so the only real work is the virtual call.

functions.name: Ui_PlateWidget_BindEntry
functions.summary: Binds one bag/medal entry into a plate widget: fetches the plate_base layout, writes the icon/background/text values through the Ui_TextElement helpers, maps the plate style (0..5) to a variant and flags the two side icons.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_UpdateTabVisibility
functions.summary: Shows or hides the two detail panes of the skill panel depending on the incoming UI state (states 0x13/0x14/0x15/0x16 are treated as 'list' states): it toggles the pane at +0x1124 or +0x1174 with func_003DFF34 and caches the last value per panel in g_002291CC so the switch only happens when it changes.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RowList_PopulateRows
functions.summary: Populates eleven row widgets at self+0x308 (stride 0x148) from the entry's category byte at entry+0xC: category 0 disables all rows, categories 3..6 enable the subset listed in the static index tables at 0x00729DB8/0x00729DC4/0x00729DD4/0x00729DE8 and set each row's value through 0x00647230.

functions.name: Ui_PlateWidget_BindPlateLayout
functions.signature: void Ui_PlateWidget_BindPlateLayout(UiPlateWidget* self, void* part, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Binds the 'plate_base' layout to a plate widget: stores the part/resource pointer at f_1C4, resolves the plate_base layout through the layout manager at f_A8 and stores the returned handle in part+0x9C.

functions.name: Ui_PlateWidget_Update
functions.summary: Chooses the plate layout variant from the entry id (small vs wide part at +0x1124/+0x1174), remembers the choice and then redraws the plate.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_RemapChildPointer
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Part_RemapChildPointer(UiPart* self, u32* slot, UiPartOwner* owner)
functions.summary: Remaps the pointer stored in slot[1] through the owner's virtual +0x24, with owner+0x60C temporarily pointing at that slot so the owner can see which field is being fixed up; the result is written back and the marker cleared. Nothing is moved, so the old 'MoveChildSlot' wording described the wrong operation.

functions.name: Ui_PlateWidget_InitRows
functions.summary: Registers up to six embedded plate rows from the static table at 0x00729D38: for every non-empty (id, flags) pair it links owner+offset to the matching self+offset descriptor and stores the pair.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindowCtor
functions.summary: Constructor of the large panel message window: runs the base UI-object constructor, initialises six intrusive list pairs with their shared sentinels, constructs the panel sub-object and the three-pair number window, and default-constructs the eleven 0x148-byte children.

functions.name: Ui_RowList_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for UiRowList: invokes destructor body func_002298F4 and frees instance memory via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_RowList_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the eleven-row list panel: clears the 11 x 0x148-byte row block, re-links the five intrusive list heads to empty and tears down the trailing embedded objects.

functions.name: Ui_TitlePager_SetOpen
functions.summary: Virtual +0x1C of the title pager: forwards straight to Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim, so opening/closing the pager is just the shared pane fade with no pager-specific work.

functions.name: Ui_SetTextColorTint
functions.summary: Computes and stores the text tint/colour values for a widget from its current state.

functions.name: Ui_TextBlink_Update
functions.summary: Blink timer for a small text element: counts f_98 down and, every 30 frames, flips the state byte f_94 and re-applies one of the two 0x24-byte parameter blocks at self+0x50 / self+0x74 to the widget, producing the flashing label/cursor.

functions.name: Ui_ApplyTextColor
functions.signature: void Ui_ApplyTextColor(TextWidget* self, u32 color, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Applies a text colour to a widget by setting the tint and pushing it to the widget's text layers.

functions.name: Ui_ApplyTextColorAlt
functions.signature: void Ui_ApplyTextColorAlt(TextWidget* self, u32 color, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Alternate text-colour path (different colour source lookup) that applies a tint to a widget's text layers.

functions.name: Ui_DirectionIndicator_Draw
functions.signature: void Ui_DirectionIndicator_Draw(UiDirectionIndicator* self, u32 direction, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Draws the four-way direction indicator: for each set bit of the direction mask (2/4/8/0x10) it submits the matching arrow sprite (atlas ids 0x53/0x54/0x55) at self+0x4C, then sets the text and hides the widget (f_94 = 0, f_98 = -1).

functions.name: Ui_StatusPanel_SetCharacter
functions.summary: Fills the parameter row for a character: picks the row icon from the character's status word (record+0xda) using icon id 0x38, binds 'current/max' into the three text slots, stores the value from func_0058F9E4 as the text colour and applies the tint.

functions.name: Ui_StatusPanel_SetCharacterField
functions.signature: void Ui_StatusPanel_SetCharacterField(UiStatusPanel* self, u32 charId, int field)
functions.summary: Twelve-way variant of Ui_StatusPanel_SetCharacter that shows one character parameter at a time: fields 0/2 show HP-style current/max, 1/3 show another cur/max pair, and fields 4..11 show single stats (fields 0x18/0x1a/0x1c/0x24/0x26/0x28/0x2a plus one computed value for field 0xB) with their own icon ids 0x39/0x3a..0x42/0x51/0x3d.

functions.name: Ui_StatusPanel_SetValueOnly
functions.summary: Writes a single number into the panel: slot 1 is set to the empty string, slot 2 to the value formatted with u"%d" and slot 3 to the empty string, i.e. the same three-slot layout as the 'current/max' setter without the separator.

functions.name: Ui_BindTextStrings
functions.signature: void Ui_BindTextStrings(Widget* self, u32 textId, u32 layer)
functions.summary: Binds a text string id to a specific text layer of a widget, resolving the string and storing the layer handle.

functions.name: Ui_SetupTitlePager
functions.summary: Builds a titled pager: binds the title text and the left/center/right pager number layers.

functions.name: Ui_DirectionIndicator_Update
functions.signature: void Ui_DirectionIndicator_Update(void* self, u32 direction, u32 spriteId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Front-end of the direction indicator: when any of the four direction bits is set it defers to the drawing routine, otherwise it shows the supplied sprite id in the needle pane and marks the widget idle (f_98 = -1).

functions.name: Ui_MenuWindowCtor_vt22A93C
functions.summary: Constructor stub: base-constructs through Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x0022A93C and default-constructs two 0x24-byte children at +0x4C.

functions.name: Ui_ListOwner_Dtor
functions.summary: Complete destructor of a UI list-owner object: restores the derived vtable, destroys the two embedded 0x24-byte elements at +0x4C, releases the base UI object and frees the memory.

functions.name: Ui_ListOwner_DtorBase
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the same list-owner: restores the base vtable, destroys the two 0x24-byte elements at +0x4C and releases the base UI object, leaving the deallocation to the caller.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_ReleaseEntries
functions.summary: Releases all entries in the skill panel by iterating its 52 capacity slots (0x34) and dispatching virtual +0x7C, then resetting active count self->f_14 to zero.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_RemoveEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_RemoveEntry(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Removes one entry from the skill panel: compacts the 0x34-entry id array at +0x1D0 and the parallel 0x34-word array at +0x100, rebuilds every slot label through 0x001A6680 and reselects the previous entry.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Selection_AdvanceAndClamp
functions.summary: Advances the index at self+0xB0 by one and clamps it twice: first to [0, wcslen(&self+0x184)] (the 0-terminated u16 entry array), then to 0x33 (51). The decompiled C is wrong - Ghidra decoded the wcslen call as a noreturn tail call - so the old 'TriggerCallback' name described a call that does not exist.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_SelectEntry
functions.summary: Selects one skill row: sets the 'has selection' bit on the current pane f_F8, formats the pane name 'txt_d_%d' (index+1) with func_006F0C50, asks the layout for that pane (vtable+0x2C), copies its rect into f_F4 and then hides the two detail texts f_54 and f_A4.

functions.name: Ui_Cursor_SetOpen
functions.summary: Virtual +0x18 of the cursor widget: a pure forward to Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim, i.e. the cursor shows its select pane and hides its disabled pane (or the reverse) with the standard layout fade.

functions.name: Ui_SetupCursor
functions.signature: void Ui_SetupCursor(Widget* self, int* layout, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Binds the selection cursor and its select/disabled icon states to a widget.

functions.name: Ui_ListOwner_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the UI list-owner object: builds the base UI object (Ui_Object_CtorBase), installs the class vtable and its +0x9C secondary vtable, then zeroes the two embedded sub-object blocks (0xD0 and 0x6A bytes) at +0x50 and +0x12C.

functions.name: Ui_Cursor_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the cursor widget: fixes the self-pointer at +0x4C, releases the two layout arenas at +0x9C/+0x4C and the trailing sub-object, then frees the object.

functions.name: Actor_PlayShakeAnim
functions.summary: Plays the actor's 'Shake' reaction: notifies the battle/field manager (func_0023B61C on scene work +0x48), attaches the shake effect from the manager's +0x3B4 slot with func_005F5DF8 and pushes the animation name 'Shake' to the actor's animator (vtable+0x84).

functions.name: maybe_Actor_FinishMotionIfDone
functions.summary: When the owner actor reports its motion finished (0x00669DD4), switches it back to the attract/idle animation (selection 0). Identical body to 0x001BA350.

functions.name: Actor_InitVtable
functions.summary: Installs the Actor class vtable 0x75C598 over a freshly created object descriptor (Action_CtorBase) and returns it; the minimal constructor/initialiser of the field actor base class.

functions.name: Actor_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the Actor class: runs the base teardown 0x294C88 and frees the object.

functions.name: Actor_CreateActionTable
functions.summary: Builds the complete action/command table of a field actor: mesh and equip objects, movement controllers, battle action-anim entries, cut/action records and the per-action handler records, then sorts them by priority and registers the default action. No direct caller - the table is installed by the actor class factory.

functions.name: PlayerActor2D_ResolveHandle
functions.summary: Resolves an entity handle through global table 0x007B80C0 and validates that its RTTI class inheritance chain matches g_playerActor2DClassRecord (0x007C4E3C).

functions.name: Actor_RebuildCharacterModel
functions.summary: Rebuilds an actor's character model after a character/outfit change: resolves the character table, applies the entry's size/offset to the model object f_B8, resets the transform controller f_BC and unregisters the old model id.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_OnPlayEvent
functions.summary: Event hook: forwards eventId to the children, then for event 5 on an idle actor (f_43 == 0) with f_2EC == 0 copies the global default from 0x007A3F6C into f_2F0 and sets f_2EC = 1.

functions.name: maybe_Font_QueryAtlasCellAtGridPos
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Font_QueryAtlasCellAtGridPos(void* self, const char* text, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Looks up the font-atlas cell at the sprite's 8-scaled grid position (f_78*8, f_7C*8) and queries its glyph class in the device font context at +0xF50. Returns 1; no draw call appears, so it is a query/lookup, not a glyph plot.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateModelOnStateChange
functions.summary: Per-frame model/pose refresh of the field actor: refreshes the transform (func_005F38C4) and clears the 'moving' flag f_BB when the position changed, then switches on the player-state byte (work+0x48 -> +0x281): state 3 re-resolves the current animation/character (func_0047B844), sets the animator's f_128 and re-applies the model pattern, states 4/5 check the action animation (func_00634114) and push a trail sample.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateStateSeTimerA
functions.summary: Advances an actor's state sound timer: clears the state byte f_2EC when the scene's attract/auto flags are set, and while the state is 1 or 2 decrements the integer timer at f_2F0 and plays a sound effect once it reaches zero.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateStateSeTimerB
functions.summary: Float-timer twin of 0x0022C884: same attract-flag check, but the timer is the float at state+4; while the state byte is 1 or 2 it subtracts the frame delta and plays the same sound effect when the timer reaches zero.

functions.name: Actor_PlayActionAnimation
functions.signature: u32 Actor_PlayActionAnimation(Actor* actor, u32 actionId, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Maps a field action id to its animation id and plays it: 5->0x15, 6->0x16, 0x0B->0x12, 0x0C->0x13, 0x0D->0x14, 0x0F->0x18, 0x11->0x17, 0x12->0x19, returning 0 for unknown ids; the whole mapping is skipped in the 'auto/attract' player state byte at scene work +0x27C.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ResetTrailToCurrentState
functions.summary: Builds a trail sample from the actor (0x00161E00), marks its enable byte +0x23, submits it to the trail object reached through (work+8)->f_48 via Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples, then refreshes the actor's action state.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayIdleAnimation
functions.summary: Attempts to switch the actor to idle animation (action id 6): backs up current orientation vector at actor+0x214, initiates orientation reset via func_006722FC, calls func_005E74A0(actor, 6, 1) to play idle motion, and restores original orientation if the motion request fails.

functions.name: Actor_SelectIdleAnimation
functions.summary: Picks the actor's ambient action from the current game/UI mode: mode 9 forces the 'surprised' action (id 9) and flags f_AC, otherwise the attract flag f_43 selects action 0x11 and the scene attract flag at work+0x27C selects action 5, defaulting to action 1 (idle).

functions.name: Actor_SelectIdleAnimationEx
functions.signature: void Actor_SelectIdleAnimationEx(Actor* actor, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Picks and plays one standby animation: 0x11 when actor+0x43 is set, otherwise 5 when the world byte work+0x48+0x27C is set and 1 when it is not, always through func_005E7848(actor, id, 1). Same selection shape as 0x002322AC without its trail work.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0D
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0D(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the parameters of action 0x0D (f_284..f_29C) and tries to start that action sequence; when the sequence refuses to start the previous parameter values are restored and the function returns false.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0B
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0B(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the parameters of action 0x0B (f_244..f_25C) and tries to start it, restoring the old values when the sequence is rejected.

functions.name: Actor_ApplyModelVariant
functions.summary: Switches an actor to another model variant: rebuilds the model from the character table, rebuilds the movement-command record, applies it to the player set (work+0x48) and refreshes the action state.

functions.name: Actor_TrySelectIdleAnimation
functions.signature: void Actor_TrySelectIdleAnimation(Actor* actor, u32 blend, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Tries to play the actor's idle animation by priority: action 0x11 when f_43 is set, action 5 in the 'attract' state at scene work +0x27C, action 1 otherwise.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0F
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0F(Actor* actor, const u8* params)
functions.summary: Stores the five parameters of action 0x0F (f_2C4..f_2D0) and tries to start it, restoring the previous values if the sequence is rejected.

functions.name: maybe_ActorPart_CreateNamed
functions.signature: void maybe_ActorPart_CreateNamed(Actor* actor, const char* name, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Creates a named attachment part on an actor: copies part name into descriptor and attaches sprite object.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ApplyModelPartsA
functions.summary: Applies the actor's per-state part/model set: asks ActorPart_GetPartIds for the ids of the current game mode, binds the animation if a part id is present, copies the part rect and offsets into the part record and notifies the scene when the part handle changes.

functions.name: Actor_PlayIdleAnimationForState
functions.signature: void Actor_PlayIdleAnimationForState(Actor* actor, u32 blend, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Force-plays the idle animation: action 0x11 when f_43 is set, action 5 in the attract state at +0x27C, action 1 otherwise - the func_005E7848 (play) twin of 0x0022CECC.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq11
functions.summary: Refreshes the actor transform (func_005F4E48) and tries to start action 0x11 (the 'busy/talk' idle).

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq10
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq10(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the three parameters of action 0x10 (f_2DC/f_2E0/f_2E4) and tries to start it, restoring the old values on rejection.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_CreateModelFromCharacterTable
functions.signature: void maybe_Actor_CreateModelFromCharacterTable(Actor* actor, u32 variant, u32 immediate)
functions.summary: Switches actor to another model variant: resolves model row, attaches variant instance via Model_SetMeshById, and updates model size.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0C
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0C(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the eleven parameters of action 0x0C (f_260..f_280) and tries to start it, restoring the whole block if the sequence is rejected.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq16
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq16(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the two parameters of action 0x16 (f_2D4/f_2D8) and tries to start it, restoring the old values on rejection.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ApplyModelPartsB
functions.summary: When actor+0xB8 is set, gets part ids for UI mode byte +0x281 of work+8->+0x48 (ActorPart_GetPartIds) and applies them.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_CreateModelParts
functions.signature: void maybe_Actor_CreateModelParts(Actor* actor, u32 partId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates one model part from a part descriptor: 0x00423E94/0x00423E0C/0x00423D84 fill the part object at actor->f_BC (+0x4C..+0x58), 0x00423AA0 yields an optional builder that is called with the actor's f_B0/f_B4 and f_78/f_7C transform, the new part replaces actor->f_210 and the old handle is released through 0x001C7570(world+0x54, ...).

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0A
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0A(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the parameters of action 0x0A (f_228..f_240) and tries to start it, restoring them if the sequence is rejected.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateActionState
functions.summary: Refreshes an actor's action state from the overlay state bytes at +0x27C/+0x27F/+0x281, choosing model scale/anchor values and applying them to the actor.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0E
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq0E(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the eleven parameters of action 0x0E (f_2A0..f_2C0) and tries to start it, restoring the block if the sequence refuses.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq07
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq07(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the two parameters of action 7 (f_220/f_224) and tries to start it, restoring the old values on rejection.

functions.name: Container_RemoveValueFromVector
functions.summary: Erases every occurrence of `value` from the integer vector at f_BC->f_5C..f_9C using the std::remove compaction, updates the element count at f_9C and returns the new end pointer (or 0 when there is no vector).

functions.name: maybe_ActorPart_CreateNamedB
functions.signature: void maybe_ActorPart_CreateNamedB(Actor* actor, const char* name, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Second named-part constructor variant B: copies part name into descriptor and creates actor action table entry.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_BindEntrySlots
functions.summary: Binds the overlay entry's two slot handles: when f_BC is present it calls the slot-list helper 0x004C395C and, if f_C0 is also present, re-binds f_BC with the +0x48 value of f_C0 through 0x004C397C.

functions.name: Actor_TryPlayActionSeq08
functions.signature: bool Actor_TryPlayActionSeq08(Actor* actor, const u32* params)
functions.summary: Stores the two parameters of action 8 (f_220/f_224) and tries to start it, restoring the old values on rejection.

functions.name: Actor_ReleaseModelId
functions.signature: void Actor_ReleaseModelId(Actor* actor, u32 forwarded, u32 forwarded2, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: When the actor is in the detach state (f_41) it unregisters its registered model id (f_210) from the scene's model list, clears the id and then forwards to Field_SceneObject_FreeModelAndTrail, which drops the model and its trail.

functions.name: Ui_CharacterPanel_Ctor
functions.signature: int* Ui_CharacterPanel_Ctor(void* mem, const AllocInfo* info, u32 variant, u32 charId)
functions.summary: Constructor of the 0x2F4-byte character panel element: builds the base object, installs the vtable (0x0075C5CC plus the second-base vptr at +0x1F4), initialises the colour/animation fields (0.0 blocks, 5.6, 0xFF/-1 markers), stores variant and character id and copies the character's model-variant byte.

functions.name: Actor_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for Actor: restores primary vtable 0x0075C5CC and secondary vtable (+0x84), detaches child scene objects via Field_SceneObject_SetSubObjectC0(actor, 0), executes scene node teardown func_005F52D8, and frees memory via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Model_SwitchAttachmentsByState_Show
functions.signature: void Model_SwitchAttachmentsByState_Show(Model* model, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Shows the attachment set that belongs to the current player state: it indexes the per-state attachment array at +0x244 with the player-state byte at scene work +0x281 and enables that slot (0x002219C8) when the model is not already busy (f_51 == 0).

functions.name: Model_CreateCharacterModelWithEquipment
functions.summary: Builds a complete character model: creates the render model object f_224 from the model template, attaches it to the scene node, creates and wires the weapon/accessory meshes and all attachment slots, loads the layout config, applies the character equipment and creates the effect instances for the model's part table.

functions.name: Model_AttachAccessoriesAndWeapons
functions.signature: void Model_AttachAccessoriesAndWeapons(Model* model, u32 equipSlot, u32 flags, float* transformOut)
functions.summary: Internal routine of Model_CreateCharacterModelWithEquipment: attaches weapon and accessory meshes to character model attachment slots, computes bone transform vector and configures attachment parameters at +0x58..+0x64.

functions.name: Model_SwitchAttachmentsByState_Hide
functions.signature: void Model_SwitchAttachmentsByState_Hide(Model* model, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Hides the attachment set of the current player state: indexes the per-state array at +0x244 with scene work +0x281 and disables that slot (0x0022225C).

functions.name: Actor_ResolveHandleByRtti
functions.summary: Resolves an actor or scene object handle through global handle table 0x007B80C0: checks generation counter at handle >> 11, retrieves object pointer, and validates against expected RTTI type descriptor chain.

functions.name: Model_UpdatePatternTransformA
functions.summary: Copies the model's world position and orientation into its pattern/billboard block and rebuilds the rotated pattern axes for the current game mode's attachment slot; the +0x244 slot decides whether the block is written to f_280 or f_2B0.

functions.name: Model_UpdatePatternTransform
functions.summary: Rebuilds the model's pattern transform: when the current pattern index (world+0x48+0x281) is not 0xFF and the model has that pattern slot (+0x244 + index*4) it copies f_88/f_9C..f_A4 and the rotation f_8C..f_98 into the secondary transform block (f_280, f_294..f_29C), multiplies the quaternion through 0x00573144 into f_2A0 and writes the resulting pair of transforms; without a pattern it only refreshes the base pair.

functions.name: dBc
functions.signature: void dBc(int arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: Model_SyncAttachmentVisibilityByState
functions.summary: Keeps the two attachment sets in sync with the current player state: when the state's slot exists and the state record's flag f_56 is set it shows f_160, otherwise it hides it; then it shows or hides the state slot itself depending on the f_589/f_58B visibility flags.

functions.name: Model_CreateStateEffects
functions.summary: Creates the effects attached to one player state: releases the previous handle in the per-state array at +0x420 and, when the state table has an effect id, builds and instantiates the effect request named 'N_ALL'.

functions.name: Actor_CreateBehaviourTasks
functions.summary: Builds the actor's behaviour-task chain (emote, behaviour and move tasks) from the model's task count f_40, installing each created task through Container_SlotReplace and destroying it again if the slot is already taken; finally starts the initial action with the action-sequence player.

functions.name: Actor_HandleCollisionLanding
functions.signature: void Actor_HandleCollisionLanding(Actor* self, int hitType, u32* hitRecord)
functions.summary: Landing handler for a collision hit: for hit type 4 with a flat surface it normalises the actor's velocity, compares it with the hit normal through an acos, and when the impact angle is inside the limit marks the actor as landed and remembers the surface id (no value is returned, so 'Check' was the wrong word).

functions.name: maybe_Model_UpdateNamedNodeAndId
functions.summary: Debug/validation hook: when the global switch at 0x7A3168 is on it resets the model's "N_ALL" node to the default transform and re-registers the model's two record ids; when the second switch is on it re-applies the render object at f_30C.

functions.name: Actor_PlayAnimationByState
functions.summary: Routes an animation request to the right model: when the current player state has an attachment slot and that state's flag f_5A is set it starts the action sequence on the state model (0x00223030), otherwise it sends the animation name to the shared model node (vtable+0x84); finally it forwards to the generic scene-node setter func_005F6000.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_UpdateDirectionBlend
functions.summary: Per-frame movement integrator for the scripted action ids 0x253..0x25B: blends the actor's direction vector toward the stored target, renormalises it and adds the per-frame motion scaled by an easing factor chosen by actor[0x105], then advances the motion counter and hands the transform to Gfx_Node_UpdateChildren.

functions.name: Model_CreateBillboardPart
functions.signature: void Model_CreateBillboardPart(Model* model, const void* partDesc)
functions.summary: Creates a 200x120 billboard/sprite part for the model when the descriptor's f_1F flag is set and the current model id is not registered yet: builds the sprite descriptor (0x10/0xFF colour) through the billboard descriptor helper, allocates a 0x224-byte part, registers it and applies the name strings.

functions.name: Actor_InitStateModels
functions.summary: Initialises an actor's per-state models: sets the model visibility flags, plays the initial action and creates the effect/mesh part for every state the inventory/state tables report.

functions.name: Model_SyncAllStateAttachments
functions.summary: Makes attachment visibility match the current player state byte (work+0x48 -> +0x281): in state 0 it hides every visible slot 0..0xB plus the special slot f_274, otherwise it shows only the slot for the current state, then points f_88 at the default parameter block.

functions.name: Actor_StartBehaviourState
functions.signature: void Actor_StartBehaviourState(Actor* actor, const void* stateRecord)
functions.summary: Enters actor behaviour state 2: sets the state byte f_312 to 2, copies the seven state parameters and two flag bytes, and creates the tasks/parts required by that state through Container_SlotReplace.

functions.name: Actor_ApplyStateAnimEvent
functions.signature: void Actor_ApplyStateAnimEvent(Actor* actor, const u8* record)
functions.summary: Applies an animation event to the actor: for record kind 0 it stores the eleven parameters f_3C8..f_3F0 and plays action 0x18, but only when the player is in state 2; kinds 1..3 apply only in player state 5; other kinds fall through to the generic handling.

functions.name: ModelPreview_CreateAttachments
functions.summary: Builds the attachments/effects of one model-preview slot: creates the scene-node part, wires the character model and its attachment slots, applies the layout config, spawns the preview effect and toggles the attachment visibility for the slot.

functions.name: Model_ReleaseStatePart
functions.signature: void Model_ReleaseStatePart(Model* model, int stateIndex, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Releases the render part that belongs to one player state: validates the handle stored at model+0x420+state*4 against the id registry and destroys it through func_0035FC84 on the scene's object heap.

functions.name: maybe_Model_SetTrailTarget
functions.signature: void maybe_Model_SetTrailTarget(Model* model, const float* targetPos, const float* targetDir)
functions.summary: Places a trail/ribbon anchor: stores target position and direction in model trail descriptor block.

functions.name: Actor_CreateTaskChain
functions.summary: Creates a chain of behaviour tasks for the actor (task 0x19 and following slots) with Mem_AllocAligned and a per-state factory, installing each through Container_SlotReplace and refreshing the action state.

functions.name: ModelPreview_UpdateAttachments
functions.summary: Refreshes a model preview's attachment/effect set: rebuilds the per-state parts and effects, plays the slot's animation and shows/hides the attachment slots according to the preview state.

functions.name: maybe_ModelPreview_ResetToDefaultRecord
functions.summary: Resets a preview/model slot: stops any sub-animation running on the handle at self+0x30C (vtable +0x40 with 4) and then re-applies character record 0 to the object through Actor_ApplyNameStringsFromRecord(self, 0), i.e. restores the default name/appearance block. Used when a preview is released.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ResetIdleAnimAndTrail
functions.summary: Resets actor standby state: plays idle animation 0x1B and submits trail record reset via 0x0023D60C.

functions.name: Monster_UpdateBehavior
functions.signature: void Monster_UpdateBehavior(Monster* self, int state, int mode, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Runs the monster behaviour state machine: follow/egg/bee/dragon/dulneigh/hell transitions, choosing the next action from the behaviour table and updating movement.

functions.name: Actor_TrySelectAttractAnimation
functions.signature: void Actor_TrySelectAttractAnimation(Actor* actor, u32 blend, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Try-variant of the idle-animation selection: action 0x1B when f_43 is set, otherwise action 5 when the actor's motion id (func_00669250) is 4 and the attract state at +0x27C is on, action 1 in attract mode, or action 4 in the normal field state.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateStateTimer
functions.summary: Advances the per-actor frame counter f_3FC while the world is not paused (work+0x44 clear): with f_3F4 clear it walks the counter back towards 0, otherwise it increments and, when the counter reaches 1 or 6 (depending on the pattern byte world+0x48+0x281), rewinds it to -0x18 and clears f_3F4.

functions.name: Actor_StartStateOne
functions.signature: void Actor_StartStateOne(Actor* actor, const void* record)
functions.summary: Enters actor state 1: copies 0x0D bytes of state data to f_314, creates the behaviour tasks 0x19 and 0x1A and plays action 0x19.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_SetupEventActionList
functions.summary: Event/action setup for a field actor: dispatches the model virtual +0x88, clears model+0x312 and then, when the model's action count is large, allocates and installs the emote, walk, climb and ladder action components through Container_SlotReplace.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_EndStateChainEx
functions.summary: Actor action-chain restart: if actor+0x312 is set it is cleared and, for model task type 0x1A, the actor's action slots 1 and 2 are rebuilt with freshly allocated 0x44/0x74-byte action objects.
