functions.name: maybe_Actor_EndStateChainEx_Cont
functions.summary: Interior label, not a function: the disassembly at 0x00233DBC starts with `bl 0x1E158C` and has no prologue, so it is a continuation of maybe_Actor_EndStateChainEx (0x00233BEC, which does push {r4-r8,lr}). The body is halt_baddata, so nothing more can be said.

functions.name: Actor_ResetStateModelIfCurrent
functions.signature: void Actor_ResetStateModelIfCurrent(Actor* actor, u32 arg2, int modelHandle)
functions.summary: Clears the actor's active attachment slot only when that slot holds the given model handle: refreshes the preview through ModelPreview_UpdateAttachments and resets the active slot index f_278 to 0.

functions.name: Actor_SelectAttractAnimation
functions.signature: void Actor_SelectAttractAnimation(Actor* actor, u32 blend, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Force-playing twin of 0x00233738: action 0x1B when f_43 is set, action 5 when the actor's motion id is 4 in attract mode, action 1 in attract mode, action 4 otherwise.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateFollowTarget
functions.summary: Per-frame follow update: compares the actor position with the follow target, plays the walk/run animation depending on the state flag, and clears the follow offset when the actor is inside the arrival radius.

functions.name: Actor_ResetToIdleAction
functions.summary: Resets the actor to idle action 0x1B; when the UI overlay has no active mode it applies the scene node's motion id, and when a mode is active it copies the five display strings from the mode record into the model object and clears the 0x20000000 flag.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateTrailQuad
functions.summary: Builds/updates the actor's trail quad: computes the two side vertices from the current and previous positions, expands the quad by the width factor and writes the four vertices into the trail object.

functions.name: Actor_ApplyStateAnimName
functions.summary: Installs a name/animation string on the actor: when the pattern byte (world+0x48+0x281) is non-zero it looks the record up with 0x0063D6B8 and passes the relative string at record+0x38, otherwise it passes the built-in g_00234BB8; either way through owner vtable+0x84, the slot 0x001BA510 uses for its completion callback.

functions.name: Actor_CreateTaskChainB
functions.summary: Second task-chain builder for actors: allocates and installs the state tasks (task 0x19 and the next slots) through Container_SlotReplace, then refreshes the action state and the overlay animation.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Object_EnterState4
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Object_EnterState4(GfxObject* self, const GfxTransform* xform)
functions.summary: Puts a scene object into state 4, stores the caller's transform and attaches the four state components (0x44/0x2C/0x30/0x74 bytes) via Container_SlotReplace, switching the related overlay groups off.

functions.name: maybe_ModelPreview_SelectAttachmentSlot
functions.signature: void maybe_ModelPreview_SelectAttachmentSlot(GfxSubObject* self, const u8* slot, u8 value)
functions.summary: Selects the model-preview attachment for a slot: if the slot already holds an attachment with the expected id it just refreshes it, otherwise it creates the attachment from the 12-entry constant table at 0x00726808 and records the slot index in f_278.

functions.name: ModelPreview_SelectSlot
functions.signature: void ModelPreview_SelectSlot(ModelPreview* self, const u8* sel)
functions.summary: Switches which previewing character model is shown: if slot sel[0] already holds the wanted variant (slot->f_126 == sel[1]) it just re-applies the pose, otherwise it builds the model for that slot from the 12-entry parameter table g_00235238 and records the slot in f_278.

functions.name: Actor_ApplyNameStringsFromRecord
functions.summary: Copies the five 16-byte name strings of a character record into the actor (display name, short name, ...) and pushes the first one to the view through virtual +0x84.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_SyncSlotFromHandle
functions.summary: When no display slot is active it resolves the object behind the slot's handle and, if it is an overlay element of the expected class, tells it to detach (vtable+0x3C with 4) and copies its slot id back into the slot object.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ReleaseEffectHandles
functions.summary: Release virtual of the character-model actor: while the actor is active it walks the two effect handles at +0x420/+0x424, releases each one that is still alive in the global handle table, then runs Gfx_Node_Dtor on the node.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a 2D sprite/particle object: allocates it with tag 0x20000001, installs vtable 0x002357D8 and seeds the position/velocity/scale/uv blocks from the shared constant tables at 0x002357DC..0x002357E0.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the sprite-object class: stores the class descriptor, points the embedded vtable slot self[0x88] at baseClassDesc+0xB8, releases the cached scene handle through the actor manager (work+8->f_54), then runs Field_SceneObject_Delete, the widget detach/destroy helper and the allocator free.

functions.name: Ui_OverlayManager_Reset
functions.summary: Resets the UI overlay manager at work+0x48: clears the row id/flag fields, copies the saved UI mode bytes into f_281/f_282, and (re)allocates its three work buffers (800/100/100 words) plus the 25-entry parameter table.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_ClearAll
functions.signature: void Ui_Overlay_ClearAll(UiOverlay* self, const u8* mode)
functions.summary: Full reset of the overlay manager: destroys both child sprite layers, blanks the twelve slot widgets (keeping slots 8 and 9), resets the cached per-slot ids and releases every live marker through its element's virtual release.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup
functions.signature: void Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup(UiOverlay* self, const u8* mode, const UiSlotSetup* setup)
functions.summary: Sets self+0x11 and derives visibility flags (e.g. +0x27C) from mode bytes 0..4 before applying the slot setup on the UI overlay manager.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_RefreshActorAttachments
functions.summary: Clears the overlay's animation flag f_284 and then refreshes the attach transform of every visible field actor whose type word f_30 carries the 0x20000040 attach bits, by walking the field actor list (work+8 -> +0x54) and calling maybe_Field_Actor_UpdateAttachTransform.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_RefreshSlots
functions.signature: void Ui_Overlay_RefreshSlots(UiOverlay* self, const u8* mode, const UiSlotSetup* setup)
functions.summary: After a mode change re-posts the overlay marker transform, re-triggers/shows (or resets/hides) its element classes and rebuilds the slot list from the master table (func_0066AA7C, count +0x3218).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_UpdateSlotVisibility
functions.summary: Chooses the entry's display state: mode 8 places the slot marker (0x004D78E4 on the sub-object at +0x16C plus Ui_RegisterActor), mode 9 clears self+0x280, and every other mode hit-tests the entry's cell and position against the Field2D view (0x0062F0E0/0x0062C388/0x0062C3B0/0x0062CB64/0x0062C23C) to pick state 3, else 2, which is then applied with func_005E7848(entry, state, 0).

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlot_ApplyStateChange
functions.summary: Applies a queued overlay-slot state change: for a model slot it creates/reuses the character model, copies the transform, scale and colour block from the actor and releases the old model; for the effect slot it copies the effect transform and restarts it; finally it refreshes the children and the layout.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_PlayElementSe
functions.signature: void Ui_Overlay_PlayElementSe(u32 arg1, u32 slotId, u32 seId)
functions.summary: Plays an SE on the overlay element that owns a given slot id: resolves the slot handle to the element, checks it against the accepted element classes and forwards the sound id to that element's sound component.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_TryTouchSelect
functions.summary: Touch-select step of the map overlay: bails out while a menu/mode flag is set or the overlay is not allowed to show markers, then either hit-tests the marker grid (mode 9) or projects the anchor and calls the hit function, and finally selects the marker and registers it.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_CreateSlotWidget
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Overlay_CreateSlotWidget(UiOverlay* self, u32 slotKind, u8 alpha)
functions.summary: The overlay slot widget factory: ten slot kinds each construct their own widget class and register it at self+0x50+kind*4.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_CreateAuxWidget
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Overlay_CreateAuxWidget(UiOverlay* self, const u8* slot)
functions.summary: Creates the auxiliary widget for the selected overlay slot (kinds 1..7, stored at +0x20..+0x38) from that slot's sprite record and marks the element as needing a re-place.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_ReleaseSlotObject
functions.summary: State-exit hook that detaches the field slot object held by the scene root (work+0x54) and always reports success.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ObjectManager_DetachSlotB
functions.summary: Calls Field_DetachSlotObjectB on the field object manager at (work+8)+0x54 and always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_FreeSpriteHandleB
functions.summary: Releases the slot's sprite: resolves the handle at +0x4C to a scene sprite through 0x005F2EC8 and, when it is still alive, detaches and destroys it through Ui_Widget_DetachAndDestroy on the scene's 2D root (work+0x54).

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_HideElementClass
functions.summary: Clears the overlay manager's second visibility flag and asks every registered element of one class to hide itself (the hide half of the show/hide pair).

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_ClearEntries
functions.summary: Drops every live marker: releases both handles of each of the f_278 entry records, zeroes the records, resets the marker count and releases the second child sprite.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_ResolveSlotSprite
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Overlay_ResolveSlotSprite(UiOverlaySlot* self, u32 kindA, u32 kindB, u32 id)
functions.summary: Resolves which sprite an overlay slot should show: tries the first child object (work+0x54 -> +0x1C) by id, falls back to the second child (+0x20), and records the matching kind in f_3B4 and the id in f_3B8; returns 0 when neither child knows the id.

functions.name: Party_Status_SetMemberValue
functions.signature: void Party_Status_SetMemberValue(PartyStatus* self, u32 charId, int value)
functions.summary: Sets a party member's current value (HP-style) to 'value', clamped to the maximum reported by the character record's vtable: it clears the record's 0x10 flag, calls the record setter, then refreshes that member's row (model colour/parameter block, UI event, list rebuild).

functions.name: Party_Status_RequestFieldActorRefresh
functions.summary: Marks partyStatus->u8_284 = 1, refreshes the primary field actor at (work+8)->f_54->f_1C via 0x00230A90 if present, and calls 0x003E870C(actor, resetMode) on all field actors in (work+8)->f_54 whose +0x30 flags have 0x20000040 set.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_AvoidCollision
functions.summary: Nudges a map marker out of blocked map cells: tests the four direction bits through the bitmap manager, derives a -1/+1 delta scaled by the overlay step byte (+0x27F), applies it to the marker and plays the matching move action.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_UpdateMarkerTrail
functions.summary: Updates one map-overlay marker: builds the marker rectangle (maybe_Ui_Overlay_GetMarkerRect), shifts the 16-entry position ring at +0x308/+0x30C by one, looks for an overlapping entry (maybe_Field_FindOverlapIndex) and, when found, plays the 8-way facing animation on the marker model; then copies the 0x80-byte history into +0x288.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_RegisterSceneNode
functions.summary: Resolves the scene-node handle at self+0x4C through 0x005F2EC8 and, when it yields a node, hands it to the field object manager so the node is linked into its per-class bucket and gets its vt[+0x64] callback.

functions.name: Party_Status_AddMember
functions.summary: Adds a character to the member list: ignores duplicates, resolves the record, inserts the id into the global id array (count at heap+0x27218) - appending at the end for ordinary members and keeping the front positions for special ones - creates that member's row/3-D preview, then rebuilds the list and the selection.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_AssignEntryOrder
functions.summary: Re-numbers the overlay entries: walks the 0xC-byte entries from index 1, writes a running counter into word +0x8A of each and calls 0x003E7110(element, index); the anchor entry is given order 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_SetMarkerState
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Overlay_SetMarkerState(u8* slot, u8 value, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Writes a state byte into a marker slot and applies the matching animation: the same id-range switch as 0x00239D58, resolving the model effect entry and the part attribute, with the arguments destroyed by the decompiler (unaff registers).

functions.name: Party_Status_SelectPage
functions.signature: void Party_Status_SelectPage(PartyStatus* self, const u8* sel)
functions.summary: Switches the displayed page: stores sel[0] in f_281, rebuilds the per-page model widget (ModelPreview_SelectSlot on the preview holder), rebinds the secondary panel with the new selection, then walks all 12 element handles at self+0x1c removing the ones that are no longer wanted and re-adding the selected one before marking the page and refreshing the selection.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_ApplyMarkerAnimation
functions.summary: Applies the pending animation/effect of an overlay marker: if the cached id (+0x4B32) is not 0xFFFF it switches on the id range (0x9E0/0x9D6/0x14/0x600/0x6FE/0x700), resolves the model effect entry and the part attribute, and plays the direction animation; clears the cache afterwards.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_SetStateByte
functions.summary: Stores the byte at self+0xC1C and then broadcasts message 8 to group 0 of the field object manager's object lists, i.e. stores a state and tells the field objects to refresh.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_RemoveEntry
functions.summary: Removes the marker with the given id from the overlay list: detaches its sprites, releases both handles, re-numbers the remaining markers and decrements the count.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateIdleAnimationPair
functions.summary: Updates the two actor-manager slots (work+8 -> +0x54 -> +0x1C and +0x20) with Actor_SelectAttractAnimation and Actor_PlayIdleAnimationForState and ORs their results, so a non-zero return means one of them is still animating.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ReleaseUnitHandle
functions.summary: Drops the battle unit's weak handle at +0x39C: when the generation-tagged handle still resolves and the bound object has the flags 0x20000010, it notifies it through vtable +0xB4, then clears the +0x395 flag and resets +0x39C to the empty sentinel.

functions.name: Party_Status_ResumeFieldActors
functions.summary: Marks partyStatus->u8_285 = 1, updates primary actor (work+8)->f_54->f_20 via 0x0022CB90 if non-null, and calls Field_Actor_Resume(actor, resumeMode) on every actor in (work+8)->f_54 whose +0x30 flags have 0x40000040 set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_ApplyEntryTag
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Overlay_ApplyEntryTag(UiOverlay* self, u32 id, u32 index)
functions.summary: Pushes a 0x12-byte tag record (text colour and layout fields) to the player's HUD object or to the marker with the given id, and clears it when the index is out of range.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_CheckEntryPlacement
functions.summary: Decides whether a marker entry may be placed and where: bails out when the overlay is suppressed, CanShowMarkers fails or entry+0x1C5 is set, resolves the target through Data_ResolveRecordPtrs, then walks candidate anchor offsets (anchor kinds 0/2/4/6) and rejects any that overlaps a field actor (Field_FindActorInRect) or an occupied UI cell, returning 1 only for a free position.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_SetStateByteB
functions.summary: Template copy of 0x0023A080: stores the byte at self+0xC1C and broadcasts message 8 to group 0 of the field object manager's object lists.

functions.name: maybe_Field_FindOverlapIndex
functions.summary: Walks idsA from start, skips ids also present in idsB, resolves the remaining object and, when its flag word matches mask and its condition/group reference is active, applies the attribute hook for shapeHandle; returns start+1 on the first hit.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_ApplyShapeToTarget
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_Overlay_ApplyShapeToTarget(FieldObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 geometry, u32 mask)
functions.summary: Resolves the target under the cursor through the overlay entry list (maybe_Ui_Overlay_FindTargetUnderCursor), then applies the viewport/shape attribute of the matching entry kind to the model part.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ApplyUnitPartMask
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_ApplyUnitPartMask(BattleUnit* self, u32 maskIn, u32 arg3, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Applies a part/attachment selection to a battle unit: merges the caller mask with the model flag word, probes the primary/secondary attachment tables and forwards the successful transform to the render model, otherwise falls back to the default part update.

functions.name: Party_Status_RemoveMember
functions.summary: Removes a character from the member list: finds it in the global id array, marks that entry 0xff, shifts the following ids down one slot, decrements the count and tears down the member's row.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UnitMatchesHandle
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_UnitMatchesHandle(BattleUnit* self, u32 handle, u8* other)
functions.summary: Handle/ID match test: masks the argument and self+0x39C with the same constant, compares both the masked index and the shifted generation, then compares the byte at self+0x3A0 with a byte taken from the third argument. The old 'ApplyPartMaskToModel' name came from the caller and does not fit a comparison.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UnitMatchesHandle_Cont
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_UnitMatchesHandle_Cont(BattleUnit* self, u32 handle, u8* other)
functions.summary: Continuation of 0x0023B6F4 (no prologue at this address): the masked handle comparison and the +0x3A0 byte comparison, followed by the rest of the match test. It is a separate symbol only because Ghidra split the function here.

functions.name: Party_Status_SetMemberValueByRatio
functions.signature: void Party_Status_SetMemberValueByRatio(PartyStatus* self, u32 charId, float ratio)
functions.summary: Sets a member's value to a fraction of its maximum: takes the maximum from the character record, multiplies it by the incoming float, truncates and clamps it to the maximum, and delegates to Party_Status_SetMemberValue.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetPartPairForId
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetPartPairForId(u32 arg1, u32 key, u32 value)
functions.summary: For every 3-byte entry of the sprite-set table whose key byte matches, sets two parts visible: the first entry byte's part to value and the second's to the opposite, so exactly one of the pair is shown.

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_PushSample
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Trail_PushSample(GfxTrail* self, const TrailSample* sample, int reset)
functions.summary: Shifts the 56-sample trail history (0x38 entries of 0x30 bytes) one slot, inserts new transform sample into slot 0, and submits vertex strip via 0x006F511C.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Trail_BuildRibbon
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Trail_BuildRibbon(void* self, const void* sample, const void* offset, u8 flags)
functions.summary: Builds one ribbon segment: shifts 0xEE-entry history buffer, computes perpendicular camera-facing offset, and inserts new control point.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_CanShowMarkers
functions.summary: Boolean gate for marker drawing: needs self+0x283, a world/UI context whose two header bytes are clear, an active world slot (0x1C or 0x20 depending on self+0x27C) and a mode from 0x00669250 in {1,2,9} or {1,2,4,5}; the optional flag then also requires the current child (slot+0x1C->f_312) to be clear.

functions.name: Ui_Menu_ClearMode
functions.summary: Leaves the special display mode: clears the two mode bytes at work+0x2D549 and work+0x2D54A, releases the page-1 state effect of the window's model object and clears bit 1 of the global enabled-element mask.

functions.name: Party_Status_RebuildRows
functions.summary: Rebuilds the visible member rows from the global id list in four ordered passes - ordinary members, special members, members carrying the 0x10 flag, and id 0x1C last - emitting one row per id.

functions.name: Party_Status_SetEnabled
functions.signature: void Party_Status_SetEnabled(PartyStatus* self, int enabled, int only)
functions.summary: Enables or disables the whole status display: records the state in f_27c/f_27e, tells the two child panels to open/close, mirrors the inverse into the core's global 'input consumed' byte (+0x46) and pushes the state to the model and widget objects of every visible row.

functions.name: Ui_SetModeAndNotify
functions.signature: void Ui_SetModeAndNotify(void* self, u32 mode, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Value-changed setter for the widget's mode byte: when f_27E differs from the new mode (or the pending flag f_27D is set) it stores the mode, clears the flag and asks the UI core to refresh the window's mode through maybe_Ui_Window_ReleaseChildAndRequestMode.

functions.name: Party_Status_MarkPageState
functions.summary: ORs the 3-bit state field of one party-status page into the work block at +0x274FC/+0x27500, so a page that has been shown is remembered.

functions.name: Ui_Menu_ActivatePage
functions.summary: Activates one page of a menu window: resolves the window's model object (class 0x007C4E50), asks it to create the page's attached effect (Model_CreateStateEffects) and sets the page bit in the global enabled-page mask, unless page 1 is requested while a mode is already active.

functions.name: Ui_Menu_SetMode
functions.summary: Sets the menu mode: writes mode into the save block at work+0x24A98+0x8AB2 and its inverse into work+0x2D549, repositions the element at self+0x4A3C and activates page 1 so the mode takes effect.

functions.name: Ui_Menu_DeactivatePage
functions.summary: Deactivates one page: resolves the window's model object through its handle, releases that page's state effect (Model_ReleaseStatePart) and clears the page's bit in the global enabled-element mask at work+0x2A628.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_ApplyPlacement
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Overlay_ApplyPlacement(UiOverlay* self, u32* coords, u8 flag)
functions.summary: Applies placement parameters to the overlay's sub-object at +0x16C and re-registers it: 0x004D78E4 writes the overlay mode byte to +0x45, the two coordinate words to +0x48/+0x4C and the flag byte to +0x50, then Ui_RegisterActor re-binds the sub-object under the field object manager's slot (work+8)+0x54->+0x20.

functions.name: Menu_Equip_SetMemberVisibilityFlag
functions.signature: void Menu_Equip_SetMemberVisibilityFlag(void* self, u32 memberId, u8 value)
functions.summary: Stores a flag at member record +0x12E4 and then updates the equipped-model node visibility for that member (id 0 = the player's own model, otherwise every marker whose id matches), so equipment pieces can be shown or hidden.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_ReorderLastEntry
functions.summary: Inserts the newest 0x30-byte record into its depth-sorted position: it takes the order index of the last entry and of the previous one and, when the new record sorts earlier, shifts the intervening records one slot down.

functions.name: Party_ResolveAppearanceVariantIndex
functions.summary: Resolves which 0x10-byte appearance/costume sub-record index (from 0x0063EB94(dataMgr, charaId)) currently applies to charaId, checking Hero field-scene model-set overrides, global state overrides (0x62AB04), and the party member's equipped costume index at member->u8_E5.

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples
functions.signature: void Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples(GfxTrail* self, const TrailSample* sample)
functions.summary: Collapses the whole trail onto one transform: copies the sample into all 0x39 history records and all 0x19 vertex pairs, then re-submits the strip so the ribbon degenerates to a point.

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_Smooth
functions.summary: Smooths the ribbon motion trail history by calculating weighted midpoint averages between adjacent 0x30-byte trail samples from self+0x3F7C to self+0x4A2C.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_AddActorsForMode
functions.summary: Registers the actors that should have an on-screen marker for the current mode: walks the game-work actor table (+0x27218 count, ids via func_0066B0E4), respects the per-mode limit (2 or 4 markers) and adds each enabled actor through Ui_Overlay_AddEntry.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_Update
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Overlay_Update(UiOverlay* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the overlay: advances the anchor path, resolves the element for the active slot, tests/adjusts its placement, handles the touch selection, refreshes both element classes and returns the number of live markers.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_UpdateProgressionState
functions.summary: Continuation branch of Ui_Overlay_Update (0x0023D988): queries game progression manager (+0x24A98) via 0x0066B340, evaluates quest condition, and updates overlay element visibility and placement state.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_AddEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_Overlay_AddEntry(UiOverlay* self, u32 id, u32 kind)
functions.summary: Adds a marker for the given actor id: removes a stale marker for the same id, picks the first free entry slot, creates the element with the matching sprite and registers it with the ordering pass.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_FindMarkersInRect
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Overlay_FindMarkersInRect(void* self, int primary, u32 rect, u32 rect2)
functions.summary: Asks the scene for the objects of one anchor area or rectangle: the primary anchor queries the area around the anchor position, the secondary anchor queries the anchor's child-relative rect, and the scene query result is returned.

functions.name: Ui_Map_WrapMarkerPosition
functions.summary: Wraps a marker's map cell around the map edge: a cell of -1 becomes width-1 (or 0 when it equals the width), the same for the height, and the shift is applied to the map camera before the marker rectangle is recomputed.

functions.name: Field_SceneObjectCtor_vt23EC5C
functions.summary: Constructor stub of a third field scene-object class: base-initialises through 0x004712D0, installs vtable 0x0023EC5C, seeds the two -0x800 position sentinels and default-constructs twelve 4-byte children at +0x1C.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for Ui_Overlay: invokes destructor Ui_Overlay_Dtor and deallocates instance memory via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for Ui_Overlay: installs vtable 0x0075C72C, detaches child elements, and executes chained destructors for embedded sub-objects in reverse order.

functions.name: Ui_List_SetupRows
functions.summary: Creates the ten visible row objects of a list widget, labels the first one 'display' and the rest 'list0'..'list9', and registers each row with its index.

functions.name: Ui_List_DestroyRows
functions.summary: Destroys the list widget's rows and its label node: calls the row destructor for all ten 0x410-byte rows and releases the label layout.

functions.name: Ui_List_SelectRow
functions.summary: Highlights one of the ten list rows: every row gets 1 when it is the selected index and 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Ui_Frame_SelectColor
functions.summary: Highlights exactly one of the three colour frames of the casino table: frame_green for colour 0, frame_blue for 1, frame_red for 2, by writing the +0x44 visible bit of each layout part.

functions.name: Ui_List_ApplyRowTransform
functions.signature: void Ui_List_ApplyRowTransform(UiListWidget* widget, void* rowContext, int* transformNode)
functions.summary: Virtual method in Ui_List vtable 0x0075C750 (slot +0x08): invokes child widget layout transform callback at transformNode virtual +0x24 and stores updated child coordinate into row record +0x04.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindowCtor
functions.summary: The poker-window constructor: it runs the base ctor, installs vtable 0x0023F080, chains the table ctor and default-constructs ten 0x410-byte children.

functions.name: Ui_List_ClearRows
functions.summary: Clears all ten row structures to the default row template and releases the row block array.

functions.name: Ui_PokerCards_PlayOpenAnim
functions.summary: Plays the opening animation on all five card slots of the casino poker table: loops i<5 over the 0x60-stride array at self+0x5B8 and calls Ui_PokerWindow_PlayOpenAnim on each.

functions.name: Ui_PokerTable_SetupCards
functions.summary: Builds the poker table's panes: five card parts whose names are generated by incrementing the digit string 'card0' (card0..card4), six 'null_txt_w0' value panes, four 'null_txt_h1' label panes, five 'select0' markers, plus icon_cursor_parts, icon_change and poker_txt.

functions.name: Ui_PokerCards_StopFlash
functions.summary: Deactivates the flash state on all five card slots: calls Ui_PokerWindow_PlayFlash4(slot, 0) for each of the five 0x60-stride slots at self+0x5B8; active==0 is the callee's 'deactivate parent layer, remember flash3' path.

functions.name: Ui_PokerTable_UpdateCardSlots
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the poker table: runs the stored follow-up animation of each of the five card slots (0x60-byte stride at self+0x5B8) through 0x0030412C, then calls the owner hook at self->f_98->f_2C.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindow_SetAllCardVisibility
functions.summary: Applies one visibility/face parameter to all five card slots of the poker table by calling Ui_PokerWindow_SetCardVisibility on each 0x60-byte slot.

functions.name: Ui_Frame_SelectColorAlt
functions.summary: Selects the coloured frame: looks up the frame_green/frame_blue/frame_red panes through the layout and sets bit 0 of each pane's +0x44 flag so only the pane for the requested colour is shown.

functions.name: Ui_PokerCards_ApplyRowTransform
functions.signature: void Ui_PokerCards_ApplyRowTransform(UiPokerCardsWidget* widget, void* rowContext, int* transformNode)
functions.summary: Virtual method in Ui_PokerCards vtable 0x0075C7A0 (slot +0x08): evaluates layout transform for 5-card poker card widgets by invoking transformNode virtual slot +0x24.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWindowPartCtor
functions.summary: Constructs the poker window's part object: allocates it, installs vtable 0x0075C78C, chains the three sub-object constructors (0x004A0354, 0x004066DC, 0x003B00F0, clearing the field between them) and default-constructs the five 0x60-byte card children.

functions.name: Ui_PokerTable_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the poker table widget: clears the five 0x50-byte and five 0x60-byte slot arrays, releases the trailing sub-objects and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWindow_Setup
functions.summary: Creates every pane of the casino (medal game) window by layout name: win_gold, win_casino_lineup, win_casino_param, win_casino_have, win_casion_caption, win_casino_num, win_casino_party, win_casino_dougu and win_casino_fukuro, linking each into an intrusive list.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWin_UpdateFukuroWindow
functions.summary: Refreshes the 'fukuro' (prize bag) window: when the bag has contents it switches to the bag state (0x002D9894 + activate), writes the current bag text into win_casino_fukuro and finally deactivates the pane again.

functions.name: Ui_Casino_SetRowFlagForItem
functions.summary: Reads the currently selected list entry's item id and sets the flag on the row at +0x1c58 only when the id is a normal equipment/item id (0xA4..0x9BE) or one of the four special ids 0xB19..0xB1C; otherwise clears it.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_ScrollToCursor
functions.signature: void Ui_ListWidget_ScrollToCursor(UiListWidget* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int visible)
functions.summary: Keeps the list cursor inside the six-row window: it removes the cursor pane for the old row, computes the new top row from the cursor index minus up to five rows, clamps it into 0..5 and re-selects that row before the widget redraws itself.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWin_PopWindowStack
functions.summary: Window-stack driver of the casino screen: closes every stacked pane down to the requested depth (calling each pane's close callback/gate at +0x34..+0x38), then per action pushes the lineup/param panes (1, 2) or refreshes the party and fukuro panes (3, 4).

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the casino window object: installs the class vtable, builds the embedded panel/stack/list sub-objects (func_001A66A0 x3, 0x00380164, 0x003B6590, 0x004B5538, 0x003701B4, 0x00365844, 0x00477428, 0x002D98B4) and wires their intrusive list heads.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CasinoWindow_CtorLiteralPool
functions.summary: Not code: 0x0024039C and 0x002403A0 are the two literal-pool words (0x0076B520, 0x0076B1D8) that the constructor ending at 0x00240384 loads; the first real function after them starts at 0x002403A4 (a deleting destructor). Named only so the address is covered.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for casino UI window (vtable 0x0075C7DC slot +0x04): invokes non-deleting destructor 0x002403B4 and releases memory via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the casino window: reinstalls the sub-object tables, walks the widget hierarchy releasing the embedded panes and runs the UI base destructor.

functions.name: Ui_MapWindow_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the world-map window: loads ui_map_param.bxon as a smart handle, finds the 'stamp_L' pane in the layout and builds the stamp sub-object at +0x124.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_PlaySe50WhenThrottled
functions.summary: Timed part update hook: forwards to the child object (vtable +0x2C) and, while latch f_1C4 is set, timer predicate 0x00649BFC is true and f_18C exceeds 8.0, plays SE 0x32 once and clears the latch.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_ResetSubWidget
functions.summary: Resets the list's embedded anim ref at +0x174 and sets the dirty byte at +0x1C4, which makes the list rebuild its rows on the next update.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_InitChildWindow
functions.summary: Initialises a part's child row/window at +0x124: formats it through Ui_ItemRow_Format, hides the null-button state, sets the animation reference at +0x174 to its frame, and finally calls the owner virtual +0x24. The object is the same 0x1C8-byte part built by Ui_Part_Ctor (0x00240980), not a standalone list.

functions.name: Ui_Part_ApplyRowTransform
functions.signature: void Ui_Part_ApplyRowTransform(UiPartWidget* widget, void* rowContext, int* transformNode)
functions.summary: Virtual method in Ui_Part widget vtable 0x0075C840 (slot +0x08): executes child row transform callback via transformNode virtual method +0x24.

functions.name: Ui_Part_Ctor_2
functions.summary: Constructor of the 0x1C8-byte UI part object: installs vtable 0x0075C82C, marks the two handle fields empty and constructs the embedded child window at +0x124 (Ui_QuestWindow_Ctor) and the animation-reference list at +0x50 (Ui_AnimRefList_Ctor).

functions.name: Ui_MapWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the world-map window: releases the layout arena at +0x174, destroys the base object, releases the pack handle and the trailing sub-object, then frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_SenrekiWindow_ShowPlayTime
functions.summary: Displays the global play-time counter on the records page: formats minutes into text slot 8 with u"%d" and seconds into slot 9 with u"%02d" (dividing the 60 Hz frame counter by 3600 and 60), then pushes the page's property 1 from its widget's virtual getter(0x10).

functions.name: Ui_HideButtonPane
functions.summary: Finds the layout pane named "null_btn" through the layout vtable (+0x2C) and clears its visible bit (+0x44 & 0xFE).

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemInfo_FillStats
functions.summary: Fills the item-information window of the shop: formats the party's gold (8/9 digit panes), the item's name and then thirteen stat rows (attack, defence and the other item parameters obtained from the 0x00629xxx item accessors), drawing '-' when a value is absent.

functions.name: Ui_SetupAdventureLogWindow
functions.summary: Builds the adventure-log (play record) window: creates the label/number layer pairs for play time, wins, monsters, medals, smithing, items, recipes and title.

functions.name: Ui_AdventureLogWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the adventure-log window: base-constructs through Ui_Object_CtorBase and installs the class vtable 0x0075C87C.

functions.name: Ui_AdventureLogWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the adventure-log window: releases the list label object, runs the base destructor and frees the window.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_Recreate
functions.summary: Recreates the object's renderer: unregisters the old one, allocates a fresh 0x6f4-byte renderer for the current scene mode, registers it and starts its draw path.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ResourceIcon_Update
functions.summary: State machine of a resource icon widget: waits for loading, resolves its resource handle and attaches the matching sprite/icon (199-line tail).

functions.name: Ui_Event_HandleMessage
functions.summary: Handles one UI event message: event type 5 creates/refreshes the 0x1E4-byte overlay object, types 3/4 create the 0x26C-byte object and apply its u16 payload, types 6/7/8 refresh the second overlay, anything else destroys both.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ResourceIcon_FinishLoad
functions.summary: Tail of an icon load: creates the shared 0x98-byte object, stores it in the global at 0x007BE310, resolves it through the data manager and applies it to the render object at +0x9C, then switches the icon to the finished state (+0x14 = 1, +0x18 = 8).

functions.name: Ui_MonsterBook_FillEntry
functions.summary: Builds the monster-book detail view for one monster: takes the enemy_book_rel.bxon node (index 0x413), stores its handle and creates the model pane and the data pane.

functions.name: Game_GetDisplayModeFlag
functions.summary: Returns the first byte of the game work's 2D/3D display-mode pair at work+0x27508; callers read it with the second byte at +0x27509 to choose between a sprite and a model (monster book and item candidate lists).

functions.name: Ui_MonsterBookWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the monster book (bestiary) window: installs vtable 0x0075C8E4 with all the 0xFFFF/0xFFFFF000 empty sentinels, then loads record_text.bxon (node 0x37), ui_map_param.bxon and ui_map_pack.bxon (both node 0x5AE), enemy_book.bxon (node 0x413) and enemy_book_rel.bxon, and creates the two child panels.

functions.name: Ui_MonsterBookWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the monster book window (vtable 0x0075C8E4 slot +4): runs the full release 0x00242EDC and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_MonsterBookWindow_Release
functions.summary: Complete destructor of the monster book window: unregisters the five heap children at +0x88..+0x9C, drops the five layout smart handles at +0x19..+0x21 and the handle word at +0xA4, releases the UI context's page pool (0x00626A80) and restores the list heads.

functions.name: Menu_StatusScreen_InitFaceAndCommands
functions.summary: Sets up the status screen: pushes the face-icon widget, clears the face id to 0xFFFF, fills command slots 6..9 with the texts of command ids 0x15..0x18, writes two colour/text widgets into the shared window object and fills slot 4 with the face/expression variant (0x23 or 0x25).

functions.name: Ui_FaceIcon_SetId
functions.summary: Switches the face/portrait id: when 0x006443BC() differs and 0x00241CAC(id) finds a record, it sets the two update flags (f_11C4/f_11C5) and runs the widget update on f_11B4/f_1194, calls func_00296F98(self,id), releases the current widget when the id is 0xFFFF or the record's f_224 changes, and recreates it with maybe_Ui_FaceIcon_CreateWidget.

functions.name: Ui_SenrekiMonsterList_SetupCamera
functions.signature: void Ui_SenrekiMonsterList_SetupCamera(UiSenrekiList* self, ModelView* monster, int* paneCounter)
functions.summary: Builds the 3D backdrop for the battle-history (senreki) monster list screen: finds the three monster model panes by name, computes an orthonormal camera basis from the list layout points, uploads the view/projection matrix and colours to the device and loads the three monster model files.

functions.name: Ui_FaceIcon_CreateWidget
functions.summary: Creates the sprite for a portrait/face id: resolves the id through the picture tables, allocates the 0x22c-byte sprite, builds it and stores the tagged handle in f_11d4.

functions.name: Menu_StatusScreen_EnableEffects
functions.summary: Virtual method in status screen vtable 0x0075C910 (slot +0x08): sets effect active flag at self->f_C->f_1A = 1 and clears pending flag at self->f_49 = 0.

functions.name: Ui_MonsterBook_HandleListEvent
functions.summary: Handles the monster-book face-icon event: after the standard cancel/refresh prologue it either rebuilds the full monster list (all 0x413 monster ids, sorted), or pushes the text/decoration widget for sub-state 1, posting menu events 0x26/0x27/0x28.

functions.name: Menu_StatusScreen_DispatchWidgetEvent
functions.signature: int Menu_StatusScreen_DispatchWidgetEvent(MenuStatusScreen* self, int eventType, void* eventData)
functions.summary: Virtual method in status screen vtable 0x0075C910 (slot +0x0C): tests child widget handler against FaceIcon (0x00243C84) and MonsterBook model (0x00243EEC) widgets and dispatches event to sub-widget at +0x4C or +0x54.

functions.name: Ui_MonsterBook_BuildModelList
functions.summary: Monster-book page handler: for the selected part index it walks all 0x413 monster records, collects those whose part byte matches, sorts and submits the list, then pushes the page widget. The sister of Ui_MonsterBook_HandleListEvent with a different filter.

functions.name: Ui_MonsterBook_HandleInput
functions.summary: Input/animation handler of the monster book: for page flips it plays message ids 0x23/0x25 and toggles the list state, for a model grab it toggles the rotate flag at +0x11A5 and spins the model, and otherwise it updates the model transform.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_FaceIcon_Init
functions.summary: Builds a small icon widget: obtains the base object, constructs two intrusive list heads, initialises the 2-entry 0x10-byte picture table with 0x0045CE88/0x00111384, then the last member, and returns the base-adjusted pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MonsterBookEntry_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor fragment that installs vtable 0x0075C904 on the object, validates the weak handle at +0x11D4 against the type table and allocates/constructs the embedded 0x98-byte object at the caller's slot. Ghidra loses control flow after 0x002447B8, so the tail is missing.

functions.name: Menu_StatusScreen_GetWidgetByHandler
functions.signature: void* Menu_StatusScreen_GetWidgetByHandler(MenuStatusScreen* self, void* handlerFunc, void* filterArg)
functions.summary: Resolves child sub-widget pointer inside Menu_StatusScreen matching a specific widget handler callback (returning +0x4C for FaceIcon, +0x54 for MonsterBook model).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Layout_SetCornerGradientColors
functions.signature: u64 maybe_Ui_Layout_SetCornerGradientColors(int* out, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Builds a four-part layout quad and writes its four corner colours: it binds three parts by walking the pack class-marker chain and one by the literal "res/motion/equip.bxon", allocates a 0x1348-byte block holding three 0xDC-byte sub-objects (vtable 0x007828EC), then writes the four corners through 0x0055EB00/0x0055EB60/0x0055F2E4/0x0055F344 at quad+0xB2C.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_BindModel3dBxon
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_BindModel3dBxon(UiLayoutResource* layout, void* resContext, void* outList)
functions.summary: Continuation block of Ui_Layout model resource setup (0x002448BC): validates resource count >= 0x28, calls Gfx resource loader 0x0057231C on 'res_model3d.bxon', and links the loaded 3D model resource into the layout resource node list.

functions.name: Ui_FaceIcon_FreeHandles
functions.summary: Releases the four resource handles held by the icon widget (words at +4, +0xC, +0x14, +0x1C) and clears each handle word, leaving the object reusable.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_FaceIcon_SetOnOff
functions.summary: Switches the icon's graphics node between the two literal node names s_g3085b_off and s_g3085b_off_on by calling vtable +0x70 on the render object, and caches the state in +0x18 (no-op when unchanged).

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_SetFadeColors
functions.summary: Animates a 0..1 fade value on the jackpot screen and pushes the resulting four corner colours (two sprite colours added per corner) to the screen's colour widget.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Toggle_Init
functions.summary: Builds two-state toggle icon: loads syscmn.bch, looks up node names 'g3085' and 'g3085_jp', and creates sprite.

functions.name: Ui_Toggle_FreeHandle
functions.summary: Releases the toggle icon's sprite handle back to the scene's 2D root (work+0x54, via 0x001C7570) when the handle at +0x14 is still present in the global handle table, and returns self so it can be chained in a destructor list.

functions.name: Container_Vector_Reserve
functions.summary: Reserve/shrink for a vector whose elements are 0x20 bytes: when the requested count exceeds the capacity it grows the buffer to count*1.5 elements via realloc, and when the request is at most half the capacity it halves the capacity; returns the (possibly moved) buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Toggle_UpdateAllNodes
functions.summary: Per-frame node update: takes the transform context from self->f_50's virtual +0xC, runs the node updater 0x00245C80 over the child array at +0x24 (count +0x1C) and over the twelve fixed sub-nodes at +0x30..+0x9C, then walks the auxiliary list at +0x48. The 'update all nodes' part is verified; the Ui_Toggle class is not.

functions.name: Script_Table_GetRefOrMinusOne
functions.summary: Squirrel table read that returns the stored object with its reference still held, or -1 when the key is missing; the 0x08000000 flag marks a value that must be released when its refcount drops to zero.

functions.name: Script_Vm_RegisterDefaultDelegates
functions.summary: Registers every built-in delegate of the Squirrel VM (table, array, closure, string, userdata, integer, float, userpointer, function, generator, thread, class, instance, modulo, typeof, nexti, call, cloned, newslot, delslot, tostring, newmember, inherited, constructor, ...) so scripts can use them.

functions.name: Script_Vm_InitTables
functions.summary: Initialises the VM's own tables: allocates the 0x50-byte header with three self-linked list heads, resets all statistics counters and installs the default delegate pointer.

functions.name: Script_Vm_ReleaseTables
functions.summary: Destructor of the Squirrel VM: releases every delegate slot, all hash buckets, the stack, the free-list and the shared string table, then returns the VM pointer.

functions.name: Script_HashTable_GetOrInsert
functions.signature: u32* Script_HashTable_GetOrInsert(ScriptHashTable* table, const char* key, u32 len)
functions.summary: Looks a string key up in a Squirrel hash table and inserts a new entry when it is missing, growing the bucket array when the load factor is exceeded.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_RemoveAndFree
functions.summary: Unlinks a node from a chained hash table (bucket index = node->hash & (map->bucket_mask)): decrements element count, invokes the node's virtual destructor, and deallocates node memory via 0x00147AEC.

functions.name: Save_LoadTask_Update
functions.summary: Advances the save-data load task: inspects the game work byte at +0xE3C5 (load active) and the mode byte at +0xE3C4 (0/3/4/6/7). Mode 4 hands the slot to 0x2CD6D0, mode 3 finds a slot whose state at +0xE1C0 is 2 and starts it (0x24932C), mode 6/7 calls the completion hook 0x111D0C, anything else clears the task with error 0x10000.

functions.name: Save_LoadTask_StartSlot
functions.summary: Starts loading one of the save slots: when the slot state at work+0xE1C0+slot*0xA8 is 1 (valid) it records the slot at task+8, opens the slot's data panel (Ui_DataPanel_OpenDefault) and moves the task to state 5; otherwise it sets error 0x10000 and state 1.

functions.name: Ui_BeginLoadTask
functions.signature: void Ui_BeginLoadTask(void* self, u8 mode, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Starts loading one UI element: stores the mode byte at +8, releases the previous request handle, allocates a 0x21C-byte page and opens chunk type 0xE for it, then marks the element's state byte as 6 (loading).

functions.name: maybe_Save_LoadTask_Abort
functions.summary: Load-task cancel/reset: drains the queued requests (while 0x0062F070 > 0), clears the error word f_814, asks the UI manager to begin the load again (maybe_Save_BeginLoad) and sets the task state to 1 - the same state the failed-start path uses, but without writing 0x10000.

functions.name: Save_BeginLoadRequest
functions.signature: void Save_BeginLoadRequest(u32* request, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Clears the caller's request word (+4), starts a save-data load on the shared save/UI container (Ui_UiManager_GetInstance then maybe_Save_BeginLoad) and marks the request as issued (+0 = 1).

functions.name: maybe_Save_LoadTask_ResolveObject
functions.signature: void maybe_Save_LoadTask_ResolveObject(SaveTask* task, u32 slot, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves the object that owns the requested save chunk: looks the chunk up in the type table keyed by (f_C >> 12), takes its two dwords through a virtual call, hands them plus the slot to 0x002CE5A8 and moves the task to state 7.

functions.name: Save_SaveTask_StartSlot
functions.signature: void Save_SaveTask_StartSlot(SaveTask* task, int slot, u32 data)
functions.summary: Starts writing one save slot: for slot states 1 or 4 it records the slot at task+8, opens the data panel with the given flags (maybe_Ui_DataPanel_OpenWithFlags) and sets state 2; for states 2 or 3 it only requests a reload and sets state 1; anything else fails with 0x10000 and is cleared.

functions.name: Save_ClearTask
functions.summary: Releases the file handle owned by a save/load task (returns the entry to the 0x007BA2D0 handle table when the generation matches), zeroes the task state word and sets the handle field to 'no handle'.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_BeginOpenWithRecord
functions.signature: void Ui_DataPanel_BeginOpenWithRecord(void* req, int slot, int recordId, void* flags)
functions.summary: Starts the asynchronous data-panel open with a character/item record: when the slot's loader state is free it writes the slot, captures the scene state, selects the record (or the fallback/alternate one), hands the name buffer to the manager and calls the OpenWithStrings entry; the request is left in state 2, otherwise it is flagged 0x10000 and left in state 1.

functions.name: Save_Task_DispatchStep
functions.summary: Pumps the save/load task state machine: the mode byte selects the load-task update, one of the three save-slot save starts (flag bits 2/4/8), the VM-busy wait paths or the 0x20/0x10000 flag paths, and returns 1 once the task has finished (mode 0).

functions.name: Save_SaveTask_BeginSlot
functions.signature: void Save_SaveTask_BeginSlot(SaveTask* task, int slot, int markUsed)
functions.summary: Begins writing a slot: validates that its state is 1/2/4, calls 0x2CD6A8(slot) and sets state 4; when markUsed is set it also sets the per-slot flag 0x1000/0x2000/0x4000/0x8000 according to slot 0..3, so the caller knows which slot was touched.

functions.name: Gfx_RecreateResources
functions.summary: Virtual +0x28 of the UI context: fetches the UI core and recreates the renderer resources of its +0x14 sub-object through Gfx_Resource_Recreate38, the routine that frees and rebuilds the 0x20-byte resource handle.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AdvanceChildWhenIdle
functions.summary: Vtable step of a small window: when the UI input manager's slot +0x38 is empty (no active input receiver) it asks the child at self+8 to switch to state 3 through its virtual +0x14; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SetupIconHandlesA
functions.summary: Screen setup step: asks the UI core for the five category-1 slot handles at resource size 0x0B through Ui_SmithMenu_SetAllSlotHandles, then runs the still unnamed second setter 0x00625FC0 with category 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_HandleConfirmInput
functions.summary: Confirm handler: when func_0066D0CC reports the input is valid and the child screen's +0x4C latch is set, it clears the latch, marks the controller at self+0xC (f_a4=1, f_a8=0) and sets self+0x10; always returns 1.

functions.name: Gfx_Gadget_AttachMesh
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Gadget_AttachMesh(GadgetDef* self, u32 objHandle, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves a packed object handle through the global handle table, verifies the object is of the expected class, then attaches a gadget mesh to it and remembers the handle (f_d4) and the resulting mesh id (f_d8). Returns 1 on success, 0 when the handle does not resolve.

functions.name: Gfx_Gadget_DetachMesh
functions.summary: Detaches the mesh previously attached by 0x00249550: re-resolves the stored object handle, calls func_005F7798(obj, f_d8) to remove the gadget mesh, then marks the handle field as invalid.

functions.name: Event_ReleaseCapturedObject
functions.summary: Releases the object captured in the event state: calls the captured object's vtable slot +8 (release) with the field's own address so the callee can clear it, then sets the 'released' byte at +0x3D8.

functions.name: Party_MoveEquipmentToMemberOrBag
functions.signature: void Party_MoveEquipmentToMemberOrBag(u32 arg1, int srcMemberId, int srcSlot, u32 itemId, int dstMemberId)
functions.summary: Equips itemId into slot srcSlot of the source member after unequipping whatever was there, and routes the unequipped item to the destination member, or to the bag when dstMemberId is 0xFF; it then re-adds/equips the requested item and refreshes the bag.

functions.name: Script_ResourceManager_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the script resource manager: allocates the 0x37C-byte manager and its 0x21C-byte page pool, initialises the loader with func_0056C910 and opens the two mandatory script packs script/base.pack and script/common.pack, keeping their handles at +0x2C and +0x30.

functions.name: Event_ResetState
functions.summary: Resets the event/cutscene runtime: clears both completion flags, clears the pending script contexts, drains the queued command list, runs the four sub-system resets and marks the state idle.

functions.name: Event_OnFieldEnd
functions.summary: End-of-field handler: resets the event state if the script context is no longer active and then fires the OnFieldEnd script event.

functions.name: Script_BindUiMessageNatives
functions.summary: Registers the 73 UI / message / talk natives into the Squirrel root table: window control (StartUI, EndUI, IsMenuActive, StartTutorialUI), message setup and query (ScriptMessageSetup, ScenarioMessageSetup, IEMessageSetup, MessageFunc, FukidashiMessage, SpiritMessage, DialogOpen, GetDialogResult), message arguments, quest stamps, hope/soul/yocchi selection, party talk, picture cards, the casino jackpot queries and ChangeUIMap.

functions.name: Field_GadgetList_FindOrAddByHandle
functions.summary: Finds the 16-byte gadget entry belonging to a packed object handle, or appends a new one: it scans the entries comparing the handle derived from each entry's stored resource (func_00310CE8/func_00310D30), then fills {handle, u16 slot id, byte variant, two Gfx resource handles} from the slot table and returns the entry index (count-1).

functions.name: Event_GetOrAddActorSlot
functions.summary: Returns the index of the 0x10-byte actor slot whose byte +6 equals `actorId` in the event's slot vector (f_430..f_434); if absent and the id resolves to a valid actor/object handle, pushes a new slot with both resource handles and returns its index; -1 for an unknown actor.

functions.name: Field_GadgetList_FindOrAddBySlotId
functions.summary: Same gadget-entry list as 0x0024B010 but keyed by the u16 slot id stored at entry+4: returns the existing index, or resolves the slot id to the two object handles (func_001C8EDC/func_001C8F58), acquires the matching Gfx resources, appends a new entry and returns its index. Returns -1 when the id is invalid or nothing resolves.

functions.name: Field_GadgetList_AddByActorName
functions.signature: int Field_GadgetList_AddByActorName(void* self, const char* actorName)
functions.summary: Finds the live actor whose two packed id words (+0x96 and +0x8C) match the ids hashed from the given actor name, appends a gadget entry (handle plus two resource references) for it and returns the new index, or -1 when no actor matches.

functions.name: Text_DrawToken
functions.signature: u8 Text_DrawToken(TextLayout* self, MessageToken* token, u32 arg3, int mode, u8 alpha)
functions.summary: Draws a single message token: switches on the token type byte (+8) and emits a plain text run (0), a coloured run (1/2/4), a raw text pointer (3), a sprite (5) or a model/effect (6), honouring the byte at +0x10 as the 'invert/dim' flag derived from mode/type bit 1.

functions.name: Script_CallEventHandlers
functions.signature: bool Script_CallEventHandlers(EventState* self, u32 filter, u32 call)
functions.summary: Runs the script handlers registered for an event: for every enabled record (optionally filtered by id) it pushes the arguments and calls the Squirrel closure, stopping at the first handler that asks to abort.

functions.name: Field_FindObjectByMode
functions.summary: Selects one live scene object out of the slot table: it walks slots 0x0F..0xD6, keeps only records whose flag byte is set, resolves each candidate's packed handle through the two object-handle tables (func_001C8F58/func_001C8EDC) and compares its position with a reference position taken from the object manager (+0x48 / +0x14 transforms via func_006344E0/func_0063451C), keeping the minimum squared 3D distance or the minimum 2D Manhattan distance depending on the selected type. Modes 1 and 3 skip the distance search and return a fixed/first valid handle.

functions.name: maybe_Party_MemberHasItemEquipped
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Party_MemberHasItemEquipped(u32 memberId, u32 itemId, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: If the member is active, returns 1 when one of its six equip slots (func_006292F0) holds an item whose base/variant id matches itemId through func_0066C368.

functions.name: Script_RegisterThread
functions.signature: void Script_RegisterThread(GameObject* self, u32 nameKey, u32 funcRef)
functions.summary: Adds one script thread object to the game object's thread list: builds a Squirrel reference to the closure, appends a 0x14-byte entry (vtable, key, reference, flag) to the growable array at +0x3F0, and stores the value under the given key in the VM table. This is the C++ side of the script function RegistThread().

functions.name: Script_RegisterThread_InitContext
functions.signature: void Script_RegisterThread_InitContext(ScriptThread* thread, void* arg2, void* arg3)
functions.summary: Continuation routine of Script_RegisterThread (0x0024C6B8): allocates and initializes script string context through 0x00579D98/0x006BD10C, resets thread event slots with 0x002537B0, and links into active thread registry.

functions.name: Event_FindNearestActor
functions.signature: u32 Event_FindNearestActor(u32 arg1, int* startSlot, u32 idA, int x, u32 idB, u32* slots, int count)
functions.summary: Searches the object table for the closest match: walks handles 0..0xD6 (maybe_Field_GetObjectHandleA) keeping the candidate of the requested type with the smallest squared distance to the reference point in unaff_r4/unaff_r6/lr, and also compares candidates in the given slot list by Manhattan distance of their +0x1E/+0x1F fields.

functions.name: Event_RequestInnMapJump
functions.signature: void Event_RequestInnMapJump(int self, u32 arg2, u8 * arg3)
functions.summary: Raises the 'OnInnMapJumpEvent' event: it first resets the event state when the trigger context changed and then dispatches the named event with id 0xFF.

functions.name: Event_OnCutSceneEnd
functions.summary: End-of-cutscene handler: resets the event state when the cutscene script context has finished and fires the OnCutSceneEnd script event.

functions.name: Event_OnCutSceneCommand
functions.summary: Fires the script event for one cutscene command kind, selecting the event name from a six-entry table.

functions.name: Script_BindActorNatives

functions.name: Script_NativeTable_ActorAim

functions.name: Script_NativeTable_ActorActionSeq
functions.summary: Squirrel native binding descriptor table for Actor action sequence methods: pairs native method names (ActorAdvanceActionSeq, IsEndActorActionSeq, ActorDeleteEffectActionSeq) with their C++ implementation pointers.

functions.name: Script_NativeTable_Actor2DMove
functions.summary: Squirrel native binding descriptor table for 2D Actor movement methods: pairs native method names (Actor2DMoveEx, Actor2DMoveSylviaShip) with their C++ implementation pointers.

functions.name: Script_BindNative_GetMiniGameCategoryFromGimmick
functions.summary: Registers Squirrel native method 'GetMiniGameCategoryFromGimmick' (implementation at 0x006F7338) into script table via Sq_BindNativeMethod (0x006BC528).

functions.name: Script_BindNative_GetMiniGameIDFromGimmick
functions.summary: Registers Squirrel native method 'GetMiniGameIDFromGimmick' into script table via Sq_BindNativeMethod (0x006BC528).
