functions.name: Script_BindFieldNatives
functions.summary: Registers the 41 field / world natives: map loads and jumps (LoadField, LoadBattleFunc, LoadRespawnJump, LoadCampOutMap, LoadInnMapJump, LoadDiveMapJump), background and weather control (BG3DSetVisible, BG2DSetVisible, BG3DChangeFog, SetWeather, SetScenarioWeather), time-zone and day counters, event messages, camera shake helpers, horse-race results and the random-enemy work values.

functions.name: Script_BindPlayerShopNatives
functions.summary: Registers the 13 gold / shop / party natives: inn prices, gold, the ATM (bank) menu, the 'rura' (teleport) point add/remove/reset/queries, riremito points, player appearance and equipment drawing, and GetPartyMemberMaxHP. The decompiler loses the start of several names (the string pointer is loaded just before the call), but the surviving literals pin the domain down.

functions.name: Script_BindTableSlot_GetPartyMemberMaxHP
functions.summary: Not a function: this address is the code-pointer field of the Squirrel native-binding table entry 'GetPartyMemberMaxHP'. It holds 0x006FB5F0, the native stub that the script VM calls when a .nut script invokes GetPartyMemberMaxHP. The batch scanner mistook the bytes f0 b5 for a Thumb push.

functions.name: Script_BindTableSlot_GetPlayableMemberNumber
functions.summary: Not a function: this address is the code-pointer field of the Squirrel native-binding entry 'GetPlayableMemberNumber' (inline string at 0x250644). It holds 0x006FB540, the native stub bound to that script function.

functions.name: Script_RegisterSubThread
functions.signature: void Script_RegisterSubThread(GameObject* self, u32 nameKey, u32 funcRef)
functions.summary: C++ side of the script function RegistSubThread(): appends one entry to the game object's script-thread array at +0x3F0 (growing it by doubling when full), stores the closure under nameKey in the VM table, and keeps the Squirrel reference counted so the sub-thread stays alive.

functions.name: Gfx_Effect_CreateTracked
functions.signature: int Gfx_Effect_CreateTracked(GfxEffectList* self, u32 effectId, u32 effect)
functions.summary: Creates an effect through the effect manager (Mem_AllocHandle on work+0x64), inserts the returned handle into the owner's ordered effect vector (f_760..f_768) and returns its index, or -1 when no effect manager exists.

functions.name: Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent
functions.signature: u32 Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Native function behind the Squirrel name 'ATrgMapJumpEvent': it looks the script callback up by name, pushes the map/marker arguments and invokes it, then clears the pending map-jump actor slots.

functions.name: Script_BindBattleNatives
functions.summary: Registers the 11 battle natives: GetBattleResult, the scenario-battle queries (GetScenarioBattleID, GetScenarioBattleResult, IsHalfGoldScenarioBattle), the lose/respawn helpers (DefaultBattleLoseRespawn, BattleEndToDefaultField, BattleEndToTraining), trial state and GetBattleActionCount, plus the EncountEventEx entry point that drives the battle transition.

functions.name: Script_BindGameNatives
functions.summary: Registers the 105 general game-system natives: event control (RegistThread, RegistSubThread, CatchEvent, EndEvent, ExecEventByMapJump), respawn points, game/display mode, map and area queries, scenario/quest/global flags, record counters, fades and screen effects, the whole SE/ME/BGM API, 2D effects, loading of gadgets/effects/picture cards, mini-games and GetRand.

functions.name: Field_GadgetDef_FindByName
functions.signature: GadgetDef* Field_GadgetDef_FindByName(FieldManager* self, const void* name)
functions.summary: Looks up a gadget definition by its 16-byte name in the manager's definition list; a definition that is still uninitialised (flag f_30 == 0) is initialised first (func_0030A0E0 on its part block at +0x14), then the definition pointer is returned, or 0 when no name matches.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_ClearStateFlag
functions.summary: Clears the camera's byte at +0xAD when the camera exists and that byte is set; nothing else happens.

functions.name: Event_OnTriggerCommand
functions.summary: Fires the TrgCommand script event for a field trigger; returns the script result, or 0 when the state is already busy.

functions.name: Script_LoadEventScript
functions.signature: u32 Script_LoadEventScript(EventState* self, int mode, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Loads the script/message data an event needs: pulls script_message.bxon and cs_text.bxon from the message archive, finds the .cnut script object and applies it to every actor slot according to the mode selector.

functions.name: Casino_Jackpot_UpdateCounter
functions.signature: void Casino_Jackpot_UpdateCounter(EventState* self, int from, int to, int wrap)
functions.summary: Advances a casino jackpot counter by (to - from), folds it into a 0..12 band modulo 100, and on the wrap path refreshes the jackpot history and adds 100 while the counter is still below 300.

functions.name: Event_ResetScreenFade
functions.summary: Resets the event subsystem's fade state: releases the event draw nodes at +0x950/+0x964/+0x99C and sets device+0x1204 = 1 with the colour at +0x1200 cleared.

functions.name: Script_BindCameraMovieNatives
functions.summary: Registers the 29 movie / cutscene / camera natives: movie and TCS playback state (IsMovieEnd, GetMovieFrame, TCSJump, IsTCSEnd), cut-scene load/end and next-id queries, CS and IE camera setup, camera change/shake/zoom/free-cam reset, the 2D camera variants and the debug frame counter.

functions.name: Event_Script_BindAllNatives
functions.summary: Registers all event Squirrel native function tables (UI/message, actor, battle, and camera/movie natives) onto the script VM wrapper at eventState+0x70 when eventState->f_94 is non-NULL.

functions.name: Gfx_Effect_SpawnByName
functions.signature: void Gfx_Effect_SpawnByName(int self, u32 name, int effectId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Spawns an effect instance by name: it copies the four descriptor strings, allocates a 0xDC-byte effect object, pushes it into the instance vector and stores the name and parameters.

functions.name: Event_OnQuestFlagChange
functions.signature: void Event_OnQuestFlagChange(u32 self, u32 quest, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Fires the OnQuestFlagChange script event when a quest flag is set or cleared.

functions.name: Sound_GetOrAddSlot
functions.summary: Returns a slot index for a sound effect: appends the SE id to the owner's inline handle array while it has room, otherwise scans the existing handles and reuses the first whose sound finished or became stale.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ReleaseLists
functions.summary: Bulk teardown of a large window: clears the 0x18-stride and 0xC-stride record vectors (releasing each element), frees the SMART-pointer vector at +0x298, releases the five embedded members, resets the page pool and sets the "nothing selected" sentinel 0xFF at +0x398.

functions.name: Event_FireTrgEvent
functions.summary: Fires the generic TrgEvent script event (the four-argument form of the dispatcher).

functions.name: Event_LoadScenarioPack
functions.signature: void Event_LoadScenarioPack(EventState* self, const u8* mode, const u16* ids)
functions.summary: Prepares a scenario/cutscene event: resolves the scenario pack name from the map/event id, loads 'param/scenario_cs*.pack', binds the 54 resource names into the script object and selects the event, the CS viewer or the scenario entry depending on the mode.

functions.name: Item_FindInInventory
functions.signature: void Item_FindInInventory(u32 arg1, u32 item_id, int skip_equipped, u8* out_bag, int* out_index)
functions.summary: Searches the whole bag for one item id: it walks the 31 bag containers (func_0035EB98 per bag index), compares the item's name/key with func_0066C368 and - unless skip_equipped is set - also requires func_006292A4 to report it as not equipped, returning the bag index and slot. If nothing matches it falls back to the key-item and special-item lists.

functions.name: Container_PackRefVector_Push
functions.summary: push_back for the vector of 0xC-byte records that each hold a pack handle: it appends in place or grows the buffer (doubling via 0x0025513C), moving the entries and releasing the old handles, then stores the value in the new last slot.

functions.name: Event_OnScenarioJumpInit
functions.signature: void Event_OnScenarioJumpInit(EventState* self, u32 scenario, u8* extra)
functions.summary: Resets the event state if the previous script context ended and then fires the OnScenarioJumpInit script event with the scenario id and payload.

functions.name: Script_CallBookIdCommand
functions.signature: u32 Script_CallBookIdCommand(EventState* self, u32 book, int withArg, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Runs the TrgBookIDCommand handlers: for every enabled handler it pushes the book id (and optionally an extra integer) and calls the Squirrel closure, returning 1 while a script context is still alive.

functions.name: maybe_Script_SetBookCommandParams
functions.summary: Publishes four script parameters to the running .cnut script while the script object is active (guarded by f_94), using the four pooled names g_002555E4..g_002555F0.

functions.name: Item_SelectCategory
functions.summary: Switches the item window to a category: only when no category is active yet (self->f_398 == -1) and the category is accepted by 0x00454880, it stores the category, walks the entry count and clears each entry's filter flag.

functions.name: Script_CallSelectRuraPattern
functions.summary: Runs the OnSelectRuraPattern handlers and returns the first non-0xff selection they produce, or 0xff when no handler chose a pattern.

functions.name: Event_OnFloorMapJump
functions.signature: u32 Event_OnFloorMapJump(EventState* self, u32 jump, u8* payload)
functions.summary: Fires the TrgFloorMapJumpEvent script event for a floor/map jump, after resetting the state when the previous script context has ended.

functions.name: maybe_Event_ActivateRecordHandles
functions.summary: Walks the 0x0C-byte records in [eventState->f_2F8, eventState->f_2FC), validates each record's handle at +4 through Field_HandleIsValid (which also stores the pack-table index at +8) and marks the record active (u8_02 = 1); returns 1.

functions.name: Event_NotifyScenarioFlagChanged
functions.signature: void Event_NotifyScenarioFlagChanged(EventManager* manager, int flagId, int value)
functions.summary: Second half of SetScenarioFlag: after the story flag itself was stored, tells the event/scenario manager to re-evaluate whatever depends on that flag (looks the flag record up and calls the manager's virtual notify slot with its 16-bit id).

functions.name: Event_ClearEffectsAndHandles
functions.summary: Clears the event state: maybe_Event_ClearActorSlots(), then every handle in f_760..f_764 is destroyed with 0x003DB2BC(work+0x64, handle, 0) and the vector is emptied; then every effect in f_298..f_29C with f_D8 != -1 has its gadget (hash lookup on f_D4) detached via maybe_Gfx_Gadget_DetachMeshByKey and is marked dead with f_D4 = 0xFFFFF800.

functions.name: Script_CallOnCalcScenarioProgress
functions.summary: Walks the 0x18-byte event-handler records of a field/event object, loads each referenced script and invokes the global script callback named "OnCalcScenarioProgress"; returns the callback result (0-0xFF, 0xFF = none). Used by the story-progress / adventure-log calculation.

functions.name: Script_CallSelectRiremitoUsable
functions.summary: Asks the OnSelectRiremitoUsable handlers whether the selected travel point is usable and returns 1/0 from the first handler that answers.

functions.name: Event_ClearActorSlots
functions.summary: Releases the two tagged handles held by every 0x10-byte actor slot of the event (low 6 bits of the handle tag select the record table) through the scene actor release helper, then empties the slot list by setting f_434 = f_430.

functions.name: Event_AddCommonHandler
functions.summary: Appends a handler record to the event handler vector at self+0x98, stores the literal name "common" in it and copies the event descriptor handle pair from self+0x30. Event_ApplyScenarioJumpSettings registers it while applying jump settings.

functions.name: Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand
functions.signature: u32 Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand(FieldManager* self, u32 commandName, u32 objHandle)
functions.summary: Registers the object handle in the scene gadget list (0x0024B010), stores the resulting entry index in f_948 and then fires the script trigger named 'TrgRCommand' through func_006D4588 with commandName as payload. If the manager is already shut down (f_3ac) nothing happens and 0 is returned.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_UpdateFadeAndJobs
functions.summary: Per-frame scene-flow update: polls and cancels the asynchronous jobs stored in the 0x14-byte list at +0x3F0, removes completed entries, and advances the screen-fade timer at +0x20, pushing the resulting brightness to device+0x1284 or device+0x1220 depending on the configured fade target.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_ReleaseSubObject
functions.summary: Releases one scene-flow sub-object: drops the screen-effect grain/vignette, releases the window's lists and frees the two pack handles it owns.

functions.name: Field_SceneSubObject_Ctor
functions.signature: void Field_SceneSubObject_Ctor(SceneSubObject* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor of the 0x9D4-byte scene sub-object that Field_InitSceneObjects attaches at self+0x6C: builds its empty intrusive lists, fills the -1000.0 position sentinels, resets the 0xFF slot bytes and default-constructs the two 0x38-byte entries at +0x8F4.

functions.name: Ui_Window_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (C++ D0) of the UI window class: runs the destructor body at 0x00256CD4, then tail-calls operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_Window_DestroyLists
functions.summary: Destroys a window's dynamic containers: calls the first virtual of every 0x14-byte record in the vector at +0x3F0, releases the 0xC-stride handle vector and the 0x18-stride record vector, and releases the trailing smart handles.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SetupTitleTexts
functions.summary: Sets the four title strings of a window: the title plus three translation texts, each addressed by a control id composed from self+0x10 shifted into the high half and 0..3.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ReportRecordRefCounts
functions.summary: Fills a diagnostic window for one data record: writes four labels/layers into the window's text-arg slots, counts how many of the record's embedded u16 ids exist as items (Item_GetStoragePointer on the shared table) and how many of its embedded bytes exist in the character table (func_0066B7FC on work+0x24A98), and reports found/total into four counter widgets at +0x530/+0x638/+0x848/+0x950.

functions.name: Ui_InitEmbeddedByFactory
functions.summary: Asks the widget factory (func_00382A98) for the instance and installs the vtable 0x0075C9B0 on it - the two-instruction 'construct the embedded sub-object' helper of that window class.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_UpdateTransition
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_UpdateTransition(int hostOwner, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 animArg)
functions.summary: Two-way transition step on the widget host at self+4: when the host's two timer fields +0xD58/+0xD5C differ it re-targets the embedded panes (0x0029D100, then a pane push of host+0xD80 onto host+0x13C) and sets the controller at host+0x11C to state 1/3; otherwise it starts an anim transition with ids 0x27/0x2F.

functions.name: maybe_Event_OpenRuraPatternPane
functions.summary: Handles the result of the Rura (travel) pattern selection: when Script_CallSelectRuraPattern returns anything other than 1 it builds the 0x2A page record, binds it into self+0xCC0 and pushes it into the jumon (spell) window at self+0x13C; when it returns 1 it starts the 0x27->0x31 widget transition instead.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_CtorBase
functions.summary: Base constructor of a UI window: allocates the shared 0x98-byte object, installs the base vtable, releases the mapped renderer with full alpha, then installs the derived vtable and marks the child state valid/idle. Returns self.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_ConfigureRowFromType
functions.summary: Reconfigures the list widget from the row-type bytes of the current and next row: the type of the current row selects one of five layouts (clear all rows, mode A fed with the f_24 column block, mode B fed with the f_a8 column block, type-only, or the alternate mode) while the next row's type picks the style/animation id (0x0C..0x0E) stored in the widget's f_2F4 word; the row-visible flag f_94 is set accordingly.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_SetRowFromRecord
functions.summary: Points the list widget at one row of the global record table: for a valid index it copies the row's 0x84-byte display block into the widget (func_00257DB0) and switches the widget to mode 6, while an out-of-range index clears the current-row byte, resets the row visibility (func_00463580) and tears the list down.

functions.name: Text_ExecuteCommand
functions.signature: void Text_ExecuteCommand(TextCommandState* self, u32 command, int restoreCursor)
functions.summary: Executes one text/talk control command: saves the current character, dispatches through the eight-entry handler table, refreshes the text window for commands that change the layout and restores the cursor.

functions.name: Text_CommandHandler0
functions.signature: void Text_CommandHandler0(MessageText* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handler #0 of the 8-entry message-text command table: empties the text object's control-byte vector (at +0xC) and appends control byte(s) 5.

functions.name: Text_CommandHandler7
functions.signature: void Text_CommandHandler7(MessageText* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handler #7 of the 8-entry message-text command table: empties the text object's control-byte vector (at +0xC) and appends control byte(s) 0.

functions.name: Text_SetCommandArgs
functions.signature: void Text_SetCommandArgs(TextCommandState* self, const void* args, u8 count)
functions.summary: Stores the argument block and argument count used by the next text command.

functions.name: Text_CommandHandler6
functions.signature: void Text_CommandHandler6(MessageText* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handler #6 of the 8-entry message-text command table: empties the text object's control-byte vector (at +0xC) and appends control byte(s) 3.

functions.name: Text_CommandHandler5
functions.signature: void Text_CommandHandler5(MessageText* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handler #5 of the 8-entry message-text command table: empties the text object's control-byte vector (at +0xC) and appends control byte(s) 3 then 4.

functions.name: Text_CommandHandler2
functions.signature: void Text_CommandHandler2(MessageText* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handler #2 of the 8-entry message-text command table: empties the text object's control-byte vector (at +0xC) and appends control byte(s) 1 then 4.

functions.name: Text_CommandHandler1
functions.signature: void Text_CommandHandler1(MessageText* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handler #1 of the 8-entry message-text command table: empties the text object's control-byte vector (at +0xC) and appends control byte(s) 4.

functions.name: Text_CommandHandler3
functions.signature: void Text_CommandHandler3(MessageText* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handler #3 of the 8-entry message-text command table: empties the text object's control-byte vector (at +0xC) and appends control byte(s) 1 then 2.

functions.name: Text_CommandHandler4
functions.signature: void Text_CommandHandler4(MessageText* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handler #4 of the 8-entry message-text command table: empties the text object's control-byte vector (at +0xC) and appends control byte(s) 1.

functions.name: Container_RingBuffer_Next
functions.summary: Advances a ring-buffer cursor: increments the index, wraps it to 0 at (end - begin) and invalidates the view by calling the owner's vtable +8; returns whether the index actually changed.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the scrolling list widget: zeroes the inline arrays at +9/+0x2A, stores the style (0..4), and creates the 0x31C-byte view object whose vtable depends on the style, seeding its two colour words (+0x2F4) with the 0x0C0C/0x0403 or 0x0C0C/0x0505 pair.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the scrolling list widget: unregisters the view object at +0x130 and frees the widget and its two inline arrays.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_Release
functions.summary: Partial teardown of the list widget: unregisters the view object at +0x130 without freeing the widget itself.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SetupValueText
functions.summary: Sets the single 'txt_x' label of a small value window and pushes a numeric value into its parameter slot (control id self+0x10 in the high half).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_SetChildColorFromRecord
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_SetChildColorFromRecord(UiWindow* window, u32 arg2, const u32* record)
functions.summary: Sets the colour of the window's child pane (pane id = self->f_10 << 16) from a record word: rec+4 normally, rec+0xC when the caller's Z flag is set. The flag is inherited from the caller, so this is a shared tail fragment rather than a self-contained function.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SetRecordValue
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_SetRecordValue(UiWindow* self, u32 owner, UiRecord* record)
functions.summary: Stores a two-word record into a window node and links the node into the owner's list at +0x4A8: copies record+8/+0xC into self+0x30/+0x34, points self+0x2C back at self, and does nothing for an all-zero record.

functions.name: Ui_CharaStatusWindow_FillPartyMember
functions.summary: Fills the character status panel for one party member: loads that member's icon model icon_chara_pc%d_3d.bch (member 0x1B uses model 9, the generic silhouette), writes name/level/HP/MP and the five skill rows, then the twelve numeric parameters at pane ids 0x15..0x20.

functions.name: Ui_SetupCharaStatusWindow
functions.signature: void Ui_SetupCharaStatusWindow(Window* self, int* layout, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Builds the character status window: name, level, title, experience/next-level numbers, right-hand stat rows, the character icon and weapon selection slots.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AnimRefPart_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a UI part that owns two animation-reference groups: allocates the common UI object with Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x0075CA18, sets the 0xFF byte at +0x49, constructs the sub-object at +0x13 and then two Ui_AnimRefList_Ctor lists at +0x10 and +0x50, returning the embedded part pointer (-0xAC).

functions.name: Ui_CharaStatusWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the character status window: releases the two layout arenas, the icon model (func_003A6E70) and the trailing sub-window, then frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_CharaStatusWindow_Release
functions.summary: Complete destructor matching 0x002590DC: same layout/model releases but the object itself is not freed.

functions.name: Ui_CharaStatusWindow_BindCharaPanes
functions.summary: Binds the character-icon pane of the status window: picks "chara_mask" or "chara_default" from the layout depending on bit 0x10000000 of the story/system flags at work+0x2A454, binds its animation through Ui_AnimRef_Bind and resets the anim ref, then clears bit 0 of the other pane's f_44 so only one of the two is shown.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InsertChildByVirtual
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_InsertChildByVirtual(u32* self, u32* link, u32* parent)
functions.summary: Inserts a child through the container's virtual insert at slot +0x24: parks link+4 in parent[0x183], calls the virtual with (parent, *link, self+0x98) and stores the returned handle back into *link.

functions.name: Ui_CharaStatusWindow_DeletingDtor

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_EvaluateRecipeQuery
functions.signature: int Ui_RecipeBook_EvaluateRecipeQuery(RecipeBook* self, RecipeQuery* q, void* out, int out2)
functions.summary: Evaluates a recipe/item query: gathers the registered item records into two candidate pools (owned at self+0x24, other at self+0x124), then walks the query's ~30 clause blocks and keeps only the candidates that satisfy every enabled clause (category, id range, numeric attribute range, ingredient availability, character flags...). Returns 0 when the query leaves nothing.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterByIdList
functions.summary: Narrows one candidate pool (f_24 or f_124) to the entries whose record id is the clause's first or second id, honouring the clause's match mode, rewrites the pool in place and returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_ApplyFilterClause
functions.signature: u32 Ui_RecipeBook_ApplyFilterClause(RecipeBook* self, int mode, u32 lo, u32 hi, u32 poolFlag)
functions.summary: Applies one comparison clause to a pool: mode 0 keeps the current selection, 3/6 test 'has it / lacks it' by asking func_0049ABCC, and modes 1/2/4/5/8/9 delegate to the numeric comparison helpers. Returns 1 if at least one candidate survives.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_CheckRecipeIngredients
functions.summary: Checks whether the recipe currently under the cursor can be crafted: reads the recipe's ingredient table (three {itemId, minCount, maxCount} entries) and compares each against the player's item counts, also honouring the 'already known' recipe state.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterByValueRangeA
functions.summary: Keeps the candidates whose first numeric attribute pair (vtable+0x90/+0x94) satisfies the clause's range test (func_00636EE4), rewriting the selected pool in place and returning whether it is non-empty.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterByValueRangeB
functions.summary: Identical to Ui_RecipeBook_FilterByValueRangeA except that it tests the second numeric attribute pair (vtable+0x98/+0x9C); kept as the B variant so the two attribute families stay distinguishable.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterByKnownIngredients
functions.summary: Filters a recipe list in place: keeps only recipes that match the query and reference at least one ingredient the player already knows (item flag 0x5F bit 0). Query+1 selects the source list (+0x24, marking self+0x224) and query+2 selects the 'any ingredient' variant.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterByOwnedIngredients
functions.summary: Second recipe filter pass: keeps only recipes whose referenced ingredients are actually in the bag (vtable 'owns item' slot +0xE8) and whose item record flag 0x3B is set for at least one of them.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterByRelativeValue
functions.summary: Keeps candidates whose value compares (per the clause's compare-mode byte) against twice the currently selected item's value (constant 2.0): the better-than-what-I-have filter of the recipe/equipment list.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterByCategorySet
functions.summary: Keeps candidates that are equipped/usable (f_10 != 0) and whose record kind is one of {2,3,6,0x0C,0x0D,0x10,0x1B}, i.e. the wearable/equipment category filter.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutState_InitDefaults
functions.summary: Initialises a 0x228-byte layout state block from the compiled-in template at 0x00726A10 (8 dwords), clears the two 0x100-byte candidate pools and resets the flags at +0x89/+0x225/+0x226.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BattleTargetMarker_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a battle target marker: while f_D8 is clear it advances the marker animation by f_D4 and, once the timer at +0x5C reaches +0x64, marks it finished and releases its handles.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_ApplyTrackPoseThumb
functions.summary: Thumb-compiled twin of 0x00267FF0: walks up to three animation tracks, looks the track ids up in the animation table and applies the resulting offset/rotation to the target nodes. Ghidra's signature has 7 args and many unaff_ registers, a sign of a mis-detected boundary.

functions.name: Anim_SetupNamedTrackList
functions.signature: void Anim_SetupNamedTrackList(TrackList* self, unsigned int owner, unsigned int listType, unsigned int* transforms)
functions.summary: Builds the animation-track list of a model/UI object: copies 12 transform words into self+0x28..0x54, resolves up to 10 animation names built as "<name>_s_%02d" against the model, stores their ids in a 0x18-byte array (+0xCC) and keeps a count at +0xC8.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetMarker_UpdatePositions
functions.summary: Per-frame position refresh of the battle target markers: for each of the first two 0x18-byte marker entries it looks up the tracked target object by handle, copies the target's world position into object+0x9c and the rotated offset into object+0xc0 via Gfx_EffectPart_SetDirection, and clears f_d9 when a marker handle is still live. The decompiler dropped the argument of the leading maybe_Ui_BattleTargetMarker_Update(0x00267BC4) call.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_ApplyTrackPose
functions.summary: Applies the stored animation tracks: for each track id it fetches the 0x60-byte animation record and writes the record's position into the target object, then applies the transform and clears the needs-update byte.

functions.name: maybe_Model_GetInstanceBase
functions.summary: Tiny accessor: calls 0x001CF7F8 and returns the result minus 8, i.e. the base of an embedded instance header. 0x001CF7F8 is still unnamed, so the -8 could be a base or a container offset.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetMarker_ReleaseAll
functions.signature: void Ui_BattleTargetMarker_ReleaseAll(MarkerSet* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Releases every target marker: calls the marker object's release slot (+0x40 with 4), invalidates the stored handles, destroys the entry array and finally destroys the intrusive list at self+8. 18 call sites (all battle teardown paths).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BattleTargetMarker_CreateFromModelRecord
functions.summary: Reads model record 0x0063DF9C(manager, id), stores its f_C4 as the effect type in self+0xD0 and, for each 0x18-byte entry in self->f_CC, resolves the unit slot and creates the effect instance.

functions.name: Container_FindObjectByTypeIdK
functions.signature: u32 Container_FindObjectByTypeIdK(Container* self, u32 typeId, u32* out, u32 hash)
functions.summary: Type-id hash lookup in the object container: hashes the id into the bucket table, walks the collision chain calling each object's virtual +0, and when the type matches stores the id into out[] and dispatches the object's virtual +0x3C with selector 4.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetMarker_CreateFromCurrentModel
functions.summary: Spawns the battle target markers for the currently active actor: takes the actor's model id, and for every marker record resolves its locator, fills the effect descriptor (position from the locator, default basis vectors) and asks Effect_FindOrCreateInstance for the slot effect.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetMarker_CreateFromModelId
functions.summary: Sets the target-marker effect type from a model id (0xFFFF leaves it unchanged) and recreates every marker instance with it, positioning each at its stored slot transform.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ObjectWithDefaults_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a 0xF0-byte render/animation object: default-constructs two 0x14-byte entries at +0x50 and seeds the defaults (0 at +0x38, -1 at +0x40, 0xFFFF at +0x78, literal floats at +0x3C/+0x7C).

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetMarker_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the battle target-marker set: releases every marker effect (Ui_BattleTargetMarker_ReleaseAll), destroys the embedded anim model instance at self+8 and the 20-entry two-word array at self+0x58, then returns self unchanged (the caller frees it).

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_CreateLayout
functions.summary: Creates the four enemy-target panes and their HP/MP sub-windows ('win_target1..4', 'win_hpmp1..4'), the result window, the state label, the two battle backgrounds and the key icon, then hooks up their pane bindings.

functions.name: Ui_TargetWindow_SetSlotCharacter
functions.signature: void Ui_TargetWindow_SetSlotCharacter(TargetWindow* self, int clearFirst, u32 characterId, u32 slotIndex)
functions.summary: Sets the character shown in target slot slotIndex (0..3) of the four 0x470-byte slots through Ui_StatusWindow_SetCharacter(self + slotIndex*0x470 + 0x154, characterId, 0, work+0x432C). When clearFirst is 0 it also resets slot 0 to 0xFF with a fade-out before fading the widget back in.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_RefreshAllTargets
functions.summary: Refreshes all four target slots from the party list: for i<4 it takes 0x002AB62C(world+0x5C+0x4254, i) and, when that unit exists, calls maybe_Ui_StatusWindow_SetCharacter(self+i*0x470+0x154, unit->f_768, unit, work+0x432C) and fades the slot in (0x0029126C(...,1)).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_Init
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_Init(TargetWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Initialises the four target panes and shared state label of the battle target window: resets cursors, clears the pane widgets, formats the state text and resets the shown targets in normal mode.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_InitEntry2
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_InitEntry2(TargetWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Secondary entry point inside the battle target-window initialiser 0x00269200 (Ghidra status covered_by): the index gives it 540 bytes but no decompiled body of its own, so the name is inherited from the container and cannot be checked.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_SetStateVisible
functions.summary: Shows or hides the shared state label (self+0x158). Small helper used by every state transition of the target window.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_Hide
functions.summary: Closes the target window if it is open (battle state byte self+0x34d0 non-zero): hides the state label and then the whole window object at self+0x1314.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_HideAlt
functions.summary: Second copy of the battle target window's hide routine: when the window is shown it sets it invisible and releases the 0x1314 layout object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_ScrollPage
functions.summary: Page-cursor handler for the battle target window: counts the party list plus the four enemy page lists, wraps the cursor to the last page when page+delta would go below zero, refreshes the pager through func_0043F200 and re-enables the text items.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_SetPage
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_BattleTargetWindow_SetPage(u32 self, u32 current, u32 total, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Small pager helper: forwards the current page, the total and self to the shared pager func_0043F200 and commits the result through Ui_TextLayer_UpdateEnabledItems.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_ScrollToActor
functions.summary: Jumps the battle target window's page to the page containing the current actor and rebuilds that page's state text; used when a new action starts.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_SetStateHidden
functions.summary: Hides the battle target window: loops over the four rows hiding both sub-widgets of each through the flag setter 0x0029126C, clears the row's visible bit, hides the stat-compare panel at +0x1314, calls Ui_BattleTargetWindow_SetStateVisible(self, 0), hides +0x1360 and finally marks the state byte +0x34D0 = 1.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_CloseIfNotEnemyTurn
functions.signature: void Ui_BattleTargetWindow_CloseIfNotEnemyTurn(TargetWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Closes the target window unless the battle is in the enemy-turn state (+0x34D0 == 2), in which case it stays open while the enemies act.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSubObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a Gfx scene sub-object: installs its vtable, sets up two empty intrusive lists, constructs the embedded render-object member at +0x138 and default-constructs the 4 render entries (0x470 bytes each) that follow it.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the battle target window: runs the non-deleting destructor Ui_BattleTargetWindow_Dtor (0x00269DF8) and then frees the object through operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor: installs the class vtable, destroys the embedded 4x2 sub-widgets through Ui_Widget_ReleaseSub, unlinks the five intrusive lists and tears down the nested page/state objects before the base destructor.

functions.name: BattleAi_EvaluateTacticShowNoMercy
functions.summary: Battle AI tactic evaluator: implements 'Show No Mercy' tactic, prioritising highest damage skills/spells.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_GatherElementList
functions.summary: Fills the 16-entry working table at self+0x9bd0 with the registered elements that are enabled and still alive, and returns how many were stored.

functions.name: BattleAi_FilterCandidatesByTargetState
functions.summary: Filters AI action candidates by target condition (e.g. removes sleep on already-sleeping targets).

functions.name: BattleAi_ExecuteTacticsDecision
functions.summary: Master party tactics decision dispatcher: switches over tactics 0..6 to evaluate candidate actions for party member.

functions.name: BattleAi_EvaluateTacticFightWisely
functions.summary: Battle AI tactic evaluator: implements 'Fight Wisely' tactic, balancing offense, buffing, and emergency healing.

functions.name: BattleAi_SelectActionForCurrentActor
functions.summary: Selects best action candidate for the actor currently taking their turn.

functions.name: BattleAi_ChooseActionSlot
functions.signature: int BattleAi_ChooseActionSlot(void* aiCtx, void* targetCtx, int isPrimary)
functions.summary: Chooses one of the six action slots of the current actor's tactics plan: collects the six slot weights from the tactics-weight table indexed by aiCtx+0xC, drops empty/excluded slots and then picks by weight (modes 0..6), by rotating index (7), by a rotating two-slot window (8) or by lowest non-empty slot (9); returns the chosen slot index.

functions.name: BattleAi_PopulateActionCandidates
functions.summary: Populates the candidate pool with all available spells, skills, and inventory items for current actor.

functions.name: BattleAi_RollCandidateWeight
functions.summary: Rolls a random weight value using battle RNG to pick among scored action candidates.

functions.name: BattleAi_SelectBestAttackAction
functions.signature: int BattleAi_SelectBestAttackAction(void* self, void* outDecision, u32 filterFlags, u32 mpReserveMode)
functions.summary: Evaluates and sorts candidate actions across up to 16 target-unit buckets (stride 0x9BC), compares top candidates against basic-attack damage (bucket->f_14), and commits the best offensive attack, skill, spell, or item action (returning 2, 4, 5, 6, or 0).

functions.name: BattleAi_CheckAnyTargetHasCondition
functions.signature: u32 BattleAi_CheckAnyTargetHasCondition(void* aiCtx, void* targetGroup, int mode, u32 count)
functions.summary: Checks if any target unit in group array has status condition 0x68 via target->vt[+0xE8](0x68); returns 1 if found, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: BattleAi_BuildCandidateList
functions.summary: Constructs the list of eligible targets and candidate actions for AI evaluation.

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_BuildCandidateList_Cont
functions.summary: Interior label of BattleAi_BuildCandidateList (0x0026E56C), not a function: the fragment walks the actor's inventory items, resolves each through the data manager and adds the usable ones as AI candidates. The old 'PopulateItemActions' name described the fragment's role but presented it as a separate function.

functions.name: BattleAi_ExecuteDefaultTactic
functions.summary: Default fallback tactic evaluator when no specific tactic matches.

functions.name: BattleAi_AppendCandidateIfValid
functions.summary: Appends an action candidate to the candidate list if MP cost and conditions are met.

functions.name: BattleAi_EvaluateSpellAndSkillScores
functions.summary: Scores spell and skill candidates based on expected damage/healing vs target status.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_CollectMatchingElements
functions.signature: int Ui_TextLayout_CollectMatchingElements(TextLayout* self, int** out, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Collects the battle elements that belong to the currently referenced object: walks the four unit lists (work+0x5C+0x4298, stride 0x1C) and the party list (work+0x4260), keeps the elements accepted by func_0049ABCC and writes their pointers to out, returning how many were collected.

functions.name: BattleAi_CheckActorSkillUsable
functions.summary: Checks if actor has sufficient MP and is not prevented by status ailments from using skill.

functions.name: BattleAi_AppendCandidateFromSkill
functions.summary: Creates and adds an action candidate from a known skill ID.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_AnyRowItemHasFlag14FAnd18F
functions.summary: Scans up to 16 layout rows and their 0x12-byte sub-entries, returning 1 when a resolved record has a non-zero byte at +0x18F and the state byte +0x14F equal to 1.

functions.name: BattleAi_AppendCandidateFromItem
functions.summary: Creates and appends an action candidate in BattleAi from an equipped or bag combat item, checking offensive skill record 0x0063D018.

functions.name: BattleAi_CommitChosenAction
functions.summary: Commits the highest-scoring AI action candidate to the battle turn command buffer.

functions.name: BattleAi_ScoreCandidateDamage
functions.signature: int BattleAi_ScoreCandidateDamage(void* aiCtx, void* candidate, void* target)
functions.summary: Scores offensive candidate by estimated damage against target HP and resistance.

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_AppendCandidateFromSpell
functions.summary: Creates and evaluates an action candidate in BattleAi from known spell ID.

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_AppendCandidateFromSpell_Cont
functions.summary: Interior label of 0x002710A8 (maybe_BattleAi_AppendCandidateFromSpell): the fragment evaluates a party member status byte and appends candidate rows. Ghidra split the function here and the fragment decodes to bad instructions.

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_BuildCandidateAction
functions.signature: int maybe_BattleAi_BuildCandidateAction(BattleAiContext* self, u32 index, u32 category, int listBase, int** outList)
functions.summary: Battle-AI candidate scoring step: rolls candidate weights, builds the message/estimation rows for a party member (Text_BuildRowForMember, Battle_Message_ApplyRowLayout) and returns the action kind of the winning candidate (4 skill, 5 spell, 6 item).

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_ScoreSpellCandidate
functions.signature: int maybe_BattleAi_ScoreSpellCandidate(void* aiCtx, int spellId, void* target)
functions.summary: Scores a spell candidate for the party AI: evaluates the spell's category and the target's weaknesses/resistances and returns the utility score used by the candidate list.

functions.name: BattleAi_PickRandomFilteredAction
functions.signature: int BattleAi_PickRandomFilteredAction(void* self, int filterCategory, void* outDecision)
functions.summary: Filters scored BattleAi action candidates for filterCategory via 0x0027240C (falling back 6->3, 7->4, 8->5 if empty), picks one uniformly via BattleScene RNG (+0x4218), populates *outDecision, and returns action kind 4 (skill), 5 (spell), 6 (item), or 0 (none).

functions.name: BattleAi_PickWeightedActionCandidate
functions.summary: Selects one action candidate using weighted random selection among top scoring options.

functions.name: BattleAi_ScoreCandidateHealing
functions.signature: int BattleAi_ScoreCandidateHealing(void* aiCtx, void* candidate, void* ally)
functions.summary: Scores curative candidate by amount of missing HP on ally and severity of status ailments.

functions.name: BattleAi_SelectBestCandidateFromAllCategories
functions.summary: Compares top candidates across physical, magical, buff, and item categories to pick the winner.

functions.name: BattleAi_FilterUsableCandidates
functions.summary: Eliminates candidates that cannot be executed due to silenced, paralyzed, or out-of-MP states.

functions.name: BattleAi_AppendStatusCandidates
functions.signature: void BattleAi_AppendStatusCandidates(void* aiCtx, u32* outCandidates, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Collects up to 16 units matching each status in the table at 0x00726A54, sorts them by the random key 0x0066F9A4 and feeds each sorted group to BattleAi_AppendCandidateIfValid, trying status slots 0..9 until a candidate is accepted.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_MeasureElementWidth
functions.signature: int Ui_TextLayout_MeasureElementWidth(UiTextLayout* self, u32 elementId, u32 index)
functions.summary: Returns the pixel width an element needs: builds the measure parameter block and calls the glyph-measure helpers once per sub-count of the record (f_df5+1 and f_df6+1 times, the second loop only when the optional list is active), summing the resulting short advances; the whole result is tripled when the owner reports mode 0xa0.

functions.name: BattleAi_EvaluateActionsMultiPass
functions.signature: u32 BattleAi_EvaluateActionsMultiPass(void* self, u32 passMask, int arg3)
functions.summary: Master multi-pass BattleAi action evaluator: scores party member spells (40), skills (60), and items (24) across 16 target-unit buckets.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_BeginLayout
functions.signature: u64 Ui_TextLayout_BeginLayout(TextLayout* self, LayoutCtx* ctx, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Starts a layout pass: uses the forced re-layout dispatcher when the style object is idle, otherwise the current-actor layout; returns the style object and the result code.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_ComparePriority
functions.summary: Sorting predicate for UI layout elements: compares elements by virtual priority method at +0x90, breaking ties using secondary index at +0x08.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_CompareSlotIndex
functions.signature: int Ui_LayoutElement_CompareSlotIndex(short* slotA, short* slotB, void* arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Sorting comparator for UI layout slot indices: compares 16-bit slot identifiers at offset +0x02 and +0x1E, breaking ties using tertiary index at +0x08.

functions.name: BattleAi_SelectBestTargetBucket
functions.signature: void BattleAi_SelectBestTargetBucket(void* outTargetAndMetric, void* self, int bucketCount)
functions.summary: Evaluates basic-attack damage across target buckets in BattleAi; expands whip/boomerang targets and outputs best target unit and kill metric.

functions.summary: Appends a fixed four-byte control/separator descriptor {2, variant, 0, 0} to the layout when the current element id resolves to a record; the variant becomes 2 or 3 for element kinds 0x13/0x0F without a record.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_CheckSlotsFit
functions.signature: u32 Ui_TextLayout_CheckSlotsFit(TextLayout* self, LayoutCtx* ctx, int minElements)

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_InitStyleFromOwner
functions.signature: void Ui_TextLayout_InitStyleFromOwner(TextLayout* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)

functions.name: BattleAi_EvaluateTacticMixItUp
functions.summary: Battle AI tactic evaluator: implements 'Mix It Up' tactic, favouring debuffs, status effects, and versatile skills.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_LayoutMode7
functions.summary: Layout strategy 7: clears the record buffer, then tries the single-line fit and the all-sources pass with category 7 (used by the multi-line message styles).

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_LayoutMode0
functions.signature: int Ui_TextLayout_LayoutMode0(TextLayout* self, LayoutCtx* ctx, int relayout)
functions.summary: Layout strategy 0 ('list/menu' style): clears the table, builds the element list, tries the single-line fit and the all-sources pass, then falls back to the row pass; dispatch target of case 0.

functions.name: BattleAi_EvaluateTacticDontUseMp
functions.summary: Battle AI tactic evaluator: implements 'Don't Use MP' tactic, restricting selection to regular attack and 0-MP skills.

functions.name: BattleAi_EvaluateHealingAction
functions.summary: Evaluates emergency healing response when party members fall below critical HP thresholds.

functions.name: BattleAi_EvaluateTacticFollowOrders

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_Ctor

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_InvokeVirtual138
functions.summary: Thunk that calls the object's virtual slot +0x138 and returns 0; called from maybe_Actor_HasSpecialModelPart and maybe_Actor_QueryInteraction, so the receiver is an actor-side object, not a UI object.

functions.name: BattleUnit_GetLinkedModelByIndex

functions.name: maybe_Model_RandomizeEquipSlots
functions.signature: u16 maybe_Model_RandomizeEquipSlots(Model* self, u32 request, int variant)

functions.name: Item_CheckBagAcquire
functions.signature: int Item_CheckBagAcquire(ItemBag* self, unsigned short itemId, unsigned short* outId, int resolveTransform)

functions.name: Actor_AnimEvent_EnableSlotFlag
functions.summary: Enables an animation event slot flag on an actor: calls virtual slot method at +0x120 and sets active state byte at actor + slotIndex + 0x5E0 = 1.

functions.name: maybe_Item_HasAnyWithFlag39
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the bag owns at least one entry (vtable +0xE8) whose record from func_0063E05C has byte 0x39 set; scans ids 0..0x120.

functions.name: maybe_Model_SetSlotState
functions.signature: void maybe_Model_SetSlotState(void* model, u32 slotId, int state)

functions.name: Actor_ResetModelSlots
functions.summary: Resets all of the actor's model-slot state: clears the 0x5e0 flag array and the 0x124 model array, sets every one of the ten slot descriptors to the 'empty' id (0xffff) and clears the per-slot handles.

functions.name: Actor_LinkToParentList
functions.signature: void Actor_LinkToParentList(Model* self, Model* parent, u32 id, int arg4)

functions.name: Actor_AnimEvent_ActivateSlot
functions.summary: Activates specific actor animation event triggers: tests slot state via virtual method +0xE8 and executes event transition via virtual method +0x128 for slots 6, 7, 10, etc.

functions.name: Actor_AnimEvent_EnablePairedSlots

functions.summary: Party-panel member-slot handler with two paths: with flag 0x102 it commits the current value (0x004F8C34, now Battle_Ui_RefreshPartyNameLines) into the slot array at self+f_10A*8+0x409; with flag 4 it backs out one slot, decrementing f_10A, or cancels the window at index 0.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_SetStateFromMemberAvailability
functions.summary: Asks Ui_PartyPanel_AllMembersUnavailable whether any usable member is left and pushes controller state 2 (normal advance) or 9 (abort) into the window state controller at self+0x138.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_CheckMembersReady
functions.summary: Counts the battle party members whose actor object is available and idle and, if the counts allow it, continues the panel with the confirm message args and state 8; otherwise it refreshes the window.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ShowSingleText
functions.summary: Opens the message window on one fixed text: clears the list pane at +0x204, adds id 0x8B8 or 0x8B9 depending on a global flag bit, requests window state 0x11 and finishes the pane setup.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_ConfirmAndAdvance
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_ConfirmAndAdvance(void* self, int arg2, int arg3, void* ctxOut)
functions.summary: Confirm handler of the party panel: when the panel is visible, the game work is live and the confirm flag is set it requests state 0x13 and hides the panel; otherwise it asks the member list whether the selected member is unavailable and commits the selected command.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_CancelIfIdle
functions.summary: When the battle flag at work+0x5C+0x424C is clear it cancels the party panel (vtable+0x4C(self,0,1) and child reset); otherwise it does nothing.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_ToggleAutoFlag
functions.summary: Handler-table entry 0x24 of the battle command window (slot 0x00728C94): on a confirm event it shows the battle popup, inverts bit 0 of the global flag byte GameWork+0x2D384 when the sub-window has a live selection, then hides the panel, closes the command pane and asks the state controller for state 0xD.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindow_LayoutRows
functions.signature: void Ui_CompositeWindow_LayoutRows(UiCompositeWindow* self, LayoutMsg* msg, LayoutCtx* ctx, LayoutParam* params)
functions.summary: Composite-window override of the layout pass: runs the children of its two nested lists (+0x3D4/+0x3DC and +0x3F0/+0x3F8) through their layout callbacks in order, then hands the message to the base layout methods (0x0053CDE0 and the window vtable slot +0x20).

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindow_ReleaseChildren
functions.summary: Releases the 0x1d child objects stored at self+0x1c0 (stride 4) and then the five named sub-objects at self+0x138/0x1bc/0x238/0x23c/0x240, and drops the refcounted handle at self+0x438.

functions.name: Ui_Window_IsActive
functions.summary: Predicate used by the window-frame code: true only when the window's own active byte (+0x405) is set and the UI context singleton still has a live root manager (+0x10).

functions.name: Ui_BattleCmd_ResetPendingInput
functions.summary: Clears and resets pending battle command input context at self+0x1BC if an input operation is currently in flight.

functions.name: Ui_Window_DeactivateAndClearMembers
functions.summary: Deactivates the window: unlinks both intrusive child lists (f_3D4/f_3F0) calling vtable+0x18(child,0) on each entry, clears f_234, sets f_404=1, handles the optional child at f_23C when world+0x4249 is set, and resets the selection indices f_42C/f_430 to -1.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_AllMembersUnavailable
functions.summary: Returns 0 if the unit at f_42C has f_B128 < 2 or the one at f_430 has f_B148 < 2; otherwise scans the four party units and returns 0 as soon as one both passes maybe_Battle_CheckActorCanAct(world, unit, unit->f_768) and is not skipped by maybe_Actor_ShouldSkipUpdate; only when all four fail does it return 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_SelectFirstAvailableMember
functions.summary: Scans downwards from the stored index over the battle party list, testing vt[+0x170], vt[+0xE8](0x7D), vt[+0x80] != 0xFF and the state byte to find a usable unit, then either selects it through vt[+0x174] or falls into the f_40A/f_412/f_41A/f_422 slot bookkeeping and returns 0.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ResetChildrenAndState
functions.summary: Clears f_F0, unlinks the list at +0xFC, then deactivates all 29 child slots (self[0x70+i], vtable+0x18(child,0) and vtable+0x7C), optionally toggles the child at self[0x8F] when world+0x4249 is set, calls self vtable+0x4C(self,0,0,0,0), deactivates self[0x4E] and zeroes f_4C and f_101.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the composite battle window: installs vtable 0x0075CFC8, registers its child node list (flag 1), constructs the anim-ref member and default-constructs the four 0x48-byte sub-widget descriptors at +0x140.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindow_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor: runs the class destructor and frees the allocation.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Class destructor: reinstalls the vtable, releases all children, then tears down the two embedded node lists at self+0x438 and self+0x470 and the message page at self+0x4b0.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindow_EnableAndRefreshHandle
functions.summary: Enables the shared UI flag and then validates the packed handle at self+0x11C against the generation table at 0x007B80C0; when the tag is stale it rebuilds the handle through 0x002828BC and stores the new one.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ModelPreview_UpdateSpin
functions.summary: Updates a rotating model preview pane: resolves the scene node behind the pane's handle f_11C, advances the spin angle f_120 by 0.1 * the lazy 0x1D4-byte rotation-state object's field 7, applies it with Gfx_Node_SetEulerRotation and then attaches or releases the accessory mesh depending on the pane's f_126 id.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindow_MeasureCurrentText
functions.summary: Measures the window's current wide string at self+0x2D0C8 with the Thumb wcslen at 0x00100B74 (FACTS.md: mis-marked noreturn); the leading lazy work-block access is the shared accessor idiom, not part of the measurement.

functions.name: Gfx_SetCameraLookAt
functions.signature: void Gfx_SetCameraLookAt(float* eye, float* target, u32 color)
functions.summary: Builds an orthonormal look-at basis from eye/target (with the global up axis), writes it to the device's active camera matrix slots +0x84C..+0x878, uploads a fixed projection matrix +0x87C..+0x8C0 and stores the colour at +0xDD8..+0xDE4.

functions.name: Ui_GlobalFlag_SetEnabled
functions.signature: void Ui_GlobalFlag_SetEnabled(u32 self, int enable, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Enables or disables the shared UI 'slot active' flag: writes the byte at UI context+0xDE8, lazily creates the 0x98-byte helper singleton (0x0011FE8C/0x0011CFAC/0x00116AE0 + object header) and notifies it through 0x00626A9C/0x00282CFC. Called with enable=0 from Ui_Slot_Dtor and with enable=1 from maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_SetMode.

functions.name: Ui_BoushiShopWindow_ApplyRowTransform
functions.signature: void Ui_BoushiShopWindow_ApplyRowTransform(UiBoushiShopWindow* widget, void* rowContext, int* transformNode)
functions.summary: Virtual method in Ui_BoushiShopWindow vtable 0x0075D060 (slot +0x08): evaluates layout coordinates for hat/costume shop list row items using transformNode virtual method +0x24.

functions.name: Ui_Slot_Init
functions.summary: Initialises one list/index slot: installs the slot vtable, stamps the 16-bit row id and resets the two 8-bit selection fields.

functions.name: Ui_Slot_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for Ui_Slot_Init: releases the shared helper at self[2]+0x54, disables the global flag, releases the node and frees the slot.

functions.name: Ui_BoushiShopWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the hat-shop (boushi) window's message trio and registers the win_boushi_shop layout as child pane 0.

functions.name: Ui_BoushiShopWindow_CloseIfActive
functions.summary: Virtual method in hat shop window vtable 0x0075D0BC (slot +0x08): tests if child preview sub-panel at self+0x11C is active and closes it via virtual method +0x10.

functions.name: Ui_BoushiShopWindow_UpdateAnimStep
functions.summary: Virtual method in hat shop window vtable 0x0075D0AC (slot +0x08): advances animation timer at self+0x124 and frame counter at self+0x128 for preview display panes.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ReleaseChildWidgetsA
functions.summary: Window child-list reset step: clears the two flags at +0x5D8/+0x5DE, pops every pending child, re-links both widget lists (+0x4BC and +0x244) and broadcasts visibility flag 1 to the children at +0x244. Entry of the handler table at 0x00729140.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DeactivateChildWidgetsB
functions.summary: Window vtable slot: flushes the pending-child queue at +0x110, re-links the widget at +0x4BC and deactivates the children at +0x244. Does not free anything.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemIcon_UpdateOwnedState
functions.summary: Updates an item icon widget: for item ids 0xAA3..0xB3A it compares the owned count in work+0x24A98 with the record's required count and sets icon state 7 (owned), 6/3 (enough/not enough) or 5, and also forwards the grid cursor selection; returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DeactivateChildWidgetsC
functions.summary: Window vtable slot: flushes the pending-child queue at +0x110, re-links both the +0x244 and +0x4BC widgets and deactivates the +0x244 children. Same body as 0x002839E4/0x00283B94.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState8
functions.summary: Updates child widgets of a UI window to state 8: queries layout bounds via 0x006F0F1C and propagates state transition through 0x001F076C.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState9
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x4BC against the frame block at frame+0x1C4 and, when the tick reports a change, requests controller state 9 on the object at self+0x11C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_ResetSelectionMode4
functions.summary: Resets shop window item selection state for mode 4 (vtable 0x00729170): allocates state buffer via 0x00210A50(4) and clears sub-panel at self+0x4BC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_ShowSelectionText
functions.summary: Refreshes the shop window's description text for the selected id at f_238: resolves the id twice through 0x006131B0/0x00613410, builds the text id with 0x00210A50(3) and stores it in the message pair at f_4BC.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState4Or5
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x4BC and, when it has finished, requests controller state 4 when the prompt was confirmed or state 5 otherwise, on the object at self+0x11C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DeactivateChildWidgetsD
functions.summary: Window vtable slot with the same body as 0x00283784: flush the +0x110 queue, re-link +0x244 and +0x4BC, deactivate the +0x244 children.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState2CopyC
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x4BC and, when the tick reports a change, requests controller state 2 on the object at self+0x11C. One of four identical copies; the trailing letter only records which vtable slot the copy sits in.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState2CopyD
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x4BC and, when the tick reports a change, requests controller state 2 on the object at self+0x11C. Identical to 0x00283A6C; the trailing letter only records the vtable slot.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState2CopyE
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x4BC and, when the tick reports a change, requests controller state 2 on the object at self+0x11C. Identical to 0x00283A6C; the trailing letter only records the vtable slot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DeactivateChildWidgetsE
functions.summary: Window vtable slot with the same body as 0x00283784: flush the +0x110 queue, re-link +0x244 and +0x4BC, deactivate the +0x244 children.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DeactivateChildWidgetsF
functions.summary: Window vtable slot with the same body as 0x0028340C: flush the +0x110 queue, re-link +0x4BC, deactivate the +0x244 children.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState2CopyA
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x4BC and, when the tick reports a change, requests controller state 2 on the object at self+0x11C. Identical to 0x00283A6C; the trailing letter only records the vtable slot.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState1Or8
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x4BC and, when it has finished, requests controller state 1 when the prompt was confirmed or state 8 otherwise, on the object at self+0x11C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DeactivateChildWidgetsG
functions.summary: Window vtable slot with the same body as 0x0028340C: flush the +0x110 queue, re-link +0x4BC, deactivate the +0x244 children.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenToState2SetDirty
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x4BC, sets the dirty byte self+0x240 and, when the tick reports a change, requests controller state 2 on the object at self+0x11C.

functions.name: Ui_BoushiShopWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the hat/equipment shop window: installs vtable 0x0075D098, constructs its anim-ref member and default-constructs the 10-entry 0x18-byte item row table.

functions.name: Ui_BoushiShopSubWidget_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for hat shop sub-widget (vtable 0x0075D09C slot +0x04): invokes destructor 0x00284398 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_BoushiShopSubWidget_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of hat shop item preview sub-widget: initializes base widget structures, installs vtables 0x0075DBAC and 0x0075E92C, and allocates layout buffers via 0x0036B514/0x001A6768.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenEffect_LoadGrainAndVignette
functions.summary: Loads the shared 2D screen-effect texture pack ("textures.bch") and resolves its "filmgrain_01" and "vignette_01" resources into self->f_C and self->f_10, setting the ready byte at self+4.

functions.name: ScreenEffect_SetFade
functions.signature: void ScreenEffect_SetFade(ScreenEffect* self, int mode, float start, float duration)
functions.summary: Starts a screen fade/screen-effect from the script native: stores the fade mode in +0x1C/+0x1D, clamps the start value against the duration bounds and programs the device brightness (+0x1284 or +0x1220), screen colour (+0x1208..+0x1210) and the two fade positions at +0x126C/+0x1270.

functions.name: ScreenEffect_UpdateFade
functions.signature: void ScreenEffect_UpdateFade(ScreenEffect* self, float step, float arg3)
functions.summary: Advances the ScreenEffect fade by step seconds: clamps +0x14 to the end value, calls the completion handler 0x002845D0 when the fade has finished, otherwise applies the same easing curve as Ui_SceneFlow and writes the resulting brightness to device+0x1284 or +0x1220.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenEffect_ReleaseGrainAndVignette
functions.summary: Releases the screen-effect resources loaded by 0x28447C and clears the handles and ready flag; called from the effect owner's destructor path (0x256A58).

functions.name: Ui_ScreenEffect_ApplyFrameColor
functions.summary: When the effect owner at self+4 is in mode 2, builds the shared 0x10-byte colour object once and pushes the 5-byte record {9, 0xFF, 0xFF, 7, 2} through Gfx_SetFrameColorParam, then remembers that it was applied.

functions.name: Ui_StreetPassVipMsg_Ctor
functions.signature: UiStreetPassVipMsg* Ui_StreetPassVipMsg_Ctor(UiStreetPassVipMsg* self, int mode, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Constructor for the StreetPass VIP-message object: allocates the 0x254-byte body through Ui_StpassCallVipMsg_Create, registers it with the object manager, binds the caller's arguments and marks the object active.

functions.name: Ui_StreetPassVipMsg_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for StreetPass VIP message UI widget (vtable 0x0075D0FC slot +0x04): calls destructor and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_StreetPassVipMsg_InitPanes
functions.summary: Continuation of Ui_StreetPassVipMsg_Ctor (0x002849F0): retrieves text layout manager 0x0021F8B8 from UI singleton and binds message panes.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Cue_Finish
functions.summary: Ends a UI cue object when its sound has finished: asks the sound system whether the handle at +0x10 is still active, then clears the handle and reloads the descriptor's callback words (+0x78/+0x7C) from 0x0072A79C.

functions.name: Ui_Cue_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame tick of a UI cue: adds 1/30 s to the float timer at +0x14 and, once the duration at +0xC is reached, plays the cue's sound id (first word), stores the returned handle at +8 and loads the next callback pair from the descriptor at 0x0072A79C (+0x70/+0x74).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Cue_ResetIfIdle
functions.summary: When the sound player's state byte at +4 has bit 3 clear, resets the cue to its neutral state: clears +0x14 and copies the two default words at 0x0072A79C+0x68/+0x6C into cue+4 and cue+8.

functions.name: Ui_Cue_StopBgm
functions.summary: Finalises a BGM cue: installs the terminal descriptor pair from the shared cue table at 0x0072A79C, clears the cue's timer, and requests the BGM stop through Snd_RequestBgmStop when the cue was not already marked stopped.

functions.name: Ui_Cue_Start
functions.signature: int Ui_Cue_Start(UiCue* cue, u16 cueId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, int startMode)
functions.summary: Starts a UI cue on an idle cue object: stores the cue id, the three packed parameters and the start/stop flag, invokes the matching sound-player callback, copies the initial callback pair and returns 1 (0 when the cue was busy).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_PlaySeOnState6
functions.summary: Only when the actor owned through self+4 (+0xD38) is alive: queues SE 6 and stores its handle at f_2C, then - unless the window's state byte at +9 already equals 6 - installs the fixed 0x48-byte template at 0x0072B810 into self+0x30; the tail is a state-6 template snapshot, not a generic sound play.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ApplyControlCode
functions.summary: Re-applies the pending message control code after a sound/lookup succeeded: rewinds the message cursor through GameWork+0x24A98 by the amount reported by the window's slot vtable +0x18, re-reads the 7-byte code, executes it with Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode and stores the resulting 0x48-byte control record when the opcode is not 7.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipPart_SetStateIndex
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipPart_SetStateIndex(EquipPart* self, unsigned int state, unsigned char state2, EquipPartState* out)
functions.summary: Stores the requested equip-part state in out->f_130 and self+8 and, unless the part is fully initialised (state 8), copies the 0x48-byte default transform table into self+0x30.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_HandleConfirmResult
functions.summary: Handles the shop's confirm answer: if a reply object is pending it copies the reply (byte/int/two bytes/u16 and 0xE-byte text) into the command record, asks the record whether the answer was accepted and issues control code 1 (declined) or 2 (accepted); the bit-2-only case switches to code 8 and restores the default pane rect.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_UpdateAffordability
functions.summary: Refreshes the shop window's input-enabled flag f_130 from the mode bytes f_d3C/f_d3D/f_d3F, then for modes 2/4 asks the window vtable +0x18 for the current price and issues message control code 4 when the price is above the player's gold or code 5 when it is affordable; modes 3/5 always issue code 3.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_ResetToIdle
functions.summary: Resets the shop window to control code 0: releases every child through Ui_Root_ReleaseAll with the window's current value, issues code 0 and restores the default 0x48-byte pane block when the displayed code was not already 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListItemValue_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a small list-item value object: installs vtable 0x0075D118 at +0, stores the passed value at +4, zeroes +8 and sets +9 = 8, then installs the second vtable 0x00782638 at +0xC and zeroes the fields at +0x1C and +0x38.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StopFadeAndSound
functions.summary: Stops a pending fade and its sound: calls the UI core +0x14 fade helper, the sound-player stop helper and then the cleanup routine 0x0029126C on self+4's +0x133C field.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_OnConfirm
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_OnConfirm(void* self, u32 p1, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Confirm handler of the shop window: reads the two input managers' slot-0x30 state and, when both report the button, either sends command 0xD or sets state 6 and sends command 0x11 through the window's +0xC vtable.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_CloseSubPanel
functions.summary: Calls the still-unnamed func_0036B450 on the widget at window+0xD4C and then issues message control code 0x0F.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode4
functions.summary: Slot selection handler for shop window in mode 4 (vtable 0x0072B9AC): validates active shop mode at self+4+0xD3C and dispatches event 0x11 to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode7
functions.summary: Clears the message window's pending-task flag at +0xD65, resets the task copy at +0x14C, applies two bytes to the window and then executes message control code 7 with argument 0xFF.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode9
functions.summary: Slot selection handler for shop window in mode 9 (vtable 0x0072B95C): validates shop mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event 9 to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Event_WaitSoundThenAdvanceA
functions.summary: Waits until the sound id stored at self[1]+0x134 is no longer active and the save/load task at self[1]+0x13C has finished, then marks self[1]+0xD65, copies the task and requests state 7 (empty record) or 0xF (record has data) from the state machine at self+0xC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWidget_ShowCurrentRow
functions.summary: Shows the row the list widget's cursor currently points at: reads the cursor (f_D6C) and count (f_D70), fetches the 8-byte row record from the table at f_D84, applies the record's enable/height bytes and height class, pushes message command 9 and displays the record through Ui_Widget_ShowWithRecord.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode1
functions.summary: Slot selection handler for shop window in mode 1 (vtable 0x0072B9CC): validates shop mode byte at +0xD3C, sets self+8 = 1, and dispatches event 0x11 to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode2Or8
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B8EC: checks mode byte at self+4+0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 2 (for modes 2, 4) or 8 (for modes 3, 5) to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode1B
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B9BC: validates shop mode byte at +0xD3C, sets self+8 = 1, and dispatches event 0x11 to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode1A
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B8DC: validates shop mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event 1 to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_ClearPriceText
functions.summary: Resets the widget at window+0x14C, starts a load request on window+0x13C, clears the pending byte at +0xD65 and issues message control code 4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_ShowRowDataText
functions.summary: Issues message control code 5 with a pointer to the selected list row's +0x220 field, i.e. asks the message window to show something belonging to that row.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Event_AdvanceAfterSaveTask
functions.summary: When the save/load task at self[1]+0x13C has finished, marks self[1]+0xD65, copies the task and requests state 3 (empty record) or 0xE (record has data) from the state machine at self+0xC.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode6Or2
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B92C: checks mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 6 (for modes 2, 4) or 2 (for modes 3, 5) to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_HandleRowInput
functions.summary: One frame of shop row input: dispatches on the row flag word f_D60 (bit 0 confirm, bit 2 cancel, bits 0x142 reply) to play the row reaction, poll input ids 4/5/6 or rebuild the row text after a reply, then marks the owning window dirty.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode12Or2
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B98C: checks mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 0xC (for modes 2, 4) or 2 (for modes 3, 5) to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode16
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B99C: validates shop mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 0x10 to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode0
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B91C: validates shop mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 0 to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_ReturnToIdle
functions.summary: Finishes a shop-window sub-screen: releases all of the window's panes (Ui_Root_ReleaseAll) and then issues control code 6 (0xFF,0,0 payload) through Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode, i.e. 'window finished, return to the list'.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode11
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B97C: validates shop mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 0xB to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode10
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B96C: validates shop mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 0xA to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode5Or7
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B94C: checks mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 5 (for modes 2, 4) or 7 (for modes 3, 5) to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_OnSelectRowMode4Or7
functions.summary: Slot selection handler in shop window dispatch table 0x0072B93C: checks mode byte at +0xD3C and dispatches event opcode 4 (for modes 2, 4) or 7 (for modes 3, 5) to sub-panel f_C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_EndTransition
functions.summary: Releases the window's children (Ui_Root_ReleaseAll) and then runs the pending command 0 through the pane-animation object at self+0xC (query slot +0x14, commit slot +0x10).

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_PartCtor

functions.name: Ui_CreditEffectWindow_Ctor

functions.name: Ui_DungeonStartWindow_BindPane

functions.name: Ui_CreditWindow_Create

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CreditWindow_SelectGroupAndPlaySe

functions.name: Ui_TalkSubWidget_DeletingDtor
