functions.name: Ui_Widget_DtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor: stores the vtable argument at self+0, runs the widget destructor (maybe_Ui_Widget_DtorB) and then operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_TalkYesNoWindow_BindPanes
functions.summary: Binds the two halves of a talk/yes-no window ("win_talk" and "win_yesno"), pairs them with Ui_MessagePair_Bind and broadcasts to the pair.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a large composite menu window: stamps the class vtables (0x0075E540 / 0x0077FCFC), destroys the message page at self+0x786, releases the two layout refs, tears down the inline object arrays and the Ui_Object base, then frees the block with operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_RankIcon_Bind
functions.summary: Resolves the eight monster-rank medal sprites (icon_rank_f/e/d/c/b/a/s/key plus chara) for the given character and stores the sprite handles in the set.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ShowWithEffect
functions.summary: Shows or hides the sprite at self+0x38 by writing its visible bit (+0x44) and, when becoming visible, lazily allocates the fade helper singleton and starts its fade effect.

functions.name: Ui_RankIcon_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a rank/medal icon: installs the empty animation record at 0x0029A118 through vtable slot +0x0C, sets fill colour and alpha to 0xFF through slots +0x10/+0x14 and stores -1 in the icon index at +0x10.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonCheckWindow_BindPanes
functions.summary: Binds the dungeon-check window panes: two small text blocks (ids 0x6762 and "stage") plus the "win_dungeon_check" widget, then registers the pane group.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Pane_SetFlag4
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Pane_SetFlag4(UiPane* self, u32 p1, int enable)
functions.summary: Sets or clears bit 2 (value 4) of the pane state byte at +0x204, tells the child widget at +0x168 whether the byte is now zero (through its slot +0x18) and then recomputes the widget transform with 0x001A62E4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Pane_SetEnabledByLookup
functions.summary: Resolves the passed list-item reference: a resolved row sets bit 1 of the pane's +0x204 flag word, an unresolved one clears it, and the child widget is told whether the pane is now empty.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_SetRowEnabled
functions.summary: Enables or disables one list row from a one-byte spec: a value other than 0xFF selects the row in the keyed list at +0x134 and sets +0x138/+0x120 plus bit 1 of +0x204, 0xFF clears both flags, and the row widget is told the final state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_AttachListNodes
functions.summary: Splices the two optional intrusive list nodes held in the static descriptor 0x0072AF1C into the owner's lists at +0x588 and +0x568, setting the back-pointers at +0x218/+0x234 to self.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_CreateInstance
functions.summary: Part factory used by the dive manager: allocates through 0x001D8B6C, installs vtable 0x0075E160, constructs the list headers and two panes and returns obj-1.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the dive window: runs the destructor body at 0x0029A4CC and frees the object through the virtual deleter 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing complete-object destructor of the dive window: re-links the three embedded list heads, releases the trailing pane chain and runs the embedded object destructors.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Registers all panes of the 'dive' expedition window: menu_dive_select, _continue, _rank, _type, _stock1, _stock2, _sort, _sortie and the win_talk message strip.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_ApplyChildState
functions.summary: Pushes the stored child state byte at +0x120 into the child controller at +0x130 (slot +0x14) and commits the transition through slot +0x10 when the controller accepts it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveWindow_UpdateAnimation
functions.summary: Per-frame driver of the dive-window animator: runs the base update, advances the 1/30 s timer at +0x140, dispatches the current 0x18-byte step record while +0x134 < 0x0B and clears the UI input-mode word when the +0x264 latch is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveWindow_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update: releases finished child panes, then - depending on the state byte at +0x11C and the mode byte at +0x586 - asks the 2D object state-sequence runner (0x002D24BC) to advance the UI core's +0x14 manager.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_ResetSelection
functions.summary: Resets the dive window after a sortie: re-runs the pane setup for the given base object, clears both stock panes, raises the flag at self+0x2982 and blanks the 13-byte sort key at self+0x2984+0x558.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_SetSelectionRow
functions.signature: void Ui_DiveWindow_SetSelectionRow(DiveWindow* self, int rowId, DiveWindowState* state)
functions.summary: Selects a row of the dive/profile window: rowId 0 clears the 0xD-byte selection record to the 'none' pattern (0xFF, with a 4-byte -1 id) and marks it changed; otherwise it clamps the row against the source list, copies the record when it differs and raises the changed flag.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_SetTextArg4
functions.summary: Refreshes the dive window's panes and binds message text argument 4 into the widget at self+0x2908.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_UpdateChildrenToState1
functions.summary: Dive-window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x2908 against frame+0x168 and, when the tick reports a change, requests controller state 1 on the object at self+0x130.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveWindow_InitRowState
functions.summary: Dive-window setup step: when the widget at +0x2908 has no children it is unlinked first, then the dive manager is recreated, the entry flags are rebuilt with id 5 and the window's data binding is re-initialised.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_UpdateChildrenToState10
functions.summary: Dive-window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x2908 and, when it has finished, restores the saved sub-state (self+0x12A into self+0x11C) and requests controller state 10 on the object at self+0x130.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_SetTextArgAndFillRows
functions.summary: Broadcasts the source window's text-argument block (src+0xEC) to every child widget, rebuilds the eight-row list sub-widget at self+0x9C0 with Ui_EightRowListWindow_FillRows and then marks that list active (0x0029126C with 1).

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_SetTextArg7
functions.summary: Refreshes the dive window's panes and binds message text argument 7 into self+0x2908.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_SetTextArgVar
functions.summary: Binds the message text argument whose index is stored in self+0x12d (the currently selected row) into self+0x2908.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveWindow_EnableSubWidget
functions.summary: Single call that shows the dive window's sub-widget at +0xBF0 (Gfx_Node_SetVisible(...,1)).

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_SetTextArg6
functions.summary: Refreshes the dive window's panes and binds message text argument 6 into self+0x2908.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_SetTextArg0
functions.summary: Clears the stock pane selection and binds message text argument 0 into self+0x2908.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_RefreshListData
functions.summary: Rebuilds the dive window's list contents: notifies the children, marks the list widget at self+0x2984 dirty, rebuilds its entries with kind 7 starting from f_129 through Ui_ListData_BuildEntries, restores f_484, dispatches the state callback, resets the selection (0x0029AB00), computes the message id from the screen-mode byte at +0x12C and invokes the pane callback.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_UpdateChildrenToState10Or3
functions.summary: Dive-window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x2908 and, when it has finished, requests state 10 after restoring the saved sub-state when self+0x124 is negative (otherwise the controller's default state), or state 3 on cancel.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_UpdateChildrenToState3Or10
functions.summary: Dive-window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x2908 and, when it has finished, requests state 3 on confirm, or restores the saved sub-state byte at self+299 into self+0x11C and requests state 10 on cancel.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_HandleInputA
functions.summary: Input handler of the dive window: toggles the sub-window at +0x464 on open/close events, forwards cursor events to the detail widget, and requests state 3 or 0 depending on the frame's event mask.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_HandleInputB
functions.summary: Dive-window input handler: ticks the widget at self+0x2908, forwards bit 0 to the child at self+0x2B4, and on confirm/cancel uses the three-way result of maybe_Ui_GetTableByteByChild to request controller state 3, 2 or 10 (the last restoring the saved sub-state).

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_UpdateChildrenToState10B
functions.summary: Dive-window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x2908 and, when it has finished, restores the saved sub-state byte at self+299 into self+0x11C and requests controller state 10 on the object at self+0x130.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_HandleInputC
functions.summary: Dive-window input handler for the selection list at self+0x3A4: applies the selection when the widget finishes, forwards bit 0 to the child, and on confirm/cancel reads the selected value (0x0064E974) into maybe_Ui_DiveWindow_ApplySelection and requests controller state 3, 0 or the default.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_HandleInputD
functions.summary: Dive-window input handler for the sub-window at self+0x268: on confirm/cancel the three-way result of 0x0064D744 selects controller state 4, 5 or the saved sub-state, bit 0 is forwarded to the child, and the cancel path leaves through maybe_Ui_SetBusyFlagAndLeave.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_HideTalk
functions.summary: Refreshes the dive window's panes and hides the win_talk strip at self+0xbf0.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_OnInput
functions.summary: Input handler for the dive window's sortie list: accepts/cancels rows, keeps the cursor inside the 0x80-entry window and updates the selected-row text.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_NotifyChildren
functions.summary: Walks the circular child list at list+0x10 and calls slot 0x18 on every child, which is the standard 'pane became visible/hidden' notification used by the dive window.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the dive (underwater) window: installs vtable 0x0075E1B0, clears all selection fields to 0xFF/-1 and default-constructs the 11-entry anim-ref table at +0x11C.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_DtorDeleteAlt
functions.summary: Second deleting-destructor entry of the dive window (base-subobject variant): runs the destructor at 0x0029C428 and frees the object through the virtual deleter 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_DtorC
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a large composite window (vtable-0x001F0700 family): destroys the embedded sub-widget at +0xA5A, the message pages, layout refs, the 8 x 0x3C array and the 0x50-stride child arrays, ending in the deleting base helper.

functions.name: Ui_DiveWindow_SetEightLabels
functions.summary: Fills the dive window's eight rows: for each row it resolves the {kind,id} pair as an item name (kind 1) or spell name (kind 2), writes 'Invalid' when the id does not resolve, and finally writes the page counter and page count into slots 8 and 9.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AbilityList_BuildEntryIds
functions.summary: Builds the up-to-32-entry u16 list at window+0x50 for one party member: first the learned skills (Party_CountLearnedSkills/0x00629214, id getter 0x006298F0, SkillRecord 0x0018C1B8) whose +0x80 bit0 is set (type 1), then the spells (0x006291EC, 0x006298E0, SpellRecord 0x0018C184) whose +0x2E9 bit0 is set (type 2); finally sorts the pairs with the window comparator and notifies virtual +0x5C.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_CompareEntryKey
functions.signature: bool Ui_ListWindow_CompareEntryKey(const EntryKey* arg1, const EntryKey* b)
functions.summary: Sort comparator: turns each {kind, id} descriptor into an integer sort key (kind 1 = party member, key member+0xC2; kind 2 = monster, key monster+0x2E4 + 0x10000; anything else = INT_MAX) and returns true when the first sorts before the second.

functions.name: Ui_PagerWindow_InitRows
functions.summary: Builds eight numbered text rows ("txt_l%d") plus the left/right pager number panes for a paged list window.

functions.name: Ui_ComplexWindow_InitMember
functions.summary: Initialises one member of the composite window: Ui_Object_CtorBase, install vtable 0x75E200 and zero the following 0x12 words.

functions.name: Ui_PagerWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (vtable slot 1) of the pager-row window object that Ui_ComplexWindow_InitMember builds; runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees. The class table pairs with Ui_PagerWindow_InitRows, so it is the pager shown inside the composite window.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveWindow_SetSixLabels
functions.summary: Fills the dive window's label column: writes up to six names from the id bytes at self+0x50 through Data_LookupSubRecord, pads the remaining rows with an empty string, then writes the position counter and the page count into rows 7 and 8.

functions.name: Ui_PagerWindow_InitPageNumbers
functions.summary: Sets up the pager's six numbered text labels (null_txt_l0..l5 over txt_l0..l5) and the pager_num_r/pager_num_l counters, then rebuilds the page-id list from the owned items in the bag (work+0x24A98), sorts it by the item record's sort key (+0xB) and notifies the window.

functions.name: Ui_ComplexWindow_ListCtor
functions.summary: Constructs the intrusive list used by the composite window: Ui_Object_CtorBase, install vtable 0x75E274, zero the head word and point both the head and tail sentinels at the list's own two embedded nodes (+0x5D and +0x76).

functions.name: Ui_PagerWindow_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the second pager object of the composite window (the list built by Ui_ComplexWindow_ListCtor): stores the class table, runs the UI base destructor and frees.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_RefreshPageRows
functions.summary: Refills the twelve visible rows for the given page: row i shows entry page*12+i taken from the window's u16 id array, or is reset to the empty text when the page runs out; afterwards the cursor is clamped to the rows present on this page and the selection display is moved.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_SetRowItem
functions.summary: Binds one list row to an item id and writes its label: for a real item (id inside the 0x0AA3..0x0B3A block) it uses the formatted item name, otherwise (0xFFFF or outside that range) it installs the shared 'empty' text and a lazily created dummy item object.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_SetVisibleAndSetTextLayers
functions.summary: Visibility override of a list window: calls Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim(self, visible) and then refreshes the twelve 0x10-byte text layers at +0x70 with Ui_TextLayer_SetText, using each layer's stored id and alpha.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_InitRowsAndPager
functions.summary: Builds a 12-row list window: eight visible text rows, empty/centre placeholders, left pager and the pager arrow handling.

functions.name: Ui_TwelveRowTextWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a twelve-row text/list window: chains the Ui_Object_CtorSmall base, installs vtable 0x0075EB0C, builds the scroller sub-object at +0x54 (type 0x0C) and default-constructs twelve 0x10-byte row records.

functions.name: Ui_TwelveRowTextWindow_DtorDeleting
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the twelve-row text window: reinstalls vtable 0x0075EB0C, destroys the twelve 0x10-byte row records at +0x1C, runs the list-window base destructor and frees the instance.

functions.name: Anim_Clip_Build
functions.signature: unsigned int Anim_Clip_Build(AnimClipSet* self, AnimResource* res, AnimClipParams* params)
functions.summary: Builds the runtime animation clip data for an animation resource: resolves the skeleton/anim handle, computes track/step counts, allocates the 0x58-byte track array plus 0x14-byte step arrays (0x4C when the per-step data is needed) and converts each track via 0x002D0760.

functions.name: Gfx_LookupSpritePriorityByte
functions.summary: Looks up and mode-adjusts the 8-bit draw/layer priority byte for a 2D sprite record from (*Gfx_GetContext())+0xF50 using row spriteRec+0x29, column spriteRec+0x28, and mode spriteRec+0x2A.

functions.name: Anim_Clip_Start
functions.summary: Starts the "Start" animation clip on the widget's animation player and arms the update path.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GetEntryByteProperty
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Gfx_GetEntryByteProperty(int entryIndex, u32 key, int mode)
functions.summary: Reads a per-entry byte property (default 0x80) from the 2D sprite entry table in the graphics context: resolves the row, maps the key through Font_MapCharToGlyph and, for mode 2, repeats the lookup with key 10.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_Clip_BuildLoopFragment
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Anim_Clip_BuildLoopFragment(AnimClipSet* clipSet, unsigned int trackStep)
functions.summary: Thumb fragment of the Anim_Clip_Build per-track loop: walks the 0x1C-byte track descriptors, counts their present steps and calls Anim_Clip_ConvertTracks for the next output pointers.

functions.name: Anim_Player_SetFrame
functions.summary: Stores a frame index as a float in the animation player's +0x64 field, but only when a clip is attached at +0x44 and the frame lies in [0, clip frame count].

functions.name: Anim_Clip_Update
functions.summary: Updates the sprite clip: finds the first clip in the 0x18-stride table whose animation is present and not suppressed, applies the stored mode/params to its sprite list, detaches the surplus sprites and reports whether any clip is active (f_71).

functions.name: Anim_Clip_ClearList
functions.summary: Empties an animation-clip container: clears the busy byte at +0x71 and walks the nodes between the begin/end markers, unlinking each and destroying its payload through vtable +4.

functions.name: Anim_Clip_SpawnAndApply
functions.summary: Spawns the animation clip's sprite/mesh instances, distributes them across the owner's slots and applies the per-slot transforms and colours.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_Clip_SetClockModeAndTime
functions.signature: void maybe_Anim_Clip_SetClockModeAndTime(AnimClip* clockMode, int stampTime, int stampTime2)
functions.summary: Selects the clip's clock source (0 = the 0x0063C750 clock, anything else = 0x0063C75C) and, when asked, stamps the current time of that clock into the float at +0x64. Does nothing until the clip has a sprite list at +0x44.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_Teardown
functions.summary: Shared teardown for the paged list window: frees the row object list, releases each 0x4c-byte row through 0x0029F2A8, frees the row buffer and drops the three refcounted handles.

functions.name: Text_SetCharCode
functions.summary: Changes the character drawn by a text/sprite glyph object: stores the code, queries the font system (device+0xF50) for its glyph metrics and marks the object dirty when the glyph index changed.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteTree_ApplyLayout
functions.signature: void Ui_SpriteTree_ApplyLayout(void* self, int dx, int dy)
functions.summary: Recursively pushes the accumulated (dx,dy) layout down a 2D sprite tree: writes the node's params to its draw record, applies the frame/uv/colour block, recurses into the children and offsets each node by the parent delta.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for the paged list window: runs the shared teardown 0x0029ED50, releases the two trailing node lists and frees the allocation.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for the paged list window: runs the shared teardown (Ui_ListWindow_Dtor at 0x0029ED50) and releases the two trailing node lists without freeing the allocation.

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_DetachFromLayer
functions.summary: Removes a sprite/text draw node from its render layer (0 = device+0x310, 1 = device+0x304, 2 = device+0x31C) and clears the cached layer field +0x44.

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_AttachToLayer
functions.signature: void Ui_Sprite_AttachToLayer(UiSpriteNode* self, u32 layer, int mode)
functions.summary: Attaches a sprite/text draw node to a render layer: records the layer in +0x44 and splices the node into the device list for that layer (0x310/0x304/0x31C).

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_BuildQuadFromFrame
functions.signature: void Ui_Sprite_BuildQuadFromFrame(UiSpriteRecord* self, UiSpriteOffset* offset, SpriteQuadParams* params)
functions.summary: Converts one animation frame plus a placement/params block into the concrete quad record the 2D renderer consumes: source uv rect (from the 0x10/0x12/0x14/0x16 fields of the frame, with 0/1/2/3 flip modes), screen position and size, rotation, alpha, palette row and flip flags.

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_LayoutRows
functions.signature: void Ui_DiveForm_LayoutRows(UiDiveForm* self, LayoutMsg* msg, LayoutCtx* ctx, LayoutParam* params)
functions.summary: Layout override of the dive-form window: pushes a message/layout block (self+0x4C), forwards it through the layout context (0x0053CDE0 and vtable slot +0x20) twice around a call to its own script handler (vtable +0x48), then runs the base Ui_Window_LayoutRows.

functions.name: Ui_StreetPassText_Load
functions.summary: Loads the StreetPass text resources (stpass_text.bxon and stpass_msg.bxon) and keeps the handle of the record the window needs from each.

functions.name: Ui_StreetPassText_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for the StreetPass text object.

functions.name: Ui_StreetPassText_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for the StreetPass text object: reinstalls the vtable, drops the six refcounted record handles and releases the trailing widget.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_BindPanes
functions.summary: Binds the four named layout panes of the party 'strength' window (win_tsuyosa1 and win_tsuyosa4 groups plus two helper widgets) and marks the window as initialised (+0x108).

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_ApplyModeRecord
functions.summary: Applies the main-menu state record to the strength window: stores (mode[1] == 2) in +0x94 and, only for state 2, shows the pane at +0x138 when mode[8] < 0x1F (copying mode[8] into it), shows the pane at +0x234 otherwise, and refreshes that second pane through 0x0046408C when +0x248 is set.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_CreateInstance
functions.summary: Constructs the party-strength window (0x234 bytes plus its layout child), installs both vtables, initialises the intrusive list and the 0x50-byte message/row structure, and registers the window with its parent.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_Dtor
functions.signature: void Ui_TsuyosaWindow_Dtor(UiTsuyosaWindow* self, void* vtable, int obj)
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the party-strength window: unlinks the three intrusive lists it owns and destroys the nested window child created by 0x2A00FC, then releases the memory.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Registers every pane of the strength (tsuyosa) status screen: win_tsuyosa_party, win_tsuyosa5_typeA, win_tsuyosa3, win_tsuyosa3_typeB/C/D/E and win_tsuyosa2.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_Update
functions.summary: Main update of the strength screen: dispatches the stored input mask to the party pane, handles the scroll direction and plays the matching pane animation.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_UpdateSelection
functions.summary: Shared selection step for all strength-screen panes: resolves the current row, moves the list cursor by ±1 for the up/down bits and re-renders the affected pane.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_NotifyAndRequestClose
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_NotifyAndRequestClose(UiTsuyosaWindow* self, u32 arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Window event pump: notifies the animator through self+0x98 vtable+0x2C, then either dispatches the pending handler from the 3-word table at +0x13C (index +0x178) or, when bit 0x20 of +0x134 is set, marks the state machine at +0x11C finished and requests event 0x0D.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_OnInput
functions.summary: Input entry for the strength screen: on cancel it closes the pane, on the confirm bits it either plays the 'no rows' animation or forwards to Ui_TsuyosaWindow_UpdateSelection.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_OnInput_PaneTypeC
functions.summary: Per-pane input handler for the win_tsuyosa3_typeC pane (self+0x8bc): forwards the event then runs the shared selection step.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_OnInput_PaneTypeE
functions.summary: Per-pane input handler for the win_tsuyosa3_typeE pane (self+0xccc).

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_OnInput_PaneBase3
functions.summary: Per-pane input handler for the win_tsuyosa3 pane (self+0x6b4).

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_OnInput_NoPane
functions.summary: Minimal input handler of the parameter window: on the cancel mask (f_134 & 4) it pops the current pane, otherwise it just runs the shared selection step - without forwarding to the five sibling panes the other handlers do.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_OnInput_PaneTypeB
functions.summary: Per-pane input handler for the win_tsuyosa3_typeB pane (self+0xed4).

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for the strength screen: installs the vtable, builds the party/character table objects and the whole pane graph.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the strength (Tsuyosa) window: runs the destructor body at 0x002A10B4 and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_DtorBody
functions.summary: Complete-object destructor body of the strength (tsuyosa) window: re-links the node lists, releases the character grid and the two pane chains, and runs the embedded destructors without freeing.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Registers every pane of the tactics (sakusen) screen: win_sakusen_main/text/select1/select2/list1/list2/profile2/tutorial1/config plus the win_bind_* sub-panes and win_sakusen_dive1.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_PushCommandForCursor
functions.summary: Main cursor-action handler of the tactics window: reacts to the confirm button, reads the current selection of the cursor widget at +0x198 and pushes the command id that belongs to that row (ids 0x48-0x61) into the window command queue.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_Update
functions.signature: void Ui_SakusenWindow_Update(UiSakusenWindow* self, u32 p1, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Update for the tactics screen: when the state byte at self+0x11c+0x14 is 7 and the up bit (0x20) is held it moves the tactic cursor and refreshes the description panels.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_OnConfirmCommand
functions.summary: Confirm handler for one of the tactics sub-pages: when the sub-widget reports a confirm, sets the selected party member's value to 3, pushes command 0x57 and clears the 'page selected' byte.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_RebuildMemberOrder
functions.summary: Rebuilds the ordered list of party member ids used by the tactics list: takes the live member ids from the game work, appends the four pending ids stored at +0x6DD..+0x6E0, appends the leader marker 0x1C and de-duplicates while keeping the original order, then writes the list back to the work.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateCounter
functions.summary: Odometer-style counter tick of the tactics window: unless the fast-forward flags are set it advances the displayed number, derives the ones digit with a divide-by-ten, clamps it to 9, updates the digit glyph and the composed value and stores the carry in f_8CC; the busy bit only refreshes the message layout.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_OnInput
functions.summary: Confirm handler for the tactics list: forwards the event, updates the character rows' colour index and closes the pane.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_RefreshList
functions.summary: Recomputes the tactics list geometry (8 rows) and pushes the new height to the list widget at self+0x238.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_OpenCommandPane
functions.signature: void Ui_SakusenWindow_OpenCommandPane(UiSakusenWindow * self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: State handler run after a script callback returns: once the widget tick reports idle it advances the window's command queue, reads the queue entry id and pushes the matching command pane, playing the pane's SEs. Entry id 0 opens the two-pane (detail) layout; any other id collects the availability SEs 0x5A and 0x5C..0x60 for the four command slots and opens the single-pane layout.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdatePaneCommand
functions.summary: Per-frame handler of one tactics-window state: ticks the widget at self+0x1140 and, when it reports idle, selects the command entry identified by the constant pair in the literal pool (0x0072A610) in the command queue at self+0x120.

functions.name: Ui_Window_BuildMessageArgFromToken
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_BuildMessageArgFromToken(void* self, u32 token, u32 tokenType)
functions.summary: Converts a control-token chain into button-icon message arguments: the token type byte selects icon resource 0x4D..0x51 (0x50 becomes 0x51 when only one party member is alive), stores it at self+4, applies it with Ui_SakusenWindow_BuildMessageArgs, and keeps pulling the next token while the chain continues.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_BuildMessageArgs
functions.summary: Builds the message-parameter block for the tactics window detail page: resolves the selected party member's status record, fills the message arguments (name, level, HP/MP, weapon/armour ids) and refreshes the two-column value list.

functions.name: maybe_FalseEntry_SakusenBuildMessageArgs
functions.summary: Not a real function: a three-instruction tail fragment (bl 0x1902A4; mov r1,#4) inside 0x002A29A8 Ui_SakusenWindow_BuildMessageArgs. Ghidra split it off because the preceding block ends in a tail branch.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_BuildMessageArgsTail
functions.summary: Not a real entry point: 0x002A2C0C is the second bl plus the epilogue inside Ui_SakusenWindow_BuildMessageArgs (0x002A29A8); the symbol only exists so the merge does not create a bogus function.

functions.name: Ui_Window_GetMessageArg
functions.summary: Returns this window's message-argument id, building it from the current text token on demand and clearing the cache; for ordinary characters it also registers the character's display name as argument 3.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateWithPreCall
functions.summary: Variant of the tactics-window update that first invokes virtual slot 0x78 on the owned object at self+0x10E4, then ticks the widget at self+0x1140 and advances the command queue at self+0x120 when the tick completes.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateDetailList
functions.summary: Update/confirm handler of the tactics window's scrolling detail list (+0x3C0/+0x694): refreshes the list entry when the selection changes, rebuilds the detail object (+0x6E4) and pops or pushes the corresponding command.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_HandlePaneEvent
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_HandlePaneEvent(void* self, u32 p1, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Pane event handler for the tactics window's two panes at +0x160/+0x17C: swaps visibility when the active pane is hidden, otherwise dispatches on the pane event mask - bit 4 disables the 3D view and advances the command queue, bit 1 executes the pane's text command (0..3), bit 0x10 consumes a ring-buffer entry - and records the result in the pane/command state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdatePaneCommandB
functions.summary: Second per-frame handler of the same shape as 0x002A2820: ticks the widget at self+0x1140 and, when idle, selects the command entry identified by the literal pair at 0x0072A610 in the queue at self+0x120.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_AdvanceCommandQueue
functions.summary: Per-frame handler: ticks the widget at self+0x1140 and, when the tick reports idle, advances the command queue at self+0x120 with Ui_CommandQueue_AdvanceAlt.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_Confirm
functions.signature: void Ui_SakusenWindow_Confirm(UiSakusenWindow* self, u32 p1, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Confirm handling: refreshes the active pane, plays the confirm animation and lazily creates the 0x200-byte tactic-detail object at self+0x97c.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CreateDetail
functions.summary: The tactic (sakusen) detail-window creator: it pushes a pane and allocates the 0x1E30-byte detail object into self+0x118C.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_PushDetailCommands
functions.summary: Builds the detail command sequence of the tactics window: when the detail selection changed it appends command 0x5B, then 0x5C or 0x5D/0x5E/0x5F/0x60 depending on which of the four ability flags are set, and pushes the resulting command list.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_CancelIfIdle
functions.summary: Cancels a pending window command when bit 8 of the shared cancel-flag object is clear: calls 0x001DAC7C on self+0x1140 and marks game-work byte +7.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_InitPane
functions.summary: Prepares and starts one pane of the tactics window: it resets the pane resources at +0x198, pushes the pane layout, zeroes a 0x84-byte clip record, binds the two clip sources to the animation player at +0xF60, selects the clip matching paneMode and starts it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_AdvanceCommandQueueB
functions.summary: Second copy of the tactics-window queue-advance handler: ticks the widget at self+0x1140 and, when idle, advances the command queue at self+0x120 with Ui_CommandQueue_AdvanceAlt.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateSelectedIcon
functions.signature: void Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateSelectedIcon(UiSakusenWindow* self, int arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Refreshes the icon of the currently selected tactics entry: if the selection cursor has an item it copies that item's icon id into the icon widget, otherwise it clears the icon, then re-pushes the pane layout so the change is displayed.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateDetailPane
functions.summary: Switches the tactics window's detail area to match the selected entry: on the input flag it feeds the input to the pane group at +0xA40 and relabels the sub-window at +0xA8C with the entry kind; on the confirm flag, kind 0 shows the member child at +0xB6C (after rebuilding the bag context) and kind 1 shows the parameter child at +0xAF4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SakusenWindow_UpdateEx
functions.summary: Secondary per-frame update of the tactics (sakusen) window while its detail is open: ticks the layout animation pair at +0x1140/+0x160, then advances the command queue and pushes the detail pane once the prompt confirms.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_OnConfirmCommandB
functions.summary: Confirm handler of the second tactics sub-page: writes value 3 into the selected member row and pushes command 0x57, then clears the page byte.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_OnInputEx
functions.signature: void Ui_SakusenWindow_OnInputEx(UiSakusenWindow * self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Input handler for the member/tactic list at self+0xB6C: on the accept flag it shows the row cursor, checks the per-row availability table at 0x0072D430 and, for a real member row (index < 4), keeps the cursor visible and scrolls the list to it; on the cancel flag with the list's fifth row (index 4) selected it clears the UI mode word and advances the command queue.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_PlayAnim
functions.summary: Plays the pane animation described by the class table entry pointed to by g_002A3D04.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CloseDetail
functions.summary: Closes the tactics window's detail view: hides the extra member row of the embedded status-parameter view at self+0x6E4, and, when the battle work reports nothing pending, releases the child screen and selects the fixed follow-up command entry.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_ApplyMemberOrder
functions.summary: Finishes the party-order page: when the member list is in state 1 it rebuilds the member order (0x2A2098), pops the pending command and queues the 'keep order' command; otherwise it only resets the detail object.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: UiSakusenWindow* Ui_SakusenWindow_Ctor(u32 self, u32 vtable, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Constructor for the tactics screen: installs the vtable, builds the embedded list/pane graph and the tactic-data object.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_Delete

functions.summary: Destructor for the tactics screen: unregisters the two created sub-objects, reinstalls the vtable and tears down the whole embedded pane chain.

functions.name: Ui_ShowInfoMessage
functions.summary: Shows a one-line informational message through the shared message manager: builds a 0x??-byte message request from self[4] and submits it.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutChild_InitDispatch
functions.summary: Chooses one of the two embedded layout children (self+0x4C or self+0xD18 by self->f_49), stores the parent and the layout word at child[8]/child[9] and dispatches the child's init virtual (slot +0x18).

functions.name: Ui_Window_CtorBase
functions.signature: UiWindow* Ui_Window_CtorBase(void* parent, unsigned char mode)
functions.summary: Common constructor of every UI window: builds the base Ui_Object, stores the caller's mode byte at +0x49, installs the shared window vtable (0x75E540) and attaches the window's layout/scene node.

functions.name: Ui_Window_CtorBaseEx
functions.summary: Second window base constructor: same layout child as 0x2A4774 but also probes the global work to decide whether the window is being opened over a running battle, storing the result in the byte at -0xCCF relative to the child.

functions.name: Ui_Window_DtorWithPanelArrays
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a window that owns two arrays of 0x414-byte Ui_Panel objects plus an embedded message page: releases the layout refs, destroys both arrays and the embedded objects, runs the base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LoadWindow_RebuildEntryList
functions.summary: Rebuilds the load window's entry list: zeroes the four availability bytes at +0x23C, sets each from func_005AF920(i) for i = 0..3, derives +0x23E from +0x240 and copies +0x241 into +0x23F, writes the enabled indices 1..6 into the byte list at +0x49, applies it through 0x002A4D2C and finally calls vtable+0x18(self, 1).

functions.name: Ui_LoadWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Initialises the save/load window: builds eight text rows and binds the sub-windows win_load_main3 through win_load_main8 used for save-slot details.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_SetSlotVisibility
functions.summary: Refreshes the eight equipment slots from an 8-byte kind mask: each slot gets the icon resolved from its mask value (0xFF -> the 'empty' icon string 0x002A4F78, otherwise a 7-entry kind->icon byte table), the used-slot count f_8E is recomputed, then six 0x14-byte slot frame groups are shown/hidden by a switch on that count (3..8), and with all eight used it applies the element's default value and pane visibility.

functions.name: Ui_LoadWindow_CtorBase
functions.summary: Base constructor for the load/save list window: installs vtable 0x75E5CC, constructs six 0x50-byte row sub-objects, zeroes their state and initialises the shared scroll/cursor parameters.

functions.name: Ui_LoadWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the load/save list window: releases the six 0x50-byte panes, runs the base destructor and frees the object; identical to 0x002A504C plus the free.

functions.name: Ui_LoadWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the load/save list window: releases the six 0x50-byte panes through their layout references and runs the base destructor.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeRowWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds a small three-row text window using the placeholder pane name null_txt_l1.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeRowWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Trivial constructor of the three-row window: builds the base Ui_Object and installs the three-row vtable (0x75E630).

functions.name: Ui_ThreeRowWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the three-row window: the only work is the base Ui_Object destructor followed by the engine delete.

functions.name: Actor2D_SetDialogueMessagePairArgs
functions.summary: Installs dialogue speaker and listener entity names into message argument slots.

functions.name: Ui_Font_IsBffntName
functions.summary: Returns 1 when a font/resource name contains both '.bffnt' and 'D' - i.e. it looks like a BFFNT font file name - and 0 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Font_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor: runs the base destructor 0x005799D4 and tail-calls operator delete 0x0010F6CC. The class is unknown - the vtable slot 0x0075E6B4 has only unnamed neighbours (0x002A53FC, 0x002A5400).

functions.name: Save_SlotEntry_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a save-slot entry to its defaults: sets the state byte at +0x10 to 0xFF, clears +8/+0xC, and fills the three 0x100-byte (128 wchar) name buffers at +0x18, +0x11C and +0x220 with empty strings.

functions.name: Ui_TextWidget_Ctor
functions.signature: UiTextWidget* Ui_TextWidget_Ctor(UiTextWidget* self, u32 id, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Constructs a text-widget node: self-links its intrusive list, lazily creates the shared global registry node, registers the widget there and stores the two ids at +0x0C/+0x10.

functions.name: Field_FindActorInRect
functions.signature: void* Field_FindActorInRect(int type, Rect* reference, Rect* b, unsigned char includeHidden)
functions.summary: Searches both field actor lists for the first actor of the requested class (0x007C4D4C) and type whose handle is valid and whose collision rectangle overlaps the caller's rectangle; returns the actor or NULL.

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_UpdateAnimStep
functions.summary: Animator step of the dive form: asks the animator at +0x3574 whether step 0 has finished (vtable+0x14) and, if so, commits the transition through vtable+0x10.

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_UpdateAnimation
functions.summary: Per-frame driver of the dive-form animator: while the animator is idle it advances the clock at +0x357C by 1/30 s and dispatches the current step out of the 27-entry table at +0x3574.

functions.name: Ui_Input_SetMode
functions.summary: Puts the shared input subsystem into mode 1 (the standard 'menu owns the pad' switch).

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_DispatchEvent
functions.signature: u32 Ui_DiveForm_DispatchEvent(UiDiveForm* ev, const UiEvent* ev2)
functions.summary: Dive-form event entry: bit 0 forwards the three event bytes to the child widget at +0x23C, bit 4 advances the animator to step 0x1A, and the 0x142 mask selects step 1, 0x12 or 0x18 from the modal result of 0x0064A6C8 while marking the event handled.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction14
functions.summary: Attaches the child window's widget (child+0xD8) to this window and then starts window action 0x14 with no extra argument (virtual call at vtable+0x54).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_InitAndActivateA
functions.summary: Window bring-up/reset variant A: resets the base-window parts, drains the pending-child list, re-links this window's list node at +0x344C and re-enables the sub-widget at +0x288.

functions.summary: Variant B of the same sequence: marks every child row active (bit 0 of +0x44), raises the two state flags f_188 and f_208, then drains the child list, re-links the +0x344C node and enables the +0x288 sub-widget.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction0
functions.summary: Window action step: ticks the tween at +0x34D8 and, when it has finished, sets the closing bytes +0x134=1/+0x135=0 and starts action 0 on the object at +0x3574, cancelling it at once if the start call reports completion. Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_OnInputConfirm
functions.summary: Window input/step entry biased to confirm: mask 0x142 runs the selected action node with flag 1, calls 0x003BDD90 and selects animator step 0x19; mask 4 selects step 0; mask 0x10 sets the sequence's f_560 flag; mask 1 forwards the three pointer arguments to the widget at +0x288.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_AttachParentNodeAndShow
functions.summary: Splices the parent's node at parent+0x4A0 into this window's child list at self+0x110 (0x00123594), clears the selection with Ui_Object_SelectEmbeddedNode(self, parent+0x4A0) and then makes the sub-widget at +0x31B8 visible through 0x0029126C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_OnInputCancel
functions.summary: Twin of the confirm entry: mask 0x142 runs the selected action node with flag 0, calls 0x003BDD90 and selects animator step 2; mask 8 calls maybe_Ui_ActivateScriptedElement; mask 0x10 sets f_560; mask 1 forwards the pointer arguments to the widget at +0x288.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_TriggerLayoutSound
functions.summary: Triggers the layout sound on the window's layout object at +0x353C, passing the value reported by the sub-object at +0xDF8 as the sound argument.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_OnInputSelect

functions.summary: Window input/step entry: on confirm (mask 0x142) it resolves the selected list entry, stores it through maybe_Actor_SetStateWord, runs the row action node and selects animator step 2 or 0x11 depending on the root singleton's active-object state; mask 4 selects step 2, mask 1 forwards the three pointer arguments to the widget at +0x31B8.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_CloseByMode
functions.summary: Closes a window down to its two base children: drains the extra children, unlinks the +0x3484 node and the window itself, and when the passed mode is 2 also confirms the current list entry at +0xDF8 and hides the cursor icon.

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_PollMessageEF
functions.summary: Pending-message poll of the dive form: runs the shared request check on +0x353C, then asks the message handler for id 0x0F (or 0x0E depending on the object flag) and consumes it when reported; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_InitAndActivateD
functions.summary: Variant D: byte-for-byte variant B minus the f_208 flag - resets, marks the child rows active, sets f_188, drains the list, re-links the node and enables the +0x288 sub-widget.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction18
functions.summary: Attaches the child window's widget (child+0xD8) to this window and starts window action 0x18 with no extra argument (virtual call at vtable+0x54).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_OnInput
functions.summary: Input dispatcher: reads the stored mask at self+0x3534 and routes it to the two-tab cursor at target+0xDF8 (mask 0x102, then animator step 0xD), to the page refresh 0x0021E124 (bit 0x10), to the cancel path 0x0021DF40 plus animator step 2 (bit 4), or forwards the key vector through the cursor's +0x3C slot (bit 1).

functions.summary: Window input/step entry: on confirm it inspects the current 0x10-byte action node and selects animator step 0x13/0x14 (or toggles the node's work byte) or 0x15/0x16 depending on the node's counter, then marks the window advanced (f_356C); other masks forward to the widget/scripted-element handlers.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction12
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 0x12 on the window core at self+0x3574 and commits it.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction1F
functions.summary: Attaches the child window's widget (child+0xD8) to this window and starts window action 0x1F with no extra argument (virtual call at vtable+0x54).

Byte-identical to 0x00308970.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction1E
functions.summary: Attaches the child window's widget (child+0xD8) to this window and starts window action 0x1E with no extra argument (virtual call at vtable+0x54).

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction1
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 1 on the window core at self+0x3574 and commits it.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_SubObject_ResetChildrenAndShow
functions.summary: Resets an actor sub-object to a single child: drops children through 0x0010EBD8 until 0x0062F070 reports one left, splices self+0x3468 into the list at self+0x110, clears the child selection with Ui_Object_SelectEmbeddedNode and makes the widget at +0xD00 visible.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction2IfIdle

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction1D
functions.summary: Attaches the child window's widget (child+0xD8) to this window and starts window action 0x1D with no extra argument (virtual call at vtable+0x54).

functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 1 on the window core at self+0x3574 and commits it. Byte-identical to 0x002A6AA0; the Plain suffix is only a disambiguator.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction11
functions.summary: Attaches the child window's widget (child+0xD8) to this window and starts window action 0x11 with no extra argument (virtual call at vtable+0x54).

functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 0x12 on the window core at self+0x3574 and commits it. Byte-identical to 0x002A6908; the Plain suffix is only a disambiguator.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction16

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction1C

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction8Or2
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, resolves the selected row, removes it from the list and requests step 8 if the prompt was confirmed, or step 2 on cancel.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction0C
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8, sets the closing bytes self+0x134=1/self+0x135=0 and requests the core's default step on self+0x3574. Fourth copy of the 0x002A5DD8 body.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction12WithFlag
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8, sets the closing bytes self+0x134=1/self+0x135=1 and requests step 0x12 on the window core at self+0x3574.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction19WithTime
functions.summary: Attaches the child widget and starts window action 0x19, passing the current time value (0x0063C8BC of the global slot g_002A78D8) as the action argument instead of -1.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartActionByState
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8, sets the closing bytes and requests step 0x18 when the owner's byte +0x4A5 equals 3, otherwise step 1.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction17Or12
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, collects the pending action nodes and requests step 0x17 if the prompt was confirmed, or step 0x12 on cancel.

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_DerivedCtor
functions.summary: Derived-class constructor of the dive form: chains the base-class ctor (0x003BE214) and then installs vtable 0x0075E6D8, which repeats the base InitPanes/layout slots (0x003BD260, 0x003BD778, 0x0029FA00) and adds two slots; it builds the message/anim-ref member at +0x3574 and default-constructs its 27-entry 0x18-byte table.

functions.name: Container_KeyedListEntry_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a keyed-list entry: stores the supplied vtable at +0x174, runs the base-class destructor 0x003BE544 (which re-installs its own table) and frees the object.

functions.name: Container_KeyedList_SelectAndCommit
functions.signature: unsigned int Container_KeyedList_SelectAndCommit(Container* self, int arg2, int b, int entry)
functions.summary: Marks the container's selection as dirty and commits the currently selected entry of its keyed list; returns 1 when an entry changed.

functions.name: Container_KeyedList_SelectEntry
functions.summary: Selects and immediately commits the default keyed-list entry; the callers are the field NPC / monster action code paths that need 'pick the entry for the current action'.

functions.name: Container_KeyedList_CommitSelection
functions.summary: Commits a pending list selection: ends the previous entry (vtable slot 0xC on the old entry), begins the new one (vtable slot 8), records it as current and clears the pending index.

functions.name: Container_KeyedList_ReleaseEntry
functions.summary: Releases one entry of the keyed list (vtable slot 4) and clears the slot; returns 0 when the index is out of range.

functions.name: Container_KeyedList_Select
functions.signature: u32 Container_KeyedList_Select(Container* self, u32 index, int subIndex)
functions.summary: Selects element `index` of a container only if it exists and its sort key (f_18) is not before the currently selected element's key; optionally runs the element's own +0x20/+0x28/+0x24 vtable checks and a `func_0063AF80` notification, then stores the new key pair. Returns 1 on success, 0 when the move is illegal.

functions.name: Ui_RowList_ReleaseAllRows
functions.summary: Releases every row of a list window: calls each row's virtual slot +4, zeroes the slot, frees the pointer array and resets the bookkeeping (count 0, indices 0xFF, value 0).

functions.name: Container_SlotReplace
functions.signature: u32 Container_SlotReplace(Container* self, u32 index, void* object)
functions.summary: Replaces the object stored in slot `index`: destroys the previous occupant through its vtable slot +4, then stores the new pointer. Used by the field/monster action tables to register a compiled action object in a numbered slot.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnimEntry_Create
functions.signature: void* Battle_ActionAnimEntry_Create(u32 owner, ActionAnimDesc* src, ActionAnimDesc* src2)
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises one action-animation entry (0x4c bytes) from two parameter blocks: copies position/rotation words, sets the id/flag bytes at +0x35..+0x3a, clears the two counters at +0x3c/+0x40 and stamps the default animation id.

functions.name: Ui_RowList_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a row-list window: runs the base destructor 0x002650C4 and tail-calls operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Anim_ActionSeq_AdvanceEvents
functions.signature: void Anim_ActionSeq_AdvanceEvents(AnimActionSeq* self, int arg2, int deltaTime)
functions.summary: Advances an action/animation sequence by `deltaTime` and fires every event whose timestamp falls in the newly covered interval. Five parallel event arrays are walked with different record strides (0x14/0x08/0x18/0x3c/0x08), which is why the five cursor fields exist.

functions.name: Anim_ActionSeq_AdvanceTime
functions.signature: void Anim_ActionSeq_AdvanceTime(AnimActionSeq* self, int delta, int runEvents)
functions.summary: Advances the animation action sequence clock: with runEvents=0 it only walks the five per-type event cursors (+0x14/+0x16/+0x18/+0x1A/+0x1C) forward while their timestamps are below the new time; with runEvents!=0 it fires both event streams through 0x2A8CCC and accumulates the time.

functions.name: Anim_ActionSeq_Reset
functions.signature: void Anim_ActionSeq_Reset(AnimActionSeq* self, void* sequenceData, int playNow)
functions.summary: Prepares the sequence player for a new sequence: stores the header, zeroes the time and all five event cursors, and marks both end times as 'not reached' (0xffffffff); when `playNow` is set it immediately dispatches the events at time 0.

functions.name: Anim_ActionSeq_StepFrame
functions.summary: Steps the action sequence by exactly one frame, clamps at the clip length (clip+0x34) and resets all five event cursors when the clip wraps.

functions.name: Gfx_ObjectTable_LookupByTypeMask
functions.summary: Looks a handle up in the global object table, and when the found object's type mask at +0x30 covers the reference's mask it notifies the reference (vtable+0x14), forwards it to the object's vtable+0x48 and records the handle; returns 1 when a match was handled.

functions.name: Gfx_HandleTable_Release
functions.summary: Releases the packed handle stored at self+0x14: verifies the 11-bit generation tag in the table at 0x007B80C0, sends messages 0x10 and 0x4C to the object and then writes the invalid-handle sentinel back.

functions.name: Ui_List_MoveSelectionSkipDisabled
functions.summary: Moves the message/talk list selection one row up or down, skipping rows whose vtable+0x18 predicate reports 'not selectable', and wraps at the ends.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ApplyTalkEntry
functions.summary: Applies the currently selected talk entry: asks 0x2A9E18 for the talk/text id, stores it in the window (+0x3292), builds the entry object through vtable+0xCC and hands the result to vtable+0xF8 so the message text is laid out.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_BuildLines
functions.summary: Appends the next visible talk line(s) for the current speaker: resolves the speaker object (window vtable +0x48), looks up its text record, fills the 0x60-byte line record at +0x5d0 (clearing its 18 sub-fields and the 0x38-byte tail), then binds the line's text to the renderer and advances the line index up to 0x47 (71) lines.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CanShowMessage
functions.summary: Returns 0 when the current speaker is in state 4 or 8 (i.e. hidden/removed) so the message must not be drawn; otherwise refreshes the name/face lookup and returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_GetTalkId
functions.summary: Resolves the message id the talk window should display for its current entry: takes the speaker's party-member index from the sub-object's +0x768, reads the item equipped in hand 0 or 1 (self+0xCA4 selects the hand) and returns that item record's +0xC0, else the talk record's +0xA8, else the 0x212 default; in the second-hand path the two sentinels 0x237/0x239 are remapped to 0x23B.

functions.name: Ui_TalkWindow_RunMessageState
functions.summary: The talk/message window state machine: on every frame it advances the current state id at +0x3260 (values 0x9C0/0x9C8/0x9EB/0x9F1/...), collects/draws the visible dialogue lines, applies the current text id, handles the pager, plays the per-character voice and finally flushes the window through vtable+0x108.

functions.name: FieldParty_ResetAllMembers
functions.summary: Empties a field party: calls virtual slot +0x34 with 0, writes the 0xFFFFFFFF 'no party' marker at +0x3260 and clears the ten member-slot bookkeeping fields at +0x3278..+0x3296.

functions.name: Ui_TalkWindow_BaseCtor
functions.summary: Constructs a 0x3298-byte Ui_TalkWindow base object: runs Ui_Screen_CtorWithTextCache(self), installs vtable 0x0075E7B8 (whose +0x1C update method is Ui_TalkWindow_RunMessageState 0x002A9F4C), resets member slot and talk state fields +0x3244..+0x3296, and returns self.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a field-party member container: installs the vtable at +0, runs the party base destructor 0x00200220 and frees the object.

functions.name: Model_SetupPartsFromTable
functions.signature: void Model_SetupPartsFromTable(Model* self, int useAltTable, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Looks up one of the four part ids at self+0x3C in the model part table, clears the four part slots to the 0xFFFF sentinel and registers three part ids: row[0], row[3], row[4] for the primary row, or row[0], row[1], row[2] when useAltTable is set.

functions.name: Container_List_CountVisible
functions.summary: Counts the entries of an intrusive list (sentinel at +0xC, head +0x10) that have a live object handle (+0x110 in the global handle table) and, when requireVisible is set, also pass vtable+0x18.

functions.name: Container_List_CollectVisibleIds
functions.signature: int Container_List_CollectVisibleIds(Container* self, int first, int* outIds, int capacity)
functions.summary: Collects the +0x18 id of every visible entry into the caller's array starting at index 'first', stopping at capacity; returns the number written.

functions.name: Battle_UnitList_SetActorsFloatParam
functions.signature: void Battle_UnitList_SetActorsFloatParam(void* unitList, int requireVisible, float targetVal, float blendDuration)
functions.summary: Iterates a battle unit list (such as battleWork+0x4254, +0x4270, or +0x428C+i*0x1C), resolves each entry's actor handle (+0x110 in 0x007B80C0, RTTI-checked against g_actorBaseClass 0x007C33D4), and when actor->f_160->f_5BC != targetVal invokes actor->vt[+0x98](actor, targetVal, blendDuration).

functions.name: Container_List_FindNthVisible
functions.summary: Returns the nth entry that is visible, ready and selectable (vtable +0x18, +0x28 and +0x24 all true), or 0.

functions.name: Container_List_AllReady
functions.summary: Returns 1 when every entry of the list reports 'done' through vtable+0xD8, 0 as soon as one is still busy.

functions.name: Container_List_CollectVisibleIndices
functions.signature: int Container_List_CollectVisibleIndices(Container* self, int offset, int* out, int capacity)
functions.summary: Collects (entry id + offset) for every ready entry (vtable +0x14/+0x28/+0x24) into the caller's array; returns how many were written.

functions.name: Container_List_DestroyAll
functions.summary: Destroys every entry of the intrusive list (vtable slot 4) while leaving the list head itself intact.

functions.name: Container_IntrusiveList_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of an intrusive doubly-linked list of objects: installs the list vtable, walks every node from +0x10 and destroys its payload (virtual slot +4), then re-links the two sentinel nodes so the list is empty.

functions.name: Ui_TextListWindow_SetVisible
functions.summary: Show/hide virtual of the text list window: a tail call to Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim (the standard pane fade) supplying the window's own instance.

functions.name: Ui_RowListWindow_ApplyRowColors
functions.summary: Re-applies the four per-row text colours (normal, highlighted, dim, disabled) to all ten visible rows; when the window is flagged as dimmed the extra colour from the second pool entry is also written to the first three columns.

functions.name: Ui_RowListWindow_LoadPage
functions.summary: Fills the ten visible rows from the page's glyph-id table (`f_160`, two bytes per entry): each row gets either a formatted glyph string (via func_002AC044) or blanked text plus the default colour, then the scrollbar is moved to `page*10 + rows` and the colours are refreshed.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ClearLabels
functions.summary: Clears four text label IDs on window using func_001A6680 with NULL string, resets identifier at +0x14 to 0xFFFF, and zeroes state bytes +0x16 and +0x17.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SetMessageArg
functions.summary: Publishes a message id on a window: stores it at self+0x14, resets the two status bytes at +0x16/+0x17 and refreshes the window's five text panes, formatting the id as message argument 8 with Message_SetArg. The three body branches handle the cases 'message exists and is a word', 'message exists' and 'message missing'.

functions.name: Ui_TextListWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds a 10-row, four-column text list window (txt_l, txt_title_r_1/2/3) with numeric pagers and per-row layout animations.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_WidgetWith10Rows_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for a UI widget with ten embedded rows: base 0x2CFACC, scroller sub-object via func_00622248 and a fixed array of rows built with std_ConstructArray.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PagedWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a window derived from the 0x00760350 class: installs the derived vtable, destroys the owned 0x18-byte element array at +0x1C (std_destroy_range, 10 elements), restores the base vtable 0x00760350 and runs Ui_Object_DtorBase plus the free.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_InitDataObjects
functions.summary: Creates the three data objects of a list window from the allocator word at params+4 - the list-entry object (0x30), the row-data object (0x30) and the child-window list (0x38) - stores them at +0x14, +0x10 and +0xC and dispatches the selected one's init virtual.

functions.name: Container_NamedMap_Lookup
functions.signature: void* Container_NamedMap_Lookup(Container* self, const char* name)
functions.summary: Looks an object up by name in the name-keyed map rooted at self+0x18. It builds a 32-byte key (name copy + FNV-1a hash), queries the map and returns the stored object pointer or 0.

functions.name: Container_NamedMap_Insert
functions.signature: unsigned int Container_NamedMap_Insert(int* self, NamedRecord* rec)
functions.summary: Inserts (or re-keys) a record in the name-keyed map at self+0x18: builds the same FNV-1a name key, removes any existing node with the same sort key, then links the node into the sorted tree ordered by the record's +0x54 key.

functions.name: Container_NamedMap_EraseEntryForKey
functions.summary: Erases the name-keyed-map entry for one key before it is replaced: looks the node up with the same 9-word hash/name key as the insert path and, if a node exists, destroys the stored key string at +0x30 and unlinks the node from the red-black tree; returns 1 when something was erased.

functions.name: Container_NamedMap_Clear
functions.summary: Destroys every object stored in both name-keyed maps of a container (the +0x24 list and the +0x34 list), calling vtable slot 4 on each.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_UpdateSmoothFollow
functions.summary: Large per-frame interpolation routine: picks one of the three controller slots at +0xC, copies its value into the previous/current pair, integrates the frame delta into the accumulated x/y offsets and publishes them to the two shared state records.

functions.name: Container_List3_Destroy
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the three-slot intrusive container: runs the container destructor 0x002ADC20 and tail-calls operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Container_List3_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a container that owns three child pointers and one intrusive tree: installs vtable g_list3DtorTable, destroys the three children at +0xC/+0x10/+0x14 through vtable+4, unlinks the list at +0x34/+0x38, erases every node of the tree at +0x1C (successor via 0x00115358/0x00115390), destroys the list at +0x1C when the flag at +0xB is set, and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenController_InitChildren
functions.summary: Builds the child screen objects of a big UI screen controller: allocates and constructs fifteen children of different classes (0x94, 0x10C, 0xC0, 0x26C ... 0x5F0 bytes) into f_C..f_44, activates the initially selected child through its vtable slot 8 and runs the shared post-init.

functions.name: Container_NamedMap_LookupB
functions.signature: void* Container_NamedMap_LookupB(Container* self, const char* name)
functions.summary: Same name-keyed FNV-1a lookup as 0x2AC978 but for the second map rooted at self+0x48, using the lookup helper 0x6F3088.

functions.name: Camera_SetFocusOffsetAndBlend
functions.signature: void Camera_SetFocusOffsetAndBlend(void* cameraMgr, const float* blendDuration, const float* offsetVec3)
functions.summary: Stores a 3-float focus offset (0.0, 2.5, 0.0 when offsetVec3 is NULL) in the camera manager's +0x84..+0x8C follow-camera block, asks the camera child at f_40 to re-blend with *blendDuration and clears the +0x90 mode byte. Used by talk-zoom, cutscene and battle-UI camera code when the focus moves to a new speaker/target.

functions.name: Container_NamedMap_InsertB
functions.signature: unsigned int Container_NamedMap_InsertB(int* self, NamedRecord* rec)
functions.summary: Insert into the second name-keyed map (rooted at self+0x48): same FNV-1a key and sorted insert as 0x2ACAA4, but reusing existing nodes with the same +0x54 key before linking.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenLayer_SetCameraMatrix
functions.signature: void Ui_ScreenLayer_SetCameraMatrix(UiScreenLayer* self, const float* matrix10, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Takes a 10-float UI draw matrix, builds its orthonormal basis (position/forward/up), stores it on the object and uploads the resulting camera/projection matrices to the device's per-screen slot (device + 0x754 + screen*0x7C and +0x784, i.e. the top and bottom 3DS screens).

functions.name: Ui_Widget_SetTwoScaleTriples
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_SetTwoScaleTriples(UiWidget* self, int arg2, int b, float* s1, float* s2)
functions.summary: Stores two independent three-float scale/colour triples at +0x94 and +0xA0 (each defaulting to 0, 2.5, 0 when the source pointer is NULL), applies them to the owner object through 0x004E2A64 and marks the widget dirty.

functions.name: Ui_ModelView_SetSelectedCharacter
functions.signature: void Ui_ModelView_SetSelectedCharacter(UiModelView* self, int** character, float* scale, int force)
functions.summary: Switches a model-view window to another character model: when the record's +0x14 id changes it marks the view dirty, stores the id, rebuilds the model through the named Ui_ModelView_BuildPathTable and resets the scale triple.

functions.name: Ui_ModelView_SetSelectedCharacterB
functions.signature: void Ui_ModelView_SetSelectedCharacterB(Ui_ModelView* self, int** record, float* scale, int force)
functions.summary: Second model-view variant: takes the id from the record's +0xC field, sets mode 2 and refreshes the character text through maybe_Ui_ModelView_SetCharacterText.

functions.name: Container_NamedMap_Remove
functions.signature: unsigned int Container_NamedMap_Remove(int* self, int arg2)
functions.summary: Removes the entry with the given key from the map at self+0x48 (used by the insert path to reuse the slot) and detaches the node through 0x10EC14; returns 1 when a node was removed.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_PlaceMarkerOnUnitModel
functions.summary: Calls Battle_Ui_PlaceMarkerOnModel with the model handle at self+0x38, caches the returned byte in self+0xAD and returns it (Ghidra dropped the return value).

functions.name: Container_NamedMap_ClearB
functions.summary: Clears the second name-keyed map of a container (list at +0x54, sentinel +0x4C) and the companion list at +0x64.

functions.name: Camera_BuildProjectionMatrix
functions.summary: Builds the perspective projection matrix for the camera from the incoming FOV/near/far registers and the aspect field at +0xD4, writing the 16 coefficients at +0x160..+0x19C.

functions.name: Camera_UpdateViewAndProjection
functions.summary: Per-frame camera update: picks the active camera-work slot among the 15 entries at +0xC, copies its position/target/up into the camera, rebuilds the orthonormal view basis and its translation terms, rebuilds the projection matrix when the FOV changed, and writes both matrices into the render context (0x7C-byte camera block, offsets 0x754..0x7B8).

functions.name: Container_List15_Destroy
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the fifteen-child container: runs Container_List15_Dtor (0x002AF880, which erases the rb-tree nodes) and then frees the block with operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Container_List15_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a container with fifteen child slots plus an intrusive list: installs g_list15DtorTable, destroys every non-null child through vtable slot +4, unlinks and walks the list erasing each node with std_RbTree_EraseNode, then erases the head node.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetNumberArg
functions.summary: Pushes the window's stored number into the message text: when the 'already formatted' flag (f_214) is clear it renders `f_20c` with format id `f_210` into a local string and binds it as message argument 2, otherwise it resolves `f_20c` as a name-table id; in both cases the same string is also bound as argument 5.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_InitRenderParams
functions.summary: Initializes message window rendering parameters, setting layout scales and default colors.

functions.name: maybe_FalseEntry_MessageWindowAllocEntries
functions.summary: Not a real function: tail fragment (size computation 0x0011CFAC, alloc 0x00116AE0) inside 0x002AFA88 maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_InitRenderParams, which allocates the line-entry array.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CollectVisibleEntries
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block that reuses the caller's r4-r8/sb/sl/fp and stack frame (it starts with bl 0x0011CFDC and then reads [sp,#0x40]). Ghidra produced only halt_baddata, so the entry-walk reading cannot be re-verified.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RowRecord_Ctor
functions.summary: Default constructor of the 0x8C-byte UI row record: constructs the inline element array and writes 0xFF at +0x80 with zero at +0x84/+0x88.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_PlayVoiceSe
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_PlayVoiceSe(UiMessageWindow* self, int arg2, int b, int ctx)
functions.summary: When the talk window is active, requests SE 0x1C and stores the sound handle plus the two timing words from g_002AFCE8 in the window object.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_PushControlByte
functions.summary: Pushes a control byte into the message window's pending input queue at +0x1948: it checks that the window is the active one (0x63071C), clears the message work, appends the byte read from the queue head and executes it through Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode (0x30F258).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_StepCode3E
functions.summary: One message-window task step for control code 0x3E: in window states 2/4 it executes the 0x3E record and schedules the next step from the 0x0072B858 timing table; in states 3/5 it only finishes the step (state 1) with the alternate timing pair.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_StepCode3F42
functions.summary: One message-window task step that executes control code 0x3F in window states 2/4, or code 0x42 in states 3/5 (the two text-speed/auto variants), and then schedules the next step from the corresponding pair of the 0x0072B858 timing table.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_StepNextQueuedByte
functions.summary: Message-window task step: if the window's 0x1948..0x194C byte queue is empty it finishes the task with step state 1 and the default timing record from 0x0072B888; otherwise it pops the next byte, memmoves the remaining queue down and executes that byte as a control code.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_StepCallAndCheckCloseB
functions.summary: Message-window step: invokes the pending member-function callback stored at +0x10/+0x14 (ARM pointer-to-member encoding, virtual when bit 0 of +0x14 is set) and then sets the owner window's close flag +0x130 when (mode +0xD3C == 1 and +0xD3D == 1) or (mode is 2/3) or (+0xD3F != 0).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_StepCode3D
functions.summary: Message-window step: releases the sub-window at index 7, feeds control code 0x3D through the message interpreter and copies the next timing words (0x0072B858) into the step record.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_StepQueuedByteEx
functions.summary: Extended queued-byte step of the message-window task: if the 0x1948..0x194C byte queue is empty it finishes the task with state 5 and copies the default timing record from 0x0072BA14; otherwise it pops one byte, shrinks the queue and executes it as a control code with payload length 0x14 and the 'more text follows' flag.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_StepCallAndCheckClose
functions.summary: Message-window step: invokes the pending member-function callback stored at +0x0C/+0x10 and then sets the owner window's close flag +0x130 when (mode +0xD3C == 1 and +0xD3D == 1) or (mode is 2/3) or (+0xD3F != 0).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_StepBranchOnFlag8
functions.summary: Branches the message script on a progress flag: releases the window, then either enables tags 0x20..0x25 (flag clear) or 0x20/0x21 (flag set), pops the next queued byte and finishes with a step time read from the table.

functions.name: Ui_ScrollBar_Update
functions.summary: Scrollbar update: compares the bar's current content offset with the value object at self+8, re-centres the thumb when they differ, forwards the new offset to the thumb widget and refreshes the row drawing when the dirty flags are set.

functions.name: Ui_ScrollBar_Ctor
functions.signature: void Ui_ScrollBar_Ctor(u32* self, u32 owner, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Constructor for the scrollbar part: installs the vtable, creates and registers the 0x204-byte bar object, then builds the bar's own list node and marks it active.

functions.name: Ui_ScrollBar_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the scroll bar: installs vtable 0x0075EA1C, releases the value object at +8 through the UI core, unlinks the intrusive list node at +0xC and releases the block through the ref-counted free 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Gfx_ObjectDesc_InitShared
functions.signature: void Gfx_ObjectDesc_InitShared(ObjectDesc* desc, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4, unsigned int arg5)
functions.summary: Shared object-descriptor initialiser: runs maybe_Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init with the 0x20000000 flag word, installs vtable 0x75EA3C and stores the owner argument at +0x28.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextScrollWindow_DtorDeleteB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor: runs the base destructor 0x00193E44 and tail-calls operator delete 0x0010F6CC. The class label is inherited from the vtable slot 0x0075EA40, whose only named neighbour is Ui_ScrollBar_Update (0x0075EA24).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetCounterDisplay
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_SetCounterDisplay(CounterWidget* self, int value, u32 divisor, u32 arg4)

functions.name: Field_ActorMotion_SyncBasePosition
