functions.summary: Pushes an event object's stored transform onto the two live field actors: copies position self+0x9C..+0xA4 and sets the dirty flag on the actor at (work+8)->f_54+0x1C, derives the facing vector from the quaternion at self+0x8C..+0x98 and applies it with Gfx_EffectPart_SetDirection; the second actor at +0x20 gets the same position through Actor_ApplyModelVariant plus the 8-way facing animation (Actor_ClassifyDirection8 -> Field_SceneNode_PlayAnimation).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_UpdateVisibilityByRay
functions.summary: Ray-tests the object's stored point (position, -direction, 100.0) through the scene ray helper; when the ray is clear it deactivates the object's children, otherwise it releases the model nodes - a visibility/occlusion update, not a camera move.

functions.name: maybe_Event_SelectPartyStatusPageEx
functions.summary: Event handler that reads the page pair from the event object (virtual +0xCC and self[0x58]+0x126), selects it through Party_Status_SelectPage on the overlay manager at work+8->+0x48 and then calls Party_Status_ResumeFieldActors(...,1).

functions.name: maybe_Event_WaitForCameraB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Event_WaitForCameraB(void* eventObject, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: When the camera-side chain work+0x54->+0x20->+0xB8->+0x138 is null it advances state sequence 61 to state 3 (0x006C767C(self+0x2C8, 3)); always returns 1.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_UpdateAnimStep0
functions.summary: Asks the node animator at +0x2C8 whether step 0 has finished (vtable+0x14) and, if so, commits the transition through vtable+0x10; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SpriteActor_CreateCharacterSprite

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteChain_Node_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a sprite-chain node: creates it through the shared 0x0028EF18 builder, installs vtable g_002B6250 and constructs the 4-entry anim-ref table at +0x2C8.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_DeletingDtor

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_DestructorBodyB

It frees nothing itself.

functions.name: Ui_ActionPane_InitAnimators
functions.summary: Creates the "action" pane child for a menu window and attaches up to two animation controllers (attack/reaction) to it.

functions.name: Gfx_CollisionProxy_FindNearestPoint
functions.summary: Casts up to ten rays in a random cone around the proxy's forward axis, keeps the first point that lies inside the collision radius and stores it as the proxy's target point (+0x370/+0x374/+0x378); when nothing hits it falls back to the point on the axis at the configured distance.

functions.name: Event_Actor_PlayWalkMotion
functions.signature: void Event_Actor_PlayWalkMotion(EventObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Script-method entry for the walking gesture: resolves the handle, applies the parameter block from g_002B680C into self+0x304..+0x318 when the state is 2 and f_2E8 is set, then plays animation 0 through func_005E7848(self, 0, 1).

functions.name: Gfx_CollisionProxy_Create
functions.signature: void Gfx_CollisionProxy_Create(int* self, int* from, int* to)
functions.summary: Copies source/target positions into the object and lazily creates a child object named "collision", copying the resolved transform from the looked-up model.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a second Gfx scene-node variant: runs the node destructor 0x002B6270 and tail-calls operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_DeletingDtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a third Gfx scene-node variant: runs the node destructor 0x002B6270 and tail-calls operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_GetDirectionName
functions.signature: const char* Field_SceneObject_GetDirectionName(void* directionId, u32 directionId2)
functions.summary: Returns the direction name for a direction id: maps the id through 0x002D1810 (1 and 3 -> 2, 5 and 7 -> 6) and tail-calls 0x005F4E14, which indexes the eight-entry string table at 0x007A3100 (dir_up, dir_r_up, dir_right, dir_r_down, dir_down, dir_l_down, dir_left, dir_l_up) and falls back to entry 4 when the object's render node has +0x150 == 9.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorE_2B6B74
functions.summary: Third identical deleting destructor of the field scene-object family (sprite actor at +0x24C).

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_GetEventSceneStatus
functions.summary: Field scene-object vtable slot: evaluates the field event-scene validity test 0x00636AFC(world+0x6C) and leaves 0/1 in r0.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CreateSpriteB
functions.summary: Second sprite spawn variant for field scene objects: same model/animation setup as 0x2B4938 but with the alternate sprite child helper 0x31A658 and no drag-controller creation.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_TriggerGadgetCommandB
functions.summary: Gadget interaction variant: if the current actor is in the 'scripted' state it forwards the object rectangle to 0x22D828, otherwise sends gimmick command 0x0C with the object as argument.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorF_2B6FC8
functions.summary: Fourth identical deleting destructor of the field scene-object family (sprite actor at +0x24C).

functions.name: Ui_SelectList_BuildRows
functions.summary: Rebuilds the selection list: clears 6 row ids to 0xFF, then for each of 5 game-work flags (0x00629FB8) that is set, appends the matching list row (up to the list's row count), enables exactly that many rows and finally resizes the list widget to the number of rows.

functions.name: Ui_SelectList_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds a six-line selection list: one placeholder row plus five numbered rows, then finds and hides the five "select2".."select6" panes.

functions.name: Ui_Widget5Anim_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a UI object that owns five anim-ref-list entries: Ui_Object_CtorBase, install vtable 0x002B7818, then default-construct five 0x50-byte entries at +0x4C with the same Ui_AnimRefList ctor as Ui_AnimWidget_Ctor.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget5Anim_LoadRecord
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the widget constructor at 0x002B761C that reuses the caller's r4-r7 and stack frame (it starts with bl 0x00124E5C and then writes [r4,#0x1E4]). Ghidra produced only halt_baddata.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget5Anim_ReleaseHandles
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the same constructor that reuses the caller's r6 and stack frame (it starts with bl 0x00124F60 and then ldr r0,[r6,#4]!). The handle-release reading is unverified.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget5Anim_CreateItems
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Widget5Anim_CreateItems(u8* flag, u32 passed, u32 forwarded, u32 forwarded2)
functions.summary: Tail fragment of a UI constructor: allocates 0x1C-byte items (0x0011FE8C + 0x0011CFAC rounding), fills the first seven words with the caller's default, creates the object through 0x00293A00 and installs vtable 0x00782950.

functions.name: Ui_Window_DtorDeleteB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the big window object: runs the non-deleting destructor Ui_Window_Dtor_3 (0x002B7868) and then frees the object through operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_Window_Dtor_3
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a large window object: clears the member at +0x1E4, releases the reference-counted block at +0x1E8, frees the five 0x50-byte panes at +0x30 and destroys the embedded intrusive list node.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_UpdateIfActor
functions.summary: When the object has an attached actor (+0xF24), resolves its handle in the object table, walks the class chain and, if the object is derived from g_actorBaseClass, calls 0x00669E24 and - when that reports nothing - 0x00669DD4; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_WindowWith16Records_Ctor
functions.summary: Window constructor: stores the vtable, builds the record container at self+0x1C through 0x002DB7B4 and default-constructs sixteen 0xE4-byte records at container+0x58 with element ctor 0x00407740.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_CtorSmallVtable
functions.summary: Constructor of a small Ui widget: takes the object from the factory 0x001E4B98, installs the vtable 0x0075F88C and clears the two state bytes at +0x24 and +0x26.

functions.name: Ui_WindowFrame_NextStateStep
functions.summary: Advances the window-frame skin state machine by one step: increments the 0..6 phase at +0x5C (wrapping at the 7 sentinel), re-applies the skin and returns 1 only when the phase actually changed.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_CreateEffectForItemId
functions.summary: Rebuilds the effect a pane shows from an item id: hides the current effect, resolves the item row, takes its name string and creates/assigns the named UI effect into the pane's handle pair at +0x124.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_ShowWithSpriteSize
functions.summary: Makes a pane visible and sizes it from its sprite sheet: reads the two 16-bit size fields at sprite record +4/+6 and stores them as the pane's width/height, setting the 'size dirty' flag bits.

functions.name: Ui_WindowFrame_ApplySkin
functions.summary: Applies the window-frame skin for the current frame phase: reads the 7-byte phase table at +0x54 (0xFFFF = no frame), resolves the border texture for the phase and the next phase (id table at 0x0072CC98) into the sprite at +0x28, and then sets the visible bit of each of the sixteen border parts at +0x60..+0xA8 according to the phase - corners for phases 0/2/3/6, the two side pairs for 3/4/5, the seam pieces only for phase 1. Phases 4 and 5 additionally swap the frame texture to ids 0xA1/0xA2.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberFrag1
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It formats the first 16-bit field with a wide "%d" literal, clamping negatives to 0; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberFrag2
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It formats the second field (+4) with a wide "%d" literal, clamping negatives to 0; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberFrag3
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It formats the third field (+6) with a wide "%d" literal; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberFrag4
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It formats the fourth field (+8) with a wide "%d" literal; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberFrag5
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It formats the second value of the entry pair; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberFrag6
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It formats a constant wide literal; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberFrag7
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It formats a fixed wide literal; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberFrag8
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It formats a fixed wide literal; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_FormatNumberLoopTail
functions.summary: Not a function entry: a Thumb interior block of the routine that ends at 0x002B90D4. It the loop tail: advances the row/column counters, exits the two 5-iteration loops and restores the stack; it has no prologue and reuses the caller's registers and stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ApplyIconStyles
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ApplyIconStyles(UiMessageWindow* self, u32 messageId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Item-icon styling for a message window: caches the id at +0x4C and returns when unchanged; resolves it through Item_LookupRecord, applies the default window skin when the id is not an item, otherwise dispatches the message commands and picks the icon/effect style from the item's equipment ranges (0xA4..0x9BF, 0xB19..0xB1C) and category byte.

functions.name: Ui_ItemInfoWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_ItemInfoWindow_InitPanes(int* self, int* layout, int arg3, int arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Initialises the item/recipe information window. It binds about 130 panes: titles, category/rank icons, buy/sell numbers, four parameter blocks with sub-numbers, recipe and book rows, character slots and background/empty masks.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetTextId
functions.summary: Sets the message currently shown by a message pane: looks the text id up (0x0063E998), and either fills the control-byte array (+0x54..+0x5C) with the 'blank' sequence (7s) or with the real sequence 3,4,5,7,7,.. and applies the two message commands (0x003DFBEC) for the text and its id.

functions.name: Ui_ItemInfoWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the item-info window: base Ui_Object ctor, install vtable 0x0075F8A0, seed the id fields with -1/0xFF/0xFFFF and fill the window's eight-entry colour table so all eight 2-byte entries are colour 7.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_IconTableDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor trampoline of an embedded window sub-object: stores the incoming vtable, releases the handle pair at +0x124, runs Ui_Object_DtorBase on the enclosing object (self-0x124) and frees it. Only the callers (item-info-window teardown) tie it to a class.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_IconTableDtorBase
functions.summary: Non-deleting tail-jump variant of 0x002BB758: stores the vtable, releases the handle pair at +0x124 and branches to Ui_Object_DtorBase on the enclosing object without freeing.

functions.name: Ui_SetChildWindowVisible
functions.summary: Sets the enabled/visible flag of a child window by forwarding to the widget's flag setter at child+4 (tail call).

functions.name: Ui_TimerDisplay_SetTimeFromCentiseconds
functions.signature: void Ui_TimerDisplay_SetTimeFromCentiseconds(TimerDisplay* self, float value, float scale)
functions.summary: Splits value*scale into minutes/seconds/centiseconds (division by 6000 and the 10/100/1000 fixed-point constants) and pushes the six digits into the six digit panes at self+0x50 with stride 0x9C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_WindowWith6Blocks_Ctor
functions.summary: Window constructor: stores the vtable and default-constructs six 0x9C-byte sub-blocks at +4 with element ctor 0x00368118, the part constructor also used by the timer-display parts.

functions.name: Ui_TimerDisplay_InitDigitPanes
functions.summary: Constructs the six 0x9c-byte digit panes of the timer display in place and installs the class vtable.

functions.name: Ui_PopEntryRecord
functions.summary: Pops one byte index from the caller's vector and returns the 8-byte record with that index from the pool reached through 0x007A909C, or null when the index is out of range.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CreateItemMenuWidget
functions.summary: Factory for the 0x1170-byte item-menu widget: allocates from the UI heap, runs the Ui_ItemMenu_CreateRoot constructor (0x0019BDC4), attaches it through Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, activates it (vtable +0x24) and marks it running (f_25=1); on part failure it releases the block. Reached from a table, no direct callers.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CreateWithIconState
functions.summary: Allocates the 0x11D8-byte tactics window, constructs it with Ui_SakusenWindow_Ctor, registers it with the UI core, starts it, sets the active flag and applies Ui_Panel_UpdateStateIconFromList to initialise its state icons.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CreateAndRefreshList
functions.summary: Same Ui_SakusenWindow construction sequence as 0x002BBC3C, but the post-construction step is Ui_SakusenWindow_RefreshList, so the new window is created with its slot list already rebuilt.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CreateWithMessageId
functions.summary: Same Ui_SakusenWindow construction sequence as 0x002BBC3C, then Ui_SakusenWindow_InitPane is called with the owner's 16-bit message id (owner+0x4E) so the new window shows that message.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CreateDialogWidget
functions.summary: Factory for the 0x594-byte dialog-root widget: allocates from the UI heap, runs the Ui_DialogRoot_Init constructor (0x0019CBF4), attaches its parts through Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, activates it and marks it running; on part failure it releases the block.

functions.name: Text_FindMessageCommand
functions.summary: Searches the message-command table (0x14-byte records, count at +0, relative array base at +4) for the entry matching the current game state: first a direct (0xFF, id) match against work+0x2A49A, then a match on the scene/slot byte work+0x2A498, the per-flag byte from work+0x24A98 and the current message channel (0x005B0C68), with the two optional flags checked against the work bitmask at +0x2A444 and the per-id byte table at +0x27508. Returns the entry or 0.

functions.name: Ui_MainMenu_LoadTextResources
functions.summary: Opens the three text/message resources the main menu needs - `mainmenu_text.bxon` (entry id 0x53), `mainmenu_msg.bxon` (0x6E) and `item_failure_msg.bxon` - and stores the resource handles plus their reference-counted copies at self+4/0xC/0x14, initialising the list heads at self+0/0x10/0x18 first.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DetachAndReleaseMembers
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_DetachAndReleaseMembers(void* self, u32 value, DetachTarget* target)
functions.summary: Stores value into target+8 and then releases the three generation-tagged handle members at self+4, +0xC and +0x14, returning self. Called from Ui_Layout_UpdateScreenBuffers and maybe_Ui_MapWindow_ResolveTouchTarget, i.e. from UI layout code.

functions.name: Ui_MainMenuText_SetWindowState
functions.signature: void Ui_MainMenuText_SetWindowState(void* self, unsigned char* state)
functions.summary: Applies a main-menu text screen state: creates/releases the state-specific sub-window, copies its colour/style block and dispatches a per-state setup, keeping the last state in f_78.

functions.name: Ui_MainMenu_UpdateTextState
functions.summary: Recomputes whether the main menu's text resources are usable: cancels the in-flight request at +0x30, replaces the two owners' handle at +0x10C (-1 or a value from func_0062F070), asks the three engine layers for their idle/busy state, and stores the resulting 0/1 flag at +0x1F1 of the shared 0x1F8-byte status object.

functions.name: Ui_MainMenuText_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the main-menu text screen: installs vtable 0x75F938, loads the text resources, initialises two intrusive lists and creates the two member windows (0x348-byte main window and 0xB08-byte guide window).

functions.name: Ui_MainMenuText_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the main-menu text/message holder: releases its loaded resources through Ui_MainMenuText_ReleaseResources and then frees the object (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_MainMenuText_ReleaseResources
functions.summary: Releases everything the main-menu text holder owns: the five child resources at self+0x1C..0x2C, the global 0x1F8-byte status object, the intrusive lists at self+0x18/0x60/0x38/0x54 and the three reference-counted members at self+0x10/0x18/0x20, leaving the object in a clean empty state.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_LoadResourceFromDescriptor
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_LoadResourceFromDescriptor(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Hands the descriptor at +0x58 to the resource loader 0x0055A500, which fills the block at +0x60 and registers it in the engine memory manager's global resource list at +0x344. The first pass read this as adding the object to a render list; there is no render list here.

functions.name: Ui_IsChipLayoutPath
functions.summary: Returns true when the given layout path contains the chip-layout suffix ".chp".

functions.name: maybe_ListNode_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Second copy of the scalar deleting destructor at 0x001E6C40: installs the caller's vtable, runs the shared base destructor 0x005799D4 (base vtable 0x00782714 + unlink of the +8 list node) and then operator delete 0x0010F6CC. Byte-identical to 0x001E6C40, so it is a second class on the same list-node base, not a 'Gfx render object'.

functions.name: Ui_Window_RelocatePointerA
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_RelocatePointerA(Widget* widget, PtrSlot* slot, UiWindow* owner)

functions.name: Ui_Window_RelocatePointerB
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_RelocatePointerB(Widget* widget, PtrSlot* slot, UiWindow* owner)
functions.summary: Second pointer fix-up entry of the same window class; the body is byte-identical to 0x002BD5BC (same widget+0x98 context, same owner+0x60C marker).

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the Ui window whose relocators are 0x002BD5BC/0x002BD5F4: runs the base destructor 0x001D8C2C and tail-calls operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_EnableChildrenExceptBase
functions.summary: Enables or disables every child pane of the widget except the ones named "base" and "disabled": walks the child list and writes bit 0 of the state word at +0x10.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_EnableOnlyBaseChildren
functions.summary: Inverse of 0x002BD650: only the child panes named "base" or "disabled" get their enabled bit changed, every other child keeps its state.

functions.name: Ui_StampWindow_ShowStamp
functions.signature: void Ui_StampWindow_ShowStamp(StampWindow* self, int animate, int stampIndex)
functions.summary: Shows a quest/book stamp: picks the `stamp1` or `stamp2` sprite name, binds it to the widget's sprite pane, resets the pane transform and either stays at full scale or slides/zooms in from the animation start value.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_CtorWithSubObject
functions.summary: Constructor of a small UI widget class: runs the Ui object constructor, installs vtable 0x75F9C4 and creates the sub-object at +0x4C.

functions.name: Ui_WidgetWithSubObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the small widget built by Ui_Widget_CtorWithSubObject: reinstalls its table, releases the one embedded layout/animation reference at +0x4C, runs the base destructor and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_WidgetWithSubObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing complete-object destructor of the widget built by Ui_Widget_CtorWithSubObject: releases the embedded layout/animation reference and the base object, leaving the allocation to the caller.

functions.name: maybe_Object_GetAndSetValue
functions.signature: void maybe_Object_GetAndSetValue(void* value, u32 value2, u32* out)
functions.summary: Reads the current value through the interface vtable at pair+8 slot +4 (with the object at pair+4 as this), stores it through out, then writes the new value through slot +8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SnapToNearbyActor
functions.summary: Walks the scene object's linked list for the entry with class tag 0x7C4D9C; when that entry is not at the same position, moves this gimmick's model to the entry's x/y/z via Model_SetMeshById and then either calls Field_SceneObject_SetModelSize or 0x5F2F4C according to the entry's +0xD4 flag.

functions.name: Field_NpcFlwAction_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Field_NpcFlwAction_Ctor(void* storage, void* npc, void* actionList, const char* tag, u32 slot)
functions.summary: Constructor of the NPC follow ('flw') action object (0x2C bytes): runs Field_ActorAction_CtorBaseA and installs vtable 0x0075FA64, whose behaviour slots include maybe_Field_Gimmick_SnapToNearbyActor.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a Field object derived from the Ui layout sub-component: runs the Ui layout base destructor 0x001B7A34 and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC. It is the dtor slot of vtable 0x0075FA64.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_UpdateDeferredSubObject
functions.summary: Two-phase start of the gimmick's sub-object at +0x304: on the first frame where the event state reports idle it latches +0x350 and starts the sub-object through its virtual +0x1C slot; on every later frame it polls that sub-object through 0x0046E50C and returns its status. Returns 0 while the game work is not up yet.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update (a vtable slot of the field gimmick, next to the scene-node methods): steps the gimmick's animation frame while a marker is visible, clamps the scene object to the marker/record position and tests collision, tears the effect nodes down when the marker disappears, and finally plays the animation that matches the current direction byte.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_ClearQuestStateByte
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_SceneObject_ClearQuestStateByte(u32 index, u32 kind, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Scene-object command: forwards the command to the children, then for kind 3 maps index through a u16 lookup and writes 0xFF (unset) into GameWork + 0x24A98 + 0x5A4E + id, i.e. into the shared pastword/quest id block.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_StepAnimFrame
functions.summary: Advances the gimmick's frame index when the scene object reached the current frame's offset, then writes the new screen position and the frame's direction to the scene object.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_ApplyModelSettingsThunk
functions.summary: Thunk: forwards unchanged to 0x00180910 (maybe_Field_SceneObject_ApplyModelSettings) and returns its result. It is the vtable slot 0x0075FAC8 of the field scene-object table.

functions.name: Actor_DisableForNpcScript
functions.summary: Disables an NPC/enemy from script: clears the work words +0x2F4 and +0x290, turns off the actor bits through the vtable hooks (+0x40 and +0x58), releases its attached effects and raises the "disabled" flag bit 4 in +0x14.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_ClampObjectPosition
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_ClampObjectPosition(void* gimmick, int* basePos, int* offset, int* candidatePos, float* threshold, int axis)
functions.summary: Computes the gimmick's 2D position along one axis and stores it: takes the base point (arg2 + b) plus either the candidate point c (when the object is inside the threshold) or the camera edge at self+0xC0 (+0x54/+0x58), subtracts the camera offset (+0x5C/+0x60) and writes the result with the position setter 0x005F34F0.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitFromRecord

functions.name: Field_ActorGimmick_UpdateModel

functions.name: Field_ActorGimmick_InitFromRecord

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorGimmick_NotifyCommand1E

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_ApplyDrawEntryFragment

functions.name: Actor_Action_CurveMove_ApplyPosition

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_CurveMove_Begin

functions.name: Actor_Action_CreateCurveMove
functions.summary: Creates a curve-move action entry (opcode 2): allocates through Actor_Action_InitDescriptor, installs g_actorActionCurveMoveVtable, copies the two default control-point words from 0x007BE2D4, clears the three state words and builds the embedded cubic curve at +0x13 with 0x0017C4CC.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DtorDeleteA

The concrete action class (the table 0x0075FC64 also holds Actor_SyncFacingToTarget and the curve-move Begin/ApplyPosition pair) cannot be named from the data, so the A suffix stays.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_ApplyDrawEntryFragmentB

functions.name: Actor_Action_CopyMoveParams

functions.name: Actor_Action_CurveMove2_ApplyPosition

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_CurveMove2_Update

functions.name: Actor_Action_CreateCurveMove2

functions.name: Actor_Action_DtorDeleteB

Its method table 0x0075FC98 is the curve-move variant whose Update/ApplyPosition slots are 0x002BF298/0x002BF260, but no class name is recoverable from the data, so the B suffix stays.

functions.name: Actor_Action_Move_ApplyShadowHeightToActors
functions.signature: void Actor_Action_Move_ApplyShadowHeightToActors(ActorActionMove* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: Actor_Action_Move_Setup

functions.name: Actor_Action_Move_Update

functions.name: Actor_TrySelectIdleAnimationThunk
functions.summary: Four-byte tail jump to Actor_TrySelectIdleAnimation (0x0022CECC), forwarding every argument unchanged. The 620-byte extent Ghidra reports is the next function at 0x002BFA6C, which it merged into this entry.

functions.name: Actor_Action_Move_Finish
functions.summary: Closes the move begun by 0x002BF5C4: clears f_130 on the actor's f_B8 block and on every list object matching class mask 0x40000040, restores the actor position with maybe_Gfx_Actor_SetPosition3D(actor, f_30, &f_38, 0) when f_34 is not 1 and the position changed, calls 0x005F34F0(actor,&f_38), clears actor->f_2E9 and resets the trail samples through 0x00161E00 + maybe_Gfx_Trail_ResetSamples.

functions.name: Actor_Action_CreateMove

functions.name: Actor_Action_Move_DeletingDtor

functions.name: Actor_Action_Move_RestorePosition

functions.name: Actor_Action_Move_UpdateAnimStep0
functions.summary: Drives the move action's animator one step: takes the animator handle at +0x2C, calls its slot +0x14 with (&handle, 0), and only if that reports progress calls slot +0x10 on the same handle (tail call). functions.name: Sound_PlaySe52or53

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_ReleaseObject

functions.name: Actor_UpdateBankingTilt

functions.summary: When the owner actor reports its motion finished (0x00669DD4), switches it to the attract animation with selection 1 and always returns 1 (step complete).

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_Move_UpdateAnimation
functions.summary: Per-frame driver of a move action: adds the frame delta to the clock at +0x34, bumps the frame counter at +0x38 and dispatches the current step of the four-entry 0x18-byte table at +0x2C.

functions.name: Ui_DiveStartWindowPart_Ctor

functions.name: maybe_FalseEntry_UiLoadScreen

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Element2D_Ctor_vt76007C

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DeletingDtorA

functions.name: maybe_Container_InlineVector_PushRecord
functions.signature: void maybe_Container_InlineVector_PushRecord(InlineVector* vector, const TextSlotSource* source, int len, void* arg4, u8 flag)

functions.name: Text_MessageStack_Pop

functions.name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_A

functions.name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateListAlt

functions.name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_ExcludeThreeClasses

functions.name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_CardRange

functions.name: Item_SortIdList

functions.name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_ThreeFilters

functions.name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_ByCategoryRange
functions.summary: Item-id walk over 0x91B..0xB3A that keeps items of the requested category and appends them to the candidate list.

functions.name: maybe_Item_BuildCandidateList_TwoFilters

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Effect_CreateInstance

functions.name: Ui_StoryModel_SelectPage

functions.name: Ui_StoryPanel_SetupRecord
functions.signature: void Ui_StoryPanel_SetupRecord(StoryPanel* self, StoryPanelParent* parent, unsigned char mode)

functions.name: Ui_List_ScrollVertical

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ObjectWithArray_Ctor

functions.name: Ui_ResourceSet_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a UI resource bundle: installs the vtable, releases the four reference-counted handles at +0xC..+0x18 and the one at +0x1C, and destroys the 4-word handle array.

functions.name: Ui_Model2D_LoadResource
functions.summary: Loads the 2D model table resource `res/model2d.bxon` and keeps a reference to its 0x224 entry: it looks the resource up by name through the pack manager, walks the entry list for type 0x007E7250, validates the entry id and stores the raw pointer plus a reference-counted copy in the two output words.

functions.name: Res_HandleClear

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_Init

functions.name: RouletteActor3D_ResolveHandle
functions.summary: Resolves an entity handle through global table 0x007B80C0 and validates that its RTTI class inheritance chain matches g_rouletteActor3DClassRecord (0x007C5078).

functions.name: Ui_IconList_BindIcon
functions.signature: void Ui_IconList_BindIcon(IconListModel* self, u32 iconId, u32 state)

functions.name: Ui_Model2D_BindRotationAnimation

functions.name: Ui_Model2D_BindBaseAnimation
functions.summary: Binds the '%s_base' animation of the widget's 2D model resource and starts it at the requested frame: normalises the offset modulo 0x1C, binds through Gfx_BindSingleResource, then chains the rotation animation and applies the resulting frame to the model.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoJackpot_InitModels
functions.summary: Loads and binds the two "jackpot" / "jackpot_jp" 2D model resources of the casino jackpot display and starts their animations.

functions.name: Ui_Model2D_BindRotationByName
functions.summary: Binds the model's rotation animation by name: formats the name from the stored prefix and frame number, resolves it with Model_FindEntryById, binds the resource through Gfx_BindSingleResource and starts the animation at the fractional frame.

functions.name: Ui_Model2D_UpdateRotationPhase

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_CreateAnimObject

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdateIntro

functions.name: maybe_Container_InlineSlot_PopFront

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StoreRectPairC

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_HandleInput

It then updates every enabled row, refreshes the roulette frame and copies the default timing pair.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StoreRectPairAIfViewReady

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StoreRectPairCIfPromptNotConfirmed
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_StoreRectPairCIfPromptNotConfirmed(UiWidget* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_StartPayout

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IconList_UpdateState
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_IconList_UpdateState(IconListModel* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdatePayout
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdatePayout(void* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int b)

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_EndPayout

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_EndSequence
functions.summary: Closes the slot-machine/jackpot sequence: if the payout widget's animation has finished, plays SE 0xEA7 and resets the roulette panels; then invokes the screen's next callback and restores the start position from the layout table 0x0072AA0C.

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_ContinueIntro

functions.name: Ui_IconList_RefreshIcons
functions.signature: void Ui_IconList_RefreshIcons(IconListModel* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdateReels
functions.summary: Rebinds the reel model's base and rotation animations using the screen's frame counter (x10) as the phase, resets the counter and installs the next step pair from the screen's step table.

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdateReelResult
functions.summary: Per-state update of the jackpot reel screen: compares the two reel models' state bytes and, when both have stopped, detects a winning line from the direction dot product (threshold 0.95), sets the model state and plays the win SEs; while the payout runs it advances the payout thresholds, sets f_144 when a payout mark is reached and caches the last payout position in f_1CC.

functions.name: Ui_IconList_Tick
functions.summary: Per-frame tick of the icon grid: when the list owns a window it refreshes the visible-child draw list and the scroll widget, then stores the next frame budget from the shared timer entry.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdateStopTransition
functions.summary: Per-frame step of the jackpot screen's stop sequence: advances the transition at +0x1A8, starts the cue at +0x1D4 once the counter at +0x1BC reaches 0x37 (with a colour chosen by whether the u16 at +0xE0 is 0x3C), and when the transition state at +0x1AC equals 0x004457BC and +0x1B0 is 0, commits the pending control and copies two floats from the global 0x0072AA0C+0x88 into +0x50.

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_SetNextState
functions.summary: Minimal step transition: dispatches the screen's queued callback and installs the next {function,arg} pair from the jackpot step table into the current step at +0x50.

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_SetNextStepUpdateReels
functions.summary: Advances the jackpot screen one step by installing entry 7 of the step table (UpdateReels) into the current step pair, unless the reel animation attached through +0x44 is still running.

functions.name: Ui_IconList_TickOnAnimationEnd
functions.summary: Tick variant that refreshes the icon grid only once the open animation has finished (maybe_Ui_IconList_AreAllIdle), then stores the frame budget.

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_UpdateWidgets
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the jackpot screen: advances the camera track, applies the fade colours, updates the two reel models with the current value and ticks the optional child widget.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_CommitPendingControl
functions.summary: Commits the screen's pending control: if the owner and its pending control exist it binds that control slot at owner+0x1E18, marks the owner's layout dirty (f_94 = 1) and invokes the owner's layout virtual at f_11C+0x78.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JackpotScreen_CtorParts

functions.name: Ui_JackpotScreen_Ctor

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DeleteDtor48
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a 0x48-byte object: calls the object's own destructor through vtable slot 0 and frees the block with the sized free helper 0x00147AEC.

functions.name: maybe_Script_ThumbStub_2CC714

functions.name: maybe_Save_LoadSlotRecords
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Save_LoadSlotRecords(void* save, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Ghidra-damaged save-slot loader: formats two resource names (0x108-byte buffers through format vtable 0x0072D7B0), converts them to wide text with std_mbrlen/std_mbrtowc, splits and opens each archive entry and reads the payloads into the save work (the second into +0xE0E0 with length 0x14). It reads; it does not write.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_OpenDefault
functions.signature: void Ui_DataPanel_OpenDefault(DataPanel * self, u8 mode, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Opens a data panel in its default state: clears the busy byte, resets the game window's shared state, re-initialises the panel's party snapshot, stores the requested mode, switches the panel state machine to state 3 and takes the panel's mutex before the caller fills it.

functions.name: Save_WriteSlotStrings
functions.summary: Writes the two variable-length string blocks of one save slot: formats the slot text with the save formatter (g_2CD018), converts it to the on-disk encoding (0x504DB4), writes it (0x505DE0) and validates each step with 0x2CDB84; the second block is the 0x14-byte record at save+0xE0E0.

functions.name: Save_LoadSlotData
functions.summary: Loads one save slot into the panel object: reads the small 0x14-byte slot header into save+8 and the 0xC8B0-byte party snapshot into save+0x1830, then the trailing 0x1828-byte block into save+0xE0E0, converting the path through the slot's virtual name method and aborting with the Fs status if any read fails.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DataPanel_OpenWithStrings
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_DataPanel_OpenWithStrings(DataPanel* self, u32 mode, char* flags)
functions.summary: Opens the panel with its 31 text strings: copies 0x200 bytes per record into the string block, stamps the time hash, binds the two label panes and switches to state 5.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DataPanel_OpenWithFlags
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_DataPanel_OpenWithFlags(DataPanel* self, u32 mode, char* flags)
functions.summary: Opens the save/data panel with an option-byte block: optionally resets member triggers and writes a message control tag, initialises the party snapshot, stamps the time hash, copies the 31 member record strings and switches to state 5.

functions.name: Save_BuildSlotFilePaths
functions.summary: Builds the two on-disk names of a save slot: formats "%s/Data%d" and "%s/mini_%d" with the slot number and the "data:" mount prefix, converts each narrow name to the engine's UTF-16 form and passes it to the filesystem name helper 0x00504F0C; a negative result is reported through 0x0011ED40.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_Reset
functions.signature: void Ui_DataPanel_Reset(DataPanel* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resets the data panel to an empty state: clears the mode and secondary words, zeroes the 0x24-byte header and the small 0xE-byte field, rebinds the label pane and switches the panel to state 6.

functions.name: Save_LoadSlotHeader
functions.summary: Loads a save slot's header: memsets a 0x108-byte buffer, formats the resource name for slot through format vtable 0x0072D7A0, converts it to wide text, splits/opens the archive entry and reads 0x1828 bytes into save+8; returns 0 on success and otherwise the Fs error code.

functions.name: Fs_ClassifyResult
functions.summary: Classifies a 3DS file-system Result code into the save layer's small status enum: 0 when the call succeeded, 1 for module 0x4400 codes 100..179, 2 for 199..219, 3 for codes at or above g_2CDC40 up to 399, and 5 (after reporting a fatal error through 0x11ED40) for anything else.

functions.name: Os_CalcTimeBasedHash
functions.summary: Builds a 64-bit hash from the console's real-time clock: converts the current date/time with six calendar helpers (year, month, day, hour, minute, second) and mixes them with fixed multipliers into one 64-bit value. Used as a cheap tamper/version fingerprint for stored blocks.

functions.name: Fs_ClassifyResultB
functions.summary: Second variant of the save-layer Result classifier: 0 for success, 1 for module 0x4400 codes 0x154..0x167, 2 for everything else after reporting a fatal error through 0x11ED40.

functions.name: maybe_Save_MigrateAllSlots
functions.summary: Mounts the save data archive (shared handle 0x72D780, name 'data:') and loops over the four slots: writes each slot's strings with Save_WriteSlotStrings, validates two stored markers and the two 0x5E magic bytes, then copies the slot header fields into the per-slot record and sets the slot state (1/2 ok, 3/4 failure, 6/7 abort).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListState_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a list/scroll state block: clears the counters and flag bytes, zero-fills the 14-byte tail, allocates the 0x1820-byte table at +0x182C, restores the 0x5E cursor, the 0xFF sentinel and the 6-per-page count, and locks the state mutex at +0xE118.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DataPanel_OpenSimple
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_DataPanel_OpenSimple(void* self, u8 mode, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Minimal data-panel open: rewinds the embedded pane buffer (+0xE3C4 = 0), copies the three pane words from game work +0x2FB18..+0x2FB20, rebinds the pane through 0x0051BB08 with id 0xC, sets the pane state to 9 and locks +0xE118.

functions.name: maybe_Save_MigrateVerify
functions.summary: Verification half of the save-slot setup: mounts the same 'data:' archive, loads the slot header with slot 0xFFFFFFFF, reads the marker at save+0x1820 and compares save->f_1828 and the f_182C checksum with the 0x5E magic; writes result state f_E3C0 = 1 (ok), 4 (already done) or 3 (failed) and sub-state f_E3C4 = 3/4/6/7.

functions.name: Save_VerifyBlock
functions.signature: void Save_VerifyBlock(DataPanel* self, u8 mode, int buffer, u32 size)
functions.summary: Verifies a stored 0xc8b0-byte block: recomputes the time-based hash over the block and compares it with the 64-bit stamp stored in the global state block; on a match the data is copied into the panel's 0x200-byte string block and the state machine advances to 10, otherwise the panel reports error 3.

functions.name: Fs_FormatMiniPath
functions.signature: int Fs_FormatMiniPath(char* self, char* dst, int dstSize, const char* root, ...)
functions.summary: Formats the 'mini' variant asset path "<root>/mini_<index>" into the caller's buffer, twin of Fs_FormatDataPath with a different inline format.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DataPanel_Restore
functions.summary: Writes the panel's current mode and cached strings back to the root object and re-binds the two panes - the restore half of the mode-change path. Walks 0x1F member slots through Party_Member accessor records.

functions.name: std_UInt64Mod256
functions.signature: unsigned int std_UInt64Mod256(unsigned int lo, unsigned int hi, unsigned int value)
functions.summary: Returns `value & 0xff` after calling the 64-bit divide helper, i.e. the remainder of a division by 256 (the compiler emitted a division-by-power-of-two helper call and then kept only the low byte).

functions.name: Ui_KyoukaiWindow_CreatePanes
functions.summary: Builds the "win_kyoukai" window: instantiates the `win_kyoukai_icon` layout (part 0) and the `win_kyoukai_save` layout (part 1) into self+0x2CE and self+0x56, binds the icon/save text widgets from the shared text manager, splices the row list nodes into order and finally calls the widget's own vtable+0x48 to switch it to state 2.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_KyoukaiWindow_UpdateB
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a second win_kyoukai-class window (vtable 0x0075DF40): pumps its animator, runs the fade update, advances the key animation (Ui_AnimSequence_Update), calls the class tick at vtable+0x4C and, when the close flag is set, clears it and lazily creates/releases the shared UI object.

functions.name: Text_PushMessageByte
functions.signature: void Text_PushMessageByte(TextBufferOwner* self, unsigned char value)
functions.summary: Appends one byte to the message/command byte vector at self+0xD6C..+0xD74 (begin/cur/cap), growing through the vector's reallocate helper when full. This is the primitive every list-window row-state function uses to build its message bytecode.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetLeader
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_SetLeader(UiMessageWindow* self, unsigned int leaderId, unsigned char kind, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Selects the speaking character / message leader for the window: stores the id at +0x138, registers it with the message manager (0x00248D34 with the window's message handler +0x11C) and enables the leader pane (+0xB38).

functions.name: Text_PushMessageFlags
functions.summary: Appends the control bytes that correspond to a message-flag record: byte 5 set -> 0xB (and stop), otherwise byte 1 -> 0xC, byte 2 -> 0xD, byte 3 -> 0xE, byte 4 -> 0xF.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_ShowRowState10WithFlags
functions.summary: Appends message byte 0x0A followed by the flag-driven bytes of the row record, then runs the shared show-row tail. Recovered entry point that takes the window via a pointer-to-window (arg1+4).

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_ShowCurrentRow
functions.summary: The shared show-row tail: takes the row record at (self+0xD84, index self+0xD6C, 8-byte entries), applies the row height/style byte when < 0x21, and calls maybe_Ui_Widget_ShowWithRecord (0x001C5924) with the assembled record.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateFrame
functions.summary: Per-frame refresh of a message-style window: notifies the layout child, runs Ui_MessageText_Update, resolves the pending text id f_131 through the text-sequence manager into f_134 and starts the fade/row transition when f_D6C and f_D70 differ.

functions.name: maybe_Save_NotifyComplete
functions.summary: Marks the save operation complete: sets flag +0x12F, optionally runs the completion branch that writes a buffer through 0x0011FE8C/0x0011CFAC, copies the result byte +0x138 into game work +0x2D545 and shows the sub-object at +0xB38.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_CtorBase
functions.signature: void Ui_ListWindow_CtorBase(UiListWindow* self, unsigned int* params, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Base constructor of the list window: installs vtable 0x007602E0, copies the 4-word parameter block (+0x11C..+0x128), clears the selection/scroll fields to 0/0xFF, initialises the message manager member at +0x13C and constructs the 3 x 0x330-byte page widgets.

functions.name: Ui_Drawable_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the base 2D drawable widget: runs the non-deleting destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_Drawable_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the base 2D drawable widget: tears the widget tree down in reverse member order (the 0xD88 refcounted block, the 0x3C intrusive list, three list heads, the 0x54/0x84 list nodes, three 0x50 containers, the 0x330 container array, the 0xD30 reference and the 0x148 sub-object at 0x001D8C2C).

functions.name: Ui_PageList_StepSelectionDown
functions.summary: Moves the paged list's selection down by one and notifies the owner: calls Ui_TextListWindow_StepItemRects(self+0x54, 0) - which maps 0 to a -1 step - and then the owner's +0x6C slot with the stored index at self+0x64.

functions.name: Ui_PageList_StepSelectionUp
functions.summary: Upward twin of 0x002CF838: passes 1 (a +1 step) to Ui_TextListWindow_StepItemRects and then notifies the owner's +0x6C slot with the stored index at self+0x64.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorThenFree_SetVtable
functions.signature: void Ui_Object_DtorThenFree_SetVtable(unsigned int* self, unsigned int vtable)
functions.summary: Destructor thunk that stores the given vtable and then runs the UI object destructor and the delete.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BigGrid_Teardown
functions.summary: Flag-gated teardown of a large grid/dive-form screen: when bit 4 of self+0x3770 is clear it either pops the dive-form pane stack at self+0x134 or, for bit 1, releases the pack handles, the layout refs and the embedded UI objects (Pack_ReleaseHandle, Ui_LayoutRef_Release, Ui_Object_DtorBase, std_destroy_range) and finally destroys the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GridCursor_ApplySelection
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_GridCursor_ApplySelection(UiGridController* grid, int allow, u32 delta, u32* out)
functions.summary: Applies a pending grid-cursor selection: reads the current cell/index through the controller's +0x58/+0x5C virtuals, writes the new index and cell count to the caller's output and releases the previous owner.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Drawable_ReleaseMembers
functions.summary: Member-release half of the drawable widget teardown: releases the 0xD88 reference, the 0x3C list, the list heads and nodes, the 0x50 containers, the 0x330 container array, the 0xD30 reference and the 0x148 sub-object.

functions.name: Ui_Object_CtorSmallB
functions.summary: Second minimal UI object constructor: Ui_Object_CtorBase, install its own vtable and clear the two trailing owner/child words. Same shape as 0x002B1E0C, different vtable.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorThenFree_NoVtable
functions.summary: Destructor thunk that runs the UI object destructor and the delete without changing the vtable.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_AdvanceChildAndSetCharacter
functions.summary: Window virtual that advances the active child page (self+4 +0x748), pushes the pane pair at +0x13C/+0xBFC with the shared layout descriptor, then applies the page's current member id to the status panel at +0xB5C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Text_FitLineWidth
functions.summary: One copy of the shared member-row update block: resolve the party members at self+0x0A and glyphId, resolve the spell record at self+0x09, and when the member record carries flags 0x0C clamp member+0x16 by the spell record's +0x2EC and re-apply the two row colours; otherwise start transition 0x45/0x47. Ghidra truncates the clamped path with halt_baddata().

functions.name: Ui_MessageVoice_SelectBlipPattern
functions.signature: void** Ui_MessageVoice_SelectBlipPattern(int lineIndex, int hasLongRun, void** outDesc)
functions.summary: Selects one of five static message-voice typing-blip pattern descriptors (0x00773DE0..0x00773E10, 0x0076E29C) using weighted random choice based on lineIndex and hasLongRun, writes it to *outDesc, and returns outDesc.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Sequence_AdvanceTimedStep
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Ui_Sequence_AdvanceTimedStep(void* self, int* ctx)
functions.summary: Timed UI sequence step: increments the frame counter at +0x10, plays an SE at steps 0 and 0x49 through Sound_PlaySeCached, and reports done when the sub-object at (*ctx+0xC)+0x1540 has no value or its float at +0x24 equals the constant at 0x00645828.

functions.name: Ui_DigitRoll_Update
functions.summary: Animates a five-digit rolling counter: plays an SE at step 0 and step 10, scrolls each of the five digit sprites according to the counter and reports completion after 0x2E steps.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_RelocateRecordPointerA
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_RelocateRecordPointerA(UiWidget* self, void* record, void* loader)
functions.summary: Layout-load fix-up: marks loader+0x60C with the pointer being patched, resolves the stored offset through the widget's relocation table and writes the pointer back before clearing the marker.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_PlayOutcomeAnim
functions.summary: Plays the outcome animation of the smith mini-game: maps outcome 0..3 to the layout panes txt_charge / txt_seikou / txt_daiseikou / txt_shippai, stops the previous animation, starts the named animation through Ui_PlayAnimByName and applies the animation speed via slot +0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateChargeSlotList
functions.summary: Walks a list of 0x0B-stride timer/effect slots and calls the per-slot updater 0x001EE8B4 on every entry.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_RelocateRecordPointerB
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_RelocateRecordPointerB(UiWidget* self, void* record, void* loader)
functions.summary: Second emitted copy of the layout-record pointer relocation helper: marks loader+0x60C, re-bases the offset through the widget's table and stores the pointer back.

functions.name: Ui_DigitRoll_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the number-rolling widget: allocates through the UI base constructor 0x001D8B6C, installs vtable 0x00760480 and clears the id word at +0x11C.

functions.name: Ui_DigitRoll_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the number-rolling widget: runs the shared base destructor and then operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GetTableByteByChild
functions.summary: Returns one byte from a two-word static table at 0x0072B09C, selected by the child index stored in self->f_38->f_C and by the flag self->f_BC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SetWidgetEnabled
functions.summary: Widget state vtable slot: when the widget is still uninitialised (+0x14 clear) and the new state is non-zero it raises the UI core's mode word at +0x94, then forwards the flag to the object's state setter.

functions.name: Ui_NumberRoll_Update
functions.summary: Drives a slot-machine style digit roll: waits until the digit strings have been laid out, then increments the counter byte group by group with decimal carry (a '9' becomes '0' and carries into the next group), switches between the two panes depending on func_0062A2FC and finally loads the two digit glyph pairs (0x0c/0x0e) into the panes.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small panel object owning two 0x50-byte panes: installs the vtable, destroys the panes at +0x4C and +0x9C (0x50 apart), destroys the list and frees.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ApplyRowColorState
functions.summary: Applies one menu row's state: queries the overlay cursor-row state (1, 2 or 3), and for each state performs the same row update - resolve the party member at self+0x0A and the skill record at self+0x08, clamp member+0x16 by the record's cost (+0xEE), then push the two row colours (Ui_ApplyTextColorAlt / Ui_ApplyTextColor on pane+0x68C) and start transition 0x2A with tail 0x32/0x33/0x34. With state 0 it runs 0x37/0xFF instead.

functions.name: Anim_Clip_ConvertTracks
functions.signature: void Anim_Clip_ConvertTracks(AnimTrack* out, AnimSource* src, void* base, AnimTrack* trackBase, void* stepBase, void* step2Base, int* owner)
functions.summary: Converts one animation track: fills the 0x58-byte output record (source pointer, base/linked track, 6-word keyframe header, 0x14/0x4C step arrays) and, when the owner has a table, resolves the 4-byte step entries through the script int table (0x00193F54) and appends them to the step list.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteTree_SetRenderMode
functions.summary: Applies a render mode to every sprite in a sprite tree: mode 0 detaches each sprite from its layer, other modes attach it to the layer stored in the entry.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteTree_UpdateLayerAssignments
functions.signature: void Ui_SpriteTree_UpdateLayerAssignments(UiSpriteTree* self, u32 requestedLayer, u8 blend)
functions.summary: Re-assigns every sprite in the tree to a layer, promoting sprites whose source object requests a special blend mode (object+0x50 == 1 or 2) to layer 2, and stores the blend byte for the renderer.

functions.name: Anim_SpriteList_SetMode
functions.signature: void Anim_SpriteList_SetMode(int self, unsigned int mode, unsigned char flags)
functions.summary: Applies a playback mode to every sprite-animation entry: resets the 0x58-byte entries, then restarts or reconfigures each 0x14-byte slot through func_0029F34C (mode 0 is promoted to 2 for special entries).

functions.name: Anim_SpriteList_Clear
functions.summary: Destroys every 0x58-byte sprite-animation entry in the list (calls the per-entry destructor).

functions.name: Ui_SpriteList_ApplyFrame
functions.signature: void Ui_SpriteList_ApplyFrame(void* self, int frame, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Applies a frame/argument pair to every sprite in the list (count at +0x14, array at +8, stride 0x14) through Ui_Sprite_BuildQuadFromFrame.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSet_Build
functions.signature: void Anim_ClipSet_Build(AnimClipSet* self, AnimAllocator* alloc, AnimResource* res, unsigned char layer)
functions.summary: Builds the runtime clip set for a resource: allocates res->f_24 clip entries of 0x7C bytes and fills each with Anim_Clip_Build, copying the layer byte into each clip's +0x72 and finally sorting them (0x0029E3B0).

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_ApplyParams
functions.signature: void Ui_Sprite_ApplyParams(UiSpriteParams* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Copies a compact sprite/text parameter block onto the live render node at self+0x0C (scale, size, character code, colours, blend flags) and then applies the sprite-tree layout so the change becomes visible.

functions.name: Anim_Instance_Update
functions.summary: Updates the widget's active animation instance: advances the clip and then re-applies the layout animation to the linked panes.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSet_Release
functions.summary: Releases the clip array allocated by Anim_ClipSet_Build (operator delete[] at +8, clear the clip count).

functions.name: Anim_ClipSet_PlayById
functions.summary: Starts the animation clip with the given id: walks the clip array from the end, and on a match makes it the active clip, copies its settings, starts it, applies the blend offset and mode, and finally stops every other clip in the set.

functions.name: Anim_Instance_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of an animation instance: installs the class vtable, deletes the owned array at +8 through std_operator_delete_array and clears its slot fields.

functions.name: Anim_PlayByIdForActor
functions.signature: u32 Anim_PlayByIdForActor(Actor* self, int clipId, int force)
functions.summary: Plays a named animation clip on an actor after checking that its model is ready and not hidden; also updates the actor's animation-blend target so the transition is smooth.

functions.name: Anim_PlayById
functions.signature: u32 Anim_PlayById(AnimOwner* self, u32 clipId, int force)
functions.summary: Play helper without the actor-state checks: skips the request when the clip is already current and `force` is 0, otherwise activates it through the clip set and retargets the blend.

functions.name: Anim_Instance_ApplyTemplate
functions.signature: void Anim_Instance_ApplyTemplate(int* self, void* params, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Resets an animation instance (vtable slot 0x10) and copies the large default parameter template g_002D150C into it, overriding selected fields from the caller's parameter block.

functions.name: maybe_Thunk_StateSequenceChangeStateA
functions.summary: Two-instruction trampoline (push {r4,lr}; bl 0x006C8108; pop {r4,pc}) that forwards its three arguments unchanged to the state-sequence transition dispatcher 0x006C8108.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSet_PlayByName
functions.signature: void Anim_ClipSet_PlayByName(AnimClipSet* self, AnimResource* res, AnimPlayRequest* req)
functions.summary: Switches the clip set to another animation: resolves the requested clip id, assigns it to the model (0x003B3650), releases the previous clip set, builds a new one for the resource and plays the requested clip by name or by id (Anim_ClipSet_PlayById), then fills the event fields.

functions.name: maybe_Thunk_StateSequenceChangeStateB
functions.summary: Two-instruction trampoline (push {r4,lr}; bl 0x006C8108; pop {r4,pc}) that forwards its three arguments unchanged to the state-sequence transition dispatcher 0x006C8108; same body as 0x002D1588 and 0x002D1F1C.

functions.name: Actor_ClassifyDirection4
functions.summary: Classifies a 2D direction delta into four facing sectors (0, 2, 4, 6 = north/east/south/west as used by the 8-way direction set), based on the angle against the reference forward vector and the sign of the cross product.

functions.name: Actor_ClassifyDirection8
functions.summary: Classifies a direction delta into the 8-way facing set (0..7, even = axis aligned, odd = diagonal) by comparing the angle against the reference forward vector with four thresholds and the sign of the cross product for left/right.

functions.name: Anim_Owner_Tick
functions.summary: Per-frame animation update of an object that owns one animation instance: if a pending transition is set at +0x108 it snaps the player to that frame first, then advances the embedded anim instance at +0xFC.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSet_Refresh
functions.summary: Rebuilds the clip set from the current resource when the resource changed (0x003B3650 returns true), then plays the default layer clip and notifies the parent with event 1.

functions.name: Anim_Instance_Tick
functions.summary: Single-step animation tick: runs the instance update and unconditionally reports success (returns 1).

functions.name: Anim_Resource_Bind
functions.signature: int Anim_Resource_Bind(int self, unsigned int* desc, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Binds (or re-uses) the widget's 2D model resource: returns 0 when the same id and alpha are already bound, otherwise destroys the old instance, allocates a 0x6C replacement, loads it through Ui_2dModel_Load and stores the new id/colour block.

functions.name: Anim_BindWithDefaultContext
functions.summary: Builds a default 0x30-byte bind context through 0x0011FFD8, zeroes its three trailing fields and passes it to Anim_Resource_Bind. The callers are the actor model rebuild paths, which want the default binding rather than a caller-supplied context.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSet_ApplyPending
functions.summary: When a clip request is pending (self+0x138) and its resource is loaded (0x006488D0), applies it through Anim_ClipSet_PlayByName, resets the request fields and then updates the owner (0x004602B0). Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_UpdateAndReportDone
functions.summary: 16-byte wrapper: runs the pending-dispatch helper 0x0046011C on the object and then returns 1 ('handled'). 0x0046011C itself only does anything when self+0xC is non-zero, in which case it tail-calls 0x0046015C(self, 1, 0).

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_UpdateFromLayout
functions.summary: Refreshes a sprite/text draw object from its attached layout entry: reads the layout position floats at +4/+8, moves the embedded sprite at +0xFC and re-applies its parameters; returns 1 even when nothing is attached.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_ClipSet_TickAndEnterState1
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the clip set: ticks the embedded 3-state sequence at +0x3C (when no transition happened it stores dt at +0x4C, adds it to the state timer at +0x44 and increments the frame counter at +0x48), then requests state 1 through the sequence's ChangeState dispatcher 0x006C8108.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseTwoSubObjects
functions.summary: Tears down two owned sub-objects: releases the embedded animator at self+0xFC, then releases and nulls the two objects at +0x134 and +0x138 (each through 0x003B3C74 + the virtual destructor).

functions.name: maybe_Thunk_StateSequenceChangeStateC
functions.summary: Two-instruction trampoline (push {r4,lr}; bl 0x006C8108; pop {r4,pc}) that forwards its three arguments unchanged to the state-sequence transition dispatcher 0x006C8108; same body as 0x002D1588 and 0x002D1804.

functions.name: Anim_Instance_CtorSprite
functions.signature: void Anim_Instance_CtorSprite(AnimInstance* self, AnimInstanceDesc* desc, AnimAllocator* alloc)
functions.summary: Constructor of a sprite/animated-object instance: builds the base instance from the descriptor via 0x002D9744, installs the instance vtable and constructs the 3-entry anim-ref table at +0x3C.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_Owner_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of an object that owns an animation instance: stores the incoming vtable, destroys the embedded Anim_Instance at self+0xFC through Anim_Instance_Dtor and the 0x002650xx module, then frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Label_SetTextId10
functions.summary: Sets the label to the string registered under text id 0x10, one half of the on/off label pair used by the toggle widget at 0x002D20F4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Label_SetTextId11
functions.summary: Sets the label to the string registered under text id 0x11, the other half of the on/off label pair used by the toggle widget at 0x002D20F4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ToggleLabel_SetState
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ToggleLabel_SetState(void* self, int value, unsigned char mask)
functions.summary: Applies a toggle state: splits value into 'off' (value & ~mask, f_1A8) and 'on' (value & mask, f_1E0), then writes the corresponding text id (0xF when off, 0x11 when on) into the label.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Pane_StartAnimFrame15
functions.summary: Starts animation track 15 on the pane referenced by f_18 and passes the frame number from f_10 (packed as frame<<16) to the pane's animation call.

functions.name: Gfx_Resources_Release
functions.summary: Releases the three optional graphics resource handles (f_34 animation, f_38 motion, f_3C model) if present and clears their slots.

functions.name: Anim_Instance_ReallocHandle
functions.summary: Rebuilds the animation instance's helper object: destroys the old object at +0x44 through its vtable slot 4, allocates a 0x40-byte block from the instance heap and constructs a fresh helper with 0x002129A0.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseChildScreen
functions.summary: Releases the child screen/object held at self+0x48 through Ui_GuideWindow_ReleaseChild and clears the child's active byte at +0x94.

functions.name: Gfx_Resource_Recreate3C
functions.summary: Frees and recreates the 0x84-byte model resource stored at f_3C.

functions.name: Ui_ClearChildrenAndDeleteSlot
functions.signature: void Ui_ClearChildrenAndDeleteSlot(UiObject * self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Tears a UI object down: detaches the six children tracked at +0xC (keeping the raw pointers, releasing the references) and then deletes the object whose handle sits at +0x48 through the UI core's non-clearing delete helper.

functions.name: Gfx_Resource_Recreate34
functions.summary: Frees and recreates the 8-byte resource handle stored at f_34 (animation player).

functions.name: Ui_EnsureSubObject
functions.summary: Lazy child creation: when self+0x48 is null, allocates a 0x1D4-byte object from the UI heap, constructs it with Ui_GuideWindow_Ctor, registers it through Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable (freeing it again on failure) and stores it at self+0x48 with +0x94 cleared.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_ReleaseMembers
functions.summary: Releases every owned member of a UI screen in order: the animator at +0x34, the model at +0x38, the title-screen object at +0x3C, the resource pair at +0x40, the owned object at +0x44, the child list at +0xC and the sub-object at +0x48, clearing each pointer after the release.

functions.name: Anim_Instance_ReleaseHandle
functions.summary: Releases the instance's animation handle (+0x44) through its virtual destructor and clears the field.

functions.name: Gfx_Resource_Recreate38
functions.summary: Frees and recreates the 0x20-byte resource handle stored at f_38 (motion/locomotion data).

functions.name: maybe_Container_ArrayCtor3
functions.signature: void maybe_Container_ArrayCtor3(u32 * self, u32 * params, u32 u32, u32 u322)
functions.summary: Stores the two caller words and params+4 at +0..+8, sets the static table pointer maybe_g_arrayCtorTable at +0xC and default-constructs three 0xC-byte elements at +0x10 with element ctor 0x0060E9C8.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the UI screen: installs the screen vtable 0x007605D4, calls the confident Ui_Screen_ReleaseMembers, switches the embedded sub-objects to the Gfx_Screen vtable, destroys the three 0xC-byte screen entries and frees the object.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadowPass_Release
functions.summary: Releases the character shadow pass: the shadow texture/render target (0x0057E518, 0x0055E21C), the shader pair (0x0055D888), the two vertex buffers (0x00564054/0x00569CB8), the material (0x00579794) and the sampler (0x005644A8), and clears the shared pass state at 0x007AE500.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawSprite
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawSprite(OverlayCtx* self, u32 arg2, u32 layer)
functions.summary: Draws one overlay sprite: lazily creates the 0x28-byte draw state, looks the sprite record up (0x1DB6BC with the layer byte) and submits it with 0x56AC80 followed by 0x55D868; used by both overlay draw passes.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawScreenQuad
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawScreenQuad(OverlayCtx* self, GfxCmd* cmd, int screen)
functions.summary: Draws a full-screen textured quad for the top or bottom screen: picks 400x240 or 320x240 from the screen argument, builds the two vertices with the current Gfx scene transform, submits the copy commands and flushes.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_BeginDraw
functions.summary: Starts the 2D overlay draw for one screen: ends the previous overlay frame, draws the 3D overlay passes, then issues the overlay quad/backdrop/content passes through the command list and stores half the screen height in self+0xB0 (a 320-pixel screen gives 160).

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_EndFrame
functions.summary: Ends an overlay frame: flips the double-buffered overlay page (+0x18/+0x19), clears the new page's two fields, draws the frame's node list, releases the overlay resource and flushes the command list; the first call also lazily creates the 0x28-byte draw state.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawSortedList
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawSortedList(OverlayCtx* self, u32 cmd, IntrusiveList* list)
functions.summary: Draws an overlay list ordered by the per-entry priority byte at +0x6C: builds a temporary sorted copy of the list (0x1235A4/0x1235A4 splice helpers) and submits each entry through 0x577868.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawBackdrop
functions.signature: int* Gfx_Overlay_DrawBackdrop(OverlayCtx * self, u32 cmdArg, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Draws the full-screen backdrop quad (240x320) into the render command list and, unless the scene's 'skip overlay' bit (f_1346 bit 1) is set, submits it as a sorted element and flushes the buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawContent
functions.signature: int* Gfx_Overlay_DrawContent(GfxOverlay* self, u32 x, u32 y)
functions.summary: Draws the overlay content into the 320x240 top screen: sets up the destination rect, clamps the given position, binds the overlay texture and configures the two viewport/sub-rect structures when the wide flag is set.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawMainScreen
functions.signature: int* Gfx_Overlay_DrawMainScreen(OverlayCtx* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Main overlay draw pass: draws the 400x240 background quad, then the three sorted sub-lists, a sprite batch and the 0x100x0x200 scene rectangle when present.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawFourQuads
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawFourQuads(OverlayCtx* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Overlay draw pass that emits four consecutive 0x408-byte quads (texture commands 0x1000..0x1300) around one source rectangle and then walks two priority-sorted overlay lists.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LayoutAnim_SwitchCaseBlock
functions.summary: Not a function: a Thumb jump-table case block that sits 2-mod-4 inside maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawMainScreenB (0x002D3E1A) and branches back into that function's common tails. The recovered C is a mixture of unaff_ registers and halt_baddata.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawMainScreenB
functions.summary: Second variant of the main overlay draw pass: the same 0x2D2930/0x2D31B0/0x2D4484 submission sequence plus 0x0055DC6C, used when the overlay mode differs from 0x002D36C8.

functions.name: Gfx_Model_DrawOverlayPasses
functions.summary: Draws an overlay 3D model for both screens: accumulates the spin angle, builds part matrices and node lists for view 0 and view 1, optionally runs the model's post pass, then derives the inverse camera basis from the model's camera matrix and uploads it to the two per-screen draw contexts.

functions.name: Gfx_SortAndSubmitByPriority
functions.signature: void Gfx_SortAndSubmitByPriority(void* self, u32 pass, void** list, u32 arg4, u32 sort)
functions.summary: Collects the elements of an intrusive list, inserts each into a second list ordered by its +0x88 key against the node's +0x22 byte, and submits the ordered result through Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteListTransition.

functions.name: Gfx_SubmitSortedElement
functions.signature: void Gfx_SubmitSortedElement(RenderElement* self, unsigned int pass, int layer)
functions.summary: Submits one render element (text/model) for a pass: sets up the model instance state, walks the element's three sub-lists (meshes, sorted transparent parts, overlays), sorts the transparent parts by depth (f_1E - f_26 + f_22) and issues the per-part draw/state calls.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadowPass_Init
functions.summary: Creates the character-shadow render pass: loads the "ChipShader.shbin" shader pair and the "syscmn.bch" common resource and instantiates the "cha_shadow01" shadow model/texture setup.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderPassTask_Init
functions.summary: Constructs a render-pass task object: initialises four intrusive linked lists, clears the task fields and installs the "Task_RenderPass" type name.

functions.name: maybe_Container_Node_DtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the class whose vtable is 0x007824E0: vtable install, conditional release of the inline string at +0x1C, unlink of the two intrusive list heads, free. Byte-identical copy of 0x001C635C.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_PushVariantEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_RecipeBook_PushVariantEntry(UiRecipeBook* self, unsigned int recipeId, unsigned int variantId, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Appends one 4-byte variant entry {u16 id = 0x001F2F4C(recipe,variant), u8 kind = 0x001F303C(recipe,variant), u8 a4>>24} to the recipe book's variant vector at self+0x4, growing it when full.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_BumpSpawnCounter
functions.summary: Increments the small counter at self+0xC, saturating at 10 instead of wrapping; the rest of the 22-byte body is bad instruction data.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_AttachChildToFreeSlot
functions.summary: Finds a free child slot with 0x00649050; on 0xFF it raises the list-full flag at +0xC, otherwise it marks the chosen child and resets the +0/+8 bookkeeping.

functions.name: Ui_SubObjectHost_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the small sub-object host that owns one 0x200-byte child window: installs vtable 0x00760628, builds the child through Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, registers the host in the priority-2 UI update list (id 0x12F) and links it to its neighbour. Used by fourteen menus that need a one-child sub-object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SubObject_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the sub-object host: installs the vtable, unregisters the update-list node at self+0x14, releases the owned child through the UI context and releases the host.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_ShowWithSpriteSizeEx
functions.summary: Shows the pane, copies the sprite's 16-bit width/height into the pane size and sets the 'transform dirty' bit while clearing the 'size dirty' bit — the variant used when the pane must be re-laid out.

functions.name: Ui_TutorialPane_ShowEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_TutorialPane_ShowEntry(UiTutorialPane* self, unsigned int tutorialId)
functions.summary: Shows a tutorial entry: looks the id up (0x0063E3C8), sets the two label panes of the row and, when the record has an icon, creates the tutorial picture effect from "ui_tutorial_%s.bch".

functions.name: Ui_KeyHintWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_KeyHintWindow_InitPanes(int* self, int* layout, int arg3, int arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Binds the key-hint window: title text plus the left/right key icon panes and their animation lookup.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorThenFreeEx
functions.signature: void Ui_Object_DtorThenFreeEx(unsigned int* self, unsigned int vtable)
functions.summary: Destructor thunk for a UI object with an embedded sub-object at +0x4C: stores the given vtable, destroys the sub-object and frees the memory.

functions.name: maybe_Container_SortRangeByKind
functions.summary: Jump-table dispatcher over nine tiny stubs: each stub loads the begin/end pointer pair from self+0/+4 and sorts that 16-byte-element range with a fixed comparator - cases 0..2 pass a comparator function pointer to 0x7230BC, cases 3..8 pass comparator index 0..5 to 0x722EDC.

functions.name: Container_Vector16_PushRecord
functions.summary: Appends a 16-byte record to a vector of 16-byte elements: builds the default record (0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFF, 0x10000, 0xFF...), copies 0xD bytes from the argument over it, then stores it at the write pointer or inserts it via std_vector16_insert.

functions.name: Ui_ListData_BuildEntries
functions.signature: void Ui_ListData_BuildEntries(UiListData* list, int mode, int limit, int arg4)
functions.summary: Builds the entry list shown by the multi-purpose list window: mode 0 collects the character/actor rows (0x8c-byte records at root+0x24a98), mode 1 the item rows (0x98-byte records at root+0x6b8), 2 both, 3 the third table (f_7bb6/f_7bc0), 4 the fourth and 5 a mixed set; each entry is four words (index, packed id/size, packed flags, kind).
