functions.name: Script_DispatchStateCallback
functions.summary: Dispatches a stored script callback according to the state byte at site+0x11C: states 0..3 call the fixed native function pointers 0x001492BC / 0x00149204 / 0x00147DC4 / 0x00154BE8 through 0x007230BC, and states 4..9 forward to the VM's indexed native call 0x00722FCC with index 0..5.

functions.name: Container_Vector16_EraseAt
functions.signature: unsigned int Container_Vector16_EraseAt(Vector16* self, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Removes the 16-byte element at the given index from a vector of 16-byte elements (shifting the tail down with 0xD-byte copies), shrinks the size and returns the removed element's first word (-1 when the index is out of range).

functions.name: Ui_LayoutRequest_Type6
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutRequest_Type6(u32 scene, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Queues a layout/format request of type 6 for the scene: builds the stack argument with the low byte forced to 6 and tail-calls the layout loader.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutRequest_Type1
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutRequest_Type1(void* scene, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int b, unsigned int c)
functions.summary: Requests a type-1 layout load for the scene, then resets the corner-gradient colours of the current layout and reloads the scene's 2D model resource.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutRequest_Type4
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutRequest_Type4(u32 scene, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Queues a layout/format request of type 4 for the scene (type byte 4 in the stack argument, tail-call 0x006DDFA4).

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseHandleBlockB
functions.summary: Releases the eight-handle block at self+0x9E4 (four bytes apart), clearing each handle word and returning it to the handle table.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseLayoutResources
functions.signature: void Ui_ReleaseLayoutResources(void* scene, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Releases the UI/layout resources owned by a field-scene object: frees the face-icon handle array at scene+0x3E4, clears the resource handle at +0x3E8 and forwards the scene plus resource id to Field_SceneObject_ReleaseResourceHandles. Called from Ui_SceneFlow_TeardownAll and from the scene-object destructor, i.e. on scene teardown.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutRequest_Type5
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutRequest_Type5(u32 scene, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Queues a layout/format request of type 5 for the scene (type byte 5, tail-call 0x006E0B28).

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseHandleBlockC
functions.summary: Releases the large handle block at self+0x834 (the 0x834..0x9E0 run of alternating mark/handle words), clearing each handle and returning it to the handle table.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseHandleBlockA
functions.summary: Releases the handle block at self+0x784 (0x784..0x830), clearing each handle word and returning it to the handle table.

functions.name: Ui_LookupMapValueById
functions.signature: unsigned short Ui_LookupMapValueById(void* self, unsigned int key, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int b, int direct)
functions.summary: The map/handle value lookup: it resolves a key through the self+0x7CC table and returns the 16-bit value at +0x54.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_InitRows
functions.summary: Builds a simple N-row text list using the placeholder pane name null_txt_l1, with the usual incrementing row labels.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorThenFree_Variant2
functions.summary: Destructor thunk: runs the UI object destructor and frees the memory.

functions.name: maybe_GameMode_IsPlayable
functions.summary: Returns true unless the shared global mode value from 0x00664A80 is 8 or 0xFF, i.e. unless the game is in one of the two loading/transition modes.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_IsRenderMode400
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the Field2D manager's sub-object at +0x08 holds 0x400 in its +0x14 field. The three callers use the answer as a part-selector / layout switch, so it is a mode test, not a renderer profile.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_ProbeAdjacentCell
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Overlay_ProbeAdjacentCell(u8* self, u32 slot, int* offset)
functions.summary: Builds a small cell descriptor (2/2/2/1 from g_002D7AE4) from the target widget position (core+0x54+0x20, f_78/f_7C) and probes one neighbouring cell: left by 2 + width when offset[0] < 0, right by 2 when offset[0] > 0, or one row up/down when only offset[1] is set, always through Field_Placement_TestAreaC.

functions.name: Map_QueryCellRecord
functions.signature: void Map_QueryCellRecord(u32 * out, u32 x, u32 y, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves one map cell by (x,y) and writes {y, cell pointer, record pointer} into the caller's triple, requiring the cell to be walkable (flag +0x38 == 1) and populated (+0x20 > 0); on failure it writes the 0xFFFFFFFF sentinel triple.

functions.name: Map_IsCellSolid
functions.signature: unsigned char Map_IsCellSolid(u32 x, u32 y, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the map cell at (x,y) exists and its state byte at +0x38 equals 1 - the 2D field's 'static/solid chip' test; missing layer or cell returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Map_FindCellInArea
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Map_FindCellInArea(u32 x, u32 y, u32* pos)
functions.summary: Looks up the map cell at (x,y), searches its record list through maybe_Map_SearchCellRecord and then re-checks the hit with the cell hit-test; returns 1 only when the found cell's +0x38 flag is set.

functions.name: maybe_Map_TestCellBlockedFlags
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Map_TestCellBlockedFlags(u32 x, u32 y, u32* pos, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves the Field2D cell at (x,y) and its attribute record for pos, then returns 1 when either attribute 0x20 or 0x40 is present (the pair the trail direction finders treat as impassable).

functions.name: Map_FindCellInDirection
functions.signature: void Map_FindCellInDirection(u32 * out, int cell, u32 layer, u32 arg4, int * origin, int dir)
functions.summary: Finds the map cell next to `cell` in the requested direction: decides which edge of the cell (+0x30/+0x34 range) faces the origin, and only if that matches the sign of `dir` resolves the neighbour through the layer lookup and hit-test chain; writes {index, cell} or {0xFFFFFFFF, 0} when there is none.

functions.name: Map_FindCellInDirectionEx
functions.signature: void Map_FindCellInDirectionEx(u32 * out, u32 x, u32 y, int * origin, int dir)
functions.summary: Coordinate form of the directional cell search: resolves the cell at (x,y), requires it to be a walkable, populated cell (flag +0x38 == 1, count +0x20 > 0), tests the direction against its edge range, and then writes {cell, cellPtr, containedActor} when the neighbour check passes.

functions.name: maybe_Map_FindCellInDirectionAlt
functions.signature: void maybe_Map_FindCellInDirectionAlt(u32* out, int cell, u32 x, u32 y, int* origin, int dir)
functions.summary: Third directional cell search: picks the dominant axis of the cell rectangle around the origin, then walks the Field2D cell layers with the same attribute queries as the other finders and writes the hit cell or -1.

functions.name: Map_SearchCellRecord
functions.signature: int Map_SearchCellRecord(u32 map, int cell, u32* pos, int mode)
functions.summary: Searches one map cell's record list for the entry at the given position: it resolves the index with 0x0062CB64, then applies the 0x20/0x40 neighbour-mode masks and the 0xF/0x10 short reads from the cell's extra block. Returns the index, the short value, or -1.

functions.name: Ui_List_HandleInputIfActive
functions.signature: void Ui_List_HandleInputIfActive(u32 list, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d)
functions.summary: Gate that forwards an input event to the list window only when the list controller reports it is active (0x62AF84 != 0).

functions.name: Ui_SpriteList_LoadPage
functions.summary: Loads one page of 14 sprite rows: for every slot it takes the record at `page*14 + i` from the row table and binds its text, or blanks the slot when the page is short; then recomputes the scrollbar position.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ActivateScriptedElement
functions.summary: Starts a script-driven UI element: marks its controller (self+0x3570) active, advances the controller state byte through 0x00636C48, dispatches the matching script state callback (Script_DispatchStateCallback on controller+0x34), sets the started flag self+0x356C, rebuilds the element container (Container_SetCountFromByteSize on +0x2DC/+0x2D4) and selects the current grid entry through Ui_List_SelectEntryById.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_SelectById
functions.summary: Asks the window for its bound list object (vtable+0x58) and, when present, selects the entry id stored at the u16 self+0x28 (high-half encoding).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_GetPendingCode
functions.summary: Returns 14 (0x0E) when the signed byte at self+0x1C is set, otherwise -1 - a small status/result selector.

functions.name: Ui_ListView_SetItemCount
functions.summary: Recomputes the list view's item count from a begin/end range, resizes the child list accordingly, refreshes the selection and enables/disables the empty-list indicator.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TriplePane_SetActive
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_TriplePane_SetActive(void* self, const u8* indices)
functions.summary: Shows exactly one of three 0x50-byte panes at +0x70: the pane whose index equals *indices is enabled with func_003E043C(...,1) + Ui_AnimRef_ResetPanes, the other two are disabled.

functions.name: Ui_ListView_BindDataSource
functions.summary: Binds the list view to a new source range: sets the item count, resizes the child list, refreshes the selection and toggles the empty indicator, but leaves the pane visibility untouched.

functions.name: Ui_ItemListWindow_InitBase
functions.summary: Constructor/base-initialiser of the item list window: it is a pure tail call into the shared initialiser 0x001A6460, which installs the window's vtable, sets its initial flag and binds its background texture.

functions.name: Ui_ItemListWindow_InitRows
functions.signature: void Ui_ItemListWindow_InitRows(int* self, int* layout, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Builds the eight-row item list: text row, empty-row marker, four state icons per row (check/keshin/book/ex) and the numbered left/right pagers. Also creates the three icon-set child animations (set_new/set_check/set_normal).

functions.name: Ui_ItemListComposite_Ctor
functions.summary: In-place constructor of the item-list composite object: runs the shared list base constructor, installs the Ui_ItemListWindow vtable on the outer object (0x760724) plus the embedded script-object interface at +0x54 (vtable 0x77F71C, which is also given field +0x18 = 14), then default-constructs three Ui_AnimRefList children. It is chained from the global static-initialiser so the game has the shared list instance ready before any menu opens.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Composite_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a composite list object: resets the two intrusive child-list heads and their sentinels, destroys the 0x78 x 0x0E and 0x50 x 3 child arrays, then runs the list-window base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_ItemListWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the item-list window: destroys the fourteen 0x78-byte row entries and three 0x50-byte children, re-links the two child lists and runs the UI object destructor.

functions.name: Ui_ScrollList_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a scroll-list object by re-initialising its item iterator from the stored list pair (self+0x58 / self+0x74) and scrolling the list back to the top. Nothing is freed - this is not a destructor.

functions.name: Ui_ScrollBarObject_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises the scrollbar object used by the shop and casino windows: zeroes the counters, installs the vtable from the literal pool, sets the initial scroll value (0x11), the 'not visible yet' byte and the step size.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorThenFreeWithArg
functions.signature: void Ui_Object_DtorThenFreeWithArg(unsigned int* self, unsigned int vtable, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Destructor thunk that stores the vtable and one extra field before running the UI object destructor and the delete.

functions.name: Ui_TwoPane_PlayBottomAnims
functions.summary: Binds the "bottom_in" animation to the pane at self and "bottom_out" to the pane at self+0x50, then resets the animation value of both panes.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_BeginSubTweenIn
functions.summary: Starts the widget's sub-tween-in: queries the controller at +0x14, then initialises the tween block with duration 10, progress 0 and the active byte set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_BeginSubTweenOut
functions.summary: Starts the opposite sub-tween: calls vtable slot +0x14 of the sub-object at self+0x14, marks the returned controller's byte +0x6D, sets the running byte at +0x120 and clears the reverse flag at +0x121.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_Step_PostUnitMessage
functions.summary: One step of the battle UI state machine at self+0x125C (state 0xCDB): posts battle message 0x1B for the acting unit through Battle_MessageQueue_PushEntry, in 3D also resolves the popup anchor with Battle_Ui_GetMemberAnchor, waits for the actor queue to drain and then moves to state 0xCEE/-2. It creates no visual effect.

functions.name: FieldParty_DeletingDtorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the FieldParty screen: runs the shared Ui_Screen base destructor (0x00200220, inside Ui_Screen_CtorBase) and then frees the object through operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Battle_CollectDisplayedUnits
functions.signature: void Battle_CollectDisplayedUnits(int* list, int* head, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Walks the battle unit list at battlework+0x4260 and appends every live, handle-valid unit that is not busy (vtable+0xd8) and is neither type 8 nor 10 to the caller's display list via list vtable+0xb0 with kind 0xb.

functions.name: Battle_UpdateUnitDisplay
functions.summary: Per-frame battle display update: returns immediately once the finished flags +0xD2/+0xD3 are set, otherwise polls all units through vtable +0x48 for the busy byte, then runs the stage state machine at self[0x497] that advances unit animations, spawns damage popups and waits for the camp/menu fade.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_Ctor_vt7609AC
functions.summary: Constructor of one UI/field screen class: runs the shared Ui_Screen_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x7609AC, resets the embedded member slot and clears the three 'no id / no selection' words at +0x125C..+0x1264.

functions.name: FieldParty_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Second deleting destructor of the FieldParty family: runs the FieldParty base destructor at 0x00200220 and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UpdatePartyDisplay
functions.summary: Battle party-display state step: ignores itself while self+0xD2 is set; otherwise uses the sequence counter at self+0x17FC (states 0x558/0x56F/0x57B, -1 initialises) and, on the first state, centres the field party, replays member animation 0x2E in 3D mode (battle+0x4244 == 1), resolves the unit/item refs and plays popup 0x48, then waits for the current actor to go idle before leaving in state -2 via the vtable +0x108 call.

functions.name: FieldParty_MemberActor_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the field party-member actor: base-constructs through Ui_ScreenObject_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x00760AC0 and initialises the two tail fields at +0x17FC (-1) and +0x1800 (0).

functions.name: Battle_UnitDisplay_DtorDeleteA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of one unit-display variant: installs the caller's vtable, releases the packed handle at +0x1268 with Pack_Handle_Dtor, runs the shared base destructor 0x00200220 on the adjusted pointer and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UpdateUnitDisplayAlt
functions.summary: Alternate battle unit-display step: switches on self->f_4E0 against the 0x2DABE8/0x2DABF0 thresholds, drives the shared wait timer (maybe_Menu_AdvanceWaitTimer), popup 0x?? and the actor-idle check before requesting the next state.

functions.name: Battle_UnitDisplay_DtorDeleteB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the second unit-display variant: installs the vtable, releases the record handle at +0x125C through the pack handle destructor and the UI release, then frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_PlayStatePoseWithCtx
functions.summary: Pose replay: when the unit's motion is done it builds/lazily fetches the UI context object (vtable 0x782950), resolves the actor by handle with Menu_FindActorByHandle and replays the selected state pose with Battle_SelectPoseGroup.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateA
functions.summary: Creates sub-object A of the battle action window: calls the family base ctor and installs its own vtable g_battleActionSubObjectVtableA.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UnitDisplay_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a battle member-widget class: runs the shared battle base destructor (0x00322D14, inside maybe_Battle_Action_DeletingDestructorBase) and then frees the object.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_ApplyDamageLayout
functions.summary: Plays the "dmg" animation on the damage pane and copies the shared layout values from the data manager record (one scalar and an xyz vector) into the pane through slots +0xA4 and +0xA0.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_PlayStatePose
functions.summary: Puts a battle unit's actor back into its state pose once the current motion finished: if the ready check (0x669DD4) passes it resolves the actor from the unit's handle through the menu list, asks Battle_SelectPoseGroup for the pose that matches its state and plays it.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateB
functions.summary: Creates sub-object B of the battle action window: family base ctor plus vtable g_002DB008.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the battle action sub-object that owns the damage pane: base destructor 0x00322D14 then operator delete.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_ApplyDefaultAnim
functions.summary: Applies the actor's default animation to its scene object: asks Actor_GetDefaultMotionId for the id/name and sets it through the actor's +0x84 slot.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_HandleCommand9
functions.signature: unsigned long long Battle_Unit_HandleCommand9(void* self, int cmd)
functions.summary: On command 9, compares the actor's current animation name with its default motion id and re-applies the default animation when they differ.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_PlayStatePoseIfSet
functions.summary: Minimal pose replay: resolves the unit's actor by handle, asks Battle_SelectPoseGroup which pose group applies and plays it through 0x005E7848 only when the group is non-zero.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateC
functions.summary: Creates sub-object C of the battle action window: family base ctor plus its own vtable.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the battle unit widget: runs the shared battle base destructor (0x00322D14) and then frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_SelectFirstAnimEntry
functions.summary: If the frame player at self+0x28 reports that it has frames, seeks it to entry 0 (rewinds the unit's animation to its first frame).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UnitAnim_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the frame-player sub-object embedded at Battle_Unit+0x34: runs the shared battle base destructor (0x00322D14) and then frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelAttach_SetLocatorPairById
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelAttach_SetLocatorPairById(void* self, u16 id, u32 tableKind, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Selects the data record for the given id, stores the id at self+0x50, clears the two 'resolved' flags at +0x54/+0x55 and copies the record's two 16-bit locator/attachment ids into +0x4C/+0x4E so the per-frame code can bind the nodes.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Effect_SetLinkRecord
functions.summary: Stores the id byte at +0x52, clears the two resolved flags at +0x54/+0x55, then resolves the id through 0x0018C1B8 and copies the record's two u16 ids (+0x94/+0x96) into +0x4C/+0x4E.

functions.name: Battle_ActorModel_SetLocatorPairFromActor
functions.signature: void Battle_ActorModel_SetLocatorPairFromActor(void* self, void* actor, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Clears the two visibility flags on a battle actor model attachment and caches the locator ids of the actor's action row (u16 f_138/f_12E) into the attachment's f_4C/f_4E.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_SetLayoutId
functions.summary: Stores the layout/record id at +0x53, clears the two resolved flags at +0x54/+0x55, and copies the two u16 values (+0x2B6/+0x2B8) of the resolved record into +0x4C/+0x4E.

functions.name: Battle_Effect_UpdateLinkSegment
functions.summary: Updates one effect link segment: copies the eleven-word link description from src into self+0x20, builds its transform, normalises the direction vector and updates or creates the linked effect instance.

functions.name: Effect_LinkInstance_Update
functions.summary: Updates a 0x58-byte directional/beam link effect controller: normalizes direction self+0x3C, resolves effect handle self->u32_00 in 0x007B4D68, updates its target span toward self+0x24 via 0x00574224, and releases the handle via Effect_ReleaseHandle when expired or below threshold 0.5f.

functions.name: Effect_LinkInstance_Dtor
functions.summary: Releases the effect handle stored at *self from the effect manager ((work+8)->f_60) via Effect_ReleaseHandle, destroys the embedded sub-object at self+8 (0x001CF7F8), and returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiRow_RestoreIdleByHpWhenAnimEnds
functions.summary: When the model at self+0x28 reports that its current animation has reached its end, restores the actor's post-action idle posture from its HP percentage with Battle_Action_RestoreActorIdleByHp.

functions.name: Ui_ListSubObject_CreateA
functions.summary: Constructs list/row sub-object variant A: runs the shared Ui_ListSubObject_BaseCtor and installs vtable 0x00760E34, returning the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiRow_DeletingDtorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a battle actor-display class: runs the shared base destructor 0x0038AD34 (inside Battle_ActorAction_DeletingDtorAlt) and then frees the object.

functions.name: Battle_DamageExtWindow_ApplyLayout
functions.summary: Refreshes the extended damage window: plays the "Damage" animation on its pane, applies the shared layout scalar/vector, then commits or releases the acting model's two attachment slots depending on whether the action's actor is still visible, so the damage numbers follow the right body part and disappear with it.

functions.name: Battle_DamageExtWindow_RestoreIdleByHpWhenAnimEnds
functions.summary: When the model at self+0x28 finishes its current animation, restores the actor's idle posture by HP percentage; identical body to 0x002DB940.

functions.name: Battle_DamageExtWindow_UpdateModelNodes
functions.summary: Shows or hides the model nodes attached to the damage pop-up: the owning list-row object is asked whether it is still visible (vfunc +0x188) and the two sub-nodes at +0x40/+0x48 of the character model in self->f_28 are committed accordingly.

functions.name: Ui_ListSubObject_CreateB
functions.summary: Constructs list/row sub-object variant B: runs Ui_ListSubObject_BaseCtor and installs vtable 0x00760E68, returning the object.

functions.name: Battle_DamageExtWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the extended damage window: base destructor 0x00193E44 then operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiRow_UpdateEntryState
functions.summary: Battle list-row update: looks the row's unit (owner->f_273) up in the two battle unit lists (+0x4254/+0x4270); if present it either plays actor animation 0x2F (0x005E7848) or calls the owner's vtable+0x84 with a fixed literal, if absent it does nothing.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiRow_ClearEntryState
functions.summary: Subset of 0x002DBC0C: same two-list unit lookup on owner->f_273, but only the animation-0x2F branch (the literal-install branch is missing).

functions.name: Ui_ListSubObject_CreateC
functions.summary: Constructs list/row sub-object variant C: runs Ui_ListSubObject_BaseCtor and installs vtable 0x00760E9C, returning the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiRow_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a battle UI row class: runs the shared base destructor 0x0038AD34 (inside Battle_ActorAction_DeletingDtorAlt) and then frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_ListSubObject_CreateD
functions.summary: Constructs list/row sub-object variant D: runs Ui_ListSubObject_BaseCtor and installs vtable 0x00760ED0, returning the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiRow_DeletingDtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a battle UI row sub-object: runs the shared base destructor 0x0038AD34 and then frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_ListSubObject_CreateE
functions.summary: Constructs list/row sub-object variant E: runs Ui_ListSubObject_BaseCtor and installs vtable 0x00760F04, returning the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiRow_DeletingDtorD
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the innermost battle UI row sub-object: runs the shared base destructor 0x0038AD34 and then frees the object.

functions.name: Battle_UiList_CalcContentWidth
functions.summary: Measures the content width of the four battle unit columns: sums the per-row text widths (+0xC4) of every entry in the sub-lists at work+0x4298, clamps the total with the font metric at ui+0x130, and adds the padded per-character widths of the selected rows; returns the width in pixels.

functions.name: Battle_UiList_ApplyContentWidth
functions.summary: Recomputes the list content width (Battle_UiList_CalcContentWidth) and applies it to the party/UI list object (work+0x24A98) through 0x613FC0, so the scroll area matches the widest row.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SubObject_TogglePairA
functions.summary: Bootstraps the shared UI context and calls the sub-object's virtual +0x28 twice - first with (1), then with (0, 1) - then returns its argument unchanged.

functions.name: Battle_GiveItemToSelectedRow
functions.summary: Hands a battle-reward item to the party so it lands in the selected bag row: copies the nine-word u16 item-id table from battle work+0x4E78, indexes it by the row's f_7C (0xFFFF = empty), finds the selected rows, rotates that row's bag entries, adds the item through 0x0035EBB0 and raises Item_OnAcquired, restoring the bag ordering afterwards. Returns self.

functions.name: Battle_UiRow_ApplyActorVisuals
functions.summary: Applies a pending visual change to the row's 3D character: resolves the battle unit actor, recreates the attached model node, rebuilds the name text layout from the character-record name range (0xB105/0xB106) and re-fits the row's text to the new width.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_UpdateState
functions.summary: Per-frame state dispatcher of the battle command/message window flow: switches on self->f_1A8 (0x39, 0x3A..0x45, 0x47, 0x6F, 0xDC) and calls the corresponding step handler (e.g. 0x39 -> Battle_UiRow_OpenRowDetailWindow).

functions.name: Gfx_EffectParams_LoadTemplate
functions.summary: Seeds an effect parameter block from the static default template at 0x002DCC24: it clears the 0x198-byte payload and copies the template words (and the remaining defaults) into the owning object.

functions.name: Battle_UiList_CalcContentWidthEx
functions.summary: Second variant of the battle unit list content-width measurement: same traversal of the four entry lists at work+0x4298 but reads the wider +0x100 metric and the base width at work+0x56B4.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_GateValueOnCurrentActor
functions.summary: Returns the incoming value only when the battle current-actor slot (work+0x5C+0x4320) is non-null and 0x0027BCB0() (in the battle-window-manager cluster) is non-zero; otherwise returns 0.

functions.name: Battle_UiRow_CalcTextWidthFactor
functions.summary: Measures the width of pane id 0xB8 for every row whose window reports it has that pane, converts it through the font table (0x63E05C -> first/last glyph, 0x1CA474) and stores the resulting scale into self->f_1B4->f_88.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_CanPlayDecideSe
functions.summary: Checks the player-input bitfield (work+0x10->f_6C) for the confirm/cancel masks 0x10/0x40/0x80 and, when a button is held, plays the decision SE (Sound_PlaySeById) on the active window's sound object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_IsSoundHandleActive
functions.summary: Returns the flow node itself when the sound player's table at +0x1848 still has an entry whose first word equals node->f_1B4->f_78, otherwise 0; a per-node keep-alive test.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenSelectedRowWindow
functions.summary: Opens window 0x39 for the selected row: collects the row counts and the two measured widths (0x2DBE3C/0x2DCC28) plus the row flags into a 0x21C-byte window descriptor and pushes it through the UI window callback.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_FindSelectedRows
functions.signature: u32 Battle_UiFlow_FindSelectedRows(BattleUiRow* self, int** firstRow, int** selectedRow)
functions.summary: Walks the row list at work+0x4260 and returns in *firstRow the first inactive row and in *selectedRow the row whose character is currently usable (0x6293A8); returns 1 when the list was scanned.

functions.name: Battle_UiRow_CalcDetailTextWidth
functions.summary: Measures the widest of the four detail panes 0xB8/0xD7/0xD8/0xD9 across all rows (stopping at the first row that has each pane) and stores the resulting scale into self->f_1B4->f_8C.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_ApplyVolumeFromField
functions.summary: Fetches the sound player and applies the value stored at self+0x1A8 (converted to float) through the sound volume setter 0x001EE018; returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_UpdateWidthHook
functions.summary: Only the first call is readable: it recomputes the battle list content width through Battle_UiList_CalcContentWidthEx and then enters the game work. The rest of the routine is lost to a truncated jump table.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_CreateEffectObject
functions.signature: void* maybe_Battle_Ui_CreateEffectObject(int heapIndex, u16 kind, int mode)
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x214-byte battle UI object from the render heap, installs the two vtables 0x00782608/0x0076DCD8, stores the kind at +8 and registers it with the battle window manager (callback 0x3A).

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenItemNameWindow
functions.summary: Opens the item-name window for the selected row: picks window id 0x3D when the row text is shorter than two glyphs and 0x3E otherwise, resolves the item record of the slot (Item_LookupRecord) and passes the edited text range.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_CreateEffectObjectB
functions.signature: void* maybe_Battle_Ui_CreateEffectObjectB(int heapIndex, u16 kind, void* ownerA, void* ownerB)
functions.summary: Second factory of the same 0x214-byte battle UI object: allocates from the render heap, installs vtables 0x00782608/0x0076D824, stores the kind and the two owner pointers, then registers it with the battle window manager.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenItemNameWindowEx
functions.summary: Second item-name window opener: same 0x3D/0x3E choice but also runs the row usability checks (0x2DDCCC/0x2DDD04/0x2DDEEC) before opening and passes the selected row object.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_IsRowIndexValid
functions.summary: Returns true when the row index is below the per-row count stored at work+0x4E98.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_CanUseRowItem
functions.summary: Scans rows from startRow to the end and returns 1 as soon as a row's item record satisfies the per-item condition (0x63E7F8 + counter at g_002dde0c), i.e. whether any later row can be used.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_MarkRowFlag
functions.summary: Sets the per-row 'handled' byte for the current row (work+0x4E95 + f_1B4->f_7C = 1).

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_PlayBgmForState
functions.summary: Requests the music/SE for the flow state: Snd_RequestBgmPlay(ui, self->f_1A8).

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_CloseActiveWindow
functions.summary: Closes the currently active UI window by calling vfunc +0x5C (hide/close) on the interface stored at work+0x4320->f_1BC.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_RowTextFits
functions.summary: Builds the text layout of the row's character name (range 0xB105..0xB106) and returns whether its measured height exceeds self->f_1B4->f_80, i.e. whether the name needs the taller row variant.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenRowInfoWindow
functions.summary: Opens window 0x3F showing the selected row: passes the row object and the combined 'row usable' flag computed from 0x2DDCCC/0x2DDD04/0x2DDEEC/0x2DE668.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenRowInfoWindowEx
functions.summary: Opens window 0x41: same row information as window 0x3F plus the extra value f_1B4->f_80 (the measured text height) in the descriptor.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenItemDetailWindow
functions.summary: Opens window 0x45 with the item id and count of the selected slot (work+0x4E78/0x4E88 arrays copied to the stack first).

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenMessageWindowDc
functions.summary: Opens the battle detail/message window for flow state 0xDC: closes the current actor's window (0x0027DBE8), allocates a 0x20C window with the battle-flow detail vtable, sets its state byte f_82 = 0xDC and flags +0x20A = 0 / +0x20B = 1, then shows message index 0xDC on the current actor through Ui_BattleWindow_ShowMessageByIndex.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_RebuildEffectList
functions.summary: Rebuilds the per-actor effect descriptor list of the menu (delegates to Menu_RebuildEffectList 0x207DEC on work).

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenRowInfoWindowB
functions.summary: Opens window 0x40 with the same row/flag payload as window 0x3F; the flow uses the two ids for the two sides of the character comparison.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_HasFormattedRowMessage
functions.summary: Formats the battle UI flow's candidate message for rowIndex into a temporary wide-string stack buffer (substituting player name tag 0 via Text_SetPlayerNameTag) and returns 1 if the resulting string is non-empty, or 0 if empty.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_NotifyMenuUpdate
functions.summary: Forwards a menu update to the menu state machine (0x20C294) on the UI work object.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_HideTargetWindow
functions.summary: Hides the battle target-window variant (0x269648) registered at work+0x431C.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenSelectionWindow
functions.summary: Collects the currently highlighted party row and opens window 0x6E (or 0x6F when a row carries flag bit 2 of +0xE74), passing a seven-field selection block to the window.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_ResetEntryStates
functions.summary: Writes the default 0x5A-byte per-entry state table into the flow's entry array at self->f_1b4+0x10, i.e. clears the used/per-entry marks before a new selection round. Returns self.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenSelectionWindowEx
functions.summary: Like the 0x6E/0x6F opener but always uses window 0x20A, adds the counter action id (0x632704) and treats a non-zero work+0x56B4/0x56B8 as 'force selected'.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_NotifyMenuOpenItem
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_UiFlow_NotifyMenuOpenItem(void* uiFlow, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Battle UI-flow method-table forwarder (slot 0x00727050): calls the menu helper at 0x0020D23C on the battle object (work+0x5C) and returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_NotifyMenuCloseItem
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_UiFlow_NotifyMenuCloseItem(void* uiFlow, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Battle UI-flow method-table forwarder (slot 0x00727040): calls 0x0020D268 on the battle object (work+0x5C) and returns self; the adjacent slot to 0x002DEB34.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenConfirmWindow
functions.summary: Opens the equip-confirmation window 0x44 for the selected row and marks the row pending (f_1B4->f_84 = 1) so the flow waits for the answer.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_OpenInfoWindow
functions.summary: Opens the battle flow's info window (id 0x3C): counts the entries of the battle party list at battle work +0x4260, allocates the 0x214-byte window descriptor from the named g_battleUiFlowInfoWindowVtable with the walk length/count at +0x208/+0x20C, and invokes the current actor's window callback with id 0x3C.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_UpdateCancelInput
functions.summary: Handles the cancel/new-input bits of work+0x10->f_6C: on cancel it plays the SE and clears the active window's +0x405 field, on the 'new' bit it sets f_1B4->f_85 and closes the window.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_AcquireUsableEntry
functions.summary: Finds the first of the 0x59 selection entries that is still unused in the flow's state array and marked usable (value 1) in a freshly generated table, marks it used and returns its index; called every state update when the battle UI needs a free window/slot.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_IsEntryUsable
functions.summary: Gates a flow entry value: reads the sound player's current id (field +0x58, or +0x64 when state bit 1 is set), treats out-of-range values (>= 0x9E or 0xFF) as unusable, and returns 0 when the player is in the state reported by 0x006305F0; otherwise returns value unchanged.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_ReleaseChild
functions.summary: Releases the flow's current child/graphic object (self->f_1B4->f_74) through its vfunc +4 and clears the slot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CloseChildIfFinished
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_CloseChildIfFinished(UiObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Ticks the child object at self+0x1B4 (virtual+8) and, when its finished query (+0xC) returns true, sets bit 0 of the 101-entry save flag array at (work+0x24A98)+0x5762 for id 0x12 and returns 0; otherwise returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_NotifyMenuRefresh
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_UiFlow_NotifyMenuRefresh(void* uiFlow, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Battle UI-flow method-table forwarder (slot 0x00727048): calls 0x0020F2CC (inside the maybe_Menu_InitScratchRecord area) on the battle object (work+0x5C) and returns self.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_ToggleDetailWindow
functions.summary: Toggles the detail sub-window: closes the active window when the UI is in the 'detail open' state, otherwise opens window 0x20C and creates the 0x30-byte sub-object (Ui_SubObject_Ctor 0x2D5A08, kind 0x12) attached to the row.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_AdvanceStep
functions.summary: Advances the flow: if the current sub-state has no finished step, it walks the step list (circular list at self->f_1B4) and makes the step whose id (+0x1B8) matches self->f_1A8 current; returns 0 when a step was found.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_RefreshPartyRowValues
functions.summary: Recomputes the displayed values of every party row: clears the per-row delta (+0xE0) of the listed characters, then for all 31 character slots that are active and have a flag in work+0x27508 pushes the new value through 0x191D40.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ThumbCaseBlock
functions.summary: Not a function: a Thumb jump-table case block made of strh stores followed by branches back into the common tails of the containing function. The recovered C is a single halt_baddata().

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UiFlow_ToggleSubObjectFlags
functions.summary: Bootstraps the UI singleton at 0x007BE340 and calls the battle UiFlow sub-object's slot +0x1C twice - once with (1,0), once with (0) - applying both directions of one toggle.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_PlaySeAndStoreId
functions.summary: Plays the SE for the current flow state (Sound_PlaySeById with f_1A8) and stores the returned SE handle in f_1B4->f_78.

functions.name: Battle_UiFlow_EvaluateCondition
functions.summary: Condition dispatcher used by the flow before advancing: switches on the sub-state self->f_1A4 (0x1A..0x27) and answers questions such as 'is a row selected', 'does the item exist', 'is the window idle'.

functions.name: Battle_PopupEntry_Create
functions.signature: void* Battle_PopupEntry_Create(int self, unsigned short id, unsigned char kind, unsigned int arg4, unsigned char arg5, unsigned char arg6, unsigned int* extra)
functions.summary: Creates a 0x24-byte battle popup entry (id, kind, flags, extra value) and inserts it into the popup lists, with an early-out for invalid targets.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetCurrentText
functions.summary: Sets the current message text: clears the pending element, applies the new string through Ui_TextElement_SetString (0x3A7A2C) and refreshes the related text resource (0x4C1158); used by the message-window command processor.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ApplyCommand
functions.signature: u32 Ui_MessageWindow_ApplyCommand(UiMessageWindow* self, int commandId, int arg3, int* payload)
functions.summary: Applies one queued message-window command: command 0xFFFF ends the current message (closes the three sub-layouts and calls vfunc +0x10), command 0 selects the string at (arg) from the layout table and dispatches it through the callback stored in arg4.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetLayoutByState
functions.signature: u32 Ui_MessageWindow_SetLayoutByState(UiMessageWindow* self, int choiceMode, int force)
functions.summary: Selects the message-window layout: force sets layout 5, choiceMode==0 selects layout 3 (plain message) and clears the two choice sprites, otherwise layout 4 (message with choices).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetLayoutMode
functions.summary: Switches the active message layout to mode 3 (self+0xB0), 4 (self+0xFC) or 5 (self+0x148) by resetting the two choice slots and pointing self->f_AC at the selected layout; returns 0 when the mode is already active.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetChoiceCursor
functions.summary: Moves the message window's choice cursor to slot 0/1/2: hides the three choice sprites, shows the selected one and notifies the parent window when leaving the two-choice state.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ShowNextIcon
functions.summary: Shows or hides the 'next page' icon: writes bit 0 of the icon sprite's +0x44 flag, using the message icon sprite ('_icon_messagei_3d') or the plain 'icon_next' sprite depending on the UI state.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ProcessCommands
functions.summary: Pumps the message-window command list: for the current command it selects layout/cursor mode, applies the command (0x2E03B0), advances the list (0x10EBE4) and notifies the message system (0x3A7A2C) when a command completes.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ReleaseLayout
functions.summary: Releases the currently bound layout object (self->f_AC) by calling its vfunc +0x10.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ReleaseChildren
functions.summary: Destroys all child sprite objects of the message window: first detaches and releases the object at child+0x20 of each node, then frees the nodes of the list at self+0x1C4.

functions.name: Text_LayoutEntryContainsNewline
functions.summary: Looks up the text of list entry <index>, copies at most 63 wide chars into a stack buffer and reports whether that window contains a line break (L"\n"); the layout code uses it to decide whether an entry needs an extra line.

functions.name: Gfx_Effect_Release
functions.summary: Releases a 3D effect object: tears down both emitters and the emitter list, runs the class cleanup, clears the state word and drops the object reference (freeing its handle) before marking it empty.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_InitFieldPanes
functions.summary: Binds all message-window panes from the layout: message lines 1/2, the two choice lines, the 'next' icon, the signboard (kanban) left/centre texts and the window frame, using the layout names recorded in the strings.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_BuildChildSpriteQuads
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_BuildChildSpriteQuads(UiMessageWindow* self, u32 spriteData, UiObject* target, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Builds the layout entry for a child sprite: temporarily publishes the sprite pointer at target+0x60C (the relocation-marker protocol), calls the layout-quad builder 0x0053CD1C with the sprite and the object at self+0x38/+8, then clears the marker.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CtorFieldPanes
functions.summary: Constructor of the message window used by Ui_SetupMessageWindow: runs the shared window base constructor, installs vtable 0x760F38 (whose pane-init slot is Ui_MessageWindow_InitFieldPanes), stores the four embedded interface vtable pointers and default fields, and constructs two 0x24-byte child objects.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a battle popup object: releases +0x1D4, re-splices three intrusive list heads, destroys the 0x60 container, installs two sub-object vtables, destroys two 0x24-byte arrays and the list node at -0x174, then frees.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_CreateChildSprite
functions.signature: void Battle_Popup_CreateChildSprite(BattlePopup* self, BattlePopupHost* host, UiObject* parent, u32 nameId, u32 arg5, int combo)
functions.summary: Creates the damage-pop-up sprite under the given parent: resolves the child pane by name (0x53D170=Ui_Layout_CreateChildSprite), attaches the pop-up pane ('null_pop_single'/'null_pop_combo') and hands it to the pop-up host's vfunc +0x20.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureAndPlayByType
functions.signature: void Battle_Popup_EnsureAndPlayByType(int self, unsigned int type, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Central popup dispatcher: switches on a 0..N popup type, lazily creates the corresponding popup object through the Ensure* helpers and forwards the play/parameter call to it.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_Update
functions.signature: void Battle_Popup_Update(BattlePopup* self, int arg2, void* callback)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the battle damage pop-up pool: waits for the pop-up animation to start (0x2E18F0=Battle_Popup_EnsureAndPlayByType), then per pop-up type polls the pop-up actors (fields at +0xA4/+0xBC/+0xD4/+0xEC/+0x104) and marks the pool free when they finished.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureMissSingleB
functions.summary: Lazily creates the single MISS popup and resets its shake: if f_130 is set and f_114 is empty it allocates the 0x9C popup (vtable g_battleMissPopupVtable), builds the 0x3C animation handle, binds it through func_002E1794 with layout 'pop_miss_single' (0x002E2700), then sets f_98 = 1.0 and runs Ui_AnimShake_Update.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureHeal
functions.summary: Lazily creates the single heal-number popup stored at f_CC: allocates 0x530 bytes, constructs the popup base with vtable g_battleHealPopupVtable (the heal class that owns 6 number objects of 0xA8 plus 3 labels of 0x50) and builds the 0x50 x 3 label array.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureMissSingle
functions.summary: Lazily creates the single MISS popup from layout "pop_miss_single" and binds its animation and playback state.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup_EnsureHealB
functions.summary: Lazily creates the big heal popup stored at f_9C: allocates 0xBB8 bytes (15 number objects of 0xA8 + 5 labels of 0x50 + header) and constructs the popup base with vtable g_battleHealPopupVtableB, building the 0x50 x 5 label array.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureCrit
functions.summary: Lazily creates the fixed critical-hit popup stored at f_FC (case 0xC of the popup update): allocates 0x530 bytes, constructs the popup base with vtable g_battleCritPopupVtable and builds its 0x50 x 3 label array.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_ReleaseChild
functions.summary: Releases one pop-up child object: removes its pane from the parent layout (0x537EC8/0x11FCBC), then runs the object's deleting destructor and frees it (0x53CEF8).

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureDamage
functions.summary: Lazily creates the damage-number popup stored at f_B4 (case 3 of the popup update): allocates the larger 0xBB8-byte form, constructs the base with vtable g_battleDamagePopupVtable and builds its five 0x50-byte label objects.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_ReleaseChildren
functions.summary: Destroys every pop-up child object of the pool: for each of the six pop-up groups releases the paired objects at +0xA4/+0xAC, +0xBC/+0xC4, ... +0x11C/+0x124.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureMpDamage
functions.summary: Lazily creates the MP-damage popup stored at f_E4 (case 9 of the popup update): allocates 0x530 bytes, constructs the base with vtable g_battleMpDamagePopupVtable and builds its 0x50 x 3 label array.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureLargePerSlot
functions.summary: Lazily creates the per-character large popup object for slot index in the f_D4 array (the type 7/8 popup path): allocates 0x530 bytes and initialises it with Ui_Object_CtorBase plus the popup type init.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureMissCombo
functions.summary: Creates the per-target combination MISS popup: builds the "pop_miss_combo%d" pane name and loads "pop_miss.bflyt" into the slot's popup object.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureLargePerSlotB
functions.summary: Same lazy per-slot popup factory as 0x002E2F40, but for the f_A4 array used by the type 1/2 popup paths.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup_EnsureLargePerSlotC
functions.summary: Lazy per-slot popup factory for the f_104 array: the same 0x530-byte allocation and init as its A/B/D/E siblings; the popup type that uses this array has not been identified.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureLargePerSlotD
functions.summary: Lazy per-slot popup factory for the f_BC array, used by the type 4/5 popup paths.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_EnsureLargePerSlotE
functions.summary: Lazy per-slot popup factory for the f_EC array, used by the type 10/11 popup paths.

functions.name: Battle_PopupWindow_ReleaseSub
functions.summary: Destructor helper of the battle pop-up window: releases the widget sub-objects and then the pop-up pool, clearing the two trailing pointers.

functions.name: Battle_PopupWindow_InitComboPane
functions.summary: Binds the combination-popup pane "pop_combo" in the popup window layout and stores its handle.

functions.name: Battle_PopupObject_Create
functions.summary: Creates a 0x9C popup object with default timing/alpha fields; used as the shared popup instance initialiser.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_Dtor_C
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small widget owning one 0x50-byte pane: installs the vtable, destroys the pane at +0x4C and the intrusive list, then frees.

functions.name: Ui_Object_ForwardToMoveSelection
functions.signature: void Ui_Object_ForwardToMoveSelection(UiObject* self, u32 p1, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Ui_Object vtable slot: when the object's render target is visible, forwards the three arguments to Ui_ListWindow_MoveSelection; otherwise does nothing.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteList_LoadPageEx
functions.summary: Second page loader for the 14-row sprite list: binds each row's text from `page*14 + i` (marking out-of-range slots with -1) and then updates the scrollbar; unlike 0x002D8580 it does not use the animated text accessor.

functions.name: Ui_ListView_SetItemCountEx
functions.summary: Same as 0x002D88EC but without the empty-list visibility update: recomputes the item count from a 16-byte-stride range, resizes the child list, refreshes the selection and toggles the selection state from the new count.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_BindSubObjects
functions.summary: Stores the owner pointer at self+0x3570 and then hands the same owner to four embedded sub-objects at self+0x204, self+0x288, self+0xAB8 and self+0xBC8, i.e. a bind pass that wires a freshly created object to its owner.

functions.name: maybe_Event_RegisterTimelineListener
functions.signature: void maybe_Event_RegisterTimelineListener(EventTimeline* self, void* owner, void* entry)
functions.summary: Registers a timeline step: stores the owner at +0x118, splices the node at self+0x120 into the intrusive list at owner+0x4A8 and records the step id/callback at +0x130/+0x134.

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnList_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds a two-column list window with left/right placeholder rows and left/right pager numbers.

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnList_Ctor
functions.summary: In-place constructor of the two-column list object: runs the shared list base constructor, installs vtable 0x761038 (pane-init slot Ui_TwoColumnList_InitPanes) plus the embedded script-object interface at +0x54 (vtable 0x77F71C), and default-constructs fourteen 0xC-byte child entries with ctor 0x001F0730.

functions.name: Ui_Object_Dtor
functions.signature: void Ui_Object_Dtor(UiObject* self, void* arg2, u32 vtable)
functions.summary: Destructor of a UI list/entry object: installs the vtable, unlinks the embedded list head at +0x120 and then calls the base destructor (Ui_Object_DtorBase) and the free routine.

functions.name: Anim_Interp_Update
functions.summary: Advances a UI interpolation by the per-frame delta in s0 and recomputes the interpolated point from the start/end vectors.

functions.name: Anim_Interp_Evaluate
functions.signature: void Anim_Interp_Evaluate(float* out, AnimInterp* self, u32* from, int* to)
functions.summary: Evaluates the UI interpolation curve: normalises the elapsed time by the duration, applies one of four easing modes (linear/out/in/soft) from self->f_18, and lerps the integer start/end points into out.

functions.name: Anim_Interp_Init
functions.summary: Initialises an interpolation: resets the controller at +0x10, stores the frame constant, copies the 64-bit start value from self->f_C+0x48 into +0x20 and, when a source is given, copies its end value from +0x28 into self+4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListEntryObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for a 0x30-byte list-entry helper: installs vtable 0x007610B0, stores the owner, sets -1.0f at +0x1C and initialises the embedded sub-object at +4.

functions.name: Container_NameHash_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a name-hash container: initialises the embedded list heads, copies up to 31 bytes of the name into the object and computes the 32-bit hash with the multiplier at g_002e4480.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorStringListA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a pooled object: installs the vtable passed in, unlinks the intrusive list at +0x48/+0x4C, destroys the list at +4 when the ownership flag at +0x14 is set, and frees the block through func_0010F6CC. Byte-identical to 0x002E4BD4, 0x0046B5C0 and 0x0046BDEC.

functions.name: Anim_Interp_EvaluateEx
functions.summary: Second interpolation evaluator: applies the easing mode stored at self+8 to the value in s0/t (used for UI scaling) using the sine helper.

functions.name: Anim_UpdatePoseBlend
functions.summary: Advances a keyframe blend by step (the parameter arrives in s0), rebuilds the 10-float pose from the two endpoint poses at +0x40 and +0x04 and writes the blended pose to the target node (self+0x68).

functions.name: Anim_InterpolatePose
functions.signature: void Anim_InterpolatePose(float* out, BlendState* self, float* poseA, float* poseB)
functions.summary: Interpolates two 10-float keyframe poses (three float3 blocks plus a scalar) at the blend factor self+0x3C, using angular interpolation for the orientation block and lerp for positions; copies pose B when the blend weight is below the epsilon.

functions.name: Ui_AnimWindow_SelectFrame
functions.summary: Selects which animation frame set the window uses: copies the start/end values of slot 1, 0 or 0xB out of the animation template at self->f_2C into the window fields and rebinds the frame pair (0x1CEE24).

functions.name: Ui_AnimWindow_ApplyFrame
functions.signature: void Ui_AnimWindow_ApplyFrame(UiAnimWindow* self, u32 slot, int frameRef)
functions.summary: Applies a frame selection to the anim window: runs Ui_AnimWindow_SelectFrame and, when a frame reference is supplied, copies it from frameRef+0x68, otherwise syncs the window's own frame pointer.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeObject_Ctor
functions.signature: int Ui_CompositeObject_Ctor(unsigned int* obj, unsigned int owner)
functions.summary: Constructor of a multi-base composite UI object: installs vtable 0x007610EC, initialises the two embedded sub-objects and returns the adjusted base pointer (-0x68).

functions.name: Container_NameHash_CtorB
functions.summary: Second name-hash container constructor, identical to 0x2E4324 but with its own hash seed/multiplier globals; used by the second half of the UI list objects.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorStringListB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a pooled object: installs the vtable passed in, unlinks the intrusive list at +0x48/+0x4C, destroys the list at +4 when the ownership flag at +0x14 is set, and frees the block. Byte-identical to 0x002E4488, 0x0046B5C0 and 0x0046BDEC - only the vtable the caller passes differs.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorStringListC
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor variant: installs the hard-coded vtable g_002E4C6C, unlinks the intrusive list at +0x48/+0x4C, destroys the list at +4 when the ownership flag at +0x14 is set, and returns self. Same body as 0x002E4488 minus the trailing pool free, so it is the base-destructor half of that pair.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_BindMessagePairs
functions.summary: Binds the two message-pair texts of the window: resolves the two panes, pairs them with Ui_MessagePair_Bind and stores the pair at self+0x1E18.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the message window: destroys the message page at +0x1E18, restores the remaining sub-object vtables, destroys the two 0x414-byte containers and the list node, releases the layout references and frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_Message_SetNameArg
functions.summary: Binds the object's display name to message arguments 2 and 5 so a message like "%s obtained" can be shown.

functions.name: Ui_Message_SetNameAndNumberArgs
functions.summary: Binds both a name and a number to one message: argument 5 gets the name (or the formatted number when the name flag is clear) and arguments 2/3 get the two numbers, with the formatted/name variants selected by f_218/f_219.

functions.name: Ui_Message_SetNameAndCodeArgs
functions.summary: Binds a name (argument 2) and a code/level value (argument 5) to a message, resolving the code through func_00629034 and falling back to the default pool value when it is not found.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_EncodeSelectionCode
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_EncodeSelectionCode(int self, u8* out, int kind)
functions.summary: Eight-way dispatcher that fills a caller record {u8 code, u8 arg, u32 value} for kind 0..7 with codes 0x13/0x14/0x26/0x15/0x16/0x1F/0x27; for kind 2 the value comes from the object's vtable slot +0x18.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CreateSpriteByName
functions.summary: Lazily creates a shared sprite object from the UI heap and applies the name in *name to it.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_GetEntryPayloadById
functions.summary: Looks the id up in the entry pool at self+0x50 and returns the entry's payload word at +0x18, or NULL when the pool or the entry is missing.

functions.name: Gfx_EntryPool_Init
functions.signature: void Gfx_EntryPool_Init(void* pool, uint32_t heapTag, uint32_t heapTag2)
functions.summary: Initialises a gfx scene entry pool: stores the heap tag at +8, allocates the two 8-byte allocator wrappers at +0xC/+0x10, a 0x14-byte occupancy header at +0x18 and 16 entries of 0x34 bytes plus a sentinel, then hands every entry to Battle_PopupPool_InitEntry and clears the occupancy bitmask.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DrawSprite
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_DrawSprite(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 spriteId, u32 arg3, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Submits one sprite to the scene renderer: passes the sprite id, the object's vertex/param block at self+0x1C and the caller parameters to 0x58E770 (scene draw entry).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AddSpriteEntryLarge
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_AddSpriteEntryLarge(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32* posBlock, u32* colorBlock, int flag)
functions.summary: Allocates a large draw entry (handle tag 0x20000) from the scene's fixed slot pool, stores the 3+10 dwords of geometry/colour data and returns the slot handle.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AddSpriteEntrySmall
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_AddSpriteEntrySmall(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32* posBlock, u32* colorBlock, int flag)
functions.summary: Allocates a small draw entry (handle tag 0x10000) from the same slot pool and fills the 3+4 dwords of colour/geometry data.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_GetTaggedEntryPayload
functions.summary: Tagged id lookup: ids carrying 0x0F0000 tag bits resolve through the pool at self+0x50, untagged ids through the pool at self+0x58; both return the entry's payload at +0x0C, or NULL.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_RemoveSpriteEntries
functions.summary: Removes the object's draw entries from the scene: for each of the four entry lists detaches the list heads (0x58EE0C/0x58EFEC/0x588C38/0x588F68) and frees the corresponding bit in the slot bitmap.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DrawSpriteEx
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_DrawSpriteEx(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 spriteId, u32 arg3, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Second sprite submission variant (0x58E918 instead of 0x58E770); used for the alternate sprite shader/primitive.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AllocSpritePoolHandle
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_AllocSpritePoolHandle(void* sceneSpriteCtx, u32 frameId, const void* srcRect, void* outInfo)
functions.summary: Forwards (sceneSpriteCtx->f_5C, frameId, srcRect, outInfo) to Gfx_SpritePool_Alloc (0x005F24A4) to allocate and initialize a 0x70-byte sprite pool entry, returning its handle word at entry->u32_68 (or 0 if f_5C is NULL or allocation fails).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AddNodeType2
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_AddNodeType2(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 handle, u32* data)
functions.summary: Attaches a type-2 node record to the entry addressed by the handle: allocates a 13-dword record from 0x707E98, links it into the entry's chain (0x7141A8) and copies the 10-dword payload.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AddNodeType1
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_AddNodeType1(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 handle, u32* data)
functions.summary: Attaches a type-1 node record (6 dwords) to the entry addressed by the handle.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_GetChildPayloadById
functions.signature: void* maybe_Gfx_Scene_GetChildPayloadById(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 id, int index)
functions.summary: Resolves the entry for a tagged id in the pool at self+0x50 and walks <index> links down its child chain (entry+8 -> node[0]), returning the child's payload word (+4).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AllocSpriteSlot
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_AllocSpriteSlot(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32* posBlock, u32* colorBlock, int flag)
functions.summary: Finds the first free slot in the sprite bitmap, reserves it, writes the entry header (tag 0x1040000 | slot) and the 3+3 data dwords, and returns the new entry handle.

functions.name: Field_HandleSet_ClearBits
functions.summary: Releases a packed object handle: looks it up in one of two handle tables (0x7141A8 for bit 0x1000000, 0x714160 otherwise), clears the occupancy bit for the record and for every entry in its child list, and decrements the live counter. Used when a field 2D object or scene entry is destroyed.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_GetEntryPayloadByIdB
functions.summary: Same id->entry+0x18 lookup as 0x002E5270 but against the second entry pool at self+0x58.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_GetEntryPayloadByIdC
functions.summary: Third emitted copy of the id->entry+0x18 lookup against the pool at self+0x50, instruction-identical to 0x002E5270.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_SetNodeParams
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_SetNodeParams(GfxSceneSprite* self, int arg2, int* values)
functions.summary: Pushes up to four changed parameters (x/y/z + extra) into the sprite instance found by 0x5F1BFC, recomputing the derived fields and copying the matching 0x88-byte records.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntries
functions.summary: Frees all draw entries of the object: runs std_destroy_range over the 0x70-byte records, releases the two owned sub-objects and frees the container itself.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_SetEntryFlag
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_SetEntryFlag(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 handle, int enable)
functions.summary: Sets or clears the 0x1000000 'disabled' flag of the entry referenced by the handle, selecting the large or small pool from the handle tag.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AddNodeType4
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_AddNodeType4(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 handle, u32* data)
functions.summary: Attaches a type-4 node record (5 dwords) to the entry addressed by a 0x1000000-tagged handle.

functions.name: Gfx_EntryPool_Clear
functions.summary: Empties a gfx scene entry pool: walks the occupancy bitmask at +0x18 and for every live 0x34-byte entry unlinks and frees its sprite list, node list and the two list heads through the named Gfx_Scene_Delete*/Destroy* helpers, clearing the bit as it goes. Called from Field_DestroyScene.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesInArea
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesInArea(GfxSceneSprite* self, float* point, int maxResults, u32* outHandles)
functions.summary: Spatial query: walks the 0x40-byte entry table, tests each entry's region (type 1 = sphere distance, 2 = cone via 0x6652C4, 3 = axis-aligned box) against the point, applies the extra predicate 0x2E68C8 and writes the handles of the hits into outHandles.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_ReleaseChildHandle
functions.summary: When the object owns a child handle at +0x5C, the caller passes a non-zero flag and the child reports itself active through 0x005F1BFC, releases that handle through Svc_HandlePool_Release. Otherwise does nothing.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_CountChildEntries
functions.summary: Resolves the entry for a tagged id in the pool at self+0x50 and counts the nodes of its child chain (entry+8 -> node[0]); returns 0 when the id is untagged or the entry is missing.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_IsPointInRegion
functions.summary: Tests a point against a linked list of region records: type 1 sphere (distance <= radius), type 2 cone (projection with sin/cos helper), type 3 box (min/max on all axes).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListEntry_SetChild
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ListEntry_SetChild(UiListEntry* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Replaces the optional 0x40-byte child block of a list entry: when self+0x0C and both arguments are non-zero it releases the old child through Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntries, allocates and zeroes a 0x40-byte block, stores it at self+0x5C and initialises it with 0x005F1F08(child, self+0x0C, arg3, arg2).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_TransformPoint
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_TransformPoint(float* out, GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 matrixId, u32 p1, u32 p2, u32 p3)
functions.summary: Transforms a point through the sprite's current matrix: builds a temporary transform (0x58C40C/0x58C370), calls Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteInstance (0x2E74FC) and releases the temporary.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePool_SetHandleVisible
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpritePool_SetHandleVisible(void* mgr, int handle, int isVisible)
functions.summary: Looks up a 0x74-byte sprite/render pool entry in mgr->f_14 by handle (0x00589124) and clears (isVisible != 0) or sets (isVisible == 0) hidden flag bit 0x80000000 on entry->u32_10.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesInRect
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesInRect(GfxSceneSprite* self, int entryId, int x, int y, int w, int h, int maxResults, u32* outHandles)
functions.summary: Rectangle query over the 0x24-byte entry table: collects entries of the requested id whose screen rectangle overlaps the given rectangle (and optionally walks their child chains).

functions.name: Font_CacheGlyphsForText
functions.signature: u32 Font_CacheGlyphsForText(FontCache* self, char* text, FontResource* font, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Ensures every glyph needed by `text` is present in the font cache: it walks the cache's dirty bitmap (one bit per 0x34-byte glyph slot), allocates a slot for each missing code point, hashes the character name to pick the atlas page, and uploads the glyph geometry/UVs (0x0058D2xx / 0x00589Dxx / 0x0058EAxx) into the page. Returns 1 when all glyphs could be installed, 0 when a slot or upload failed.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesAlongLine
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesAlongLine(GfxSceneSprite* self, float* start, int count, u32 p4, u32 p5)
functions.summary: Line/segment query: steps from the start point along the object's direction vector (self+0x38..0x40) and submits each intermediate point to 0x58E770, counting how many succeeded.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteInstance
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteInstance(u32* out, GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 matrix, u32 arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Creates a sprite instance from the scene resource (0x588AB0) and either copies it (0x58EF24) or clones it with a template (0x58EE64); returns the new instance in out.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FindSpriteByName
functions.summary: Hash lookup of a scene sprite by name: hashes the name with the multiplier at g_002e76a0 and scans the 0x34-byte name records of the sprite table for a matching hash.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_SetSpriteFlag
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_SetSpriteFlag(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 arg2, u32 enable)
functions.summary: Sets or clears bit 0 of the sprite instance's +0x67 flag (scene sprite lookup 0x5F1BFC).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritePart14
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritePart14(u32 * out, GfxSceneSprite * self, u32 nameId, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: Creates a scene sprite whose part list is built from the part added by maybe_Gfx_SpriteParts_Add14: bails out when the sprite has no scene object, otherwise builds the parts record with the name id, creates the sprite instance through Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteInstance and clears the temporary parts record.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_SetIndexPair
functions.summary: Applies a two-word index pair to the Gfx scene stored at self+0x14: it removes the node at indices[1] through Gfx_Scene_RemoveNode and passes indices[0] to a second scene helper (Ghidra split the callee).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritePart40
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritePart40(u32 * out, GfxSceneSprite * self, u32 nameId, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: Same sprite creation as 0x002E76F8 but the parts record is built with maybe_Gfx_SpriteParts_Add40, i.e. the second part layout (the '40' part table) used by the other sprite flavour.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteFromBounds
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteFromBounds(u32* out, GfxSceneSprite* sprite, int bounds, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: Creates a scene sprite sized from a bounds record: computes the three scaled extents of the record's +0x64/+0x68, +0x74/+0x78 and +0x84/+0x88 pairs, and only when their sum is non-zero stores the caller's value at record+4 and creates the sprite instance; otherwise it clears out[0]/out[1].

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritesFromResource
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_CreateSpritesFromResource(GfxSceneSprite* self, u32 resource, u32 filter)
functions.summary: Creates scene sprites for every named chunk of a resource: enumerates the chunk names (0x58D300/0x58D328), skips filtered-out chunks and submits each one through 0x5885A8 with the sprite template.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_ReleaseAll
functions.summary: Destructor of the scene sprite object: releases the entries, then frees the three owned containers (self+0x50, +0x54, +0x58) and their sub-objects.

functions.name: Field_Collision_RaycastScene
functions.signature: u32 Field_Collision_RaycastScene(void* collisionCtx, const void* raySegment, u32 hitMask, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Resets the raycast hit record at collisionCtx+0x1C and, if collision scene collisionCtx->f_14 is loaded, performs a 3D world raycast via 0x0058E3F4, returning non-zero on collision hit or 0 when unobstructed.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_SpriteCtx_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the scene sprite context: installs the default type/limits words, clears the counters and initialises the vertex/param block at self+0x1C (0x588430).

functions.name: Ui_LayoutParams_LoadFromId
functions.summary: Fills a layout/parameter block from the data record selected by layoutId: stores the id at +0, copies the eight header words, the 0x13D-byte block at +0x24 and the 0x1E-byte block at +0x164, converts the eight pointer slots at +0x188 and the two 0x68-byte sub-records at +0x1C4 to absolute pointers, then copies the long tail of scalars up to +0x46C.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutParams_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a layout/parameter block: writes 0xFF as the current id byte, default-constructs the four 8-byte pointer pairs at +0x188 and the two 0x68-byte sub-records at +0x1C4, zeroes the later slots (+0x35C, +0x420..+0x428, +0x454, +0x46C) and then loads the block for layoutId through 0x002E7FBC. Returns the block pointer.

functions.name: Ui_ScrollBar_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the scroll-bar window class: calls the UI object base destructor and frees the instance.

functions.name: Ui_TwoTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds two text lines and two position markers (positionA/positionB), with positionB initially hidden.

functions.name: Ui_PaneSet_Dtor_2
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a two-pane UI object: installs the vtable, destroys the panes at +0x4C and +0x9C and the list, then frees.

functions.name: Menu_SpawnPopupAtObject
functions.signature: void Menu_SpawnPopupAtObject(MenuPopupOwner* self, u32 index, u32 objectId, u32 arg4, int toggle)
functions.summary: Spawns a screen-space popup anchored to a world object: resolves the object handle, projects its position to screen space with Gfx_ProjectWorldToScreen, clamps the anchor to the screen margins and hands it to Menu_SpawnPopupWidget, alternating the owner's slot bit when toggling.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_InitPopups
functions.signature: void Battle_Popup3D_InitPopups(int self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Builds a 3D battle popup window: creates the "null_pop" anchor plus the "pop%d" popup instances backed by "battle_up_3d_pop.bflyt" and sets up their sprite/animation handles.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_UpdateRoot
functions.signature: void Battle_Popup3D_UpdateRoot(BattlePopup3D* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Per-frame root update of the 3D battle pop-up container: advances the fade timer, ticks the eight pop-up objects and handles the single-pop-up case.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup3D_UpdateRootEx
functions.summary: Alternate entry of the 3D battle popup update: on the constructor path it initialises the gauge-bar fields, otherwise it finds the first free popup slot, applies the slide offset and finishes it through vtable +0x2C.

functions.name: Menu_SpawnPopupWidget
functions.signature: void Menu_SpawnPopupWidget(MenuPopupOwner* self, u32 index, u32 arg3, const float* screenPos, int side)
functions.summary: Finds the first free popup widget among the eight pointers at owner+0x11C, activates it, copies the caller's screen position into its transform and starts its show animation.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWidget_Ctor
functions.summary: Allocates and constructs a list widget: vtable 0x007612F0, two self-referential intrusive list heads at +0x13C/+0x14C, embedded node vtable 0x00759388 and eight cleared words.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the 3D battle popup: releases the eight popup widgets, installs the destructor vtable 0x00759388 on the embedded object at +0x13C, unlinks the three intrusive lists, runs the shared node base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_PlayAttackAnim
functions.summary: Plays the "atk1" animation on the popup's model and, when the model's animation time has passed the start threshold, applies the follow-up rate through 0x005F7564.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_SelectFirstAnimEntry
functions.summary: If the popup's model has animation entries, selects entry 0 with looping enabled - resetting it to the default animation.

functions.name: Battle_Action_AttackRow_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_AttackRow_Ctor(void* block, void* window, void* list, u32 labelId, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the 'atk' row widget of the battle action list: calls Gfx_ObjectDesc_InitShared and installs vtable 0x00761344.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Second deleting destructor of the 3D popup family: runs the shared popup base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_PlayDamageAnim
functions.summary: Plays the "dmg" animation on the popup's model and applies the follow-up rate when the model's animation time has passed the start threshold; twin of PlayAttackAnim with the damage clip.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_SelectFirstAnimEntryB
functions.summary: Second copy of the 'reset to animation entry 0 (looping)' helper, used by the sibling popup class.

functions.name: Battle_Action_DamageRow_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_DamageRow_Ctor(void* block, void* window, void* list, u32 labelId, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the 'dmg' row widget of the battle action list: calls Gfx_ObjectDesc_InitShared and installs vtable 0x00761378.

functions.name: Battle_Popup3D_DeletingDtorC
functions.summary: Third deleting destructor of the 3D popup family: shared popup base destructor then operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_Object_SetHandleB0
functions.summary: Stores a handle in self+0xB0 only when the handle table at 0x007B80C0 resolves it and its class chain includes g_actorBaseClass; otherwise the old handle is kept. Same body as 0x00447110 with a different field.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ProjectAnchorObject
functions.summary: Positions a world-anchored widget: resolves the actor handle at self+0xB0 in the object hash, checks the actor class, projects its +0x9C..+0xA4 position to screen space and writes the quad position (with a constant vertical offset) into the draw slot at self+0x30.

functions.name: BattlePopup_3DGaugeBar_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle popup's 3D gauge bar: UI object base constructor, vtable g_battlePopup3DGaugeBarVtable, the default scale/offset set 1.0/1.0/-1.0/0/0 at +0x4C, one embedded animation-reference list at +0x60 and the list's flag word masked to 0xFFFFF800.

functions.name: Ui_PaneSet_Dtor_1
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a one-pane UI object whose pane sits at +0x60: destroys the pane and the list, then frees.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_UpdateVisibility
