functions.summary: Drives the show/hide transitions of a panel with four sub-containers: advances each present animation and, depending on the mode byte, plays or stops the 0x9C/0xEC/0x13C group, clearing the request afterwards.

functions.name: Ui_AnimWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the animation control panes "anim", "in" and "out", enabling the anim pane and hiding the in/out markers.

functions.name: Ui_AnimWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the animated-window base class: runs Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs the vtable, sets the two state bytes and constructs the four 0x50-byte sub-widgets.

functions.name: Ui_PaneSet_Dtor_4
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a four-pane UI object: destroys the panes at +0x4C, +0x9C, +0xEC and +0x13C, the list, and frees.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the dungeon-map window panes: the command window ('win_dungeon_com'), two list panes ('win_dungeon_list1/2') and the talk window ('win_talk'), then enables pane group 3.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonWindow_ReleasePanes
functions.summary: Slot +0x24 of the dungeon window: destroys the children, marks the pane-group bytes at g_002e960c/g_002e9610 as released and stops the child animator.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DungeonWindow_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the dungeon window (vtable row 0x00761488): runs the base window virtual +0x2C, releases the sub-widgets, advances the five-slot timer array by 1/30 s, fires the armed timer callback and clears the 'needs rebuild' byte at self+0x4FD4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ResetChildrenD
functions.summary: Window reset step: drains the child ring down to one entry, re-links the embedded pane at +0x1E0 and broadcasts visibility flag 0 to the children at +0x1C4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_ReleaseChildrenB
functions.summary: Child-list reset step (one of five near-identical copies): pops the child list down to the class minimum, re-links the embedded node at +0x1C4 and broadcasts visibility flag 1 to it. The copy is an entry of the handler table at 0x0072ADF4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DispatchInputToChildren
functions.summary: UI input handler: for confirm/cancel events it marks the widget dirty and requests state 0 from the controller at +0x120 (slot +0x14, then commit +0x10); for plain movement events it forwards the three signed axes to the navigation object at +0x980 slot +0x3C. Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DispatchInputByState
functions.summary: Variant input handler for a widget with a 3-state controller: 0x00642630(self+0x260, event) returns 0/1/2 and selects the child action 1/2/3 before the same mark-dirty/notify tail; movement events go to the +0x260 slot +0x3C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_ReleaseChildrenC
functions.summary: Child-list reset step (one of five near-identical copies): pops the child list down to one entry, re-links the embedded node at +0x1FC and broadcasts visibility flag 0 to the node at +0x1C4. Entry of the handler table at 0x0072ADF4.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ActionSeq_RunChoice2
functions.summary: Action-sequence step for a branch node: runs the embedded choice widget (vtable+0x3C), compares the returned id with the stored selection, and either retries with action 0 or marks the runner done and stores the new step id.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_ReleaseChildrenD
functions.summary: Child-list reset step (one of five near-identical copies): pops the child list down to one entry, re-links the embedded node at +0x218 and broadcasts visibility flag 0 to the node at +0x1C4. Entry of the handler table at 0x0072ADF4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_StepTo4Or0
functions.summary: Widget step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x218 against the owner block at owner+0x3B8 and, when it has finished, sets self+0x11C=2 and requests step 4 on the controller at self+0x120 if the prompt was confirmed, or step 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Battle_TextWindow_CtorPane
functions.summary: In-place constructor of the battle text window's pane object: runs the window base constructor, installs vtable 0x761474, initialises the member pair at +0x48 with its back-pointer and default-constructs the five 0x18-byte child state objects.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the dungeon/map window: runs its own destructor body 0x002EA26C and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_Dtor_Large
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the largest message-window variant: tears down the extra members in reverse order (the 0x18-entry array at -0x28CC, the model block, the list nodes and the message page) and re-splices each intrusive list before releasing the final sub-object.

functions.name: Field_ActorMotion_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Field_ActorMotion_Ctor(void* self, u32 owner, u32 name, u32 resource, u8 flag)
functions.summary: Generic constructor of the field actor motion/action helper: forwards to the shared object descriptor initialiser (0x00193D84) with flag 0x20000000, installs vtable 0x7614C4 and stores the owner argument at +0x28. Every field-actor motion and action subclass starts here.

functions.name: Ui_EquipRow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the equipment row widget: installs the base vtable 0x00758AE0 (the shared 0x00193E44 block) and frees the object through the allocator at 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_BindIconAndTextPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_Panel_BindIconAndTextPanes(UiPanel* self, int index, void* layout, int kind, int flags)
functions.summary: Binds a list-panel row to its named child panes: builds "icon_dummy_<n>", "txt_<n>_1", "txt_<n>_2", "txt_<n>_3", resolves each through the layout's slot +0x2C and validates the icon against the sprite class descriptor 0x007AE8A4.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ShowNextIcons
functions.summary: Sets bit 0 of the three 'next' icon sprites at self+0xC/+0x10/+0x14 and notifies the child at self+0x18 (pane group 1); decompiler lost part of the tail, but the icon-flag updates are clear.

functions.name: Ui_Dive_ReloadTextResources
functions.summary: Reloads the diving-minigame text bundle into an existing holder: it fetches `dive_text.bxon` (entry 0x35), `dive_sortie_msg.bxon` (0x0B), `dive_blend_color_text.bxon` (0x25), `spirit_skill_text.bxon` (0x1D) and `dive_msg.bxon` (0x0F) and stores each handle plus a reference-counted copy in the 10-word slot array.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyValueToChildren
functions.summary: Walks both child containers of a UI window (self+0x10 and self+0x14: four fixed slots each plus their variable child list) and writes the same value into every child's +0x70 field.

functions.name: Ui_SubObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a small UI sub-object: fills the six leading words with the argument, runs Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs the vtable and creates one 0x50-byte sub-widget.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DetachMembers
functions.summary: In-place reset of an embedded UI object: stores the new vtable/handler word at +0x18, destroys the 0x50-byte pane at +0x64 and the list at +0x18, and returns the enclosing object pointer.

functions.name: Ui_Dive_LoadTextResources
functions.summary: Opens every text table the diving minigame needs - `dive_text.bxon` (0x35), `dive_sortie_msg.bxon` (0x0B), `dive_blend_color_text.bxon` (0x25), `spirit_skill_text.bxon` (0x1D), `dive_msg.bxon` (0x0F) - and fills the ten-word slot array at self+0/+4.. with the handles and their reference-counted copies.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePairArray_Clear
functions.summary: Releases and clears the five (owner, handle) pair slots of the sprite-pair array: each owner word is zeroed and each generation-tagged handle is released through Pack_ReleaseHandleEntry, leaving the array ready for reuse.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePairArray_ClearAndGetBase
functions.summary: Clears all five (owner, handle) pair slots of the sprite-pair array - releasing each handle entry - then releases the five handles once more through the chain of Pack_ReleaseHandle calls and returns the buffer base (the address just before the first pair) so the caller can free it.

functions.name: Ui_EquipRow_Update
functions.summary: Refreshes one row of the equipment list: walks the 0x1A-byte row records, filters out rows whose item is not in the bag/party (Item_GetStoragePointer) or whose party flag in work+0x27508 is unset, pushes the pane and sets the row's state id.

functions.name: Fs_FileJob_Update
functions.summary: State machine of an asynchronous file read job: state 0 opens/queries the file (0x1CFFCC, 0x503264), state 1 acquires the read buffer (0x1D0378), state 2 polls and then closes the pending resource (svc 0x24 wait, svc 0x23 close), state 3 queues the read (0x503A7C, 0x655398), states 4/5 handle retries and the error results (0x6552AC/0x6552BC/0x655304) before signalling completion; returns 1 while the job still runs.

functions.name: maybe_Container_AddToFirstFreeSlot
functions.signature: void* maybe_Container_AddToFirstFreeSlot(Container* c, u8 kind, u32 forwarded, u32 second)
functions.summary: Finds the first free slot among five fixed 9-word slots (empty = the global null handle at 0x007A8A44), stores the kind byte at +0x18, configures the slot through its vtable +0xC and links it into the container list at +0xC0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipRow_RangeCheck
functions.summary: Compares the row's cursor with the end marker of its item list; the decompiler lost the real body after the comparison.

functions.name: maybe_Container_UnlinkAndReleaseHandles
functions.summary: Empties a handle list: for each registered entry it resolves the handle's type through the global table at 0x007B5D70, tests liveness, unlinks the node and rewrites the handle word to drop the reference.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSlot_InitArcMotion
functions.summary: Configures the clip slot for the arcing variant: runs the shared clip-slot init, reads the actor/monster record for the id stored in its sprite object, seeds the start/step/end fields (+0x3C, +0x40, +0x4C), sets the speed constant g_002EBCAC at +0x48, and finally plays the clip named "Run" on the sprite pane.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSlot_UpdateArcMotion
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the arcing variant: advances +0x48 by dt (backwards while the +0x2C flag is clear), checks it against the owner's +0x44 and the stored end limit +0x4C, and either stops the clip (mode 8) or applies an incremental rotation derived from the sprite's sin/cos components to the sprite basis fields +0x100/+0x104/+0x108 before refreshing the sprite actor.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CreateEnemyAiArcAnim
functions.summary: Constructs the eight-slot enemy-AI clip-slot object: base Gfx_BillboardObjectCtorBase, then slot count 8, the arc parameters (0x40A00000 = 5.0, 0xBE4CCCCD = -0.2, 0.5) and the g_animClipSlotArcVtable.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSlot_DeletingDtorArc
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the clip-slot variant that drives an arc motion: shared clip-slot base destructor 0x0028B708 then operator delete.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSlot_InitLinearMotion
functions.summary: Initialises the non-arcing clip-slot variant: runs the shared slot init 0x0028B3AC, stores the amount at +0x3C and starts the clip named "Nut" on the sprite pane at +0x28.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSlot_UpdateLinearMotion
functions.summary: Per-frame update of one animation clip slot: while the slot is inactive or its progress has not passed the owner's limit it clears the sprite animation, then steers the sprite toward its target and refreshes the move/stuck check.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSlot_DeletingDtorLinear
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the non-arcing clip-slot variant: installs the base vtable 0x00758AE0 (shared 0x00193E40 block) and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CreateEnemyAiTwoSlotAnim
functions.summary: Constructs the two-slot enemy-AI clip-slot object: base Gfx_BillboardObjectCtorBase, slot count 2, parameter 0x40400000 (3.0) / 0x3E4CCCCD (0.2) and the base g_animClipSlotBaseVtable.

functions.name: Anim_ClipSlot_DeletingDtorBase
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the base clip-slot sub-object (the one with no motion driver of its own): installs the base vtable 0x00758AE0 and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_ListData_AppendSpecialPartyRows
functions.signature: u32 Ui_ListData_AppendSpecialPartyRows(u8* count, UiListData* list, int tableId)
functions.summary: Appends the rows of the 'special_party' table to an equipment list: for the given table id it reads the row ids and their string ranges from the text table (0x51B1FC/0x11CD80) and stores id+range into the list entries.

functions.name: Ui_ListData_AppendReincarnationRows
functions.signature: u32 Ui_ListData_AppendReincarnationRows(u8* count, UiListData* list, u16* tableId)
functions.summary: Appends the 'reincarnation' entries (and an 'equip' row when a party member has a high enough value at +0x420) to the equipment list.

functions.name: Ui_ListData_RemapItemIds
functions.summary: Rewrites the four item ids of a list row (f_3C/f_40/f_44/f_48) through the 0x17-entry remap table at 0x63FB18, but only while the party is in one of the five relevant states (0x66AF08).

functions.name: Ui_ListData_AppendMetalPartyRows
functions.signature: u32 Ui_ListData_AppendMetalPartyRows(u8* count, UiListData* list, int tableId)
functions.summary: Appends the rows of the 'metal_party' table to an equipment list, using 0x63E124 for the row array instead of 0x63ECA4.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Node_DrawWithParentTransform
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Node_DrawWithParentTransform(GfxNode* self, float forwarded, float b, int c)
functions.summary: Vtable slot that calls slot +0x7C on itself and passes the result as the second argument to slot +0x70, forwarding the caller's remaining words. It sits directly before Gfx_Node_ApplyTransformMatrix in the Field_SceneObject table, so a transform-related forwarder is likely, but neither slot's meaning is proven.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnimWindow_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the battle action-animation window/controller. It builds the "battleact" layout with action-state animations (avoid, escape, vanish, sleep, guard, approach/move-back phases, sp1..sp25 start/loop/end) and creates the per-state child objects and animators.

functions.name: Model_PlaySeOnFlag
functions.summary: Plays SE 0x12E when the attached model exists and its flag f_6FD is set, after running the model's attach/fade step.

functions.name: Model_PlaySeOnFlagB
functions.summary: Plays SE 0x12E from the lazily created sound player when the owner has an attached model (+0x160) and its flag +0x6FD is set; the twin of 0x002F09A8 without the model attach/fade step.

functions.name: Ui_MenuActor_ApplyAnimAndFade
functions.summary: Plays the menu actor's current animation (0x640A14) on its display object and, when the model is fully faded in, applies the character's fade range (0x225BF4).

functions.name: Battle_AnimWindow_ApplyModelParam
functions.signature: void Battle_AnimWindow_ApplyModelParam(BattleAnimWindow* self, u32 paramId, u32 forwarded, u32 forwarded2)
functions.summary: Virtual 'apply model parameter' method (vtable 0x761640 slot +0x38) of the battle animation window: param ids 0x1D/0x1F/0x20 and 0x29..0x2D OR the part flags 1/4/8 and 0x1000..0x10000 into f_270; 0x21..0x24 commit or release the weapon/shield nodes at model+0x40/+0x48; 0x2E..0x30 start a camera shake through the shake spawner; unknown ids do nothing.

functions.name: Ui_MenuActor_UpdateEffects
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the menu actor's 0x121 effect handles: resolves the actor by handle, creates/updates each effect (0x35FF3C=mabye_Effect_FindOrCreateInstance) with per-slot transforms and releases the finished ones.

functions.name: Battle_AnimWindow_ReleaseEffects
functions.signature: void Battle_AnimWindow_ReleaseEffects(BattleAnimWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Releases every effect handle owned by the battle animation window (the main handle at +0x26C plus the 0x121 per-slot handles at +0x278) and then releases the window's own render object.

functions.name: Battle_AnimWindow_UpdateAttach
functions.summary: Updates the attach effect of the window: refreshes the effect transform (0x2F0D0C), then when the actor's animation reaches its end either keeps or recreates the effect instance and pushes the transform block into it.

functions.name: Battle_AnimWindow_UpdateAttachEx
functions.summary: Second half of the attach update: same effect-transform rebuild as Battle_AnimWindow_UpdateAttach but without the 0x5F7F30 preparation step (called from the damage-ext window variant).

functions.name: Battle_AnimWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: BattleAnimWindow* Battle_AnimWindow_Ctor(u32 heapTag, u32* ownerParams, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle animation window object: allocates the instance, installs vtable 0x761640 plus the secondary vtable at +0x220, marks the model handle as invalid (0x26C = -0x400), clears the state/effect fields and constructs the four handle slots at +0x278.

functions.name: Battle_AnimWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the battle animation window: runs the handle-release helper and frees the instance.

functions.name: Battle_AnimWindow_ReleaseHandles
functions.signature: void Battle_AnimWindow_ReleaseHandles(BattleAnimWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor body: installs the class vtable, releases the 0x121 effect handles at +0x278 and frees the embedded render object at +0x228.

functions.name: Field_Npc_UpdateFacingHook

functions.name: Field_NpcActionScript_DeletingDtor

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_UpdateSeState
functions.summary: Starts or stops the object's looping SE depending on its linked record: when the record's first u16 is 0x9DB it restarts SE 4, otherwise it plays SE 4 only when the animation id changed; then stores state byte f_2BA and forwards the command to the scene-node children.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_AddHandleToSlot

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_SetFlagsOnTwoObjects
functions.summary: Thumb fragment inside a larger function rather than a standalone routine: it asks 0x003DF8BC for a model-part flag word and ORs it into two objects at +8 and +0x24 before returning 1.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_InitBaseClass

functions.name: Field_Npc_UpdateFace
functions.summary: Advances the NPC's talking/face animation: when the face timer expires it either holds the last expression or advances to the next face pattern (0x253688=Event_UpdateCounter) and applies it to the model (0x1D60AC).

functions.name: Field_Npc_AdvanceFacePattern
functions.summary: Simplified face advance: when the current face duration has elapsed it moves to the next face pattern ((face+5)&3), resets the timer and sets the 'face changed' byte +5.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Marker_GetEventScene
functions.summary: Field-marker vtable slot (immediately before Field_Marker_OnEvent): returns the field event-scene validity test 0x00636AFC(work+0x6C); Ghidra dropped the returned value.

functions.name: Field_Marker_OnEvent
functions.signature: void Field_Marker_OnEvent(FieldMarker* self, int eventId, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Field marker event handler: on event 0x10 it stops the marker's effect/trail, releases the effect handle, starts the pickup SE (or the special 0x9DB SE) and then forwards all events to the base class (0x5E754C).

functions.name: Field_Marker_UpdatePickupState
functions.summary: Slot +0x28 of the field marker: if the marker's item (f_2B8) is not in the party bag it is shown/turned on, otherwise it is released and its effect handle is freed.

functions.name: Field_Marker_SetupSpriteObject
functions.summary: Configures the field marker from a BXON record: stores the model/pattern ids, sets the model size, creates the sprite actor from the table (Gfx_SpriteActor_CreateFromTable) and adds it as a child (0x335A6C).

functions.name: Field_Marker_SetupAnimatedObject
functions.summary: Same setup as Field_Marker_SetupSpriteObject but for objects that also need an animator: allocates a 0x178-byte animator, applies the animation template (0x2D1304=Anim_Instance_ApplyTemplate), binds it to the render node and creates the colour animator (Gfx_CreateFColAnimator).

functions.name: Field_Marker_ReleaseSubObject
functions.summary: Releases the marker's render sub-object (0x5E78E4) and sets the 'hidden' flag on the effect node found through the handle map at self+0x2BC.

functions.name: Field_Marker_ReleaseEffect
functions.summary: Releases the marker's effect instance (0x2D1258) and the effect handle stored at self+0x2BC.

functions.name: Field_Marker_ApplyTransform
functions.summary: Pushes the marker's two-word transform (f_78/f_7C) into the attached effect instance (0x44B4C4).

functions.name: Field_Marker_ReleaseHandle
functions.summary: Variant of the handle release that clears (sets 0) the effect node's flag instead of setting it.

functions.name: Field_Marker_UpdateChild
functions.signature: void Field_Marker_UpdateChild(FieldMarker* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Slot +8 of the field marker: updates the child render object (0x335C24) and, for markers with a valid model pattern, lets the field renderer cull it (0x1C90A4), then releases the effect handle.

functions.name: Field_Marker_NotifyGadgetCommand
functions.signature: void Field_Marker_NotifyGadgetCommand(FieldMarker* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Reports to the gadget/event system (0x256678=Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand) whether the marker's sound node is still playing.

functions.name: Field_Marker_Ctor_vt7617EC
functions.signature: void Field_Marker_Ctor_vt7617EC(FieldMarker* self, void* argument, int c)
functions.summary: Constructor of the Field_Marker variant whose vtable is 0x007617EC: runs the base scene-object constructor 0x0044C654, installs the vtable plus its secondary table at self+0x22C, sets the id halfword at +0x2B8 to -1 and clears the low flag bits of +0x2BC.

functions.name: Field_Marker_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the Field marker object: base destructor 0x0028E6C4 then operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Marker_LoadMesh
functions.summary: Field-marker override that loads the node's mesh by the resource name forwarded from the caller and then sets the state word at +0x2B4 to 1.

functions.name: Field_Marker_OnUpdate
functions.summary: Slot +0x28 of the marker class: checks whether the marker's item is still in the bag and, depending on the two state bytes +0x2EE/+0x2EF, plays the 'closed' animation (0x3C), keeps it hidden or releases the effect handle.

functions.name: Field_Marker_UpdateEffectState
functions.summary: Per-frame upkeep for one map marker: if the marker's placement id is no longer present in the object table it switches the node to its "Open" animation (or "Off" when the marker is flagged closed), plays it, releases the effect handle and tells the child node it is being removed.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Marker_IsAlive
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the game work exists and the field event-scene validity test 0x00636AFC(work+0x6C) is non-zero, else 0; one of the shared field-object vtable predicates.

functions.name: Field_Marker_OnNotify
functions.signature: void Field_Marker_OnNotify(FieldMarker* self, u32 message, u32 message2)
functions.summary: Node message handler for a map marker: on state 0x10 it releases the marker's effect handle and clears its interaction state, on state 0x0F it checks whether the marker's record id is 0x9DB and, if so, raises system event 4 (the 'examine' bump). Then it forwards the message to the base node and to the child at +0x270.

functions.name: Field_Marker_InitFromPlacement
functions.summary: Initialises a map marker from its placement record: copies the position, halves the offset vector for the sprite, spawns effect 0x496 slightly above the node with rotation (0,0,pi), stores the marker id and copies the four u16 parameters of the marker's table record.

functions.name: Field_Marker_InitModelMarker
functions.summary: Initialises a field marker that carries a 3D model: copies the placement id/position, applies its Euler rotation, adds the sprite-node descriptor child, registers the fCol animator, creates the mesh from the placement's model id (+0xC, variant byte +0x32), then looks up motion ids in the marker motion table (func_0063DCE8) and caches them at +0x2C8..+0x2E0; model id 0x2D6 also sets the quick-blink flags.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Marker_OnShow
functions.summary: Show/resume handler of a field marker: calls Field_SceneObject_Show and, when the marker still has its effect flag f_2EF and the activity test 0x006281C8 succeeds, spawns effect 0x496 at the node position (self+0x9C, +0.3f on Y) with Effect_CreateScaledInstance and stores the new handle at f_2F0.

functions.name: Field_Marker_OnHide
functions.summary: Hide virtual of the field marker: calls the base Field_SceneObject_Hide and then releases the marker's own effect handle at +0x2F0, so the effect disappears together with the marker.

functions.name: Field_Marker_OnDestroy
functions.summary: Destroy hook of a field marker: releases the marker's effect slots, unregisters it from the world (id at +0x26C) and releases the effect handle at +0x2F0.

functions.name: Field_Marker_NotifyCommand00
functions.summary: Marker notification handler: plays SE 9 when the marker's f_2C7 flag is set and always forwards the marker's placement id to the field gadget with command id 0, returning 1 so the marker stays alive.

functions.name: Field_Marker_Ctor_vt7618A8
functions.signature: void Field_Marker_Ctor_vt7618A8(FieldMarker* self, void* argument, int c)
functions.summary: Constructor of the second Field_Marker variant (vtable 0x007618A8): base constructor 0x0044CAB4, vtable plus secondary table at self+0x258, id halfword -1 at +0x2EC, and +0x2EE/+0x2EF/+0x2F0 cleared.

functions.name: Field_Marker_DeletingDtor_2
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field marker class: runs the base destructor 0x0028EFB4 and frees the object with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_Marker_UpdateDelay
functions.summary: Marker delay timer: accumulates dt in f_298 and, in state 1, sends task event 0x0B once 0.5 s have elapsed and returns to state 0; in state 0 it just reports whether the command slot is still busy.

functions.name: Field_Marker_CreateSpriteChild
functions.summary: Creates the marker's 2D 'sprite' child (0x178-byte object) from the character/object visual record, sizes it from the placement's width/height, attaches it to the node transform at self+0x94 and then creates the marker's sub-node (0x23C bytes) that follows the sprite position.

functions.name: Field_Marker_ExecuteAction
functions.summary: Runs a field marker's interaction: aborts with gadget command 0xC when the game is not in field mode 5, plays action sequence 0x0E on the player with the marker's position block, or (record f_FC == 3) plays SE 0x9D and switches the marker to state 1.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite2D_DeletingDtorC
functions.summary: Same body as Gfx_Sprite2D_DeletingDtorA (0x001A3BA8): installs the caller's vtable, unlinks the embedded node, destroys the attached scene object 0x24C bytes back and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_CreateChild
functions.summary: Factory of the 2D sprite class whose destructor is at 0x002F41F0: loads the caller's resource as the node mesh, allocates a 0xAC-byte child (vtable 0x0075AB7C), stores the owner and constructs two 0x40-byte sequence entries (ctor 0x006C8624).

functions.name: Field_Marker_PollEvent
functions.summary: Polls the marker's script task: on first call (f_2C8 == 0) it arms f_2C9 and sends task event 1 with the stored ids; afterwards it only returns whether the command slot is still busy.

functions.name: maybe_Actor2D_ApplyChildVisibility
functions.summary: Resolves the object handle and then applies a visibility/enable flag to the child object at +0x4C: it calls the child's virtual +0x18 with 1 and, when the +0x2C9 flag is set, tail-jumps into the same slot with 0, so the net result is 'visible unless +0x2C9'.

functions.name: Field_Marker_OnOpenAnim
functions.signature: void Field_Marker_OnOpenAnim(FieldMarker* self, u32 message, u32 payload)
functions.summary: Event handler that starts the marker's open animation: on event 0 it sets the animation "OpenAnim" and raises system event 0x100 (or plays the cached open sound when the marker is already open), on events 2/3 it enables/disables the door child, then forwards the event to the child node.

functions.name: Gfx_CreateMeshWithColorAnim
functions.signature: void Gfx_CreateMeshWithColorAnim(int* self, unsigned int* params)
functions.summary: Model-part style initialiser: copies the record's mesh/colour bytes, applies position and Euler rotation, adds a sprite child plus an fCol descriptor, calls the node's vtable +0x58 with 4 and creates the mesh from params->f_F/f_10.

functions.name: Field_Marker_NotifyCommand11
functions.summary: Marker notification handler for command 0x11: while the marker's f_2C8 flag is clear it forwards the placement id to the field gadget with command id 0x11 and returns the dispatcher result.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_Ctor
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_Ctor(GfxSprite2D* self, void* descriptor, void* arg3, int arg4)

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite2D_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 2D sprite actor class: runs the base destructor 0x0028EFB4 and frees the object with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_Marker_SetTransform
functions.signature: void Field_Marker_SetTransform(FieldMarker* self, const float* pos, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Applies a full transform to a marker: position, rotation (Gfx_Node_SetEulerRotation), uniform 0.5 scale, sprite anchor and cached transform snapshot, then re-registers it with the world object manager.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor: same vtable store, sibling unlink and embedded-scene-object teardown as 0x0028EFB8, then releases the object itself through its vtable slot 1.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Marker_QueueSystemCommand
functions.summary: Posts system command id 8 to the field command queue after building the argument block, bailing out while the event task slot is busy (func_00636AFC).

functions.summary: Loads the marker's visual record, stores its animation ids, then creates one sub-effect node per entry of the placement's inline array (10-byte entries: two u16 rects and a type byte).

functions.name: Field_Marker_StartSequence
functions.summary: Starts the marker's scripted sequence once both referenced resources are ready: checks the two id pairs (f_3B8/f_3BA and f_3BC/f_3BE) through the resource-status query, then sends task event 0 with the first pair.

functions.name: Field_Marker_DestroyChildren
functions.summary: Destructor helper for a marker: installs both marker/base vtables, destroys the fixed four-element sub-node array, unlinks the attached sub-node and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_MeshNode_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the mesh-carrying scene node: runs the base node destructor 0x002B6270 and frees the object with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_HopeSelect_LoadLayout
functions.summary: Loads the BFLYT layout 'win_hope_select' into the window's sub-window slot at +0x138 and hides it until it is shown.

functions.summary: Per-frame update: applies the layout's slot +0x2C, then - when the input object at +0x370 is active - forwards its three signed cursor axes to the child at +0x138 and, if the mode byte +0x338 is set, also to the second child at +0x324.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextWidget_Ctor

functions.name: Ui_HopeSelect_FreeResources
functions.summary: Tears down the 'hope select' window's nested layout object and its resources.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StateSequence_LazyCreate
functions.summary: Lazily creates the owner's 0x134-byte sequence object the first time it is needed: allocates it, installs vtable 0x0075ABA0 and its secondary table at +0x98, stores the owner back-pointer and constructs the 11 (0xB) 0x18-byte states with 0x006C8980.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_Clear

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_OpenFromSlot
functions.summary: Opens the message window for the current script message: marks the screen as "fade in" (self+0x143), dims the background, prepares the slot array at self+0x10, and if a message window exists it opens it with a configuration that uses texture 0xA0 and then loads the text from the message work area.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_ApplyVisualParams
functions.signature: void Ui_JockeyPanel_ApplyVisualParams(UIWindow* self, u32 id, const SelectionKey* key, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Fills the jockey panel from 'npc_jockey_visual_param.bxon': finds the parameter record whose class matches the jockey visual class and whose id field is > 0x27, stores it as the active preview, then binds the record to the 3D preview object and toggles the 8 direction/colour switches.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JockeyPanel_UpdatePreviewSlots
functions.summary: Refreshes the jockey panel's preview: if a preview object is attached at +0x124 it re-runs the slot transforms for the panel's part block, then returns the shared UI core value at (work+8)->f_88.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_SelectStatusCharacter
functions.summary: Forwards a character id to the field status window: Ui_StatusWindow_SelectCharacter(work+8->+0x88, id). It is the small selection wrapper used by the scene-open path, not a jockey-panel visibility setter.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_ResetStateAndSound
functions.summary: Resets the jockey panel's interaction flags (self+0x141..0x145, including the one-shot unlock flag used by Ui_JockeyPanel_UpdateCursor), notifies the bound UI parts, then restarts the panel's preview sound: voice gain from f_148, stops the old handle f_14C, rebuilds the player state and prepares BGM/voice stream 5 into f_150.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_HandleClose
functions.summary: Drives the message screen's close step: if the message window reports "close requested with auto-close" (byte +0x3F set) it raises self+0x144 and switches the screen animator to state 9; otherwise it clears the fade flag, un-dims the background, disposes the slots, closes the message window and switches the animator to state 6. Always returns 1 so the caller keeps running.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_OnOpen
functions.summary: Panel-open handler: when the enable byte is set it pushes the UI input mode, releases the pending preview child slots and asks the state machine for state 6; always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_Teardown
functions.summary: Teardown of the jockey panel: plays the panel close sound through the UI core player, stops the cached sound handle f_14C and the preview channel f_148 and clears both.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Panel_HandleInput
functions.summary: Per-frame input handler for a selectable panel: reacts to the menu cursor, plays error SE 0xEC0 and BGM 0x2E when the last slot is selected with no valid target, and drives the panel state machine with state 7 (accept) or 8 (back).

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_SetState5
functions.summary: Jockey-panel step: when the ready byte at +0x140 is set, moves the child window at +0x13C to state 5 through slot +0x18, then reports 1 (step finished).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageScreen_HandleConfirm
functions.summary: Confirm handler of a message screen: when the child screen's +0xC object reports a hit through virtual +0x14, it advances the screen state machine at self+0x13C to state 10; always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_Close
functions.summary: Closes the jockey panel: restores the input mode (system+0x30+0xE0), plays SE 0x3E and BGM/SE 0x7C, notifies the bound parts and triggers event command 0x1C.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_UpdateCursor
functions.summary: Per-frame cursor step of the jockey panel: if the current cell's preview scale has grown past the per-cell threshold stored in work+0x2A264[f_129][f_12a], it arms the one-shot flag f_145, stops the old handle and plays unlock SE 3 into f_14C; it then advances the child window at f_13C to state 9 once that child's own timer has run past 10 seconds.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_OnConfirm
functions.summary: Confirm handler of the jockey panel: if the selection is not accepted yet it triggers event command 0x1B and switches the panel to state 3; otherwise it plays the cached sound and switches to state 3.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JockeyPanel_SetState0
functions.summary: Jockey-panel state setter: forwards to 0x002AE0C4(work+0x74 context, 0) with a literal 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JockeyPanel_OnDecide
functions.summary: Commits the panel's current grid cell in UI mode 0xD: packs the two cursor indices and the cell kind, writes the value into the grid table at work+0x24A98+0x57D4 (+0x15F3 byte plane), fires command 0xAE, notifies the scene flow and closes the panel.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageScreen_ResetMenuSubsystem
functions.summary: One-line wrapper: calls func_002D2440 on the UI child-screen manager (Ui_GetCore()->f_14), the same call the talk-party wait loop uses to close the field UI.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageScreen_HandleCancel
functions.summary: Cancel handler of a message screen: when the child screen's +0xC object reports a hit through virtual +0x18, it advances the screen state machine at self+0x13C to state 5; always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_JockeyPanel_SetState4
functions.summary: Twin jockey-panel step that moves the child window to state 4 and reports 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JockeyPanel_Destruct
functions.summary: Resource teardown of the jockey panel (no memory free): rebinds the UI parts to the layout unless f_143 is set, stops the preview stream 5 and clears f_150 when the player reports a pending stream, and releases the child state object at f_13C through its vtable slots +8 and +0xC.

functions.name: maybe_Field_UiWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the field's UI window object (vtable 0x00761E58, 0x154 bytes): base-initialises through 0x004712D0, then constructs the embedded composite-window base at +4 with maybe_Ui_CompositeWindowCtor and clears the colour/fade fields +0x114..+0x140. Field_InitSceneObjects stores the result at scene+0x80.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemInfoWindow_SubDtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a sub-object of the item-info window family (vtable 0x761E58): deletes the owned object at +0x13C through its vtable, releases the handle at +0x138, tears down the 0x128-byte embedded sub-object and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_ItemInfoWindow_Open
functions.summary: Opens the item/recipe information window: marks itself visible, finds the window node by class, binds the item-info layout and forwards to the pane initialiser.

functions.name: Ui_ItemInfoWindow_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the item info window (vtable slot 1 of 0x00761E78): it advances the window frame at self+0x138 (0x002B7D4C/0x002B7C6C) while the "animating" flag 0x10 is set in self+0x130 and, when the frame animation wraps, releases the shared UI singleton so the new frame is picked up.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyTextEvent
functions.summary: Window event handler: for event kind 1 it marks the window open (+0x94/+0x135), binds the u16 text id at event+2 through 0x002F6B0C and forwards event+4/+8/+9 to the embedded window at +0x138; for any other kind it marks the window closed and tail-calls the base handler 0x002F6A3C.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ResolveChildPointerByName
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_ResolveChildPointerByName(UiWidget* self, void** slot, void* loader)
functions.summary: Layout fix-up: marks loader+0x60C with the slot, resolves the stored name/inline value through the layout's slot +0x24 (lookup child by name) and writes the resolved object pointer back.

functions.name: Ui_ItemInfoWindow_Create
functions.summary: Creates (once per UI core) the shared item-info window: installs the item-info vtable, registers its node list and sub-objects and returns the window base pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemInfoWindow_ChildWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the window embedded at parent+0x138: stores the incoming vtable, tears the child object chain down (0x002BB778 / 0x0036B514 with the -0x1C/-0x11C base recovery) and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemInfoWindow_ChildWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting twin of 0x002F6B48: stores the incoming vtable and runs the same embedded-window teardown at +0x138, but ends in 0x001D8C2C instead of freeing the block.

functions.name: Ui_BigWindow_Ctor

functions.summary: Constructor of a wrapper around the 0x1FBC-byte big window: installs vtable 0x00761EB8, clamps `variant` to 0/1, allocates and constructs the big window through Ui_BigWindow_CtorBase, registers it with the UI core, applies the two extra arguments with maybe_Ui_JewelShopWindow_SetFlag and marks it enabled (+0x94 = 1).
