functions.name: maybe_Ui_TwoListObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Member initialiser that constructs two animation-reference lists 0x50 bytes apart inside the caller's object (the first pointer is forwarded untouched, the second is built at +0x50) and returns the object base.

functions.name: Ui_Pager_ClearAllPages
functions.summary: Empties a pager: while slot +0x84 reports a positive entry count it asks slot +0x74 to remove the current entry, then clears the dirty byte at +0x14.

functions.name: Ui_Pager_SetPage
functions.summary: Moves the pager one page forward (wrapping to 0) and updates the visibility of every page: the current page is shown, all others are hidden.

functions.name: Ui_Pager_ApplyPage
functions.signature: void Ui_Pager_ApplyPage(UIPager* pager, u32 index, int pageArray, int slot)
functions.summary: Applies one page selection: calls the pager's commit and page virtuals and forwards the page id (or the per-page table entry) to the shared scroll/notify helper.

functions.name: Ui_CursorWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the cursor icon panes "icon_cursor_default_0" and "icon_cursor_flash_0" for every row and configures their flash animation.

functions.name: Ui_CursorWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the small cursor window: runs the Ui_Object base constructor, installs vtable 0x761ED8 (with the secondary vtable at +0xA4) and clears the two cursor state fields at +0x14 and +0x54. Called from the larger window constructors that embed a cursor.

functions.name: Ui_CursorWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the cursor window: stores the class table, runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees. The matching Ui_CursorWindow_Ctor sits 0x2C bytes earlier.

functions.name: Ui_Pager_SelectTab
functions.summary: Selects one of the pager's three panes: hides the other two, shows the chosen pane and sets the pane's label text, playing the per-tab sound id (0xE for tabs 0/2, 9 for tab 1).

functions.name: Ui_ThreePositionWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds one text line and three position markers (position1..3), hiding all three markers initially.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TabBar_Ctor
functions.summary: UI object constructor: Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs the class vtable, then chains three Ui_AnimRefList_Ctor calls at +0x4C/+0x9C/+0xEC and returns the object base.

functions.name: Ui_PaneSet_Dtor_3
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a three-pane UI object: destroys the panes at +0x4C, +0x9C and +0xEC, destroys the list and frees.

functions.name: Ui_LoadingWindow_InitPane
functions.summary: Binds the "loading" pane of the loading window.

functions.name: Ui_PaneSet_Dtor_1B
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a one-pane UI object whose pane sits at +0x4C: destroys the pane and the list, then frees.

functions.name: Ui_Message_SetNameAndCountArg
functions.summary: Binds a name plus an optional count to a message: argument 2 always gets the name/number, and when `f_210` is at least 1 argument 8 additionally receives the count (used for the "%s x%d" pickup message).

functions.name: Ui_ModeWindow_Setup
functions.summary: Binds the mode window's layout by name ("win_mode"), plays its open SE (through 0x18FD04 with argument 1), re-sorts the cursor list and copies the mode byte f_14C to f_1A1.

functions.name: Ui_ModeWindow_UpdateChildren
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the mode window: applies the layout slot +0x2C, mirrors the mode byte +0x14C into +0x1A1, refreshes the animated child list at +0x138 and, when the input object is active and the mode set, passes its three signed cursor values to that list.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_Create
functions.summary: Creates the list window: installs vtable 0x0076216C, initialises the intrusive list heads and the priority-ordered object, and returns the window base.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_DtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a list window: installs vtable 0x0076216C, destroys the base object at +0x138, unlinks the three list pairs, destroys the 0x50-byte container/sub-object and frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteCache_LookupOrLoad
functions.summary: Returns the sprite/texture registered under <name> in the cache at self+4, loading it through Ui_ResourceCache_CreateEntry on a miss; a freshly loaded sprite is announced to the owner through vtable +0x18.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteList_LoadSlotTextures
functions.signature: int Ui_SpriteList_LoadSlotTextures(UiSpriteList* self, u32 packedNames, const char* arg3, const char* b, int* outSize)
functions.summary: Loads the (up to eight) slot sprites of a list: for each used slot it formats a resource path with the inline "%s/%s/%s" or "%s/%s" pattern into a 0x100-byte buffer, finds it through Fs_Sarc_FindFile and stores the resulting size.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteList_AllocFreeSlot
functions.signature: void* Ui_SpriteList_AllocFreeSlot(UiSpriteList* self, void* arg2, u8* value)
functions.summary: Finds the first free slot (in-use byte +0x2C == 0) among the eight list slots, initialises the sprite at self+0x10+i*0x20 through Fs_Sarc_Open and stores *value in the slot payload byte +0x1D.

functions.name: Ui_ResourceCache_GetOrCreate
functions.summary: Two-level resource cache: asks the global map at 0x007C6E58 for <name> and, on a miss, creates the object through the owner's vtable +0x1C and registers it with Ui_ResourceCache_Insert (replace flag 1).

functions.name: Text_FontManager_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the text/font manager singleton: base-initialises through 0x00536718, installs vtable 0x007621BC, creates the empty intrusive list head at +4/+8/+0xC and default-constructs eight 0x20-byte text-style slots at +0x10.

functions.name: Field_Prop_HandleCommand
functions.signature: void Field_Prop_HandleCommand(FieldProp* self, u32 message, const char* name, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Scene-node command handler for a field prop: on command 7 with a matching name it switches the prop to interactive state 4, activates its children and, if the player's box overlaps, starts the interaction; every command is then forwarded to the children.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromParams
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromParams(SpriteActor* self, SpriteActorParams* p, u32 animId)
functions.summary: Initialises a 2D sprite actor from a compact parameter block: copies the position, size, depth and colour, creates the animation instance, uploads the transform and stores the initial animation id.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromParamsEx
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromParamsEx(SpriteActor* self, SpriteActorParamsEx* p, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Extended 2D sprite actor initialiser: also selects the animation frame entry whose id matches the actor's variant byte (0x18-byte entries of the frame table at p+0x14 with the sort key at +0x17 checked against the save's per-id byte table at root+0x27508) and applies the chosen offset.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromFixedEntry
functions.summary: Initialises a 2D sprite actor from a fixed-layout entry (no dynamic frame table): copies the packed 16-bit position/size, creates the animation instance and either applies an explicit palette variant (func_00290AA8) or stores the variant id for later (func_00290A08).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Prop_OnActionEnd
functions.summary: Action-end callback of a field object: looks up the party member/actor record at self+0xB0 and, only when its flag byte +0xDA has bit 0x10 set, checks the current scene record's +0x1D; if that is clear it stops the object (vtable 0x58/0x40 with 4) and releases its attached objects, otherwise it marks the member value in the overlay at work+0x48.

functions.name: Field_Prop_FreeSubNode
functions.summary: Destroys and frees a prop's attached sub-node: releases the node header at -0x100 from self, runs the sub-node destructor and frees it.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_ReleaseOnAnimEnd
functions.summary: Releases a 2D sprite actor once its animation has finished: if the actor is not already done and the animation id resolves to nothing, it marks itself done, signals both vtable handlers with code 4, releases the effect nodes and the shared resource, and sets the 'released' flag.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromParamsB
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromParamsB(SpriteActor* self, SpriteActorParamsB* p, u32* extra)
functions.summary: Third 2D sprite actor initialiser: same frame-table selection as 0x002F7D4C but the animation ids sit at p+0x26/p+0x28 and the extra resource id comes from `*extra`, which is stored at +0x2b8 and marked 'not started'.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromParamsC
functions.summary: Third 2D sprite-actor initialiser: copies the param block (position, size, model/variant, flags), creates the collision and effect sprites, and then scans the per-map variant list at params->f_28 (entries stride 0x18) for the first entry whose area flag (+0x17) is satisfied by work+0xF14+0x27508, storing the chosen variant in f_240/f_242/f_2A8.

functions.name: Field_Prop_FreeSubNodeEx
functions.summary: Second destroy-and-free variant for a prop sub-node: installs the vtable, destroys the embedded object at +0x254 and frees it.

functions.name: Ui_ActionPane_AddReactAnimator
functions.summary: Adds the fifth animation controller ("react") to the action-pane child list when the pane has more than five slots.

functions.name: Field_Npc_OnReact
functions.summary: Reacts to the special 'React' balloon: when the talk-balloon controller is showing the 'React' emote it clears the react flag and, for action ids 0x212..0x215, plays the react animation and sound.

functions.name: Field_Npc_InitTalkBalloons
functions.signature: void Field_Npc_InitTalkBalloons(FieldNpc* self, const NpcPlacement* p, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Initialises an NPC that shows dialogue balloons: copies the placement (position, flags, animation id, colour index), attaches the 'outBalloon' and 'defaultTalk' effects, sets the balloon tint from the NPC's colour entry, and hands the NPC to the character renderer.

functions.name: maybe_Trail_UpdateNodeFromOwner
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Trail_UpdateNodeFromOwner(TrailNode* self, u32 arg2, TrailNode* which)
functions.summary: Callback that refreshes one of the object's two owner nodes: for the node at +0x268 it asks the owner to restart (vtable +0xC8) or plays state 5; for the node at +0x390 it looks the effect up in the shared slot table and clears it when missing. Always returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ObjectWithSprite_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a Field object that also owns a Gfx_SpriteObject at +0x390: stamps the vtable, destroys the sprite object, then runs Field_Object_DtorWithHandle on self (releasing the registered handle) and frees.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_EnsureChildObject
functions.summary: Lazily creates a 0x6C-byte child scene object through the shared factory (name 0x007BE88E), stores it at f_390 and attaches it to the node.

functions.name: Field_Npc_OnApproach
functions.signature: void Field_Npc_OnApproach(FieldNpc* self, u32 message, const char* name, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: NPC proximity handler: when the player with the matching name comes within the NPC's talk radius it turns the NPC towards the player, switches it to its talk animation and starts the talk state.

functions.name: Field_Npc_ApplyFaceFromTalk
functions.summary: Recomputes the NPC's facial expression: if the current talk/event record has a face record it uses that record's face id and two variant bytes, otherwise it falls back to the NPC's own default face (or the per-type table byte), then pushes the 3-byte result to the model's face node.

functions.name: Field_Npc_ResolveMotionId
functions.signature: u32 Field_Npc_ResolveMotionId(FieldNpc* self, int situation, u32 arg3, u32 spill)
functions.summary: Maps a semantic situation code to the concrete NPC motion id to play, taking the NPC's state byte and its type record into account; returns ids in the 0x54E..0x55D / 0x5E0 / 0x612 range and falls back to 0x550.

functions.name: Field_Npc_InitEmoteBalloon
functions.signature: void Field_Npc_InitEmoteBalloon(FieldNpc* self, const NpcPlacement* p, u32 owner, u32 balloon)
functions.summary: Second NPC balloon variant: initialises the NPC, attaches a single 'defaultTalk' emote balloon, applies the tint and starts the NPC in the scene; the extra argument selects the balloon rendering mode.

functions.name: Field_Npc_InitFullBalloons
functions.signature: void Field_Npc_InitFullBalloons(FieldNpc* self, const NpcPlacement* p, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Widest NPC balloon variant: two balloons plus an optional extra effect, extra animation/scale fields and a follow target used for cut-scene placement.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Npc_OnActionEnd
functions.summary: Small NPC state hook: reads the character id at self+0x394, and if that party-member record has flag 0x10 at +0xDA set it resolves the action record for actionId. When the record's +0x1D is 0 it cancels the NPC through vtable slots +0x58/+0x40 with mode 4 and releases the model nodes, otherwise it sets member state 1 in the world system.

functions.name: Field_Npc_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field NPC scene object: runs the shared object/handle teardown 0x00184CB4 and frees the block with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_ReleaseWithChildren
functions.summary: Heavier release path for a 2D sprite actor: when the animation has ended it marks itself done, signals both vtable handlers, releases the model/effect nodes and the child resources, and — if the actor owns a child — also frees the associated 0x98-byte resource block.

functions.name: maybe_FieldNpc_DrawPartyIcon
functions.summary: Draws the floating map icon above a field NPC: lazily creates the shared 0x98-byte UI object, resolves the NPC's icon record from the id at self+0x258, finds the party entry by self->f_38C and draws the icon at self->f_9C/f_A0/f_A4, scaling its colour by the NPC state byte f_313.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Npc_InitColorBalloonA
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Npc_InitColorBalloonA(FieldNpc* self, const NpcPlacement* p, const u32* color, u32 owner)
functions.summary: NPC placement-record initialiser with an explicit colour: copies the transform from p[8..13], stores *color into the balloon colour field f_38c, forces the balloon flag f_35d = 1, builds the sprite/model children and registers the actor sprite.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Npc_InitColorBalloonB
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Npc_InitColorBalloonB(FieldNpc* self, const NpcPlacement* p, const u32* color, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Variant of the explicit-colour NPC placement initialiser: same transform/model/sprite sequence as 0x002FA83C but with a different record offset base and colour mode, used where the caller already resolved the colour.

functions.name: Field_NpcSprite_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the sprite variant of the field NPC class: runs 0x00184CB4 and frees with 0x0010F6CC; byte-identical to 0x002FA43C but for a second NPC table.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_Ctor_vt7625D4
functions.summary: Derived field-action constructor: base-constructs through Field_ActorAction_CtorBase and installs vtable 0x007625D4, a horse-action vtable whose slots call the model's vtable+0x84/+0x88 with the inline motion name "Hors...".

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small field actor-action/scene object: runs the shared Gfx object-desc base destructor 0x00193E44 and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC. It is slot 0 of vtable 0x007625D8.

functions.name: Field_HorseMesh_ApplyAnimEntry
functions.summary: Applies the animation entry currently requested in self+0x270 to the horse mesh: clamps the index to count-1 of the entry table at self+0x368, copies the 0x18-byte entry (four words, two flag bytes, one word) into self+0x36C..0x388 and commits the change through the keyed-list helper 0x005E7848(self, 1).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Prop_Destruct
functions.summary: Field prop teardown: releases the prop's action object and then reselects entry 0 of the keyed list at self+0x60. The readable body is empty (Ghidra dropped it); the identical body exists at 0x003E60F0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_PaneSetupSlot17
functions.summary: Vtable slot 17 handler for window at 0x0076267C: allocates 0x228-byte pane record and initializes pane bounds.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActionList_FillSlotsWithTimers
functions.summary: Fills the field action list with timer action rows: walks the row count at +0x40, allocates 0x2C-byte rows, builds each with 0x002FB460 and inserts it with Container_SlotReplace, releasing the new row through its slot +4 when the replace fails.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActionList_FillSlotsWithHorseActions
functions.summary: Second half of the field action-list fill: for successive slots it allocates 0x2C/0x34/0x48-byte horse-action objects through the Field_HorseAction constructors and installs them with Container_SlotReplace.

functions.name: Field_CollisionObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a Field collision object: runs the scene-object base destructor (inner entry 0x003680CC of 0x003680B4) and then operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_ItemRows_MovePage
functions.signature: void Ui_ItemRows_MovePage(UiItemRows * self, int delta, u32 arg3, int wrap)
functions.summary: Moves the eight-row item list to another page: converts the delta into a page index (row count from vtable+0x64 divided by 8), clamps or wraps it into [0, pageCount], stores it at +0x50 and notifies the row renderer (vtable+0x60) or the repaint path (vtable+0x3C); with an empty list it falls back to select-by-id 0x1B6.

functions.name: Ui_ItemRows_RefreshRows
functions.summary: Refreshes the eight visible item rows of a bag/equipment list: resolves each row's item id, picks the part/icon image, applies the row tint (state colour multiplied by the global row colour per channel), writes the icon and count text, sets each row's selected/equipped visibility bits and finally updates the page counter labels.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StatusIcon_SetFromType
functions.summary: Refreshes the embedded six-row count list and its part animation, then sets the sprite at +0x4A4 from texture 0x83+type when the record's type byte is below 0x19 and clears it otherwise.

functions.name: Ui_Icon_SetFromType
functions.summary: Sets the icon's texture from a type code: types below 0x19 select atlas texture 0x83+type and apply it to the widget's frame slot; any other type clears the slot (no texture).

functions.name: Ui_Text_FitString
functions.signature: void Ui_Text_FitString(TextLayout* self, const u16* text)
functions.summary: Measures a UTF-16 string until the terminator and, when the whole run fits into the remaining line width, appends it to the layout and advances the write cursor.

functions.name: Ui_ItemMenuWindow_InitBase
functions.summary: Constructor/base-initialiser of the item menu window: a pure tail call into the shared initialiser 0x001A6460 (install vtable, set initial flag, bind the two background textures).

functions.name: Ui_ItemMenuWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_ItemMenuWindow_InitPanes(int* self, int* layout, int arg3, int arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Initialises the item-menu window: title, pager numbers, placeholder rows and the check/star/key icons, plus the per-row item state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_SelectByEntryId
functions.summary: Selects the list row whose 16-bit entry id equals id: id 0x1B6 selects the 'nothing' marker 0x13, otherwise it scans the id array between self+0x58 and self+0x5C, converts the hit index to an 8-rows-per-page page+offset and selects it with Ui_List_SelectEntryById before repainting (vtable+0x60).

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_CtorB
functions.summary: Constructor of the shared scrolling list window base: runs Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x007626EC, clears the five cursor/scroll words at +0x4C..+0x5C and constructs eight 0x5C-byte row objects at +0x60.

functions.name: Ui_ItemMenuWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the item-menu window: releases the eight 0x5C-byte element objects, clears the container and frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_List_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the eight-element list container: installs vtable 0x7626EC, destroys the eight 0x5C-byte elements at +0x18 with their destructor (0x61798C) via std_destroy_range and then runs the UI object base destructor.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_PropagateTextResource
functions.summary: Stores the panel-text resource pointer into four mirrored state fields (f_278, f_2FC, f_688, f_2438) of the skill panel so every sub-state uses the same text resource.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_Ctor_vt762760
functions.summary: Small UI-object constructor: runs Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x00762760 and clears the single object pointer at +0x4C.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ItemBox_Destruct
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small menu object: vtable 0x00762760 slot 1 (0x00762764; slot 0 is 0x002FCC74); runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees. Its own table has no class override, so the 'item box' owner still rests on Menu_ItemBox_Reset just before it and on the Ui_SkillPanel_Dtor caller.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ResetLargeScreenState
functions.summary: Resets a large screen object: rebuilds the 8-entry table at +0x11C, resolves the view at +0x148, lazily creates the 0x80-byte helper, then empties the element list at +0x300, frees cached nodes, resets three list heads and rebinds +0x43E0 when the scene is active.

functions.name: Ui_BaseWindow_UpdateStep
functions.summary: Per-frame step driver of the base Ui window: advances the step clock in the core object at self+0x3574 (time += 1/30, frame++ when the animation query says it is not finished), then invokes the member-function pointer stored in the core's 19-entry, 0x18-byte-stride step table (entry = fn + ARM member-pointer adjustment, virtual bit honoured) with the object at core+0x20 as 'this'.

functions.name: maybe_Container_UnlinkNodeAndEnableView
functions.summary: Unlinks a node from an intrusive list (fixes the two neighbour links and re-points the head) and then enables the view object (child-screen sub-object +0x1C, virtual +0xC with 1).

functions.name: Ui_Widget_UpdateInput
functions.summary: Thin input-update override for a UI widget: forwards to the shared widget input routine and reports the widget as still alive.

functions.name: Text_LayoutLine_AutoSize
functions.signature: void Text_LayoutLine_AutoSize(PageBuilder* self, int tableIdx, char* line, int* widthOut, int flags, int seeded)
functions.summary: Appends one already-wrapped line to the page: it tries the six font sizes from 1 upward with the measured width, picks the first (largest) size that fits, and then hands the line to the text renderer with that size.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ResetAndActivateA
functions.summary: Teardown/reset template variant A: drains the child list, re-links the +0x344C node, resets the base parts and raises the object's +0xAB8 state flag.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemScreen_HandleConfirm
functions.summary: Confirm handler of the item screen: when the input manager reports a hit it sets the two flags at self+0x134/+0x135 and advances the sub-widget at self+0x3574 to state 0xE (empty list), 3 (no selection) or 2 (selection), then commits it; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ResetAndActivateB
functions.summary: Reset template variant B: drains the children, re-links the +0x34D8 node and resets the base parts, then on the lazily created shared 0x80-byte object returns whether the low two flag bits are both set and sets bit 1 in the companion flag word when they are.

functions.name: Text_LayoutPage_BuildLines
functions.summary: Builds one page of text: measures the available line count (max 20), walks the record table and for every record adds its (up to two) text halves as lines through the auto-size layout helper, then fills the remaining slots from the reservation table; finally starts the layout animation.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ResetB
functions.summary: Teardown half of a large UI widget/screen object: drains the child list, unlinks the two intrusive list nodes at +0x344C and +0x34D8, runs the shared widget base reset and releases the sub-widget at +0xAB8. The class is not identified, so the name stays generic.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputToState18
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputToState18(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it reports the input was consumed, pops one pending text entry (0x0010EBD8) and requests step 0x12 on the window core at self+0x3574.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ResetC
functions.summary: Reset of a large UI widget/screen object: drains the children, unlinks the +0x344C node, runs the shared widget base reset, hides the sub-widgets at +0x184/+0x204, releases the one at +0x288 and finally rebuilds the list at +0x3570 (Ui_ListData_BuildEntries) and re-applies the row colour.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_OnInputRunActionNodeB
functions.summary: Second variant of the window input/step dispatcher: on confirm it walks the 0x10-byte action nodes of the list at self+0x3570 (toggling the node's work byte or requesting steps 7/8, and steps 9/10 depending on whether fewer than 0x33 entries remain), applies the row value colour to self+0x184 and marks the window advanced (f_356C).

functions.name: maybe_Text_Block_ClearChildren
functions.summary: Clears a text block's child list: pops children until only one remains, re-initialises the list at self+0xD36, writes the emptied count through the trace formatter and calls the window slot +0x54 with (0x25, -1).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ResetD
functions.summary: Reset of a large UI widget/screen object: drains the children, unlinks the +0x344C node, runs the shared widget base reset, hides the sub-widget at +0x1C0, releases the one at +0x2B8, rebuilds the list at +0x3570 and re-sets the row message.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Block_BindSourceList
functions.summary: Moves the source list at source+0xD8 into the block with 0x00123594, notifies the owner through virtual +0x5C with the area at self+0xDDC and sets the sub-widget at self+0xCF9 active (0x0029126C with 1).

functions.name: maybe_Text_MeasureOverflow
functions.signature: bool maybe_Text_MeasureOverflow(u32 arg1, u32 textId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Measures a text against its page: clears the shared line buffer (maybe_Text_ClearLineBuffer), tests the two low state bits of the layout object and sets the overflow flag 0x48 in the block when both are set.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputToStateConfirm
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputToStateConfirm(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, sets the window bytes self+0x134/self+0x135 and requests step 6 if the prompt was confirmed, or step 0x0C on cancel.

functions.name: Ui_TextWindow_StartAction1F
functions.summary: Window step handler: moves the child's pending entry list (child+0xD8) into the window and then starts window action 0x1F through the virtual slot at vtable+0x54 with -1 as the argument.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_StepSelectListRow
functions.summary: Window step entry: with mask 1 it forwards the three pointer arguments to the list sub-object at +0xAB8, maps the returned row through 0x003BD8A4 and runs that row's action node; mask 0x10 sets f_560 on the sequence object; cancel (4) requests step 0x12; confirm requests step 4 once the sub-object's timer reports done and sets f_356C.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputClearList
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputClearList(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when the cached input byte self+0x3534 has bit 3 set or the widget consumed the input, cancels the widget interaction (0x001DAB30), clears the 0x2C-byte row vector at self+0x3774 and hides the list sub-widget at self+0x33E4.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Block_CloseAndActivate
functions.summary: Notifies the owner through virtual +0x5C with the area at self+0xF42 and then sets the sub-widget at self+0xCF9 active (0x0029126C with 1); no core state or text id is written.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ActionSeq_RunEnd
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Actor_ActionSeq_RunEnd(ActorActionSeq* self, int seqDesc, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Finishes an actor action sequence: binds the descriptor's +0x520 block into self+0x34D8 and, unless the sequence reports done, clears the two root bytes and requests action 0x11 (more nodes) or 0x12 (none pending).

functions.name: Ui_TextWindow_StartAction22
functions.summary: Same body as Ui_TextWindow_StartAction1F (0x002FE024) with action id 0x22: move the child's entry list (child+0xD8) into the window, then start window action 0x22 through vtable+0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ResetWithCommand
functions.summary: Reset of a UI widget/screen object of a different class than the +0x344C family: drains the children, unlinks the +0xD36 node, runs the shared widget base reset and then dispatches virtual command 0x20 with -1 through the object's own vtable slot +0x54.

functions.name: Ui_TextWindow_StartAction1E
functions.summary: Same body as Ui_TextWindow_StartAction1F (0x002FE024) with action id 0x1E: move the child's entry list into the window, then start window action 0x1E through vtable+0x54.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputToState6
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputToState6(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 6 on the window core at self+0x3574 and commits it.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputHideList
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputHideList(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when the cached input byte self+0x3534 has bit 3 set or the widget consumed the input, hides the list sub-widget at self+0x33E4 (0x0029126C) without changing state.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction26
functions.summary: Flushes the window's pending text entries down to one, moves the child window's pending entry list (child+0xD8) into the window's own entry list, then starts window action 0x26 with no extra argument through the virtual call at vtable+0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ActionSeq_RunEndB
functions.summary: Sequence-end step: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 3 on cancel, or on confirm compares the remaining node count (owner+0x34/+0x38 plus maybe_Actor_ReleaseTailMember(work+0x24A98)) with 0x33 and requests step 0x0F when it is below that, else step 5.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputToState18B
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputToState18B(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8, pops one pending text entry (0x0010EBD8) and requests step 0x12 on the window core at self+0x3574. Duplicate of 0x002FD8A8 for a second window class.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputToState6B
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputToState6B(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 6 on the window core at self+0x3574. Duplicate of 0x002FE4C4.

functions.name: Ui_Window_StartAction27
functions.summary: Window step handler: splices the child's entry list (child+0x360) into the window, formats the remaining slot count into the shared UI number string and starts window action 0x27 through vtable+0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_InputToState18Or6
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 0x12 if the prompt was confirmed, or sets the window bytes self+0x134/self+0x135 (unless the owner byte +0x4A5 is 2) and requests step 6.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputToState6C
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputToState6C(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 6 on the window core at self+0x3574. Third copy of the 0x002FE4C4 body.

functions.name: maybe_Item_CollectIdsFromBag
functions.summary: Collects item ids into the object's set at f_F42: clears the linked list at f_F46, walks entries in the save/bag work (work+0x24A98), resolves each id with Item_LookupRecord, marks ownership through 0x00613168 and inserts the id with Item_Set_InsertItemId, then requests page 0x23 or 0x24 through vtable+0x54.

functions.name: Ui_ListData_BindEntries
functions.summary: Fills the block's list data with the combined character+item entry set (mode 2 of the list builder) and stores the resulting entry count, then advances the page step to command 0x1b.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputToState16
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputToState16(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 0x10 on the window core at self+0x3574 and commits it.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InputToState15
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_InputToState15(UIWindow* self, const UiUpdateArgs* args)
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, requests step 0x0F on the window core at self+0x3574 and commits it.

functions.name: Ui_TextWindow_StartAction19WithCount
functions.summary: Moves the child's entry list into the window, counts the used rows of the sequence object at self+0x3570 through 0x0063C8BC (rows whose flag byte +9 is set) and starts window action 0x19 with that count instead of -1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_InputToState11Or6
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, on confirm collects the pending action nodes and party member ids, subtracts that from the scroll value self+0x3768 and requests step 0x0B, or requests step 6 on cancel.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveForm_CtorB
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_DiveForm_CtorB(u32 object, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Second constructor variant of the dive-form window hierarchy: calls the confident Ui_DiveForm_Ctor, installs the derived vtable, initialises the member pair and constructs its 19 (0x13) 0x18-byte state array. The B suffix only distinguishes it from the other ctor variant at 0x003096D4.

functions.name: Mem_Alloc
functions.summary: The game's general heap allocation entry: takes the global heap lock and allocates `size` bytes with 4-byte alignment from the heap object pointed to by 0x7B0078.

functions.name: std_va_list_get
functions.summary: Returns the current position of the C variadic argument cursor plus the 4-byte header offset; used by the vsnprintf wrapper to hand the same argument list to another formatter.

functions.name: std_vprintf_flags0
functions.signature: void std_vprintf_flags0(u32 stream, u32 fmt, u32* vaList, u32 extra)
functions.summary: One of the two printf entry points: builds a formatting context with control flag 0 and runs the shared formatter.

functions.name: std_vprintf_flags1
functions.signature: void std_vprintf_flags1(u32 stream, u32 fmt, u32* vaList, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Second printf entry point: same formatter with control flag 1 (the 'long'/wide variant selected by the caller).

functions.name: std_Format_PadZero
functions.summary: Format-output padding helper: emits sink->count copies of the pad character ('0' when the zero-pad flag is set, ' ' otherwise) through the sink callback and advances the written-character counter; does nothing once the 'done' flag is set.

functions.name: std_Format_PadSpace
functions.summary: Second padding helper used when the pad direction differs: emits the remaining count of spaces (0x20) through the callback and advances the written counter; returns immediately unless the sink is in the 'active' state.

functions.name: std_Format_WriteInteger
functions.signature: u32 std_Format_WriteInteger(FormatSink* sink, int width, const char* digits, int count)
functions.summary: Core integer conversion for the printf engine: adjusts the field width (pad-before/pad-after), emits the leading zeros, then copies `count` digits through the sink callback, emits the trailing spaces and finally the right-aligned padding; returns 1 or 2 depending on the final sink state.

functions.name: std_DivideU64
functions.summary: Unsigned 64-bit divided by 10 with the remainder returned in the high word: the shift/add division sequence used by the itoa/printf digit loops to peel one decimal digit per call.

functions.name: std_strtoul_B
functions.signature: u32 std_strtoul_B(const char* text, u32* endPtr, int base)
functions.summary: Parses an unsigned long from text with 0x/0 prefix detection and saturation: values that overflow 32 bits return 0xFFFFFFFF.

functions.name: std_Format_Dispatch
functions.signature: u32 std_Format_Dispatch(u16* out, int code code, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Wide-character printf dispatcher: fetches the active format state (0x2FF68C), and if the engine is in 'wide' mode calls the installed converter through the jump offset at state+0x103, otherwise stores the character code into *out and returns 1. Returns -1 when the code is not mapped.

functions.name: Ui_TextListWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the large text/list window (over 0x404C bytes): stores the incoming vtable, installs the text sub-object vtable 0x00762D2C at +0x3D08, returns the pool nodes of the lists at +0x3D18/+0x3D24, walks the 0x2C-stride row vector at +0x3774, runs the base window destructor 0x003BE544 and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_AreaTrigger_Run
functions.summary: Virtual 'run' step (vtable 0x762830 slot 1) of an area trigger: if the trigger has a record and the map context is valid, it marks the trigger's flag bit in the global visited bitmap, looks the sub-record up in the 16-byte entry table and re-dispatches the map-jump event (id 2) with the record's id, then sets the done byte +8.

functions.name: std_ScaleByPowerOfTen
functions.signature: void std_ScaleByPowerOfTen(double* out, int exponent, int roundMode)
functions.summary: Multiplies/divides a double by 10^exponent by splitting the exponent into base-55 chunks and using a table of pre-scaled 10^k constants, i.e. the power-of-ten scaling step of strtod/dtoa.

functions.name: std_DoubleDivideAlt
functions.signature: void std_DoubleDivideAlt(const double* lhs, const double* rhs)
functions.summary: Registers-in/registers-out variant of the soft-float double divide: same normal-number test, mantissa divide core and result packing as std_DoubleDivide.

functions.name: std_DoubleMultiplyAlt
functions.signature: void std_DoubleMultiplyAlt(const double* lhs, const double* rhs)
functions.summary: Registers-in/registers-out variant of the soft-float double multiply: tests for non-zero significands, runs the mantissa multiply core and packs the result.

functions.name: std_DoubleToDecimal
functions.signature: char* std_DoubleToDecimal(DtoaResult* result, char* digits, double* value, int ndigits, int mode)
functions.summary: Converts a double to a decimal digit string for printf %e/%f/%g: scales by powers of ten until the digit count fits, emits digits (reversing them), trims leading zeros or rounds up one digit and reports the decimal point position plus the final digit count through result.

functions.name: std_PrintfFormatFloat
functions.signature: u32 std_PrintfFormatFloat(PrintfStream* out, int conv, int width)
functions.summary: Handles the %e / %f / %g float conversions for printf: takes the double from the varargs, asks std_DoubleToDecimal for digits plus decimal point, builds the exponent part, and emits the sign, padding and digits through the stream putc callback.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PastPlaceWindow_HolderCtor
functions.summary: Constructor of the small window holder (vtable 0x762830): takes the heap from the shared UI singleton, allocates and starts the child 0x530-byte past-place window through Ui_PastPlaceWindow_Ctor, attaches it to the manager and marks the holder enabled (+0x94).

functions.name: std_vprintf_core
functions.signature: u64 std_vprintf_core(FormatCtx* ctx, const u32* vaList)
functions.summary: The engine's own printf formatter: parses '%' conversions, handles the flag characters, width, precision, the h/l/j/t/z/L length modifiers and calls the output callback, pulling variadic arguments through the va_list.

functions.name: std_vsnprintf_B
functions.signature: u32 std_vsnprintf_B(u8* buf, u32 size, u32 fmtAndArgs)
functions.summary: vsnprintf-style wrapper: forwards to the formatter implementation stored in the current format context when that context uses the extended implementation, otherwise checks the character against the context's table.

functions.name: Ui_Window_Dtor_530
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the window holder created by maybe_Ui_Window_Ctor_530 (0x00300314): reinstalls vtable 0x00762830, releases the owned 0x530-byte child window through the UI manager (0x0021F8B8), clears the pointer and frees the holder.

functions.name: Field_Action_SyncTransformFromActor
functions.summary: Caches the owning actor's position, facing and 'movement blocked' flag inside the action object, so the action's own steps can interpolate towards it. This is the default start step of the base field-action class.

functions.name: std_ScanfConvertFloat
functions.signature: void std_ScanfConvertFloat(u32 dst, int width, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, ScanSource* src)
functions.summary: scanf %f/%e/%g conversion: fills the scan-source descriptor (getc/ungetc/char-class callbacks from the 0x003007A8 block) and runs strtod on the input to store the converted double.

functions.name: Ui_Text_MeasureLineBreak
functions.signature: int Ui_Text_MeasureLineBreak(const u16* text, int start, int* outBreak)
functions.summary: Thumb text-layout helper: asks the metrics routine 0x00300710 how much of the UTF-16 run starting at <start> fits, reports start+consumed as the break position, and re-measures once when the measurement consumed the run but rejected it, so the caller always gets a break that fits.

functions.name: Actor_MoveToPointAndPlaySe
functions.summary: Moves a field actor toward a target point: plays SE 0xFD once (latched by f_40), computes the XY offset to the target position from the model node, interpolates the actor's f_38/f_3C and, once within the 1.0 distance threshold, applies the position and starts the arrival animation.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_CreateStateAction
functions.summary: Action-table entry constructor: runs Actor_Action_InitDescriptor, installs vtable 0x00762850, copies the two default words from 0x007BE2D4 and 0x007AE734 and sets the two state ids 1 and 2 at +0xD/+0x10.

functions.name: Field_Action_Base_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the base field-action class - the one whose start step only copies the actor transform (0x0030069C) and whose end step moves the actor to a point and plays a sound (0x003007BC).

functions.name: Field_Action_StartCheckAny
functions.summary: Starts the 'CheckAny' field action: resets the actor's interaction state and begins the named animation on the actor node.

functions.name: Field_Action_FinishIfDone
functions.summary: Finishes the current field action when the actor reports that the animation/action has completed.

functions.name: Field_Action_CheckAny_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the field-action class that waits until any of its child checks succeeds: calls the shared Action_CtorBase and installs vtable 0x00762884. That vtable's start slot is Field_Action_StartCheckAny, its update slot is 0x003E49F0 and its finish slot is Field_Action_FinishIfDone, so this is the missing constructor of the CheckAny action.

functions.name: Field_Action_CheckAny_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 'CheckAny' field action, whose start step is 0x003009D4 Field_Action_StartCheckAny and whose finish step is 0x00300A44 Field_Action_FinishIfDone.

functions.name: Field_Action_WalkStartToTarget
functions.summary: Starts walking toward another object (normally the player): plays the 'Walk' animation, saves the actor state, stores the target position, the normalised direction and the two travel distances used by the following frames.

functions.name: std_DoubleToFloat
functions.summary: Narrows a double to float with the C conversion semantics: returns HUGE_VALF/0 and sets ERANGE on overflow/underflow (checked against the exponent range of the unpacked double).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Action_WalkUpdate
functions.summary: Three-phase field movement action: phase 0 moves the actor at self+0x28 along the stored direction (self+0x40/+0x44/+0x48) while the travel budget self+0x3C lasts, then snaps it to the ground through Field_SpriteObject_CaptureOffset + Gfx_EffectPart_SetDirection and switches to phase 1; phase 1 waits 20 ticks, plays SE 0x104 and switches to phase 2; phase 2 keeps moving the actor along the offset at self+0x58.

functions.name: Field_Action_WalkEnd
functions.summary: End hook of the walk action: clears the shared interaction state (work+0x48), resets the overlay element animation, requests actor state 4, flushes the actor (vtable+0x88) and restores the saved state dword (actor+0x138 = action+0x68).

functions.name: Field_Action_Walk_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the walk field action: runs Action_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x007628B8 and initialises the two 3-float move vectors (rodata 0x007E7000 and 0x007E7030), the state byte f_B = 0 and the scale/step words +0x68/+0x6C. Its vtable holds Field_Action_WalkStartToTarget (start), maybe_Field_Action_WalkUpdate and maybe_Field_Action_WalkEnd.

functions.name: Field_Action_Walk_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the walk action (start 0x00300AAC WalkStartToTarget, update 0x00300E40 WalkUpdate, end 0x003012A4 WalkEnd).

functions.name: Field_Action_MoveCollide
functions.summary: Moves the actor with collision: builds a rotation from the camera-relative input direction, adds velocity to the actor node and pushes it out of the hit normal when it runs into geometry.

functions.name: Anim_SetBeeJumpParams
functions.summary: Creates an animation object and parses the parameter string "Bee_Jump" into four values stored on the object.

functions.name: Field_Action_Move_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the collision-aware move action (start 0x001E1248 InitDirection, cancel 0x001E1534, per-frame 0x003013B8 MoveCollide).

functions.name: Field_Action_StepBegin
functions.summary: Start hook of the field step action: calls Field_Actor_BeginStep (turns the movement visuals on and records the facing), invalidates the current step SE id (f_80 = 0xFFFF) and releases the previous voice handle f_74 so Field_Action_PlayStepSound starts a fresh footstep.

functions.name: Field_Action_PlayStepSound
functions.summary: Footstep sound: picks SE 0x97 or 0x98 depending on the surface flag, starts it with a randomised pitch and keeps re-triggering it while the actor moves.

functions.name: Field_Action_StepEnd
functions.summary: End hook of the field step action: ends the actor behaviour (turning the movement visuals off) and releases the footstep voice handle f_74.

functions.name: Field_Action_Step_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the field footstep action: runs the walk-task base constructor, installs the walk-task vtable, loads the motion-name pairs for records 1 and 4, then installs g_fieldActionStepVtable and initialises the step state (+0x74..+0x80) with the -1 sentinel at +0x80.

functions.name: Field_Action_Step_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the footstep action (play/stop footstep sound, stop the move).

functions.name: Field_Action_StepBehaviour_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the walking-behaviour action (start 0x001E1634 BeginStep, update 0x001E18F4, end 0x001E1A7C EndBehaviour); it also owns the direction helpers 0x001E18C8/0x001E189C/0x001E16D4/0x001E181C.

functions.name: Field_Action_SelectDirAnim
functions.summary: Chooses one of the eight directional idle/walk animations from the actor's facing angle and starts it.

functions.name: Field_Action_MoveDir
functions.summary: The directional movement action: it selects the eight-way facing animation, scales the camera-relative direction and applies collision-corrected movement.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_StopAndHide
functions.summary: When the owner actor has f_234 set, it triggers the field-2D visual update with flag 0 and resets f_234->f_B8->f_FC; the same tail appears at 0x00227BFC and in the second half of 0x002C0E54.

functions.name: Field_Action_MoveDir_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the direction-driven move action: runs Action_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x007629B0 and sets the mode byte f_B = 0xFF (meaning 'no direction chosen yet'). The vtable's start slot is Field_Action_SelectDirAnim and its update slot is the confident Field_Action_MoveDir.

functions.name: Field_Action_MoveDir_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the directional-movement action (0x00301AB4 SelectDirAnim, 0x00301B4C MoveDir, 0x00301D8C StopEffect).

functions.name: Field_Action_Nut_Ctor
functions.summary: Tiny action constructor: base-constructs through the shared action ctor 0x001BAB48 and installs vtable 0x007629E4, the Field_Action_Nut vtable.

functions.name: Field_Action_Nut_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 'Nut' field action: runs the shared action destructor 0x00193E44 and frees the block. The action itself starts with maybe_Field_Action_StartNut and updates through maybe_Field_Action_UpdateNutState.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor in actor action vtable 0x00762A1C slot 0: calls shared destructor func_00193E44 and frees object with func_0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_Action_AttachNamedEffect
functions.summary: Attaches an effect to the action's actor: when a mode byte (work+8->+0x48 +0x281) is set, reads that mode's effect name from its data record into a 15-char string and passes it to the actor (vtable +0x84); then creates effect instance f_2C (Effect_FindOrCreateInstance) and attaches it.

functions.name: Field_Action_AttachNamedEffect_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame step of the 'attach named effect' field action: releases the actor's effect slots (0x005F747C with 1 = drop the override) and then re-evaluates the actor through its vtable+0x88.

functions.name: Field_Action_AttachNamedEffect_Ctor
functions.summary: Tiny action constructor: runs Action_CtorBase, installs g_fieldActionAttachNamedEffectVtable and stores action id 0x4A0.

functions.name: Field_Action_AttachNamedEffect_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the effect action (0x00301E58 AttachNamedEffect, 0x00301F4C ResetActor).

functions.name: Field_Action_OpenDoor
functions.summary: Door-open action: pushes the player away from the door if he stands inside the door's footprint, then plays the 'OpenDoor' animation on the door node.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Action_FinishIfDoneEx
functions.summary: When the owner actor reports its motion finished (0x00669DD4), switches it back to the attract/idle animation (selection 0). Byte-identical to 0x00300A44, hence the Ex suffix.

functions.name: Field_Action_OpenDoor_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the open-door field action: calls Action_CtorBase and installs vtable 0x00762A84, whose start slot is Field_Action_OpenDoor and whose finish slot is maybe_Field_Action_FinishIfDoneEx.

functions.name: Field_Action_OpenDoor_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the door-opening action (0x00301FB8 OpenDoor, 0x00302184 FinishIfDoneEx).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Action_TrackCamera
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Action_TrackCamera(u32* action, const void* outVector)
functions.summary: Fills a 3-float out vector from action+0x2C/+0x30/+0x34 and, when the camera object at work+0x74+0x30 exists, replaces it with that camera's +0x140/+0x144/+0x148 (the same camera transform triple referenced by 0x001BA8D0).

functions.name: Field_Action_MoveInput
functions.summary: Applies the analogue-stick direction to the actor as velocity: reads the move/look sticks, applies the dead zone and speed*dt scaling, adds the result to the actor's velocity and finishes the action update.

functions.name: Field_CreateActionHorseInput
functions.summary: Constructor of the mounted-steering field action: base-constructs the object, installs g_fieldActionHorseInputVtable (0x00762AB8) and zeroes the default parameter words.

functions.name: Field_Action_HorseInput_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the mounted-movement action that turns stick input into horse velocity: runs the shared action destructor and frees the block. Its vtable slots are maybe_Field_Action_InitHorseParams (start), 0x00303DDC, Field_Action_MoveInput (update) and Field_ActorAction_UpdateTurnDirection.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Action_ToggleRun
functions.summary: Toggles the field action's run state: initialises horse parameters, loads five preset floats into self+0x3C..+0x4C, compares actor f_278/f_27C against the preset and either runs func_003027C0 or calls Field_Action_SetRunState, then swaps the two actor speed presets.

functions.name: Field_Action_SetRunState
functions.summary: Switches the actor's locomotion state: when running it enables the run step sound and stops the current walk action; when walking it disables the run sound and creates the small footstep effect (effect id 0x4F1) anchored at f_50, keeping its handle in f_58.

functions.name: Field_Action_Run_CheckCanContinue
functions.summary: Continuation test of the run action: returns -1 while the actor must keep moving, 3 when it may still run, and 1 when the run should end (both move bits clear, or no input while no auto-move distance is left).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Action_CreateWalkEffect
functions.summary: Builds an effect descriptor from g_003028A8..g_003028BC and creates the instance at world+0x60, storing it in self+0x58.

functions.name: Field_Action_UpdateMove
functions.summary: Per-frame movement update of the field action: reads the analogue stick with the dead zone, integrates the delta, applies the move, and on a blocked move switches the action to the blocked state (or plays the bump reaction).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Action_StopMoveEffect
functions.summary: Stops the in-flight movement effect and clears the run flag, restoring the actor's animation speed unless the caller asked to keep it.

functions.name: Field_CreateActionRun
functions.summary: Constructor of the running field action: installs g_fieldActionRunVtable (0x00762AFC), zeroes the default words and seeds the run parameters at +0x50..+0x5C.

functions.name: Field_Action_Run_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the run/move action: stores the class vtable into the embedded sub-object at +0x50 (0x001CF7F8), then runs the shared action destructor and frees the block. The real entry point is the 4-byte thunk at 0x00302C8C, which loads the vtable and falls through here.

functions.name: Field_Action_HorseStart
functions.summary: Starts horse riding: resolves the mount's rotation, converts it into the rider's yaw/pitch, applies the orientation, clamps the run speed and starts the run animation/UI mode.

functions.name: Field_Action_HorseJump
functions.summary: Horse jump: switches to state 1, plays the 'Horse_Jump' animation and starts the vertical velocity.

functions.name: Field_Action_HorseLand
functions.summary: Horse landing: switches to state 2, plays the 'Horse_Land' animation, releases the run mode and restores the ground flag.

functions.name: Field_Action_HorseUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame horse movement: integrates the horse velocity in the rider's frame, applies gravity while airborne, and switches to the landing state when the horse touches the ground or runs into an obstacle.

functions.name: Field_Action_HorseStart_End
