functions.summary: Second text step: ticks the widget at self+0x34D8 and, when it has finished, hides the shared text block at (work+0x24A98) on confirm and requests step 0x11 or 0x10 depending on the root check 0x00383A80, or step 0x0C on cancel.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveFormEx_Ctor
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_DiveFormEx_Ctor(void* self, u32 record, u32 argument)
functions.summary: Constructor variant of the dive-form hierarchy: runs the base Ui_DiveForm_Ctor, overwrites the vtable, initialises the member pair through Ui_Object_InitMemberPair and constructs a 0x18-stride x 0x14 state array.

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor: installs the class vtable, runs the base-window destructor at 0x3BE544 and tail-calls operator delete (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: Field_FindObjectByPrefix
functions.summary: Searches the object list for an entry whose name starts with the 5-byte key stored in the object table and returns 1 on the first hit.

functions.name: maybe_Field_RunwayEnv_Init
functions.signature: int maybe_Field_RunwayEnv_Init(int self, unsigned int map)
functions.summary: Initializes runway/astron environment for a field map; registers resulting scene objects.

functions.name: maybe_Field_RunwayEnv_Update
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_RunwayEnv_Update(int self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of runway/astron environment; iterates scene objects and updates transform arrays.

functions.name: Container_FindEntryByKey
functions.summary: Binary-style search over the container's 0xC-byte entries: halves the range, walks from the middle downwards and returns the first entry accepted by the key matcher.

functions.name: Container_FindEntryByKeyAlt
functions.summary: Searches the container's 0xC-stride entry array backwards for the first entry whose handle resolves and whose value for key is non-zero, returning that value (0 when none matches).

functions.name: Field_RunwayEnv_CreateParts
functions.signature: void Field_RunwayEnv_CreateParts(int self, unsigned int map)
functions.summary: Creates the runway environment pieces for the current mode: binds astron_env01/astron_env02 and instantiates the numbered runway objects, including the _MT (moving) variants.

functions.name: maybe_Model_LoadVariant
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Model_LoadVariant(UiModelSlot* self, u32 key, u32 variant)
functions.summary: Loads a model variant: builds the name from the type byte at self+0xB (0x10 selects self+0xA) and the slot data at self+8, looks up the model, computes the frame size from self+0x20..+0x24 and assigns the loaded handle to self+0x20.

functions.name: Fs_ResourceSet_InitFromRecord
functions.signature: u32 Fs_ResourceSet_InitFromRecord(FsResourceSet* self, int* nameTables, u16* record)
functions.summary: Fills a resource-set object from a data record: copies the record header, loads the primary and secondary resource by name into pack handles, appends up to four numbered sub-resources, plays the record's sound id and copies the flags/extra words.

functions.name: Effect_Instance_ReleaseResources
functions.summary: Releases an effect/attachment slot's active resources: stops sound voice self->u16_AC via Sound_StopVoiceBySeId (resetting it to 0xFFFF), destroys controller self->f_A8, returns render node self->f_1C to the FX manager (*0x007BE388), and releases all pack handles in self->f_64..f_68 via Pack_ReleaseHandleEntry.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowsB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_List_BuildRowsB(u32 self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Body is 2.2 KB of overlapping Thumb instructions; its callee set matches the 0x0030B120 resource loader (Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple, Pack_HandlePair_MoveAssign/Pack_ReleaseHandle), so it is not a list row builder.

functions.name: maybe_Container_LinkByName
functions.summary: Damaged container helper: visible code does a strlen and a 32-byte prefix compare against a key and walks intrusive lists at +0x7C, but the entry point begins mid-function.

functions.name: Container_DtorWithArrays
functions.summary: Destructor of a container that owns two arrays: installs its vtable, runs the class cleanup, releases every 8-byte entry (handle at +4) and destroys every 0xC-byte entry (Effect_List_DestroyAll + handle release), then drops the container's own reference.

functions.name: maybe_Field_HandleAcquire
functions.summary: Handle re-acquire helper: probes the handle table on f_2CC, re-acquires through 0x00360854 and stores the resulting class byte/handle in f_2D0.

functions.name: Field_HandleIsValid
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the handle is still present in the global handle table.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectPack_LoadById
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_EffectPack_LoadById(u32* handleSlot, u32 packKind, int effectId)
functions.summary: Loads the effect pack that belongs to an effect table entry: looks the entry up, builds "effect/<name>.pack" from the name stored in the entry and swaps it into the given pack handle, releasing whatever handle was there before. Returns 1 on success, 0 when the id is invalid or the entry has no name.

functions.name: Gfx_BattleItemEffectPack_LoadById
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_BattleItemEffectPack_LoadById(u32* handleSlot, u32 packKind, int itemEffectId)
functions.summary: Same pattern as Gfx_EffectPack_LoadById but for battle-item effect packs: resolves the entry, builds "effect/bitem/<name>.pack" and swaps the loaded pack into the caller's handle. Called from the talk window when an item-use effect has to be shown.

functions.name: Gfx_SpellEffectPack_LoadById
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_SpellEffectPack_LoadById(u32* handleSlot, u32 packKind, int spellId)
functions.summary: Same pattern again, for spell effect packs: looks up the spell table entry, builds "effect/spell/<name>.pack" and swaps the loaded pack into the caller's handle. Used by the battle actor update and by the message system when a spell effect is requested.

functions.name: Field_HandleRelease
functions.summary: The handle-entry release: it frees the secondary class slot and unlinks the handle from the global table.

functions.name: Menu_IconModelLoadTask_Update
functions.summary: Step function of an asynchronous icon-model load job: in state 1 it polls the handle table 0x007BA2D0 and waits while the child object is below state 4, launches the load with Menu_IconModel_LoadBch, then finishes/releases on failure or moves to state 2/3.

functions.name: Menu_IconModel_LoadBch
functions.summary: Finishes loading the BCH model of a 3D menu icon: formats '<name>.bch' from the record's name buffer, resolves the resource handle, finds the matching model object in the resource's object list, attaches it and marks the record ready. Called from the shared icon updater once the pack has been loaded.

functions.name: Container_FindEntryByTagAndType
functions.summary: Hash-table lookup: uses key->f_10 as bucket selector, verifies the bucket tag, then walks the bucket's intrusive list and returns the first object whose virtual type id equals the wanted global type id.

functions.name: Menu_CombinationIcon_LoadPack
functions.summary: Loads the pack '3d/cs/combination/<name>.pack' for a combination icon, swaps the new pack handle into the icon record (releasing the previous one) and marks the record loaded.

functions.name: Menu_IconModel_Release
functions.summary: Releases a 3D menu-icon model: frees the model handle through the menu model manager (0x003603F0), frees the pack handle, and resets the record to the empty state (id 0xE, no model, not loaded). Called by every icon setter before assigning a new icon.

functions.name: Menu_ItemIcon_LoadPack
functions.signature: void Menu_ItemIcon_LoadPack(MenuIconModel* self, const IconDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Loads the pack '3d/cs/item/<name>.pack' for an item icon and installs it into the icon record, replacing the previous pack.

functions.name: Menu_SkillIcon_LoadPack
functions.signature: void Menu_SkillIcon_LoadPack(MenuIconModel* self, const IconDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Loads the pack '3d/cs/skill/<name>.pack' for a skill icon and installs it into the icon record, replacing the previous pack.

functions.name: Menu_IconModel_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 3D menu-icon record: installs the class vtable, runs the named Menu_IconModel_Release and releases the embedded pack handle at +0x10, returning the adjusted secondary-base pointer.

functions.name: Ui_ArrangeEightChildPanes
functions.summary: Copies the transforms of eight child sprites into a temporary rectangle and applies them to their picture panes, forces all eight visible (flag bit 0 of +0x44), and with a non-zero frame counter rotates the rectangle and applies the shared layout scale.

functions.name: Ui_RouletteWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds the roulette screen: starts/keeps the 'menu_roulette_caption' animation, binds the two slime panes slime0_0/slime0_1, generates and binds eight numbered panes at self+0x128, and binds the txt_in/txt_out and roulette_lw_txt_00 text panes.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RouletteWindow_ForwardFieldToVirtual24
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_RouletteWindow_ForwardFieldToVirtual24(WindowPart* part, AccessorFrame* frame, UiWindow* window)
functions.summary: Roulette window accessor helper; forwards frame value through window vtable slot +0x24 with part+0x98 and stores back result.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RouletteWindow_CreatePanels
functions.summary: Panel-creation helper of the roulette window: allocates through 0x001D8B6C, installs vtable 0x00762E54, creates the anim-ref list at +0x148 and two 0x003E0454 child pane holders, then clears their 2x4 and 8x4 arrays.

functions.name: Ui_PaneSet_Dtor_2C
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a two-pane UI object variant: destroys the panes at +0x4C/+0x9C and the 0x148 sub-object, then frees.

functions.name: Ui_DrawList_Append
functions.summary: Appends a child to the UI root's five-entry draw list: finds the first free slot by testing each 7-word slot with the comparator in g_0030d468 and, if one is free, stores the child plus its three position words and the two default depth words.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RouletteWindow_BuildReelEntry
functions.summary: Initialises 7-word roulette reel entry from source definition, copying IDs and limits at +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24 and writing constant 0xC35C0000.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RoulettePanelList_Construct
functions.summary: In-place constructor of the roulette/jackpot panel list: zero-fills 0x230 bytes (20 entries of 0x1C) with 0x00116AE0 and clears the trailing count word at +0x230, then returns self.

functions.name: Ui_ChildSlot_SetVisibleIndex
functions.signature: void Ui_ChildSlot_SetVisibleIndex(UiObject* self, int slot, int index)
functions.summary: Shows or hides one child slot of the UI root and points it at a table entry: sets the child's visible bit from `index > 0`, binds the icon/texture found at (index-1)/2 in the table at +0x2f00 and clears the 'no texture' bit.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWinWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds the casino win screen: releases the old menu_coinget pane, creates the poker/jackpot win sub-window (0x00406460) and binds the select, cursor, cursor_front, display, menu_txt and menu_casino_jackpot panes.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWinWindow_CreateWinRateAnim
functions.signature: void Ui_CasinoWinWindow_CreateWinRateAnim(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 layout, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates the roulette win-rate tip animation: finds the null_icon_cursor pane, allocates a child sprite from the roulette_tip_win_rate_anim layout, names it from the pane, places it at the pane transform and attaches it to the window's draw list.

functions.name: Ui_RouletteWindow_ResetPanels
functions.summary: Resets the roulette window's feedback: stops the animation at +0x30FC and clears the visible bit of all 113 child panes at +0x664.

functions.name: Ui_DrawList_CollectVisible
functions.summary: Rebuilds the root's draw list: walks all 113 child slots, appends every child whose visible bit is set to the draw list and, when there are more visible children than slots, renders them into the overflow list.

functions.name: Ui_CasinoWinWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Tears down the casino win screen: releases the cursor/front pane holder, destroys the 113 per-pane animation objects, virtual-deletes the layout object and releases the jackpot pane.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CasinoWinWindow_ForwardFieldToVirtual24
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_CasinoWinWindow_ForwardFieldToVirtual24(WindowPart* part, AccessorFrame* frame, UiWindow* window)
functions.summary: Casino win window accessor helper; forwards frame value through window vtable slot +0x24 with part+0x98 and updates frame value.

functions.name: Ui_RouletteWindow_BuildReels
functions.signature: void Ui_RouletteWindow_BuildReels(RouletteWindow* self, const void* desc, const u8* frameState)
functions.summary: Binds the 113 roulette panes: for each index it reads the pane name from the layout table, resolves the pane and its "<name>_anim" animation into +0x664/+0x828, then shows the frame colour selected by the caller (red/green/blue) and refreshes the two text panes.

functions.name: Ui_RouletteWindow_SetFrame
functions.summary: Shows one frame of the roulette result animation: advances the reel/tween state at self+0x3058 with Ui_SlotMachine_UpdateReelPositions and selects the frame bit mask 1<<frameIndex on the pane group at self+0x5A4.

functions.name: Ui_RouletteWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for the casino roulette window: allocates the object, installs vtable g_0030e0f8, constructs the container sub-object at +0x11C, the roulette select grid at +0x488 and a table of 113 (0x71) 0x58-byte bet cells at +0x284. The casino jackpot/roulette screen ctor calls it while assembling the roulette screen.

functions.name: Ui_RouletteWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the large roulette window: tears down the pane set, the 113-pane/animation arrays and the embedded list heads, then frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_KyoukaiWindow_CreatePartyPanes
functions.summary: Creates the five sub-windows of the "kyoukai" screen: `win_kyoukai_party` (part baseIndex), `win_kyoukai_2d3d` (+1), `win_bind_select` (+2), `win_gold` (+3, with the gold formatter 0x0061B7A4) and `win_kyoukai_select` (+4), linking each into the row list at self+0xD2C and finally disabling the group at self+0x158.

functions.name: Ui_Root_SetFlagBits
functions.signature: void Ui_Root_SetFlagBits(u32 arg1, u8 bits, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Sets bits in the UI root's per-frame flag byte at +0x2d390 (the same block that carries the other per-save state bytes).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_AdvanceTweenState
functions.summary: Maps message window state self->f_124 (0..4) to tween controller transition (2,0,3,1,3) on self->f_d8c and commits it.

functions.name: Ui_Root_ReleaseAll
functions.summary: Shuts the UI root down: destroys every child object, releases the two registered lists, hides the two manager panes through their vtable slot +0x18 and frees the root at +0x158.

functions.name: Ui_KyoukaiWindow_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the "kyoukai" screen (vtable slot 1 of the same class): it advances the gold formatter (0x0061B7A4) and the party animation (0x001964BC) when their flags are set, and pumps the 8-slot, 0x18-byte timer table at self+0xD8C with the 1/30 s step, firing the armed timer callback.

functions.name: Ui_Root_ReleaseWithCode
functions.summary: Release path that frees the root's children and then posts a result code before the object dies: code 0x2C when f_124 == 1, otherwise 0x0D.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ShowMainHideSub
functions.summary: Shows the window's main child list at +0xD1C and hides the secondary list at +0x1614; unlike its five siblings it does not reset the window or run a control code.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ConfirmAdvance
functions.summary: Message window input handler for confirm/advance during paging; marks page dirty (+0x12C), requests tween state 7, and refreshes input flag +0x130.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_SetCursorMode
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_SetCursorMode(MessageWindow* self, u32 handle, int mode)
functions.summary: Resolves an optional handle through the shared hash-bucket table (and releases the old object through its virtual +0x7C), then stores the cursor/selection mode: 0xFF means 'keep the previous mode', and a stored mode of 2 is promoted to 3 before it is written to +0x1943.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ResetAndRunCode2C
functions.summary: Shows the main child list at +0xD1C, hides the secondary list at +0x1614, resets the window through Ui_Root_ReleaseAll and then executes message control code 0x2C with parameter 0xFF.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ResetAndRunCode2B
functions.summary: Shows the main child list at +0xD1C, hides the secondary list at +0x1614, resets the window through Ui_Root_ReleaseAll and then executes message control code 0x2B with parameter 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ResetAndShowSub
functions.summary: Hides the main child list at +0xD1C, shows the secondary list at +0x1614 and resets the window through Ui_Root_ReleaseAll; the only one of the six that inverts the two flags.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ResetAndRunCode01
functions.summary: Shows the main child list at +0xD1C, hides the secondary list at +0x1614, resets the window through Ui_Root_ReleaseAll and then executes message control code 0x01 with parameter 0xFF.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ConfirmAdvanceAlt
functions.summary: Message window confirm/advance variant; marks page dirty (+0x12C), requests tween state 7, and updates input accept flag +0x130.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CancelAdvance
functions.summary: Message window cancel transition handler; leaves page dirty byte unchanged, requests tween state 6, and updates input accept flag +0x130.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_SelectSubWindowAndGoto
functions.summary: Forwards input event to sub-window at self+0x1388; maps selected sub-page index (0..8) to corresponding sub-window structure into self+0x192C and switches tween state to 5 or 6.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ApplySubWindowResult
functions.summary: Processes sub-window return code (1..6) from page object at +0x192C, mapping it to tween state and updating visible page and cursor mode.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AdvanceIfListNotEmpty
functions.summary: Message-window state handler: if the queue/list at +0xD38 is non-empty it requests tween state 4 (start scrolling the next message) and commits it; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ResetAndRebuild
functions.summary: Shows the main child list at +0xD1C, hides the secondary list at +0x1614, resets the window through Ui_Root_ReleaseAll and then rebuilds a pool-backed structure (0x0011FE8C allocation loop) instead of running a control code.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AdvanceIfListNotEmptyAlt
functions.summary: Second copy of the 'advance when the queue is non-empty' message-window handler (tween state 4), kept by the sibling message-window vtable/table.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode(UiMessageWindow* self, u8* code arg2, int moreFollows)
functions.summary: Executes one message control tag: looks the tag id (0..0x42) up in the window's tag table (0x28-byte rows, up to 8 parameter slots), resolves the referenced name id to a string, optionally fills the two sprintf buffers with the %u/%l arguments, then starts the text block with the tag's style/align/break flags and the selected parameter slot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListScreen_Ctor_vt762EF4
functions.summary: Constructor of a list-window-derived screen: runs Ui_ListWindow_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x762EF4, initialises the member pair at +0xD8C (vtable 0x75AC30 plus a back-pointer to the screen) and constructs its eight 0x18-byte child widgets with std_ConstructArray.

functions.name: Ui_BigScreen_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the large UI screen class: runs the class destructor at 0x0030FF0C and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_BigScreen_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a very large UI screen: restores the vtable, releases the 0x1934/0x193C members, destroys the embedded containers and finally the base drawable at -0xE78 (0x002CF644).

functions.name: maybe_Game_ResetWorkBlock
functions.summary: Lazily builds the 31-element game-work block (vtable 0x00764B84), then puts the sub-block at +0x24A98 back to its empty state: resets it wholesale with 0x00613528 when the marker at +0x2A1F4 is 1, then writes the 0xFF/0xFFFF sentinel records through 0x00612C2C and 0x00613354.

functions.name: Ui_ApplyFaceIconToWork
functions.summary: Applies a face-icon request to the game work: resolves the face record for self->f_14 and writes its face byte into work+0x5761, then resolves the character record and (in 3D mode) stores the jump-location id and the record's +0x10 byte into work-block slot 8.

functions.name: Ui_IconRequest_Update
functions.summary: State machine of an icon request: while not done/busy it dispatches on the record's kind byte (1..7) to start the matching icon path (case 2 applies the face icon through 0x003103A8, cases 3/7 raise event commands) and then marks the request busy.

functions.name: maybe_Text_LineFillChars
functions.summary: Fills count characters into a text line: initialises the line state (mode/colour/value), measures the line through the glyph helpers and appends each character, with the font-0x139 special case that emits space codes 0xCD/0xCE and refreshes the text root.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_CtorTail
functions.summary: False function entry: 0x00310900 is inside the constructor at 0x00310844 (no prologue, live r4-r8, falls through). The recovered 'Text_LineFillCharsEx' body is a misdecode; the enclosing constructor stores vtable 0x00762F54 and initialises a UI state object with a type byte (default 0x45), pointers at +0x8/+0xC/+0x10 and parameters at +0x18/+0x1C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DualWindow_Dtor_B
functions.summary: Second destructor of the same two-child window shape: releases the sub-objects at self[3] and self[4], clears both slots and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_TextScroll_IsFinished
functions.summary: Reports whether a text scroll/animation has finished: true only when the window has a scroll object and that object's state machine is in step 1.

functions.name: Ui_TextScroll_End
functions.signature: void Ui_TextScroll_End(u32* owner, u32 forwarded, u32 step)
functions.summary: Ends the current text scroll: finishes the scroll object and then either stops or leaves the text animation running depending on whether the step counter is below 0x1f.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GetSingletonAndClearBusy
functions.summary: Ensures the shared 0x98-byte context exists and clears its byte at +0x25 (the same field 0x002CEA08 and 0x002F6950 clear).

functions.name: Shop_GetMaxAffordableCount
functions.summary: Returns how many of an item the party can pay for: party gold (bag work+0x24A98 +0x28) divided by the item price (record +0x18), clamped to 9, or 0 for an unknown item.

functions.name: Shop_CanAffordItem
functions.signature: u32 Shop_CanAffordItem(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, int count)
functions.summary: Returns non-zero when the item exists and its price (record +0x18) does not exceed the party gold (bag work+0x24A98 +0x28); a negative count skips the check.

functions.name: Shop_GoldWouldExceedCap
functions.signature: u32 Shop_GoldWouldExceedCap(u32 unusedA, u32 itemId, int count)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when buying `count` of an item would push the party's gold past the 9,999,999 cap: looks the item row up, multiplies its price-like field (+0x1C) by count, adds the gold at bag+0x28 (work+0x24AC0) and compares with 0x0098967F. The first argument is not read (the lookup id arrives in r1).

functions.name: Shop_BuyItemForMember
functions.signature: int Shop_BuyItemForMember(u32* screen, int itemId, int count, u32 memberIndex, int equipSlot)
functions.summary: Buys count units of an item: multiplies the record price (+0x18) by count, subtracts it from the party gold through the ItemBag (work+0x24A98), then gives the item to a party member (index < 0x1F), equipping it in the requested slot when asked, or adds the remaining units to the bag.

functions.name: Shop_SellItem
functions.signature: u32 Shop_SellItem(u32* screen, int itemId, int count, int inventorySlot, int memberIndex)
functions.summary: Sell path: looks the item up, removes the units from a party member's inventory (memberIndex < 0x1F) or from the bag, and credits the party gold with record field +0x1C x count. Returns 1 on success, 0 when the item is unknown or the count is invalid.

functions.name: Ui_ActivateScreenMessageAndModel
functions.summary: Activates a screen's message window and model: sets the message window's active byte, binds the screen's 0x88 sub-object into the message page and re-binds the screen's model.

functions.name: Ui_ItemScreen_ShowItemInfo
functions.summary: Refreshes the item screen's detail pane for one item: resolves the item row, writes the item name into the label at owner+0x28+0x1DA0 and toggles the pane at owner+0x28+0x1C80 depending on whether the id falls in the equipment ranges 0xA4..0x9BF / 0xB19..0xB1C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemIcon_PlaceInLine
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ItemIcon_PlaceInLine(TextLine* line, u32 itemId, u32 column, int glyphSlot)
functions.summary: Places an inline item icon into a text line: when glyphSlot is negative it looks the item up and, if the id is equipment (0xA4..0x9BF or 0xB19..0xB1C), resolves its icon category with func_0066C724 and writes it into the line at column; otherwise it maps the equipment slot through the party member's record before writing.

functions.name: Ui_TextBuild_Start
functions.summary: Starts a multi-part text build: lays out part 0 and, when the record has more than 1/2 lines, parts 1 and 2 with their style ids; plays SE 0xE70 when part 3 begins and reports completion after 50 frames.

functions.name: maybe_Text_LayoutEmitStyleRuns
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Text_LayoutEmitStyleRuns(TextBuilder* self, TextRecord* rec, int part, int extraOffset)
functions.summary: Walks the text record's characters from the end and, for every run of three or more characters that share the same style byte (0x06 = inherit), emits the run as one glyph draw through 0x0044641C; returns 1 when anything was emitted. The `part` argument selects which byte of the 24-bit style word is compared.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextBuilder_SetStyleResource
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_TextBuilder_SetStyleResource(TextBuilder* self, u32 layout, int styleId, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Binds style/font resource: releases previous handle in table 0x007B4D68 with Ui_Object_DestroyChildren and stores new resource from maybe_Gfx_Effect_CreateByIdFromObject at +0x8C (or +0x90 for style 0x697).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_ReleaseHandles
functions.summary: Clears four state words (+0x04, +0x08, +0x28, +0x94) and releases the two tagged handles at +0x8C and +0x90 through the shared 0x007B4D68 handle table (22-bit index / 10-bit tag check), destroying each resolved object via 0x0017C51C.

functions.name: Ui_TextBuilder_InitLayout
functions.signature: void Ui_TextBuilder_InitLayout(TextBuilder* self, u32 textObj, const u32* styleMask)
functions.summary: Initialises a text builder from a text object: resolves the font metrics and layout box, clamps the origin, selects the active part styles from a bit mask (or from the metrics for multi-style fonts) and computes the per-part baseline/height entries (up to four 0x18-byte descriptors at +0x30).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextBuilder_StepLayout
functions.summary: Per-frame driver of a timed text/effect layout: interpolates the text origin over a 0x10-frame window, at frame 0 binds the style resource and plays the part sound, at frames 5 and 15 spawns effects 0x69E/0x69F (or plays sounds 0xECC/0xEEA) depending on each part's position, and updates each of the four parts' 0x18-byte entry at self+0x18*i.

functions.name: maybe_Game_EnsureWorkBlock

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_DeletingDtorE
functions.summary: Deleting destructor in the 0x31Axxx actor/sprite-actor block: installs the vtable plus its +0x98 secondary, unlinks the object's embedded base node at +0x24C, runs Field_Object_DtorBase and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field2D_TestAreaPassable
functions.signature: u32 Field2D_TestAreaPassable(void* self, const int* point)
functions.summary: Tests a 2x2 sample of map cells starting at point+self offsets with Map_IsCellPassable; if all four are passable it asks Field_QueryOccludersInBoxLayer whether the box is clear and returns 1 for a clear area, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Gfx_Actor_ApplyModelSize
functions.summary: Applies the actor's configured model size and/or scale to its scene object; mode picks which of the two values to push (0 resets nothing, 1 pushes size, 2/3 push scale).

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_SetPosAndScale
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteActor_SetPosAndScale(SpriteActor* self, const float* pos, u32 scale)
functions.summary: Moves the sprite node to pos (x,y) and applies scale when the actor has a live scene node.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_SetModelAndPos
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteActor_SetModelAndPos(SpriteActor* self, const void* params, u32 modelId, u32 variant)
functions.summary: Applies the sprite model selected by (modelId, variant) to a 2D actor: creates the table entry, stores its anim id and the ids on the scene node, applies the priority byte, sets the model size from the locator param block and starts the idle animation.

functions.name: Gfx_Actor_BindModelHandle
functions.summary: Resolves the model handle stored in f_14 through the global handle table and caches the pointed object plus its derived values (object+0x78/+0x7C, position ptr +0x20, a byte from object[0x2E]+0x128, and object[0x75]) into the actor.

functions.name: Gfx_Actor_ApplyAppearance
functions.summary: The actor appearance applier: it stores the model id/variant and hides the default model when the actor is in a special mode.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Actor_ApplyAppearanceB
functions.summary: Probably the post-model-change appearance variant, but the body only proves a visibility/release path on f_14 and the +0xB8 sub-object.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_ShowForModelSet
functions.summary: The model-set show path: it validates the model-set index and, outside the four menu modes, enables model visibility and re-applies the scale.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_HideForModelSet
functions.summary: The model-set hide mirror: it is byte-identical to 0x31B328 except that the visibility call passes 0.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteAnimationBank_Create
functions.summary: Allocates a sprite-animation bank (64-byte rows out of a shared 50-slot pool), stamps it with a rotating slot id, initialises the clip table and returns it. One clip only, unlike 0x31CD88 which adds the TurnL/TurnR clips.

functions.name: Gfx_Actor_ReleaseModelHandle
functions.summary: Releases the actor's entry from the global handle table (slot selected by f_1C & 0x3F is cleared to {0, 0x3FFFFFF}) and then frees the actor.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteActor_ApplyColourAnim
functions.summary: Applies a sprite actor's colour/animation state: pushes the stored colour when the +0x18 bit 0 is clear, otherwise resolves the animation id at +0x49, sets colour+alpha and falls back to the virtual update.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_ReleaseByClass
functions.summary: Walks the node's RTTI chain and releases it with the routine matching its base class (0x182AC4 for class 0x007C4D9C, 0x232248 for 0x007C4E50).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteActor_ReleaseChildResource
functions.summary: When the object at +0x20 has a child at +0x160 whose virtual +0xC reports busy, releases the child's handle at +0x11C through 0x0030AC50, which itself tail-calls 0x00562FD0 with the child's +0xA8 value.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Actor_ApplyMotion
functions.summary: Commits the actor's stored motion to its scene object according to a mode: mode 0/1 copy position and direction (0 also notifies the effect owner), mode 2 copies and hands the offset target to the sprite mover, mode 3 normalises the direction, builds the rotation from the scene facing and moves the sprite toward the rotated point.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_ReleaseByClassB
functions.summary: Second class-dispatch releaser: walks the node's RTTI chain and calls 0x183918 or 0x235378 for the matching base class (0x007C4D9C / 0x007C4E50).

functions.name: Field_Actor_SetWorldPosition
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_SetWorldPosition(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 flags, float* pos)
functions.summary: Writes a new x/y/z world position into the actor's transform (+0x9C/+0xA0/+0xA4), marks the transform dirty (+0x118 = 1) and notifies the owner through func_005F5F54; if the actor's parent object still resolves through vtable slot +0xC, the attached sub-object at index 0x47 is refreshed as well.

functions.name: Gfx_Actor_BindTransformFromHandle
functions.summary: Resolves the handle in f_14 and copies the source object's position/rotation (f_9C/f_A0/f_A4), composes the world transform (0x669D88), and caches size/scale fields (f_138/f_13C) plus two bytes from the model slot at f_160.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Actor_FinishMotion
functions.summary: Finishes the actor's current motion: takes a handle-table release, applies the final transform (scene +0x21C, +0x138/+0x13C), copies the stored rotation, toggles the scene flag +0x160->f_599 from +0x48, re-finalises the actor (0x005F5DA8), clears the motion handle and returns 1 when a motion was active.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_UpdateMotion
functions.summary: Per-frame movement integrator for a sprite actor: advances the node along its stored direction with damping, recomputes the normalised direction when it changes, stops at the target distance and derives the alpha/offset from the view direction.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_MoveTowardPoint
functions.summary: Turns a sprite actor toward a target point and advances it, choosing between two rotation states depending on whether the target is in front of or behind the current facing.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteAnimationBank_CreateWithTurns
functions.summary: Same pool-backed animation bank as 0x31B4F0 but pre-populates five extra clip slots, including the named clips "TurnL" and "TurnR", and the follow-up idle clips.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Actor_ReleaseHandleSlot
functions.summary: Releases an entry in global handle table 0x007B7F28 for slot index self+7, unlocks table, and deallocates self.

functions.name: Item_ClassifyDualEquipCategory
functions.summary: Classifies a pair of equipped weapons (1H sword, dagger, wand, etc.) into dual-wielding animation and stat categories.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_SlotParams_Reset
functions.summary: Zeroes u16 fields (+0x00..+0x16), byte flags (+0x52..+0x57), and clears 0x38-byte buffer at +0x1A via memset.

functions.name: Battle_PushActorMessage1
functions.summary: Pushes battle message id 1 for the actor returned by vtable+0x48, then calls actor vtable+0xEC.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetColumnCount
functions.summary: Recomputes how many text columns the message window uses: 1 normally, doubled when the selected font record advertises the wide/vertical flag, and tripled when the text contains the icon glyph 0xa0.

functions.name: FieldParty_DispatchEvent
functions.summary: Generic FieldParty event dispatch: always calls vtable+0x3C, then routes event id 0 to vtable+0x138 and any other id to vtable+0x13C.

functions.name: maybe_Party_UpdateMemberConditionFlag
functions.summary: Group-wide flag update: clears self+0xC91, then walks the members through vtable +0x60 (and +0x10C for the fallback) and sets +0xC91 to 1 as soon as one member reports a non-zero byte at member+0x10.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_UpdateSlotEffects
functions.summary: Iterates member slots (stride 0x60, offset +0x1740) up to count at +0x3240 and invokes per-slot function 0x001FA9D4.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AppendLinesWrapped
functions.summary: Appends one more text line to the message window from the current message record, with automatic wrapping enabled, then finishes the line (control byte, colour and font application) and pushes it to the pane list.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AppendLinesUnwrapped
functions.summary: Same as 0x31D6DC but adds the line without auto-wrap (flag 0 in 0x486208), i.e. a line that must fit as-is.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AppendLinesMulti
functions.summary: Appends several message lines in one go (one per list entry, walking the candidate list backwards) and tracks the running choice index used for the selected-option highlight.

functions.name: FieldParty_IsFlag2Set
functions.summary: Returns 1 when bit1 of the party state word (f_72C) is set, else 0.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AppendLinesFromList
functions.summary: Appends lines for every entry of the current list up to the list length, using the single-style builder 0x497520 and the wrap flag from the window, then rebuilds the pane list.

functions.name: FieldParty_IsFlag1Set
functions.summary: Returns bit0 of the party state word (f_72C).

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_UpdateSlotEffectsAlt
functions.summary: Iterates member slots (stride 0x60, offset +0x1740) up to count at +0x3240 and invokes per-slot function 0x001FD2CC.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_CtorWithTextCache
functions.summary: Shared base constructor for a family of large UI screens: runs Ui_Screen_CtorBase, installs base vtable g_0031efcc, clears the flag byte at g_0031efd0, initialises a text-line cache at +0x498 (twice-nested sub-object) and constructs 72 (0x48) 0x60-byte layout entries at +0x48. Concrete screens call it and immediately overwrite the vtable with their own.

functions.name: FieldParty_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the FieldParty-derived class: installs the given vtable, runs the party base destructor 0x00200220 (lists at +0x04/+0x08, 0x20 x 0x7C member array at +0x148) and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextFade_Update
functions.summary: Fade/scroll animation step for a text element: runs a small 0..4 state machine (0x0031F214 for the transitions), interpolates the element's alpha (f_78) towards the target and accumulates the phase; states 4/reset restore the initial values.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_StartSubTween
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Widget_StartSubTween(UiWidget* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 tween)
functions.summary: Activates embedded tween controller at self+0x100 (sets active=1, phase=0) and triggers tween helper 0x0031F214.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_StartTween
functions.summary: Starts the widget's own fade tween: sets active=1 at +0x19, phase 0 at +0x1B and calls 0x31F214 with the curve argument.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_StopSubTween
functions.summary: Deactivates embedded tween controller at self+0x100 (sets active=0, phase=0xFF, target=0xFF) and updates via 0x0031F214.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a small object that owns one smart handle: installs its vtable, releases the handle at +0x10 (with the handle-table validity test), unlinks the node and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_HandleIdle
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_HandleIdle(BattleSequence* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: One step of the battle action-sequence state machine: when the sequence reaches idle state 0x1615 it notifies the battle context, clears/applies the finished-sequence effects and returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ReapplyScaleKeepingRow
functions.summary: Re-applies the screen scale while preserving the selected row: clears the row index at +0xDE10 to -1, saves the current row through virtual +0x140, calls Ui_ApplyScaleToChildren and restores the row through virtual +0x144.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_SubObjectDtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a FieldParty sub-object: installs the base vtable g_fieldPartyVtable, destroys the sixteen 0x58-byte entries at +0xB464 with std_destroy_range, runs the base destructor 0x00200220 and frees the object.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_StepUpdate
functions.summary: Frame update of one battle action step: runs the state machine 0xE7D/0xE92/0xE9B/0xEA1/0xEA7/0xEB7, plays SE/popup 0x62, sets the effect direction, resolves the action row through Game_GetDataManager and returns 1 once the +0xD2 done flag is set.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CtorB
functions.summary: Constructor of the second 2D variant of the field object class: runs the base constructor, installs vtable 0x007634AC and initialises the same three trailing words (-1, 0, 0xFFFFFC00).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionObject_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the action-sequence object: installs the vtable, releases the packed handle at +0x125C through Pack_Handle_Dtor, runs the shared base destructor 0x00200220 and frees the object. Its non-deleting twin is 0x0031F9F0.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionObject_Dtor
functions.summary: In-place destructor companion of 0x0031F9C4: installs the vtable, releases the packed handle at +0x125C and runs the base destructor 0x00200220, without freeing the memory.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_InitStep
functions.summary: Action-sequence step at state 0xD06: spawns the leader effect, then for a normal action spawns the model-actor popup from action record self[0x48C]+0x160 or posts message 0x4E6, sets the effect direction and finally waits for actor idle.

functions.name: FieldParty_DeletingDestructorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for a FieldParty variant: runs the party destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_WaitStep
functions.summary: Action-sequence step at state 0xAB4: if the sequence is still valid it pushes the message id from data row 0x76 for the actor, then waits for the actor queue and advances to 0xAC3.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_DeletingDestructorB
functions.summary: Second FieldParty deleting destructor: runs the party base destructor 0x00200220 and frees the object; same teardown as 0x0031FC40, used by the message-window derived variant.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_ShowActionResults
functions.summary: Battle action-sequence playback phase (states 0x175D-0x17A6): waits until every actor is idle, queues actor name changes, plays step sounds and number popups for the resolved action list, and advances the turn when the pending-action counter is used up.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_AdvanceAction
functions.summary: Action-list advance phase (state 0x17DC): once the current actor is idle it dispatches the actor's next queued action and clears its slots; when the per-actor counter reaches the pending-action count it calls AdvanceTurn and sets the +0xDE46 done flag.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchStepMessage
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchStepMessage(BattleSequence* self, u32 first, u32 last)
functions.summary: Builds the action message for entries first..last: walks the 0x68-byte action entries at self+0xBAB0, copies the action record into a stack buffer, accumulates the message words, and dispatches the accumulated message through vtable +0xF4; if the result is not suppressed it also plays the action's SE from record+0x2CE.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_AnnounceAction
functions.summary: Announces the currently acting unit's action: unless the unit is a special case it spawns a battle popup entry (Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForActorPair) with the action id and target; otherwise it pushes the member action message from the unit record's +0x2AA. Both branches return the battle UI block at world+0x5C+0x4238.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_CheckFinish
functions.summary: Finish check for the phase set 0x17BD/0x17C1/0x17CC: runs the same dispatch/clear/advance loop as AdvanceActor and returns 1 once the actor queue is drained, setting the +0xDE46 done flag; returns 0 while the actors are still busy.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_ExecuteRound
functions.summary: Executes one action round: builds the ordered target list, applies each action, plays the acting unit's sound/animation, refreshes the HUD and advances the participant cursor until the done flag at +0xDE46 is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateGlyphStyle
functions.summary: Picks the glyph/icon style for the current message line (character record +0xC0 then font record +0xA8), stores it in the per-window short table at g_00321000+self and rebuilds the affected glyph runs (0x004297E4/0x00429BD8/0x00429BB0, 0x004A7CAC).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchAction
functions.summary: Dispatches the current unit's action to the handler for its action category byte (0..7 at self[0x498]+0x293): normal attack, skill, item, defend, etc., building the action text and advancing the action index at self+0x377C.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateTurn
functions.summary: Per-turn body of the battle action sequence: runs the turn state machine (0x1688/0x1697/0x16A6/0x16DE...), waits for units to be ready, advances the party/member cursor and action text, and moves to the next turn state; returns 1 once the finished byte +0xD2 is set.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchCommand
functions.signature: u32 Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchCommand(BattleSequence* self, u32 arg2, int actionTable)
functions.summary: Dispatches a battle command by its command character ('7','8','9',':',';','=','>','C','D') to the corresponding action handler, with a wait state between the command and the effect. This is the command interpreter of the battle sequence.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_ReapplyLayout
functions.summary: Clears the selected row (+0xDE10) and the word at +0xDE18, re-applies the screen scale with Ui_ApplyScaleToChildren, then re-reads the active child's record id and rebuilds the resource dependency tree when that record is valid.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_ShowCommandResults
functions.summary: Playback phase for the '>' command block (state base 0x18D0): queues actor names, plays sounds and number popups and advances the turn when the action counter is done.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the 0xDF68-byte action-sequence controller derived from FieldParty_Ctor (0x003CAE00), installing vtable 0x00763830 (destructor Battle_ActionSequence_Dtor, update slots 0x003212C8/0x003212D4) and initialising +0xDE10..+0xDF64.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the battle action-sequence object: installs vtable 0x00763834, destroys the two eight-entry 0x1C-byte unit arrays (the two ends of the turn order) and the sixteen 0x58-byte entries, then runs the base destructor 0x00200220 and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_DetachActor
functions.summary: Validates actor handle self->f_28 via 0x00669DD4 and invokes actor stop routine 0x005E7848(handle, 0).

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateD
functions.summary: Creates sub-object D of the battle action window: family base ctor plus its own vtable.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_DeletingDestructorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant A for BattleAction subclass; executes base teardown 0x00322D14 and frees memory.

functions.name: Battle_Action_CalcTargetOffsetPosition
functions.summary: Computes where the action's actor must move to: reads the actor's model offset record (func_0063E5C8 on the actor's record id at +0x274), rotates that offset by the actor's orientation quaternion (+0x8C..+0x98) and adds it to the actor's world position, storing the current position into +0x34/+0x38/+0x3C and the computed goal into +0x40/+0x44/+0x48; it then resets the progress scalar and registers a completion callback through vtable slot +0x84.

functions.name: Battle_Action_UpdateTargetInterpolation
functions.signature: void Battle_Action_UpdateTargetInterpolation(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Per-frame update that moves the actor from the stored start position (+0x34/+0x38/+0x3C) toward the computed target (+0x40/+0x48) by advancing the progress scalar +0x30 with the record's step duration, writing the interpolated x/y/z back to the actor and marking its transform dirty; a sound is triggered once when the move starts.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateE
functions.summary: Creates sub-object E, the variant with a larger default data block: base ctor, vtable g_00322B9C and three vectors copied from 0x007E7000 into words 0xD..0x12.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_DeletingDestructorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant B for BattleAction subclass; executes base teardown 0x00322D14 and frees memory.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_DetachActorAlt
functions.summary: Validates actor handle self->f_28 and detaches actor via 0x005E7848; duplicate copy of 0x00322884 in vtable 0x007639F0.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_DeletingDestructorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant C for BattleAction subclass; executes base teardown 0x00322D14 and frees memory.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_ShowActor
functions.summary: Validates actor handle self->f_28 and invokes actor vtable slot +0x74 with arguments (1, 0) to make actor visible.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_CreateF
functions.summary: Creates sub-object F of the battle action window: family base ctor plus vtable g_00322CA8.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_DeletingDestructorD
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant D for BattleAction subclass; executes base teardown 0x00322D14 and frees memory.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSubObject_BaseCtor
functions.signature: void* Battle_ActionSubObject_BaseCtor(void* self, void* owner, u32 id, const char* tag, u32 kind)
functions.summary: Base constructor for battle action sequence sub-objects: delegates (self, owner, id, tag, kind, 4) to Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init, installs base vtable 0x00763A48, stores owner at self+0x28, and returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_DeletingDestructorBase
functions.summary: Base deleting destructor for BattleAction family; destroys member strings via 0x00193E44 and frees object via operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_BattleTargetWindow_ApplyRowParams
functions.summary: Refreshes the list window's row text and then applies one of the two parameter blocks at g_00322DCC+0x48 / +0x40 to the list through its +0x4C slot, choosing by the flag at self->f_468->f_108.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_Init
functions.signature: void Battle_Popup_Init(BattlePopup* self, ActionRecord* action, TargetRecord* target, u32 layout, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, PopupSource* source, void* list)
functions.summary: Initialises a battle popup (damage/heal text over the unit): sets up the embedded HP-gauge window, binds the two animation ids on the +0x264 component, copies the action/target values, selects the member and level text and registers both children in the window list.

functions.name: Ui_StatusWindow_SetCharacter
functions.signature: void Ui_StatusWindow_SetCharacter(StatusWindow* self, u32 memberSlot, PartyMember* character, u32 source)
functions.summary: Switches the character a status window shows: stores the slot and source, retargets the embedded HP gauge, resets the cached gauge values and writes the member's level text (record+0xE8 < 9) into the second column; with a null character it falls back to the slot's member record.

functions.name: Ui_WindowWithTweens_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for a window that owns animation/tween references: installs vtable g_00323234, builds the embedded Ui_Object base (vtable g_0032323c), fills the two identical animation-reference fields at +0x4C/+0x50, sets the style byte at +0x15 to 0xFF, and constructs a 4-element 0x50-byte tween/pane array at +0x50.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DtorWithTweens
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a window with five 0x50-byte tween members, one message/list child and an embedded 0x50-byte container that is zero-filled at the end.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DestructMembers
functions.summary: Member destructor for window-with-tweens; frees five 0x50-byte layout references, base UI object, array, and dynamic string at -0x14.

functions.name: BattleScene_ReleaseModelSlot
functions.signature: void BattleScene_ReleaseModelSlot(int scene, int slot, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Frees one battle-scene model slot: looks up the slot's entry count from the master-data table, destroys every 0xC0-byte model entry in the array, deletes the array with std_operator_delete_array and clears the slot pointer so the slot can be reused.

functions.name: BattleScene_ReleaseAllModelSlots
functions.signature: void BattleScene_ReleaseAllModelSlots(int scene, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Releases every battle-scene model slot at once by running the per-slot teardown for indices 0 through 3, destroying each 0xC0-byte model entry and deleting the slot arrays. Used when the battle scene is torn down or its models are rebuilt.

functions.name: BattleScene_IsModelSlotIdle
functions.signature: u32 BattleScene_IsModelSlotIdle(int scene, int slot, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Polls a battle-scene model slot and returns 1 when every model entry has finished its load/animation (or the slot is empty) and 0 as soon as one entry is still busy; the caller uses it as a wait condition before continuing a battle sequence.

functions.name: BattleScene_ModelSlotManager_Dtor
functions.signature: u32* BattleScene_ModelSlotManager_Dtor(u32* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Destructor for the battle-scene model-slot manager: installs the teardown vtable g_00323998, releases all four model slots (destroying each 0xC0-byte model entry and deleting the arrays) and returns the object pointer for destructor chaining.

functions.name: Ui_Message3DWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds a two-line 3D message window ("txt_meesage1/2", note the original typo) plus the 3D message icon.

functions.name: Ui_Message3DWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the 3D message window used by the battle scene: stores the class table, runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup3D_ReleaseActorAnim
functions.summary: Stops the 3D popup animation on the actor: uninstalls the popup's actor hook (actor vtable +0x84 with the local callback 0x00323B40) and, when the actor's playing flag f_272 is set, resets the effect, stops the animation and releases the attached effect slot.

functions.name: Ui_ListSubObject_CreateF
functions.summary: Constructs list/row sub-object variant F: runs Ui_ListSubObject_BaseCtor and installs vtable 0x00763B04, returning the object. The vtable sits next to the popup-3D deleting destructors (0x00323B70/0x00323BAC/0x00323C1C), which uses the same base ctor.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup3D_DeletingDestructorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant A for BattlePopup3D; destroys strings via 0x00193E44 and frees object via operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_ListSubObject_CreateG
functions.summary: Constructs list/row sub-object variant G: runs Ui_ListSubObject_BaseCtor and installs vtable 0x00763B38, returning the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup3D_DeletingDestructorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant B for BattlePopup3D; destroys strings via 0x00193E44 and frees object via operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup3D_ReleaseActorHook
functions.summary: Uninstalls popup update hook on actor self->f_28 via vtable+0x84 with tag 0x6E727554, and cleans up effect at f_160.

functions.name: Ui_ListSubObject_CreateH
functions.summary: Constructs list/row sub-object variant H: runs Ui_ListSubObject_BaseCtor and installs vtable 0x00763B6C, returning the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup3D_DeletingDestructorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant C for BattlePopup3D; destroys strings via 0x00193E44 and frees object via operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Popup_SetActor

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalScale
functions.summary: Evaluator slot 0 of the tween table: samples the curve with 0x00325BDC and multiplies the result by track->f_0 (output scale).

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalOffset
functions.summary: Evaluator slot 1 of the tween table: samples the curve and adds track->f_0 (output offset).

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalClampedMix
functions.summary: Clamped interpolation: samples the curve, and when the threshold track->f_18 is not above the sample it adds (signed-short track->f_4) * sample; always adds track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalOffsetAlt
functions.summary: Second additive evaluator slot: byte-identical to 0x00325A5C (sample + track->f_0), kept as a separate table entry.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalMode2
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_C == 2: uses the curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; the result is multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalMode2Only
functions.summary: Additive variant for mode byte f_C == 2: samples and adds track->f_0 only when the mode byte is 2, otherwise it returns track->f_0 unchanged.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeD1
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_D == 1: curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; result multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeD1Only
functions.summary: Additive variant for mode byte f_D == 1: sample + track->f_0 when the byte is 1, otherwise just track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC5
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_C == 5: curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; result multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC5Only
functions.summary: Additive variant for mode byte f_C == 5: sample + track->f_0 when the byte is 5, otherwise just track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC0
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_C == 0: curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; result multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC0Only
functions.summary: Additive variant for mode byte f_C == 0: sample + track->f_0 when the byte is 0, otherwise just track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC1
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_C == 1: curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; result multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC1Only
functions.summary: Additive variant for mode byte f_C == 1: sample + track->f_0 when the byte is 1, otherwise just track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC3
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_C == 3: curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; result multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC3Only
functions.summary: Additive variant for mode byte f_C == 3: sample + track->f_0 when the byte is 3, otherwise just track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC4
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_C == 4: curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; result multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC4Only
functions.summary: Additive variant for mode byte f_C == 4: sample + track->f_0 when the byte is 4, otherwise just track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC6
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_C == 6: curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; result multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC6Only
functions.summary: Additive variant for mode byte f_C == 6: sample + track->f_0 when the byte is 6, otherwise just track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC7
functions.summary: Evaluator for mode byte f_C == 7: curve sample when the mode matches, otherwise the linear evaluator 0x00325C78; result multiplied by track->f_0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Tween_EvalModeC7Only
functions.summary: Evaluator slot 12 from table 0x007286A0; checks track->f_c == 7 to conditionally sample curve via 0x00325BDC and return float in s0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Tween_EvalModeC8
functions.summary: Evaluator slot 13 from table 0x007286A0; branches on track->f_c == 8 between samplers 0x00325BDC and 0x00325C78 returning float in s0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC8Only
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: when the track's mode byte +0xC is 8 it returns sample(0x325BDC) + track->f_0, otherwise it returns track->f_0 unchanged, i.e. the parameter only animates for mode 8.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC9
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: mode byte +0xC == 9 selects sample(0x325BDC) x track->f_0, any other mode selects the second sampler (0x325C78) x track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC9Only
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: mode byte +0xC == 9 returns sample(0x325BDC) + track->f_0, any other mode returns track->f_0 alone (no fallback sampler).

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC10
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: mode byte +0xC == 10 selects sample(0x325BDC) x track->f_0, any other mode selects the second sampler (0x325C78) x track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC10Only
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: mode byte +0xC == 10 returns sample(0x325BDC) + track->f_0, any other mode returns track->f_0 alone.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalDefault
functions.summary: The generic parameter evaluator: sample(0x325BDC) + track->f_0, with no mode test at all. This is the behaviour every other slot falls back to.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalShortScaled
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: track->f_0 + sample(0x325BDC) x (float)(s16)track->f_4, i.e. the parameter is a 16-bit step count scaled by the sampled curve.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeD2
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: the second mode byte +0xD == 2 selects sample(0x325BDC) x track->f_0, any other value selects the second sampler (0x325C78) x track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalModeC9B
functions.summary: Second table slot with the mode-9 behaviour: mode byte +0xC == 9 selects sample(0x325BDC) x track->f_0, otherwise the second sampler (0x325C78) x track->f_0. Byte-identical to 0x326018.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalClearOffsetAndSample
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator that suppresses the record offset: it stores 0.0 into track->f_0 first, then returns sample(0x325BDC) + that now-zero offset, i.e. the raw sampled value.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalDefaultB
functions.summary: Second copy of the generic evaluator: sample(0x325BDC) + track->f_0, no mode test (same body as 0x3260E8).

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalIfFlagE
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator gated by the flag byte +0xE: when the flag is zero it returns track->f_0 unchanged, when it is non-zero it returns sample(0x325BDC) x track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalIfFlagF
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator gated by the flag byte +0xF: non-zero selects sample(0x325BDC) x track->f_0, zero selects the second sampler (0x325C78) x track->f_0.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalShortTimesConst
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: sample(0x325BDC) x 0.0263 x (float)(s16)track->f_4, with no offset added - the parameter is a 16-bit fraction of a fixed step.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalUnsignedScaled
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: track->f_0 + sample(0x325BDC) x 0.0263 x (float)(u8)track->f_10. Same shape as 0x326258 but reads the byte field and adds the record offset.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalRandomScale
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator with a randomised upper clamp: it computes sample1(0x325BDC) x (u32)track->f_14, draws sample2(0x325C78) and returns the smaller of the two, re-drawing once when the first draw came out below the scaled value.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Tween_EvalRandomStep
functions.summary: Tween evaluator: calls 0x00325BDC, draws rand()%100+1, and only when that value is <= the incoming float calls 0x00325C78(tween, value) and writes the random value back - a random-threshold interpolation step, not a time delta.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalStoreSampleToOffset
functions.summary: Parameter evaluator that caches its result: it samples 0x325BDC, writes the value back into track->f_0 and returns it, so later evaluators of the same record reuse it as the offset.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalDefaultC
functions.summary: Third copy of the generic evaluator: sample(0x325BDC) + track->f_0, no mode test (same body as 0x3260E8).

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalDefaultD
functions.summary: Fourth copy of the generic evaluator: sample(0x325BDC) + track->f_0. The symbol size (148) is wrong - the function is 24 bytes and the dispatcher 0x326428 starts right after its literal pool.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_EvalScaleE

functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: sample(0x325BDC) x track->f_0, no mode test and no offset - byte-identical to Ui_Tween_EvalScale 0x325A44. Eight table slots share this body, i.e. those parameter ids are all scaled by the record factor.

functions.summary: Parameter evaluator: sample(0x325BDC) x track->f_0, no mode test and no offset - byte-identical to Ui_Tween_EvalScale 0x325A44. Eight table slots share this body, i.e. those parameter ids are all scaled by the record factor.
