functions.name: Casino_Slot_StepReel
functions.signature: void Casino_Slot_StepReel(SlotMachine* self, u32 arg2, u32 frame)
functions.summary: Slot-machine reel step: clamps the reel index f_44 from the signed direction byte f_582 and advances the wheel through the shared step routine func_004C2C60(self->f_10, 1, frame, frame>>3), then bumps the frame counter f_600.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_StopReel
functions.signature: void Casino_Slot_StopReel(SlotMachine* self, u32 reel, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Stops one reel: maps the incoming reel number 5..10 to the internal index 5..0 (11 = special final reel, which copies the global win pattern into f_18/f_1C) and issues the shared step call func_004C2C60(...).

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_ProcessPatterns
functions.summary: Walks the 22 pattern lists, asks every node whether it should be removed (virtual +8) and destroys the matching nodes, then resets the window's frame range.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_UpdateReelTimer
functions.summary: Slot machine reel timer: increments frame counter at self+0x600; on multiples of 5, executes step sequence (cases 5..10 call func_004C2C60 with descending arg 5..0; case 0xB updates float pair from 0x0072ABF8).

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_AnimCallbackE
functions.signature: void Ui_SlotWindow_AnimCallbackE(UiSlotWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, unsigned int frame, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Slot window callback mirroring Ui_SlotWindow_AnimCallbackB but for the second reel: on sub-index 1 it either stops the reel (row 0xD) when rows exist or falls back to the idle animation.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_UpdateSubWidget
functions.summary: Slot-window refresh entry: forwards the tick at self+0x56C to the embedded widget at +0x588 (Ui_Widget_Update), then drives the payout state machine - resets the payout animation, requests state 0x10/0x11 depending on the +0x48 flag, notifies the widget at self->f_14 and restores the default float pair.

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeCached
functions.summary: Plays a sound effect with de-duplication: keeps the last SE id/handle per object, stops the previous handle when a different SE is requested, skips ids in the ignored range 0xE00..0xE62, and caches the new handle.

functions.name: Sound_PlaySeCachedB
functions.signature: void Sound_PlaySeCachedB(SlotWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Second cached-SE player used by the slot window (different channel/owner object), with the same 'play only if changed' logic.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_BuildPayoutSequence
functions.summary: Builds the whole payout result sequence of the slot machine: clears the pattern lists, debits the bet, then appends the chain of HUD/credit/jackpot/win animations (including the jackpot and coin-get popups) to the window's pending-action list.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_ResetPayoutAnim
functions.summary: Stops the slot window's two payout animations and clears the ten payout interpolation values.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: UiSlotWindow* Ui_SlotWindow_Ctor(UiSlotWindow* self, unsigned char mode)
functions.summary: Constructor of the casino slot machine window: allocates the four helper objects (layout animator 0x37C, 0x1A40 reel object, effect pack 0xE84/0x130, list widget 0x1E84), zeroes the 22 pattern lists and the 0x18-slot message table.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_Destroy
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor wrapper of the slot window: runs Ui_SlotWindow_Dtor and then frees the storage.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_Dtor
functions.signature: UiSlotWindow* Ui_SlotWindow_Dtor(UiSlotWindow* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor body of the slot window: drops the layout animator, the four helper objects, all 22 pattern lists and the message pair children.

functions.name: Ui_SpriteSpan_SetFromFlags
functions.signature: void Ui_SpriteSpan_SetFromFlags(SpriteSpanWidget* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Rebuilds a sprite-span widget from the flag word at +0x208: selects the sprite span, then renders the numeric/text value held at +0x20c.

functions.name: Ui_TwoListWindow_UpdateChildSelection
functions.summary: Propagates the window's selected id (signed byte at self+0x64) to its two child widgets at self+0x130/self+0x134: each child's vtable+0x1C reports its id, and the child's vtable+0x0C receives whether it is the selected one.

functions.name: Ui_TwoListWindow_Init
functions.summary: Window initialiser that adopts the two embedded list widgets at self+0x80 and self+0xD8: stores both pointers at f_130/f_134 and, for each, calls virtual +8 to attach the owner and +0xC to reset the list.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Effect_UpdatePlacement
functions.summary: Positions a screen-space effect relative to the camera: builds the effect world offset, scales the offset by the distance to the camera (clamped to a near/far range), projects it with Gfx_ProjectWorldToScreen and lets the owner apply it (virtual +0x2C).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TwoListPanel_Ctor
functions.summary: In-place constructor of a two-list window variant: runs the window header constructor (0x1D08D8), installs the class vtable 0x763E68 plus the secondary table at +0x4C, then constructs the two embedded sub-objects (vtables 0x767258 and 0x75ECE0) and clears their state words.

functions.name: Ui_SlotSubObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small slot-window sub-object: stores the vtable and the owner back-pointer at +0x4C, releases two tween objects, unlinks the list node and frees.

functions.name: Ui_SlotSubObject_DtorBase
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a small slot-window sub-object: same teardown as 0x00329D64 without the final free.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_SetMessageArgNum
functions.signature: void Ui_SlotWindow_SetMessageArgNum(UiMessageRef* msg, unsigned int text_id, int value)
functions.summary: Formats a number for message argument slot 8 and assigns it to the given text id, then records the cached value byte.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_InitTextTable
functions.summary: Lazily builds the slot window's 0x10-byte string-table singleton (allocation idiom + Engine_ResourceNode_CtorBase, vtable 0x782A08) behind the one-shot flag, then selects text row 7 with 0x00633560(table[4], 7).

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_CtorB
functions.summary: Constructor of the Ui_SlotWindow variant that also stores a caller-supplied word: base Ui_SelectListWindow_Ctor(self, 0), then vtable 0x00763F04 and self+0x320 = arg2.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_DtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the second slot-window variant (different vtable, four tween members plus a 0x5C-byte embedded block).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AnimWidget_ResetAndSetFrameB
functions.summary: Twin of 0x0032A288 on the second animation reference: resets the anim ref at self+0x9C with Ui_AnimRef_ResetPanes(...,1) and stores the float frame (VFP s0, shown as in_s0) into its +0x18 field at self+0xB4.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Effect_ReplaceResource
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Effect_ReplaceResource(EffectSlot* self, u32* handle, u32 effectId)
functions.summary: Re-points an effect slot at another resource: validates the tagged handle against the global handle table, resolves the owner effect by id, attaches the new resource to +0xF0, clears bit 3 of +0x7C, then walks the slot's sub-object list for the vtable-0x7C8584 node and re-applies the sprite pattern.

functions.name: Ui_TextureNameWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_TextureNameWindow_InitPanes(UiWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Cursor window that looks up the 'texture' and 'txt_name' child widgets in the layout and attaches the 'in'/'out' panes.

functions.name: Ui_AnimWidget_ResetAndSetFrame
functions.summary: Resets the animation reference embedded at self+0x4C (Ui_AnimRef_ResetPanes(self+0x4C, 1)) and stores the float frame argument into its +0x18 field (self+0x64). The float arrives in VFP s0, which Ghidra shows as in_s0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SlotPanel_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a small tweenable UI panel: UI object base, vtable 0x00763F74, two embedded animation-reference lists at +0x4C and +0x9C and cleared tween fields; returns the panel base 0x9C bytes before the innermost list.

functions.name: Ui_SlotPanel_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small slot-window panel: releases the tween member, one 0x50 step down and the list node, then frees.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_StepToTarget
functions.summary: Moves a tween value toward its target by a fixed step, clamps it at the target and refreshes the animated widget when it moved.

functions.name: Ui_GaugeBarWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Cursor window that attaches the 'gauge' pane and initialises its two min/max gauge values from func_00649BD4.

functions.name: Ui_Tween_SetSpeeds
functions.signature: void Ui_Tween_SetSpeeds(Tween* self, float speed, float b, float c)
functions.summary: Clamps three incoming values to 0..1, stores the resulting tween speeds at +0x4C/+0x50 and +0x58/+0x5C (base 0.3 multiplied by the clamped values), resets the tween object and applies them.

functions.name: Ui_SlotPanel_DtorBase
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a small slot-window panel: one tween member plus the list node are released, storage is left to the caller.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitActionTrigger
functions.summary: Initialises a field gimmick's interaction trigger: resets the icon/id word to 0xFFFF and the flag byte to 0xFF, copies the 0x25-byte trigger descriptor, then maps the trigger mode (+0x30, cases 0..8) onto a concrete prompt icon/action id (0xD, 7, 0x23, 0x24, 0xB5, 0x97, 0x45) or onto a special flag value for modes 6 and 7.

functions.name: maybe_Model_HandleDeadTag
functions.summary: Looks the 4-byte tag "dead" (0x64616564) up on the model at self+0x28 and, when present, re-applies it through the model's vtable+0x84; then runs the state slot at self+0x2C and starts the attached effect.

functions.name: Dive_Effect_InitFromActor
functions.summary: Initialises one dive-effect parameter from the owning actor: takes the actor's visual/monster id (self->f_28->f_238), looks it up in the lazily built shared table (0x63E5C8) and stores tableRow->f_E2 (a size/rate byte) scaled by a constant into self->f_A0; id -1 keeps the default.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveEffect_Update
functions.summary: Timer-driven effect-slot sequencer: after the first timer expires it plays the impact SE once, and after the second it walks the effect slots at +0x2C (state 1/2) and attaches the impact effect/model data from the object at +0x28; always returns 1 while waiting.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SpawnScreenShake
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SpawnScreenShake(void* source, int id, float amount)
functions.summary: Spawns a screen-shake/effect instance from a source transform: reads the position, computes a length and forwards the request to Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.

functions.name: Dive_SpawnDropEffect
functions.summary: Spawns the dive mini-game's drop/impact effect: plays the 'diveDrop' animation on the effect object, offsets it by the window position, checks the item that was hit and creates the attached impact effect / plays SE 0x1F.

functions.name: Dive_Effect_UpdateStartDelay
functions.summary: Per-frame start-delay check of the dive effect: while the frame counter f_38 is not yet 0x3C (60) it does nothing; on frame 60 it asks the tween controller at +0x2C for state 2 and commits it, i.e. the effect starts. Always returns 1 so the caller keeps ticking.

functions.name: maybe_Dive_Effect_SpawnOriented
functions.summary: Spawns effect 0x45C on an actor with a fully built 0x60-byte instance parameter block: copies the actor transform from actor+0x28->0x9C, builds and orthonormalises a second basis from two global vectors, applies the left/right mirror flags and hands the block to Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.

functions.name: maybe_TweenSequence_Update
functions.summary: Three-step animation timeline: accumulates the frame delta into f_34/f_38, then runs the callback of the current step (0..2) from the 0x18-byte descriptor array at +0x2C, resolving the (fn & 1) thunk convention against the object at +0x4C.

functions.name: Ui_ActionListWindow_InitPanesB
functions.summary: Builds the panes of the battle action-list window: initialises the base object (0x002B09BC), installs vtable g_0032B604, binds the pane/member pair at +0x2C (vtable g_0032B608) and constructs three 0x18-byte child panes. Called while the action list window itself is being created.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TweenSequence_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the tween-sequence object: stores the vtable from r1, destroys the base object through 0x002B0A04 and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_UpdateQuantityRows
functions.summary: Fills one 16-row page from the 4-byte entries at self+0x1F0 (count from func_00668C84), writing each entry's name and count into the row panes.

functions.name: Ui_TextSpan_Rebuild
functions.summary: Rebuilds a text widget's span array from the current item list: applies the current entries to the span array at self+0x7C, appends one span per item id (using the entry's extra byte), clamps the count to at least 1 and notifies the owner through vtable +0x6C.

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnListWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_TwoColumnListWindow_InitPanes(UiWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Builds the pane set of an eight-row, two-column list window: title, txt_l1..8, txt_r1..8 with two numeric sub-texts each, plus left/right pager counters.

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnListWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for the two-column list window: allocates through Ui_Object_CtorSmall, installs vtables g_0032BAD4/g_0032BADC, wires the embedded sub-object via 0x00622248, stores 0x10 as the row count and constructs sixteen 0x18-byte row entries.

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnListWindow_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the two-column list window: installs the vtables, destroys the 0x10-entry 0x18-byte row array, runs the UI object destructor and frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_NumberedTextRowsWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Creates three numbered text rows from the 'null_txt_l1' template, advancing the digit each iteration and registering each row through virtual +0x34 and +0x38, then finishes the layout with +0x48.

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnListWindow_DtorBody
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the two-column list window: runs only the base-object destructor.

functions.name: Ui_DiveStartWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the 'menu_dive_start' message window and its message pair (yes/no) for the dive start screen.

functions.name: Ui_DiveStartWindow_Close
functions.summary: Closes the dive-start window: asks the embedded widget at +0x98 for its next state (vtable +0x2C) and then invokes the window's own close entry (vtable +0x48).

functions.name: Ui_NoopThunk
functions.summary: Empty stub: fetches the UI core pointer and returns. Used as a placeholder vtable slot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveStartWindow_SetRecordHandle
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_DiveStartWindow_SetRecordHandle(UiDiveStartWindow* self, u32 record_handle, u8 * flag)
functions.summary: Validates a tagged record handle against the global handle table (0x7B80C0, 21-bit tag as in Ui_MessageWindow_SetRecordHandle) and, when valid, notifies the record object at self->f_2d4 through its vtable+0x7C; then stores the caller's flag in self+0x284.

functions.name: Ui_DiveStartWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the dive-start window: builds the window base, a message page, the message pair and a 0x28-entry table, then loads 'pre_dive_msg.bxon' and installs its layout.

functions.name: Ui_DiveStartWindow_Destroy
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor wrapper of the dive-start window.

functions.name: Ui_DiveStartWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor body of the dive-start window: releases the message pair/page, the animator and the message page at +0x38C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveResultWindow_ShowItem
functions.summary: Shows one item in a result text widget: clears the pending byte at text+0x12C, resolves the item reference to a display row and runs text command 6 with (row, item byte +0xB), or command 0 when the reference resolves to nothing.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveManager_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the dive manager: asks the virtual state query (vtable+0xC) whether it is idle; when it is not, a successful condition check sets the 'ready' byte at +0x18; when it is, four pending sub-objects are released through their vtable+8 and their flags cleared.

functions.name: Ui_DiveManager_Ctor
functions.signature: UiDiveManager* Ui_DiveManager_Ctor(UiDiveManager* self, UiDiveParams* params, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Constructor of the dive mini-game manager: creates the layout controller and the reel/board object, builds nine intrusive lists from the data table and hooks the manager into the frame callback list.

functions.name: Ui_DiveManager_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the dive manager: runs the ordinary destructor (maybe_Ui_DiveManager_Dtor, which releases the two heap objects and unwinds the nine intrusive lists) and then frees the object through the allocator's delete (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_DiveManager_Dtor
functions.signature: UiDiveManager* Ui_DiveManager_Dtor(UiDiveManager* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor of the dive manager: installs vtable 0x007641B8, releases the two heap objects at self+8/+0xC and re-initialises the nine intrusive list heads and timer blocks (offsets 0x5, 0x7, 0x12A, 0x156, 0x162, 0x16B ...) to empty, returning self.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ProjectLocalAnchor
functions.summary: Projects the widget's own world position (self+0xB0) to screen space and writes it, with a constant vertical offset, into the quad draw slot at self+0x30.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveSubObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of dive mini-game sub-object: installs vtable and initializes animation reference list via Ui_AnimRefList_Ctor.

functions.name: Ui_DiveSubObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a dive-window sub-object: releases its tween/layout members and the list node, then frees.

functions.name: Ui_DiveSubObject_DtorBase
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a dive-window sub-object: same teardown as 0x0032CBB8 without the final free.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Damage_PlayAnimAndSe
functions.summary: Plays 'Bt_Damage' animation on actor node at self+0x28 via virtual method +0x84, steps animation with func_0066A244, and if float parameter in s0 is positive triggers sound effect with func_005F7564.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_DamagePopup_DetachActor
functions.summary: Tests the popup's actor link at f_28 and, when it resolves, calls 0x5E7848(actor, 0, 1) - the same call the sibling 0x322884 makes with flag 0, so this is the 'detach / clear the actor link' variant.

functions.name: Field_ActorMotion_CreateVariant
functions.summary: Creates the actor-motion helper through the generic motion constructor at 0x002EA430 and installs the vtable at 0x0032CCB0; a constructor variant for one field-actor class.

functions.name: Battle_DamagePopup_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the battle damage popup: tears down its string/member (0x193E44) and frees the object (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanesB_2
functions.summary: Variant gauge window initialiser that only attaches the 'gauge' pane.

functions.name: Ui_DiveSubObject_Dtor2
functions.summary: Second deleting destructor of the dive-window sub-object family: releases the same members and frees.

functions.name: Ui_ActionListWindow_Init
functions.summary: Builds the eight-row battle/field action list: creates the 'action' list container and one row widget per action name ('nut', 'run', 'atk', 'dmg', 'protect', 'break', 'dead', 'end'), guarded by the row count.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_ResetChildren
functions.summary: Scene-node lifecycle slot: syncs the node's child instances through Field_SceneNode_SyncChildInstances and then clears the pending handle at self+0x234.

functions.name: Gfx_FindObjectByHandle
functions.summary: Looks a sprite/effect object up by handle in the global (tag,entry) hash table and verifies its RTTI type id against the global type id before returning it.

functions.name: Field_Actor_PlayAttachedEffect
functions.summary: Plays the actor's cached attached effect and its sound: rebuilds the effect descriptor at the actor position, spawns it through the effect manager and clears the pending flag f_240.

functions.name: Field_Actor_PlayEffectBySlot
functions.summary: Same effect-spawn path as Field_Actor_PlayAttachedEffect but selects the effect id and sound from tables with the slot index; caches the returned handle in f_23c/f_23b.

functions.name: Field_Actor_HandleAnimEvent
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_HandleAnimEvent(void* self, int eventId, u32 arg3, u32 context)
functions.summary: Dispatches animation-timeline events for a field actor: each event id ORs a specific bit into the state word at +0x234 (0x1, 0x4, 0x8, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x10000), while the effect events 0x2E/0x2F/0x30 resolve the actor's effect record through the GameWork tables and spawn a shake/dust node; unknown ids are ignored.

functions.name: Field_Actor_RestartActionSequence
functions.summary: Stops the actor's running child sequences (base node broadcast) and immediately starts the default sequence with func_005E74A0(actor,0,1).

functions.name: Field_Actor_InitAttachedEffect
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_InitAttachedEffect(void* self, u32 id, u32 caller)
functions.summary: Sets up an attached model/effect on a field actor from master-data records: resolves the record's resource index, picks a vertical offset (the record's default offset vector selects field +0x38, otherwise +0x44), stores it at +0x230 together with the record id +0x238, and resets the remaining attach state (alpha 0xFF, id byte, +0x24C = 0).

functions.name: Field_Actor_ReleaseAttachedEffect
functions.summary: Releases the actor resource bundle (0x005F7F98) and destroys the attached effect instance referenced by f_23c, leaving the effect slot empty.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_InitParams
functions.signature: GfxSprite* Gfx_Sprite_InitParams(GfxSpriteManager* mgr, ResDesc* desc, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Allocates a sprite/effect slot through the manager and installs the default parameter block: vtable 0x7642D4, zero origin, alpha 0xFF, two 0xFFFF limits and the -1/-8 sentinels.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a field actor/scene-node class: releases the base object (0x5F8528) and frees it (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_BeginEffectState
functions.summary: Switches an actor's effect state: if the byte at +0x238 is not 0xFF it clears +0x221, builds an effect transform at the actor position and spawns effect 0x45C through the 2D effect manager, then sets f_8C=1 and stops the sub-animation; otherwise it plays animation 0x0032DD6C and clears f_8C.

functions.name: Field_Actor_TickEffectState
functions.summary: Per-frame effect-state tick: once the accumulated timer at actor->f_4C+8 passes 0.3 (0x3E99999A) it spawns the state effect once (0x32DE54, guarded by f_230) and then asks the sub-state at f_4C for state 2. Always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Node_StartAnim
functions.summary: Starts the node animation: installs the per-frame callback &LAB_0032de44 through vtable+0x84, starts an animation of length 0x3C through 0x5F7784, sets the running byte f_8C and clears the byte at +0x221.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_SpawnStateEffect
functions.summary: Spawns a 0x240-byte effect/model object for a field actor: when the actor has a held item id (f_232 != -1) it looks the item record up, chooses between two effect variants by the item's id range (0xAA3..0xB3A / 0xA82..0xAA2) and calls maybe_Gfx_EffectObject_Replace with the actor position; when f_232 is -1 it instead builds the object from record 0x2DE and loads it through Ui_ItemModel_Load.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_InitParamsAlt
functions.summary: Second sprite initialiser: allocates the slot, installs vtable 0x76438C and writes the alternate default block (zero origin then 1.5 scale, 0xFFFF/0xFF limits and the +0x221 flag byte set to 1).

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a second field scene-node class: releases the base object (0x5F8528) and frees it (0x10F6CC) - same body as 0x32DBD0.

functions.name: Ui_TitleWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Cursor window that attaches only the 'txt_title' pane, with a 0x10-byte layout parameter.

functions.name: Ui_TitleWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the title window: runs the UI object base destructor and releases the block.

functions.name: Ui_TitleTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Attaches the 'txt_title' pane and a second one-character 'txt' pane to the window at the base layout id.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetTextFromTable
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_SetTextFromTable(UiMessageWindow* self, char table_index, unsigned int text_id, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Sets a text id on the message window using a string from the shared text table (index is offset by 0x22), tagging the write with the window's own id.

functions.name: Ui_TitleTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the title-text window: runs the UI object base destructor and releases the block.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TitleWindow_SetAnimFrame
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_TitleWindow_SetAnimFrame(UiTitleWindow* self, unsigned int frame, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Window step handler: plays step 0x36 through 0x617D7C, binds the detail widget at owner+0x1084 to owner+0x111C and pushes the pane descriptor 0x729A7C+0x48 onto the window at owner+0x120.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TitleWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a small window object: detaches the child sprite, removes the node from its owner's ring, releases the tween/layout members and frees.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateNextIcon
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateNextIcon(UiMessageWindow* self, unsigned int frame, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the message text window: decrements the typewriter countdown, moves/blinks the 'icon_next' marker under the last line, plays the 'stop1' page-end animation and re-positions the text panes 'txt'/'txt1'.

functions.name: Field_Actor_InitActionSequencer
functions.summary: Hooks a field actor's action/sequencer object together: stores the address of the object's +0x18 block into owner+0x10CC, lazily constructs the shared sequencer table, pulls the actor record with 0x0063D960 and constructs the four 0xC-byte action entries that drive the actor's motion/effect steps.

functions.name: Field_Actor_AdvanceModeState
functions.summary: Advances the actor's scene-mode byte (+4): if the current mode matches the scene's mode it first detaches the mode's effect (Ui_ChildSprite_Detach, removes it from the intrusive list, clears f_16C), and at the end it increments the mode byte and runs the extra step 0x002BBB44 when leaving mode 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_DtorB
functions.signature: UiMessageWindow* maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_DtorB(UiMessageWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor of a message-window variant: installs vtable 0x00764534 and runs the shared message-window teardown chain.

functions.name: Fs_FileRequest_Update
functions.signature: u32 Fs_FileRequest_Update(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 high)
functions.summary: Drives one asynchronous file request through its phases (0 = start, 1 = wait for sync, 2 = prepare, 3 = poll, 4 = finish): publishes the request, builds the request header, waits on the event flag/semaphore, releases the command buffer and records a status code in +0xC. Returns 1 while the request may continue and 0 when it has completed or failed.

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateMotionScale
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_UpdateMotionScale(FieldActor* actor, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Computes the actor's motion speed/scale from its action parameters (f_2c4/f_2c8) and random jitter, stores them in f_1b4/f_1b8, then runs the normal anim update.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_UpdateTimeline
functions.summary: Per-frame NPC-action timeline: accumulates the delta into f_68/f_6C and then runs the callback of the current keyframe (0..11) from the 0x18-byte descriptor array at +0x60, resolving the (fn & 1) thunk convention against the object at +0x80.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_ComputeOffsetFromHandle
functions.summary: Resolves the target object through Container_FindObjectByTypeIdH, copies its position (+0x9C..+0xA4) and asks 0x005E8BEC to compute the actor's local offset into a stack buffer; returns 1 unconditionally.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_MoveToOffset
functions.summary: Moves the NPC along a small offset stored in its action record: if the action animation has ended it plays sequence 2, otherwise it adds the record offset to the actor position.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_StartMoveToTarget
functions.summary: Starts an NPC walk/run action toward a target: copies the target actor's position and the follow point from the owner block (+0x2D8/+0x2E0 and +0x2E4..+0x2EC) into the action's start/goal vectors, initialises the movement helper with them, selects walk or run playback depending on the owner's state and stores the duration in +0x50.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WalkToStoredTarget
functions.summary: Per-frame update of an NPC movement action: after the entry delay in +0x1B4 it latches the position stored on the actor at +0x2D8 and the facing stored at +0x2E4 into the action, picks the Walk/Run animation (or idle 'Nut' when it is already on the spot), steers the actor to that point, then makes it face the stored direction and signals completion through 0x0028C42C before returning 1.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteSlot_SetParams
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SpriteSlot_SetParams(u32 index, u8 flagA, u8 flagB)
functions.summary: Fills one 0x40-byte entry of a global sprite/effect parameter array: copies three words of the default basis vector into +0x48/+0x4C/+0x50 and stores the caller's flags in the trailing bytes +0x54..+0x58.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_MoveToOffsetStart
functions.summary: One-shot setup for the 'move by offset' action: it derives the offset from the actor's stored origin (+0x2CC) to its stored goal (+0x2D8), stores it in +0x1BC/+0x1C0/+0x1C4, clears the actor's +0x2A4 field, executes one step of the movement helper 0x0032FCC4, then takes the model's ground speed from 0x005E82C4 and plays 'Run' or 'Walk' depending on the flag that helper returns.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NpcAction_TurnToActor
functions.summary: Starts an NPC action step: takes the target actor id from the action owner (or the object found by Container_FindObjectByTypeId), applies the move speed from Field_NpcAction_GetMoveSpeedById, installs step 0x0032FE7C and feeds a random value when the target has the rotation flag.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NpcAction_PlayScaledActionAnim
functions.summary: Fetches action animation id and model scale, chooses animation name by scale flag, and plays it on owner actor.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NpcAction_IdleB
functions.summary: Twin of 0x0033026C without the target lookup: applies the actor's move speed (from in_s0), installs step 0x0032FE7C, and when the actor animation is ready converts the system speed and applies it through 0x005F5A50.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WalkToPlayer
functions.summary: Walk-toward-player action: checks line of sight, measures the squared distance to the player, steers the movement direction and adds velocity each frame; plays sequence 4 when the player is out of sight.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_RunToActor
functions.summary: Run/chase action: gets the target actor, computes a steering direction through 0x005E890C, accelerates the actor and switches to sequence 4 when the target is lost.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_StartAnimAndFlagStep
functions.summary: Starts the action's animation through the actor's vtable+0x84 (callback 0x3308E8) and, when the action counter f_2C8 is below 4, sets the matching 'step done' byte in the array at self->f_5C (+0x271 + counter).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WalkToPoint
functions.summary: Walks toward the stored point (f_48) at the action speed, optionally offset toward a target actor; when the timer expires it switches to the next action.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WalkToActor
functions.summary: Like WalkToPoint but the destination is the target actor's position plus a fixed offset; on timeout it changes the sequence and speed.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WalkToActorStep
functions.summary: Movement step for 'walk to actor': each frame it checks line of sight, computes the target position (own actor position plus the target's offset, or the current walk target), and adds the resulting motion to the actor's position; when the step budget runs out it finishes with flag 4.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WaitForLinkEnd
functions.summary: Wait action that ends when the timer f_54 runs out or when the NPC action reports the 'LinkEnd' event; then triggers sequence 4.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_AdvanceTweenState
functions.summary: Asks the action's tween controller at +0x60 whether the current step finished (vtable+0x14 with no id) and, if it did, commits the next state through vtable+0x10.

functions.name: Monster_EcologyCoSubCtor
functions.signature: void* Monster_EcologyCoSubCtor(void* mem, void* owner, void* actor, const char* name, int flag)
functions.summary: Placement constructor for the 'ecoCoSub' monster-ecology sub-behaviour object: it runs the base constructor, installs vtable 0x0076480C on the object and 0x0075AC9C on the member pair at +0x60, back-links the owner at +0x60+0x20, and default-constructs the following 12-entry table of 0x18-byte elements.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_DeletingDestructorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant for an NPC-action class: installs the vtable argument at the object base, runs the shared base-action destructor 0x00193E40 and frees the block with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_RunToLinkSetup
functions.summary: Setup of an NPC run action: it computes the run direction either toward the object resolved from the action's link (0x00619B20) or, when there is no link, out of the actor's own rotation (+0x8C..+0x98); it then stores direction, delay (actor+0x2C4->+0x1C or 1.0s), speed (a global from 0x0063E650) and finally starts a turn request (0x001798D0) plus the idle 'Nut' animation.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_RunToLinkUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the run-to-link action: while the elapsed time (self+0x24->+0x44) is still below the stored delay (+0x44) it merely re-aims the actor at the linked object; once the delay has elapsed it plays 'Run' once, and every frame turns the actor toward the stored direction (0x005F5F54) and translates it by direction * speed(+0x48) * dt.

functions.name: Monster_EcologyBehaviorCtor
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises the monster ecology behaviour object: runs the shared AI-behaviour constructor, installs the ecology vtable 0x764848 and copies the three default parameter words.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_RunToLink_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 'run to link' NPC action: destroys the string member (0x193E40) and frees the object (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: Field_NpcJumpAction_Setup
functions.summary: Prepares a jump: records the take-off position/rotation (or a target point from the NPC record) and asks the jump planner to build the trajectory.

functions.name: Field_NpcJumpAction_RandomizeAndPlan
functions.signature: void Field_NpcJumpAction_RandomizeAndPlan(FieldNpcAction* action, u32 arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Starts the next jump of an NPC: rolls a pause from the game RNG, and when the pause has expired (or a target was supplied) rolls the jump delay, stores it at +0x60 and re-plans the path (Field_NpcJumpAction_PlanPath); then marks the action done (+0x2C = 1).

functions.name: Field_NpcJumpAction_PlanPath
functions.summary: Computes the jump trajectory with the ballistic/collision planner at 0x001D233C and stores the landing point and duration in f_48..f_58.

functions.name: Field_NpcJumpAction_Update
functions.summary: Advances the jump: counts the delay, checks the remaining distance and collision state, then moves along the planned direction each frame.

functions.name: Field_EnemyAiBehavior_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Field_EnemyAiBehavior_Ctor(void* obj, void* owner, void* params, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Constructor of one enemy-AI behaviour object (100 bytes, vtable 0x0076487C): runs the shared descriptor ctor and fills the default parameter block, including the duplicated vector triples at +0x34..+0x40.

functions.name: Field_NpcJumpAction_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the NPC jump action: destroys the string member (0x193E40) and frees the object (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_RunTowardTargetStart
functions.summary: Setup of the timed run action: it calls the base start 0x0028B3AC, stores a model-derived duration in +0x3C, the actor model's ground speed (0x005E80A4 on the model id at actor+0x258) in +0x40, zeroes the progress accumulator +0x48, stores a limit from 0x005E88F0 in +0x4C and starts the 'Run' animation.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_RunTowardTargetUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the timed run: it adds dt to the progress counter +0x48 (or subtracts it, leaving the counter at 0, when +0x2C is clear) and, while elapsed(+0x24->+0x44) is below +0x3C and the counter is below +0x4C, moves the actor along the unit direction returned by 0x005E7FA8 at speed +0x40; otherwise it puts the actor into animation state 8 and runs the base update.

functions.name: Field_EnemyAiAnimCtor
functions.summary: Constructs the eight-slot enemy-AI animation object with vtable 0x007648B0 and the default animation ids at +0x34..+0x4C.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_RunToward_DeletingDestructor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 'run toward target' NPC action: destroys the string member (0x193E40) and frees the object (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_SubactionStart
functions.summary: Activates and starts the internal subaction state at offset +0x2C by evaluating its virtual predicate at +0x14 and invoking its entry method at vtable+0x10.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_OnEvent
functions.signature: void Field_NpcAction_OnEvent(FieldNpcAction* self, int event_type, u32* event_data)
functions.summary: Handles event notifications for the NPC action state, updating state flags for events 0x16, 0x17, and 0x18, or forwarding event 0x19 to actor method +0xB4.

functions.name: Field_NpcFallAction_Start
functions.summary: Starts a fall/landing action: places the actor, switches it to action state 4, lifts its Y by the height taken from the actor/monster data (f_68 or f_44 depending on the f_26A class), clears the ground-clamp byte f_119 and derives the action duration f_C0 from the height and the actor's scale.

functions.name: Field_NpcFallAction_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the leap/fall action: it integrates the vertical progress at +0xBC and translates the actor along the action's fixed direction (0x0033241C scaled by 0x00332418), and as soon as 0x00669DD4 reports the actor has landed it sets actor+0x119, calls actor vfuncs +0x54(4) and +0xA4(5) and then either switches the animation state (0x005E7848) or notifies the embedded sequencer at +0x2C. Always returns 1.

functions.name: Field_NpcMimicAction_Start
functions.summary: Starts the Mimic (treasure-chest monster) action: plays the 'Mimic' action animation, sets the player-distance threshold f_b8 and initialises its effect slots.

functions.name: Field_NpcMimicAction_Update
functions.summary: Mimic action tick: when the player comes within f_b8 it arms the attack timer f_c4=0x16 and lets the nested sub-action advance.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NpcMimicAction_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of an NPC action: plays the action animation through the actor vtable slot +0x84, and while the flag at +0xC8 is set copies the field scene node position (work+8 -> +0x48) into f_CC..f_D4; finally stores the scaled speed state into f_BC.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_MoveToCoordUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the coordinate-targeted NPC movement action: computes 2D distance to destination (+0xCC, +0xD4), switching the actor to idle state 0 once within threshold or otherwise stepping toward destination at speed self->f_3C * self->f_BC.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_SetStateFinished
functions.summary: Completion step of an NPC actor action: detaches the placed map object when f_C5 is set, switches the actor state machine to mode 4, selects the finish animation through vtable +0x84 (constant 0x00332918 when there is no target-bone transform) and clears the pending action id at model+0x2A8.

functions.name: Field_NpcFallAction_LandedUpdate
functions.summary: Landing-phase update of the same leap action (identical to 0x00332270 minus the horizontal movement): it watches the actor's current/total animation frames and, in the last ten frames, snaps the facing toward +0xCC or toward the reference point via 0x005E7FA8; when the animation has finished it either sets the actor's animation state (0x005E7848) or notifies the +0x2C sequencer with id 3. Returns 1.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_SubactionUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update step for the NPC subaction controller: advances subaction timers (+0x34, +0x3C) and steps through up to 4 sub-state handlers structured at stride 0x18 from +0x2C.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Stop
functions.summary: Terminates the current NPC action: stops actor action via virtual method +0xB4, resets state variable +0x2A8, invokes actor motion cleanup 0x0066A228, and resets animation state when blending out.

functions.name: Field_NpcMimicAction_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Field_NpcMimicAction_Ctor(void* mem, void* owner, void* actor, const char* name, int flag)
functions.summary: Placement constructor for the NPC 'mimic' gesture/behaviour object: it runs the 0x0019C8F4 base constructor, installs vtable 0x007648E4 on the object and 0x0075ACC0 on the member pair at +0x2C, back-links the owner, and default-constructs the following 4-entry table of 0x18-byte elements.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for Field_NpcAction: invokes the base action destructor 0x00193E40 and frees object memory via the global allocator wrapper 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_OnStateChanged
functions.summary: Actor state hook: for state 0x13 it refreshes the actor's cached level-grid revision; for state 0x11 it does the same and re-places the map object with id 3; other states are ignored.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_OnStateExit
functions.summary: State-exit hook: refreshes the actor's level-grid revision (0x179084 on self->f_28) and clears the actor's pending action id at +0x2A8.

functions.name: Field_NpcGesture_Create
functions.summary: Constructor used by Field_NpcPlayGesture: allocates the generic object through 0x0019C8F4 and installs the gesture vtable g_00332E54.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_SubactionDeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for the NPC subaction helper object: invokes base destructor 0x00193E40 and deallocates memory via operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_ItemSelect_UpdateRowSelection
functions.summary: Broadcasts the selection to the row children: stores the incoming flag on the object at +0x384, then for the five child widgets compares the child's vtable+0x1C id with the selected id at +0x64 and pushes the result to the child's vtable+0x0C.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_ForwardEventToSubaction
functions.signature: void Field_NpcAction_ForwardEventToSubaction(FieldNpcAction* self, u32 cmd, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Forwards an action event or command to the subactor at self->f_60 when flag self->f_399 is active, running state sync 0x0029129C and indirect dispatch at +0x10.

functions.name: Ui_FiveChildWindow_Init
functions.summary: Window initialiser that wires five embedded sub-widgets (pointers at +0x384..+0x398, aimed at self+0x80/+0x13C/+0x1F8/+0x2B4/+0x31C) and, for each, calls virtual +8 to attach the owner and +0xC to reset it. What the five widgets display is not visible.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NpcAction_UpdateApproach
functions.summary: Approach tick of an NPC action: projects the target point to screen space, picks one of four facing states from the screen position (x against 200.0f, y against 30.0f), stores it at +0x65 and asks the attached object (action[0x18] vtable +0x20) to face that way.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: In-place constructor of the equip window: runs the window header constructor, installs the class vtable and chains the five embedded sub-part constructors (three Ui_EquipPart_Ctor and two 0x002158D0 parts), installing each part's vtable and clearing its state words.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of an equipment-window sub-object: stores the owner back-pointer at +0x4C, performs five relative Ui_LayoutRef_Release steps, installs the two nested vtables, destroys the list and frees.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_DtorBase
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor twin of 0x00333240 for the same embedded equipment-window sub-object (identical body without the final free).

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds the equipment window from 'ui_equip_msg.bxon': creates the message pages 'win_equip_equip1', 'win_equip_type', 'win_equip_equip2', 'win_equip_name', 'win_equip_dougu', plus 'win_talk'/'win_yesno' with their message pair, and binds the list container.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_HandleTextInput
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_HandleTextInput(void* self, u16* charPtr, u32 glyphSource, int flag)
functions.summary: Character-input helper: resolves the font record for the typed character (func_0061BCC8) and, when there is none, forwards the raw code with a default glyph; the second half of the function is lost to halt_baddata.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_UpdateInputState
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_UpdateInputState(void* self, int isCancel, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Updates the equip window's input-state object at +0x11C from the focused pane: stores the index/flag byte, refreshes or clears the highlighted text span (0x00409720 vs 0x0040996C), and for the two sentinel pane types (0x00333BEC, 0x00334B84) also copies the equipped item id and its extra byte into the state object.

functions.name: Equip_PlaySeForSlot
functions.summary: Plays the sound effect that belongs to the equipment slot currently selected at self+0x198: lazily creates the shared sound player (Anim_Sequence_CtorBase, vtable 0x782914), asks the slot for its SE id and plays it.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_OnDecideA
functions.summary: Equipment confirm handler (variant A): when the selected entry's flag byte at +5 is set it applies the selection, plays the slot SE and pops the pane, returning true.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_OnDecideB
functions.summary: Equipment confirm handler (variant B): acts only when the cursor index f_12 equals the entry's byte at +4, then applies the selection, plays the SE and pops the pane.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_HandleInput
functions.signature: void Ui_EquipWindow_HandleInput(EquipWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Main input handler of the equipment window: dispatches on the +0x17c input flags (confirm, cancel, left/right page, up/down) and updates the selected slot, the icon pane, the item grid and the equipment comparison panes accordingly.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_RunCallbackStep
functions.summary: Advances the equip window's callback step: runs the +0x2C virtual of the embedded object at f_98, then either marks the next-state bytes f_1A/f_1B (input flag 0x20), finishes the pending 0x00333BEC step or pops the pane (flag 4), or invokes the callback stored in the current 0xC-byte entry of the stack at +0x128.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_TryEquipSelected
functions.summary: Attempts to equip the currently selected item: checks whether the slot is empty, asks 0x6293A8 whether the member can use it, and pushes the corresponding result message (5 = no item, 8/9 = equipped/not equippable) onto the pane stack.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_UpdatePaneAndPop
functions.summary: Updates a window's child widget and, when a pane id matches, pops panes down to the configured id.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_UpdateSlotTypeFlag
functions.summary: Classifies the focused equip slot: it reads the slot's type word (from the global at 0x00729B98 when +0x164 is 0, otherwise from the 0xC-stride record array at +0x128) and sets the input state's +0x19 flag when the type is Ui_EquipWindow_CheckSlotSpace or Ui_EquipWindow_BuildCandidateList, refreshing or clearing the item text when the flag changes.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_PopPaneAndPushSelectPane
functions.signature: void Ui_EquipWindow_PopPaneAndPushSelectPane(UiWindow* window, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Pops the current pane and pushes the next one (0x006D8270) using the pane rectangle from the layout table.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_PushSelectPane
functions.summary: Equipment-window selection handler: pops the old pane when input flag 4 is set, scrolls the candidate list, and when the selection flags (f_17C & 0x102) are set resolves the member's equipped item in the highlighted slot (func_006292A4) and either pops back or pushes the candidate pane with message id 8 (normal) or 9 (alternate) through Ui_EquipWindow_PushPane.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_CanEquipSelected
functions.summary: Returns true when the selected item can be equipped by the current member (0x66C434 on the item id) and, in that case, pushes the 'equipped' message pane 10.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_ShowEquipMessage
functions.summary: Builds the equipment-change message for the selected item: puts the item name into message arg 5 and the member name into arg 3, then pushes message pane 6.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_RebuildSlotText
functions.summary: Rebuilds the six equipment-slot lines: collects the glyph ids of the current member's six slots, removes glyphs that are no longer equipped, marks the slot index of each remaining one and re-applies the font record.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_PopPaneAndRunCallbacks
functions.summary: Pops the current pane once the widget at window+0x2134 has finished, and on confirm walks the global handler table 0x007A8F00..0x007A8F30 invoking each member-function entry until one returns non-zero.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_MoveCursor
functions.signature: void Ui_EquipWindow_MoveCursor(EquipWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Moves the equipment-window cursor: confirm re-reads the current grid entry and refreshes icon/text, up/down changes the highlighted slot via the item grid, and page-left/right toggles the comparison mode.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_PopPaneAndSetMode
functions.summary: Pops the pane and marks the linked sub-object's mode fields f_10/f_19 for a refresh.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_OnDecideC
functions.summary: Unconditional confirm action of the equip window: resolves the member's candidate item (func_0064EE60), applies it through func_00333760 with slot -1, plays the equip SE and pops the pane, always returning 1 (no predicate).

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_CheckSlotSpace
functions.summary: Counts how many of the six equipment slots are still empty for the current member and pushes either the 'equipped' (1) or the 'bag full' (2) message pane; rebuilds the slot text first when a slot is free.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_PopCurrentPane
functions.summary: Minimal pane pop used by windows that only need to close the current pane.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_BuildCandidateList
functions.summary: Builds the list of equipment that can be swapped in for the selected slot: counts how often each candidate glyph occurs in the six slots, drops entries over the 99/25 limits and pushes the resulting pane.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_Ctor_2
functions.signature: UiEquipWindow* Ui_EquipWindow_Ctor_2(UiEquipWindow* self, unsigned int owner)
functions.summary: Constructor of the equipment window (0x414-byte base): sets the owner back-pointer, initialises nine intrusive list heads, the animators and the nested window/list/actor objects.

functions.name: Field_NpcController_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for Field_NpcController: executes destructor 0x003357F0 to teardown internal sub-objects at offsets +0x2180, +0x1C00, and +0xD18, then frees memory via 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the equipment window: unwinds the two candidate layouts, the actor/list objects and all row nodes, in the exact reverse order of Ui_EquipWindow_Ctor.

functions.name: Err_ThrowFatalErrorWithCode
functions.summary: Builds a 0xF80-byte nn::err FatalErrInfo on the stack, tags its first word with 2, runs the two err:f state helpers (0x51CCF8 / 0x51CD28) and launches the fatal-error applet (0x51CC68).

functions.name: Field_Object_ActivateChildren
functions.summary: One-shot activation of all children in the object's child array (+0x204, count f_224): calls each child's activate slot.

functions.name: Actor_ReleaseAttachedObjects
functions.summary: One-shot release of attached child sprite actors: when self->u8_1F4 is non-zero, clears self->u8_1F4 and invokes virtual slot +0x0C on (child + 0x3C) for all self->f_224 children in self->f_204[].

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild(SpriteActor* self, SpriteTemplate* tmpl, SpriteParams* params, int flag)
functions.summary: Allocates one 0x23C-byte sprite child from the parent's template, copies the frame-rect parameters, stores it in the parent's 8-entry child array (self->f_204, count f_224), links it and returns its index (0xFF when full).

functions.name: Field_Object_ReleaseChildList
functions.summary: Destroys the intrusive child list at f_1fc (calls each child's virtual destructor) and clears the cached span bounds.

functions.name: Field_NpcManager_DeletingDtor

functions.name: Field_Object_DtorBase

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_DestroyObjectBody

functions.name: Item_AddToStorage
functions.signature: u32 Item_AddToStorage(void* gameWork, u32 storageOffset, u32 count, u32 itemId)
functions.summary: Adds items to one of the player's storage buckets: looks the item record up by id, dispatches on the item's category byte (0x25/0x26/0x27 and the id ranges 0x9BF-0xA19, 0xA19-0xA82, 0xA82-0xAA3, 0xAA3-0xB3B) to the matching per-category add routine, otherwise scans the 24 u16 slot ids at +0xEC for a matching slot and finally calls 0x00612008 to append the remaining count.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_CaptureSceneState
functions.summary: Snapshots the current world/camera/party state into the data panel so the panel can display a frozen scene: positions, model ids, day/time and party flags.

functions.name: maybe_Party_WriteSlotRecordFromMaster
functions.signature: void maybe_Party_WriteSlotRecordFromMaster(PartyData* party, int slotIndex, u32 masterRecordId, u8 mode)
functions.summary: Copies a 10-byte record obtained from the master data into one of the two fixed per-slot records of the party block: the destination is party+0x24A98 + slotIndex*10 + 0x31CE and the trailing byte is overwritten with mode. The party-block initialiser sets both records to 0xFF/0xFFFF, so this fills a rarely used two-entry table.

functions.name: Item_RemoveFromParty
functions.signature: int Item_RemoveFromParty(void* work, u32 itemId, int maxCount, int skipSlots)
functions.summary: Removes up to maxCount copies of item id from the party: the '%'-kind item (record +0xC == 0x25) is taken from the global counter at work+0x27C7C, bag items are decremented through the count table at work+0x24ACC, and otherwise the member inventories are scanned and the id is deleted from the first free slots, skipping the six equipped slots; returns how many were removed.

functions.name: Party_Member_SyncOwnedItemsToBitmask
functions.summary: Iterates through the 24 inventory items of a party member (+0xEC) and marks each item ID in the save ownership bitmask (work+0x24A98 + 0x4B30).

functions.name: SaveData_RebuildPartyRoster
functions.summary: Rebuilds all 31 party-member records from the character master records (func_0063F8F0 + Party_Member_InitFromMasterRecord) and, for member 0, walks its 24 inventory item ids, resolving each item and marking the item and its variants in the save ownership bitmask at partyWork+0x24A98+0x4B30.

functions.name: Party_RecalcActiveMembersStats
functions.summary: Iterates through the party roster and invokes Party_Member_RecalculateStats for each member marked active in the save data.

functions.name: Party_GetActiveMemberDataByIndex
functions.signature: int* Party_GetActiveMemberDataByIndex(GameWork* gameWork, int activeIndex, u32 ctx, u32 forwarded)
functions.summary: Returns a pointer to the record of the activeIndex-th member that is currently in the active party (skipping slots whose master character record lacks the in-party bit), or the last scanned slot when the index runs past the end. It is the shared accessor used by shop, equip, party-select, status and battle code to read member data by party position.

functions.name: Party_GetActiveMemberIdByIndex
functions.signature: u32 Party_GetActiveMemberIdByIndex(GameWork* gameWork, int activeIndex, u32 ctx, u32 forwarded)
functions.summary: Returns the character id of the activeIndex-th active party member, or 0xFF when the party holds fewer active members. Battle_DecideFirstStrike uses it to choose which member performs the first-strike animation, while 0x0035F6C0 returns the whole record for the same ordering.

functions.name: SaveData_ResetMemberTriggers
functions.summary: Clears member event trigger flags in save data container.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateFadeTimers
functions.summary: Advances and clamps the window's fade/alpha timers (0x2d540, 0x2dee0, 0x2e1e4, 0x2fb20); when a timer expires it triggers the corresponding callback and decrements the effect counter.

functions.name: Party_UpdateAllMemberRecords
functions.summary: Per-frame pass over the 0x1F party member records at the base of the game work (stride 0x4BB*4 = 0x12EC): re-applies each member's font record, dispatches the member's virtual update with its field at +0xEC and clamps +0x1A between +0x16 and +0xEE; when the current actor changes it restarts the 300-frame timer at work+0x2FB18.

functions.name: Effect_SetupPackInfo
functions.summary: The per-slot effect pack setup: it loads effect_packinfo.epi, validates the frame count and fills the effect animation slot.

functions.name: Effect_ReleaseHandle
functions.signature: void Effect_ReleaseHandle(void* effectManager, u32 handle, int immediate)
functions.summary: Releases an effect instance by its packed 20-bit handle: removes it from the manager's list/tree, tears down its sub-effects and frees the object.

functions.name: Effect_CreateScaledInstance
functions.signature: void Effect_CreateScaledInstance(void* effectManager, u32 effectId, u32 flags, float* position, u32 scaleKey)
functions.summary: Builds an effect spawn descriptor at a position with a scale multiplier and forwards it to maybe_Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.

functions.name: Effect_FindOrCreateInstance
functions.signature: u32 Effect_FindOrCreateInstance(EffectManager* self, u32 key, int type, u32* params, u8 flag)
functions.summary: Binary-searches the effect manager's keyed tree for a 16-bit effect key and, when the node is enabled, allocates and initialises a 0x98-byte effect instance from the template words, links it into the active list and returns its handle.

functions.name: Effect_RequestInstance
functions.signature: u32 Effect_RequestInstance(EffectManager* mgr, int index, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Requests one effect instance for a slot: finds the slot's pack through Pack_ObjectTable_FindByClass, records the request stamp/frame count and hands the slot to Effect_SetupPackInfo; returns 1 when the slot is ready.

functions.name: Pack_HandleTable_ReleaseObjects
functions.summary: Releases the object lists associated with a pack-handle table (the 0x18 ref list and the 0x2c object list), destroying each entry's virtual object.

functions.name: Pack_HandleTable_UpdateRelease
functions.summary: Countdown-driven release of a pack batch: when the timer expires it unregisters handle 0, destroys the tagged objects and returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EffectSlot_Release
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_EffectSlot_Release(void* self, int slot, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Releases one reference-counted slot: decrements the count at self+slot*0x10+0xA8 and, when it reaches zero, clears the resource through 0x0055DBB0, removes every list entry keyed by that slot from the two keyed lists and the handle list, destroys the nodes and releases the slot's draw handle. Returns 1 when the slot was actually released.

functions.name: Pack_HandleTable_Acquire
functions.summary: Acquires the pack handle for one of the table's fixed slots and stores it in the slot.

functions.name: Pack_HandleTable_ReleaseAll
functions.summary: Releases every pack handle and object owned by the table: 26 slot handles plus the intrusive object list.

functions.name: Pack_HandleTable_Add
functions.signature: int Pack_HandleTable_Add(PackHandleTable* table, u32* name, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Registers a pack handle in the first free slot (7..0x18): resolves the pack id, increments its refcount, records the size and returns the slot index.

functions.name: Pack_HandleTable_LoadCommon
functions.summary: Loads the common 2D pack (id 0x6a1) into the table, scheduling its release and registering the handle.

functions.name: Battle_CutsceneObject_Init
functions.signature: void Battle_CutsceneObject_Init(BattleCutscene* self, u32 id, u32 flags, int* params)
functions.summary: Initialises a battle cutscene object: reserves its resource handles from the '.btcs' name, registers the paired TCS scene data and sets up the animation and intrusive-list state.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CutsceneObject_InitAlias
functions.summary: 12-byte entry point that Ghidra merged into 0x00360BC0; it is an alias/thunk of the battle cutscene initialiser rather than a distinct function.

functions.name: maybe_Container_Map_DestroyLoopTail
functions.summary: Internal loop tail of a std::map/std::set teardown: erases the current red-black-tree node (std_RbTree_EraseNode at 0x0010EC14), releases stored object through its virtual slot, and restores stack frame.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CutsceneObject_InitFromParams
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_CutsceneObject_InitFromParams(BattleCutscene* self, u32 id, int arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initializes battle cutscene animation object: creates sprite actor from table and binds keyframe tracks.

functions.name: maybe_Container_Map_DestroyLoopTailB
functions.summary: Second teardown tail of the same map/dictionary class: walks remaining tree nodes with rb-tree helpers (0x0010EBE4, 0x00115390, 0x00115358), destroys attached object at [node+0xC] and returns to common epilogue.

functions.name: maybe_Container_Map_DestroyLoopTailC
functions.summary: Third teardown tail for map/dictionary class: erases node via std_RbTree_EraseNode (0x0010EC14), calls stored object virtual destructor (+4) and jumps back to shared epilogue.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectNodeList_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a node-list container: installs vtable 0x764B98, initialises two intrusive node lists (+0x14 and +0x24) and builds a 26-entry array of 4-byte node handles at +0x38. Its destructor walks the node list, destroys each node and releases the container's pack handles, which fits an effect/resource instance list.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectNodeList_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the effect-node list object: invokes Gfx_EffectNodeList_Dtor to release playbacks and intrusive list nodes, then frees the object memory via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Gfx_EffectNodeList_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the effect-node list: stops the two effect playbacks (0x3602E8/0x360720), deletes every node of the intrusive list through the allocator pair, clears the embedded 0x1A-entry slot array and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteActor_PlayAnim
functions.summary: Refreshes the actor's model record and starts the shared default animation (g_actorDefaultAnimName at 0x00725900) on the animator at self+0xB8; a very small helper with no state handling.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_InitFromRecord
functions.summary: Creates the sprite actor's animation object from a record (sprite id, size, flags) and binds it to the actor.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteSceneNode_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (vtable slot 0) of the sprite/scene-node class: runs its destructor body and frees the object.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_SetAnim
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteActor_SetAnim(GfxSpriteActor* sprite, int animIndex, int loop)
functions.summary: Switches the sprite's animation to animIndex (or the default when 0) and optionally jumps to the last frame.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelPart_InitAnimated
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelPart_InitAnimated(void* self, const void* params)
functions.summary: Initializes one animated model part from parameter block: sets model size, applies sprite animation instance, and attaches sprite child.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite_InvokeEventHandler
functions.summary: Slot 29 of the Gfx sprite scene-node vtable 0x00764C6C (whose slot 1 is the confident Gfx_Sprite_CreateInstance): gates on the global handler-registry entry at 0x0072840C selected by self->f_2A0, then calls self->f_29C(self->f_2A0, self->f_2A4, self) and returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_DeletingDtorF
functions.summary: Deleting destructor in the 0x36xxxx sprite-actor block: installs the vtable plus its +0x98 secondary, unlinks the embedded base node at +0x24C and runs Field_Object_DtorBase; Ghidra truncates the listing at a bad instruction, so the final free is not visible here.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite_DeleteThunk
functions.summary: Eight-byte tail thunk whose only instruction is 'b 0x0010F6CC', the shared operator-delete dispatcher; the preceding function in the same class has already released the sprite body, so this is the deleting-destructor entry.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_CameraFocusTask
functions.summary: Overlay state machine (state at f_297) that centres the camera on an overlay target: nudges the camera offset (+0xC4/+0xC8) until the target is framed, shows/hides the element classes through Ui_Overlay_ShowElementClass/HideElementClass, plays SE 0x104 and finally fades the overlay out.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_RefreshTaskModel
functions.summary: When the overlay task is in one of its visible states (self->f_297 == 2 or 3), re-creates its model from the stored ids (f_b4/f_b0) and refreshes the priority byte on the current field object manager entry (work+0x54 -> +0x20 -> f_b8).

functions.name: Field_SpriteObject_InitFromRecord
functions.summary: Creates a field sprite object (billboard/2D actor) from a placement record: reads position/size/flags, builds the 'sprite' anim and adds it to the scene part list.

functions.name: Field_SpriteObject_ResetState
functions.summary: Resets the sprite object's state timer and clears the HUD/overlay hidden flag.

functions.name: Actor2D_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Actor2D_Ctor(u32 owner, int* params, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor of the Actor2D scene object: allocates the instance through 0x0028E630 with the 0x4000000C size tag, installs the class descriptor 0x00764D20 at +0x00 and its sub-descriptor at +0x22C, then resets the id/flags/scales (+0x297 = 0, +0x298 = 0xFFFF, +0x29A = 0xFF, +0x29C/+0x2A0 from 0x007BE2D4, +0x2A4 = 4, +0x2A8/+0x2AC = 0.0f).

functions.name: Field_SpriteObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor: unlinks the object from its base, destroys the embedded object and frees it.

functions.name: Field_SpriteObject_UpdateFollow
functions.summary: Keeps the sprite object attached to its owner actor: triggers the follow command once, then copies the owner's position plus the stored offset each frame.

functions.name: Field_SpriteObject_CaptureOffset
functions.summary: Records the offset between the sprite object and its owner actor so the follow update can maintain it.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelPart_InitFromParams
functions.summary: Sets a model part's colour/scale/position from a parameter block and creates its mesh and material object.

functions.name: Field_SpriteObject_SetOffset
functions.signature: u32 Field_SpriteObject_SetOffset(FieldSpriteObject* object, u32* offset, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Sets the follow offset and triggers the follow command (0x17) on the owner actor.

functions.name: maybe_Actor2D_CtorWithSprite
functions.signature: void* maybe_Actor2D_CtorWithSprite(u32 owner, int* params, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructs larger 2D actor variant: installs vtable 0x00764DDC and copies transform vectors from 0x007E7000.

functions.name: Actor2DNode_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the 2D actor class: calls its destructor body (0x0028EFB4) and frees the memory.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_InitFromParams
functions.summary: Initialises a screen-space overlay from its creation descriptor: sets the visible/initialised byte at +0x2AD, splits the packed descriptor word into +0x2B0/+0x2B4 and refills the parameter block from party-member work slot 10 before committing.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_SyncToActor
functions.summary: Event hook: event 6 clears task+0x2AD; event 4 resolves the camera object (work+0x54+0x20), destroys pending objects, sets task+0x2AD=1, copies its f_78/f_7C position, optionally moves it with maybe_Gfx_Actor_SetPosition3D when task+0x298 differs from f_AC, picks the anchor point from task+0x2AC (0/2/4/6 -> f_2B0/f_29C), runs maybe_Ui_Overlay_UpdateAnchorPath and then re-looks-up the object through the class hash table.

functions.name: Field_Object_InitSpriteFromParams
functions.summary: Initialises a field object's sprite from a 17-short parameter block (position, size, colour, model id, variant), resolves the model table entry and attaches the sprite as a child of the object's node.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_NotifyCommand14
functions.summary: When the scene/UI mode byte (work+8 -> +0x48 -> +0x281) equals 0x0A it sends field-gadget command 0x14 for this overlay task's placement id, then always returns 0.

functions.name: Field_SpriteObject_DtorAlt
functions.summary: Second deleting destructor thunk of the same sprite-object class: installs the vtable, unlinks and destroys the sprite actor at +0x24C and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateBreakState
functions.summary: Per-frame break/visibility step (vtable slot 2 of 0x00765044): returns 0 while the hold timer at +0x51 is set; otherwise, if a break is pending and the model is live, it calls the actor's vtable +0x40 and +0x58 with parameter 4 and returns 1.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ForwardAnimEvent
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_ForwardAnimEvent(FieldActor* actor, int eventId, u32 data)
functions.summary: Forwards an animation event to the actor's attached model/part controller and, for event 6, refreshes the actor's visibility state.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_OnModelReady
functions.summary: After a model/attachment becomes available: resolves the object handle, validates the handle at +0xB3, and when the ready flag +0x2C8 is set calls the actor's two visibility slots with mode 4 and applies the visibility state.

functions.name: Field_Actor_SwitchVisibilityState
functions.summary: Switches the actor's visible part set: two virtual calls (vtable+0x40(4), vtable+0x58(4)) and actor[0xAD]=0, then either enables the three part objects at +0x9E/+0xB5/+0xC8 (func_0017C02C) and toggles the scene entry pair at +0xDA/+0x171 according to byte 0x2C9, or disables them all (func_0017C040) when bytes 0x2CA/0xB2 are set.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ApplyVisibilityState
functions.summary: Applies the actor's visibility state to its second set of part handles: sets f_2C9 from the UI overlay mode byte (context+0x281 == 7), and when both f_2C8 and f_2CA are clear it shows the f_278/f_2D4/0x320 parts and enables the scene entry at +0x368 or at +0x5C4 depending on f_2C9; otherwise it disables both scene entries.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelPart_InitWithTransforms
functions.summary: Initialises a model part that needs explicit local transforms: copies the parameter block, builds four transform matrices/quaternions, creates the mesh through Gfx_CreateMeshObjectByParams and adds the colour animator.

functions.name: Field_Actor_PlayBreakEffect
functions.summary: Plays the 'Break' effect and animation on a party actor: creates the 'N_ALL' effect at the actor position, switches the action sequence to Break and flags the actor.

functions.name: Field_SpriteObject_DtorBody
functions.summary: Destructor body of the field sprite object: re-stamps the two embedded vtables (0x00764F90 and its +0xD4 base) and tears the members down in reverse construction order - handle release, two sprite destructors, two Ui_Object bodies, the pack handle and the two tail members - before freeing.

functions.name: Field_Actor_IsModelActionDone
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the actor's model animation/action has finished (or when it is the currently controlled model), otherwise 0.

functions.name: Field_Actor_InitFromPlacementRecord
functions.summary: Creates the actor's model/anim from a placement record (model id, size, flags) and starts the 'Break' effect; used by the field scene spawn-by-type helpers.

functions.name: maybe_Model_AnimInstance_CreateTail
functions.summary: Tail fragment of actor model setup: creates a sprite animation instance via Anim_Instance_CtorSprite (0x002D1F28) and stores it in self->f_B8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_SetupModelParts
functions.summary: Continuation of actor model setup: applies animation template (Anim_Instance_ApplyTemplate at 0x002D1304), binds model to actor, applies placement size (Field_SceneObject_SetModelSize at 0x005F3500) and creates color animator.

functions.name: Field_Object_PlayDefaultAnim
functions.summary: Plays the object's default animation (the shared id from func_00590504(1)) and, depending on hide, either plays SE 0xA4 through the lazily created 0x1EB0-byte sound manager or snaps the animator to its last frame and tells the object (vtable +0x40) to enter state 4; finally sets state 4 through vtable +0x58 and clears self[0xA2].

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_OnBreakCommand
functions.summary: Mode-dependent actor reaction: when the UI overlay mode byte (work+0x48 -> +0x281) is not 7 it fires event command 0x18 through the event state; otherwise it plays the actor's default animation and returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_StartHide
functions.summary: Snaps the window's two animation objects to their start values, sets the hide countdown at +0xB0 to -1 and stores the vtable pointer at +0, i.e. it puts the window into the hidden state. The body is damaged (unaff_r4 carries the real self), so the class and the exact role stay unproven.

functions.name: Field_Actor_PlayBreakEffectAll
functions.summary: Second Break-effect variant that spawns the 'N_ALL' effect with the default scale/rotation descriptor and switches the actor to Break.

functions.name: Field_Actor_SetPlacement
functions.summary: Applies a placement record to an actor: position, rotation, model id and draw flags, then registers it with the renderer.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_CheckModelAction
functions.summary: Per-frame check: if the actor's model reports the end of its action, it switches the actor back to state 4.

functions.name: Field_Actor_DtorBody
functions.summary: Actor destructor body: installs vtables, unlinks and destroys the embedded sprite/anim objects and frees the actor.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorPart_DtorBody
functions.summary: Destructor body (vtable 0x00765244 slot 1; slot 0 is maybe_Field_ActorPart_DeletingDtor) of a small part object attached to an owner actor at self+0x28: it asks the owner to detach the part named "Nut" through owner->vt[+0x84](owner, "Nut") and caches owner+0x37C (a float, per the sibling update at vtable+0x0C) into self+0x2C.

functions.name: Ui_ActionPane_AnimCtor
functions.signature: void* Ui_ActionPane_AnimCtor(void* owner, u32 actionId, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d)
functions.summary: Derived constructor for an action-pane animator: runs the base Ui_ActionPane_Init, overwrites the vptr with 0x00765240, stores the action id at +0x28 and the float 0.26f (0x3E851EB8) at +0x2C.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorPart_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of actor sub-part: runs base destructor func_00193E44 and frees object via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_UpdateHide
functions.summary: Per-frame hide update: counts the delay at +0xB0 down and, when it expires, snaps the tween at +0x60 and the anim at +0x58 to their start values and sets +0xB0 to -1; then updates both animation objects (self+8 and +0x60) through 0x003DFEC4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_ApplyVisibility
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ShopWindow_ApplyVisibility(void* window, const u8* request)
functions.summary: Applies a show/hide request to the window: byte 3 of the request hides it, byte 4 arms the delayed hide with the delay from 0x007AABEC, otherwise it animates the window in; it then snaps the second animation object and sets the countdown to -1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartSlot_InitTwoAnimParts
functions.summary: Initialises the two animation references a UI part needs from a record's two adjacent anim ids (0x364960 and 0x364968): looks each up, stores them at slot+4 and slot+0x5C, initialises the owning widget and binds both clips through Ui_AnimRef_Bind; the second slot's f_74 flag decides whether f_7C is cleared.

functions.name: Ui_Window_LayoutChildren
