functions.signature: void Ui_Window_LayoutChildren(UiWindow* self, u32 rows, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Lays out a compound window: runs the base row layout, forwards the row arguments to five sub-widgets and then applies the callback to both child lists at +0x2240/+0x2298.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_AccumulateChildState
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_SceneNode_AccumulateChildState(void* self, u32* outState, u32 context, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Walks the two intrusive child lists (self+0x04 and self+0x5C) and, for every child whose flag byte +0x11 has bit 0 set and whose vtable slot +0x08 does not return the class tag 0x007AE8A0, folds the child into outState[1] through 0x0053CD1C. That helper builds the closure {predicate 0x00537E70, accumulator, extra, context} and runs 0x006EF5AC, a subtree walk that tests each node with the predicate (node+0x44 bit 1 and node+0x45).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_AttachPanels
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_AttachPanels(void* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Attaches the window's five embedded animation/panel objects to a layout and registers the frame-callback node at self+0x22F4.

functions.name: maybe_Container_IntrusiveList_InsertNode
functions.signature: void maybe_Container_IntrusiveList_InsertNode(void* self, void* owner, u32* value)
functions.summary: Splices node embedded in self into intrusive list anchored at owner+0xC4 and stores two-word value (ptr + flags) into node.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartSlot_InitEmbedded
functions.summary: Constructs an embedded object with two animation-ref lists: stores the vtable/owner words, builds the first list at +8 and the second at +0x60, links both intrusive list heads to themselves and copies the default timing/owner pair; returns the base 0x58 bytes before the argument.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EmbeddedObject_Reset
functions.summary: Resets an embedded UI object: installs the caller-supplied vtable at +0xB4, re-links the circular list head at +0xB8, copies the two-word descriptor 0x0072B384 to +0xC8 and releases the two animation-ref lists at +0x60 and +0x08; returns the object base.

functions.name: Ui_ShopItemList_PopulateRows
functions.summary: Fills the twelve visible list rows of a shop/equipment list: for every visible entry it writes the item name, the price string, the icon and the owned/equipped marker through the row provider's virtual text setters, using the row text-id pattern (row<<16 | 0xC/0x12/0x1E/0x20).

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentListWindow_SetVisible
functions.summary: Shared visibility override for the equipment-list window family: calls Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim(self, visible) and, only when becoming visible and the sub-object pointer at +0x54 is set, tail-calls the object's own vtable +0x60 (the refresh slot).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipmentListWindow_InitPanes_2
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipmentListWindow_InitPanes_2(UiWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Builds a paged list whose rows have four columns - index (txt_lN), name (txt_eN), number (txt_numN) and right-hand value (txt_rN) - plus pager_num_r/pager_num_l and a digit-incrementing row generator.

functions.name: Ui_ItemMenu_Row_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the small item-list row/entry object used by the item menu, shop, casino and item-list cores; initialises the UI object base and the three state flags.

functions.name: Ui_ItemMenu_Row_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the item-list row object (base destructor plus free).

functions.name: Ui_JewelShopWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds the jewel (orb) shop window from 'jewel_shop_msg.bxon': gold display, the 'win_houjyu_select' list, and the talk/yesno message pair.

functions.name: Ui_JewelShopWindow_UpdateSelect
functions.signature: void Ui_JewelShopWindow_UpdateSelect(UiJewelShopWindow* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Updates the jewel-shop orb selection list: passes the cursor position to the list widget and, when a confirm/cancel bit is set, updates the gold display and closes the selection.

functions.name: Container_Queue_PopFront
functions.summary: Pops the front element of a fixed-stride queue: returns the first word, shifts the remaining 0x1C bytes down by one slot and clears the count/tail at +0x20.

functions.name: Ui_Part_UpdateWithCallback
functions.summary: Part update: calls the part's own virtual slot 0x2C, then either ticks the part tween at part+0x1F38 against part+0x128 while the completion test says 'not finished', or dispatches the deferred callback stored as a function/offset pair at part+0x144/+0x148.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AdvancePage
functions.summary: Advances the message window to its next page: when the page animation is not running it selects page 6; otherwise it scrolls the text by the current line height and re-applies the status text.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JewelShopWindow_OpenSelect
functions.summary: Opens the jewel-shop select pane: forces the sub-pane at +0x1B8 visible, refreshes the selection list at +0x230/+0x1D0 and installs the update callback pair {Ui_JewelShopWindow_UpdateSelect, 0} at +0x144. It ignores the incoming argument, so it is an 'open', not a visibility setter.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_PreparePage
functions.summary: Stores item 0x2C's +0x18 field in self+0x14C and formats work+0x2A2C4 as a number into the shared message buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BigWindow_SetFlag
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_BigWindow_SetFlag(void* self, u32 arg2, u8 value)
functions.summary: Sets one byte of the window's per-instance flag block at self+0x1F94 after touching the active sub-object of the widget at self+0x23C.

functions.name: Ui_BigWindow_CtorBase
functions.summary: Base constructor for the large message/big window: builds the window core, the pane set, the text object, the tween/instrusive lists and the message list, returning the object at its base offset.

functions.name: Ui_JewelShopWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 1) of the jewel-shop window; runs the window destructor body 0x00366294/0x00366298 and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_JewelShopWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the jewel shop window: releases the seven embedded tween/list members and the message page at +0x779, then frees the object.

functions.name: Field_CollisionObject_Init
functions.summary: Adds the standard 'collision' child object to a field actor and wires its collision shape callbacks and shared transform.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SlotWindow_ResetSlotActors
functions.summary: Resets the window's two animated slot sub-objects (+0x160 and +0x220) to their idle state: restarts each action sequence through Anim_ActionSeq_StartForActor, steps the actor animation to frame 1, re-points its +0x528, clears the visibility toggles and marks the window dirty at +0x2F4.

functions.name: Field_HorseMesh_Init
functions.summary: Creates and configures the horse mount mesh for a field actor (meshHorse), attaching it to the actor's layout and applying the layout config.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectSlot_ResetPlayback
functions.summary: Resets the nested scene/effect parameter block at self+0x26C to its defaults and raises the two restart flags at +0x2C8 and +0x2F4.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_ClearHandles
functions.summary: Stops and forgets the emitter's four voice handles and stores the enabled flag.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_UpdateTransform
functions.summary: Rebuilds the emitter's orientation/position matrix from its rotation angles so positional SE/voice calls use the current transform.

functions.name: Ui_JewelShopWindow_UpdateFade
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the jewel-shop window: toggles the pane visibility flag and re-evaluates the size/position of the two fade panels.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_PlaySe
functions.signature: void Sound_Emitter_PlaySe(SoundEmitter* emitter, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Plays the SE id returned by the emitter's virtual +0xcc (when sound is enabled) at the emitter position.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_PlayVoice
functions.summary: Starts or stops the emitter's voice line: resolves the voice SE id from the owner, plays it with the current position and stores the handle.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_UpdateHorseSe
functions.summary: Horse-riding SE update: stops the old gallop loops and starts the walk/gallop loop when the horse speed crosses the threshold.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_PlaySeAt
functions.signature: void Sound_Emitter_PlaySeAt(SoundEmitter* emitter, u32 position, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Plays SE id 2 from the owner at an explicit position (used for one-shot action sounds).

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_PlayLoopingEffect
functions.summary: Creates a looping 'N_ALL' effect attached to the emitter and records its handle; used for continuous action effects.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_UpdateLoopingEffect
functions.summary: Updates the looping effect/SE position with the emitter transform and applies the special animation when the state flag has bit 1.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_UpdateSizeAndPos
functions.signature: void Ui_Pane_UpdateSizeAndPos(UiWindow* self, UiPane* pane, UiPaneCache* cache)
functions.summary: Copies the pane's name/rect/frame state into a cache block, applies the pane's "H,W" size key and position, and clears the pane's pending size field.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_StopHandleSlot
functions.signature: void Sound_Emitter_StopHandleSlot(SoundEmitter* emitter, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Stops the emitter's action, releases the effect handle and clears the slot.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_ReleaseEffect
functions.summary: Releases the effect instance currently held in the actor's effect slot.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_SetPositionAndDirection
functions.signature: void Sound_Emitter_SetPositionAndDirection(SoundEmitter* self, u32* position, float* direction)
functions.summary: Places a 3D sound emitter at a world position and orients it along a direction, normalising the direction unless it is degenerate, then commits the transform so attached sounds follow the actor. It is the position/orientation setter used by the actor part updates that own sound emitters.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_PlayStepSe
functions.summary: Footstep effect: picks SE id 0x4f0 (walk) or 0x4f2 (run), attaches the 'N_ALL' effect at the foot position and starts the matching voice/step sound.

functions.name: Ui_Part_UpdateCursorRepeat
functions.summary: Shared cursor auto-repeat for UI parts: queries the pressed/repeat flags for `input`, and on a repeat with the edge flag f_275 not yet consumed it advances the part index f_9C (wrapping at the core's row count - 1), resets the sub-cursor fields f_A6..f_A8, calls the change slots +0xC8/+0xC4 and records the edge.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_SetEffectSlot
functions.signature: void Sound_Emitter_SetEffectSlot(SoundEmitter* emitter, u32 handle, int slot, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Stores a newly created effect handle into one of the emitter's effect slots, releasing the previous handle in that slot first.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_PlayLandSe
functions.summary: Plays the landing effect/SE ('N_ALL' effect at the emitter position) used when the horse lands.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_ReleaseEffectSlot
functions.summary: Releases the actor's effect slot and restores the saved visibility flag.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_UpdateVoices
functions.summary: Maintains the emitter's voice/SE handles each frame: counts down the voice start delay, starts/stops the held voice and updates the positions of active handles.

functions.name: Sound_Emitter_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame emitter update: refreshes the transform/effect, starts or stops the looping effect depending on state and then updates all voices.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CtorWithDefaults
functions.signature: void* Field_SceneObject_CtorWithDefaults(u32 owner, int* params, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructs a scene object with the default part/colour data: allocates through the sprite-slot allocator with flag 0x20000000, installs vtable 0x765340, copies the two eight-word default tables, and fills the id/flag/scale fields and the empty handle sentinels.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor helper: stores base descriptor into object, calls scene-object destructor 0x005F8528 and frees memory via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_NumPanel_BindNumPane
functions.summary: Binds the single pane named 'num' of the passed layout to the widget at self+0x4C through Ui_AnimRef_Bind; nothing else is initialised.

functions.name: Ui_TimerDisplayPart_Ctor
functions.summary: In-place constructor of a tiny Ui_Object-derived part that owns one animation-reference list at +0x4C; Ui_TimerDisplay_Ctor instantiates it twice inside the countdown display.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small embedded UI sub-object: stamps its vtable, releases the 0x50-byte pane at +0x4C and the list, then frees. Same four-line template as 0x00383724/0x00398B7C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_DtorBase
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor twin of 0x0036813C for the same embedded sub-object (same body without the free).

functions.name: Ui_ScreenFade_Setup
functions.summary: Initialises a screen-fade object from the current display brightness and the UI core settings, storing the start/end/target values.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenFade_Update
functions.summary: Advances a screen fade toward its target, applying the brightness delta to the two screen faders and forwarding it to the UI core.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_ReleaseScene
functions.summary: Releases the current child screen: calls Ui_ReleaseChildScreen on Ui_GetCore()->f_14 and does nothing else.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_BeginClose
functions.summary: Starts closing the guide window: reads the two scroll positions through the view object's +0x48 slot, applies them to the two scroll widgets, then clears the done flag at self+4 and arms the 150-frame close delay at self+8.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_UpdateClose
functions.signature: void Ui_GuideWindow_UpdateClose(UiGuideWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Counts the guide window's close delay down while the done flag at self+4 is clear and, when the counter at self+8 goes below zero, releases the child screen through the UI core and sets the done flag.

functions.name: Scene_TransitionSequence_ReleaseChildScreen
functions.summary: Final step of the scene transition sequence: releases the current child screen by calling Ui_ReleaseChildScreen on Ui_GetCore()->f_14. Byte-identical to 0x0036855C, which fills the same slot of the guide-window class.

functions.name: Scene_TransitionSequence_Setup
functions.summary: Initialises the scene transition sequence: copies the scene's transition flag ((work+8)->f_3D, with -1 meaning 1) into +0x10, kicks the named Battle_UpdateEncounterTransition once, then sets the state to 0, the frame counter to 1 and the 120-frame delay at +0xC.

functions.name: Scene_TransitionSequence_Update
functions.summary: State machine that drives a scene transition: state 0 waits for the named Battle_UpdateEncounterTransition to report finished, state 1 reads the two layer values from Ui_GetCore()->f_14 and slides both layers to them, state 2 counts the 120-frame delay down and then releases the layer owner through 0x002D2564 before switching to state 3.

functions.name: Ui_LoadingWindow_Init
functions.summary: Loads the 'win_loading' layout into the window and starts the loading animation.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_ReleaseChild
functions.summary: Releases the window's child screen/object and resets its state pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_UpdateActorChild
functions.summary: Window virtual (slot 4) that ticks attached 3D actor (+0x98) through its own virtual and updates embedded actor-node block at +0x184.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyActorProjection
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyActorProjection(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, void* outMatrix, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Window virtual (slot 7): builds a projection matrix for the attached 3D actor, reads the node transform, selects one of two stored frustum constants for mode 2/3, fills the matrix and applies it to the node.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the guide window: allocates the 0x138-byte object, installs the class vtable, initialises three circular list heads and constructs the embedded message object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_DtorB
functions.summary: Destructor of the guide window: releases the message object and the tween at +0x184, destroys the page list and frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Creates the four guide-window panes plus the 'win_guide' root, numbering each pane by incrementing the id string.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_RefreshMemberRows
functions.summary: Refreshes the four party rows of the guide window: queries the active party member count (0x00643504), sets or clears each row's active bit, and for active rows fetches the i-th active member (0x0035F6C0), initialises the row's embedded HP gauge with that member's character id, stamps the row with the frame counter and calls Battle_HpGaugeWindow_SetMember/Update.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_LayoutRowSlot
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_LayoutRowSlot(void* self, void* rowParams, void* row)
functions.summary: Lays out one row of a window: publishes row parameter block into row[0x183], invokes row layout virtual +0x24 using self+0x98, then clears pointer.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_CtorB
functions.summary: Constructor of the guide window that displays the four party member rows: it runs the common window constructor, installs vtable 0x765554 (InitPanes slot 0x00368BC8 creates the numbered panes plus the 'win_guide' root) and constructs the four 0x260-byte member rows at +0x11C.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the guide window: resets the vtable, re-links its list head, destroys the four 0x260-byte member rows and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_Label_SetFormatArgs
functions.summary: Fills a label from an item id: writes the two debug trace strings, releases the old args, looks the item record up, formats its name with Text_FormatMessageArg into message arg 5, copies the 0xDC-byte working buffer into the slot and clears the pending flag.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_ChangePage
functions.summary: Page-change handler of the guide window: advances the page counter and pushes the page-number message. The decompiled body is partly destroyed (unaff_r6/r7, halt_baddata, an overlapping battle-row loop), so only the page-change role is trustworthy.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_Sequence_CreateAndPlaySeTail
functions.summary: Tail of a four-iteration loop that creates animation sequences and plays sound effects per slot, then restores frame.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Timer_ResetToDefaults
functions.summary: Releases running gadget command at +0x54 and copies two default words from constant block at 0x00369394 into self+8/+0xC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_InitPageCounter
functions.summary: Initialises guide window's page counter/layout from shared table entry and stores resulting state id.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_Update
functions.summary: Releases the previous text layout, rebuilds the guide text from the current message and refreshes the window's title/subtitle strings.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_ReleasePageNode
functions.summary: Releases guide window's current page node using message id from Ui_GuideWindow_GetPageMessageId (0x0064385C) and sets text via Ui_GuideWindow_SetTextFromMessage (0x003A8948).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_IncrementPageCounter
functions.summary: Guide-window page step: increments the page counter at self+0x178 and, when the scroll object at self+0x44 exists, refreshes the row list and re-applies Ui_GuideWindow_SetPageValue(self+0x44, self+0x17C); then copies the style pair from 0x007292B0.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_HandlePageInput
functions.signature: void Ui_GuideWindow_HandlePageInput(UiGuideWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Page up/down handler of the guide text: when the window has more than one page (f_17C > 1) and a scroll object (f_44) it moves the current page (f_178) by the signed direction in f_3E, wrapping between the first and last page when f_40 allows it, animates the scroll object and clears the pending message flag.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_UpdatePageMetrics
functions.signature: void Ui_GuideWindow_UpdatePageMetrics(GuideWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Measures the current guide page: sums the per-line heights of the two line lists (f_20/f_10, 8-byte entries), finds the line that overflows the visible height at UI+0x27C88 and pushes the page number/label through 0x003691FC (page 3 uses the 'last page' variant).

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_BuildPageContent
functions.summary: Builds the visible content of one guide page: walks the page's 4-byte element list, and for each entry either builds a normal text row or, for entry ids in the 0xa19..0xa81 range, a recipe row, finally attaching the 'medalstamp' sprite when the page is a medal page.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_NextPage
functions.summary: Moves to the next guide page: increments the page index while it is below the page count, builds the new page, and when the last page is reached it either closes the window or keeps the counter on the final page.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_CloseCurrentPage
functions.signature: void Ui_GuideWindow_CloseCurrentPage(GuideWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Closes the current guide page: releases the page element container (0x003A9368 on f_44/f_178), chooses the 'last page' or normal page label (id 10) and tells the guide handler to drop the page index.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_CreateBackgroundSprite
functions.summary: Creates the guide window's background sprite: releases the old handle, builds a 0x220-byte sprite (vtable 0x7737B0) from the fixed descriptor, registers it in the actor list, stores its handle in f_184 and sets the sprite's render modes to 3.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_SelectPageFitLabel
functions.signature: void Ui_GuideWindow_SelectPageFitLabel(GuideWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Sums the heights of the lines up to the current page index (8-byte lines at f_178), compares with the visible height UI+0x27C88 and selects the 'fits' or 'overflow' label variant for self->f_C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SetValueAndPlaySe11
functions.summary: Mechanical helper: requests SE 0x0B through the sound command queue and copies the two dwords of the global result block at 0x0036A144 into self+8 and self+0xC.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_LayoutPage
functions.summary: Lays out the current guide page: measures the used height of the f_20 lines, finds the overflowing line, stores the resulting text range (start/end widths) into the page element at self+0x5C (5-word stride) and refreshes the page counter label.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_UpdateState
functions.summary: State machine for opening/closing the guide window: waits for the page-change animation and the parent screen to become ready, then notifies the caller.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_CommitPendingPage
functions.summary: Commits the guide window's pending page: binds the stored pane (f_58) into the message-window slot at f_4C+0x1E18, marks the message window dirty (f_94 = 1) and invokes its layout virtual at f_11C+0x78.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_SelectPageAction
functions.summary: Chooses the guide window's next pending action from whether the current page's text fits: when it fits it schedules Ui_GuideWindow_NextPage, when it overflows it schedules Ui_GuideWindow_LayoutPage, and in the scroll modes it schedules the page-input handler; the chosen pair is stored in self+8 (handler) and self+0xC (argument, always 0).

functions.name: Ui_StampBookWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: UiStampBookWindow* Ui_StampBookWindow_Ctor(UiStampBookWindow* window, u8 mode, u8 tab)
functions.summary: Constructor of the stamp-book/guide window that loads the stamp message/page/reward BXON tables and builds the page parts.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StampBookWindow_SetupPageRows
functions.summary: Builds stamp-book page: refreshes child list windows (Ui_List_SetupRowWindows at 0x003A8D80), sets message text (Ui_GuideWindow_SetTextFromMessage at 0x003A8948), and starts pooled page effect (Ui_Effect_InitPooled at 0x003A89D4). Real code starts at 0x0036AD70 (ARM); batch address is 2 bytes early.

functions.name: Ui_StampBookWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 1) of the stamp-book window; runs 0x0036B248 (window destructor) and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_StampBookWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the stamp-book window: reinstalls vtable 0x007655A4, releases the five part handles at +0x44..+0x54, the model handle taken from work+0x54, resets the draw group, clears the two gfx-context flags and releases the pack handles.

functions.name: Ui_NodeList_Register
functions.signature: UiNode* Ui_NodeList_Register(UiNode* node, u8 priority, u16 id)
functions.summary: Registers a UI node in the global priority-sorted node list (higher priority first) used by every window root; returns the node.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_NodeList_CreateChildSlots
functions.summary: Creates the eighteen child panes of a list widget - ids 0..8 and 10..18 (9 is skipped) combined with the owner id in the high half (self+0x28 << 16) - through 0x001A6680, then fills them from the supplied UTF-16 string (wcslen 0x00100B74, std_wcsncpy, std_wcsncat, Str_WcsStr, std_memcpy) and plays the layout animation (Ui_Pane_PlayLayoutAnim).

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnTextWindow_InitPanes_2
functions.summary: Creates a two-column text grid: nine left rows 'txt_1_1..9' and nine right rows 'txt_2_1..9'.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorVariant
functions.summary: Small UI-object destructor variant: installs the vtable, runs the base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Actor_PlayDirectionalAnimationFromBasis
functions.summary: Converts the actor's 2x2 rotation basis (f_8C..f_98) into a facing vector, classifies it into one of four directions and plays the matching animation on the attached scene node (f_260).

functions.name: Actor_UpdateTurnAnimation
functions.summary: Turn-toward-target update: compares the node's facing basis with the normalised direction to the target, plays the TurnR or TurnL animation through the node's animation-by-name slot (+0x84) and, once the remaining angle is under the threshold, builds the corrective quaternion and pushes the new facing to the tracked effect part.

functions.name: maybe_Field_HorseAction_CommitTransform
functions.summary: Copies the action's two words at +0x30/+0x34 into the actor at +0x138/+0x13c, resets the actor's sub-object field (+0x160->+0x4c8 = +0x4ec), and when the +0x38/+0x39 flags are set deactivates the actor's children and tail-calls the motion-reset helper 0x005F5DA8 (clears actor+0x144, copies a 3-word default vector into +0x148..+0x150, sets bit 11 of +0x154).

functions.name: Field_ActorTurnActionCtor
functions.summary: Constructor of the field-actor turn action: allocates through 0x294BD4, installs vtable 0x765638 and sets the turn speed/angle defaults.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the generic field actor-action class; runs the shared action destructor 0x00193E44 and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_Start
functions.summary: Starts the mount action: asks the action's vtable+0x30 for the motion id and plays it, then splits on the actor's mounted flag +0x2D4 - mounted starts the timer and plays the mounted step sound, otherwise it stores the unmounted delay, plays the other step sound and resets the turn state.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_CheckRideState
functions.summary: Decides whether the horse action may continue: inspects the owner actor flags at +0x28C/+0x290/+0x2CC, the "blocked" byte +0x276, calls 0x00669338 and compares the computed distance against +0x2C. Returns -1 (cancel), 3 (special) or 1 (continue).

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the mount action: runs the arrival check, the owner sync and the turn blend, asks the action's vtable+0x34 for the next motion id and plays it on the actor, and when the motion is finished and the actor is mounted (+0x2d4) starts the mounted step timer and plays the mounted step sound.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_Stop
functions.summary: Stops the mount action: calls the action's +0x88 slot, clears the two mount flags at f_276/f_2D4 and, unless the reason is 3, releases the movement effect.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for the field horse-riding action object. Allocates the shared action base through func_0036D364, installs vtable 0x765674 and clears the jump state; the two animation helpers that follow it play Horse_Jump/Horse_Land.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the horse action; runs 0x00193E44 and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_UpdateRideOrientation
functions.summary: Per-frame orientation step of the horse action: it resolves the entity referenced by self->f_28->f_2D0 through the global handle table, stores it at +0x44 and, depending on whether a target exists, derives the facing either from the owner's quaternion or from the target's position fields, applies it to the model, clamps the model's speed and dispatches the ride/gallop clip through model vtable +0x84.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_BeginJump
functions.summary: Starts the horse jump: sets state 1, asks the actor to play the Horse_Jump animation at speed 4, and initialises the vertical velocity/gravity fields.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_BeginLand
functions.summary: Enters the horse landing state: state 2, plays Horse_Land at speed 4, marks the actor grounded and calls func_00367B1C on it.

functions.name: Field_HorseAction_UpdateMotion
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the horse action: applies gravity/drive velocity, tests the actor ground normal against per-axis thresholds, and switches between airborne (1), landing (2) and grounded states while pushing the actor out of slopes.

functions.name: maybe_Field_HorseAction_CtorVariantA
functions.summary: Constructor of derived horse field action: calls Field_ActorAction_CtorBase and installs vtable 0x007656B4.

functions.name: Field_HorseRideAction_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the horse ride/orientation action variant: runs base action cleanup (0x00193E44) and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_OnStateNotify
functions.summary: Action virtual (slot 10) invoked when the owner changes state: ticks the base action and, if the notification is active while the actor is not in battle and still has HP, requests motion 2 through the actor motion component (0x005E7848 -> 0x002A891C).

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_SyncToOwner
functions.summary: Slot 1 of the field actor-action vtable: calls its own slot 12 (0x0036CE18, which returns -1, 2 or 3 from owner->f_2D4 and bit 3 of owner->f_2CC) and forwards that state code to the owner actor through the actor's vt[0x84]. The old doc said it asked the owner for a value; it asks itself.

functions.name: Field_ActorTurnAction_Ctor
functions.summary: Minimal derived action constructor: base-constructs through Field_ActorAction_CtorBase and installs vtable 0x007656EC, the actor turn-action vtable whose update slot is Field_ActorAction_Update.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorTurnAction_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (base vptr reset 0x00193E44, which writes the base vtable 0x00758AE0, then operator delete 0x0010F6CC) heading vtable 0x007656F0, the field actor-action table whose slot 3 is Field_ActorAction_Update and slot 10 Field_ActorAction_OnStateNotify. The 'ActorTurnAction' part of the name is unsupported.

functions.name: Actor_UpdateTurnBlend
functions.summary: Second stage of the actor turn update: recomputes the angle between the current facing basis and the target direction, interpolates the basis toward it and hands the result to the node transform setter.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_CheckArrived
functions.summary: Returns true when the actor is within one unit of its target point; on arrival it forwards the target position through the action's +0x2C slot and notifies the actor.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_CheckFacingTarget
functions.signature: u64 maybe_Field_ActorAction_CheckFacingTarget(void* self, u32 mode, void* target)
functions.summary: Shared action virtual (slot 6 in the horse/turn action vtables) that measures the target position against the owner actor orientation and sets the 'in front'/'behind' bits (1 or 4) in the actor motion flags at +0x290.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_Update
functions.summary: Base per-frame update of a field actor action: runs the arrival check, the owner sync and the turn blend, asks the action's vtable+0x34 for the next motion id and plays it on the actor, then clears the actor's pending-turn counter at +0x290.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_CtorBase
functions.summary: Shared base constructor for the field actor actions: builds the base object with flags 0x20000002, installs vtable 0x76572c and stores the owning actor pointer at +0x28.

functions.name: maybe_Field_TurnAction_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (base vptr reset 0x00193E44 + operator delete 0x0010F6CC) of a field action subclass whose vtable 0x00765730 adds an item-name formatter at slot 16 (0x0036D3AC: Item_LookupRecord on the u16 at self+0x12, then Text_FormatMessageArg) and Ui_ShowInfoMessage at slot 15, i.e. an action that shows an info message about an item. The 'TurnAction' label is still a guess.

functions.name: FieldParty_InitMemberSlots
functions.summary: Constructor body of the field party group: stores the owner and then builds its member sub-objects (the FieldParty object at +4 plus three further embedded controllers), installing each vtable and secondary vtable and resetting every member slot through FieldParty_ResetMemberSlot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_DtorLarge
functions.summary: Destructor body of a very large composite UI object: reinstalls the outer/inner vtable pairs and tears down five repeated widget groups (Ui_BattleTargetMarker_ReleaseAll, Anim_ModelInstance_Release, std_destroy_range over 0x14/0xE4/0x58-stride arrays) plus the embedded Pack_Handle/Effect_LinkInstance base destructors. No caller; it is a vtable destructor entry.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_InitPanes
functions.summary: Builds the skill panel (DQXI's skill-point screen) from 'panel_msg.bxon': the party list, skill point display, skill list, skill change, talk/yesno pair and the renkei (combo) pane.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateChildrenIfActive
functions.summary: When the window is not busy (the +0x1C4 field is clear and +0x1C8 has no pending bits) it forwards the message to the child widget list at +0x23A4 through maybe_Ui_Widget_Update and then drains the queued child updates until 0x0062F070 reports no pending children.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_AdvanceNodeSequence
functions.summary: Advances the skill panel's node walk by one entry: it takes the byte at the cursor, forwards it to the object at self+4, increments the cursor, loads that skill's parameter block (0x002E7FB4) and fills the message arguments - argument 5 from the block's record/string and arguments 2..5 with the names of up to four party members whose bits are set in the block's 31-bit mask.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_EpilogueTail
functions.summary: Not a real entry point: 0x0036DCF6 is two bytes into the blt at 0x0036DCF4. The coherent code is the epilogue at 0x0036DCFC (ldr r0,[r4,#0xC]; add sp,sp,#0x480; pop {r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,pc}) of the action update that starts earlier.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_OpenClose
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_OpenClose(UiSkillPanel* self, UiSkillPanelState* state, unsigned int arg3, int open)
functions.summary: Opens or closes the skill panel: on open it arms the panel state and binds the 'renkei' sub-page; on close it drains the queued input and restores the closed position.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_UpdateSkillDescription
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_UpdateSkillDescription(UiSkillPanel* self, UiSkillRow* row, u32 ctx, u32 forwarded)
functions.summary: Fills the skill panel's 'win_talk' message window with the description of the selected row: it reads the row id, looks the list entry up and sets message argument 5, then either uses the entry's inline string or falls back to one of two message ids in the skill record (0xE/0xF) when the record carries no inline text, and finally re-lays out the message window.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_HandleInput
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_HandleInput(UiSkillPanel* self, UiSkillPanelState* state, const UiInput* input)
functions.summary: Handles pad input for the skill list: moves the cursor, confirms a skill (skill-point check), or reports 'not enough points' / 'already learned' through the panel's result byte.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_UpdateFrame
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_UpdateFrame(UiSkillPanel* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Advances the skill panel's open animation frame counter (0..0x36) and, once it passes the halfway frame 0x12, rebinds the 'renkei' pane animation and starts the follow-up animation; sends SE 0x34 on the way.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_AttachTail
functions.summary: Not a real entry point: 0x0036E566 is two bytes into the blt at 0x0036E564. The coherent code starts at 0x0036E56C (mov r0,r7; bl 0x0062F680; cmp r0,#0; beq ...), a fragment of the surrounding action-attach routine.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_HandleInputB
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_HandleInputB(UiSkillPanel* self, UiSkillPanelState* state, const UiInput* input)
functions.summary: Second input handler of the skill panel (party-member switching): validates the selected member, plays the accept/cancel sound and sets the state result code.

functions.name: Ui_CompareRow_SetValueFromChar
functions.summary: Sets one comparison row from a character code: looks the character up in the item/record table and writes the row value (id, icon or count) into the compare widget's three value slots.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CompareRow_SetValueFromByte
functions.summary: Sets a row's value to a party member's remaining amount: resolves the member record from the byte at memberIdPtr, computes (u16 at member+0x12dc) - (u16 at member+0xe6) clamped at 0, and stores it on the pane at self+0x22c.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_ApplyState
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_ApplyState(UiSkillPanel* self, const unsigned char* command)
functions.summary: Executes one skill-panel command (0..0xF): positions the corresponding pane, plays its animation, updates the party member data and shows the matching hint text.

functions.name: Ui_CompareRow_SetValueFromRecord
functions.summary: Sets a comparison row from a table record (id at +2, category byte +6), writing the value through maybe_Ui_CompareRow_SetValueB.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_SetSelectedIndex
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_SetSelectedIndex(UiSkillPanel* self, const unsigned char* row)
functions.summary: Stores the current list row index in the skill panel's per-instance table, pushes it to the list widget and refreshes the view.

functions.name: Ui_Cursor_HandleAnalogInput
functions.signature: void Ui_Cursor_HandleAnalogInput(UiCursorHost* self, UiCursor* cursor, InputState* input)
functions.summary: Cursor update from the analog stick: when the input is a press it feeds the three analog axes to 0x1A60A0 and stores the resulting direction into cursor->f_11 (setting the changed flag f_10); a cancel press sets f_30 = 1 and f_31 = 0x17, and a confirm press plays SE 0 and copies the target coordinates f_98/f_9C.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_UpdateRequiredSp
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_UpdateRequiredSp(UiSkillPanel* self, u32 ctx, u32 arg3, u32 forwarded)
functions.summary: Updates the SP-cost label next to the skill list: it reads the currently selected list cell, looks the skill record up in the master data and displays the record's cost byte either as a plain number or, when the list owns an animation record for that id, as the animated number-icon variant. When the id has no record it displays 0.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_SetListWidget
functions.summary: Attaches the skill list widget to the panel (stored both as f_1D4 work pointer and f_304).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyDefaultResult
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyDefaultResult(UiWindow* window, UiNotify* out, int message)
functions.summary: Window notify handler: ticks the child widget at window+0x23A4 and, when the child fires, marks the notify record handled (out+0x30 = 1) and returns the window's default result code (window+0x1D8) in out+0x31.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult9OrDefault
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult9OrDefault(UiWindow* window, UiNotify* out, int message)
functions.summary: Window notify handler: ticks the child widget at window+0x23A4 and, when the child fires, marks the notify record handled and returns result code 9 when the prompt was confirmed, or the window's default code (window+0x1D8) otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult1Or2WithEffect
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult1Or2WithEffect(UiWindow* window, UiNotify* out, int message)
functions.summary: Window notify handler: ticks the child widget at window+0x23A4 and, when the child fires, triggers the effect/cue 0x003AA7E8 on window+0x1D4, sets the extra flags out+0xC4/out+0xC5 and returns result code 1 on confirm, or code 2 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult16OrDefault
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult16OrDefault(UiWindow* window, UiNotify* out, int message)
functions.summary: Window notify handler: ticks the child widget at window+0x23A4 and, when the child fires, marks the notify record handled and returns result code 0x10 when the prompt was confirmed, or the window's default code (window+0x1D8) otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult9OrDefaultB
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult9OrDefaultB(UiWindow* window, UiNotify* out, int message)
functions.summary: Window notify handler: ticks the child widget at window+0x23A4 and, when the child fires, marks the notify record handled and returns result code 9 when the prompt was confirmed, or the window's default code (window+0x1D8) otherwise. Duplicate of 0x0036F3F4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult16OrDefaultB
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_NotifyResult16OrDefaultB(UiWindow* window, UiNotify* out, int message)
functions.summary: Window notify handler: ticks the child widget at window+0x23A4 and, when the child fires, marks the notify record handled and returns result code 0x10 when the prompt was confirmed, or the window's default code (window+0x1D8) otherwise. Duplicate of 0x0036F4C0.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_LayoutRows
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_LayoutRows(int self, int* rowCursor, int* layoutCtx, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Builds the next display row of the skill list: runs the common row layout, appends the pending row from self->f_243C when that row is flagged visible, appends through the second layout helper, emits the row via the context's virtual slot +0x20 and finally closes it with 0x00507CBC.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_InitRowList
functions.summary: Initialises the six row groups of the skill panel list: for each group it links the list head into the row object and stores the callback id pair from g_0036F874.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the skill panel: allocates the big window object, initialises the root list plus five row-list heads, the selector, the message page and the nested window/actor parts.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 1) of the skill panel; runs the panel destructor body 0x0036FB10/0x0036FB14 and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the skill panel: unwinds the row lists, the message page at +0x8FB, the scroll list at +0x38C and the six selector groups, then frees.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_SetVisible
functions.summary: Visibility override of the skill panel: calls Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim(self, visible) and, when becoming visible with the byte at +0x4A set, refreshes the panel's row data from the game work block at +0x26C3A.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_PopulatePartyList
functions.summary: Fills the skill panel's party-member list: one row per member with a generated number label ('1','2',...) and the member name, plus a final row for the 'select-all/none' entry.

functions.name: Ui_Object_CtorSimple
functions.summary: Minimal UI object constructor: runs the UI object base ctor, installs vtable 0x37011c and clears three small fields.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorSimple
functions.summary: Minimal UI object destructor: runs the base destructor and the shared free routine.

functions.name: Ui_PartySelectWindow_SelectInitialMember
functions.summary: After the party-select window is built, selects the party member that the cursor vector at +0x410 points at and opens his row (0x3DFF34) with the matching character action.

functions.name: Ui_SelectableGrid_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a twelve-cell selectable grid: it runs the UI object base constructor, installs vtable 0x75DC34 and constructs twelve 0x50-byte cell widgets at +0x4C. The class is shared by the casino and the smith (forge) menu screens, both of which need a small fixed grid of selectable item cells.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorWithArray
functions.summary: Destructor for a UI object that owns an array of 0x50-byte records at +0x4c: destroys the records, then the base object and frees it.

functions.name: Ui_Object_Dtor_vt75DC34
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of a UI object that owns twelve 0x50-byte animation-reference entries at +0x4C: installs vtable 0x75DC34, destroys the entries with their own destructor (0x3E04BC) through std_destroy_range and runs the UI base destructor.

functions.name: Ui_PastPlaceWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Creates the 'win_past_place' message window for the past-place (memories teleport) screen and starts its animation.

functions.name: Ui_PastPlaceWindow_RefreshRecords
functions.summary: Resets the selection index, asks the list data (copied out of +0x11C) how many entries are available and toggles the child window accordingly: the child's slot +0x14 is called with 0 or 1 and, when it reports a change, slot +0x10 commits it. This keeps the record list and its scroll/selection widget consistent with the current data.

functions.name: Ui_PastPlaceWindow_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the past-place window: advances the child actor, drives the fade/open animation counters and dispatches the pending row callback identified by self+0x124.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ResetChildrenB
functions.summary: Window reset step: drains the child ring to zero, re-links the embedded pane at +0x4C4 and broadcasts visibility flag 1 to it.

functions.name: Ui_PastPlaceWindow_HandleInput
functions.signature: uint Ui_PastPlaceWindow_HandleInput(UiPastPlaceWindow* self, const UiInput* input, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Handles input for the past-place list: moves the cursor over the destination entries, confirms a destination (returns 1) or cancels the window.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ResetChildrenC
functions.summary: Window reset step: drains the child ring to zero, re-links the embedded pane at +0x4C4 and broadcasts visibility flag 1 to it. Same body as 0x00370460.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ResetChildStateAndStep3
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at window+0x4C4 against message+0x10C and, when it has finished, writes the child state byte window+0x11D = 0xFF and requests step 3 on the controller at window+0x120.

functions.name: Ui_Object_BroadcastChildrenEvent
functions.summary: Forwards one event to all children at +0x4a8.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_StepChildTo3Or1
functions.summary: Window step handler: ticks the widget at window+0x4C4 and, when it has finished, requests step 3 on the controller at window+0x120 when the prompt was confirmed, or step 1 otherwise.

functions.name: Ui_PastPlaceWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the past-place window: runs the common window constructor, installs vtable 0x7658A8, stores the mode byte at +0x11C, clears the selection index and initialises the embedded child-window member pair at +0x120 (vtable g_00370D18) together with four 0x18-byte list items at +0x144.

functions.name: Ui_PastPlaceWindow_Destroy
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor wrapper of the past-place window.

functions.name: Ui_PastPlaceWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the past-place window: releases the handle member, the window base, the message page and the list part, then frees.

functions.name: Field_TimerPlaySe254
functions.summary: Frame counter for a field timer: increments the counter at timer+0x34 and, when it catches the limit at timer+0x30, plays SE 0xFE and resets limit=4, counter=0. Returns the timer pointer so it can be chained.

functions.name: Field_ActorList_ClearFlagByType
functions.summary: Actor-list operation: initialises the filter state (f_2C from the reference actor's f_2E4, defaulting to 4, f_2E = 0, f_30 = 7, f_34 = 0) and clears byte +0x202 on every actor of the matching type in the global scene-object list.

functions.name: Field_ActorList_ForEachByType
functions.summary: Actor-list operation: when the list's enable byte f_2E is set it plays the animation on the reference actor, builds the type filter and applies the same one-byte message to every actor of the matching type in the global scene-object list.

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateCellTransition
functions.summary: Moves the player actor across a map-cell boundary: bails out while the game-work mode bytes or the UI transition are busy, compares the cell computed from the actor grid position (+0x78/+0x7C) with the cached cell, then either performs the cell switch (release trail, redraw, idle animation) or offsets the actor position by the cell delta.

functions.name: Field_ActorList_SendMessageByType
functions.summary: Actor-list operation: sends the one-byte message 1 to the reference actor and then to every actor of the matching type in the global scene-object list.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_CtorSimple
functions.summary: Small action-table entry constructor: allocates through Actor_Action_InitDescriptor, installs vtable 0x007658F8, sets the state bytes +0xB/+0x2D to 0xFF and +0x2E to 0 and clears +0x30/+0x34.

functions.name: Field_ActorList_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the field actor list/filter class; runs 0x00193E44 and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Actor_CalcOverlayPosition
functions.summary: Resolves the object behind the UI context handle (work+0x48+0x3B4) through the class hash table and derives the overlay anchor from that object's f_A8 / +0x78/+0x7C (f_1E/f_1F) / f_A9/f_AA fields, then continues with 1180 bytes of anchor math against the same field set.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_ResetInteractionState
functions.summary: Field-actor component reset: calls 0x00239A1C on the UI overlay/context at work+0x48, the shared interaction-state clear also used by the action end hooks.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_CtorSimpleB
functions.summary: Small action-table entry constructor: allocates through Actor_Action_InitDescriptor, installs vtable 0x0076592C and copies the two default words from 0x007BE2D4.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorComponent_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (base vptr reset 0x00193E44 + operator delete 0x0010F6CC) heading vtable 0x00765930, a field-actor component table whose slot 1 is the 1180-byte overlay-position routine 0x00371518 and slot 2 the interaction-state reset 0x003719B4.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ResetStep
functions.summary: Clears the per-step movement state of a field actor.

functions.name: Model_ApplyFacingTilt
functions.signature: u32 Model_ApplyFacingTilt(ModelNode* self, const float* dir)
functions.summary: Moves a model node along a direction and, depending on the tilt mode (+0x74), snaps it to the world axes or rotates it toward the direction, then selects the 'Ascent'/'Decent' animation state.

functions.name: maybe_Field_PlayerActor_ChangeMotionState
functions.summary: Player-actor virtual (slot 12 of vtable 0x00765964) that applies the motion for the three-way mode byte at +0x74: mode 1 requests motion 0x17, mode -1 requests motion 3 (both through 0x005E7848) and both set +0x78 = 1. Mode 0 is handled by the two attachment slots 10/11 instead, so this slot only covers the non-zero modes.

functions.name: maybe_Field_PlayerActor_SetAttachmentA
functions.summary: Player-actor virtual (slot 11 of vtable 0x00765964): only in mode 0 of +0x74 it hands the 0x14-byte node at self+0x30 to the owner actor's vt[0x84], then clears the owner's selector byte +0x311. Its twin slot 10 (0x00371E14) does the same with the node at +0x44 and sets +0x311 = 1.

functions.name: maybe_Field_PlayerActor_SetAttachmentB
functions.summary: Twin of slot 11: in mode 0 of +0x74 it hands the 0x14-byte node at self+0x44 to the owner actor's vt[0x84] and sets the owner's selector byte +0x311 = 1.

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateInputDirection
functions.summary: Translates the player's d-pad/stick input flags into the actor direction field (+0x74: -1/0/1) and then runs the generic behaviour update.

functions.name: Monster_BehaviorActionCtor
functions.summary: Constructor for a monster behaviour component: builds on the walk-task base (Field_ActorWalkTask_Ctor) and installs vtable 0x00765960 with the AI update at slot 2, clearing the two state words at +0x74/+0x78.

functions.name: Field_PlayerActor_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the player-controlled field actor: runs the class destructor 0x001E1B88 (which chains to the base object destructor 0x001E1B70) and frees the block with operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_TriggerNearbySameType
functions.summary: Triggers the 'situation' reaction of every other actor of the same sub-type (byte +0x2E5) within the radius g_007A3EB4 of this actor's world position: ORs the results of maybe_Field_Actor_PlaySituationEffect and, if anything reacted, plays SE 0xEE on this actor and plays its own situation effect.

functions.name: Field_Actor_CheckWallCollision
functions.summary: Wall/obstacle test: builds a direction from the actor facing (or controller rotation), projects it onto the movement normal and compares the per-axis components with actor thresholds to set the collision flag.

functions.name: Field_Actor_BeginPush
functions.summary: Starts pushing a heavy object: checks the wall test, plays Grab_Push, derives the push speed from the actor speed, plays SE 0xED and spawns the push effect instance.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Actor_SpawnEffectSprite
functions.summary: Resolves a handle to an actor (rejecting anything that is not an Actor subclass), builds a world position from the actor's +0x9C/+0xA0/+0xA4 origin plus the probe's float offsets with a 2.0 radius, and asks the scene to draw/spawn a sprite there with the given direction.

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdatePush
functions.summary: Per-frame push update: moves the pushed object along the push direction, corrects its height with a shape query, then either finishes, plays zDGrab_Push, or falls back to the generic action state 0x1A.

functions.name: Field_Actor_EndPush
functions.summary: Ends the push: notifies the actor virtual, releases the push effect handle and stops the looping push sound.

functions.name: Actor_Action_RunCtor
functions.signature: void* Actor_Action_RunCtor(void* buffer, Actor* actor, u32 index, u32 nameToken, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Constructor of the 'run' actor action: runs Action_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x007659A8, clears f_B and the 0x2C/0x30/0x38 fields and stores -1024 at +0x34.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of an actor-action subclass: stores the caller-supplied class vtable, releases the effect handle at +0x34, runs the shared actor-action base destructor 0x00294C88 and frees the object with operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_ActorBase_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the base field actor vtable; runs 0x001E1B88 (base destructor body) and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_Init
functions.summary: Initialises an actor action from the actor: clears state, snapshots the actor transform into f_54 and copies the bone/attachment transform blocks (+0x5F4 of the current part, default 0x007E7110) into f_78..f_A4.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_UpdateModelRotation
functions.summary: Smoothly turns the action's scene object toward its target yaw: rate from f_2C/(f_34*dt), clamped and blended into f_30, then writes the resulting matrix into model+0x5F4 (and the optional model+0x160 node).

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_Update_2
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a vertical field-actor action: integrates the vertical offset with the rise/fall rates, clamps against the configured limits, sets the attached effect instances' direction/speed and switches the actor to its attract animation once it has settled.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_ApplyTransforms
functions.summary: Copies the action's cached transform blocks (self+0x78..+0x94 and +0x98..+0xA4) into the actor's render node actor->f_244[self->f_D8] at +0x5F4..+0x620, and the second block into actor->f_160.

functions.name: Monster_MoveActionCtor
functions.summary: Constructor for a monster movement behaviour: builds on Action_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x00765A24 and fills ~30 movement parameters (turn/approach speeds from 0x007E7030 and 0x007E7110, the -1024 sentinel, the 0x49F/0x4A0 limits and the 8-step default).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_DeletingDtorAlt
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for derived Field_NpcAction instance: executes destruction helper 0x00294C88 and frees object memory using allocator wrapper 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_PlayStateAnim
functions.signature: void Field_ActorAction_PlayStateAnim(FieldActorAction* self, int restart, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Looks up the animation clip name that belongs to the action's current state (virtual slot +0x2C then master-data lookup 0x0063D6B8, string at record+0x38) and plays it on the actor's model through model slot +0x84. When the second argument is 0 the previous motion is restarted first, and the call is finished by the common action update 0x001BA6AC.

functions.name: Actor_Action_Nut_Ctor
functions.summary: Action constructor used by the monster behaviour state machine: base-constructs through 0x001BAB48 and installs vtable 0x00765A58, the actor-side nut-action vtable.

functions.name: Field_Action_DeletingDtorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor in Action hierarchy: invokes base action virtual destructor 0x00193E44 and deallocates memory via 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_Action_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for secondary action variant: calls base destructor 0x00193E44 and frees memory through 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_StoreForwardVector
functions.summary: Computes and caches the actor's forward orientation vector: reads rotation/quaternion angles from actor self->f_28 via 0x00669D88 and writes the 3D vector to self->f_2C, self->f_30, and self->f_34.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_UpdateJump
functions.summary: Jump/fall action update: applies velocity, clamps the Y coordinate to the ground-height range, tests party/field flags and snaps the actor to the ground on landing.

functions.name: maybe_Monster_BehaviorState9ActionCtor
functions.summary: Slot-1 action constructor used by Monster_UpdateBehavior in its state 9 branch (0x3C-byte object): runs Action_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x00765AC8, copies the default vector from 0x007E7030 into +0x2C..+0x34 and stores 2.0 at +0x38.

functions.name: Field_Action_DeletingDtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for action node: calls base action teardown helper 0x00294C88 and frees memory with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_UpdateTurn
functions.summary: Turning action update: decides the turn animation (TurnL / TurnR) from the angle difference to the target, rotates the actor and moves it forward while the turn lasts.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_UpdateApproach
functions.summary: Approach action: picks an animation by actor type/state, moves the actor forward with deceleration and switches to the attract animation when the timer expires.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_StoreActorValue
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_ActorAction_StoreActorValue(void* actorAction, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Actor-action step: clears the shared interaction state (0x00239A1C on work+0x48) and copies action+0x2C into the owner actor's +0x138.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_CtorB
functions.summary: Constructor of another small field action: shared action base ctor, vtable 0x00765AFC, f_2C = 0.6f, f_30 = 1.0f and f_34 = 0 - the store order is scrambled by Ghidra, so the field mapping is approximate.

functions.name: Field_Action_DeletingDtorD
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for action sub-class: invokes base destructor 0x00294C88 and deallocates buffer via 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnimTable_Build
functions.summary: Builds the complete battle/field action-animation table: creates the 'action' container and one animator entry per action name (battleact, atk, dmg, dead, win, turn, skill_01..16, cskill_01..16, item, guard, jump, ...).

functions.name: Field_Actor_TransformOrientation
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_TransformOrientation(FieldActor* self, u32 flags, u32* transform_data)
functions.summary: Calculates and applies orientation transform updates to the field actor: computes forward orientation vector using 0x00669D88 and updates coordinate attributes from transform parameters.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ForwardButton
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_ForwardButton(UiWindow* self, int buttonId, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Button handler of a UI window: records the button in the f_72C bitmask, maps shoulder/trigger ids 0x21-0x24 onto the model's two attach slots (commit vs release) and 0x33/0x34 onto the f_700 three-object visibility toggle, then forwards the event to the child scene node.

functions.name: maybe_Model_Actor_SetAttachSlotResource
functions.summary: Applies an equipment record to a model actor's attach slot: if the slot's current descriptor already matches the record it just releases the pending effect handle; otherwise it releases the old handle, adopts the new one and re-initialises the slot resource from the record via Model_AttachSlot_InitResource.

functions.name: maybe_Model_Actor_SetAttachSlotHandle
functions.signature: void maybe_Model_Actor_SetAttachSlotHandle(ModelActor* self, u32 handle, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Sibling of 0x0037706C with the branches swapped: when the attach slot's descriptor does not match the equipment record it releases the pending effect handle and returns; when it matches it applies the accessory visuals (Model_Equip_ApplyAccessoryEffects), releases the old handle and adopts the new one.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_SelectIdleAnim
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Object_SelectIdleAnim(FieldObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Switches a field object to its default pose: notifies the children, resolves the party member record from self+0x273, selects keyed animation 1 (or 8 when the member record flag 0x10 is set), records the choice at +0x272, clears both animation slots and enters sub-state 4.

functions.name: Field_Actor_SetEquippedPairText

functions.name: Anim_SaveCurrentState
