functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextSpan_Refresh
functions.summary: Refresh routine with no decompiled body (Ghidra status missing_function): the disassembly calls 0x0032B7D0 on self+0x198, starts the state machine at self+0x198 with argument 1, lazily creates a global singleton (zeroed 0x1C-byte block plus a vtable) and then updates the object reached through its +8/+0x8C fields.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_OnDialogueEvent
functions.summary: Handles incoming dialogue events for the NPC action: checks event flags at event->f_14, and when bit 0 is set dispatches callback (*self->f_198->f_3C) with event arguments.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonListWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for the dungeon-list window: installs the window vtable, zeroes the row cursor, remembers the mode byte and builds the member-pair child with its two 0x18-byte row slots.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_GetParameter
functions.summary: Trivial accessor stub returning the provided parameter value unmodified.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonListWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the dungeon-list window: destroys the 0x18 x 0x10 entry grid, the embedded child list and the trailing widget, then frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanesC
functions.summary: Gauge window variant that attaches the 'gauge' pane and immediately enables its animation.

functions.name: Ui_GaugeWindow_DeletingDtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the gauge-window variant whose pane initialiser is Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanesC: installs vtable 0x00766F8C, releases the layout reference at +0x4C, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_CreditWindow_SelectPaneGroup
functions.signature: void Ui_CreditWindow_SelectPaneGroup(UiCreditWindow* self, u32 group, int visible)
functions.summary: Shows or hides one of the credits window's three animation groups (panes at +0x4C/0x9C/0xEC and +0x13C/0x18C/0x1DC), resetting the other groups so only the requested one plays.

functions.name: Ui_CreditWindow_PlayPaneAnim
functions.signature: void Ui_CreditWindow_PlayPaneAnim(UiCreditWindow* self, int pane, int reverse)
functions.summary: Plays the in or out animation of one of the three credits panes at +0x230/+0x280/+0x2D0, resetting the other two.

functions.name: Ui_SkillOpenWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Creates a panel of nine animation panes: three 'open' layers, three 'open_in' layers and three skill slots ('skill_1..3'), each initially hidden.

functions.name: Ui_SkillOpenWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the skill-open window: installs vtable 0x00766FF0, releases the eight layout references from +0x2D0 down to +0x4C, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_Dead
functions.summary: Death action: plays the 'Bt_Dead' animation on the actor, stops its motion, and marks the actor as dead/immobile once the animation passes its end.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_Dead_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor stub of the death actor action: allocates the base action through 0x002B1808 and installs vtable 0x00767054; it is entry 9 of the action table built by Field_ActorActionSet_Init.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_DeletingDtorAlt2
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for NPC action: calls base destructor 0x00193E44 and frees memory with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_PlayDefaultAnim
functions.summary: Plays the actor's default 'Act_Def' animation and forwards the action-start notification to the actor's motion controller.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_DeletingDtorAlt3
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for secondary NPC action variant: calls base destructor 0x005F8528 and deallocates memory via 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSet_Init
functions.summary: Builds the field actor's ten-slot action table: creates the base action plus the named sub-actions nut, run, jump, exit, skill, sklEd, dmg and dead and stores each into the actor's action array. This is the behaviour/animation set used by field monsters and NPCs.

functions.name: Container_Handle_ResolveObject
functions.summary: Resolves an entity pointer from a compact handle: verifies handle generation tag (handle >> 11), indexes handle table g_00399E8C, and matches target object generation tag against g_00399E90.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_GripOn
functions.summary: Plays the 'wbhm_grip_on' animation (weapon/held-item grip) on the actor's attached model and marks the action as running.

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateAttachment
functions.summary: Positions the actor's attached model (weapon/accessory) from the actor's body slot +0x220, adding the slot's local offset and the actor's current motion; optionally writes the result into the actor's render position.

functions.name: Model_AttachEquipmentMeshes
functions.signature: void Model_AttachEquipmentMeshes(CharacterModel* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int memberIndex)
functions.summary: Attaches the character's weapon and accessory meshes to the model: resolves the member's equipment records, creates the 'meshEquip' part config for the weapon and the 'meshAccessory' node config for the accessory, and binds both to the model node.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ReleaseAttachment
functions.summary: Releases the actor's attached model and clears its body-slot pointer when the attachment flag is set.

functions.name: Field_Actor_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises a field actor object: creates the base 3D actor, fills its position/rotation defaults, model id, animation slots and interaction state.

functions.name: Ui_PresentWindow_DeletingDtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for present UI window component: calls base destructor 0x005F8528 and deallocates memory using 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_CommandMenu_Build
functions.summary: Builds the field command menu (talk, search, item, equip, ...) from the current interaction target: enables each command according to the target/event flags and inserts the available event commands.

functions.name: Text_CommandExecutor_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a text command executor: resets the command list and registers the command table and default text id.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ClearPendingInputC
functions.summary: Tiny input-queue handler (table 0x0072C498): if Container_RingBuffer_Next(self+8) reports another event, fetches the process-wide UI core (the lazy 0x98-byte allocation is inlined) and clears its pending-input/mode word at +0x94.

functions.name: Ui_Window_TransitionState
functions.summary: Coordinates layout transition state updates for the UI window: manages active pane states, resets sub-panels via virtual destructor +8, and allocates node memory aligned to 0x10 bytes via 0x0011CFAC.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_Ctor1F8
functions.summary: Constructor of the 0x1F8-byte list window used by the UI part factory (case 7): installs vtable 0x767238, builds the embedded list widget, its two handle vectors and an embedded 0x37D8 message window, and copies the layout's row settings into the widget.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow1F8_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 0x1F8-byte list window: runs the destructor body and frees.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow1F8_Dtor
functions.summary: Complete destructor of the 0x1F8-byte list window: releases the row-list object at +4, the two inline handle vectors, the child lists, and resets every embedded intrusive list head.

functions.name: Ui_EmotionBalloon_Init
functions.summary: Creates the emotion/expression balloon for a field actor: resolves the 'null_ex' and 'emotion_chara_ex' panes, attaches them to the actor's UI layer and hides the balloon until an emotion is requested.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EmotionBalloon_Init
functions.summary: Initialises an owner-plus-list object: stores the owner pointer at +0, clears +4 and constructs the animation-ref list at +8, returning the object base.

functions.name: Field_Npc_UpdateAnchor
functions.signature: void Field_Npc_UpdateAnchor(FieldNpc* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Places an NPC at its map anchor: looks up the actor's spawn/anchor record, copies the anchor position into the NPC's target position and starts the placement animation.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WaitAnimUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the NPC wait animation subaction: advances subaction timers at +0x68/+0x70 by frame delta dt, increments cycle counter at +0x6C, and steps through up to 12 (0xC) state jump table entries.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_PlayWaitAnim
functions.summary: Plays the idle standing animation on the NPC actor: checks animation validity via 0x00669DD4, sets active flag self->f_5C->f_26C to 1, and invokes virtual method +0x84 on actor self->f_28 with animation string 'Nut' (Natural idle).

functions.name: Field_Npc_FaceTarget
functions.summary: Turns the NPC toward its current look-at target by adding the target offset to the NPC's base rotation, and triggers the turn animation.

functions.name: Field_Npc_UpdateMoveTarget
functions.summary: Converts the NPC's local target point and rotation into world space and stores the resulting movement target; also refreshes the vertical offset used by the walk animation.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Follow_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update for an NPC action that moves the actor towards its owner's current goal: it snapshots the owner's two position triples into the action object, starts the steering, then chooses the animation - idle pose when the distance is below 0.2, otherwise 'Run' or 'Walk' depending on whether the owner's move request is active - and reports the speed back to the state machine.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Approach
functions.summary: Approach action: steers the NPC toward its target point while playing the neutral 'Nut' action, advances its position at the configured speed and hands over to the next action when the target is reached.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WalkToTarget_Init
functions.summary: Starts a 'walk to target' action: it computes the target offset (owner goal position minus the owner's base position) into the action's movement vector, clears the owner's move-request id, snaps the NPC to face the target, samples the movement result and switches the state machine to the walk or run animation accordingly.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Walk_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the walk action: computes the movement target, starts the walk animation and sets the action speed.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WalkToCoords_Init
functions.summary: Same action start as the target-relative variant, but the walk offset is supplied by the caller instead of being derived from the owner, so scripted/patrol code can send an NPC to arbitrary coordinates. It clears the move request, faces the point and selects the Walk (or Run) animation.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Walk_InitB
functions.summary: Second walk-action initialiser: computes the movement target, starts the walk animation and sets the action speed; differs from 0x0039BADC only in the animation-name pointer used.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_PlayWalkAnim
functions.summary: Plays the secondary natural animation on the NPC actor: calls virtual method +0x84 on actor self->f_28 passing animation string 'Nut' (0x0039BC14) and verifies actor subaction limit self->f_28->f_2C8.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Turn
functions.summary: Turn-in-place action: rotates the actor toward its target angle in fixed steps and finishes when the remaining angle is inside the tolerance or the actor is blocked.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Patrol
functions.summary: Patrol action: moves the NPC forward along its current heading for a timed interval, then switches to the next action; used for wandering town NPCs and monsters.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Turn_Update
functions.summary: Vtable wrapper for the NPC turn action; always reports success to the action scheduler.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Patrol_Update
functions.summary: Vtable wrapper for the NPC patrol action; always reports success to the action scheduler.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Idle
functions.summary: Idle action: plays a random idle animation for a duration, then falls through to the action's link/end handler so the NPC's behaviour chain continues.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_LinkEnd
functions.summary: Link action: plays the 'LinkEnd' animation and, when it finishes, hands control to the next action in the behaviour chain (used to join two scripted NPC actions).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_WaitAnimStart
functions.summary: Initiates the NPC wait animation action: evaluates readiness predicate (*self->f_60->f_14) on subaction struct at +0x60 and invokes its start method at vtable+0x10.

functions.name: Monster_AiBehavior_CtorVariant
functions.summary: Constructor variant of a field monster's AI/behaviour object used when the monster ecology is spawned; it installs the behaviour vtable and creates twelve 0x18-byte member-pair entries that hold the behaviour's sub-actions.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_SubactionDeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for subaction component: executes base Action destructor 0x00193E40 and frees object memory using 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Jump
functions.summary: Jump/land action: computes the landing point from the actor's current velocity, interpolates its height along the jump arc and plays the landing animation when it touches the ground.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Move
functions.summary: Generic move action: moves the NPC along its heading at the configured speed while keeping it on the ground; switches to the arrive action when it reaches the destination.

functions.name: Field_EnemyAiAnimCtorB
functions.summary: Two-slot enemy-AI animation constructor (same family as 0x00331EE4): base 0x0028B6BC, two slots, vtable 0x0076731C with the default words at +0x44..+0x4C.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_SubactionDeletingDtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for tertiary subaction instance: invokes base destructor 0x00193E40 and frees memory via 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Layout_SetLineLimit
functions.signature: void maybe_Text_Layout_SetLineLimit(uint8_t* lineCount, TextLayout* layout, uint32_t lineLimit)
functions.summary: Stores the line budget at layout+0x4C and returns immediately when the current line counter already reached it or exceeds 3; otherwise it continues building the next line record (the tail constructor is marked noreturn by the decompiler).

functions.name: maybe_Text_ConstructRowTable
functions.summary: Builds a 4x6 array of 0x5F9720-type elements on the stack and, when the alternate flag is 0, also reads the game work and a save-work byte table (work+0x24A98). The decompiled body ends in the array constructor, so the consumer is not visible.

functions.name: Text_LayoutSingleLine
functions.signature: void Text_LayoutSingleLine(TextLayout* self, TextLine* line, u32 text_id)
functions.summary: Lays out one text line: measures the string, applies the current font scale and stores the start/end glyph indices and width into the line record.

functions.name: Text_LayoutColumns
functions.signature: void Text_LayoutColumns(TextLayout* self, TextLine* line, u32 text_id)
functions.summary: Lays out a multi-column text block: gathers candidate lines from the actor/table lists, sorts them by width and fills up to three columns, merging short lines into the current column.

functions.name: Text_LayoutRecord
functions.summary: Lays out text for the current actor/record: reads the record's name/text, selects the appropriate font style and writes the measured line into the destination.

functions.name: Ui_Window_LayoutTransition
functions.summary: Executes layout transitions for complex UI window components: processes node alignment, adjusts margins, updates viewport buffers, and syncs layout matrices via 0x002F74D8 and 0x001051F0.

functions.name: maybe_Item_AssignEquipSlotItem
functions.signature: void maybe_Item_AssignEquipSlotItem(void* self, int slotMode, u32 itemId)
functions.summary: Writes itemId into the object's equipment-slot field (self+0x10 for slot mode 0, self+0xE for mode 1) only after validating the item's equip category and two-handed rule against the currently equipped item.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipPanel_SyncEquipmentChanges
functions.summary: Per-frame equipment-panel poll: when the member index is valid and the current 12-byte equipment snapshot differs from the cached copy, it feeds the changed slot ids to the compare pane (window+0x88 slot +8), recomputes the dual-equip category, applies the accessory effects and stores the new snapshot; otherwise it only decrements the refresh delay f_1C.

functions.name: Ui_EquipTextWindow_Refresh
functions.summary: Refreshes the equipment text window from a request record whose first byte is the character id. With req[7] set it builds the six-slot comparison list from the member's actor record (+0x2188, 0x18-byte stride) and hands it to the stat-compare panel (0x0046DF7C). Otherwise it caches the six equipped ids, refreshes the layout text through the widget at +0x60 and updates the comparison panel's selected row.

functions.name: Ui_EquipTextWindow_SetCharacter
functions.summary: Binds the equipment text window to a character: stores the id at +0x90, rebuilds the window's 0x22C-byte text/status object from a descriptor (1.0/0.3/100.0 scale constants and pane ids 0x10/0x78/0xC8), keeps it in the generation-tagged handle at +0x68 and fills both six-entry parameter caches (+0x6E and +0x7A) plus the compare code at +0x86.

functions.name: Effect_UpdateBillboardOrientation
functions.summary: Per-frame billboard orienter: runs the object's stored callback, resolves its owner node, builds a camera-facing basis from the billboard angles with std_Sinf/std_Cosf, uploads it to the device matrix at +0x7D4..+0x7FC and applies the resulting Euler rotation to the render node.

functions.name: Ui_EquipTextWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: UiEquipTextWindow* Ui_EquipTextWindow_Ctor(UiEquipTextWindow* self, int parent, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructor of the equipment/status text window: installs vtable 0x767354, loads equip_text.bxon and builds its text panes, handles and the two embedded list objects.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipTextWindow_DeleteThunk
functions.summary: Four-byte entry point that falls through into the destructor + release pair at 0x0039ED90; an artefact of Ghidra splitting the deleting destructor, identical to 0x0039ED80.

functions.name: Ui_EquipTextWindow_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the equipment text window: runs the destructor body and frees.

functions.name: Ui_EquipTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Complete destructor: releases the four text handles, the renderer child, the anim object at +0x2C and the panel chain below +0x15, then restores the inline list heads.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_InitFromDesc
functions.signature: void Field_ObjectSprite_InitFromDesc(FieldObjectSprite* self, int* desc, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Builds the scene-sprite draw entries of a field object from its descriptor: resolves the object/kind pair, allocates the sprite slot with Gfx_Scene_AllocSpriteSlot (or appends with Gfx_Scene_AddNodeType4), copies the shape-group ids/masks and, for the kind-10 record, stores the sprite rectangle, then links each group's bit mask into the render entry.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_InitBox
functions.summary: Sets up the simple rectangular scene-sprite entry for a field object: allocates/replaces the object's draw slot from a four-value rectangle and refreshes the object's render state.

functions.name: Field_SceneObjectSprite_Ctor
functions.summary: Minimal sprite constructor used by field scene objects: it runs the sprite base initialiser, installs the scene-object sprite vtable, zeroes the sprite id/state fields and sets the 0x20000000 visibility-request flag on the node.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_Dtor
functions.signature: GfxSprite* Gfx_Sprite_Dtor(GfxSprite* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 slot)
functions.summary: Sprite-object destructor: installs the vtable, releases the object's scene handle through the handle set (0x2E5F50 with word 0xD) and disposes the inline string.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_InitComplex
functions.summary: Builds a complex scene-sprite object from three descriptor arrays (large entry records, node records and transform records), creates the corresponding draw entries and computes the object's aggregate transform and bounds.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_SetTransform
functions.signature: void Field_ObjectSprite_SetTransform(FieldObjectSprite* self, float* transform, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Applies a position/rotation/scale transform to a field object's sprite sub-entry (at +0x4C), creating or replacing its draw entries and storing the resulting orientation and extents.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_SetPosition
functions.signature: void Field_ObjectSprite_SetPosition(FieldObjectSprite* self, u32* position, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Moves a field object's sprite sub-entry to the given position, recreating its small draw entry and refreshing the object's render state.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_CtorBase
functions.summary: Generic 2D sprite/quad constructor shared by every field object type: it runs the sprite base initialiser, installs the generic sprite vtable, initialises the two texture-coordinate rectangles, the rotation step (PI) and scale (2.0f), and marks the node for drawing.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_DtorAlt
functions.signature: GfxSprite* Gfx_Sprite_DtorAlt(GfxSprite* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 slot)
functions.summary: Second sprite-object destructor, identical to 0x39F388 but with the vtable of the 2D sprite class; releases the scene handle (0x2E5F50) and disposes the string. Called from every field object/sprite destructor.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_EnableDraw
functions.signature: int Field_ObjectSprite_EnableDraw(FieldObjectSprite* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Registers the field object's sprite/draw entry with the scene once, using the object's sprite id and shape id; the one-shot flag at +0x2A8 prevents duplicate registration.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_InitFromRecord
functions.summary: Initialises a field object's sprite state directly from a map record: sets its transform/orientation, marks it active and copies the shape/texture ids used for drawing.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_ResolveName
functions.summary: Builds the object sprite's display label: resolves the event and actor names, formats them as '%ls/%ls', publishes them as message args and stores the label in the object record; when the id is valid it triggers event command 0x13.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for a field-object sprite object: allocates it from the field object pool, sets the debug/display id to 0xFF and initialises the embedded sprite list.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for a field-object sprite: destroys its embedded sprite/shape list, releases the field object and frees it.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_CreateActor
functions.summary: Creates the sprite actor for a field object: skipped while the UI overlay is active (overlay manager mode byte +0x281 == 1), otherwise resolves the object's kind-6 record, builds the quaternion and submits the sprite to the scene object manager (work+0x24A98); when the scene mode is 2 it also creates the child actors.

functions.name: Field_ObjectSprite_CreateChildActors
functions.summary: Creates one visible sprite actor per matching child of a field object: walks the object's f_16D8/f_16DC child list, matches the shape ids f_46/f_45, resolves the kind-7 record and spawns the sprite actor with Gfx_SpriteActor_CreateFromTable, then attaches it to the object's node.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ObjectSprite_UpdateOwner
functions.summary: Refreshes a field object's sprite after its owner moves: takes the scene-mode byte for f_50, optionally re-registers the draw entry through Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent/0x4417EC, then walks the returned ids 4 and 5 and calls the actor's sprite update.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_Ctor_vt7673DC
functions.summary: Constructor of another scene object type created by the field object factory: obtains storage through the shared scene allocator, installs vtable 0x007673DC and initialises the id/sentinel fields (+0x45 = 0xFF, +0x46 = 0xFFFF, +0x4A = 0xFF, +0x4C = 0x0FFFFFFF).

functions.name: maybe_Field_ObjectSprite_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field object-sprite record: Ui_Object_DtorBody + operator delete. It is slot 1 of type table 0x7673DC, whose class method at +0x1C is maybe_Field_ObjectSprite_UpdateOwner.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_SetVisibilityFlag
functions.summary: Sets the pane visibility flag: updates attribute bit 0 on self->f_44 and synchronizes child node display states.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_UpdateTransform
functions.summary: Updates the 2D affine transformation matrix and screen coordinates of the UI layout pane relative to its parent container.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ObjectSprite_BindHandles
functions.summary: Resolves a handle pair for a field sprite from its object record and stores it at sprite+0x10/+0x14, retrying with the record's secondary handle; on success it clears the owner's shared state word and dispatches to one of two interface objects of a global service singleton, selected by the kind byte in the resolved descriptor.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for UI pane: invokes pane teardown methods and frees allocated memory via 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gadget_GetEventSceneStatus
functions.summary: 36-byte field-gadget thunk: when the game work exists it evaluates the field event-scene validity test 0x00636AFC(work+0x6C) and leaves the result in r0 (Ghidra dropped the return).

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_InitSingleQuad
functions.summary: Initialises a 2D sprite actor from a short parameter table: resolves the animation set from def[0x0E]/def[0x0F] through 0x00319848, takes its frame count into +0xAC, applies def[0x0A]/def[0x0B] as size through Actor2D_SetSize (0x005F3500), copies the flip/frame bytes, then builds one 0x40-byte sprite record from the four rect pairs and registers it with Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild.

functions.name: Field_Gadget_TriggerTouchCommand
functions.signature: u32 Field_Gadget_TriggerTouchCommand(FieldGadget* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Raises the gadget's touch/interaction event (command 0xF) in the field event system when the player touches it.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_InitDescriptor
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_InitDescriptor(u32 ctx, int desc, u32 descriptor, u32 capacity)
functions.summary: Allocates and initializes a 2D sprite descriptor: calls 0x0028E630 to allocate buffer memory with tag 0x4000000C, installs vtable g_003A13BC+0x98 at offset +0x8B, and sets capacity limit to 0xFFFF.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for 2D sprite object: invokes sprite destructor 0x0028E6C4 and frees memory with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_Object_ApplyModelRecordAndNotify
functions.summary: Re-applies the object's model record (the confident Actor_ApplyModelRecordFast) and then notifies the embedded motion/transform sub-object through its vtable +0x10, passing the owner.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_UpdateAnimation
functions.summary: Updates sprite animation frame: calls sprite update helper 0x0028E548 and dispatches virtual frame update +0x18 on the animation controller at self->f_298.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_GetFrameStatus
functions.summary: Queries sprite animation playback status: dispatches virtual status query +0x14 on the animation controller at self->f_298 and returns 0.

functions.name: Field_Gadget_DtorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the gadget's embedded state at +0x24C: installs the vtable, unlinks the node, destroys the embedded gadget and frees the allocation.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gadget_GetEventSceneStatusB
functions.summary: Field-gadget vtable slot: returns 1 when the game work exists and the field event-scene validity test 0x00636AFC(work+0x6C) is non-zero, else 0.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelPart_InitColored
