functions.summary: Assigns the effect/resource selected by id to self+8: releases the old handle, lazily creates the 0x21C-byte pooled object (vtable 0x007829E0), resolves the id through Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple with a 0xC-byte descriptor and stores the new handle.

functions.name: maybe_ReleaseTwoHandles
functions.summary: Releases the two handles at self+8 and self+4 through Pack_ReleaseHandleEntry and then checks the object's type id against 0x007C8584. The decompilation is truncated (halt_baddata) after that, so the rest is unknown.

functions.name: Event_TriggerNotification
functions.summary: Triggers notification callbacks on registered event listeners: calls event verification 0x00193FA0, traverses listener chain at [r5+0x90]+0x24, verifies listener object via 0x0014C3EC, and executes listener callback.

functions.name: Ui_HandlePair_Assign
functions.signature: void Ui_HandlePair_Assign(UiHandlePair* self, u32 v, u32 arg3, u32 b)
functions.summary: Replaces the two generation-tagged pack handles at self[1]/self[2] of a UI part: validates both entries, releases stale ones, moves slot 2 into slot 1 and attaches the new resource, then reruns the sprite pattern setup.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseTwoHandles
functions.summary: Releases the two generation-tagged handles stored at +4 and +8 of the given pair object and returns the address just before the pair (the enclosing element), the standard 'release both children' helper used by window destructors.

functions.name: Ui_Text_EmitCharRun
functions.summary: Handles a run of characters for the text layout engine (the control-code-2 case of the text command interpreter). In measure-only mode it just advances the character pointer and returns 0; otherwise it sets the text object's position/character range, emits the run through 0x0071330C/0x00713344 and advances the layout cursor by the run width, returning 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Tween_DispatchCommandA
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_Tween_DispatchCommandA(UiTween* interpolator, int opcode, int** targetRef, u32 value)
functions.summary: Opcode dispatcher: 2 runs the step helper, 3 copies the element's current fixed-point values into the target record and reseeds the element, 4 starts it through 0x003A6F08 with mode 0; any other opcode hits the no-argument trap.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Tween_DispatchCommandB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_Tween_DispatchCommandB(UiTween* interpolator, u32 variant, int opcode, int** targetRef)
functions.summary: Twin opcode dispatcher with the same 2/3/4 handling, but it starts 0x003A6F08 in mode 1 instead of 0 and its trap path calls Math_Vector_FloatToFixed.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_AllocViewportState
functions.summary: Allocates and initializes a layout viewport transform descriptor: calls heap allocator 0x006F0924 and initializes matrix scales (1.0f) and coordinate limits (FLT_MAX) from globals g_003A7330 and g_003A7338.

functions.name: Ui_Window_CollectNamedPane
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Window_CollectNamedPane(UiWindow* self, const char* paneName, int tag, LayoutRoot* layout)
functions.summary: Binds one named layout pane into a window's pane array: walks the layout's child list, matches the pane name, grows the array if needed and appends the (pane, tag) pair. Returns 0 when the pane is already bound or not found.

functions.name: Ui_Text_MeasureAndEmitRuns
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Text_MeasureAndEmitRuns(u32 textId, TextSink* sink, const u16* tags, u32 tagCount, u32 skipBlocks)
functions.summary: Splits a tagged text buffer into drawable runs: walks the u16 control array, emits each run through the sink's vtable+0x6C, and for control code 4 with a handler index below 0x10 jumps into the per-character escape handler table. Returns the total emitted length.

functions.name: Ui_Element_SetFlagBit0
functions.signature: void Ui_Element_SetFlagBit0(UiWindow* self, u32 pane, u8 on)
functions.summary: Sets or clears bit 0 of the layout element's flag byte at +0x44 — the visible/active flag used by every Ui element.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TitleLoopWindow_SetInverseFlag
functions.summary: Stores the inverse of the argument at self+0x108 after running the shared widget/layout method 0x001D863C; the owning class is Ui_TitleLoopWindow, the flag's meaning is unknown.

functions.name: Ui_Element_SetColor
functions.signature: void Ui_Element_SetColor(UiWindow* self, u32 pane, u32* rgba)
functions.summary: Writes the element's two colour words (+0xAC and +0xB0) from the packed RGBA value, i.e. sets the text/plate colour of one bound pane.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_ApplyClipRect
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_ApplyClipRect(u32* self, u32 clip, u32 clip2, u32 clip3)
functions.summary: Applies rectangular clipping bounds to the UI layout viewport: calls clip intersection function 0x003A733C with viewport dimensions.

functions.name: Ui_TextElement_SetString
functions.signature: void Ui_TextElement_SetString(UiWindow* self, u32 textId, int stringPtr, u32 skipBlocks)
functions.summary: Sets the text of one bound element: measures the tagged string with 0x003A7594, resizes/allocates the element's text buffer through vtable+0x58 when non-empty, emits the runs and toggles the 'has text' bit at +0x11.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_InitViewport
functions.signature: int Ui_Layout_InitViewport(u32* self, u32 viewport, u32 viewport2)
functions.summary: Initializes a UI viewport container: zeroes header words self[1]..self[4], calls allocator 0x003A72E8 on self+5, and returns the adjusted viewport base offset.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_Reset
functions.summary: Installs vtable 0x00768278 at self, releases the child at +8 through 0x0010F69C, clears +4, then resolves self+0x14 through 0x006F0934 and returns the result minus 0x14. The vtable store contradicts the old 'GetSceneNode' reading, which assumed a plain getter.

functions.name: Ui_Window_CreateChildSprite
functions.summary: Creates a child sprite inside the window's layout from a sprite id, validates its class descriptor, registers it in the child list and returns it (0 on failure).

functions.name: Ui_MapShipIcon_Update
functions.signature: void Ui_MapShipIcon_Update(UiMapIcon* self, const int* pos, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Positions the ship icon on the field/world map: lazily creates the sprite from the layout 'icon_aship2.bflyt' (cached at +0x8F0, only while UI context byte +0x276AB is set), copies the three-word position block into +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24 and forces the draw flag (bit 0x10) in +0x44.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PaneGroup_BindSlotAnimations
functions.summary: Binds and resets the animation refs of a 25-slot table: for each slot it resolves the slot id through 0x0058FC10 and the 6-entry cache at +0x26 via 0x0053D4C4, then Ui_AnimRef_Bind/Ui_AnimRef_ResetPanes on the 0x14-byte anim ref at +0x48+slot*0x14; finally tail-calls the class update slot.

functions.name: Ui_LoadRecordTable
functions.signature: void Ui_LoadRecordTable(void* self, const u8* begin, const u8* end)
functions.summary: Decodes a packed record table into the fixed 0x20-entry array at +0x8F4: for each 4-byte entry {u8 relative name offset, u16 id, u8 type} it resolves the name through the resource object at +0xA8 (vtable+0x2C), stores the handle, the u16 id and the type byte, and fills the remaining entries with 0 and 0xFFFF.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMapMarker_UpdateVisited
functions.summary: Per-frame visited-state refresh of the 25 world-map markers: runs the parent update, then for each marker copies the per-map visited byte from the save data (work+0x24A98 indexed by marker index) into bit 0 of the marker pane's flag byte +0x44.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_WorldMapMarker_UpdateCurrent
functions.summary: Calls Ui_WorldMapMarker_UpdateVisited and falls through into the shared highlight loop at 0x003A7F3C, which for each of the 32 markers (8-byte records at +0x8F4) sets the visible bit when the save's map-state byte for that id equals the marker's expected state byte.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_HighlightList_ApplyMapState
functions.summary: Shared highlight updater: walks 32 8-byte records at self+0x8F4 (element pointer, u16 map id, expected state) and sets bit 0 of element+0x44 when the per-map state byte at bag+0x2A70+mapId equals the record's expected state.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMapMarker_ApplyVisitedFlags
functions.summary: Applies the per-map visited flags to the 25 world-map marker slots: for slot 0..24 it copies the save flag from 0x0066B45C(bagWork, slot) into bit 0 of the marker pane's +0x44 flag (so unvisited markers are hidden). Same loop as Ui_WorldMapMarker_UpdateVisited without that function's parent-update prologue.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_UpdateScreenBuffers
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_UpdateScreenBuffers(int self, int screen, int* pointer, u32 update)
functions.summary: Updates screen display buffers and vertex matrices for active layout panes: checks layout enable flag self->f_9F4, queries display state via 0x002BC768, aligns node allocations via 0x0011CFAC, and flushes vertex streams.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMapMarkerList_Ctor
functions.summary: Lazily creates the singleton world-map marker collection: takes the storage block, installs vtable g_003a81bc, clears the entry count at +0x11c and constructs the 25 (0x19) 0x50-byte marker records that start at +0x120. The world-map loading code needs this object before it can place or highlight the map pins.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutRefList_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the UI node that owns a 25-entry list of 0x50-byte layout references: installs vtable 0x0076828C, releases all 25 refs, runs the base teardown 0x001D8C2C and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutRefList_Dtor
functions.summary: Base destructor of a UI node owning 25 layout references: installs vtable 0x0076828C, releases the 25 0x50-byte refs starting at +0x48 and runs the base teardown 0x001D8C2C, without freeing the object.

functions.name: Ui_LocationWindow_ApplyTexture
functions.summary: Resolves the id in f_16C through the loaded-resource hash table, walks the class chain to the expected sprite class, attaches it (Gfx_ResourceList_Attach) and reapplies it as the banner sprite pattern (Gfx_Sprite_SetupPattern on f_170). Called only from Ui_LocationWindow_UpdateFade, i.e. the load-the-texture-the-fade-needs step.

functions.name: Ui_LocationWindow_BindPanes
functions.summary: Binds the location banner's panes: resolves the dummy sprite named 'location_dummy' and binds the layout ref named 'location'.

functions.name: Ui_LocationWindow_Open
functions.signature: void Ui_LocationWindow_Open(UiLocationWindow* self, u32 id, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Open/animate handler of the map-location banner: formats the layout name from the id via 'ui/location/%s', allocates the banner's name string object and starts the slide-in animation.

functions.name: Ui_LocationWindow_UpdateFade
functions.summary: Per-frame fade update of the location banner: once the banner object exists, starts the fade-out, waits for the layer transition to finish, and sets the 'closing' flag at +0x176.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_RenderTextNode
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_RenderTextNode(int self, int render, int target, u32 render2)
functions.summary: Renders text node content to layout context: sets layout properties self->f_4C=1, self->f_50=7, self->f_5E=2, computes text formatting via 0x006564C0, and draws pane self->f_A8 using 0x0053CD1C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LocationWindow_CreateChild
functions.summary: Creates a child object of the location banner: installs secondary vtable 0x007682DC, constructs the animation-ref element at +0x11C with the given style and returns the banner base.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LocationWindow_ReleaseChild
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the child object created at 0x003A87DC: releases the handle at +0x16C, destroys the element at +0x11C and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_TwoLineGuideWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the three text panes of the two-line guide window: 'txt_top2', 'txt_bottom_1_2' and 'txt_bottom_2_2'.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_SetTextFromMessage
functions.summary: Writes the guide window body label (+0xD4): looks up the record the window currently points at, formats it through Text_FormatMessageArg when present and writes an empty literal otherwise.

functions.name: Ui_Effect_InitPooled
functions.summary: Creates the shared UI effect once (global pool at 0x003A8BF0), registers it with the UI layer and starts the effect instance at +0xD4.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_DispatchDraw
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_DispatchDraw(int self, int render_ctx, int* target_ctx)
functions.summary: Dispatches draw command for layout node: assigns target_ctx[0x183] to render_ctx+4, and invokes virtual draw method +0x24 when self+0x98 is valid.

functions.name: Ui_TwoLineGuideWindow_Create
functions.summary: Allocates one object from the UI singleton allocator 0x001D8B6C and stamps vtable 0x0076832C, the Ui_TwoLineGuideWindow vtable; there is no other initialisation.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for UI layout component: invokes teardown helper 0x001D8C2C and deallocates memory using 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_SetPageValue
functions.summary: Pushes one value into all six page objects of the guide window (array at +0x11C, skipped when null) and remembers it at +0x2C8 so the next update can detect a page change.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_ReleasePlates
functions.summary: Releases both plate (background frame) sprites of the guide window: detaches each of the two plate ids from the global pair 0x007A8370 and destroys the returned sprite through its vtable+4 and Mem_DeleteObject.

functions.name: Ui_List_SetupRowWindows
functions.signature: void Ui_List_SetupRowWindows(UiListRows * self, int ** table, int ** end, u32 count)
functions.summary: Builds the visible row widgets of a list: initialises the row pool, stores the row count at +0x2C8, and for each entry of the two packed tables allocates a 0x1720-byte row window, creates its parts from the table and links it into the list at +0x11C.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_AttachPlate
functions.signature: void Ui_GuideWindow_AttachPlate(UiGuideWindow* self, u32 resId, UiSprite* sprite)
functions.summary: Installs a sprite as the window plate: detaches the previous plate (maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_DetachPlate) for the old sprite and the new id, creates the child sprite on the null_plate pane, attaches it, registers the ownership pointer at +0xC0/+0xC4 and swaps the plate list owner at self+0x224 for the new sprite.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_DetachPlate
functions.summary: Detaches the plate sprite for a resource id from the guide window: resolves it with func_0053D4C4, unlinks it from the window's sprite list, detaches it from its parent, and rewrites the 'plate' pane-list slot that referenced it back to the window's placeholder (self+0x224).

functions.name: Ui_StampAnimPlayer_Init
functions.signature: void Ui_StampAnimPlayer_Init(UiStampPlayer* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Initialises a UI 'stamp' animation player with three animation clips (start, next, prev) from common_3d_up_stamp*.bflan resources.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_InitPool
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_List_InitPool(UiListRows* self, u32 first, u32 count)
functions.summary: Pool initialiser for the list rows: builds the six-slot row set (dividing the index by six) and prepares the scroll controller at self+0x26.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_ReleaseSubWidgets
functions.summary: Releases the six sub-widget references a list widget keeps at +0x11C (each released through 0x0021F8B8 and then cleared); the release half of the list-widget reference handling whose resolve half is at 0x003A948C.

functions.name: Ui_List_ResolveSubWidgetRefs
functions.signature: void Ui_List_ResolveSubWidgetRefs(int self, int* reader, int* stream, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Two-pass relocation of a list widget's resources: resets the six row-widget handles at +0x11C, resolves the widget's own reference at +0x98 through the stream's vtable +0x24 (with the reader's relocation slot +0x60C temporarily installed), then binds and enables the six handles again.

functions.name: Ui_List_UpdateRowA
functions.summary: Refreshes one column of a six-column row: divides the index by 6 (magic 0x2AAAAAAB), looks the widget up in the pointer table at +0x11C with Ui_Widget_FindComponent, binds it into the row controller at +0x184 and dispatches the controller's vtable+0x24. This copy also touches the column at index+5 (wrapping).

functions.name: Ui_List_UpdateRowB
functions.summary: Row refresh variant B: refreshes the given column and the next one (wrapping to the row base at +0x11C), then rebinds and dispatches the row controller at +0x1D4.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_SetCell
functions.summary: Commits a selected grid cell: splits the index into row/column, resolves the two column widgets at +0x11C and the row's neighbour columns, rebinds them, then binds and resets the layout object at +0x134.

functions.name: Ui_StampBookPage_Ctor
functions.summary: Lazily creates the singleton stamp-book page object: installs vtable g_003a982c and constructs the 3 (count 3) 0x50-byte stamp slot records at +0x134. The stamp-book window needs it to show the stamps collected on a page.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the guide window: stamps vtable 0x0076837C, detaches both plate sprites (the two ids at 0x007A8370), resets the list pool, destroys the window's children and the three 0x50-byte elements, then frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_UpdateTransform
functions.summary: Scene-node update of a guide-window object: runs the base child update, and when the element list at self+0x89 is non-empty forwards that list to the node virtual +0x84 (the child-transform update).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GuideWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor that stores the vtable argument in the object, runs the shared window destructor 0x005F8528 (vptr reset plus release of the +0x1EC list) and frees with operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_Tab_PlayChangeSe
functions.summary: Tab/state change handler: when the requested state f_D differs from the current f_C it resets the animation refs of both sub-objects (0x3DFF34 for state 1, 0x649BD4/0x3E0088 otherwise) and plays SE 0x36 (state 1) or 0x35; finally latches f_C = f_D.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TwoChildObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a vtable-0x00768484 object owning two 0x16C-byte UI children: allocates each from the UI heap, builds it with the base ctor plus vtable 0x0076AC20 / 0x0076ABD0 and its anim-ref list at +0x11C, registers both through Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable and stores them at self[1]/self[2].

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmallPanel_Delete
functions.summary: Destructor of a small panel: installs the given vtable, releases the two sub-objects at self[1] and self[2] through func_0021F8B8, clears both slots and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_MovieTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the panes of the movie-text window: the text pane 'win_movie_txt' and the two message/effect hooks around it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Panel_Init
functions.summary: Constructor of the tiny panel base used by the battle message rows: allocates through 0x001D8B6C, installs vtable 0x007684A4, initialises the intrusive list heads and the embedded text element with Ui_Object_CtorBase.

functions.name: Ui_MovieTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the movie-text window: tears down the base UI object, releases the trailing sub-object (0x001D8C2C) and frees the window.

functions.name: Ui_Row_UpdateFull
functions.summary: The full icon+label row refresh: it resolves icon/label ids, sets the three panes and re-applies the row content.

functions.name: Ui_NumberGridWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Creates a 12x2 grid of numbered text panes ('txt_l1_num'..'txt_l12_num') plus the two position markers.

functions.name: Ui_SetTextWithColor
functions.signature: void Ui_SetTextWithColor(PaneWidget* self, u32 pane, int colorA, int colorB)
functions.summary: Sets a pane's text and its two colours: writes the text id with 0x001A6680, then the big-endian RGBA pair with 0x001A629C. When both colours are equal it forces 0xFFFFFFFF (the 'no tint' sentinel).

functions.name: Ui_Panel_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a small panel object: runs Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x00768510 and constructs the two animation-ref lists at +0x4C and +0x9C.

functions.name: Ui_NumberGridWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the number-grid window: installs vtable 0x00768510, releases the two animation-ref lists at +0x9C and +0x4C, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_NumberGridWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the same number-grid window as 0x003AA3E0: installs vtable 0x00768510, releases the animation-ref lists at +0x9C and +0x4C and tail-calls the UI base destructor.

functions.name: maybe_Party_SumSkillCostScaled
functions.summary: Sums the per-skill byte at record+6 over every skill the character has in the given slot and multiplies by 20, i.e. returns the value in the display units used by the skill panel.

functions.name: SkillPanel_CanUnlockSkill
functions.signature: u32 SkillPanel_CanUnlockSkill(u32 characterId, u32 skillId, u32 panelType)
functions.summary: Answers whether a skill may be unlocked in the skill panel: it locates the per-character record for (characterId, panelType) in the data manager table (0x20-byte stride, keys at +0x18/+0x19), fetches the master skill record for skillId and returns 1 as soon as one of that record's prerequisite ids (bytes +1 or +2, or u16 +4) is already present in the character record's id lists (byte list at +1, byte list at +2, u16 list at +4). Returns 0 when nothing matches or any bound fails.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartList_RemoveAndRebuild
functions.summary: Removes one id from a UI object's fixed 16-bit part-id list (+0xA0..+0x118) and rebuilds the remaining entries: each id is looked up in the part array (+4, stride 0xE), entries whose part is in anim state 1 are re-appended, and the gap is filled with 0xFFFF.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SkillPanel_IsDetailOpen
functions.summary: Global UI query: returns non-zero when the flag byte at GameWork+0x2767D is set. The skill panel's input and state handlers test it before opening the detail view.

functions.name: maybe_Party_SumSkillCost
functions.summary: Sums the per-skill byte at record+6 over every skill of the character that passes the slot filter, returning the raw sum (no scaling); the unscaled twin of 0x003AA448.

functions.name: Ui_SkillList_CollectSorted
functions.summary: Rebuilds the 60-entry skill-id list at +0xE: keeps the skills the character may unlock in this slot, sorts them with the shared quicksort plus the inlined insertion sort by id byte, writes the count and pads the rest with 0xFFFF.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SkillList_CollectPruned
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SkillList_CollectPruned(UiSkillList* self, int characterId, int slot)
functions.summary: Builds the character's usable skill list: copies the 60-entry skill table, blanks entries the character does not have in the requested slot and repeatedly drops skills whose prerequisites are not present, compacting the survivors into the u16 list.

functions.name: maybe_SkillList_GetLastSkillCost
functions.summary: Rebuilds the character's prerequisite-ordered skill id list (via 0x003AB074) and returns byte +6 of the master record of the last accepted skill, or 0 when the list is empty. Byte +6 is the SP cost field that 0x003AAB38 sums, so this returns the cost of the final (deepest) entry rather than a total.

functions.name: Ui_Element_ResolveResourceRef
functions.signature: void Ui_Element_ResolveResourceRef(int self, int* stream, int* reader)
functions.summary: Reads one serialized word from a resource stream, resolves it into a live pointer/id through the resource reader's vtable slot +0x24 and writes the result back into the stream word. While the resolution runs the address of that word is published at reader+0x60C so the resource manager can relocate it if the resource is reloaded.

functions.name: Ui_SetHitText
functions.summary: Writes the hit/result counter into the pane named 'atari_txt7': looks the pane up through the layout vtable, walks the pane's child list, lazily creates the 0x98-byte text object with vtable 0x00782A08 and formats value with the "%d" format into that pane.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindow_CreateText
functions.summary: The panel-message-window text-object creator: it installs vtable 0x3ABAB0 and constructs the embedded 0x003E0454 element.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelMessageWindow_TextDeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the text object created by Ui_PanelMessageWindow_CreateText: installs vtable 0x00768574, releases the layout reference at +0x11C, destroys the embedded object at +0x11C and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_MiniPlateWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the panes of the small plate window: the left text row and the 'plate_mini_in'/'plate_mini_out' sprites.

functions.name: Ui_Text_SetCharacterName
functions.signature: void Ui_Text_SetCharacterName(UiTextWidget* self, const u8* idPtr, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Message-command handler that writes a party member's name into the text widget: with a slot other than 0xFF it resolves the member record and sets the label to its name field (+0xCA); 0xFF leaves the label untouched.

functions.name: Ui_MiniPlateWindow_SelectPlate
functions.summary: Switches between the two plate variants: when the text starts with a control code (0x00 or 0x13..0x16) one element is shown, otherwise the other, and the change is animated.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DrawNodeChainA
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_DrawNodeChainA(int self, int nodeState, int* ctx, int drawFlags)
functions.summary: One step of a widget's draw chain: publishes the node slot into the context's bracket word, optionally advances with vtable slot 0x24, draws with Ui_Widget_DrawAndResetFlags, advances with slot 0x20 and finally points the parameter block at self+0x98.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindow_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the panel message window: releases two layout refs, resets the two embedded intrusive lists to their sentinels and destroys the member block (0x001D8C2C) before freeing the window.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanelWindow_Release
functions.summary: Release/rebuild of the skill panel window: unloads panel_reset_msg.bxon and the whole menu_skill_* layout set, closes win_gold and the two talk/yes-no message windows and resets the child list.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_OnCommandPopPane
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_OnCommandPopPane(UiSkillPanelWindow* self, void* cmd, const UiCommand* arg3)
functions.summary: Skill-panel command handler that only pops the panel's current page (self+0x170) when the command carries a payload (arg3+0x14 non-zero).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SkillPanel_SelectRowsByIds
functions.summary: Selects two rows on the row widget at self+0xA4 by entry id: first the caller's id, then the constant 0x1B6, after fitting the row text through Ui_Text_FitString.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_SetTextResource
functions.summary: Stores the panel-text resource pointer into the two mirrored fields f_2C0 and f_4F0 of the skill panel.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_OnCommandShowMessage16
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_OnCommandShowMessage16(UiSkillPanelWindow* self, void* cmd, const UiCommand* arg3)
functions.summary: Skill-panel command handler: pops the current page and then sets the pending-message state (cmd+0x30 = 1, cmd+0x31 = 0x16) so the panel shows message 0x16.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_OnConfirm
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_OnConfirm(UiSkillPanelWindow* self, void* msg, const UiCommand* cmd)
functions.summary: Confirm handler of the skill panel: plays the click animation, resolves the selected row against the skill table and either opens the skill detail page or shows message 5 ('not enough points') via Message_SetArg.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_OnCursorMove
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_OnCursorMove(UiSkillPanelWindow* self, void* msg, const UiCommand* cmd)
functions.summary: Cursor-navigation handler of the skill panel: moves the row cursor with wrapping, re-resolves the skill under the cursor at each step and scrolls the list when it reaches an edge.

functions.name: Ui_CompareRow_SetFromCharacter
functions.signature: void Ui_CompareRow_SetFromCharacter(UiCompareRow* self, const u8* idPtr, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Fills a comparison row from a party member: an id of 0xFF clears the row, otherwise it resolves the member record with func_0035EB98(work, id), reads the attribute through func_00629280, writes it into the row value pane and updates the secondary display.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_HandleCommand
functions.summary: Small command handler of the skill panel: commands 0x13/0x14 show or hide the part at +0x1BC, and 0x15 builds a message record (state 2 or 6 from the panel byte +0x2566), applies it to the block at +0x84C and pushes the next pane.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_OnTabChange
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_OnTabChange(UiSkillPanelWindow * self, void * msg, const UiCommand * cmd)
functions.summary: Skill-panel tab handler: on the input flag it feeds the command to the member tab strip at +0x224 and stores the newly selected party member id in msg+0x11, and on cancel it either writes the pending message 0x17 and clears the UI busy word, or pushes the panel's confirm pane when the selected member has data.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_SetIconResource
functions.summary: Stores the icon resource pointer (the panel_icon.bch resource object) into the two mirrored fields f_1B8 and f_4F8 of the skill panel.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_OnClose
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_OnClose(UiSkillPanelWindow* self, void* msg, const UiCommand* cmd)
functions.summary: Close handler of the skill panel: when the command carries a payload it pops the current page, applies the pending command (0x00647C34), confirms with SE, and pushes the handler's next page pair from the entry at 0x0072A158.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_OnPageInput
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanel_OnPageInput(UiSkillPanelWindow* self, void* msg, const UiCommand* cmd, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Input handler of the skill panel's scrolling page: forwards the pad state to the part at +0x24F8, and on the accept bits clears the UI busy flag and either exits or walks the pane stack looking for the handler's target entry.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanelWindow_DrawNodeChain
functions.signature: void Ui_SkillPanelWindow_DrawNodeChain(void* self, void* nodeState, void* ctx, u32 drawFlags)
functions.summary: Draw slot of the skill-panel window: lays the rows out (Ui_Window_LayoutRows), appends the widget's own command through Ui_Widget_DrawAndResetFlags and the draw-context virtual +0x20, clears the scratch slot and hands the result to 0x00507CBC.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindow_DispatchEvent
functions.signature: void Ui_PanelMessageWindow_DispatchEvent(UiPanelMessageWindow* self, int event, UiCommand* cmd)
functions.summary: Dispatches the panel message window's current command: the index at +0x1AC selects a 0xC-byte descriptor at +0x170, and the descriptor's target either is the window's own message object at +0x2548 - where the control bits of cmd+0x14 decide whether the text advances - or a jump-table handler for another target.

functions.name: Ui_PanelMessageWindow_BindWidgets
functions.summary: Binds the panel message window's three sub-widgets (+0x120, +0x13C, +0x158) to the panes of the given layout panel, copying each vtable/handle pair through the container link helper.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanelWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the skill panel window: installs vtable 0x768614 and initialises the two scrolling lists, the four text elements, the gold window link and the input-handler table reference.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanelWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for the skill panel window: runs the class destructor at 0x003AD0F0 and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SkillPanelWindow_DtorBase
functions.summary: Second-stage teardown of the skill panel: stores the class vtable, re-links the inline lists, then releases and destroys the 0x414-byte element chain below +0x24F8 (panel vtables 0x759388/0x75E540).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RowTable_InitFromRecord
functions.summary: Builds the window's six-row descriptor table at self+0x49: fetches the record object through 0x0063DD90, fills each 7-byte row (visible flag, colour index, colour word, text pointer), sets the pane texts and walks the row extents for the total size.

functions.name: Ui_SelectListWindow_InitPanesHidden
functions.summary: InitPanes override of the select-list window: it only hides the window (calls the shared SetVisible(false) at 0x001A6460) because its panes are created lazily by the selection code.

functions.name: Ui_SelectListWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Creates a twelve-row selectable list with a title and a 'select_d' cursor pane.

functions.name: Ui_SelectListWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the select-list window: installs vtable 0x00768664, destroys the six embedded elements, runs the UI object base destructor and frees the allocation.

functions.name: Ui_SelectListWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the select-list window: installs vtable 0x768664, destroys its six 0x50-byte animation-reference entries at +0x74 and runs the UI object base destructor.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ResetHomePosition
functions.summary: Puts a field actor back on its home placement: writes the default speed/turn constants, copies the stored home position (+0x220..+0x228) over the current position, raises the dirty flag, re-applies the orientation block and marks the transform dirty.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for a field actor-action object: runs the action base destructor 0x005F8528 and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_SyncStateByte
functions.summary: Copies the byte returned by 0x0029E488 into the actor's action-state record at actor+0xB8 -> +0x128, i.e. propagates a freshly sampled state (facing/pose id) into the model state the action drives.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_CacheActorSnapshot
functions.summary: Snapshots the owning actor's transform block (11 words at actor+0x260..+0x280, including the position/rotation triple) into the action's workspace at +0x30..+0x54 and marks the workspace fresh by clearing +0x2C.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_ApplyCurvePosition
functions.summary: Per-frame action step: when the flag at self+0x2C is set, evaluates the cubic curve at self+0x58 with Math_Curve_EvaluatePoint and stores the resulting point on the actor through 0x005F3ADC.

functions.name: ActorAction_UpdateMoveTo
functions.summary: Four-state scripted 'move to' action: state 0 snaps/turns the actor toward the target and captures a reference transform, state 1 plays the action animation, state 2 waits while playing SE 0x91, state 3 waits for the 0.3 s timer and then raises follow-up command 9 on the map event task.

functions.name: ActorAction_CreateMoveAction
functions.summary: Constructor of the scripted move action: installs g_fieldActorActionMoveVtable, sets opcode 4, seeds the 0xFF/0xFFFF sentinels and builds the embedded transform; returns base-0x58.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_DtorDeleteB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a Field actor action: runs the shared actor-action base destructor 0x00294C24 and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC. It is slot 0 of vtable 0x00768784, the move-to action class.

functions.name: ActorAction_BeginMove
functions.summary: Start hook of the scripted actor move: notifies the actor subsystem through the target scene node and caches the actor start position (+0x2D4/+0x2D8) into +0x2C/+0x30, clearing +0x34.

functions.name: ActorAction_UpdateMove
functions.summary: Per-frame step of the 'move to target' actor action (vtable 0x7687B8 slot 3): while the actor is short of the target it adds the frame delta to +0xC4/+0xC8; on arrival it broadcasts action 4 to itself and to every scene object within 0.5 units (vtable+0x40(4)) and, if a field object occupies the arrival point, stops the action and plays the idle animation, otherwise pushes a trail sample.

functions.name: ActorAction_EndMove
functions.summary: End hook of the scripted actor move: makes the single counterpart call 0x00239A1C on the target scene node, undoing the notification that ActorAction_BeginMove issues through 0x0023B61C.

functions.name: ActorAction_CreateMoveActionB
functions.signature: FieldActorAction* ActorAction_CreateMoveActionB(void* owner, int forwarded, int forwarded2, int forwarded3)
functions.summary: Constructor of the second scripted-move field action: runs the shared action base constructor, installs the move-action vtable variant B, copies the two descriptor words from 0x007BE2D4 into +0x2c/+0x30 and clears the state byte at +0xd.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_DtorDeleteC
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for another action in the same derived family: calls the 0x00193E44 base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_ActorAction_UpdateAttract
functions.summary: When the owner actor reports its motion finished (0x00669DD4), switches it to the attract/idle animation (selection 0). Same template body as the other finish steps.

functions.name: Monster_HellBreakActionCtor
functions.summary: Minimal monster action constructor: runs Action_CtorBase and installs vtable 0x007687E8 (no extra state).

functions.name: maybe_Monster_ActorAction_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for a monster field action: runs the action base destructor 0x00294C88 (a `b 0x00193E44` alias of the base vptr-reset destructor) and frees the block.

functions.name: Monster_LoadMotionNamePair
functions.summary: Copies the two fixed strings stored at record+0x3C and record+0x40 (relative offsets) into the behaviour object's name slots +0x44 and +0x30, i.e. the two motion/animation names the monster plays later.

functions.name: maybe_Monster_FieldBehaviour_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for a monster field-behaviour subclass: resets the vptr through 0x001E1B88 and frees the object.

functions.name: Monster_FieldBehaviour_SkullDash
functions.summary: Per-monster field update for the alerted state: scales the movement speed by g_003AE460 while flag 0x200 is set, and switches the actor to the literal animation "Skull_Dash" (with a return to the previous animation when the alert ends).

functions.name: maybe_Monster_FieldBehaviour_DtorDeleteB
functions.summary: Second scalar deleting destructor of the monster field-behaviour family, identical in shape to 0x003AE340.

functions.name: maybe_Monster_FieldBehaviour_UpdatePhysics
functions.summary: Large movement/physics step for field-monster behaviours: reads camera/party input flags, integrates turn and bob rates from the behaviour floats, builds the orientation matrix/quaternion, commits the actor position and pushes a trail sample.

functions.name: Monster_FieldBehaviour_PlayNutAnim
functions.summary: Stops the actor's current motion and plays the motion named "Nut" (the rolling-nut attack of the field monster behaviour).

functions.name: Monster_BehaviorAction_Start
functions.summary: Virtual slot 1 (start) of a monster field-behaviour action: copies the actor's orientation/scale block (f_5F4..), derives the turn/aim angles and playback rates, then starts the nested state machine (state vtable f_14(flag), then f_10()).

functions.name: Monster_FieldBehaviour_PlayRunEffect
functions.summary: Run presentation of a field-monster behaviour: resets the actor's animation, switches it to the "Run" animation, records the linked model id in the behaviour, spawns the configured effect in front of the actor through Effect_FindOrCreateInstance and plays SE 0xFC.

functions.name: maybe_Field_TrackActionSlot
functions.summary: Appends the current slot index to the small slot table at self+0x2C (used-flag words at +0x14/+0x18) when it is not already present, but only while the UI overlay is idle and the work flag word work->f_C->f_6C has bit 0x40 set.

functions.name: maybe_Monster_FieldBehaviour_UpdateChase
functions.summary: Per-frame monster field-behaviour update: advances the monster's steering/physics toward its target and refreshes the model transform each frame.

functions.name: maybe_Monster_FieldBehaviour_UpdateAttack
functions.summary: Monster field-behaviour update: when the world is in the 2D/3D transition mode it only re-aims the effect part, otherwise it tracks the action slot, integrates the physics, applies the per-frame velocity/rotation deltas and falls back to the attract animation when the actor has come to rest.

functions.name: maybe_Monster_BehaviorAction_UpdateBlend
functions.summary: Advances the behaviour action blend timer by the frame delta in s0 and dispatches the current action slot via table at +0x4C.

functions.name: Monster_BehaviorAction_SyncEffectAndAnim
functions.summary: Copies the action's cached effect/transform words (+0xB8..+0xE4) into the attached effect object, and when the action is in state 1 stops the current motion and plays the motion named "Nut".

functions.name: Monster_BehaviorAction_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the action object used by a monster's field behaviour: runs the Action base constructor, installs vtable 0x007688AC, initialises the member pair at +0x2C (vtable 0x0075AE28 with an owner back-pointer) and constructs its two 0x18-byte state elements.

functions.name: Monster_BehaviorAction_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor: stores the vtable argument, runs the action base destructor and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Monster_BehaviorAction_DtorDeleteB
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of a class in the behaviour-action family (base destructor 0x00294C84 plus free).

functions.name: maybe_Monster_BehaviorAction_DtorDeleteC
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of a third class in the same behaviour-action family (base destructor 0x00294C88 plus free).

functions.name: Party_FindNextEntryForCharacter
functions.summary: Advances a party character-entry cursor to the next matching 0x14-byte row of the data-manager table: row charaId 0xFF or equal to cursor->u8_00, story-flag bit set in GameWork+0x2A444, map-visited byte at +0x27508, quest state 9 and party condition opcodes 0x19..0x22; sets the cursor index to 0x7FFFFFFF when exhausted.

functions.name: Data_FindNextRowMatchingConditions
functions.summary: Advances the cursor to the next row of the 0x14-byte condition table: skips rows whose type byte does not match *cursor, requires the row flag bit in the save work and the per-row flag byte, then walks the row's compact condition list (opcodes 0x19..0x22) against the selected party member's fields (+0x664, +0x668, +0x66C, +0x3EC and +0x370+0x2F5..0x2FB). On a match it stores the row index in cursor+4; otherwise it writes the FF FF FF 7F end marker.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ClassifyTableId
functions.summary: Classifies an id against the 0x14-byte rows of the table from 0x0063F93C: a row is eligible when its u16 at +8 is 0xFFFF or set in the Work+0x2A444 bitmap and its u16 at +10 is 0xFFFF or its Work+0x27508 byte is non-zero, and its +0xC is either -1 or the current quest-state is 9; for eligible rows it returns 0 when row+0x10 equals id, 1 when row+0x11 does, else 2.

functions.name: Party_GetFirstActorForCharacter
functions.summary: Returns the first party actor slot that belongs to the given character, or the 'none' pair (0xFF, 0x7FFFFFFF) when no actor is loaded.

functions.name: Party_GetFirstActorForCharacterB
functions.summary: Variant of 0x003AFE90 that uses the second 'find next entry' search (0x003AFAC4), i.e. a different actor table.

functions.name: Ui_CursorSelectWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_CursorSelectWindow_InitPanes(UiCursorSelectWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Window init hook of the cursor-select window: runs the shared cursor-widget init (drN) and then starts the 'cursor_select' BFLAN clip on the window layout so the selection cursor is animated as soon as the window appears.

functions.name: Ui_CursorSelectWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the cursor-select window: constructs the UI object base and stamps its vtable.

functions.name: Ui_CursorSelectWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the cursor-select window: destroys the UI object base and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_CreateChildHandle
functions.signature: void Ui_CreateChildHandle(HandleSlot* slot, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Replaces the object owned by a handle slot: releases the old object through the UI core's parts table, allocates a 0x218-byte object on the UI heap, installs vtable 0x00776C1C, zeroes its 0xE0-byte tail and registers it with Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, storing the result back in *slot.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseChildHandle
functions.summary: Releases the child object stored in a handle slot through the UI heap (Ui_GetCore()->+0xC) and clears the slot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CursorSelectWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of a UI window in the cursor/select group: runs class destructor 0x002C3234 and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_TalkMenuWindow_Build
functions.summary: Builds the talk/menu window: binds the layout names "menu_present_list", "win_talk" and "win_yesno", sets the list page size from the item count (clamped to 5), selects the entry, pairs the talk window with the yes/no window, plays the open SE (0x18FD04) and stores the "null_menu_present" element pointer in the game work.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageQueue_Pop
functions.summary: Pops the head of a small message queue: re-formats the entry's three u16 ids, pushes them as message arguments 5..7 and shifts the 0xE0-byte entry block down one slot.

functions.name: Ui_TalkMenuWindow_UpdateChildAnim
functions.summary: Updates layout animation on talk-menu window layout object (+0x98) and refreshes talk subwindow (+0x1E8) when dirty byte (+0x2050) is set.

functions.name: Ui_TalkMenuWindow_RebuildContent
functions.summary: Rebuilds the talk-menu window's interactive content: resets the paged menu list at +0x158, pops the sliding pane at +0x124, switches the window to state 1 through 0x003B0F44, then rebinds the slot at +0x1EE4 to the control at +0x1F2C and attaches it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessagePanel_EmitEntryList
functions.summary: Walks the range [range[0], range[1]) and emits one message-panel entry per element, resolving ids through the data manager and item table.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessagePanel_ExecStateA
functions.summary: State handler of the message panel: honouring the pending flags at +0x2048 (bit 2 forces the wait state, bit 0 resets the message object), it looks up the queued message id and emits opcode 3 for unknown ids or opcode 2 with argument 2, pushing the matching pane in both cases.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessagePanel_HandleConfirm
functions.summary: Message-panel confirm handler: pops the raw pane at +0x124; when the prompt reports the first choice confirmed it copies and emits the entry list, stores the scroll row in bag work, binds the +0x1EE4 control and pushes the result pane; otherwise it emits the 'no message' opcode 1 with 0xFFFF ids.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BigWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Window open/init step: pops the raw pane at +0x124, emits the three 0xFFFF sentinel fields through the window fill helper (0x3B0F44), binds the +0x1EE4 control to +0x1F2C and registers it.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePanel_SetState
functions.signature: void Ui_MessagePanel_SetState(UiMessagePanel* self, int kind, int page)
functions.summary: Selects the message panel state: with a source object (kind != 0 and func_0065084C counts at least one) it stores it, sets the page count and pushes the with-speaker pane; otherwise it pushes the empty/idle descriptor pair (page 0xFF chooses the alternative) and finally rebinds the slot control at +0x1EE4. Called from Ui_PresentWindow_Update.

functions.name: Ui_TalkMenuWindow_UpdateChildren
functions.signature: void Ui_TalkMenuWindow_UpdateChildren(TalkMenuWindow* self, u32* nodeState, UiDrawContext* ctx, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Per-frame child update of the talk-menu window: while its +0x2030 flag is set it advances the current message/animation node through 0x0053CD1C with the node temporarily published at ctx+0x60C, then defers to the shared Ui_Widget_UpdateAnimatedChildren so the child widgets animate.

functions.name: Ui_Window_MeasureContent
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_MeasureContent(UiWindow* window, UiLayoutPass* pass, UiLayoutCtx* ctx, int flags)
functions.summary: Measure override of the message window: when the window has content, lets the layout context accumulate the window extent and then tail-calls Ui_Window_LayoutRows.

functions.name: Ui_Window_DispatchCommand
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_DispatchCommand(BigWindow* self, u32 command, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Command router of the large windows: while the bound slot widget is busy it only ticks it, otherwise it runs 0x002A46D4 on self+0x1E8 and dispatches the member-function entry selected by self+0x154 from the 3-word table at self+0x124.

functions.name: Ui_Window_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a 0x2054-byte composite window object: allocates through 0x001D8B6C, installs vtable 0x003B1208, copies the style pair from 0x003B120C and creates the embedded scroll/anim object at +0x158 through 0x0045C8E8.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for a message window: runs destructor 0x003B1230 and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_ReleaseChildrenB
functions.summary: Second copy of the large message-window release helper (0x2078-byte class): drops the handle at +0x2034 and unwinds the child chain through the page/text/panel/animation destructors.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_QuestList_PopulateActiveQuests
functions.summary: Rebuilds a compacted list: clears the count at self+0x1CFC, then walks all 0x35 rows of the 0x8C-byte table in the save work (work+0x24A98), appending each row that the 0x002AFA88 row builder accepts to self + count*0x8C.

functions.name: maybe_std_StaticArrayInitThunk
functions.summary: Compiler-emitted static-array initialiser thunk: calls std_ConstructArray with the r0..r3 arguments still live at entry, then clears the word at +0x1CFC inside the constructed object and returns.

functions.name: Container_DispatchListNodes
functions.summary: Iterates through active child nodes in NodeList intrusive list (+0x18) and dispatches event/message through virtual slot +0x0C.

functions.name: Container_DispatchListNodesEx
functions.signature: u32 Container_DispatchListNodesEx(NodeList* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Iterates through active child nodes in NodeList intrusive list (+0x18) and invokes virtual slot +0x08 with arguments (child, arg2, arg3, 2, 1).

functions.name: maybe_Camera_PickLayerAtPoint
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Camera_PickLayerAtPoint(CameraStack* self, u32* out, u32 x, u32 y, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Layer hit test: walks the layer list at self+0xC (sentinel at self+8), skips disabled layers (byte at +0x10), calls vtable+0x14 (contains) and vtable+0xC (get), keeps the hit with the highest priority byte (+0x20) and writes {tag bytes, object} into *out; 0xFF/0 means none.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_PickLayerAtPointEx
functions.summary: Extended layer hit test: when an explicit layer id (not 0xFF) is given it consults only that layer (id translated through the table at 0x007BE310), otherwise it walks the whole list; both paths keep the highest-priority hit and return tag plus object.

functions.name: Container_ReleaseListNodes
functions.summary: Destroys the nodes of the two intrusive lists the object owns (heads at +8 and +0x14, first nodes at +0xC and +0x18) by calling each node's virtual destructor (vtable slot +4).

functions.name: Model_RebuildPartListB
functions.signature: void Model_RebuildPartListB(Model* owner, void* defs, void* params)
functions.summary: Rebuilds the model's second part list: releases the old nodes (Container_ReleaseListNodes) and creates one 0x34-byte hit/part object per entry of the f_32C/f_328 table, then repeats for the second table at f_504.

functions.name: Model_RebuildPartListA
functions.signature: void Model_RebuildPartListA(Model* owner, void* defs, void* params)
functions.summary: Rebuilds the model's first part list: releases the old nodes, then creates 0x3C-byte part objects from the f_2A0/f_29C definition table (filtered by 0x00240A40) and appends them, also processing the f_360 table.

functions.name: Container_ResetListHeads
functions.summary: Empties both intrusive lists of the container after releasing their nodes (maybe_Container_ReleaseListNodes): relinks the circular sentinel heads at +0x18/+0x1C and +0xC/+0x10 and returns the container. Used from Camera_Delete, i.e. container teardown.

functions.name: Ui_SetNullButtonVisible
functions.summary: Shows or hides the window pane named 'null_btn': resolves the pane by name through the layout object's virtual slot +0x2C and sets bit 0 of its flag byte to the requested state.

functions.name: Ui_ItemRow_Format
functions.signature: void Ui_ItemRow_Format(UiRow * self, u32 itemId, int selected)
functions.summary: Fills an item row: resolves the item's name (0x0063D338) and its icon group (0x0063D384 via the bag helper 0x0066AF08), picks the icon/texture for the group, copies the description into the shared line buffer while stripping CR/LF, and writes the icon, the name and the description into the row's three panes; the selected flag also updates the row's highlight byte.

functions.name: Ui_QuestWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: InitPanes of the quest list window: calls the shared window base init (drN) and creates the title, main text, drop1/drop2 text panes plus the quest_stamp_s / null_stamp_l stamp icons.

functions.name: Ui_QuestWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the quest-list window: constructs the UI object base, clears its scroll state and stamps the vtable.

functions.name: Ui_QuestWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the quest-list window: destroys the UI object base and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_QuestWindow_CollectRewardItemIds
functions.signature: void Ui_QuestWindow_CollectRewardItemIds(u16* self, u32 rowKey, u32 never, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Collects the item ids of one master table row into the window's sorted u16 set: it resolves the row through the data manager, then inserts the first u16 of each 4-byte element using the sorted-insert helper. Used to build the reward/drop item list a quest window displays.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SortedIdList_AddTableIds
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SortedIdList_AddTableIds(SortedIdList* list, int tableId, int arg3, int rowId)
functions.summary: Reads a game-data table through the data manager and inserts every u16 id it contains (stride 4, starting at record + record[1] + 4) into the sorted id list via Container_SortedInsertU16; the loop is bounded by the table's count word at *record.

functions.name: Container_SortedInsertU16
functions.summary: Inserts a 16-bit id (taken from the record's word +4) into the descending fixed list at +8 by binary search plus tail shift, ignores duplicates and bumps the count at +0x1054; the companion word at +2 comes from the record's second table.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_QuestList_BuildSortedIds
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_QuestList_BuildSortedIds(int list, int start, int count, int* out)
functions.summary: Start of a routine that collects quest/monster-book ids from the data tables and inserts them into a sorted u16 array; the recovered C truncates at the global already-built flag.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_QuestList_BuildSortedIdsContA
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_QuestList_BuildSortedIdsContA(int list, int* first, int* last)
