functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListGrid_MoveCursor
functions.signature: void* maybe_Ui_ListGrid_MoveCursor(void* self, int dx, int dy, int wrapPage)
functions.summary: Moves the selection cursor by (dx, dy) in a two-column paged grid: computes col = idx%2 + dx and row = idx/2 + dy, clamps/wraps the page at +0x1E0 within pageCount +0x1E4 and itemCount +0x1E8, refreshes the page via 0x003B8B88 when it changed, selects the cell with Ui_List_SelectEntryById and returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_FillDetailRows
functions.summary: Fills the lower detail stat rows (indices 0x32, 0x33, 0x34) of the strength/status list from selected entry at +0x1E8. Truncated in Ghidra decompilation.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Row_Activate
functions.summary: Marks one of the row's three selection icons as current: clears the selected bit (0xFE mask) on the first two child icons, sets it on the third, re-applies the row's entry id through Ui_List_SelectEntryById, then re-measures the text and re-applies the row.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_UpdateRowText
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_UpdateRowText(TsuyosaRow* row, int row2, int value, u32 string)
functions.summary: Fills one row of the party-strength (tsuyosa) comparison window: copies the row's pane names ('txt', 'txt_Al0', 'txt_Dl_2_0', ...) into the 12 u16 columns at row+0x54 + line*0x30, selects the list entry, formats the row text and re-applies the row.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_FillRowsA
functions.summary: Fills the parameter window's per-character row: clears the 0x180-byte flag block, then walks the character's record list (member record from func_0035EB98) and appends each entry's id bytes that pass the map-visit conditions into the 0x30-byte, 16-slot grid at +0x54, plus the high-bit-marked entries of the member's second list; finally selects the entry, refreshes the row text and calls Ui_Row_Apply.

functions.name: Ui_Row_Reset
functions.summary: Puts a parameter row back into its empty state: clears the selection index f_4A and the cursor fields f_1E0/f_1E4, turns off the two icon panes at +0x1D4/+0x1DC while turning on +0x1D8, re-measures the empty caption and re-applies the row.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_FillRowsB
functions.summary: Second filler of the parameter window's grid: takes the character's id list (func_00629214 count / func_006298F0 getter), sorts it by the display-name field of each entry (comparator reading record+0xC2), writes the ids 17 per row into the 0x30-byte grid at +0x54, then refreshes the caption text and calls Ui_Row_Apply.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_CreateRow
functions.summary: Creates one row object of the tsuyosa (strength) window: UI object base plus vtable 0x00768F10, stores the row index at +0x49, the 0xFF sentinel at +0x4A, clears the six words at +0x1D4..+0x1E8 and fills the 8-byte id array at +0x4B and the 0x180-byte scratch buffer with 0xFF.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TsuyosaWindow_DeleteRow
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of one tsuyosa (strength) row object: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees. The table's row updater is still a maybe_ name, so the row-class attribution stays tentative.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_BindEntries
functions.signature: void Ui_Overlay_BindEntries(UiOverlay* self, u32 owner, u32 actorA, u32 actorB)
functions.summary: Binds the eight overlay sub-objects to the actors they follow: caches the player id, the two actor pointers and the cursor mode, then calls vtable+8 on each of the eight entries.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_ApplyVisibility
functions.summary: Decides which overlay elements are visible from the referenced record's flags (data-manager record f_49: +0x17/+0x18) and the current mode (work+8->+0x48 +0x281 == 8), toggling element objects through vtable +0x24.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_UpdateEntries
functions.summary: Per-frame overlay update: detects movement of the followed actor (3D distance or 2D screen delta), applies the visibility pass and steps each of the eight sub-objects' size/timer, hiding the ones that shrink past the threshold.

functions.name: maybe_Container_NodeList_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a container object: installs its vtable, clears the eight intrusive node-list heads, allocates the 0x8C/0x14-byte helper nodes with their own vtables and stores them at self[2..9].

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_ReleaseSubObjects
functions.summary: Releases the eight sub-objects of the overlay widget: for each of the eight pointers at self+i*4+8 it calls the sub-object's vtable+4 and clears the slot, then returns self.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_SetVisibleAndForward
functions.summary: Two-step visibility setter shared by the layout-child classes: calls Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim(self, visible) and then unconditionally tail-calls the object's vtable +0x5C with the same visible value.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_UpdateTransform
functions.signature: void Ui_Overlay_UpdateTransform(UiOverlay* self, uint32_t arg2, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4, float scale)
functions.summary: Positions the active overlay slot: computes the distance scale from the slot's world anchor, tests whether it is ahead of the camera (stored as the slot visibility byte), projects it, refreshes the slot record and then applies the widget screen transform.

functions.name: Ui_PartySelectWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the party-selection window: base 0x001D8B6C, vtable 0x77404C (party-select row binding) and six 0x14-byte member rows, one per party member.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartySelect_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor: stores the vtable argument, runs the scene-node base teardown 0x001D8C2C and releases the block.

functions.name: Ui_Marker_FollowActor
functions.summary: Lazily allocates the 0x98-byte marker and keeps it on its actor: copies the actor position, hides the sprite when the actor is hidden/far (distance limit actor+0x320), and refreshes attachment visibility.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SetState
functions.summary: Sets a window's state through its holder: marks the window dirty, resets its sub-object lists for the new state (maybe_Ui_Window_ResetSubObjectLists), commits the sub-objects, records the state and clears the retry counter; when there is no window it raises the holder's 'unavailable' byte.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Marker_RetryBindTarget
functions.summary: Throttled rebind step of a UI marker: counts up the retry counter at +0x08, then samples an id through 0x00649050 (0xff = not ready), stores it on the target object and commits it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Marker_RetryBindTarget_Label
functions.summary: Unaligned Thumb entry artefact located two bytes inside 0x003BC428 instruction; not an independent function.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CreateSubObject
functions.signature: void* Ui_SakusenWindow_CreateSubObject(void* slot, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates and registers the 0x200-byte sub-object of the tactics (sakusen) window: allocates from the UI heap, constructs it with the sakusen sub-object ctor, registers it through Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable, stores it in the slot and clears the slot's ready byte at +0x94.

functions.name: Ui_ReleaseSubObject
functions.summary: Releases the sub-object referenced by slot word [1] through the UI core's heap and clears the slot, returning the slot so callers can chain; a template copy of the same body lives at 0x003D2DFC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SpriteActor_CreateEntry
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SpriteActor_CreateEntry(void* self, const void* params)
functions.summary: Creates a 3D sprite-actor entry for the UI: allocates the 0x298-byte actor object, initialises its parameter block, creates the sprite from the table and links it into the list.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SpriteActor_SetSprite
functions.summary: Resolves sprite id through 0x002D1810 and assigns the resulting handle to the sprite actor via tail call to 0x002B6B24.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a sprite actor: stores the caller-supplied vtable and its +0x98 secondary, unlinks the render node at +0x24C, runs Field_Object_DtorBase and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_DtorB
functions.summary: Second, shorter copy of the sprite-actor deleting destructor: unlinks and destroys the sprite at +0x24C and frees the actor.

functions.name: Field_FindPlacementCellByDelta
functions.signature: void Field_FindPlacementCellByDelta(u32* out, int* dx, int* dy, u32 record, u32 record2, u32* extra)
functions.summary: Searches for a placement cell one step away from the current one: reads the field object manager's grid at (work+8)->f_54->f_20, resolves the record pointers, offsets the current cell index by dx/dy and tests the candidate through maybe_Field_Placement_TestAreaB.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_CanMoveCursor
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_List_CanMoveCursor(u32 cursor, u32 target, u32 arg3, u32 direction)
functions.summary: Cursor-move gate: when Field2D_MapChip_CanWalkDirection reports that the map chip cannot be walked it asks maybe_Ui_List_CellMatchesAtPoint about the {cursor, target} pair in the given direction, otherwise the move is allowed and it returns 1.

functions.name: Map_IsCellPassable
functions.summary: Returns true when the map cell is walkable: false if the interaction/blocking test 0x005A3604() reports busy or if the terrain/collision id returned by 0x00664A80(cell) equals 9. Called for every cell in an area footprint by hit-test and placement code.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_MoveCursorToFreeCell
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_List_MoveCursorToFreeCell(u32* out, int* offsetRect, int* gridSize, u32 group, u32 key, u32* owner)
functions.summary: Scans a gridSize[0] x gridSize[1] rectangle of cells anchored at the current field object's position (work->f_54->f_20 + f_78/f_7c), returns in out the first cell that the geometric cell hit-test accepts, or the empty record when none does; the not-found path instead tests the area around the actor through 0x006E4900. The caller 0x003BD008 uses the empty record as 'no free cell', so 'free' is still only the caller's interpretation: the accept test itself is a pure hit-test.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_FindFirstFreeSlot
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_List_FindFirstFreeSlot(char* out, u32 record, u32 grid, u32 group, u64 packed)
functions.summary: Searches a list/grid for the first free slot in one of three scan orders (forward, backward or rotated, chosen by the current layout mode 0/2/4) and returns the first hit, or the empty record.

functions.name: Ui_Object_SelectEmbeddedNode
functions.summary: Broadcasts the selection flag to the children of the embedded node at self+0x3430: passes 1 only when that node equals the element pointer given in r1, so the node shows when it is the current selection and hides otherwise.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_AddRowToView
functions.summary: Action step that copies one data row into the list window's view: tail-calls 0x00612848(bagWork, rowId), which rejects rows whose name is 7+ characters or whose id/key is empty, finds the first free slot of the 20-entry view table at bagWork+0x7b3c and copies the 0x84-byte row plus its flags and owner key into it; returns 1 on success, 0 when the row is unusable or the view is full.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_RemoveRowByKey
functions.signature: u32 Ui_ListWindow_RemoveRowByKey(void* self, const u32* key)
functions.summary: Action step that removes one row from the list window's view: loads the owner key and calls 0x00612fc8(bagWork, &key), which finds the row of the 20-entry view table at bagWork+0x7b3c whose +0x88 key matches, shifts the following rows down one 0x8c record and clears the last row (key = -1).

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds every pane of the dive/profile window: the normal and VIP backgrounds, the title and the five list panes, then all the sub-windows (people list, list2, album, keyboard, name entry, talk, yes/no, call list, gold, accessory, operation).

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_BindControl
functions.summary: Unlinks the window's control node and rebinds the shared control slot used by all five dive-family windows.

functions.name: Ui_BaseWindow_Release
functions.summary: Shared release/destructor tail for base windows: calls the base teardown 0x0029F9E0, the class hook at vtable +0x4C, clears the per-object 'pool owner' flag at self+0x356C while clearing the shared pooled UI object, then runs the vtable +0x60 hook and rebinds the child pane.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SelectRowFromRef
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_SelectRowFromRef(void* self, const UiItemRef* ref)
functions.summary: Makes the display row named by a {index, kind} list-item reference the current row: resolves the reference with Ui_ListItemRef_ResolveRowSimple and copies the row into the data panel's current-row block through Ui_DataPanel_CopyRowIntoCurrent.

functions.name: ActorActionSeq_RunNode
functions.signature: void ActorActionSeq_RunNode(ActorSeqRunner* self, int nodeIndex, int step)
functions.summary: Runs one node of the actor action sequence: resets the command list at runner+0x4C8, marks the runner busy (+0x4C4), pushes the 0x10-byte node at array[index] with the step number, and when the node has neither +3 nor +6 set it marks +6 = 1 and the per-actor state byte (work + actorId*0x8C + 0x2AB00) so the step runs only once.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_RemoveSourceRowAt
functions.summary: Deletes row `index` from the 50-entry, 0x8C-byte row table at (work+0x24A98)+0x5FE4: the rows behind it shift down one slot and the freed last row is zeroed with a 0xFFFFFFFF key.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_SubObject_ResetAndActivate
functions.summary: Reset-and-activate handler of an actor sub-object (sole slot of vtable 0x0072BD8C): resets the base state, re-shows every child of the +0x180 list, drains the pending-animation counter, re-links the embedded node and sets the sub-widget state to 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ActorRow_Refresh
functions.summary: Refreshes an actor list row from field/bag state: reads gold and storage values from bag work (+0x24A98) through 0x0066B11C and 0x0066B19C, stores them into sub-objects at +0x160/+0x184, then formats the row message from work record +0x6B8.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_RenderObject_ReleaseBindings
functions.summary: Conditionally releases the three resource bindings held by a render object: the texture binding at +0x68 (when +0x90 is clear), the material binding at +0x94 (when +0x28 is set and +0x30 clear) and the material set at +0x98.

functions.name: std_LoadU64
functions.signature: u64 std_LoadU64(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, u64* p)
functions.summary: Trivial 64-bit load: returns *p unchanged (used as a callback where the container passes two context words that the accessor ignores).

functions.name: Actor_SubObject_Reset
functions.summary: Shared reset of an actor sub-object: resets the ten embedded lists/flags (+0x138, +0x140, +0x17C, +0x1A4, +0x1C4, +0x1F4, +0x1FC, +0x208 ...), marks it busy at +0x14C, starts animation track 15 on the pane at +0x1A4 and moves the state machine at +0x23C back to 0.

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_Close
functions.summary: Shuts the dive window down: drains the pending message queue, releases the two control blocks, resets the actor sub-objects, sets the label state and hands over to the shared UI reset helper at +0xBC8.

functions.name: Data_SetIndexedLabel
functions.signature: void Data_SetIndexedLabel(int unusedCtx, int index, const u16* label)
functions.summary: Stores a 7-character UTF-16 label in the indexed 0x8C-stride label table in GameWork: clears the four leading words of the row and copies the fixed-length string with zero padding.

functions.name: Party_AppendBlankMemberRecords
functions.summary: Calls Party_List_InsertBlankRecord(bagWork) `count` times: that helper shifts the 0x2A0-byte party-record array at bagWork+0x9400 up one slot and installs a freshly blanked record at the front, so this appends `count` empty party members.

functions.name: maybe_ActorActionSeq_CollectPendingNodes
functions.summary: Collects into a 50-entry buffer the ids (first word of each 0x10-byte node) of the action-sequence nodes that are enabled (+9 non-zero) but not started (+3 zero), then blanks the matching rows of the 50-entry work table at bagWork+0x5fe4 through Ui_DataPanel_ResetRowsByIndexList, and returns how many nodes were collected.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_SetStateWord
functions.signature: void maybe_Actor_SetStateWord(void* self, int actorId, u16 value)
functions.summary: Plain setter that stores a u16 at work + actorId*0x8C + 0x2AAF8, in the same per-record array whose neighbouring +0x2AB00 byte is the record's state.

functions.name: maybe_Party_CollectMemberIds
functions.summary: Collects IDs of all active party members into a stack array and passes them to maybe_Party_CompactSlotTable (0x0018D3D4).

functions.name: Ui_BaseWindow_Close
functions.signature: void Ui_BaseWindow_Close(UiWindow* self, u32 messageId, int arg3)
functions.summary: Shared close handler for four window classes: sets message arguments 5 and 6, applies the optional message id, runs the class close hook and rebinds the panel pointer.

functions.name: Work_CopyRowToDataPanel
functions.summary: Copies row rowIndex of the 0x8C-byte row table at save work +0x7B3C into the first free row of the 50-entry data-panel table at +0x5FE4. Shop_BuyItem calls it after a purchase so the bought item's row shows up in the panel.

functions.name: lt0
functions.signature: void lt0(int arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the diving ('dive form') UI screen: installs vtable 0x768FC8 (Ui_DiveForm_InitPanes) and chains six embedded sub-widget constructors (0x00382A98) before building the child array.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_DtorDelete_2
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of a composite window base: invokes destructor 0x003BE544 and frees object memory via operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CompositeWindow_ReleaseChildren
functions.summary: Release helper of a large composite window (state extends past +0x3520): stores the vtable, drops the handle at +0x3520 and unwinds the child chain (two title labels, a layout container, two elements and two list objects).

functions.name: Ui_TitleLoopWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds the title window's text panes: 'txt_title', a second text row, the small 'title' sprite and the looping 'title_loop' element.

functions.name: Ui_Timer_CountdownSe221
functions.summary: Timed UI part tick: forwards to the child object, then while the counter f_140 is positive decrements it and plays SE 0xDD when it reaches zero; when bit 0x10 of f_138 is set it instead resets the part (f_13D=0, f_94=0, f_140=1).

functions.name: Ui_TitleWindow_ShowTitle
functions.summary: Shows one title entry: sets/clears the selected flag on both row elements, resolves the title string for ids below 300 and pushes it into the two bound text rows; ids outside the table leave the rows as they are.

functions.name: Ui_TitleWindow_SetButtonVisible
functions.summary: Looks the pane named 'null_btn' up in the window's layout, sets or clears bit 0 of its +0x44 flag and remembers the request at +0x13D so later refreshes can re-apply it.

functions.name: Ui_TitleWindow_StartAnim
functions.summary: Restarts the title window's element animation and resets its frame counter to 0x18.

functions.name: Ui_Element_ResolveResourceRefAlways
functions.signature: void Ui_Element_ResolveResourceRefAlways(int self, int* stream, int* reader)
functions.summary: Same serialized-reference resolution as 0x003AB824/0x003D27CC, but without the (self+0x98) guard: the word at stream+4 is always passed through the reader's vtable slot +0x24 (with the relocation slot at reader+0x60C) and written back.

functions.name: Ui_TitleLoopWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the title window: allocates it from the UI singleton allocator, initialises the row cache and two embedded elements, and returns the base-adjusted pointer.

functions.name: Ui_TitleLoopWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the title-loop window: installs vtable 0x00769034, releases the layout references at +0x194 and +0x144, unlinks the node at +0x124, destroys the embedded object at +0x124 and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_TitleLoopWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor twin of 0x003BEE4C: installs vtable 0x00769034, releases the layout references at +0x194 and +0x144, unlinks the node at +0x124 and destroys the embedded object there.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GridList_AllocRows
functions.summary: Allocates the two row arrays of a grid list: clamps the row and column counts from the parameter block to at least 1, stores them at +0x0d/+0x0e, and allocates the 0x34-byte and 0x2c-byte record arrays through Mem_AllocAligned plus std_ConstructArray, each with a [elementSize, count] header.

functions.name: Model_BindIndexedResource
functions.signature: u32 Model_BindIndexedResource(Model* self, int index, Resource* res)
functions.summary: The indexed model-resource binder: it clears the index slot, releases the old binding and binds the new resource (or unbinds on NULL).

functions.name: Model_BindDoubleBufferedResource
functions.summary: Binds a resource into the model's double-buffered slot: toggles the buffer selector (+0xC), releases the previously bound handle of the other slot, binds the new resource and registers it with the renderer (or clears the slot on failure).

functions.name: Model_BindIndexedResourceB
functions.signature: u32 Model_BindIndexedResourceB(Model* self, int index, Resource* res)
functions.summary: Binds (or unbinds, when res is null) one entry of the model's second resource table at self->f_98 (stride 0x2C): releases the old material set, binds the new one through Gfx_BindResourceSetVariant and registers it with the render object.

functions.name: Model_BindVariantResources
functions.summary: Binds one resource-set variant to a model: fills a small bind descriptor with the resource-set tags (0x782244/0x782254), binds the variant through Gfx_BindResourceSetVariant using the model's render object, applies it with the model's bind-set call and releases the temporary bindings.

functions.name: Model_BindSingleResource
functions.summary: Binds a single resource to the model's dedicated binding slot at +0x68: clearing the resource unbinds it, otherwise the old texture binding is released, the new one is bound through Gfx_BindSingleResource and, on success, the render object switches to slot +0x68.

functions.name: Model_ResourceSet_ReleaseCachedLists
functions.summary: Releases the five cached sub-lists of a model resource set (three embedded list heads and the two allocated list blocks at +0x94/+0x98) when they are no longer shared.

functions.name: Model_ResourceSet_DtorLists
functions.summary: Destroys a model resource set's list storage: releases the three embedded lists, deletes the two heap blocks at +0x94 and +0x98 and clears the set to its empty state.

functions.name: maybe_Container_SmallArrayCtor
functions.signature: void maybe_Container_SmallArrayCtor(u32 * self, u32 u32, u32 u322)
functions.summary: Stores two caller words at +0/+4, clears the count word and three flag bytes at +8/+0xC and default-constructs two 0x2C-byte elements at +0x10 with element ctor 0x0055E628.

functions.name: Model_ReleaseResourceSet
functions.summary: Releases the three embedded texture-binding sub-sets at f_10/f_3C/f_68, frees the two arrays at f_94/f_98 with operator delete[], resets the handle/state fields and destroys the 0x2C-stride binding array, returning self. Called from the model attach-slot destructor path.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_UpdateMain
functions.summary: Main update of the field actor-action sequence player: runs the current 100-byte action entry, plays its SE/animation, waits for the actor and then advances to the next entry or ends the sequence (ten switch cases on the state word at self[0x882]).

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorActionSeq_UpdateAlt
functions.summary: Second field actor action-sequence runner (states 0x1A23..0x1AA5): runs the current 100-byte entry at +0x70C, applies the sound/camera side effects and advances or ends the sequence.

functions.name: ActorActionSeq_CanAdvance
functions.summary: Answers whether the action sequence may move on: it counts the actors whose per-actor report (virtual +0x14) is finished and, when not all are, compares the per-character counters at +0x9A5/+0x9A6 with the actor count. Returns 1 when the sequence may advance.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_StepEntryA
functions.summary: Runs one entry of the field actor action sequence: applies the entry's camera/actor action, waits for the animation and advances the entry index.

functions.name: ActorActionSeq_AdvanceAction
functions.summary: Advances the sequence's action cursor: derives the per-character repetition limit from +0x4ED (character ids 5 and 0x24 have their own rules), bumps the action counter +0x9A6 and the per-character index +0x87D when the current slot count reaches the limit, and returns 1 when it moved.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_RunExtraEntry
functions.summary: Action-sequence state step for the secondary entry list at f_21F4: state 0x18DE flushes the pending entry and pushes the damage action entry, waits for Actor_IsIdleAndQueueEmpty, then advances the action, updates the unit anim/slot widgets and ends in state -2 or 0x18F8.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_AppendEntries
functions.summary: Builds the action-entry queue for the sequence: appends a new 100-byte entry (actor index + resolved action object), clamps the count to 12 and hands the queue to the submit/advance helpers.

functions.name: Battle_Sequence_EmitQueuedMessage
functions.summary: Emits the battle message queued for one actor: takes the u16 message id from the per-actor table at self+actorIndex*6+0x237C and, when it is not -1, releases the current layout and queues the popup entry {0, msgId}; returns 1 when a message was emitted.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_RunSteps
functions.summary: Executes the current 8-byte action step from table 0x0063F60C: for the selected actor (or all actors when the single-actor flag is clear) it checks the unit's virtual state and applies a byte parameter via virtual method +0x64; then advances the step index or jumps to the u16 'next' id, ending on 0xFFFF.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_BeginEntry
functions.summary: Starts the current action entry: asks the entry's object to begin (vtable slot 4), builds the entry's parameter block with 0x00630D94 and registers it with the event command interface.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_ApplyActorCommand
functions.summary: Applies the current per-actor command of a field action sequence: for an 'M'-type entry it takes the actor through vtable +0x4C, adds action state flags (Battle_AddStateFlags 4) and releases the pending action object, then bumps the actor index, wraps it at the sequence's actor count and plays the new actor's animation and SE.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateActorStep
functions.summary: Per-actor dispatch of the battle action sequence: reads the actor state byte at self+0x168D and routes state 0/6/7 to the extra-entry runner, 1 to StepEntryA, 2 to AppendEntries, and 3/4/5 through the wait-id states 0x19BF/0x19E0/0x19FF (+0x11/+0x0E) that advance the action once Actor_IsIdleAndQueueEmpty, ending with the ready flag f_27CC and state -2.

functions.name: FieldParty_Ui_RefreshMemberSlot
functions.summary: Vtable slot 1 of the field-party HUD: resets the slot id, rebuilds the member's resource tree and sprite from the battle data, then re-applies the five slot flags and forces a refresh when the battle-side flag is set.

functions.name: FieldParty_Ui_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the 0x27D0-byte FieldParty_Ui object derived from Battle_UnitObject_Ctor (0x0042963C), installing vtable 0x00769084, initializing layout params (+0x2218) and member slots (FieldParty_ResetMemberSlot), and returning self.

functions.name: FieldParty_Ui_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field-party HUD object: installs the two part vtables (0x00769088 and the base 0x00769084), destroys the eight 0x1C-byte member slots at +0x9B9, runs the base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: ItemList_Iterator_GetEntryByte
functions.summary: Iterator virtual (vtable 0x007691A4 slot +4): normalises the cursor with Ui_ListCursor_MoveToSelectable and returns the byte at +2 of the current 4-byte item entry, i.e. its kind/category byte.

functions.name: ItemList_Iterator_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a filtered iterator over the item/record table: modes 0..2 use the static table at bag work +0x24ACC, other modes the generated table from func_0061175C; it stores begin/end/cursor, sets the index to -1 and advances the cursor until maybe_Item_MatchesCategoryFilter accepts an entry.

functions.name: ItemList_Iterator_GetEntryId
functions.summary: Iterator virtual (vtable 0x007691A4 slot +1): normalises the cursor with Ui_ListCursor_MoveToSelectable and returns the 16-bit id at +0 of the current item-list entry.

functions.name: ItemList_Iterator_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the item-list iterator: installs vtable 0x0076919C, clears the four state words, sets the mode byte to 0x11 and initialises the cursor through maybe_ItemList_Iterator_Init.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeRowNullTextWindow_InitPanesB
functions.summary: Second three-null-row window: binds 'null_txt_l1..l3' at row ids 0..2 and then is cut off by a bad jumptable at 0x003C2450.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeRowNullTextWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the three-row null-text window: releases the widget and frees the object.

functions.name: FieldParty_ResetState
functions.summary: FieldParty vtable slot: frees the embedded anim array at self+0x1C through Mem_FreeAnimArray and clears the four state fields at self+0x7C, +0x88, +0x89 and +0xB8.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_DeleteThunk
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor thunk of a scene-node class: stores the supplied vtable word in *node, runs the destructor body Gfx_SceneNode_DtorBody and frees the block with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: FieldParty_Ui_UpdateMemberSlot
functions.summary: The field-party HUD member-slot state machine: it waits on 0x14A0/0x14A8/0x14B4 and binds the member model before finishing in 0x00630BB8.

functions.name: FieldParty_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor copy used by the FieldParty vtable: stores the given vtable at +0, releases the render/attach handle at +0x125C and frees the object. 0x003CDEB4 is the byte-identical base interactive-object copy.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_Ui_Slot_Ctor
functions.summary: Tiny record constructor: calls 0x00111394, which clears the four halfwords at self+4..+0xA, and returns self. Byte-identical to 0x003C3318.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_UpdateMemberActionDisplay
functions.summary: Refreshes the battle member display: scans the eight 0x2C-stride member records for state 6, then per member updates row visibility, spawns name/number popups and queues battle messages for the current action.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_TryStartAction
functions.summary: Starts the current actor's action if one is pending: reads the actor, its HP/state byte at +0xB0F7 and its stat, compares against the action row and the row-offset helper, then queues action id 0x1F/0x20 (normal) or 0x21/0x22 (variant) through Battle_QueueActionEx. Returns 1 when an action was queued.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_UpdateEquipStateByte
functions.summary: Recomputes a unit's equipment-state byte at +0xDE0E: resolves the party member of the unit's slot-0 child, tests the member's equipped item category (slot 1, category 6 clears the flag) and forces 0 when the unit's owner object has +0x307 clear.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_BuildMemberRow
functions.signature: u32 Battle_ActionSequence_BuildMemberRow(BattleActionSequence* self, u32 actorIndex, u32 actionId, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Fills the current member slot of a battle action sequence and builds its display row: clears the 0x1a-byte slot record, takes the slot's UI object from vtable+0x10c, records the actor index byte, builds the row with Text_BuildRowForMember and attaches the paired slots with maybe_Ui_Row_AttachPairedSlots.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_PushActionMessage
functions.signature: u64 Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_PushActionMessage(BattleUiMemberWidget* self, u32 arg2, u32* arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Member-widget vtable slot: pushes the action message id stored in the member record (+0x2AA) through Battle_Ui_PushMemberActionMessage, runs the widget's own update slot at +0x48 and returns the battle UI block at world+0x5C+0x4238.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_Ctor
functions.summary: Tiny record constructor: calls 0x00111394, which clears the four halfwords at self+4..+0xA, and returns self; one of the many template copies of the same 20-byte record constructor.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_SelectActor
functions.summary: Member-widget slot: if the requested actor differs from the displayed one, or is in the dead/fled states (type 10/8), route the change through func_001F9B58; otherwise just re-select the actor.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_PickRandomReadyActor
functions.summary: Counts the actors whose virtual +0x10 reports ready, rolls a battle-RNG index in [0, count-1] and returns the actor slot at that ordinal. The command and round code use it to pick which ready actor acts.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateActorFlags
functions.summary: When self->f_1260->u8_306 != 0, evaluates 0x00486208 on the primary acting unit (self->vt[+0x48](self,0)) with active unit count (0x00630D64(self) or 1 when self->f_DDF8 != 0) and self->u8_125C, storing the resulting 0/1 byte at self->u8_DE0C.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_PushBalloonMessages
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_PushBalloonMessages(BattleUiContext* self, u32 recordHandle, u32 arg3, * u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: Decompilation is damaged (unaffected registers); appears to de-duplicate a message id against a stack list.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_AdvanceTurn
functions.summary: Advances the battle turn cursor: bumps the participant counter at self+0x377D; when the all-ready byte +0x377E is clear it bumps the acting slot +0x377B, clears +0x377C, otherwise re-selects the slot through maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_FindNextReadyActor. It then resolves the actor for the new slot via vtable+0x10C (2D) or +0x60 (3D) and stores the resulting selection.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_BuildMemberRowB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_BuildMemberRowB(BattleActionSequence* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Second (Thumb, register-starved) copy of the member-row builder at 0x003C3118: same self+0x2EAB/0x2EC1 slot arithmetic, Text_BuildRowForMember and maybe_Ui_Row_AttachPairedSlots.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_BuildMemberRowC
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_BuildMemberRowC(BattleActionSequence* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Third copy of the battle member-row builder (0x003C3118 / 0x003C36AC): same self+0x2EAB/0x2EC1 slot arithmetic, Text_BuildRowForMember call and paired-slot attach call. The readable body is a register-starved decode, so only the callee set is trustworthy.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_Update
functions.summary: Slot 0 of the four Battle_Ui_MemberWidget vtables: fetches the sequence object at self+0x122C, asks 0x00630DC8 for the pending count, marks byte +0x108 on each widget returned by vt[0x48], then handles the current widget's state 0x99 (including a vt[0xE8]/vt[0x128] probe).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_ActionSequence_MarkSlots
functions.summary: Not a real entry point: it is the continuation of 0x003C36E8 after the beq at 0x003C36FC, and the readable C is a single bogus CONCAT44 on unaff_r9. The block marks byte +0x108 on each of the N widgets returned by the widget's vt[0x48].

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_GetPendingActionCount
functions.summary: Returns how many action executions the current action has (func_0048EDD0 over the action id at +0x125C), tripled when the battle multi-action flag at battle-work +0x4244 is set.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_AreActionsReady
functions.summary: Returns 1 when every planned action slot is either empty or still resolvable through the handle table (and the four balloon/spawn flags are satisfied), 0 while something is still pending; on the way it drives the four member-balloon spawners for the pending slots.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_RunCommands
functions.summary: Runs the queued commands of a round: builds the processed-index list, keeps dispatching the current actor's commands (ProcessActorCommand) while the pending count allows it, then advances the turn and repeats for every acting actor of the round.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_BeginTurn
functions.signature: void Battle_ActionSequence_BeginTurn(BattleActionSequence* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Starts a turn: clears the participant counter, takes the action count from the sequence record (+0x1FB), applies the x3 multi-hit rule when the actor has the 0xA0 flag, and picks the first acting slot with the battle RNG (func_001CA474).

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_PlayMemberActionSound
functions.summary: Plays the sound effect for a member's current action: resolves the actor, checks its animation handle and plays the id at actor+0x2D0 or +0x2D2.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_BuildMemberActionEntries
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_BuildMemberActionEntries(BattleUiContext* self, BattleActor* actor, u32 actionId, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Fills the next free entry of the battle HUD's 48-entry (0x90-byte) action table for up to six action slots of an actor: checks the actor against the slot's type byte, copies the 0x58-byte action descriptor, stores the actor pointer and validity byte and spawns the type-0xF balloon when the battle is in 3D mode.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_PushActionBlockedMessage
functions.summary: For the actor at actorIndex: plays SE 0xA6B, sets the actor's display state and pushes a battle message row built from the actor record's f_52/f_54 message ids; when the helper 0x0048ECE8 reports the actor ineligible it clears the popups and replays popup 0x4B.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_RefreshAllMemberRows
functions.summary: Slot 19 of the member-widget vtables: once the row data is dirty (self->f_DE0E and actor state 1) it rebuilds every member row through Battle_Ui_BuildMemberRow - forward, or in reverse when the party uses the 'all members' layout (equipment category 4) - and returns 1.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_PushMemberActionMessage
functions.summary: Pushes the per-member action popup: builds the {member index, actor, target, actionId} descriptor from the battle UI context and, unless the action id is 0xFFFF, hands it to the popup queue (Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForActorPair).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_ToggleStatusMessage
functions.summary: One-shot member-widget step (guarded by self+0xDE0D): if the member's +0x2AE is -1 it clears popups and plays popup 0x84, else it spawns the actor-pair popup with that id, then pushes the member status message.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_PlayPopupSe
functions.summary: Shared tail block (no frame of its own) that plays SE 0x15E (350) at volume 1.0 through Sound_GetPlayer + Sound_PlaySeById; reached by tail-branch from three Battle_ActionSequence processors (ExecuteMemberActions, ProcessDefaultAction, ProcessState5). The 'popup' attribution is unverified.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnPopupForUnit
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_SpawnPopupForUnit(BattleUi* self, BattleUnit* unit, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Builds a popup descriptor for a battle unit (id from table 0x0063E05C(unit id)->f_4a) and spawns it through the popup-entry manager 0x003FBE4C. Ghidra marks the tail as bad code, but the descriptor setup is clear.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnPopupEntry
functions.summary: Thin wrapper: obtains the battle popup manager via 0x001FD96C and spawns one descriptor with count 1.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_PushMessageIfStateFlag
functions.summary: Tail-merged block that reads the battle-work 3D/2D flag at work+0x4244 (Os_GetGameWork -> +8 -> +0x5C) and, only when it is set, queues a battle message with the pending message id kept in r7.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_PushActorStateMessage
functions.summary: Posts one popup message for the current actor: id 0x4B when the actor state is 9, otherwise the literal id at 0x003C4AAC, handed to Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForActorPair as an {actor, index, id} descriptor.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_ActionEntryTail
functions.summary: Not an independent function: 0x003C4A20 is a cold tail block (no prologue, live r4-r8) that increments member+0xDF0 when the battle work's 3D flag (+0x4244) is set, then pops. Ghidra's 'BuildMemberActionEntriesB' body is a recycled decompilation of 0x003C3F5C's internal labels and must not be merged as a separate routine.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnPopupUnique
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_SpawnPopupUnique(BattleUi* self, BattleUnit* unit, u32 count)
functions.summary: Spawns a popup for a unit only if its table id (f_4a) is not already present in the caller's id list; the dedup list lives on the stack. Called from the battle action-sequence dispatcher when a command is executed.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_RefreshAllMemberRowsB
functions.summary: Damaged reverse loop that rebuilds battle member rows: it counts an index down to -1 and calls Battle_Ui_BuildMemberRow for each step, then returns 1. The index/base registers are lost (unaff_r8, in_r12), so only the loop shape and the named row builder are reliable.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloonForSlot
functions.summary: Damaged per-slot balloon spawn: when the record at (unaff_r5+4)->+0x2A6 is clear it refreshes the balloon layout (Battle_Ui_LayoutBalloons / Battle_Ui_Balloon_CalcAnchorTransform); otherwise it takes the member-anchored variant through vtable+0x10C and 0x005F5818. In both cases it creates the effect instance for record id +0x2BA and stores it at context+0xD8EC.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_SetSequenceEndFlag
functions.summary: Tail-merged block of the action-sequence updater: calls the bag routine 0x006138D4 with id 3 (Game_GetWork -> +0x24A98) and then sets the 'sequence finished' byte at self+0xF1C to 1 if it was still 0.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_ConfirmSelection
functions.signature: bool maybe_Actor_ConfirmSelection(void* self, int index, int value)
functions.summary: If `index` equals the panel's current selection (self+0x497) it applies it: takes the member id from the child object at +0x768, resolves the member record, calls the inventory-slot helper 0x00190270(member,index,value), sets member+0x12E0/+0x12E2 to 0xFF and notifies the owner (self[0x48B]) with code 4; returns whether the index matched.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_LinkMemberActors
functions.summary: Links live battle actors to their HUD widgets: walks the party list at battle work+0x4260 and the sibling list at +0x427C, resolves each entry's handle through the tagged object table (0x7B80C0), compares the actor/UI ids and calls the widget's vtable slot +0x98 to bind the actor.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_ExecuteMemberActions
functions.summary: Executes a member's queued battle actions: spawns the member effect, starts the per-slot balloon and advances the participant cursor (+0x3780) until all actions are consumed.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchActorState
functions.signature: void Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchActorState(BattleActionSequence* self, u32 actorIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Main dispatcher for the next acting unit: handles the 'already acting' case, then switches on the actor state byte (+0x293) to the normal (0x003C52E0 / 0x003C819C), special (0x003C583C inline) or item (0x003CA5E0) action handlers.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_ExecuteSpecialAction
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_ExecuteSpecialAction(BattleActionSequence* self, u32* actorIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Registers one member action in the current sequence slot: stores the slot's UI object and the actor index byte, finds a free entry in the 0x90-byte table at +0x4af, spawns the balloon, scans the eight member records for the '!' and '0' status markers and raises the matching indicator, plays the member action sound in 3D mode, then advances the slot cursor (clamped at 0x47).

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloonA
functions.summary: Spawns balloon slot A for a member: plays the member's SE (record+0x2CC), builds the layout/transform with Battle_Ui_LayoutBalloons or Battle_Ui_Balloon_CalcAnchorTransform depending on the record flags, then creates the effect instance for record id +0x2BA with Effect_FindOrCreateInstance and stores it at self+0xD8EC.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloonB
functions.summary: Spawns balloon slot B for a member: same layout/anchor/effect chain as 0x003C5B58 but with record id +0x2BC (700 decimal in the C), record flags f_2F8/f_2A1, offset record+0x254 and the handle stored at self+0xD8F0 with a one-shot byte at self+0xDE07.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloonC
functions.summary: Spawns balloon slot C for a member: same chain as 0x003C5D8C with record id +0x2BE, record flags f_2F9/f_2A2, offset record+0x260, handle at self+0xD8F4 and one-shot byte at self+0xDE08.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnAllMemberBalloons
functions.summary: Spawns all member balloons for the current display: calls the four spawners (A..D) guarded by their per-balloon done bytes, then creates one balloon per extra slot through the shared balloon spawn helper and lays them out.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberBalloonD
functions.summary: Spawns balloon slot D for a member: same chain again with record id +0x2C0, record flags f_2FA/f_2A3, offset record+0x26C, handle at self+0xD8F8 and one-shot byte at self+0xDE09.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_LinkMemberActorsB
functions.summary: Second actor-to-widget link pass: for the party list at battle work+0x4260, the sibling list at +0x427C and the four unit lists at +0x4298, it matches each entry's actor handle against the UI's actor list and calls the widget's vtable slot +0x98 (bind) when they match, with a unit-kind filter for the enemy lists.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_ApplyCommand
functions.summary: Body of the member-widget virtual that starts at 0x003C6BE0 (slot 9 of vtable 0x00763464; 0x003C6BE4 is the continuation after the add r1,r0,#0x1000 prologue). It dispatches on unit->f_260->f_29D: mode 3 asks the UI for the action record (ui->vt[0x40]) and forwards (1, record, message id) to unit->f_22C->vt[0x4C]; modes 1 and 2 only call vt[0x50] with 1.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_BuildMemberRow
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_BuildMemberRow(BattleUiContext* self, int memberIndex, u32 actionId)
functions.summary: Builds the display data of one battle member row: resolves the character record, equipment/item info and action slot, then stores the row and requests its effect/balloon.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnPopupsForFlaggedUnits
functions.summary: Scans unit ids 0..0x120, and for every table entry with flag f_3b set asks the list object (virtual 0xe8) whether the unit is eligible, marks it via virtual 0x120, dedups its f_4a id and spawns a popup. Used to refresh all outstanding battle popups.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_CollectActionTargets
functions.summary: Collects the distinct actor pointers referenced by the queued actions into a local vector and pushes the resulting target set to the UI as popup number/actor lists.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_ProcessActorCommand
functions.signature: void Battle_ActionSequence_ProcessActorCommand(BattleActionSequence* self, u32 actorIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Processes one participant's battle command: builds the target list and dispatches on the command character in the actor record (+0x59) to the normal/guard/item handlers.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_ProcessCommandStep
functions.summary: Battle action-sequence command branch: resolves the current actor; when the actor reports a ready action it spawns balloon 0xF and replays popup 0x4B, otherwise it puts the actor in state 0x76 and links it to the sequence.

functions.name: Battle_Effect_UpdateLinkSegments
functions.summary: Computes the two endpoints of a battle link/rope effect from model attachment nodes (part indices at self->f_768 and offsets f_29e/f_29f), converts them to world space and calls the link-segment updater 0x002DB2F0 for segment self+0x2d19+index*0x16.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_IsActorFlagSet
functions.summary: Returns bit 0 of the current actor's +0x72C flag word when the actor exists and its +0x30 bit 0 is set, otherwise 0. Used as the gate before an action sequence may run.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_NotifyUiActors
functions.summary: Marks the current actor in state 0x75 through vtable+0xE4 and then loops the UI list at battle+0x4260/+0x4264 calling 0x002789C8(object, actor) for each entry.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_ProcessState8
functions.summary: Handles the actor state 8 with action id 0x1D: pushes the message, plays the SE and sets the action slot's animation (slot 8).

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_ProcessDefaultAction
functions.summary: Default member-action handler (actor states 0 and 6): builds the target list, applies effect/message per target, checks the item category and advances the participant slot.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberEffectA
functions.summary: Member-widget slot 16: spawns the member's hit effect at its world position via effect manager call func_0070FA08 with variant 0, gated by record+0x29D and the battle-mode byte.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_FindPartIndexByKind
functions.summary: Searches the unit's model-part table for the part whose kind byte at +0x30 equals the resolved part kind: the kind comes from 0x0031D2DC(self+0x294) (0xFF when unset) and the table from func_0063FDAC(dataManager, unit+0x768), walking 0x38-byte entries. Ghidra dropped the returned index, which is why the C ends with a bare return.

functions.name: Actor_GetEquipCategory
functions.summary: Returns the category byte (+0x29) of the item equipped in slot 1 of the actor's party member: resolves the actor's slot-0 record (vtable+0x48), checks it is a party member (+0x10), gets the member record by +0x768 and the slot-1 item id (func_006292F0), then returns ItemRecord+0x29 or 0xFF when there is none.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnSlotEffectA
functions.summary: Spawns the effect attached to the current unit's first slot id (record +0x2C2): resolves the unit actor, builds the 0x5C-byte parameter block on the stack and creates the effect through Effect_FindOrCreateInstance, storing the handle at self[slot + 0x2E79].

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnSlotEffectB
functions.summary: Second per-slot effect spawner: same as 0x003C8F74 but for the unit record's +0x2C4 id and colour byte f_2A5, storing the handle at self[slot + 0x2E89].

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnSmallPopup
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_SpawnSmallPopup(BattleUi* self, BattleUnit* unit, int kind)
functions.summary: When the unit is idle or has no spare effect slots, spawns a small popup carrying text id 0x56 (kind 0) or 0x57 (kind 1) through the battle popup hub.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_ExecuteCommand
functions.summary: Runs the actor's selected command: resolves the target list, spawns the hit effects and command balloon, plays the member action SE and advances the participant cursor at self[0x3780].

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchActorEvent
functions.summary: For the current actor (vtable +0x60): counts in self[0x377C] when battle flag +0x4244 is set; when the actor fails four checks (vtable +0x10, Item_Container_CanAddItem, accepted types 8 and 10) it clears the popups and spawns popup 0x636.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateTalkMembers
functions.summary: Applies the talk-member state to every party member while the sequence is in the talk sub-mode (record +0x1F8 == 2 and +0x1F9 in 1..3), calling maybe_FieldParty_UpdateTalkMemberState for each member.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_ProcessStatusCommand
functions.summary: Status-effect command branch: if the actor carries effect id 0xD/0xE/0xF it records self+0xDE0A = 1 and clears those effects; otherwise it shows balloon 0xF and replays popup 0x4B.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_MemberWidget_UpdateLinkState
functions.summary: Slot 14 of the member-widget class: when the linked actor has flag bit 0x20000000 or 0x40000000 set it runs the matching vtable pair, calls the link/unlink pass (maybe_Battle_Ui_LinkMemberActors or its B twin) and clears that bit.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_Balloon_CalcAnchorTransform
functions.summary: Scans up to 16 unit slots, selects the one with the largest model scale (table field f_9a), then fills the balloon anchor offset (+0x2C..+0x50) and builds a quaternion rotation from the model's orientation and an attachment node. Used when spawning member balloons.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SpawnMemberEffectB
functions.summary: Member-widget slot 15: same hit-effect spawn as 0x3C8D34 but with effect variant 1 and its own colour constant block.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateEffectSlots
functions.summary: Updates the 72 (0x48) per-slot effects via 0x003CA6DC, then - if any of the 8 formation entries at BattleScene+0x30+idx*0x2C has type 0x21 - rolls 1..100 per entry in self->f_DE00 with the battle RNG and spawns the slot effect (0x003C91DC) when the roll is <= the entry's threshold at +0xBB08.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateUnitsForSubMode2
functions.summary: When self->f_1260->u8_1F8 == 2 and u8_1F9 is 1..3, iterates all battle units (0..func_00630D64(self)-1 via virtual +0x10C) and dispatches 0x001FD10C(self, unit) on each.

functions.name: Battle_ActionSequence_UpdateMemberPoses

functions.name: Ui_DiveForm_OnCursorInput
functions.signature: void Ui_DiveForm_OnCursorInput(UiDiveForm* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveForm_UpdateSelectionVisual
functions.summary: Entry 0 of the dive-form handler table at 0x0072C508: with bit 2 of +0x3770 set it only refreshes the command list at +0x134 (0x006D89DC), otherwise it applies the current entry's three signed angle bytes to the model at +0x388, marks +0x3778 and the render object visible and continues at 0x003D6C18.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveForm_OnConfirm
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_DiveForm_OnConfirm(UiDiveForm* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Input handler of the dive form (handler table 0x0072C4C8): f_3770 bit 2 pops a pane, the 0x142 mask hit-tests the button at self+0x2A4 and either pushes the detail pane or writes pending result 0xFFFF, marks f_3778 and pops panes to the handler; the plain bit-0 path forwards the stored input triple to 0x001A60A0.
