functions.summary: NPC version of the model-variant refresh: runs the shared 0x005E7818 refresh, selects variant 3 from actor byte +0x43 or variant 2/1 from the character record of the id at +0x22C, then pushes the pending attachment value +0x164 into the model and clears it.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ApplyWeaponAnim
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_ApplyWeaponAnim(FieldActor* self, int arg2, int arg3, int owner)
functions.summary: Applies the weapon pose: copies the weapon transform slots into the actor pose, initialises the attach matrices, updates the weapon animation and falls back to the default weapon animation when none is set.

functions.name: Field_Actor_SetWeaponAnimTime
functions.summary: Computes the weapon-animation start value at +0x230: (f_228 + f_254 + 1) * 16, or a randomised/scaled variant built from the game RNG at (work+8)+0x98 when randomize is set.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ReleaseWeaponAttach
functions.summary: Detaches the weapon attachment: resets the attach object at f_160 (Model_Attach_SetFadeRange), clears the attachment pointer f_29C and invalidates the weapon slot f_2A0 with -1.

functions.name: Field_Npc_ApplyModelVariant
functions.signature: void Field_Npc_ApplyModelVariant(FieldNpc* self, int forwarded, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Picks the NPC's model variant: variant 3 when the override flag at +0x43 is set, otherwise variant 2 when the party member at +0x22c has bit 0x10 of +0xda set, else variant 1; the choice is applied through 0x005E7848.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_UpdateWeaponAttachRange
functions.signature: int maybe_Field_Actor_UpdateWeaponAttachRange(FieldActor* actor, int arg2, int arg3, int * owner)
functions.summary: Per-frame weapon-attach watchdog: when the UI overlay byte (work+8->+0x48, +0x284) is clear it compares the weapon position (+0x27/+0x29) with the body position (+0x30/+0x32) and drops the attachment once the distance exceeds the epsilon 0x34000000 (Model_Attach_SetFadeRange on +0x160, clears +0xA7 and sets +0xA8 to -1); in the scripted-pose branch it counts the hold time at +0xA8 down and calls vtable +0x98 when it reaches zero. Always returns 1.

functions.name: Field_CollisionObject_InitB
functions.summary: Second variant of the field-actor collision attachment, using a 0x6C-byte 'collision' object and a different shape table.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_UpdatePoseAnim
functions.summary: Per-frame animation state machine of a field actor: picks animation by state and blends toward body transform.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_ReleaseEffectSlots
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Actor_ReleaseEffectSlots(FieldActor* self, int arg2, int arg3, int owner)
functions.summary: Release virtual of the field actor: while the actor is active it releases the two effect handles at +0x2A4, tears the render node down with Gfx_Node_Dtor and releases the attached object at +0x2AC through its second virtual.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_PreviewModelCtor
functions.signature: void* Ui_EquipWindow_PreviewModelCtor(u32 allocator, int params, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructs the scene node that hosts the equipment-preview character model: creates the node with the 0x005F8174 factory, installs vtable 0x0076B3DC (+0xB8 half) and initialises the position/scale/motion fields plus two 4-byte child entries (std_ConstructArray).

functions.name: Field_EquipPreviewModel_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Field_EquipPreviewModel; restores base vtables at offsets 0 and +0x220 (+0x88 words), runs base destructor 0x005F8528, and frees memory via operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_PreDiveText_Load
functions.summary: Loads the pre-dive (diving minigame) text table pre_dive_text.bxon, picks the first entry of the requested group whose record type is 4 and stores the row handle in out[1].

functions.name: Pack_HandlePair_Reset
functions.summary: Void variant of 0x003E9DC0: zeroes the owner word of a two-word handle pair, releases the handle stored in the second word when its generation still matches the table entry and writes the pair's null encoding.

functions.name: Pack_HandlePair_ResetAndGetBase
functions.summary: Clears a two-word generation-tagged handle pair: zeroes the owner word, releases the entries of the second word through the pack handle table (0x7BA2D0) and writes the 'null' encoding 0xFFFFF000, then returns the address just before the pair - the enclosing element - so the caller can go on tearing that down.

functions.name: Ui_DebugLabel_Update
functions.summary: Virtual update handler for Ui_DebugLabel; executes sub-system updates and flushes buffer if condition holds.

functions.name: Ui_DebugLabel_Delete
functions.summary: Deallocates a Ui_DebugLabel instance using operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_SetCounterText
functions.summary: Shows a decimal counter on the prize window: formats work+0x27C7C into the shared message buffer, points the buffer cursor at it and sets the label pane image to resource 0x21.

functions.name: Ui_Casino_SetPrizeCounterText
functions.summary: Formats the money/counter value from the shared bag block into the message buffer and applies it to pane 0x21 of the casino prize window.

functions.name: Ui_TxtLWindow_Init
functions.summary: Minimal window initialiser that binds a single text pane whose name literal at 0x003E9FD8 is 'txt_l' (a left-hand text pane, not a numbered row).

functions.name: Ui_TxtLWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the small text-label window whose pane literal is 'txt_l': runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_SetProductText
functions.summary: Writes the prize window's product text: formats f_50 with '%d' into the first pane and the product f_50*f_4C with '%02d' into pane 1 (UI key 0x21).

functions.name: Ui_GoldTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Money text window: attaches the numeric label ('txt_num_l') and the 'txt_gold' caption only.

functions.name: Ui_GoldTextWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the gold-text window: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SubObject_Init
functions.summary: Attaches object mesh through Gfx_SceneNode_LoadMeshByName and replaces effect object.

functions.name: Ui_GoldTextWindow_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the gold-text window: runs the base scene-node update, re-attaches the node transform and dispatches the window virtual +0x40 with argument 4.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_UpdateIfActive
functions.summary: Conditional update method for Gfx_SceneNode; checks flag at offset 0x51 and active status via 0x0066A2BC, invoking virtual method +0x40 with mode 4.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor thunk for the Gfx scene-node class: runs Gfx_SceneNode_Dtor and frees the node.

functions.name: Field_HitBox_Setup
functions.signature: void Field_HitBox_Setup(HitBox* self, HitBoxDef* def, ShapeParams* params, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Rebuilds a hit/collision box list from a definition: clears the old nodes, picks the sub-definition by shape type, sets the integer bounds x/y/width/height and the layer byte, and rebuilds the shape list.

functions.name: Field_HitBox_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the integer hit/collision box object: runs the base constructor, installs vtable 0x0076B63C and clears the bounds words at +0x24..+0x30.

functions.name: Field_HitBox_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Field_HitBox; calls base class destructor at 0x0037BC48 and deallocates self via operator delete.

functions.name: Field_HitBox_SetupFloat
functions.signature: void Field_HitBox_SetupFloat(HitBox* self, HitBoxDef* def, ShapeParams* params, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Float variant of the hit-box setup: drains the old shapes, selects the definition block by the shape type byte, writes the six min/max floats (+0x24..+0x38) as centre +/- half extents, copies the layer/id bytes, and loads each simple sub-shape into the box list.

functions.name: Field_HitBox_CtorFloat
functions.summary: Constructor of the float hit/collision box: base constructor, vtable 0x0076B65C, and copies the shared six-float default extents at 0x007E71EC into +0x24..+0x38.

functions.name: Field_HitBox_DtorVariant
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Field_HitBox float variant; invokes base destructor 0x0037BC48 and operator delete.

functions.name: Camera_FollowController_Setup
functions.summary: Configures camera follow target and mode parameters, allocating target strings and binding follow transform.

functions.name: Camera_Controller_ResetParams
functions.summary: Resets camera controller state fields +0x4..+0x54 to default values and initializes camera tracking block.

functions.name: Camera_TargetDescriptor_Init
functions.signature: u32 Camera_TargetDescriptor_Init(void* desc, short* name16, u32 arg3, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Initializes camera target descriptor block with header 0x303, zeroes tracking fields 4..13, and calculates target name length via std_wcslen.

functions.name: Camera_FollowActorPosition
functions.summary: Copies the followed actor's position and rotation into the camera pose, clamps the height against the camera controller floor, and rebuilds the view basis / node matrices for the tracked nodes.

functions.name: Ui_Roulette_LoadTipTextures
functions.summary: Loads the 5 casino roulette tip textures (roulette_tip1.bflim - roulette_tip5.bflim) via the resource loader virtual method at offset +0x14 into an output buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DebugMenu_SetPageState
functions.summary: Debug-menu page-state switch: drives the 0x21C-byte debug page singleton, resets the cursor and calls the page/movie/script helpers, but no debug-menu literal or caller confirms it.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DebugMenu_CheckFrameSpike
functions.summary: Detects a slow frame in the debug page: compares two frame counters and returns true when their delta is below 0x2E or at least 0x4C with debug flag bit 0x40 set; on a hit it clears the pending update and asks the view object for state 2.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DebugMenu_UpdateState
functions.summary: Page-sequence state machine (states 0-4 in self+0x11): waits for the page to become ready, runs the frame-delta check, waits for the animation to finish and then accumulates frame time until 1.8 s (0x3ECCCCCD) before advancing the page; always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_DebugMenu_CheckActionTrigger
functions.summary: Checks input/action trigger state via 0x0066D0CC, setting flag at self+0x10 if triggered and returning 1.

functions.name: Model_ReapplyStateBytes
functions.summary: Re-applies the character model's two equipment-state bytes: runs the weapon-node attach step, then for the grip node at self+0x6E4 reads each of the two state bytes (+0x60 main, +0x61 for the secondary grip resolved via the item id at +0x4C) and re-sets the corresponding grip node.

functions.name: Model_CharacterAttachment_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for model character attachment; runs base destructor at 0x0022616C and deallocates memory via operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_TxtRightWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Smallest pane initialiser: base ctor plus one right-aligned text pane 'txt_r' at the window's base layout id.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_SetItemText
functions.summary: Sibling of the medal prize counter setter: resolves the caller's value to an item-storage pointer, formats it into the shared message buffer and sets the label pane image to resource 0x1F.

functions.name: Ui_TxtRightWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the right-aligned text window: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees.

functions.name: Ui_Choice_SetSelectedIndex
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Choice_SetSelectedIndex(u32 arg1, void** choiceContext, void* arg3)
functions.summary: Sets the selected index byte at offset 0x171 of the choice widget context from field +0x10 of param, returning 1.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Choice_Start
functions.summary: Starts a choice: reads the owner's kind byte through func_00644BBC, requests message id 0xEE6 (kind 2) or 0xEE5 (otherwise) with func_0038196C, advances the input manager to state 2 and stores the default pair from 0x00728550 into self+4/+8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Marker_UpdateVisual
functions.summary: Builds the balloon/marker visual above a field actor: reads the actor's marker type (0/1/2), plays the matching sound effect and creates the marker sprite object, then attaches it to the actor and refreshes the marker's UI state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Choice_Confirm
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Choice_Confirm(UiChoice* self, u32 owner, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Confirms the choice: when the controller's virtual +0x30 reports ready it clears the two choice states, resets the owner's accessory handle (maybe_Model_SetAccessoryHandle), re-applies the owner's id from func_00644BBC and stores the default pair from 0x00728550 into self+4/+8.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Choice_Tick
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Choice_Tick(UiChoice* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Counts up the choice timer at self+0x10 and, after 0x27 ticks, notifies the input manager with state 2 and stores the pair at 0x00728550+0x20/+0x24 into self+4/+8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Marker_CreateVisual
functions.summary: Builds visual object of map marker: copies marker transform to actor and attaches billboard sprite 0x32F.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ReleaseHandleAndReset
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ReleaseHandleAndReset(void* self, int unusedA, int unusedB, int unusedC)
functions.summary: Releases the handle stored at self->f_C through the handle table at work+8->+0x54, then restores self+4 and self+8 from the constant block at 0x00728550.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_DetailPanel_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the vtable-0x0076B7E0 panel: installs the vtable and releases the single handle at +0xC through the field object manager, returning self.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CommandStack_Unwind
functions.summary: Pops every 0xC-byte entry of the stack at self+0x11C while the depth at +0x170 is non-zero: detaches the popped node, decrements the depth, calls the entry's handler pair and finally re-shows the entry that remains (broadcast 1).

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_DetailClose
functions.summary: Closes the smith (forge) detail animation: releases the current detail animation object, loads the 'detail_out' layout animation and starts it, then asserts the menu state.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_LoadDetailPanes
functions.summary: Loads the smith-menu detail panes: creates four 'power_num0' digit labels (incrementing the number), then the 'menu_kaji2_text', 'menu_kaj2_point' and 'menu_kaji2_critical' panes and links them into the window's list.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_DetailOpen
functions.summary: Opens the smith detail view: stops the running detail animation, loads 'detail_in', plays it, validates the selected item and asserts the menu state.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_OnTick
functions.summary: Periodic tick handler for Ui_SmithMenu; invokes child callback at +0x98->+0x2C and decrements animation/delay counter at +0x1278, deactivating widget +0x34C on zero.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_SetRowValueDigits
functions.summary: Fills the seven smith-menu row cells: for each of seven rows it decomposes the row's item value into decimal digits, writes them into the three sub-nodes at +0x2EC/+0x33C/+0x38C and toggles each node's visibility for the >=10 and >=100 thresholds.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetParamValue
functions.summary: Splits a numeric value into four decimal digits and writes each digit's text into the four 'power_num' panes.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_SelectCategoryPower
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_SelectCategoryPower(UiSmithMenu* self, void* actor, int arg3)
functions.summary: Menu tab handler: enables the sub-object at +0x34C (0x0029126C), fetches the category-0xC data for the actor (0x00644B5C), applies it (0x004DC960) and clears the word at +0x1278.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_SelectCategoryDetail
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_SelectCategoryDetail(UiSmithMenu* self, void* actor, int arg3)
functions.summary: Menu tab handler, twin of 0x003ECA7C: enables the sub-object at +0x34C, fetches the category-0xD data for the actor, applies it and stores 0x3C at +0x1278.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_DetailStack_PopPush
functions.summary: Maintains the smith menu's detail stack at self+0x11C (depth f_170, 0xC-byte entries): pop mode destroys the top entry only while it is this pane's own object, releases it, decrements the depth and invokes the stored callback before re-broadcasting to the revealed pane; push mode appends this pane's detail record through Ui_SmithMenu_PushPaneDetail.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateCategory
functions.summary: Maps the smith menu's current category index (0..4) to the selection values 10/2/4/6/8 (0xFF when out of range), applies the value to the category list and the name label at self+0x2B4, then sets the active flag of the widget at self+0x34C from the category record's +0x10 field.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateDetailList
functions.summary: Refreshes the smith menu's detail list from the controller: for cell index 1 only it takes the controller's current entry and row count, then pushes both into the detail list widget through Ui_SmithMenu_SetDetailPair; other cell indices push a null entry.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateDetailListEx
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateDetailListEx(UiSmithMenu* self, u32 controller, u32 row)
functions.summary: Like 0x003ECCF8 but for an explicit row: resolves the row's name string and writes it into the name widget at self+0x2B4, then pushes the row's entry and count into the detail widget through maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_SetDetailPair(self+0x300, ...).

functions.name: Ui_TextWindow_LayoutRows
functions.signature: void Ui_TextWindow_LayoutRows(TextWindow* self, LayoutNode* node, UiLayout* layout, LayoutCtx* ctx)
functions.summary: Lays out a text window: clears the idle flags on the child node and background, appends their transforms and delegates to Ui_Window_LayoutRows for the row grid.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_OpenPage
functions.summary: Opens the smith menu page: clears the command stack, resets the category widget, loads the 'positionA'/'positionB' animation and the category layout, refreshes the detail and category lists and sets the page state.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetCursorPosition
functions.summary: Moves the smith menu cursor between the two layout positions: resets the category widget, then loads 'positionA' or 'positionB' depending on the requested side.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SubWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the smithing (alchemy forge) menu screen: allocates via 0x001D8B6C, installs vtable 0x76B7F0 (Ui_SmithMenu_LoadDetailPanes), initialises 0x48 bytes of state and a 0x50 x 4 array. Called from the field-screen initialiser.

functions.name: Camera_MotionSet_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the camera motion set: runs the class teardown at 0x003ED388 and then frees the block with 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Camera_MotionSet_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the camera motion set: installs its vtable, builds 24 0x50-byte camera slots and 8 0xB8-byte track records and relinks the embedded intrusive lists.

functions.name: Ui_CameraAnimWindow_Init_2
functions.summary: Initialiser for the window that previews camera animations: resolves the resource id of the passed entry to its name, copies it into the 32-byte name field at +0x370 and sets three visible rows.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_UpdatePageLabel
functions.summary: Updates the smith menu's paged label: advances the two-digit page suffix through the 8-entry u16 table at +0x224, formats it with '%s_%02d' or '%s_%02d_%s' (the second form for entries that carry a name id), applies the model preview parts and syncs the scene node.

functions.name: Ui_CameraAnimWindow_BindRowCallbacks
functions.summary: Binds the window's eight row callbacks: for each of the eight entries in the static descriptor at 0x726984 it stores {callback pointer, flags, this} into a 0x1C-byte slot (+0x274, +0x290, ... +0x338) via the delegate-assign helper 0x001235A4. The descriptor pairs are (0x3EDBDC,0), (0x3EDDC0,0) ... which are the per-row effect functions next to Ui_CameraAnimWindow_DrawRow.

functions.name: Ui_CameraAnimWindow_InsertRowNode
functions.signature: void Ui_CameraAnimWindow_InsertRowNode(void* self, void* rowNode, void* arg3)
functions.summary: Inserts a row element into the intrusive linked list at self+0x354 via 0x001235A4 if param fields +0x48/+0x4C are non-zero, recording node parameters.

functions.name: Ui_CameraAnimWindow_DrawRow
functions.signature: void Ui_CameraAnimWindow_DrawRow(UiWindow* self, u32 row, int indent)
functions.summary: The camera-animation list row drawer: it resolves the row resource, builds the indented sprite transform and submits it.

functions.name: Ui_CameraAnimWindow_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the camera-animation window after construction: formats the child layout name s__s_loop_cmtsa into its name buffer, asks the model/resource registry for the entry (0x00641738), binds the indexed resource set (0x0055E2A8) and then draws all eight list rows through Ui_CameraAnimWindow_DrawRow.

functions.name: Ui_CameraAnimWindow_SetPlaybackMode
functions.summary: Applies animation playback mode from *modePtr via 0x003ED7AC; if mode is 1, immediately resets playback mode to 0.

functions.name: Ui_CameraAnimWindow_CtorBase
functions.signature: void* Ui_CameraAnimWindow_CtorBase(u32 allocator, int params, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructs the UI camera-animation window: allocates through 0x005F8174, installs vtable 0x76B840 (Ui_CameraAnimWindow_Ctor/Init, Gfx_Node methods) and initialises an 8-element array of 0x1C-byte entries plus camera parameters.

functions.name: Ui_CameraAnimWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the camera-animation window: installs the class vtable (literal 0x003ee044 -> 0x76B840), initialises the embedded scene-node/sprite bases (0x0055E3BC twice, 0x005F8528), builds the intrusive list at +0x354 and the child array at +0x9C, and finally frees the temporary allocation.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_InitPanes
functions.summary: Initialises all smith (forge) menu panes: main window, weapon/armour/accessory lists, item/material/parameter/overlap counters, party pane and the two sort windows, in that fixed slot order.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_HandleInput
functions.summary: Handles input for the smith menu category list: on a confirm event it switches on the selected category and opens the matching sub-list (weapons, armour, accessory, party or exit).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Message_SetNameArg
functions.summary: Writes the name of the character stored at self+8 into message argument 2 via the party record (+0xCA) and uses the u16 at +0x0A to pick the argument index for the remaining value; the tail is not decoded (bad instruction data).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemList_SelectItem
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ItemList_SelectItem(void* self, u32 list, char* names)
functions.summary: Selection loop of an item list: writes the chosen index into the row byte +0x1AD, refreshes the category text and the list scroll, and formats the item's name into a message argument (Item_LookupRecord + Message_SetArg + Text_FormatMessageArg) until the confirm helper 0x0064D6E0 reports done.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_HandleArmorList
functions.summary: Input handler for the smith armour list: moves the list cursor, applies the selected value to the material/parameter widgets and opens the confirm page.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_CommitSelection
functions.summary: Applies the smith controller result: when the controller object at +0x11b4 reports a pending value at +0x1e18 it clears the flashing accessory and pops the detail pane at +0x11c.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_HandleWeaponList
functions.summary: Input handler for the smith weapon list (mirror of the armour handler): moves the weapon cursor, updates the parameter display and opens the confirm page.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_HandleAccessoryList
functions.summary: Input handler for the smith accessory list: moves the accessory cursor, updates the parameter display and opens the confirm page.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_DispatchCommand
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_DispatchCommand(UiSmithMenu* self, u32 controller, int* command)
functions.summary: Dispatches one smith-menu command pair: pushes the pair onto the command stack at self+0x11C and forwards it to the page handler (0x003EEDA8).

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_PushCommandPage
functions.summary: Pushes one smith-menu command page: pops every pending detail pane from the window's pane stack (while +0x170 != 0), pushes a new page with the {handler,0} pair taken from the static command table at 0x72B44C, then runs Ui_SmithMenu_ExecuteCommand on that page. Used when a smith-menu list row opens a sub-page.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_Cancel
functions.summary: Back/cancel handling for the smith menu: depending on the page gate it pops the command stack and dispatches the stored back command, or runs the current page's cancel entry.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_HandleMaterialList
functions.summary: Input handler for the smith material list: moves the material cursor, refreshes the required-material widget and confirms or cancels the material selection.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_ExecuteCommand
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_ExecuteCommand(UiSmithMenu* self, u32 command, int arg3, u32 controller)
functions.summary: Large command dispatcher for the smith menu: compares the incoming command against the table at 0x003EF530 (window ids such as 0x3EE3CC, 0x3EE7E4, 0x3EE69C, 0x3EEC70, 0x3EFC48) and runs the matching page transition or list refresh.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_ExecuteCommand_Part2
functions.summary: Continuation of the command dispatcher for Ui_SmithMenu (split by Ghidra from 0x003EEDA8); handles forged item animations, confirmation prompts, and UI updates.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_OpenDefaultPage
functions.summary: After a mode change the smith menu applies the pending mode (0x3EC01C), empties the pane stack through the named Ui_SmithMenu_PopPaneDetail, pushes the default page (Ui_SmithMenu_PushPane) and runs its entry delegate.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_UpdateRowDescription
functions.summary: Refreshes the smith-menu row description: checks whether the page stack is idle, gets the selected row, looks up its text id and calls the message window's SetTextById with positioning offsets. If the page is not idle it forwards to PopPage.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_HandleListCommand
functions.summary: Command handler of the smith menu (vtable slot +5): bit 4 pops back to the previous page, bit 0 forwards the three bytes of the command to the item list at +0xC34, and the 0x102 bits rebuild the visible list - unlinking/relinking the two list heads at +0x112C/+0x1178, resetting the list scroll, applying the category visual and the text from the table, then pushing the next command.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_HandleSortInput
functions.summary: Handles the smith menu sort mode: toggles the sort order, updates the sort icon/labels, re-sorts the item list and recomputes the visible page window.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_PopPage
functions.summary: The smith-menu page pop: it pops one command entry and re-executes the command below it.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_PushCommand
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_PushCommand(UiSmithMenu* self, u32 arg2, u32 command, u32 arg4, u32 controller)
functions.summary: Pushes a smith-menu command onto the menu stack and runs it immediately through the command dispatcher 0x003EEDA8.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_InvokeEntryDelegate
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_InvokeEntryDelegate(UiSmithMenu* self, UiEntryDef* def, u32 arg3, void* target)
functions.summary: Invokes the delegate stored in one of the window's 3-word entry records: copies the entry's byte fields into a stack argument block, resolves the entry by index (self+0x11C, count self+0x170), calls its virtual/invoke pointer with that argument block, and destroys the temporary through 0x0036B510. This is the common "run the row callback" helper of the SmithMenu entry array.

functions.name: Ui_SlotTable_BuildEntriesFromRecords

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_StepOptionIndex

functions.name: Ui_TxtLowerWindow_InitPanes

functions.summary: Constructor of the lower-text child window (a two-line text pane with one extra word): runs the Ui_Object base ctor, installs vtable 0x76B948 and stores the owner at +0x4C while clearing the field at +0x50.

functions.name: Ui_TxtLowerWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the lower-text child window: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_JumonWindow_AdvanceChildAndSetCharacter
functions.summary: Command handler of the spell (jumon) window: advances the active child page, pushes the spell pane with the shared layout descriptor and applies the page's current member to the status panel.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_JumonWindow_SelectEntry
functions.summary: Member-selection step of the spell (jumon) window: resolves the row's own member (self+0x0A) and the newly selected member, and when the selected member's count at +0x14 is non-zero and below its vtable+8 maximum it updates the own row (clamp +0x16 by the skill cost at self+0x08, apply both row colours) and calls Ui_JumonWindow_SetPartyMask(self, memberId). Empty selections start 0x27/0x25, unusable ones 0x27/0x28.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SevenSlotRow_SetSlotIcons
functions.summary: Stores the mode byte, fills the seven slot bytes with 0xFF placeholders or 0..6, then writes one Ui_TextLayer_SetText value per cell (slot id | row<<16), using the alternate value for slot 1 while the menu is open.

functions.name: Ui_SevenSlotWindow_SetVisibleAndSetRowAlphas

functions.name: Ui_SevenSlotWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Pane initialiser of a seven-row window: generates txt_l1../null_txt_l1.. for seven rows, records the slot bytes +0x49..+0x4F (0,0,1,2,3,4,5) and refreshes the seven icon layers with Ui_TextLayer_SetText.

functions.name: Ui_SevenSlotWindow_Dtor

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_MoveMemberCursor
functions.summary: Command handler (sole slot of vtable 0x0072A5A8): with bit 4 set it pops the status pane, otherwise it moves the member cursor (+0x1189) by the step at +0x136 with wraparound over the member count (+0x118A) and refills the rows when the selection changed.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_FillMemberRows
functions.summary: Fills the four member rows of the party status window: for each of four rows it resolves the member record, writes its name (+0xCA), level and parameter fields into panes i*0xC+7..+0x12 (hiding the dead/alive variants), and finally writes the page number into pane 5.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_InitPagerPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_TsuyosaWindow_InitPagerPanes(UiTsuyosaWindow* self, UiElement* owner, int arg3, int arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Pane/pager initialiser of the party status window: creates the 'pager_num_r'/'pager_num_l' page labels and the 4x12 text matrix (i*0xC+7..) with 'null_chara_d' overlays for each member row, then fills the rows through 0x003F1340.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_ChildCtor
functions.summary: Constructor of the "tsuyosa" (strength/status) child window: base-constructs the Ui_Object, installs vtable 0x76BA2C, clears two flag bytes and zeroes the four pager values at +0x4C..+0x58.

functions.name: Ui_TsuyosaWindow_ChildDtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the "tsuyosa" status window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Ui_FourRowIconWindow_Dtor

functions.summary: Appends a node of kind 0xE5 carrying one byte value to an intrusive sorted entry list: allocates a 0x14-byte node with vtable 0x0075A554, links it and re-sorts; 0xFF means 'no value' and adds nothing.

functions.summary: Destroys every element of an intrusive list: walks from head->next to the sentinel, calls each node's virtual +0x8 (destructor) and releases it with 0x0010EBE4, then calls virtual +0x4 (delete) on the last node.

functions.summary: Destroys the UI notification list: clears its registration in the game work (ctx+0x7C+0x1C = 0), destroys and releases every node of the intrusive list and re-links the head so the list is empty.

functions.summary: Initialises the menu mode state: clears the flag word at +4 and then selects mode 1 (flag 0x10000 plus 0x002CDB5C) when the UI manager's +0xE3C0 state is 3, or mode 3 after Ui_DataPanel_Reset otherwise; the mode is stored at +0.

functions.name: maybe_Save_LoadTask_Finish
functions.signature: void maybe_Save_LoadTask_Finish(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Drains whatever queue/child list self owns (while 0x0062F070(self) > 0, call 0x0010EBD8(self)), ticks the list at +0x718, clears +0x824, asks the UI manager singleton for its manager and calls 0x002CDB5C on it, then sets the ready byte +0x820 to 1. Both a finished save/load task and a UI window/child teardown fit this body.

functions.signature: void maybe_Save_LoadTask_Start(SaveTask* task, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Minimal load-task start: clears the task status word at +4, fetches the UI manager and calls its loader (0x002CDB5C), then sets the state word to 1. It sits between the save/load task finish and step handlers at 0x003F30EC/0x003F3160.

functions.name: maybe_Save_LoadTask_StepB
functions.summary: Initialises the load task's state: ticks the list at +0x718, then branches on the global UI mode (uiManager+0xE3C0 == 3) - the abort path sets error bit 0x10000 and state 1, the normal path resets the list state and sets state 2. The same body exists at 0x003F3180 applied to the task's 8-byte state sub-object, so the 'load task' identity is inherited rather than proven.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Menu_SetModeState
functions.summary: Fills an 8-byte mode-state record: clears the flag word at +4, then either sets bit 0x10000 and mode 1 (abort path, when the global UI mode uiManager+0xE3C0 is 3) or resets the list state and sets mode 2. Same body as 0x003F3160, which applies it to the whole load-task object.

functions.name: Save_LoadTask_UpdateAlt
functions.summary: Second save/load task state machine (UI dialog variant): dispatches on work+0xE3C4 while the load flag +0xE3C5 is 1; mode 0 checks work+0xE3C0 (state 1 -> done, 4 -> error bit), mode 3 sets the error bit 2, mode 4 finishes the write (0x2CD6D0) and state 4, mode 6 starts the read (0x2CDB5C) and state 1, mode 7 sets error 0x40.

functions.name: Ui_Menu_UpdateModeTransition
functions.summary: Advances the menu mode-transition state machine (states 1..4): when the UI manager reports the switch bytes (+0xE3C5 == 1, +0xE3C4 = 0..3) it sets the matching flag bit (4/8/0x10/0x20), clears the state and returns 1; while a transition is pending it resets the data panel and moves to state 1.

functions.summary: Dispatches the current schedule entry for actor field +0x28 via virtual method +0x84, falling back to default schedule entry *g_003f3924 if inactive.

functions.summary: Calculates weighted total of the 4 row values, clamps to maximum at +0xA0 if exceeded, and formats and displays each row string via 0x001A6680.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_FourRowList_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a four-row window: stores the text id at +0x28, formats the caption from 0x003F7274 into pane 7, clears the row-slot byte +0x49 and the four per-row bytes at +0x13 (stride 5), sets every row's pane to the empty value and finishes by calling its own vt[0x18](self, 1).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_FourRowList_ResetFromStateB
functions.summary: Second wrapper around the same four-row reset, identical to 0x003F6F20 but reading context offset 0x003F72CC and map-state getter 0x0066BA6C.

functions.name: Ui_SevenLineTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Pane initialiser of a seven-line text window: attaches txt_1..txt_7 plus a right-aligned txt_r, then anchors the four arrow panes txt_4..txt_7 to the 'null_arrow' reference pane using the centre of the txt_3/txt_4 block as origin.

functions.name: Ui_SevenLineTextWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the seven-line text window: Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x76BF04 (Ui_SevenLineTextWindow_Dtor/InitPanes) and builds a 4-element array of 0x14-byte rows.

functions.name: Ui_SevenLineTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the seven-line text window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Monster_Pattern_LoadModel
functions.summary: Loads the shared monster model pattern for an id: formats and loads 'pattern_%02d.bch', then reads the integer out of the matching 'pattern_%02d' table into +0x18.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionUi_ShowMemberAction
functions.summary: ActionUi step at state 0xBC6: plays popup 0xC77, waits for the battle actor to be idle, then either posts a message from table 0x5C/0x5D, spawns an actor-list popup, or (immune-to-status branch) consumes item 0x8B from the member and posts its name message.

functions.name: Battle_ActionUi_MemberWidget_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionUi member widget; invokes base destructor 0x00200220 and frees memory via operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionUi_ShowStatusEntry
functions.summary: ActionUi step at state 0xC90: rolls 0..0x3F with the battle RNG, looks up the status-message table entry at +0x6C[index*2], plays SE 0x9F and pushes two battle messages before waiting at 0xCAF.

functions.name: Battle_ActionUi_StatusWidget_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionUi status widget; invokes base destructor 0x00200220 and frees memory via operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionUi_ShowMemberStatePopup
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_ActionUi_ShowMemberStatePopup(BattleActionUi* self, u32 arg2, void* entry, u32 message)
functions.summary: Displays a member state popup: if self+0x12CE is clear it queues an action message or calls vtable+0x94 with mode 0x1C/0x1D, otherwise it builds a number-list/actor-list popup pair and plays sound 0x15D.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionUi_ShowMemberStatePopup3D
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_ActionUi_ShowMemberStatePopup3D(BattleActionUi* self, u32 arg2, void* entry, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Large battle ActionUi step: switches on self[0x4B6]+0xE0 (modes 0,1,7,8,9) and spawns actor/number popups, battle messages or sound; it is the larger sibling of 0x003F7DE0.

functions.name: Battle_ActionUi_RefreshMemberFlags
functions.summary: Rebuilds the per-row effect state of the battle action UI: for each displayed row it stores the row's effect id, clears the 'effect created' byte, creates the field effect for the row's member (func_0020A630 with the party ordinal and list index) and sets the flag on success; a second pass applies the accumulated state flags with Battle_AddStateFlags.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionUi_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame state machine of a 0x2014-byte battle UI object; state in self[0x4E0] around 0x102E..0x10E6.

functions.name: Battle_Actor_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a battle actor: sets the action id at 0x4E0 to -1, clears 0x575, publishes the animation object (vtable+0x150) into the resource tree and, when a unit is attached and still uninitialised, dispatches its initial state through virtual +0xD0 with the id at 0x48C.

functions.name: Field_GameObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the large (0x14B4-byte) field game object: chains the interactive-object base with vtable 0x76C1A0, seeds the id fields with -1/0xFFFFFC00 sentinels, builds the two chained sub-objects and resets the embedded party member slot.

functions.name: BattleParty_Dtor
functions.summary: Freeing destructor of the battle-party object: destroys its two 0x1C x 8 sub-object arrays, resets the two vtable pointers, releases the handle at 0x125C and frees the object.

functions.name: BattleParty_DtorNoFree
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of the battle-party object: destroys the two 0x1C x 8 sub-object arrays, resets the vtable pointers and releases the handle at 0x125C, leaving deallocation to the caller.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_MapStateToTextId
functions.summary: Maps a state/command value to a message text id (0x50..0x58) and plays it through the map-value lookup helper; states 0..7 and 0xB..0x11 share ids, unknown states fall back to 0x50.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActionUi_DirectorUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame step of the battle action director: switches on the action-UI state, moves the focus point/camera, plays the action SE and spawns the attached effect; returns the done flag.

functions.name: Battle_ActionUi_DirectorWidget_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionUi director widget; invokes base destructor 0x00200220 and frees memory via operator delete.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_ConfuseElement_Play
functions.summary: Triggers the "confuse" battle animation on the target unit via virtual method +0x84, setting completion flag at +0x2C if the animation was not triggered.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_PlayStatePoseWhenFlagged
functions.summary: Element-side pose replay: when the element flag at +0x2C is set or the actor passes the 0x00669DD4 ready check, resolves the actor by handle and plays the pose group selected by Battle_SelectPoseGroup.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_ConfuseElementCtor
functions.signature: BattleAnimElement* Battle_ActionAnim_ConfuseElementCtor(BattleAnimElement* storage, void* window, void* controller, const char* actionKey, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action-animation element that plays the 'confuse' action; it is registered at slot 0x28 of the action-anim window.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_ConfuseElement_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionAnim confuse element; runs base destructor at 0x00322D14 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_PlayDamageAnim
functions.summary: Resolves the element's actor by handle, skips if its state-2 query is non-zero, asks for the default motion id, verifies the actor can play it (vtable +0x84) and starts it with a battle-RNG delay.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_Element_PlayHitOrDeathAnim
functions.summary: Reaction-animation step of a battle action element: resolves the bound actor by handle and plays animation 0x1B when the actor is in state 2, or 0x28 when it is in state 8, and nothing when it is in neither state.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_DamageElementCtor
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action-animation damage-number element: base constructor plus the damage-element vtable, 0x2C-byte object registered at slot 1 of the action-anim window.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_DamageElement_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionAnim damage element; calls base destructor 0x00322D14 and operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_StatComparePanel_Fill
functions.signature: void Ui_StatComparePanel_Fill(UiStatComparePanel* self, int characterId, const StatBlock* other)
functions.summary: Fills the stat comparison panel for one character: writes the name, temporarily clears the 'dead' bit of the character record, then for nine stats (level, HP, MP, attack, defence, ...) computes current minus the comparison block's value and emits one row through 0x003FBC78, restoring the record's bit afterwards.

functions.name: Ui_StatComparePanel_SetRow
functions.signature: void Ui_StatComparePanel_SetRow(UiStatComparePanel* self, int row, int newValue, int oldValue)
functions.summary: Writes one stat comparison row: the label into pane row, the formatted value into pane row+9, and tints the value green when it went up (newValue < oldValue, colour from descriptor +0x54) or red when it went down (descriptor +0x40).

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Pane initialiser for a two-column list: one 'txt_text' label plus nine rows in each column, whose pane names are generated as 'txt_r1_%d' (ids 1..9) and 'txt_r2_%d' (ids 10..18).

functions.name: Ui_TwoColumnTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the two-column text window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Battle_MessageQueue_PushEntry
functions.signature: void Battle_MessageQueue_PushEntry(void* queue, const BattleMsgEntry* entry, int flag)
functions.summary: Pushes a battle message entry ({actor, target, msgId, flags}) into the active battle message queue.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForRefList
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForRefList(u32 ctx, u16* refList, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns a popup entry from a small reference list: allocates a 0x218-byte entry, fills it from the referenced actor record (f_768 model id, f_1C variant, f_10 flags) and posts it with animation id 0x0C53 or a mapped message id.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForWindowRows
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForWindowRows(BattleUiWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Populates the action entries for the current window rows: resolves each member row's actor record, calls the per-entry setup, then posts the 0x218-byte pooled entry (id 0x84 / 0x25-0x29 family) and notifies the menu.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForActorList
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForActorList(u32 ctx, void* actorList, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Builds and posts the popup for a whole actor list: allocates a 0x218-byte entry, fills it from the first actor record, scans the list to decide single/multiple and same-name variants, and dispatches one of the ids 0x25/0x26/0x28/0x29/0xC76 after clearing the previous popups. This is the generic "show these N actors" entry used by the battle and field action UIs.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_ClearAll
functions.summary: Clears/hides all current popup/display entries: fetches the battle context and posts the reserved id 0xFFFF with a null entry and the given fade flag, which makes the popup manager drop the active entries. Called before every batch of new popups.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnValue
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnValue(u32 ctx, u8* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns a minimal popup entry carrying a single kind/value pair: builds a 0x20C-byte entry with the kind at +0x208 and the u16 value at +0x20A, then posts it with animation id 0x4C.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForActorPair
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForActorPair(u32 ctx, u32* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns an entry that references two actor records (source and target): builds the 0x21C-byte entry from both records and posts it with the message id stored in the descriptor.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForStatus
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForStatus(u32 ctx, u8* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns an entry for one actor status change: builds a 0x218-byte entry from the actor record and, depending on the flag byte at desc+0xA, posts it with animation id 0x18 or 0x8BE (the 'state applied/removed' pair).

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnNumberList
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnNumberList(u32 ctx, void* valueList, int fadeStep)
functions.summary: Builds the numeric popup entry for one actor: if the record has several 12-byte rows it averages their signed values and picks the multi-number animation (0x1A-0x1F / 0x1C/0x20 / 0x33 family); for a single value it picks the small/big variant, then posts the 0x21C-byte entry through 0x20A9B8. This is the damage/heal number popup used by the action sequences.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnRevive
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnRevive(u32 ctx, int* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns the revive popup: builds a 0x214-byte entry from the actor record and posts it with animation id 0x23 or 0xEBD selected by the byte flag at +0x211.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_PlayById
functions.summary: Plays a popup/animation id directly on the battle UI scene object without building a new entry (entry pointer null). Used when an already configured popup must be re-triggered, e.g. the 0x84 refresh in 0x3FC0D4.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForRecord
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForRecord(u32 ctx, void* rec, u32 animId, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Builds a 0x21C-byte popup entry from a record and posts it with the requested animation id; ids 0xFFFF and 0x11B select default/alternate animations and 0x11B also resolves a second record and a sound id.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnUnitEffect
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnUnitEffect(u32 ctx, u16* idList, u32 arg3, u32 fallback)
functions.summary: Populates display entries for a battle unit effect: scans the id list for special effect ids (0x173/0x174, 0x13D, 0x289, 0x38D...), builds the matching entries and posts them when units enter or leave the battle scene.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnBalloonEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnBalloonEntry(u32 ctx, int* src, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns the balloon/message entry above a battle actor: picks the message id from the sound/message table for the actor, builds a 0x218-byte entry and posts it; the two branches select the left/right variant from the actor flag.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnNameCodeBalloon
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnNameCodeBalloon(u32 ctx, u8* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Balloon entry carrying a name/code argument pair: builds a 0x218-byte entry from the actor record and the descriptor u16 code, resolves the message id through the message table and posts it (or the fixed 0x8BE id when flagged).

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnSpeakerBalloon
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnSpeakerBalloon(u32 ctx, u16* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Balloon entry for a speaking actor: maps the speaker/expression id (record +0xCE, values 0x16..0x1F) to one of the balloon animation ids 0x3A..0x51, then builds and posts the entry with the speaker message arguments.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnCountBalloon
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnCountBalloon(u32 ctx, int* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Balloon entry for a counted event (e.g. 'N times'): routes the negative count/kind cases to fixed message ids and the positive case to the generic count formatter, then posts the 0x218-byte entry.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnModelDebugText
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnModelDebugText(u32 ctx, int* rec, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Model-debug entry builder: counts the 0x20 non-null ids in the record and posts a 0x218-byte entry whose label text is built by the debug-label model-text helper.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnCountBalloonEx
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnCountBalloonEx(u32 ctx, int* desc, u32 animId)
functions.summary: Second form of the counted balloon entry: the same 0x218-byte entry shape as 0x003FEE54 but with a caller-supplied animation id and the alternate count-formatting path.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForMonsterPair
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForMonsterPair(u32 ctx, u32* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns the two-monster popup (monster book/encounter message): builds a 0x218-byte entry from both monster records and posts it with the descriptor message id via the name+number argument formatter.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnEquipCompare
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnEquipCompare(u32 ctx, u8* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Entry used by the equipment comparison messages: carries the two compared stat values and posts the message id at desc+6, with the extra flag forwarded to the popup manager.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnActorSpanEntry
functions.summary: Spawns an entry made of actor/text spans: filters the id list for the known span ids (1/2/0x14C/0x268/0x27C family), builds a 0x20C-byte entry and posts it.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForModelActors
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnForModelActors(u32 ctx, int* desc, int fadeMode, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Spawns an entry that references one or two model actors (name plus number arguments): builds the 0x21C-byte entry, posts the descriptor id (or the default 0x5D/0x24E forms) through the popup hub and stores the two actor ids.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnCurrentLogEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnCurrentLogEntry(u32 ctx, int* rec, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns a one-line popup entry for the current message/log record: copies the value word into +0x208 and posts the record's message id.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnMultiActor
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnMultiActor(u32 ctx, int* desc, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Spawns an entry that references up to four actors (four record words, a flag byte and the id): builds the 0x21C-byte entry and posts the descriptor id.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnFromDescriptor
functions.signature: void Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnFromDescriptor(u32 ctx, int* desc, u32 animId, u32 actorRec, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Most general descriptor-based popup spawner: inspects the descriptor id fields (0xFFFF sentinels) and chooses one of the 0x20C/0x214/0x218/0x21C entry forms (single actor, actor+value, multi actor, plain value), then posts it.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_MoveLandingElement_RestoreIdleByHpWhenAnimEnds
functions.summary: Per-element hook: when the model at self+0x28 finishes its animation, restores the actor's idle posture by HP percentage; otherwise does nothing.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_MoveLandingElementCtor
functions.signature: BattleAnimElement* Battle_ActionAnim_MoveLandingElementCtor(BattleAnimElement* storage, void* window, void* controller, const char* actionKey, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action-animation element for the 'move_landing' action (a 0x2C-byte object registered at slot 0x33 of the action-anim table).

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_MoveLandingElement_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionAnim move landing element; resets base vtable via 0x00193E44 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_LevelUpElementCtor
functions.signature: BattleAnimElement* Battle_ActionAnim_LevelUpElementCtor(BattleAnimElement* storage, void* window, void* controller, const char* actionKey, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action-animation element for the 'levelup' action (registered at slot 0x30 of the action-anim table).

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_LevelUpElement_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionAnim level-up element; restores base vtable via 0x00193E44 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_Element_UpdateActorState
functions.summary: Element virtual: resets the pending-action slot, stores the element marker, resolves the bound actor (ally list then reserve list) and either plays the actor animation g_004004C4 or hides it with animation 0x2F depending on the actor state call +0xD8.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_Element_UpdateDyingActor
functions.summary: Element virtual: resolves the bound actor from the two battle actor lists and, when func_00639F48 reports the dead/removed condition, plays animation 0x2F on it.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_DyingElementCtor
functions.signature: BattleAnimElement* Battle_ActionAnim_DyingElementCtor(BattleAnimElement* storage, void* window, void* controller, const void* actionKey, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructs the special 0x34-byte battle action-animation element that carries no action-name string (the death/dying element): base list sub-object constructor, then the dying-element vtable and two zeroed state words.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_DyingElement_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionAnim dying element; restores base vtable via 0x00193E44 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_UseItemElement_Play
functions.summary: Performs the item-use animation: releases both equipment attach slots of the actor's model and asks the actor to play the action named "UseItem" through vtable +0x84.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_Element_CommitEquipAndUpdateMarker
functions.summary: Vtable method of a battle action-animation element: if the actor has a model it commits the two equipment attach nodes and then refreshes the target marker, i.e. it pushes the finished action pose out to the model.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_UseItemElementCtor
functions.signature: BattleAnimElement* Battle_ActionAnim_UseItemElementCtor(BattleAnimElement* storage, void* window, void* controller, const char* actionKey, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action-animation element for the 'use_item' action (registered at slot 0x2E of the action-anim table).

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_UseItemElement_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionAnim use item element; restores base vtable via 0x00193E44 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_RevivalElement_RestoreIdleByHpWhenAnimEnds
functions.summary: Same three-line animation-end hook as 0x00400304, used by the revival action-animation element.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_RevivalElementCtor
functions.signature: BattleAnimElement* Battle_ActionAnim_RevivalElementCtor(BattleAnimElement* storage, void* window, void* controller, const char* actionKey, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action-animation element for the 'revival' action (registered at slot 6 of the action-anim table).

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_RevivalElement_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionAnim revival element; restores base vtable via 0x00193E44 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Battle_Effect_SpawnFocusPoint
functions.summary: Spawns or repositions the battle 'FocusPoint' effect attached to an actor: picks the locator name, resolves the attachment node, builds the effect transform and creates/updates the effect instance (effect ids 0x396/0x402, model id 800 special case).

functions.name: Battle_Effect_PlayHandEffect
functions.summary: Plays the left- or right-hand effect for an actor: dispatches on the record variant (0x83 -> 0x400B80, 0x84 -> 0x400D60) and, when the actor is in the matching state, inserts the effect action slot with the computed focus/effect ids.

functions.name: Battle_Effect_SpawnLeftHandEffect
functions.summary: Spawns the left-hand ("L_Hand") effect: builds the "L_Hand" node name, creates the effect instance with 0x35FF3C at the hand node, and in 2D mode only toggles the 2D effect flag through 0x4B9FAC.

functions.name: Battle_Effect_SpawnRightHandEffect
functions.summary: Spawns the right-hand ("R_Hand") effect counterpart of 0x00400B80, using the same node-name/effect-instance path with effect id 917.

functions.name: Battle_Model_ApplyMonsterSize
functions.summary: For each of up to 32 unit slots whose model type is 0xDA (monster), reads the monster table record (0x0063DCA4), and for size ids 0x83/0x84 applies scale/orientation values to the model node and stores them on the unit.

functions.name: Battle_Effect_UpdateAuraEffect
functions.summary: Toggles the actor's aura effect: when disabled it releases the stored instance; when enabled it recreates it at the actor position with a +35/-35 height offset, using effect ids 0x390/0x391 (912/913) normally and 0x42D/0x42E (1069/1070) for model id 800, then stores the new handle in +0xF24.

functions.name: Model_Actor_UpdateArmAttachmentAnim
functions.summary: Selects and plays the arm attachment animation of the actor model: based on the arm-state bits in +0xF22 it picks one of cbhm_arm_alive / cbhm_arm_dead_L / cbhm_arm_dead_R / cbhm_arm_dead_W and applies it with 0x00223CF4.

functions.name: Model_Actor_UpdateMaskAttachmentAnim
functions.summary: Selects and plays the mask/face attachment animation: mask-state bits choose cbhm_mask_alive / cbhm_mask_damage / cbhm_mask_dead, applied through 0x00223CF4.

functions.name: Actor_ApplyAttachedTargetEffect
functions.signature: u32 Actor_ApplyAttachedTargetEffect(void* self, u32 p2, u32 p3, u32 effectParam)
functions.summary: Resolves the attached target actor handle at self+0x110 from generational entity table and applies effect via 0x004E4468 if type matches g_00401548.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnim_Element_ResetState
functions.summary: Resets the element to idle: cancels the current turn, forwards the new state to vtable+0x15C, refreshes the element, stores the default marker at +0x118 and clears the +0xE4/+0x120 flags.

functions.name: Battle_Effect_SpawnFocusPointB
functions.summary: Variant of the FocusPoint effect spawner for another actor class: builds the same 'FocusPoint' node and transform, releases the previous handle and creates the effect through 0x35FF3C.

functions.name: Model_ObjectType0x74_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor variant that the actor-model factory runs for model-definition type 0x74: allocates the status block, installs vtable 0x76C5F0, clears the two flag bytes at +0xF22/+0xF23 and writes the -1024 sentinel at +0xF24.

functions.name: Battle_ActionModel_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Battle_ActionModel; cleans up model action state and frees memory via operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_TextLabel_SetFormattedNumber
functions.summary: Formats a numeric value into a temporary buffer (decimal conversion with dynamic size selection) and assigns it to the label's text element with Ui_TextElement_SetString; returns early when no text element exists.

functions.name: Ui_MessageSelectWindow_SetFocus
functions.summary: Updates widget focus/selection state via virtual methods +0x40 and +0x4C, propagating color/transform to child widget at +0x1C.

functions.name: Ui_NameStatWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Character panel initialiser: one txt_name header, three left stat labels (txt_l1..l3) and three right value labels (txt_r1..r3), each with its null_ overlay, then a refresh; the text formats are the S/M/H/I/F/P style blobs at 0x004020BC..

functions.name: Ui_NameStatWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the name/stat window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_UpdateMemberNames
functions.summary: Fills the party command panel rows: sets the panel mode, then for each active party member writes the member name (record+0xCA) and its colour into the row widgets, skipping members that are absent or flagged.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_RefreshMemberRows
functions.summary: Refreshes the active member rows of the party panel: walks Menu_CountPartyActors, reads each member's name (record+0xCA) and state-dependent colour and writes them into the panel rows; it is the second entry of the panel command table and differs from 0x00402180 only by the missing leading mode call.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_IsMemberUnavailable
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the member selected by vtable +0x88 is missing or cannot act (the actor lookup fails or the actor's +0xF0 check is 0), i.e. the row must be shown as unavailable; used by the confirm/advance path.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_ApplyMemberTextColors
functions.summary: Applies the per-member text colours of the party panel: for each of the four member slots it maps the member type byte (+0x6E..+0x71: 1/2/3 = different states) to one of four colour constants and writes it to the text layer through 0x001A629C.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_CanSwapMember
functions.signature: u32 Ui_PartyPanel_CanSwapMember(UiPartyPanel* self, u32 skipIndex, u32 memberId)
functions.summary: Swap guard of the party panel: when the incoming member's battle unit reports the virtual +0x10 state, it counts the other existing units (virtual +0x24) and refuses (returns 0) if every one of them is in that state too, so the swap cannot leave the party with nobody outside it. Ui_PartyPanel_SwapMembers shows the 0xF55 popup on 0.

functions.name: Party_GetCharacterIdAtSlot
functions.summary: Asks the object's vtable +0x88 accessor for the selected party slot (-1 = no selection) and returns the per-slot character id byte from the party table at (work+0x24A98)+slot+4, or 0xFF when no slot is selected. Ui_PartyPanel_SwapMembers uses it to learn which member is currently in the slot being swapped.

functions.name: Ui_FourLineMenuWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Four-row menu initialiser: binds txt_l1..txt_l4 plus their null_txt_l1..l4 overlays with style 0x15 and refreshes the layout.

functions.name: Ui_FourLineMenuWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the four-line menu window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_BuildReserveRows
functions.summary: Fills the four reserve-member rows: clears four label slots, walks the party id list from index 4 to 0x1F and writes the first four remaining members' names and colours, then resets the selected row and re-selects the gauge.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_BuildReserveRowsB
functions.summary: Second copy of the reserve-member row builder (0x004028A4): the same party index 4..0x1F walk and four-row limit, writing through self->f_34 instead of the child widget and without the leading panel-mode call.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_SetHpGaugeVisible
functions.signature: void Ui_PartyPanel_SetHpGaugeVisible(UiPartyPanel* self, u32 visible, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Shows/hides the member HP gauge and its label: toggles vtable +0x40, writes the on/off alpha to +0x4C, notifies the bound gauge object at +0x70 and calls its vtable +0x18 with the new state.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_SelectMemberGauge
functions.summary: Second entry point into the party-panel member-gauge selection: it first runs the window constructor 0x00325500 (the same ctor used by Menu_TalkParty_CreatePanel) and then falls through into the shared 31-member scan that binds the selected entry to the HP gauge window.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_SelectMemberGaugeByIndex
functions.summary: Scans the 31 party ids and, for the entry whose ordinal matches the panel's requested slot (self->f_28 plus the base offset), rebinds the HP gauge window to that member and records it in f_74; otherwise keeps the gauge on the first visible member.

functions.name: Party_GetReserveMemberId
functions.summary: Returns the character id of the reserve-list entry the panel cursor points at: it walks the 31-entry roster at save work +4, counts the members whose record has bits 0-1 of +4 set, and returns the id whose running count equals the cursor value (virtual +0x88) plus 4 - i.e. the entry after the four on-screen slots. Returns 0xFF when there is none.

functions.name: Ui_FourLineMenuWindow_InitPanesB
functions.summary: Second four-row menu initialiser: same txt_l1..txt_l4 rows and null_txt_l1..l4 overlays, but the overlays use null style 9 instead of 0x15, i.e. a differently styled sibling class.

functions.name: Ui_FourLineMenuWindow_DtorB
functions.summary: Destructor of the second four-line menu window layout (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_SetVisible
functions.summary: Vtable thunk that forwards its flag unchanged to Gfx_Node_SetVisible on the party panel (slot 0x0076C964).

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_HpGauge_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the embedded HP-gauge window of the party panel: initialises the sub-object at +0x70 with Battle_HpGaugeWindow_InitPanes and then runs the inherited UI-window constructor on the composite.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_HpGauge_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the embedded HP-gauge composite: destroys the gauge sub-object at +0x70 (Battle_HpGaugeWindow_Dtor) and then the base UI object.

functions.name: Ui_TwoLineTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Two-line text window initialiser: attaches txt_l1 and txt_l2 (the second with text format blob 0x00403148) and their null overlays with styles 0x14 and 0x16, then refreshes.

functions.name: Ui_TwoLineTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the two-line text window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_Cursor_Init
functions.signature: void Ui_PartyPanel_Cursor_Init(UiPartyPanelCursor* self, void* owner, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Initialises a party-panel cursor widget: stores the owner/context words, binds the cursor panes through Ui_CursorWidget_InitPanes, binds the cursor animation reference (Ui_AnimRef_Bind with the descriptor at 0x004031DC) on the owner's layout and activates the widget (vtable +0x18).

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_Cursor_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the party-panel cursor widget: installs vtable 0x0076CAE8, releases the one layout reference at +0x4C, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Battle_ItemWindow_FillItemDetails
functions.summary: Fills the battle item window's detail area for the currently selected item: resolves the item record (Item_LookupRecord), formats name/description/count strings with Text_FormatMessageArg and writes them into the two text elements, using the member record for usability.

functions.name: Battle_ItemWindow_BuildFilteredList
functions.summary: Builds the item list shown by the battle item command for one party member: resolves the member actor, looks up its carried-item record and asks the shop/filter helper 0x17B59C to fill the window's filtered list; returns whether any entry was produced.

functions.name: Ui_SixPairMenuWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Two-column menu initialiser: right-hand rows txt_r1..txt_r6 first, then left-hand rows txt_l1..txt_l6, followed by six null_txt_l1..l6 overlays with style 9 and a refresh.

functions.name: Battle_ItemWindow_FreeList
functions.summary: Teardown of the battle item window's filtered list: stores the vtable word, frees the record array at +0x70 via Mem_FreeRecordArray and runs the embedded list base destructor.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_PrepareHealNumberPanes
functions.summary: Prepares the three 'pop_heal_num_N' damage-number panes for a new heal value: counts the decimal digits of the value, clears the blink flag on each digit node and hides the panes before the popup is closed.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_InitLayout
functions.signature: void Battle_Popup_InitLayout(BattlePopup* self, u32 kind, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Shared battle-number-popup layout step: formats the 'pop_heal_%d' layout (here with 1), constructs the popup base inside self, binds the 'num' pane, caches the owner pane at +0x188 and closes the window.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_Heal_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the heal-number battle popup: installs the popup vtable, destroys its two fixed-size embedded arrays (0xA8/6 and 0x50/3 elements) with std::destroy_range and runs Ui_Object_DtorBase.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_InitMissPopup
functions.summary: Initialiser for the 'MISS' battle popup: base popup init then binds the 'pop_miss' pane at +0x4C.

functions.name: Battle_Popup_Miss_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 'MISS' battle popup: installs vtable 0x0076CC4C, releases the 'pop_miss' pane reference at +0x4C, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_PagedTextChildWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_PagedTextChildWindow_InitPanes(void* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: InitPanes override for a window that embeds a paged-text child at self+0x70: runs the base prologue and forwards all four arguments to Ui_PagedTextWindow_InitRows on that child; it creates no panes of its own.

functions.name: Ui_PagedTextChildWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Two-base deleting destructor of the paged text child window: destroys this base, destroys the primary base at -0x70 and frees (multiple-inheritance layout).

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_RefreshMemberIds
functions.summary: Rebuilds the battle party panel's id lists: clears the 31-entry main and spare id arrays and the four-slot shortlist, walks the party member list, fills the main array with every member id, splits off the reserve members and the first four usable actors and finally updates the icon row and the target window's slots.

functions.name: maybe_Party_ValidateMemberPage
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Party_ValidateMemberPage(PartySlots* self, u32 firstId, u32 mask)
functions.summary: Checks a page of party slots: counts how many of the four slot ids (self+0x6E..+0x71, -1 = empty) are filled plus whether firstId is valid, then walks character ids from firstId while their record's +4 bits satisfy mask and returns 1 when that run reaches four entries or matches the slot count.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_UpdateRowEnable
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ListWindow_UpdateRowEnable(UiListWindow* self, u32 first2, u32 arg3, ListRows* rows)
functions.summary: Row-enable scan: for each of up to 0x1E rows it looks the row record up in the 0x0063F8F0 table, tests flag bit 0 and toggles the row control through virtual +0x40 (visibility) and +0x4C (string).

functions.name: Party_ValidateMemberSlots
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the panel's four slot ids (+0x6E..+0x71, -1 = empty) agree with the active party: it counts the filled slots and the roster entries whose record has bits 0-1 of +4 set, and accepts when all four slots are filled or the two counts match.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_HasRequiredMembers
functions.summary: Returns true when the four requested member slots (+0x6E..+0x71, 0xFF = empty) can all be filled by the available party actors (actor vtable+0xF0).

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_RefreshRows
functions.summary: Refreshes the four party rows of the panel: resolves each member id to actor and character record, writes the member name/level strings and colours, copies the row state bytes and pushes the row layout through 0x404F3C.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_SetFocus
functions.summary: Updates party panel row selection/focus state via methods +0x40 and +0x4C, propagating focus parameters to child element +0x1C.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_HasAvailableMember
functions.summary: Returns 1 as soon as one of the panel's four slot ids resolves to a battle unit whose virtual +0x10 state is 0, i.e. when at least one member in the panel is still usable; returns 0 when all four are missing or in that state.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_BuildMemberOrder
functions.summary: Rebuilds the party panel's display order: collects up to four member ids from the game work's party list (+0x24A98), inserts the matching actors at the front of the panel's list with maybe_Menu_InsertPartyActors, then pushes the new order to the layout/window (func_00612ADC) and refreshes the slot data.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_SetMemberSelectionState
functions.signature: void Ui_PartyPanel_SetMemberSelectionState(void* self, int state, u32 p3, void* p4)
functions.summary: Sets selection state and active highlight colors for party panel member row via virtual methods +0x40 and +0x4C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PartyPanel_WriteRowOffset
functions.summary: Fragment of the party-panel row setup: computes a signed row offset from self->f_38->f_c and self->f_28 and writes the low halfword at +6 of a record the decompiler lost (unaff_r7); the rest of the body is bad instruction data.

functions.name: maybe_Party_ValidateMemberMask
functions.summary: Mask-parameterised variant of the party-slot validation: walks character ids while their record's +4 bits satisfy the caller's mask, and returns 1 when the run reaches four entries or matches the panel's filled-slot count.

functions.name: Ui_SwapWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Pane initialiser for the equipment swap (irekae) window: four left-hand rows txt_l1..txt_l4 and four right-hand rows txt_r1..txt_r4 with their null overlays, then a refresh.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_SelectMemberRow
functions.summary: Moves the party-panel cursor to a member row by id: selects the entry through Ui_List_SelectEntryById and then refreshes the rows with 0x00404384; used when the player picks a member slot.

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_RemoveMemberFromList
functions.summary: Rebuilds the party panel's ordered member list after a slot change: resolves the last visible member through the battle party list (work+0x5C+0x4254), and when it is gone compacts the 31-entry id array at +0x93 and the shortlist at +0x74, then refreshes the rows.

functions.name: Ui_SwapWindow_SlotTable_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the swap window's slot table: clears the count word and fills two 31-entry id arrays with 0xFF ('empty'), one for each side of the exchange.

functions.name: Ui_SwapWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the party member-swap window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Ui_PartyPanel_RefreshRowText
functions.summary: Writes one party row's text fields: resolves the member actor/record, builds the name and level strings and applies them plus the row colour through the UI text/colour elements.

functions.name: Ui_SwapWindow_ResetSlotRows
functions.summary: Resets the swap window's four selectable rows: three id bytes go back to 0xFF and each of the four rows is enabled or disabled depending on whether its index is below the requested visible-row count.

functions.name: Ui_FourPairTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds eight text panes in one pass: txt_r1..txt_r4 at layout ids base+0..3 and txt_l1..txt_l4 at base+4..7, with no pager or overlays.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_ChildDtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the shop window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Anim_UpdateBlendLerp
functions.summary: Advances the blend and lerps the two stored poses: runs Anim_UpdatePoseBlend, clamps the weight f_3C/f_30 into [0.2, 1.0] and writes the interpolated position triple into +0x74..+0x7C while folding it back into the +0x98 pose.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_UpdateWorldTransform
functions.summary: Recomputes the window's render transform: when the f_91 flag is set it copies the stored translation (f_A4..f_AC) into +4/+8/+0xC and loads the fixed basis vector 0x007E7024 into f_1C..f_24; the f_93 flag then selects either the stored offset (f_B0..f_B8) or the live scene-node position (work+8 -> +0x48) so the window stays screen-aligned.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a screen-level Ui container: runs the composite-object base constructor, installs vtable 0x76CEEC, clears the id bytes at +0x91..+0x93 and +0xD5 and copies the three-word default anchor from 0x7E7000 into +0x98..+0xA0.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for UI screen object; deallocates instance memory via operator delete.
