functions.name: Ui_TxtOnlyWindow_SetOptionText
functions.summary: Retrieves localized text descriptor for optionIndex from table at g_004055c8 via 0x002BCFF4 and applies it to the text pane via 0x001A6680.

functions.name: Ui_TxtOnlyWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Minimal window that binds a single pane named 'txt'.

functions.name: Ui_TxtOnlyWindow_CtorB
functions.summary: Constructor variant of the text-only child window: base-constructs the Ui_Object and installs vtable 0x76CF18 (the class whose InitPanes is Ui_TxtOnlyWindow_InitPanes).

functions.name: Ui_TxtOnlyWindow_DtorB
functions.summary: Destructor of the text-only child window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWidgetScreen_DispatchToChild
functions.summary: Resolves the screen's child object from the generation handle at +0x26C and dispatches by child class: the list class gets Anim_SaveStateToSlot plus the bag-work update, the second class gets its own +0xE1 callback, the third gets maybe_Field_Object2D_StartWakeupCallback.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidgetScreen_UpdateState
functions.summary: Per-frame state step of the list-widget screen: on the first frame it inspects the child's state byte (+0x11C) and for state 0 resets the list through the bag-work string helper, then dispatches to the child; clears the one-shot latch at +4 and fires the child callback when +0x23C is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWidget_Screen_Ctor
functions.signature: UiListWidgetScreen* maybe_Ui_ListWidget_Screen_Ctor(UiListWidgetScreen* self, u32 owner, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructs a list-widget screen: installs vtable 0x76CF80, runs Ui_ListWidget_Ctor, initialises the list anchors and copies the owner's cached row data (0x84/0x44-byte blocks) into the new screen.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_Screen_DeleteDtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the list-widget screen: calls the class destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_Screen_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the list-widget screen: stamps vtable 0x0076CF80, releases the managed row object through the UI heap, re-initialises the four intrusive lists and the embedded elements, and runs the Ui_ListWidget base release.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_SetupPayoutGauge
functions.signature: void Ui_SlotWindow_SetupPayoutGauge(UiSlotWindow* self, u32 start, u32 end, u32 base, u32 step, u32 hold)
functions.summary: Sets up the seven payout gauge segments: stores the value range (+0x46C/0x470/0x478/0x47C), splits the difference into seven segments at +0x58 (stride 0x50) by dividing with the magic constant and writes each segment's alpha, then initialises the counter +0x474/+0x484.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_UpdatePayoutAnim
functions.summary: Advances the slot machine payout animation: on the first frame it snapshots the medal counter and starts the payout, then interpolates the seven gauge segments toward the new total, plays the payout SE while the count is running and reports completion when the final value has been reached.

functions.name: Ui_SlotWindow_StepPayoutGauge
functions.signature: bool Ui_SlotWindow_StepPayoutGauge(UiSlotWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Per-frame step of the payout gauge: compares the current counter with the start/end range, distributes the remaining value over the seven segments (0x50 stride), plays the coin SE at the end and returns whether the hold time has elapsed.

functions.name: Ui_PokerWinWindow_Init
functions.signature: void Ui_PokerWinWindow_Init(UiPokerWinWindow* self, UiScreen* screen, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, int* counter)
functions.summary: Initialises the poker/casino win window: loads the 'win_win' pane, fetches the coin and win number panes, and fills the seven 'coin_num_0..6' plus 'win_num_0..6' digit panes from the payout counter.

functions.name: Container_ArrayCtor
functions.summary: Constructor of a small container: zeroes the three-word header and default-constructs a fixed array of seven 0x50-byte elements at +0xC using the element constructor 0x00326838.

functions.name: Ui_Casino_DestroyFixedArrays
functions.summary: Destroys the two fixed arrays of seven 0x50-byte elements at +0xC and +0x23C with std_destroy_range and element destructor 0x0032686C, then returns the object base; the accompanying constructor is Container_ArrayCtor (0x004066DC).

functions.name: Ui_Message_SetNameAndNumberArgs_2
functions.summary: Fills message arguments 2, 3 and 5 for a message that shows a name and two numbers: arg 3 gets the character name at +0x20C, arg 2 a formatted value built from +0x210/+0x214 and arg 5 the text of the message id at +0x208.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_EncodeTagVariantA
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_EncodeTagVariantA(void* self, u8* outBuf, u32 tagId, u8* argPtr)
functions.summary: Encodes formatted message tag bytes (0x17-0x1A, 0x1F, 0x26, 0x27) into output stream according to message tag command id.

functions.name: Actor_ClearStatusFlag2
functions.signature: void Actor_ClearStatusFlag2(void* self, const u8* memberIdPtr)
functions.summary: Message-command handler (vtable 0x0076CFC0 slot +6): resolves the member record for the id byte at *arg2 and clears bit 2 of the member's flag halfword at +0xDA.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_EncodeTagVariantB
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_EncodeTagVariantB(void* self, u8* outBuf, u32 tagId, u8* argPtr)
functions.summary: Encodes secondary variant of formatted message tag bytes (0x1B-0x1E, 0x1F, 0x26, 0x27) into output stream according to message tag command id.

functions.name: Actor_ClearStatusFlags4And8
functions.signature: void Actor_ClearStatusFlags4And8(void* self, const u8* memberIdPtr)
functions.summary: Message-command handler (vtable 0x0076CFEC slot +6): resolves the member record for the id byte at *arg2 and clears bits 4 and 8 of its flag halfword at +0xDA (0x001902A4 called twice).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateTagState
functions.summary: Advances the message window's tag state (byte +9, values 1..4): it inspects the page state byte at +0xD3C and either moves to state 2/3 with the 'auto' flag at +0x130 or to state 4, then executes the matching control tag (0x28/0x29/0x2A) through Ui_MessageWindow_ExecControlCode.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ResetAndExecTag
functions.summary: Resets the message window (releases the whole UI child tree through Ui_Root_ReleaseAll), puts the tag state at +9 back to 1 and executes the corresponding control tag 0x28.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CreateFromDefs
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_CreateFromDefs(u32 owner, void* def1, void* def2)
functions.summary: Builds message-window sub-object from two descriptor blocks: constructs object and installs vtable 0x0076D028.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_DtorDeleting
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Ui_MessageWindow; invokes base message window destructor 0x002650C4 and deallocates memory via operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneObject_CreateFromDefs
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SceneObject_CreateFromDefs(u32 owner, void* def1, void* def2)
functions.summary: Builds a renderable scene object from two definition blocks: copies a 5-word descriptor from def1 and a 2-word one from def2, calls the scene-node base constructor 0x002D97E8 and installs vtable 0x76D070 (then clears the state bytes).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_DtorVariant
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Ui_MessageWindow variant class; invokes base message window destructor 0x002650C4 and deallocates memory via operator delete.

functions.name: Effect_SpawnAttachedFromDescriptor
functions.signature: void Effect_SpawnAttachedFromDescriptor(EffectAttach* self, u16* desc, u32 arg3, void* actor, int mode)
functions.summary: Creates the attached-effect instances described by a descriptor: copies the 0x6A-byte descriptor into the attachment state, and depending on the mode either spawns the two-id pair, resolves a single id and builds the transform from the actor's bone, or defers to the slot spawners, storing the effect handles back into the state.

functions.name: Effect_SpawnAttachedForSlot
functions.signature: void Effect_SpawnAttachedForSlot(EffectAttach* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, void* actor, int slot)
functions.summary: Slot variant of the attached-effect spawner: when the owner object and its +0x110 handle are valid and the slot's handle is stale, it builds the spawn transform for the slot's position/rotation and creates the instance through Effect_FindOrCreateInstance, then sets the state byte to 3 (or 4 after spawning the child variant at 0x00407534).

functions.name: Effect_SpawnAttachedPair
functions.summary: Spawns the two-effect pair of an attachment: resolves both effect ids of the descriptor, builds their shared transform from the owning actor and creates both instances, letting the effect manager place each one.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_SpawnAttachedSingleB
functions.summary: Spawns the single effect of attachment slot at +6: when the cached handle at +0xC8 is stale and the slot id is not -1 it builds the spawn transform through Battle_Effect_ComputeSpawnTransform and creates the instance with Effect_FindOrCreateInstance, caching the new handle.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_SpawnAttachedSingleC
functions.summary: Second single-slot spawner, byte-for-byte twin of 0x00407470: slot id at +0xA, cached handle at +0xD0, spawn transform through Battle_Effect_ComputeSpawnTransform and instance through Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.

functions.name: Battle_TargetMarker_UpdateSlotEffects
functions.signature: void Battle_TargetMarker_UpdateSlotEffects(EffectAttach* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Per-frame state machine (states 1..4) for the effects attached to a battle target marker: validates the cached effect handles against the 0x7B4D68 table, spawns/updates the slot effects through 0x407468/0x407534 and clears the pending byte +0xE0 when 0x406E08 reports completion.

functions.name: Gfx_Effect_ResetChannelState
functions.summary: Fetches graphics effect context via 0x002DB7B4, resets channel state bitmasks on offsets +0x5C..+0x68, and clears secondary channel parameters +0x6C..+0x78.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_GetAttachedInstancePtr
functions.summary: container_of-style accessor: calls the effect-link destructor helper (which returns its own 'self') and subtracts 0x68, recovering the owner record that embeds the effect link at +0x68.

functions.name: Ui_Message_BindTextPageParams
functions.summary: Binds text page layout parameters by searching row node list, allocating sub-structure via 0x00293A00 and committing layout coordinates +0x1C..+0x24.

functions.name: Ui_TwoLineMessage_SetFirst
functions.signature: void Ui_TwoLineMessage_SetFirst(UiTwoLineMessage* self, u32 arg2, int mode)
functions.summary: Fills the two text panes of a small two-line message: builds line 1 from the text table (or the fixed fallback id 0xF when mode != 0), clears line 2 and resets the sub-widgets.

functions.name: Ui_TwoLineMessage_SetSecond
functions.signature: void Ui_TwoLineMessage_SetSecond(UiTwoLineMessage* self, u32 arg2, int arg3, u32 arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Fills both text panes of the two-line message from two descriptors, stores the two extra arguments at +0x3B/+0x3C and resets the sub-widgets.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeLineTwoSelectWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Pane initialiser for a three-row list with two independent cursors: attaches txt_l1..txt_l3 and their null overlays, then binds the select1/select2 cursor panes and resets the selection.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeLineTwoSelectWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the three-line/two-select window: base-constructs the Ui_Object, installs vtable 0x76D0B8 and constructs the two 0x50-byte choice sub-widgets at +0x4C/+0x9C with 0x003E0454.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeLineTwoSelectWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the three-line two-cursor select window: installs vtable 0x0076D0B8, releases the layout references at +0x9C and +0x4C, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeLineTwoSelectWindow_InitLayout
functions.summary: Initialises the window's layout and entry animations: binds the three text lines and the two choice widgets to their panes (0x1A6680/0x1A61FC), builds the animation descriptors (0x213E30/0x2EAC44/0x3DFF34/0x3E043C/0x6406D0) and starts the opening animation.

functions.name: Ui_SevenLineSelectWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Pane initialiser for a seven-row selectable list: seven txt_lN rows with null overlays plus seven per-row 'selectN' cursor panes.

functions.name: Ui_SevenLineSelectWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the seven-line selection window: Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x76D11C (Ui_SevenLineSelectWindow_Dtor/InitPanes) and builds a 7-element array of 0x50-byte rows.

functions.name: Ui_SevenLineSelectWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the seven-line select window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Ui_SevenLineSelectWindow_SetEntryNumber
functions.summary: Formats 1-based index (entryIndex + 1) into text buffer and updates widget text pane via 0x001A6680.

functions.name: Ui_PlaceNameWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Window that binds the single 'txt_place' pane, i.e. the place/location-name label.

functions.name: Ui_PlaceNameWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the place-name window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_InitLayout
functions.summary: Loads and shows the dungeon skill window's layout: binds the embedded widget at +0x128 to the layout named "win_dungeon_skill" (0x001D85EC) and marks the layout visible with 0x0029126C.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_Teardown
functions.summary: Shuts the dungeon-skill window down: invokes the layout close callback self->f_98->f_2C and tears the embedded section block at +0x128 down through 0x289F14.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_AdvancePageProgress
functions.signature: void Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_AdvancePageProgress(void* self, int curPage, int curProgress, int step)
functions.summary: Advances progress counter at +0x124 by step, advancing to next page via 0x0028A04C if reaching 100%, and updates animation lerp at +0x128 via 0x00289E9C.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_SetPagePercent
functions.summary: Sets page animation fraction from field +0x124 converted to float, applies scaling constant g_0040835c, and updates lerp at +0x128 via 0x00289E9C.

functions.name: Battle_TextWindow_CtorSub
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle text window used for battle messages: installs the class vtable and builds its embedded text/message sub-objects.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Ui_DungeonSkillWindow; invokes teardown helper 0x004083D8 and deallocates memory via operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.signature: void Ui_DungeonSkillWindow_DeletingDtor(UiDungeonSkillWindow* self, void* vtable, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the dungeon-skill window: installs vtable 0x0076D1E4, re-links the three embedded list heads at +0x844/+0x84C/+0x858, releases the nine layout references of the embedded panes, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Gfx_SkillMeshNode_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for skill mesh scene node; invokes base node destructor 0x005F8528 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Gfx_SkillMeshNode_PlayLoopAnimation
functions.summary: Plays the loop animation "On_Loop" on node via virtual method +0x84 if condition 0x00669DD4 is satisfied, updating child node state.

functions.name: Ui_NineLineWindowNode_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for nine-line text window node; calls base destructor 0x005F8528 and deallocates memory via operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_NineLineTextWindow_PlayOpenEffect
functions.summary: Plays the 'Open_Back' animation on the window, spawns 2D effect 0x504 at the window position through the effect manager, then plays SE 0xE4B on the lazily created shared anim-sequence object.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindowNode_TriggerState2
functions.summary: Checks trigger condition via 0x00669DD4 and invokes child node virtual method at +0x4C->+0x14 with state mode 2.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindowNode_PlayOpenBackAnimation
functions.summary: Plays the "Open_Back" UI transition animation on the equipment window node via virtual method +0x84 and sets a 60-frame timer via 0x005F7784.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindowNode_Dtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for equipment window scene node; calls base destructor 0x005F8528 and frees memory with operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenItemPage
functions.summary: Opens the equipment window's item/use page for the selected member: checks with 0x0063469C whether the item is usable, pushes the "use" or "equip" pane through Ui_Window_PushPane (0x6D7508), then either resets the panel (0x19AD70) or pushes the confirmed page (0x19BD2C).

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenPageForMember
functions.summary: Opens the equipment page for the selected member: if no script/rura call is pending it pushes the member's pane, applies the equip mark for the focused row and pushes the confirmed page, otherwise it pushes the disabled variant and clears the mark.

functions.name: Fs_FileJob_UpdateAlt
functions.signature: u32 Fs_FileJob_UpdateAlt(FsFileJob* job, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Second instantiation of the asynchronous file-read state machine (same six states, same 0x1CFFCC/0x503264/0x1D0218/0x1D033C/0x1D0378/0x655xxx sequence as 0x2EB658) but with an extra request parameter word; returns 1 while the job is still running.

functions.name: Ui_NineLineTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Nine-row text window: attaches txt_l1..txt_l9 and their null overlays, then refreshes the layout.

functions.name: Ui_NineLineTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the nine-line text window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_FrogJumpStart
functions.signature: void Field_ActorAction_FrogJumpStart(FieldActorAction* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Starts the field 'frog jump' action: saves the landing position, enables the jump motion, plays either the 'FrogJump' or 'FrogJumpNoEffect' animation depending on the actor variant, computes the arc velocity toward the target and sets the actor's facing.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_OnValueChanged
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_ActorAction_OnValueChanged(void* self, u32 newValue, u32 unusedA, u32 unusedB)
functions.summary: Value-changed callback: when the new value is 2, the work byte at +0x44 is set and the latch f_48 is clear, stops the actor's current animation (vtable +0x98) and plays animation 2 on it.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_FrogJumpUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame continuation of the frog-jump action: integrates the stored velocity, restores the collision mode after 0x17 frames and ends the action when the actor reports completion.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_StopMovement
functions.summary: NPC action step that stops the actor: marks the action busy (f_48=1), switches the actor at f_28 to movement mode 2, applies speed 4, clears its destination f_2A8 and reapplies the movement flags.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_OpeFrameCtor
functions.signature: NpcAction* Field_NpcAction_OpeFrameCtor(NpcAction* storage, void* owner, void* actor, const char* actionKey)
functions.summary: Constructor for the NPC action used by action states 0x0A and 0x0B ('opeFr'): installs the action vtable, stores the key handle and copies a three-word vector twice (source and working copy) before marking the action active.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_FrogJump_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0 of vtable 0x0076D5AC) of the frog-jump action: runs the 0x00193E40 base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ItemIconRow_SetIcons
functions.summary: Stores the member id at self+0x49, binds UI strings 0x5C/0x5D to the first two cells, then fills six equipment cells (base cell 6) with the member's equipped item names and colours, with the two-handed special case for the second hand.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipCompare_SetSlotPanes
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipCompare_SetSlotPanes(void* self, int characterId, const u16* slots)
functions.summary: Stores the member id at self+0x49 and fills six slot panes with the member's equipped item names, colouring each name by whether it equals the compared item id; slot 1 has a two-handed special case.

functions.name: Ui_NumberedTextWindow_SetVisible
functions.summary: Visibility override of the numbered-text window: calls Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim(self, visible) and then applies the window's own gated follow-up work.

functions.name: Ui_NumberedTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Creates the twelve numbered text panes of a text/list window: builds 'txt_l0..' and 'txt_r0..' style names incrementally and binds each to the pane slot with the matching text handle.

functions.name: Ui_NumberedTextWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the numbered text window: base-constructs the Ui_Object, installs vtable 0x76D5DC and constructs the two numbered-row sub-objects at +0x4C and +0x9C with 0x003E0454.

functions.name: Ui_NumberedTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the numbered text window (Ui_Object_DtorBase + free).

functions.name: Ui_ItemIcon_SetFromItem
functions.signature: void Ui_ItemIcon_SetFromItem(UiItemIcon* self, ItemRecord* item, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Sets an item icon pane from an item record: chooses the icon frame (5 or 6) from the record flags, resolves the item icon or the 'no item' icon and writes both panes.

functions.name: Ui_TitleNameWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Two-pane window that binds a 'txt_title' caption and the 'txt_name' value below it.

functions.name: Ui_TitleNameWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the title-name window: constructs the UI object base and stamps the class vtable 0x0076D640, whose InitPanes slot is Ui_TitleNameWindow_InitPanes.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorTrivial
functions.summary: Destructor of a Ui_Object subclass that owns no extra members: it chains to the shared Ui_Object base destructor and then the shared object-free helper. Reached only through the class vtable, which is why it has no static callers.

functions.name: maybe_Model_ApplyCharacterParam
functions.summary: Applies one character-display parameter to the model: resolves the party member with 0x0035EB98(work, self->f_3C), bails out when the member's +0xDA bit 0x10 is set, resolves the portrait index (f_3D, or the first valid one), reads the 0x10-byte portrait entry and binds the resulting transform/resource.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_SecondaryDeletingDtorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor in the secondary (multiple-inheritance) vtable 0x0076D6A8: runs the 0x002650C4 Ui window base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Model_Equip_CreateWeaponMeshes
functions.summary: Creates the four equipment meshes of a character model: slots 0 and 1 get a 'meshWeaponEquip' node, slots 2 and 3 get a 'meshSheathEquip' node; each node is attached to the owner, given a layout config and stored at self+0x40+8*slot.

functions.name: Model_Equip_ApplyCommand
functions.signature: void Model_Equip_ApplyCommand(CharacterModel* self, const u8* cmd, int updateCompare)
functions.summary: Applies one equipment command to a character model: commands 0/1 set the weapon or off-hand item, commands 2..5 clear all attached items, and when updateCompare is set it recomputes the equipment compare code and notifies the panel if it changed.

functions.name: Model_Equip_AttachItemNode
functions.signature: void Model_Equip_AttachItemNode(CharacterModel* self, int slot, int itemId, const float* transform)
functions.summary: Attaches the mesh node of an item to the model: builds the attachment record (node name 'N_ALL', the item's transform block), for slot 1 rotates it by pi/2 using the sin/cos helpers so the off-hand item is oriented correctly, then creates the node through 0x0040A980 and stores the item id in the slot; on failure it releases the node and stores 0xFFFF.

functions.name: Model_Equip_CommitNodeChanges
functions.summary: Commits a pending node change: when the node exists it intersects the model's visibility mask with the character's +0x12E4 byte and, if the node should be shown, applies the model state and re-binds the node; then marks the reference as committed (byte +6).

functions.name: Model_CreateAttachedEffect
functions.signature: u32 Model_CreateAttachedEffect(CharacterModel* self, ItemRecord* item, const void* nodeDesc)
functions.summary: Builds the effect node that visualises an equipped item: copies the item's 0x12-byte effect parameter block plus its colour/scale fields, creates the attached effect (0x2239F4) and binds it to the model at the descriptor's node via Model_AttachSlot_Setup.

functions.name: Model_Equip_UpdateNodeVisibility
functions.summary: Shows or hides the model's four equipment nodes (f_40 every 8 bytes): a node is shown only when the model's visibility byte, the character's +0x12E4 mask and the node's own +6 flag all agree, otherwise it is detached.

functions.name: Model_AttachSlot_Release
functions.summary: Releases an equipment/model attach slot: if the slot still holds a model it hides every attach slot of that model and clears the 'occupied' byte at +6. Called from model creation, equipment update, model release and NPC balloon setup, i.e. every place that tears a character model down.

functions.name: Model_Equip_GetBoneTransformDescriptor
functions.signature: int Model_Equip_GetBoneTransformDescriptor(void* modelEquip, u32 equipCategory, int index, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the bone-transform descriptor for one equipment category: resolves the CharacterRecord through the data manager and 0x0063eb94, then returns the per-category sub-record (0x160/0x1b0 for category 0, 0x200, 0x250, 0x2a0, 0x2f0, 0x340, 0x368+index*0x28, 0x3b8, 0x3e0, 0x408) that holds the bone name and Euler angles the item model is attached with.

functions.name: Model_Equip_ApplyCharacterEquipment
functions.summary: Binds a character to the model and applies its equipment: stores the id (+0x65) and the character's shape byte (+0x3C), reads the two equipped item ids from the character record, applies them to slot 0 and 1, clears the remaining attachments and refreshes the node visibility.

functions.name: Model_Equip_ApplyAccessorySlots
functions.signature: void Model_Equip_ApplyAccessorySlots(CharacterModel* self, int slotA, int slotB)
functions.summary: Handles the two accessory slots of the model: when they change it either detaches both accessory nodes or, when both are cleared, re-applies the character's default items to them, updating the node ids and grip state.

functions.name: Model_Equip_ApplySlotFromCharacter
functions.signature: void Model_Equip_ApplySlotFromCharacter(CharacterModel* self, int slot, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Re-applies one equipment slot of the model from the bound character's record: reads the item id for the slot, dispatches to the slot-0/slot-1 setter or clears everything for the accessory slots, then refreshes the compare display.

functions.name: Model_Equip_SetSlot1Item
functions.summary: Sets the off-hand (slot 1) item of the model: validates the item, picks the attachment transform for the item's class (shield vs. other, with a per-shape variant at +0x3C), attaches the node through 0x0040A758(slot 1) and updates the accessory node accordingly; an invalid or empty item detaches the node.

functions.name: Model_Equip_SetSlot0Item
functions.summary: Sets the main-hand (slot 0) weapon of the model: attaches the weapon node with the shape-dependent transform, updates the paired accessory node, and for two-handed items also sets the off-hand node; an empty id detaches both nodes.

functions.name: Model_Equip_ApplyAccessoryEffects
functions.summary: Applies the accessory effect of the bound character to the model: takes the character's effect index (0x0023D078), looks the effect record up in the 0x10-byte table from 0x0063EB94 and creates the attached effect, then updates the two accessory node slots and the node visibility.

functions.name: Model_Equip_SetGripNode
functions.signature: void Model_Equip_SetGripNode(CharacterModel* self, int gripState, int hand)
functions.summary: Switches the weapon grip of the model: for gripState 0 it detaches the paired hand node and attaches the 'wbhm_grip_on' node of the selected hand, for gripState 1 it attaches the node and swaps to 'wbhm_grip_off', committing each change through 0x0040A8C4.

functions.name: Model_Equip_UpdateGripState
functions.signature: void Model_Equip_UpdateGripState(CharacterModel* self, int gripState, int force)
functions.summary: Applies a grip-state change unless the off-hand item is a shield and force is clear, in which case the grip must stay unchanged; stores the new state at +0x61.

functions.name: Model_Equip_AttachItemSlot
functions.signature: void Model_Equip_AttachItemSlot(void* modelEquip, u32 slotIndex, int itemId)
functions.summary: Releases any existing attachment on equipment slotIndex, resolves itemId's equip category (ItemRecord->u8_29) and bone transform descriptor (0x0040AC1C, default bone "N_ALL", converting Euler degrees to a 3x4 matrix), and attaches the 3D item model via Model_CreateAttachedEffect (0x0040A980).

functions.name: Model_Equip_SetGripSlot
functions.summary: Sets which grip node a model uses: forwards (self, slotId, 1) to Model_Equip_SetGripNode and remembers the slot id in the byte at +0x60. Used by the equipment and model-creation paths.

functions.name: Ui_TextLabel_SetTextGroup
functions.signature: void Ui_TextLabel_SetTextGroup(UiTextLabel* label, u32 groupId, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: The text-label group setter: it assigns the group id, records the line count and rebuilds the label's slot objects.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CreateSceneEntry
functions.signature: SceneEntry* Field_Object2D_CreateSceneEntry(u32 factory, SceneEntryDef* def, SceneRef* ref)
functions.summary: Creates a 2D-field scene entry object: copies a 5-word descriptor, calls the scene-node base constructor 0x002D97E8, installs vtable 0x76D724 (Field_Object2D_ReleaseSceneEntry/UpdateSceneNodes) and constructs a 4-element 8-byte array.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_SecondaryDeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Sibling of 0x0040A374: deleting destructor in the secondary vtable 0x0076D6E8, which has the identical 0x002650xx base-method layout and adjustor 0x0040BAE8.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_UpdateSceneNodes
functions.summary: Recomputes a 2D field object's screen rectangles: offsets its stored rect by the parent transform, writes the node position/size for every type-4 node in the handle list and swaps width/height when the display mode (0/2/6) mirrors the screen.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_AddQuadChild
functions.summary: Adds one textured quad child to a sprite actor: runs the base prepare virtual, copies the source/destination rects and the size into the per-child tables, allocates the draw slot through Gfx_Scene_AllocSpriteSlot and increments the child index (max 8).

functions.name: Field_Object2D_ShowSceneEntryA
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_ShowSceneEntryA(FieldObject2D* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Latch-on 'show' method for one of the object's two 2D scene entries: if the entry is currently hidden it marks it visible (byte +0x10) and, when the object is active (+0x42), tells the scene manager to enable the entry (Gfx_Scene_SetEntryFlag(...,1)).

functions.name: Field_Object2D_ReleaseSceneEntry
functions.summary: Detaches the object from the 2D scene: releases the scene entry (Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntries), clears the handle at +0x5c and resets the parameters of every attached node (8-byte stride at +0x16c) to the default 'visible, no flip, no offset' values, then zeroes the node count.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_HideSceneEntryA
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_HideSceneEntryA(FieldObject2D* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Latch-off counterpart of 0x0040C200: when the entry is visible it clears the visible byte and disables the corresponding scene entry (Gfx_Scene_SetEntryFlag(...,0)).

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CreateSpriteEntry
functions.signature: SceneEntry* Field_Object2D_CreateSpriteEntry(u32 factory, SceneEntryDef* def, SceneRef* ref)
functions.summary: Creates the sprite variant of a 2D-field scene entry: base 0x002D9744, then a child node via 0x003DFB10 with vtable 0x76D724 and an 0x8 x 0x10 array. Called when a sprite actor adds a child.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelPart_DeletingDtorC
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PanelPart_DeletingDtorC(void* self, unsigned int flags)
functions.summary: Deleting destructor variant that first stores the third register argument at +0x3C, then runs the 0x002650C4 base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_SyncAttachedNodes
functions.summary: Per-frame positioner for the 2D nodes/light attached to an object: computes the owner transform (or rotates the local offset by the owner quaternion when self+0x16A is set), writes the node position only when it actually changed, and repeats for every child node (type 1 position, type 2 position plus quaternion).

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteActor_AddRotationChild
functions.summary: Adds one child quad to a sprite actor: copies the child's six transform floats into the actor's per-child table, rotates them by the parent matrix and submits either a rotated (type 2, Gfx_Scene_AddSpriteEntryLarge) or billboard (type 1, AddSpriteEntrySmall) sprite; the handle lands in self[0x17].

functions.name: Field_Object2D_ShowSceneEntryB
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_ShowSceneEntryB(Field_Object2D* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Second 'show' entry of the same class as 0x0040C200 (two independent scene handles are used, for example body and shadow sprites); identical semantics with the flag store ordered after the scene call.

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_AddSegment
functions.summary: Appends one segment to a 16-segment trail: stores the six floats, transforms them by the parent matrix and submits a rotated (Gfx_Scene_AddNodeType2) or billboard (AddNodeType1) quad; returns 0 when the ring is full.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_ResetAttachedNodes
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_ResetAttachedNodes(Field_Object2D* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Teardown for the attached-node list: releases the scene entry, clears the handle at +0x5c and restores every one of the +0x2f8 node transforms (0x18 bytes each, two vec3s at +0x178) to the default orientation constant, then zeroes the node count.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_HideSceneEntryB
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_HideSceneEntryB(Field_Object2D* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Second 'hide' entry: disables the object's scene entry and clears the visible latch.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CreateSpriteEntryB
functions.signature: SceneEntry* Field_Object2D_CreateSpriteEntryB(u32 factory, SceneEntryDef* def, SceneRef* ref)
functions.summary: Second sprite-entry constructor: base 0x002D97E8, child via 0x003DFB10 with vtable 0x76D77C (Field_Object2D_ResetAttachedNodes/SyncAttachedNodes), plus three copied vector components and an 0x18 x 0x10 array.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PanelPart_DeletingDtorD
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_PanelPart_DeletingDtorD(void* self, unsigned int flags)
functions.summary: Fourth sibling of the 0x0040A374 group: writes +0x3C, destroys the 0x002650C4 base object and frees it.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_IsEventSlotFree
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the game work and its event state exist and the shared field/event gate reports ready. Slot 1 of the Field_Object2D vtable 0x76D7D8.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_ApplyResultFlag
functions.summary: Issues the object's interaction command (Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent with the three argument bytes f_46/f_45/f_48) and, when it succeeds and a flag id is stored at +0x49, sets that bit in the game-work flag word via 0x006135D8(work+0x24A98, id); returns the command result.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CtorC
functions.summary: Third constructor of the 2D field-object class: runs the base initialiser 0x0017C1C8, installs vtable 0x0076D7D4 and seeds the id/layer fields with the 'none' sentinels (id byte 0xFF, u16 0xFFFF, word 0, byte 0xFF) so the object reads as unplaced.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for the 2D field-object class: releases the embedded drawable object (0x17C334, named maybe_Ui_DestroyObject earlier) and frees the instance.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CommitPendingFlag
functions.signature: int Field_Object2D_CommitPendingFlag(Field_Object2D* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Commits a pending interaction: when the command manager is idle it sends the stored triple (f_2CE, f_2CD, event 1) through Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent and clears the pending byte f_2CC.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_AttachToActor
functions.summary: Binds the object's sprite to a live field actor: resolves the handle in the actor table, accepts only actors of type 0x20000001 and asks the actor for the world transform to attach to.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_ApplyPlacementRecord
functions.summary: Initialises a field object from its placement record: copies the record id, position/scale (scale 0.5), rotation quaternion, the two sprite ids, the flag bytes and the action ids, builds the model transform (0x39FA90) and applies the model scale. This is the bridge between the level3d object table and the runtime 2D sprite object.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_UpdateInteraction
functions.summary: Per-frame interaction step: when the object has a hold mode or a live actor it either keeps the sprite attached to the actor transform or sends command 0xB with the mask 0xFFFFF800.

functions.name: Field_ObjectCtor_vt76D7FC
functions.summary: Constructor of a field object from the shared object pool: installs vtable 0x76D7FC, seeds the two inverted default vectors, the id/flip/alpha defaults (0, 3, 0xFF), then constructs the embedded sprite at +0x1C and its default fields; returns the object base 0x70 bytes before the sprite.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_DestroyNode
functions.summary: Destructor of the object created by 0x0040D29C: stamps the base vtable, destroys the embedded sprite at +0x70 and the Ui_Object part, then frees the node.

functions.name: Ui_TextFormat_SetMemberNameAndItemText
functions.summary: Sets message argument slot 2 to the member name (+0xCA, padded/truncated to 0x7F wchars) and slot 5 to the display text of the id at self+0x210 (Item_LookupRecord then Text_FormatMessageArg), i.e. a 'member got item' message.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_IsEventSlotFreeB
functions.summary: Returns the shared field/event gate value (0 when the game work is absent). Slot 2 of the Field_Object2D notification vtable 0x76D8F0.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_UpdateEffectSlot
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a 2D field object's attached effect: runs the standard prelude, restarts the effect through 0x40D7E0 when the object is active, then pushes the object's world position into the 2D effect manager (0x6224F8).

functions.name: maybe_Effect_QuadEmitter_SetupA
functions.summary: A-variant setup of a sprite emitter: copies layer/colour/position/rotation from the definition, builds one type-2 sprite child descriptor, attaches it at f_278, stores the definition origin at +0x2C8 and loads effect pack 0x4B5.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_QuadEmitter_SetupB
functions.summary: B-variant of the sprite-emitter setup: reads its layer byte from def+0x18, stores f_2D8 = 1 and sub-id f_2DC = def[0x17], otherwise performing the same child-descriptor build, attach and effect-pack load as 0x0040D4F8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_PlayStateEffect
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Object2D_PlayStateEffect(Field_Object2D* self, int state, u32 arg3, float arg4)
functions.summary: Starts the effect that belongs to a given object state: for states 10/11 it stops the previous effect, builds the spawn transform from the object position and requests effect id 0x4B5, also notifying the model interface through vtable +0x38.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_RestartStateEffect
functions.summary: Stops the object's current state effect (Effect_ReleaseHandle on self->f_2E8), rebuilds the effect transform from the object position at f_9C..f_A4 (mirroring the global at 0x007E7024 when f_2D8 is clear) and recreates effect id 0x4B5 via Effect_FindOrCreateInstance, storing the new handle back in f_2E8. Called by Field_Object2D_UpdateEffectSlot when the object's state effect has to be restarted.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_SyncTaskChain
functions.summary: Attaches or detaches the object's task chain (self+0x2C8) to match the actor state byte f_312 (state 7 uses the detach helper 0x002337CC, other states the attach helper Actor_CreateTaskChainB) and returns whether it changed anything.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_DtorWithSubObject
functions.summary: Multiple-inheritance destructor of the 2D field-object class: installs the primary vtable (from the literal g_0040d9f8) and the secondary one 0xd4 bytes later, destroys the embedded sub-object at +0x2e0 and frees the instance.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_UpdateTouchState
functions.summary: Touch/click state machine for interactive field objects: phase 1 drags the object by the delta between the current and previous touch point, phase 2 feeds the touch point into the game's cursor handler and starts the press animation, phase 3 waits for the animation to end, phase 4 sends the release and advances the event. Phases are written back into ev[0].

functions.name: Field_Object2D_BuildTouchEvent
functions.signature: TouchEvent* Field_Object2D_BuildTouchEvent(TouchEvent* out, u8 phase, u8 phase2, u32* point)
functions.summary: Fills a touch event (type 1, kind, phase, x, y) and immediately hands control to the game's input handler with slot 4, i.e. it synthesises a press/move/release for a 2D object.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_RunStateSequence
functions.summary: Four-step sequence that opens a scripted view around the object: request the overlay (0x2D24BC), wait for it (vtable +0x30), then move a camera/effect anchor either to the object position or to the stored anchor (+0x324) and play the overlay element animations; the last step waits for the anchor to finish and closes the overlay. Always returns true (it is polled until the state machine reaches 4).

functions.name: Field_Object2D_SetDrawPass
functions.summary: Switches a field 2D object between its two sprite draw passes: calls the remove/insert vtable slots (+0x40/+0x58 or +0x3C/+0x54) with layer 4 in opposite order, sets the two draw ids at +0x2B4/+0x310 to 0/-1 accordingly and records the mode byte at +0xC8.

functions.name: Effect_MeshEmitter_Setup
functions.summary: Configures a mesh-based effect emitter from its definition: loads effect pack 0x4A1, sets the rotation from the definition quaternion, adds two sprite children, a colour animator and the mesh object (mesh id at def+0x9A), and copies the definition's offsets/scale into the emitter fields.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CtorWithAttachedEffect
functions.signature: Field_Object2D* Field_Object2D_CtorWithAttachedEffect(Field_Object2D_Desc* desc, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor for a Field::Object2D subclass that also creates an attached effect/node sub-object: installs the primary and secondary vtables, invalidates the handle field and copies a global 3-vector pair into the sub-object.

functions.name: maybe_Actor2D_HandleObject_DeletingDtorWithPack
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of an Actor2D-derived object with three sub-objects: it stamps the primary vtable at +0 and the secondary one at +0x258, runs the Actor_HandleRefEx base body at +0x2D4, destroys the Pack_Handle at +0x2CC, runs the Actor2D_EffectNode body on self and frees.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_IsEventSlotFreeC
functions.summary: Returns the shared field/event gate value. Slot 2 of the Field_Object2D notification vtable 0x76DAE0.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_PlaceEffectInFrontOfCamera
functions.summary: Places the object (typically a 'look at me' effect sprite) on the line from the camera to its target: computes the squared distance to the reference position, applies an exponential distance factor (0.1 step) and offsets the object from the camera position along the camera orientation, then marks the transform dirty.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_PlayIdleEffect
functions.summary: Spawns the object's default effect (id 0x4B0) at the object position and stores the handle at +0x2D8.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_SetStateEffect
functions.summary: Swaps the object's effect when its state changes: states 4/5 stop the old handle and spawn 0x4af or 0x4b0, states 2/3 toggle a boolean on the sub-object (vtable slot 0x14) and in all cases the model interface (f_270, slot 0x84) is told about the new state.

functions.name: Effect_BillboardEmitter_Setup
functions.summary: Configures a single billboard (descriptor type 1) effect part: layer byte, the two sub-ids and the colour, one non-rotated sprite child whose scale is the definition's radius times the shared basis vector, and the colour mirrored into +0x2C8..+0x2D0.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_OnDeactivate
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_OnDeactivate(Field_Object2D* self, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Deactivation path: when the object was active it notifies the embedded scene object (0x336938), unregisters itself from the field scene (0x1C9110(work->f_54, self)) and releases the state effect handle.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_NotifyCommand16
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Object2D_NotifyCommand16(Field_Object2D* self, int offset, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Sends field-gadget command 0x16 with the object id when the u16 at self+offset is not 0xFFFF and the object's u16 f_2D4 is not 0xFF.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of a Field::Object2D node: destroys the Actor2D effect-node base (0x28EFB4) and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_UpdateBattleTrigger
functions.summary: Per-frame poll of an object's battle trigger: when the per-map byte at work+0x2A4E6+self->f_298 is 1 or 4 it returns the channel busy state; otherwise it starts the trigger once (flag f_29A, trigger object f_29C) and on later frames calls Field_BattleTrigger_StartBattle.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_SetConfirmMessage
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_SetConfirmMessage(FieldObject2D* self, int which, u32 textId)
functions.summary: Builds the message arguments for the object's confirm prompt: selects the primary or secondary message record, sets args 8/9, resolves the text id to a message line and registers it for display.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_UpdateTalkText
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a field scene node with a message slot: when the node is not yet talking (0x309 clear) but has text pending (0x308 set) it forces the slot's message-state byte to 0xFF; when that state is 1 or 4 and the node has a model it plays the talk animation (0x002D1258) and freezes the animator on the last frame.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_InitModel
functions.summary: Builds the 3D representation of a field object from its placement record: copies the record fields, looks the monster/NPC model definition up by (kind, id) and, when found, allocates a 0x178 anim instance, applies the anim template, attaches the colour animator, sets the model size from the record and registers the resulting sprite in the scene.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_InitModelVariant
functions.summary: Byte-for-byte twin of 0x0040F0F0 (model/animator construction from a placement record) except that the object is flagged variant 1 (f_2f0 = 1) and a different anim template name is used, so the two spawning paths build the normal and the alternate appearance of the same object.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_FinishTalkText
functions.summary: End-of-talk step: if the node's talk slot +0x298 is set, it may write 0xFF into the shared state byte at work+0x24A98+0x5A4E+slot, then if that byte is 1 or 4 and node->f_B8 is live it refreshes the talk target through 0x002D1258.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_ConfirmInteraction
functions.summary: Player-confirm branch of a field 2D object: clears the latch byte +0x29A; if the per-map byte is 1 or 4 it posts script command 0x19/0x1A via Event_OnTriggerCommand, otherwise it plays the confirm SE, stops the stored animation and sends command 0x18 through Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CtorSprite
functions.signature: Field_Object2D* Field_Object2D_CtorSprite(Field_Object2D_Desc* desc, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor for the sprite variant of Field::Object2D: installs the sprite vtable, sets the object handle to 0xFFFF ("none") and initialises the embedded sprite slot.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_SpriteDeletingDtor
functions.summary: Destructor counterpart of Field_Object2D_CtorSprite (0x0040F898): reinstalls the primary vtable and the +0x98 secondary one, tears the sprite slot down through 0x0059AA7C/0x0028E6C4 and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_UpdateDeferredSubObject
functions.summary: Third copy of the same deferred start: flag +0x2CA, sub-object +0x2CC. Waits for the event state to report idle, latches the flag, starts the sub-object through its virtual +0x1C slot, then polls it through 0x0046E50C.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_SetCancelMessage
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_SetCancelMessage(FieldObject2D* self, int which, u32 textId)
functions.summary: Cancel-prompt twin of 0x0040EEE8: sets message args 8/9 and registers the resolved text for the object's cancel interaction.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneNode_UpdateMessageAction
functions.summary: Per-frame talk/message state machine of a field scene node: it resolves the attached object handle, fires the node's +0x84 handler with 0x6E4F when the +0xC6 byte is 1, and when the per-node message state at work+0x2A4E6+index is 1 or 4 it fires +0x84 with the node's +0xC8 block, starts a 60-frame action through 0x005F7784 and clears the pending byte at +0xAD.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_MeshEmitter_SetupB
functions.summary: Mesh-emitter setup variant B: stores the emitter record fields, sets the effect node name to the fixed string "Open" at +0x320, applies the placement position/rotation, adds a sprite child with a colour descriptor, registers an fCol animator and creates the mesh from def->+0x42 and variant byte f_11.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_MeshEmitter_SetupC
functions.summary: Mesh-emitter setup variant C: same sprite child + fCol animator + mesh creation as 0x0040FBB8 but stores the fixed string "Off" at +0x320, sets the variant flag f_318 = 1, takes the mesh id from def->f_F and writes it to +0x312 instead of +0x2C8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_FinishMessageAction
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_SceneObject_FinishMessageAction(void* node, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Variant of the talk-action completion: clears the same shared state byte at work+0x24A98+0x5A4E+id to 0xFF when the node is flagged idle, and when the byte is 1 or 4 it plays the talk animation through virtual +0x84, calls 0x005F7784(node,0x3C,0) and clears node[0xAD].

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CancelInteraction
functions.summary: Cancel branch of a 2D field-object interaction: clears the interaction latch, then depending on the object variant either calls the vtable stop slot (+0x84) or plays the cancel SE, and finally sets the cancel message and pushes event command 0x18 for the object.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_CtorMesh
functions.signature: Field_Object2D* Field_Object2D_CtorMesh(Field_Object2D_Desc* desc, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor for the mesh variant of Field::Object2D: installs the mesh-node vtable, resets the 0xFFFF handle and initialises the attached mesh/scene-node slot.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_DtorVariant
functions.summary: Variant destructor for the same 2D field-object class: installs the given vtable plus the secondary one 0xd4 bytes later, destroys the embedded drawable at +0x2cc and frees the instance.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_BindLayoutAnimation
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Screen_BindLayoutAnimation(Ui_Screen* self, int layoutId, int arg3)
functions.summary: Registers a (table, context) pair with the Ui core singleton: calls 0x00707C1C(core+0x848, 0x007BFBD4, self->f_20C) and then rebinds core+0x844 to core+0x84C.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenFade_Update
functions.summary: Advances a screen fade/blend: counts the progress value up to the duration, lerps three RGB triples (start->end colours for the three screen regions) by the resulting 0..1 factor and hands the factor to the blend routine. When the record is in 'cycle' mode (+0x5c == 4) it first counts down a hold timer and switches to the next of four colour sets from a table.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_ComputeViewTransform
functions.signature: void maybe_Camera_ComputeViewTransform(float* out, CameraParams* mode, float* src, float* target)
functions.summary: Builds a camera view/orbit transform: normalises the look direction, derives yaw/pitch with acos/cos/sin, rotates the offset by the resulting quaternion, stores the four orientation components at mode+0x44..+0x50 and writes the rotated eye position into out.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ScreenFade_ApplyPreset
functions.summary: Applies one of the four screen-fade presets: copies the six preset floats into the fade state (+0x1C position, +0x34/+0x3C limits, +0x40/+0x58 timing), seeds the mode bytes, and converts preset[3] into the signed orientation angle stored at +0x38.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_CreateFromDesc
functions.signature: UiWidget* Ui_Widget_CreateFromDesc(UiWidget* self, u32 owner, u32 desc)
functions.summary: Creates a UI widget from a descriptor: gets the descriptor's resource size, allocates the named widget subclass (0x438 bytes) and initialises it with the owner and descriptor.

functions.name: Ui_DescWidget_DeleteDtor
functions.signature: void Ui_DescWidget_DeleteDtor(UiWidget* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the descriptor-created widget: installs vtable 0x0076DCF0, releases the managed child at self+8 through the UI context and frees the widget.

functions.name: Menu_HorseRace_InitUi
functions.summary: Builds the horse-racing menu screen: looks up the BFLYT panes 'racing', 'position', 'position2', 'arrow_right', 'arrow_left', the four 'plate_dN' widgets and the course masks, binds them into the screen's animation objects, hides the arrow panes and the mask panes for the courses that are not active, and copies the plate frame rectangles.

functions.name: Menu_HorseRace_UpdateCourseArrows
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the course direction arrows: reads the currently selected course from the race state (work->f_80->f_130->f_75) and shows either the right or the left arrow pane while hiding the other, then advances the plate animation.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_UpdateChildren
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a composite screen: runs the screen callback at self->f_98->f_2C, updates each of the three optional child blocks at +0x148/+0x1A4/+0x1FC when its enable byte is set, then drives the trailing slot-grid cross-fade at +0x24C.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_SetFlagRecursive
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_SetFlagRecursive(Ui_Widget* self, Ui_Widget* widget, int flag)
functions.summary: Sets or clears bit 0 of a widget's flag byte and applies the same flag to every child in its intrusive child list, recursively.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_UpdateFourChildTransforms
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_UpdateFourChildTransforms(UiLayout* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Runs the generic layout update and then updates four child transform blocks at +0x138, +0x19C, +0x1F4 and +0x140.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_BindCallbacks
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Widget_BindCallbacks(UiWidget* self, UiWidgetHost* host, u32 arg3, u32 forwarded)
functions.summary: Links the widget into two of its host's intrusive lists: the descriptor at 0x0072B318 is inserted at host+0x114 into the node at self+0x9AC, and the one at 0x0072B34C at host+0x98 into self+0x960.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CreatePartsB
functions.summary: Creates the remaining message-window parts: base 0x001D8B6C, vtable 0x76DD10, three intrusive lists and three anim-ref lists, then an 0x0C x 4 array. Called while the message window creates its parts.

functions.name: Menu_HorseRace_DeletingDtor
functions.signature: void Menu_HorseRace_DeletingDtor(MenuHorseRace* self, void* vtable, void* owner)
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the horse-racing menu screen: installs vtable 0x0076DD10, re-links the embedded list heads, releases the layout references of the panel chain, destroys the trailing sub-object and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_BuildTwoChildren
functions.summary: Builds two child widgets for a layout: initialises two transform holders, fetches two child objects (0x0061BD90), attaches their panes and adds them to the layout's 6-element array.

functions.name: Ui_TimerDisplay_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the timer/countdown display: base 0x001D8B6C, vtable 0x76DD60 (window layout methods), then a digit widget (0x003A5718) with vtable 0x75F928 (Ui_TimerDisplay_InitDigitPanes) and an 0x9C x 6 array.

functions.name: Ui_TimerDisplay_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for the Ui timer-display widget: runs Ui_TimerDisplay's own destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a large UI screen: stamps the vtable, releases the embedded layout references and animation lists, destroys the 0x5C/0xFC/0x3B8/0x9C member arrays, tears down four embedded sub-objects (including 0x0036813C) and the base object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Row_SetCurrentChild
functions.summary: Marks one child of a seven-pane row as current: maps the row through the table at (ctx+0x80)+0x10 with 0x633894/0x6338A8 and sets/clears bit 0 of f_44 on each of the seven children at self+0x5C.

functions.name: Ui_ColorSelectWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_ColorSelectWindow_InitPanes(UiWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 unusedA, u32 unusedB, u32 unusedC)
functions.summary: Pane initialiser for the recolouring window: a 'txt_name' label, four 'numN' value labels, the seven colour swatches (color_red/green/yellow/blue/white/black/pink) and four directional cursors (down_out, up_in, up_out, down_in).

functions.name: Ui_ColorSelectWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the colour-selection window: Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x76DDD4 (Ui_ColorSelectWindow_InitPanes) and builds a 4-element array of 0x50-byte rows.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorWithArray50
functions.summary: Destructor that first destroys the 0x50-byte-stride array at +0x78 (20 elements, 4-byte stride destroy), then chains to the Ui_Object base destructor and frees the instance.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorWithArray50NoFree
functions.summary: Same as 0x00411EE8 but used when the object lives inside a larger allocation: it destroys the array and chains to the base destructor without freeing the memory.

functions.name: maybe_Container_IntrusiveListCtor64
functions.summary: Initialises four self-referential circular list heads at +0..+0xC, zeroes the two u16 fields at +0x10/+0x12 and constructs 64 nodes of 0x10 bytes at +0x14 with element ctor 0x00411F5C.

functions.name: Str_DisposeInline
functions.summary: Disposes an inline std::string-like buffer when its allocated flag at +0x10 is set and returns the same pointer, so it can be used as an in-place destructor expression.

functions.name: Ui_TextFormat_SetMemberNameAndValue
functions.summary: Sets message argument slots 2 and 8 from the member behind self->f_208: slot 2 gets the padded name ('%ls', +0xCA) and slot 8 gets '%d' of the u8 at member+0xD8, both formatted into the slots' inline buffers (*0x007AC834 + 0x218 / + 0x848).

functions.name: Ui_TxtOnlyWindow_InitPanesB
functions.summary: Second single-pane window: binds only the pane named 'txt'.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_WorkerThread
functions.summary: Icon-cache service thread: locks the semaphore/monitor, opens the icon cache, loads pages, decodes icons into the shared buffer, handles job flags 1..0x40 and releases the service on shutdown.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_StartThread
functions.summary: Ten-byte thunk that starts the icon-cache worker (calls 0x004121B4 with the same argument).

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the Ui icon-cache object: the real teardown is the out-of-line vtable slot 0 (0x5646EC), so the body is only the free call.

functions.name: Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanesB
functions.summary: Alternative gauge-window pane setup: locates the 'base_dummy' and 'flash_dummy' placeholder panes, walks each one's child list to find the real base/flash object, stores them at +0x4C/+0x50 and then binds and shows the 'normal' pane.

functions.name: Ui_Window_CtorWithThreeParts
functions.summary: Constructor of a UI window that owns three consecutive 0x50-byte animation-ref sub-objects (+0x54/+0xA4/+0xF4): installs vtable 0x0076DE64, clears the two fields at +0x4C/+0x50 and constructs the three parts.

functions.name: Ui_GaugeWindow_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the gauge-window variant whose pane initialiser is Ui_GaugeWindow_InitPanesB: installs vtable 0x0076DE64, releases the layout references at +0xF4, +0xA4 and +0x54, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_GaugeWindow_DtorB
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor twin of 0x00412B0C: installs vtable 0x0076DE64, releases the layout references at +0xF4, +0xA4 and +0x54 and tail-calls the UI base destructor.

functions.name: maybe_Str_WStringInitFromLiteral
functions.signature: void maybe_Str_WStringInitFromLiteral(void* out, const unsigned short* text)
functions.summary: Prologue of a wide-string temporary: writes the capacity tag 1 and the small-string size 3 into the header and then tail-calls the wide strlen helper 0x00100b74 to measure the source.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_RequestIcon
functions.signature: void Ui_IconCache_RequestIcon(IconRequest* out, u32 jobId, IconParams* params)
functions.summary: Submits an icon-load request: resolves the icon table entries for params->f_2c/f_30, marks the request pending and wakes the icon thread via 0x00100B74.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_PropagateFlag
functions.summary: Takes the byte produced by 0x0029E488 (read with the owning actor self->f_28) and, if the actor's state object at +0xB8 exists, stores it into that object's +0x128. Same body as 0x003E41D4 and 0x003ADB74.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_SnapshotActorPose
functions.summary: Copies the owning actor's ten-word pose block (actor+0x2A0..+0x2C0) into the action's own cache at self+0x34..+0x54, zeroes the blend value at +0x30 and clears the running flag at +0x2C.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_ApplyCurvePositionC
functions.summary: Third copy of the curve-position step: evaluates the curve at self+0x58 with Math_Curve_EvaluatePoint and applies the resulting point through 0x005F3ADC.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ComputeBillboardTransform
functions.summary: Builds the screen-facing transform of an Actor2D drawable: after the 0.5 s hold it reads two points of the owner model, converts the animation frame to float, builds the basis with 0x0017C3C0 and stores the nine rotation/scale floats at self+0x58..0x78; the other branch plays SE 0x9D and sends command 10 when the hold expires.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_CreateTurnState
functions.summary: Constructor of the turn-toward action state: installs vtable 0x76DEC8, sets opcode 2, seeds the 0xFF/0xFFFF sentinels and builds the embedded transform; returns base-0x58.

functions.name: Monster_ReadNameFields
functions.summary: Reads two 16-byte fixed-string records (offsets +0x40 and +0x38) from the monster table entry 0x0063D6B8(monsterId) into the model's name/description fields using std_FixedString15_Ctor.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0 of vtable 0x0076DF00) of a battle-action class: runs the 0x00294BB8 base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_TurnStart
functions.summary: Start handler (slot 1 of vtable 0x0076DF34) of the turn action: runs the shared action init 0x00372B00 and clears the running flag at +0xE4.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_TurnTowardTarget
functions.summary: Turn-toward action: selects the 'attract' animation for the action, converts the remaining turn angle at 0.03 rad/frame into the actor's rotation (0x63D6B8), tracks the target rotation and ends the action when the angle is reached.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_Update_3
functions.summary: Per-frame action update: copies the action's two eight-word transform blocks into the actor's two render nodes (actor->f_244[self->f_D8] and actor->f_160, fields +0x5F4..+0x620), releases the actor's effect slots and then calls actor vtable +0x88.

functions.name: Monster_ActionSet_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a monster behaviour parameter set: builds on Monster_MoveActionCtor, installs vtable 0x0076DF30 and fills the movement/steering parameters (seven floats, id 0x4A1, a 10-frame timer and the active flag) with defaults.

functions.name: maybe_Object_DeletingDtorWithVtableC
functions.summary: Third copy of the shared scalar deleting destructor: installs the vtable passed in, runs the shared empty base destructor 0x00294C88 and frees the object through the virtual deleter 0x0010F6CC. Same body as 0x001E160C and 0x001E1B70.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_PlayStateAnim_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the field-actor action that plays a state animation (its first virtual is Field_ActorAction_PlayStateAnim).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Action_ApplyAnimResource
functions.summary: Lazily builds a 0xA24-byte shared animation-resource buffer, resolves its sub-block with 0x0063D6B8(buf,4) and pushes the block at +0x38 into the actor through virtual +0x84 (twice, with +0x88 between) so the animation restarts.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_AnimResource_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0 of vtable 0x0076DFA0) of the class whose other virtual is the animation-resource applier 0x00413AA4: runs the 0x00193E44 base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_StepBase_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the step/movement action base class: runs the base destructor (0x00294C88) and frees the object. Its vtable slot 0 shares the table with Field_ActorAction_BeginStep/ClampDirection/MoveAlongVector.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_BeginStep
functions.summary: Starts the 'step' behaviour: calls the shared step entry (0x372Bxx, maybe_Field_Actor_BeginStep), triggers actor vtable +0x68 and stores the walk pair (speed*0.3333, 0x3FEEEEEF = 1.867) into +0x54/+0x58.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_UpdateMoveDirection
functions.summary: Computes field actor movement direction for the current frame from target anchor and obstacle avoidance raycasts.

functions.name: Field_Actor_MoveAlongVector
functions.summary: Applies a movement vector to the actor: if the vector is non-zero it normalizes the actor's forward axis (or the vector when misaligned), writes the transform and advances the model position by speed; returns 1 when moved.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_NarrowRun
functions.summary: Initialises the 'Narrow_Run' actor action: installs the action vtable, stores the run animation name, the walk/run speed pair (0.3333/1.867) and the parameter block, then starts the timers.

functions.name: Field_ActorBehaviour_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the actor behaviour object that drives step direction: its vtable exposes BeginStep, EndBehaviour, UpdateBehaviour, ClampDirection and MoveAlongVector.

functions.name: Field_Npc_UpdateModelFromTable

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ObjectDesc_CtorA
functions.summary: Constructor of a Gfx_ObjectDesc subclass: obtains the descriptor through Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init, installs vtable 0x0076E04C and stores the caller's word in descriptor slot +0x28.

functions.name: Field_Npc_DeletingDtor_2
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the field-NPC class: runs the 0x193E44 base destructor and frees the object.

functions.summary: Decides which way the actor has to turn to face a target: if the target is close enough it normalises the direction, converts the angular tolerance from degrees to radians and sets the "turn left" (bit 0) or "turn right" (bit 2) flag on the actor.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_Ctor_2
functions.signature: void* Field_ActorAction_Ctor_2(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_DeletingDtor_2
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0 of vtable 0x0076E084) of an actor-action class whose slot 6 is Field_ActorAction_UpdateTurnDirection: runs the 0x00193E44 base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Gfx_ObjectDesc_CtorB

functions.name: maybe_Field_ActorMove_DeletingDtorB_2
functions.summary: Second deleting destructor in the same group: vtable 0x0076E0B8, whose slots 1-3 (0x004145CC/0x004145D4/0x004145D0) are all unnamed, runs the 0x00193E44 base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Math_RandMod4
functions.summary: Returns a random number in 0..3 from the game RNG: draws func_0051B1FC(work+0x98, 0x7fffffff) and takes the remainder modulo 4.

functions.name: Casino_Poker_DealHandA
functions.summary: Deals one five-card poker hand: shuffles the 13-entry suit/rank table and the 4-entry aux table, moves deck cards into the five hand slots (the first one from a random deck position, the rest via the slot exchange helper), then shuffles the hand window and rotates the visible slots.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandB
functions.summary: Poker deal variant B: shuffles the rank (13) and suit (4) decks, then swaps the five hand slots with the cards found at (rank f_82, suits f_8F..f_93), i.e. a fixed five-card pattern, and finally calls Casino_Poker_DealAndEvaluate.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandC
functions.summary: Poker deal variant C: shuffles the 13-card deck and the 4-card page list, exchanges the five hand slots with random deck positions, then rolls the rank chance and either swaps the last slot or rotates the hand slots.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandD
functions.summary: Poker deal variant D: after shuffling both decks, a Casino_Poker_RollHandRankChance roll decides whether the first three cards are dealt from the deck top or from a random position; the remaining slots are dealt from fixed deck positions, the hand is rotated with Casino_Poker_RotateHandSlots and the hand is evaluated.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandE
functions.summary: Poker deal variant E: three fixed deck exchanges, a second deck-4 shuffle, seven random page exchanges, then the rank-chance roll decides whether the last slot is swapped with a random hand position; ends with the shared hand rotation.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_SwapTenSlots
functions.summary: Poker deal variant: reshuffles the rank order (Casino_Poker_ShuffleDeck13) and the suit order (Casino_Poker_ShuffleDeck4), then for ten (rank,suit) pairs looks the deck entry up with func_00416638 and swaps it into the hand slots two bytes at a time.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_RotateHandSlots
functions.summary: Reorders the dealt poker hand: shuffles the two ten-slot halves, swaps that many 2-byte slots between the halves and shuffles the first half again. The swap count comes from a game-RNG roll whose result Ghidra lost (extraout_r1).

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandF
functions.summary: Poker deal variant F: shuffles both decks, performs a random rotation of five rank entries (game RNG % 9, then a modulo-5 pass) and applies the same fixed five-card swap as the other variants before calling Casino_Poker_DealAndEvaluate.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandG
functions.summary: Poker deal variant G: rolls 1..3 from the game RNG and swaps the cards (roll, ranks 10..13) into hand slots f_17.., then continues with the shared evaluate tail.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_DealHandH
functions.summary: Poker deal variant H: no shuffle; swaps a scripted straight/royal-flush-style set (ranks 10, 11, 12, 13 and ace of suit 0) into the five hand slots, then calls Casino_Poker_DealAndEvaluate.

functions.name: Casino_Poker_DealAndEvaluate
functions.summary: Deals a hand and evaluates it: optionally re-rolls when the 'lucky' percentage check fires, shuffles the deck window at +0x17, copies five cards into the visible hand at +8, runs the hand evaluator (0x416D10) and stores the resulting hand rank at +0x81. Returns a pointer to the hand cards.

functions.name: Casino_Poker_ReplaceCards
functions.summary: Redraw step: for every card whose hold flag is clear it swaps the card with the corresponding card from the second half of the deck window, then copies the five cards into the visible hand, re-evaluates the hand and stores the new rank.

functions.name: Casino_Poker_DealHandWithJokers
functions.summary: Largest deal variant: shuffles the deck, exchanges five slots keyed by the fixed index f_8f, then deals a sixth card whose colour comes from a three-entry table at +0x90 and whose rank is a modulo-13 roll + 1 - i.e. it builds a hand that can contain jokers/wildcards.

functions.name: Casino_Poker_EvaluateHand
functions.summary: Poker hand evaluator: counts how many of the five cards carry each rank (1..13), detects five of a kind / straights / flushes including joker-wildcards and returns a hand category index (2..9, 0..1 for partial matches, 0xff when the hand is invalid).

functions.name: maybe_Container_FixedArrayCtor5
functions.summary: Constructor of a small fixed container: clears the two header words and default-constructs the inline five-element array of 2-byte entries through std_ConstructArray with element ctor 0x005e94e0.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_PlayAnimObject
functions.summary: Replaces the panel's current clip: releases the old one, loads animId with Ui_PlayAnimByName into self->f_4C and starts it through +0x54.

functions.name: Ui_Panel_PlayAnimFromTable

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Poker_MatchCardFlags
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Casino_Poker_MatchCardFlags(u32* cards, u32 hand, u32 b)
functions.summary: Card-flag scan used by the poker hand evaluator: compares a card index against two expected values and writes the five per-card 1/0 flags, returning 1/2/0 (or 0xFF when an inner compare fails).

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorTrivialB_2

functions.name: maybe_Field_SpriteActor_RunWalk_DeletingDtor

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_SetThreeRowNumbers

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_AppendEntryB

functions.signature: void Ui_ScoreCheckWindow_InitPanes(UiWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AllocWidget_DeleteDtor_vt780820

functions.name: Os_FindObjectByHandle

functions.name: maybe_Monster_Model_StartSubTween
functions.summary: Starts a tween on the model sub-node (self->f_14 resolved through virtual +0x14) towards target float using tween helper 0x0031F214.

functions.name: Monster_Model_ApplyScreenOffset
