functions.summary: Battle animation state machine: state 1 delegates to the layout rebuild (0x428738), state 0x27 plays the 'damaged' voice/SE (0xdf) for every unit, and state 0x34 cross-links unit 0 and unit 1 so their animations stay in sync.

functions.name: Battle_UpdatePartyWidgets
functions.summary: Pushes the current party state into the battle UI widgets: copies every unit pointer into the layout record, copies each widget's transform into its 3x3 rotation + translation block, applies the 0.9 scale to the rotation, starts the 'appear' animation for each visible unit and finally writes the resulting count into the widget list.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_AppendEntry
functions.signature: void Field_ActorActionSeq_AppendEntry(BattleUi* self, u32 arg2, int unitIndex)
functions.summary: Appends a new entry to the action sequence: for the special states (0/1) it first runs the per-unit build/cleanup handlers, then clears the entry at the current cursor, stores the unit index and its UI object and advances the cursor (capped at 12).

functions.name: Battle_Ui_BuildEntryFromUnitsA
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_BuildEntryFromUnitsA(BattleUi* self, int unit, u16 id, u8 flags)
functions.summary: Fills the current action-sequence entry from the first eight unit pointers: collects them into a local array, stores the unit index in the entry at self[self[0x877]*0x19+0x722], builds the row geometry (Text_CalcRowGeometry) and applies the attachment set.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_FlushPending
functions.summary: Scans 10 battle unit action slots for state 5, retrieves the active unit via vtable slot +0x60, and flushes pending command execution.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_ChooseDamageNumberFont
functions.summary: Chooses one of five ids for the battle HUD: it popcounts the 31-bit mask at +0x16B0 and returns 0xE89 for 1-2 set bits or 0xEBC for 3+, unless the battle-mode byte (work+0x5C+0x4244) and the per-unit byte +0x16BD select 0xF54, 0xF51 or 0xF50.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_NotifyUnitHighlight
functions.summary: Sets the battle context highlight flags for up to four scripted unit slots when their stored unit id matches the acting unit and unit 0 is present. Slot 8 of the 9-slot battle UI vtable 0x76C6xx.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_CloseCommandMenu
functions.summary: Closes the battle command menu and restores the underlying unit widgets: it removes the command window's list entries, walks the target lists at +0x4264 and the four unit quadrants at +0x4298, hides the widgets that no longer belong to a live unit, clears the 'menu open' flags and re-arms the fade timer.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RollActiveSlotIndex
functions.summary: Rolls a random index in [0, count-1] over the battle work array at +0x4218, where count is the number of non-zero entries in the 16-word table at self->f_70. The result is discarded by the caller.

functions.name: Battle_PushActorMessage5D
functions.summary: Pushes battle message id 0x5D for the actor returned by vtable+0x48 and sets self+0x2202 to 1.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_BuildEntryFromUnitsB
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_BuildEntryFromUnitsB(BattleUi* self, int unit, u16 id, u8 flags)
functions.summary: Second variant of the entry builder 0x00424CA8: identical eight-pointer collect loop and entry index, but fills the entry through Battle_MonsterUi_CalcStatValue instead of Text_CalcRowGeometry. Called from maybe_Battle_PushDamageActionEntry.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_AllUnitsReady
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the battle can advance: it collects a bitmask of the unit kinds that report 'ready' and compares it with the required mask (or, in the other mode, waits until every unit is ready).

functions.name: Battle_SpawnUnitModel
functions.summary: Spawns the model/effect for one battle unit: looks the model definition up by kind, applies the record's scale, creates the actor and the attach slot, or, when the actor already exists, registers it in the unit table (+0x852, 13 entries) and pushes a packet to the renderer.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_PlayResultSound
functions.summary: Plays the battle-result jingle: counts the result entries with a positive value, compares the count with the data-manager thresholds f_14D/f_14E/f_14F and plays sound effect 0xE59, 0xE5B or 0xE5D through Sound_PlaySeById; when there is exactly one entry it instead calls vtable+0xF0 with the copied result row.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_ResetMenuState
functions.summary: Counterpart of 0x00425048: clears the command window state, hides the target lists and the four unit quadrants, resets the fade timer and the cursor, and restores the 'menu closed' flags.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_UpdateUnitExpression
functions.summary: Applies the current facial expression to units 1..3: resolves each unit's model through the battle-unit table and applies its expression byte with func_00223084.

functions.name: Battle_SpawnUnitEffect
functions.summary: Second spawn path for a battle unit (effect/model variant): resolves the unit's actor from the battle-actor table, scales the record's size by the party scale and registers the actor with the attach-slot system (0x398744/0x39881C).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_CloseCommandMenuB
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_CloseCommandMenuB(BattleUi* self, u32 arg2, u32 b)
functions.summary: Mis-bounded copy of the 'close command menu' body that starts at a label inside another function.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_FinishUnitSelection
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_FinishUnitSelection(BattleScene* self, int actionId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Walks the formation unit lists and clears pending flags on units without a matching action (decode starts mid-function).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ShowCommandListEntry
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_ShowCommandListEntry(BattleScene* self, int entryIndex, int visible)
functions.summary: Shows or hides one row of a battle list: hiding row N (or the 0xFF 'none' row) clears the visible flag of the actor whose id sits at self[N*2+0x498] in the battle actor list, while showing the special row 4 either forwards to the window's virtual +0x60 or to the shared actor action handler depending on the state byte +0x168D.

functions.name: Battle_PushActionEntry
functions.signature: void Battle_PushActionEntry(BattleScene* self, u16 actionKind, int actionId)
functions.summary: Appends one unit-action entry to the 12-slot action queue at self+0x70C (stride 0x64=25 words): clears the slot, stores the action id, builds the entry for the unit picked by vtable+0x60, optionally queues the actor action sequence and sound, then advances self->f_877 (wrapping at 12).

functions.name: Battle_UpdateUnitTransform
functions.summary: Per-frame battle unit transform pass: for four formation slots it copies the pose/orientation block (8 words at +0x88..+0xA4) into the render transform block (+0x240..+0x268), recomputes the quaternion terms, then updates every unit's model equipment/state via vtable+0x40/+0x48 and finishes by retiring the command window.

functions.name: Battle_UpdateActionSoundCues
functions.summary: Plays the per-action sound cues of one battle unit: picks the cue table for the unit's category (0/1/2 at +0x360/+0x3A0/+0x3E0), and when the elapsed time passes the next cue's timestamp starts that SE and advances the 8-entry cursor at +0x21FC.

functions.name: Battle_PrepareUnitListUi
functions.summary: Prepares the battle UI's unit lists for the current action: hides the shared and four formation lists, fills the command window's list from the live actors, and re-shows only the lists matching the action mode (all formations for mode 5, one for modes 1/2), finishing with the camera alpha reset.

functions.name: Battle_PushDamageActionEntry
functions.summary: State-0 variant of the battle action-entry push: computes the effective power for the unit, clears the entry at the sequence cursor (self[0x877], stride 0x19 dwords at +0x70C), stores the unit and its UI object, queues the action message and spawns the damage-number popups.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_PushUnitKindMessage
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_PushUnitKindMessage(BattleUi* self, BattleUnit* unit, int kind)
functions.summary: Validates the unit through vtable+0x18, calls unit vtable+0x130(kind), then pushes battle message 0x56 for kind 0 or 0x57 for kind 1.

functions.name: Battle_IsUnitSelectable
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the player may pick this battle unit as a target/actor: it is not flagged dead at +0x2201, its id at +0x125C is not already present in the battle work bitset at +0x29F14, and the global message/menu lock +0x4251 is clear; otherwise 0.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UpdateConditionIcons
functions.summary: Counts the non-zero entries of the 32-slot array at self+0x1BAC and, when one of the two condition masks at +0x169E/+0x16A0 is set, re-spawns the model-attached popup text for index 0 or 1.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_UpdatePresenceFlag
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Actor_UpdatePresenceFlag(FieldActor* actor, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Scans the actor's child objects (vtable +0x48/+0xD8 and, for '/' actors, +0x98 < 0x40) and stores whether any of them keeps the actor active in the byte at actor+0x2201; when none does it clears the per-save flag through 0x006138D4.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_PushKindMessage
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_PushKindMessage(BattleUi* self, int kind, PopupOwner* owner)
functions.summary: For kind 2 or 3 only, pushes a battle message for the owner using the message id (+0x4E) of data-table row 0x5D or 0x5C respectively; other kinds do nothing.

functions.name: Battle_ShowMonsterPairPopup
functions.summary: Handles the 'monster joined/recruited' popup: resolves the acting unit and its monster pair ids (+0xCA/+0xCC), marks the pair as seen in the game work, spawns the monster popup and a balloon, or plays the 'already seen' popup.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_UpdateActionPopupForUnit
functions.summary: Handles the popup for one unit action: resolves the acting unit (0x00426D9C), checks the monster table type, computes row visibility with Text_ApplyRowVisibility, and spawns either the damage or the status popup descriptor.

functions.name: Battle_CleanupUnitActors
functions.summary: Battle teardown: when the battle UI flag is set, walks every unit, resolves its actor through the handle table and stops/detaches the actor's effect, model and script objects, then clears the party slot type flags.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_StopUnitMotion
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_StopUnitMotion(u32 unitIndex, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Stops the presentation of the actor bound to a battle unit: for sprite-set system id 0x572 it hides the effect nodes, otherwise it calls 0x005F9110 with mode 1; then clears the busy byte at +0x35 and refreshes the sprite-set preset.

functions.name: Battle_RefreshUnitTextSlots
functions.signature: void Battle_RefreshUnitTextSlots(BattleScene * self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Enables or disables the combat-text slot of every battle unit and refreshes each unit's party-member record: resets and re-arms the glyph slot at +0x71C while the battle 'show text' flag is set, copies the HP/MP display flags into the member record, and finally shows or hides the units' UI objects according to the battle UI mode and the force-refresh global.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ResetUnitUi
functions.summary: Resets the battle unit UI: iterates the scene's units (vtable +0x48/+0x60) and calls each unit's vtable slot +0x50 with (1,0), with Ui_GlyphSlot_Reset and Battle_UpdateConditionIcons in the callee set; called from the battle UI state machine and the field action-sequence update.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_CreateUnitNameLabel
functions.summary: Prepares unit name string buffer and spawns 2D nameplate effect node for a battle unit.

functions.name: Battle_UnitObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Base constructor of the battle unit/model object: base 0x0020002C, installs vtable 0x76EE58 (maybe_Battle_CleanupUnitActors), initialises the text-line cache at +0x470 and the embedded list at +0x498.

functions.name: Field_ActorActionSeq_InitArray
functions.summary: Allocates and zero-initialises the array of action-sequence entries (stride 0x64) whose per-entry layout matches Field_ActorActionSeq_ClearEntry.

functions.name: Battle_UnitObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Destructor that immediately follows Battle_UnitObject_Ctor, i.e. the unit object's own destructor: restores the vtable, destroys the embedded base object through its virtual and frees the unit.

functions.name: Battle_PlayPartyMemberSe
functions.summary: Updates the eight battle party-member slots: either re-binds each slot's model animations and plays the member SE at f_18, or walks the four formation lists, clears the per-unit marker byte and plays the SE at f_16.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_AdvanceAnimSequence
functions.summary: Advances the current animation-sequence step for the main unit and its eight sub-parts: looks the step table up by unit id (0x0063F60C), applies the step's byte parameter through virtual +0x64 and moves to the next step, playing the party-member SE when a sequence ends.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_SetPosition
functions.summary: Stores the unit model's world position and pushes it to the model node and to all four child part objects.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_PlayAnimSe
functions.signature: void Battle_UnitModel_PlayAnimSe(BattleUnitModel* self, int arg2, u32* out)
functions.summary: Finds the animation record for the unit's current action (table 0x006400B4, stride 0x14) and plays its sound id via Sound_PlaySeById; on the first frame also triggers the action's secondary SE.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_MoveBy
functions.summary: Moves the unit model by a screen/field delta: adds the offset to the stored position and forwards the delta to all four part objects.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_AssignHandleA
functions.summary: Reference-counted handle assignment for the battle unit model field at +0x13C: releases the old generation, adds a reference to the new handle and stores it.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_Update
functions.signature: void Battle_UnitModel_Update(BattleUnitModel* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a battle unit model: updates animation channels, model motion state, the action clock (self[0x37]) and then runs the part and SE updates.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_UpdateParts
functions.summary: Updates the four sub-model parts of a battle unit: drives their motion state, clamps their blend weights to 0/0xFF and applies the animation record matching the current action/frame through virtual +0x44.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_SetAlpha
functions.summary: Copies the unit's alpha/transparency byte (+0xE9) into the model node and applies it to all four part objects.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_AssignHandleB
functions.summary: Same reference-counted handle assignment as 0x0042A3B4 but for the battle unit model field at +0x138.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_StartTween
functions.summary: Starts the model's part tween: asks the model for its current node (virtual +0x14), marks the tween as running at +0x105, clears +0x107 and +0x106 and kicks the node tween starter 0x0031F214 on the sub-block at +0x3B.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_TriggerAnimRecords
functions.signature: void Battle_UnitModel_TriggerAnimRecords(BattleUnitModel* self, int oldId, int newId)
functions.summary: When the unit's animation/action id changes, scans the four sub-parts and dispatches the matching animation record (table 0x006400B4, stride 0x14) to each part via virtual +0x44.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_ResetTween
functions.summary: Resets the model's tween state to its defaults: speed 1.0f, countdown 10, running flag set and the secondary flag cleared, after asking the model for its current node.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_FinishTween
functions.summary: Marks the current tween as finished: sets the done byte at node+0x6D, sets self+0x43 and clears the running byte at +0x10D - the exact inverse of StartTween's flag writes.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SceneNode_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a small battle-scene node: installs vtable 0x76EF7C, sets three (id=0xFFFF, payload=0) pairs at +0x128..+0x136, a float 256.0 at +0x130/+0x134 and flag bytes +0x141..+0x143 = 0/1/0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DeletingDtor_vt7743A0
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a Ui widget-derived class: installs the caller's vtable, releases the two pack handles at +0x4F/-4, restores the base Ui_AllocWidget vtable 0x7743A0 on the embedded widget at -0x134, releases its cached model, runs Gfx_SceneNode_DtorBase and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_ShowAttackPopup
functions.summary: Battle actor step at state 0xD3A: when the actor row is not visible it builds a popup from status ids 0x5E/0x5F (and more branches below), otherwise it waits; the exact popup content is split across many named callbacks.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_DeletingDtorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for battle actor action class (vtable 0x76F03C slot 0), invoking base destructor 0x00200220 and operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_WaitStep
functions.summary: Battle actor step at state 0xC14: immediately advances to 0xC16, then for stage 2 sets status 0x117 on the actor, pushes the data-row message id and waits for the actor queue at stage 0x10.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for battle actor action class variant (vtable 0x76F150 slot 0), invoking base destructor 0x00200220 and operator delete.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_ApplyAddedState
functions.summary: Applies the state/condition added by a battle actor action: resolves the two state ids from the action and adds them to the target unit through the battle state API.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_SelectAnimation
functions.summary: Chooses and plays the actor animation for a battle actor action: reads the action record, picks animation 5 or 6 depending on the command result and starts it; returns 1 when nothing needs to play.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_PlayActionSe
functions.signature: void Battle_ActorAction_PlayActionSe(BattleActorAction* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Looks up the current monster/action record (0x0063FC70) and, if it defines a sound id at +2, flags the unit and plays that SE.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_ShowNamePopup
functions.summary: Looks up the actor's action record, spawns the model-actor popup (name/HP), plays the SE stored in the record at +0xA and finishes the action step. Returns the done flag.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_SpawnEffects
functions.summary: Spawns the one or two attached effects of the current battle actor action and stores their handles in the actor (+0x4E3/+0x4E4); returns 1 once the effects exist. Used for actions that have an effect on the caster and one on the target.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_Complete
functions.summary: Completion step of a battle actor action: sets the done flag at +0xD2, spawns the model popup, plays the action SE and exits; used as the shared tail of several action elements.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_ApplyMonsterTransform
functions.summary: Prepares a monster unit's transform before an action: reads the monster size data (0x0063FA60/0x0063FC70), computes scale and facing offset, optionally arms a balloon, applies the transform and restores the animation id.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_MoveAndSpawnEffect
functions.summary: Battle actor action that moves actors along the action path (FieldParty_MoveActorTowardTarget), spawns up to two effects and shows two popups, e.g. a monster charge or a breath attack.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_ShowDamage
functions.summary: Shows the damage/heal result of a battle actor action: builds the actor row message (Battle_Message_BuildActorRowBig), spawns the number list and actor list popups, plays the hit SE and updates the row state.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_SpawnThreeEffects
functions.summary: Spawns the effect set of a battle actor action (three FindOrCreateInstance effects) after playing the action's SE, and initialises the action's effect state from the shared defaults table.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_Sequence
functions.signature: u32* maybe_Battle_ActorAction_Sequence(void* self, void* action, void* ctx, void* out)
functions.summary: Long multi-stage battle actor action: plays the record's SE cues (offsets 0x6/0x10/0x12), moves the actor toward its target, spawns popups/effects per record id and returns a pointer into the action data.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_PopupStep
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_ActorAction_PopupStep(BattleActor* self, u32 popup, u32 popup2, u32 popup3)
functions.summary: Small actor-action step that spawns the model-actor popup from the stack packet and returns; used as a sub-step of the longer action sequences.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_SyncCameraParam
functions.summary: Vtable slot 12 method of battle actor action class: invokes virtual methods at +0x11C and +0x3C, calls 0x0066A244, and caches incoming float parameter from VFP register s0 at offset +0x1304.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_SetupFormationScale
functions.summary: Chooses the formation slot and computes the unit's scale/offset from the monster size values (f_260/f_261/f_278), setting the 'follow leader' flag and the derived step value.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_ShowNamePopupById
functions.summary: Looks up the actor's action record and shows its popup (id, model id, monster id), then waits for the UI; a second call from the menu window can cancel the actor's UI flag. Returns 0 (not a blocking step).

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_MoveToFormation
functions.summary: Moves a unit toward its formation position: computes distance from the monster size record, lets the party formation code push the actor (FieldParty_MoveActorTowardTarget) and returns 1 when the unit is close enough or the action ends.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_PlayStateSe
functions.signature: void Battle_ActorAction_PlayStateSe(BattleActorAction* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Plays the state-appropriate SE from the monster/action record (0x0063FC70), selecting byte +3, +9 or +4 depending on the unit's animation mode.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_SpawnAttachedEffects
functions.summary: Spawns the two effects attached to an actor's action record (ids at record+0x134/+0x136) at the actor's position and stores the handles at +0x4E3/+0x4E4; returns 1 when the effects were created.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_HandleDamageResult
functions.summary: One step of the battle actor's post-hit sequence: walks the action-step id (0x1899/0x18BA/0x18C9/0x18DB), spawns the matching model/damage popups, updates the drop-item and condition flags and finishes the weapon animation.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_HandleDamageResultB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_ActorAction_HandleDamageResultB(BattleActor* self, ActionStep* step, u32 action)
functions.summary: Thumb-mode duplicate of the post-hit step block at 0x004309A8: calls the action-step callback, then walks the same 0x1899/0x18BA/0x18C9/0x18DB ids and spawns the same popups.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateActionState
functions.summary: Per-frame action state machine for a battle unit model: consumes action-flag bits, spawns damage/status popups (0x003FBE4C / 0x003FF9AC), reacts to hits and advances the actor action (0x0043247C).

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateActionStateB
functions.summary: Variant action state machine for melee/weapon actions: same popup plumbing as 0x00430D24, but for unit id 0x1E2 it also finds a weapon target and calls Battle_ActorAction_FinishWeaponAnim. Returns whether the action is still running.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_SetModelVisibility
functions.summary: Applies the visibility mode to the actor's action model(s) and returns 0; used when a battle actor action hides/shows parts of the model during the animation.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateSubCommands
functions.signature: u32 Battle_ActorAction_UpdateSubCommands(BattleActor* self, u32 command, u32 command2, u32 command3)
functions.summary: Runs the three queued sub-commands of a battle actor action: for each non-empty slot it invokes the stored function object with the three arguments and, when it reports completion, resets the slot to the idle constant pair.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_UpdateHitSequence
functions.summary: Per-frame state machine of a battle actor action (states 0x1324..0x1386): clears the actor's hit flag, spawns message/damage popups at the Spine03 node, sets effect-part directions, plays the associated SEs and advances the linked effects.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateReaction
functions.summary: State machine for a battle actor's reaction (hit/stagger) animation: looks up the action record, walks the state at +0x62B, spawns the popup entries and plays the reaction animation until the done byte at +0x1386 is set.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_UpdateReactionB
functions.summary: Second battle reaction state machine: resolves the action row for the actor's action id (self+0x497), builds the popup packet and drives the state word self[0x623] to completion.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_UpdateReactionC
functions.summary: Battle actor state machine in self[0x623] from 0x1097; consumes flag bit 0 of the actor's +0x270.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateMotion
functions.summary: Moves a battle actor along its action's motion curve: interpolates the offset and rotation, applies the actor transform and returns 1 when the motion step has finished.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateSequence
functions.summary: Advance step of a battle actor action: iterates the action's sub-commands in a 0x5B8-byte scratch frame, executes each popup/effect/sound entry and advances the state at +0x623.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_FinishWeaponAnim
functions.summary: Finishes the weapon part of a battle actor attack: clears the 'weapon locator dirty' bit, calls Monster_Model_UpdateWeaponLocators, plays the weapon SE and removes the two attack icons 0x9A/0x9B from the actor's UI.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_DropItemStep
functions.summary: Sequential actor-action updater that executes the action's popup/SE commands, posts the drop-item message and advances the state at +0x623, returning the step result.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateAuraState
functions.summary: Drives the aura/glow state of a battle unit: manages its state word, spawns the aura popup and updates the aura effect (0x00401138) when the aura flag clears.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_UpdateAttackState
functions.summary: Large attack-resolution state machine for a battle unit: builds the actor message row (0x00493980), applies attachment slots, spawns balloons/number popups, plays action SEs and waits for the action sequence to finish.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateActionStateC
functions.summary: Variant of the battle action state machine for model type 0xDA (large monster): same popup/aura plumbing, then re-applies monster size and flags the unit as updated.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_SpawnImpactEffects
functions.summary: Impact branch of a battle actor action: places the hit locator pair, spawns impact effect instances and the damage popup, plays the hit SE and updates the monster size.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_UpdateCompositeA
functions.summary: Composite per-frame battle action update handler managing sound effects, locators, unit markers, and popup notifications.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_UpdateComposite
functions.summary: Composite actor-action updater that delegates to the damage (0x42D4D4) and sequence (0x42F104) steps and adds extra effect/anchor handling; the local return value is passed through unchanged.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_UpdateCompositeB
functions.summary: Probably the second composite actor-action updater, but the 1.7 KB no-caller variant is only distinguished by the +0x1385/+0x1386 return bytes.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_UpdateCompositeC
functions.summary: Large battle actor-action updater: builds the effect descriptor from the unit ids, spawns the effect and popups, then waits for both the effect and the actor animation before returning 1.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ActorAction_UpdateCompositeD
functions.summary: Composite actor-action updater (fourth variant): runs the action's sub-steps, stores the sub-index at +0x1308 and returns the second done flag at +0xD3.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_TurnAndMoveToFormation
functions.summary: Turns a unit toward its target and moves it to the formation position: uses the facing dot product with acos to decide whether to align, then walks toward the formation point until within range and plays the arrival SE.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_FinishMove
functions.summary: Completes a movement action: snaps the model position/rotation to the target, restores the model animation id and returns 1 once the movement SE has finished.

functions.name: Battle_ActorAction_ClearPendingTarget
functions.summary: Clears the action's pending-target state: resets the flag on the referenced target actor and invalidates the cached target index.

functions.name: Battle_ActorModel_UpdateWeaponLocators

functions.summary: Allocates a 0x28-byte timeline entry and inserts it at the start of the track, with its time span taken from the default length and the payload cleared.

functions.name: Container_IntrusiveList_InsertOrderedByFloat
functions.signature: void Container_IntrusiveList_InsertOrderedByFloat(void* self, void* node, float arg3, void* head)
functions.summary: Ordered insert into an intrusive doubly-linked list: walks the list at self+4 comparing each node's float at +0x1C against the new value and links the node before the first greater element using 0x1235A4.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_InsertRange
functions.signature: void Anim_TimeTrack_InsertRange(AnimTimeTrack* self, TimeRange* range, void* heap)
functions.summary: Inserts a new time range into the track, first shrinking the existing ranges that overlap the requested [start, start+length] window so the new range never overlaps them.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_PurgeAndRenumber
functions.summary: Housekeeping for the animation timeline list: drops every track whose owner object is gone or whose owner's vtable+0x18 reports 'finished', re-inserts the survivors into the live list ordered by their time field (+0x1C), and (unless the debug flag at +0x4201 is set) rewrites the sequential index at +0x18.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_ReserveRange
functions.signature: void Anim_TimeTrack_ReserveRange(AnimTimeTrack* self, TimeRange* range, void* heap)
functions.summary: Reserves a time range in the track: finds the first existing range that overlaps it and, depending on whether the overlap starts at the same time, either drops that range entirely or splits it around the new one.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_IsAlive
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the track with the given index still exists and its owner is alive (owner->vtable+0x18 != 0), else 0. Used by the timeline code to skip dead tracks.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_MergeDuplicates
functions.summary: First purges expired tracks, then merges tracks that start at (almost) the same time: it copies the newest track's value/weight into the older one, advances the older track's start time and removes the duplicate. This keeps the timeline free of overlapping identical keys.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_MergeDuplicatesNoPurge
functions.summary: Same duplicate-time merge as Anim_TimeTrack_MergeDuplicates but without the initial purge pass; used when the caller has already purged the list.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_BuildArcKeyframes
functions.signature: void Anim_TimeTrack_BuildArcKeyframes(AnimTimeTrack* self, int shape, void* heap, u32 segmentMode)
functions.summary: Generates one to four keyframe entries along a sine/cosine arc: the shape argument picks one of four base angles and the segment mode picks the step size, and each keyframe stores the sampled angle plus its sin/cos offsets.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_AppendKeyframe
functions.signature: void Anim_TimeTrack_AppendKeyframe(AnimTimeTrack* self, const Keyframe* keyframe, void* heap)
functions.summary: Appends one raw keyframe (seven values) to the end of the track without any overlap handling.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_FindKeyframeAt
functions.summary: Finds the keyframe whose start time and value both equal the two floats passed in, within the track's epsilon; returns 0 when there is none.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_HasExpired
functions.summary: Returns 1 as soon as any track in the list is expired (owner missing or owner->vtable+0x18 == 0), else 0.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_RemoveFirstExpired
functions.summary: Finds and unlinks the first expired track, returning it (or 0 when every track is alive). Used by the timeline update to recycle one dead key per frame.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a timeline list: clears the time/scale fields at +0x18..+0x34, unlinks both intrusive lists and frees every entry.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_SetKeyframe
functions.signature: void Anim_TimeTrack_SetKeyframe(AnimTimeTrack* self, const Keyframe* keyframe, void* heap)
functions.summary: Inserts a keyframe, or overwrites the existing one at the same time/value if there already is one, then rebuilds the track.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_Init
functions.signature: void Anim_TimeTrack_Init(AnimTimeTrack* self, int preset, void* heap)
functions.summary: Initialises a timeline track from one of four presets: stores the preset's duration and scale, clears the cursor fields and inserts the first zero-length keyframe into the track's list.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_Ctor
functions.summary: Initialises an animation timeline list: sets both intrusive-list sentinels to point at themselves and resets the timing fields. Returns self.

functions.name: Anim_TimeTrack_Dtor
functions.summary: Destroys an animation timeline: resets the timing/ownership fields and unlinks both intrusive lists (including the self-sentinels). Returns self.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_UpdateRowText

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CommandListRow_UpdateName

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CommandListRow_UpdateDetail

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_UpdateSecondaryText
functions.summary: Helper of the battle row update: returns when the row has no secondary id, sets the primary string and clears the second column, then for member/monster rows resolves the actor or sprite from the battle unit lists (+0x4254/+0x428C) and selects the icon, or falls back to the text-table entry 7.

functions.name: Ui_TextTable_GetStringById
functions.signature: u8* Ui_TextTable_GetStringById(u32 arg1, u32 kind, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns a pointer to one of nine string fields of the global text/data block (offsets 0x70..0x90) selected by kind; returns a static empty string for unknown kinds and NULL for empty fields.

functions.name: Ui_TextElement_SetSecondColumn

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_UpdateSelectedRow

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_ShowEntryNameById

functions.summary: Computes the left/right eye positions of the stereoscopic 3D camera: adds the screen-space parallax offset for the current 3D mode (constants +-2.5, +-5, 6) to the camera eye position, producing two laterally separated eye points. This is what makes the 3DS 3D slider deepen the view.

functions.name: Camera_UpdateStereoSmoothing
functions.summary: Per-frame stereo-camera smoothing: only while the field/free-camera display flags are set, it advances the convergence factor at +0xB8, rebuilds the two eye positions with Camera_InterpolateStereoParameters and slerps the stored eye/up vectors toward them, then restores the screen-plane constants.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenChild_GaugeObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for a screen child object that carries two three-word vectors and an embedded list, built on the shared UI composite base.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenChild_GaugeObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for Ui_ScreenChild_GaugeObject (vtable 0x0076FE64 slot 0), freeing the 0xBC-byte composite object allocated in Ui_ScreenController_InitChildren.

functions.name: Camera_UpdateGyroYaw
functions.summary: Gyroscope-controlled camera yaw: takes the 3DS gyro vector, projects it on the camera's reference axis (+0x138), converts the angle to degrees (57.29578) and then to a turn fraction (1/360), clamps it and stores the resulting yaw at +0x118/+0x11C plus the yaw quaternion at +0x128.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateBlendPoseAlt
functions.summary: Third blend-pose variant: adds the step to f_3C, interpolates the two poses with Anim_InterpolatePose into +0x68, and when the loop flag f_1E1 is set recomputes the target pose from the f_40..f_54 direction before lerping +0x74..+0x7C and folding it back into +0x160.

functions.name: Camera_ResolveCollision
functions.signature: void Camera_ResolveCollision(Camera* self, Vec3* camPos, Vec3* targetPos)
functions.summary: Camera collision and smoothing for the field camera: casts rays from the target toward the camera (Gfx_Scene_DrawSprite/FindsEntriesAlongLine), shortens the boom when geometry is hit, keeps a 10-entry history of positions and blends the result so the camera glides instead of snapping. Called from Camera_Update.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_ComputeAngleFromReference
functions.summary: Computes the unsigned angle between the camera forward vector and the global reference axis 0x007E7030: clamped acos, sign from the cross term, degrees via fmod 360 into self+0x11C, plus two rotated reference vectors.

functions.name: Camera_SetTransitionTarget
functions.signature: void Camera_SetTransitionTarget(Camera* self, Vec3* eye, Vec3* target, Vec3* upOrNull)
functions.summary: Starts a camera transition: snapshots the current eye/target/up into the interpolation sources (+0xA0/+0xD0/+0x104), stores the new pose in the destinations (+0xAC/+0xDC/+0x108), publishes the new eye distance to globals and resets the transition timer; when the transition time is zero it snaps immediately and rebuilds the rotation quaternion.

functions.name: Camera_UpdateTransition
functions.summary: Advances an active camera transition: computes the eased blend factor from the remaining time at +0x144, walks the eye/target/scale from the start pose toward the destination pose, optionally shortens the boom when the line of sight is occluded (modes 1 and 2 via Camera_FindOccludingSegment), and writes the interpolated pose.

functions.name: Camera_UpdateManualYaw
functions.summary: Manual camera yaw from player input: adds the rotated circle-pad input to the camera yaw, blending it with the actor's facing/party orientation flags, and stores the smoothed yaw at +0x11C. Handles the 'hold L/R to rotate the camera' path.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_StoreAnchorState
functions.summary: Copies a source actor/camera transform into the global game-work anchor at +0x2A62C: the position length, the vector at +0x100/+0xC4, two quaternion halves, the flags at +0x188..+0x19C and a mode word built from source+0x154 and source+0x1E0.

functions.name: Camera_ResetState
functions.summary: Resets a camera to its idle state: snaps the current pose to the stored eye/target, releases the two occlusion object lists and clears the path mode and resource id (+0x170/+0x174).

functions.name: Camera_InitGyroReference
functions.summary: Captures the current gyro/sensor vector as the camera's yaw reference (+0x138), re-evaluates the gyro helper and zeroes the yaw accumulator; optionally rebuilds the yaw quaternion. Called by CameraResetFreeCam.

functions.name: Camera_InitGyroReferenceInverted
functions.summary: Same as Camera_InitGyroReference but stores the negated sensor vector (the 'reverse the 3DS orientation' variant used by the free camera when the player looks behind).

functions.name: Camera_SetupSinglePath
functions.signature: u32 Camera_SetupSinglePath(Camera* self, CameraPathRecord* path, int force)
functions.summary: Loads a single-CV camera rail: reads the path record (id at +0xC), converts its control points to a point list and hands it to the camera curve object at +0x1A0, switching the camera into path mode 1. Returns 1 when a new path was installed.

functions.name: Camera_ResetStateB
functions.summary: Identical reset to Camera_ResetState for the other camera subclass: snaps the pose, releases the two occlusion lists and clears the path mode/id.

functions.name: Camera_SetupDualPath
functions.signature: u32 Camera_SetupDualPath(Camera* self, CameraPathPair* paths, int force)
functions.summary: Loads a dual-CV camera rail (two curves, e.g. for cut-scenes that blend between a dolly and a look-at track): builds point lists for both records and hands them to the two curve objects at +0x1A0/+0x1C0, switching the camera into path mode 2.

functions.name: Camera_SetYawNormalized
functions.signature: void Camera_SetYawNormalized(Camera* self, u32 snap, float yaw)
functions.summary: Normalises the incoming angle to [0, 360), writes it to the camera yaw fields +0x118/+0x11C and, when snap is set, rebuilds the yaw quaternion at +0x128..+0x134.

functions.name: Camera_Update
functions.summary: Main per-frame update of the field/free camera: advances any running transition, applies gyro or manual yaw, clamps pitch, slerps the orientation quaternion, converts the stored spherical offset into a world position around the target, resolves collision and writes the final eye/target/up vectors used by the renderer.

functions.name: Camera_ComputeYawSpring
functions.summary: Small math helper shared by the camera yaw code: returns the smooth-yaw filter value (sin(angle) - angle) * k used to damp manual and gyro rotation.

functions.name: Camera_SetupFromActor
functions.signature: void Camera_SetupFromActor(Camera* self, int mode, Actor* target)
functions.summary: Configures the field camera from the current actor: copies the actor's transform into the camera base, computes the yaw needed to look at it (with the same acos/spring filter), sets the boom distance and refreshes the camera's name/target fields. Modes 1/7/0xB have special handling for the actor's flags.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenChild_EffectObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Large constructor for a screen child that owns ten repeated three-word blocks and two sub-objects (a particle/animation context), used by the screen controller's child list.

functions.name: Camera_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the field camera class: installs the camera vtable, releases the two occlusion object lists and frees the camera allocation. Found at vtable slot +8 of the camera vtable next to Camera_Update.

functions.name: Ui_DiveCapture_InitPanes
functions.summary: Initialises the dive-capture result window: loads the menu_dive_capture layout, binds the two message panels and the cursor, and starts the result animation.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DiveCapture_HasFreeSlot
functions.summary: Lazily builds the dive-capture record block (a 0x2FB28-byte object with vtable 0x00764B84 and 31 elements of 0x12EC bytes) on first use, then counts the records in the table at +0x5FE4 and returns true while fewer than 50 are in use.

functions.name: Ui_SpiritCaptureMessage_Hide
functions.summary: Hides the spirit-capture message window pane at self+0x120 (Ui widget set-visible) and then runs the window base teardown 0x10EBD8.

functions.name: Ui_SpiritCaptureMessage_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the spirit-capture message window: advances the fade timer at +0x2A0, then dispatches one of seven state callbacks stored in a 0x18-stride table at +0x2A4.

functions.name: Ui_DiveCapture_SetResultMessage
functions.signature: void Ui_DiveCapture_SetResultMessage(UiDiveCapture* self, int* message, u8 flag)
functions.summary: Submits a dive result message to the capture window: sets message argument 2, applies the character look when the attached record is valid, and pushes a 0x30-byte message structure (text pointer, flag, target pane) into the panel through its vtable +0x60.

functions.name: Ui_SpiritCaptureMessage_SelectEntry
functions.summary: Shows the spirit-capture list pane, publishes its node into the intrusive list at self+0x16C, and if a list object exists selects the entry whose id comes from the widget at +0x148; also sets the list window mode flag.

functions.name: Ui_DiveCapture_ShowResult
functions.summary: Shows the dive result page: indexes the result table with the player's rank, resolves the corresponding message id and calls the message setter.

functions.name: Ui_DiveCapture_HandleInput
functions.summary: Per-frame input handler of the dive result window: on the state bits 0x142 it reads the result object's +0xC byte and asks the window animator for state 4 (no next page), 3 (next page) or 5 (last page); bit 4 sets the +0x11C latch and bit 1 forwards the four bytes at +0x28E..+0x290; always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_OpenRow4
functions.summary: Row-4 open helper: binds row 4 of the message window and marks the message object open (f_FC=1, display mode 0), i.e. exactly the OpenRow0 shape with a different row.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_OnOpened
functions.summary: Per-frame handler of the message window's 'opened' state: updates the widget and, when the open animation has finished, switches the window state to 2. Always returns 1 to keep the state machine running.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_Open_2
functions.summary: Brings a multi-row message/choice window on screen in its default state: hides the two child widgets, loads the row list for the current message id and flags the message object as open in display mode 6.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_OpenRow0
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_OpenRow0(UiMessageWindow* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Open helper for the message window: clears the UI mode word at core+0x94, binds row 0 through Ui_MessageWindow_ShowRow and marks the message object open (f_FC=1, display mode 0).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_OpenRow1
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_OpenRow1(UiMessageWindow* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Row-1 twin of 0x444238: writes mode 5 into the UI mode word at core+0x94, binds row 1 and marks the message object open (f_FC=1, display mode 0).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AdvanceRow
functions.signature: int Ui_MessageWindow_AdvanceRow(UiMessageWindow* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Steps the message-window row cursor to the next row and shows that row; when the last row is already shown it asks the owning list whether more content exists and closes the window if not.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_AdvanceIfReady
functions.summary: Updates the window and, when the child widget is done, advances/closes the current message row via the row controller at +0x2A0.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetOpened
functions.summary: Row handler that marks the message window as opened (state 1) once the open animation has finished.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetClosed
functions.summary: Row handler that marks the message window as closed (state 0) once the close animation has finished.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_OpenRow3
functions.summary: Row-3 open helper: binds row 3 of the message window and leaves the message object open in display mode 6 (f_FC=1, f_100=6), the same tail as Ui_MessageWindow_Open (0x4441E8).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ConfirmRow
functions.summary: Handles the player's confirm/cancel input on the current message row: checks the input result at +0x2A0 (button 6 for cancel, 1 for confirm) and advances the row controller when accepted.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ShowRow
functions.summary: Selects one of the window's loaded rows and binds it to the text pane: it writes the window's message id into message slot 5 and resolves the row descriptor through the relative-offset table of the row list.

functions.name: Ui_DiveCapture_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the Dive-capture screen: builds the base UI object, a member pair (list + scroller) and four sub-widgets, installing vtable 0x76FEC4 whose pane-init slot is Ui_DiveCapture_InitPanes.

functions.name: Ui_Window_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor: runs the window destructor at 0x00444B58 (reinstalls the vtable and releases the child handle at +0x29C) and then frees the object with 0x0010F6CC. Ghidra prints the callee as the bogus symbol HKD.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SpiritCapture_LoadMessageResources
functions.summary: Formats string parameters with '%d' into global message argument slots at *0x007AC834 (+0x848, +0x950) and initializes local handle array at self+4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_UpdateTransitionState
functions.summary: Drives a window's open/close transition: if the screen state at +0x1E18 is 1 it copies the descriptor rectangle, scrolls the message window by -f_3C*f_1C0, sets animation state 7 and notifies the slot control; otherwise it copies the other descriptor pair, sets state 4 and notifies the same control.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenTransition_InitFromTable
functions.summary: Initialises a screen-transition helper from a static two-word record: resolves the transition owner via 0x46BEC8 and copies 8 bytes from table 0x729250+8 into self+4.

functions.name: Ui_Screen_UpdateTransition
functions.signature: void Ui_Screen_UpdateTransition(UiScreen* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Per-frame transition update: when the open flag (0x102) or close flag (4) is set it writes the matching timer pair from 0x00729250 into self+4/+8, starts the panel transition (mode 5, or mode 6 with the +0x1C0 count), commits the layout and marks/binds the child widget.

functions.name: Ui_Window_DispatchAnimation
functions.summary: Drives the open/close animation of a window: updates the widget and, when it is ready, dispatches through the animation function table at +4/+8 to run the next step.

functions.name: maybe_Container_HandleList_Ctor
functions.signature: ContainerHandleList* maybe_Container_HandleList_Ctor(ContainerHandleList* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Builds a container object that owns a registered intrusive list of 0x14-byte elements, four descriptor words, a zeroed handle array and a ref-counted resource at +0x18.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SpiritCapture_CreateLayoutParts
functions.summary: Layout parts instantiator with damaged decompilation containing register spillage and unrecovered jump table.

functions.name: Container_HandleList_Dtor
functions.signature: void Container_HandleList_Dtor(ContainerHandleList* self, int vtable, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor for the handle-owning list: restores the vtable, releases the two UI resources at +0x30/+0x34 through the engine release helper 0x0021F8B8, disposes the intrusive list created by 0x0044508C, drops the pack handle and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenTransition_CreateLayers
functions.summary: Starts a screen transition: checks the UI core transition state, creates the four child layers of the transition quad and stores the fade start/end times.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Transition_OnAccept
functions.summary: When the input manager's virtual +0x14 reports a hit it notifies it with slot +8 and argument 2, clears the child object's visibility flag and stores the pair at 0x0072A79C+0x30/+0x34 into self+4/+8.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenTransition_CopyTableData
functions.summary: If the object at self+0xC exists and its virtual +0x34 returns true, copies the 8-byte static record at 0x72A79C+8 into self+4. Sits in the screen-transition vtable, probably initialising transition layers.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenTransition_UpdateTimer
functions.summary: Advances the transition timer: plays the start SE at frame 5 and the end SE at frame 25, and after 60 frames finishes the transition (UI core state 2) if the target screen exists.

functions.name: Ui_Transition_Start
functions.signature: void Ui_Transition_Start(UiTransition* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Starts a transition: asks the input manager (Ui_GetCore()->f_14->f_28) for mode 2 through slot +0xC and copies the transition timer pair 0x0072A79C+0x28/+0x2C into self+4/+8.

functions.name: Ui_Transition_CreateFadeQuad
functions.summary: Creates the full-screen fade quad of a screen transition: checks the layout resource handle, fills the 12-entry quad descriptor and creates the polygon object, then resets the timer.

functions.name: Ui_Card_Ctor
functions.signature: UiCard * Ui_Card_Ctor(UiCard * self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor of one casino card object: installs vtable 0x0076FF34, copies the shared two-word layout value, allocates a 300-byte part object with vtable 0x00769AA4 through Ui_GetCore's allocator, registers it with Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable (freeing it again on failure) and finishes with func_00626A9C on the UI core.

functions.name: Ui_Transition_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the screen transition object: installs the vtable, releases the layout resource handle, tears down the UI core transition and clears the owner flag.

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the 40-slot touch-icon board: advances and wraps the shared icon timer, then for every occupied slot whose target is showing a cursor it rebuilds the 'icon_atari' highlight pane and clears the highlight request.

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_SetupSlots
functions.summary: Builds the two 'icon_hit' widgets of a hit-icon row by resolving both child nodes by name and attaching them to the widget.

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_FindSlotNode
functions.signature: int* Ui_HitIcon_FindSlotNode(UiHitIcon* self, u32 group, int slot)
functions.summary: Finds one hit-icon child node by name: looks up the child named 'icon_hit', then the per-group node id from the table at g_00446020 and returns the resulting widget (or null).

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_UpdateVisibleSlots
functions.summary: Refreshes the icons of a hit-icon row: positions the visible icons on their slots and hides the unused ones (up to two icons).

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_CreateSprites
functions.signature: void Ui_HitIcon_CreateSprites(UiHitIcon* self, u32 group, int iconData, u32* layout)
functions.summary: Creates the sprite children for a whole hit-icon page: for each of up to 24 rows and 2 slots it reads the icon id from the 5-byte entry array, creates a child sprite from the layout and swaps it into the slot.

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_RebuildSprites
functions.signature: void Ui_HitIcon_RebuildSprites(UiHitIcon* self, u32 group, u32 iconSet, u32* layout)
functions.summary: Recreates the two hit-icon sprites for one row after the icon set changed: removes the old child sprites, creates the new ones from the layout and attaches them with the 'icon_change' name.

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_Add
functions.signature: void Ui_HitIcon_Add(UiHitIconBoard* self, UiObject* target, const char* name)
functions.summary: Registers a hit icon for one object: releases any pane already bound to that target, loads the requested 'icon_*' pane on the target's layout, stores {target, pane, is_hit} in the first free of the 40 slots and computes is_hit by comparing the name with 'icon_hit'.

functions.name: Ui_RotatePaneWindow_Init
functions.signature: void Ui_RotatePaneWindow_Init(UiWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 unusedA, u32 unusedB, u32 unusedC)
functions.summary: Binds the 'null_rot' pane, stores it at self+0x4C and gives it a symmetric rotation (the same angle on both axes) plus a source position from the window's f_50, setting bit 0x10 in the pane attribute byte.

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_ClearAllSlots
functions.summary: Releases every one of the 40 hit-icon/effect slots: clears the animation time, returns the sprite to the factory and zeroes the slot.

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the hit-icon widget: chains to the Ui_Object base, installs the vtable, clears the group fields and zero-initialises the 0x1E0-byte icon buffer.

functions.name: Ui_HitIcon_Dtor
functions.summary: Trivial destructor of the hit-icon widget: base Ui_Object destructor plus free.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SetMessageArgs
functions.summary: Sets message arguments 2 (party member name from member+0xCA), 5 (item self+0x20A) and, when present, 6 (item self+0x20C) through Ui_TextFormat_ReleaseSlot with format 0x007BFC46.

functions.name: Effect_InstancePair_Setup
functions.signature: void Effect_InstancePair_Setup(EffectPair* self, EffectPairDesc* desc, Actor* owner)
functions.summary: Creates the two effect instances described by an effect-pair record: copies the descriptor fields, builds the effect parameters from the owner actor and starts both effects.

functions.name: Ui_TextFormat_SetMemberNameSlot
functions.signature: void Ui_TextFormat_SetMemberNameSlot(void* self, int slot, u32 memberId)
functions.summary: Formats the name of the member `memberId` (+0xCA, strlen+1 clamped to 0x7F wchars) into message argument slot `slot` through Message_FormatArgSlot_Reset + std_String_FormatInitG, i.e. the generic 'put this member's name in text slot N' setter.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_BuildSpeakerLine
functions.summary: Builds one message-window line in a 748-byte frame; the readable body is lost after the 0xFF array constructor, but the callee set (Message_FormatArgSlot_Reset, Effect_InstancePair_Setup, Ui_DungeonDamage_LoadLayout) is message/effect code.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_RebuildRows
functions.summary: Rebuilds the message rows for the attached actor: validates the actor against the sentinel list, rebuilds the rows through maybe_Ui_TenRowWindow_BuildRows, resets the scroll counter and re-selects the row in the label object.

functions.name: Ui_Serialize_ReadOptionalObjectRef
functions.signature: void Ui_Serialize_ReadOptionalObjectRef(void* self, void* ref, void* reader)
functions.summary: Serialized-reference reader used while loading Ui element trees: publishes the destination at reader+0x60C, resolves the stored id through reader vtable +0x24, tolerates a missing self+0x98 target (writes null) and clears the relocation slot afterwards.

functions.name: toD
functions.signature: void toD(int arg1, int arg2, int * arg3)

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EmbeddedObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a message-window sub-object that embeds a UI object at +0x120: destroys the embedded object and its prefix, then frees.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ProjectAnchorObjectAlt
functions.summary: Positions a world-anchored widget from the actor handle stored at self+0x4C: resolves the handle through the 0x7B80C0 table, keeps only g_actorBaseClass objects, projects actor+0x9C..0xA4 with Gfx_ProjectWorldToScreen and writes the screen-space quad into self->f_30, flagging the transform dirty.

functions.name: Ui_Object_SetHandle4C
functions.summary: Stores a handle in self+0x4C only when the handle table at 0x007B80C0 resolves it and its class chain includes g_actorBaseClass; otherwise the old handle is kept.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ToggleButton_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a small button widget: Ui_Object_CtorBase, install vtable 0x770028 and OR the default state/mask word at +0x4C.

functions.name: Ui_ToggleButton_Dtor
functions.summary: Trivial destructor of the toggle/check button: base Ui_Object destructor plus free.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ReleaseSubWidgets
functions.summary: Releases eight per-row sub-widgets with stride 0xBC (offset +0xB8) and two footer widgets at +0x634 and +0x684 using func_003DFEC4.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_SelectSavedEntry
functions.summary: Restores the list selection from the window's saved value: gets the list object, combines the saved index (low 16 bits of arg1[10]) with the saved page and asks the list to select that entry.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateIcons
functions.summary: Refreshes the eight speaker/status icons of a message window from the current message's icon list and updates the scroll selection when the icon count shrank.

functions.name: Ui_PartyGaugeWindow_UpdateAllSlots
functions.summary: Refreshes all party gauge entries: for 8 party slots it walks two gauge sub-objects of 4 elements each, calls the element update virtual (+0x10) and then the element list virtuals +0x24/+0x28, writing the slot value into element+0x70.

functions.name: Ui_PartyGaugeWindow_InitPanes
functions.signature: void Ui_PartyGaugeWindow_InitPanes(UiWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 unusedA, u32 unusedB, u32 unusedC)
functions.summary: Pane initialiser for the eight-gauge party panel: for each of l1/r1 .. l4/r4 it binds 'txt_%s_1', 'null_txt_%s' and 'txt_%s_3', starts a child gauge layout from 'gauge_%s', resolves the 'icon_dummy_%s' node and caches the two extra sub-panes; finally binds the 'normal' and 'disabled' overlays.

functions.name: Ui_PartyGaugeWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the party HP/MP gauge window: base ctor, vtable 0x77008C, then constructs its 8 gauge rows (0xBC bytes each) at +0x54 and the two fixed panes.

functions.name: Ui_PartyGaugeWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the party HP/MP gauge window: destroys the eight 0xBC-byte gauge rows at +0x54, the footer widget and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_PartyGaugeWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the party HP/MP gauge window: destroys the eight 0xBC gauge rows and the footer widget, leaving the allocation to the caller.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_SetItemPanesA
functions.summary: Fills the four icon panes of an equipment row: the two fixed slot markers (sprite ids 0x60 and 0x61), then the item icon of the member's equipped item in slot 4 and the secondary icon, falling back to the empty icon when the item has no icon data; sets the 'filled' byte at self+0x49 to 0.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_SetItemPanesB
functions.summary: Second icon-setter of the equipment row: draws the two compare markers (sprite ids 0x5C/0x5D, swapped when maybe_Item_GetEquipCategory returns 0) and then the item icons read from equipment slots 0 and 1, with the empty-icon fallback; sets the 'filled' byte to 1.

functions.name: Ui_TwoPairTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Four-pane window: two left labels (txt_l1, txt_l2) and two right labels (txt_r1, txt_r2) with null overlays for the left pair.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentRow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for one equipment-row widget: chains to the Ui_Object base, installs the vtable and marks the row as empty/selectable at +0x49.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentRow_Dtor
functions.summary: Trivial destructor of the equipment-row widget.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenItemDetails
functions.summary: Opens the item/equipment detail pane for a party member: looks up the item record, applies it to the member status, pushes the right detail pane (or the comparison pane when the slot is empty) and clears the equip marks.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_UpdateEquipStatus
functions.summary: Counts the party members that can equip/compare the selected item (two list walks) and updates the equipment status pane: pushes the pane and shows either the 'can equip' or 'cannot equip' rows.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentRow_CtorSmall
functions.summary: Constructor of one equipment-window row: installs vtable 0x7701E4, marks the row valid, and clears its selected flag; the matching destructor Ui_EquipmentRow_DtorWidget sits immediately after.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentRow_DtorWidget
functions.summary: Destructor helper for an equipment row: installs the vtable and destroys the embedded widget before freeing.

functions.name: Ui_FormatMessageArgSpan
functions.summary: Formats the text span of a widget into a message argument slot: selects the span stored at widget+0x208, copies its message line and applies it to argument slot 2 with format 0x006C0025, then returns the requested slot.

functions.name: Ui_ThreeLineTextWindow_InitPanesB
functions.summary: Second three-row text window: txt_l1..txt_l3 with null overlays, generated by incrementing the trailing digit.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorTrivialB
functions.summary: Trivial destructor used by several UI widget subclasses: base Ui_Object destructor plus free.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_Jump_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field NPC jump action class (vtable slot 0, siblings Field_NpcAction_Jump and Field_NpcAction_Move).

functions.name: Ui_SortListWindow_BindHeaders
functions.summary: Binds the three column headers of the list window (name, level, sorting) and prepares the three row entries when the window has fewer than two entries.

functions.name: Ui_SortListWindow_SetRow
functions.summary: Fills one row of the sort list from an entry: character name, level and the sorting key, and sets message argument 2 to the name.

functions.name: Ui_Serialize_ReadObjectRef
functions.signature: void Ui_Serialize_ReadObjectRef(void* self, void* ref, void* reader)
functions.summary: Serialized-reference reader: resolves an object id from the stream through reader vtable +0x24 into the destination self+0x98 and stores the resulting pointer at ref+4, temporarily publishing ref+4 at reader+0x60C for relocation tracking.

functions.name: Container_IntrusiveList_Ctor
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises an intrusive list head: installs the list vtable, makes the head self-linking, copies the element type/size words, and when the static pair (0x0044888C) is set splices the head into owner+0x1C and stores it at +0x4B.

functions.name: Ui_SortListWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a list window that supports sortable headers: builds the intrusive list header at self+0x11C, installs list vtable 0x782E98/0x729B88, then calls the list base destructor 0x1D8C2C and operator delete.

functions.name: Script_IsSystemReady
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the script (Squirrel) subsystem of the current game context is available, else 0; used as a guard before calling into scripts.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SetupSprite
functions.summary: Initialises the sprite part of a field scene object from its layout record: stores the sprite id/flags, creates the sprite actor from the sprite table, initialises its box and computes the object's clamped bounding rectangle.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CallScriptCommand
functions.signature: u32 Field_SceneObject_CallScriptCommand(FieldSceneObject* self, u32 command, u32 command2, u32 command3)
functions.summary: Invokes the object's script command (book/event id at +0x46): plays the interaction SE and calls the Squirrel command handler with the script context, returning its result.

functions.name: Field_ObjectCtor_vt77034C
functions.summary: Constructor of a field object variant: installs vtable 0x77034C, sets the id/flag bytes (+0x45 = 1, +0x46 = 0xFF, +0x47 = 0) and constructs the embedded field scene-object sprite at +0x48, returning the enclosing base.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorSprite
functions.summary: Destructor of the sprite-owning field scene object: installs the vtable, destroys the embedded sprite actor (func_0039F388) and the Ui object at -0x48, then frees the object.

functions.name: Script_IsSystemReadyB
functions.summary: Second copy of Script_IsSystemReady (same code emitted for another translation unit); returns 1 when the game's script context exists.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitFromEntry
functions.summary: Initialises a spawned field object from its 8-byte spawn entry: sets the visible/active byte f_45 from entry[7] and entry[5] != 0xFF, resolves the model variant via 0x0066B6D0(bagWork, entry[5], entry[6]) clamped to entry[0], and stores entry[5]/entry[6]/entry[2] in f_46/f_47/f_48.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_AdvanceBookFlag
functions.summary: Advances the object's 'book/read' progress counter: increments the per-book flag in the game work (clamped to 0xFF), plays the page SE and calls the book event handler.

functions.name: Ui_Part_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the Ui_Part base class (the part objects that drive map-jump and other field UI parts): chains to the Ui part base, installs the vtable and initialises the part ids to 'none'.

functions.name: Ui_Part_DeletingDtor_2
functions.summary: Tiny deleting destructor of a UI part object: runs the UI base destructor (0x0017C334 = Ui_Object base dtor), then frees the block (0x0010F6CC). Reached from the class vtable at 0x770378.

functions.name: Ui_Part_StartMapJump
functions.summary: Starts the map-jump sequence for this trigger/UI part: clears the destination flags in the player work block (func_00612CA0/func_006133B4 with 0xFFFF), writes the target map/entry ids, then calls Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent(ctx, mapId, entryId, 6) and stores the result in f_46 as the 'jump launched' flag.

functions.name: Ui_Part_UpdateMapJumpSelection
functions.summary: Prepares and fires a map jump: takes either the stored player position or the map/entrance record selected by f_53, resolves the destination ids into f_48/f_47/f_4c/f_4a (plus f_50/f_4e on the multi-exit path) and, when visible, triggers event command 0xd (jump) or 0xe (blocked).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitSymbolParams
functions.summary: Constructor helper that installs the 0x77039C vtable and fills the five byte+u16 "symbol/label" parameter pairs at +0x45..+0x54 with 0x00/0xFF and 0xFFFF sentinels.

functions.name: Ui_Part_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Second deleting destructor of the same small UI part class (identical body to 0x00448F10): UI base destructor plus free.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_PlayActorAnimation
functions.summary: If the object's actor (+0xB8) is visible, resolves the animation record from +0x298->+0x12 through 0x590504 and starts it on the actor with 0x2D1258(actor, animId, 0).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ApplyLayoutVisibility
functions.summary: Re-applies the object's model record and forwards the layout visibility flag (self->f_298->f_11) to the render node, so the sprite/model matches its placement record.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SetVisibleState
functions.summary: Handles visibility state transitions 2/3 for a field scene object: forwards state 2/3 to the first sub-object's virtual +0x14 with 1/0 and repeats the same call on the object itself at the end.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitModelFromLayout
functions.summary: Builds the visual model of a field scene object from its layout record: looks up the monster/model record, allocates the model instance, applies the animation template and model size, and attaches the animator.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorSpriteNode
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); calls base destructor 0x28E6C4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Effect_ParticleEmitter_InitPoolA
functions.summary: Creates an effect-emitter part object: runs the scene-node base init for the caller's resource name, allocates a 0xAC-byte emitter (vtable 0x0075AF90), stores the owner at +0x20 and constructs 64 two-word state-sequence entries (ctor 0x006CE2B8); the failure path fills the default colour/fade block from table 0x00725E4C (f_50..f_7C).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_PlayStoredMotion
functions.summary: Plays an actor motion selected by the byte at +0x2C8->+0x33: maps the id through 0x590504 and calls actor vtable +0x84, falling back to actor vtable +0x88 when the mapped motion is null.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_UpdateAnimVisibility
functions.summary: Switches the object between its 'Act_Def' and active animations and passes the resulting visible flag (target record exists and f_38 set) to the node's virtual visibility slot.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_StopMotionIfValid
functions.summary: Checks whether the actor handle is still active and, if so, dispatches virtual +0x14 with 0 on the sub-object at +0x4C; always returns 1 so the action scheduler keeps the entry.

functions.name: Effect_SphereEmitter_Setup
functions.summary: Builds a spherical effect part from its definition: transform, colour, a radial fCol animator only when the radius vector def[3..5] is non-zero, then the mesh from def->f_c and the optional row-count reset on the emitter's list window.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a second Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28EFB4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CheckAndNotify
functions.summary: If the actor at +0xB8 exists and its readiness check 0x63C7C4 succeeds, dispatches virtual +0x40 with selector 4 and returns 0 (entry finished); otherwise returns 0 immediately.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnEventDispatch
functions.signature: void Field_SceneObject_OnEventDispatch(FieldSceneObject* self, int eventId, uintptr_t arg3)
functions.summary: Event hook: on event 0x0E it first runs the break reaction (0x0044A220), then always forwards the event to the base Field_SceneNode handler.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitSpriteFromLayout
functions.summary: Initialises a sprite-based field scene object from a packed short layout: resolves the monster/sprite record, creates the model and animator, registers the sprite actor and copies the per-record size/movement constants.

functions.name: Effect_Emitter_SetupFromDescriptor
functions.signature: void Effect_Emitter_SetupFromDescriptor(void* self, const u16* desc)
functions.summary: Configures an effect emitter from a 16-bit descriptor: model/anim ids, lifetime, colour animator, default particle parameters and the initial position/rotation.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_PlayBreakReaction
functions.summary: Plays the object's 'Break' animation, stops its current action and plays break SE 0xF1/0xF2 depending on whether the object has already been broken.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ResetMoveTarget
functions.summary: Clears a scene object's movement target: resets the target ids to the 0xFFFF sentinel, asks the field command system (0x256678, command 8) for the new target and stores the resolved name handle, so the object idles until a new target arrives.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CtorSprite
functions.summary: Constructor of a field scene object: chains the base constructor 0x44C654, installs vptr 0x770578 and initialises the sentinel fields (-1 at +0x2B8, 0 at +0x2BA, 0xFF at +0x2BB, 1 at +0x288).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a third Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28E6C4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CheckCanUpdate
functions.summary: Returns true when the object may update: stops its pending effect and checks that the field is in the normal (non-paused) game state.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnEventState
functions.signature: void Field_SceneObject_OnEventState(FieldSceneObject* self, int eventId, uintptr_t arg3)
functions.summary: Event hook for the sprite variant: on 0x0E it spawns the break effect, on 0x10 it resets the target fields and marks them dirty, then forwards every event to the base handler and the attached object.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitStaticModelFromLayout
functions.summary: Initialises a static, layout-driven field scene object: two sprite children from the layout's 0x28-byte descriptor blocks, an fCol animator, a mesh from layout word 0x18, and (when the object id exists in the bag/flag table) its width/height words from the data manager.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SpawnBreakEffect
functions.summary: Plays the object's break animation/SE and spawns the matching break particle effect at the object position (two variants chosen by the break-state byte).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_FinishBreak
functions.summary: Completes the break: sends event 0x0E to the attached object, tells the field command system the object is gone and marks the player record flag 7, then reports success.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CtorB
functions.summary: Constructor of another field scene object variant: chains 0x44CAB4, installs vptr 0x770638 and initialises alpha/scale fields (0.35f at +0x138, 0xFF byte, 1 at +0x2B4/+0x2C6).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorD
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a fourth Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28EFB4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Effect_ParticleEmitter_InitPoolB
functions.summary: Variant of 0x00449930 with a 0x6C-byte child object (vtable 0x0075AFB4) and 64 single-word entries (ctor 0x006CE608); the default block comes from 0x00725E4C f_30..f_44.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_TickMapJumpCountdown
functions.summary: Counts up a small timer while the object is armed and, after 15 ticks, triggers the map/field command stored in the object record, then disarms.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SetUpdateCallbacks
functions.summary: Resets a scene object per-frame callbacks: installs 0x0044AD70 through vtable+0x84, runs the reset slot +0x88, installs Field_SceneObject_UpdatePositionQuery as the new callback, clears +0x2FC and sets +0x300.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_UpdatePositionQuery
functions.summary: Re-registers the object's current position with the scene query system (used to keep spatial lookups in sync after a move).

functions.name: Effect_HelixEmitter_Setup
functions.summary: Builds a helical effect part from its definition: transform and colour, the fCol animator for the helix radius, then the mesh from the definition's id and flags.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_TryCopyActorTransform
functions.summary: Clears the three pending-jump fields and, when the actor exists and is not in state 0x18, copies its transform into self+0x2C8 (Actor_ApplyStateAnimEvent), arms the delayed flag f_301 when f_2F8 is set and returns true.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SubDtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the secondary base sub-object at offset +0x258: re-points the sub-vptr to arg1+0xD4, stores it at +0x258, then runs base destructor 0x28EFB4 and operator delete.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_IsFieldUsable
functions.summary: Returns true when the field can accept input (the field command system is not busy); a leaf helper duplicated for several field object classes.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnEventUnregister
functions.signature: void Field_SceneObject_OnEventUnregister(FieldSceneObject* self, int eventId, uintptr_t arg3)
functions.summary: Event hook: on event 0x10 it unregisters the object's symbol handle from the field symbol manager, then forwards the event to the base node.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnStateChange
