functions.summary: State 3 handler: clears +0x288, resolves the global registry entry for the id at +0x2B8 through table 0x7B5D70 and calls 0x29E380(obj+0x2C,0); then forwards states 2/3 to the +0x4C sub-object virtual +0x14.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_UpdateSymbolVisibility
functions.summary: Shows or hides a field symbol depending on the player distance (or always in the special camera mode), by toggling the symbol's visible flag.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitSymbolFromLayout
functions.summary: Initialises the symbol variant of a field object from a packed short layout: resolves the monster record, applies size/animation, creates the sprite actor and, if the monster is already defeated, suppresses the symbol.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ShowSymbol
functions.summary: Makes the object's symbol actor visible (base show hook + symbol visible flag = 1).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_UpdateSymbolDistance
functions.summary: Per-frame hook that refreshes the symbol visibility from the object's current 2D position.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_HideSymbol
functions.summary: Makes the object's symbol actor invisible (base hide hook + symbol visible flag = 0).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_Cleanup
functions.summary: Destruction path for the symbol object: releases its child actors/effects, unregisters the object from the field actor manager and disables the symbol.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ResetState
functions.summary: Resets the object to its initial state: clears the movement target, re-registers the symbol, releases the special effect and sends event 0x0E to the field.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorE
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a fifth Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28E6C4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_IsFieldUsableB
functions.summary: Second copy of the field-usable check (game singleton + field not busy), used by the sprite symbol class.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnEventReset
functions.signature: void Field_SceneObject_OnEventReset(FieldSceneObject* self, int eventId, uintptr_t arg3)
functions.summary: Event hook: on 0x10 it releases the sprite actor for the object's effect handle, resets the movement target bytes to the sentinel and marks them dirty; then forwards the event.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ResetEffectState
functions.summary: Releases the object's effect sprite and re-initialises the movement target from the stored record, clearing the active-effect flag.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitFromLayout
functions.summary: Initialises a field sprite/effect object from a layout record: reads the record id/position, checks the player's defeat flag, builds the sprite actor and effect sprite and computes the final spawn position.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SpawnAuraEffect
functions.summary: Spawns the looping aura/glow effect at the object position when the object currently has a valid model instance.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ReleaseEffectOnHide
functions.summary: Hides the object and releases its aura effect sprite.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CleanupEffect
functions.signature: void Field_SceneObject_CleanupEffect(FieldSceneObject* self, uint32_t eventId, uintptr_t arg3)
functions.summary: Destruction hook of the aura-effect object: releases child actors, detaches from the field actor manager and disables the effect sprite.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_TriggerFieldCommand
functions.summary: Sends event 0x0E with this object's handle to the field command system, then reports success.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorF
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a sixth Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28EFB4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Actor_FindByHandleAndRtti
functions.summary: Resolves a generational actor handle through the global actor table at 0x7B80C0 (index = handle & 0x7FF, generation = handle >> 11) and returns the object only when its first virtual returns the RTTI token 0x7C439C; otherwise returns null.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ConsumeTriggerRecord
functions.summary: One-shot trigger-record loader for a field scene object: clears the +0x298..+0x2B4 state block, and when recordId is not 0xFFFF and its save bit is still unset it copies the four u16 fields of the 8-byte record from dataMgr->f_8FC into +0x298/+0x2A0/+0x2AC/+0x2B0, marks the bit used and returns 1.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SpawnItemFieldEffectB
functions.summary: Template copy of Field_SceneObject_SpawnItemFieldEffect (0x0044C5C8): item kind 0x25 -> 2D effect at the object's tile. The item id passed to Item_LookupRecord was dropped by the decompiler in this copy.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SpawnItemFieldEffect
functions.summary: If the scene object's item (+0x298) has kind 0x25 ('%'), creates the item's 2D field effect at the object's tile (f_78*8+8, f_7C*8) through Gfx_Effect2D_CreateSlot.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorG
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a seventh Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28E6C4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Actor_FindByHandleAndRttiB
functions.summary: Same generational actor-handle lookup as Actor_FindByHandleAndRtti, specialised for RTTI token 0x7C4860.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_ConsumeTriggerRecordB
functions.summary: Twin of 0x0044C454 on the second state block: clears +0x2C8..+0x2E4, and when the record's save bit is still unset it copies the four u16 fields of the 8-byte record into +0x2C8/+0x2D0/+0x2DC/+0x2E0, marks the bit used and returns 1; otherwise it sets the 'no record' flag at +0x2D0 and returns 0.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CreateVariantEffects
functions.summary: Applies the object's variant/effect ids (f_B2, f_B3, the u16 at +0x2CA) by creating the corresponding item model or effect model, spawning the scaled effect for id 0x2B and forwarding to the attached object's effect spawner.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorH
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of an eighth Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28EFB4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Actor_FindByHandleAndRttiC
functions.summary: Same generational actor-handle lookup, specialised for RTTI token 0x7C44F0.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_IsFieldUsableC
functions.summary: Third copy of the field-usable predicate; returns the raw value of func_00636AFC (field busy flag).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitEffectSprite
functions.summary: Initialises the effect-sprite field object from a packed record: resolves the monster record, sets size/animation, creates the sprite actor and selects the effect variant from the record's optional sub-records.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnConfirm
functions.summary: Confirmation handler: runs the base confirm hook and sends event 0x12 with the object handle to the field command system.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CtorC
functions.summary: Constructor of a field scene object variant: chains 0x28E630, installs vptr 0x770B9C and initialises the sentinel fields at +0x297..+0x2A0 (0xFF, -1, 0xFF, 0xF0000001).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a field scene object: unlinks and destroys its child list, runs the field-node destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Actor_FindByHandleAndRttiD
functions.summary: Same generational actor-handle lookup, specialised for RTTI token 0x7C4B6C.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_IsFieldUsableD
functions.summary: Fourth copy of the field-usable predicate used by the next symbol class.

functions.name: Effect_SelectEmitterVariant_Setup
functions.summary: Configures an emitter whose particle comes from one of four variant groups: one sprite child with the definition colour/scale, then tests def[1]/def[3]/def[5]/def[7] in turn (first >= 1 wins), stores the chosen group (0..3) in f_2C8 and the referenced byte in f_2CC.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnConfirmB
functions.summary: Second confirmation handler variant (different base hook 0x0028EBE4) that also sends event 0x12 with the object handle.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CtorD
functions.summary: Constructor of a field scene object variant: chains 0x28EE8C, installs vptr 0x770C5C and initialises +0x274/+0x2C8..+0x2D4 sentinels (0, 0xFF, -1, 0xFF, 0xF0000001).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DeleteDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the second field object class: unlinks children, calls Field_SceneObject_Dtor (0x00336B3C) and frees the block.

functions.name: Effect_ParticleEmitter_InitPoolC
functions.summary: Variant of the emitter-pool factory: 0xAC-byte object (vtable 0x0075AFD8), 64 two-word entries (ctor 0x006CE940), defaults from the 14-word table 0x00726114 and an extra scalar f_138 = 0.35.

functions.name: Field_PathMover_SnapToNearestPathPoint
functions.summary: Moves a path-following field object onto the closest point of its path relative to the player, then points its facing along the segment.

functions.name: maybe_Field_PathMover_OnEvent
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_PathMover_OnEvent(FieldPathMover* self, int eventId, uintptr_t forwarded)
functions.summary: Event hook: on events 1 and 2 it samples the global riding/attached byte at (work+8)+0x44 into +0x2f0, then always forwards the event to the base anim-object handler.

functions.name: Field_PathMover_AdvanceAlongPath
functions.summary: Advances the path mover along its curve at its current speed, moves and orients the node, and registers actors standing at the passed path points.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_InitSpriteList
functions.summary: Initialises a multi-sprite field object from its layout: applies position/rotation/scale, allocates the child-handle array and creates one sprite actor per layout entry.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_HideChildren
functions.summary: Hides the multi-part object and returns each of its child part handles to the field actor manager.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_ShowChildren
functions.summary: Shows the multi-part object and re-registers each child part handle with the field actor manager.

functions.name: maybe_Field_MultiPart_AttachActors
functions.summary: Resolves the part's scene target and two actor handles through the handle table, then registers the pair with the scene (0x17C054).

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor thunk: runs the multi-part destructor body (0x0044E3E0) and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor body of the multi-part object: frees its six child/part buffers, destroys the embedded field-scene-object base and resets the vtables.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_CreateSpriteFromResource
functions.summary: Creates a part's sprite from the scene resource id stored on the actor record and caches it at scene-context +0x120, then attaches the 0x70-byte wrapper holding the part frame data.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_MeshEmitter_SetupD
functions.summary: Mesh-effect part initialiser of the 0x44E6xx family: copies the definition's position into self+0x9C..0xA4, sets the visible flag self+0x118 = 1, applies the Euler rotation from def+3 and creates the mesh from the u16 id at def+6.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the multi-part object: unlinks children, destroys the embedded field-object base and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_CreateSpriteFromResourceB
functions.summary: Second sprite-from-resource path of the multi-part object: same as 0x44E4D0 but caches the created sprite in the other scene slot (+0x118).

functions.name: maybe_Field_MultiPart_InitFromLayout
functions.summary: Initializes multi-part field object from layout: copies position/rotation/scale, sets up four child part offsets, and creates sprite actor.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_DtorB
functions.summary: Third copy of the multi-part destructor body (unlink children, destroy base, free).

functions.name: maybe_Effect_ParticleEmitter_InitPoolD
functions.summary: Allocates the 0xAC-byte effect object with vtable 0x75AFFC and a 64-entry two-word pool (ctor 0x006CEC80), falling back to the default block from 0x007261B4 when the allocation is empty. Later analysis identifies 0x75AFFC as a two-state sequence node, so the object is an effect sequence, not necessarily a particle emitter.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_IsFieldUsable
functions.summary: Field-usable predicate for the multi-part class (game singleton + field not busy).

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_RegisterSymbol
functions.summary: Registers the object's symbol handle with the field symbol manager so it is drawn/tracked.

functions.name: Field_MultiPart_CreateSymbolAtSelf
functions.summary: Builds a symbol descriptor at the object's grid position (with its monster record id) and asks the scene to spawn a new symbol object.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ApplyModelAndShow
functions.summary: Applies the model record and sets the node's 'visible/active' flag to 1 through the virtual table.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnStateChangeB
functions.summary: Visibility state handler for another field scene object: forwards states 2/3 to the +0x4C sub-object virtual +0x14 with 1/0 and repeats the same dispatch on the same object.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_InitModelFromRecord
functions.summary: Initialises a symbol/model field object from a compact byte record: resolves the monster entry, sets the model size from the record's cell size, creates the sprite actor and stores the animator id.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ShowModel
functions.summary: Show hook: runs the base show and sets the model object's visible flag to 1.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_HideModel
functions.summary: Hide hook: runs the base hide and sets the model object's visible flag to 0.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CleanupActor
functions.summary: Destruction hook: releases child actors, detaches from the actor manager and unregisters the model/symbol handle.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnTouch
functions.summary: Touch/step handler: optionally plays SE 9 and sends event 0x10 with the object handle to the field command system.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorI
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a ninth Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28E6C4 then operator delete.

functions.name: Effect_ParticleEmitter_InitPoolE
functions.summary: Variant of the emitter-pool factory: 0xAC-byte object (vtable 0x0075B020), 64 two-word entries (ctor 0x006CEFC4) and defaults taken from the upper half of table 0x00725E4C (f_88..f_B4).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_IsFieldUsableE
functions.summary: Another copy of the standard field-usable predicate.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_Despawn
functions.summary: Despawn hook: calls the object's virtual despawn slot and releases its effect sprite.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SpawnStartEffect
functions.summary: Plays the 'Start' animation and spawns the object's start-up effect, storing the effect handle for later release.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ApplyModelVisibility
functions.summary: Reapplies the model record and forwards the object's 'has effect' byte to the node's visibility slot.

functions.name: Field_Prop_PlayStartMotion
functions.summary: If the prop actor is alive, plays the "Start" then "Loop" motion on it via actor vtable +0x84 and returns 1; otherwise returns 1 without playing.

functions.name: Field_Prop_PlayLoopMotion
functions.summary: Plays the "Loop"/"EndLoop" motions on the prop actor and returns 1; used while the prop animation is running.

functions.name: Effect_MeshEmitter_SetupE
functions.summary: Mesh-effect part initialiser (variant E of the 0x44E6xx-0x44F7xx family): transform, colour, mesh from the definition's id and byte flags. The letter is an ordinal over the identical-shaped siblings.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ReleaseActorAndEffect
functions.summary: Cleanup hook of the effect-sprite class: releases children, detaches from the actor manager and releases the effect sprite.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_OnTouchB
functions.summary: Second touch handler variant (guarded by f_2C7) that plays SE 9 and sends field event 0x10.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorJ
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a tenth Field_SceneObject subclass (vtable slot 0); base destructor 0x28EFB4 then operator delete.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_SpriteEmitter_SetupE
functions.summary: Configures a pure sprite (no mesh) effect emitter: one billboard child plus a shared emitter-parameter block, with the layer byte taken from the definition.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a model-based field object: destroys the embedded object (0x0028EFB4) and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePair_SetupPanels
functions.summary: Wires the two-line message widget: passes its three embedded panels (+0x248/+0x29C/+0x2F0) to the shared Ui_MessagePair_SetPanels helper and then re-links the assembled group at +0x2F0 into the widget's child list.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InitMessageArgs
functions.summary: Initialises the window message-argument records (two 11-byte blocks at f_388/f_394 from a zero template) and builds the two argument tables through the data manager, then binds them to the window.

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateMessageArgs
functions.summary: Applies message-argument changes: if the window is not yet initialised it builds the argument records, then asks the argument object to update and commits the change.

functions.name: Ui_WindowPart_UpdateTimers
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a composite UI part: refreshes the bound control, advances the part's internal timer and dispatches any of the nine slot callbacks that fired this frame.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SetMessageResource
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_SetMessageResource(UiWidget* self, unsigned resId, unsigned char flag)
functions.summary: Assigns a message/resource id to the window and tells the message object to rebuild if the id really changed; always stores the accompanying flag.

functions.name: Ui_WindowPart_SetTextWithIcon
functions.summary: Prepends the icon control code 0x0C and the text code 0x16 to the widget's string buffer, then binds the string to the whole part once.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeInfoWindow_ActivatePane8
functions.summary: Generic window activation helper: if the list at self+0x2F0 is non-empty, dispatches virtual +0x14 with selector 8 on the widget at self+0x11C and, when it reports handled, calls its +0x10 action.

functions.name: Ui_WindowPart_SetText
functions.summary: Appends only the plain text control code 0x16 to the widget's string buffer and binds it - the icon-free sibling of 0x0044FF18.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeInfo_BuildText
functions.summary: Builds the recipe/alchemy info text: fills the item name, ingredient counts and craftability message for the currently selected recipe, then binds the composed string.

functions.name: Ui_WindowPart_SetTextWithSe
functions.summary: Sets a window-part text like Ui_WindowPart_SetText (0x0044FFC0) but appends control code 0x13, triggers the one-shot vtable+0x7C path guarded by f_34d, binds the string to the slot and queues sound effect 0x0B (handle kept in f_224).

functions.name: Ui_UmaWindow_ActivatePane8
functions.summary: Identical activation helper for the horse (Uma) window class: list check at +0x2F0, then widget +0x11C virtual +0x14 with selector 8 and +0x10.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeInfo_IsUnlocked
functions.summary: Checks whether the currently selected recipe is visible/unlocked by testing the global and per-slot flag tables.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RecipeInfo_TickCraft
functions.summary: Sound-gated step: while the sound player still has the id stored at self+0x224 and the widget at self+0x2F0 is idle (+0x28 == 0), requests step 7 on the script object at self+0x11C and commits it; always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_WindowPart_RefreshMessageArgsA
functions.summary: Rebuilds the message argument of a two-value widget: it formats the value at f_350 through maybe_Ui_TextStyle_GetDescriptor into Message_SetArg slot 6 and selects text variant 0x0F (single value), 0x0D (no separator) or 0x0E+0x0F (value pair) from f_354/f_352/f_392, then rebinds the string slot.

functions.name: Ui_WindowPart_RefreshMessageArgsB
functions.summary: Variant of the message-argument rebuild that fills two message slots: slot 6 gets the outer value f_350 and slot 7 the nested value from func_001A5B4C(f_350), both formatted through maybe_Ui_TextStyle_GetDescriptor, using text variant 0x14.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeInfoWindow_ActivatePane2
functions.summary: Activation helper with selector 2 (open the second pane) on the widget at self+0x11C after the +0x2F0 list check.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeInfoWindow_ActivatePane6
functions.summary: Activation helper with selector 6 on the widget at self+0x11C after the +0x2F0 list check.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeInfo_ShowCraftMessage
functions.summary: Displays the recipe result message: takes the text-style descriptor, fills message argument 7 and binds the result text, then starts SE 0x0A.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_RecipeInfo_TickCraftB
functions.summary: Second copy of the sound-gated step: same sound id at self+0x224, same idle widget at self+0x2F0 and same step-7 request on the script object at self+0x11C, returning 1.

functions.name: Ui_Window_SetMessageArgFromEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_SetMessageArgFromEntry(u32 arg1, u16* dst, int* entry, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Copies one message argument out of a formatted message entry: either a plain 16-bit value or a string (id + length) depending on the entry kind, and mirrors it into the argument slot.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePairWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a message window that owns one message pair (vtable 0x007712EC, slot 4 = Ui_MessagePair_SetupPanels) and nine 0x18-byte message parts.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a message page: stores the class pointer, releases its pack handle, runs the named message-page / horserace-message child destructors and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_Anim_UpdateFramesOnState
functions.summary: When the requested animation range differs from the current one, plays the range-change SE and sets the animation frame of three refs (self+0x58C, self+0x5DC and self+0x50) plus the shake update, then re-syncs the attached part.

functions.name: Ui_Window_InitChildParts
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_InitChildParts(UiWindow* self, const uint8_t* layout)
functions.summary: Applies a child-part layout record to a big window: stores the layout value at +0x1964, sets the frames of the two part animations (+0x50, +0xEC) and initialises the window's row list from the layout entry when the third flag is set.

functions.name: Ui_Window_BindChildLayoutBlocks
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_BindChildLayoutBlocks(UiWindow* self, u32* rowData, u32 ctxA, u32 ctxB)
functions.summary: Walks the window's child list and re-binds the layout block of every child flagged as visible; the sentinel-tagged entries are skipped.

functions.name: Ui_ShopWindow_BindPanels
functions.summary: Binds two layout panels of the shop window to self: stores the layout object and links the panels at layout+0x40 and layout+0xC4 into the window's own intrusive nodes at +0x1978 and +0x1994.

functions.name: Ui_RaceWindow_BindPanels
functions.summary: Binds the layout pane named racing (string 0x00451204) into the window at +0x196C and turns on bit 0 of +0x44 for every child pane, mirroring Ui_ShopWindow_BindPanels.

functions.name: Field_SensorGadget_ClearChildHandles
functions.summary: Empties the two handle lists of the field sensor gadget (a field object that watches for other objects at its position), releasing all child objects.

functions.name: Field_SensorGadget_UpdateOverlapFlagA
functions.summary: Scans the gadget first handle list (+0xC) for an object of the target class (0x007C4AF4) whose OBB contains the given position (Math_Obb_ContainsPoint) and sets or clears bit 1 of the target state word f_2CC accordingly.

functions.name: maybe_Container_AddMaskedEntry08
functions.signature: void maybe_Container_AddMaskedEntry08(void* owner, const MaskedEntry* entry)
functions.summary: Appends one masked id (entry->f_C & the mask at g_004515B0) to the category list at owner+8, allocating a 0x10-byte node from the owner's heap.

functions.name: Field_SensorGadget_BreakObjectsAt
functions.summary: For every object of the gadget's target class standing at the given position it plays the break effect and the break sound.

functions.name: maybe_Container_AddMaskedEntry20
functions.signature: void maybe_Container_AddMaskedEntry20(void* owner, const MaskedEntry* entry)
functions.summary: Same masked-id append as 0x00451540, into the category list at owner+0x20 (mask g_00451784).

functions.name: maybe_Container_AddMaskedEntry14
functions.signature: void maybe_Container_AddMaskedEntry14(void* owner, const MaskedEntry* entry)
functions.summary: Same masked-id append as 0x00451540, into the category list at owner+0x14 (mask g_00451800).

functions.name: maybe_Container_AddMaskedEntry2C
functions.signature: void maybe_Container_AddMaskedEntry2C(void* owner, const MaskedEntry* entry)
functions.summary: Same masked-id append as 0x00451540, into the category list at owner+0x2C (mask g_0045187C).

functions.name: Field_SensorGadget_UpdateOverlapFlagB
functions.summary: Second sensor scan: walks the gadget second handle list (+0x24) for a target-class object containing the position, stores the found handle in target f_2D0 and sets bit 3 of f_2CC (clears both when nothing is found).

functions.name: Field_FindNearbyActorsAndFlag
functions.summary: Scans the object list at self+0x2C, resolves each entry through the 0x7B80C0 handle table, filters by RTTI 0x7C4B58, and for entries within their radius (squared distance <= +0x2D4^2) marks target+0x2D4/+0x2D5 and calls 0x472030.

functions.name: Container_MultiList_ClearAll
functions.summary: Destroys four intrusive lists embedded at +8, +0x14, +0x20 and +0x2C: unlinks every node, clears the low 11 bits of node+0xC, frees the node with operator delete, and finally re-initialises each list head.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Text_IncrementDigitString
functions.summary: Rolls a decimal digit string (used by counter/score displays) by incrementing digits with carry, seeding the local buffer from 'null_txt_0'.

functions.name: Ui_List_HandleInputPad
functions.summary: Translates one frame of pad input into list operations: reads the key state, dispatches keys 0..8 to six different virtual handlers of the list's controller (confirm, cancel, up, down, left, right), clears the UI mode word for the handled keys and finally applies the analog-stick direction as a step on the list's +0x3C slot.

functions.name: Ui_Cursor_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the UI cursor: base object ctor, vtable 0x75A184 (whose slot 1 is Ui_Cursor_Dtor), and three 0x50-byte cursor icon parts at +0x4C.

functions.name: Ui_Cursor_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the cursor object: restores the UiCursor vtable 0x0075A184, destroys the three 0x50-byte cursor-icon parts at +0x4C and frees.

functions.name: Ui_Cursor_DtorBase
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor of the cursor object: restores the UiCursor vtable, destroys the three 0x50-byte cursor-icon parts and returns.

functions.name: Ui_TextFormat_SetMemberNameAndTwoValues
functions.summary: Sets message argument slots 2, 8 and 9 for the member behind self->f_208: slot 2 the padded name (+0xCA), slot 8 '%d' of the byte at (self->f_A8 + 0xB105) and slot 9 '%d' of the byte at +0xB106, all into the slots' inline buffers.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ChildTransform_UpdateRotatedRow
functions.summary: Lays out the up-to-0x20 children stored at self+0xB64 as a rotating row: derives each child position/rotation from the parent transform and the ring angle, toggles visibility flags and finally reports the visible mask to the pack object through func_00613A10.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ChildTransform_CreateRowChildren
functions.summary: Creates up to 32 numbered child panes from the ASCII digit template at 0x007BFA7E: it increments the trailing digits with carry, builds each pane through the layout factory (vtable+0x2C of self->f_A8), stores the pointers after the u16 id pair at self+0xB64, and hides the children whose bit is clear in the mask returned by 0x0066B64C(bagWork, f_B64, f_B66).

functions.name: Ui_ChildTransform_ApplyVisibilityMask
functions.summary: Re-confirmed from previous naming pass; function behavior described in readable C supports the name but no new high-confidence evidence.

functions.name: Ui_ItemInfoWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the item-info window (builds its list header at self+0x26C, installs vtable 0x783064/0x729D20, calls base 0x2F6B70 and operator delete).

functions.name: Ui_StampWindow_UpdateSelectedStamp
functions.signature: void Ui_StampWindow_UpdateSelectedStamp(UiStampWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Recomputes which stamp of the stamp book is selected from the global stamp counter and the window's page offset, and tells the stamp renderer to highlight it.

functions.name: Ui_GuideWindow_SetPageText
functions.summary: Sets the guide window's page text element to the string for the given text id.

functions.name: Ui_StampWindow_RefreshStamps
functions.summary: Rebuilds the stamp book page: binds the pager numbers, creates one 'stamp_%02d' entry per stamp slot with its obtained/complete state and shows the completion banner when the page is full.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_ResetIfReleased
functions.summary: If the pane at self+0x1680 still exists and 0x649BF4 reports it as released, clears the pointer and disables all non-base children; otherwise re-enables only base children.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_FindComponent
functions.summary: Looks up a component of the widget by walking the single-linked component chain hanging off self+0xa8 and comparing against a global type tag.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_BindAndEnable
functions.signature: void Ui_Pane_BindAndEnable(void* self, void* node, void* reader, void* out)
functions.summary: Binds a serialized pane reference while re-enabling children: disables non-base children, publishes the value at reader+0x60C, resolves reader vtable +0x24 into node, re-enables all children and copies the pane handle to out+0xB0.

functions.name: Ui_StampWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: void Ui_StampWindow_Ctor(UiStampWindow* self, const int* initValues)
functions.summary: Constructor of the stamp (kondate/stamp) card window: installs vtable 0x771478 and copies four init values to +0x11C..+0x128, then constructs the 0x23 stamp rows of 0x9C bytes at +0x12C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Screen_DtorDelete_2
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a large screen object: destroys the 0x9C-stride sub-widget array (0x23 entries), the nested widget at -0x1684 and frees the screen.

functions.name: Ui_SixLineTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Six-row text window: txt_l1..txt_l6 with null overlays, followed by an extra per-window setup call and a refresh.

functions.name: Ui_SixRowChildLayout_Start
functions.summary: For each of the six row type bytes it looks the type up in the lazily built shared table (0x007BE310, entries 0x10 bytes) and, for types below 5 that resolve, starts that row child-layout animation by writing node id (row | f_28<<16).

functions.name: Ui_Object_DeletingDtorA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a UI object subclass: UI base destructor plus free.

functions.name: Ui_SixRowCountList_Populate
functions.summary: Fills the six rows of a count list: binds each row's icon, the per-owner matching count from the bag/skill helpers and a total, and blanks unused rows.

functions.name: Ui_ThreePairNumberWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Number-cell initialiser: six iterations cover three rows times two columns, and each cell binds four panes named txt_{l|r}N_num1, _num1_1, _num1_2 and _num1_3 (24 panes in total).

functions.name: Ui_ThreePairNumberWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the three-pair number window (three label/value pairs): base object ctor plus vtable 0x77152C whose pane-init slot is Ui_ThreePairNumberWindow_InitPanes.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Second deleting destructor of a UI object subclass (base destructor plus free).

functions.name: Ui_SixRowCountList_SetEntries
functions.summary: Applies up to six new entry ids to the count list: copies them in, pads the rest with 0xFF, refreshes each row's icon and count text, recomputes the total and selects the first row.

functions.name: Ui_SixRowCountList_Refresh
functions.signature: void Ui_SixRowCountList_Refresh(UiSixRowList* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Recomputes the six rows from the ids already stored in the object (no new entry array): refreshes icons, per-row counts and the total, and raises the alpha block matching the row count.

functions.name: Ui_GoldSelectWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Six-row gold/detail window: txt_lN and txt_rN row pairs with null overlays, the 'txt_gold_r' total label and four select cursors (select3..select6).

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_InitParts
functions.summary: Placement-constructs the four 0x50-byte sub-parts of the skill-panel window inside the caller's object and returns the panel base pointer.

functions.name: Ui_GoldSelectWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the gold-select window: installs vtable 0x00771590, releases the four layout references at +0x140, +0xF0, +0xA0 and +0x50, runs the UI base destructor and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: Ui_GoldSelectWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor twin of 0x00453AF8: installs vtable 0x00771590, releases the layout references at +0x140, +0xF0, +0xA0 and +0x50 and tail-calls the UI base destructor.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_SelectAnimByPartState
functions.signature: extern void Ui_Part_SelectAnimByPartState(UiPart* self, u32 partIndex, u32 animIndex, maybe_Ui_Part_SelectAnimByPartState;
functions.summary: Selects and starts a part animation from the model's animation list: resolves the part at self+0x54..+0x5C by partIndex, looks up the anim record (0x6479CC / 0x646060 / 0x647A88) and hands it to the animation state machine. Part of the body is lost in the Ghidra export (halt_baddata).

functions.name: Ui_PlateWindow_UpdateText
functions.summary: Large text/plate update: formats descriptor strings (Ui_Plate_FormatFullDescriptor 0x647724), sets text through Ui_TextLayer_SetText 0x1A629C/0x1A6680 and copies colour bytes from a global plate state 0x7A9320.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_SelectEntryByCursor
functions.summary: Selects the entry under the list cursor: fetches the bound list (vtable+0x58) and selects row (self[0x14]-1) combined with the window id in the high half.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_MoveSelectionThunk
functions.signature: void Ui_ListWindow_MoveSelectionThunk(UiListWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Vtable slot (0x007716A4) of a Ui_Object-derived list window: when the owner-active gate 0x0062AF84 reports true it forwards the call unchanged to Ui_ListWindow_MoveSelection, otherwise it does nothing.

functions.name: Ui_TenRowTextWindow_FillRows
functions.summary: Fills the ten text rows of a paged window from its entry table, blanking rows past the end, then updates the pager to the current page remainder.

functions.name: Ui_ListView_UpdateItemCountAndVisibility
functions.summary: Synchronises a list view with its backing array: computes the element count from the begin/end pointers, calls Container_SetCountFromByteSize, dispatches the list virtual +0x6C, then copies the count into the two row sub-widgets at +0xE8/+0xEC and updates visibility.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListView_MoveSelectedItem
functions.summary: Unlinks a list item node and updates pointers at self+0xF4 using intrusive list helper 0x001235A4.

functions.name: Ui_NumberPlate_UpdateDigits
functions.summary: Formats a multi-digit numeric plate: copies two colour descriptors from pc-relative tables, walks the digit string swapping the characters '9'/\0, and re-emits each digit through the text layer virtual +0x34 (up to 10 digits).

functions.name: Ui_TenRowTextWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the ten-row text window: base ctor 0x2B1E0C, vtable 0x75EB0C, one scroller sub-object (0x622248) with 10 rows and ten 0xC-byte row records.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Pack_LoadLayout
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_Pack_LoadLayout(UiPackOwner* self, unsigned packName, char* name)
functions.summary: Opens a UI layout pack for a screen: builds the '<name>.pack' path with 0x006F0C10, opens/loads the pack and swaps the cached handle into self->f_828.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutAnim_AddOffset
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutAnim_AddOffset(UiLayoutAnimSet* self, int index, const float* delta, u32 easing)
functions.summary: Adds a 2D offset to the current position of one animated layout value (index selects one of the 0x74-byte entries) and re-targets the value with the given easing type.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutAnim_SetTwoValues
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutAnim_SetTwoValues(UiLayoutAnimSet* self, int index, const float* v1, const float* v2, u32 easing)
functions.summary: Re-targets two animated values of the same layout entry (the pair at +0x1C and the pair at +0x38) with one shared easing type.

functions.name: Ui_Pack_LoadLayoutChecked
functions.summary: Checked layout-pack loader: returns 0 when the pack cannot be opened, otherwise runs the same open/'%s.pack'/Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple chain as 0x4546A8 and reports whether the new handle was accepted into +0x828.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LayoutAnim_SetTarget
functions.summary: Twelve-byte tail-branch into Anim_Tween_SetTarget (0x006E6F04); all arguments stay in registers, so neither the target nor the easing can be read.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutAnim_UpdateAll
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the 18 animated layout values: advances each value's five 2D tracks toward their targets, then sorts the 18 entries by the layout's comparator and uploads the two active entries per screen (device+0x10B0 + screen*0x20) including the eased position, size and alpha pairs.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutAnim_Reset
functions.summary: Resets the UI layout animation set: clears the screen-effect ids at device+0x123C/+0x125C, releases the layout resource handle at +0x828 and re-initialises all 18 value entries to their default (zero) tracks.

functions.name: Field_EggJumpAction_GetTrajectoryPoint
functions.summary: Reads the jump trajectory sample at self+8+index*0x74 and passes it (with an empty stack vector and the float argument) to 0x6E7090, which returns the interpolated point.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LayoutObject_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the layout object: constructs the inline array, ORs the pool mask into the packed flag word at +0x828, clears +0x82C, calls Ui_LayoutAnim_Reset and returns the object pointer.

functions.name: Ui_Pack_UnloadLayout
functions.summary: Unloads the cached UI layout pack: resets the owner (Ui_LayoutAnim_Reset), releases the handle at +0x828 and wipes the 0x12 per-entry blocks with the class fill pattern.

functions.name: Field_EggJumpAction_SetActorFlashFlags
functions.summary: Queries 0x29E488 and writes the resulting byte into +0x128 of the actor and of every actor in the list at self+0x34 (flash/blink flag).

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_InitState
functions.summary: Initialises an actor action: detects the special state byte 'x', stores the action-state flag/timer and plays the action's start sound when the actor is not in that special state.

functions.name: Field_EggJumpAction_SyncChildPositions
functions.summary: Copies the jump offset at self+0x34+0x1C into the actor position field +0x9C, then copies one float per child in the +0x34 list into each child's +0x9C.

functions.name: Actor_Action_UpdateState
functions.summary: Two-state actor action tick: state 1 accumulates the delay, records the actors' x positions and advances to state 2; state 2 runs the member-fade follow-up.

functions.name: Actor_Action_End
functions.summary: Ends a scripted actor action: restores the party member models in states 1/2, releases the actor through 0x0022DB08 and resets the field UI/overlay state through 0x00239A1C on work+0x48.

functions.name: Actor_Action_TableEntryCtor
functions.summary: Constructs one entry of the actor action table: initialises the base action and fills the entry's data fields (two 4-word blocks) with defaults.

functions.name: Ui_TextSpanList_Release
functions.summary: Destroys the span list: releases every span through the layout package, clears the count, then deletes the list object itself.

functions.name: Actor_Action_ReadParams
functions.summary: Loads the action's runtime parameters (state, timer, ids) from the actor action record.

functions.name: Actor_Action_TableEntryCtorB
functions.summary: Second variant of the action-table entry constructor (different vtable and default id 0xFF).

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_DtorBase
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small field actor-action base class: calls 0x294C24 and operator delete; the vtable's next slot is maybe_Actor_Action_ReadParams.

functions.name: Field_EggJumpAction_RestoreActorPosition
functions.summary: Stops the actor animation (virtual +0x88), copies the saved position +0x3C8/+0x3CC/+0x3D0 back into +0x9C/+0xA0/+0xA4 and sets the position-dirty flag +0x118=1.

functions.name: Field_EggJumpAction_ReleaseSubObject
functions.summary: Releases the sub-object at self+0x2C (virtual +0x14 with 0) and, when it reports handled, calls its +0x10 teardown.

functions.name: Actor_Action_ResetActorState
functions.summary: Resets the actor for a new action: clears the overlay animation, sets the action timer constant, clears the actor animation and plays animation id 4.

functions.name: Field_EggJumpAction_OnEvent
functions.summary: On event id 0xD it sets the sub-object at self+0x2C to mode 2 through 0x6CF670; all other events are ignored.

functions.name: Field_EggJumpAction_Update
functions.summary: Main update of the egg-jump action: validates the actor, decrements the timer +0xD0, interpolates the arc position into +0xC8, writes the actor transform +0x100..+0x108, and indexes a 7-entry motion table at +0x34 to play the next jump phase.

functions.name: Actor_Action_EggJumpUpdate

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_Begin
functions.summary: Start method of the Dragon Jump action: stops the actor animation, sets frame 4, clears the jump flags (+0x14c..+0x14e) and requests the state (0, 2 or 5) that matches the actor's jump variant byte (+0x3f0), committing the request if accepted.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_DragonJumpBaseUpdate
functions.summary: Common update of an actor jump action: derives the horizontal displacement from the actor's position delta, scales it by the action's speed factor (self+0x140 = 1/3) and applies the delta matrix to the actor node.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_OnEvent
functions.summary: Animation-event hook of the Dragon Jump action: event 13 (0xD, the end of the 'JumpM_Up_Loop' animation) raises the loop-finished flag read by the up-loop update.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpMUpLoopUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the 'Dragon_JumpM_Up_Loop' segment: plays the loop animation, moves the actor along the stored velocity for the frame delta, and when the animation time budget is used up requests jump state 4.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpMDownLoopUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the Dragon-Jump 'M down loop' element: sets the model's anim name to Dragon_JumpM_Down_Loop, scales the fall speed (halved when the actor's +0x3F1 flag is set) and applies the frame displacement to the actor node.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpAirDriftUpdate
functions.summary: Airborne hold state: keeps adding a constant drift vector to the actor position each frame; when the remaining height (+0x3d8 - +0xa0) drops below zero it requests jump state 7.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpSStartUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the Dragon-Jump 'S start' element: sets the anim name, computes the jump arc (horizontal distance vs. gravity constants) and derives the vertical speed factor, scale and duration stored in f_13C..f_148.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpMUpStartUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the Dragon-Jump 'M up start' element: names the model animation 'Dragon_JumpM_Up_StartSE' and applies the frame displacement/rotation to the actor node.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpMUpEnd_Start
functions.summary: Prepares the 'Dragon_JumpM_Up_End' segment: plays the end animation, converts the remaining horizontal distance and height into per-frame speeds over (animationFrames-2) ticks and stores the half-frame vertical step.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpSEnd_Update
functions.summary: Update for the short jump's landing segment: switches from 'Dragon_JumpS_End' to 'Dragon_JumpS_Loop' when the animation runs past frame 14, clamps the vertical speed so the actor cannot overshoot the ground, and requests state 8 when the tick budget runs out.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_LerpToStartPose
functions.summary: Eases the actor position and height toward the stored jump start pose at 0.15 per frame and then requests state 3; used as the recovery/return segment after a jump.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpMUpEnd_Update
functions.summary: Continuation of the 'M Up End' segment: counts the ticks down, keeps the vertical speed inside the remaining height, moves the actor along the horizontal velocity plus the vertical component, and requests state 8 when the timer expires.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpMDownEndUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the Dragon-Jump 'M down end' element: sets the anim name, computes the landing distance/height factors from the actor's position delta and writes the final frame data.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpMDownStartUpdate
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the Dragon-Jump 'M down start' element: sets the anim name, applies the frame displacement and derives the fall speed from the anim length.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_QueueEndState
functions.summary: Jump segment that queues the landing state: when its tick budget expires it appends state id 8 to the action's pending-state array (self+0x40, count self+0x48) unless it is already queued; meanwhile it moves the actor and recomputes the vertical speed so the landing height is exact.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_AdvanceOnAnimEnd
functions.summary: Short airborne segment: integrates the stored velocity each frame and requests jump state 6 as soon as the animation reports finished.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_Action_DragonJumpAnim5Update
functions.summary: Actor-action update that takes its animation from animation-table entry 5 (func_0063D6B8(manager,5)) and then applies the frame displacement to the actor node.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_LerpAndRestart
functions.summary: Eases toward the jump start pose at 0.2 per frame and restarts the action (state 1) once the elapsed time (+0x34) passes ~1.0 s.

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the Dragon Jump action: advances the shared timer and the active element, invokes the element's bound delegate (9 element slots of 0x18 bytes at self+0x60), and when the action-finished flag is raised resolves the owning actor from the global id map and marks it (+0x314 = 0, +0x318 = 1).

functions.name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_End
functions.summary: Stop method of the Dragon Jump action: stops the actor animation and puts it back on animation frame 4 so the actor returns to a neutral pose.
