functions.summary: Resolves member active buff/debuff modifiers into combat calculation multipliers.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Action_TestFlag80OrMemberHandFlag
functions.signature: u8 maybe_Battle_Action_TestFlag80OrMemberHandFlag(void* unit, int hand, u8* action)
functions.summary: Battle action predicate: requires unit+0x10 and action+0x10 to be non-zero, then returns true when the spell id at action[0] resolves to a record whose +0x2E8 has bit 0x80 set (or, when action[0] is 0xFF, the skill id at action[1] resolves to +0xFF with bit 0x80), and otherwise falls back to the acting member's per-hand byte +0xDED (hand 0) / +0xDEE.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RollResistanceChance
functions.summary: Chance roll against a unit's resistance class: looks up the target record (id arg2->f_76C), maps its class byte f_CE (0..6) to a weight 1/8/16/32/64/128/256, combines it with the attacker's f_3EC value and a random roll on the battle RNG, and returns whether the roll succeeds; a class outside 0..6 returns false.

functions.name: Text_ApplyRowStyle
functions.signature: void Text_ApplyRowStyle(int arg1, int arg2, int arg3, int * arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7)
functions.summary: Applies a row style/template to a battle message row: copies the style words, sets the visible flag and applies the layout variant for the current row kind.

functions.name: Battle_CalcSkillDamageMultiplier
functions.summary: Computes damage multiplier for physical combat skills.

functions.name: Battle_CalcSpellDamageMultiplier
functions.summary: Computes magical damage multiplier scaling with Magical Might.

functions.name: Battle_CalcDefenseReduction
functions.summary: Calculates defense damage reduction according to target resilience.

functions.name: Battle_Message_IsRowVisible
functions.summary: Returns whether a message row is currently visible: the flag byte must carry bit 2 and the message object must have either the 0x73 or 0xCB marker.

functions.name: Battle_CalcElementalDamage
functions.signature: int Battle_CalcElementalDamage(int damage, int elementId, void* target)
functions.summary: Applies target elemental weakness or resistance percentage to calculated damage.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RollStatusProc
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_RollStatusProc(void* actor, void* target, int statusId)
functions.summary: Rolls 1..100 on the battle RNG and compares it with a game-setting threshold (record f_144/f_145/f_146) selected by the actor value (10..12, 8 or 2); returns 1 when the roll passes. Target must be alive (f_10) with f_768==0 and the global at work+0x2771B set.

functions.name: Battle_RollCriticalOrHitRate
functions.summary: Determines whether an attack hits, misses, is dodged, or scores a critical hit.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_UpdateComputedStat
functions.summary: Recomputes a bounded percentage for a battle unit: takes 100.0 or the value produced by Battle_CalcRandomDamageVariance when the unit's virtual +0xE8 reports flag 0x41/0x42, scales it by 0.01 against 200.0, compares it with the sum of the character-work fields f_A20+f_DE0+f_11A0 and notifies when the result changes.

functions.name: Battle_ApplyElementalResistances
functions.signature: int Battle_ApplyElementalResistances(void* target, int damage, int elementFlags)
functions.summary: Adjusts damage by target elemental resistance flags (fire, ice, wind, lightning, light, dark).

functions.name: Battle_Message_BuildRow
functions.signature: u64 Battle_Message_BuildRow(int arg1, int arg2, int * arg3, int arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Builds one battle message row from the message id: selects the caller-provided or stored row template, then applies the per-kind layout (row kinds 0x00/0x01/0x02/0x03/0x07/0x08/0x0A) and marks the row dirty.

functions.name: Battle_CalcSkillParamValue
functions.signature: int Battle_CalcSkillParamValue(void* out, const void* arg2, void* owner)
functions.summary: Computes a skill-derived combat value from a weapon/ability parameter record: if the record has an extra id it rolls base +/- variance around that sub-record, otherwise it selects skill 0x4E/0x4F/0x50 from the parameter type 0x94/0x96/0x97 and interpolates between the skill record's min and max fields, finally clamping and returning a short.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CalcSkillParamValueEx
functions.signature: int maybe_Battle_CalcSkillParamValueEx(void* out, const void* arg2, void* owner)
functions.summary: Battle-time twin of Battle_CalcSkillParamValue: resolves skill 0x4E/0x4F/0x50 from the parameter type, interpolates the skill record's min/max fields with an RNG variance and returns the short value; called while a member's queued battle actions execute.

functions.name: Battle_EvaluateStatusConditions
functions.summary: Evaluates active status conditions (poison, sleep, paralysis, confusion) at turn boundaries.

functions.name: Battle_RollAilmentInfliction
functions.signature: u32 Battle_RollAilmentInfliction(void* target, int ailmentId, int baseRate)
functions.summary: Computes status ailment hit rate considering target status immunities and resistances.

functions.name: Battle_Message_RowIsActive
functions.summary: Decides whether the optional battle-message row (type 0x75 or 0x11B) is shown: checks the row type, verifies the member's equipped item record flag, then rolls the battle RNG in [1,100] and compares it with the row's random threshold.

functions.name: Battle_RollMemberProcChance
functions.summary: When the actor is flagged active (+0x10), resolves its party member from the character id (func_0035EB98), rolls 1..100 with the battle RNG and returns 1 when the roll is <= the member's float chance at +0xB74.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RollResistanceChanceB
functions.summary: Second resistance-chance roll, keyed on the neighbouring record byte f_CF: same 0..6 class -> weight switch and the same battle-RNG roll, without the attacker-value threshold shortcut of 0x00488470.

functions.name: maybe_Party_MapMemberIndexToSlot
functions.summary: Maps a party member index to the displayed battle slot number: normally 1..8 for indices 0..7 and 9 for 0x1B, but 0x0B..0x13 for the same indices when the member record's +0xEDC byte is set; finally calls 0x0063FD68(dm, slot). Returns 0 for unknown indices.

functions.name: Battle_Enemy_GetDisplaySlot
functions.summary: Maps a monster index to its on-screen display slot: resolves the monster record for the work's f_768 id and maps 0..7 to slots 1..9 and 0x1B to 0xF (the same table as 0x48B150); returns 0 when the work has no monster.

functions.name: Battle_ApplyDamageClamp
functions.signature: int Battle_ApplyDamageClamp(int rawDamage, int minDamage, int maxDamage)
functions.summary: Clamps calculated combat damage to valid game bounds (1 to 9999).

functions.name: Battle_Message_ApplyRowLayout
functions.signature: void Battle_Message_ApplyRowLayout(u32 arg1, int arg2, u32 * arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7)
functions.summary: Master row-layout dispatcher: looks up the row template, then switches on the row kind (0x01/0x02..0x05/0x08..0x0B/0x0F..0x12/0x13/0x24/0x25) to call the appropriate geometry helper for every cell of the row.

functions.name: Text_CalcRowWidthFromActor
functions.signature: int Text_CalcRowWidthFromActor(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, int * arg3)
functions.summary: The actor-anchored row-width calculation: it takes the minimum of the actor available width and the scaled row height.

functions.name: Battle_CalcSkillMpCostOrBonus
functions.summary: Calculates effective MP cost of skill or spell, applying MP conservation traits (+0xB78/+0xF38).

functions.name: Battle_RollMultiHitDamage
functions.signature: int Battle_RollMultiHitDamage(void* actor, void* target, int hitIndex, int baseDamage)
functions.summary: Calculates individual strike damage for multi-hit attacks (e.g. Falcon Slash, Multithrust).

functions.name: Battle_ApplyDamageScaleRatio
functions.signature: int Battle_ApplyDamageScaleRatio(int damage, int num, int denom)
functions.summary: Scales combat damage by fixed-point ratio.

functions.name: Battle_MonsterUi_ResolveRowType
functions.summary: The monster row-type/state selector: it switches on the actor config bytes and returns the row kind to display.

functions.name: Battle_MonsterUi_CalcStatValue
functions.signature: void Battle_MonsterUi_CalcStatValue(u32 arg1, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Computes a monster stat value for display: resolves the stat record (0x48ECE8) and otherwise measures the formatted value through MonsterUI_Dispatch, writing the result into the row.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CalcAttackMultiplier_Prologue
functions.summary: Not a callable function: the 24 bytes are only the ARM prologue (save r4/r5/r7, vpush d8-d10, reserve 0x1C bytes) that falls through into the real body at 0x0048C4A8, maybe_Battle_CalcAttackMultiplier_Body.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CalcAttackMultiplier_Body
functions.summary: Interior body of battle combat math function 0x0048C490: tests active battle state, reads party member weapon ID and looks up ItemRecord.

functions.name: Battle_MonsterUi_ResolveStatRow
functions.summary: The monster stat-row resolver: it combines the current stat value and condition/effect flags into the row record.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CheckStatusItemGate
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_CheckStatusItemGate(void* unit, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Returns 1 only when the unit's vtable status queries for ids 0x5C..0x5F all report zero AND the party member mapped by unit[0x1DA] holds item 0x8B in one of the 24 inventory slots. Buff/debuff application calls it to decide whether to skip the normal apply path.

functions.name: Monster_FormatEffectText
functions.signature: void Monster_FormatEffectText(u32 effectId, int kind, int member, MonsterWork* work, u32 arg5, u8 arg6, u8 arg7)
functions.summary: Builds the eight battle message layout rows for an effect cast: copies the default layout table for the effect id, fills the parameter block from the caster/monster record and appends the rows through 0x00326428; kind selects the cast/effect/resist variant.

functions.name: Text_CalcRowSpacing
functions.signature: u32 Text_CalcRowSpacing(int arg1, int arg2, u32 arg3, int* arg4)
functions.summary: Computes the vertical spacing around a row: 100.0 or 62.5 pixels depending on the row kind (0x22), scaled by 0.01, and marks the layout dirty.

functions.name: Battle_ApplyCombatBuffDebuff
functions.signature: void Battle_ApplyCombatBuffDebuff(void* unit, int statKind, int stageChange)
functions.summary: Applies stat buff or debuff stages (e.g. Oomph, Kabuff, Sap, Kasap) to combat unit.

functions.name: Battle_CalcTargetResistanceModifier
functions.summary: Looks up target resistance multiplier for given attack attribute.

functions.name: Text_ClampRowWidth
functions.signature: int Text_ClampRowWidth(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Clamps a computed row width to zero: delegates to 0x48E7F4 and replaces negative results with 0.

functions.name: Text_UpdateRowBlink
functions.summary: Updates the blink/alpha animation of a message row: switches over the visibility flags 0x79/0x7A/0x9F/0xC2 and interpolates towards the target alpha, marking the layout dirty when it changes.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_AnimateMemberStatBar
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_AnimateMemberStatBar(u32 scratch, MonsterWork* work, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, int which)
functions.summary: Updates one displayed member stat: when the guard byte +0x10 is set it looks the party member up by work+0x768, picks +0xB58 or +0xB5C by 'which', compares it with the displayed value at +0xF18 plus the delta, rescales through 0x00487FC0 and calls 0x00496164 to refresh the condition/stat display.

functions.name: Text_GetRowRecordCopy
functions.summary: Returns a mutable copy of a text-row template: copies the 0x63FD24 record's ten header words, its 0x1E-byte block, four more fields at +0x46..+0x52 and the two trailing string fields into the caller's buffer (the apparent stack locals are the structure-return buffer).

functions.name: Battle_Monster_GetStateIcon
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Monster_GetStateIcon(u32 monsterId, BattleWork* work, int slotOrFlag, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Returns the status icon index (0..6, 0xFF = none) for a battle monster: the record's own state byte f_295 wins, otherwise the f_2E8 bits and the battle work's action rows 0x62/99/100/0x65/0x66/0x67 pick the display state, with the equipped item's state as the fallback.

functions.name: Battle_Actor_GetStateIcon
functions.summary: Party-actor twin of Battle_Monster_GetStateIcon: returns f_DD when set, otherwise uses the f_FF flag bits with the battle work's action rows 0x62/99/100/0x65/0x66/0x67 to pick icon 0..6, falling back to the equipped item's state.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RollUnitVisibilityChance
functions.summary: Probability gate used when syncing battle unit models: for kinds 2/8/10/11/12/0x90 it succeeds outright when the model record's +0x108 flag is set, otherwise it rolls the battle RNG against 25%; kinds 3/9 roll against 12.5% or 67.5% depending on the same flag. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: Text_IsRowVisible
functions.signature: u32 Text_IsRowVisible(int * self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Visibility gate shared by the battle row builders: true when the object carries flag 0x85 or the game is in battle mode (+0x4208 == 0x0B).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RollActionStatusChance
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_RollActionStatusChance(u32 actionId, u32 unitArg, void* target, void* result, int variant)
functions.summary: Rolls an action's status-effect chance against a target: resolves the action row (or the SkillRecord it points at), computes the chance with Battle_ResolveMemberCombatModifiers, compares a 1..100 battle-RNG roll, then calls maybe_Battle_RollStatusProc and tests the target's immunity; sets result->f_54 and returns 1 when the status lands.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CalcSkillEffectValue
functions.signature: int maybe_Battle_CalcSkillEffectValue(void* skillRef, void* unit, int varianceMode)
functions.summary: Computes a skill effect value from the skill record's min/max/threshold/curve fields: picks the unit stat selected by record+0xDF (unit+0x24 or +0x26), interpolates between record+0xC4/+0xC6 using the +0xC8 threshold and +0xCA cap, then adds a battle-RNG variance from record+0xCE (forced to -value for mode 1 or +value for mode 2).

functions.name: Text_CalcRowHeightEx
functions.signature: int Text_CalcRowHeightEx(int arg1, int row, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, int arg5, int arg6)
functions.summary: Computes the height of a text row including the 1.0/1.2 line scaling and the row padding, storing the result in the row at +0x52.

functions.name: Text_UpdateBlinkStateA
functions.summary: Blink-state updater for the row flag family 0x2C..0x2F/0xA5: resolves the currently set flag, scales it and refreshes the layout.

functions.name: Text_UpdateBlinkStateB
functions.summary: Blink-state updater for the row flag family 0x34..0x37.

functions.name: Battle_MonsterUi_CheckStatusIcons
functions.summary: Asks the monster UI whether status keys 0x6A/0x6B are active and returns 0xFFFFFFED (-19) or 0xFFFFFFEC (-20), or 0 when neither is set - the row code uses these as 'display the status icon' result codes.

functions.name: Party_Member_GetAttackCount
functions.summary: Returns the member's number of attack instances: 2 when the equipped slot-0 item kind is 0x11 (falcon, two hits) or the member has an off-hand weapon, otherwise 1.

functions.name: Text_FindMarkerRow
functions.summary: Scans the layout rows of a message id and returns the index of the first marker row (characters 0x3E..0x47 in byte +0x58).

functions.name: Battle_Monster_UpdateStatBar
functions.summary: The monster stat-bar update: it applies the bar scale, refreshes the display slot and delegates to the agility updater out of range.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_GetEffectValue
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Monster_GetEffectValue(int arg1, int * arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: The monster effect-row value getter: it formats the effect text and returns the scaled value stored at row+0x2A.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Row_UpdateIfKindMatches
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Row_UpdateIfKindMatches(char* self, void* unit, int arg3)
functions.summary: Compares the row's two stored ids with the unit's data-table record fields (+0xA and +0xB) and, when either matches and arg3 is 0, advances the battle RNG at +0x4218. The RNG result is discarded in the decompilation, so the visible effect is only the callee's side effect.

functions.name: Battle_Action_GetEffectValue
functions.summary: Returns the action's effect value as a float: special units (+0x10 set) go through Battle_Monster_GetEffectValue, ordinary units convert the action record's u16 fields +0x13C/+0x13E/+0x140/+0x142 to float, each guarded by the flag bytes +0x189/+0x187/+0x185/+0x184.

functions.name: Text_MeasureRowByTemplate
functions.signature: int Text_MeasureRowByTemplate(int arg1, int * arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: The template-based row measurement: it builds the nine-field 100.0-height template, runs the shared layout engine and writes the error code.

functions.name: Battle_CalcSkillDefenseReduction
functions.summary: Calculates effective target defense against skills that partially ignore armor.

functions.name: Text_CalcRowGeometry
functions.signature: void Text_CalcRowGeometry(int arg1, u32* row, int arg3)
functions.summary: Lays out one text row: fills the row layout context (Text_Row_Init/Text_Row_TryLayout, Text_CalcGlyphAdvance) and copies the measured rectangle into the row; message id 0x33 is special-cased.

functions.name: Text_BuildRowForTarget
functions.signature: int Text_BuildRowForTarget(u32 arg1, int arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8)
functions.summary: Builds a target/actor message row: resolves the row template, then applies the width/height flags (0x10/0x20 bit in +0x2E8) and the measured text box.

functions.name: maybe_Monster_GetAttackStat
functions.summary: Three-field monster stat computation for the battle UI: the raw branch returns f_738+f_EB8+f_AF8, the scaled branch uses vtable+0x1C, func_0048B278(work)->f_C and the g_0048FDC4/CC/D8/D0 multipliers, then marks the row layout dirty.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_GetHpBarAnchor
functions.signature: float Battle_Monster_GetHpBarAnchor(BattleUnit* unit, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the monster's HP bar vertical anchor offset as a float in VFP register s0: for special units forwards directly to Battle_Monster_CalcHpBarAnchor (0x0049627C), otherwise loads monster model record via 0x0063E5C8 and reads u16 offset +0xDC as float.

functions.name: Text_GetRowAdvance
functions.summary: Returns the advance to use after a fixed message row (0x18/0xA4/0xA5): the message object width from vtable 0x98, or 0 for other rows.

functions.name: maybe_Party_GetMemberCombatStats
functions.summary: Returns two float combat stats for a party member: reads the member record through 0x0035EB98 and the triple +0x740 / +0xEC0 + +0xB00, with an extra slot lookup and float scaling when the member flag +0xDA bit 7 is set.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_UpdateMpBar
functions.summary: The monster MP-bar update: it scales the current MP and refreshes the bar rectangle, falling back to the stat formatter for an invalid actor.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_GetHpBarRatio
functions.summary: Computes the HP-bar fill of a battle monster: takes the record max at f_26, compares the current ratio with 1% and marks the layout dirty on a change; the value is returned in s0.

functions.name: Battle_CalcSpellEffectTotal
functions.signature: int Battle_CalcSpellEffectTotal(u32 spellId, void* row, u32 target, float scale, u32 arg5, int applyLayout, int arg7)
functions.summary: Evaluates a spell's eight 0x2C-byte effect entries (row kind 5) against a target, sums their values with the RNG variance, and when the spell's +0x296 flag is clear instead lays out the eight default rows; writes the resulting short to row+4.

functions.name: Battle_Message_BuildRowForMonster
functions.signature: int Battle_Message_BuildRowForMonster(int arg1, int arg2, int * arg3, u32 arg4, int arg5, int arg6, u32 arg7)
functions.summary: Builds a monster message row: handles the battle value rows 0x18/0xA4/0xA5, computes the bar offsets from the actor box (+0xC4..+0xCE) and applies the 0.01-scaled row geometry.

functions.name: Battle_ApplyEquipCategoryDamageModifier
functions.summary: Scales a battle damage value by the equipment category of the unit's slot-0 item: resolves the party member and its equipped item, reads ItemRecord+0x29 and picks one of four coefficients (f_114/f_118/f_11C, default f_120) from the data-manager record returned by 0x0063D178, then clamps the scaled value.

functions.name: Text_BuildRowForActor
functions.signature: int Text_BuildRowForActor(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, int arg6, u32 arg7)
functions.summary: Builds a generic actor message row: resolves the actor, measures the row through the layout engine, applies the 0x10/0x20 width flags and stores the result.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Monster_GetActionRow
functions.signature: int maybe_Battle_Monster_GetActionRow(BattleUnit* unit, void* target, int handIndex)
functions.summary: Prepares and returns the battle message/action row for a monster actor: looks up the party-member record, the equipped item in slot 0 or 1 (handIndex), the ItemRecord+0x3B byte and the target record's +10 byte, then returns the fixed battle-work row base at +0x4238. The row-specific values are written by calls Ghidra shows without arguments.

functions.name: Battle_CalcCriticalBonusDamage
functions.summary: Calculates bonus damage awarded on critical strike (ignoring target defense).

functions.name: Text_UpdateBlinkStateC
functions.summary: Blink-state updater for the row flag family 0x83/0xBA/0x9E.

functions.name: Battle_ApplyMonsterEffect
functions.signature: void Battle_ApplyMonsterEffect(u32 effectId, BattleWork* work, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Loads the display rows for a monster's effect/condition: with a concrete effect id it formats the effect text and loads the condition record by the record's type (4/8/other); with 0xFF it instead takes the member's equipped item, switches on its category and refreshes the matching condition rows.

functions.name: Battle_ActionRecord_GetPower
functions.signature: s16 Battle_ActionRecord_GetPower(u32 actionId, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Looks up an action record by action ID through Game_GetDataManager and func_0063FD24, returning the signed 16-bit action power / HP delta field at +0xD0.

functions.name: Battle_CalcRandomDamageVariance
functions.summary: Rolls random damage spread around base damage using battle RNG at work+0x4218.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RollHitRateByTemplate
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_RollHitRateByTemplate(void* actionTemplate, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Resolves the action's 0x1D-class combat-modifier entry from an 8-entry template (0x2C stride, entry kind at +0x58), computes the chance with Battle_ResolveMemberCombatModifiers and compares a 1..100 battle-RNG roll against it; returns 1 when the roll passes. The real parameters were dropped by Ghidra (the body still references arg2/arg3).

functions.name: Battle_Monster_UpdateBarAlpha
functions.summary: The monster bar-alpha update: it reads the bar record +0x10, applies the 0.01 scale and marks the layout dirty on change.

functions.name: Battle_CalcActorDamageModifier
functions.summary: Applies actor-specific damage modifiers (tension, pep power, charge) to outgoing damage.

functions.name: Battle_CalcDamageVarianceOffset
functions.summary: Computes percentage variance offset to add or subtract from damage.

functions.name: Text_UpdateBlinkStateD
functions.summary: Blink-state updater for the row flag family 0x30..0x33/0xA6.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionRow
functions.signature: void Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionRow(int effectId, int memberIndex, int targetUnit, u32 flags, int arg5)
functions.summary: Refreshes one condition row of a battle unit: resolves the party member and its equipped slot, reads the target monster record's display byte, rebuilds the row through maybe_Monster_FormatEffectText when a real effect id is supplied and marks the layout dirty.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Row_UpdateIfKindMatchesB
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Row_UpdateIfKindMatchesB(char* self, void* unit, int arg3)
functions.summary: Byte-for-byte duplicate of 0x0048F204: compares the row's two ids with the unit's data-table record fields and advances the battle RNG at +0x4218 on a match. Same body, different address (template copy).

functions.name: Text_BuildRowForMember
functions.signature: int Text_BuildRowForMember(u32 arg1, int arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8, u32 arg9)
functions.summary: Party-member variant of the row builder: applies the row template and the 0x10/0x20 width flags, measuring the text box for the member name/action row.

functions.name: Battle_MonsterUI_Dispatch
functions.signature: u32 Battle_MonsterUI_Dispatch(u32 op, BattleWork* work, int arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Operation dispatcher for the battle monster window: op 0..N selects the HP/MP bar update, effect update, popup refresh, the vtable+0x90 hook or one of the bar/stat helpers.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_GetMpBarRatio
functions.summary: Computes the MP-bar fill of a battle monster: takes the record max at f_24, compares the current ratio with 1% and marks the layout dirty on a change; the value is returned in s0.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_CalcBarScale
functions.summary: Returns the monster HP-bar display scale as a float in s0: 1.0f when the unit's vtable +0x1C getter returns null, otherwise the dm->f_3CC table float scaled by 0.01 and adjusted through 0x00487FC0.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Monster_CalcBarScale_Tail
functions.summary: Continuation tail of maybe_Battle_Monster_CalcBarScale (0x004925DC): scales monster UI bar coordinates in VFP registers.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_UpdateBlinkStateE
functions.summary: Blink-state updater for the row flags 0x38/0x39/0xCE.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_RefreshConditionFlags
functions.summary: Re-rolls the condition row values (0x3A/0x3B/0x3C plus 0xB5/0x100) of a battle monster: for each row it checks whether either equipped item's record type is 0x0B/0x10/0x12 and refreshes the row value when one matches.

functions.name: Battle_ResolveActionCommandModifiers
functions.summary: Resolves action command modifiers before executing damage delivery.

functions.name: Battle_ApplyStatusDrain
functions.signature: void Battle_ApplyStatusDrain(void* attacker, void* target, int damageDealt)
functions.summary: Applies HP or MP drain (e.g. Miracle Slash, Drain Magic) to restore attacker stats.

functions.name: Battle_Spell_CheckUsable
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Spell_CheckUsable(u32 spellId, u32 castMode, int strictFlag, u32 targetFlags)
functions.summary: Evaluates whether a spell can be cast: resolves SpellRecord via 0x0018C184, checks target eligibility and tier restrictions at +0x2F4, +0x1FB, +0x1F9, and validates target unit constraints through 0x0011CFAC.

functions.name: Battle_CalcSpellRowValue
functions.signature: int Battle_CalcSpellRowValue(u32 spellId, void* row, const void* arg3, void* owner)
functions.summary: Single-row companion of Battle_CalcSpellEffectTotal: resolves the spell record for spellId, picks param->f_18/f_1C (or their min/max for row kind 0x12) according to the spell row-kind byte +0x2A, adds the RNG variance, clamps at zero and stores the short in row+4.

functions.name: Battle_FindActorSlotByRecord
functions.summary: Resolves which of the eight battle actor-slot pointers corresponds to a record: subtracts the preceding groups' counts from the record index until the right 4-group entry is found, then matches the group's model id against each slot's f_768 and returns that slot (or null).

functions.name: Battle_CalcMemberStatusDamage
functions.summary: Calculates periodic damage inflicted by status effects (poison, envenomed, burning).

functions.name: Battle_Monster_SyncStatBars
functions.summary: The stat-bar synchroniser: it refreshes both bar widgets and returns the shared bar container from GameWork+0x4238.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_CalcBarPercent
functions.signature: u64 Battle_Monster_CalcBarPercent(int * self, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: The monster bar-percentage calculation: it reads the current value +0x20 and the maximum and returns the 0..1 fill fraction.

functions.name: Battle_Message_BuildActorRowBig
functions.signature: int Battle_Message_BuildActorRowBig(u32 arg1, int * arg2, int * arg3, u32 * arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Large multi-branch row builder for an actor message: walks the row list, checks the monster action category and the party-actor index, then selects the row variant for the current condition.

functions.name: Battle_ApplyStatusVisibility
functions.summary: Updates visible combat status markers on unit model / hud.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_CalcBarSpan
functions.signature: u64 Battle_Monster_CalcBarSpan(BattleUnit* self, int barIndex, int scaled)
functions.summary: Computes the filled width of one of the unit's two gauge bars (HP for barIndex 0, MP for 1): adds the record's bar origin, the current/reference span and the bar's offset, optionally scaling by the global ratio, and returns the end value packed with the flag.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_CalcHpBarFill
functions.summary: Returns the fraction of the HP bar that is filled: combines the bar width (+0x22) with the 1.0/0.01/0.25 constants and the actor scale.

functions.name: Text_MeasureRowByType
functions.signature: int Text_MeasureRowByType(int arg1, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Measures one row by fixed kind (0x8C/0x8D/0x8E map to types 2/0x40/0x3E): fills a 0x4A0-byte layout context, lays the text out and stores the resulting width/height at row+4.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_GetHpBarValue
functions.summary: Returns the pixel value of a monster HP/MP bar: uses the bar kind byte (+0xDF) to choose between the HP bar (0x492520) and the MP bar (0x4900A8) and returns the rounded fill.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CheckTargetReceivesAction
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_CheckTargetReceivesAction(u32 actionId, u32 unitArg, void* target, void* result)
functions.summary: Decides whether an action can resolve against a target: returns 0 with a failure code in result+4 when the action row blocks it, when the target carries state 0x6F/0x70/0xFF, or when it is status-immune; otherwise computes the action's chance modifier and returns 1 only if a 1..100 battle-RNG roll is within it.

functions.name: Battle_Message_BuildConditionRow
functions.signature: int Battle_Message_BuildConditionRow(int arg1, int * arg2, int * arg3, u32 arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Builds a condition/effect row for an actor: checks the monster condition flags (+0x183/+0x185/+0x186/+0x187/+0x188/+0x189) and pushes the matching bar/row segments.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_RefreshDisplayValuesAlt
functions.summary: Alternative branch of the battle-unit display refresh: converts the member's +0x73E/+0xEBE/+0xAFE display values to floats, marks the layout dirty when the enemy slot ratio changed, and pushes the pair through the message-row preset helper. The stat identity is not proven.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_CalcHpBarOrigin
functions.summary: The monster HP-bar origin calculation: it combines the actor offset +0x73C with the bar rect +0xB0C/+0xECC into the two corner pixels.

functions.name: Battle_GetBuffStageMultiplier
functions.summary: Returns the float stat buff/debuff multiplier in VFP s0 for a given stage tier (0..4) and buff category (0=Attack, 1=Defence, 2=Agility) from the battle modifier table at dm->func_0063D178.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_FlagConditionSlot
functions.signature: u64 Battle_Monster_FlagConditionSlot(int arg1, int arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Marks a condition slot of a monster as active (byte +0x1A + slot*2) when the value exceeds the threshold, and returns the updated bar container.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionSlots
functions.signature: void Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionSlots(u32 arg1, MonsterWork* work, u32 arg3, u32 * ctx)
functions.summary: Updates the seven condition/ailment indicator slots 0x15..0x1B of a battle monster, one Battle_Monster_FlagConditionSlot call per slot, after resolving the member record.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionIconAlpha
functions.signature: void Battle_Monster_UpdateConditionIconAlpha(int* self, u32 rowId, int force)
functions.summary: Recomputes one monster condition row: id 0xFF refreshes row 0xB1, otherwise it walks the ten 0x10-byte slot records at +0x2B8, takes the first present slot's float at +0x2C4 and marks the text layout dirty when the value changed.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_CalcHpBarAnchor
functions.summary: The HP-bar anchor calculation: it derives the anchor from the model offsets +0xB4C/+0xF0C and returns the bar container.

functions.name: Text_UpdateBlinkStateF
functions.summary: Blink-state updater for the row flag family 0x47..0x4B/200.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_FindTargetIndexByState
functions.summary: Resolves a target descriptor from a combatant list by state, optionally builds a target record and rolls the battle RNG (1..100) against the resolved index; returns the selected index and falls through to func_0048FE7C. Used both by action-entry building and by the AI action picker.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_RefreshDisplayValues
functions.summary: Refreshes a battle unit's displayed numbers: resolves the unit's party-member record, checks the enemy display slot and marks the layout dirty when it changed, converts the member's +0x740/+0xEC0/+0xB00 values to floats for the message rows and returns the (f_B00, f_EC0) pair.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_RefreshDisplayValuesB
functions.summary: Second display-refresh variant of a battle unit: resolves the unit's party-member record, checks the enemy display slot and marks the layout dirty when it changed, converts the member's +0x746/+0xEC6/+0xB06 values to floats for the message rows and returns the (f_746, f_EC6) pair.

functions.name: Battle_MonsterUI_MeasureText
functions.summary: Measures one monster HUD text: when the message has a format record it builds the layout params, dispatches the formatted text through Battle_MonsterUI_Dispatch and returns the measured width multiplied by the layout scale at +0x420.

functions.name: Text_UpdateBlinkStateG
functions.summary: Blink-state updater for the row flag family 0x3D..0x3F/0xC3/0xE3.

functions.name: Text_UpdateBlinkStateH
functions.summary: Blink-state updater for the row flags 0x2B and 0xC6.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Monster_GetAttackPower
functions.summary: Attack-family stat computation for the monster battle UI: scales the enemy record value f_4 by the base constant block, adds the unsigned f_73C component and recomputes it through 0x00487FC0, then marks the row layout dirty.

functions.name: Battle_Message_BuildRowForMonsterEx
functions.signature: void Battle_Message_BuildRowForMonsterEx(int arg1, u32 * arg2, int arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Extended monster row builder: fills a 0x4B8-byte layout context, resolves the run/row and applies the row template including the 5.0/2.0/-10.0 offsets.

functions.name: Text_CalcRowValue
functions.signature: int Text_CalcRowValue(u32 arg1, int arg2, int arg3, u32 arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Computes the value/height pair for a message row: resolves the row record (f_297) and the actor, then measures the value through the monster-UI statistic helpers.

functions.name: Battle_Monster_GetStatBarScale
functions.summary: Returns the scale factor of a monster stat bar for the requested kind (switch on 0..7), derived from the model stat box and the monster record.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_RefreshDisplayValuePair
functions.summary: Refreshes a battle unit's alternate display values: converts the member's +0x744/+0xEC4/+0xB04 fields to floats, marks the layout dirty when the enemy slot value changed, and returns the (f_744, f_EC4) pair. Its only caller is Battle_Monster_GetMpBarRatio.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Monster_GetAttackPowerB
functions.summary: Alternate attack-family stat computation for the monster battle UI: performs four record lookups, picks the B constant block (g_00497510 vs g_0049750C) when record->f_665 is clear, and applies the same scaled f_738+f_EB8+f_AF8 formula as 0x00496B50.

functions.name: Text_BuildActorRowEx
functions.signature: int Text_BuildActorRowEx(int arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8)
functions.summary: Actor row builder used by both the message window and the battle rows: measures the text run, applies the row template and returns the row height.

functions.name: Battle_MessageRow_BuildLayout
functions.signature: int Battle_MessageRow_BuildLayout(int row, short* outMetrics, BattleRowCtx* ctx, RowDef* def, int index, void* owner, int flag, int* outIndex)
functions.summary: The battle message-row layout builder: it handles mode 0 text measurement and mode 1 fixed-row dispatch and writes the row size.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CalcMemberStatScale
functions.summary: Returns a float resistance/status multiplier for a party member and stat index: reads the member's float tables at +0x998 and +0xD58 (the +0xB68/+0xD74/+0xF28/+0x1134 blocks for index 7), applies the status-0x4F check and Battle_CalcRandomDamageVariance, then combines the factors.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Row_GetScaleFactorA
functions.summary: Returns a per-row-type float multiplier for a battle text/bar row: probes the row type through virtual +0xE8 for the id group 0x1E, 0x1F, 0xA2, 0xAB, 0xAE, 0x20, 0x21, 0x101, 0x114 and 0x11C, reads a value for that type through 0x00491270 (default 100.0), scales it by 0.01f and marks the layout dirty when the result is non-zero. Callers multiply a row value by the returned s0 float.

functions.name: Battle_Message_MeasureMonsterRow
functions.signature: int Battle_Message_MeasureMonsterRow(u32 textId, u32 monsterId, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Initialises a temporary text row, fills it with the monster-message builder and returns the measured row advance/height.

functions.name: Text_Row_MeasureIconRowWidth
functions.signature: int Text_Row_MeasureIconRowWidth(int rowTableId, BattleRowCtx* ctx, int def, int index, int flag, int* owner)
functions.summary: The icon-row width measurement: it walks the eight row slots, resolves both status-icon text ids for type-5 slots and sums their widths.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Row_ApplySpacingPresetB
functions.summary: Picks the first row id present on the object from a preset group (0x27/0x28/0xA4/0xAD/0xB0/0x29/0x2A/0x108/0x103/0x11E/0x120), takes that row's value and marks the layout dirty when the scaled value is non-zero.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Row_GetScaleFactorC
functions.summary: Second per-row-type float multiplier for a battle text/bar row: probes the row type through virtual +0xE8 for the id group beginning 0x23, 0x24, 0xA3, 0xAC, 0xAF, 0x25, 0x26 (then 0x115, 0x107, 0x102 and a computed +8 id), reads a value for that type through 0x00491270 (default 100.0), scales it by 0.01f and marks the layout dirty when the result is non-zero. Callers multiply a row value by the returned s0 float.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_GetMemberScaledStat
functions.summary: Looks up the party member behind actor+0x768 and folds the two float tables at member+0xD78 and member+0x1138 for the given stat index, scales by 0.01 and passes the result through the float scaler at 0x00487FC0; returns the battle-work pointer at +0x4238.

functions.name: Battle_Row_DispatchForActor
functions.summary: Copies the 4-entry row template for a table id, finds the entry whose id matches actor->f_768, then finds the matching row slot and dispatches that row's id to maybe_Battle_MonsterUI_Dispatch.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Row_SumActorValues
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Row_SumActorValues(int rowTableId, BattleRowCtx* ctx, int def)
functions.summary: Copies the row template, sums a per-row value over the up-to-four slots whose actor matches, writes the total into the three label segments of the row's text element and updates the bar/blink animation.

functions.name: Text_Row_ApplySpacingByCategory
functions.summary: Switches on a row category (0..6) and, for every row-type id of that category present on the UI object, applies the per-type row spacing. Used by the row measuring/placement code to accumulate the height of present rows.

functions.name: Text_GetActorFieldByIndex
functions.summary: Returns one of the 28 consecutive u8 fields at record+9..record+0x22 of the monster/actor record (Monster_LookupRecord(actorId)), selected by index 0..0x19 (0x15 and 0x16 share +0x1E), as a float; the text-row builders use it to print arbitrary actor stats.

functions.name: Battle_Row_SumHpBar
functions.summary: Builds the summed-HP battle row for a party group: adds the HP-derived values of up to four matched actor slots, converts the total into a bar fill, applies the hit flash and writes the three label segments.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Row_SumActorValuesB
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Row_SumActorValuesB(int rowTableId, BattleRowCtx* ctx, int index)
functions.summary: Variant of the row value summer that takes an explicit row index, re-dispatches the row through 0x004989DC and writes the accumulated value plus two companion segments into the row's text element.

functions.name: Battle_Row_UpdateFromActorSlot
functions.signature: void Battle_Row_UpdateFromActorSlot(int rowTableId, void* ctx, int clipBand)
functions.summary: Updates one battle message row from the four ctx actor slots: initialises the row layout from rowTableId, finds the slot whose actor f_768 equals the row-template entry, scales the row's current value (ctx->f_18) by the template factor and pushes it through the text row helpers (Text_BuildRowForTarget, Text_UpdateRowBlink, Text_MarkLayoutDirty). Caller Text_MeasureRowByType uses it while re-measuring rows.

functions.name: Battle_MonsterPanel_Build
functions.signature: void Battle_MonsterPanel_Build(int rowTableId, BattleRowCtx* ctx, int def)
functions.summary: Builds a monster battle-row panel: resolves the monster record, measures the name, computes the HP-bar origin/fill/span and writes the numeric label segments plus the blink animation.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_MessageRow_RollVariance
functions.summary: Rolls a symmetric battle-RNG value in [-f_14, f_14] and returns it together with the battle-work message-row base at +0x4238; all five callers are battle message-row builders, so this is most likely the row's random variance, not a group-attack proc roll.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_RollSignedRange
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_RollSignedRange(void* record, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Rolls a random integer in [-record->f_14, record->f_14] over the battle work array at +0x4218 and converts it to float. The 64-bit return the decompiler shows is a decode artefact.

functions.name: Text_Row_Init
functions.summary: Zero-initialises a 0x58-byte text-row descriptor: clears the scalar fields at +4..+0x18 and the bytes at +0x52..+0x57 and memsets +0x1a..+0x52; returns the row pointer. Called by every row builder to prepare its stack row.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Row_InitFromRecord
functions.summary: Only two operations survive in the readable body: fetch the game-data manager and call 0x0063D178 on its first word, after which the decompilation hits halt_baddata. The record id and every store are lost, so neither the row nor the record type can be pinned.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Row_InitFromRecord_Tail
functions.summary: Continuation of 0x0049AA74: copies remaining fields from data record into row buffer; readable body is truncated by halt_baddata().

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Actor_CompareConditionFlags
functions.signature: int maybe_Battle_Actor_CompareConditionFlags(void* arg1, void* b, unsigned int mask)
functions.summary: Comparator for two battle actors: the validity byte f_10 is the primary key and the type-10 condition value (& mask) the secondary key, giving a strict ordering (returns 1 when the first actor should sort before the second).

functions.name: Text_Row_IsMonsterType
functions.signature: bool Text_Row_IsMonsterType(BattleUnit* unit, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns true when the unit's model record is of the monster kind (record byte +0xB == 1); the eight text-row builders use it to choose the monster layout instead of the party layout.

functions.name: Battle_ResolveTurnOrderAndModifiers
functions.summary: Resolves turn order priorities across all active combatants and prepares action turn queues.

functions.name: Text_Row_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for a message row: frees the row object (no other resource is owned).

functions.name: Anim_BlendTransform
functions.signature: void Anim_BlendTransform(float* out, const AnimTransform* arg2, const AnimTransform* b, float t)
functions.summary: Blends two 3D poses by the factor t: lerps the position triple and slerps the quaternion at +0xC..+0x18, writing seven floats (position + quaternion) to out. Used by the motion/anim-object blend update.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_TargetPanel_ComputeLookAt
functions.signature: float* Battle_Ui_TargetPanel_ComputeLookAt(float* outQuat, const float* from, const float* to)
functions.summary: Builds the look-at quaternion used by the battle target panel: normalises the from->to vector (falling back to the default axis), rotates it by the fixed reference quaternion at 0x49B790 and returns a normalised 4-component quaternion plus position.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_HandleMessage
functions.signature: void Ui_ArcListWindow_HandleMessage(UiArcListWindow* self, int message, void* data, unsigned int workFrame)
functions.summary: Window message handler of the 4x26-handle arc list window: message 0 with subtype 0 reloads the four container handles from battle work +0x4254 and re-links the entry grid, other subtypes switch the animated sub-widget at +0x94 to states 1..0xB; messages 1/2/3/6/7 relink or forward to the window's own vtable slot +0xAC, messages 4/5 toggle the flag at +0x545.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_RefreshEntryObjects
functions.summary: Walks the 4x26 entry grid, resolves each entry's handle and calls vtable+0x98 on the matching object to refresh/attach it.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_ComputeRowAnchors
functions.summary: Computes the three anchor vectors (row base, row axis and arc centre) that the arc-list window uses to place its rows, from the stored layout vectors at +0x1E4/+0x1F0/+0x1FC and the control points at +0x3D8/+0x3E4.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_SetSwingMode
functions.summary: Selects the arc-list swing mode from the global UI mode byte, seeds the swing angle/velocity from the rodata constant set and re-arranges the rows on the arc.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_LinkEntryHandles
functions.summary: Fills the window's 4x26 entry-handle grid: for each of four groups it copies 26 container handles from work+0x428c + group*0x1c into self+0x220 + group*0x68. Called by the constructor 0x49E010 and by the message handler when the window is re-shown.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_UpdateSwing
functions.summary: Advances the window swing angle f_530 by f_534*dt (self->f_a4) and, in mode 0, bounces it between two rodata limits (mode 1 keeps integrating); then re-arranges the entry grid with 0x49C93C. Returns 1 so it can be used directly as an update callback.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_UpdateFocusBounds
functions.summary: Updates the arc list window's focus-point rectangle: scans the four row groups (4x26 actor slots), reads the focus point of the first valid actor's model, and derives the six screen-space bounds (+0xF0*4) and the transformed quad used for the highlight.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_UpdateAnchorPositions
functions.summary: Recomputes the window's two anchor points (self+4 and self+0x10, plus orientation at +0x1c) from the transform of the game object selected by work byte 0x4202 and the four-entry handle table at work+0x4254. Returns 0 when the object is not resolvable, which lets the caller skip the frame.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListRow_BlendAnchorTransforms
functions.summary: Advances a row's open/close blend: clamps the timer +0x9C to the layout limit, turns it into a 0..1 phase with the sinf helper, interpolates the two stored anchor transforms (0x005753BC vec lerp) and writes the resulting two 3-float vectors to self+4 and self+0x10.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_ArrangeRowsOnArc
functions.summary: Recomputes the two endpoint vectors that place the list rows on an arc from the visible entry count (Container_List_CountVisible on work+0x4254), the swing state f_538 and the angle/size f_530, using sin/cos and sqrt(1-s*s).

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_UpdateScrollAim
functions.summary: Computes the window's scroll aim: when the work flag at +0x5694 is set it takes the delta from the current anchor to a target actor (position at actor+0x9c) and stores origin, normalized direction and length in f_508..f_520; otherwise it averages the positions of all active entries and aims at that average.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ArcListWindow_UpdateIdlePose
functions.summary: Per-frame idle pose gate: when the battle work byte +0x4210 is negative it parks the row on the cached pose pairs, otherwise it polls the animation sub-object at +0x94 and plays it. Always returns 1.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_CommitSelection
functions.summary: Applies basis transform from self+4 into arc transform self->f_1e4 via 0x001CEE24 and notifies owner via virtual slot +0xC4.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_RefreshAfterSelection
functions.summary: Invokes virtual refresh method at vtable slot +0xC8 and returns 1 in Ui_ArcListWindow selection flow.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_OnAnimateEvent
functions.summary: Animation completion and mode event handler for Ui_ArcListWindow: releases animation controller f_3f8 via 0x0055AC50, resets animation flags, and either snapshots the live transform into home fields f_4ac..f_4d0 (mode 6) or restores the transform and refreshes entry objects via Ui_ArcListWindow_RefreshEntryObjects (0x0049BB0C).

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_SyncSelectionFromWork
functions.summary: Pulls the menu selection byte at UI work+0x4210: a negative value resets the row animation (0x006D0674(self+0x94,2)); otherwise, when it differs from the cached copy f_524, it calls the virtual setter at vtable+0xb4 and caches it, then always runs the virtual refresh at vtable+0xb8.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_LayoutEntriesByHeight
functions.summary: Measures every active entry's row height, averages and clamps the total into the 155-pixel window band, then derives the two visible-run end points from the aim point and stored rotation.

functions.name: Anim_PingPongFloat_Update
functions.summary: Generic ping-pong integrator: adds velocity (+0x140) times the frame delta (owner f_A4) to the value (+0x13C), reverses and clamps the velocity at 0x8C/0x8D0000-style limits on overshoot and then applies the pose through 0x0049DDB8 (now named Ui_ArcListRow_UpdateSwingPose).

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_SetupFromPlayerActor
functions.summary: (Re)initialises the window from the player: copies the live transform, resolves the '$offset' animation node, snapshots the leader actor's position and quaternion, then recomputes the scroll aim and, when the flag +0x546 is set, re-lays the entries.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ArcListWindow_AssignEntrySlot
functions.summary: Scans up to 26 entry slots for the entry selected by the work index byte at +0x5691, compares it with the active-entry list at work+0x5628 and attaches the surviving entry through its vtable +0x98, then positions it from the work transform at +0x5628.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ArcListWindow_AssignEntrySlot_Tail
functions.summary: Continuation tail of maybe_Ui_ArcListWindow_AssignEntrySlot (0x0049D648): finishes slot assignment in entry array +0x220; readable body truncated by halt_baddata().

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_ApplyFrameDelta
functions.summary: Applies one frame of the arc list window's own motion: adds the stored per-frame position/scale/rotation deltas to the window transform and rebuilds the normalised direction vector, switching between the absolute and delta modes.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListRow_BlendPoseToTarget
functions.summary: Per-row animation step of the arc list: eases the row's snapshot start/end points (f_4AC/f_4B8) toward the target vectors (f_4D4/f_4E0) that Ui_ArcListWindow_LayoutEntriesByHeight writes, using the period at battleWork+0x569C, then renormalises the forward vector f_1C..f_24 and applies the lateral offsets. Returns 1 so it can act as a row update slot.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListRow_UpdateSwingPose
functions.summary: Rebuilds the row pose from its swing angle f_53c: converts degrees to radians, scales by (visible count-1) and the phase constants, derives sin/cos and sqrt(1-s*s) offsets and writes the anchor vector f_4/f_8/f_c plus the swung end point f_10/f_14/f_18.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_UpdateAnimSlots
functions.summary: Per-frame animation tick, gated by UI work byte +0x4244: advances the timer f_9c by dt, bumps the frame counter f_a0, and dispatches every active slot of the 12-entry, 0x18-byte animation table at self+0x94 (count f_98, handler at slot+0x34, resolved through the table base at f_b4), then copies the position block to f_1e4.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Base constructor: builds the default transform from the rodata basis vectors 0x007E7000/0x007E7030 (mirroring one axis), copies it to f_4 and f_1e4, stores the four container entries 0..3 from work+0x4254 into f_210..0x21c, runs the shared init 0x49BD54, initialises the anim controller f_30 and sets the default sway angle f_28 = 0.4887 rad (28 deg) and f_3c = 0.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_CtorParts
functions.summary: Constructor of the arc-list window object itself: composite-object base ctor, vtable 0x774FDC (ArcListWindow), one member pair and twelve 0x18-byte anim slots.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the arc-list window: installs the two base vtables (+0 and +0x3F8), releases the embedded window object at +0x3F8 and frees.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ArcListWindow_UpdateRowHighlights
functions.summary: Re-evaluates row marker states across all 4x26 entry slots of the arc list window: tests for marker ID 0x34A and invokes 0x0049EB60.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ArcListWindow_UpdateRowHighlight
functions.summary: Copies the six anchor words self+4..+0x18 into +0x560..+0x574, scans one row's 0x1A child slots for the id 0x34A and calls 0x0049EB60(self, &f_548, &f_554, found), then sets +0x528 = 0 and +0x52C = 0.2f.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_CtorWithMode
functions.summary: Derived constructor: calls the base ctor, then stores the screen mode from UI work byte +0x4201 in f_1e0 and picks the transition duration f_28 from two rodata constants, using the longer one for modes 5/6/7 (battle/summary screens) and the shorter one otherwise; finally re-copies the transform to f_1e4.

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_CtorMode3

functions.summary: Per-frame transform of a spline-driven motion path object (vtable 0x775194): gated by f_91, it evaluates the cubic Hermite curve at self+0xC8 over the 12-float segments at f_A4, writes position f_4..f_C and forward f_1C..f_24, then blends a second point through maybe_Ui_MotionPath_EvaluateRotation or maybe_Motion_ApplyRotationBlend.

functions.name: Battle_Sequence_UpdateMemberAnchor

functions.summary: Handles cursor selection input for a menu slot: decodes pending input word at self+0xD80 (& 0x142/4/1), delegates to cursor object at +0x24C, advances controller state at +0x124, and attaches model handle via Menu_Slot_AttachModelHandle (0x004A0FF4).

functions.signature: void Field_ActorGroup_PlaceMember(FieldActorGroup* self, Actor* actor, GroupPlacement* placement)
functions.summary: Places one group member on the formation pattern: takes the offset (or its mirrored copy) from the per-formation table g_004A25AC (0x60 bytes per pattern, 8 vectors of 12 bytes), adds it to the actor-to-anchor delta, stores the anchor position (actor+0x228), orients the actor toward the target position (or a supplied direction vector) through 0x5F5F54, and fills the actor's action parameters (f_24C..f_264 speed/blend/scale, action name copied into f_26C..f_278) before starting it with 0x5E7848(actor,2,1).
