functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextList_ClearRows
functions.summary: Constructor-time reset of a text list: runs the base constructor and binds the 12-byte placeholder panes ("null_txt_l0" and friends) so every row starts empty.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DeleteViaVtable
functions.summary: Multiple-inheritance deleting destructor: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase on the primary base and then dispatches the secondary base's delete through the vtable word at (object-8)+4. The table belongs to the text-list class, but the body is the generic MI dispatch idiom.

functions.name: Effect_ActorTrail_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame tick of a small follow-effect object. When the owning model record is loaded and the owner has moved more than ~0.03 units since the previous frame, it releases the old instance and spawns effect id 1237 (moving) or 1238 (standing still) at the owner's position clamped to the ground; when the model record is missing or hidden it simply releases the instance.

functions.name: Effect_ActorTrail_ReleaseInstance
functions.summary: Release path of the follow-effect object: it validates the effect handle stored in f_40 against the engine handle table (generation check) and then calls Effect_ReleaseHandle on it. Used when the object is torn down or the effect must be dropped without touching the enable flag.

functions.name: Effect_ActorTrail_Stop
functions.summary: Stops the trail effect: only when the 'effect active' byte f_10 is set does it release the tracked handle (same handle-table/generation check) and then clear f_10, so a later update can create the effect again.

functions.name: Effect_ActorTrail_Ctor
functions.signature: EffectActorTrail* Effect_ActorTrail_Ctor(void* owner, void* transform, void* ownerRef)
functions.summary: In-place constructor of the follow-effect object: runs the base init 0x2D97E8 with a parameter block built from the transform/owner reference, overwrites the vtable with 0x7757A0, zeroes the mode/active bytes and stores the invalid handle 0xFFFFFC00 in f_40.

functions.name: Effect_ActorTrail_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the actor trail effect: resolves and releases the attached trail instance and frees.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_ActorTrail_Ctor_Tail
functions.summary: Mid-function split symbol inside Effect_ActorTrail_Ctor (0x004A650C) completing trail parameter configuration.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_AdvanceChildWhenIdleC
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_AdvanceChildWhenIdleC(UiWidget* window, int arg2, int b, int c)
functions.summary: Third copy of the 'advance the child to state 3 when the input manager is free' vtable step, testing the input-manager slot +0x34; returns 1 so the caller treats the frame as handled.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SetupIconHandlesB
functions.summary: Same two-step slot-handle setup as 0x00249498 for a different panel: category-1 handles at resource size 0x0B through Ui_SmithMenu_SetAllSlotHandles, then the unnamed second setter 0x00625FC0 with category 2.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_PollFinish
functions.summary: Polls the message page's typewriter/finish animation and marks the page as finished (f_10 = 1) when the helper reports completion. Always returns 1 so the page stays alive.

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a message page: binds two layout panes (self+0x11C and self+0x1DC8) to their widgets with the shared 0x1D85EC binder, initialises the second pane and then binds the text/name message pair (0x1DACFC).

functions.name: Ui_MessagePage_Update
functions.summary: Updates a message page: decodes/step the current page (Ui_MessagePage_Decode) and then, when a message object is attached at f_20, notifies it through virtual +0x78, the message-changed slot used by the surrounding window code.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessagePage_DtorDelete2
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a large message-page object: stamps the class vtables (0x0075E540 / 0x0077FCFC), destroys the page at self+0x786 and releases the first layout ref before the decompilation breaks off.

functions.name: Ui_NumberTextWidget_Init
functions.summary: Binds the 'txt_num' number text pane and delegates the rest of the number formatting setup to func_004A6944.

functions.name: Ui_NumberTextWidget_UpdateValue
functions.summary: Refreshes a number-text widget: takes the item-storage pointer (slot 0x2F), formats the current count into the widget's text buffer and writes it to the text layer.

functions.name: Ui_NumberTextWidget_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the small number-text widget (the class whose initialiser binds the 'txt_num' pane): runs the shared Ui_Object destructor and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_EightLineTextWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Binds eight numbered text lines with their blank placeholders in a list window, generating the pane names by incrementing a digit template.

functions.name: Ui_EightLineTextWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the eight-line text window (the class whose initialiser binds txt_l1..txt_l8 plus their null_txt_* placeholders): runs the shared Ui_Object destructor and frees the block.

functions.name: Ui_PageControl_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the page-control widget: resets the page object at self+4 (+0x748 block), sets up the two page-count/step fields and installs the text cache for the new page.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PageControl_Init_Tail
functions.summary: Mid-function split symbol at +0x14 inside Ui_PageControl_Init (0x004A6E74) setting up child text layout.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PageControl_UpdateLayout
functions.summary: Rebuilds a paged widget's page table: allocates one 0x98-byte UI object per page and drives both directions of each page's animation controller, then plays SE 0x89. Ghidra lost most argument registers, so the page count and layout maths are unreliable.

functions.name: Anim_InstanceList_UpdateTiming
functions.summary: Recomputes the instance list's two timing scales: 2x the global factor, and 4/8/8/16 from the special state, the state byte 0x27F or the current scene id.

functions.name: maybe_Party_UpdateMemberHpDisplay
functions.summary: Per-frame party status pass: walks the alive party members, derives a per-member offset from the status bits at member+0xDA and pushes (HP - offset, clamped to 1) into the member's display object, then lazily creates the two 0x98-byte status widgets and sets their colour from the same mode bits (0xFF440000 / 0xC7158500 / 0xEEEE6600 / 0xEEEEEE00).

functions.name: maybe_Anim_InstanceList_ApplyModeByte
functions.summary: Reads the current state byte at (work+8)->+0x48->+0x281 and, when it is non-zero, looks it up through 0x0063D6B8. The return value is unused, so the only visible effect is the callee's side effect.

functions.name: Anim_FormatEnemyAnimationPath
functions.signature: void Anim_FormatEnemyAnimationPath(AnimPath* out, u32 kind, int variant, u8 mode)
functions.summary: Builds the RomFS path of an enemy animation file: the kind (0..4) selects one of six name suffixes stored in .data (0x7BFD2B/2E/30/32/34/37, default 0x7BFD37) and the result is formatted as 'enemy_%s.ani' or, when a variant index is given, 'enemy_%s%d.ani'.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ClearSceneEventFlags
functions.summary: Clears three save-work story/event flags (ids 0x1A8, 0x1A7 and 0x1A9) by calling the save-work vtable +0x8 setter with value 0. It is invoked by Field_SceneNode_OnCommand for command 0, the node reset path.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_Instance_CreateForModel
functions.summary: Creates (or reuses) an animation instance for a model/animation pair: builds the 0x23-word descriptor from the constants at 0x004A7B20, allocates a 0x2A0-byte instance through 0x003BC8F0 and binds the resolved clip.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_PlaceInFreeCellMode5
functions.signature: int Ui_Widget_PlaceInFreeCellMode5(UiWidget* self, int x, int y, int width, int height)
functions.summary: Wrapper around Ui_PlaceWidgetInFreeCell (0x004231B4) that fixes the cell layout mode parameter to 5 (UI_CELL_MODE_5).

functions.name: Actor_ActionBase_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Actor_ActionBase_Ctor(void* self, void* actor, void* actionContainer, const char* actionName, u8 kind)
functions.summary: Base constructor for named actor action handlers (0x28 bytes): copies up to 14 characters + NUL of actionName into inline string self+0x04..+0x17, stores kind at self+0x18, zeroes self+0x1C, stores actor at self+0x20 and actionContainer at self+0x24, installs base vtable 0x007759C8, and returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UnitModel_DrawList_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a battle unit-model draw list: stores the owner, installs maybe_g_battleUnitModelDrawListVtable, seeds the -0x400/-1 defaults at +4/+8 and constructs eight 0x1C-byte entries at +0x34.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_ApplyVariantToParts
functions.summary: Applies a model variant to the unit's four part slots: parts whose id is 0x34E/0x34F get the variant directly, the 0x34E|0x800 ones get variant-1/-2, and the model animation state is refreshed first.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_SetVariantPaired
functions.summary: Switches the unit-model object to the variant used when a partner unit is present: sets f_142=0/f_143=1, resolves model id 0x18F, builds its animation instance and attaches it through the f_13C slot.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModelA_Update
functions.signature: void Battle_UnitModelA_Update(UnitModel* self, int arg2, int frameArg)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the 0x1A5 unit-model variant: ticks the anim channels, motion state and elapsed counter, runs the shared part/SE updates, then switches to the paired (vtable+0xA8) or solo (+0xA4) display variant depending on whether a live model-0x1A5 unit is present.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_SetVariantSolo
functions.summary: Switches the unit-model object to the variant used when no partner unit is present: sets f_142=1/f_143=0, resolves model id 0x18F, builds its animation instance and attaches it through the f_138 slot.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UnitModel_ResetAndNotifyPartner
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_UnitModel_ResetAndNotifyPartner(UnitModel* self, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Resets the model's animation state (f_105=1, f_106=0, f_107=0) and restarts the controller at +0xEC, then walks the four battle unit lists for the unit whose body id is 0x350 and calls that unit's model virtuals +0x38 and +0x34(model, 0).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UnitModel_HidePartnerPart
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_UnitModel_HidePartnerPart(UnitModel* self, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Resets the unit-model display values (scale 1.0, timer 10, flag 1) and, for the unit with model id 0x350, calls its vtable+0x50(0) and the attached model's vtable+0x4C.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModel_ShowPartnerPart
functions.signature: void Battle_UnitModel_ShowPartnerPart(UnitModel* self, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Shows the partner part of a battle unit model: marks the owned unit (virtual +0x14) with f_6D = 1, sets self->f_43 = 1 and clears +0x10D, then finds the body-0x350 unit in the four battle unit lists and calls its model virtuals +0x50(1, 0) and +0x48.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModelB_ApplyVariant
functions.summary: Stores the unit model's variant byte and restarts the model (vtable+0xB0 then vtable+0x68 with animation 8) so the new variant is applied.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DeletingDtorB_vt7743A0
functions.summary: Second byte-identical copy of the Ui widget deleting destructor at 0x42AAF4: same pack-handle release, same restore of the base Ui_AllocWidget vtable 0x7743A0, same scene-node teardown and free.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModelB_ApplyVariantToParts
functions.summary: Same part-variant propagation as 0x4A7DC8 with the second unit-model id set (0x34B, 0x34C, 0x34D).

functions.name: Battle_UnitModelB_SetVariantPaired
functions.summary: Second unit-model class (model id 0x1A5) switching to its partner-present variant: sets f_142=0/f_143=1, resolves model 0x1A5, builds the animation instance with mode 0 and attaches it through the f_13C slot.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModelB_Update
functions.signature: void Battle_UnitModelB_Update(UnitModelB* self, int arg2, int frameArg)
functions.summary: Second unit-model update variant: same channel/motion/part update as 0x004A7F08 but keyed on model id 0x18F when deciding between the paired and solo display variants.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModelB_SetVariantSolo
functions.summary: Second unit-model class switching to its partner-absent variant: sets f_142=1/f_143=0, resolves model 0x1A5, builds the animation instance with mode 0 and attaches it through the f_138 slot.

functions.name: Battle_UnitModelB_SetMode
functions.summary: Sets the unit model's display mode byte at +0x50 and rebuilds the model via vtable[0xB0] and starts animation 8 via vtable[0x68] when the mode changed.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_DeletingDtorC_vt7743A0
functions.summary: Third byte-identical copy of the Ui widget deleting destructor at 0x42AAF4 (same handle release, base vtable 0x7743A0, scene-node teardown and free).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_TryFinish
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_Object_TryFinish(void* self, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: One-shot finish helper: returns 1 when the done byte f_D2 is set, otherwise runs the shared 0x1FC countdown and, on expiry, asks vtable+0x24, runs cleanup, calls vtable+0x108 and parks the countdown at -2.

functions.name: Field_Object_Type1351_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of field object type 1351: runs Ui_Screen_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x775B74, sets the two default words at 0x497/0x498 and resets the party member slot.

functions.name: Battle_Action_Guard_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the guard action base (base destructor 0x200220 + free).

functions.name: Battle_Action_GuardS_Begin
functions.summary: Begin step of the battle action whose animation is "guard_s": if the action's actor is ready, it resolves the party actor by the bit-swapped handle, asks for the guard pose group and plays it on the actor (0x005E7848(actor, pose, 0)).

functions.name: Battle_Action_GuardShield_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_GuardShield_Ctor(u32 heap, void* owner, u32 arg3, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action class registered as 'guard_s' (guard with shield).

functions.name: Battle_Action_GuardShield_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the shield-guard action (action base destructor 0x322D14 + free).

functions.name: Battle_Action_SpecialMove_Begin
functions.summary: Shared begin/sync step of the generic special-move action: lazily creates the 16-byte helper (vtable 0x782950), resolves the acting party member with Menu_FindActorByHandle, selects the pose group and pushes the actor's current action into its action player.

functions.name: Battle_Action_SpecialMove_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_SpecialMove_Ctor(u32 heap, void* owner, u32 arg3, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the generic battle special-move action class, reused for all spNStart/spNLoop/spNEnd animation phases (sp1..sp25).

functions.name: Battle_Action_SpecialMove_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the special-move action (action base destructor 0x322D14 + free).

functions.name: Battle_Action_GuardW_Begin
functions.summary: Begin step of the 'guard_w' (guard with weapon) battle action: if the action's actor link (self->f_28 via 0x00669DD4) is valid, resolves the actor from the handle at f_28+4 through the battle work (Menu_FindActorByHandle), asks Battle_SelectPoseGroup for the pose group and applies it with func_005E7848 (play animation by state).

functions.name: Battle_Action_GuardWeapon_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_GuardWeapon_Ctor(u32 heap, void* owner, u32 arg3, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action class registered as 'guard_w' (guard with weapon).

functions.name: Battle_Action_GuardWeapon_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the weapon-guard action (action base destructor 0x322D14 + free).

functions.name: Battle_Action_Combination_PlayAnim
functions.summary: Plays the team-attack animation: reads the battle state byte, looks up the action record for the current action id, converts its relative +0x41C pointer and passes it to the actor's vtable+0x84.

functions.name: Battle_Action_Combination_Finish
functions.summary: Finish step of the combination action: checks actor validity via 0x0066A2BC and tail-calls Battle_Action_RestoreActorIdleByHp (0x0038AB68) to restore post-action actor idle posture.

functions.name: Battle_Action_Combination_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_Combination_Ctor(u32 heap, void* owner, u32 arg3, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action class registered as 'combination' (combined/team attack).

functions.name: Battle_Action_Combination_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the combination-attack action (trivial vptr reset + free).

functions.name: Battle_Action_CounterLoop_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_CounterLoop_Ctor(u32 heap, void* owner, u32 arg3, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action class used for the 'counter_loop01..06' counter-attack loop animations.

functions.name: Battle_Action_CounterLoop_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the counter-loop action (trivial vptr reset + free).

functions.name: Battle_Action_ShieldGuard_PlayMotion
functions.summary: Virtual 'play action motion' slot of the battle action 'ShieldGuard': looks up the acting actor, checks whether the guard skill (id 0x79) was used and asks the actor to play either "ShieldGuard" or the looping "ShieldGuardKeep" motion.

functions.name: Battle_Action_ShieldGuard_UpdateTargetMarker
functions.summary: Per-frame hook of the ShieldGuard action: if the actor still exists and its current motion name is exactly "ShieldGuardKeep", forwards to the shared target-marker UI update (0x38AB68); otherwise does nothing.

functions.name: Battle_Action_ShieldGuard_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_ShieldGuard_Ctor(u32 heap, void* owner, u32 arg3, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action class registered as 'shield_guard'.

functions.name: Battle_Action_ShieldGuard_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the shield-guard animation action (trivial vptr reset + free).

functions.name: Battle_Action_WeaponGuard_PlayMotion
functions.summary: Same virtual slot as 0x4A91FC but for the WeaponGuard action: resolves the actor, tests skill id 0x79 and plays "WeaponGuard" or "WeaponGuardKeep" on the actor's motion interface.

functions.name: Battle_Action_WeaponGuard_UpdateTargetMarker
functions.summary: Per-frame hook of the WeaponGuard action: when the actor exists and its current motion name equals "WeaponGuardKeep", it triggers the shared target-marker UI refresh.

functions.name: Battle_Action_WeaponGuard_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_WeaponGuard_Ctor(u32 heap, void* owner, u32 arg3, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action class registered as 'weapon_guard'.

functions.name: Battle_Action_WeaponGuard_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the weapon-guard animation action (trivial vptr reset + free).

functions.name: Battle_Action_UpdateTargetFromGrid
functions.summary: Maps the battle-grid cursor cell to a target: reads the current cell through 0x001D806C(self->f_38), indexes the grid at self->f_70 by row/column with maybe_g_battleCommandListRowStep, and stores the encoded target byte at self+0x7E unless the cell is empty (-1).

functions.name: Battle_Command_ResolveVariantCode
functions.summary: Maps three special command ids to variant codes: 0x47 -> 1 if slot 7 knows ability 0x7F, 0x45 -> 2 if slot 3 knows 0x7E, 0x4D -> 3/4 from battle flags 0x4247/0x4253, otherwise 0.

functions.name: Battle_CommandListWindow_SelectEntryById
functions.summary: Scans the window's per-cell id grid (+0x70, row pitch +0x66, page byte +0x64) page by page and, when it finds the cell whose id equals entryId, selects that cell through Ui_List_SelectEntryById and re-scrolls the list; bails out once the scroll pointer runs past the entry count.

functions.name: Battle_CommandListWindow_BuildEntries
functions.summary: Rebuilds the command list for one party member's chosen command: remaps id 0x1b to category 3, stores the category at +0x7d, frees and reallocates the 0x59-byte id grid at +0x70 (filled with 0xFF), fills it through the per-command jump table using the party availability mask, then asks the object to relayout (vtbl+0x90).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CommandList_CommitSelection
functions.summary: Validates and commits the current command selection: returns for selection id -1/0xFF, rebuilds the entry through maybe_Battle_CommandEntry_Build, and only then calls func_004A96AC to commit it.

functions.name: Battle_CommandListWindow_ClearSelection
functions.summary: Resets the battle command list's cursor and scroll: when the window has a list it clears the highlighted cell (+0x7E = 0xFF), aligns the scroll offset with the item count (+0x68 = +0x78) and restores the default row step from g_battleCommandListRowStep, then refreshes the scroll position and icons.

functions.name: Battle_CommandListWindow_SetCursorState
functions.summary: Switches the command-list cursor between its two visuals: pushes the matching cursor sprite id (from the table at 0x7A7974) and flips the stored cursor side byte.

functions.name: Battle_CommandListWindow_IsCursorUsable
functions.summary: Tests whether the command at the current cursor cell can be executed: resolves grid coordinates via 0x001D806C, checks command validity with maybe_Battle_CommandEntry_Build (0x004A9FE4), and verifies that disabled flag from 0x004A96AC is zero.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CommandListWindow_IsCursorEntryUsable
functions.summary: Cursor predicate on the command grid: an empty cell (0xFF) is usable, ordinary ids are not, and special id 0x2F is usable only when one of the four party members is in the record's bit mask and passes an extra virtual check.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CommandEntry_Build
functions.summary: Builds or validates one battle command entry and returns whether it is usable; the readable body is only a 1904-byte stack frame plus a lost array constructor, so the field logic is not visible.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CommandList_BuildRows
functions.summary: Builds the battle command-list rows: zeroes a 0x80-byte local block, then formats and writes text entries through Ui_TextElement_SetString, std_String_FormatInitG and Ui_TwelveRowNumberedTextWindow_InitPanes.

functions.name: Ui_MessageTextWindow_Init
functions.summary: Binds the message body pane 'txt_text' plus three left and three right sub-text rows with their 'null' templates.

functions.name: Ui_BattleCommandPopup_Create
functions.summary: Creates the small battle text popup shared by the swap and combination-command windows: allocates the widget, zeroes its fields to the 0xFF/0xFFFFF000 defaults and lazily loads the shared 'battle_Text.bxon' string table into it.

functions.name: Ui_BattleCommandPopup_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the battle command popup: releases the cached text-table handle and the auxiliary buffer, destroys the child widget and frees the popup.

functions.name: Ui_TextPaneWindow_Init
functions.summary: Minimal window initialiser that binds the single text pane 'txt' at the window's base layout id.

functions.name: Ui_TextPaneWindow_DeletingDtor_vt775EB0
functions.summary: Deleting destructor (slot 0) of the single-'txt'-pane window used by the battle command list: runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and frees. The vtable suffix keeps it apart from the other TextPaneWindow tables.

functions.name: Ui_MpDamagePopup_SetNumber
functions.summary: Shows an MP-damage number in the pop-up: normalises the value to <1.0 by dividing by 10, fills the three digit panes 'pop_mpdamage_num1..3' and hides unused digits.

functions.name: Ui_MpDamagePopup_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the numbered MP-damage pop-up: builds the 'pop_mpdamage%d' name, attaches 'X0Y' and resolves its text child.

functions.name: Ui_MpDamagePopup_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for the class whose init is 0x4AAF94 (layout "pop_mpdamage_d"): installs vtable 0x775F48, runs element destructors over the 6 embedded 0xA8-byte popups at +0x13C and the 3 0x50-byte records at +0x4C, then calls the Ui_Object base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_EquipListWindow_Scroll
functions.summary: Scroll handler for the equipment-slot item list: scrolls the list, and only when the visible page byte (+0x64) changed does it rebuild the entries for the currently selected slot (+0x88) and update the scroll bar, then refreshes the cursor info texts.

functions.name: Ui_EquipListWindow_RebuildEntries
functions.summary: Fills the equipment-choice list for one equipment slot (0=left hand,1=right hand,2=head,3=body,4=accessory 1,5=accessory 2): sets the slot label text, builds the filtered item list for the selected party member, then for every row writes the item name via Text_FormatMessageArg and sets the row colour, flagging items that are already equipped on this slot.

functions.name: Ui_EquipListWindow_GetCursorItemId
functions.summary: Returns the u16 item id of the entry under the list cursor (cell index from GetCursorCell combined with page and row pitch into the 8-byte entry array at +0x7C), or the global 'no item' value when the cell is out of range.

functions.name: Ui_EquipListWindow_GetCursorEquippedItemId
functions.summary: Returns the short at +2 of the entry under the cursor, which the rebuild code compares against the item currently equipped on that character/slot (0x6297C8), i.e. the id of what is equipped right now for that row.

functions.name: Ui_EquipListWindow_GetCursorOwnerFlag
functions.summary: Returns the byte at +5 of the entry under the cursor; the cursor-info updater uses it to decide between the owning character name and the bag word, so it is the equipped-by/in-bag flag getter.

functions.name: Ui_EquipListWindow_UpdateCursorInfoText
functions.summary: Refreshes the two detail lines of the equipment list for the entry under the cursor: line 1 shows the owning character's name or 'fukuro' (bag), line 2 shows 'soubi-chuu' (currently equipped) or 'mochimono' (belongings).

functions.name: Ui_MessageSubTextWindow_Init
functions.summary: Binds a body text pane plus three left and three right sub-rows (the message window variant that also exposes the 'txt_text' body).

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_SubWidget_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the sub-widget used inside the equipment window (layout 'win_equip2'): builds the base object, installs vtable 0x775FAC and allocates its 0x37C-byte helper table.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_SubWidget_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the sub-widget created by 0x4ABA84: restores the vtable passed in, frees the record array at +0x74, calls the Ui_Object base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_BindMessagePanes
functions.summary: Resolves the two message panes named 'txt_meesage1' and 'txt_meesage2' (spelling as in the layout) and stores them on the equip window, then refreshes the window.

functions.name: PartyStatus_LoadNewestRecord
functions.signature: void PartyStatus_LoadNewestRecord(u32 arg1, int rebuildPanel, int arg3)
functions.summary: Rebuilds the party-status view from the stored time-tagged records: fills the cached party sizes, picks the record with the newest Svc_Time timestamp, copies its 0x44-byte slot with std_memcpy and rebuilds the panel when asked.

functions.name: maybe_Field_TalkParams_EnsureLabelObject
functions.summary: Talk-parameter helper called from Field_SetupTalkParams: checks the record's two flag bytes, lazily creates the global 0x80-byte label object (func_00384050) and then measures the wide string at work+0x2D0C8 (the current speaker/label text).

functions.name: PartyStatus_ApplyPendingReload
functions.summary: Checks if a pending reload request is latched at self+8, forwards reload parameters at self+9 and self+10 to PartyStatus_LoadNewestRecord (0x004ABC48), and clears the request bytes.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_SetSpinRateConstant

functions.summary: Constructor of an embedded UI object of the casino slot machine (vtable 0x776084, 0x100 bytes): initialises the Ui_Object base and clears eight 0x10-byte digit/payline groups at +0x80..+0xFF to {0x7F,0,0,0}.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_Ctor_7760E8

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_Dtor_7760E8

functions.name: Ui_FormatWindowArgSlot

functions.name: Casino_Slot_SetDigitSprite

functions.name: Ui_TextPaneWindow_Init_776168

functions.name: Ui_ItemGrid_RefreshPage

functions.name: Ui_PartyListWindow_SetVisible

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_Init
functions.summary: Binds a seven-row list ('txt_l0'..) plus a six-row footer ('txt_e0'..) and the two pager arrows.

functions.name: Ui_PartyListWindow_Ctor

functions.name: Ui_PartyListWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the party member list window created by 0x004AE758.

functions.name: Field_BattleTrigger_StartBattle

functions.name: Field_BattleTrigger_HandleTouch
functions.summary: Touch/click handler of the field battle-trigger object: hit-tests the cursor against the trigger shape and, on a hit, notifies the cursor owner at game work+0x54 and returns 1.

functions.name: Field_BattleTrigger_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the field battle trigger (the region that starts a battle when the player enters it): installs vtable 0x77627C and resets the shape/alpha bytes.

functions.name: Field_BattleTrigger_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field battle-trigger object (class of 0x004AE8C4 / 0x004AEB70).

functions.name: Field_MapObject2D_SetupFromList19D4

functions.name: Field_MapObject2D_SetupFromList1BE4
functions.summary: Initialises a Field_MapObject2D from a record of the scene's f_1BE4 object list: copies the type id to +0x3C, sets +0x64=0 and +0x65=1 and skips the record-flag copy.

functions.summary: Resolves the actor handle at self+0x30 through the global handle table and starts a behaviour state on that actor with the object's vec3 at +0x48, choosing between two behaviour-start entry points by the actor's category byte; does nothing if the actor is already in states 0x19/0x1A.

functions.name: Field_MapObject2D_Ctor
functions.summary: In-place constructor of the 0x2C4-byte 2D field object: base-inits it, installs vtable 0x7762E4, seeds two vec3s at +0x48 (negated) and +0x54 from globals, sets +0x64=1/+0x65=0/+0x66=0 and constructs the sprite at +0x68.

functions.name: Field_MapObject2D_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 2D field object: stores the class vtable, destroys the embedded sprite at +0x68, releases the object with Ui_DestroyObject and frees it.

functions.name: Field_MapObject2D_DispatchCommand
functions.summary: Resolves the object's target from its handle and forwards a command (id self->f_30) to it through vtable+0x7C; returns 0 when the handle no longer resolves.

functions.summary: In-place constructor of the tiny helper object that stores an actor handle: runs the shared base init and installs the class vtable; its methods forward virtual calls to the actor resolved from the stored handle.

functions.name: Field_MapObject2D_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the Field_MapObject2D object: Ui_Object_DtorBody + operator delete. It is slot 1 of table 0x77630C, whose class method at +0x1C is Field_MapObject2D_DispatchCommand.

functions.summary: Resolves the referenced object and forwards the value to its vtable+0xC0 setter.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_DeletingDtor_vt77635C

functions.name: maybe_Field_Prop_IsEventSlotFree

functions.name: Actor2D_EffectNode_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 2D effect node: runs the Actor2D base destructor (0x28EFB4) and frees.

functions.summary: Clears the object's effect flags and, if the effect node is present, tells it to stop (vtable+0x38).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_IsEventSlotFree

functions.name: Field_Prop_UpdateEffect2D

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_SetModelAnimSimple
functions.signature: void Event_ActorModels_SetModelAnimSimple(EventActorModels* self, u32 archive, u32 animId, EventModel* model)
functions.summary: Simplified animation switch for an event actor model: builds %s.ani, loads it from the archive and applies it (setting f_A8 and scale 1.0 unless the id is 0x36), without the expression-slot branch of 0x004B8DEC.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_IsModelIdle
functions.summary: Reports whether an event actor model finished its current action: checks the model's animation state (f_A8/f_A5) and the current track's f_60/f_30, returning 1 for idle/usable.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_AllocModelSlot
functions.signature: void Event_ActorModels_AllocModelSlot(EventActorModels* self, uint archive, uint modelId, uint arg4, BattleUnit* unit)
functions.summary: Finds a free model slot (8 slots at +0x4C), creates the model through 0x4B9DA4, links the owning battle unit and allocates the unit's 0x8D0-byte effect array.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_SetGroupState
functions.summary: Applies state changes across the three model group slots (+0x6C, +0x70, +0x74): invokes vtable+0x98 (reset) and additionally sets group flag through vtable+0x9C (mode 1) or +0xA0 (mode 2).

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_LoadPartResources
functions.signature: void Event_ActorModels_LoadPartResources(EventActorModels* self, uint archive, BattleUnit* unit)
functions.summary: Loads every model part of a battle/event unit: iterates 47 part rows x 6 sub-parts (0x63FC70), resolving each part id and loading its resources through Event_ActorModels_LoadModelResources.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_ResetModelState
functions.summary: Resets an event actor model's animation state to idle/cleared: clears the anim flags (f_A5/f_A6/f_A7/f_A8) and stops the current track, mirroring Event_ActorModels_IsModelIdle.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_CreateSpritePart
functions.signature: void* Event_ActorModels_CreateSpritePart(ActorModelSet* set, int group, void* resName, int slotArg, ActorEntry* owner)
functions.summary: Creates a sprite/effect part for a cutscene actor: resolves the resource, allocates the 0x118-byte part, positions it in the viewport using the same 64/128/256/200/131 mapping as 0x4B930C, stores it in the first free transform slot and activates it.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_CreateMonsterModel
functions.signature: void Event_ActorModels_CreateMonsterModel(ActorModelSet* set, int group, void* modelRes, void* extraRes, int slotArg, ActorEntry* owner)
functions.summary: Creates a monster model for a cutscene actor (model id 0x360/0x361 class): resolves both resource names, builds the model through Monster_Model_Create, places it in the actor's transform slot, activates it and records it in the 3 monster-model slots at +0x78.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_UpdatePartOffset
functions.summary: Advances one model part offset: for the current model it sets f_6C to the sum of the two stored offsets (f_88+f_89), otherwise it asks the slot model found through Event_ActorModels_FindModel to advance (virtual +0x74).

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_CreateMonsterModelDual
functions.signature: void Event_ActorModels_CreateMonsterModelDual(ActorModelSet* set, int group, void* res1, void* res2, void* res3, void* res4, int arg7, int arg8, ActorEntry* owner)
functions.summary: Creates a two-pattern monster model for a cutscene actor (model id 400): resolves the four resource names, builds it with Monster_Model_CreateDualPattern (the variant that blends two body patterns), places and activates it in the actor's transform slot and records it as the entity's model.

functions.name: Battle_Action_ShouldUpdateUnitModel
functions.summary: Eligibility check run before an action updates its unit model in the battle scene: rejects unit 0x350 and idle 0x18F/0x1A5, verifies anim alpha blend > 0, action flag +0x2C != 0, unit flag f_f21 == 0, and confirms model presence with 0x004B98F8.

functions.name: BattleScene_BindUnitModelResources
functions.signature: void BattleScene_BindUnitModelResources(BattleScene* self, uint archive, BattleUnit* unit)
functions.summary: Binds the full resource set (model, anim, bch, bxon) of a battle unit's model: walks 47x6 part entries, loads each resource through the archive and attaches it to the model node; unit id 400 also gets the extra 'm210b' row.

functions.name: BattleScene_SetupUnitModelVariant
functions.signature: void BattleScene_SetupUnitModelVariant(BattleScene* self, u32 archive, BattleUnit* unit)
functions.summary: Sets up a unit model variant: for the current model it copies f_89 into f_6C, otherwise it finds the slot model and calls vtable+0x44(unit, unit->f_768 & 0xFFFF) followed by the finalise slot +0x70.

functions.name: BattleScene_ClearUnitAnimSlots
functions.summary: Counterpart of Scene_ReleaseUnitAnimSlots for battle scenes: scans the 20 animation-slot entries (stride 0x0C) and drops the ones bound to the action's unit (same actor id at unit+0x14), also clearing already-dead entries whose player pointer is null.

functions.name: BattleScene_AllocUnitModelSlot
functions.signature: void BattleScene_AllocUnitModelSlot(BattleScene* self, u32 archive, u32 modelId, u32 animId, u32 arg5, BattleUnit* unit)
functions.summary: Finds one of the two battle model slots at +0x6C, creates the model through maybe_Battle_SceneInit_Shared, links it to the unit and allocates the unit's 0x8D0-byte effect array.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SceneInit_Shared
functions.signature: void* maybe_Battle_SceneInit_Shared(u32 owner, u32 parameter, u32 parameter2, u32 parameter3)
functions.summary: Large battle-scene setup routine: allocates several helper objects, installs the two unit-model vtables (0x7759FC / 0x775AB8) and links the scene's camera, animation and text objects.

functions.name: BattleScene_LoadUnitSubResources
functions.signature: void BattleScene_LoadUnitSubResources(BattleScene* self, u32 archive, BattleUnit* unit)
functions.summary: Loads a battle unit's sub-model resources: the 47x6 part table through func_0063FC70, up to 10 nested sub-parts per model (model+0x118) via Event_ActorModels_LoadModelResources, with id overrides for units 0x1A4/0x1A5/0x350.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_LoadPartyModelResources
functions.summary: Loads the party model resources for both battle model containers: walks the 47x6 part entries per container, builds the '.ani'/'.bxon'/'.bch' paths (plus the 'm210b' row for unit 400) and binds each resource to its model node.

functions.name: BattleScene_InitModelContainer
functions.signature: void BattleScene_InitModelContainer(BattleModelContainer* self, u32 owner, ModelDesc* desc, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initializes a battle scene model container: stores owner and descriptor, initializes embedded list node via Container_ListNode_Ctor_vt778F00 (0x004D2A98), sets no-model marker 0xFF at +0x108, and clears 20 animation-slot records (12 bytes each).

functions.name: Ui_NamedEntry_InitFromName
functions.signature: UiNamedEntry* Ui_NamedEntry_InitFromName(UiNamedEntry* self, const char* name)
functions.summary: Builds a small named list entry: copies up to 62 characters of the name into the inline buffer at self+0x14, installs the entry vtable/flags, and registers the finished 0x3c-byte record with the UI table manager (func_003882F0) before inserting it into the global list.

functions.name: Battle_Model_UpdateVisibility
functions.signature: void Battle_Model_UpdateVisibility(BattleModel* self, int frameArg, int arg3)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a battle model with visibility handling: hides the model while its cutscene actor is model 0x350, scans the four event actor lists for the 0x18F/0x1A5 models, runs the shared model update and then sets the material/visibility byte +0x26 to 0 or 0xFF.

functions.name: Ui_NamedEntry_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the named list entry created by Ui_NamedEntry_InitFromName: releases the registered table handle, drops the cached name buffer at self+0x68 and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_UpdateIntroMessage
functions.summary: Battle UI step at state 0x1F18: copies the actor's +0xE8A into self+0x125C and pushes messages 0x803 and 0x5D for that actor, then waits for the actor queue and advances to 0x1F2C.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_MemberModel_DtorA
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the first of four party member-model subclasses: runs the shared base destructor 0x00200220 and frees object memory.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_ForwardCommand
functions.summary: Command forwarder for the battle UI: clears the object's active byte, asks the current view (vtable +0x10c) to handle the command, and if it declines forwards the command to the base handler (vtable +0x60).

functions.name: Battle_FindActorWithCondition9A
functions.summary: Searches the battle's actor list and returns the first actor that satisfies condition id 0x9A (a 'downed/removed' style state). Used by the battle UI to pick the actor whose messages/rows should be refreshed.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_ShowActionEffectMessage
functions.signature: u8 Battle_Ui_ShowActionEffectMessage(BattleUi* self, BattleActor* actor, ActionRecord* action, int value, int showPopup)
functions.summary: Shows the message/effect feedback of one battle action: resolves the action id through the battle tables, builds the message row and the floating-number popup, plays the sound tied to the action, and spawns the effect balloon for special ids (0x8F, 0x98, 0xF0..0xF2). Returns 1 when the action was handled.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_ShowActionMessage
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_ShowActionMessage(BattleUi* self, int actionId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Displays the message associated with a battle action row: looks up ActionRecord via 0x0063FD24(dm, actionId) and dispatches message 0x466 (with extra parameter arg4) or 0x488 through self->vtable[0xC4].

functions.name: Battle_Ui_PushUnitMessageFromDescriptor
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Ui_PushUnitMessageFromDescriptor(BattleUi* self, BattleUiUnit* unit, const uint16* messageDesc)
functions.summary: Pushes a battle message for a unit from a 6-halfword descriptor: resolves the data row, uses the unit's status vtable calls, special-cases status ids 0x98/0xF0/0xF1/0xF2 and falls back to Ui_LookupMapValueById; returns 1 when a message was queued.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_ApplyUnitHpChange
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Battle_ApplyUnitHpChange(BattleUi* self, u32 unit, u32 value)
functions.summary: Applies a damage/heal number to the acting battle unit: it validates the unit's effect state (0x11) and remaining HP, then either queues action 0x553/0x554 and records it on the unit, or subtracts the action's power from the unit and returns 1.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_UpdateMessageSequence
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Ui_UpdateMessageSequence(BattleUi* self, MessageCtx* ctx, ActorView* view, int actorIndex)
functions.summary: Battle-UI state machine keyed on the acting row (self[0x497] action record): advances a message/animation sequence, pushes battle-message entries, spawns popups and balloons and plays sound effects as each row state finishes.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_ShowItemDropPopup
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_ShowItemDropPopup(BattleUi* self, u32 recordId, u32 owner)
functions.summary: When self+0x128E is set, pushes the action row's +0x154 message id for the owner, or +0x152 when self+0x128F is set.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_ShowDropItemMessage
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Ui_ShowDropItemMessage(BattleUi* self, int showFallback, int slot, DropTable* drops, int arg5)
functions.summary: Shows the battle-result drop messages: for the current drop slot it checks the monster/item counters in the battle tables, opens the item entry window for the dropped item, and falls back to message ids 0x42/0x43 (or an empty popup) when nothing dropped. Returns 1 when a message was posted.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_UpdateTargetMarkerPosition

functions.signature: void Ui_Window_BindTwoLinePanes(Ui_Window* self, LayoutView* layout, int arg3, int arg4)

functions.summary: Applies the battle arc layout mode from battle work +0x4202: stores the mode byte, seeds the angle/velocity constants, re-arranges the rows on the arc and clears the two unit-list float parameters at +0x4254/+0x4270.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_TargetGroup_UpdateCornerAnimA

functions.name: Ui_Window_UpdateScrollOffset

functions.name: Battle_Ui_TargetGroup_UpdateCornerAnimB

functions.name: Battle_Ui_TargetGroup_CalcGroupBounds

functions.name: Ui_ArcListWindow_Dtor

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_CreateQuadObject
functions.signature: int Ui_Overlay_CreateQuadObject(int parent, int variant, u32* colors)

functions.name: Ui_SlotPlateWindow_StopSpin

functions.name: Ui_SlotPlateWindow_Init
functions.signature: void Ui_SlotPlateWindow_Init(UiWindow* self, UiLayout* layout, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)

functions.name: Ui_SlotMachine_DtorBase

functions.name: maybe_Field_Marker_UpdateScreenOffset

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_CreateBrief

functions.name: Field_Marker3D_DtorA

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_RaycastToWorldPoint

functions.name: Gfx_CollisionProxy_InitDesc

functions.name: Field_Marker3D_DtorB

functions.name: Text_BuildMessageGlyphRun

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateAttachedEffect
functions.summary: Per-frame actor effect update: plays the behaviour's animation label, updates the attached effect and, when the incoming strength exceeds 0, runs the extra effect callback before starting the attached effect.

functions.name: Battle_Action_Break_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Battle_Action_Break_Ctor(u32 heap, void* owner, u32 arg3, const char* name, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Constructor of the battle action class registered as 'break' (equipment/guard break).

functions.name: Ui_LoopPane_DtorDelete

The same class also owns the "loop" child object at +0x4C (0x004C43A8) and plays the "dmg" label (0x004C4320), i.e. it is the looping damage-number popup.

functions.name: Ui_LoopPane_Init

functions.name: Ui_LoopPane_DeleteDtor

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ResourceList_PreloadType4

functions.name: maybe_Container_LookupType4Value

functions.name: Battle_TextWindow_LoadTextureSet

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_CtorArray37

functions.name: Battle_TextWindow_ReleaseTextureSet
functions.summary: Releases the 37 'ui/dive' texture handles loaded by Battle_TextWindow_LoadTextureSet and resets the array to the empty-handle sentinel.

functions.name: Ui_ItemUse_ApplyHpRecovery

functions.name: Ui_List_FillPageRows

functions.name: Ui_PagedListWindow_Init
functions.summary: Binds a paged two-column list ('txt_l0'/'txt_r0' rows), an 'txt_empty' placeholder and the pager arrows.

functions.name: Ui_List_SwitchPageMode
functions.summary: Switches the list between its two page sizes (0x30 and 0x60 entries): saves the current page and row counts for the old mode, changes the page size, re-selects the first row of the new page and replays the row updates.

functions.name: Ui_PagedListWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the paged list window used by the menu screens: base-constructs through 0x2B1E0C, installs vtable 0x777F94, embeds a sub-object at +0x54 (0x622248), stores the owner at +0x70 and default-constructs 16 rows of 0x10 bytes at +0x74 plus two 8-byte entries at +0x178.

functions.name: Ui_List_DeleteDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the list window: destroys the 16-row array, runs the Ui_Object destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_PagedListWindow_SetPageRows
functions.signature: void Ui_PagedListWindow_SetPageRows(PagedListWindow* self, int page, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Fills the sixteen visible rows from page: rows that have an entry get the text of their u16 id via 0x4C525C, rows past the end get the default 'empty' text plus the transparent colour 0xFFFF, then it computes the number of rows on this page and updates the pager position through the window's layout.

functions.name: Ui_ListRow_SetFlaggedValueText
functions.summary: Sets one list row's text from a table entry: 0xFFFF shows the empty text; otherwise it tests the global flag bitmap (work+0x273FC) and either displays the entry's stored colour/text from the 0xA24-byte table or formats the numeric value.

functions.name: Ui_List_ClearRow
functions.signature: void Ui_List_ClearRow(Ui_Row* row, int arg2, int arg3, int row2)
functions.summary: Clears a list row: resets its pane template, marks its id as empty (0xFFFF) and sets an empty text run through the text-layer API.

functions.name: Ui_PagedListWindow2_SetVisible
functions.summary: Visibility override of the second paged-list widget; delegates to Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim.

functions.name: Ui_PagedListWindow2_Init
functions.summary: Second variant of the paged two-column list window; additionally calls func_00622038 (pager step/limit setup).

functions.name: Ui_PagedListWindow_CtorVariant
functions.summary: Constructor of the second paged-list window class: constructs the base object, builds the +0x54 sub-object, installs vtables 0x77800C/0x75EB0C, stores the owner and default-constructs the 16-element row array.

functions.name: Ui_List_DeleteDtorB
functions.summary: Second deleting destructor for a list window variant: destroys the row array, runs the Ui_Object destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_FindVisibleEntry
functions.summary: Finds the first visible field-model object belonging to the list (matching owner id f_154 and state 1/2 at +0x26A), caches its index in f_264 and returns that row's data through 0x0062A9F4.

functions.name: Monster_EcologyActor_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a field-monster ecology actor: sets up its ecology behaviour by monster id and creates the associated effect/render object.

functions.name: Actor_CheckVisibility
functions.summary: Visibility/range test used by the field actor manager: for itself and three 0x40-byte sibling slots it checks the object handle, resolves the candidate object and tests its position with Field_IsPointInActorViewCone; on the first hit it stores the slot index in f_27C and returns whether one was found.

functions.name: Ui_Object_TrivialDeleteDtor
functions.summary: Minimal deleting destructor for a class whose destructor has no work to do: stores the base vtable pointer into the object and frees it with operator delete.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_CycleDetailMode
functions.summary: Cycles the equipment window three-way detail mode by delta with wrap-around, and on a change looks up the matching icon (ids 7/8/9 through 0x0039E628) and writes it into node (f_28<<16)|1. Called from Ui_EquipWindow_HandleInput.

functions.name: Ui_TextRowL1_Alt_SetVisible
functions.summary: Visibility override of the alternate level-1 text row: calls Ui_Pane_SetVisibleWithAnim(self, visible) and then applies the row's own follow-up work.

functions.name: Ui_TextRowL1_Alt_Init
functions.summary: Binds one text pane: runs the base constructor, then calls the window's +0x34 pane-binding slot twice - once for the literal 'txt_l1' (0x004C6218) with a colour from func_0039E628(4), once for the second pane id 0x004C6220 with flag bit 0.

functions.name: Ui_EquipWindow_SubObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the equipment window's slot widget: shared Ui_Object constructor, class vtable and slot index 0 in the byte at +0x49.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorTrivialL
functions.summary: Trivial destructor of another member-less Ui_Object subclass: shared Ui_Object destructor plus free.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_UpdateFrame

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_Show
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteObject_Show(SpriteObject* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_Hide
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteObject_Hide(SpriteObject* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_InitFromDesc

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_HideIfDrawing

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_Ctor_2

functions.summary: Constructor of the sprite object: builds the Ui drawable from the two definition blocks, installs the sprite-object vtable and initialises the frame/visibility state (frame 0, enabled, visible).

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_SetNodeFlagOff
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteObject_SetNodeFlagOff(void* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)

functions.summary: Initialises a sprite object from a BFLYT/layout sprite descriptor: stores the transform, frame and mode, composes the entity matrix, builds the sprite name 'fChit_<id>' and creates one of three sprite variants (plain/rotated/matrix) accordingly.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_SetVisibleOn
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteObject_SetVisibleOn(SpriteObject* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_CtorWithVectors
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteObject_CtorWithVectors(int owner, void* parentDef, void* layoutDef)

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_Dtor

functions.name: maybe_Field_CreateInteractableObject

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_DtorB

functions.summary: Copies the marker's stored position (f_D4..f_DC) to the actor at work+8->+0x54->+0x1C, marks its position dirty (+0x118) and notifies the UI core.

functions.name: Event_ShowTextToken1E

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Fade_IsIdle
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_Fade_IsIdle(void* self, void* arg2, void* arg3, void* arg4)

functions.name: maybe_Field_ApplyOverlaySlotStateChange

functions.name: Field_Marker_DrawOverlay
functions.summary: Draws the marker's screen overlay: projects the world position with the camera block, computes the quad corners and submits the sprite. Returns 0 when the marker is hidden, off-screen or the view is 2D.

functions.summary: Marker side of the same wait: when the field marker state query on work+0x48 reports all slots free it advances the marker's state sequence at self+0x48 to state 3 and returns 1.

functions.name: Field_Marker_ShowWithEffect
functions.summary: Shows the marker: places the actor at the stored position, rotates it to the marker direction, attaches the marker model/sprite and enables the overlay element class.

functions.name: Field_Marker_HideWithEffect

functions.name: Field_Marker_Dtor

functions.name: Field_Marker_DtorB

functions.name: Field_Marker_DtorC

functions.name: Model_Actor_ResetAnimSequence
functions.summary: Clears the actor's animation-track list at +0x9C and resets the two cached track handles at +0x94/+0x98 and the 'pose dirty' byte at +0x104, so the next update rebuilds the pose from scratch.

functions.name: Model_Actor_ApplyTransformFromSource
functions.summary: Applies a source transform to the model actor: when the attachment source (f_94/f_98) is valid and the two animation cursors differ, it rebuilds the local matrix at +0x9C and copies or adds the stored position/rotation block f_D0..f_FC into the actor transform at +4..+0x28, renormalising the rotation.

functions.name: maybe_Model_Actor_CacheAttachOffset
functions.summary: Initialises the actor transform from its placement record (position +0x94..+0x9C, rotation +0xB0) and then caches whether the model has a '$offset' attachment node: the name is looked up in the model's node trie and the result is stored as a flag at +0x104.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneObject_CtorB
functions.summary: Second scene-object constructor: installs vtable 0x0077AE08, builds the object through the same sub-constructors as Ui_SceneObject_Ctor and applies the scale/angle defaults.

functions.name: Model_Actor_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of the Model_Actor class: reinstates its own vtable and the embedded sub-object vtable at +0x9C, tears the sub-object down and frees the instance.

functions.name: Model_Actor_ResetPoseTime
functions.summary: Restarts the actor's animation clock: copies the animation start time (+0x30) over the current pose time (+0x3C) via 0x002E460C and marks the pose as needing an update (+0xC8 = 1).

functions.name: Model_Actor_AnimState_DtorDelete

functions.name: Ui_Prop_SpawnChildEffects
functions.summary: Creates the two child effect instances a UI prop owns: it takes the prop's child-bounds centre, spawns the effect id stored in the prop's first two u16 fields and keeps the handles at +0x1DA/+0x1DC, playing each slot's sound effect.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Prop_UpdateChildEffects
functions.summary: Per-frame sibling of 0x004E3714: re-creates the prop's child effect when the slot id changes, walks the child model slots, applies the layout parameters and plays the slot SE.

functions.name: Ui_Prop_CalcChildBoundsCenter
functions.summary: Computes the centre of the bounding box of the prop's up-to-16 visible children by taking the min/max of their x/z corners.

functions.name: Model_GetNamedNodeWorldPosition
functions.signature: void Model_GetNamedNodeWorldPosition(float * out, int nameId, void * obj)
functions.summary: Writes the world position of a named model node: starts from the zero vector, finds the node id by name, applies its transform and adds the model offset from the 0x7E7110 table.

functions.name: Ui_ItemListCore_InitState
functions.signature: void Ui_ItemListCore_InitState(UiItemListCore* self, unsigned char mode)
functions.summary: Initialises the shared item-list core inside a menu window: stores the mode byte, resets the embedded tween at +0x2428 and refreshes the list through the owning widget's virtual.

functions.name: Ui_ItemListCore_SetMode
functions.signature: void Ui_ItemListCore_SetMode(UiItemListCore* self, unsigned char mode)
functions.summary: Sets the item-list core mode byte, re-initialises its iterator at +0x17 and asks the list to refresh through vtable +0x5C.

functions.name: Ui_ItemListCore_ApplyMode
functions.summary: Re-applies the stored item-list mode: re-initialises the list iterator at self+0x17 with the mode byte at self[0x1F] and, when the flag at self[0x16] is set, notifies the owning widget through vtable slot +0x5C.

functions.name: Ui_ItemListCore_Ctor
functions.summary: Creates the shared item-list core used by the item, equipment and shop menus: installs vtable 0x77AECC and sets up its embedded list widget with entry width 0x11.

functions.name: Ui_ItemListCore_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the shared item-list core used by the item, equipment and shop menus: restores both base vtables, tears the row down through Ui_ItemMenu_Row_Dtor and frees.

functions.name: Ui_TenRowTextWidget_Init
functions.summary: Binds ten left text rows (txt_l1..txt_l10) together with their ten null_txt_l1..null_txt_l10 template panes, then finishes the window.

functions.name: Ui_TenRowTextWidget_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the ten-row text widget: Ui_Object_DtorBase plus the shared free thunk 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Battle_DamageExtWindow_Init

functions.summary: Initialises the extended damage display: creates the 'dmgExt' action object, the 'meshBG' background and the text/effect child used for battle damage presentation.

functions.name: Ui3D_ApplyModelVisibility
functions.summary: Re-applies the node's pending model-visibility flag to the scene model (visible = f_6FE), clears the flag, and fires the "cbhm_arm_alive" and "cbhm_mask_alive" model animations so the character's arms/mask follow the state.

functions.name: Actor_Action_ApplyFlagsAndAdvanceState
functions.summary: Conditional transition of an actor action: when the actor is in state 7 it decides (using the optional sub-object at +0x238, its vtable slot 0xE8 tag 0xDA, and the current +0x6FF/+0x700 flags) whether the incoming 3-byte flag triple may be copied into +0x6FF..+0x701; it then advances the action state to 7, or tells the parent at +0x60 to run command 9 if already there.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_AnimWindow_DtorWithVtable
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor helper of the battle animation-window family: stores the vtable passed in r1 at +0 and its secondary table at +0x220, runs Battle_AnimWindow_ReleaseHandles and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui3D_ComputeOrientationBasis
functions.summary: Builds the orientation basis for a 3D UI element from the rotation stored at host+0x88..0xA4, optionally folding in the world matrix of the scene node named "N_ALL", fixes the handedness when the trace is negative, normalises the axes and applies the resulting basis to the draw object at self+0x50.

functions.name: Ui3D_Node_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor of a 2D/3D UI node that uses the Gfx sprite/2D-node base: calls the base destructor 0x00406E04 and frees the instance.

functions.name: Ui3D_InitEffectEntryFromRecord
functions.summary: Initialises one 0x24-byte effect-entry record: derives the source rect from the record's offset table, resolves the resource and entry for the record's kind byte and short id, creates the matching draw entry (id stored at f_20) and marks the entry visible (f_1c = 1).

functions.name: Ui3D_ShowEffectEntry
functions.signature: void Ui3D_ShowEffectEntry(Ui3DEffectEntry* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Turns the entry's draw object on: if the visible flag f_1c is clear it sets f_1c = 1 and calls func_002E76AC(app, f_20, 1), which clears the hidden bit (f_67 bit 0) of the draw object identified by the id left in f_20.

functions.name: Ui3D_HideEffectEntry
functions.signature: void Ui3D_HideEffectEntry(Ui3DEffectEntry* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Turns the entry's draw object off: if f_1c is set it clears it and calls func_002E76AC(app, f_20, 0), which sets the hidden bit of the draw object held in f_20.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSprite_Dtor
functions.summary: Base destructor of the scene-sprite class with vtable 0x0077B0C0: installs the class vtable, releases the sprite child handle at +0x20 through the scene context and erases the embedded +0x4 red-black-tree node when the +0x14 flag is set.

functions.name: Ui3D_InitEffectPairFromRecord
functions.summary: Initialises one 0x28-byte effect-pair record: walks the record's 0x44-stride transform list and its 0x24-stride id list, feeding each entry to the draw-object transform setters, then builds the "ECV:%x" name from rec[5] and resolves the two draw-entry ids stored at f_20/f_24.

functions.name: HON
functions.signature: void HON(int arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: Ui3D_HideEffectPairAux
functions.signature: void Ui3D_HideEffectPairAux(Ui3DEffectPair* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Hides the second draw object of the pair: clears f_1c and calls func_002E6C68(app, f_24, 0), which sets bit 31 of the object's f_10 flag word.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSprite_DtorB
functions.summary: Base destructor of the second scene-sprite class (vtable 0x0077B0D8): installs the class vtable, pushes the UV scene node at +0x8 through maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_SetUV and erases the +0x4 red-black-tree node when the +0x14 flag is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui3D_SubmitRecord
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui3D_SubmitRecord(void* self, u32 unusedA, u32 unusedB, u32 unusedC)
functions.summary: Submits the three-word record at self+0x48 to the 3-D UI manager at work+8->+0x74 through func_002AE0C4, which copies it to manager+0x74 and stamps +0x70 = 0xFF and +0x80 = 0xF0000000. Returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui3D_RecordObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a small UI-3D record object: Ui_Object_DtorBody + operator delete. It is slot 1 of type table 0x77B0F0, whose class method at +0x1C is maybe_Ui3D_SubmitRecord (submits the 3-word record at +0x48 to the UI manager).

functions.name: Ui3D_InitPanelFromRecord
functions.signature: void Ui3D_InitPanelFromRecord(Ui3DPanel* self, const u32* rec)
functions.summary: Initialises the 0x5a4-byte panel from its definition record: scales the two transform pairs by 0.5, converts the record's rotation quad into a matrix, sets both draw nodes (+0xec and +0x348), writes their slot-4 resource masks and the shared 0xffe attribute, and keeps the record pointer at f_e8.

functions.name: Ui3D_AttachDrawNodes
functions.summary: One-shot activation of the panel: marks it active (f_2c = 1), registers/attaches both draw nodes (+0xec, +0x348) with the renderer and enables the two embedded sub-panels at +0x48 and +0x98.

functions.name: Ui3D_DetachDrawNodes
functions.summary: One-shot deactivation of the panel: clears f_2c, detaches both draw nodes from the renderer and disables the two embedded sub-panels at +0x48 and +0x98.

functions.name: Ui3D_ConstructPanel
functions.summary: In-place constructor of the 0x5A4-byte UI3D panel: installs type table 0x0077B118, links the three list heads (+0, +0x48, +0x50) as a circular list and constructs the two 0x25C draw nodes at +0xEC and +0x348, returning the panel base (the inverse is 0x004E52AC).

functions.name: Ui3D_DestructPanel
functions.signature: void Ui3D_DestructPanel(Ui3DPanel* self, const void* typeTable)
functions.summary: Destructor of the 0x5A4-byte UI 3D panel: installs the base type table, destroys the two 0x25C draw nodes at +0x348/+0xEC and the three embedded list objects at +0x98/+0x50/+0x48, then frees the allocation.

functions.name: Ui3D_ApplySlotMasks
functions.signature: u32 Ui3D_ApplySlotMasks(Ui3DPanel* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Applies the panel's two 18-bit slot masks to the shared resource table: bits set in the show mask mark the slot byte 1, bits in the hide mask mark it 0, and the table dirty flag is raised.

functions.name: Ui3D_ConstructListElement
functions.summary: Constructor of the 0x50-byte UI3D draw-list element: obtains the object from the shared scene allocator, installs type table 0x0077B140 and clears the two id words at +0x48/+0x4C. The object table inserts it into the keyed tree by its record key.

functions.name: Ui3D_SlotMaskPanel_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the UI-3D slot-mask object: Ui_Object_DtorBody + operator delete. It is slot 1 of type table 0x77B140, whose class method at +0x1C is the confident Ui3D_ApplySlotMasks.

functions.name: Ui3D_AttachRecordEntries
functions.summary: Walks the element's entry-record block (unless the current scene mode is masked out), resolves each entry's actor object and animation, re-initialises its draw parameters and re-attaches it to the render list through Ui_ActorSlot_BindActor.

functions.name: maybe_Ui3D_RecordEntryObject_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a UI-3D record-entry object: Ui_Object_DtorBody + operator delete. It is slot 1 of type table 0x77B168, whose class method at +0x1C is maybe_Ui3D_AttachRecordEntries.

functions.name: Ui3D_UpdateAttackSequence
functions.summary: Drives the element's three-state attack animation: state 0 picks the FAtk_SR_{NoW,THS,Swd} animation from the equipped weapon class, aims the model's facing at the target and locks it; state 1 counts down the two timing windows and, when the second expires, spawns the swoosh draw entry (id 0x48F) and triggers the follow-up animation; state 2 finishes and notifies the scene manager.

functions.name: Ui3D_TryStartAttackSequence

functions.name: Ui_Effect2DOverlay_End
functions.summary: Ends the 2D effect overlay: ends the Effect2D frame, releases the element animation and restores the element's stored position/scale from the constant block at 0x7E7000. Counterpart of 0x4FB814 (adjacent vtable slot); the only callee is the Effect2D end-frame call.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_RuraStart_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the field actor action that plays the "Rura_Start" teleport spell: builds the action object from Field_ActorAction_Ctor, installs vtable 0x77D198 and copies the 15-character action name "Rura_Start" into the object. The only string in the function is "Rura_Start"; the class base is Field_ActorAction_Ctor (0x3E4A10), so this is the action instance for that scripted spell.

functions.name: Ui_Effect2DOverlay_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the 2-D effect overlay window class. The real entry is 0x004fbd20, which loads vtable 0x77d198; the body then stamps it, runs the UI base destructor 0x003e4a4c (-> 0x00294c88 -> 0x00193e44) and frees the object.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_ActorTrailVariant_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a second actor trail-effect variant (the one used from the field side): builds the instance through 0x002d97e8 from the caller's transform and value at arg3+4 with the base layout documented for Effect_ActorTrail_Ctor, links follow/attachment member at +0x44 and stores owning actor at +0x50.

functions.name: Effect_ActorTrailVariant_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field-side actor-trail variant: stamps the follow member at +0x44 with the class vtable, releases it, runs the base object destructor 0x002650C4 on the owning instance and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_HitBox_LoadExtended
functions.signature: void Field_HitBox_LoadExtended(HitBox* self, const uint32_t* desc)
functions.summary: Loads a field hit-box from an extended descriptor: stores the kind byte, resolves two id pairs into the base transform and then copies up to 0x12 named entry transforms (0xC stride) into the array at +0x20, finishing with the flags byte at +0xF8.

functions.name: Field_HitBox_LoadSimple
functions.signature: void Field_HitBox_LoadSimple(HitBox* self, const uint32_t* desc)
functions.summary: Loads a field hit-box from a compact descriptor: forces kind 0xFF, resolves the two id values into the transform and stores the flags byte.

functions.name: Ui_TitlePagerWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the title pager window: stores the owner, links the intrusive list head to itself, installs vtable 0x0077D210 and constructs the embedded 18 x 0xC-byte entry array at +0x20 (vtable 0x0077A31C).

functions.name: Ui_TitlePagerWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the title pager window: restores vtable 0x77D210, destroys its 18 x 0xC-byte child entries at +0x20 and unlinks the intrusive list, then frees the object. The base vtable 0x77D240 of the same class carries 0x4FBF64 (Ui_TitlePagerWindow_InitPanes), which fixes the class name; the function is the derived-class destructor.

functions.name: Ui_TitlePagerWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Initialises a titled paged window: binds the txt_title header and the two pager counters pager_num_r and pager_num_l.

functions.name: Ui_TextBuilder_SetNumericValues
functions.signature: void Ui_TextBuilder_SetNumericValues(int self, u32 builder, u32 record)
functions.summary: Fills the two numeric text entries of a text builder from a record: formats the record's value pair into decimal strings and stores them as the two sub-elements of the element at +0x300. Called by Ui_TextBuilder_InitLayout; the two 0x6F0F1C conversions and the pair of 0x1A6680 element setters are the number-formatting path.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetDetailPair
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_SetDetailPair(UiWidget* self, int value1, int value2)
functions.summary: Writes two numeric detail fields, using the '-' glyph for negative values.

functions.name: Ui_TitlePagerWindow_DtorBase
functions.summary: Base-subobject deleting destructor of the title pager window: Ui_Object_DtorBase plus the shared free thunk 0x0010F6CC. The derived-object destructor of the same class is the already named 0x004FBF1C.

functions.name: Ui_TitlePagerWindow_SetupRows
functions.signature: void Ui_TitlePagerWindow_SetupRows(TitlePagerWindow* self, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4)
functions.summary: Fills the title pager's row list at self+0x50 from the singleton record at +0xE318: reads the record, asks 0x2CE7A8 for the row count and builds the three-column list with that count.

functions.name: Ui_ModeListWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Initialises a mode list: sets up the ten-row mode panes on the child at self+0x14 with mode 1 and binds one null_txt_l1 cursor row before finishing the layout.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ModeListWindow_Dtor
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ModeListWindow_Dtor(void* vptr, void* object, u32 value)
functions.summary: Base-subobject deleting destructor near Ui_ModeListWindow_InitPanes: installs the passed vptr and the +0x50 field on the object, then runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and the shared free thunk 0x0010F6CC. The class link is only by adjacency: no vtable or data word in the image references this address.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieTrack_Create
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_MovieTrack_Create(u32 channel, u32 streamId, u32 frameCount)
functions.summary: Allocates a free 0x70-byte movie-track slot, allocates its frameCount*0x18 descriptor table, opens the decoder channel through 0x0051649C and resets the per-track counters; 0xFFFFFFFF when no slot is free.

functions.name: Gfx_InitCommandPool
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_InitCommandPool(Allocator* alloc, u32 arg2, int count, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Creates the fixed-size command-record pool: asks the supplied allocator for count*0x70 bytes, zeroes it, stores the allocator and the count in the global pool state, initialises the pool lock, and - when the 'async' flag is set - submits a 0x1000-byte command buffer through 0x0010EAB0 (Gfx_CommandBuffer_Submit, N_080). Returns 1 when the pool was created, 0 when it already existed or the allocation failed.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieTrack_Pause
functions.summary: Pauses a movie track by sending decoder state 2 to its handle under the player lock; out-of-range indices are ignored.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieTrack_Resume
functions.summary: Resumes a paused movie track by sending decoder state 0 to its handle under the player lock.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieTrack_QueueBuffer
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_MovieTrack_QueueBuffer(u32 track, void* data, u32 size)
functions.summary: Submits one input buffer for a movie track: refuses when the track has no free frame slot or the 64-entry completion ring is full, flushes the buffer for DMA and pushes {track, data, size} into the ring; returns 1 when queued.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_WaitForTracks
functions.summary: Flushes the movie player until every track reports idle: it sets the 'draining' byte, calls the update pump Gfx_MovieTrack_UpdateAll (0x004FC8A8) while no track has work left and sleeps 5,000,000 ticks between polls. This is vtable slot 2 of the movie player (base 0x00780C14).

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the movie (video playback) object used by the movie player; it has no base destructor of its own, so it only frees the allocation (the real clean-up lives in the neighbouring 0x005646F0 slot).

functions.name: Gfx_MoviePlayer_AddRef
functions.summary: Adds one reference to the global movie-context counter and, on the first reference, initialises the mixer/buffer object embedded at +0xAB0. Used by the window code before starting playback.

functions.name: Gfx_MoviePlayer_ReleaseRef
functions.summary: Drops one reference to the movie context and, when it was initialised, shuts the embedded buffer object down. Exact counterpart of Gfx_MoviePlayer_AddRef.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieTrack_UpdateAll
functions.summary: Per-frame pump of the movie player: under the player lock and the sound driver lock it retires finished frames, feeds every queued buffer from the 64-entry ring into the decoder, accounts the consumed samples and releases the frame slots.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_ShutdownTracks
functions.summary: Tears the whole movie player down: stops every track, releases the deferred-stop event and each slot's handle and frame table, frees the slot array and marks the manager closed (0xFFFFFFFF at 0x7AE160+8).

functions.name: Gfx_MovieTrack_Destroy
functions.summary: Frees one movie track: closes its decoder handle (0x00519BE4), gives the frame-descriptor table back to the player allocator and clears both pointers; out-of-range indices are ignored.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieTrack_Start
functions.summary: Starts a prepared movie track: records the track index and slot array in the slot, configures and starts the decoder channel (priority/stream id, plane pointers), then un-pauses it.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieTrack_ResetQueue
functions.summary: Drops all pending work of one movie track: stops its decoder channel, nulls every entry of the 64-entry completion ring that points at the slot, and clears the frame counters and timestamps.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_WaitTracksFinished
functions.summary: Blocking flush used at movie teardown: while the first track is not in its finished state (+0x10 != 1) it locks the track semaphore, runs one movie update (maybe_Gfx_Movie_Update) and sleeps 1,000,000 ticks; returns 0.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieSurface_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a movie surface wrapper (one decoded video/audio surface); releases the allocation only.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_StreamSlot_AllocEntry
functions.summary: Allocates an 8-byte VRAM bookkeeping entry into the slot's first word and, on success, clears the slot counters f_58/f_5C and the busy byte +6. Returns whether the allocation succeeded.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_QueueSurfaceSlot
functions.summary: Adds one decoded surface to the movie player's four-entry ring: returns 0 when the ring is full (write index - read index == 4) or the surface is not ready, otherwise stores {surface,track,timestamp} in ring[idx & 3] (0x14-byte entries) and bumps the write index.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_WaitSurfacesIdle
functions.summary: Blocks until all four decoded-frame surfaces are free: it keeps pulling from Gfx_Movie_PresentFrame (0x004FD4F4) and, when the ring is non-empty, counts how many slots are still in state 1 and waits on the surface event.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_PresentFrame
functions.summary: Presents one decoded movie frame: asks the current ring slot for the ready line count, halves the height for field output, feeds the Y/U/V planes to the Y2R conversion (Gfx_Y2r_Convert/Gfx_Y2r_IsDone) and advances the ring; returns 1 when a frame was presented.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ReleaseDeviceObject
functions.summary: Releases one device/resource handle through the global callback dispatcher 0x006B8FB8 and clears the caller's pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_FindTrackEntry
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_FindTrackEntry(MovieTrackTable* table, MovieTrackEntry* out, unsigned flags)
functions.summary: Looks up a frame/track entry in the movie's track table: chooses the row id via the table's virtual 'find(id)' with the kind tag from flags (4 -> 0x410, 1 -> 0x400, 2 -> 0x401), indexes layer*(3*264) + row*264 into the entry array, and copies the entry's size/offset/timestamp fields into the caller's struct.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieSurface_Ctor
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_MovieSurface_Ctor(GfxMovieSurfaces* self, u32 w, u32 h, u32 decoder, u32 b, u32* c)
functions.summary: Constructor of the decoded-frame surface set: allocates the 3 x 2 plane groups with Gfx_MovieSurface_Allocate, converts the size words to floats for the decoder and wires the per-channel release helpers.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieSurface_Allocate
