functions.signature: int Gfx_MovieSurface_Allocate(GfxMovieSurface* self, int arg2, int arg3, GfxSurfaceDesc* desc, int* arg5, int arg6, int* arg7)
functions.summary: Allocates the decoded movie surfaces: rounds the requested width up to the 0x100/0x200/0x400 buckets, picks 1 or 2 buffers depending on the surface format (6 = single), and hands the VRL/VRAM parameters to the surface setup helpers 0x500DA0/0x500F78.

functions.name: Gfx_MoviePlayer_InitBuffers
functions.summary: Initialises the movie player's decoded-frame storage: installs the play-state table 0x00780C3C, clears the four counters at +4..+0x10 and default-constructs nine 0x108-byte frame slots at +0x74 with the element constructor 0x00501268.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieBuffer_Ctor
functions.signature: extern u32 Gfx_MovieBuffer_Ctor(GfxMovieBuffer* self, u32 fmt, u32 info, int frames, Gfx_MovieBuffer_Ctor;
functions.summary: Constructor of the decoded-frame buffer (vtable 0x00780C5C, slot 0): sizes the PCM/frame buffer as 8*stride*channels*frames*2 bytes, allocates it with the 32-byte alignment used by the DMA engine, and creates the matching track with Gfx_MovieTrack_Create (0x004FC230). Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieBuffer_Read
functions.signature: bool Gfx_MovieBuffer_Read(GfxMovieBuffer* self, void* dst, u32 size)
functions.summary: Reads decoded PCM or video sample frames from the movie buffer ring.

functions.name: Gfx_StreamSlot_Stop
functions.summary: Stops an active stream slot: if the slot still owns a handle (not -1) it releases the underlying buffer (0x004FD0BC) and clears the cursor/count fields f_18..f_25.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_Pause
functions.summary: Pauses movie playback: when a movie is open (+0xC != -1) and playing (+0x24 == 1) it pauses the track (0x004FC4C4) and flips the state bytes to +0x24=0, +0x25=1.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_StartPlayback
functions.summary: Starts the movie/stream that the movie player holds, if a stream is open and it is not already playing.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_IsPlaybackComplete
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the movie is playing and both track positions reported by 0x4FCBB0/0x4FCBEC have met (playback reached its end).

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame movie player update: consumes buffered frames, starts/stops the decode thread, pauses/resumes, advances the timeline, presents frames and finishes the movie when the stream reports state 7.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_Resume
functions.summary: Resumes movie playback by signaling the active movie track decoder to resume and clearing pause flags.

functions.name: Gfx_StreamSlot_Destroy
functions.summary: Stops active stream playback via Gfx_StreamSlot_Stop (0x004FE06C) and frees allocated stream slot resources.

functions.name: Gfx_StreamSlot_ReleaseSurfaces
functions.summary: Releases and detaches all decoded video/audio surfaces associated with this stream slot.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_CreateStreamObject
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_CreateStreamObject(void* alloc, void* listener, StreamDesc* desc, void** out)
functions.summary: Creates the per-stream object for a movie stream according to the stream kind at desc+4 (0 -> vtable 0x00780C88, 1 -> 0x00780D04, 2 -> none/null, 4 -> 0x00780CAC), then initialises it with desc+8/desc+0xC; returns 0 on unknown kind.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_CreateStreamObjectEx
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_CreateStreamObjectEx(void* owner, void* listener, StreamDesc* desc, void** out)
functions.summary: Variant of the movie stream-object factory that also reads the extra fields at desc+8 / desc+0x14 and, when desc indicates an audio kind, forwards three extra arguments to the created object's vtable slot 8.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_NotifyAndRelease
functions.signature: void Gfx_Movie_NotifyAndRelease(void* arg1, void* listener, void* object)
functions.summary: Invokes virtual release method slot 0 on stream object and dispatches completion callback to listener vtable slot 1.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_NotifyAndReleaseIfNotNull
functions.signature: void Gfx_Movie_NotifyAndReleaseIfNotNull(void* arg1, void* listener, void* object)
functions.summary: Invokes virtual release method slot 0 on stream object and dispatches completion callback to listener vtable slot 1 if listener is non-null.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieBuffer_Consume
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_MovieBuffer_Consume(GfxMovieBuffer* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int initial)
functions.summary: Feeds the movie decoder as many frames as it can take: waits for the surface state to settle (7/8), advances the timeline, then for each of the two streams computes how many frames fit in the remaining space and calls the stream's consume entry (vtable +0x1C) that many times; returns 1 when the buffer was usable.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieThread_Stop
functions.summary: Moves the decoder thread object from 'running' (3) to 'stopping' (6), records a tick stamp (svcGetSystemTick / std_Int64MulDiv by 1000) and takes the object monitor; returns 1 when the state allowed it.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieThread_Start
functions.summary: Moves the decoder thread object to state 5 ('starting') and waits, sleeping 500,000 ticks at a time, until the worker reports state 3 ('running'); returns 1 when the worker came up.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieThread_Join
functions.summary: Stops the decoder worker (6 -> 5 -> 3) and accumulates the elapsed ticks into the two 64-bit counters at +0x150/+0x158; returns 1 when the worker stopped cleanly.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_AdvanceTrackSamples
functions.signature: extern void Gfx_Movie_AdvanceTrackSamples(Gfx_MoviePlayer* player, unsigned arg2, Gfx_Movie_AdvanceTrackSamples;
functions.summary: Advances playback timeline and presentation timestamps for active tracks, invoking Gfx_Movie_WaitForDecodedFrame (0x004FFDEC) when required.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_EndPlaybackIfSurfacesIdle
functions.summary: Checks whether all decode surfaces are idle via Gfx_Movie_WaitSurfacesIdle (0x004FD3DC) and terminates playback cleanly.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieDecoder_FeedVideo
functions.summary: Main demux/feed pump for video: fetches video samples from demuxer using GPU/VRAM block API (0x006B9920/0x006B9948) and submits decoded surface to output sink.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieDecoder_FeedAudio
functions.summary: Main demux/feed pump for audio: forwards finished PCM audio samples to the audio stream decoder and stores timestamps in 16-entry ring.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieDecoder_CheckEndOfStream
functions.summary: Checks whether the movie reached its end: queries demuxer stream status (0x006B9BF4) and updates internal decoder state f_c to 7 (failed) or 8 (finished) when EOF is reached.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_FlushStreams
functions.signature: void Gfx_Movie_FlushStreams(GfxMovieContext* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int initial)
functions.summary: Flushes the active movie stream slots: waits for the surfaces to go idle, advances the timeline, drops the consumed frames from the surface ring, rewinds the read positions and stops the surface set.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_ReadTrackInfo
functions.summary: Reads movie track table from demuxer (0x006B9920/0x006B9A8C) and sorts tracks into video (+0x304), audio (+0x4A0), and text (+0x2A0) descriptor arrays.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_HasFrameReady
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the movie has a decoded frame ready to present (presented count reached the decoded count), 0 while more data is needed; sets the movie state to 7 when the source is exhausted.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_ReadTextSamples
functions.summary: Fetches subtitle/text samples from the demuxer for active text tracks (+0x2E0), validates sample header, allocates buffer, and copies sample payload.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_SelectAudioTrack
functions.summary: Switches active audio track: waits for in-flight audio handover to complete, detaches previous track from audio device (vtable +0xC) and binds new track (+8).

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_SelectVideoTrack
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Movie_SelectVideoTrack(GfxMovieContext* self, int slot, int track)
functions.summary: Binds video track to one of the two decode surfaces: detaches previous track (vtable +4) and binds new track descriptor (+0).

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_QueueDecodedSurfaces
functions.summary: In movie states 3/8, walks both tracks, checks whether each has a decoded surface ready, and queues it into the surface ring through Gfx_Movie_QueueSurfaceSlot (0x004FD33C).

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_HasPendingBytes
functions.summary: Returns 1 while the stream still holds unread data, i.e. when the 'end offset' (+0x58) minus the 'read offset' (+0x5C) is non-zero.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_AdvanceTimeline
functions.summary: Advances the playback timeline: drains the surface ring (0x004FD498/0x004FD2F4), moves both stream read cursors forward by one or two frames depending on the track's interlace field and stores the next presentation timestamp, sleeping 500,000 ticks while the frame is not yet decoded.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_WaitForDecodedFrame
functions.summary: Waits until the selected track has buffered at least one frame, then latches the presentation timestamp into +0x158/+0x15C (track timestamp plus player base time).

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_ComputePresentationTime
functions.summary: Converts the player's current presentation time into a 64-bit tick value: scales the base time by three with std_Int64MulDiv and returns the difference against the latched timestamp, or -1 when no movie is playing.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_AdvanceTracks
functions.signature: void Gfx_Movie_AdvanceTracks(GfxMovieContext* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: One step of the movie track/decoder state machine: it reads the track info and text samples, runs the open->play->end states (0..8), drops already-shown frames from the two per-track rings and feeds the video and audio decoders.

functions.name: Gfx_StreamSlot_Init
functions.signature: bool Gfx_StreamSlot_Init(StreamSlot* self, void* sourceA, void* sourceB, void* sourceC, void* sourceD, uint32_t bufferSize, uint32_t heap)
functions.summary: The double-buffered stream-slot initialiser: it checks four source pointers, creates the mutex/cond objects and a 0x4000 transfer buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_StreamSlot_Release
functions.summary: Releases a graphics stream slot: marks it busy, tears down the GPU side (software_interrupt 0x24/0x23 = GSP wait commands, func_00118100/func_00118170 for the transfer buffer), drops the cached surface at +0x40, frees the arrays at +0x300 (0x304 slots), +0x49C (0x4A0 slots) and +0x1DC (0x18-byte entries), then zeroes the handle fields.

functions.name: Gfx_MoviePlayer_InitTracks
functions.summary: Initialises the movie player's stream state: clears the counters, sets the 'no track' word -1, then on the shared device object cleared by 0x0010EBB0 sets the four default track states (0, then 2/1/0) and default-constructs four 0x14-byte slots at +0x150.

functions.name: Gfx_StreamSlot_Shutdown
functions.summary: Tears down a streamed-texture slot: releases the sub-channels, the pending transfer and the upload object at +0x170, then destroys the embedded object at +0x28.

functions.name: Gfx_BufferChannel_Init
functions.signature: bool Gfx_BufferChannel_Init(BufferChannel* self, void* source, Allocator* allocator, uint32_t heap)
functions.summary: The buffered-channel initialiser: it queries the source size, allocates the 0x80000 buffer and two 0x2000 staging areas and creates two completion handles.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_ReadThread
functions.summary: Worker thread that streams the movie file: waits on the two synchronisation handles and, whenever the 0x80000-byte ring has room, reads up to 0x40000 bytes through the file object's read slot and advances the 64-bit position; exits when the stop handle is signalled.

functions.name: Gfx_BufferChannel_Destroy
functions.summary: Destroys a buffered command channel: signals and releases both completion handles, releases the staging objects at +0x48/+0x50, frees the command buffer at +0x30 and zeroes the header. The guard byte at +0x4C makes it idempotent.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieSurface_SetupDescriptor
functions.signature: void Gfx_MovieSurface_SetupDescriptor(GfxMovieSurface* self, int arg2, int arg3, int * arg4, int arg5, int arg6, int arg7, int arg8, int arg9, int arg10, int arg11, int arg12)
functions.summary: Fills in a movie surface descriptor: stores the parameters, translates the framebuffer address with Os_VirtualToPhysical for the hardware copy, flags "raw camera frame" when the format word is not 0x6752 and submits the descriptor.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_Init
functions.summary: Opens the 3DS 'y2r:u' colour-conversion service (YUV -> RGB) and stores the session handle at 0x007AE17C; also initialises the conversion registers. Called once before the first movie frame is converted.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_Convert
functions.signature: void Gfx_Y2r_Convert(u32 srcY, u32 srcU, u32 srcV, u32 format, u32 arg5, u32 dstRgb, u32 dstRgb2, u32 dstRgb3, short width, short height, short stride, u32 fmtFlags, short outStride)
functions.summary: Programs the Y2R unit for one frame - input Y/U/V plane addresses and sizes (U/V at half resolution), input format, output RGBA format, block/stride - and starts the conversion. This is the step that turns the decoded YUV movie frame into the RGB texture the renderer samples.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_IsDone
functions.summary: Polls the Y2R unit's busy flag and returns 1 when the conversion has finished (it inverts the driver's 'still busy' result). Used by the frame presenter before reusing the output surface.

functions.name: Svc_ReleaseHandleSlot
functions.summary: Releases the handle stored in *slot through 0x006B9CDC, clears the slot and returns it so callers can chain the release in an expression.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieStream_DtorDeleteA
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the first movie-stream wrapper class: installs its vtable 0x00780C88, shuts the wrapped codec object at +4 down via 0x006B881C and frees the wrapper.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieStream_DtorDeleteB
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the second movie-stream wrapper: installs vtable 0x00780CAC, shuts the wrapped object at +4 down via 0x006B90EC and frees the wrapper.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieStream_DtorDeleteC
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the third movie-stream wrapper: installs vtable 0x00780CD0, shuts the wrapped object at +4 down via 0x006B9584 and frees the wrapper.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieStream_DtorDeleteD
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the fourth movie-stream wrapper: installs vtable 0x00780D04, shuts the wrapped object at +4 down via 0x006B8BDC and frees the wrapper.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_OpenSession
functions.summary: Reference-counted opener of the 'ac:u' service session: if the session is not open it allocates the service handle with 0x001192C0, bumps the reference counter and publishes the state. Returns 0 on success or the srv error code.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_CheckSession
functions.summary: Cheap 'ac:u' availability probe used by the UI: returns 0 when no session is open, otherwise issues the small query 0x005019F4 (Svc_AcClient_Cmd003E0042) and returns its first result byte.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_QueryIfReady
functions.summary: Account-service query guard: takes the service lock (Os_AcquireSharedSession), checks that the account content is ready (0x0050D864), releases the lock and only then forwards the query to maybe_Svc_AcClient_Query; otherwise it returns 0xC9209F84.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_GetAccountState
functions.summary: Returns the cached 'ac:u' account state: sends command 0x0005 (Svc_AcClient_Cmd0005), and if the reply is not the 0xE1209C46 'not initialised' sentinel closes the stale session so the next open re-queries; returns the command result.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_IsSessionOpen
functions.summary: Takes the client lock and reports whether the 'ac:u' session handle at 0x007AF094 is non-zero.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Query
functions.signature: int Svc_AcClient_Query(u32 cmd, u32* out, u32 command, u32 command2)
functions.summary: Generic 'ac' client command dispatcher: sends one request through the command helpers (0x27/0x2D/0x24/0x04) and, when the reply asks for a session, lazily opens the ndm:u service and retries.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_CloseSession
functions.summary: Closes the 'ac:u' session if it is open, dropping the service handle (0x0050F244) and clearing the open flag. Safe to call repeatedly.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Close
functions.summary: Performs synchronous shutdown of the AC (Auto-Connect) network session: creates a temporary event handle, calls Svc_AcClient_CloseAsync, waits for completion via svcWaitSynchronization1, and retrieves the final close status.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_CloseAsync
functions.summary: Issues asynchronous AC session close command 0x00080004 with a completion event handle to the AC service.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Cmd003E0042
functions.summary: Raw IPC request with header 0x003E0042 (command 0x3E) to the 'ac:u' session; writes the reply byte and returns the response word.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Cmd0004
functions.summary: Sends ac:u command 0x0004 (IPC header 0x00040006) with two normal parameters and returns the raw reply word; the caller passes the command id and an output pointer straight through.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Cmd0024
functions.signature: u32 Svc_AcClient_Cmd0024(u32 buffer, u32 buffer2, u32 request)
functions.summary: Sends ac:u command 0x24 (header 0x00240042) that maps one caller buffer and temporarily swaps the thread-local descriptor pair at +0x180/+0x184 for the second buffer.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_GetCloseResult
functions.summary: Queries the result of an asynchronous AC session close request via IPC command 0x00090002.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Cmd0005
functions.summary: Sends the parameterless ac:u command 0x0005 (header 0x00050002) and returns the reply word; the account-state getter compares it with 0xE1209C46 when the service has not been initialised.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Cmd0027
functions.summary: Sends ac:u command 0x27 (header 0x00270002) with one parameter and, on success, returns the reply byte through *outByte.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send000A0000
functions.summary: Issues the 3DS IPC request with command header 0x000A0000 (command 0x0A, no normal parameters) on the given session handle: builds the request at the thread-local IPC buffer (TLS+0x80), calls svcSendSyncRequest (swi 0x32) and returns the response code, with the reply word copied to *out.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Cmd0040
functions.summary: Raw 'ac:u' IPC request: writes command word 0x00400042 into the thread TLS block with the request as parameter and a 0x20 word, issues svc 0x32 and returns the reply word.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send00010000
functions.summary: Issues the IPC request with command header 0x00010000 (command 0x01) on the given session, passing 'arg' as the first normal parameter; saves/restores the scratch words at TLS+0x180 so the call is re-entrant, then returns the response code.

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_Cmd002D
functions.signature: u32 Svc_AcClient_Cmd002D(u32 buf1, u32 buf2, u8 request, u8 b)
functions.summary: Sends ac:u command 0x2D (header 0x002D0082) with two mapped buffers, swapping the thread-local +0x180 descriptor pair for the second one around the request.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_AcClient_AcquireSessionLock
functions.summary: Tiny AC-client guard: if Svc_AcClient_CheckSession reports an open session it calls maybe_Os_CriticalSectionEnter, then returns. The readable C's monitor/refcount teardown tail is Ghidra over-running into the next entry (0x00501D14 Svc_AcClient_ReleaseSession).

functions.name: Svc_AcClient_ReleaseSession
functions.summary: Drops one reference to the 'ac:u' session and closes it when the counter reaches zero; returns the total srv result it got while closing.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_SendWithBuffer
functions.signature: Result Svc_Ipc_SendWithBuffer(Handle session, void* buffer, u32 size, u8 flags, u32 arg5, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Convenience wrapper that forwards to 0x00501E60, i.e. sends an IPC request that transfers one static buffer of 'size' bytes described by 'flags'.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Cmd1007Thunk
functions.signature: int Svc_Ipc_Cmd1007Thunk(void* request, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Thin wrapper that forwards to the fixed-header IPC sender Svc_Ipc_Cmd1007 (command 0x1007, four normal and two translate parameters) for callers that do not need the extra return fields.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_SendRequestWithByteArg
functions.signature: Result Svc_Ipc_SendRequestWithByteArg(Handle session, u8* out, u8 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: IPC request wrapper that fills three normal parameters (byte + two words) in the TLS command buffer, reads the command header from a global, issues svcSendSyncRequest and returns the response code with the reply byte copied to *out.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_SendBufferedRequest
functions.signature: Result Svc_Ipc_SendBufferedRequest(u32* out, u32 session, int count, u8 flags, u32 arg5, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Full IPC request builder: writes five normal parameters plus a static-buffer descriptor whose header encodes count*0x180 bytes with flags 0x0C at TLS+0x98, issues svcSendSyncRequest and writes back the reply.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_SendThreeParams
functions.signature: int Svc_Ipc_SendThreeParams(int handle, unsigned char cmdHigh, int arg3, int count)
functions.summary: Generic IPC request sender: writes the request header (handle, command byte, three parameters and the translate descriptors) into the TLS command buffer and issues svcSendSyncRequest (svc 0x32).

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_SendRequestWithArg
functions.signature: Result Svc_Ipc_SendRequestWithArg(Handle session, u8* out, u8 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Second IPC request wrapper with the same three-parameter layout as 0x00501E10 but a different command header (from g_00501F88).

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Cmd1007
functions.signature: int Svc_Ipc_Cmd1007(void* out, int requestPtr, int arg3, int arg4, int arg5, int arg6, int arg7)
functions.summary: Fixed-command IPC stub: writes the constant header 0x10070102 (command 0x1007) plus the five arguments into the TLS request buffer, sends svcSendSyncRequest and, on success, copies the two result words back to the caller.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_SendRequestQuery
functions.summary: Minimal IPC request wrapper: writes only the command header from g_00502030, issues svcSendSyncRequest and copies the first reply byte to *out.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_Request_WaitForService
functions.signature: void maybe_Fs_Request_WaitForService(FsRequest* req, int service, int method)
functions.summary: Issues a service-object call for a file request and waits on the completion gate: a negative result is formatted into the request, otherwise it clears the request and spins until the service publishes its reply.

functions.name: Fs_FormatResultCode
functions.signature: void Fs_FormatResultCode(FsResult* out, unsigned int resultCode, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Decodes a 3DS result code (module in bits 10..17, description in bits 0..9) and writes a human-readable form into the caller's result record; the 0xD000 module is the file-service module, whose 100..299 range is treated as a retryable status rather than a failure.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_ResultCodeInteriorA
functions.summary: Disassembly artifact: interior basic block within Fs_FormatResultCode (0x00502038) mapping filesystem error codes.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_ResultCodeInteriorB
functions.summary: Disassembly artifact: second interior branch block within Fs_FormatResultCode.

functions.name: Svc_Content_OpenByRecord
functions.signature: void Svc_Content_OpenByRecord(FsResult* out, int* state, int* record)
functions.summary: Opens a content object described by a record: releases any previous object, rejects records flagged in byte +5, then dispatches on the kind byte +6 to build the open request (0x00503D20) and the path (Fs_BuildMetaDataContentPath) before creating the object with maybe_Svc_Ipc_CreateObjectFromBlock.

functions.name: Fs_BuildContentInfoArchivePath
functions.summary: Builds the content-info archive file name for a content record: formats "__ContentInfoArchive__%s_%s.bin" from the record's two id fields, converts it to UTF-16 and stores the result for the file request.

functions.name: Fs_BuildMetaDataContentPath
functions.summary: Formats the fixed meta-data content header name "__MetaDataContentHeader.bin" and converts it to the UTF-16 form used by the file service.

functions.name: Fs_ReleaseHandlePair
functions.summary: Releases a pair of file/directory handles: if either word of the pair is non-zero it tears the pair down through 0x00503D20 and clears both words.

functions.name: Fs_MapResultCode
functions.summary: Closes an Fs handle pair and normalises the service result: each of the eight error codes handled here is tail-branched into Fs_FormatResultCode (0x00502164) before returning.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Content_TranslateResultList
functions.summary: Translates an array of 8-byte service result entries into engine status codes by switching on each entry's kind byte (+4): 0 -> 0x8C, 1 -> 0x0D, 3 -> 0x10, 4 -> 0x30, and builds the per-entry payload word.

functions.name: Fs_CheckPendingResult
functions.summary: Polls the last file-service result and returns the retry code only when it belongs to the file-service module (0x4400) with description 100..0xB3; anything else means "nothing pending".

functions.name: Svc_Content_ResolveEntryType
functions.signature: int Svc_Content_ResolveEntryType(ContentEntryTable* table, int arg2, int arg3, int kind)
functions.summary: Resolves one content-table entry (0x00503214/0x00503100) and turns its type word (f_10 low byte) into the request code 0x8C/0xD/0x10/0x30, packs the entry bytes plus arg2 into the shared request block at 0x007D0000 and submits it.

functions.name: Snd_RequestArchiveEntry
functions.signature: int Snd_RequestArchiveEntry(ContentEntry* entry, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Formats a 16-hex-digit id from an entry record (kind 0/1/3/4 -> 0x8C/0x0D/0x10/0x30 plus the packed id/type word) and sends it as the string of the snd:u command-3 request.

functions.name: maybe_Snd_RequestResourceByName
functions.summary: Two-instruction wrapper: calls Svc_Snd_Cmd0004WithName(name) and normalises a non-negative result to 0, so callers see 0 on success. No callers, so which resource kind snd command 4 requests stays open.

functions.name: Svc_Object_InvokeAndStoreResult
functions.summary: Calls the service-object invocation helper with the argument and, on a non-negative result, writes the returned value through the out pointer and normalises the status to 0.

functions.name: Svc_InvokeAndNormalizeResult
functions.summary: Invokes the shared service object (0x00503264) and normalises a non-negative result to 0 (success), propagating negative result codes unchanged.

functions.name: Container_KeyedLookupAndNotify
functions.signature: void Container_KeyedLookupAndNotify(void* owner, int keyA, int keyB)
functions.summary: Looks a two-word key up in the two container lookups and, when either finds it, publishes the request through Fs_PublishRequest.

functions.name: Fs_FillRequestBlock
functions.signature: int Fs_FillRequestBlock(int* counter, int* outCounter, int cmd, int len, void* data, * void* extra)
functions.summary: Fills the shared Fs request block: bumps the generation counter, stores command 0x40 and the length, copies the 0x40-byte payload and the 0x44-byte argument record, and publishes the new generation.

functions.name: Fs_NoOp
functions.summary: Empty stub (a single bx lr, padded to 0x1E bytes) that exists so a virtual or dispatch-table slot has an address.

functions.name: Fs_PublishRequest
functions.summary: Publishes a completed request to the file service: bumps the request generation counter in the shared 0x7E8044 block and copies the 0x9C-byte request record into it.

functions.name: Fs_ValidateRequestEntry
functions.signature: int Fs_ValidateRequestEntry(int* request, int arg2, int arg3, int kind)
functions.summary: Resolves a request entry through the shared service object and validates it, returning 0 on success or the first error code.

functions.name: Svc_Object_InvokeWithArg
functions.signature: int Svc_Object_InvokeWithArg(unsigned arg1, unsigned* arg2, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4)
functions.summary: Invokes one method on the shared service object: resolves the object with 0x00503214 and dispatches 0x00503100(object, &arg, *extra), mapping any non-negative status to 0; the generic 'call the service' wrapper of the fs/content layer.

functions.name: Fs_BuildRequestArgs
functions.signature: void Fs_BuildRequestArgs(FsResult* out, int arg2, int* arg3, int* arg4, int arg5, int* args, int argCount)
functions.summary: Serialises up to 0x40 typed arguments into the file-service request format: switches on each argument's kind byte at +4, writes the corresponding value into the 0x7D0000 request buffer and then submits it with the IPC sender 0x501ED4.

functions.name: Fs_BuildReadRequestArgs
functions.signature: void Fs_BuildReadRequestArgs(FsResult* out, int* request, int arg3, int argCount)
functions.summary: Read-path twin of Fs_BuildRequestArgs: rejects more than 0x40 arguments, resolves the request through 0x503038/0x502E20, copies the 0x9C-byte request and submits the read through the shared buffers.

functions.name: Fs_FileJob_CompleteRead
functions.summary: Completion step of a file-service job: validates the request through Svc_InvokeAndNormalizeResult/Svc_Content_ResolveEntryType (kind 0xB), copies the 0x44-byte reply out of the service block with std_memcpy, checks the pending-result and object tables and finally publishes the request.

functions.name: Fs_BuildRequestHeader
functions.signature: void Fs_BuildRequestHeader(FsRequest* req, int* arg2, int* kindRecord)
functions.summary: Builds the request header for the file service: maps the record's kind byte (+1) 0/1/3 to command 0x8C/0xD/0x10, packs the extra fields and submits the IPC through maybe_Svc_Ipc_Cmd1007Thunk / 0x00501ED0, formatting errors with Fs_FormatResultCode.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_ReleaseObject
functions.summary: Releases filesystem client object via virtual slot +0x30.

functions.name: Svc_ContentObject_CreateAndRegister
functions.signature: int Svc_ContentObject_CreateAndRegister(const char* name, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, * unsigned arg4, unsigned arg5, unsigned arg6, unsigned arg7, unsigned arg8, unsigned arg9, unsigned * arg10)
functions.summary: Creates a content object from the descriptor and registers it under the given 8-character name; when the registration fails the object is released through its vtable +0x30 and the error returned.

functions.name: Svc_ContentObject_GetSharedHandle
functions.signature: unsigned Svc_ContentObject_GetSharedHandle(unsigned mount, unsigned not, unsigned not2, void** out)
functions.summary: Returns the process-wide content handle, creating it once: when the cached handle at 0x007AEA48+8 is null it creates one (0x00505804), registers it under the caller's name and caches it; every caller gets the same status.

functions.name: Fs_NotifyService
functions.summary: Notifies the Fs service of a pending file/commit event: fetches the pending object (0x006E7310) and passes its handle, size and flags to the named IPC helper Svc_Ipc_Send080D0144.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_FormatAndSend
functions.signature: void Svc_Ipc_FormatAndSend(unsigned arg1, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3)
functions.summary: Formats the two argument strings through the std_FormatV family (0x0051BBD8) and submits one IPC command (Svc_Ipc_SendCommand, 0x00505A58) with the command id from 0x007AEA48+0x10, flags 0x200 and both strings.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadAt
functions.signature: uint32_t Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadAt(FsEntry* self, uint32_t offset, uint32_t size, uint32_t countOut)
functions.summary: Reads a block at an absolute offset from an open archive entry through 0x00505DE0, raises 0x0011ED40 on error and returns the byte count actually read.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveEntry_Seek
functions.summary: Seeks an open archive entry through the three-mode seeker 0x00505E68 and raises through 0x0011ED40 when it reports an error; the paired wrapper of ReadAt.

functions.name: Svc_Object_ReleaseHandleA
functions.summary: Releases the service object handle at +4: if bit 0 is set the shared lock is released (0x0011C814), then the handle itself is freed (0x00505040) and the word cleared. Returns the object for chaining; identical body to 0x005040A8.

functions.name: Svc_Object_CreateFromBlock
functions.signature: int Svc_Object_CreateFromBlock(u32* out, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 size, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8, u32 arg9, u32 arg10)
functions.summary: Builds a four-word descriptor block {arg2, arg3, arg4, size} on the stack, creates the object through Svc_Object_CreateFromDescriptor and, on success, writes {handle, -1} to out and returns 0.

functions.name: Svc_Object_ReleaseHandleB
functions.summary: Second copy of the service-object handle release: if the word at +4 holds a handle it releases the shared lock when bit 0 is set, frees the handle and clears the word. Returns the object for chaining.

functions.name: Svc_ContentObject_OpenWithRetryCode
functions.signature: unsigned Svc_ContentObject_OpenWithRetryCode(const char* name, unsigned packed, unsigned packed2, unsigned forwarded, unsigned forwarded2, unsigned forwarded3, unsigned forwarded4, unsigned forwarded5, unsigned forwarded6)
functions.summary: Creates a content object from a descriptor, registers it under the given name, and maps the 'busy/try again' error cluster (0x4400 with codes 601..601) to the retry constant 0xC86044C8 so callers retry instead of failing.

functions.name: Svc_ContentObject_OpenSimple
functions.signature: void Svc_ContentObject_OpenSimple(const char* name, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4, unsigned arg5, unsigned arg6, unsigned arg7, unsigned arg8)
functions.summary: Convenience wrapper over the content-object opener 0x005040E4 with the third descriptor word fixed to 0.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_NotifyByHandle
functions.signature: void maybe_Svc_Object_NotifyByHandle(unsigned int value, unsigned int handle)
functions.summary: Resolves service object pointer by handle via 0x006E7310 and forwards notification value through virtual slot +0x2C.

functions.name: Svc_ObjectPool_InitA
functions.summary: Initialises one service object pool: stores the slot count in obj+0x10, appends the 0x209-entry block to the pool at 0x007E7AB8 and tells the kernel the pool layout through Svc command 0x90040, panicking on either failure.

functions.name: Svc_InitSharedState
functions.summary: Initialises one shared-state object: sets up the two LightEvents at +0 and +8 (one-shot), locks their embedded light locks, links the object into the shared list at 0x007E7AA4 and acquires shared resource id 0x207 through the service command, panicking on failure.

functions.name: Svc_ObjectPool_InitB
functions.summary: Initialises the second service object pool: stores the slot count in obj+0x10, appends id 0x207 to the pool list at 0x007E7AA4 and tells the kernel the pool layout through Svc command 0x90040, panicking on either failure.

functions.name: Svc_ReleaseSharedState
functions.summary: Releases one shared-state resource (id 0x209) that the present window acquired: sends the release request, asserts on failure and then frees the free-list entry.

functions.name: Svc_ReleaseSharedResources
functions.summary: Releases the two shared GPU/svc resources (0x209 first, then 0x207) that the title screen owns, asserting on the service result.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_ObjectPool_DestroyB
functions.summary: Releases shared IPC resource pool 0x207 via Os_Ipc_SendRequestA0040 and Svc_UnlinkSharedEntry.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_CreateWithPayload
functions.signature: int maybe_Svc_Object_CreateWithPayload(u32* outSize, u32 packed, u32 low, u32 forwarded, int count1, int count2, int withHeader)
functions.summary: Creates a service object for a payload made of count1 0x20-byte and count2 0x18-byte records: sends the create request with header 0x0004008C, takes a vtable-0x00780EAC object from the pool and optionally queries its 0x28-byte header, returning the computed payload size in *outSize.

functions.name: Svc_Object_CreateSimple
functions.signature: void Svc_Object_CreateSimple(u32* outSize, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 count1, u32 count2, int withHeader)
functions.summary: One-line forwarder to the object creator 0x00504378 with the third argument fixed to 0, for callers that need no extra flag word.

functions.name: Svc_FetchContentInfo
functions.summary: Queries the service for a small content-info record (command 0x0C with a 3-word descriptor) and, when the reply carries data, creates the "icon" object and asks it for the record; used by the icon cache.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveStream_ReadAt
functions.signature: int Fs_ArchiveStream_ReadAt(void* streamObj, s64 offset, void* dstBuf, u32 size)
functions.summary: Reads size bytes at 64-bit byte offset from an archive backing buffer or substream into dstBuf: copies directly via __aeabi_memcpy (0x00116A14) when streamObj->directBuf_00 != NULL, or dispatches IReadStream::TryRead on streamObj->f_08 (+0x0C + bucket*4) at streamObj->baseOffset_0C + (u32)offset, returning 0 on success or negative nn::Result.

functions.name: Fs_File_SelectWorkerByPriority
functions.summary: Maps an I/O priority in [-8..8] to one of five cached worker objects (indices 0..4 at self+0xC) and lazily creates the missing worker through the session's vtable slots 0x44/0x3C, then selects the priority on it (slot 0x18) and remembers it in self+0x18.

functions.name: Svc_Object_Release
functions.summary: Releases a service object: calls its close entry (vtable +0x34) and pushes it back onto the free list embedded in its owner, decrementing the owner's live counter.

functions.name: Fs_File_ReadAtOffset
functions.signature: Result Fs_File_ReadAtOffset(FsFile* self, void* buffer, u64 offset, u32 arg4, u32 size)
functions.summary: Reads from the Fs file through the worker chosen for the file's current priority: adds the file's base offset (+0x8/+0xC) to the 64-bit offset, clamps the size to the remaining length, and calls the worker's vtable slot 0 with (buffer, absolute offset, size).

functions.name: maybe_Fs_Archive_OpenRecordByPath
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Fs_Archive_OpenRecordByPath(void* self, u32* out, int* typeAndIndex)
functions.summary: Opens one archive entry by name: resolves the UTF-16 path with Fs_Archive_ResolvePath, folds the name into a 64-bit rotate-xor hash seeded with 0x075BCD15, looks it up with Fs_Archive_FindFile (retrying as a directory for the 0x11/0x6F 'not a file' result), then allocates a 0x30-byte accessor node from the pool at 0x007E7B58, fills its offset/size and owner and calls its virtual +0x18. Returns 0 or the Fs error code.

functions.name: Fs_SplitResourceName
functions.signature: unsigned Fs_SplitResourceName(unsigned mountId, const unsigned short* name)
functions.summary: Validates and splits a resource name: resolves the mount/device (0x006E73D0), returns the fixed error 0xC8804465 on failure, otherwise walks the UTF-16 name to the ':' separator and hands the remainder to 0x00100B74.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadBlock
functions.signature: uint32_t Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadBlock(uint32_t handle, void* stream, uint32_t offset, uint32_t size, uint32_t buffer, uint32_t flags)
functions.summary: Performs one physical read of an archive entry: applies the disc-latency simulation and tail-calls the stream's virtual read, returning the 0xE0E046BC error when no stream or buffer is present.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_Object_ReadChunk
functions.signature: unsigned char* maybe_Fs_Object_ReadChunk(void* object, void* reader, unsigned offset, unsigned arg4, int size, unsigned arg6, unsigned arg7)
functions.summary: Null/zero-safe chunked read: rejects a null object, a null reader or a zero size with nn::Result 0xE0E046BC, otherwise simulates the read latency (Fs_SimulateReadLatency) and forwards the request to the reader's virtual read slot +4, returning whatever that returns.

functions.name: Fs_DeleteFile
functions.signature: unsigned int Fs_DeleteFile(const unsigned short* path)
functions.summary: Deletes a file by wide-character path: parses the archive mount prefix, builds an FS_Path descriptor of type PATH_UTF16, and invokes archive vtable method 2 (DeleteFile).

functions.name: maybe_Fs_File_QueryValue
functions.signature: Result maybe_Fs_File_QueryValue(u32* out, void* object, u32 arg3, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Generic filesystem object query: invokes virtual method slot 0 on object with in/out value, returning result through *out.

functions.name: Svc_Object_CreateFromDescriptor
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Object_CreateFromDescriptor(u32* out, u32* desc, u32 size, u32 flags, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7)
functions.summary: Creates a service object from a descriptor: allocates a 0x130-byte handle, sends the create request with header 0x2345678A, takes an object of vtable 0x00780EAC from the pool, runs its open entry (vtable +0x18) with the descriptor payload and writes the result to out.

functions.name: Fs_SimulateReadLatency
functions.summary: Emulates optical-disc access time: when the global drive descriptor 0x007AEA48 enables latency it adds a per-read cost (0x17C ms for data reads, 100 ms otherwise), scales it by the descriptor's multiplier and sleeps that many nanoseconds.

functions.name: Svc_Object_Cmd3
functions.summary: Object-protocol command 3: when the descriptor size (desc[2]) is below 0x201 it sends the three descriptor words plus the object's session (+8) and tag (+0xC) through Svc_Ipc_Send08040142.

functions.name: Svc_Object_ReleaseRef
functions.summary: Closes an object (vtable +0x34) and returns it to the global pool at 0x007E7B1C, decrementing the live counter under the pool monitor.

functions.name: Svc_Object_Cmd1
functions.signature: void Svc_Object_Cmd1(SvcObject* object, u32 request, u32 arg3, u32 request2)
functions.summary: Object-protocol command 1: forwards the request and the object's session (+8) / tag (+0xC) through Svc_Ipc_Send08120080; slot 0 of vtable 0x00780F1C.

functions.name: Svc_Object_Cmd5
functions.signature: void Svc_Object_Cmd5(SvcObject* object, u32 request, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Object-protocol command 5: a no-payload request that forwards the handle/request pair through Svc_Ipc_Send080C0000.

functions.name: Svc_Object_Cmd6
functions.signature: void Svc_Object_Cmd6(SvcObject* object, u32 request, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Object-protocol command 6: single-argument request forwarded through Svc_Ipc_Send080A0040; slot 1 of vtable 0x00780EC0.

functions.name: Svc_Object_Destroy
functions.signature: void Svc_Object_Destroy(SvcObject* object, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Destructor of the small service object: optionally closes the underlying handle, calls vtable +0x34 and returns the object to the 0x7E7B58 free list under the +0x30 lock.

functions.name: Svc_Object_SendCommand080200C2
functions.signature: void Svc_Object_SendCommand080200C2(SvcObject* object, u32 request, u32 request2, u32 third, u32 fourth, u32 fifth)
functions.summary: Slot 0 of the service-object vtable 0x00780EAC: takes the object's handle with the checked getter and forwards five payload words to Svc_Ipc_Send080200C2.

functions.name: Svc_Object_Cmd7
functions.signature: void Svc_Object_Cmd7(SvcObject* object, u32 flag, u32 flag2, u32 flag3)
functions.summary: Object-protocol command 7: packs (flag|flag3)&0xFF together with (flag2&0xFF)<<16 into one word and sends it with Svc_Ipc_Send08030102.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_Cmd8
functions.signature: void maybe_Svc_Object_Cmd8(SvcObject* object, u32 request, u32 second, u32 third, u32 request2, u32 fifth, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Slot 1 of the service-object vtable: obtains the checked object handle and forwards six arguments plus the packed flag word to Svc_Ipc_Send08030102 (command header 0x08030102).

functions.name: Svc_Object_ReleaseHandleSlot
functions.summary: Destructor-style helper: if the handle stored at self+4 is non-zero it calls svcCloseHandle (svc 0x23) and clears the slot, then returns self. Used to release a kernel handle owned by a small wrapper object.

functions.name: Svc_Object_CreateWithBuffer
functions.signature: int Svc_Object_CreateWithBuffer(u32* obj, u32* out, u32* desc, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Creates an object that wraps a caller buffer: rejects descriptors of 0x201 bytes or more, sends command 0x080201C2 with the buffer address/size, takes an object of vtable 0x00780EAC from the pool and stores it in *out.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_Dtor
functions.summary: Base destructor of the service-object protocol: installs the class vtable 0x780EF0, flushes the buffered handle through Svc_Ipc_Send080E0080 when one is pending, then clears the session, buffer and handle words.

functions.name: Svc_Object_CreateBare
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Object_CreateBare(u32 not, u32* out, u32 handle)
functions.summary: Allocates a bare object of the 0x00780EAC class from the 0x007E7B58 pool and stores the given handle in it, without sending any command. Returns 0 or the 0xD8604659 'out of memory' sentinel.

functions.name: Svc_Object_ReleaseRefB
functions.summary: Same release as 0x00505314 for the second object pool (owner reached through 0x007AEA48); slot 1 of vtable 0x00780F60.

functions.name: maybe_Object_DtorMultipleBases
functions.summary: Complex destructor for multi-base container object: resets five child sub-objects at +0x0C via virtual offset 0x30, installs vtables 0x780E5C/0x781028, and invokes chained base destructors.

functions.name: Svc_CreateContentHandle
functions.summary: Creates a content handle from "count" descriptor words: sends command 0x0C (header 0x080C00C2), takes a 0x780EF0-class object from the pool and stores the two returned values in it.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send08040142
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Ipc_Send08040142(u32* session, u32 request, u32 request2, u32 request3, u32 request4, u32 buffer, int size)
functions.summary: Hand-written IPC request with header 0x08040142 (command 0x04, buffer descriptor) to the unnamed service; returns the response word.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send080C00C2
functions.signature: int Svc_Ipc_Send080C00C2(int* session, u32* out, u32 arg3, u32 buffer, u32 arg5, int size)
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x080C00C2 (command 0x0C) that returns two 32-bit values; used to create and to query content handles.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send080E0080
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Ipc_Send080E0080(u32* session, u32 arg2, u32 request, u32 request2)
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x080E0080 (command 0x0E), a two-word payload; used as the 'close/release' call of the content handle.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send08120080
functions.signature: int Svc_Ipc_Send08120080(int* session, u32* out, u32 request, u32 request2)
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x08120080 (command 0x12) returning two words; the 'bind/reference' call of the object protocol.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send080D0144
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Ipc_Send080D0144(u32* session, u32* unusedOut, u32 size, u32 offset, u32 zero, u32* outByte, int outSize, u32* buffer, int bufferSize)
functions.summary: Raw fs:USER IPC request with header 0x080D0144 (command 0x080D = Read, 4 normal + 1 translate parameter) sent over svc 0x32; copies an unaligned output buffer and returns the IPC result. Caller 0x00503E84 passes a file handle, a buffer and a size/offset pair.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_SendCommand
functions.signature: unsigned Svc_Ipc_SendCommand(const void* header, unsigned requestId, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4, int handle, unsigned arg6, unsigned arg7, unsigned arg8, unsigned arg9, unsigned arg10, unsigned char arg11)
functions.summary: Generic IPC command sender: builds the per-thread IPC header (svcThreadLocal+0x80: request id, normal and translate descriptors, handle flags shifted by 14) and issues svc 0x32 (SendSyncRequest); returns the reply word or the service status.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send08170000
functions.summary: Parameterless IPC request with header 0x08170000 (command 0x0817, no normal/translate parameters) that returns one status byte. Part of the fs:USER wrapper layer next to Svc_Ipc_Send080D0144.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send08180000
functions.summary: Parameterless IPC request with header 0x08180000 (command 0x0818) that returns one status byte; twin of 0x00505AB0 and part of the same fs:USER wrapper table.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send080201C2
functions.signature: int Svc_Ipc_Send080201C2(int* session, u32* out, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 session2, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8, int buffer, u32 buffer2, u32 arg11)
functions.summary: Largest IPC request of this protocol (header 0x080201C2, command 0x02): sends eight words plus a mapped buffer and returns one reply word. Used to create the buffer-backed object.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send080A0040
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x080A0040 (command 0x0A), one payload word.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send080C0000
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x080C0000 (command 0x0C) with no payload, returning one word.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send080200C2
functions.signature: int Svc_Ipc_Send080200C2(int* session, u32* out, u32 request, u32 request2, u32 buffer, int size)
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x080200C2 (command 0x02) carrying a buffer; the 'write/append' call of the object protocol.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send08080000
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x08080000 (command 0x08), no payload; the 'delete/close' call used by the small object destructor.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send08030102
functions.signature: int Svc_Ipc_Send08030102(int* session, u32* out, u32 request, u32 request2, u32 buffer, int size, u32 flags)
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x08030102 (command 0x03) carrying a buffer and a packed flag word; used for both the 'set flags' and 'write with flags' commands.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Send08040000
functions.summary: IPC request with header 0x08040000 (command 0x04) returning two words; the close entry (vtable slot 3) of the 0x00780EAC class.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_GetSharedContext
functions.summary: Retrieves shared system context pointer from *0x007AEA68, asserting through 0x0011C814 if null.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_ArchiveEntry_SetReadPosition
functions.signature: int64_t maybe_Fs_ArchiveEntry_SetReadPosition(FsEntry* self, int32_t status, uint32_t offset, uint32_t size)
functions.summary: Calculates file window offset and updates read position on archive entry, refilling buffer if requested range exceeds cache.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadInto
functions.signature: int Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadInto(FsEntry* self, uint32_t* bytesRead, uint32_t offset, uint32_t size)
functions.summary: Accumulating read: loops over maybe_Fs_ArchiveEntry_ReadBlock until the requested size is satisfied or a short/zero read occurs, advancing the entry window (self[1]/self[2]) and summing the byte counts into *bytesRead.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_ArchiveEntry_SeekByMode
functions.signature: int maybe_Fs_ArchiveEntry_SeekByMode(FsEntry* self, uint32_t where, uint32_t offsetLo, int offsetHi, int mode)
functions.summary: Implements all three archive-entry seek modes: 0 = absolute, 1 = relative to the current position, 2 = relative to the end; it computes the 64-bit position and delegates to Fs_ArchiveEntry_SetReadPosition, returning 0xE0E046BD for an unknown mode.

functions.name: Fs_Object_ReadAll
functions.signature: int Fs_Object_ReadAll(unsigned* state, int* bytesRead, unsigned buffer, unsigned totalSize, int flag)
functions.summary: Reads a whole resource in chunks: loops over Fs_Object_ReadChunk with the current 64-bit offset, accumulates the bytes read and advances until totalSize is consumed or a short read ends the loop, then stores the total.

functions.name: Gfx_Texture_SwizzleAndConvert
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_Texture_SwizzleAndConvert(void* dst, int dstSize, int* src, int* srcSize, int* arg5, int* arg6)
functions.summary: Converts and re-tiles a texture block between linear and 8x8-tiled layout for format ids 0x64..0x6F, swapping channels per RGBA/RGB/LA variant and using a staging buffer when source and destination overlap.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CallGlobalCallbackSlot
functions.signature: int maybe_Gfx_CallGlobalCallbackSlot(int self, int forwarded, int forwarded2)
functions.summary: Invokes callback pointer at *(forwarded2 + 4) if non-null and returns self.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSet_Parse
functions.signature: void Gfx_ResourceSet_Parse(GfxResourceSet* self, int* header, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Parses a packed Gfx resource-set header: reads the entry count at +4 and turns the header-relative offsets into absolute pointers (self[i+4] = header + word), then resolves the two trailing record pointers and dispatches to the sub-parsers for the payload tables.

functions.name: maybe_Thumb_BuildDescriptorList
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Thumb_BuildDescriptorList(u32 base, u32 arg2, u32 kind)
functions.summary: Writes kind and constant 0x0008025E into caller descriptor buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_Texture_Decode
functions.signature: unsigned int* Gfx_Texture_Decode(int header, unsigned int* dst, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Decodes a compressed texture block into the caller's surface: walks the format ids (0x0229/0x0253/0x0289/0x0252...) and expands each 8x8 tile with the ETC/ETC1 swizzle masks.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSet_ProcessCommands
functions.summary: Walks the parsed resource-set entries and issues the per-entry GPU command: one of the four codes 0x2C0/0x2B1 or 0x290/0x281 depending on the flag byte at entry+6, written into the destination array.

functions.name: Gfx_VertexStream_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of an eight-slot vertex stream descriptor: clears the two counters and default-constructs the eight 0x2C-byte attribute records at +4.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateSlot2
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateSlot2(GfxModelInstance* self, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Rebuilds the second 0x210-byte sub-block of a model instance (at +0x238) from the shared scratch record and applies it to the instance.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateSlot3
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateSlot3(GfxModelInstance* self, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Same as 0x5084F8 for the third sub-block at +0x448 (slot index 3).

functions.name: Gfx_VertexStream_WriteQuantizedColors
functions.signature: void Gfx_VertexStream_WriteQuantizedColors(int self, u32 channelShift, float* values, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Quantises 256 float channel values into saturated 8-bit samples, inserts each byte into one lane of two 0x82-word vertex blocks and marks the block dirty; used to bake per-vertex colour data into the GPU stream.

functions.name: Gfx_Lighting_BuildLutDeltas
functions.signature: void Gfx_Lighting_BuildLutDeltas(u32 self, u32 channelShift, float* values, u32 forwarded)
functions.summary: Constructs 256 consecutive difference/derivative samples from a floating-point table and passes them to Gfx_VertexStream_WriteQuantizedColors to configure PICA200 lighting lookup tables.

functions.name: Gfx_BuildVertexFormatDescriptor
functions.summary: Builds the PICA200 vertex-attribute block: attribute-buffer headers at 0x0201/0x0203, a 0x98-byte cleared region, twelve FIXEDATTRIB_INDEX entries (register 0x0232, index 0..11) and the chained sub-descriptors, returning the final descriptor.

functions.name: Gfx_CommandBuffer_AppendBlock
functions.signature: void Gfx_CommandBuffer_AppendBlock(GfxCommandBuffer* buf, int size, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Appends a block to the growing GPU command buffer: grows the buffer with 0x508B9C (keeping the 0x18-byte header aligned to 4), writes the payload with 0x508BE8, then patches the relative pointer of the previous block and optionally emits the flush record.

functions.name: Gfx_CommandBuffer_InitPair
functions.signature: unsigned int* Gfx_CommandBuffer_InitPair(GfxCommandBuffer* buf, unsigned int** out, int address, int arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises a two-address GPU descriptor: stores the caller's words, translates the source address and the following record to physical addresses, shifts them right by 3 (PICA200 address encoding) and marks the pair valid.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_DrawState_InitDefaults
functions.summary: Default-initialises a 0x40-byte GPU draw-state block: runs the 12-element fixed-array default init at +4 (empty element ctor 0x006E7B38) and zero-fills the block so draw passes only override the fields they use.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSet_ApplyFormat
functions.signature: void Gfx_ResourceSet_ApplyFormat(GfxResourceSet* self, int* record, int arg3, int kind)
functions.summary: Maps a resource kind (0/1/2/3/4/5/6) to the element size used when registering the resource in the set (through 0x508FE4) and stores the count byte at record+2.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSet_SetSlot
functions.signature: void Gfx_ResourceSet_SetSlot(GfxResourceSet* self, int* record, int value, unsigned int* src)
functions.summary: Stores one resource slot: marks the present byte at +0x154+index, writes the five-word descriptor at +0x1A8+index*5 (from src or the default descriptor 0x0072FC2C) and registers the slot through 0x00508FE4.

functions.name: Gfx_Material_BindTextureSlots
functions.signature: void Gfx_Material_BindTextureSlots(Gfx_Material* material, const TextureSetRecord* set, unsigned pageId)
functions.summary: Fills a material's twelve texture slots from a texture-set record: finds the first free 0x1C-byte slot, binds each texture, records its type code and converts the format byte to a texel size (1/2/3/4/6/8/0xC/0x10).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Object_CtorFlags12
functions.summary: Stores the owner word at +0 and default-constructs twelve one-byte flags at +4 with the empty element stub 0x006E7B38.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ConstructPassSlots
functions.summary: Default-constructs the twelve 0x70-byte per-pass slots of a model instance at +0x160 via std_ConstructArray.

functions.name: Gfx_CommandNode_BuildChain4
functions.summary: Builds a chain of four GPU state nodes from the pool: marks the head with command 5, links each node to its predecessor and stores the caller's pointer in the tail node, returning the head.

functions.name: maybe_Container_DefaultInit3x3
functions.summary: Default-constructs three consecutive three-element byte arrays (at offsets 0, +3 and +6) with the empty element stubs and returns the object base.

functions.name: Gfx_CommandNode_InitSixSlots
functions.summary: Default-constructs six 0x18-byte GPU state nodes in place (element ctor 0x5096B8); companion of 0x509638, which builds the same nodes as a chain.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_SubmitReadRequest
functions.signature: void Gfx_Movie_SubmitReadRequest(u32 bufHi, u32 bufLo, int size, u8 flag)
functions.summary: Assembles the four-word movie read request (buffer, buffer high word, size, flag) and submits it to the async archive read helper 0x00125614 with the completion callback 0x00125D84; sizes below 0xB take the stack-array path whose continuation was lost.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_SyncObject_DestroyA
functions.summary: Destructor: unlinks the object through Os_CloseHandleAndUnlink(self), then closes the kernel handle at +0x14 (svcCloseHandle) and clears it, returning the object.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_StartAsyncRead
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Fs_StartAsyncRead(int self, u32 handle, u32 length, u32 destination, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Starts a read on an already-open handle: requires a 0x1000-aligned length and an idle object, stores the handle, sets the wait flag from bit 1 of flags, issues svc 0x1F on the handle and marks the request done on success.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_SyncObject_DestroyB
functions.summary: Destroys the second kind of synchronisation object: closes its kernel handle with Os_CloseHandle, then closes the remaining handle with svcCloseHandle and clears the stored handle field; returns the object.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Object_ReleaseHandles
functions.summary: Destroys two kernel handles held in self via svc 0x23 (svcCloseHandle) and restores default vtable 0x00741A74.

functions.name: Svc_HandleSlot_CloseA
functions.summary: Closes the handle in *slot through svcCloseHandle (svc 0x23) and stores 0; returns the slot for chaining.

functions.name: Svc_HandleSlot_CloseB
functions.summary: Second, byte-identical close-and-clear helper used for a different handle slot; kept separate by the original code layout.

functions.name: Svc_CloseHandleSlot
functions.summary: Closes the kernel handle stored in *handleSlot when it is non-zero (pre-close sync helper then svcCloseHandle) and clears the slot; returns the slot so callers can chain.

functions.name: Os_CreateEventHandle
functions.summary: Creates an anonymous kernel event handle if *cachedHandle is 0, storing the resulting handle in *cachedHandle.

functions.name: Ui_IconAtlas_Load
functions.summary: Loads the shared icon atlas once: guards on the global loaded byte, runs the texture-open sequence (0x0050C22C/0x0050C520/0x0050C4E4), reads the atlas format byte and marks the global state as loaded.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_OpenService
functions.summary: Starts the icon/atlas service once: skips when already started, opens 'cecd:u', waits for the atlas load, acquires the shared atlas context/session, records the cache mode byte and marks the global state started.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_EnsureReady
functions.summary: Makes sure the cecd content session is up before a create/read/write: starts the service (0x0050F2A4), sleeps 16 ms, then either sends the 0x0B/0x0C request once or polls up to 60 times while the change-state event is pending.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_ReleaseService
functions.summary: Releases the icon-cache service: takes the monitor lock 0x007E7948, sends the stop command 0x0E when `force` is set, releases the service object (0x0050F284) and clears the 'started' byte when it was running, and always unlocks. Returns the state/error word it observed.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_GetChangeStateEvent
functions.summary: Retrieves the CECD state change notification event handle into *out by dispatching through Svc_Cecd session selector 0x0050C5C4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IconCache_StartService
functions.summary: Starts the icon-cache service once: when the state block 0x007AE9E0 says 'opened but not started' it takes the 0x007E7948 lock, calls 0x0050F2A4(0), waits 16,000,000 ticks (~60 ms), marks 0x007AE9E0+2 started and unlocks. It never polls for readiness.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_StopService
functions.summary: Stops the icon-cache service: drops the start reference (Svc_RefCount_Release), clears the started bytes, asks the protocol layer to close (0x0050C4C0), resets the mailbox (Svc_Cecd_ResetMailbox) and clears the global 'opened' byte at 0x007AE9E0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IconCache_ReadPageEntries
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_IconCache_ReadPageEntries(UiIconCache* self, UiIconPage* page, int* outPtrs, u32 size, int pageIndex)
functions.summary: Reads one icon-cache page: queries the size for page index 0/1 through the object's +8 vtable, allocates/locks the matching page buffer (self[0xEA] or self[0x156]), copies the 0x20-byte page header into page, validates the 0x6060 entry tag and the object id, and writes the pointers of the 0x70-byte entries into outPtrs.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_InvokeReadEntryPoint
functions.signature: int maybe_Fs_InvokeReadEntryPoint(int* self, u32 forwarded, u32 forwarded2, int mode)
functions.summary: Invokes virtual slot +0x14 on self and returns error code 0xC8810BEF.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_WriteEntry
functions.signature: int Ui_IconCache_WriteEntry(UiIconCache* self, void* out, int arg3, int arg4, int arg5, int arg6)
functions.summary: Serialises one icon-cache entry: prepares/validates it with 0x50A520 and, when that succeeds, writes the raw block through maybe_Ui_IconCache_WriteRawBlock.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_RequestPage
functions.signature: int Ui_IconCache_RequestPage(UiIconCache* self, int pageIndex, u32 size)
functions.summary: Issues the read request for one of the two icon-cache pages (command 0x14 with page flag 3 or 4) and then parses the reply into the page's entry-header arrays, clearing the page's 'dirty/valid' byte.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_CommitEntryThunk
functions.summary: Tiny thunk that jumps straight to Ui_IconCache_CommitEntry (0x0050A714); exists only so a vtable/table slot can point at a distinct address.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_CommitEntry
functions.signature: int Ui_IconCache_CommitEntry(void * self, void * entry, u32 slot, u32 flags, int arg5)
functions.summary: Commits one icon-cache entry: takes the monitor lock, resolves the entry's timestamp, writes the entry record and its page through the service helpers, then unlocks and notifies the waiting worker.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_Open
functions.signature: int Ui_IconCache_Open(UiIconCache* self, u32 recordId, int expectedCount)
functions.summary: Opens the icon cache for one content record: starts the worker service, looks the record up, rejects a count mismatch, reads both entry-header tables and the entry table, stores the current timestamp and returns 0 (or the lookup error/0xC8810BEA on mismatch).

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_Close
functions.summary: Closes the icon cache: writes back both pages (0x18C bytes each), drops the record handle, wipes the page structures and the two temporary buffers, and - when the argument is 0 - also releases the service reference and clears the global state flags.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_OpenRawWithRetry
functions.signature: void Svc_Cecd_OpenRawWithRetry(u32 self, u32 id, u32 size, void* buffer, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8)
functions.summary: Opens a raw CECD file through Svc_Cecd_OpenRawFile and, on 0xC8A10BF0 'not started', starts the service, sets the retry byte at 0x007AE9E6 and retries the open once.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_ReadEntryTable
functions.summary: Reads the small index block (service command 0x05): asks for its size, allocates 800 bytes, verifies the 0x6767 magic and the declared count, converts the 8-byte entries into pointers at +0x159 and returns the number of entries.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_Create
functions.signature: int Ui_IconCache_Create(UiIconCache* self, u32 recordId, int stored, int must, u32 size1, u32 size2, u32 count1, u32 count2, u32 max1, u32 max2, u32 max3, u32 max4, u32 max5)
functions.summary: Creates the two icon pages of a record: validates the size/count limits (0x100000 bytes, 99 entries, 0x19000), sends commands 0x0B/0x0C/0x0D through the object's vtable, reads the two page headers and the entry table, then stores the record id and the current timestamp. Returns 0 on success.

functions.name: Ui_IconAtlas_LoadEntries
functions.summary: Loads the atlas entry table: issues command 0x0B with the entry count, commits the request and closes the object; returns the protocol result. This is the single call the UI screen uses after Ui_IconAtlas_Init.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_CountMatchingEntries
functions.summary: Walks the icon-cache entries (self[6] of them), reads each 0x60-byte record through the vtable read slot (+0x34) and counts the records whose flag byte intersects flagMask (bit 0x80 ignored); a mask of 0 counts every readable record.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_SetPage
functions.summary: Selects and re-reads one of the icon cache's two pages: sends command 0x0D for page 1 or 0x0C for page 0, reads the page header, requests the page block (+0xF3/0x87) and, for page 1, refreshes the entry table.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_StoreRecordByCommand
functions.signature: void Ui_IconCache_StoreRecordByCommand(int* self, int command, u8* data, u32 size)
functions.summary: Handles one cached-record write command: 0x8C..0x8F store a single saved flag byte (+0x77/+0x1DD/+0x1DE/+0x1DF), 0x65..0xC7 forward the payload through the vtable write slot (+0x30, or +0x24 when there is no data), and the 0x60-byte header is then flushed back to the backing handle.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_ReadHeader
functions.summary: Reads the 0x18C-byte icon-cache header through the object's vtable read slot, validates the 0x6868 magic and every per-entry tag (command 0x0B), then commits the cache and returns the read status.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_Commit
functions.summary: Commits a pending icon-page operation: reads the 8-byte status (command 0x0A), writes the whole 0x18C page buffer with command 0x01 and reads the status back.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IconCache_IsPresent
functions.summary: Probes the cache service through self->vtable+0x2C with two flags, returning the service's status and using maybe_Svc_ContentObject_QuerySize to latch whether the requested content is present.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_ReadRawWithRetry
functions.signature: void Svc_Cecd_ReadRawWithRetry(u32 self, u32 id, u32 size, u32 destination, u32 arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8)
functions.summary: Reads a raw CECD file through Svc_Cecd_ReadRawFile and retries once after starting the service when it returns 0xC8A10BF0.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_ReadWithRetry
functions.signature: void Svc_Cecd_ReadWithRetry(u32 self, u32 id, u32 size, u32 destination, u32 arg5, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: Protocol entry 1 of the CECD service: reads a raw CECD file through Svc_Cecd_ReadDispatch and, when it fails with 0xC8A10BF0, starts the service (0x0050D864 path), sets the retry byte and dispatches once more.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Cecd_Cmd0009WithRetry
functions.signature: void maybe_Svc_Cecd_Cmd0009WithRetry(u32 self, u32 value, u32 buffer, int size, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Retry wrapper for CECD command 0x0009: dispatches through 0x0050D050, and on 0xC8A10BF0 starts the service, sets the retry byte and dispatches once more.

functions.name: Ui_IconAtlas_Close
functions.summary: Closes an icon atlas object: releases the two page buffers, closes the pages, drops the service reference and clears the 'open' byte. Safe on an already closed object.

functions.name: Ui_IconAtlas_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the icon-atlas descriptor: installs vtable 0x00780FC4, clears the atlas state bytes and the 0x21F..0x22E slot array, seeds the two glyph/style constants 0x6262/0x6767 and marks the atlas usable.

functions.name: Ui_IconAtlas_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the icon atlas: installs the class vtable (0x00780FC4), closes the object and frees the allocation.

functions.name: Ui_IconAtlas_Release
functions.summary: Non-deleting destructor / release of the icon atlas: installs the class vtable and closes the object, returning the same pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Cecd_ResetMailbox
functions.summary: Resets the CECD state block at 0x007EF020, writing state bytes, clearing message markers, and releasing owned sub-object.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_OpenRawFile
functions.summary: Opens the raw CECD file: dispatches CECD command 0x03 to whichever of the two session slots is active (Cmd0003 or the B variant) and returns.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_WriteRawFile
functions.summary: Wraps CECD command 0x12 (header 0x00120104) for whichever of the two session slots is active.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_DeleteRawFile
functions.summary: Wraps CECD command 0x11 (header 0x00110104) for whichever of the two session slots is active.

functions.name: Ui_IconAtlas_WaitForLoad
functions.summary: Spin-waits for the icon atlas completion flag (g_007B0058) to become non-zero, sleeping 10 ms (0x00989680 ns) per iteration.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_OpenService
functions.summary: Opens the CECD service session ('cecd:u') used by the icon/content cache and stores the handle in the global session slot 0x007B0058.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_ReadRawFile
functions.summary: Reads the raw CECD file: dispatches CECD command 0x07 to the active session slot (Cmd0007 or the B variant).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0003
functions.signature: int Svc_Cecd_Cmd0003(u32 request, u8 request2, u32 input, int input2, u32* out, u32 output, int output2)
functions.summary: Raw CECD request with header 0x00030104 (command 0x03): maps one input and one output buffer and returns one reply byte. This is the CECD 'open/read raw file' command used for the icon data.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_GetCecInfoEventHandle
functions.summary: CECD request 0x000E (GetCecInfoEventHandle) on the primary cecd:u session (0x007B0058): sends a parameterless request and returns the event handle from the reply block.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0012
functions.signature: int Svc_Cecd_Cmd0012(u32 ctx, int size, u32* out, u32 request, u32 request2, u32 request3)
functions.summary: Raw CECD request with header 0x00120104 (command 0x12): passes the process mapping context and one buffer, returns one reply byte.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000D
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd000D(u32 value, u32 buffer, int size)
functions.summary: CECD command 0x000D with two normal and two translate parameters (header 0x000D0082). The descriptor 'size<<4|0xC' maps the caller buffer, so this is one of the buffer-taking raw-file commands.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0011
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd0011(u32 ctx, int size, u32 request, u32 request2, u32 request3)
functions.summary: Raw CECD request with header 0x00110104 (command 0x11) carrying the mapping context and one buffer.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0007
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd0007(u32 request, u8 request2, u32 request3, int input, u32 input2, int output, u32 output2)
functions.summary: Raw CECD request with header 0x00070106 (command 0x07) with two mapped buffers; the 'write raw file' command.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_GetChangeStateEventHandle
functions.summary: CECD request 0x000F (GetChangeStateEventHandle) on the primary cecd:u session; returns the notification event handle used to detect message-box changes.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0010
functions.summary: CECD request 0x0010 on the primary session; parameterless and returns one handle-sized value (header 0x00100000).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0001
functions.signature: int Svc_Cecd_Cmd0001(u32 request, u32 request2, u32 request3, u32* out)
functions.summary: CECD command 0x0001 with two normal parameters and a 0x20-byte translate block (header 0x000100C2); the 0x20 constant is written to the descriptor word.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000C
functions.summary: CECD command 0x000C, one normal parameter (header 0x000C0040), on the primary session.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000B
functions.summary: CECD command 0x000B, one normal parameter (header 0x000B0040), on the primary session.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0008
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd0008(u32 request, u32 request2, u8 request3, u32 buffer, int buffer2)
functions.summary: Raw CECD request with header 0x00080102 (command 0x08) with one buffer; the delete/replace variant used by 0x0050D004.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0009
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd0009(u32 value, u32 buffer, int size, u32 flags)
functions.summary: CECD command 0x0009 with two normal and two translate parameters (header 0x000900C2): maps one caller buffer with descriptor 'size<<4|0xA'.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000A
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd000A(u32 mapping, int size, u32 request, u32 request2, int buffer)
functions.summary: Raw CECD request with header 0x000A00C4 (command 0x0A) carrying the mapping context and one buffer.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0003B
functions.signature: int Svc_Cecd_Cmd0003B(u32 request, u8 request2, u32 input, int input2, u32* out, u32 output, int output2)
functions.summary: Duplicate of 0x0050C63C (header 0x00030104) for the second session slot at 0x007B005C.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000EB
functions.summary: Same request as 0x0050C6BC (CECD 0x000E) but sent on the secondary cecd session at 0x007B005C; N_033 already named the other secondary-session wrappers with a 'B' suffix.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0012B
functions.signature: int Svc_Cecd_Cmd0012B(u32 ctx, int size, u32* out, u32 arg4, u32 arg5, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: Duplicate of 0x0050C6F8 (header 0x00120104) for the second session slot.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000DB
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd000DB(u32 value, u32 buffer, int size)
functions.summary: Secondary-session (0x007B005C) copy of CECD command 0x000D (header 0x000D0082).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0011B
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd0011B(u32 ctx, int size, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Duplicate of 0x0050C7B0 (header 0x00110104) for the second session slot.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0007B
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd0007B(u32 request, u8 request2, u32 arg3, int input, u32 input2, int output, u32 output2)
functions.summary: Duplicate of 0x0050C808 (header 0x00070106) for the second session slot.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_GetChangeStateEventHandleB
functions.summary: Retrieves the state change event handle from the secondary/system CECD session (*0x007B005C) via command header 0x04020002.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0010B
functions.summary: Secondary-session copy of CECD command 0x0010 (header 0x00100000).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0001B
functions.signature: int Svc_Cecd_Cmd0001B(u32 request, u32 request2, u32 request3, u32* out)
functions.summary: Secondary-session copy of CECD command 0x0001 (header 0x000100C2, 0x20-byte block).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000CB
functions.summary: Secondary-session copy of CECD command 0x000C (header 0x000C0040).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000BB
functions.summary: Secondary-session copy of CECD command 0x000B (header 0x000B0040).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0008B
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd0008B(u32 request, u32 request2, u8 request3, u32 buffer, int buffer2)
functions.summary: Duplicate of 0x0050C9C0 (header 0x00080102) for the second session slot.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd0009B
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd0009B(u32 value, u32 buffer, int size, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Secondary-session copy of CECD command 0x0009 (header 0x000900C2, one mapped buffer).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_Cmd000AB
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_Cmd000AB(u32 mapping, int size, u32 request, u32 request2, int buffer)
functions.summary: Duplicate of 0x0050CA64 (header 0x000A00C4) for the second session slot.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_ReadDispatch
functions.summary: Dispatches a read to whichever of the two CECD sessions is open (0x0050C9C0 or 0x0050CF04).

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_DeleteDispatch
functions.summary: Dispatches a delete to whichever of the two CECD sessions is open (0x0050CA64 or 0x0050CFA8).

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_FlushEntries
functions.signature: int Ui_IconCache_FlushEntries(UiIconCache* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
