functions.summary: Flushes the dirty icon-cache slots: builds the header strings, checks the cache file with 0x00658BFC and commits every 0x70-byte entry via 0x0050D530 up to self->f_130.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_WriteRawBlock
functions.signature: unsigned int Ui_IconCache_WriteRawBlock(UiIconCache* self, short* header, unsigned int size)
functions.summary: Writes a raw block into the icon cache: validates the 0x6060 magic and the 0x70..0x19000 size range, memcpy's the payload and marks the cache entry written.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IconCache_BeginWrite
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Ui_IconCache_BeginWrite(void* self, int arg2, unsigned int size)
functions.summary: Begins a cache-block write: validates a 4-byte-aligned size in 0x70..0x18000, opens/validates the cache index through 0x00658BFC, records the size at f_134 and arg2 at f_138, and computes the total block size from the self->f_130 directory entries (0xC stride) into self+4/self+8. Returns an nn::Result code (0 on success).

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_ResetHeader
functions.summary: Clears the cache header: zeroes the two words of every 6-word record, resets the record count at +0x98, memsets the 0x70-byte header and restores the 0x6060 magic.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_ResetEntry
functions.summary: Clears the twelve icon-cache state fields at +0x130..+0x160 and resets the shared block header, leaving the object itself intact.

functions.name: Str_AssignIfNotNull
functions.signature: int Str_AssignIfNotNull(int dest, int src, int present)
functions.summary: Assigns a string member when the source is present, using the empty-string constructor 0x006722EC for the empty case or the copy helper 0x0011FFFC otherwise.

functions.name: std_String_InitFrom
functions.signature: unsigned int* std_String_InitFrom(unsigned int* self, int src)
functions.summary: Small-string construct/copy helper: initialises an empty string when the source pointer is null, otherwise copies the source string into the destination.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IconCache_CopyTimestamp
functions.summary: Writes one 8-byte icon-index field into the caller's buffer: a non-null source is copied by 0x0011FFFC, a null source takes the initialiser 0x006722EC; returns the out pointer.

functions.name: std_String_InitEmpty
functions.summary: Initialises an empty small string by calling the shared empty-string constructor 0x6722EC and returning the same buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Font_MapCharToLanguageFallback
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Font_MapCharToLanguageFallback(u8* charPtr, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 high)
functions.summary: Queries system language configuration block 0x000A0002 and checks language bit tables to map character code to font fallback index.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_ContentInfo_IsCacheCurrent
functions.summary: Returns whether the cached content info is at least as new as the system's content version: reads the 0xD0000 system word, fetches the content info under the global monitor and compares the stored halfword at +0x2C with the low half of the system word.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Cfg_GetRegionInfo
functions.summary: Sends command 0x0003 with one normal parameter on the cfg session at 0x007AF0F8 and copies the 64-bit reply into outPair.

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_GetSystemLanguage
functions.summary: Retrieves the system language ID byte from cfg:u service handle *0x007AF0F8 via IPC command 0x00020000 (CFGU_GetSystemLanguage).

functions.name: Svc_Cfg_GetSystemLanguageCode
functions.summary: Calls Svc_Cfg_GetSystemLanguage and returns the active system language enumeration as an integer (0..255).

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Cfg_ShutdownAndFree
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Svc_Cfg_ShutdownAndFree(u32 object, u32 arg2, u32 forwarded, u32* callbackSlot)
functions.summary: Executes shutdown callback at *callbackSlot and cleans up configuration service object.

functions.name: Os_InvokeCallbacksVariant
functions.summary: Second copy of the OS pending-callback dispatcher: when (pending & ~handled) is set, invokes up to eight registered callbacks, drains the runtime event, sends the close request and clears the pending flags; unlike Os_InvokeCallbacks (0x00118814) it also writes the handled state (0/1) into block[0] before returning it.

functions.name: Str_Utf16ToUtf8Thunk
functions.signature: int Str_Utf16ToUtf8Thunk(const unsigned short* src, unsigned char* dst, int dstSize)
functions.summary: Tail-call wrapper around Str_Utf16ToUtf8, used where the UTF-16 to UTF-8 conversion is installed in a function table.

functions.name: Str_Utf8ToUtf16Wrapped
functions.signature: int Str_Utf8ToUtf16Wrapped(void* out, const char* in, int capacity, int* written, int * wrap)
functions.summary: Forwarding wrapper around the UTF-8 to UTF-16 converter: the decompiler lost the parameter registers, leaving only the tail call to Str_Utf8ToUtf16.

functions.name: Str_WriteLineBreakUtf8
functions.signature: int Str_WriteLineBreakUtf8(char* buffer, int index, int mode, int write)
functions.summary: Writes a line break into a UTF-8/UTF-16 text buffer: mode 1 writes CRLF, 2 writes CR, 3 writes LF, and returns how many code units the break occupies.

functions.name: maybe_Str_TerminateConversionOutput
functions.summary: Disassembly artifact / tail block of string conversion routines writing trailing null bytes.

functions.name: Str_Utf16ToUtf8
functions.signature: int Str_Utf16ToUtf8(char* out, int* out_written, const unsigned short* in, int* in_read, int crlf)
functions.summary: Converts UTF-16 text to UTF-8 with optional CRLF translation and output-size clamping, returning an error code when the output buffer is too small.

functions.name: Str_Utf8ToUtf16
functions.signature: int Str_Utf8ToUtf16(unsigned short* out, int* out_written, const unsigned char* in, int* in_read, int crlf)
functions.summary: Converts UTF-8 text to UTF-16 with CRLF translation, skipping a leading UTF-8 BOM and clamping to the destination size.

functions.name: Gfx_VramBank_Setup
functions.signature: void Gfx_VramBank_Setup(GfxVramBank* self, uint32_t address, uint32_t size, uint16_t * format)
functions.summary: Registers one VRAM bank: delegates the (address, size, format) triple to 0x50E608, raises through 0x11C814 when it fails and clears the bank's dirty flag.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Font_ReleaseRef
functions.summary: Cleans up embedded sub-object at +0x18 and decrements reference count at self+0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Object_ReleaseOwnedMember
functions.summary: Releases owned sub-object pointer at self+0x18 via 0x0050E910 when non-null and clears the field.

functions.name: Mem_ExpHeap_Create
functions.signature: int Mem_ExpHeap_Create(int self, u32 offset, int size)
functions.summary: Initializes an nn::fnd::ExpHeap (Expanded Heap): verifies buffer 4-byte alignment, registers the heap range with magic 0x45585048 ('EXPH'), formats initial free block header with tag 0x4652 ('FR'), and sets up free list pointers.

functions.name: Mem_ExpHeap_FindBlock
functions.summary: Traverses ExpHeap memory block range tree rooted at node to locate the block descriptor encompassing the specified address.

functions.name: Mem_ExpHeap_UnlinkBlock
functions.summary: Finds the ExpHeap memory block for address and unlinks it from the doubly-linked free list rooted at 0x007F25C0, decrementing the free block counter.

functions.name: Mem_ExpHeap_InsertBlock
functions.signature: void Mem_ExpHeap_InsertBlock(u32* node, u32 tag, u32 stored, u32 stored2, u32 byteFlag)
functions.summary: Inserts a newly formatted or freed memory block into the ExpHeap block list rooted at 0x007F25C0, updating doubly-linked list pointers and incrementing the block counter.

functions.name: Svc_Time_IsValidDate
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Time_IsValidDate(u32 year, int month, int day)
functions.summary: Calendar validator used when the game stores/loads a date: checks the year against the two limits at 0x50EE0C/0x50EE10, rejects months outside 1..12, for February applies the leap-year rules (divisible by 400 or by 4 but not by 100) and finally checks the day against the month's length taken from the table at 0x72FBD8.

functions.name: Svc_Time_MakeTimestampFromRecord
functions.summary: Unpacks a date/time record and forwards it to Svc_Time_ComposeTimestamp: fields are the day value (+0), month (+1), hour (+5), minutes (+7), seconds (+2), milliseconds (+9) and the day-of-year/days word at +0xA.

functions.name: Svc_Time_ComposeTimestamp
functions.signature: s64 Svc_Time_ComposeTimestamp(u32 year, u32 month, u32 day, int hours, int minutes, int seconds, int milliseconds)
functions.summary: Builds a millisecond timestamp from calendar fields: days*86,400,000 + hours*3,600,000 + minutes*60,000 + seconds*1000 + milliseconds, i.e. the same unit the save/clock code uses.

functions.name: Svc_Time_IsValidDateTimeRecord
functions.summary: Full runtime validator for a saved date/time record: the date must pass Svc_Time_IsValidDate, the encoded hour must be 0..23, minutes and seconds 0..59, milliseconds 0..999 and the stored weekday byte (+6) must equal (days+6) mod 7.

functions.name: Svc_Time_GetCurrentTimestamp
functions.summary: Returns the current 64-bit timestamp: the raw clock from maybe_Svc_ComputeClockMs multiplied by 1,000,000 plus the global epoch base g_007AEA28, written as a two-word value.

functions.name: Svc_Time_GetTimestamp
functions.summary: Thin wrapper that returns the current/computed timestamp from Svc_Time_ComposeTimestamp through an out pointer (used by maybe_Svc_ComputeClockMs).

functions.name: Svc_AdvanceTimeMs
functions.signature: void Svc_AdvanceTimeMs(u32* clock, const u32* delta)
functions.summary: Adds a 64-bit delta converted from microseconds to milliseconds to the running 64-bit clock pair, using the compiler's divide-by-1,000,000 sequence (0x431BDE82D7B634DB) with the 18-bit shift and 0x4000 exponent fix-up.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_SyncObject_DestroyC
functions.summary: Destructor of a handle bundle: unlinks it (Os_CloseHandleAndUnlink(self+0x2C)) and closes the six kernel handles at +0, +8, +0x10, +0x1C, +0x24 and +0x40, clearing each slot.

functions.name: Svc_HandleSlot_CloseC
functions.summary: Third instance of the close-handle-and-clear helper (svcCloseHandle + store 0); used for yet another handle slot.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Ipc_Send0007
functions.summary: Sends IPC header 0x00070040 with one normal parameter on the session stored at 0x007B00E8 and returns the reply parameter (or the raw result on error).

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Ipc_Send0001
functions.summary: Sends IPC header 0x00010042 with one normal parameter and a 0x20-byte descriptor on the session at 0x007B00E8, returning the reply parameter or the raw error.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Ipc_Send0002
functions.summary: Sends IPC request 0x00020002 with a 0x20-byte translate descriptor and no normal parameter on the session at 0x007B00E8, returning the reply parameter or the raw error.

functions.name: Svc_RefCount_Release
functions.summary: Drops one reference on the shared content-service object: at count 1 it closes the stored handle, zeroes it and issues the software interrupt, otherwise it only decrements; the close error is returned.

functions.name: Regex_MatchTextRange
functions.signature: u32 Regex_MatchTextRange(TextLayoutState** state, TextRun* run, u16* text, int start, int flags, int* outLine, u32* outIndex)
functions.summary: Walks a range of UTF-16 text for the text filter: classifies each character (space/tab, 0x85, U+2028/2029, CR/LF), emits word and separator runs (codes 2/4/8, plus the 0x62 end marker) through 0x0050F360 and resolves each glyph through the 0x00712028 table, reporting the match span in outLine/outIndex.

functions.name: Regex_MatchTextLine
functions.signature: int Regex_MatchTextLine(TextLayoutState** state, int run, u16* text)
functions.summary: Single-line matcher of the text filter: same character classification and glyph lookup as 0x0050F3B4, but it stops at the terminator and returns the needs-more flag. Used by the NG-word matcher on every input field.

functions.name: Regex_ParseTokenStreamWithLength
functions.signature: int Regex_ParseTokenStreamWithLength(TextParser* p, int mode, const wchar_t* pattern)
functions.summary: Thunk that computes wcslen(pattern) and tail-falls into Regex_ParseTokenStream (0x0050F9A8) with (p, mode, pattern, length). It is not a fatal-error path: 0x00100B74 is wcslen, not an abort.

functions.name: Regex_ParseTokenStream
functions.signature: int Regex_ParseTokenStream(TextParser* p, int mode, int textPtr, int* cursor)
functions.summary: Front end of the text-filter pattern compiler: walks the UTF-16 pattern, honours the \Q...\E quoting escapes, splits on space/U+3000 boundaries and dispatches ordinary characters through the 0x60-entry table at 0x007AF2E0 to the per-character builders, falling back to 0x00510208 for non-ASCII.

functions.name: maybe_Regex_ParseBraceQuantifierB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Regex_ParseBraceQuantifierB(RegexParser* self, int* node, u32 arg3, int base)
functions.summary: Parses a brace quantifier '{...}' of the text-filter pattern: after the '{' it parses the decimal count through Regex_ParsePredefinedClass and stores node kind 8 with the count; returns 9 when the input is not a valid quantifier.

functions.name: maybe_Regex_ParseBraceQuantifierA
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Regex_ParseBraceQuantifierA(RegexParser* self, int* node, u32 arg3, int base)
functions.summary: Same brace-quantifier parse as 0x0050FDC4 but stores node kind 7 (with the parsed count) instead of kind 8; returns 9 when the input is not a valid quantifier.

functions.name: maybe_Regex_MatchLoopEntryA
functions.summary: Disassembly artifact: interior address within 32-bit instruction at 0x0051045C inside regular expression matching engine.

functions.name: maybe_Regex_MatchLoopEntryB
functions.summary: Disassembly artifact: second interior address inside instruction at 0x005104F0 within regex engine.

functions.name: Regex_Buffer_Init
functions.signature: u32 Regex_Buffer_Init(TextBuffer* self, u32 size, u32 count, int clear)
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises the regex scratch buffer: (count+0xF)>>4 units through 0x00514390, optionally clears the first count bytes, and stores capacity/size at +0x18/+0x1C and +0x08/+0x14.

functions.name: maybe_Text_MatchCharAgainstClass
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Text_MatchCharAgainstClass(int* textRef, int* nodeRef, u32 start, int length)
functions.summary: Validates a UTF-16 character sequence against primary and alternate character codes of a regex character class AST node.

functions.name: maybe_Text_MatchTokenTree
functions.signature: int maybe_Text_MatchTokenTree(u32* out, TextParser* parser, const wchar_t* text)
functions.summary: Matches a parsed pattern token tree against a wide string: stores {text, wcslen(text)} at *out, then walks the node kinds (7, 0x11, 0x12, 0xC) and returns 0/1. It is not a fatal-error path: 0x00100B74 is wcslen, not an abort.

functions.name: Regex_MatchLoop
functions.signature: u32 Regex_MatchLoop(int* ctx, u32* out, u32* cursor, code* fallback)
functions.summary: Inner matcher loop of the regex VM: dispatches on the node type through the two 0x98-byte-apart handler tables at 0x007AF1B0, calls the type's matcher and then its 'advance' counterpart until one reports a match, and returns the matcher's status.

functions.name: Regex_NodeAlloc
functions.signature: void Regex_NodeAlloc(u32* out, RegexNodeList* list, int node)
functions.summary: Allocates a list node (two units from the regex allocator 0x00514390), sets the self-referencing list pointers and inserts it after the list head, then stores the caller's value word.

functions.name: Regex_MatchNode
functions.summary: Recursive matcher for one regex node: handles alternation (kind 5), concatenation (0/2), groups (3/4), any-char (6/7) and match-all (8/0x12), recursing into the sub-nodes and switching between the group state's enter and leave callbacks.

functions.name: Regex_MatchSequence
functions.signature: u32 Regex_MatchSequence(int* ctx, int* out, int* cursor, code* fallback)
functions.summary: Matches a whole sequence: runs the generic match loop, then for kind-1 (sequence) nodes walks every element through the per-node dispatch table at 0x007AF1B0, threads the match positions through the group stacks and returns the match code.

functions.name: Regex_OpBuildOperandSets
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpBuildOperandSets(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexValueList** out, RegexCursor* left, RegexCursor* right)
functions.summary: Opcode handler of the pattern VM: allocates a result node, appends one successor-set per instruction operand, then appends the instruction's own character domain to the same node. Returns 0 or 2 (allocation failure).

functions.name: Regex_AddCharWithFoldVariants
functions.signature: u32 Regex_AddCharWithFoldVariants(RegexSet* set, u32 second, u32 ch)
functions.summary: Adds a code unit plus its up-to-three case-fold variants to a character set: 0x513F78 binary-searches the 1397-entry fold table at 0x7B00EC and every non-zero alternative is inserted with the sorted interval-list insert.

functions.name: Regex_OpBuildOperandSetsSingle
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpBuildOperandSetsSingle(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexValueList** out, RegexCursor* left, RegexCursor* right)
functions.summary: Single-operand form of Regex_OpBuildOperandSets: when the instruction flag byte at +0xA is zero it pushes the one value from *left, otherwise it walks the operand count and appends each operand's domain before the instruction's own domain.

functions.name: Regex_OpCopySetAndPush
functions.signature: int Regex_OpCopySetAndPush(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexSet** out, RegexSet** source)
functions.summary: Allocates a result set node, fills it from the instruction through Regex_MatchNode, pushes it into the source list and merges it into the destination set; only reports success when both steps returned 0.

functions.name: Regex_OpPushValue
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpPushValue(RegexCursor* cursor, u32* out, u32* value_ptr, u32* out_value)
functions.summary: Allocates one list node, copies a single scalar into it with tag type 1 (0x6E7890) and links it at the head of the given list; advances the instruction cursor and returns 0, or 2 when the allocation fails.

functions.name: Regex_OpCopySetNormalized
functions.signature: int Regex_OpCopySetNormalized(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexSet** out, RegexSet** source)
functions.summary: Like 0x00511DC0 (copy/merge the set) but it normalises the merged interval list with Regex_Set_Normalize and returns 2 when normalisation fails.

functions.name: Regex_OpPushValueFromRight
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpPushValueFromRight(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexValueList** out, RegexValueList** left, RegexValueList** right)
functions.summary: Copies the scalar currently held in the right-hand operand list into the output list with tag type 1 and returns 0/2. Mirror image of Regex_OpPushValueFromLeft.

functions.name: Regex_OpPushValueFromLeft
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpPushValueFromLeft(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexValueList** out, RegexValueList** left, RegexValueList** right)
functions.summary: Copies the scalar held in the left-hand operand list into the output list with tag type 1. Mirror image of Regex_OpPushValueFromRight (0x511FB4).

functions.name: maybe_Regex_OpReplaceOutputList
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Regex_OpReplaceOutputList(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexValueList** out, RegexCursor** left, RegexCursor* right)
functions.summary: Regex opcode that rewrites the destination value list: with the zero flag it clears the old node list and pushes one value from the right operand; otherwise it iterates the operands, builds their successor lists and appends the values.

functions.name: Regex_OpPushValueAndVariants
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpPushValueAndVariants(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexSet** out, RegexSet** value)
functions.summary: Pushes the current value, tagged with the instruction's 16-bit tag, and then pushes one node for each case-fold alternative that 0x513F78 returns for it (up to three). Used by case-insensitive literal matching.

functions.name: Regex_OpAdvanceAndMatchSub
functions.signature: int Regex_OpAdvanceAndMatchSub(RegexCursor* cursor, u32 value, u32* value2)
functions.summary: Opcode handler for a sub-expression: advances the cursor, increments the nesting counter at cursor+0x18, runs Regex_MatchSequence on the sub-expression and returns 0 when the next opcode is the 0x0A alternative-end marker, 3 (backtrack) otherwise.

functions.name: Regex_OpPushValueTaggedByte
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpPushValueTaggedByte(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexSet** out, RegexSet** target)
functions.summary: Pushes one value into the result list using tag type 4 (an 8-bit payload taken from the instruction's +0xA byte). Returns 0/2.

functions.name: Regex_OpPushNamedClassNormalized
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpPushNamedClassNormalized(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexSet** out, RegexSet** target)
functions.summary: Pushes the current value and adds the ranges of the predefined character class selected by the instruction byte through g_005142C4/g_005142C8, then normalises the set with Regex_Set_Normalize before reporting success.

functions.name: Regex_OpPushNamedClass
functions.signature: u32 Regex_OpPushNamedClass(RegexCursor* cursor, RegexSet** out, RegexSet** target)
functions.summary: Regex opcode that pushes a predefined character class: allocates the set node, adds the class ranges for the class index in the instruction byte +0xA and reports success without the normalisation pass.

functions.name: Regex_Match_StateInit
functions.signature: int Regex_Match_StateInit(RegexMatchState* state, u32 allocator, u32 program, u32* result)
functions.summary: Creates a matcher state: stores the allocator, allocates the list head and the first set, runs the compiled program through 0x51150C, and then numbers the produced nodes consecutively in field +0x14. Returns 0 or 2.

functions.name: Regex_State_FindOrCreate
functions.signature: void Regex_State_FindOrCreate(RegexState** out, RegexMatcher* m, u32 key_array, u32* key_count)
functions.summary: Looks up the state whose key array equals the requested one (memcmp of key_count words via 0x1009DC) in the bucket chain; on a miss it allocates a new state node, copies the keys, creates its bitset (0x5108A4), fills the edges (0x51310C) and links it into the bucket.

functions.name: Regex_State_SplitOverlappingClasses
functions.summary: Makes the character classes of the matcher disjoint: for the current class node it collects the ranges of all its children into a temporary set, then for every other class node whose ranges overlap that set (0x6591EC) it intersects (0x513DA4) and removes the overlap (0x513648), marking the covered keys; class nodes whose set becomes empty are unlinked and freed.

functions.name: Regex_State_DeduplicateKeys
functions.summary: Ensures every code unit belongs to only one class: for a key node (type 2) it removes the other key nodes with the same 16-bit key, and for every class node (type 3) containing the key it removes the key (0x513760) and frees the class when it becomes empty.

functions.name: Regex_State_CollectEdges
functions.summary: For every class slot the bitset marks, appends all child values other than the trivial value 1 to the state's edge list, copying each value with the allocator; returns 0 on allocation failure.

functions.name: maybe_Regex_State_BuildRecursive
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Regex_State_BuildRecursive(RegexMatcher* matcher, RegexState** slot, u32 key_list, u32* key)
functions.summary: Recursive builder for a regex sub-expression: allocates the key bitset, marks the state's own class, deduplicates/splits overlapping classes, collects the child edges and recurses; finally flags each state whose key is present in the requested list.

functions.name: maybe_Regex_MatchAlternation
functions.summary: Interior continuation branch within regex pattern matching engine calling Regex_State_FindOrCreate.

functions.name: Regex_Match_Build
functions.signature: u32 Regex_Match_Build(RegexMatcher* m, u32 allocator, u32 key_list, u32* key)
functions.summary: Builds the whole pattern matcher: counts the keys in key_list, allocates the key array and the visited bitset, creates the root state and runs the class-partition/expand passes (0x51310C, 0x512E5C, 0x512928, 0x5131E4), then masks every state against the requested key. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: Regex_Set_Subtract
functions.summary: Removes every range of the second sorted interval list from the first: overlapping intervals are clamped or split, fully covered ones are unlinked and freed. Returns 1, or 0 when a split needs an allocation that fails.

functions.name: Regex_Set_RemoveChar
functions.summary: Removes one code unit from a sorted range list, shrinking the containing interval or splitting it in two; returns 0 only if the split allocation fails.

functions.name: Regex_Set_AddRange
functions.signature: u32 Regex_Set_AddRange(RegexSet* set, u32 start, u32 end)
functions.summary: Inserts a code range into a sorted list of disjoint ranges, merging it with the neighbours it touches or overlaps; the literal at 0x5139EC is the 0xFFFF end sentinel. Returns 1 on success, 0 on allocation failure.

functions.name: Regex_Set_AddList
functions.summary: Merges every (start,end) pair of a range list into the destination set via 0x51384C and stops at the first allocation failure.

functions.name: Regex_Set_Normalize
functions.summary: Rebuilds a range list so that it covers the whole 0..0xFFFF code space with contiguous, merged intervals (the 0xFFFF sentinel comes from 0x513DA0); the list is built in a temporary list first so an allocation failure leaves the original intact. Returns 1/0.

functions.name: Regex_Set_Intersect
functions.summary: Intersects two sorted character-range lists in place: keeps only the overlap of the first list, trimming or dropping intervals the second list does not cover. Returns 1 when the list still has ranges, else 0.

functions.name: maybe_Regex_BuildSuccessorList
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Regex_BuildSuccessorList(RegexValue* node, RegexValueList** out, RegexList* operands, RegexList* visited)
functions.summary: Builds the value set for one regex expression node: allocates a memo entry, hangs it off the node, records the operand/visited links and recursively copies the operand values into the result list.

functions.name: Regex_Set_AddPredefinedClass
functions.summary: Adds the ranges of a named character class to a set: g_005142C4 holds {first_index,count} pairs into the (start,end) run table at g_005142C8, whose runs are inserted with 0x51384C. The class ids are the ones parsed from the '{Name}' table: Lower, Upper, ASCII, Alpha, Alnum, Punct, Graph, Print, Blank, Cntrl, XDigit and the Unicode block names (InLatin-1Supplement, InGreek, InCJKUnifiedIdeographs, ...).

functions.name: Regex_ParsePredefinedClass
functions.signature: u32 Regex_ParsePredefinedClass(u32 text, u32 avail, u32* out_len)
functions.summary: Parses a '{Name}' character-class reference: compares the text against the 0x84-entry class-name table g_00514338 (entries are {name,len} and the names include the closing brace, e.g. 'Lower}', 'ASCII}', 'InLatin-1Supplement}'), returning the class number (0..0x83), the matched length and 0x85 when no name matches.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_MatchWord
functions.signature: u8* Text_NgWord_MatchWord(TextFilter* self, int* field_flags, u16* word, u32 word_len, void* fields, u32 field_count)
functions.summary: Compiles one NG-word dictionary word into a matcher (0x50F9A8 parse run, 0x510A28 copy, 0x5126CC state init, 0x5133C8 build) and tests it against every input field with 0x50F6C8, setting that field's bit in field_flags for every hit.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_InitBuffers
functions.summary: Sets up the NG-word filter's workspace layout (base, +0xB000 scratch, +0xF000/+0xF800 tables) and opens the service through 0x514A20.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_ValidateAll
functions.signature: int Text_NgWord_ValidateAll(TextFilter* self, u32* field_flags, u32 kind, u32 fields, u32 field_count)
functions.summary: Loads the NG-word dictionary files 'ngword:/%d.txt' for every dictionary index that 0x5159F8 derives from the input text, and applies each file to all fields with 0x514ABC; returns the first negative file error or 0.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_OpenService
functions.summary: Opens the profanity-filter service: verifies the shared memory block (0x504360) and creates/registers the 0x800-byte content object named "ngword:" (0x503D48), storing its buffer at self+0x28 and setting the ready flag +0x19.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_ApplyDictionary
functions.signature: u32 Text_NgWord_ApplyDictionary(TextFilter* self, u32* field_flags, u32 dict_file, u32 fields, u32 field_count)
functions.summary: Applies one NG-word dictionary file to all input fields: prepares the 16 scratch buffers (self+0x2c, 0x80 halfwords each), normalises each field (0x51577C), optionally pre-tests it (0x515490), then fetches the file's UTF-16 text through its vtable, checks the 0xFEFF BOM and runs Text_NgWord_MatchWord for every newline-separated dictionary line.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_ValidateOne
functions.signature: int Text_NgWord_ValidateOne(TextFilter* self, u32* out, u32 pattern, u32 fields)
functions.summary: Validates one UTF-16 field against the NG-word dictionary: clamps the 0x200-byte working buffer (0x5154DC), splits it into dictionary indices (0x5159F8) and runs the line masker 0x514EBC for each of them; returns the first negative error or 0.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_MaskField
functions.signature: u32 Text_NgWord_MaskField(TextFilter* self, u32 flags, u32 destination, u32 b, u32 pattern_list, int* dict_object)
functions.summary: Masks one field for one dictionary: when no dictionary id is active it first applies the default e-mail-style pattern (the UTF-16 regex at 0x730C68, loaded through the literal at 0x51504C), then reads every newline-separated word of the dictionary object and applies it with 0x515C60/0x5150B4 so each match is replaced by '*'.

functions.name: Text_NgWord_CloseService
functions.summary: Shuts the NG-word filter down: unmounts the "ngword:" archive (Fs_UnmountByName), releases the work buffer (0x5099F8) and clears every field of the state back to the 'uninitialised' state.

functions.name: Text_MaskPatternMatches
functions.signature: u8* Text_MaskPatternMatches(TextFilter* self, int* match_count, u32 dst1, u32 dst2, u8* mask, u32 pattern, u32 applied)
functions.summary: Compiles/applies one pattern string to a field and masks every match: it walks the match spans reported by 0x50F3B4 and replaces each span with '*' (U+002A) in the output buffer, either the whole span or only its first/last character depending on self+0x30, maintaining the parallel character mask.

functions.name: Text_NormalizeFullwidth
functions.signature: void Text_NormalizeFullwidth(u16* dst, u8* mask, int dst_len, u16* src)
functions.summary: Folds a UTF-16 string for dictionary matching: fullwidth Latin/ASCII (U+FF01..FF5A) to ASCII by +0x120, hiragana to katakana by +0x60, and small kana + dakuten/handakuten to their combined forms using the tables at 0x7418EA/0x741A02/0x741A56/0x74191A; the mask records which output units were folded/merged.

functions.name: Text_NormalizeFullwidthTrimmed
functions.signature: void Text_NormalizeFullwidthTrimmed(u16* dst, int dst_len, u16* src)
functions.summary: Same fullwidth/kana folding as 0x5154DC but skips leading spaces (U+0020 and U+3000) so leading blanks cannot hide a dictionary match; used by the field masker before matching.

functions.name: Text_ClassifyInput
functions.signature: void Text_ClassifyInput(u32 stream, u8* out, int* out_count)
functions.summary: Classifies an input text stream into the 0..0x10 character classes used by the NG-word validator, writing one class byte per character and counting them.

functions.name: Svc_Snd_Cmd0003SendString
functions.summary: Sends one string to the snd:u session as command 0x0003: the normal parameter is strlen+1, the translate descriptor is size<<14|2, and the reply word is returned.

functions.name: Svc_Snd_Cmd0003
functions.summary: Sound service request 0x0003 with one normal and one translate parameter (descriptor 'size<<14|2') on the snd:u session at 0x007AEAB0.

functions.name: Svc_Snd_Cmd001D
functions.summary: Parameterless sound service request 0x001D on the snd:u session; returns one word.

functions.name: Svc_Snd_Cmd0004WithName
functions.summary: snd:u command 0x0004 that measures the supplied string (strlen+1) and sends it as the single translate buffer - the name-based form used to load a sound resource by name.

functions.name: Svc_Snd_Cmd0004
functions.summary: snd:u command 0x0004 with an explicit buffer and byte size (size<<14|2 descriptor), the buffer form of the name-based request.

functions.name: Svc_ComputeClockMs
functions.summary: Samples two hardware clock sources (0x0050F004 with 2000 and 0x834 = 2100 MHz), converts both to milliseconds with std_Int64MulDiv/Divide and combines them with the calibration block at 0x1FF81020 to return a monotonic 64-bit time.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ApplyMaskedWord
functions.summary: When the channel block is initialised and no slot is owned, acquires the driver slot, submits a one-word masked block carrying the byte-swapped word from self+4 and records the slot in the owner byte.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ApplyMaskedParam
functions.summary: Applies a single 16-bit channel parameter with the driver's masked write, stores the accepted mask in +0xE and falls back to the driver's default value in +0xF when nothing was accepted; returns the accepted mask.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ReleaseSlot
functions.summary: Stops a channel's parameter block: submits the mask-1 block, releases the driver slot with 0x516EEC, marks the owner byte 0xFF and clears the four channel words.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ApplyFade
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Channel_ApplyFade(SoundChannel* self, float* fade, u32 avail, u32 buf_size)
functions.summary: Converts a fade request into the driver's 16-bit channel block: clamps the two volumes to 0..1, converts the duration to milliseconds, requires 2 or 4 channels * duration * 0x280 bytes to fit the remaining buffer, then submits a five-word masked block.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetWaveBufferSlot
functions.summary: Selects the wave-buffer slot (0 or 1) for an idle sound channel and remembers it in the channel state byte; returns false if the channel is busy or the slot is out of range. Called just before the wave parameters are pushed by the sound player; the state byte +0xD must be -1 (free) and becomes the slot number.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetWaveBufferSource
functions.summary: Pushes the source/buffer-selector word into the channel parameter block (loop flag + value) and updates the channel's cached source id. The parameter block it hands to 0x518368 only carries command bit 1 (the wave-buffer/source selector), unlike 0x516A58 which sets the full wave format.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ClearWideParamRamp
functions.summary: Wide-block variant of 0x516618: submits a zero-mask block through the 0x34-byte channel writer (0x518368), releases driver slot bank 1 with 0x516EEC and clears the channel words.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetupWaveParams
functions.summary: Converts a sound definition into a full DSP wave-buffer parameter block (sample rate, format, loop, volume/pan ramp, ADPCM coefficients) and submits it for the channel. The long arithmetic against 0x500-byte blocks with a 0.95 volume clamp and 128.0 fixed-point scale is the standard 3DS wave-buffer setup, and the resulting block is applied through 0x518368.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_Allocate
functions.signature: SoundChannelNode* Sound_Channel_Allocate(SoundChannelPool* pool, int time, SoundCallback callback, u32 callback2)
functions.summary: Allocates one of the 24 channel slots: preempts the lowest-priority entry when all 24 bits are set ('popcount(*pool) == 0x18'), takes the first free bit, initialises the slot object (0x518860), sorts it into the time-ordered list by its timestamp and stores the callback/argument.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_Reinsert
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_Reinsert(SoundChannelPool* pool, SoundChannelNode* node, int time)
functions.summary: Unlinks a channel node from the pool's time-ordered list and re-inserts it at the position matching its new timestamp, under the pool monitor.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ReleaseAll
functions.summary: Releases the driver resources of all 24 channel slots (calls the per-slot release helper 0x11EE78 on each slot's descriptor at +0x68).

functions.name: Sound_Channel_UpdateScheduler
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_UpdateScheduler(SoundChannelPool* pool, int elapsed, u32 frame)
functions.summary: Advances the channel scheduler: for every active node, if its time has expired and it is not the 'already fired' node it calls the node's callback, removes it from the list, clears its slot bit and then advances/releases the underlying DSP channel; nodes whose time has not come are progressed by the elapsed amount.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_StopAll
functions.summary: Stops all 24 channel slots by calling the DSP channel reset (0x51A3C4) on each slot descriptor.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_Free
functions.summary: Frees one channel: clears its bit in the slot mask, decrements the count, unlinks the node and, if it was still playing, stops the DSP channel through 0x51A4AC(..,1); the node itself is not returned to a heap.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ReleaseBuffers
functions.summary: Releases both wave buffers of one sub-channel, zeroes the pointers and clears the channel's active flag through Sound_Channel_SetActive.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Channel_GetBaseTime
functions.summary: Returns one of four constants (0xDF0C/0xD930/0xCD78/0x30BB0) selected by the channel's mode byte at +3, plus 1500 (0x5DC) or 10000 selected by the byte at +2. The constants look like per-mode sample or tick counts, so 'base time' is still a guess.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_MixBuffers
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_MixBuffers(SoundChannel* self, u32 sub, u32 buf)
functions.summary: Mixes one sub-channel into a 4-chunk sample buffer by delegating to the active wave buffer's mixer (0x519538 or 0x519780 depending on which of the two wave slots is set).

functions.name: Sound_Channel_AddPlayPosition
functions.summary: Adds the DSP's current playback position to the channel's elapsed/sample counter when the query succeeds.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetWaveBufferMain
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Channel_SetWaveBufferMain(SoundChannel* self, u32 sub, u32 wave)
functions.summary: Replaces the main wave buffer of a sub-channel: releases the old buffers, stores the new handle, initialises it with 0x519490 and marks the channel as using it.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetWaveBufferAux
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Channel_SetWaveBufferAux(SoundChannel* self, u32 sub, u32 wave)
functions.summary: Installs the auxiliary wave buffer for one sub-channel: releases the previous one, computes the new layout and marks the channel active; the twin 0x51765C does the same for the primary slot.

functions.name: Sound_RingBuffer_Write
functions.signature: void Sound_RingBuffer_Write(SoundRing* self, u32 src, int count)
functions.summary: Copies count words from src into the circular sample buffer at the write cursor and wraps the cursor back to 0 at the end of the buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_GetSystemIfInitialized
functions.summary: Verifies sound system initialization flag at stateWord, aborting via std_RunTerminateHandler if uninitialized, and returns sound system pointer 0x007F09C8.

functions.name: Snd_WaitAudioTransfer
functions.signature: int Snd_WaitAudioTransfer(SndTransfer* self, u64* elapsed, u32 arg3, int size1, int size2, u32 dataPtr, int waitMode)
functions.summary: Submits or waits for one audio buffer transfer. On the first call it reads the millisecond clock, builds the five-word transfer request and posts it with the async transfer helper 0x00111F60; afterwards it compares the hardware tick pairs (0x005191B4/0x00519224 around the memory barrier) to report how long the transfer took in *elapsed, and either drops the user count of the owning slot or sleeps on the wait handle.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_MixerThread_MainThumb
functions.signature: void maybe_Sound_MixerThread_MainThumb(u32 thread, u32 thread2, int thread3, u32 thread4, int frame)
functions.summary: Thumb-mode mixer thread body (twin of the ARM copy at 0x00517B6C): waits for the DSP display event, runs the per-frame audio update through the callback slots at +0x20/+0x28/+0x30, advances the 64-bit frame clock with svc 0x28 and loops while the run flag is set.

functions.name: Snd_StartVoicePlayback
functions.signature: int Snd_StartVoicePlayback(SndVoice* self, u32* src, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32* arg5, u32 arg6, u32 arg7, u32 arg8)
functions.summary: Starts playback of one voice: waits/submits the buffer through Snd_WaitAudioTransfer, records the two caller parameters at +0x20/+0x24, and optionally applies a three-word loop/rate parameter block with 0x00517CF0. If that second step fails the voice is torn down again with 0x00517A70.

functions.name: Sound_GetSystemHeader
functions.summary: Copies the first two words of the sound-system object into the caller's buffer (an 8-byte header getter); the 'does not return' note is a Ghidra artifact.

functions.name: Sound_GetSystemThunk
functions.summary: 16-byte thunk: 'push {r4,lr}; bl 0x005177DC; pop {r4,lr}' returns the sound-system pointer from maybe_Sound_GetSystemIfInitialized (0x005177DC, which loads the global and tests its bit 0).

functions.name: Svc_Gpu_CleanupCommandBuffers
functions.summary: Tears down the two GPU command/transfer buffers of a slot: for each in-use buffer it waits for GSP (software_interrupt 0x24), finishes the pending transfer (func_00118100/func_00118170, software_interrupt 0x23), issues a data-synchronisation barrier, invalidates the cache range (func_00111D50) and resets the bookkeeping words (f_3C = -1, global 0x7F09C4 = 1).

functions.name: maybe_Sound_GetSystemThunkArg
functions.summary: Thunk invoking sound system instance accessor 0x005177DC.

functions.name: Sound_MixerThread_Main
functions.summary: The mixer thread: loops while the run flag is set, sleeps until the next frame (svcSleepThread via 0x518010 or the tick helper 0x517E7C), polls the two DSP event counters (0x51756C), calls the registered frame callback +0x28/0x2c and the per-frame update 0x51867C, and advances the 64-bit frame clock.

functions.name: Snd_StartChannelTransferThread
functions.signature: unsigned Snd_StartChannelTransferThread(Sound_DspChannel* self, unsigned buffer, unsigned size, unsigned* timeout)
functions.summary: Starts the DSP transfer thread of a sound channel: it resets the two light events, fills the thread attribute block and calls Os_CreateThreadWithStack with entry 0x00518768 and the buffer/size/timeout arguments, then stores the sign of the result at f_E.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SetPendingState
functions.summary: Thunk: gets the sound system (0x005177DC) and stores the argument byte at system+8, but only when the system's +0x30 flag is zero. The +0x30 gate and the +8 field are unnamed, so 'pending state' is a guess.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_CloseObjectHandles
functions.summary: Closes and clears the two kernel handles an object owns (+0x18 first, then +0x10) and returns the object; the handle-release step of a sound-subsystem teardown.

functions.name: Sound_GetDisplayTime
functions.summary: Samples the DSP display timestamp under the sound lock counter (0x5191B4/0x518BE0), computes the 64-bit delta and returns it through the caller's pair, retrying after a timeout when the DSP is not ready.

functions.name: Sound_WaitForDisplayTime
functions.summary: Locking counterpart of 0x517E7C used by the frame update: samples the DSP timestamp and sleeps before retrying while the display is not ready; returns no timestamp.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SubmitAdpcmFrame
functions.signature: unsigned maybe_Sound_SubmitAdpcmFrame(unsigned char* samples, unsigned arg2, int params, int channel, int count)
functions.summary: Packs one ADPCM frame for the DSP: splits eight sample bytes into sixteen nibbles, combines them with the channel's predictor/step values from the parameter block and writes the result, then waits for the DSP event.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_DspWriteChannelConfig
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_DspWriteChannelConfig(u32 value, u32 forwarded, u32 forwarded2, u32 forwarded3)
functions.summary: Writes DSP channel register configuration word with flag bit 0x10 and forwards to 0x0011E9A8.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_WriteParamBlock
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_WriteParamBlock(u32 driver, int channel, u16* block)
functions.summary: Copies a masked 0x14-byte DSP channel parameter block into the driver's per-channel table: mask bit0 = one halfword, bit1 = one word, bit2 = five words (filter/loop data), then marks the channel dirty and flushes the DSP cache.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ApplyParamBlock
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_ApplyParamBlock(int manager, int channel, u16 * block)
functions.summary: Applies a command block to one sound channel: stores the block's flags/parameters into the channel state (enable, wave-buffer id, sample format, loop, ADPCM coefficients) and notifies the DSP service. Its neighbours in symbols.json already name the matching writer Sound_Channel_WriteParamBlock (0x5182CC); this is the immediate-mode counterpart used by both wave setters.

functions.name: Sound_ForwardToVoicePlayback
functions.signature: void Sound_ForwardToVoicePlayback(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Gathers six register/stack arguments, fetches the sound system (0x005177DC) and tail-forwards everything to the named Snd_StartVoicePlayback (0x005179A8).

functions.name: Sound_Channel_InvokeCallback
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_InvokeCallback(SoundChannel* self, u32 sub, u32 buf)
functions.summary: Calls the decode/mix hook registered for one of the channel's two slots with the four 0x280-byte chunk pointers, a length of 0xA0 and the hook's argument, under the channel's own monitor.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetDecodeHook
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_SetDecodeHook(SoundChannel* self, u32 sub, int hook, u32 callback)
functions.summary: Installs or removes the decode/mix hook of one channel slot and tells the driver whether the slot is active (0x118BAC).

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetActive
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_SetActive(SoundChannel* self, u32 slot, u8 active)
functions.summary: Sets the per-slot active byte and publishes it to the driver through 0x118BAC(bank, slot).

functions.name: maybe_Sound_GetQueueRoot
functions.summary: Returns func_00117ED0(&soundSystem->f_34) as a tail call: it hands the sound system's +0x34 member to the kernel wait helper, and all movie-track paths call it before touching their track queue.

functions.name: Sound_Frame_BeginUpdate
functions.summary: Starts one sound frame: atomically bumps the frame counter, waits for the display time, and when the driver is idle processes the pending start request and the per-frame channel table update.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_ResetChannelState
functions.summary: Entry fragment of sound channel state reset invoking sound accessor 0x005177DC.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_InitSlot
functions.summary: Initialises a channel slot: state byte = 2, default timing/list/callback fields cleared, the DSP volume/frequency defaults installed, and the slot's wave-buffer descriptor reset (0x519C1C).

functions.name: maybe_Sound_CalcDspAdpcmStep
functions.summary: Fixed-point helper that turns a scale/step pair into two 16-bit coefficients (including a square-root term), stores them at +8/+10 of the object and copies them into the DSP register block with dirty flag 8.

functions.name: Sound_Frame_UpdateChannels
functions.summary: Per-frame channel update: reads the system tick, computes the frame delta (0x517478/0x516E58), mixes both sub-channels of the current half (0x5174F8), runs the channel scheduler (0x5171B0) with the remaining time and switches the published buffer half.

functions.name: Sound_Frame_PublishChannelTable
functions.summary: Publishes the next frame's channel table: reads the free-running frame counter, copies the 24 channel descriptors of the new half (0x519DCC), copies the 0x260-byte DSP parameter block (0x116C10) and advances the buffer index.

functions.name: Sound_DspChannel_Start
functions.summary: Starts a DSP channel: clears the low byte of its status word and raises command bit 0x10000 in the channel's DSP command word (the 'key on' bit).

functions.name: Sound_DspChannel_Stop
functions.summary: Stops a DSP channel: sets its status word to 1 and raises the same 0x10000 command bit.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_DspChannel_SetLoopCount
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_DspChannel_SetLoopCount(u32 driver, int channel, u16 count)
functions.summary: Writes 16-bit count at channel DSP state offset +0xA2 and sets command bit 0x10000000.

functions.name: Sound_DspChannel_GetPlayPosition
functions.summary: Returns the current playback position (16-bit counter at +2 of the DSP channel state selected by the frame half), or 0xFFFFFFFF when the DSP is not running.

functions.name: Sound_DspChannel_Pause
functions.summary: Sets bit 0x10 (the DSP channel pause/hold command bit) in the channel's command word while the driver lock is held, and returns 1; returns 0 when the driver is not ready.

functions.name: Sound_DspChannel_SetWaveBuffer
functions.signature: u32 Sound_DspChannel_SetWaveBuffer(u32 driver, int channel, u32* wave, u32 sub)
functions.summary: Programs one of the four sub-wave buffers of a DSP channel: converts the sample count to bytes for the channel format bits, byte-swaps the address/length, stores the loop point, sets the sub-wave valid bit at +0x4A and raises command bit 0x80000.

functions.name: Sound_DspChannel_UpdateSampleInfo
functions.signature: u32 Sound_DspChannel_UpdateSampleInfo(u32 driver, int channel, u32* wave)
functions.summary: Refreshes a DSP channel's sample info when the queued wave id matches the channel's current sample id: copies the id, the loop flag and the byte-swapped address and raises command bit 8.

functions.name: Sound_DspChannel_Flush
functions.summary: Sets the 0x20000000 command bit in one DSP channel's command word under the sound monitor and returns 1, or 0 when the sound system is not initialised.

functions.name: Snd_AdvanceFrameCounter
functions.summary: Polls one audio-transfer slot: it waits on the slot's sync handle (svcWaitSynchronization1) and, when a full frame period has elapsed, cancels the wait, bumps the slot's frame byte at +0x131D and reports true; otherwise it reports false and leaves the slot alone.

functions.name: Snd_ForceAdvanceFrameCounter
functions.summary: Unconditional twin of Snd_AdvanceFrameCounter: waits on the slot's sync handle (svcWaitSynchronization1), re-arbitrates it (svc 0x19) and bumps the transfer frame byte at +0x131D without testing whether a frame period elapsed. Sound_GetDisplayTime and Sound_WaitForDisplayTime call it when they must advance the transfer frame immediately.

functions.name: Sound_DspChannel_SetupSample
functions.signature: u32 Sound_DspChannel_SetupSample(u32 driver, int channel, u32* wave, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Full DSP channel sample setup: converts the sample count to bytes for the format bits (8/16/32-bit, mono/stereo with the 0xD/8 rounding), translates the address to DSP space, stores the sample and loop addresses, copies up to two loop halfwords and raises the 0x40200000 command bits.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_ReleaseStreamObject
functions.summary: Resets stream index at self+0x10 to -1 and closes two owned kernel handles via svc 0x23 (svcCloseHandle).

functions.name: Sound_WaveBuffer_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a wave buffer: lays out the 0x280-byte sample chunks after the aligned buffer base, zero-fills the buffer (0x1113EC) and resets the per-chunk write offsets; returns 1 the first time and 0 if already initialised.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_MixTwoChannels
functions.summary: Mixes 0xA0-sample audio channel buffers into ring buffer slots using fixed-point coefficient arithmetic and advances buffer write index.

functions.name: Sound_WaveBuffer_ComputeLayout
functions.summary: Derives a wave buffer's chunk pointers from its counts: converts the two float-derived counts with VectorFloatToUnsigned(...,3), spaces the chunks 0x280 bytes apart and fills the four mix-buffer pointers, then hands the result to Sound_WaveBuffer_BuildChannelParams.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_MixFourChannels
functions.summary: Multi-channel audio mixer: computes fixed-point weighted samples across six ring buffers and updates stream channel positions.

functions.name: Sound_WaveBuffer_BuildChannelParams
functions.summary: Builds the per-channel fixed-point playback parameters (sample-rate steps at +0x9C/+0xA4, loop counters and six volume/pan coefficients) from a wave-buffer layout record, clamping each field and scaling by 0xA0. Called from Sound_WaveBuffer_ComputeLayout (0x519674); the 0xA0 fixed-point scale, 6 coefficient slots and the pan mirror based on f_24 are the channel-parameter conversion.

functions.name: Sound_WaveBuffer_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a wave-buffer descriptor to its default state (state byte 2, default command word, cleared counters and list head) and re-initialises its embedded sync primitive.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Channel_ApplyPendingLoopCount
functions.summary: When the channel node's u16 at +0x6C has bit 0x8000 set, pushes the node's pending value (s16 at +4) into the DSP channel state through 0x00518DE8 (driver 0x007EF414, channel = node[0] & 0xFF) and clears the bit.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_ApplyCommand
functions.summary: Applies a command packet to a channel: if the packet's stream id matches it stores the byte-swapped word, drops the buffers up to the packet's start id (marking them state 3) and derives the running flag from the packet's low byte.

functions.name: Sound_SetChannelParamBlock
functions.summary: Copies a 0x20-byte parameter block into channel offset self+0x7C and sets parameter dirty flag bit 0x40 at self+0x6C.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_Refill
functions.summary: Refills a channel's wave buffers: releases exhausted buffers, starts up to five queued buffers (0x518F10/0x51908C) and advances the packet cursor; when the queue is empty it pauses the channel (0x518EA8) and stops it.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_QueueBuffer
functions.summary: Queues a wave buffer on a channel: rejects buffers without data, unlinks it from any other list, marks it state 1, appends it to the channel's buffer list and gives it the next sequence id.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_CancelBuffer
functions.summary: Walks the channel's buffer list and, when the buffer is still queued (state != 3), raises the channel's cancel flag (+0x6F bit 1) so the refill path drops it.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_FlushBuffers
functions.summary: Flushes the channel: marks every queued buffer state 3, clears the queue head/pointers, sets the lock-out bit 0x8000, bumps the stream id and clears the buffer list.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_Pause
functions.summary: Pauses a channel by sending the DSP pause command for its channel index and setting the paused byte.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetState
functions.summary: Sets a channel's playback state: writes the state byte, and for play/pause sends the matching DSP key-on (0x518D04) / flush (0x51914C) command for the channel index stored in the descriptor, mirroring the state there.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetPlayState
functions.summary: Applies a three-value play state to one DSP channel: stores the state byte at +0xD, and for state 1 issues Sound_DspChannel_Start, clears the pending byte at +3 and issues Sound_DspChannel_Flush (a restart), while state 2 only issues Start. All five callers are sound or movie-track paths, so this is the single place that turns a logical play state into DSP commands.

functions.name: Snd_InitVoice
functions.summary: Initialises one DSP voice: stores the voice index, sets the twelve data/state pointers to the -1 sentinel, resets the three counters, initialises the voice lock, sets the reference count to 1 and raises the 'active' bit 0x8000 in the flags.

functions.name: Svc_UnlinkSharedEntry
functions.summary: Looks the handle up in the global shared-resource list at 0x007F2358 under its monitor, unlinks the matching entry from the intrusive prev/next list and returns it (NULL when absent). It frees nothing itself: both callers release the returned entry afterwards.

functions.name: Os_Ipc_SendRequestA0040
functions.summary: Sends the fixed IPC command 0x000A0040 with one parameter: writes the header and the resource id into the calling thread's TLS command buffer (TLS+0x80 / TLS+0x84), issues svcSendSyncRequest (svc 0x32) on the session handle at 0x007AF900 and returns the response word on success. The shared-resource release paths use it before freeing an entry.

functions.name: Os_SvcCommand90040
functions.summary: Issues the one-parameter SVC request 0x00090040 with a shared-resource id through software interrupt 0x32 and returns the kernel's result word.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetRotation
functions.summary: Checked Y2R IPC wrapper: sends command 0x00050040 (set rotation) and aborts on a negative result.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetSrcParamsU
functions.signature: void Gfx_Y2r_SetSrcParamsU(u32 addr, u32 size, u32 width, u32 stride)
functions.summary: Checks that the U-plane address is inside the linear heap (0x1180F0/0x1180E0) or the FCRAM region (0x123DB4/0x124CEC/0x124CDC), then sends Y2R command 0x00110102 with the four parameters.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetSrcParamsV
functions.signature: void Gfx_Y2r_SetSrcParamsV(u32 addr, u32 size, u32 width, u32 stride)
functions.summary: Same range check as 0x51A750 followed by Y2R command 0x00120102 for the V plane.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetSrcParamsY
functions.signature: void Gfx_Y2r_SetSrcParamsY(u32 addr, u32 size, u32 width, u32 stride)
functions.summary: Range-checks the luma plane address and sends Y2R command 0x00100102 with the four parameters; this is the first plane Gfx_Y2r_Convert programs.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_CloseStream
functions.summary: Closes an open sound handle: if the global flag at 0x007AEAA8 is set, sends Svc_Snd_Cmd002C, closes *handle with svcCloseHandle, reports a negative handle through 0x0011C814 and clears the flag.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetDstParams
functions.signature: void Gfx_Y2r_SetDstParams(u32 addr, u32 size, u32 line_bytes, u32 lines)
functions.summary: Range-checks the RGB destination address and sends Y2R command 0x00180102 with (address, byte size, line bytes, lines); the size is width*height*bytes-per-pixel for the selected output format.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetInputLines
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x001C0040 (input line count).

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_OpenSession
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Y2r_OpenSession(u32* handle, const char* service)
functions.summary: Opens the colour-conversion service: 0x113430 init, strlen, then srvGetServiceHandle (0x1192C0) into the caller's handle, sends the Y2R initialise command (0x51AF68) and caches an 'already open' flag.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetInputFormat
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x00010040 (set input format); Gfx_Y2r_Convert calls it with 1.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_StopConversion
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x00270040 (stop conversion); called before programming a new frame.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetOutputFormat
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x00030040 (set output format); the caller's format byte also selects the destination bytes per pixel (4/3/2).

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_WaitForCompletion
functions.summary: Polls the Y2R status command (0x00260040) until the unit reports the completion code that 0x51AF38 returns, and returns that result.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_IsBusy
functions.summary: Reads the Y2R busy flag (command 0x00280040) and returns it as a byte; Gfx_Y2r_IsDone inverts it.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetBlockAlignment
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x00070040 (set block alignment).

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetInputLineWidth
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x001A0040 (input line width); called with the luma width.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_GetSessionHandle
functions.summary: Reads the colour-conversion session handle with the Y2R GET_HANDLE command, closing any previous handle first, and writes it to *out.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_StartConversion
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x00200040 (start conversion); Gfx_Y2r_Convert calls it once after programming the planes.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_DriverInit
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x000D0040 (driver initialise/finalise); called by Gfx_Y2r_Init and again at the end of each conversion.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendSetRotation
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: writes command 0x00050040 and one byte into the thread command buffer and executes svcSendSyncRequest (svc 0x32).

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendSrcParamsU
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Y2r_SendSrcParamsU(u32 addr, u32 size, u32 width, u32 stride)
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00110102 with four words (address, size, width, stride).

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendSrcParamsV
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Y2r_SendSrcParamsV(u32 addr, u32 size, u32 width, u32 stride)
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00120102 with four words.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendSrcParamsY
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Y2r_SendSrcParamsY(u32 addr, u32 size, u32 width, u32 stride)
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00100102 with four words.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendDstParams
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Y2r_SendDstParams(u32 addr, u32 size, u32 line_bytes, u32 lines)
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00180102 with four words.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendInputLines
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x001C0040 with one halfword.

functions.name: Svc_Snd_Cmd002C
functions.summary: Parameterless sound service request 0x002C on the snd:u session (used to flush/close a stream).

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendInputFormat
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00010040 with one byte.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendStopConversion
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00270040 without parameters.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendOutputFormat
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00030040 with one byte.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendGetStatus
functions.summary: Sends the parameterless Y2R request 0x00260000 on the session at 0x007AEAAC and returns the status word the service writes back; the named caller Gfx_Y2r_WaitForCompletion polls it until the conversion reports done.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendInitialize
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC call: writes command word 0x002B0000 with no parameters into the thread TLS block, issues svc 0x32 and returns the reply word. Sent once by the session opener.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendIsBusy
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00280040; returns the busy byte written by the service.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendSetBlockAlignment
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00070040 with one byte.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendInputLineWidth
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x001A0040 with one halfword.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendGetHandle
functions.summary: Sends the Y2R command 0x000F0000 and returns the 32-bit session handle the service writes at tls+0x8c.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendStartConversion
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x00200040 with one byte.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendDriverInit
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC: command 0x000D0040 with one byte.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SendSetAlpha
functions.summary: Raw Y2R IPC call: writes command word 0x00220040 with one 16-bit parameter, issues svc 0x32 and returns the reply word; the checked wrapper 0x0051B13C calls it with 0xFF.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_SetAlpha
functions.summary: Checked wrapper for Y2R command 0x00220040 (set alpha); Gfx_Y2r_Convert calls it with 0xFF so the converted frame is opaque.

functions.name: std_FastSinCos
functions.signature: void std_FastSinCos(float angle, float* outSin, float* outCos)
functions.summary: Table-driven sin/cos pair: takes |angle|, splits it into an integer index and fraction (table of 16-byte entries at 0x72FC50), linearly interpolates the sine and cosine entries and restores the sign for negative input. Used everywhere a rotation is needed instead of the soft-float library.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_GetDefaultTemplate
functions.summary: Asserts sound module initialized via stateWord and returns default data template pointer 0x008386FC.

functions.name: maybe_Math_WrapFloatToU16
functions.summary: Wraps a float into [0, limit) with fmodf, then truncates to an unsigned 16-bit value with the current FPSCR rounding mode and converts the result back to float. The name describes the arithmetic only; the owner (CRT helper vs. sound driver) is unknown.

functions.name: Fs_WorkBuffer_Init
functions.summary: Zeroes an 0xE30-byte file-service request/work buffer and stamps its first word with type 5.

functions.name: Err_WaitForAppletReady
functions.summary: CTR SDK nn::err helper: loops querying ErrDisp service status until result != 0xC8A0CFFC (busy), sleeping 10ms on retry.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_Init
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_Driver_Init(unsigned char* config, unsigned int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Starts the sound driver: negotiates the display mode, maps the shared DSP region (page-aligned), opens/closes the driver handles, sets the 0x00989680 (100 ms in ticks) and 0.01/0.1 timing constants and hands control to the driver start helper 0x51C38C.

functions.name: maybe_Err_WaitForIpcIdleOrFatal
functions.summary: Retries Gfx_WaitForIpcIdle(0) while it reports a negative non-fatal result, sleeping 10 ms on 0xE0A0CC08 and stopping on success or on the err:f sentinel 0xC8A0CFFC.

functions.name: std_FormatV
functions.signature: int std_FormatV(char* dst, u32 size, const char* fmt, u32* va_list argument)
functions.summary: Variadic tail-call thunk to the printf-style formatter 0x708BE4, forwarding the extra stack arguments; formats into dst and returns the number of characters written.

functions.name: Gfx_EnsureGpuSession
functions.summary: Opens the gsp::Gpu session on first use: takes the GPU lock, opens the handle into 0x007AF18C, mirrors it into the block's f_14 and submits the open IPC; when already open it only re-sends the IPC.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_NotifyServiceThread
functions.summary: Loads the global at 0x007418D0, asks 0x0011F730 for the current thread id and tail-jumps to Svc_Snd_Cmd001F with (threadId, global, arg1, arg2).

functions.name: Svc_Snd_Cmd001F
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Snd_Cmd001F(u32* threadId, u32 context, u32 request, u32 request2)
functions.summary: Raw sound service request 0x001F (header 0x001F0082: two normal parameters and two translate words) that associates the calling thread with the sound context.

functions.name: Err_WaitForStatusFlags
functions.summary: Wait helper of the CTR SDK nn::err (err:f) client: clears the one-byte state at 0x007AE954, runs the two state hooks 0x00113A40(3)/0x001143C8(0), then polls the status query until the returned status word shares a set bit with both of the two flag bytes it also returns (sleeping 10,000,000 ticks per poll), and restores the saved state at 0x007AE954 afterwards.

functions.name: Sound_InitializeDriver
functions.summary: Initialises the sound driver for a session: configures it (0x00020900/0x00040010) and writes a 4-byte zero wave-buffer descriptor, normalising success to 0.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_GetDriverParam
functions.signature: int maybe_Sound_GetDriverParam(unsigned arg1, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4)
functions.summary: Reads one byte parameter under the scheduler lock: locks, issues Gfx_IpcCmd90040(arg1, &out), aborts on a hard error, unlocks and returns the resulting byte.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_BuildTwoEvents
functions.summary: Constructs two 0x10-byte completion events on the caller's stack (element constructor 0x119838), used by the sound driver start/shutdown sequence.

functions.name: Sound_GetStatus
functions.signature: unsigned Sound_GetStatus(unsigned optional, unsigned* outPair, unsigned char* arg3, unsigned char* b, unsigned char* c, unsigned* d)
functions.summary: Reads the DSP/driver status block under the sound lock and copies the six returned fields into the caller's optional outputs; returns 1 on success, 0 when the driver reported an error.

functions.name: Sound_WriteWaveBuffer
functions.signature: int Sound_WriteWaveBuffer(unsigned buffer, unsigned size, unsigned params, unsigned * paramSize)
functions.summary: Writes a wave buffer to the DSP: clamps the buffer to 0x300 bytes and the parameter block to 0x20 bytes, submits the write command and retries while the driver reports busy.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_Shutdown
functions.signature: int Sound_Driver_Shutdown(unsigned int arg1, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Stops the sound driver: signals and closes the driver events, releases the scheduler/GPU lock, tears down the two runtime objects and (for the sound path) re-runs the client shutdown with the 1000000-tick timeout.

functions.name: Sound_QueryDriverState
functions.summary: Polls the sound DSP driver state (Sound_Dsp_QueryState / 0x0051CB10) under the sound lock until it leaves the retry codes, then restores the thread priority and returns the final status.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_ConvertFrame
functions.signature: void Gfx_Y2r_ConvertFrame(int base, int* srcDesc, int* planeInfo)
functions.summary: Converts one YUV frame into the Y/U/V destination planes: picks the row converter for the pixel format, walks 400 rows x 240 pixels (8 pixels per step) and finally converts the second plane.

functions.name: Gfx_Y2r_ConvertPlane
functions.signature: void Gfx_Y2r_ConvertPlane(u32* dst, u32* planeDesc, int planeIndex, int secondPlane)
functions.summary: Converts one plane of a YUV frame into the RGB destination: picks the row converter from the descriptor's pixel format and runs 240 pixels per row for 320 or 400 rows. Gfx_Y2r_ConvertFrame calls it once per plane.

functions.name: Sound_ConfigureDriver
functions.signature: void Sound_ConfigureDriver(unsigned arg1, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4, * unsigned arg5)
functions.summary: Sends the driver configuration command and retries while the sound driver answers with one of the three busy codes, sleeping 1 ms per retry.

functions.name: Fs_StartAsyncReadThunk
functions.summary: Tail-call thunk to the asynchronous read starter 0x00509A80, kept as a separate address for a dispatch-table slot.

functions.name: Sound_QueryDriverStateB
functions.summary: Second driver-state query (Sound_Dsp_QueryStateB / 0x0051CB94): polls under the sound lock, restores the thread priority and maps the final 'OK' code to 0.

functions.name: Sound_Dsp_GetStatus
functions.signature: int Sound_Dsp_GetStatus(unsigned arg1, unsigned* outPair, unsigned char* arg3, unsigned char* b, unsigned char* c, unsigned* d)
functions.summary: IPC wrapper for the DSP status command: fills the thread-local IPC block and issues svc 0x32, then copies the six reply words (pair, three bytes, word) out.

functions.name: Sound_Dsp_WriteWaveBuffer
functions.signature: unsigned Sound_Dsp_WriteWaveBuffer(unsigned buffer, int bufferSize, unsigned params, int paramSize)
functions.summary: IPC wrapper for the DSP wave-buffer write command: encodes the two sizes as descriptors (size<<14|2 and size<<14|0x802) and sends the command through svc 0x32.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_Cmd001E
functions.signature: unsigned int Svc_Ipc_Cmd001E(unsigned int arg1, unsigned int arg2, int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: IPC stub for command 0x001E with one translate buffer of arg3 bytes (translate count encoded as arg3<<14|2): fills the TLS request header and issues svcSendSyncRequest, returning the result word.

functions.name: Sound_Dsp_QueryState
functions.summary: IPC wrapper for a one-argument DSP query command (svc 0x32); returns the reply word or status.

functions.name: Sound_Dsp_Configure
functions.signature: unsigned Sound_Dsp_Configure(unsigned char arg1, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4, unsigned char arg5)
functions.summary: IPC wrapper for the DSP configuration command: packs the byte/word arguments into the command block and sends it with svc 0x32.

functions.name: Sound_Dsp_QueryStateB
functions.summary: Second one-argument DSP query IPC wrapper (svc 0x32), used by the alternate driver-state poll.

functions.name: Err_FatalErrInfo_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a 0xF80-byte CTR SDK nn::err::FatalErrInfo: zeroes the header and the 0xED8-byte body, sets +0xEE4 = 1, zeroes 0x89 bytes at +0xEE7, sets the timeout word at +0xF70 to -1 and constructs the object at +0xF76.

functions.name: Err_LaunchFatalErrorApplet
functions.summary: Launches the nn::err fatal-error applet for an already filled FatalErrInfo: queries the err service (tolerating the 'already configured' code 0xC8A0CFFC), stops the previous session, runs the err driver setup with the 0xF80 struct and the current display timing, and writes the returned state byte.

functions.name: Err_ThrowFatalError
functions.summary: Final step of the nn::err fatal-error path: queries the error state (0x0051C508 with argument 0x406) and, unless the result is success or the tolerated 0xC8A0CFFC, aborts through 0x0011C814.

functions.name: Container_ByteBuffer_Append
functions.signature: void Container_ByteBuffer_Append(ContainerByteBuffer* buf, void* data, int size)
functions.summary: Appends size bytes to a byte buffer: memcpy to buf->data + buf->used and advance the used counter.

functions.name: Container_ByteBuffer_AlignTo
functions.summary: Rounds the buffer's used size up to the given power-of-two alignment and zero-fills the padding.

functions.name: maybe_std_StringSubstrClamped
functions.signature: void maybe_std_StringSubstrClamped(u32 str, u32 length, int pos, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Five-argument thunk (real entry 0x0051D03C, which pushes r0-r3): clamps arg2 to arg3+1 and tail-calls the range helper 0x001001C4 with (arg1, clamped, arg4, &arg5). Whether that helper builds a string range or throws is still open, so the substring reading is unproven.

functions.name: Fx_ChannelGroup_UpdateUnits
functions.summary: Steps every unit of an FX channel group for count sub-steps: for each unit whose f_24 matches the group's channel id it calls the unit vtable slots +8/+0x18 (and +0x1C when the template flag bit 0 is set), then releases the finished units through 0x005306CC.

functions.name: Fx_System_InitRandomVectorTables
functions.summary: Allocates the two 512-entry vec3 tables (0x1800 bytes each) used by the particle emitter: the first is filled with xorshift128 random vectors in [-1,1), the second holds the same vectors normalised to unit length, and both are published through the globals at 0x7B0034.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSlot_ReleaseTwo
functions.summary: Releases both resources held by the global slot pair at 0x7B0034 by calling the object's virtual release slot (vtable+0xC) once per word, then clears the pair. Same idiom as the single-slot releasers.

functions.name: Fx_BuildParticleRenderQuad
functions.summary: Main per-particle render-data builder: advances the LCG at +0x8C, samples the RNG tables, decides whether the particle uses the object-local or the world transform, and writes the quad's position, size and colour fields. Called from every emission variant and from the emitter update paths.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesFromGlobalVelocity
functions.summary: Particle spawn loop that takes each particle's velocity from the global constant vector g_0051EB18 instead of the emitter's random table, clamps the spawn count with g_0051EB00/g_0051EB04 and hands each particle to the shared quad builder.

functions.name: Fx_InitSpawnedParticle
functions.summary: Initialises one freshly allocated particle: stores the emitter back-pointer, builds its transform copy, draws the spawn velocity/size/lifetime values from the emitter RNG ranges, applies the spawn-direction flags and links it into the emitter's active list.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomRadius
functions.summary: Emission variant that randomises the spawn radius (one RNG draw, then the square root of the squared radius) before handing each particle to the shared quad builder.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomOriented
functions.summary: Emission variant that draws three random angles and multiplies them into a rotation matrix (0x12551C) so each spawned particle gets its own orientation before the quad is built.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRadialSpread
functions.summary: Emission variant that spreads particles radially around the emitter axis: two square roots per particle (one for the radial offset, one for the height) before the quad build.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRing
functions.summary: Ring/disc emission: takes a random radius factor, scales it by (1 - distance/radius) and a square root, orients the offset with the 16-byte RNG table at g_005209A8 and writes the quad.

functions.name: Fx_UnlinkParticleFromLists
functions.summary: Removes a particle node from the emitter's active or pending doubly-linked list (selected by particle->f_158), decrements the list counter, clears the 'linked' word at +0x144 and releases the render data when +0x154 is set.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesBox
functions.summary: Box/axis emission: splits the spawn count between the X and Z axes with the LCG, offsets each particle along the chosen axis and leaves the other component on the centre line (no square root is used).

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesSphere
functions.summary: Spherical-shell emission: computes the radius as sqrt((1 - r) + r^2*(1 - r)) so particles land on the emitter's sphere surface, then builds the quad.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesOriented
functions.summary: Fully oriented emission: builds a 4x4 basis from the three stored angles, optionally rotates the particle direction with 0x12551C and writes the quad; supports an alternate orientation source.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesCone
functions.summary: Cone emission: the radial factor is r + (1-r)*(1 - distance^2), giving a density that falls off towards the cone base, then each particle goes through the shared quad builder.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateParticleTarget
functions.signature: float* Fx_UpdateParticleTarget(int self, int particle, float* keyframe)
