functions.summary: Applies one keyframe of the particle's steering target: each enabled axis (mask in keyframe[4]) eases the velocity towards the target position, either in object space or (when the emitter has a transform at f_CC) in world space after matrix multiply/inverse.

functions.name: Fx_AddParticleOffset
functions.signature: u32* Fx_AddParticleOffset(int self, int particle, u32* data)
functions.summary: Adds a table-driven offset to the particle's position: reads the next entry of the 12-byte offset table at g_005222FC (index at self+0x88) and scales it by the three values in the parameter block.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesArc
functions.summary: Arc emission: spaces particles evenly along an arc by stepping the angle with 1/(count-1) and emits them along the rotating axis; a single particle falls back to the base angle.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSlot_Release
functions.summary: Releases one global resource slot (the 0x7B0030 table allocated by Math_InitSinTable128) through its virtual release slot and clears the published pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleScaleFromKeyframe
functions.signature: short* maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleScaleFromKeyframe(FxParticle* self, u32* particle, short* keyframe)
functions.summary: Applies one 6-word keyframe record to a particle: tracks the running maximum in particle[4], copies the base size into particle[1]/particle[0], and when the record's transform flag is set rotates the velocity triple particle[9..0xB] through the emitter basis and negates one component by the record's factor. Returns the next record.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomB
functions.summary: Emission variant combining one RNG draw, a square root and the shared quad builder; differs from 0x51F5B8 in the field set it initialises (it uses the 0x5227C4 distance bias).

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomOrientedB
functions.summary: Second random-orientation emission variant: one RNG draw plus a 0x12551C matrix multiply and two square roots; writes orientation-related fields on the particle before the quad build.

functions.name: Math_InitSinTable128
functions.summary: Builds the effect system's 128-entry sine table: for i in 0..0x7F it stores sin(i/128 * 2*pi) * 0.5 + 0.5, interpolating from the existing 256-entry sine table at 0x741AFC with 24-bit fraction, and publishes the table through 0x007B0030.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateParticlePosition
functions.signature: int* Fx_UpdateParticlePosition(FxParticle* self, FxParticleState* particle, int* keyframe)
functions.summary: Eases the particle position (f_C/f_10/f_14) toward the keyframe target by rate*dt, optionally transforming the target through the emitter basis first; returns the next keyframe record (keyframe+5).

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRandomOrientedC
functions.summary: Third random-orientation emission variant (one RNG draw, one matrix multiply, two square roots); differs from 0x522BA8 in which particle fields it inherits from the emitter.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleA
functions.summary: Integrates one particle of emitter type A: looks up the emitter's transform/keyframes and advances position, steering and scale for the single particle.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleB
functions.summary: Per-particle update that integrates position, dispatches the three per-emitter update tables at 0x007B2CAC/0x007B2CCC/0x007B2CE8 and applies the scale/rotation/lifetime curves.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleC
functions.summary: Per-particle update that re-caches the emitter transform (0x005254FC), integrates velocity, applies the fade factors and writes the world position into the render node.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleD
functions.summary: Integrates one particle of emitter type D through the shared per-particle frame/keyframe pipeline (offset, target, scale, position, extra block) with this type's flag set.

functions.name: Fx_ApplyParticleStateThunk
functions.summary: 16-byte thunk: 'push {r4,lr}; bl 0x0052E08C; pop {r4,pc}' forwards both arguments unchanged to Fx_ApplyParticleState.

functions.name: Fx_ApplyParticleStateThunk2
functions.summary: Second 16-byte thunk with the same body as 0x005248B0: forwards both arguments unchanged to Fx_ApplyParticleState (0x0052E08C).

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleColorA
functions.summary: Interpolates the emitter template's f_368/f_36C pair by the particle's lifetime fraction into the particle's f_78/f_7C. The pair is a two-component ramp (colour or UV offset); nothing in the body proves which.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleColorB
functions.summary: Same template interpolation as 0x00524900 plus five '+= coefficient*dt' accumulators (f_74/f_80/f_84/f_88/f_8C), so a fading particle keeps drifting its colour/UV channels.

functions.name: Fx_ApplyAllParticleStates
functions.summary: Applies both particle render-state groups: calls Fx_ApplyParticleState once with mode 0 and once with mode 1, so the particle's two packed state words are refreshed together.

functions.name: Fx_IntegrateParticleVelocity
functions.summary: Simple Euler integration of the particle position from its velocity using the frame delta (float register s0), then applies the particle state flags.

functions.name: Fx_CopyEmitterBaseTransform
functions.summary: Refreshes the emitter (0x005254FC) and copies its two strided transform triples (f_34/f_44/f_54 and f_64/f_74/f_84) into the particle's cached slots (f_E8/f_F8/f_108 and f_118/f_128/f_138).

functions.name: maybe_Fx_CopyEmitterBaseTransformScaled
functions.summary: Same transform copy as 0x00524C68 but first multiplies the particle scale by f_300 + (1 - f_300)*(1 - dt), so a fading particle inherits a shrunk base transform.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRadialC
functions.summary: Radial emission variant driven by the emitter's lifetime accumulator: computes a random radius and writes the particle quad, returning an integer status instead of the usual float.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticlesRadialD
functions.summary: Another radial emission variant: one square root per particle and a different RNG table, used by an emitter type whose distribution is a flat disc.

functions.name: Gfx_TryConvertBuffer
functions.signature: int Gfx_TryConvertBuffer(int handle, int arg2, int arg3, int src, int dst)
functions.summary: Boolean guard around the buffer conversion at 0x00505FD8: rejects a -1 handle or a null source/destination and returns 1 only when the conversion does not report the high-bit error flag. The disassembly shows the whole function is 0x44 bytes, so the 632-byte size is Ghidra merging the following routine.

functions.name: Fx_CommitParticleStream
functions.summary: Flushes the pending particle vertices into the global stream at 0x007AFF18: copies the node's f_28 block (count = pending*6) and then its f_10 block, advances the write cursor and returns it. Four list updaters tail-call it after filling the records.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleE
functions.summary: Integrates one particle of emitter type E: applies the emitter's speed/gravity/steering flags, advances the keyframe/scale/rotation tracks, writes the resulting vertex position into the effect command buffer and bumps the particle age.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleF
functions.summary: Per-particle integration for emitter type F: transforms the velocity through the emitter basis, updates the sprite/scale accumulators, recomputes the two normal pairs through Fx_ComputeParticleNormal and applies the colour/state step through 0x0052E4AC.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleG
functions.summary: Integrates one particle of emitter type G through the shared per-particle frame/keyframe pipeline with this type's flag set.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticlesInline
functions.summary: Interior address, not a function entry: the disassembly at 0x00526814 is 'ldr fp,[r2,#0x548]' in the middle of the particle update loop, so Ghidra's halt_baddata body is an artefact. Kept as a marker.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleH
functions.summary: Integrates one particle of emitter type H: same per-particle frame/keyframe pipeline as the other Fx_UpdateParticle variants (offset, target, scale, position, extra block) with this type's flag set.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_SetParticleTransform
functions.summary: Copies a caller-supplied 3-float vector into the particle's render-transform block: values[2] to +0x60, values[1] to +0x64, values[0] to +0x68 (the engine stores the triple in reverse component order), then notifies the batch (0x52E3C8) and advances the emitter frame.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_ResetParticleTransform
functions.summary: Clears only the particle's +0x6C word (the fourth word of the render-transform block) and notifies the batch; it does not touch the three floats at +0x60/+0x64/+0x68, so 'Reset' means 'drop the marker', not 'zero the transform'.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListI
functions.signature: int maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListI(int self, int particle, int keyframe, int flags)
functions.summary: Per-particle update that walks the particle's child chain, emits sprite quads through Fx_UpdateParticleSprite and advances the shared vertex-stream pointer 0x007AFF18 in 0x12-entry batches.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_SetParticleRotation
functions.summary: Same three-float store as 0x00527758 (values[0] to +0x68, values[1] to +0x64, values[2] to +0x60) plus an explicit clear of the +0x6C marker word, then the batch notify and frame advance.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_ApplyParticleRotation
functions.summary: Writes the particle's f_3C/f_40/f_44 triple into the current vertex record (+0x60/+0x64/+0x68), flushes the node block (0x0052E3C8) and tail-jumps to the vertex flush 0x0052E784. The triple is a 3-component vector; rotation is only one candidate.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListJ
functions.signature: float maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListJ(int self, float dt, float* particle, float* extra)
functions.summary: Largest per-particle update variant: integrates the particle, resolves the parent transform, emits its sprite quads and links the particle into the active/free lists.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticleSprite
functions.signature: u32* maybe_Fx_EmitParticleSprite(u32 self, u32* out, void* particle, float* colour, int flag, int flag2, int flag3)
functions.summary: Emits one particle sprite's draw record: scales the template colour by the frame colour, writes the 0x28-word PICA vertex/UV/colour block and returns the advanced write pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_ResetParticleSprite
functions.signature: void maybe_Fx_ResetParticleSprite(u32 self, u32 arg2, int* particleRef)
functions.summary: Clears the +0x6C word of the current vertex record and flushes it (0x0052E3C8, then tail-jump to 0x0052E784). The +0x6C word is a per-record flag; 'sprite' is a guess.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EmitParticleSpriteB
functions.signature: u32* maybe_Fx_EmitParticleSpriteB(u32 self, u32* out, void* particle, float* colour, int flag, int flag2, int flag3)
functions.summary: Second particle-sprite emit path: same 0x28-word draw record, but the UV/position terms come from the emitter template at +0xDC instead of the keyframe copy.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_SetParticleSpriteFromNode
functions.summary: Variant of 0x005287B4: writes the f_3C/f_40/f_44 triple into the current vertex record (+0x60/+0x64/+0x68), clears the record's +0x6C flag, flushes the node block and tail-jumps to 0x0052E784.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelResource_Release
functions.signature: int Gfx_ModelResource_Release(GfxModelResource* self, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Releases a parsed model resource: frees the two owned blocks at +0xC and +0x954 with the graphics allocator and issues the GPU teardown commands for the remaining sub-resources.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelResource_Parse
functions.signature: int Gfx_ModelResource_Parse(GfxModelResource* self, void* owner, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Parses a complete model resource: allocates a 0x2B0 work block from the owner's allocator, recognises the resource-set header through Gfx_ResourceSet_Parse, converts the referenced buffers to physical GPU addresses and builds the sub-resources (resource sets, vertex streams, materials) for the model instance.

functions.name: Fx_System_ReleaseAllParts
functions.summary: Releases every part of the effect system: the named sub-objects at +0x18/+0x24/+0x30/+0x600/+0x96C/+0x978, the 30 texture/anim slots at +0x3C, and the two large buffers at +0x8/+0x954, then clears the "initialised" flag. Called from the Fx system shutdown 0x5308AC; the 30-entry x 12-byte table and the six list heads are the effect-system part table.

functions.name: Fx_EmitterInitFromTemplate
functions.summary: Initialises an emitter instance from its template at +0xDC: copies the spawn box, scale, colour and curve parameters, then builds the module pointer list from the module array at +0x100 and sets the per-module capability flags.

functions.name: Fx_Emitter_SelectUpdateModes
functions.summary: Turns the emitter template's flag word (bits 2/8/9/0xD and the 0x10/0x40/0x80 group) into the six small mode bytes at +0x290..+0x295 that the per-particle updaters switch on.

functions.name: Fx_EmitterRandomizeSpawn
functions.summary: Computes the emitter's random spawn orientation: advances the LCG (seed*0x41C64E6D+0x3039) three times per axis, maps each value through the 8-byte range table at 0x00741AFC and builds the two 3x3 spawn matrices at +0x200 and +0x1D0.

functions.name: Fx_EmitterReset
functions.summary: Resets a live emitter: clears the state words, stores the owner id at +0xDC, installs the default parameter block from g_0052B9BC and re-runs the module and spawn-transform updates.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_InterpolateParticlePair
functions.signature: void maybe_Fx_InterpolateParticlePair(float* outA, float* outB, FxParticle* self, int templateRec)
functions.summary: Scales the template's f_30/f_34 pair by the particle's lifetime fraction and writes the two results to self+0x1E/+0x1F. The sprite emitters use those as the quad centre (self[0x1E]+self[0x20], self[0x1F]-self[0x21]), so the old 'normal' reading is not supported; the pair's exact meaning is still open.

functions.name: Fx_SampleKeyframeCurve
functions.summary: Samples a keyframe curve at a time: binary-searches the (time, value) pairs starting at +0x14, interpolates between the two bracketing keys and wraps the time with fmodf when the curve loops.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateParticleListL
functions.signature: u32 Fx_UpdateParticleListL(FxEmitter* self, u32 arg2, FxParticle* particle, int forwarded, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Walks the particle's active sub-particle list (head at particle+0xE0, next at +0x14C): live entries get the per-particle update plus a vtable call, dead ones are unlinked with Fx_UnlinkParticleFromLists, and the processed count lands in particle+0x284 before Fx_CommitParticleStream.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterTarget
functions.signature: void maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterTarget(FxEmitter* self, int arg2, int target)
functions.summary: Interpolates the emitter's position from (f_34,f_44,f_54) toward the target (f_98,f_A0) in fixed-size steps, calling the emitter's per-step callback from the table at 0x007AEB6C for every intermediate position.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateParticleListM
functions.summary: Short active-list updater: walks particle+0xE0 applying maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleB to live entries and unlinking dead ones, but when the emitter flag 0x400 is set it walks the alternate list at particle+0xE8 (next at +0x148) instead.

functions.name: Fx_BuildEmitterTransformMatrices
functions.summary: Rebuilds the two 3x4 orientation matrices an emitter uses while spawning (the local basis at +0x1D0 and the world basis at +0x200): converts the emitter's three rotation angles to sine/cosine through the shared fixed-point trig table, expands them into a scaled orthonormal basis, stamps the two 32-bit spawn values (+0x18C/+0x194) into the matrix and copies the emitter's current frame number into every live particle module so newly spawned particles start on the right frame.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterFrame
functions.summary: Frame update of an emitter driven by another object: reads the owner clock at +0x53C, advances the emitter timeline and calls the target, curve and transform updates.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateParticleListN
functions.signature: u32 Fx_UpdateParticleListN(FxEmitter* self, u32 arg2, FxParticle* particle, int forwarded, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Active-list updater that pairs maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleC (dead entries) with 0x526B98 plus the vtable call (live entries), counts them in particle+0x284 and commits the stream through maybe_Fx_CommitParticleStream.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateParticleListO
functions.summary: Minimal active-list updater: walks particle+0xE0 calling maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleC for each live entry, unlinks dead entries with Fx_UnlinkParticleFromLists and counts the processed entries in particle+0x284.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleTrail
functions.signature: void maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleTrail(int self, float* particle, int update)
functions.summary: Maintains a particle's 0x58-byte-stride trail history: smooths with 0.7, advances the ring write indices and appends the current position/rotation segments.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateParticleListQ
functions.signature: u32 Fx_UpdateParticleListQ(FxEmitter* self, u32 arg2, FxParticle* particle, int forwarded, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Full active-list updater: resets the list through 0x527738, walks particle+0xE0 with maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleH plus the vtable call for live entries and maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleD for dead ones, re-applies maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListP per entry and commits the stream.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListR
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListR(FxEmitter* self, u32 list, FxParticle* particle, int forwarded, u32 forwarded2)
functions.summary: Active-list updater for one emitter type: walks the live children, advances each particle (0x5237C4/0x5257E8/0x526554), copies the vertex record and tail-jumps to Fx_CommitParticleStream. The R suffix is a positional label.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_SpawnParticleBatch
functions.summary: Spawn routine: for each of the emitter's remaining f_560 particles it takes a block from the particle pool (0x00530798), initialises position/velocity/colour/scale from the template and its RNG ranges, and links it into the active and free lists.

functions.name: Fx_UpdateParticleListT
functions.summary: Active-list updater that applies maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleD and maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListP to every live entry and, for dead ones, advances the owning emitter's frame counter (f_154) before unlinking; the 0x400 emitter flag selects the alternate list at +0xE8.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleListU
functions.summary: Minimal active-list updater: walks the child list, calls maybe_Fx_UpdateParticleA for the live entries, unlinks expired ones and keeps the particle counter in sync. The U suffix is a positional label.

functions.name: Fx_ApplyParticleState
functions.summary: Applies one group of particle render flags: refreshes the cached transform and writes the packed state words selected by the mode.

functions.name: Fx_AdvanceEmitterFrame
functions.summary: Advances the global emitter frame counter at 0x0052E3C0 (increment, reset every 8 steps) and refreshes the shared transform cache.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_ApplyParticleStateAlt
functions.summary: Interpolates particle state attributes across lifetime fraction and writes channels into +0xBC/+0xC0/+0xC4.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_FlushParticleNodeBlock
functions.summary: 0x18-byte thunk: calls the shared flush tail 0x0052E3C8 (which copies the current node's f_1C/f_20 block into the stream at 0x007AFF18 and resets the pending count) and returns its argument. It is not a batch begin.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_EndParticleBatch
functions.summary: Shared tail of the seven vertex-record writers: clears the pending count, copies the emitter node's f_810 block (f_814 words) to the stream cursor at 0x007AFF18, advances the cursor and increments the batch counter.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SkeletalAnim_InitFrame
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SkeletalAnim_InitFrame(int self, unsigned char* frame)
functions.summary: Initialises per-frame skeletal-animation work: copies the 0x120-byte default table and selects the offset/size of each node group by the frame kind byte (5/6) and its flags.

functions.name: Fx_AppendNodeData
functions.summary: Appends a node's data block to the stream: if node[1] (data) and node[2] (word count) are both set, copies node[2] words and returns the advanced pointer; otherwise returns the pointer unchanged.

functions.name: Fx_System_Init
functions.signature: void Fx_System_Init(FxSystem* self, int arg2, FxSystemDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Initialises the effect system: stores the pool sizes and geometry descriptions from the descriptor, builds the particle tables (0x51D3E8/0x5230B4), parses the effect model resources (0x529DC0) and constructs the emitter arrays.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_UpdateEmitterTransform
functions.summary: Emitter frame update that also rebuilds the emitter transform: reads the owner clock, then runs the target/curve/transform updates and the draw-list calls.

functions.name: Fx_DestroyEmitter
functions.summary: Destroys one live emitter instance: drains its two child-object lists, drops the emitter's animation link, clears the active flag, decrements the template reference counter (and the manager's template count when it reaches zero) and unlinks the instance from the manager's per-type doubly-linked list, fixing the head/tail pointers. Called by the emitter update paths as soon as the remaining lifetime or the last particle reaches zero.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelSlot_Release
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelSlot_Release(void* self, void* owner, int slotIndex)
functions.summary: Releases one model-resource slot: takes the object from the table at self->f_C[slotIndex], releases its parts (0x00531D58) and calls the owner's virtual release (vtable +0xC), then clears the table entry.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelSlot_Replace
functions.signature: int Gfx_ModelSlot_Replace(void* self, void* owner, u32 arg3, int slotIndex, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Replaces one model-resource slot: releases the old slot exactly like 0x0052F6D0, allocates a fresh 0x3C-byte 0x80-aligned slot from the owner and initialises it through Gfx_ModelResource_Reset.

functions.name: Fx_Group_DestroyEmitters
functions.summary: Destroys all active emitters in an emitter group: releases their child nodes and animation links, decrements template refcounts on the FX manager, unlinks them from manager lists, and unlinks the group via 0x005306CC.

functions.name: Fx_System_UpdateChannelGroups
functions.signature: unsigned int Fx_System_UpdateChannelGroups(Fx_System* self, unsigned int list, int channel, int flag)
functions.summary: Advances the FX system clock and updates all active emitter groups attached to a given channel list, ticking sub-steps via 0x0051D25C and updating emitter nodes through Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters (0x005304AC).

functions.name: Fx_SpawnEmitter
functions.signature: void Fx_SpawnEmitter(FxManager* manager, FxEmitterInstance* emitter, FxSpawnRequest* request, int slot, int entry, u32 seed, int useOwnerClock)
functions.summary: Instantiates one emitter from a spawn request: chooses the particle seed (fixed / drawn from the shared 32-bit LCG / explicit), optionally starts the emitter clock from the owner, resets the instance, copies the spawn position, colour and curve parameters of the requested entry into the emitter, attaches the request's animation references and resolves the two optional child nodes from the owner model's node table.

functions.name: maybe_Mem_PoolSlot_Allocate
functions.signature: void* maybe_Mem_PoolSlot_Allocate(PoolOwner* owner, ObjectSlotDesc* desc, uint32_t kind, uint32_t index, uint32_t sub, uint32_t arg6)
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x5880-byte slot from the fixed object pool, links it into the owner's slot list and fills the slot header (kind, owner, descriptor id, zeroed counters); returns null when the pool is exhausted.

functions.name: maybe_Thumb_MisidentifiedEntry
functions.summary: Not a function entry: 0x00530054 is the ARM instruction 'bl 0x00504F30' (word 0xEBFF53B5) inside maybe_Mem_PoolSlot_Allocate (0x00530014), misdecoded as a Thumb push. Kept as a marker.

functions.name: Fx_AllocParticleNode
functions.signature: u32* Fx_AllocParticleNode(FxParticlePool* self, FxParticleType* type, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Hands out one 0x5880-byte block from the fixed pool at self+0x33C using the round-robin cursor self+0x444 masked by self+0x45C, links it into the per-type list at self+type*4+0x340 through the free-list word at +0x5870, stamps the flags/type words and returns it; returns 0 after self+0x450 failed probes.

functions.name: Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters
functions.signature: int Fx_Group_UpdateEmitters(Fx_System* self, int arg2, Fx_EmitterGroup* group, int skipStart, unsigned int* params)
functions.summary: Updates each active emitter in an effect emitter group: calls emitter lifecycle methods (+8 start, +0x10 update, +0x14 sub-step), accumulates particle and quad stats onto the FX system, and unlinks the group via 0x005306CC when empty.

functions.name: Fx_System_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the FX system block: installs vtable 0x0078122C, clears the state byte at +1 and, when the descriptor reports a non-zero element count, lays the element storage out with Fx_System_Init.

functions.name: Fx_System_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the effect system singleton: runs the shutdown and frees the system block. Paired wrapper around 0x5308AC (the shutdown body) + operator delete.

functions.name: Fx_System_Shutdown
functions.summary: Shuts the effect system down: installs vtable 0x78122C, frees the cached Fx buffers and the 30-part table, releases the global effect context, and destroys the 0x1E x 0xC slot array. The routine walks the fixed Fx slot offsets (+0x338/+0x4A0/+0x3A8/+0x4A4/+0x4AC/+0x4B0/+0x320/+0x338...), which matches the effect-system pool layout used by 0x52AA80.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSlot_ReleaseArrayEntry
functions.summary: Releases one three-word resource slot (destroy through vtable+0xC, clear owner and handle) and returns the slot. Used as the element destructor of the Fx system's 30-slot resource array.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_InitFromResource
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_InitFromResource(GfxModelInstance* self, void* owner, GfxResourceSet* res, unsigned int arg4, int arg5, unsigned char* extra)
functions.summary: Builds a drawable model instance from a parsed resource set: fixes the header-relative pointers, registers the resource slots (0x509160/0x509290), converts the vertex/index buffers to physical addresses, allocates the 0x448-byte part blocks and sets up the per-pass draw state.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_ReleaseAll
functions.summary: Releases every 0x3C-byte part record of a part list (count from self->f_C+8, records at self->f_18): frees each part's GPU blocks through Mem_FreeGraphicsBlock, optionally keeping the caller's part, and drops the tracked resources.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelResource_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a model resource in place (clears +0xC, the flag byte +0x31 and +0x34) and immediately rebuilds it through Gfx_ModelInstance_InitFromResource.

functions.name: Mem_FreeGraphicsBlock
functions.signature: void Mem_FreeGraphicsBlock(unsigned int address, unsigned int tag)
functions.summary: Frees a graphics-memory block: classifies the address against the 0x20000/0x30000 allocation regions and returns the block to the matching GPU allocator.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_AllocGraphicsBlockByRegion
functions.signature: int maybe_Gfx_AllocGraphicsBlockByRegion(int address, int block, int regionType, unsigned int arg4, int cmdBuf, int force)
functions.summary: Selects a graphics memory region by kind (1 -> the 0x20000-byte region, 2 -> the 0x30000-byte region), asks that region's allocator (the function pair returned by 0x006BA1DC) for a block and, when a block came back or force is set, submits the resulting transfer through Gfx_CmdQueue_SubmitEntry or SubmitEntryDirect; returns the block pointer. The old Free verb was wrong: the only caller stores the returned pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_BuildSubBlocks
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_BuildSubBlocks(GfxModelInstance* self, int base, int* desc)
functions.summary: Lays out the model instance's sub-blocks inside the resource buffer: for each sub-block it computes the 0x448-byte slot address, default-constructs the vertex-stream and command-node arrays and records the block offsets in the descriptor.

functions.name: maybe_Fx_RenderBatch_Init
functions.summary: Constructor of a render-batch object: zeroes the header, builds three intrusive lists through 0x001252C8 with the same 0x008386FC list template, sets the default depth/near-far values 240.0/400.0 and returns the object at offset -0xD4 of the last allocation.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSet_LookupIndices
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResourceSet_LookupIndices(int * out, int set, int metadata)
functions.summary: Maps every resource name of a resource set to its u16 index in the metadata table (+0x38), marks missing entries 0xFFFF and returns a status word telling whether all/some/none were found. Called by Gfx_BindIndexedResourceSet; the 0xFFFF sentinel and the 0x80008000/0x4000 return flags are the resource-binding protocol used by the model renderer.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSet_LookupSingleIndex
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResourceSet_LookupSingleIndex(int * out, int set, int metadata)
functions.summary: Single-table variant of 0x532BB8: maps the resource names of a set to indices in metadata+0x74 (shader/texture slot table) with the same 0xFFFF/missing handling. Identical control flow to 0x532BB8, only the metadata sub-table offset differs (0x74 instead of 0x38); called by Gfx_BindSingleResource.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceSet_LookupVariantIndices
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResourceSet_LookupVariantIndices(int * out, int set, int metadata)
functions.summary: Variant of the resource-set mapper that first tries the metadata table at +0x88 and falls back to the 0xFFFF "missing" index per entry. Same loop and return flags as 0x532BB8/0x532CD0, but with the optional table +0x88 and an explicit per-entry fallback; called by Gfx_BindResourceSetVariant.

functions.name: Fx_Billboard_EmitList
functions.signature: void Fx_Billboard_EmitList(int self, u32 count, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Walks the batch's entry array and appends each transformed particle/billboard quad through the shared emit helper; called from the scene draw path.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_AllocSlots
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_AllocSlots(GfxModelPart* part, u32 base, u32 count, u32 size, u8 mode)
functions.summary: Carves a model instance's per-part slot arrays out of the resource buffer at base: 16-byte-aligns size, reserves count 0x448-byte and 0xD0-byte per-slot tables, then default-constructs the 0x20-byte elements of every 0x100-byte block. The caller passes a null destination, so the first parameter is damaged.

functions.name: Fx_BuildEmitterTransforms
functions.signature: u32 Fx_BuildEmitterTransforms(FxEmitterSet* self, u16* flags, FxContext* ctx)
functions.summary: Builds the 4x3 transform of each emitter instance from its kind: iterates the 0x18-byte emitter records, decides visibility from the enable mask and the context kind/flag bits, then for orientation modes 0/1/2 fills the matrix with std_FastSinCos rotation, scale from the packed f_98 word and translation/offset from f_A4.

functions.name: Fx_Billboard_TransformPoint
functions.signature: void Fx_Billboard_TransformPoint(float* out, float* point, int matrix)
functions.summary: Transforms one point by the matrix and writes the result into out[0..2] (plus a fourth component), using 0x0051B70C for the per-component multiply-add and 0x0053427C for the projection.

functions.name: Fx_Billboard_TransformVector
functions.signature: void Fx_Billboard_TransformVector(float* destination, float* direction, int matrix)
functions.summary: Direction-only variant of 0x0053390C: same matrix multiply but the translation column is skipped, so it transforms a vector rather than a point.

functions.name: Fx_Billboard_TransformNormal
functions.summary: Normal transformation for the billboard basis: negates the incoming normal, multiplies by the matrix's upper-left 3x3 and normalises so the sprite faces the camera.

functions.name: Fx_Billboard_BuildTransform
functions.signature: void Fx_Billboard_BuildTransform(u32 flags, float* out, float* scale, float* matrix, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Builds a camera-facing billboard matrix from the source matrix: normalises its three axes with square roots, applies the scale and emits the transformed point/vector/normal through Fx_Billboard_TransformPoint/Vector/Normal.

functions.name: Fx_Billboard_CalcBasisMatrix
functions.signature: void Fx_Billboard_CalcBasisMatrix(float* outMatrix, const float* inAxes, const float* viewMatrix)
functions.summary: Calculates an orthonormal billboard 3x3 orientation matrix from input axes and view matrix: normalizes the forward axis via 0x0053427C and computes the cross product with 0x0051B70C.

functions.name: Gfx_CommandBuffer_PadTo16
functions.summary: Pads the command buffer to a 16-byte boundary with zero words so the following block starts at the GPU's required alignment, and reports the padded size.

functions.name: Fx_BuildDistributionTable
functions.signature: void Fx_BuildDistributionTable(float* table, int mode, FxCurveCoefficients* curve, float outLo, float outHi, float exponent, float inLo, float inHi)
functions.summary: Fills a 128-entry lookup table that describes how a random emitter parameter is distributed over its input domain: the input is normalised from [inLo,inHi] to 0..1, passed through a rational curve (curve+0x28/0x2C/0x38/0x3C) and then shaped by the selected mode (0 = rational/linear, 1 = exponential decay, 2 = gaussian exp(-x^2), 3/4 = mirrored exponential variants) and mapped onto [outLo,outHi]. The caller then packs the floats to 13-bit fixed point for the runtime random sampler.

functions.name: Fx_InitQuadSlotIndices
functions.summary: Initializes an array of four slot or index words to 0xFFFFFFFF (-1) via 0x0051CF40 and returns the slots pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_BindTextureDescriptors
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_BindTextureDescriptors(GfxModelInstance* self, int* descriptor, int* material)
functions.summary: Emits the PICA200 texture descriptor block for one material: writes the size/param words, encodes the material's format, mip and border flags into the descriptor and appends it to the model instance's command buffer through Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureDescriptor.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_BindResources
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ModelInstance_BindResources(int self, int model, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Binds the resources of one model/animation group: for each of the group's 0xB-word descriptors it resolves the texture/material names against the model's metadata tables, fills the three sub-structures and dispatches the per-part setup. The 0x80000008/0x80000010/0x80000020 error bits and the repeated func_00659668 name lookups are the model resource binding used by the renderer.

functions.name: Gfx_Bch_BuildMaterials
functions.signature: void Gfx_Bch_BuildMaterials(GfxModel* self, int* materials, int* state, int arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Builds the material/primitive list of a BCH model: walks the material records, aligns each block to 4 bytes, parses the embedded resource sets (Gfx_ResourceSet_Parse) and emits the draw state for each material.

functions.name: Gfx_Bch_LoadModel
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_Bch_LoadModel(GfxBchModel* out, int* header, unsigned int* info)
functions.summary: Loads a BCH (Binary Castle) model from a memory buffer: validates the 'BCH\0' magic, the version (<= 0x22) and the reserved/alignment bits, collects the decoded error bits into the return value, then fills the caller's model descriptor and builds the materials (0x534D4C) and mesh data (0x53531C) from the header's tables.

functions.name: Gfx_Bch_LoadMeshData
functions.signature: void Gfx_Bch_LoadMeshData(unsigned int* self, unsigned int arg2, int vertexData, unsigned int arg4, int arg5, int arg6, unsigned int* counts)
functions.summary: Copies the BCH mesh payload into GPU memory: translates the source address, checks which allocation region it belongs to (0x20000), then copies the vertex/index arrays and writes their physical addresses into the draw records.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Animator_ReleaseBindings
functions.summary: Walks layout animation binding array, clears pane cached transform fields (+0x8C..+0xA0), and unbinds animation resources.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_BindSecondaryResources
functions.summary: Resolves the two secondary resource names of a model part (+0x5C/+0x60 and +0x64/+0x68) through the model metadata, storing the matched entries at +0x4C/+0x50. Same metadata lookup helper and 0x80000020 error bit as 0x5348D0 but for only two named slots; called from the same resource-list attach.

functions.name: Ui_System_SetSlotPoolParam
functions.signature: void Ui_System_SetSlotPoolParam(unsigned int self, unsigned int value)
functions.summary: Configures UI layout slot pool allocator by registering self with tag 0x0400010F via 0x0053D160 and storing parameter into global *0x007AE894.

functions.name: Gfx_Flim_Parse
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_Flim_Parse(unsigned int* self, int data, int size)
functions.summary: Parses a FLIM texture image: finds the 'FLIM' magic at the end of the block, reads the 0x07020100 header fields (format/size/mip count) and builds the texture object used by the material binder.

functions.name: Ui_AnimClip_ParseSections
functions.summary: Validates a BFLAN animation and locates its sections: checks the 'FLAN' magic, then walks the section table and stores the offsets of the tag/pane, material and texture sections into out[1..3]. The magic 0x4E414C46 ('FLAN'), the 0x7020100 version check and the tag offsets 0x10000/0xC0000 are the BFLAN layout; the callers are the UI animation bind/play functions.

functions.name: Fs_Sarc_Open
functions.signature: int Fs_Sarc_Open(FsSarcReader* reader, const void* data)
functions.summary: Validates a Nintendo SARC archive already in memory and sets up the reader: magic 'SARC', header size 0x14, BOM 0xFFFE/0xFEFF, version 0x0100, then locates the SFAT node table at header+0x14. On success stores the archive base and the SFAT pointer in the reader and returns 1.

functions.name: Fs_Sarc_ParseFatNodes
functions.signature: int Fs_Sarc_ParseFatNodes(FsSarcReader* reader, const void* data)
functions.summary: Second stage of SARC opening: checks the SFAT header size (0xC), rejects node counts >= 0x4000, then walks to the data block and verifies the SFNT header (size 8). Interior label of the SARC open routine, kept as a separate entry because the function seeds list it separately.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_Sarc_LocateDataBlock
functions.signature: int maybe_Fs_Sarc_LocateDataBlock(FsSarcReader* reader, const void* data, u32 index)
functions.summary: Not a function entry: 0x00535EDC is the 'bl 0x00123660' (memcmp against the 'SFAT' magic) inside Fs_Sarc_ParseFatNodes (0x00535E74). Kept as a marker for the FAT-section check.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_Sarc_ValidateArchiveEnd
functions.signature: int maybe_Fs_Sarc_ValidateArchiveEnd(FsSarcReader* reader, const void* data, const void* end)
functions.summary: Not a function entry: 0x00535F50 is the 'bl 0x00123660' (memcmp against the 'SFNT' magic) inside Fs_Sarc_ParseFatNodes (0x00535E74). Kept as a marker for the filename-section check.

functions.name: Fs_Sarc_FindFile
functions.signature: int Fs_Sarc_FindFile(FsSarcReader* reader, const char* name)
functions.summary: Looks a file name up in a SARC archive: hashes the name with the SFAT hash key, binary-searches the node table by hash, then compares the stored C string at data offset (attribute low 24 bits * 4) and returns the node index or -1. This is the classic SARC hash/compare lookup.

functions.name: Ui_Resource_FreeTaggedBlock
functions.summary: Frees a tagged memory buffer through the global UI allocator hook retrieved via 0x006BA1DC, passing the arena tag bits and cleared pointer.

functions.name: Ui_ResourceCache_Insert
functions.signature: UiResEntry* Ui_ResourceCache_Insert(UiResCache* cache, const char* name, u32 payload, u8 kind)
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x90-byte named cache entry, copies the name into it, stores the payload pointer and a type byte, and links it into the name-keyed cache at cache+4. Called when a resource lookup misses and the object has just been created.

functions.name: Ui_ResourceCache_FreeNode
functions.summary: Destroys one cache entry: unlinks it from the cache, invokes and frees the attached object at +0x88 when the kind byte at +0x8c is set, then frees the entry itself.

functions.name: Ui_ResourceCache_Clear
functions.summary: Empties a resource cache: repeatedly unlinks and destroys each entry (including its owned +0x88 object) and returns the cache, i.e. the cache's Clear()/destructor body.

functions.name: Ui_Material_GetColor
functions.signature: void Ui_Material_GetColor(unsigned int* outColor, const void* material, int colorIndex)
functions.summary: Retrieves a 32-bit color from an nw::lyt Material: reads primary color slots for indices 0..1, maps indices 2..6 through the texture pattern palette via 0x0065DE7C, or returns 0xFFFFFFFF.

functions.name: Ui_AnimClip_PlayFrom
functions.signature: void Ui_AnimClip_PlayFrom(int * clip, int frame, u32 target)
functions.summary: Shows/activates an animation clip: calls the clip's stop/apply virtual (+0x2C), stores the start frame in +0x30 and then invokes the clip's play virtual (+0x10) with the target. Both virtual calls are on the clip object parsed by 0x535D3C; callers bind/play UI animations.

functions.name: Ui_AnimClip_BindFrame
functions.signature: void Ui_AnimClip_BindFrame(AnimClip* clip, AnimSource* source, const void* frame_table, u32 frame_index, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Binds one frame record of a BFLAN animation to a clip: checks frame_index against the source's frame count, resolves the 0x24-byte record with func_0053649C, hands it to the clip's virtual +0x2C, stores it at clip[0xC] and applies the start flags through +0x10.

functions.name: Container_IntrusiveList_Clear
functions.summary: Empties an intrusive doubly-linked list: unlinks each node, calls its virtual destructor and returns the node to the pool, returning the container for chaining.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_EnsureLayoutLink
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_EnsureLayoutLink(UiWidget* self, int layoutId, int arg3)
functions.summary: Creates the widget's layout link exactly once: builds the layout object, registers it, attaches it to the widget and sets the linked flag at +0x2C. Later calls return immediately.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ReleaseResourceSlot
functions.summary: Shutdown step: releases the sub-object at +0x14, and if the loaded flag at +0x794 is set, clears it and hands the handle at +0x768 back to the global resource manager (0x007AE890 vtable+0xC).

functions.name: Ui_AnimObject_Destroy
functions.summary: Stops and tears down an animation player object: resets active flags at +0x2C and +0x28, stops playback via 0x00559B08, and frees its allocated curve buffer via UI allocator *0x007AE894->vt[3].

functions.name: Ui_AnimObject_Init
functions.summary: Initializes an animation player object: zeroes the curve buffer pointer at +0x00, initializes list nodes at +0x04 and +0x14 via 0x0051D024, and zeroes state bytes +0x28, +0x29, and +0x2C.

functions.name: Gfx_LoadTextureByName
functions.signature: int Gfx_LoadTextureByName(GfxResourceLoader* self, u32 out, const char* name)
functions.summary: Asks the resource loader (virtual +0xC) for the named resource of type 'timg' (0x74696D67, the CTR texture container magic) and parses the returned block as a FLIM image through Gfx_Flim_Parse; returns 1 on success, 0 when the load or the parse fails.

functions.name: Font_LoadResource
functions.summary: Loads the font resource: asks the archive loader for the member called "font", allocates a 0x48-byte font wrapper, parses the bffnt file into it and returns the wrapper (0 on failure). The literal 'font' (0x666F6E74) plus the bffnt parser 0x559D94 used by the second caller chain identify this as the font loader.

functions.name: Ui_ResourceCache_CreateEntry
functions.signature: u32* Ui_ResourceCache_CreateEntry(UiResCache* cache, const char* name)
functions.summary: Creates a 0x9c-byte named cache entry with a zeroed payload region, inserts it into the cache and returns a pointer to the payload area at entry+0x88. Used by the UI sprite/texture loader when a name is not yet cached.

functions.name: Ui_ResourceCache_DestroyAll
functions.summary: Purges all entries from a UI resource cache: unlinks each entry, frees any owned external data buffer via Ui_Resource_FreeTaggedBlock (0x00536104), and deallocates the entry node with Ui_Free (0x0053CEF8).

functions.name: Ui_AnimBinder_Init
functions.signature: void Ui_AnimBinder_Init(UiAnimBinder* self, UiAnimRes* res, void* factory, u32 slotCount)
functions.summary: Initialises an animation binder from a layout animation resource: allocates one animatable object per resource entry (via factory->vtbl[0x14]) and a zeroed array of slotCount 8-byte (object,tag) pairs that 0x00536C48 later fills.

functions.name: xnS
functions.signature: void xnS(int arg1, int * arg2, int arg3)

functions.name: Ui_Animator_AppendBinding
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Animator_AppendBinding(UiAnimator* self, void* target, LayoutAnimTag* tag)
functions.summary: Adds a (target, tag) pair to the binder's fixed array if the tag is compatible with the target, checking the tag's block type against the target's material/animation flags and against the resource's animatable objects. Returns 0 when the array is full or the tag belongs to an already-bound target.

functions.name: Ui_Animator_ApplyTagData
functions.signature: void Ui_Animator_ApplyTagData(UiAnimator* self, UiPane* pane, const LayoutAnimTag* tag)
functions.summary: Evaluates one animation tag at the current frame and writes the results into the pane: interpolates keyframe tables, applies texture-pattern / texcoord / color / rotate / scale entries into the pane's packed material arrays and clears the dirty bit. This is the per-tag 'sampling' pass of the layout animator.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_ApplyPaneVisibility
functions.summary: Applies the stored per-pane visibility flags: for each of self->f_20 pane entries it calls either the show virtual (+0x48) or the hide virtual (+0x4C) depending on the entry's byte flag at +0x1D. Called from Ui_AnimRef_ResetPanes and the equipment window; the two adjacent vtable slots are the pane show/hide pair.

functions.name: Ui_Animator_BindByName
functions.summary: Binds a layout animation group to the binder: for each unbound group entry it matches the entry's name against the pane-name list and appends the pair; entries with sub-ids go through the object's vtbl[0x30] matcher and 0x00536C48. This is what makes named BFLAN animations drive their panes.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the embedded layout element/tween record: installs the base vtable and releases the two child references at +0x18 and +0x1c.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_BuildTransform
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutElement_BuildTransform(LayoutElement* self, float* src, unsigned int arg3, LayoutElem* elem, int arg5, int kind, int childIndex)
functions.summary: Builds the 3x4 world transform matrix for an nw::lyt::Pane from layout element animation and parent matrices, applies alpha scaling, and propagates the transform to all child panes via virtual method +0x40.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LayoutElement_BuildMatrix_LabelA
functions.summary: Not a function entry: 0x00537AE8 is an interior call site (bl 0x0012515C (matrix concat) followed by bl 0x00540AAC Math_BuildRotationMatrix2D) inside Ui_LayoutElement_BuildTransform (0x00537914), which spans 0x00537914-0x00537D48. Kept as a marker.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LayoutElement_BuildMatrix_LabelB
functions.summary: Not a function entry: 0x00537B50 is an interior call site (bl 0x0012515C (matrix concat)) inside Ui_LayoutElement_BuildTransform (0x00537914), which spans 0x00537914-0x00537D48. Kept as a marker.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LayoutElement_BuildMatrix_LabelC
functions.summary: Not a function entry: 0x00537C4C is an interior call site (bl 0x001252E8 (matrix inverse/transpose)) inside Ui_LayoutElement_BuildTransform (0x00537914), which spans 0x00537914-0x00537D48. Kept as a marker.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_LayoutElement_BuildMatrix_LabelD
functions.summary: Not a function entry: 0x00537C5C is an interior call site (bl 0x0012515C (matrix concat) followed by 'b 0x00537ADC') inside Ui_LayoutElement_BuildTransform (0x00537914), which spans 0x00537914-0x00537D48. Kept as a marker.

functions.name: Ui_Animator_AdvanceSlot30
functions.summary: Advances a BFLAN animation track on a layout target: when tag is active, calls target layout object virtual method vtbl[0x30] and updates channel time self->f_4.

functions.name: Ui_Animator_AdvanceSlot2C
functions.summary: Advances a BFLAN animation track on a layout target: when tag is active, calls target layout object virtual method vtbl[0x2C] and updates channel time self->f_4.

functions.name: Ui_Animator_AdvanceSlot28
functions.summary: Advances a BFLAN animation track on a layout target: when tag is active, calls target layout object virtual method vtbl[0x28] and updates channel time self->f_4.

functions.name: Ui_ChildSprite_Attach
functions.summary: Attaches a child sprite/element to its parent: links the two list nodes at parent+0x10/parent+0x14 into the child, sets the child's parent pointer and marks the child's flag bit 0x10. Called by nearly every UI window creation routine, always right after allocating a child sprite.

functions.name: Ui_ChildSprite_Detach
functions.summary: Detaches a child sprite/element from its parent list and clears the child's parent pointer. Mirror of 0x537E90 with the matching unlink helper; called by the release/destructor paths of the same windows.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_UpdateTransformFlags
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutElement_UpdateTransformFlags(LayoutElement* self, LayoutAnimState* state, * u32 flags)
functions.summary: Per-frame half of the layout animation: recomputes the effective alpha (f_46 = f_45 * state alpha), merges the state flags with the element flags, applies the +/- packed offsets and the scale/rotation matrix, and recurses into the children through vtable slot +0x40.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPane_FindByName
functions.signature: UiPane* Ui_LayoutPane_FindByName(UiPane* self, const char* name, int recurse)
functions.summary: Finds a pane by name: compares up to 0x18 characters with the pane's own name buffer, and on mismatch optionally walks the child list calling each child's vtbl[0x4c] (recursive FindPaneByName). Returns the matching pane or 0.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPane_FindByNameEx
functions.signature: UiPane* Ui_LayoutPane_FindByNameEx(UiPane* self, const char* name, int recurse)
functions.summary: Extended pane lookup: iterates the container's indexed children through vtbl[0x24] (count) and vtbl[0x28] (get-by-index) comparing names, then optionally scans the second list at +0x14 with vtbl[0x50].

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPane_FindByNameRecursive
functions.signature: UiPane* Ui_LayoutPane_FindByNameRecursive(UiPane* pane, const char* name)
functions.summary: Unconditional recursive variant of the pane-by-name search: own-name compare first, then always walks the children list through vtbl[0x4c].

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPane_FindByNameRecursiveEx
functions.summary: Unconditional variant of 0x00538494: indexed-child scan then extended-list scan, both always performed.

functions.name: Ui_AnimClip_InitRuntime
functions.summary: Shared runtime initialiser of a UI animation clip: clears the track count and the first/last list pointers, runs the one-time static-init guard for the keyframe container type, constructs the 0x48-byte keyframe buffer and clears the playback position.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPane_InitFromRes
functions.signature: void* Ui_LayoutPane_InitFromRes(void* self, const void* resPane, const void* buildArgSet)
functions.summary: NintendoWare nw::lyt::Pane base constructor from a BFLYT pan1 resource block: initializes base pane links, copies flags (+0x09 -> +0x47), 24-char pane name (+0x0C -> +0x80), 8-char user-data string (+0x24 -> +0x99), SRT transforms and size (+0x2C..+0x50 -> +0x1C..+0x40), and alpha (+0x0A -> +0x44).

functions.name: Ui_AnimClip_CtorCopy
functions.summary: Copy-constructs a UI animation clip: installs vtable 0x00781348, copies the duration/flags/loop fields and the two 1.0f defaults from the descriptor, copies the 0x48-byte reference block and the keyframe name string, and initialises the clip's timing/curve state.

functions.name: Ui_AnimClip_CtorEmpty
functions.summary: Constructs an empty UI animation clip: installs vtable 0x00781348, clears the two intrusive list pointers, runs the shared runtime initialiser, resets all track/duration fields, sets the two default 1.0f values and the 0xFF/0x11 flag bytes, and allocates a 0x19-entry keyframe buffer at self+0x20.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DestroyChildren
functions.summary: Destroys all children of a UI widget: walks the intrusive list at self+0x14, unlinks and deletes each child (callback destroy + free) and finally resets the widget's vtable to the base 0x781348. Called from the three anim-player destructors (0x53E8DC/0x53EE74/0x53FEFC) and the guide-window delete; it is the shared child-teardown of the UI layout elements.

functions.name: Ui_AnimTrackList_CtorFromRecords

functions.summary: Builds an animation track list from a bflyt record table: links the list head, remembers the count from table+0x2A and creates one track per 0x18-byte record through the owner's +0x2C factory, appending each to the list.

functions.name: Container_Tree_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor of a small intrusive container: installs the base vtable (0x007813A4), walks the node list at +0x10 unlinking each node through 0x0011AD60 and freeing it with 0x0053CEF8.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPane_FindChildByName
functions.signature: UiPane* Ui_LayoutPane_FindChildByName(UiPane* self, const char* name)
functions.summary: Indexed child lookup without recursion/fallback: enumerates children via vtbl[0x24]/vtbl[0x28] and compares the 0x18-byte name at child+0x80.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPane_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a UI layout pane object, invoking the base pane constructor, binding vtable 0x007813B4, and zeroing child node pointers.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_GenerateQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_GenerateQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, UiTextContext* ctx)
functions.summary: Generates vertex quads for a layout text box by reading formatting properties and delegating to horizontal, vertical, or multiline quad builders.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_InitRenderState
functions.summary: Initializes layout text rendering state and default vertex color attributes, called during widget layout link initialization.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildEffectQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildEffectQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, UiTextContext* ctx)
functions.summary: Builds vertex quads for animated or effect-driven layout text elements by applying effect owner transforms and queuing quad draw commands.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_ProcessDecoratedLines
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_ProcessDecoratedLines(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, int flags)
functions.summary: Calculates transformed geometry and vertex attributes for decorated or multi-style text lines in a UI layout box.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_FlushCommandsIfPending

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_SetupMaterialAndShading
