functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_SetupTextureCombiners
functions.signature: u32* Ui_LayoutText_SetupTextureCombiners(UiTextWriter* self, u32* drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Configures PICA200 texture combiner stages and blending parameters for text rendering, writing register words to the draw buffer.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_UploadTextureSamplers
functions.signature: u32* Ui_LayoutText_UploadTextureSamplers(UiTextWriter* self, u32* drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Writes PICA200 GPU texture sampler commands and texture coordinate bindings to the draw list when sampler parameters change.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_PackTevStages
functions.signature: int Ui_LayoutText_PackTevStages(UiTextWriter* self, int drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Packs PICA200 TEV combiner source operands and blending equation words from texture descriptor tables into the draw command stream.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_AppendGlyphTexCoords
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_AppendGlyphTexCoords(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, UiGlyphQuad* glyph, u32 count)
functions.summary: Appends texture coordinates for a glyph quad into the layout vertex buffer at offset +0x3F8, flushing commands if texture format changes.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_SetupAlphaAndBlendMode
functions.signature: u32* Ui_LayoutText_SetupAlphaAndBlendMode(UiTextWriter* self, u32* drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Configures GPU alpha test, blending mode, and stencil/depth properties for layout text glyph rendering.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_FlushDrawPacket
functions.summary: Unconditionally flushes accumulated layout text vertex data and draw command packets into the GPU command buffer.

functions.name: Ui_TextBox_ResetLineColors
functions.signature: unsigned int Ui_TextBox_ResetLineColors(UiTextBox* self, unsigned int color, int convert)
functions.summary: Resets the three line color slots of a text box (+0x634, +0x654, +0x674) to zero and optionally converts color through 0x0055861C.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_SetupTextureFilters
functions.signature: u32* Ui_LayoutText_SetupTextureFilters(UiTextWriter* self, u32* drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Sets texture filtering and wrap modes (clamp, repeat, mirror) for layout text rendering stages.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_SetupMultiTextureFilters
functions.signature: u32* Ui_LayoutText_SetupMultiTextureFilters(UiTextWriter* self, u32* drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Sets multi-texture stage filtering and coordinate wrap modes for secondary text textures and effects.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_ProcessColorTagHorizontal
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_ProcessColorTagHorizontal(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds, float* offsets)
functions.summary: Parses in-line color tags ('<Cx' and '$Cx') in horizontal layout text and updates active vertex colors and character bounds.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildHorizontalShadowQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildHorizontalShadowQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds, float* offsets)
functions.summary: Generates offset vertex quads for horizontal text shadow or outline effects, computing displaced quad coordinates for each outline pass.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildHorizontalRubyQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildHorizontalRubyQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds, float* offsets)
functions.summary: Generates ruby (furigana) annotation vertex quads positioned above horizontal base text, scaling and centering annotation glyphs.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildDecorationLineQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildDecorationLineQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds, float* offsets)
functions.summary: Generates decoration quads such as underlines, strikethroughs, or background highlights across the text bounding box after glyphs are placed.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_EnsureBufferCapacity
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutText_EnsureBufferCapacity(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, int neededCmds, int neededPositions, int neededUvs, int resetPosCount)
functions.summary: Checks remaining capacity in the text command, vertex position, and UV buffers, flushing the current draw packet if thresholds (23 commands, 32 vertices/UVs) would be exceeded.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildHorizontalLayoutQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildHorizontalLayoutQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds)
functions.summary: Generates glyph vertex quads for horizontal text lines, handling inline color tags, shadow passes, and ruby annotations.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_UploadTexCoordScale
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutText_UploadTexCoordScale(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Calculates reciprocal texture dimension scales (1.0/w, 1.0/h) for font texture sheets and uploads them via 0x00558210 into GPU uniform registers.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_AppendGlyphPositions
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_AppendGlyphPositions(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, UiGlyphQuad* glyph)
functions.summary: Appends transformed glyph vertex positions into the layout vertex buffer at offset +0x1F8, updating active vertex count and flushing when buffer fills.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildVerticalLayoutQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildVerticalLayoutQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds)
functions.summary: Generates glyph vertex quads for vertical text flow in layout boxes, delegating to vertical line builders and applying decorations.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildVerticalSingleLine
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildVerticalSingleLine(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds, u32* glyphs)
functions.summary: Builds vertex quads for a single line of vertical text, stepping downwards along the vertical advance axis and appending glyph coordinates.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildVerticalMultiLine
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildVerticalMultiLine(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds, u32* glyphs)
functions.summary: Builds vertex quads for multi-line vertical text, advancing down each column and shifting to subsequent columns.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildMultiLineQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildMultiLineQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds, u32* glyphs)
functions.summary: Builds vertex quads for wrapped multi-line text boxes, advancing line baselines according to leading and font height.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildBlockLayoutQuads
functions.signature: u32 Ui_LayoutText_BuildBlockLayoutQuads(UiTextWriter* self, u32 drawList, UiTextBoxDesc* desc, u32 arg4, float* bounds, u32* glyphs)
functions.summary: Builds justified or block-formatted text quads, distributing extra space across character intervals within the text rectangle.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextLayout_InsertRun
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Ui_TextLayout_InsertRun(unsigned int layout, UiTextRun* run, UiTextLine* line, UiTextBox* box)
functions.summary: Traverses text run across line element hierarchy using dispatch table 0x0072FB2C and tree walker 0x006EF5AC.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DrawAndResetFlags
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_DrawAndResetFlags(UiWidget* self, u32 drawList, UiAnimState* anim, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Invokes the widget virtual draw method (+0x10) and clears pending animation and update flags in the animation state.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_SetupLineState
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutText_SetupLineState(UiTextWriter* self, u32 arg2, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Resets per-line text rendering parameters and initializes line state buffers before parsing character layout commands.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_DispatchDrawSelf
functions.signature: void Ui_Widget_DispatchDrawSelf(UiWidget* self, u32 drawList, UiAnimState* anim, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Dispatches self-drawing for a UI widget via vtable+0xC and invokes draw completion callback 0x00558584 when enabled.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_RegisterDefaultState
functions.summary: Initializes and registers the global default layout text rendering state object and installs vtable 0x0053CEC8.

functions.name: Mem_DeleteObject
functions.summary: Deletes a polymorphic object: calls its virtual destructor through vtbl[0], then returns it to the global heap via the singleton's slot 0x0c. This is the library's `delete` helper used throughout the UI text code.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_CreatePaneByFourCC
functions.signature: UiPane* Ui_Layout_CreatePaneByFourCC(u32 allocator, int fourcc, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Factory function creating UI layout panes from BFLYT four-character codes ('pan1', 'pic1', 'txt1', 'wnd1', 'prt1').

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_ApplyTransform
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutElement_ApplyTransform(int self, u32 source, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Builds the layout transform for this element from the given source and forwards it to the parent animator's virtual +0x40 with the given flags. Only caller is Ui_Widget_ApplyScreenTransform; the 0x538568 builder is the transform composer.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_CreateChildSprite
functions.signature: void Ui_Layout_CreateChildSprite(Sprite* self, uint32_t nameId, Container* children, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, const uint8_t* color)
functions.summary: Looks up a child layout pane by numeric id and creates a sprite child for it: builds a 0x40-byte placement record with unit scale, the caller's x/y offset and two colour bytes, then calls the container's add-child slot.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPlayer_CreateFromName
functions.signature: void* Ui_LayoutPlayer_CreateFromName(UiTextBox* self, const char* name, unsigned int extra, unsigned int extra2)
functions.summary: Creates an nw::lyt::Layout player instance for a named .bflyt resource: formats '%s.bflyt', loads it via resource manager self->f_24 with tag 'blyt' (0x626C7974), allocates 0x3C bytes with vtable 0x0078144C, and initializes it via vtbl[0x38].

functions.name: Ui_AnimClip_Load
functions.signature: int * Ui_AnimClip_Load(int self, int name, u32 start, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Loads a UI animation clip: formats the "%s_%s.bflan" resource name, opens it through the loader, parses the sections, allocates a 0x34-byte clip object and starts it at the requested frame. The only format string is "%s_%s.bflan" and the clip object it returns is exactly the one the anim-ref bind code uses.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_UnlinkAndDestroyChild
functions.summary: Unlinks a child node from the layout player's intrusive child list (+0x04) via 0x0011FCBC, invokes its virtual destructor child->vt[1], and deallocates it through the UI allocator (*0x007AE890->vt[3]).

functions.name: Ui_AnimClip_LoadResource
functions.summary: Only opens the "%s_%s.bflan" animation resource through the loader (no clip object allocation); the caller binds the returned file itself. Same format string as 0x53D36C but without the parse/allocate/play steps; called by Ui_AnimRef_Bind.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_ReleaseChildren
functions.summary: Releases the child objects of a layout player: detaches (vtbl[0x14]) and destroys (vtbl[0x0C]) every node in the primary child list at +0x08, and updates secondary child nodes at +0x2C via vtbl[0x2C] with a float parameter.

functions.name: Ui_PlayAnimByName
functions.signature: UiAnimClip* Ui_PlayAnimByName(UiLayout* layout, const char* anim_name, unsigned int loop, unsigned int start_frame)
functions.summary: Loads and starts a BFLAN layout animation by name: builds the archive path '<layout>_<anim>.bflan', resolves it through the layout's resource manager, creates the clip and sets its start frame.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_ResetChildren
functions.summary: Resets child nodes of a layout player: detaches each node of the primary child list at +0x08 via vtbl[0x14] and resets secondary nodes at +0x2C via vtbl[0x24].

functions.name: Ui_Layout_LoadBflyt
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Layout_LoadBflyt(UiLayout* self, void* bflytData, int layoutId, UiLayoutContext* ctx, u32* opt)
functions.summary: Parses a BFLYT binary layout file in memory, validating the 'FLYT' header, creating pane hierarchies, and reading 'grp1' groups.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor of a field scene node: installs the base vtable, releases the model/effect handle, destroys the child list and frees the node unless the shared-object flag is set, then empties the child ring.

functions.name: Ui_TextRun_Copy
functions.signature: UiTextRun* Ui_TextRun_Copy(UiTextRun* self, const UiTextRun* src)
functions.summary: Copy-constructs a text-run/character record: copies the 32-bit tag, two u16 fields, style/type bytes and a 32-bit payload, then recomputes the derived flags through 0x0053E004. Type byte 0x0e/0x90 marker indicates a font glyph run.

functions.name: Ui_TextRun_InitDefault
functions.summary: Default-constructs a text-run record: zeroes all fields, marks it as type 0x0e with the 0x90 flag bits and commits it through 0x0053E004.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_FindByNameExtended
functions.signature: UiPane* Ui_Pane_FindByNameExtended(UiPane* self, const char* name, void* optional)
functions.summary: Pane lookup with a fast path for the cached child at +0xd4 and an array scan at +0xd0 (0x8-byte entries, names at +0x80), falling back to the child list with vtbl[0x30].

functions.name: Ui_LayoutTextBox_Ctor
functions.signature: UiTextBoxPane* Ui_LayoutTextBox_Ctor(UiTextBoxPane* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor for BFLYT 'txt1' (TextBox) layout panes, initializing text buffers, font references, and string animation arrays.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_Dtor_781498
functions.summary: Destructor for the UI widget class with vtable 0x00781498: destroys the child pointer array at +0xD0 (each child through its virtual destructor unless flagged), the single child at +0xD4, releases the buffer pair at +0xC4 and then runs the shared Ui_Widget_DestroyChildren base teardown.

functions.name: Ui_PicturePane_SetTexCoords
functions.signature: void Ui_PicturePane_SetTexCoords(void* picturePane, u32 texCoordIdx, const float* uvQuad8)
functions.summary: Writes four (u, v) float pairs (8 floats = 0x20 bytes) into picturePane's UV texcoord array at picturePane+0xB8[texCoordIdx] via 0x00541D04 and clears bit 3 of picturePane->f_A4->u8_7C.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_UpdateTexPatternAnim
functions.summary: Advances the texcoord/pattern animation of a layout pane: when the material's current pattern/UV indices are behind the animated ones it copies the next pattern record (Ui_TextRun_Copy), rotates the packed pattern counters with wraparound, marks the material dirty, rebuilds the glyph quads (Ui_GlyphQuadArray_AppendQuads) and resamples the texcoord scale into +0x3C/+0x40.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPicture_Ctor
functions.signature: UiPicturePane* Ui_LayoutPicture_Ctor(UiPicturePane* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor for BFLYT 'pic1' (Picture) layout panes, configuring texture coordinate mappings, vertex colors, and picture pane vtable.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPicture_InitAnimation
functions.summary: Initializes animation binding array for picture layout panes, setting up keyframe curve evaluators.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutPane_BindChildren
functions.summary: Allocates and binds the child pane pointer list and hierarchy transform links for a layout pane.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_Dtor_7814F4
functions.summary: Smaller sibling of 0x0053E8DC: installs vtable 0x007814F4, destroys the single child at +0xA4 through its virtual destructor, releases the buffer pair at +0xB8 and runs Ui_Widget_DestroyChildren.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_MeasureAndPlaceRun
functions.signature: void Ui_TextLayout_MeasureAndPlaceRun(UiTextLayout* self, UiTextRun* run, UiTextRunAttr* attr)
functions.summary: Measures and places one text run: optionally lets the run's provider callback (vtbl[8]) adjust the metrics, then calls layout vtbl[0x78] to measure and vtbl[0x58] to set the line advance, and finally draws the run with vtbl[0x6c] when it has payload and measurement succeeded.

functions.name: Ui_TextBox_UpdateTransform
functions.summary: Updates text box layout transform state: calls base transform update Ui_LayoutElement_UpdateTransformFlags (0x00537EEC) and clears pending mirror/transform state on self->f_f8 when flag bit 4 is set.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_BuildDrawParams
functions.summary: Fills the per-run draw parameter block from the text layout: default colors, texture scale/offset from the loaded font material (0x0055730C), text scale, and flip/rotate flags decoded from +0xd0/+0xd1 into the packed out[0x10] word.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_FreeBuffers
functions.summary: Frees the text layout's dynamic buffers: the glyph quad array at +0xf8 (and its sub-buffer at +0xc), the glyph record block at +0xa4 and the font's auxiliary block at +0xfc+8.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_DrawScaled
functions.signature: void Ui_TextLayout_DrawScaled(UiTextLayout* self, unsigned int draw, unsigned int scale, unsigned int clip)
functions.summary: Computes font scale via 0x005573A4 and forwards the draw call with scaled parameters to the text box virtual draw method at vtable slot +0x60.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutTextBox_AllocateCharBuffers
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutTextBox_AllocateCharBuffers(UiTextBoxPane* self, int maxChars, u32 vertexCount, int arg4, int arg5)
functions.summary: Allocates character text string buffer and per-character vertex quad arrays for a layout textbox pane, initializing vertex colors to white (0xFF).

functions.name: Ui_LayoutTextBox_CalculateTextMetrics
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutTextBox_CalculateTextMetrics(UiTextBoxPane* self, int fontObj, int* outMetrics, u32* outFlags)
functions.summary: Calculates string bounds and layout metrics for a textbox pane using the specified font, updating keyframe animation tracks if animated.

functions.name: Ui_AnimTrack_EvaluateKeyframes
functions.summary: Evaluates a layout animation's keyframe tracks into per-frame records: for every frame index it computes the interpolated value from the start value and the step (frame count from the track list), then for each channel of the keyframe block either stores an X/Y/Z value, a sin/cos pair for the three rotation channels (std_FastSinCos) or a packed byte for the remaining channels.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_DrawString
functions.signature: u32 Ui_TextLayout_DrawString(UiTextLayout* self, UiTextRun* run, UiStringSpan* span)
functions.summary: Draws one UTF-16 string span: measures the string when no explicit length is given, sets the line width through vtbl[0x58] and submits the characters through vtbl[0x6c]. Returns 1 when something was drawn.

functions.name: Ui_TextBuffer_AppendChars
functions.signature: u32 Ui_TextBuffer_AppendChars(UiTextBuffer* self, const u16* text, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Appends UTF-16 characters to the text box's character buffer at the given string offset, clamping to the free space and to the buffer capacity, terminating the buffer and marking it dirty (bit 2 of +0xd0). Returns the number of characters copied.

functions.name: Ui_TextBuffer_WriteCharsAt
functions.signature: u32 Ui_TextBuffer_WriteCharsAt(UiTextBuffer* self, const u16* text, u32 index, u32 count)
functions.summary: Writes characters into the middle of the text buffer at a given index, clamping to the buffer length, terminating and marking the buffer dirty. Returns the number of characters written.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutWindow_Ctor
functions.signature: UiWindowPane* Ui_LayoutWindow_Ctor(UiWindowPane* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Constructor for BFLYT 'wnd1' (Window) layout panes, initializing nine-slice frame border textures, inner content pane, and window vtable.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutWindow_DtorBody
functions.summary: Destructor body of the BFLYT 'wnd1' Window pane: installs vtable 0x00781554, frees the four child objects at +0xF4/+0xF8/+0xFC/+0xA4 and the 0xCE-entry pointer array, then runs Ui_Widget_DestroyChildren.

functions.name: Ui_AnimValue_UpdateScroll
functions.summary: Integrates a scrolling/animated value toward its target: advances by delta, handles the three wrap modes (stop, loop using the layout animation length from 0x0065D3B8, ping-pong by negating the target) and flags the value as changed. This is the smooth-scroll helper of the text box.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_SetTargetValue
functions.summary: Sets the layout element's numeric target: clamps it against the element's current range and either snaps or starts the interpolation, marking the element dirty.

functions.name: Ui_AnimValue_SetTarget
functions.signature: void Ui_AnimValue_SetTarget(UiAnimValue* self, float target, int mode)
functions.summary: Sets a scroll value's target/mode and snaps the current value when the target is outside the animated range: takes the layout length from 0x0065D3A0/0x0065D3B8 and resets the value to 0 or the animation length accordingly.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutElement_ApplyDefaultValue
functions.summary: Applies the element's default value (from the shared layout singleton) through its vtable +0x50 setter; called whenever an animation ref is reset.

functions.name: Anim_AnimClip_Ctor
functions.summary: Base constructor of the animation clip objects: runs the common 0x537720 ctor, installs vtable 0x7815D8 and clears the playback fields (+0x24, +0x28, +0x2C). Called by the UI anim-ref list ctor, Ui_PlayAnimByName and Ui_AnimClip_Load (which then overrides the vtable with the concrete clip type).

functions.name: Ui_LayoutParts_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for BFLYT 'prt1' (Parts) layout panes, embedding a nested layout component and binding vtable 0x00781650.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutSystem_InitGlobalTables
functions.summary: Initializes global UI layout subsystem descriptors, pane type mappings, and default font coordinate tables.

functions.name: Ui_Pane_ConfigureTextureLayout
functions.signature: extern u32 Ui_Pane_ConfigureTextureLayout(UiPane* self, u32 patternCount, u32 uvCount, u32 texCount, u32 texCoordCount, u32 flag9, u32 flag10, u32 paletteCount, u32 unk8, u32 alphaCount, Ui_Pane_ConfigureTextureLayout;
functions.summary: Rebuilds a pane's packed material/texture layout: compares the requested counts with the currently packed bitfields, frees and reallocates the data block with the exact size formula (pattern*0x20 + uv*0x14 + tex*8 + ...), then re-initialises the per-pattern, texcoord, palette and alpha sub-arrays. Returns 0 when the allocation fails.

functions.name: Math_BuildRotationMatrix2D
functions.summary: Builds a 2x3 rotation/scale matrix from the angle passed in register s0: uses std_FastSinCos, multiplies the sin/cos terms by the two scale factors, then adds the translation (with the 0.5 pivot correction and 1.0 offset) for both basis vectors.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_InitPaneDescriptorArray
functions.summary: Initializes an array of UI layout pane descriptors with default bounding rectangles and transformation flags.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_InitSecondaryDescriptorArray
functions.summary: Initializes secondary layout element descriptor array with default alignment and opacity parameters.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_InitDescriptorPair
functions.summary: Initializes a pair of layout descriptor entries with a caller-supplied vtable and default dimensions.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutQuadArray_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for nw::lyt layout pane quad array (vtable 0x007816C0), freeing the quad buffer at offset +0x78 via Mem_Free (not item code).

functions.name: Mem_FreeBufferPair
functions.summary: Frees a small two-word buffer descriptor (pointer at +4, length bytes at +0/+1) and zeroes it. Called from the anim-player destructors as the destructor of an embedded buffer pair.

functions.name: Ui_GlyphQuadArray_Reserve
functions.summary: Grows the glyph quad array when the requested capacity exceeds the current one: frees the old buffer, allocates capacity*0x20 bytes and resets count/position.

functions.name: Ui_GlyphQuadArray_AppendQuads
functions.summary: Appends `count` glyph quads to the quad array by copying the four 2-word UV/position templates from the global g_00541cf8 table into each 0x20-byte entry, then records the new used count. Asserts when the capacity is exceeded.

functions.name: Sound_StreamGroup_Init
functions.summary: One-time initialisation of a stream's four voice slots: stores the owner id at +0x08 and sets each 0x10-byte slot's voice-stealing threshold to 'never' (0x7FFFFFFF) for the first slot and 1 for the rest, then marks +0x58 initialised. Called from Sound_Stream_SetSource when a stream first receives a source.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_RequestPlay
functions.signature: u8 Sound_Voice_RequestPlay(SoundVoicePool* self, u32 soundId, u32 priority, u32 flags, char* outVoice)

The +/-1.570796 (+/-PI/2) clamp constants plus the sin/cos pair (0x672E44/0x6731EC) are the classic 3DS surround-pan computation; called from the pan wrapper 0x54392C.

functions.name: Sound_3D_CalcPanFromMatrix

functions.name: maybe_Sound_FindComponentByType

functions.name: Sound_Command_ExecuteList
functions.summary: Runs one round of the sound thread's queued-command list: walks command->next (first word) and switches on the one-byte opcode at +4, applying opcodes 2..0x3A to the target object held at +0x10, then moves to the next node. Opcodes 0x0D/0x0E/0x0F/0x22/0x23 land on the per-player parameter setters in this batch and 0x30..0x3A on the 12 channel/voice broadcast helpers, so this is the consumer side of the sound command queue.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextWindow_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a text window to its initial state: runs the base initialiser 0x005468B8 and clears the current value while enabling the 'visible/active' and clearing the 'closing' bytes.

functions.name: Sound_Command_SubmitVectorPair
functions.summary: Builds and enqueues sound command 0x0E aimed at the sub-object at owner+0x128: copies a 3-word vector from origin, then 8 further words and five 2-word pairs from vectors (13 words) into the command payload before submitting it on the current thread's command queue.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DrawList_InsertByDepth2
functions.summary: Variant of 0x00547BC4 that takes the owning list from self->f_11c instead of the global table: computes the clamped depth key and re-inserts the node into the sorted display list.

functions.name: Sound_Command_SubmitValuesAndTimer
functions.signature: void Sound_Command_SubmitValuesAndTimer(SoundPlayer* owner, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c, u8 d, u8 e, u64 timer)
functions.summary: Builds and enqueues sound command 0x0D for owner+0x128 with three u32 values, two bytes and a 64-bit timer, then submits it. The 0x0D handler 0x005551F8 reads the same three-word payload and the two trailing counts.

functions.name: Sound_Command_SubmitTenWords
functions.summary: Builds and enqueues sound command 0x0F for owner+0x128 with ten u32 arguments; when extra[2] > 0 it also enqueues a second command (0x10) carrying a byte and a count, then sets owner+0x121 ('initialised').

functions.name: Sound_Stream_Request_Cancel
functions.summary: Cancels an in-flight sound-stream request: if the request is marked active (+0x120) it clears that flag and the +0x121 sub-flag, releases the sub-object, then under the owner context's critical section calls vtable+0x10 (abort) and releases the wait pair at owner+0x14/+0x18.

functions.name: Sound_Sequence_AllocateTrackWork
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x128-byte sequence track work structure from the track pool for an active sequence track.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextElement_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a text element: stores the vtable, constructs the embedded subobject through 0x00555B5C and sets the element type byte (+0x9f) to 3.

functions.name: Cbnk_ParseHeader
functions.summary: Validates and prepares a CBNK binary resource (a game-owned chunk container): accepts only the magic CBNK (0x4B4E4243, bytes 43 42 4E 4B) with version 0x01000000..0x01000100, then stores the header plus the block pointer (0x00662DE0()+8) in the small descriptor and marks it parsed.

functions.name: Sound_Bank_ValidateHeader
functions.summary: Validates the Nintendo CTR sound bank ('CBNK') magic and version header, returning the instrument definition table.

functions.name: Sound_Cwav_Open
functions.signature: SoundCwavInfo* Sound_Cwav_Open(SoundCwavInfo* info, u32* cwav, int requireData)
functions.summary: Validates a 3DS CWAV wave file and resolves its INFO and DATA sub-blocks. Requires the 'CWAV' magic (and, when requireData is 0, a plausible version/size), then finds the 'INFO' and 'DATA' chunk tags through 0x00663308/0x006632A0 and stores the wave pointer plus both chunk pointers.

functions.name: Fs_BufferedStream_Read
functions.signature: u32 Fs_BufferedStream_Read(FsBufferedStream* self, void* dst, u32 size, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Reads from a buffered file stream: serves the request from the internal window when it overlaps, otherwise seeks the underlying stream and refills the buffer, falling back to a direct read for requests larger than the window. Returns the number of bytes produced or the stream error.

functions.name: Fs_BufferedStream_Seek
functions.signature: void Fs_BufferedStream_Seek(FsBufferedStream* self, int offset, int mode)
functions.summary: Seeks a buffered stream by adjusting the buffer cursor or forwarding the seek to the underlying stream, with the three standard whence modes (absolute, current, end where the end is obtained from vtbl[0x3c]).

functions.name: Fs_BufferedStream_ReadCached
functions.signature: u32 Fs_BufferedStream_ReadCached(FsBufferedStream* self, void* destination, u32 size)
functions.summary: Copies bytes out of the already-buffered window, clamped to the available data, advancing the cursor; returns the number copied. Used by the stream reader after a refill.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveStream_ReadExact
functions.signature: int Fs_ArchiveStream_ReadExact(FsStream* self, void* dst, uint32_t size, uint32_t offset)
functions.summary: Reads exactly `size` bytes at `offset` from a stream: rejects requests beyond the member length, seeks (maybe_Fs_ArchiveStream_SeekTo) and reads (maybe_Fs_ArchiveStream_ReadAt), and fails when fewer bytes than requested were produced.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveStream_OpenSubMember
functions.signature: int Fs_ArchiveStream_OpenSubMember(FsStream* self, FsStream* parent, uint32_t nameId, uint32_t offset, uint32_t size)
functions.summary: Opens a sub-member only when the parent is open and the requested id is larger than 0x53 (the reserved header range), delegating to the constructor 0x00548610 and returning null when the child stays unopened.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_SetFieldLocked
functions.summary: Stores value into object+0x180 while holding the monitor at object+0x184; a plain published-field setter under a lock.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveStream_OpenPath
functions.signature: int Fs_ArchiveStream_OpenPath(FsStream* self, const char* path)
functions.summary: Opens a stream by path and validates its header: opens the member, reads the 0x40-byte header and splits the directory part of the path for the child lookup.

functions.name: Snd_CreatePlayer
functions.summary: The music-player constructor: it allocates from 0x542B98, installs the player vtable, clears the state pointers and constructs the nested stream context.

functions.name: Fs_ArchiveStream_Destroy
functions.summary: Destroys an archive stream: restores the base vtable, frees the cached block and the name buffer when the open flag is set, then frees the remaining allocation through 0x00505040.

functions.name: Sound_WaveArchive_LoadEntry
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveArchive_LoadEntry(int* self, int entryId, u32 sampleRate, u32 loadFlags, u32 arg5, int arg6)
functions.summary: Loads a wave sample entry from a wave archive into memory, reading sample headers and allocating audio memory.

functions.name: Sound_WaveArchive_PreloadEntries
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveArchive_PreloadEntries(int self, u32 archiveId, u32 sampleRate, u32 loadFlags, u32 userParam)
functions.summary: Preloads a group of wave archive entries referenced by a sound bank or sequence track into the wave cache.

functions.name: Sound_WaveArchive_PreloadGroup
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveArchive_PreloadGroup(int self, u32 groupId, u32 sampleRate, u32 loadFlags, u32 userParam)
functions.summary: Preloads all wave entries belonging to a specified wave archive group into RAM.

functions.name: Sound_WaveCache_LoadDecoded
functions.signature: int Sound_WaveCache_LoadDecoded(SoundWaveCache* cache, u32 waveId, u32 size, * SoundAllocator* alloc, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Decodes one CWAV wave into memory: checks the cache, resolves or allocates the size+0x20 block, writes the "CIWV" in-memory header (id, size) and decodes the payload.

functions.name: Sound_WaveCache_Preload
functions.signature: int Sound_WaveCache_Preload(SoundWaveCache* cache, u32 waveId, u32 size, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Preloads one wave id: returns 1 if the entry is already resident, otherwise loads the raw wave through Sound_WaveCache_LoadRaw (flag 8 and no INFO block) or decodes it through Sound_WaveCache_LoadDecoded.

functions.name: Sound_WaveCache_LoadDecodedWithHeader
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveCache_LoadDecodedWithHeader(SoundWaveCache* cache, u32 waveId, SoundAllocator* alloc)
functions.summary: Second half of a decoded-wave load: reads the 0x2C-byte wave header, allocates the header plus the per-channel offset table, decodes the blocks, writes the 'CIWV' trailer, initialises the descriptor and registers the buffer in the cache.

functions.name: Sound_WaveArchive_LoadAndCache
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveArchive_LoadAndCache(int* self, u32 archiveId, u32 loadFlags, u32 userParam)
functions.summary: Loads and caches a complete Nintendo sound archive (.bcsar / .cwar) package, validating sub-headers and registering wave banks.

functions.name: Sound_WaveCache_PreloadGroup
functions.signature: int Sound_WaveCache_PreloadGroup(SoundWaveCache* cache, int group, SoundAllocator* alloc)
functions.summary: Preloads a whole wave group: validates the bank header, walks the group's {waveId, size} table and loads each wave raw or decoded, aborting on the first failure; returns 1 when the whole group is resident.

functions.name: Sound_WaveCache_PreloadFromFile
functions.signature: int Sound_WaveCache_PreloadFromFile(SoundWaveCache* cache, u32 arg2, u32 fileId, SoundAllocator* alloc)
functions.summary: Opens a small descriptor file, reads a {waveId, size} pair out of it and preloads that single wave into the cache with flag 8; used for one-wave data blocks that are not part of a group table.

functions.name: Sound_WaveArchive_ParseBankInfo
functions.signature: void Sound_WaveArchive_ParseBankInfo(int* self, u32 bankIndex, int* outBankInfo)
functions.summary: Parses sound bank metadata from the archive info block and populates the wave bank description structure.

functions.name: Sound_WaveArchive_LookupEntry
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveArchive_LookupEntry(int* self, u32 entryIndex, u32* outEntryInfo, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Looks up a wave archive entry by its index in the archive table and retrieves its sample offset and size.

functions.name: Sound_WaveArchive_LoadBank
functions.signature: int Sound_WaveArchive_LoadBank(int* self, int bankId, u32 priority, u32 loadFlags, int userParam)
functions.summary: Loads a sound bank and its associated wave sample archives into the runtime sound system cache.

functions.name: Sound_WaveCache_LoadRaw
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveCache_LoadRaw(SoundWaveCache* cache, u32 waveId, SoundAllocator* alloc, u32 size, int publish)
functions.summary: Loads an uncompressed wave into a fresh allocation: looks up the entry, asks the allocator for its size, optionally checks the buffer against the heap range, reads the raw blocks (no decode) and publishes the buffer through the cache's vtable slot +8.

functions.name: Sound_WaveCache_ReadBlocks
functions.signature: int Sound_WaveCache_ReadBlocks(SoundWaveCache* cache, u32 waveId, void* dst, int size, * u32 arg5, int chunkLimit)
functions.summary: Copies the wave payload out of its archive: opens the entry stream, sets the read parameter and loops over the sector-aligned reads until the whole range is transferred.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_InsertChannelNode
functions.summary: Inserts a sound channel node into the doubly-linked channel pool list.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_RemoveChannelNode
functions.summary: Removes an active channel node from the voice pool's channel list upon voice termination.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SelectLowestPriority
functions.summary: Voice stealing: while the group's used count exceeds the threshold, scans all voices for the lowest priority (distance + bias, saturated to 7 bits) and asks that voice to stop. The 0x80 initial priority, the saturation to 7 bits and the vtable+0x10 stop call are the 3DS sound voice-priority allocator.

functions.name: Container_List_DestroyNodes
functions.summary: Destructor helper for a list of large objects: unlinks each node (subtracting the 0x110-byte header) through 0x00123588 and returns the list head.

functions.name: Sound_Wave_Unload
functions.summary: Decrements the reference count of a cached wave sample and frees memory when the reference count drops to zero.

functions.name: Sound_Decoder_Init
functions.signature: void Sound_Decoder_Init(SoundDecoder* self, uint32_t work, uint32_t count)
functions.summary: Initialises one decoder channel group: clears the history/output pointers, records the workarea and sample count (count/4) and initialises two 0x20/0x21-element state arrays.

functions.name: Sound_Command_FreeQueued
functions.summary: Drains the sound command queue: pops every queued node, releases it through 0x00548800 and pushes the node back onto the free ring at queue+0xB4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextConsole_GetInstance
functions.summary: Lazy singleton accessor with one-time init for the text console/renderer object, returning the constant instance 0x007E84B0.

functions.name: Sound_Decoder_DestroyChannels
functions.summary: Tears down a sound decoder's two channel arrays: destroys the 32-entry table at self+0x34 and the 33-entry table at self+0xB4 (the 3DS DSP channel counts) and clears the 'initialised' byte at +0x18D. Mirror image of the setup done by Sound_Decoder_Init.

functions.name: Sound_Sequence_InitTrack
functions.summary: Initializes sequence track state, setting pitch bend, expression, volume, and pan defaults from track data.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextConsole_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a text console variant: stores the owner, zeroes the base, constructs the embedded object through 0x0054B328, installs vtables 0x00781AE4/+0x20 and sets the two 'ready' bytes at +0x260/+0x261.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_ReleaseSequenceWork
functions.summary: Releases sequence playback work buffers and unbinds associated track channels.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_FormatBufferHeader
functions.signature: void Sound_Stream_FormatBufferHeader(SoundStreamBuffer* self, void* pcmData, u32 byteSize)
functions.summary: Formats audio streaming buffer headers with PCM data pointers, sample counts, and loop flags.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_CalculateByteRate
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Stream_CalculateByteRate(int sampleRate, int channels, int bitDepth)
functions.summary: Calculates the streaming byte rate for an audio track based on sample rate, channel count, and format bit depth.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_SetBufferStride
functions.summary: Configures channel interleave stride and circular buffer wrap offsets for a stream buffer.

functions.name: Cwar_ParseHeader
functions.summary: Validates and prepares a CWAR binary resource: requires magic CWAR (0x52415743) and version 0x01000000, stores the payload pointer (0x0065F3F4()+8) and, when requested, resolves the CWAT sub-block (0x0065F420 + 4) whose magic is checked against CWAT (0x54415743).

functions.name: Sound_Wave_InitDescriptor
functions.signature: void Sound_Wave_InitDescriptor(SoundWaveDesc* desc, void* waveData, int format)
functions.summary: Initializes a wave descriptor structure from in-memory sample data, extracting ADPCM/PCM loop points and sample rate.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SetVolumeDirect
functions.signature: void Sound_Voice_SetVolumeDirect(SoundVoice* self, u32 leftVol, u32 rightVol)
functions.summary: Directly updates voice channel left and right volume registers in the DSP mixer.

functions.name: Sound_Track_UpdateVolume
functions.summary: Updates master volume scaling for an active sequence track and recalculates channel attenuations.

functions.name: maybe_Font_GetLineHeightFloat
functions.summary: Returns 0x0054C050() converted from unsigned to float; a small accessor used by the glyph-page setup (the float conversion is emitted inline by the compiler).

functions.name: Sound_StreamPlayer_AllocateBuffers
functions.signature: u32 Sound_StreamPlayer_AllocateBuffers(SoundStreamPlayer* self, u32 bufferSize, u32 ringCount)
functions.summary: Allocates thread-safe circular streaming memory buffers from the audio linear heap, acquiring the sound mutex.

functions.name: Sound_Bank_BindWaveArchive
functions.summary: Binds a loaded wave sample archive (CWAR) to an active sound bank (CBNK) for instrument sample resolution.

functions.name: Sound_Bank_FindWave
functions.signature: void* Sound_Bank_FindWave(SoundBank* bank, u32 waveId, u32 sampleRate)
functions.summary: Searches for a wave sample within a sound bank's attached wave archives by wave ID.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SetupStreams
functions.summary: Applies a playback mode to every DSP stream of a voice: stores the mode byte (modeParam[0]) at voice+0x50, then for each of the voice's stream handles enables it, maps the mode to the stream output type (0/2/1) and forwards the extra parameter and the global output mode to the low-level stream API.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SetPauseMode
functions.summary: Puts a voice into the requested pause state: stores the mode, re-registers the voice with the mixer and, for mode 1, enables the per-stream pause flag.

functions.name: Sound_Mixer_BuildVolumeMatrix
functions.signature: void Sound_Mixer_BuildVolumeMatrix(SoundVoice* voice, int speaker, float* out12)
functions.summary: Builds the 12-float (3 rows x 4 columns) per-speaker volume matrix for a voice: clamps the three surround gains at +0x44/+0x48/+0x4C to 0..1, derives the channel enable mask from the speaker mode at +0x2D (1..8), then combines the pan/cross-feed terms with the output mode from the global settings block.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_NotifyFinished
functions.summary: Completion poll for a voice: when the voice is active, armed and its stream has left the running states, it calls the stored callback with reason 0 and clears the armed/active bytes.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SetOutputMode
functions.summary: Sets a voice's output routing mode: forwards the mode to every stream of the voice and records it in the voice's mode byte; used together with the mute/loop setters right before the voice is started.

functions.name: Sound_Channel_SetBuffer
functions.signature: void Sound_Channel_SetBuffer(Sound_ChannelBank* bank, int index, unsigned buffer, int remember)
functions.summary: Installs a wave buffer into one channel of a bank (0x51A210) and, when asked, remembers it as the bank's current buffer (+0x1C).

functions.name: Sound_SubmitAdpcmBlocks
functions.signature: void Sound_SubmitAdpcmBlocks(unsigned channel, unsigned coefficients, unsigned byteCount, int blocks)
functions.summary: Feeds compressed wave data to a channel: repeatedly submits 14-sample ADPCM groups (0x518154) from 8-byte source blocks until byteCount is consumed.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SetStreamMute
functions.summary: Applies a 0/1/2 mute-or-solo state to every stream of a voice by calling 0x0051A3A4 on each handle; any other value is normalised to 0.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_UpdateChannelPause
functions.summary: Pauses or unpauses an active voice channel by writing the hardware channel pause register.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SetStreamLoopFlag
functions.summary: Forwards a flag to every stream of a voice through 0x0051A3D8 (the third per-stream boolean setter); used by the sequence note start to mark a voice as looping.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_ReleaseToPool
functions.summary: Returns a finished voice to the pool: clears the stream count, the state bytes and the callback owner, unlinks it from the mixer list (0x00550B78/0x00550EA4) and calls the owner callback with reason 3 (released).

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Voice_ReleaseChannels
functions.summary: Tears a voice down: stops and frees every channel in the voice's channel array except keepChannel, clears the voice state, unlinks it from the mixer list and invokes the owner callback with reason 3. The parameter order of the old name was backwards: the voice is the second argument and the first is the one channel to keep.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_ApplyPendingParams
functions.summary: Flushes the voice's dirty parameter bits onto its streams: bit 4 re-sends the stream parameters, 0x40 the mixing matrix, 8 rebuilds the volume matrix, 0x10 applies the resample flag when the sample rate is below 16000 Hz and 0x20 pushes the 3D positional parameters.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_Stop
functions.summary: Stops voice playback immediately, clearing active flags, muting DSP channels, and releasing the voice node.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_StopStreams
functions.summary: Stops a voice: if it is currently running (+0x16) it calls the per-stream stop 0x0051A4AC with 1 on every stream, then clears the running/playing/deferred bytes +0x16/+0x18/+0x17/+0x15.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_StartPcmStream
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Voice_StartPcmStream(SoundVoice* self, int channelCount, u32 sampleRate, int loopMode, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Initializes and starts a hardware PCM audio stream channel for an active voice.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_UpdatePlayState
functions.signature: void Sound_Voice_UpdatePlayState(SoundVoice* voice, u32 streamIndex, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Play/pause state machine for one voice: on the first call it starts the streams (0x00518A1C, the volume matrix, the mixer register and 0x0051A544), then applies state 0/1/2 to every stream through Sound_Channel_SetState.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_UpdateVolumes
functions.summary: Recomputes and pushes the per-stream volume matrix: for each stream it builds the 3x4 matrix for that speaker index with 0x0054C8A4 and hands it to the stream with 0x00519D24.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_ReleaseStreamPair
functions.summary: Releases the two stream slots of a voice with 0x00519BE4 and returns the voice, leaving the pointers in place (the caller is expected to drop the voice immediately afterwards).

functions.name: maybe_Font_GlyphCache_GetInstance
functions.summary: Returns static singleton instance pointer at 0x007E7578, performing one-time initialization if guard bit is unset (not an item).

functions.name: Sound_Driver_TickWithProfiling
functions.summary: One profiling frame of the sound driver: appends the current tick to the 8-byte-record ring at +0x1B8, calls Sound_Profile_RecordFrame, then - under the driver lock - drains the two pending-object lists, the completed-request queues and ticks the mixer/sequence-player subsystems.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_Tick
functions.summary: One frame of the sound driver without the profiling capture: destroys the pending objects on the two driver lists, drains the command queues and ticks the voice, mixer and sequence-player subsystems.

functions.name: Sound_Profile_RecordFrame
functions.summary: Accumulates one frame of sound-thread timing: adds the 64-bit tick delta and a sub-counter to the running totals at +0/+4/+0x18, converts the delta to a float load figure (0.02 scale, clamped to 0..100), tracks a maximum, fills a 101-bucket histogram and, when a capture buffer is installed, appends a {float, byte, byte} record.

functions.name: Sound_Profile_SetBuffer
functions.signature: void Sound_Profile_SetBuffer(SoundDriver* driver, u32* records, u32 count)
functions.summary: Installs the profiling record ring: under the driver lock it stores the buffer, capacity and a reset write cursor, but only while the driver is in the recording state.

functions.name: Sound_Decoder_DecodeFrame
functions.signature: int Sound_Decoder_DecodeFrame(SoundDecoder* self, uint32_t destination, uint32_t * length, uint32_t arg4, int channels, uint32_t b, uint32_t c, int mode, uint32_t flags)
functions.summary: Decodes one block of audio: sets the one-time decoding flag, enters the critical section, runs the decoder core with the codec table and leaves the section again.

functions.name: Sound_Profile_ClearBuffer
functions.summary: Detaches the profiling record ring from the sound driver (buffer, capacity and cursor set to zero) under the driver lock so a freed buffer is never written again.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_AddDeferredRelease
functions.summary: Appends an object to the driver's deferred-release list at +0x1D0/+0x1D4 under the driver lock, so it is destroyed on the next frame instead of in the caller's context.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_RemoveDeferredRelease
functions.summary: Removes an object from the driver's deferred-release list under the driver lock, cancelling a pending destroy.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Driver_StopTimer
functions.summary: One-shot shutdown step: when the driver's +0x1F4 flag is set it raises +0x1F7, calls the sound-system accessor 0x517A60 (whose return Ghidra drops) and clears +0x1F4.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_ShutdownHooks
functions.summary: Final driver-shutdown step: stops the periodic timer, walks the second deferred list calling the finalise slot on each node and marks the driver closed (+0x1CC = -1).

functions.name: Font_GlyphCache_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the glyph cache: zeroes the header, sets the 1.0f defaults at +0xc/+0x10, clears the two intrusive list heads at +0x1d4 and +0x1e0, zeroes the state bytes and the statistics words.

functions.name: maybe_Font_GlyphFader_SetEnabled
functions.summary: Starts a fade for every glyph node in the cache: records the target visibility byte, snapshots the current alpha, computes the fade length from the duration and resets the per-node progress counter.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_Tick
functions.summary: Per-frame step of one sequence channel: moves the five envelope/fade counters (+0x8C..+0xA6) towards their targets, counts down the remaining-length counter at +0x7C and, while a note is held, keeps calling the channel's own vtable slot 1.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_KillNotes
functions.summary: Hard-kills every note still owned by a sequence channel (0x00555DA4 on each element of the list at +0x130) and empties the list.

functions.name: Font_GlyphList_SetVisible
functions.summary: Propagates a visibility change to every glyph node in the cache that opts in (+0x139), updating the node flag and notifying its renderer through 0x0054D450.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_StopNotes
functions.summary: Fades out and releases every playing note of a channel: recomputes the channel parameters, optionally forces the volume and finishes each playing note.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_ApplyMixParams
functions.summary: Propagates the sequencer's current mix parameters onto every note of this channel: interpolates the five envelope pairs, scales the channel volume/expression/pan (0..127 and 0..255 values) by the sequencer's track gains, folds in the key-shift/pitch terms and writes the resulting per-note values (+0xB4..+0x160) before each note is re-mixed.

functions.name: Font_GlyphList_UnlinkNode
functions.summary: Unlinks a glyph node from the cache's singly-linked list (and notifies the renderer at node+300), handling the head and middle cases. Used when a glyph is evicted.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_UpdateNoteTimeouts
functions.summary: Decrements each note's duration counter at +0x190 and finishes the note when it reaches zero (unless it is already in state 4), then refreshes the note's gate flag.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_Stop
functions.summary: Stops a sequence channel completely: recomputes parameters, finishes every playing note, then frees all notes with 0x00555DA4, clears the note list and the +5 'active' byte.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_StartNote
functions.signature: int Sound_SeqChannel_StartNote(SoundSeqChannel* channel, int note, int velocity, u32 duration, int reuse)
functions.summary: Starts one note on a sequence channel: converts note+velocity to a pitch/period word, reuses a finished note in the +0x130 list or allocates a new one from the voice pool (0x005552D0), applies volume/pan/tie parameters, computes the note's sample length, links it at the head of the list and sets up its streams (0x0054C75C/0x0054C82C/0x0054CC2C). Returns the note object or 0.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_SetPauseMode
functions.summary: Virtual slot 0 of the sequence-channel class: modes 0/1 set the pause byte, mode 2 stops all notes gracefully and mode 3 frees them and releases their voices; modes 2/3 empty the note list.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Style_Ctor
functions.summary: Default-constructs a text style/console record: sets all colors to 0x7f/0xff, spacing defaults (0x40/0x3c), builds four 0x10-byte sub-records through 0x005487BC and fills the 16-entry color index table with 0xffff (unset).

functions.name: Sound_Player_InitVoiceSlots
functions.summary: Initializes the player's voice slot array, zeroing channel state flags and setting up 4 voice structures.

functions.name: Sound_SeqChannel_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for a sequence channel: installs the base vtable (0x00781B34), recomputes parameters, finishes and frees all notes and marks the channel inactive. Returns the object for the deleting-destructor convention.

functions.name: Sound_Player_ResetVoiceArray
functions.summary: Resets the global sound player voice slot descriptor array via std_ConstructArray.

functions.name: Sound_Decoder_AllocWork
functions.signature: void Sound_Decoder_AllocWork(SoundDecoder* self, uint32_t size, uint32_t base)
functions.summary: One-shot allocation of the decoder's 0x1B8-byte work record from the sound work buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Text_System_GetInstance
functions.summary: Lazy singleton accessor for the text system object at 0x007E8100, initialising its four list heads and state bytes on first use.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_ReleaseAllChannels
functions.summary: Releases every sequence channel owned by the driver: walks the intrusive list at driver+8 and calls 0x0055624C(channel, 1) on each node (node = list pointer - 0x1B0 bytes).

functions.name: Sound_Voice_ReleaseCallback
functions.signature: void Sound_Voice_ReleaseCallback(u32 caller, int endReason, SoundVoice* voice)
functions.summary: Voice completion callback: triggers user completion handler, unlinks the voice from the active queue, and recycles the voice slot.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_RecycleToPool
functions.summary: Unlinks an active voice node from the playback queue and returns it to the free voice pool.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_AcquireFromPool
functions.summary: Acquires an idle voice node from the free voice pool and links it into the active voice chain.

functions.name: Sound_Driver_ReleaseAllSeqChannels
functions.summary: Shutdown helper: when the driver is running (+0x10), releases every note in the driver's intrusive sequence-channel list and then releases the channel-pool buffer, clearing the running flag. Called only from Sound_System_Shutdown.

functions.name: Sound_Decoder_InitChannelTable
functions.summary: Initialises the global decoder channel table once: resets the two channel descriptors, clears the 0x80 pointer slots, seeds the four output pointers and records the current output mode.

functions.name: Sound_Player_SetSlotTimer
functions.signature: void Sound_Player_SetSlotTimer(SoundPlayer* player, int slot, int ticks)
functions.summary: Arms or cancels the per-slot timer: ticks 0 stops the slot and clears the alarm at slot+0x14, otherwise the alarm is set to ticks/5 so the slot refires later.

functions.name: Sound_Player_StartSlotTrack
functions.signature: int Sound_Player_StartSlotTrack(SoundPlayer* player, int slot, u32 trackId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Binds a track to a free player slot: stops the previous track and clears its alarm, applies the three channel parameters (ramp, fade, masked param) and, on success, stores the track handle at +0x290 and the busy flag at +0x294.

functions.name: Sound_Player_StartSlotCommand
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Player_StartSlotCommand(int player, int slot, u32 channel, u32 params)
functions.summary: Starts one sound slot from a command: if the slot is free it stops the previous voice, configures the wave buffer (slot, full parameters, source) and marks the slot active. Called from the sound command executor (Sound_Command_ExecuteList) and calls exactly the three channel-setup functions of this batch.

functions.name: Sound_Player_StartSlotTrackA
functions.signature: int Sound_Player_StartSlotTrackA(SoundPlayer* player, int slot, u32 trackId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Stops the slot if it is already running, clears its per-slot alarm (0x6EF854) and hands the (slot, trackId) pair to the A-list track registrar: the readable body inlines the registrar 0x519BF4, which tail-calls 0x517650 with the global list 0x7EF3C4.

functions.name: Sound_Player_StartSlotTrackB
functions.signature: int Sound_Player_StartSlotTrackB(SoundPlayer* player, int slot, u32 trackId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: B-variant of the slot restart: stops the running slot, clears the alarm and hands (slot, trackId) to the B-list registrar 0x519C08, which tail-calls 0x5176F4 with the global list 0x7EF3C4.

functions.name: Sound_Player_SetSlotCallback
functions.signature: int Sound_Player_SetSlotCallback(SoundPlayer* player, int slot, u32 callback)
functions.summary: Installs the completion callback for one player slot: stops the slot, clears its alarm, installs the default handler 0x0054F7C0 when none is registered and inserts the caller's callback into the slot's 0xC-stride wait list.

functions.name: Sound_SetOutputMode
functions.summary: Switches the audio output mode (0/1/2): returns early when unchanged, reconfigures the output device via 0x00107608 and then posts a 0x3A-tagged reconfiguration node while flushing both channel lists.

functions.name: Sound_Player_StopSlot
functions.summary: Stops everything running on one playback slot: stops and notifies the slot's two sub-tracks (0x00516618/0x0051698C), releases the note list at slot+0x54 through 0x005182BC/0x0051CF4C and clears the slot's +0x280/+0x284 state.

functions.name: maybe_Text_NotifySlotList
functions.summary: Notifies the listeners of one text slot: looks the slot record up in the table at g_0054F878 (stride 0xc), calls each listener's vtbl[0x10] with a fixed 6-argument parameter list and finally stores the cursor delta for the slot.

functions.name: Sound_Player_TickSlots
functions.summary: Per-frame tick of the two playback slots: advances the volume/envelope ramps and their duration counters, pushes the interpolated volume, reaps finished track handles in state 2 and, when a slot ran, signals the consumer queue through 0x00550B78/0x00550D48.

functions.name: Sound_Player_StopAllSlots
functions.summary: Tears down both playback slots: stops each one, hands its two track handles back, zeroes the two 4-byte handle arrays at +0x6C/+0x274 and finally clears the object's open byte.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_InitVoiceMap
functions.summary: Initializes sequence player voice channel map and channel priority weights.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_PrepareBank
functions.summary: Prepares and validates sound bank and wave archive dependencies for an active sequence player track.

functions.name: maybe_Text_IsIdle
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the text engine reports no pending work (0x0011E5C4() == 0). Small polling helper used by the text tick.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Style_Ctor2
functions.summary: Second text-style constructor variant: calls the shared base init 0x00550780 and sets the color (1.0f), spacing 0x40, palette index 0x7f/0xff, a -1 sentinel and zeroes the remaining state.

functions.name: Sound_Player_SetParams
functions.signature: void Sound_Player_SetParams(SoundPlayer* player, u32* params, u32* volumes)
functions.summary: Applies a parameter block to a player: stores the three words at +0x6C/+0x70/+0x74 and the six volume words at +0xAC..+0xC0, marks the player ready and registers it with the mixer.

functions.name: Sound_Player_StartWave
functions.summary: Starts playing the wave described by the player: opens the CWAV, reads its wave-info block, computes the start window from the player's +0x70/+0x74 fields, allocates a note from the voice pool, copies the PCM, applies volume/pan and starts playback.

functions.name: Sound_Player_UpdateVolumePan
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a playing wave: converts the 0..127 / 0..64 volume and pan fields at +0x91..+0x98 (with the +0x2C override) into the four float gains, applies the surround offsets and pushes them to the note together with the position block.

functions.name: maybe_Text_StopSlotAnimation
functions.summary: Stops a text slot's animation: for mode 2 it first runs the shared notify helper 0x00555DA4, then clears the animation state word at style+0x9c.

functions.name: maybe_Text_FlushFrame
functions.summary: Flushes pending text frame formatting state, unlinking font queue node at +0x50 and clearing dirty flags (not item code).

functions.name: Sound_Player_Update
functions.summary: State machine that turns a pending play request into a playing note: state 1 opens the file asynchronously, state 2 waits for the read, and once the data is ready it starts (or updates) playback.

functions.name: Sound_Player_Play
functions.signature: void Sound_Player_Play(SoundPlayer* player, u32* params, u32* waveRef)
functions.summary: Queues a sound file for playback: aborts any current request, stores the new parameter words and the wave reference, sets state 3 and registers the object with the driver queue and the mixer list.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Player_Reset
functions.summary: Resets a player to its idle state: unlinks its two driver-queue nodes, finishes and frees any playing note, clears the active/volume flags, releases the pending file request and detaches the driver-registry node. Its only caller, Sound_Player_Ctor, calls it to clean a reused player, so it is not a plain 'stop'.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_AcquireLock
functions.summary: Acquires the stream synchronization mutex and updates stream status flags.

functions.name: Sound_Player_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a player in place: links the two intrusive-list nodes to the driver (+0x30 and +0x44), runs the stop/init pass and installs the player vtable 0x00781BD0. Returns the player.

functions.name: Sound_System_LockMutex
functions.summary: Acquires the system-wide sound thread recursive mutex (0x00111D50).

functions.name: maybe_Text_CreateDefaultStyle
functions.summary: Obtains the text engine's default style object (0x0054EDF0) and installs vtable 0x00781BF4 on it, returning the object.

functions.name: Text_StringView_Init
functions.signature: void Text_StringView_Init(TextStringView* self, u32 owner, const u16* text, u32 length)
functions.summary: Initialises a UTF-16 string view over a text buffer: stores owner/pointer/length, converts the length into a byte/char offset with 0x0011CFAC (masked to 0x20) and clears the read cursor and flags.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_CalculatePitch
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Voice_CalculatePitch(int noteNumber, int pitchBend, int tuning)
functions.summary: Calculates the DSP sampling frequency / pitch ratio for a MIDI note number and pitch bend offset.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_StartVoiceChannels
functions.signature: void Sound_Voice_StartVoiceChannels(SoundVoice* self, int channelMask, u32 sampleRate, int loopMode, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Starts hardware audio stream playback across one or more voice channels, stopping existing streams first if needed.

functions.name: Sound_AdpcmChannel_InitTable
functions.signature: void Sound_AdpcmChannel_InitTable(SoundChannelTable* self, uint32_t source, uint32_t size)
functions.summary: Builds an ADPCM channel table: computes the entry count as size/6 (the 6-byte-per-frame ADPCM layout) and fills each 0x60-byte entry from 0x0054D804, linking it through 0x0011FCF8.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextSystem_GetInstance2
functions.summary: Lazy singleton accessor for another text-system instance at 0x007E8640, initialising its flag byte and two list heads on first use.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_UnlinkAndLinkActive
functions.summary: Unlinks a voice from its current list and inserts it into the active playback channel list.

functions.name: Sound_Mixer_TickVoices
functions.summary: Per-frame walk over every active mixer voice in three passes: completion poll (0x0054CBB4), pending-parameter flush (0x0054CFA8) and play/pause state update (0x0054D4B4). Called from both driver tick variants.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SetChannelPauseState
functions.summary: Updates channel pause state for a voice, pausing or resuming DSP playback and updating active voice lists.

functions.name: Sound_Mixer_PopFinishedVoice
functions.summary: Tries to reclaim a finished voice: if the mixer has a voice list and the head voice's priority is not above the requested one, it stops and frees that voice (Sound_Voice_StopStreams / Sound_Voice_Stop), invokes its owner callback with reason 2 and returns the freed slot value.

functions.name: Sound_Mixer_ShutdownVoices
functions.summary: Shuts down a mixer's voices: repeatedly stops the active-list head (callback reason 1) and releases finished-list entries with maybe_Sound_Voice_ReleaseStreamPair until both lists are empty, then clears the mixer's 'open' byte.

functions.name: Sound_Mixer_RelinkVoice
functions.summary: Moves a voice between the mixer's two intrusive lists (deferred at +4, active at +0x10/+0x14) in one step; used when a voice is released or re-registered while the mixer is being walked.

functions.name: Sound_Mixer_ResetVoiceList
functions.summary: Resets a sound mixer/stream object: clears the voice list (0x55141C), zeroes the playback counters and states and sets the priority/timeout words to their defaults (-1, 3).

functions.name: Sound_Stream_FillPcmBuffer
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Stream_FillPcmBuffer(SoundStream* self, void* buffer, u32 sampleCount)
functions.summary: Reads and decodes streaming audio data into an output PCM buffer, advancing stream read pointers.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_CalcSampleCount
functions.summary: Calculates the number of audio samples corresponding to a given byte count for a stream format.

functions.name: Sound_Mixer_ClearVoiceList
functions.summary: Drains the mixer's intrusive voice list: unlinks and destroys every entry, returns it to the pool and then releases the attached output object through its vtable +0x38.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_CancelWorkByOwnerA
functions.summary: Copy of 0x005480C4 that fetches the engine through 0x00547FB0 first: unlinks and cancels (state 4) every queued node owned by `owner` across the three lanes.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_QueueWorkItem
functions.signature: void Sound_Stream_QueueWorkItem(SoundPlayer* player, u32* channels, u32 offset, u32 length, u32 forwarded, u8 priority, u8 flags)
functions.summary: Queues an asynchronous sound-data read: takes a 0x58-byte work item from the player's stream handle (0x00556C48), zero-fills it, installs the work-item vtable 0x00781C08, stores offset/length and the per-channel destinations, links it into the player's completion list and posts it with the stream work lane.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_ProcessChunk
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Stream_ProcessChunk(SoundStream* self, void* chunkData, u32 chunkSize)
functions.summary: Processes an encoded audio data chunk from the file stream reader, validating chunk boundaries.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_AdvanceReadPointer
functions.summary: Advances the circular stream read position by bytesRead and checks for end-of-stream or loop wrap.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_DispatchDma
functions.summary: Dispatches asynchronous DMA transfer of decoded streaming audio data into DSP channel memory.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_QueueNextBuffer
functions.summary: Queues the next available streaming buffer block for playback.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_SubmitDmaCommand
functions.summary: Submits a DMA transfer command to the DSP command queue after filling the PCM stream buffer.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_UpdateRingPointers
functions.summary: Updates circular stream ring buffer write pointers and remaining byte counters after a transfer.

functions.name: Ui_TextElementList_Release
functions.summary: Releases all finished text elements from the typed list at +0x88: unlinks each node whose type byte is 3, calls its virtual destructor and returns it to the free list at +0x90.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_CancelWorkByOwnerB
functions.summary: Third identical copy of the owner-based work cancellation (engine via 0x00547FB0), called from the stream end path instead of the stop-voices path.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_DecodeAdpcmBlock
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Stream_DecodeAdpcmBlock(SoundStream* self, void* dstPcm, void* srcAdpcm, u32 sampleCount)
functions.summary: Decodes an ADPCM compressed audio block into 16-bit linear PCM samples for DSP playback.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_DecodePcmBlock
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Stream_DecodePcmBlock(SoundStream* self, void* dstPcm, void* srcPcm, u32 byteSize)
functions.summary: Copies and converts raw uncompressed PCM stream samples into the target DSP channel playback buffer.

functions.name: Sound_Sequence_InitBufferPool
functions.summary: Initializes the MIDI sequence event buffer pool, allocating streaming event memory via 0x0054BFF4.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_InitBuffers
functions.summary: Initialises the buffer arrays of a sound stream object: prepares the 0x90/0x94 regions, destroys the 32 x 0x58-byte entry array and returns the decoded buffer base. The 0xB00-byte span (32 x 0x58) and the 0x90/0x94 pair are the stream ring buffer; caller is the stream player ctor.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_StartMultiVoiceNote
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqPlayer_StartMultiVoiceNote(void* player, int restart, u32* outSlots, u32 expectedId)
functions.summary: Starts one sequence note across up to eight voices: allocates the voice slots from the mixer, starts them at priority 0x7FFF, queues one stream read per slot and then applies the per-channel output-mode/loop flags.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_UpdateActiveNotes
functions.signature: void maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_UpdateActiveNotes(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 frame, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Consumes the sequence player's active note table: loops the entries in the 'ready' state (state byte 3 at +0x241), accumulates their sample offsets into f_58, requeues stream work through Sound_Stream_QueueWorkItem and starts the next batch of voices.

functions.name: Sound_Track_ApplyChannelKey
functions.signature: u8 Sound_Track_ApplyChannelKey(SoundTrack* self, int channelIndex, int* keyParams, int arg4, int arg5, int arg6)
functions.summary: Applies a note-on or key-pressure event to a sequence track channel, looking up instrument key mappings.

functions.name: Sound_Track_ExecuteCommand
functions.summary: Executes a parsed MIDI/sequence track bytecode command (note, program change, pan, volume, pitch bend).

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_BuildFromStyle
functions.summary: Builds the layout for one styled string: converts the style's fixed-point size/spacing fields into floats, computes the per-character advance including kerning through 0x00661634, then lays out and draws each glyph run of the style (0x0054C7xx/0x0054Dxxx) with the requested colour.

functions.name: Sound_Track_StopChannel
functions.signature: void Sound_Track_StopChannel(u32 trackId, u32 stopMode, int* channelNode)
functions.summary: Stops playback of an individual sequence track channel and clears its channel work reference.

functions.name: Sound_Track_DispatchMidiEvent
functions.summary: Dispatches a MIDI sequence event code, updating track tempo, controllers, or triggering note playback via 0x0055315C.

functions.name: Sound_Track_CheckDuration
functions.summary: Calculates remaining playback duration for an active sequence track note and triggers note release on expiration.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_StopVoices
functions.summary: Stops every voice belonging to a sequence player: cancels the player's pending stream work, stops each of the player+0x220 channel voices and unlinks the player's queue node from the driver.

functions.name: Ui_TextBlock_SetVisible
functions.signature: void Ui_TextBlock_SetVisible(UiTextBlock* self, int visible, u8 animate)
functions.summary: Sets a text block's visibility and propagates the change to all its line objects: compares the effective state with +0x54 and calls each line's visibility setter 0x0054D450 when it changes.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_ApplyChannelMap
functions.summary: Applies the player's channel map to the hardware voices: for each of the player+0x224 entries with a non-zero channel count it configures the voice streams (0x0054C664) and starts them (0x0054D470), then registers the player with the driver queue.

functions.name: Ui_TextBlock_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a text block: releases finished elements, lays out every pending style once the first free line is available, and when the fade-in animation ends it finishes once, updates all line visibility and clears the close request.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_InitFromParam
functions.summary: Initialises a sequence player from a parameter block: stores the driver handle, the mode byte and the value at param+4, takes the next sequence id from the global counter 0x007AED00, publishes the player into the driver's sequence record (+0x10/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x24/+0x26/+0x28/+0x2C) and opens it (0x00547E7C). Returns 1.

functions.name: Sound_Track_ResetAllChannels
functions.summary: Resets all active channels on a sequence track, stopping active voices and muting pitch envelopes.

functions.name: Sound_TrackPool_InitSlots
functions.summary: Initializes the sequence track pool allocator, zeroing channel descriptors and constructing track work blocks.

functions.name: Sound_Track_BindAllocators
functions.summary: Binds memory allocators and channel descriptors to an active sequence track.

functions.name: Sound_Track_PrepareResources
functions.summary: Prepares and binds sound banks and wave sample archives required for track playback.

functions.name: maybe_Text_IsIdle2
functions.summary: Second copy of the 'text engine idle' poll (0x0011E5C4() == 0), used by the other text block variant.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Style_Ctor3
functions.summary: Third text-style constructor variant: calls the shared base 0x00550780 and applies the default colours (1.0f), spacings 0x78/0x30, palette index 0x7f, 16-entry -1 color table and the two state bytes.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_ComputeTempoStep
functions.summary: Converts the player's tempo/tick fields into the next step length: multiplies the two 16-bit tempo values by the 1/60000 sample constant, performs the 64-bit fixed-point division and stores the resulting tick counts used to advance the sequence.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetParamBlock
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetParamBlock(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32* triple, u32* block13)
functions.summary: Stores the 3+13 word parameter block carried by sound command 0x0E: three words into +0x168/+0x16C/+0x170 and thirteen into +0x17C..+0x1AC (two 4-word vectors plus five 2-word pairs), then registers the player with the mixer.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat10
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat10(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, float value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one float to field +0x10 of every masked channel: loads the member-function pointer pair for that field from the channel-class table at 0x73D2E8+0x20 and hands it to Event_BroadcastSlotMask together with the player's 16-slot channel array.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_ReleaseChannels
functions.summary: Releases all 16 sequence channels of a player: unlinks the pending queue node, then for each of the 16 channel pointers at player+0x90 stops the channel (0x0054E828) and destroys it through its owner vtable (slot 0xC), clearing the slot.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_CallChannelsSlot0
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_CallChannelsSlot0(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Calls virtual slot 0 of every channel selected by a 16-bit mask, passing one argument. Slot 0 of the channel method table at 0x73D2E8 is 0x54EBA4, the pause/stop-mode setter, so this is the 'pause/stop selected channels' sound command.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat0C
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat0C(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, float value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one float to field +0xC of every masked channel: loads the member-function pointer pair for that field from the channel-class table at 0x73D2E8+0x18 and hands it to Event_BroadcastSlotMask with the player's 16-slot channel array.

functions.name: maybe_Text_CharWidthTable_Lookup_Label
functions.summary: Interior label of the small 'lookup u16 by index' helper that precedes it: returns the address of a per-character u16 width for index < 0x10 (record+0xd0) or 0x10..0x1f (global table +2*index-0x20), else 0. Not a real function entry.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat08
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat08(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, float value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one float to field +0x8 of every masked channel: loads the member-function pointer pair for that field from the channel-class table at 0x73D2E8+0x10 and hands it to Event_BroadcastSlotMask with the player's 16-slot channel array.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat104
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat104(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, float value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one float to field +0x104 of every masked channel: loads the member-function pointer pair for that field from the channel-class table at 0x73D2E8+0x30 and hands it to Event_BroadcastSlotMask with the player's 16-slot channel array.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_FadeChannelNotes
