functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_FadeChannelNotes(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, int on, u32 length)
functions.summary: Broadcasts a note fade to every channel selected by the mask: channel virtual slot 1 stores the on/off byte at channel+0x7B and then, for every note of that channel, sets the fade target to 0x00 or 0xFF and the fade length.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat18
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat18(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, float value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one float to field +0x18 of every masked channel: loads the member-function pointer pair for that field from the channel-class table at 0x73D2E8+0x40 and hands it to Event_BroadcastSlotMask with the player's 16-slot channel array.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelField83
functions.signature: bool Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelField83(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, int value)
functions.summary: Guarded broadcast of one byte to the masked channels: returns false when the per-index enable byte at player+index*0xC+0x13C is clear, otherwise calls channel virtual slot 9 (which stores the byte at channel+0x83) and returns true.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFieldF4
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFieldF4(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, u32 value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one byte to every masked channel through channel virtual slot 10, which stores it at channel+0xF4.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat14
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat14(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, float value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one float to field +0x14 of every masked channel: loads the member-function pointer pair for that field from the channel-class table at 0x73D2E8+0x28 and hands it to Event_BroadcastSlotMask with the player's 16-slot channel array.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat108
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFloat108(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, u32 value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts a float plus a byte to every masked channel by calling channel virtual slot 7, which stores the float at channel+0x108 and the byte at channel+0xFE.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFieldF0
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqPlayer_SetChannelFieldF0(SoundSeqPlayer* player, u32 channelMask, u32 value)
functions.summary: Broadcasts one byte to every masked channel through channel virtual slot 11, which stores it at channel+0xF0.

functions.name: Ui_Text_DrawGlyphRun
functions.signature: void Ui_Text_DrawGlyphRun(TextGlyphRun* self, void* target, TextGlyphStyle* style)
functions.summary: Draws one glyph run: when the run has a callback it builds a parameter block (metrics at self+0xd0, glyph index from 0x0054E294, the style's +0x24 byte) and calls the callback as callback(target, block, self->f_8c), restoring the style byte afterwards.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_SetAllChannelNotesFlag
functions.summary: Stores the byte at player+0xE and then applies it to every note of all 16 channels: for each non-null entry of the channel array at player+0x90 it calls 0x54E2B0, which walks that channel's note list at +0x130 and flips the per-note flag +0x138.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_BindChannels
functions.summary: Binds channel objects to a player from a source descriptor: counts the requested bits, asks the source for its channel count through its vtable and stores each created channel (source vtable+8) into the player's 16-slot channel array.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_Update
functions.summary: Main per-frame update of a sequence player: drives the async file-load state (open, wait, then decode/play), feeds the tempo step, applies the channel parameters and finally updates the playing wave.

functions.name: Sound_Track_ReleaseActiveChannels
functions.summary: Releases all active audio channels belonging to a sequence track back to the voice pool.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_Shutdown
functions.summary: Destroys a sequence player: releases the channel objects, unregisters it from the driver queue, aborts the four channel-map entries and four parameter blocks, stops the pending read request and detaches from the driver registry.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_PlayFrame
functions.summary: Advances a playing sequence: stops and recycles the notes of all 16 channels, waits for the tempo accumulator to reach a full sample frame, then re-arms the voices and recomputes the tempo step.

functions.name: Sound_Track_ConstructWork
functions.summary: Constructs a sequence track work control block, locking the sound mutex and setting up channel buffers.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a sequence player in place: links the two intrusive-list nodes to the driver (+0x34 and +0x48), runs the init/shutdown pass and installs the player vtable 0x00781BD0. Returns the player.

functions.name: maybe_Text_System_GetInstance3
functions.summary: Lazy singleton accessor for a third text/console system instance at 0x007EF590; the seed address is inside a Thumb-marked block so the readable C is a halt stub, but the asm shows the same lazy-init + fixed instance return as its siblings.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Registry_NotifyAll
functions.signature: void maybe_Sound_Registry_NotifyAll(u32 registry, int begin, int end)
functions.summary: Walks the circular sound-object list at 0x007F2590/0x007F2594 and calls vtable slot 2 on every node with the [begin, begin+end) range, re-checking the static-init guard 0x007B0044 around each callback.

functions.name: maybe_Text_AttachRenderer
functions.summary: Attaches a renderer callback to the text element found through 0x00556C48: stores it at +0x12c and copies self+4 to +0x134 when the element exists.

functions.name: Sound_SeqNote_UpdateChannelMute
functions.summary: Propagates a per-channel mute mask onto a note's stream descriptors: compares each stored mask with the new one and re-applies it when it changed.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_StartNote
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqPlayer_StartNote(SoundSeqPlayer* self, int noteNumber, u32 velocity, u32 duration)
functions.summary: Triggers a new musical note on a sequence player channel, acquiring a free voice and starting DSP playback.

functions.name: Sound_SeqNote_SetupVoices
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqNote_SetupVoices(Sound_SeqNote* self, const NoteRecord* rec, unsigned sampleCount)
functions.summary: Sets up the voices of a sequencer note from its record: copies the timing/scale, allocates per-voice sample data, decodes the ADPCM blocks (Sound_SubmitAdpcmBlocks) and installs each voice's buffer in the channel bank (maybe_Sound_Channel_SetBuffer).

functions.name: Sound_SeqNote_Release
functions.summary: Fully releases a note: stops and frees its voice streams, clears the playing flags, invokes the owner completion callback with reason 0 and unlinks the note from the driver's release list.

functions.name: Sound_SeqNote_Start
functions.signature: void Sound_SeqNote_Start(SoundSeqNote* note, u32 info, u32 duration, u32 startOffset)
functions.summary: Starts a prepared note: stores the duration/start offset, resets the four 0x20-byte time envelopes, applies the wave-info block to its streams, sets the mute mask and marks the note as playing.

functions.name: Sound_SeqNote_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a playing note: advances the fade/priority counters, interpolates the volume/pan ramp, applies the loop and 3D parameters and, when the wave reaches its end (state 4 or the end callback), stops the streams and reports completion to the owner.

functions.name: Sound_SeqNote_FinishIfDone
functions.summary: Finishes a note whose duration ran out: marks it stopped (state 4) and applies the 'release' mode to its voice, unless the note is already stopping or the player is in gate mode.

functions.name: Sound_SeqNote_MarkFinished
functions.summary: Unconditionally marks a note as finished: applies the release mode to its voice and sets the note state to 4. The workhorse used by every 'stop this note now' path.

functions.name: Sound_SeqNote_FindNoteInRange
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqNote_FindNoteInRange(SoundSeqNote* note, u32 start, u32 end)
functions.summary: Searches the sub-notes of a note for one whose [position, position+length) overlaps the requested [start, end) window and, when found, reports a range hit to the owner (callback reason 3) and clears the callback.

functions.name: Sound_Track_AllocChannelWork
functions.summary: Allocates channel work state and initializes modulation envelopes for an active sequence track channel.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_InitPoolSlot
functions.summary: Initializes a newly allocated voice pool slot with default envelope, pan, and priority values.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_FreeNode
functions.summary: Frees an allocated voice node back to the free voice pool and resets voice work pointers.

functions.name: maybe_Text_GlyphRenderer_Setup
functions.summary: Initialises the global glyph-renderer dispatch table: memsets the storage and installs five function pointers (0x0054BFD8, 0x0054BF74, 0x0054BFD4, 0x0054BF58, 0x0054BF38) at 0x007E8120.

functions.name: maybe_Text_InsertSorted_Label
functions.summary: Interior label of the sorted-insert routine for display-list entries: computes the key from node[-0x2a] + u8[node-0x5b] clamped to 0x7f and calls 0x0011FCF8 to insert before the first larger entry. Ghidra's C for this label is register garbage.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Range_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a small text range/value record: calls the shared 0x005487BC init and sets min 0.0f, max 1.0f, current 0 and the two flag bytes 0.

functions.name: Sound_WorkBuffer_AllocBlocks
functions.signature: uint32_t Sound_WorkBuffer_AllocBlocks(uint32_t* ring, uint32_t base, uint32_t size, uint32_t stride)
functions.summary: Carves `n` aligned blocks of `stride` bytes out of a region and pushes them onto a free-list ring; returns the block count.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SendDspBiquad
functions.summary: Queues biquad filter coefficient words for a voice into the hardware DSP command buffer.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SendDspPan
functions.summary: Queues stereo panning and surround matrix coefficient words for a voice into the DSP command buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Scroller_Reposition2
functions.summary: Third copy of the depth-sorted reposition routine (identical to 0x00549038): unlink and reinsert the node before the first larger key in the list owned by self->f_11c.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_SendDspPitch
functions.summary: Queues pitch ratio and sample rate conversion words for a voice into the DSP command buffer.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_Request_CancelB
functions.summary: Second copy of the sound file request canceller (identical to 0x00549288): clears the active flags, closes the archive handle and aborts the pending operation under the object's critical section.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_Request_AllocInit
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises a sound-stream request from the driver pool: installs vtable 0x781D3C, stores the owner at +0x11C, clears the request flags and initialises the queue node.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Element_Init2
functions.summary: Second text-element initialiser variant: stores the vtable, constructs the embedded subobject through 0x00550740 and sets the type byte (+0x9f) to 3.

functions.name: Ui_Font_LoadGlyphSheet
functions.summary: Loads and parses a font glyph sheet and texture mapping table from font binary data.

functions.name: Ui_Font_ParseGlyphTable
functions.summary: Parses font character-to-glyph index mappings, kerning pairs, and glyph bounding box metrics.

functions.name: Ui_Font_GetKerningOffset
functions.summary: Calculates horizontal kerning advance adjustment between consecutive glyphs in a text line.

functions.name: Ui_Text_CalcScreenScale
functions.signature: void Ui_Text_CalcScreenScale(TextLayout* self, float x, float y)
functions.summary: Converts a pixel extent into the layout's normalised scale by dividing by the screen/font dimensions obtained from the object's vtbl[0x0c] and vtbl[0x10]; stores the two reciprocal scales at +8 and +0xc. Called from the draw-parameter builder.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_InitStringDesc
functions.signature: int Ui_LayoutText_InitStringDesc(int bufferA, int bufferB, int arg3, u32 maxChars, int flag)
functions.summary: Initializes a layout text string descriptor structure linking text buffer and vertex quad arrays.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_CalcBufferLength
functions.summary: Calculates the required memory buffer size in bytes for a layout string with charCount characters.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_InitStringDescSimple
functions.signature: int Ui_LayoutText_InitStringDescSimple(int bufferA, int bufferB, u32 maxChars, int flag)
functions.summary: Convenience helper to initialize a text string descriptor with default buffer stride.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_InitMetricsArray
functions.summary: Initializes an array of character metric structures for layout text box sizing.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_CopyColorAttributes
functions.summary: Copies text vertex color matrices and alpha multipliers into the layout text writer rendering state.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_InitQuadVertexTable
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutText_InitQuadVertexTable(UiTextWriter* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int quadDesc)
functions.summary: Initializes the quad vertex index and position lookup table for layout text box character rendering.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_FormatQuadVertices
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutText_FormatQuadVertices(u32 arg1, UiTextQuad* quad, u32* vertexData, u8 flagA, u32 arg5, u8 flagB)
functions.summary: Formats individual quad vertex coordinate and color records from text glyph layout parameters.

functions.name: Gfx_EmitUniformMatrix
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_EmitUniformMatrix(u32 context, u32* drawList, u32* matrixData, u32 regIndex, int vectorCount)
functions.summary: Emits PICA200 uniform float register commands (0x80000000 | reg) writing matrix vector data into the GPU draw command buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushAllState
functions.signature: unsigned int* Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushAllState(GfxCmdBuf* self, unsigned int* out)
functions.summary: Flushes every pending PICA state group held by the command-buffer object: the fixed 9-slot block at +0x88, the 0x10-stride slot range at +0x1f8 and the 0x10-stride slot range at +0x3f8. It then appends a 20-word consecutive block (0x80000000 header, command word 0x000F0227, two count/index words and a 0x40-byte template copied from 0x0072F6A8) and returns the advanced output pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushMatrixSlots
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushMatrixSlots(GfxCmdBuf* self, unsigned int* out, unsigned char count)
functions.summary: Emits the pending slice of the 32-slot, 0x10-byte-stride state array at self+0x1f8 (from cursor f_32 up to f_31, base command index cursor+0x20) into the PICA command list, then sets both the start and write cursors to count so the array can be refilled.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushSlotBlock
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushSlotBlock(GfxCmdBuf* self, unsigned int* out)
functions.summary: Emits the fixed 9-slot state block at self+0x88 (base command index 9, count f_30) into the command list and clears the dirty-slot count f_30.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushUniformSlots
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushUniformSlots(GfxCmdBuf* self, unsigned int* out, unsigned char count)
functions.summary: Emits the pending slice of the 64-slot, 0x10-byte-stride state array at self+0x3f8 (cursor f_34 up to f_33, base command index cursor+0x40) into the command list and rewinds both cursors to count.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_SetMatrixBlock
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdBuf_SetMatrixBlock(GfxCmdBuf* self, unsigned int* out, const unsigned int* mtx)
functions.summary: Copies a 16-word (4x4 float, 0x40-byte) matrix from the source descriptor into the transform block at self+0x38..+0x77 and emits the whole 5-slot block (base command index 0) to the command list, so the transform becomes active.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CopyBlock24
functions.signature: void* maybe_Gfx_CopyBlock24(const void* src, void* dst)
functions.summary: Copies a fixed 24-byte record from src to dst and returns dst+0x18: a small fixed-size record writer used when serialising state blocks into an output buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CopyBlock48
functions.signature: void* maybe_Gfx_CopyBlock48(const void* src, void* dst)
functions.summary: Copies a fixed 48-byte record from src to dst and returns dst+0x30; the 0x30 size matches the state templates copied from 0x0072F608/0x0072F638 elsewhere in the region.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_BuildGradientRamp
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutText_BuildGradientRamp(u32* out, u32 ctx, u32 start, u32 end)
functions.summary: Builds the three-word gradient descriptor used by the text shading setup: compares the integer parts of two 8.24 fixed-point endpoints, clamps the extreme one, computes 0xFF00/(delta+1) and picks a shift (2/3/4) so the step fits in 8 bits, writing {end, start, shift|0x40} to out[0..2].

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_EmitMaterialDraw
functions.signature: unsigned int* Gfx_CmdBuf_EmitMaterialDraw(GfxCmdBuf* self, unsigned int* out, int* desc)
functions.summary: Emits the complete PICA command sequence for drawing one material/pass pair: the 0x30-byte pipeline template (0x0072F548/0x0072F608), the 5-slot transform block, the 3+2 texture-matrix uniform slots at +0x1f8 (scale/offset/rotation derived from the instance fields f_28..f_34 and the short fields f_3c/f_3e), the shader/state blobs (desc->f_c with size f_14, or via 0x005575D0) and then repeats the stage for the second texture unit, returning the advanced output pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteStateTemplate
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteStateTemplate(unsigned int arg1, unsigned int* out, unsigned int mode)
functions.summary: Writes a 48-byte render-state template into the output block by copying the 0x30-byte constant template at 0x0072F638, then patches it for the requested mode (mode 2 clears word 5, mode 2 and 3 set word 6 to 0x0EEF0DFE and word 9 to 0x00010004) and, when bit 0x40 is set, replaces word 0 with 0x0EDE0EEE.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushStateBlock
functions.signature: int Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushStateBlock(GfxCmdBuf* self, unsigned int* out, unsigned int flags)
functions.summary: Finishes a state block: if the pending counter f_30 is set it first flushes through 0x0053AD18, then clears the dirty counters (f_31..f_35) and, unless bit 0 is set in flags, copies the object's stored data block (pointer self->f_18, size f_1c) to the output and returns the 4-byte-aligned end pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushStateBlockData
functions.signature: int maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_FlushStateBlockData(unsigned int* out, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int flags, GfxCmdBuf* self)
functions.summary: Clears the dirty counters of a command-buffer object and, unless bit 0 of the flags is set, copies the stored data block to the output and returns the aligned end pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_EmitStateBlob
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_CmdBuf_EmitStateBlob(GfxCmdBuf* self, u32* out, u32* flags)
functions.summary: Emits an eight-word GPU state header (PICA command words 0x0002006F / 0x00200080, 0x1000) into the command stream, copies the object's inline descriptor (pointer at +8, size f_C) after it and advances the write pointer; the caller's flags are used to mark the state as set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GlyphRenderer_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs the glyph renderer: stores the owner, zeroes the base, constructs the embedded object at +0x10 (two-step 0x0051D024 init), sets the six state bytes and four 0.0f fields at +0x5e4..+0x5f0.

functions.name: Font_SetupTexture
functions.summary: Re-initialises the font's embedded texture descriptor from the loaded resource: it takes the sub-resource at self[3]+0xc, queries a value through the object's vtable slot +0x7c, and passes the data address, format, width, height, size and flag into the texture-descriptor initialiser 0x0055A2BC.

functions.name: Font_Create
functions.summary: Allocates a font object via 0x00559D4C, installs the base vtable 0x00781DB4, zeroes the resource pointers, initialises the embedded texture descriptor to the default (format 8) and stores the constant 0x00002206 in field 9; a conditional block afterwards re-derives the descriptor if a resource were already attached.

functions.name: Font_DestructBase
functions.summary: Base-class destructor body: installs the base vtable 0x00781DB4 and resets the embedded texture descriptor to its empty default (format 8, no data), returning the object.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutText_InitStringDescArray
functions.signature: void Ui_LayoutText_InitStringDescArray(unsigned int* self, unsigned int owner, unsigned int value)
functions.summary: Shared initialiser of a layout-text string descriptor: stores the owner at +0 and the value at +0xC, zeroes the header words and constructs the inline two-element (4-byte) array at +0x18.

functions.name: Font_EnsureDisplayList
functions.summary: Lazy one-shot initialiser: if the built-flag at object+0x28 is clear it runs the 2412-byte display-list builder 0x005593E4 and then sets +0x28 = 1 and +0x29 = 0, so the static glyph command list is generated only once.

functions.name: Font_BuildDisplayList
functions.signature: void Font_BuildDisplayList(int* self, unsigned int base, unsigned int res)
functions.summary: Builds a complete static GPU command list into the supplied buffer: computes the total size from the glyph/index counts, initialises the byte stream, fills the 35x6 ramp table, converts it with Os_VirtualToPhysical, emits the glyph quad commands, appends the per-character width/flag table and finishes by copying the constant templates.

functions.name: maybe_Text_Descriptor_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a tiny descriptor: stores the value, sets the two flag bytes to 1 and returns self. Used to build the inline 'object + flags' records passed to the text engine.

functions.name: Font_LoadBffnt
functions.summary: Parses a Nintendo bffnt/bfnt font file into a font object: validates the CFNU/CFNT/FFNU/FFNT container magic, locates the FINF and KRNG sections, builds the glyph maps and marks the font ready. The four container magics (0x554E4643 'CFNU', 0x544E4643 'CFNT', 0x554E4646 'FFNU', 0x544E4646 'FFNT'), the FINF section (0x464E4946) and KRNG (0x474E524B) are the exact 3DS bffnt layout.

functions.name: Font_CreateDerived
functions.summary: Creates the derived (resource-backed) font object: it calls the base constructor 0x00559144 and then overwrites the returned object's vtable with 0x00781F18, selecting the derived implementation; used by Font_LoadResource.

functions.name: Font_DestructDerived
functions.summary: Derived-class destructor: restores the derived vtable 0x00781F18, releases the attached resource through 0x00559118 when self[2] is set, then chains to the base vtable 0x00781DB4 and resets the embedded texture descriptor to empty.

functions.name: Gfx_Texture_InitDesc
functions.signature: void Gfx_Texture_InitDesc(unsigned int* desc, unsigned int cpuAddr, unsigned int vaddr, unsigned char format, unsigned short width, unsigned short height, unsigned short arg7, unsigned int size, unsigned char flag)
functions.summary: Fills a 0x14-byte texture/image descriptor: CPU pointer at +0, physical address (vaddr >> 3 after Os_VirtualToPhysical) at +4, width/height at +8/+0xa, a third u16 at +0xc, format byte at +0xe, flag byte at +0xf and size >> 3 at +0x10; vaddr 0 means 'no physical address'.

functions.name: Gfx_ParseChipFile
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_ParseChipFile(GfxChipFile* self, const void* data, unsigned int heap)
functions.summary: Parses a 'CHIP' 2D-background container (RomFS '2d/bg/<map>/<map>.chp', 485 files): checks the magic/version template, reads the section count at +0xC and the section-table offset at +0xE, resolves the seven named sections (Header, Areas, AnimRGBA, AnimData, CharacterDepth, Name, BlockData00), stores their pointers in self (+0xC..+0x24), derives the pixel/aspect ratios with 0x0055A2BC and Mem_AllocAligned-allocates one 0x14-byte record per entry.

functions.name: Text_ReleaseBuffer
functions.summary: Releases the run's heap block: when +0x28 is set it subtracts the 8-byte header and calls the global operator delete, clearing the field.

functions.name: Gfx_Material_ResolveTextures
functions.summary: Resolves the material's texture indices into real texture objects: after resetting the sub-object at self+8, it looks up the three u8 indices at desc+0x1f..0x21 in the descriptor's pointer table and binds them at self+0x58/+0x5c/+0x60, plus the base/animated texture indices into self+0x1c/+0x40/+0x4c according to the mode byte at self+0x64 (0, 1 or 2 textures).

functions.name: maybe_Container_InitListObject
functions.summary: Small list/array container constructor: installs vtable 0x00782080, builds two self-referential link pairs, stores the owner twice, zeroes six u16 counters and constructs the inline four-byte-element array at +0x28.

functions.name: Container_MultiList_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a container that owns several intrusive red-black trees/lists: unlinks the four list heads, erases every node of the tree at +0x1C and returns the object.

functions.name: Pack_IsTextResourceName
functions.summary: Returns 1 when a resource name contains the text/script suffixes .bxon, .bspa or .bact, i.e. classifies the member as a text/data resource rather than a binary asset. The three suffix literals are the only data used; there is no caller in the readable tree because it is reached through a resource-table callback.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelPart_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor shim for a model part: releases its buffer pair (0x5799D4) and then the object reference (0x10F6CC).

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_AddQuad
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_AddQuad(GfxOverlay* self, const void* quad, int scale)
functions.summary: Appends one screen-space quad to the global 2D batch: after a one-time init of the singleton at 0x008384A0 (memset 0x140, vtable 0x00782AFC), it converts the descriptor's pixel rect and UVs into normalised coordinates using the screen mode (320x240 for mode 2, 400x480 otherwise), picks a palette colour when the descriptor's colour index is >= 0, and writes the 0x48-byte (18-word) vertex record (pos, size, uv, 8 colour words, 3 table colours, flag) at buffer[count*0x48], incrementing the count.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadowPass_Create
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_CharShadowPass_Create(GfxCharShadowPass* self, unsigned int ctx, unsigned int heap)
functions.summary: Allocates the character-shadow-pass resources: it builds five resource descriptors (slots 0-5 with sizes 0xec0/0xc00 and formats 3/1) and registers them through 0x0055F8B8 on the current command list, then allocates a 0x1800-byte block (128 objects of 0x30 bytes) with Mem_AllocAligned and constructs it with 0x0055B980, clearing the cursor at self[7].

functions.name: Text_LayoutGlyphRunTwoPass
functions.signature: void Text_LayoutGlyphRunTwoPass(Text_Layout* self, unsigned context, GlyphRun* run, Text_Row* row, unsigned flags)
functions.summary: Lays out one glyph run for a text row: computes the run box (0x1E0x140 or 0xF0x140 for two-line mode), scales the glyph positions to the box and emits the quads twice through Text_BuildGlyphQuads - once per texture page.

functions.name: Text_CharFilter_Match
functions.signature: u32 Text_CharFilter_Match(int self, u8* outVisible, int charRecord, int kind, u32 filter, int inRect, int x, int y, int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY, u32 layerMask)
functions.summary: Decides whether one glyph is drawn: compares the glyph's layer/type bits (byte +2 & 0x1F, >>5) with the requested filter, tests the glyph rectangle against the clip rectangle and the 1<<(layer-1) layer mask, and returns 1 (draw) or 0 (skip) while also writing the decision to outVisible.

functions.name: Text_BuildGlyphQuads
functions.signature: void Text_BuildGlyphQuads(int self, u32 count, u32 * chars, float * layout, int line, float * clip, int arg7, u32 arg8, u32 arg9, u32 arg10, float scale)
functions.summary: Lays out the text of one line into 0x48-byte glyph quads: for every character it resolves the glyph metrics, clips to the visible rectangle, filters by layer, computes the screen/world quad corners and UVs and writes the instance array. This is the core text renderer: it calls 0x663FB8 Text_BuildCharTransform and the 0x663xxx glyph-metric helpers, and its output stride 0x48 matches the text instance format.

functions.name: maybe_Text_BuildGlyphQuadsThumb
functions.signature: void maybe_Text_BuildGlyphQuadsThumb(int self, u32 count, float * chars, float * layout)
functions.summary: Thumb fragment of the glyph-quad builder: the same per-character transform/UV loop as Text_BuildGlyphQuads (0x0055B984), which appears both as its caller and as its callee, so this is a mid-function split symbol rather than a separate routine. The body is damaged (unaff_r6/unaff_r7, BADSPACEBASE), so nothing beyond glyph-quad code is verifiable.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdList_BindTexture
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdList_BindTexture(unsigned int* table, unsigned int unit, int index, unsigned int ctx)
functions.summary: Binds one texture object from a per-pass resource table into the current PICA command list: it obtains the singleton command list for ctx and passes the resource at table[index+1] (offset table+4+index*4) plus the target unit to 0x0055FC5C.

functions.name: Gfx_SubmitScreenQuad
functions.signature: void Gfx_SubmitScreenQuad(unsigned arg1, unsigned target, unsigned x, unsigned y)
functions.summary: Submits a screen-space quad: derives the source rectangle from the current viewport (0x56C738) and forwards it to the draw-command builder (0x6F19A8).

functions.name: Gfx_State_SetAlphaBlend
functions.signature: void Gfx_State_SetAlphaBlend(unsigned int arg1, GfxState* state, char blendEnable)
functions.summary: Configures the packed alpha-blend state of the overlay state object: it starts from a default descriptor produced by 0x0050971C and, when blending is enabled, selects blend factors (4/3/0x0e/0x0f) and encodes the alpha byte from the float argument passed in s0 (value * 255), then applies the descriptor to state[1] via 0x00658050.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_FlushQuads
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_FlushQuads(GfxOverlay* self, unsigned int cmd, int* params)
functions.summary: Flushes the accumulated overlay quads: it resets the vertex-buffer write cursor, expands the compact 0x30-byte quad records at self+0x1c (count self->f_20) into 0x48-byte GPU vertex records (position/uv/colours, padding the 0.0 and 1.0 components), advances the buffer count, then issues the draw (0x006F19A8) and the finaliser 0x0055CE34.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_ValidateSlot
functions.summary: Reads the command buffer's current slot (self->f_18 indexed by its own f_18 word, stride 0xC), computes the base + index*0x48 entry address and, when the slot's end index and write index disagree, falls into the 12 x 0x70-byte construct-array path. The readable C stops at that call because the Thumb CRT helper std_ConstructArray is mis-marked noreturn, so the 540-byte body is not covered.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SamplerState_Write
functions.summary: Writes a three-byte PICA200 texture-sampler state into the draw command stream: mode 0 sets filter 1 / 0x80 / wrap 6, modes 1 and 2 swap the filter and wrap bytes, then the bytes are appended after the element command and the stream cursor at state+4 is updated.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_SetSamplerStateB
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_SetSamplerStateB(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, SamplerState* state, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
functions.summary: Prepares texture sampler state descriptor with wrap mode 5 and invokes PICA GPU packet encoder 0x00656B24 to update command buffer at state+4.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteScreenProjection
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteScreenProjection(void* state, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, int screen, unsigned int reserved)
functions.summary: Builds an orthographic pixel-to-clip matrix for the given screen (400x240 top or 320x240 bottom) and emits it plus the associated PICA state words into the command buffer, tagging the state object with the screen index. Ghidra's 4th argument is dead (it is only overwritten with 0x1e0/0xf0), so it is treated as scratch.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_SubmitQuad
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_SubmitQuad(GfxOverlayState* state, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, GfxNode** node, int* quadDesc, unsigned int limit)
functions.summary: Emits the GPU state for one overlay quad: rewinds the command-buffer slot to its saved mark, writes the texture sampler config and the draw elements, sets up the screen projection and appends the quad through Gfx_Overlay_AddQuad. Called once per render element from Gfx_SubmitSortedElement, so it is a per-quad submit, not a batch begin.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_SubmitSkinningData
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_SubmitSkinningData(Gfx_ModelInstance* instance, ModelDrawPacket* packet, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4)
functions.summary: Packs the model instance's per-vertex skinning data into the render command list: fetches the command-list singleton (0x6F2394) and forwards the packet to 0x55FE38, which appends the bone indices/weights.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ReleaseResources
functions.summary: Releases a model instance's five bound GPU resources and its heap block.

functions.name: Font_CalcGlyphScale
functions.signature: void Font_CalcGlyphScale(int glyph, u32 arg2, u32 charCode)
functions.summary: Computes the glyph scale factor 1.0/(charSize+0x20) and stores it in the glyph record's +0x3C word. The +0x20 bias is the standard ETC1/texture-unit padding of the bffnt glyph cell.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_SetMatrix
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_SetMatrix(int self, float * matrix, float * scale)
functions.summary: Applies a 4x4 model matrix and a scale vector to a model instance: writes the three scaled basis rows and translation to +0x1A0..+0x1CC, the raw matrix to +0x1D0..+0x1FC and the effective scale to +0x200..+0x220, refreshing the secondary-motion terms. The 12-float matrix layout at +0x1A0/+0x1D0 is the model-instance transform used by the draw code; the guard checks the instance and its linked node.

functions.name: Gfx_Texture_InitDescriptor
functions.signature: bool Gfx_Texture_InitDescriptor(TextureSlot* self, uint32_t heap, uint32_t unusedA, uint32_t unusedB, const uint32_t* sizeAndFormat)
functions.summary: Creates the descriptor for a 0x4E8-byte texture object: rounds the width/height fields up to powers of two, fills a descriptor block and instantiates the object through 0x0053082C.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelSlot_Assign
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelSlot_Assign(void* self, void* resource, int slot, u32 context)
functions.summary: Assigns a model-resource slot: if the slot table at (*(self+4))+0xC already holds an entry it is released through 0x52F6D0, and when a new resource is supplied its handle (resource+4) is installed with Gfx_ModelSlot_Replace using the owner at self+8.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_ReleaseSlotEmittersIfUnused
functions.summary: Drops the emitter group held by one instance slot: when the slot still points at the current resource (slot+8 == resource+0xC) and the resource is either still referenced (0x659318) or flagged (+0x288 / +4), it destroys the group with Fx_Group_DestroyEmitters and clears slot+4.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_Init
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_Init(ModelInstance* out, ModelResource* resource, int index, int frame, uint32_t flags, const float* transform)
functions.summary: Fills a model-instance record from a model resource: selects the animation frame, creates the instance with 0x00530014, copies the 4x4 transform and stores the per-frame scale/alpha derived from the frame byte.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_InitWithTransform
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_InitWithTransform(ModelInstance* out, ModelResource* resource, int index, int frame, uint32_t flags, const float* world, const float* scale)
functions.summary: Same as 0x0055DD7C but composes a full world matrix: stores the 4x4 matrix both raw and pre-multiplied by the per-instance scale into the instance record at 0x1A0..0x220.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateAnimators
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateAnimators(unsigned render, unsigned instance, unsigned char channel, unsigned arg4)
functions.summary: Advances the animation/pose chain of a model instance: resets the scene group (0x52E990) and steps the instance's unit list at the given channel (0x52F988).

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_SetPoseMatrix
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_SetPoseMatrix(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, InstanceSlot* slot, unsigned node, float* matrix)
functions.summary: Uploads a 4x4 pose matrix for one model node: zeroes the command block, stamps its type word, inverts the matrix translation (last column) and submits it through 0x5255B4.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ReleaseResource
functions.summary: Releases the model instance's current render resource through its vtable slot +4 (deleting release) and clears both the resource pointer (+4) and the cached handle (+8).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DtorLinked
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for a model instance that is linked into a list: stores the class vtable 0x00782714 in the object, unlinks it from its neighbours (self[2]/self[3]) and frees the block.

functions.name: Gfx_BindIndexedResourceSet
functions.signature: bool Gfx_BindIndexedResourceSet(GfxResourceSlot* self, uint32_t heap, ResDesc* desc, ModelInstance* owner)
functions.summary: Binds a texture/vertex resource set of kind 1 into a draw slot: allocates the vertex buffer (2*count + 4*indexCount), binds it with 0x00532BB8 and wires the index buffer and owner pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_MaterialBinding_Release
functions.summary: Releases the GPU resource held by a material binding object (pointer at +0x2C) through the resource releaser 0x0010F69C and clears the cached handle at +0x28.

functions.name: Gfx_MaterialBinding_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Destructor variant of the material binding class that additionally frees the object itself.

functions.name: Gfx_MaterialBinding_Dtor
functions.summary: In-place destructor of the material binding class: installs vtable g_0055E480 and releases the bound resource; returns the object pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_BindSingleResource
functions.signature: bool Gfx_BindSingleResource(GfxResourceSlot* self, uint32_t heap, ResDesc* desc, ModelInstance* owner)
functions.summary: Binds a single-buffered resource (kind 0) into a draw slot: allocates 2*count bytes and binds it with 0x00532CD0.

functions.name: Gfx_TextureBinding_Release
functions.summary: Releases the texture resource held at +0x24 and clears the cached handle at +0x20; the workhorse called whenever a model/UI object unbinds a texture.

functions.name: Gfx_TextureBinding_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Destructor variant of the texture binding class that also frees the object.

functions.name: Gfx_TextureBinding_Dtor
functions.summary: In-place destructor of the texture binding class: installs vtable g_0055E6B8, releases the texture and returns the object.

functions.name: Gfx_FlushCommandBuffer
functions.summary: Flushes a pending GPU command buffer: if new commands were written it submits them (func_006BA224/func_006BA200) and advances the read pointer, returning 1 when work was submitted.

functions.name: Gfx_Texture_Init
functions.summary: Creates the texture object held at self+4 and reports success.

functions.name: HeapAlloc
functions.signature: int HeapAlloc(int arg1, int arg2, int arg3)

functions.name: Gfx_InitMatrixSlotSet
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_InitMatrixSlotSet(MatrixSlotSet* self, void* owner, u16 index)
functions.summary: Initialises the four 0x30-byte transform blocks to identity, stores the owner pointer and slot index, writes 0xFF000000 into owner->table[index] (stride 0x278) and calls 0x0055F410; returns 1.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_BuildBoneMatrices
functions.summary: Builds the per-node transform block for a model instance: transforms up to four node entries into the GPU's packed 16-bit fixed-point matrix format and computes the normal matrix scale factors.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ConstructMatrixSlotArray
functions.summary: Stores the owner/type word at +0, clears the count at +4 and constructs four 0x30-byte elements at +8 with element ctor 0x0055F4A0 (the 4 x 0x30 layout used for identity matrices).

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceTable_InsertNode
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResourceTable_InsertNode(ResourceTable * self, u32 key, const ResKey * desc, u32 arg4, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Adds an entry to the ordered resource table: bumps the table's sequence counter, allocates and links a 0x38-byte node, fills its payload with maybe_Gfx_ResourceTable_Build, walks the red-black tree comparing the sequence number against node+0x14 and links the node with std__Rb_tree_insert_and_rebalance (replacing an existing node with the same sequence).

functions.name: maybe_Container_EraseByKey
functions.summary: Erases the tree entry at the lower bound of a key: walks the red-black tree at container+0x10/+0x18, and when the lower-bound node exists it tears the payload down (stops the timer through func_0010F69C, clears +0x30, destroys the list at +0, frees the block).

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceTable_InsertRange
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ResourceTable_InsertRange(ResourceTable* self, u32* outKeys, u32 count)
functions.summary: Inserts a run of resource descriptors into the table, stepping the source array by 0x10 bytes and writing each resulting key to the caller's output array.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceTable_Build
functions.signature: uint32_t Gfx_ResourceTable_Build(ResourceTable* self, uint32_t heap, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t arg4)
functions.summary: Builds two mirrored resource lists for a render object: lays out the 0x98-byte header blocks and 0x18-stride entries, patches the 12-entry command blocks, computes the buffer extents and appends the caller-supplied sub-resource list.

functions.name: Gfx_StateCache_EmitStateBlock
functions.signature: GfxCmdBuf* Gfx_StateCache_EmitStateBlock(void* self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, unsigned int key, unsigned int stateBlock)
functions.summary: Looks a state up in a balanced tree keyed by an integer, and only when the found node differs from the last applied state does it reserve space in the command buffer and copy that node's data block (two variants selected by node->f_30 == self->f_2c), then records the new offsets/cache pointers. Returns the command buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_PackSkinningBuffer
functions.signature: int Gfx_ModelInstance_PackSkinningBuffer(Gfx_PacketBuilder* builder, Gfx_VertexPacket* packet, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4)
functions.summary: Appends one model part's skinned vertex data to the command buffer: aligns the write pointer (0x508B9C), copies the bone weights/indices (0x508BE8), records the part's byte offset and stamps the buffer base on first use.

functions.name: maybe_Model_SecondaryMotion_BuildChains
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Model_SecondaryMotion_BuildChains(void* self, u32 allocTag, void* model)
functions.summary: Rebuilds a model's secondary-motion chains: clears old buffers, walks model->f_28 nodes and their 6-byte attribute names, classifies them against table 0x0072F49C (kinds 0..6), then allocates and constructs the chain entries. Returns 0 on an inconsistent attribute set.

functions.name: maybe_Model_ComputeSecondaryMotionMatrices
functions.summary: Thumb half of the secondary-motion (hair/cloth) simulation: for every bone it composes the parent matrix with the bone's local matrix, applies gravity/spring constants and stores the resulting world matrices used by the skinning pass.

functions.name: Model_SimulateSecondaryMotion
functions.signature: void Model_SimulateSecondaryMotion(SecondaryMotionChain* self, const float* ownerMatrix, ModelBoneMatrices* bones)
functions.summary: One physics substep of a secondary-motion chain (hair, skirt, cape): converts each particle into world space through the owner matrix, integrates velocity from the accumulated force offsets and damping, resolves the chain's joint constraints (type selected by psVar12[0]), and writes the updated particle positions and velocities back for the matrix rebuild.

functions.name: Model_BuildSecondaryMotionBoneMatrices
functions.signature: void Model_BuildSecondaryMotionBoneMatrices(SecondaryMotionChain* self, const float* ownerMatrix, ModelBoneMatrices* bones)
functions.summary: Converts the simulated particles of a secondary-motion chain back into model bone matrices: for every second bone it derives the particle orientation from the rest direction and the simulated direction, slerps the two orientations by the chain's blend weight, rebuilds the 3x4 matrix in the bone table and blends it against the original bone transform.

functions.name: Model_UpdateSecondaryMotion
functions.signature: void Model_UpdateSecondaryMotion(SecondaryMotionChain* self, const float* ownerMatrix, ModelBoneMatrices* bones)
functions.summary: Per-frame driver for a secondary-motion chain: handles the enable/fade-in/fade-out blend weight (+0x20), runs the two physics substeps and then rebuilds the bone matrices, and clears the per-frame constraint state. Returns immediately when the chain is disabled or fully faded out.

functions.name: Model_SecondaryMotion_Clear
functions.summary: Releases the three owned buffers (self+4, self+8, self+0xc) with the free routine and nulls them along with three flag bytes, i.e. the clear method of the model secondary-motion data class.

functions.name: Model_SecondaryMotion_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor: installs the class vtable word, calls Model_SecondaryMotion_Clear to free its buffers and then frees the object itself.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawParts
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawParts(GfxModelInstance* self, void* cmd, unsigned int mask, int bind)
functions.summary: Submits the model instance's draw calls: bit 1/2/4 of the mask select the three mesh parts, each issued with its texture/page parameters for the 3DS GPU.

functions.name: Pack_ReleaseHandleEntry
functions.summary: Releases one packed-resource handle: validates the generation/index against the global handle table, frees the entry and poisons the stored handle to 0xFFFFF000. Twenty call sites across UI, effects and events; the 0xFFFFF/0xFFFFF000 masks and the 8-byte table entries are the game's handle allocator.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadowPass_BuildCommands
functions.signature: void Gfx_CharShadowPass_BuildCommands(void* self, unsigned int allocTag, int mode)
functions.summary: Builds the character-shadow pass command list at init time: fills a 0x50-byte 0/1 sign matrix, allocates a 0xc80-byte command buffer, chains the PICA state builders, uploads texture-unit state, and for the curve/fade variant precomputes 64-entry cubic and linear falloff tables (64 * (i/128)^3 and 1 - i/128) before writing the packed 16-bit fixed-point shadow parameters. Stores the list and its length in self->f_7a0/f_7a4.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_AppendCommandList
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdBuf_AppendCommandList(void* self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, unsigned int state)
functions.summary: Replays the pre-built command list cached in self->f_7a0 (length self->f_7a4) into the command buffer at its current write pointer, advancing the pointer with 4-byte alignment after setting the block type via 0x0055CAD4.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_WriteQuadState
functions.summary: Emits one screen-quad state block: packs the quad colour with alpha = quad->f_40*255, copies the 3x4 part of the quad transform with a translation offset subtracted (quad->f_1c/f_2c/f_3c minus offset[0..2]), then writes the matrix via 0x0012558C and 0x00657258 from the engine state at self+0x790.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_ReleaseBuffers
functions.summary: Releases the two auxiliary buffers of a large Gfx object: frees +0x79C through 0x10F6CC and +0x7A0 through 0x10F69C (both are the 'load vtable from p-8, tail-call slot +4' deleting-destructor dispatch) and clears both fields.

functions.name: Gfx_BindResourceSetVariant
functions.signature: bool Gfx_BindResourceSetVariant(GfxResourceSlot* self, uint32_t heap, ResDesc* desc, ModelInstance* owner)
functions.summary: Binds a resource descriptor of kind 2 into a draw slot, using the alternate bind helper 0x00532DE8.

functions.name: Gfx_MaterialSet_Release
functions.summary: Releases the material/texture-set resource held at +0x24 and clears the cached handle at +0x20; used when a render object or script text resource drops its material set.

functions.name: Gfx_MaterialSet_Dtor
functions.summary: In-place destructor of the material-set class: installs vtable g_0056429C and releases the material set; returns the object.

functions.name: Gfx_CopyBufferData
functions.signature: void Gfx_CopyBufferData(GfxBufferRef* ref, unsigned int* dst, unsigned int count, int stride, int offset, int base)
functions.summary: Copies a block of buffer data (count*stride words) into the destination object with the size flags the 3DS GPU DMA path expects.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadow_InitVertexLayout
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_CharShadow_InitVertexLayout(unsigned int* self, unsigned int allocTag, int count, unsigned int indexCount)
functions.summary: Allocates count*0x90 of vertex data and an index/offset table of indexCount words, pre-filling the table with 0,1,2,3,... pairs, then installs the vertex attribute descriptors (byte pairs 0..4, 5/0xf/7, and pointers into self) used later to build the shadow geometry. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: maybe_Mem_ReleaseRecordPairB
functions.summary: Releases the two owned pointers of a resource record - block[0] and block[7] (offset +0x1C) - through the deleting-destructor thunk 0x10F69C and clears both fields.

functions.name: Anim_AdvanceTimelineValue
functions.signature: void Anim_AdvanceTimelineValue(AnimTimeline* value, AnimTimelineLimit* limit, float delta)
functions.summary: Advances one animation/effect clock by delta: saves the previous value at +8, keeps the new value inside [0, limit] when the limit's wrap flag is clear, or wraps it modulo the limit with fmodf when the flag is set. This is the shared clock advance used by the scene/timeline objects in the 0x55-0x5A range.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawItemList
functions.summary: Submits every entry of a small draw list: for the f_45 entries of 0xC bytes it calls the GPU draw command emitter with the entry's three words.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_BindAllResources
functions.summary: Binds every resource set of a model instance: iterates the model's resource-set array and the optional per-part extension list, aggregating the binding status. The two loops over self->f_30's set count and part list call the two binders of this batch (0x5348D0 and 0x5356A4); called from the resource-list attach path.

functions.name: Script_LoadBytecodeOrText
functions.signature: unsigned int Script_LoadBytecodeOrText(unsigned int vm, unsigned int owner, int data, int size)
functions.summary: Loads a script from a memory buffer: rejects null data/size ('invalid argument'), detects compiled bytecode by the 0xFAFA magic (64250) and parses it, otherwise checks for a UTF-8 BOM (0xbbef 0xBF) and compiles the source text, returning an error object with a readable message when anything fails.

functions.name: Pack_ParseContainerHeader
functions.summary: Validates a packed resource header (magic g_00564b38, minimum version g_00564b40) and resolves the five section offsets by walking the header's self-relative u16/word pairs.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadow_InitCurveParams
functions.signature: void Gfx_CharShadow_InitCurveParams(void* self, unsigned int allocTag)
functions.summary: Initialises the character-shadow curve/blend parameter block: runs the class constructor, copies a 0x1a-byte template, then fills ~0x100 bytes of thresholds and weights (luminance weights 0.299/0.587/0.114, 60.0, 0.1, 400.0/240.0 screen extents, defaults 0xffff/0xff/0xffffffff) used when generating the shadow fade curve table.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_InitTextureSlotUV
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_InitTextureSlotUV(int self, int slot, int enabled)
functions.summary: Per-slot texture setup: stores the enable flag, reads two dimensions out of a tagged 0x82 descriptor record through 0x0056C738 when enabled, converts them to floats and resets the slot's UV rectangle to (0,0)-(1,1).

functions.name: Model_Face_UpdateBlink
functions.summary: Updates a character model's facial animation: advances the blink timers, computes eye-open and mouth-open amounts with a fade curve, picks the matching texture frame bytes (+0xE8/+0xE9) from the frame table and clears the eye/mouth flags when a sequence ends.

functions.name: Model_Face_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame face controller update: advances the blink timer, calls Model_Face_UpdateBlink, and when a blink/mouth sequence ends schedules the next one using two random intervals scaled by the face constants.

functions.name: Container_ResizeBuffer
functions.signature: unsigned Container_ResizeBuffer(Container* self, unsigned newSize, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4)
functions.summary: Grows a container's buffer: allocates newSize through the container's allocator vtable, copies min(oldSize,newSize) bytes and frees the old block through vtable slot +0x10.

functions.name: Bg2D_FindTexturePageByName
functions.signature: void Bg2D_FindTexturePageByName(Bg2DPageTable* self, int slot, const char* name)
functions.summary: Searches the texture-page name table at +0x04 for an entry whose name equals the given string, stores its index in the per-slot field self+slot*4+0x34 and sets the resolved flag at +0x94.

functions.name: Model_Instance_BuildNodeBoundsChecked
functions.signature: u32 Model_Instance_BuildNodeBoundsChecked(u32 model, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d, u32 e)
functions.summary: Validating wrapper around Model_Instance_BuildNodeBounds: first checks that the model handle is usable (0x0057B308) and only then builds the node bounds, returning 1 when both steps succeeded.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneObject_CullAndDrawParts
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneObject_CullAndDrawParts(Gfx_SceneObject* self, unsigned cmdList, unsigned arg3, float* bounds)
functions.summary: Culls and draws the parts of a scene object: tests each part's bounding box (6 floats) against the view volume, copies the visible parts' matrices to the draw list, then emits them with 0x125404/0x12515C and finally draws the attached effect slot.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_WriteMeshCommands
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_WriteMeshCommands(int self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, unsigned int state, unsigned short* meshDesc, unsigned int flags, unsigned int* drawState)
functions.summary: Emits the draw commands for all sub-meshes of a model instance: per material/pass entry (stride 0x2c, state block stride 0x158) it writes the state blocks, texture reference, and then per node (self->f_178, matrices at self->f_16c, stride 0x30) the 12-word node matrix plus the mesh's index/vertex block, restoring the buffer position at the end.

functions.name: Model_Instance_BuildNodeBounds
functions.signature: unsigned int Model_Instance_BuildNodeBounds(int self, unsigned int allocTag, unsigned int reserved, void* mesh)
functions.summary: Builds per-node world-space AABBs for a model instance: it allocates node matrices (count*0x60 with the second half at +count*0x30), reads the mesh's 'aabbMin'/'aabbMax' attributes, and for every node transforms the box corners by the node's 3x4 matrix (abs-sum conservative extents) into 6-float min/max pairs. Returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DeletingDtor_vt782294
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a Gfx model-instance subclass: installs the derived vtable 0x00782294, frees the two derived heap blocks, then installs the base vtable 0x007828B0, runs Gfx_ModelInstance_FreeBuffers again, unlinks the three intrusive list nodes and frees the object.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadow_InitPassState
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_CharShadow_InitPassState(unsigned int* self, unsigned int allocTag, unsigned int owner)
functions.summary: Allocates and fills the shadow-pass state object: a 0x40-byte 16-float projection/texel matrix built from 0.875 and 0.21875 coefficients, plus two 0x5000-byte buffers (command list and vertex/index area) that are double-buffered via self[1]/self[4]. Returns 1.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOptionalPasses
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOptionalPasses(GfxModelInstance* self, void* cmd, void* ctx, int include_hidden)
functions.summary: Draws a model instance's optional draw passes: up to three screen-sprite passes (f_50/f_74/f_98), the projection pass (f_210) and either the screen-space or the fullscreen-quad pass (f_e8), then submits the skinning data when the pass list changed.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawWithGxState
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawWithGxState(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, unsigned cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
functions.summary: Sets the GPU state block for one model instance draw (blend/alpha-test/depth/cull words from the instance's flags) and then emits the parts with 0x568BB4; the block is only rebuilt when the mode word is not already 0xF.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawAllPasses
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawAllPasses(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, unsigned cmdList, unsigned arg3)
functions.summary: Drives every optional draw pass of a model instance: shadow/silhouette (f_74), alpha-scaled body (f_98/f_50, skipped when alpha is 1), vertex-colour passes (f_31/f_4d), light pass (f_1dc), effect pass (f_e8/f_f8) and the transparent pass when the alpha threshold is not 0.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawAlphaBlendQuad
functions.signature: void Gfx_DrawAlphaBlendQuad(unsigned int self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, unsigned int state, unsigned int texture, unsigned int arg5, unsigned short arg6)
functions.summary: Draws a textured alpha-blended quad: converts the float alpha (passed in s0) to 0..255 with the 1.0/2.0 break points and the matching blend mode, sets up the texture/physical-address reference, emits the command through Gfx_Pica_EmitModelTextureBindings and finally draws it with Gfx_ModelInstance_BindTextureAndDraw.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTexturedPass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTexturedPass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, unsigned* cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
functions.summary: Textured material pass of a model instance: binds the instance's texture slots, builds the draw packet and emits every part; used when the material has texture entries (f_104 > 0).

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTexCoordPass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTexCoordPass(unsigned self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4, unsigned arg5, unsigned arg6, unsigned arg7, unsigned arg8, unsigned arg9, unsigned arg10)
functions.summary: Draw pass that rebuilds the texture-coordinate matrix per part and emits the parts with the alternate texture-matrix state.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawMultiStatePass
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawMultiStatePass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
functions.summary: Model draw pass gated by material float f_1B8: combines the texture-matrix pass with its own state block and per-part texture matrices, then emits the parts.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawScreenSpacePass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawScreenSpacePass(int self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, unsigned int state, int* passState, int* texState, int letterbox)
functions.summary: Screen-aligned quad pass: builds a 4x4 matrix for a 320/400-wide centred quad (1/512 scale), sets the pass state and texture descriptor and submits the draw.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOverridePass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOverridePass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, u32 cmdList, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Draws an instance through its material-override list when it has one (self->f_20->f_154): runs the override-material pass and, if that pass did not consume the override (the 5/0x11 pair is unchanged), submits the packed skinning data directly.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawScreenSprite
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawScreenSprite(int self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, unsigned int state, unsigned int* sprite, int* passState, int* texState, int arg7)
functions.summary: Blits a 2D sprite: scales the sprite rect (sprite[1]/sprite[2] size, sprite[4..6] sub-rect, sprite[7] alpha, sprite[8] flag) into the 320/400-wide screen, packs the alpha as 8-bit and the flag as a filter/format selector, writes the texture descriptor and submits the draw packet.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawSimplePass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawSimplePass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
functions.summary: Plain model pass: installs the default GX state block and emits the instance's parts without any optional effect, used for unlit materials and for the depth/silhouette write.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawShadowPass
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawShadowPass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
functions.summary: Projected model-instance pass: builds the projection matrices through 0x00673BC8/0x00672E44, stamps the command block and emits each part.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_BindTextureAndDraw
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_BindTextureAndDraw(int self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, void* resource, void* texture)
functions.summary: Common tail of every model-instance pass: converts the texture virtual addresses to physical, binds the texture set (0x00509328) with the packed texture-unit state block, and emits the final GPU packet for the accumulated quad via 0x006F11A8.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawEdgePass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawEdgePass(unsigned self, int cmdList, int* state, int arg4, int* mode, unsigned* out)
functions.summary: Outline/edge pass: derives the screen-space edge width from the current viewport, sets the edge/outline GX state and emits the instance's parts (twice when a second render target is active).

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTexturedPart
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTexturedPart(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Emits the texture-unit command chain for one textured part and draws it: Gfx_Pica_EmitDrawElements, Gfx_Pica_EmitTextureSamplerStateEx, Gfx_CommandNode_BuildChain4, Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureDescriptor, Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureUnitBlock, then Gfx_ModelInstance_BindTextureAndDraw.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawVertexColorPass
functions.signature: unsigned Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawVertexColorPass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, int* state, int* mode, int* modeOut, int flag)
functions.summary: Vertex-colour/blend pass: derives the part colour from the instance colour (byte-swapped words), installs the colour-channel GX state and emits the parts, optionally with a second blend target.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTexturedPartB
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTexturedPartB(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Second texture-unit emitter of the model-instance draw code: loops over the part's texture units calling 0x656ACC/0x65654C/0x658050 and Gfx_CommandNode_InitSixSlots, then binds and draws; the symbol size (132 bytes) is wrong, the body runs past 0x569368.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawRectPass
functions.summary: Thumb-compiled copy of the rect pass inlined in 0x00569518: builds the draw packet, applies the colour state, submits through 0x00568BB4, sets the texture matrix, writes seven texture units and finishes with the rect command.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawFullscreenQuadPass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawFullscreenQuadPass(int self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, unsigned int state, int* passState, unsigned int* texState)
functions.summary: Pass emitter for a screen-filling quad: writes a 4x4 transform made only of -1.0/1.0/0.0, then - when the pass state is 6 - applies colour state, binds the texture set, sets the texture matrix, writes 7 texture units and emits a rect covering 400x240. Otherwise it falls through to the matrix/state setup path.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawTwoSidedPass
functions.summary: Draws a two-sided material: emits the instance twice with opposite culling state so both faces of the mesh are rendered.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawProjectionPass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawProjectionPass(int self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int state, int mode, int flag)
functions.summary: Projection pass: when the instance carries a projection matrix it scales it, installs the projection GX state and emits the parts.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawScreenRectPass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawScreenRectPass(int self, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, unsigned int state, unsigned int* rect, int mode)
functions.summary: Draws a textured rectangle described by integer fields: it maps rect[4..0xb] (position/size) and the 16-bit fields at 0xe/0xc into clip space for a 480x400 or 240x320 target and writes the resulting 4x4 matrix, then submits the packet for rect[0] and draws it.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawReflectionPass
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawReflectionPass(int self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4, unsigned arg5)
functions.summary: Special model-instance pass that builds a 0x100-byte texture matrix and emits the instance parts with it; only used by the overlay main-screen renderer when the Field2D/overlay state f_1310 is set.

functions.name: maybe_Mem_ReleaseRecordTriple
functions.summary: Releases the three owned pointers of a resource record - self[0], self[3] (+0xC) and self[7] (+0x1C) - and zeroes the six header words self[0..5]; same body as 0x00579794 plus the third pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOverrideMaterialPass
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawOverrideMaterialPass(Gfx_ModelInstance* instance, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* override, int* mode)
functions.summary: Draws a model instance with an override material: installs that material's GX state and emits every part through the shared part emitter.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawRectMatrixPass
functions.summary: Thumb-compiled rect-matrix pass: writes the same 4x4 matrix as 0x005698D4, sets the pass state, writes the draw packet and submits through 0x00568BB4.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawFogPass
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawFogPass(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
functions.summary: Model draw pass gated by material byte f_119: chains the texture-matrix pass with the extra state command and emits all parts.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawAlphaBlendPass
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawAlphaBlendPass(int self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* state, int* mode)
functions.summary: Alpha-blend draw pass: computes the blend factors (including the gamma path through std_Powf) and installs the alpha state before emitting each part.

functions.name: maybe_Text_DrawBlock_Label
functions.summary: Interior label of the text/console draw routine: builds a 0x1f4-byte stack request, initialises it through 0x00509638/0x00657E28 and submits it to 0x00568BB4. Seed-table label, not a function entry (the C is a halt stub).

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpritePass
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpritePass(int self, int cmdList, unsigned arg3, unsigned layer, int arg5, unsigned char arg6, unsigned arg7, int arg8, unsigned arg9, int arg10)
functions.summary: Material pass of an overlay sprite: builds the texture/colour state block for the sprite, applies the texture stage and emits the sprite parts into the command list.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPassDispatcher
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPassDispatcher(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, unsigned cmdList, unsigned arg3)
functions.summary: Second top-level draw dispatcher for model instances: appends the vertex buffers and then runs the individual passes according to the instance flags, covering nearly every Draw* routine in this cluster.

functions.name: maybe_Model_BuildAimPartList
functions.signature: void maybe_Model_BuildAimPartList(u32 owner, u32 partA, u32 partB, u32 partC)
functions.summary: Builds the aim-part descriptors for Model_AttachAimParts: copies the owner/part ids into locals and default-constructs two 0x40-byte descriptors in a 428-byte stack buffer. Ghidra lost the remaining ~1.4 KB of the function, so the descriptor contents stay unknown.

functions.name: Model_CalcLookAtAngles
functions.signature: void Model_CalcLookAtAngles(LookAtController* self, Model* model, u32 arg3, float* outYaw, float* outPitch)
functions.summary: Computes the horizontal and vertical rotation ratios a model needs to face its look-at target: transforms the target into the model's space, projects the offset onto the horizontal and vertical planes, takes the acos of the normalised components and applies the controller's per-axis limits (+0x324/+0x328), smoothing (+0x32C/+0x330) and rate (+0x334).

functions.name: Model_UpdateLookAt
functions.signature: u32 Model_UpdateLookAt(LookAtController* self, Model* model, ModelBoneMatrices* bones)
functions.summary: Applies head/body look-at: computes the target yaw/pitch ratios (or reuses the smoothed ones while the controller fades out), slerps each of the two affected bone rotations toward the computed target orientation with its own blend factor, converts them into 3x4 matrices in the bone table and returns 0 once the blend and angles have settled, 1 while look-at is still running.

functions.name: maybe_Font_CallGlyphSlots18
functions.summary: Calls vtbl[0x18] on every registered glyph handler (array at +0x14, count at +0x10) - one of six broadcast helpers used to push a state change to every glyph slot.

functions.name: maybe_Font_CallGlyphSlots1C
functions.summary: Broadcast helper calling vtbl[0x1c] on every glyph handler.

functions.name: Font_DispatchGlyphEvent
functions.signature: void Font_DispatchGlyphEvent(FontGlyphTable* self, u32 event, u32 code character, u32 event2)
functions.summary: Dispatches a glyph event to the first handler that claims the given character code: calls vtbl[0x24](handler, code) and, on a match, tail-calls vtbl[0x0c](handler, a2, code, a4).

functions.name: Font_FindHandlerForCode
functions.signature: int Font_FindHandlerForCode(FontGlyphTable* self, u32 code character, u32 query, u32 query2, u32 query3)
functions.summary: Finds the glyph handler responsible for a character code by checking the handler's [min,max] range (fields +8/+0xc) and then calling its vtbl[8]; returns the handler's result or 0.

functions.name: Font_QueryGlyphHandler
functions.summary: Queries every glyph handler with vtbl[0x10](handler, a2, code) and returns the first non-zero answer.

functions.name: Font_BroadcastGlyphDraw
functions.signature: void Font_BroadcastGlyphDraw(FontGlyphTable* self, u32 draw, u32 draw2, u32 draw3, float arg5)
functions.summary: Broadcasts a draw/render call (four register arguments plus one float) to every glyph handler through vtbl[0x20], ignoring the results.

functions.name: Gfx_Resource_FindSizeRecord
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_Resource_FindSizeRecord(unsigned short* width, unsigned short* height, unsigned int* desc, unsigned short tag)
functions.summary: Walks a tagged descriptor/command stream, skipping records by their embedded length field, until it finds the record whose tag word is 0x82, then returns its two 11-bit fields (width and height style) through the out pointers. Returns 1 when found, 0 at end of stream.

functions.name: Font_GlyphCache_AllocSpan
functions.summary: Allocates a free span of `size` texels in the glyph page cache: rounds the request up to the page's allocation granularity (computed with the popcount trick), scans the 0x58-byte page/block descriptors for a free run whose accumulated width reaches the request, then splits the block (and trims following free blocks) so the returned cell has exactly the requested size. Returns 0 when nothing fits.

functions.name: Font_GlyphCache_FreeSpan
functions.signature: void Font_GlyphCache_FreeSpan(FontGlyphCache* self, u32 offset, int end)
functions.summary: Frees the glyph cell containing the given offset and merges it with the following free cells: marks the cell unused, clears its state, then repeatedly folds the next free cell's size into it.

functions.name: Font_GlyphCache_AddGlyph
functions.signature: int Font_GlyphCache_AddGlyph(FontGlyphCache* self, u32 code character, u32 size, const char* name, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Creates a glyph atlas entry for a character: allocates a cell of the requested size, marks it used with quality 0xff, copies the glyph key string (up to 0x3f chars) plus the 13 metric words into the cell, and returns the cell's pixel offset.

functions.name: Font_GlyphCache_FindGlyph
functions.signature: FontGlyphCell* Font_GlyphCache_FindGlyph(FontGlyphCache* self, const char* key, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Looks up an existing glyph cell by key string and owner tag, marking it used (and quality 0xff) when found; returns 0 otherwise. Used to avoid re-rasterising a glyph that is still cached.

functions.name: Font_GlyphPage_FillTexels
functions.signature: void Font_GlyphPage_FillTexels(FontGlyphCache* self, u32 x, int* cursor, u32 scale, int height)
functions.summary: Rasterises the cached glyph cells of a page into the atlas texture band: walks the cell list, converts each cell's fixed-point boxes to pixels, selects the coverage/colour value for used/dirty/free cells (0xff/0x80 and packed colour words) and advances the destination cursor. This is the atlas upload/fill pass.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureUnitBlock
functions.signature: unsigned int* Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureUnitBlock(void* texState, unsigned int* cmd)
functions.summary: Emits one texture-unit command group: packs the format/mip flags into a state word, writes the 0x000F0083 PICA command, the format byte and the 0x000F008E block, then copies the descriptor's texel data into the command buffer and returns the advanced cursor.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureUnitBlock2
functions.signature: unsigned int* maybe_Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureUnitBlock2(void* texState, unsigned int* cmd)
functions.summary: Emits one texture-block GPU command group: packs the state word with bit 0x10000000, writes the command pair 0x000F0093/0x000F0096 and copies the data block from *(texState+8) with the count at *(texState+0xC).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_CreateDefault
functions.summary: Default-constructs a model part: allocates the block, runs func_00579974, installs vtable 0x00782140 and clears the field at +0x60.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_MaterialBinding_CreateDefault
functions.summary: Default-constructs a material binding: allocates the block, sets up the intrusive list at +4, installs vtable 0x0078217C with the resource type descriptor at +0x10 and initialises the sub-object at +0x60 with func_0056EE88.

functions.name: Font_GlyphCache_MarkFree
functions.summary: Releases the 0x54-byte glyph cell that contains the given offset without coalescing: clears the in-use flag and, unless the global 'keep data' byte g_0056D8C0 is set, clears the cell's state.

functions.name: Font_GlyphCache_AllocSlot
functions.signature: int Font_GlyphCache_AllocSlot(FontGlyphCache* self, u32 size, u32 arg3, const char* key, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Allocates a glyph cell from the simpler 0x54-byte cell table: prefers the first completely free cell, otherwise the free cell with the best quality byte, marks it used, copies the key string and metrics, and returns the cell's pixel offset.

functions.name: Font_GlyphCache_Find
functions.signature: FontGlyphCell* Font_GlyphCache_Find(FontGlyphCache* self, const char* key, u32 owner)
functions.summary: Finds a cached glyph cell in the 0x54-stride table by key string and owner tag, marking it used on a hit; returns 0 when absent.

functions.name: XRf
functions.signature: void XRf(int arg1, u32 arg2, int * arg3, u32 arg4, int arg5)

functions.name: Text_Renderer_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a text renderer: releases the animation bindings (0x00535580), releases the two render objects through their vtbl[4], frees the font/texture buffer at +0x3c/+0x40 and clears the state byte.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelResource_CreateFromDescriptor
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_ModelResource_CreateFromDescriptor(void* self, void* desc, void* allocator)
functions.summary: Creates a GPU model resource from a descriptor: resolves the six section pointers, sums the aligned block sizes (0x10/0x80 alignment), allocates the block plus the index/vertex buffers through the caller's allocator, loads the model (Gfx_Bch_LoadModel), records the sub-block offsets in the resource's 0xC-byte table and registers the resource in the engine list.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ApplyColorState
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_ApplyColorState(const unsigned* colorBlock, unsigned cmdList)
functions.summary: Uploads one colour/material state packet to the GPU command list: copies the 0x10-byte colour block (RGBA, blend mode, two channel bytes) into a fresh GX colour command (0x6579C8).

functions.name: Fs_Stream_OpenByPath
functions.summary: Opens a stream from an 'archive:member' path: formats '%s:%s' with the archive name, converts it to UTF-16, splits it into mount and member, then opens the member through the stream vtable +0x24 and marks the stream open.

functions.name: Fs_Stream_ReadChunk
functions.signature: int Fs_Stream_ReadChunk(FsStream* self, void* dst, uint32_t size) Evidence: (*self->f_34->vtable[0])(...) then (*self->f_34->vtable[0x28])(self->f_34 arg3, & local_14, dst dst2, size size)
functions.summary: Reads a chunk through the stream's virtual read slot, returns the byte count and updates the caller's cursor block.

functions.name: Fs_Stream_FreeBuffer
functions.summary: Frees the stream's cached buffer when the stream is marked as owning one, honouring the low 'allocator reference' bit.

functions.name: Fs_Stream_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a named file stream: installs vtable g_0056ec10, initialises the 0xE-word state (buffer handles, path pointers) and opens the requested archive member (0x56E98C).

functions.name: Fs_Stream_Destroy
