functions.summary: Destructor for a named stream object: restores vtable 0x007823CC, frees the two cached buffers (at 0xD and 8) with the owned-bit convention and clears the flags.

functions.name: Script_ByteStream_Init
functions.signature: u32 Script_ByteStream_Init(ScriptByteStream* self, u32 base, u32 end)
functions.summary: Initialises a byte-stream reader over a memory range: stores the base at +0x14 and the end at +0x1C, clears the position at +0x18 and resets the cursor state.

functions.name: Fs_Stream_SetBufferLimits
functions.summary: Configures a file stream's decode buffer window: stores the base pointer at +0x14, zeroes the read cursor at +0x18 and installs the limit at +0x1C, then initialises the internal block reader (0x0051CD3C) with that range and resets the cursor to base. Returns 1.

functions.name: Fs_Stream_ReadFromBuffer
functions.signature: int Fs_Stream_ReadFromBuffer(FsStream* self, void* destination, u32 size)
functions.summary: Consumes up to `size` bytes from the stream's in-memory buffer (limited by the remaining length), copies them to the destination and advances the cursor; returns the number of bytes consumed, 0 when nothing is left.

functions.name: Script_ByteStream_Read
functions.signature: int Script_ByteStream_Read(void* self, void* buf, unsigned int size, unsigned int count)
functions.summary: Reads count items of size bytes by calling the stream's virtual read slot (+0x24) once per item and returns the total byte count; the script loader calls it to pull the 2-byte and 1-byte pieces of the UTF-8 BOM.

functions.name: Text_Renderer_Dtor2
functions.summary: Second text renderer destructor: releases the animation bindings and both render objects (+0x34 and +0x38) through their vtbl[4], then clears the state byte. The +0x38 variant suggests a second surface/page.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelResource_LoadFromRecord
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_ModelResource_LoadFromRecord(int self, int record, u32* allocators)
functions.summary: Loads a model resource from an already-packed record: rebases the six section offsets, allocates the vertex/index buffers (4- and 0x10-aligned) through the supplied allocators, hands everything to Gfx_Bch_LoadModel and marks the resource ready, freeing both buffers again if the load fails.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteColorState
functions.signature: void Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteColorState(unsigned int* cmd, int useRgb, unsigned char* rgb, int useAlpha, unsigned char alpha)
functions.summary: Appends two colour state descriptors to the command buffer: a 3-byte RGB group gated by useRgb and a separate 1-byte alpha group gated by useAlpha.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_Entry_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a cache entry: erases the entry's intrusive node range from its container and, when +0x14 is set, also erases the entry's red-black-tree node, then returns the entry pointer (vtable destructor convention).

functions.name: Fs_NamedObject_AttachStream
functions.summary: Links a stream into a named object: inserts the stream's list node into the object's intrusive list at +0x7C and stores the object back-pointer at stream+0x54.

functions.name: Fs_NamedObject_Register
functions.signature: NamedObject* Fs_NamedObject_Register(NamedObject* self, uint32_t owner, const char* name)
functions.summary: Registers a named object in the global slot table: allocates a 21-bit slot id from the rotating counter, stores it in the object's packed id field, links three intrusive lists and computes the name hash (FNV-1a).

functions.name: Fs_NamedObject_GetOrCreate
functions.signature: void Fs_NamedObject_GetOrCreate(uint32_t owner, TreeNode* parent, uint32_t key, const char* name)
functions.summary: Find-or-create a named node under a parent tree: hashes the name with FNV-1a, searches the ordered tree for the key, and only allocates and inserts a 0x98-byte node when it is missing.

functions.name: Ui_Window_Release20Entries
functions.summary: Releases the 20 child elements stored at self+0x34 with a 0x28-byte stride by calling each one's virtual destructor/release (+0x18). Called by the window colour/state setter; the fixed 0x14 (20) count and 0x28 stride are the window's fixed slot table.

functions.name: Fs_NamedObject_Open
functions.summary: Opens one named object from an archive: marks the request 'opening' (state 2), looks the name up, attaches the stream on success or records an error, then sets state 3 and pushes the request back to the archive's completion ring buffer at +0x790.

functions.name: Fs_NamedObject_FindAndRead
functions.summary: Finds the reader that owns a name in the global reader list, runs its vtable+0x14 (accepts?) then vtable+0x10 (open) and finally reads the name into the record with 0x005798CC. Returns the resolved reader entry or 0.

functions.name: Fs_NamedObject_ReadRecord
functions.summary: Reads one record for a slot: first tries the fast path through the slot's virtual reader, otherwise falls back to the buffered stream reader (0x0056EB8C/0x0056EAC4) and retries with the fallback slot index at 0x33C.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourcePool_Purge
functions.summary: Frees the blocks held by one pool slot (or all slots when index<0): walks the slot's block list, unlinks each block's handle-table entry and releases it via func_00115358/func_00115390.

functions.name: Fs_Worker_ProcessQueue
functions.summary: Body of the filesystem worker thread: pops open requests from the queue at +0x1BCC, releases each request's node list, updates the per-type byte counters at worker+type*0x28, recycles the request into the ring buffer at +0x2000, and when the open queue is empty waits on the +0x35C queue before running the open path (0x0056F7A4) for the next request.

functions.name: Fs_Worker_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the file-system worker object: installs the two-part vtable 0x7824A4/0x7824BC, destroys the 3 x 0xC-byte entries at +0x2C40 and tears down the two critical-section-protected queues at +0x2000 and +0x8C0. The object is the Fs worker used by 0x56FDD0 maybe_Fs_Worker_ProcessQueue; the +0x2C40 array and the two 0x434/0x143C-spaced sections are the worker's queues.

functions.name: Container_Tree_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a small container: erases every node of the tree rooted at self+4 using the successor walk and releases the header reference.

functions.name: Mem_BitmapPool_Init
functions.signature: void* Mem_BitmapPool_Init(MemPool* self, unsigned blockSize, unsigned blockCount, void* allocator)
functions.summary: Initialises a pool object: self[0..2] become a circular free-list head, a global single instance is created once (guarded by the byte at 0x007BE37C) by allocating a bitmap plus block area, and the pool parameters are stored at +0xc/+0x10/+0x14. The three init-time callers register one pool per engine object type.

functions.name: maybe_Script_CheckObjectTypeId
functions.summary: One of ~226 identical 44-byte predicates: returns 1 when scriptValue[1] == 1 and scriptValue[2] carries that class's hard-coded 32-bit id, else 0. Looks like the script-binding type check for a native class; exact class unknown because the Ghidra "function" is the whole table.

functions.name: Gfx_Context_SetTextureMatrix
functions.signature: void Gfx_Context_SetTextureMatrix(Gfx_TextureMatrix* out, unsigned src, unsigned scale, unsigned offset, unsigned mode)
functions.summary: Fills a texture-matrix/texgen parameter block for the renderer: stores the source texture, scale and offset words in the three parallel slot groups (0/2/3, 0xB/0xC/0x10, 0xC/0x11) and sets the texgen mode to 3.

functions.name: maybe_Container_Node_DtorVtableSlot1
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the class whose vtable is 0x007824E0, and literally that vtable's slot 1: vtable install, conditional release of the inline string at +0x1C, unlink of the two intrusive list heads, free.

functions.name: Math_BuildQuaternionFromEulerAlt
functions.summary: Alternative Euler-to-quaternion conversion (the SQRT branch is inverted relative to 0x572D94): produces a unit quaternion from three radian angles. Both functions have the identical 0.159155 (=1/2pi), 6.283185, 0.5, 1.0 constants and the same three-axis composition, only the sign of the square-root correction differs.

functions.name: Math_BuildQuaternionFromEuler
functions.summary: Converts three Euler angles (radians) into a quaternion using the half-angle sin/cos product; used for every actor placement and model transform. Thirty-six call sites across field actors, models, sprites and cameras; the 1/2pi scaling, PI comparison for the sign fix and the four-component output are conclusive.

functions.name: Math_MatrixInverse
functions.summary: Inverts a 4x4 affine matrix: computes the 3x3 cofactor matrix and determinant (with the identity fallback for a singular matrix) and builds the inverse translation from the source translation column. The explicit cofactor expansion and the 1/determinant scale are unmistakable; callers include the secondary-motion bone and battle target-marker updates.

functions.name: Math_ComputeBoundingSphere
functions.signature: void Math_ComputeBoundingSphere(float* outSphere, unsigned count, const void* points, unsigned stride)
functions.summary: Computes the minimum enclosing sphere of a strided point array and writes centre xyz + radius. It copies the point addresses into an on-stack pointer array and delegates to the Welzl solver at 0x5737A4, so callers get the same result as the recursive routine with an empty boundary set.

functions.name: Math_MinimumEnclosingSphere
functions.signature: void Math_MinimumEnclosingSphere(float* outSphere, void** points, unsigned count, int boundaryCount)
functions.summary: Welzl-style minimum enclosing sphere: for boundary sizes 1..4 it builds the sphere through those support points (point, midpoint, circumcircle, circumsphere) and otherwise recursively tries each remaining point as a boundary point. Output is xyz + radius.

functions.name: Math_ComputeRotatedAabb
functions.signature: float* Math_ComputeRotatedAabb(float* out, const void* transform)
functions.summary: Computes the axis-aligned bounds of an oriented box: takes the centre (+0x10) and half extents (+0x1C..+0x24), transforms four sign-flipped corners, keeps per-axis maxima of the absolute results and writes min xyz / max xyz as 6 floats.

functions.name: Math_BuildBoundsFromSphereAndOffset
functions.summary: Builds a world-space AABB from a centre plus a rotated offset and a radius: returns min = min(centre, centre+rotatedOffset) - radius and max = max(...) + radius. The two min/max branches on each axis and the radius subtraction/addition at [7] are the bounds builder used by the scene query code.

functions.name: Math_ComputePrincipalAxesQuaternion
functions.signature: void Math_ComputePrincipalAxesQuaternion(float* outQuat, void* matrixScratch, const float* diagonal, const float* offDiagonal)
functions.summary: Turns six covariance terms (xx,yy,zz and xy,yz,zx) into an orientation: the helpers at 0x574CE8/0x574774/0x574A20 fill a 3x3 frame and the tail extracts a normalised quaternion with the trace/off-diagonal formulas. Used by the OBB builder at 0x575A40.

functions.name: Math_SphereFromThreePoints
functions.signature: float* Math_SphereFromThreePoints(float* outSphere, const float* arg2, const float* b, const float* c)
functions.summary: Circumscribed circle of three points in 3D: returns centre xyz plus radius (out[3]). Collinear/degenerate input falls back to the longest of the three edges so the result stays finite.

functions.name: Math_SphereFromFourPoints
functions.signature: float* Math_SphereFromFourPoints(float* outSphere, const float* arg2, const float* b, const float* c, const float* d)
functions.summary: Circumscribed sphere of four points (centre xyz + radius). Degenerate/coplanar input is reduced to the best three-point sphere via 0x574E48, matching the fallback ladder of the Welzl solver.

functions.name: Math_MatrixMultiply
functions.signature: void Math_MatrixMultiply(float * out, float * arg2, float * b)
functions.summary: Multiplies two 4x4 matrices (row-vector convention: out = a * b) and writes 12 floats. Twelve callers are all transform composition points (model attach, camera track, trail, monster physics); the body is the plain 4x4 product with the translation column.

functions.name: Math_QuatFromAxisAngle
functions.signature: void Math_QuatFromAxisAngle(float * out, float * axis, float angle)
functions.summary: Builds a quaternion from an axis and an angle in radians: scales the axis by sin(angle/2) and stores cos(angle/2) in w. The half-angle conversion (1/2pi, 2pi, PI sign fix) and the four-component output are conclusive; Math_QuatMultiply and the physics/rotation code call it.

functions.name: Math_QuatSlerp
functions.signature: void Math_QuatSlerp(float* out, const float* q0, const float* q1, float t)
functions.summary: Spherical linear interpolation of two unit quaternions: negates q1 when the dot product is negative (shortest arc), falls back to a normalised lerp when the quaternions are nearly parallel, otherwise blends with acos/sin and renormalises the result.

functions.name: Math_Vec3Slerp
functions.signature: void Math_Vec3Slerp(float* out, const float* v0, const float* v1, float t)
functions.summary: Spherical interpolation between two 3D direction vectors: normalised lerp when the directions are nearly parallel, otherwise acos/sin slerp, always producing a unit direction. Used wherever a direction has to change smoothly (animation pose blending at 0x002E465C, 0x00591490).

functions.name: Math_BuildRotYQuaternion
functions.summary: Builds a quaternion for a rotation about the Y axis. The angle is normalised to a full turn and halved (0x6731EC = wrap, 0x672E44 = cos), giving (0, sin(theta/2), 0, cos(theta/2)) with the correct sign for the second half-turn.

functions.name: Math_ComputeObbFromPoints
functions.signature: void Math_ComputeObbFromPoints(float* outObb, unsigned count, const void* points, unsigned stride)
functions.summary: Fits an oriented bounding box to a strided point array: centroid, 3x3 covariance, principal-axis quaternion (0x574B10), quaternion->matrix (0x57600C), then min/max extents in that frame. Writes quaternion (4), centre (3) and half-extents (3).

functions.name: Math_UnionAabb
functions.signature: void Math_UnionAabb(float* out, const float* arg2, const float* b)
functions.summary: Unions two 6-float AABBs: per-axis minimum of the min triples (sign test against 0.0f) and per-axis maximum of the max triples via func_00574484.

functions.name: Math_BuildRotYMatrix
functions.summary: Fills a 3x4 rotation matrix for a rotation about Y: cos on [0]/[10], +/-sin on [2]/[8], 1.0 on [5], zeros elsewhere. The angle is wrapped to one full turn first.

functions.name: Math_BuildRotZMatrix
functions.summary: Fills a 3x4 rotation matrix for a rotation about Z: [0]=c, [5]=c, [1]=-s, [4]=+s, [10]=1.0. Used by the model/animation code to build joint frames.

functions.name: Os_ThreadObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Destroys an OS thread wrapper (vtable 0x00782668): waits for thread completion via 0x0010EA00 / 0x00118170 (svcWaitSynchronization1, svc 0x24), closes kernel thread handle self->f_04 via svcCloseHandle (svc 0x23), zeroes self->f_04, and returns self.

functions.name: Script_GetPlayerIdArg
functions.signature: unsigned char* Script_GetPlayerIdArg(unsigned char* out, void* vm, int stackIdx)
functions.summary: Reads a PlayerID argument from a script VM stack slot; anything outside 0..0x1E (and not the 0xFF sentinel) is reported by building a type-mismatch message for the expected type 'xp::PlayerID'.

functions.name: Script_GetFloatArg
functions.signature: float* Script_GetFloatArg(float* out, void* vm, int stackIdx)
functions.summary: Converts a script stack slot to a float, accepting integer, unsigned-integer and float object tags and reporting a 'float' type mismatch for anything else.

functions.name: Script_GetByteArg
functions.signature: unsigned char* Script_GetByteArg(unsigned char* out, void* vm, int stackIdx)
functions.summary: The byte-sized script argument getter: it converts the value like Script_GetIntArg but stores only the low byte and reports the 'integer' type mismatch.

functions.name: Script_GetIntArg
functions.signature: unsigned int* Script_GetIntArg(unsigned int* out, void* vm, int stackIdx)
functions.summary: Converts a script stack slot to a 32-bit integer, accepting integer, unsigned-integer and float tags and reporting an 'integer' type mismatch otherwise.

functions.name: Script_FormatTypeError
functions.signature: void Script_FormatTypeError(void* out, void* vm, int stackIdx, const char* expectedType)
functions.summary: Formats the standard Squirrel argument type error 'wrong type (%s expected, got %s )' into an sq string, resolving the actual type name from the offending stack slot (or 'unknown' when it cannot be named).

functions.name: Script_FormatValueForError
functions.signature: void Script_FormatValueForError(void* out, void* value, void* vm)
functions.summary: Fills an sq string for a script error: writes the value's type name from the sq type-name table, or copies the 0x80-byte value payload when the value already belongs to the VM; the object tag is set before and restored after the fill.

functions.name: Script_GetVmOrThrow
functions.summary: Checks the low tag bit of a script value; if it is not set the engine error handler (0x0010009C) is called with the empty format string at 0x7C087C, otherwise the global Squirrel VM pointer at 0x0083876C is returned. Effectively "get the VM for this closure, asserting the value is a closure".

functions.name: Script_Closure_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor for a script closure/thread wrapper: installs vtable 0x00782690, and when the initialised flag at +0x10 is set releases the VM child object through the Squirrel VM helpers 0x6BD10C/0x6BD12C and clears the flag.

functions.name: Script_InvokeCallbackPair
functions.signature: void Script_InvokeCallbackPair(unsigned int* out, void* callable, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Calls a Squirrel callable with one extra argument: pushes the callable's stored references plus arg3, invokes it, requires a boolean result, then duplicates the result and the first parameter into two managed reference pairs at out[1..4].

functions.name: Gfx_Node_CreateChild
functions.signature: int* Gfx_Node_CreateChild(GfxNode* parent, uint32_t heap, uint32_t desc)
functions.summary: Creates a 0x7C-byte child node: Mem_AllocAligned_2, constructor 0x005776B0, initialisation from the descriptor (Gfx_SpriteSet_Init) and insertion into the parent's intrusive child list (func_001235A4); returns 0 on failure.

functions.name: Model_UpdateMotionState
functions.summary: Updates the motion/animation handle of a model node: if no handle is set it reports idle (0), otherwise advances the motion, and when the motion finishes it clears the handle and returns 2 (done). Ten callers are monster models and UI widgets that poll the state byte; the 0xFFFFFFFF handle sentinel and state 2 are the animation-completion protocol.

functions.name: maybe_Model_Node_DestroyChildList
functions.summary: Destructor helper of the 0x57xxxx node class: resets the embedded array at self+0x1C through Mem_FreeAnimArray and calls the virtual release (+4) of every child in the intrusive list delimited by self+0x98/self+0x9C.

functions.name: Container_List_Init
functions.summary: Initialises an intrusive circular list (head/tail = self, links at +4/+0x14/+0x18), stores the capacity/allocator word twice, writes the class tag and constructs the embedded node pool at +0x1c with default 1.0/0/-1 sentinels.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_DtorBase
functions.summary: Destructor body of the generic scene node: installs vtable 0x7826D8, frees the anim array and releases the two intrusive child lists (+0x98 and +0x1C), returning the base offset. Used as base destructor by monster pattern nodes, UI widgets and status panels, so it is the shared node class destructor rather than a leaf type.

functions.name: Fs_IsAniPath
functions.summary: Returns true when the given path contains the animation suffix ".ani".

functions.name: Model_BindResourceSlots
functions.signature: u32 Model_BindResourceSlots(int self, int model, int * names, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Binds up to eight model resource slots: when no name list is supplied it looks up the generated names "00".."07", otherwise it walks the supplied names and maps each by its index byte into the instance's slot array at +0x68. Sixteen callers are monster model creation, model-animation attach and battle scene setup; the "00"-"07" naming and the eight-slot +0x68 array are the model part table.

functions.name: maybe_Script_CallbackHolder_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the small object that owns a script callback: releases the callback object with 0x005799D4 and then frees the holder with the shared operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_CreateDefault
functions.summary: Default-constructs a scene node: allocates the block, runs func_00579974, installs vtable 0x007826E8 and clears the ten words at +0x64..+0x88.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteSet_Init
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_SpriteSet_Init(void* self, unsigned int allocTag, void* bank)
functions.summary: Creates a sprite set over a texture/animation bank: allocates count*0x3C bytes for the sprite records (count at bank+100), constructs them with the 0x00576BA8 constructor, stores the bank and refreshes every record.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteSet_InitBaseFromBank
functions.summary: Binds a loaded sprite/animation bank to the object's inline base record: resolves entry 0, copies its 0x30 bytes of metadata, patches the name pointer and index and stores the bank handle at +0x60.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateChannels
functions.summary: Advances every animation channel of a node: iterates the 0x3C-byte channel records starting at +0x1C (count in the owner object at f_20+100) and calls the per-channel interpolator 0x577064, then processes the embedded single channel at +0x24. The 0x3C stride and the owner count at +0x64 are the animation track table; thirteen callers are model state updates.

functions.name: Mem_FreeAnimArray
functions.summary: Frees the animation array at +0x1C with the array-delete helper and clears the pointer. Called by the node destructor and by Model_AttachAnimationByHandle when replacing the clip; the callee is std_operator_delete_array.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteSetList_Select
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteSetList_Select(void* self, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Selects the active sprite set by index in the container's linked list, refreshes every record's name and index from the bank and marks the selection valid (or clears it when the index is out of range).

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteSet_Refresh
functions.summary: Rebuilds every sprite record of the set from its bank: skips invalid entries, copies the 0x30-byte metadata, writes the name pointer and record index, then re-derives the per-record state and colour fields.

functions.name: Container_List_InitAlt
functions.summary: Second intrusive-list constructor, same layout as 0x576A80 but with a different class tag and a node pool at +0x24 (fields 0x3c..0x55 hold count/1.0/-1/0x80/0xff defaults).

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_DtorDelete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a scene node: frees the anim array, unlinks its three intrusive list nodes, then frees the object. Same unlink triple as 0x5777AC but ends with operator delete, so it is the deleting variant.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_DtorBody
functions.summary: Base destructor body of the scene node: installs vtable 0x782704, frees the anim array and unlinks the three intrusive lists, returning the object (no free). The non-deleting half of 0x577740; called from the container node release and the node destructor.

functions.name: Gfx_DoubleBuffer_Alloc
functions.summary: Allocates a pair of 0x4000-byte buffers and stores both pointer/size pairs in the caller's structure.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawSortedSpriteList
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawSortedSpriteList(unsigned int gfx, unsigned int cmd, unsigned int ctx, void* spriteSet)
functions.summary: Draws a sprite set in draw-priority order: inserts the set's records into a temporary list sorted by the u16 priority at +0x30, then emits each sprite through func_00577E9C sharing one cached texture/blend state.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteListTransition
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteListTransition(unsigned int gfx, void* cmd, unsigned int ctx, void* list, unsigned int fade, float* color)
functions.summary: Draws a sprite set in transition mode: per record it either uses the normal sprite path (alpha 1.0) or the interpolating path when the set carries a fade colour/alpha, and updates the shared blend/alpha command state when the mode changes.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteQuad
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteQuad(void* gfx, void* cmd, unsigned int ctx, void* set, void* sprite, void* bank, unsigned int* texState, float* offset)
functions.summary: Draws one sprite quad: fetches its frame rect from the texture bank, builds a rotated/scaled 4-corner quad in screen space, applies flips and modulate colour, emits the blend/alpha command state and the texture command block.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawScreenTexture
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawScreenTexture(u32 gfx, void* cmd, void* tex)
functions.summary: Emits the GPU command sequence that binds an overlay texture for one draw: binds the texture handle, builds the texture/colour state chain (0x0065660C..0x00656BCC), a six-slot command node and finally writes the texture descriptor, advancing the command cursor stored at cmd+4.

functions.name: Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteTransition
functions.signature: void Gfx_Overlay_DrawSpriteTransition(void* gfx, void* cmd, unsigned int ctx, void* set, void* sprite, void* bank, unsigned int* texState, float* fromPos, unsigned int extraColor, unsigned int extraAlpha, float* toPos)
functions.summary: Transition variant of the overlay sprite draw: interpolates position and colour by the s0 factor, optionally emits the extra tinted bar quad (command 0x80000008) and writes the normal or extra texture command block.

functions.name: Gfx_SetBlendStateA
functions.summary: Applies a blend/depth state packet to the current draw block: initialises the state struct (0x507E00) and submits it through two GPU state commands (0x6564C0, 0x656918).

functions.name: maybe_std_StaticInitThunk
functions.summary: Compiler-emitted static-array initialiser thunk that tail-calls std_ConstructArray with the r0..r3 arguments still live at entry; neither the global nor the element type is recoverable.

functions.name: maybe_Mem_ReleaseRecordPair
functions.summary: Releases the two owned pointers of a resource record - self[0] and self[3] (+0xC) - and zeroes the six header words self[0..5]; returns the record pointer.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_CountChildren
functions.signature: int Ui_Widget_CountChildren(int self, int needVisible, int needSelectable)
functions.summary: Counts the children of a UI widget: with both filters zero it just counts the intrusive list, otherwise it counts only children that pass the visibility virtual (+0x18) and the selectable virtual (+0x24). Forty-five callers across the battle/menu/party windows make this the central child-count helper; the two virtual filters explain the arguments.

functions.name: Fs_NameCopyClamped
functions.summary: Copies an object name into a fixed 0x40-byte field of a record: clamps the length to 0x3F characters (with a NUL), memcpys it and stores the surrounding header words.

functions.name: Script_CallWithStackTop
functions.summary: Pushes null, copies the VM's top-of-stack value into a managed reference and calls the supplied callback with it, then releases the reference - the plumbing used by the script event/book parameter setters when they must hand the current stack top to a callback.

functions.name: Script_EventVm_Init
functions.summary: Creates the Squirrel VM used by an event script: Script_Vm_Create with an 0x40-entry stack, registers the default table members, installs the 0x0055A4D8 callback, finalises the VM, stores it at self+0x24 and clears the two-word global at 0x0083876C.

functions.name: Script_InvokeScriptCallback
functions.signature: void Script_InvokeScriptCallback(unsigned int out, void* self, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int ret)
functions.summary: Calls a script-side callback from a native: takes the callable on the VM stack, calls it with one argument, reads the boolean result and forwards it through the two-value invocation helper func_00576768.

functions.name: Script_RunScriptFile
functions.signature: bool Script_RunScriptFile(void* self, unsigned int scriptRef, unsigned int mode)
functions.summary: Loads a script file through the bytecode loader and runs it: saves the VM stack top, calls the loader with the script name/arguments, then restores the stack and reports whether execution succeeded.

functions.name: Script_MakeObjectRef
functions.summary: Wraps a native game object in a reference-counted Squirrel value: installs the wrapper vtable, stores the object's +0x24 handle, marks the value as owning a reference, resolves the object's own slot with 0x006BBCEC and links the reference through 0x006BA690, then bumps the object's user count.

functions.name: Svc_ReleaseMemoryBlock
functions.summary: Clears a memory-block flag and returns its buffer to the system allocator.

functions.name: Serializer_ReadVarUInt
functions.signature: unsigned Serializer_ReadVarUInt(Stream* stream, unsigned unusedArg2, unsigned unusedArg3, unsigned defaultValue)
functions.summary: Reads a variable-length unsigned integer from a virtual stream: one byte, and if it is >= 0x80 the number of extra bytes comes from the nibble-indexed table at 0x0079?EEC, then the remaining bytes are shifted in 8 bits at a time. Returns 0 on short read.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawVisiblePartsA
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawVisiblePartsA(Gfx_PartList* list, unsigned cmdList, unsigned arg3, unsigned* params)
functions.summary: Draws the visible parts of a part list: for every part index it tests the visibility bitmask (byte at list[0x16] indexed by the part's id) and calls the list's draw slot +0x30.

functions.name: Gfx_Node_DestroyChildren
functions.summary: Virtual teardown slot for a scene-graph node: asks the node for its child list (vtable+0xc) and then releases the list (vtable+0x10). Ghidra could not recover the indirect jump at 0x57A00C but the two calls are enough to identify the role.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ApplyEnvParams
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_ApplyEnvParams(GfxModelInstance* self, const float* envParams, const float* cameraBasis)
functions.summary: Per-frame environment update for a model instance: copies 12 floats of light/colour parameters into +0xa8..+0xd4 (or combines them with the instance matrix when flag bit0 of +0x164 is set), rebuilds a billboard frame and forwards it to the effect emitter 0x532F44, then computes a distance-based colour/alpha scale into +0xd8.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneObject_DrawParts
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneObject_DrawParts(void* self, void* cmd, u32 ctx, u16* partIndex, void* color, u32* drawState)
functions.summary: Draws the parts of a sized scene/overlay object: selects per-part state, binds texture state, writes the matrix/colour vertex-uniform blocks and emits the part quads honouring the clip/fade flags. Vtable method (PTRREF table 0x007828D8), no direct callers.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdatePartBounds
functions.summary: Refreshes the cached per-part axis-aligned bounds of a model instance. For each node it either derives the AABB from the node frame (when the model has an unskinned part table) or unions the child AABBs, then clears the "bounds dirty" bit 2 of +0x164.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateBlendTracks
functions.summary: Advances one frame of an animation cross-fade group: moves the fade timer (+0x11C) toward its duration (+0x120), swaps the current/next tracks when it completes, and advances the two optional sub-track timers (stride 0xC, timers at +0x128/+0x130) by delta.

functions.name: Gfx_CharModel_Init
functions.signature: int Gfx_CharModel_Init(GfxCharModel* self, GfxAllocator* alloc, GfxAllocator* alloc2, GfxModelDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Initialises a drawable character-model instance from a model resource: sizes and allocates the per-part/material buffers, counts normal vs outline parts, and builds the part index lists. Returns 1 on success and 0 when the resource header is missing or a sub-buffer fails.

functions.name: Gfx_CharModel_DrawPart
functions.signature: void Gfx_CharModel_DrawPart(GfxCharModel* self, GfxCmdBuf* cmd, void* ctx, unsigned short* partRef, float* matrix, unsigned int* xform)
functions.summary: Emits the PICA command stream for one model part: writes the palette/matrix command blocks, texture and material state, then the indexed draw call, choosing different paths for outline/1D/2D part modes.

functions.name: Gfx_CharModel_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a character-model instance: re-evaluates the skeleton/animation into the node matrices, runs the registered part interfaces and per-part update callbacks, and marks the pose dirty.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateDistanceFade
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateDistanceFade(GfxModelInstance* self, const Camera* camera, const GfxViewport* viewport)
functions.summary: Computes the distance-based fade/scale factor for a model instance from the camera and viewport matrices and multiplies the instance's per-part fade array by it. Base value uses the projection row and viewport height; parts listed in the instance fade table are scaled in place.

functions.name: Field_RunwayEnv_ApplyPartTransforms
functions.signature: uint32_t Field_RunwayEnv_ApplyPartTransforms(RunwayEnv* self, int part, uint32_t arg3, const uint32_t* uv)
functions.summary: Applies the three UV pairs of one runway/road part to the environment mesh: checks visibility with 0x0010540C and writes the 0x140/0x148/0x150 pairs plus the three 'flip' bits when the part is a curve type (0x0C/0x0D).

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_FreeBuffers
functions.summary: Releases the five heap buffers owned by a model instance (+0xfc, +0x100, +0x140, +0xe0, +0x150) and clears the derived view pointer at +0x28. Called as the second vtable slot right after the destructor.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawVisiblePartsB
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawVisiblePartsB(Gfx_PartList* list, unsigned cmdList, unsigned arg3, unsigned* params)
functions.summary: Second visible-part draw loop (slot +0x28 instead of +0x30) used for the shadow/alternate material of the same part list.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartBuckets
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartBuckets(Gfx_PartList* list, unsigned cmdList, unsigned arg3, int* params, int bucket)
functions.summary: Draws a part list in up to four material buckets: when the flag-2 parts are enabled it draws them with slot +0x28, then walks the range selected by the bucket argument (1/2 select the second/third bucket) and records the command offset in list[0x58].

functions.name: Gfx_CharModel_Construct
functions.summary: Constructor for the character-model instance: installs the vtable, zeroes the whole state block, loads the default transform matrices from a global table and constructs the embedded animation-blend array.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for the model-instance class: installs vtable 0x007828B0, frees the owned buffers/arrays (+0x38, +0xe0, +0x100, +0x140, +0x150), unlinks three intrusive list nodes and releases the object through 0x10F6CC.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadow_BuildCurveTable
functions.summary: Builds the character-shadow lookup tables: two 0x400-entry float tables plus a 256-entry curve computed as (1 - (i*0.0039)^4)^2, uploaded through 0x00507914.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelPart_BuildDrawParams
functions.summary: Builds the draw parameters of one model part: copies the part matrix into the node record, packs the part's scale fields into the colour/scale block, stores the two per-part values at +0x7C4/+0x7C8 and sets the 'visible' flag bit 0.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_BuildPartMatrices
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_BuildPartMatrices(GfxModelInstance* self, int part_index, u32 arg3, int cmd)
functions.summary: Rebuilds the packed bone matrices of the three draw slots of one model part (0x8C8 for the base part, 0xB2C for the others) through Gfx_ModelInstance_BuildBoneMatrices, then re-submits the base part's draw data and clears the two cursor fields.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawNodeList
functions.summary: Iterates the draw-node list of one model part and lets every node append itself to the GPU command stream (vtable slots 0x18/0x1C/0x20/0x24 with the part matrix); for part index 0 it delegates to the sorted-node variant 0x0057DA94.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_FlipPartBuffers
functions.summary: End-of-frame buffer flip for the part lists: releases the previous frame's material nodes and pulse entries, flips the three double-buffer indices (0xE84/0xEC0/0xF4C) and resets the new buffers to empty.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteColorBlock
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteColorBlock(void* self, GfxCmdBuf* cmd, unsigned int listIndex, unsigned int entryIndex)
functions.summary: Writes one PICA command group for a single 0x218-byte record: a flag word plus 24-bit colour, a second command header and, when the record is enabled, a 0x210-byte payload copy.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ResetDrawGroup
functions.summary: Resets one of the two three-slot draw groups of a model instance: clears the three 0xCC-byte slots at +0x8C8 (group 0) or +0xB2C (group 1) and re-arms the group's counters.

functions.name: Camera_BuildFrustum
functions.summary: Rebuilds the camera frustum: derives the 8 corner points from the two projection/view matrices and the near/far scales, transforms them into world space and stores the 6 normalized edge/plane vectors used for culling. Called by Camera_UpdateViewAndProjection and by the model-part draw-parameter builder; the 8 corners + 6 normalized edges are the frustum representation.

functions.name: Gfx_SubmitModelMatrixCommands
functions.signature: void Gfx_SubmitModelMatrixCommands(Gfx_CommandBuffer* out, unsigned model, int cmdList, unsigned index)
functions.summary: Emits the two GPU matrix commands (0x80000056 and 0x8000005A) for one animated model: converts the model's 3x4 transform and its roll/scale block (0x573714/0x573AD8) and appends both packets to the command buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_CharModel_BindResources
functions.signature: void Gfx_CharModel_BindResources(GfxCharModel* self, GfxModelDesc* desc, GfxResourceTable* table, unsigned int variant)
functions.summary: Resolves the model's material/shader names against the scene resource table and stores the resulting resource indices into the model's per-slot parameter blocks (3 blocks at +0x800 strided 0xcc, plus two slots at +0xd90).

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawSortedNodes
functions.summary: Draws the default model part's node list after sorting the nodes by their sort key, so transparent nodes come out in the right order.

functions.name: Gfx_CharShadow_AllocMeshes
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises the two char-shadow mesh/curve sets: sizes them from a vertex-format descriptor, allocates the memory, then builds three curve strips into each set.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartLayer
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartLayer(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned layer, int bindMaterial, unsigned arg5)
functions.summary: Draws one of the four part layers of a model instance: binds the layer's material object (0x6594D0) and walks that layer's intrusive list, drawing every part with the alternate slot +0x28.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartLayerByType
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartLayerByType(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned layer, int bindMaterial, unsigned long long arg5)
functions.summary: Variant of 0x57DE7C that picks the part list from the layer-type table g_0057e21c and draws it with the bucket selector 0x57C698 (so each part gets its own material bucket).

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartLayerAlt
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartLayerAlt(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned layer, int bindMaterial, unsigned arg5)
functions.summary: Same layer dispatch as 0x57DE7C but draws with slot +0x30 (0x579F38), i.e. the alternate material of each part.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawFrameNodeList
functions.summary: Submits the frame's list of small draw nodes: walks the active buffer (indexed by the frame's flipped flag 0xEC1) and calls the per-node draw list emitter 0x564708.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartLayerBoth
functions.signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawPartLayerBoth(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, int cmdList, unsigned layer, int bindMaterial, unsigned long long arg5)
functions.summary: Draws a part layer with both material slots: for every node it calls the normal-slot pass (0x57C5F8) and then the bucket pass (0x57C698), producing the two-sided material rendering.

functions.name: maybe_Model_ReleasePartBuffers
functions.summary: Releases the per-part buffers of a large model object: frees the three pointers at self+0x298 (stride 4) and the two 3-word blocks at +0xE88 and +0xEA4, clearing every field it frees.

functions.name: Gfx_ModelInstance_InitDefaults
functions.summary: Initialises the default per-instance shading/bounds constants: sets the 12-float material block at +0x30 from the const template at 0x007E7140, the 8-float extent block at +0x50, then 1.0/1000.0 fade parameters and clears the low two flag bits.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CharModel_UpdateProjMatrices
functions.summary: When the per-slot dirty flag is set it computes the inverse of the slot's 4x4 transform and pushes it (once per bound resource handle) into the projection-texture matrix slots before rebuilding the render state and clearing the dirty flag.

functions.name: Model_PartAnim_UpdateTracks
functions.summary: Advances up to three 0x40-byte layered part-animation slots (timer, then linear or sine interpolation of offset/scale/rotation/colour) and writes the results into the target render nodes, stopping a slot when its duration expires.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteColorCommands
functions.summary: Converts a float RGB triple (scaled by an incoming s3 factor) to 8-bit components and writes four 8-byte command records (value + 0xF0000-style PICA header) into the slot selected by index.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_SetDistanceFade
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_SetDistanceFade(Sprite* self, int index, int fadeMode)
functions.summary: Sets the distance-fade factor of one sprite: writes alpha 1.0 and either 0, +1/distance or -1/distance depending on whether fading is disabled or inverted.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_InitFromHandle
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_InitFromHandle(GfxSprite* self, unsigned int handle, void* res, unsigned int matrixDst, float* srcMatrix, unsigned int owner)
functions.summary: Initialises a sprite instance from a resource handle: stores the handle/resource/owner, computes the transformed bounding box, and copies the source 4x3 matrix into the destination while decomposing it into position/rotation fields.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_InitFromEntry
functions.signature: GfxSceneNode* Gfx_SceneNode_InitFromEntry(GfxSceneNode* self, void* owner, GfxSceneEntry* entry, unsigned handle)
functions.summary: Small constructor used when a scene node is bound to an entry: stores owner/handle/id, zeroes the state words and copies the entry's 12-float transform (entry+0x2c) into the node.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_SetTransform
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_SetTransform(GfxSprite* self, float* matrix, float* extraMatrix)
functions.summary: Overwrites a sprite's stored 4x3 matrix and its decomposed position/rotation block from the two supplied matrices, and recomputes the bounding box when the sprite has a resource attached.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_IntersectTrianglesA
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_IntersectTrianglesA(float* segment, int count, u32* mesh, int maxDist, u16* out)
functions.summary: Intersects the query segment with a triangle list and records the nearest hit: for every triangle it computes the plane normal, rejects back-facing/parallel cases, solves for the distance and writes the hit record (distance, normal, triangle id).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_IntersectTrianglesB
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_IntersectTrianglesB(float* segment, int count, u32* mesh, int maxDist, u16* out)
functions.summary: Triangle-list intersection variant B: same ray/triangle math as 0x57EF20 but keeps the alternate hit-record fields and handles the segment start offset explicitly.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_IntersectTrianglesC
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_IntersectTrianglesC(float* segment, int count, u32* mesh, int maxDist, u16* out)
functions.summary: Third triangle-list intersection variant: additionally performs the barycentric/edge sign tests, used when the query carries a radius/box rather than a pure ray.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_IntersectMeshA
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_IntersectMeshA(u64* segment, int count, u32* mesh, int maxDist, u16* out)
functions.summary: Mesh-level ray query variant A: for every triangle it computes the plane distance to the segment end-points, intersects the mesh, applies the per-node matrix and writes the nearest hit.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_IntersectMeshB
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_IntersectMeshB(float* segment, int count, u32* mesh, int maxDist, u16* out)
functions.summary: Mesh-level ray query variant B: the counterpart of 0x58188C for the 0x58E918 dispatcher, with the alternate hit-record layout.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_IntersectMeshC
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_IntersectMeshC(float* segment, int count, u32* mesh, int maxDist, u16* out)
functions.summary: Mesh-level ray query variant C: the counterpart of 0x58188C for the third dispatcher, including the barycentric/radius edge test; matches the triangle variant 0x580A88 step for step.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectA
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectA(u32* scene, int count, u32* nodes, int flags, u32* out)
functions.summary: Walks the candidate nodes of scene query A, transforms each node's mesh into world space with the node matrix and forwards the triangles to the ray/triangle test.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectB
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectB(u32* scene, int count, u32* nodes, int flags, float* out)
functions.summary: Walks scene graph node hierarchy to test ray-mesh intersections for query variant B.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneMesh_IntersectBlock1
functions.summary: Continuation block in scene-mesh bounding box intersection routine calling Math_ClampPointToBox and Math_MatrixInverse.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectC
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Scene_WalkNodesAndIntersectC(float* scene, int count, int nodes, float* out)
functions.summary: Walks scene graph node hierarchy to test ray-mesh intersections for query variant C.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneMesh_IntersectBlock2
functions.summary: Continuation block inside scene-mesh bounding intersection calling Math_BuildBoundsFromSphereAndOffset.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneMesh_IntersectBlock3
functions.summary: Continuation block of scene-mesh intersection testing triangle and box bounds against rotated frames.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_BindResource
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_BindResource(GfxSprite* self, GfxResEntry* res, unsigned int handle)
functions.summary: Binds a resource descriptor to a sprite without allocating working buffers: releases any previous allocation, copies the descriptor's counts/offsets and sub-matrices, and computes the name hash id.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_BuildBuffers
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_BuildBuffers(GfxSprite* self, GfxAllocator* alloc, GfxResEntry* res, unsigned int handle, float* transform)
functions.summary: Allocates the sprite's working buffers from a resource descriptor and fills the three sub-arrays (0x14, 0x28 and 0x2c byte elements), either copying them verbatim or transforming them by a 4x4 matrix with quaternion maths when a transform is given.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneEntry_Release
functions.summary: Releases one scene entry (0x9C-byte record): calls the entry's destroy virtual and clears the handle/transform/link fields. Called from the pool release and list teardown functions of this batch; the 8 cleared pointer fields are the entry's resource links.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_InitFromHandle
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneNode_InitFromHandle(GfxSceneNode* self, unsigned int handle, void* res, unsigned int matrixDst, float* srcMatrix, unsigned int owner)
functions.summary: Initialises a scene-node instance from a resource handle: stores the handle/resource/owner, computes the transformed bounds and copies/decomposes the source 4x3 matrix.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_InitFromEntryAlt
functions.signature: GfxSceneNode* maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_InitFromEntryAlt(GfxSceneNode* self, void* owner, GfxSceneEntry* entry, unsigned handle)
functions.summary: Duplicate template of Gfx_SceneNode_InitFromEntry (0x0057EEA8): stores owner, handle, entry and copies transform matrix from entry+0x2c.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_SetTransform
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneNode_SetTransform(GfxSceneNode* self, float* matrix, float* extraMatrix)
functions.summary: Sets a scene node's stored matrix plus its decomposed position/rotation block from the two supplied matrices and refreshes the bounding box when a resource is attached.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryFromBitmap
functions.summary: Allocates a free scene-entry slot: scans the inverted allocation bitmap in the scene object, marks the first free bit, computes the entry address from the slot stride 0x9c and initialises it either from the resource descriptor (0x58D5E8) or from its inline grid data (0x58D42C). Returns the slot id or 0.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntryPools
functions.summary: Releases all scene entry pools: destroys the 0x9C-byte sprite entries, the 0x74-byte node entries and their three parallel lists, plus the root table, then clears the pool header. The four repeated blocks with 0x9C/0x74 strides and 0x69069069 modular division are the pool index calculations; called from the scene destructor and Battle_PopupPool_AllocateArrays.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DestroySpriteByHandle
functions.summary: Destroys the scene sprite addressed by a 0x1000000-tagged handle: resolves the slot, runs its destroy virtual, returns the entry to the 0x9C pool and clears the used bit. The handle tag 0x1000000 plus the 0x9C pool bitmap at self->f_C are the sprite handle allocator of this scene object.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePool_AllocFromResource
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_SpritePool_AllocFromResource(GfxSpritePool* pool, GfxResEntry* res, u32 capacity, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Allocates a free index from the pool bitmask, composes the 0x02000000|index handle, and instantiates the sprite from the resource (Gfx_Sprite_BuildBuffers when the resource is loaded, otherwise Gfx_Sprite_BindResource); returns the handle or 0.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DestroySpriteList
functions.summary: Destroys every sprite entry in an intrusive list and returns each 0x9C-byte entry to the pool bitmap. Called from Gfx_Scene_RemoveSpriteEntries and Battle_PopupPool_Clear; the bitmap/index arithmetic is identical to 0x58899C.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeByHandle
functions.summary: Destroys the scene node addressed by a 0x2000000-tagged handle: releases the entry, returns it to the 0x9C node pool and clears its used bit. Same scheme as 0x58899C but with the node handle tag 0x2000000 and the node pool at arg1[0xB..0xF].

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_RenderPass1
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_Scene_RenderPass1(SceneRenderer* self, void* list, void* out_list, unsigned int flags)
functions.summary: First scene render pass: walks the visible-node list, filters nodes through visibility window 0x0070802C, and submits each visible node with key flag 0x4000000 via 0x0057EEA0, collecting entries into an intrusive list.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeList
functions.summary: Destroys every scene node in an intrusive list and returns each entry to the node pool. Node-list counterpart of 0x588C38; identical index/bitmap handling with the node pool fields arg1[0xC..0xF].

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteFromHandle
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteFromHandle(int * self, u32 handle, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates a scene sprite from a 0x1000000-tagged handle: resolves the slot, obtains a free sprite entry from the pool, fills it via 0x57EE1C and returns the new tagged handle. The 0x14000000 tag OR or the returned index, plus the 0x69069069 index conversion, identify the sprite pool allocator.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FindSpriteByHandle
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_FindSpriteByHandle(int * self, u32 handle, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Looks up the scene sprite for a 0x1000000-tagged handle and returns its entry (tagged with 0x4000000) after running the lookup hook. Used by the scene sprite property get/set functions of this batch; the tag rewrite 0x4000000 is the 'resolved entry' marker.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeByIndex
functions.summary: Frees the scene node selected by a 0x4000000-tagged index: validates the index against the node pool bitmap, returns the entry to the pool and clears its bit. Symmetric to 0x5891C8 (find); the 0x4000000 tag and the 0x74-byte node stride identify the node pool.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_RenderPass2
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_Scene_RenderPass2(SceneRenderer* self, void* list, void* out_list, unsigned int flags)
functions.summary: Second scene render pass (the 0x8000000 batch): walks the visible-node list, filters nodes through visibility window 0x007080FC, submits each with key flag 0x8000000 via 0x00588528, and cleans up via Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeListB.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeListByIndex
functions.summary: Returns every 0x74-byte node entry of an intrusive list to the node pool at self+0x44 and clears their used bits in the bitmap at self+0x48.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateNodeFromHandle
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_CreateNodeFromHandle(int * self, u32 handle, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates a scene node from a 0x2000000-tagged handle, filling the node entry through 0x5884A4 and returning the 0x18000000-tagged handle. Same allocator pattern as 0x589054 but for the node pool (0x74-byte entries, handle tag 0x2000000).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FindNodeByHandle
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_FindNodeByHandle(int * self, u32 handle, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Resolves a 0x2000000-tagged node handle to a 0x8000000-tagged entry after running the lookup hook 0x588528. Node counterpart of 0x5891C8; used by the node property accessors 0x58EED4/0x58EF24.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeByIndexB
functions.summary: Frees the scene node selected by a 0x8000000-tagged index using the second node pool (self[0x11..0x13]): validates the pool bit, releases the 0x74-byte entry, returns it to the pool and clears the bitmap bit.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeListB
functions.summary: Second node-list destroyer: returns every node of an intrusive list to the node pool at self+0x44 and clears its bitmap bit. Same body as 0x5894EC, kept separate because it is called from the second render pass.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_ReleaseAllEntries
functions.summary: Releases every entry of the scene: it first runs the destroy callbacks for all live entries (gathered from the four pool bitmaps), then clears the four bitmaps and the root table. The four bitmap/pool pairs (0x9C and 0x74 strides) and the final 0x58F918 root reset are the scene teardown; called from the pool-release function 0x588748.

functions.name: maybe_Font_GlyphCache_FindSlotA
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Font_GlyphCache_FindSlotA(FontCache* self, void* out, u32 key)
functions.summary: Looks up one glyph slot in the cache table at self+0x2C: when the key carries the 0x2000000 flag and the low 16 bits resolve through 0x7141EC, it touches the slot through 0x1235A4 and returns 1, otherwise 0.

functions.name: maybe_Font_GlyphCache_FindSlotB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Font_GlyphCache_FindSlotB(FontCache* self, void* out, u32 key)
functions.summary: Same lookup as 0x00589D54 against the second cache table at self+4: when the key carries the 0x1000000 flag and the low 16 bits resolve through 0x71423C, it touches the slot through 0x1235A4 and returns 1, otherwise 0.

functions.name: Gfx_Bounds_CalcTransformedBox
functions.signature: void Gfx_Bounds_CalcTransformedBox(GfxBounds* out, float* matrix, GfxBoundsDef* def)
functions.summary: Computes the world-space bounding volume of a resource's local box under a 4x3 node matrix, writing a sphere (centre + radius) and two min/max corner sets into the output.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntry
functions.summary: Releases a single scene entry that has an active count: runs its destroy callback, frees the attached 0x28-stride sub-array and returns the 0x9C entry to the pool. The per-entry refcount at entry+0x18 and the 200-byte (0x??) sub-block arithmetic are the entry release path used by the render passes.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_QuerySphereCandidates
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_QuerySphereCandidates(u32 * query, float * sphere, u32 cell, u32 mask, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Prepares a sphere query over one scene cell: resets the query result list, checks the cell's live-entry flag, builds the sphere AABB, resolves the grid cell and collects the candidate entries. The radius at sphere[3] and the AABB construction (centre +/- radius) are conclusive; called by the Gfx_Scene_DrawSprite dispatcher.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_QuerySphereSweep
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_QuerySphereSweep(u32 * query, int sphere, u32 cell, u32 mask, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Prepares a swept-sphere query: tests the sphere against the cell's bounding box/plane, builds the swept AABB, resolves the grid cell and collects the candidates for the sweep test. The plane-distance test against sphere radius f_1C plus the two AABB builders (0x573E3C) is the swept-sphere query used by the alternate draw path.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CollectRayCandidates
functions.summary: Collects and distance-sorts the scene entries hit by a ray: for each entry of the candidate list it intersects the two entry types' bounding spheres with the ray and stores (distance, entry) pairs in two sorted lists. The two lists at self->f_54/self->f_58 with std_qsort and the sort comparator 0x153B60 are the ray-pick result buffers.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CollectPointCandidates
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_CollectPointCandidates(int self, float * point, int count)
functions.summary: Collects the scene entries whose bounding sphere is closest to a point: computes distance - radius for every candidate, keeps the ones inside the threshold and sorts them into the two result lists. Point-query counterpart of 0x58A69C (same two sorted lists and comparator); no caller in the readable tree, reached through a query vtable.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_GridQuery
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_GridQuery(int self, int box, int cell, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves which grid cells of the scene spatial index overlap an AABB and fills the candidate list with the entries of those cells. Called by all three query entry points; the 4096.0 grid scale constant and the 0xB0/0x20 cell stride are the spatial hash. Ghidra truncated the body at an indirect jump.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Scene_GridMarkBits
functions.summary: Scene grid traversal helper marking bits in per-cell bitmap; misdecoded due to 2-byte misalignment with real entry 0x0058AAC8.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CollectSegmentCandidates
functions.summary: Collects and sorts the entries near a segment (two points + two radii): computes the distance of each entry sphere to the segment end-points, keeps entries within the threshold and sorts them by distance. The extra point/radius pair at segment[4..7] and the two 0x6654E8/0x574440 transforms distinguish it from the ray collector 0x58A69C.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FilterCandidatesByBox
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_FilterCandidatesByBox(int * query, u32 * box, int count, u32 mask, int type)
functions.summary: Rejects candidate entries that lie outside a swept AABB: it expands the box by the sweep extents, tests each entry's stored AABB with the separating-axis comparisons and appends the survivors to the hit list. The series of fabs/compare pairs on the entry's f_78..f_8C bounds is a box-overlap test; it is called from the capsule query 0x58BC78.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FilterCandidatesBySphere
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_FilterCandidatesBySphere(int * query, float * sphere, int count, u32 mask, int type)
functions.summary: Keeps only the candidate entries whose AABB comes within the query radius: it clamps the sphere centre to each entry box and compares the squared closest-point distance with radius^2. The clamp-then-squared-distance test is the standard sphere/AABB overlap; called from the sphere query 0x58A354.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FilterCandidatesBySphereSweep
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_FilterCandidatesBySphereSweep(int * query, float * sphere, int count, u32 mask, int arg5)
functions.summary: Swept-sphere/AABB filter: builds the swept bounds, tests the entry AABB against the plane and clamps the start point, appending entries whose distance is within the sweep. Combines the box test of 0x58AF50 with the sphere distance of 0x58B2A4 and the 0x573E3C bounds builder; called from the sphere-sweep query 0x58A444.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePool_Construct
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpritePool_Construct(GfxSpritePool* self, GfxAllocator* alloc, u32 nodeCount, u32 spriteCount)
functions.summary: Builds the storage of a sprite/popup pool: a free-list-linked array of spriteCount 0x9C-byte entries (each with six 0x14-byte sub-objects), a bitmask, and nodeCount 200-byte node records (each with six vec3 at +0x38); previous storage is freed through the allocator vtable first.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePool_CommitTransform
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpritePool_CommitTransform(GfxSpritePool* self, GfxSceneNode* node, u32 slot)
functions.summary: Pushes a node's current 3x2 transform block into its pooled 200-byte entry and marks the touched sub-slots dirty.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_QueryCapsule
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_QueryCapsule(u32 * query, float * capsule, u32 cell, u32 mask, float radius)
functions.summary: Capsule/segment query entry point: builds the capsule AABB (two points plus radius), resolves the grid cell, then filters candidates and runs the segment intersection. The two-point midpoint/extent construction from capsule[3] and the radius at arg5 are the capsule query used by the third scene dispatcher.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject
functions.signature: GfxSceneEntry* Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject(GfxSceneEntryPool* pool, void* owner, float* uvRect, u32 uvIndex, u8 tag)
functions.summary: Allocates one 0x9C-byte scene entry from a bitmap-tracked pool (three 8-word bitmaps), attaches it to the sprite/node object in 'owner' and stores the object's 6 floats (u0,v0,u1,v1,du,dv) as 4.12 fixed point (x4096). 'tag' 1 = sprite entry, 2 = node entry (see the two create/attach wrappers).

functions.name: Gfx_PartList_AppendRecord20
functions.signature: void Gfx_PartList_AppendRecord20(GfxSpriteParts* parts, u64* record, u32 index)
functions.summary: Appends one 20-byte part record (two u64 values plus a u16 index) to the small vector at parts+0x68, growing it with std_Vector20_Reserve and setting the dirty flag +0x60 |= 2.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteParts_AppendRecord
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpriteParts_AppendRecord(void* parts, u64* record, u32 index)
functions.summary: Appends one 40-byte (0x28) part record to the sprite-part builder's second vector: a 16-byte generated key (0x00665618), two u64 values from the source record and the u16 index, growing the vector through std_Vector40_Reserve and advancing the write cursor by 0x28.

functions.name: Gfx_PartList_AppendRecord44
functions.signature: void Gfx_PartList_AppendRecord44(GfxSpriteParts* parts, u64* record, u32 index)
functions.summary: Appends one 44-byte part record (four 64/32-bit values plus a u16 index) to the vector at parts+0x88, growing it with std_Vector44_Reserve.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteParts_Clear
functions.summary: Releases the three part vectors of the stack sprite-part builder (0x2C-, 0x28- and 0x14-byte elements) through the allocator in the element owner's vtable slot +0x14 and zeroes all capacity fields.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat2
functions.signature: void Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat2(GfxDrawPacket* packet, int countA, int countB, GfxDrawParams* params)
functions.summary: Builds a two-batch draw packet for vertex format 2 (primitive type id 2): reserves one buffer with Gfx_DrawPacket_ResizeBuffer, lays out two 0x40-byte batch headers, 0x20-byte vertices and 16-bit index lists, and copies the transform/colour parameters into both headers.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawPacket_ResizeBuffer
functions.summary: Makes sure the packet owns a buffer of at least 'bytes' bytes: frees the old block through the allocator vtable's +0x14, allocates via +0xC and zero-fills the new one. Returns the buffer (0 on failure).

functions.name: Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat3
functions.signature: void Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat3(GfxDrawPacket* packet, int countA, int countB, GfxDrawParams* params)
functions.summary: Same two-batch packet layout as Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat2 but for vertex format 3, carrying eight parameter words per batch instead of four.

functions.name: Battle_PopupSlot_Reset
functions.summary: Releases and reinitialises one battle-popup slot: destroys the previous popup object through its virtual destructor, clears the animation state and re-attaches the new owner.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneEntry_ReleaseMesh
functions.summary: Clears the entry header (ids/flags) and, when it still references a mesh owner and a child list, calls the owner's vtable+0x14 release and drops the child references.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawPacket_Release
functions.summary: Frees the packet's vertex buffer through the allocator vtable and resets the 8-word packet struct to its empty state (type 0, size limit g_0058CAEC).

functions.name: Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat1
functions.signature: void Gfx_DrawPacket_BuildFormat1(GfxDrawPacket* packet, int countA, int countB, GfxDrawParams* params)
functions.summary: Two-batch packet build for vertex format 1 (the most parameter-rich header: eight words per batch).

functions.name: Gfx_Bounds_TransformPointsToObb
functions.signature: void Gfx_Bounds_TransformPointsToObb(int count, float* outPoints, const float* points, int stride, const float* matrix, float* outBounds)
functions.summary: Transforms a point array by a 4x3 matrix, writes the transformed points, accumulates the AABB, and derives an oriented extent block (centre, axes, half-sizes) from the matrix inverse/transpose. Used when a scene entry needs both world-space points and local bounds.

functions.name: Container_ObjectRef_Release
functions.summary: Releases a 5-word object reference: when both the owner pointer (+4) and the element count (+8) are set it frees the buffer through owner vtable+0x14 and clears +4..+0x10.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneEntry_SetName
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneEntry_SetName(GfxSceneEntry* self, const char* name)
functions.summary: Copies up to 63 characters of the node name into the entry's inline name buffer at +0x10 and terminates the string (byte +0x4f).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_ReleaseEntryAttachments
functions.summary: Detaches an entry from its owner: returns the three 0x28-byte transform slots to the node animator at f_94 (count--, state 7), drops the f_90 owner and unlinks the three intrusive list nodes embedded in the entry.

functions.name: Container_ObjectRef_Init
functions.signature: u32 Container_ObjectRef_Init(ContainerObjectRef* ref, u32 object, u32 capacity)
functions.summary: Initialises a container object-reference handle: releases previous contents via Container_ObjectRef_Release, assigns the object id at +0x0C, and allocates inline buffer capacity via 0x0058D04C, returning 1.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_Entry_Release
functions.summary: Destroys the contents of one 0x9C scene entry: frees the attachment buffer at +0x80 through its allocator, then zeroes the entry's owner, transform and link fields so the slot can be reused.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneEntry_SetupFromDescriptor
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneEntry_SetupFromDescriptor(GfxSceneEntry* self, void* owner, const GfxEntryDesc* desc, unsigned id, unsigned arg5, unsigned arg6)
functions.summary: Fills a scene entry from a compact descriptor without any vertex dedup: clears old references, stores owner/id, resolves the name (0x58D328), computes the name hash (0x58D5D4..E4 constants), and copies the descriptor's bounds, grid and material fields into the entry.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneEntry_BuildMesh
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneEntry_BuildMesh(GfxSceneEntry* self, GfxAllocator* allocator, const GfxEntryDesc* desc, unsigned id, int arg5)
functions.summary: Main mesh builder for scene entries: resolves the descriptor, optionally compacts unused vertices into a smaller index buffer, allocates the vertex/index block from the scene allocator, remaps indices, transforms points when a transform function is supplied and computes bounding sphere (0x573600), AABB/OBB (0x573F48, 0x575A40) and the name hash.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_SortEntriesForDraw
functions.summary: Re-sorts the scene entry draw order: merges the two sorted intrusive lists of each of the three axis buckets by the entry key at +0xC (std::list::merge with the comparator), then insertion-sorts the three bucket distances ascending.

functions.name: Battle_PopupPool_InitEntry
functions.signature: void Battle_PopupPool_InitEntry(PopupPool* self, const PopupConfig* cfg, int heap)
functions.summary: Initialises one battle-popup pool entry from a config block: allocates the four popup arrays, the sub-pool at +0xA4 and resets the slot ring.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_ResetPools
functions.summary: Releases the whole scene container: destroys every 0x9C entry (std_destroy_range) and every 0x74 node pool, frees both pools and resets all query/batch state, then clears the draw packet.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitC
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitC(GfxScene* scene, GfxQuery* query, GfxHit* out, u32 useMesh, u32 mask, u16 layer, u32 userData)
functions.summary: Third of the three scene hit tests: collects entries along a ray (Gfx_Scene_CollectRayCandidates) and via the capsule query, builds packet format 1 from them, walks the node/mesh tree with the C-variant intersectors, and returns the closest hit record (id, two shorts, distance fixed at 0).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_SetNodeTransform
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_Scene_SetNodeTransform(GfxScene* self, unsigned int handleFlags, float* matrix)
functions.summary: Applies a 4x4 transform to the sprite (flag 0x4000000) or scene node (flag 0x8000000) referenced by the handle, short-circuiting when the cached transform already matches, and marks the pooled entry dirty.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitA
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitA(GfxScene* scene, GfxQuery* query, GfxHit* out, u32 useMesh, u32 mask, u16 layer, u32 userData)
functions.summary: First of the three scene hit tests: sphere candidates are collected, packed into vertex format 2, intersected with the A-variant triangle soup / mesh walker, and the nearest hit is written to 'out' with its distance measured from the query origin.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitB
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_TestSpriteHitB(GfxScene* scene, GfxQuery* query, GfxHit* out, u32 useMesh, u32 mask, u16 layer, u32 userData)
functions.summary: Second of the three scene hit tests: swept-sphere candidates plus segment candidates are packed into vertex format 3 and intersected with the B-variant walkers; the hit distance comes from the segment parameter.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_BuildDrawListPass1
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_BuildDrawListPass1(SceneRenderer* self, void* dst, void* node_list, u32 arg4, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Builds the opaque pass of the draw list: collects the visible nodes with Gfx_Scene_RenderPass1, creates one draw entry per node through Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject (pass 1) and links the result into the caller's list; on allocation failure the collected node list is destroyed and 0 is returned.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteWithEntry
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteWithEntry(GfxScene* scene, u32 handle, u32 resource, u32 userData, u8 index)
functions.summary: Creates a scene sprite from a resource handle and immediately allocates its hit-test entry (tag 1) from the object transform; on failure the sprite is destroyed again so the call is atomic.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateOrAttachSpriteEntry
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_CreateOrAttachSpriteEntry(FieldModelObject* obj, u32 handle, u32 userData, int resource)
functions.summary: Either finds an existing scene sprite by handle and gives it a hit-test entry (resource == 0), or creates a new sprite plus entry through Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteWithEntry.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AttachSpriteEntry
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_AttachSpriteEntry(GfxScene* scene, u32 handle, u32 userData, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Attaches a hit-test entry to an already existing scene sprite (looked up by handle) using the sprite's current transform; destroys the sprite if the entry cannot be allocated.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DeleteSpriteWithEntry
functions.summary: Destroys a scene sprite together with its hit-test entry (the entry is returned to the pool first).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_BuildDrawListPass2
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Scene_BuildDrawListPass2(SceneRenderer* self, void* dst, void* node_list, u32 arg4, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Builds the transparent/effect pass of the draw list: collects nodes with Gfx_Scene_RenderPass2, creates draw entries through Gfx_Scene_AllocEntryForObject with mode 2 and links them; failure releases the collected list through Gfx_Scene_DestroyNodeListB.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DeleteSpriteEntryList
functions.summary: Walks an intrusive list of scene sprites, releases every attached entry, then destroys the sprite list in one call.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateNodeWithEntry
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_CreateNodeWithEntry(GfxScene* scene, u32 handle, u32 resource, u32 userData, u8 index)
functions.summary: Node counterpart of Gfx_Scene_CreateSpriteWithEntry: creates a 0x74-byte scene node and allocates its hit-test entry with tag 2.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CreateOrAttachNodeEntry
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_CreateOrAttachNodeEntry(FieldModelObject* obj, int handle, u32 userData, int resource)
functions.summary: Finds an existing scene node by handle and attaches a tag-2 entry (resource == 0) or creates a fresh node plus entry through Gfx_Scene_CreateNodeWithEntry.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_AttachNodeEntry
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_AttachNodeEntry(GfxScene* scene, u32 handle, u32 userData, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Attaches a tag-2 hit-test entry to an existing scene node looked up by handle; destroys the node when the entry cannot be allocated.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_RemoveNode
functions.summary: Removes a scene node: looks it up by index (0x58912C), releases its attached render entry when present (0x58A248) and destroys the node (0x58971C).

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_DeleteNodeEntryList
functions.summary: Node counterpart of Gfx_Scene_DeleteSpriteEntryList: releases the entry of every node in the list and destroys the list.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_Delete

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_Release

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_ReleaseSubBuffer
functions.summary: Frees a scene sub-buffer (owner + element pointer pair) through the owner's allocator vtable slot +0x14 and zeroes all four words, so the owning scene can be torn down without keeping stale pointers.

functions.name: Battle_PopupPool_AllocateArrays

functions.name: Mem_BitArray_Resize

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GetGlobalContext

functions.name: Model_CopyParamBlock

functions.name: maybe_Text_WordData_Copy

functions.name: FieldParty_ActionSpawnInfoPopup_Delete

functions.name: FieldParty_ActionPlayEmote_Delete

functions.name: FieldParty_ActionWaitForActor_Delete

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_MemberAction_SpawnEventBalloon

functions.name: Ui_ScreenObject_Ctor_77D6E0

functions.name: FieldParty_ActionSpawnEventBalloon_Delete
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the party "spawn event balloon" action (vtable 0x77D6E4).

functions.name: Battle_TargetMarker_Delete

functions.name: maybe_Camera_RegularShakeKeyData

functions.name: Model_ComposeAttachmentMatrix
functions.summary: Recomputes an attachment transform: applies the wrap offset to both 3-vectors, recomputes the anchor through Model_ComputeAttachmentAnchor, writes the 3x4 result back, resets the offset vector to the global zero vector 0x007E7024 and clears the dirty flag f_98.

functions.name: Model_UpdateBlendedAttachmentMatrix
functions.summary: Blends an attachment transform: while the game-work mode pair +0x44/+0x45 is active it resolves the 'N_ALL' anchor once (cached at +0x94), applies the world-wrap offset to both endpoints, computes the anchor via Model_ComputeAttachmentAnchor and slerps both orientation halves back into +4..+0x18 before clearing the pending flag +0x98.

functions.name: maybe_Node_InitAttachmentFromParent
functions.signature: void maybe_Node_InitAttachmentFromParent(NodeAttachment* node, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises an attachment node: sets the defaults (f_30 = -1.0f, f_34 = 1.0f, f_38 = 2, f_3C = 0), copies the twelve transform words of the parent object (node->f_2C + 0xB0..0xD4) into f_40..f_64 and resolves the 'N_ALL' anchor id into f_94.

functions.name: Model_BlendAttachment_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for the ModelBlendAttachment node: invokes base constructor, installs vtable 0x0077D874, and sets default blend weight fields (+0x25..+0x27) to 0xFFFF, 0, and 1.0f.

functions.name: Model_BlendAttachment_Delete
