functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CreateRegularShakeWork
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x94-byte named work object (Container_NameHash_CtorB, vtable 0x0077D8A4), stores five float parameters and the slot byte, and inserts it into the named map at (work+8)->+0x74.

functions.name: Gfx_RegularShake_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the non-camera regular shake: counts the remaining time down by dt, sets the finished flag when it reaches zero, and re-spawns the shake node through Gfx_SpawnShakeNode.

functions.name: Gfx_RegularShake_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the ReguralyShake work object: registers it under that literal name, stores the five parameter words at +0x7C..+0x8C, records the slot byte at +0x90 and installs vtable 0x0077D8A4.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorStringListG
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a pooled object: installs the vtable passed in, unlinks the intrusive list at +0x48/+0x4C, destroys the list at +4 when the ownership flag at +0x14 is set, and frees the block. Byte-identical to 0x002E4488/0x002E4BD4/0x0046B5C0/0x0046BDEC.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnimWindow_AddDeadExt

functions.name: Field_Actor_UpdateCameraAndAnim

functions.name: Field_Object2D_InitDefault

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_DeletingDtorB

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_UpdateCameraAndAnimB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Field_Actor_UpdateCameraAndAnimB(FieldActor* actor, u32 arg2, int arg3)

The damaged prologue also stores two actor fields, so it is a distinct vfunc, not a duplicate.

functions.name: Field_Actor_Hide

functions.name: maybe_Field_ObjectType_InitRecord

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UpdateSkullRunAnchor
functions.summary: Per-frame anchor/look-at matrix update for combat action using 'Skull_Run' animation and Math_Vec3_LookAtRotationMatrix.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Action_CtorWithOffsets

functions.summary: Same as Gfx_RenderObject_CreateNamedNode but resolves the descriptor's second name offset (+0x04 instead of +0x14), i.e. the other of the two named sub-objects.

functions.name: Gfx_ApplyColorFadeKey
functions.signature: void Gfx_ApplyColorFadeKey(void* arg1, ColorFadeState* state, AnimKey* key, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Applies a full-screen colour fade key to the graphics context: reads the key's fade value, stores it in device+0x1240, sets the fade target from device+0x1224/+0x1228 to g_005A7F00/g_005A7F04 and advances the state to the next key.

functions.name: Gfx_ResetColorFadeKey
functions.summary: Resets the full-screen colour fade on the graphics context: clears the active key at device+0x123C and restores the default fade value device+0x1240.

functions.name: Model_Instance_DispatchCallback
functions.signature: void Model_Instance_DispatchCallback(int nodeState, ModelInstance* model, int context)
functions.summary: Checks if the model node state is active, flushes drawing context via 0x0055AAAC, and invokes the model instance's node callback.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_AllocFromArena
functions.signature: GfxRenderObject* Gfx_RenderObject_AllocFromArena(Arena* arena, const GfxRenderObjectDesc* desc, unsigned id, GfxRenderObjectUser* user)
functions.summary: Carves a 0x4c-byte render object out of a bump arena (arena base + used size), stamps the class tag, id, default matrix and a -1 sentinel, then records the model resource length in the user structure.

functions.name: Model_Instance_UpdateFromParams
functions.signature: void Model_Instance_UpdateFromParams(ModelInstance* self, ModelRecord* record, AnimState* state)
functions.summary: Updates a model instance from an animation/attachment record: reuses or creates the model via 0x0055DD7C, copies the 4x4 transform and pushes the record's scale onto the instance's 0x23C field.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSet
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSet(int* allocState, ModelData* model, int* materialDesc, u32 renderFlags, u32* resourceMgr)
functions.summary: Allocates and initializes a 0x20C-byte render object for a 3D model, installs vtable 0x78348C, and binds its material set and texture descriptors.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateWithScaleOverride
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateWithScaleOverride(RenderObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Render-object update variant: when the parameter object (self+0x208) is flagged at +0x1A it writes that object's +0xC value into the renderer's scale field at (*(*(self+0x10+4)+0x160))+0x134, runs the prepare hook and the renderer's virtual +0x9C, then tail-calls Gfx_RenderObject_Update.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSetA
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSetA(RenderObject* self, const ResPair* resources, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t b, uint32_t c)
functions.summary: Binds the split material set of a render object: initialises slot 0 from the first resource pair, binds an indexed set into slot 3 and a single texture into slot 2.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_Update
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_Update(RenderObject* self, u32 arg2, RenderContext* ctx)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a render object: refreshes visibility/attachment flags, binds the material set and feeds the blend/material parameters of the current animation frame into the render packets.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_ReleaseModel
functions.summary: Releases the model attached to a render object: frees the model's skeleton node, resets its material/attach state, clears the render flags and then invokes the object's virtual destructor slot.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSetFromDesc
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSetFromDesc(RenderObject* self, uint32_t arg2, ResProvider* provider)
functions.summary: Resolves two texture slots from a resource provider by name and binds them into the object's 0x9C and 0x16C slots, resetting the shared state first.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSetFromDescById
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSetFromDescById(RenderObject* self, uint32_t arg2, ResProvider* provider, uint32_t id)
functions.summary: Same as 0x005A8BF4 but resolves the two textures by an explicit resource id instead of the provider's stored pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_SkeletonNode_ResetMaterials
functions.summary: Resets a model skeleton node's material state: clears the node's shader/material overrides and releases the nine material/texture bindings held at +0x44..+0x1C4.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_InitBase
functions.summary: Initializes common base fields of a 3D render object, installs base vtable 0x7834A0, and configures default blend and render flag words.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_DetachFromDevice
functions.summary: Detaches a render object's model from the graphics context: clears its material slots, releases its three bindings, unlinks its node from the device attach-slot list (device+0x2A4 + slot*0xC) and from the layer list (device+0xE6C + layer*0xC).

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_CreateForModel
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_CreateForModel(RenderObject* self, ModelInstance* model, ResProvider* provider)
functions.summary: Creates the render object for a model instance: asks the provider for the texture-name handle and then builds the material sets with 0x005A92C0.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_BuildMaterialSets
functions.signature: uint32_t Gfx_RenderObject_BuildMaterialSets(RenderObject* self, ModelInstance* model, uint32_t heap, ResourceSet* resources)
functions.summary: Builds all material slots of a render object for one model: looks up the texture names in the model's texture tables and binds the single, indexed and variant sets plus their two 0x168-byte material records.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateLinkedSubBlends
functions.summary: Keeps an animated object's sub-blends in sync with its animation clock: when the clock wraps past zero it re-links the enabled sub-objects into the animator's blend slots and restarts their cross-fades, otherwise it just advances them.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderSlot_BindIndexedSet
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderSlot_BindIndexedSet(RenderObject* self, uint32_t heap, int slot, ResDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Resets one indexed-set slot (0xD-word stride from +0x22) and binds the supplied descriptor into it.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderSlot_BindSingleTexture
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderSlot_BindSingleTexture(RenderObject* self, uint32_t heap, int slot, ResDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Resets one single-texture slot (0xB-word stride from +0x56) and binds the supplied descriptor into it.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderSlot_Init
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderSlot_Init(RenderObject* self, ModelInstance* instance, ResDesc* desc, uint8_t flags, int16_t arg5, int16_t b)
functions.summary: Initialises a render slot: clears the alpha/UV defaults, binds the texture through 0x0055E484 and converts the wrap/border values into the slot's 1/scale and edge fields.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderSlot_BindTexture
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderSlot_BindTexture(RenderObject* self, uint32_t heap, ResDesc* desc)
functions.summary: Binds a single texture into the object's 0xC-offset slot and publishes it with 0x0057B9B0.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateBlendSlots
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateBlendSlots(RenderObject* self, u32* packet, int flags)
functions.summary: Interpolates the two material-blend weights (f_1E0/f_1E8) with Anim_AdvanceTimelineValue and writes them, with the texture/colour pointers, into the render packet slots 0x44..0x4F; releases the old texture binding when the slot changes.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_BindBlendMaterialSet
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_RenderObject_BindBlendMaterialSet(int* allocState, ModelData* model, int* materialDesc, u32 renderFlags, u32* resourceMgr)
functions.summary: Allocates and initializes a 0x210-byte blended render object, installs vtable 0x7834B4, and binds its blend material descriptors.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateScaled
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_UpdateScaled(RenderObject* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Same as the normal render-object update but multiplies the renderer scale by self->f_20C (the per-object scale factor) before tail-calling Gfx_RenderObject_Update.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_RebindById
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_RebindById(RenderObject* self, uint32_t arg2, ResProvider* provider)
functions.summary: Rebinds the material set using the resource id stored on the object, then refreshes the object's 0x20C word from the model record.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSetB
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_BindMaterialSetB(RenderObject* self, const ResPair* resources, uint32_t arg3, uint32_t b, uint32_t c)
functions.summary: Variant of 0x005A8530 that binds the same three material sources but with the alternate slot offsets used by the second render-object layout.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_UpdateDescriptorProjection
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_UpdateDescriptorProjection(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, void* desc)
functions.summary: Ensures the shared sprite context exists, pushes the descriptor's UV pair and, when the descriptor carries a size, projects its four corner words through the scene transform and stores the resulting screen position back into desc+4/+8.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Sprite_InitSharedContext
functions.summary: Lazily creates the shared sprite render context singleton at 0x007BE318 (0x60-byte objects, vtable 0x007829A4, built by Gfx_Scene_SpriteCtx_Init) and, when the descriptor has a UV/index pair at +8, pushes it through 0x2E7798.

functions.name: Field_LampGimmick_ApplyParams
functions.summary: Applies a lamp/gimmick parameter block to the current glow object: converts the block's Euler angles from degrees to radians, spawns the glow when it is missing, writes colour/cone/attenuation values into the glow record (+0x7C..+0xC4) and caches the processed threshold in params[1].

functions.name: Battle2DUnit_UpdateAllSlots
functions.signature: void Battle2DUnit_UpdateAllSlots(Battle2DUnit* self, Battle2DContext* ctx, Battle2DUnitSlotList* slots)
functions.summary: Battle 2D unit update: walks all unit slots (stride 0x60), and for slots whose part state is 3 or 4 asks the attached actor model for its effect object and advances it via 0x30AC50, then resets the slot list write cursor and notifies the unit owner through vtable+0x30.

functions.name: Gfx_RenderObject_SetMaterialColor
functions.signature: void Gfx_RenderObject_SetMaterialColor(RenderObject* self, unsigned int arg2, MaterialParams* params, int user)
functions.summary: Applies a material's colour and emissive settings to the GPU render object: converts the float RGB to 0-255, packs ARGB and writes the emission state fields.

functions.name: Gfx_ResetFaceLookAt
functions.summary: Resets the model face look-at target stored in the graphics context: clears the tracking flag and the target id (0xFFFF) and restores the default direction/colour values.

functions.name: Model_SetFaceLookAtTarget
functions.signature: void Model_SetFaceLookAtTarget(ModelInstance* self, ModelNode* node, void* animEntry)
functions.summary: Feeds a world-space look-at target to a model's face controller: derives a position from the node's world matrix and the animation entry, projects it and passes it to the face controller at device+0x10B0 so the eyes/head can track it; clears the target (0xFFFF) when the entry has expired.

functions.name: Model_ComputeWeightedDirection
functions.signature: void Model_ComputeWeightedDirection(const WeightList* list, float* out, ModelInstance* model)
functions.summary: Computes a weighted, normalised direction (or offset) from a list of weighted bone/attachment entries, resolving each entry through the model's transform table and accumulating by weight.

functions.name: Model_ComputeWeightedScale
functions.signature: void Model_ComputeWeightedScale(const WeightList* list, float* out, ModelInstance* model)
functions.summary: Accumulates a weighted scale triple from a weight list and writes the resulting 4x4 scale matrix to the output.

functions.name: Battle2DUnit_UpdateTargetHighlight
functions.signature: void Battle2DUnit_UpdateTargetHighlight(Battle2DUnit* self, int arg2, Battle2DUnitSlot* slot)
functions.summary: Scans a nine-word-per-entry table attached to the unit for the first entry whose float at +0x20 exceeds 0.0, writes the table owner into the slot's target field or clears it and resets the highlight matrix.

functions.name: Model_ComputeWeightedTransform
functions.signature: void Model_ComputeWeightedTransform(const WeightList* list, float* out, ModelInstance* model)
functions.summary: Builds a full weighted transform matrix from a 9-word-per-entry weight list, converting each entry's Euler angles to a quaternion/matrix with the sin/cos helpers and composing them by weight.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_RenderObject_CreateDefault
functions.summary: Default-constructs a render object: allocates the block, runs func_00579974 and installs vtable 0x00783470.

functions.name: Gfx_KeyframeTrack_Evaluate
functions.signature: void Gfx_KeyframeTrack_Evaluate(uint32_t self, ModelInstance* model, const TrackData* track, uint32_t offset)
functions.summary: Evaluates a keyframe/interpolation track at the current time: binary-searches the 0x14-byte key table, then binds the interpolated material set for entry types 3 and 4.

functions.name: Anim_KeyframeTrack_EvaluateAll
functions.signature: u32 Anim_KeyframeTrack_EvaluateAll(int* self, u32 animTime, int context, int* outTransforms)
functions.summary: Evaluates all active animation keyframe tracks for a model/cutscene object and applies resulting transforms.

functions.name: Anim_FindKeyIndex
functions.summary: Locates the keyframe that contains the current animation time: walks the key table at animData+0x64 (0xC-byte keys with start/end times) forwards or backwards depending on the direction of time, and asks the owner's vtable+0x44 whether the move is allowed before committing the new index.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateEventTrack
functions.summary: Runs the animation's event track (footstep/effect/sound markers): walks the event list at self+0x18, fires each event whose time window has been reached through the owner's vtable slots +0x34/+0x38/+0x3C, and advances the event index and its timer.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateAttachTrack
functions.summary: Runs the animation's secondary (attach/resource) track: for each key it looks up the node type, fetches the attached resource parameters and calls the matching node-type handler from the handler table, so effects/children appear at the right frame.

functions.name: Anim_Table_ClearActiveEntries
functions.summary: Frees every active entry of an animation table (0x60-byte records) and, when requested, restarts the animation through the named reset path.

functions.name: Anim_KeyframeTrack_ResetState
functions.summary: Resets the active animation track evaluation state, clearing interpolation caches and matrix buffers.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateModelInstance
functions.summary: Per-frame animation update for a model instance: refreshes the three GPU material layer sets, handles animation end/blending with the two 'override' tracks, evaluates every node's local transform and IK, and invokes the owner's finish callback.

functions.name: Anim_ModelInstance_Release
functions.summary: Releases a model instance's animation: drops the GPU material layers, unregisters the draw group, destroys the per-node animation state array and frees the animation data block, then clears the instance.

functions.name: maybe_BattleUi_ArrangeMemberSlots
functions.summary: Places battle party member models according to formation table coordinates and triggers slot vtable +0x98.

functions.name: BattleUi_PlayMemberPopupSingle
functions.summary: The single-member popup variant: it clears the balloon manager and plays the fixed id 0x8DD.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SetUnitListsVisible
functions.summary: Sets the visible parameter on all four battle unit lists (+0x428C, maybe_Container_List_SetParamOnVisible 1) and pokes the actor of each list's body-400 unit (vtable +0x98).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_SetUnitListsHidden
functions.summary: Same as maybe_Battle_SetUnitListsVisible with visibility 0.

functions.name: maybe_BattleUi_UpdateMemberSlotTransforms
functions.summary: Rebuilds transforms for the body-400 unit of each of the four battle unit lists from their rotation/position.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateTextScroll
functions.summary: Large message/battle-window state machine: scrolls and types the current text line, resets the attached model when the window closes and runs the open/close transitions, with several battle member-display calls interleaved.

functions.name: maybe_BattleUi_ComputeMemberSlotRotation
functions.summary: Quaternion/billboard maths for the battle member slots: normalises a quaternion, writes nine words at piVar2[0x22..0x2A] and then walks the four battle unit lists by body id 400 to chain the next slot. The decode starts mid-loop, so the entry state is lost.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenObject_Ctor_77F34C
functions.summary: Constructor of the second 0x1800-byte script/UI object of scene kind 16: runs Ui_ScreenObject_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x77F34C and the 0x769850 sub-table, and clears the id/handle fields through +0x1816.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenObject_ResetLayout
functions.summary: Stores layout parameter, resolves container offset via 0x00124154, and reconfigures the screen object's UI layout node.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Scene_FindObjectValueById
functions.summary: Finds a scene object by type id: first asks Actor_GetModelHandleById for the id and returns that handle when it resolves through the handle table, otherwise iterates the scene container for the object of class 0x7C34E8 whose f_88 matches the requested id and returns its secondary word (obj[1]).

functions.name: Field_GetGimmickEntryStateByte
functions.summary: Looks up 0x10-byte entry entryIndex in ((work+8)->f_6C)->f_430..f_434, reads the 2-bit/byte state index from its linked 2D actor (+0x322 / +0x2EA) or 3D gadget handle (0x007B80C0 -> GfxModelPart +0x314 / FieldTwoPartObj +0x2E0), maps it through the 4-byte table *0x00728A48, and returns the mapped byte (or 0xFF if invalid).

functions.name: Math_EulerToRotation
functions.summary: Converts three Euler angles into the three basis vectors of a rotation: reduces each angle modulo 2*pi, builds a half-angle sin/cos quaternion with the software trig helpers and multiplies the three quaternions, writing the result to out[0..2].

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ScrollList_ApplyRowEffect
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ScrollList_ApplyRowEffect(unsigned arg1, unsigned rowKey, int rowIndex)
functions.summary: Looks up the row entry in the table at 0x007B7F28 by index, checks that its stored key matches rowKey>>6, then applies the row's resource via 0x002A9570 and sets the fade/duration fields of the object returned by 0x005F5818.

functions.name: Ui_PartyStatus_Delete
functions.summary: Tiny destructor stub: resets the party-status widget through Ui_PartyStatus_Reset and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_FillExtraRows
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ListWindow_FillExtraRows(UiListWidget* self, const void* source, unsigned int arg3, void* callback)
functions.summary: Second list filler: same getter table as 0x004FB1CC but writes six panes per row (text id 0xAA plus the formatted number and separators) and appends a generic icon in the last column.

functions.name: Field_Scene_IsCurrentSceneId
functions.summary: Returns 1 when sceneId equals the id of the lazily-created field scene singleton's current scene, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Field_Scene_FindObjectNearPoint
functions.signature: int Field_Scene_FindObjectNearPoint(const float* point, u32 layerMask)
functions.summary: Cylinder hit test against the scene objects of one layer: returns 1 when an object lies within the radius of the point and its height differs by less than the tolerance.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_PropagateFlagRecursive
functions.summary: Sets bit 0 of the widget state word (+0x44) and propagates the same flag to every child widget reached through the intrusive child list at +0x14, recursing via 0x5AF28C.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_ApplyAnimRecord
functions.summary: Refreshes the model record, stores the resolved animation id (0x0029E488) in the animator at +0xB8 as +0x128, sets the animator state byte +0x129 = 5 and re-applies the node position (f_78, f_7C + f_298).

functions.name: Field_Object_DeletingDtorD
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a field object: installs the vtable and its +0x98 secondary, unlinks the object from the scene list, runs Field_Object_DtorBase and releases the storage through 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_Object_CompareOrder
functions.signature: u32 Field_Object_CompareOrder(u32 arg1, u32 objectA, u32 objectB)
functions.summary: Sort predicate for field objects: compares the chip kind (u16 at +8) first and the object index (u16 at +4) second.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_DispatchToChildPane
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Window_DispatchToChildPane(UiWindow* self, u32* slot, LayoutElement* child, u32 value)
functions.summary: Forwards a value to a layout element when the attached pane is visible (bit 0 of f_44) and resolves to a material: publishes the slot at child+0x60c, calls 0x0053cd1c with the slot value, writes the result back and clears the publication.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_CheckActiveFlag
functions.summary: Checks if the field scene node subsystem has been initialized, lazily allocating and initializing its node array on first call, and returns the active flag.

functions.name: Actor2D_CreateSpriteWithDefaults
functions.summary: Builds a default 2D sprite descriptor (part list, colours, scale 1.0, alpha 0.3, size 100) on the stack and creates the sprite through the 2D actor manager.

functions.name: Field_Object_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field object base: installs the vtable, unlinks the object from the scene list, destroys the model sub-object and frees the block.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CloseSubDialog
functions.summary: Resets sub-dialog active flag at 0x007BE304 to close an open modal dialog window.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_CompareFlag
functions.summary: Compares a widget flag with argument value, returning 0 on match or continuing cascade.

functions.name: maybe_Script_JumpTableDispatch
functions.signature: void maybe_Script_JumpTableDispatch(u32 packed, u32 b, int c)
functions.summary: Dispatch thunk over a lazily registered jump table: copies the three default entries of the descriptor at 0x0072D6C8, registers the table through the guard pair 0x007BE30C/0x007BE310, then tail-jumps through it with a key packed from the three arguments.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_CompareFlagAlt
functions.summary: Alternate branch of the widget flag comparison helper returning 0 on match.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ClearFlagRecursive
functions.summary: Recursively clears flag state on a widget and cascades across its circular child list.

functions.name: Field_WrapPositionXZ
functions.signature: u32 Field_WrapPositionXZ(float* pos, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 vm)
functions.summary: Wraps a position's X (pos[0]) and Z (pos[2]) into the world rectangle chosen by the current mode (two bound tables, mode 8 vs others): a value past one edge is moved in from the opposite edge. Returns flags 1/2 for X wrapped low/high and 4/8 for Z.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ApplyFlagToChildren
functions.summary: Applies a flag to a widget tree rooted at self->f_120/f_124: updates root helper func_005AFC9C, updates bit 0 of child root state word (+0x44), and recurses over its intrusive child list.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ApplyFlagRecursive

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_SetColorFromRecord
functions.summary: Fills a sprite color/material parameter block from a character/effect data record via table lookup func_0063E54C.

functions.name: maybe_Actor2D_ApplyAnimRecordOnly
functions.summary: Refreshes the model record and writes the resolved animation id (0x0029E488) into the animator's +0x128; the reduced variant of 0x005AF350 without the state byte or position update.

functions.name: Field_Object_DtorAlt
functions.summary: Alternative deleting destructor of the field object base used by a sibling class; identical to 0x5AF878.

functions.name: Math_Vec3_LookAtRotationMatrix
functions.signature: void Math_Vec3_LookAtRotationMatrix(int self, float* dir, float* up)
functions.summary: Computes a 3x3 rotation/orientation matrix from normalized forward direction and up vectors.

functions.name: Work_ItemEntry_CompareByPriority
functions.signature: u32 Work_ItemEntry_CompareByPriority(int dummy, int itemA, int itemB, u32 tag)

functions.name: Work_ItemEntry_CompareByName
functions.signature: u32 Work_ItemEntry_CompareByName(int dummy, int itemA, int itemB, u32 tag)
functions.summary: Comparator predicate for item sort routines: queries item records from the global data manager and compares their name strings alphabetically.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ForwardToPlayerObject
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_ForwardToPlayerObject(void* self, u32 valueA, u32 valueB, u32 not)
functions.summary: Forwards two values to the player actor's scene object (work+8->+0x54->+0x20) through Field_SceneObject_SetSubObjectTableValue, when that object exists. Slot 28 of a 29-slot vtable.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DeleteSprite
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the field scene object (model + trail + 2D sprite): runs 0x5F52D8 (release model/trail) and then the generic instance release.

functions.name: Field_CreateCollisionObject
functions.summary: Creates the collision proxy of a field object: allocates a 0x68-byte record named "field_collision" and registers it with the collision system.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_BuildTransformMatrix
functions.summary: Builds a 2D sprite's world matrix, either billboarded towards the camera (Camera_SetupLookAtBasis) or from its own rotation, plus scale and translation.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateAndCheckFinished
functions.summary: Updates the embedded model animation (self+0x10) for one frame and reports whether it has finished playing.

functions.name: Battle_CutsceneAnimObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the battle cut-scene animation object: installs g_battleCutsceneAnimObjectVtable, releases the two embedded model instances at +0x10, destroys the 0x14-element array at +0x18, unlinks the object from its intrusive list and frees it.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_FindChildByName
functions.signature: int* Ui_Widget_FindChildByName(UiWidget* widget, const char* name)
functions.summary: Recursively searches the widget tree for the child whose pane name matches the given string.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_MatchesFlagFilter
functions.summary: Re-confirmed from previous naming pass; function behavior described in readable C supports the name but no new high-confidence evidence.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PickElementAtPoint
functions.summary: Hit-tests the touch point against the screen rectangles of the current map's elements (count +0x8B4, list +0x8B0) for certain map ids (0x3FF-0x402) and returns the hit element's id; returns 0x3D in mode 8.

functions.name: Battle_ActionAnimTable_FindEntry

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GetStringHandle0xF4
functions.summary: Lazily creates the shared UI object and returns a handle/record derived from UI string id 0xF4, patching a pointer delta into the global at 0x7A71A4 (returns g_005B1204-3).

functions.name: maybe_Script_FindRegisteredGlobal
functions.summary: Lazily creates (once, keyed by the byte at *cacheFlag) a script-side singleton: allocates 8 words, zeroes them, stores the class tag from 0x293A00, then hashes the VM's current object and returns the registered instance from the engine hash table.

functions.name: Work_IsFlagSet273FC
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the flag id stored in the record's +4 word is set in the Work bitmap at +0x273FC (ids above 300 always return 0).

functions.name: Work_IsFlagSet274FC
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the small flag id (0..0x1C) stored in the record's +4 word is set in the Work bitmap at +0x274FC.

functions.name: maybe_Work_GetSavedValueIfIdle

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_IsStateValid

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_ReleaseEffectsAndModel

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_RequestSceneBgm
functions.summary: Chooses the scene BGM by area/scene id (f_C->f_1D78): ids 1-3 map to 0x33, 4-6 to 0x3B, 7-8 to 0x36 and 9+ to 0x37, then requests it with Snd_RequestBgmPlay.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_RequestSceneBgmStop
functions.summary: Same scene-id to BGM-id mapping as 0x005DCE00 (1-3 -> 0x33, 4-6 -> 0x3B, 7-8 -> 0x36, 9+ -> 0x37) but stops that BGM instead of playing it.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_ConfigureFromAssetList

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SendOpenedEvent
functions.summary: Builds a small interaction event record (kind 3 when the gimmick id is 0x413, kind 2 with the id as a short when self+0xD2 is clear, otherwise kind 4) and submits it to the field scene's action trigger through Field_Gimmick_ActivateActionTrigger.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_UpdatePickupFlow
