functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_IsEventIgnored
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the event id is below 0x10 or the field scene is inactive (the event is ignored), otherwise 0.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendSlotEvent
functions.summary: Chooses between the two stored targets self->f_d7/self->f_d8 (falling back to f_d4) and queues a type-2 or type-4 event with the chosen id; also latches the f_d9/f_da progress flags used by 0x5DD560.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_UpdatePickupFlowB
functions.summary: Continuation of 0x5DD488: on event id>=0x10 queues the pending target once (f_da latch), and after id 0x20 asks the +0x2C state machine to move to state 3 or returns 0 while the gimmick is disabled.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SetSubState4
functions.summary: Asks the sub-object at +0x2C to enter sub-state 4 through its virtual

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SetSubState0
functions.summary: Same as 0x5DD688 but requests sub-state 0 (the idle/reset state) from

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_StepState5
functions.summary: State-machine step with time accumulation (f_34 += delta, f_38 = frame counter) that then dispatches to one of five 0x18-byte handlers starting at +0x2C.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitHandlerList5B
functions.summary: Child initialiser: vtable 0x005DDA34/0x005DDA38, default values 4 and 1 at +0x1C/+0x18, and five 0x18-byte handler entries plus owner back-pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdatePartsVariantA
functions.summary: Per-variant part update A: resolves the referenced actor and walks its parts through the 0x005DDAC8/0x5DDBBC/0x5DDC74 helpers, placing each and playing the SE. One of several near-identical variants.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitHandlePair
functions.summary: Minimal child initialiser: installs the vtable and writes two empty-handle sentinels (0xFFFFF800) at +0x10 and +0x14.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdatePartsVariantB
functions.summary: Per-variant part update B: same handle lookup and part loop as 0x005DDA54, using the 0x005DDDC4/0x5DDEB8 helpers (the variant that also updates part tint).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdatePartsVariantC
functions.summary: Per-variant part update C: on state 0x10 it moves all parts by the negated direction vector, then applies the 0x005DDFA8/0x5DE168/0x5DE26C helpers per part and plays the SE.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitHandlePairB
functions.summary: Second two-handle child initialiser (vtable literals 0x5DE2F4/0x5DE2F8), identical to 0x5DDCF4 for another component class.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_PrepareUiReaction
functions.summary: Prepares the screen reaction of a gimmick: when the flag at +0x1BC is 1 it resolves the referenced part, builds the reaction record from the part's colour at +0x224 and hands it to the UI effect hook, then plays the sound.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_MarkActorsInStateB
functions.summary: Marks two actors of the gimmick's owner (slots at work+0x1FDC resolved with 0x66892C for keys -1 and 3): when the actor's state (0x669250) is 6 or 7 its f_93 'held' flag is set.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SpawnItemEffect
functions.summary: Effect setup for a field gimmick: resolves an item record through Item_LookupRecord, picks the effect type and spawns the pickup effect through Effect_FindOrCreateInstance.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdateSlotEffects
functions.summary: Updates the per-slot effects of a gimmick: loops the f_1BC slots at stride 0x14, builds and positions each effect through the 0x005DEBA0.. helpers and applies the shared UI label.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_UpdatePairedActorsState
functions.summary: Checks the activation state of two paired field gimmick actors (offsets -1 and +1 via func_0066892C at self->f_c+0x1FDC): verifies RTTI against g_fieldGimmickActorListClassRecord (0x007C3510) and checks state via func_00669250. If both actors are in active state 6 or 7, sets self->f_1d3 = 1 and triggers sound playback via Sound_GetPlayer and func_001EE018; otherwise clears self->f_1d3 to 0.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SpawnLinkedEffect
functions.summary: Spawns the gimmick's linked effect (handle self->f_1cc) through 0x6427B0, queues it on the scene effect list (0x3D55F4) and submits the position self->f_28/f_2c/f_30; finally invokes the callback pair at self->f_3c/f_40.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendEventType1Or2
functions.summary: Submits a type-1 or type-2 event depending on the flag self->f_1d2, after attaching the effect handle self->f_1cc.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_StopStateMachineC
functions.summary: Third copy of the 'stop the global gimmick controller' wrapper: calls virtual +0x1C with 0 on Ui_GetCore()->f_14->f_10.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_PlayScreenReactionB
functions.summary: Second screen-reaction variant: when the sub-state at +0x54 is 6 it builds the reaction record, hands it to the UI effect hook, updates the part state and stops the BGM when the reaction ends.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_CheckToggleState
functions.summary: Returns 0 when the field scene is active and the door flag at self+0x1D2 is clear; when the flag is set it requests controller state 3 through func_006D3CE8 and returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SetToggleState
functions.summary: When the field scene is active, requests controller state 2 through func_006D3CE8 on self+0x48; always returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_ComputeTimerStep
functions.summary: Computes 6-tick step intervals between self->f_34 and self->f_38 for field gimmick state transitions.

functions.name: Data_Literal005DF5AE
functions.summary: Not a function: literal/pointer data between the gimmick routines around 0x5DF434 and 0x5DF4B8; Ghidra created a phantom entry point and the readable C is only `halt_baddata`.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_CreateCompositeA
functions.summary: Constructs a composite gimmick: initialises the outer object (vtable literals 0x5E091C/0x5E0920, empty handles at +0x10/+0x1C) and then a nested sub-object at +0xE4 (vtable 0x5E0928, default 0x1E), returning the outer object.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Screen_SetFadePairB
functions.summary: Second copy of two-float screen fade parameter update in vtable 0x0078410C.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_PlayVariantReaction
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_PlayVariantReaction(void * self, int arg2, void * rec)
functions.summary: Plays the reaction for one of the gimmick's variants: switches on rec->f_10->f_10 (0..5) to pick the sound and the part counts, applies it to the actor and plays the sound.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_Callback005DFB14
functions.summary: Unidentified gimmick callback: Ghidra emits only the Ui_GetCore fetch and then truncates with bad instruction data, so nothing after the prologue is recoverable.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_InitSlotEffects
functions.summary: Resets and fills the gimmick's eight 0x14-byte slot records: clears the counters, writes the empty-handle sentinel, binds each slot to a part object found by Field_Gimmick_FindSlotObjectById and assigns randomised start/end ticks from the game RNG, then copies the per-part values into the two model objects.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_StepState7
functions.summary: State-machine step for the seven-state variant: accumulates the frame delta into +0x50 and dispatches to the handler selected by +0x4C among seven 0x18-byte entries at +0x48.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitHandlerList7
functions.summary: Child initialiser with three empty handles and seven 0x18-byte handler entries plus owner back-pointer (vtable literals 0x5E040C/0x5E0410).

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_ResetAttachedModels
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_ResetAttachedModels(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Hides every model part of the gimmick's secondary actor (handle self->f_14) and clears the part flag at +0x288 for the primary actor self->f_10, then detaches both handles.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_ApplyConfigBlock
functions.summary: Copies the gimmick's pending configuration block (+0x18..+0x30) into the active block (+0x54..+0x6C), applies it to the actor group and then runs the layout update 0x5E0FA0.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_UpdateUiReaction
functions.summary: Runs the UI-side reaction of a gimmick: in state 2 it builds the part record from part 0, sends it to the UI effect hook, ticks the timed sub-state and refreshes the gimmick list.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_CreateCompositeB
functions.summary: No-argument twin of 0x5DF6D8: builds the same composite gimmick (outer object plus nested sub-object +0xE4) and returns it; used where no extra parameter is needed.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_BuildPathTable
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_BuildPathTable(Field_Path* self, unsigned allocator, int pointCount, const void* points, unsigned frames)
functions.summary: Builds the spline path used by a gimmick's anchors: allocates the 0x30-byte control points, samples the curve (0x6F53D4), accumulates the arc length into the per-point distance table and stores the total duration.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_ReleaseBuffers
functions.summary: Teardown for a gimmick sub-object: installs the base vtable, releases the three owned buffers/objects at +8/+0xC/+0x10 through 0x10F69C, clears them and runs the base destructor (0x1CF7F8).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdatePathMotion
functions.summary: Advances a gimmick along its path: steps the phase (+0x1C by +0x18), clamps it against the arc-length table at +0xC indexed by +0x14, sets the finished byte +0x20 at the end, then writes the sampled position/tangent into the caller's frame record.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_HideAttachedModels
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_HideAttachedModels(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Stops the animation of all model parts belonging to actor self->f_10 and marks them hidden (0x399F2C).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_LayoutConfiguredParts
functions.summary: Positions the configured parts of a gimmick: applies the configured offset around the actor, sets the tint through the label object and plays the SE for each part.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_CheckUiCancelA
functions.summary: Polls the UI core's confirm/cancel slot (vtable +0x30) while the gimmick's f_24 flag is clear and, when the player confirms, rebuilds the object list (0x5E35CC) and sets f_24.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_InitParam32
functions.summary: Small child initialiser embedded by Field_Gimmick_Ctor: installs vtable 0x00783E74 then 0x007840E8, sets -0x800 at +0x10, the none bytes 0xFF at +0x1C and +0x1E, zero at +0x1D and the default 0x1E at +0x20.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdatePartsVariantD
functions.summary: Per-variant part update D: resolves the referenced actor and walks its parts with the 0x005E144C/0x5E1540 helpers, placing each and playing the SE; same skeleton as 0x005DDA54.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdatePartsVariantE
functions.summary: Part-update variant E: on state 8 it moves all parts of the actor group by the negated direction, otherwise it updates the attachments and part records and plays the SE.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitHandlePairC
functions.summary: Third two-handle child initialiser (vtable literals 0x5E1900/0x5E1904); identical body to 0x5DDCF4.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_OrientAttachedModels
functions.summary: Orients every part of actor self->f_10 from the actor's stored quaternion pair (f_8c/f_90/f_94/f_98): builds a direction vector scaled by 2.0 and calls 0x5F5F54 to place the part.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_LayoutPartsFromAnchor
functions.summary: Places the actor's parts starting from an anchor: hides the anchor panel through the UI-core vtable +0x28, stores half the anchor distance in f_20 and lays the parts out from the anchor before playing the SE.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_CheckUiCancelB
functions.summary: Second copy of the gimmick UI confirm poll: once the player confirms it rebuilds the list (0x5E3ACC) and sets f_24, returning 0 while the UI is still busy.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_InitParamBlockB
functions.summary: Second small parameter-block initialiser embedded by Field_Gimmick_Ctor: installs vtable 0x00783E9C then 0x00784110, sets -0x800 at +0x10, the none bytes 0xFF at +0x19, +0x1B, +0x1C and +0x1E, zero at +0x1A and +0x1D and the default 0x1E at +0x20.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_AddGroupMembers
functions.summary: Same rebuild as the sibling slot-list builder but with eight 8-byte slots at self+0x24: clears them through func_0011FFC4, fetches the actor group from self+0x10, orients it along the global axis vector (negated when self+0x1C is clear), syncs the member nodes and adds every actor id in self+0x14..0x18 to the group, storing each handle in the next free slot.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_UpdateSlotOffsets
functions.summary: Per-frame animation of the gimmick's tracked actors: for every slot whose handle resolves and that has the 'moving' byte set, offsets the actor's Y position by g_005E1FB0 and marks it done; returns 0 once the start frame has been reached.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitSlotArray8B
functions.summary: Child initialiser that constructs eight 8-byte slots after the vtable write; the slots hold {id,count} pairs for the gimmick's UI rows.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendEventType3OnDestroy
functions.summary: For event id 2 sends event type 3; for ids above 0x0F returns 0 when the scene is active (consumed), otherwise 1.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitHandleSlotC
functions.summary: Minimal child initialiser: vtable 0x5E20FC/0x5E2100, zero at +0x14 and one empty handle at +0x10.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SetMode
functions.summary: Chooses the gimmick's interaction mode from the two object handles at work+0x1FE0/+0x1FE4: 1 when only the first is live, 2 when only the second, 3 when both, then publishes it through 0x5E2660 and work->f_23B1.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitSlotIds
functions.summary: Distributes fresh ids to the eight per-slot entries at +0x1C (each from the generic id counter), stores the group-dependent value at +0x3C and plays the sound.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_PlacePartsByIndex
functions.summary: Places group members of one gimmick part: filters part list by partIndex and places models via Field_ActorGroup_PlaceMember.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitFlagTable
functions.summary: Child initialiser: vtable 0x5E2580/0x5E2584, flag byte 1 and count 4, then eight 4-byte entries (a small per-row flag table).

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendEventType7
functions.summary: For event id 2 queues event type 7; for ids above 0x0F returns 0 when the scene is active.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_InitHandleSlotD
functions.summary: Fourth minimal child initialiser: vtable 0x5E2658/0x5E265C plus one empty handle at +0x10.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SetUiModePair
functions.summary: Stores the gimmick's interaction mode byte (work+0x23B0) and mirrors it as a boolean into the UI work (f_1464); requests 1<->2 are upgraded to 3 because both modes then apply.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageHandle
functions.summary: Posts the 'object handle' message: resolves the gimmick's attached object reference (0x668AA4 at +0x1D7C, type 2), stores it in the pending record at +0x1530 and sends it.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageOffset
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageOffset(void* self, void* callback, u32 arg3, void* b)
functions.summary: Posts the 'offset' message: clears the byte at b+self, copies the pending value from +0x12CC into the record at +0x12D4 and sends it.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SetRowAssetId
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SetRowAssetId(FieldGimmick* self, int assetId, int rowIndex, Vec3* pos)
functions.summary: Applies a one-byte asset/layout id to one row of the gimmick's Ui list: looks the row up with 0x668AA4 (mode 1 for the first row, 3 for the others) and, if it already exists, just stores assetId in its byte at +0x8E; otherwise it builds the row from scratch with the Ui row builder 0x5D0BB4 at the owner's world position. assetId == 0xFF means 'no asset' and is ignored.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageHandleB
functions.summary: Second 'object handle' message (target record at +0x1548, handle resolved with 0x668AA4 type 2) used by the other half of the gimmick UI.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageRecord19
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageRecord19(void* self, void* callback, u32* src)
functions.summary: Posts a 19-byte record message: copies the caller's 19-byte descriptor into +0x28C and sends the pending command at +0x284.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageVector
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageVector(void* self, void* callback, void* vec)
functions.summary: Converts the caller's position/vector argument (0x672318) and posts it as a 3-float message stored at +0x30..+0x40.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageDirection
functions.summary: Posts the 'facing direction' message: maps the stored direction byte (1 -> -1, 2 -> +1, otherwise 0) plus the fixed 3/3 flags into a 14-byte record at +0x2F0.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageActorRef
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageActorRef(void* self, void* callback, u8* desc)
functions.summary: Posts an actor-reference message: resolves a handle (0x668AA4, type 1 or 3 from the descriptor's first byte) and stores it with the actor id and flags at +0x1434..+0x1450.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageRecord13
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageRecord13(void* self, void* callback, u8* rec)
functions.summary: Posts a 13-byte record message, copying the record's ids and the 0x1F/0x20/0x24..0x29 fields into +0x1550..+0x156C and the record snapshot to +0x2B4.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_CreateOwnerActor
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_CreateOwnerActor(FieldGimmick* self, int fieldOffset, int* config, int arg4)
functions.summary: Creates the scene actor that this gimmick owns and binds it to the gimmick: releases the previous actor resource, fills a 0x78-byte actor descriptor from constants, allocates a 0x1468-byte object from the UI/actor heap, constructs it (0x4A3380), assigns it a fresh id, links it into the scene's object list (+0x194), stores its handle in self->f_154C and finally syncs the member nodes and rows (0x4A2B70/0x4A2CE0).

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessagePairSelect
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessagePairSelect(void* self, void* callback, char* sel)
functions.summary: Posts the 'which of the two objects' message: picks work+0x1FE0 or +0x1FE4 depending on the selector byte and stores it with the selector at +0x1418.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageVectorB
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageVectorB(void* self, void* callback, void* vec)
functions.summary: Second vector message (same 0x672318 conversion) storing the result at +0x130..+0x13C of the pending record.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageParamBlock
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageParamBlock(void* self, void* callback, u32* block)
functions.summary: Posts a full 11-word parameter block (slot ids, two object handles, tuning floats) into +0x40C..+0x444 of the pending record.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageWord
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageWord(void* self, void* callback, void* src)
functions.summary: Small 'single word' message: copies one word from the caller's block into +0x1244 together with the owner pointer and sends it.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageWordB
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageWordB(void* self, void* callback, void* src)
functions.summary: Second single-word message (record at +0x12E8, command at +0x12E0).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_SetRowAssetFromArgs
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Gimmick_SetRowAssetFromArgs(void* self, int arg2, int* args)
functions.summary: Three-statement wrapper: resolves the gimmick owner through f_154C, converts args[1] to float (the result is discarded in the readable C) and forwards *args to Field_Gimmick_SetRowAssetId for row 0.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageRecordBlock
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageRecordBlock(void* self, void* callback, char* rec)
functions.summary: Posts a record message that carries the selected object handle (+0x1FE0/+0x1FE4) and eight words of the caller's descriptor at +0x12FC..+0x1320.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageActorRefB
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageActorRefB(void* self, void* callback, void* desc)
functions.summary: Variant of the actor-reference message that also carries the animation/frame word (+0x1448) and the flags word (+0x1450).

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_StepSelection
functions.summary: Moves the gimmick's selection cursor by args[2] steps (each step advances the index by 2 and stops at the range ends f_1550/f_1554), accumulates the number of steps actually taken in f_155C, repositions the owner actor, re-lays the two list rows at the owner and re-applies their asset ids (f_12 and args[2]).

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageHandleC
functions.summary: Third 'object handle' message; unlike the others it does not validate the lookup result, it stores whatever 0x668AA4 returns in +0x1518.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_UpdateRowStates
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_UpdateRowStates(FieldGimmick* self, int* args, int* range)
functions.summary: Per-entry state update of the gimmick's Ui list: walks the 4-byte entries (id, value, extra, side) in range, tracks the side transition in f_23B0 (0->1/2, 1<->2->3), flags f_23B2 when any entry has a value, picks effect handle f_1FE0/f_1FE4 by side, (re)builds that entry's row at the owner position with +1/-1 direction, assigns entry[1] to the target object's byte +0x24D and forwards entry[2] to 0x32D5E0; finally pushes the new side state to the actor's f_1464 and assigns the handle ref.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_RebuildRows
functions.summary: Rebuilds the gimmick's list presentation from a config record without touching the owner actor: clears and re-classifies the entry list at self+0x1570, re-lays rows 1 and 3 at the owner position, rebuilds the second Ui object at self+0x1FDC from config f_1568/f_156C and finally re-applies two row asset ids (f_12 and f_f).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_MoveSelectionIndex
functions.summary: Repositions field gimmick selection index at f_1558 in steps of 2, clamping to bounds f_1550 and f_1554, updates step accumulation f_155C, calls Field_Gimmick_PlaceOwnerActor, and tail-jumps.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_TailCallRelease
functions.summary: Tail jump b 0x5D1414 at end of field gimmick routine.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_PlaceOwnerActor
functions.summary: Snaps the owner actor to the gimmick's fixed anchor point: writes the constant rotation triple, sets x/y from the constant anchor and z = anchorZ - (int)gimmick->f_155C * step, then marks the actor dirty (f_118 = 1). This is what makes the whole list follow the gimmick after every selection change.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlaceRowsAndStoreArgs
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlaceRowsAndStoreArgs(void* self, void* arg2, int* args)
functions.summary: Places two gimmick rows at the owner actor's current position (asset id args[5] at index 1 and args[2] at index -1), stores the actor/handle pair at +0x2DC/+0x2E0 and signals the handle-linked state machine.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_UpdateActorPose
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_UpdateActorPose(void* self, u32 arg2, char* mode)
functions.summary: Re-poses every actor of the gimmick: either eases it toward the work's anchor position or snaps it, writes the result to the actor's +0x27C/+0x280/+0x284 and refreshes it (0x5E7848 with mode 3).

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdateSelectionCursor
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdateSelectionCursor(FieldGimmick* self, int* arg2, int* arg3)
functions.summary: Per-frame cursor upkeep: when no UI window is open (UI core +0xD84 < 1) it drops the gimmick's handle, and when the stored reference at +0x14 has gone stale it calls the context virtual +0x14 and clears +0x20; either way it then ticks the target marker at +0x1D7C.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlaceRowAndStoreArgs
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlaceRowAndStoreArgs(void* self, void* ctx, int* args)
functions.summary: Places one gimmick list row at the owner actor's position offset by args[0] (scaled), re-applies the row asset id from args[6], copies the 0x11-byte argument block into the state record at +0x1A8..+0x1C0 and signals the state machine through the handle ref.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlaceRowAndStoreArgsB
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Gimmick_PlaceRowAndStoreArgsB(void * self, void * ctx, int * arg3, int * args)
functions.summary: Variant of 0x005E3FE0: clears the side-state flags, places the row and copies the same 0x11-byte argument block into the state record at +0x10EC/+0x1100.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageReset
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageReset(void* self, void* callback, u32 arg3, u32* block)
functions.summary: Clears the gimmick's interaction mode (and the UI work flag) and then posts a fresh parameter message built from the caller's 4-word block at +0x10EC..+0x1124.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SetupListFromConfig
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SetupListFromConfig(FieldGimmick* self, int arg2, int* config)
functions.summary: Main 'start' of the gimmick: stores the selection range and row ids from the config record (f_1550/f_1554/f_1558/f_1560..f_156C), creates the owner actor with a UI actor descriptor when it does not exist yet, snaps it to the anchor, rebuilds and classifies the entry list, lays out rows 1-3, rebuilds the second Ui object and applies the two row asset ids.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageParams11
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageParams11(void* self, void* callback, u32* block)
functions.summary: Posts an 11-word message (record at +0x5E4..+0x618, command at +0x5DC) used for the 'row' variant of the gimmick UI.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_SendMessageOffsetB
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_SendMessageOffsetB(void* self, void* callback, u32 arg3, void* b)
functions.summary: Second 'offset' message (record at +0x125C, command at +0x1254), the twin of 0x5E2780.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_Ctor
functions.signature: void* Field_Gimmick_Ctor(void* self, const void* config, u32 arg3, u32 b)
functions.summary: Master constructor of the field-gimmick object: chains the constructors of all of its embedded sub-objects (handlers, handle slots, effect/actor configs) at their fixed offsets and returns the object base.

functions.name: Field_UiGimmick_DeleteThunk
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor thunk of the gimmick class: calls the real destructor 0x5E4D04 and then tail-calls the engine deallocator 0x10F6CC on the same pointer. Installed as vtable slot 1 right after the destructor.

functions.name: Field_UiGimmick_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the big Ui-driven field gimmick: installs the class vtable 0x784174, releases the owner-actor resource, destroys the two embedded Ui objects (the entry list at +0x1570 and the row list at +0x1D7C) with their sub-objects, and invalidates every stored handle reference (sets index 0 / generation 0x1FFFFFF) so stale handles are never followed.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_ReleaseValidHandles
functions.summary: Releases the two 7-bit handle slots at +4/+8 when both resolve in the g_005E5138 table: calls the second object's release slot, clears both slots to the empty sentinel and returns 1 (0 when nothing was released).

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_TickHandleRef
functions.summary: Advances a timed handle reference: adds the frame delta to the accumulator at +0xC, bumps the retry counter at +0x10, and asks the referenced object (vtable slot 8) whether it has finished; if it has, the reference is released (slot 4) and reset to the invalid handle 0xFFFFFF80 with the accumulator cleared.

functions.name: Text_ApplyToSpanArray
functions.summary: Applies the common virtual method to every text span of a layout: loops

functions.name: Mem_InitBlockFF
functions.summary: Tiny helper that fills a 0x20-byte block with 0xFF bytes and returns the block,

functions.name: maybe_Effect_SpawnOrientedInstance
functions.summary: Spawns an effect instance from a request carrying a locator/actor reference and a direction: derives an orthonormal basis from the source transform, fills the 0xE0-byte parameter block and calls Effect_FindOrCreateInstance with the resulting matrix.

functions.name: Text_FormatEntryWithMarker
functions.signature: void Text_FormatEntryWithMarker(char* out, int menuId, void* entry)
functions.summary: Formats one menu/list entry name into a buffer: resolves the entry text through the UI sprite-span code (0x28DDB0 + Text_CopyMessageLine) and, when the menu has more than one page/entry (Menu_HasMultipleEntries on the menu core), appends the marker character stored at entry+0x41 using the format '%ls%c'; otherwise plain '%ls'.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_BuildMessageText
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_BuildMessageText(u32 arg1, const char* name, int count, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Builds a short status string for the gimmick/field message log: for count<2 it formats the stored entry name, otherwise it formats '%s%s' of the entry name and the DataManager string, then releases the text scratch slot.

functions.name: Model_GetNodeWorldPosition
functions.signature: void Model_GetNodeWorldPosition(Vec3* out, ModelObject* obj, char* nodeName, Vec3* offset)
functions.summary: Computes the world position of a named node of an object's model: looks the node up by key (0x633C38), reads its local matrix (0x633DCC), orthonormalises the basis with cross products (guarding against zero-length axes), applies it to the supplied offset and adds the object's own position. Used wherever an effect or UI element must sit exactly on a bone.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CreateDrawObject
functions.summary: Creates the drawable node for a scene object that is being spawned from map data: reads two gameplay table values for the object id, fills the shared 16-byte sprite/node descriptor (scale 1.0, 0.3, alpha 0xFF, 200x120 size), allocates a 0x398-byte node and registers it in the scene object list at manager+0x140 with node kind 2.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_RegisterInstance
functions.summary: Registers a scene object with the field scene: copies its transform block and flags into a 0x2D-word record obtained from the scene list (func_00193654) and writes the object handle; when no slot is free it inserts a new record instead (func_00193520).

functions.name: Field_Object_DeleteThunk
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of a field scene object that also unlinks itself from its owner's object list: installs the passed vtable, points the owner slot at self+0x98, unlinks the node returned by 0x17C330 from the intrusive list, destroys the base object (0x335DAC = Field_Object_DtorBase) and frees the memory.

functions.name: maybe_Field_GetTypedObjectByHandle
functions.summary: Returns the object behind the handle at +0x3B4 of the manager at work+8->+0x48 when its active flag +0x3B2 is set and the object is of class 0x7C33D4; otherwise null.

functions.name: Field_ApplyWrapOffsetXZ
functions.summary: Applies wrap flags (1/2 for X, 4/8 for Z, as returned by maybe_Field_WrapPositionXZ) to a position: shifts X and/or Z by the world rectangle width in the indicated direction, using the same mode-dependent bound tables.

functions.name: Party_AnyMemberMatches
functions.summary: The party-wide predicate: it returns 1 when any non-0x10-flagged member satisfies func_00629944(member,query).

functions.name: Ui_ApplyToFlaggedObjects
functions.summary: Walks the UI object list (0x386B30/0x386B0C begin/end iterators) and

functions.name: Ui_List_FindRowIdAtPoint
functions.summary: Returns the id of the list row under the current point (or 0xFFFFFFFF): lazily builds the shared 0xDC-byte row descriptor table, resolves the row kind and hit-tests the list.

functions.name: BattleScene_SpawnMonstersByProgress
functions.summary: Event-battle monster spawner: reads two game-work flags (+0x27508/+0x275A4) and a per-unit byte, then picks up to two monster ids (0x342..0x345, 0x391, 0xC9, 199, 200) with counts 1-3 from a progress float (thresholds 20/30/40/50/60/70), finds a battle group slot for each and spawns that many units.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_InitFromRecord
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_InitFromRecord(SceneNode* self, Record* rec, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises a scene node from its spawn record: runs the base-slot initialiser (vtable slot 0x10), copies the record's short at +0x4A into the node's UI handle field at +0x36 (0xFFFF = none) and, when present, registers the node with the UI core through 0x1C8FE4; finally copies the record's byte +0x4C into the node's flag byte +0xE.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_HideRendererDeep
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_HideRendererDeep(SceneNode* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Hides a scene node's renderer and everything below it: when the render core is idle (core+0x40 == 0) it asks the node's renderer object for mode 3 and calls vtable slot 0x24 on every child in the intrusive list; 0x005E74C8 is the mode-4 show twin.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ShowAndSelectEntry
functions.summary: Makes a scene object visible and selects its entry in the associated keyed container: forces the object visible (0x5F4E48) and, when it owns a container at f_60, calls Container_KeyedList_SelectEntry(f_60, 3, 1).

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_ShowRendererDeep
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_ShowRendererDeep(SceneNode* self, int unusedA, int unusedB, int unusedC)
functions.summary: When the render core is idle (work+8 +0x40 == 0) tells the node's renderer (f_4C) to show (vtable +0xC with 4) and calls vtable +0x28 on every child.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_ForwardCommandToChildren
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_ForwardCommandToChildren(SceneNode* self, int command, int value)
functions.summary: Forwards a (command, value) pair to every child of the node by calling the child's vtable slot 0x2C - the generic recursive broadcast used by the scene-node tree.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_NotifyChildrenUpdate
functions.summary: Sends the 'refresh' notification (vtable slot 8) to every child of the node. With 28 callers it is the standard way the game propagates an update down a scene-node tree (after a model/animation change).

functions.name: Actor_ActionList_SortByPriority
functions.summary: Replaces the holder's active action list and sorts it by the priority byte at +0x34 (decimation sort with gap 13); this is what keeps field/NPC action and animator lists ordered.

functions.name: Container_IntrusiveList_SortByPriority
functions.summary: Insertion-sorts an intrusive doubly-linked list in place, comparing each entry's priority byte at +0x34 (higher priority first) while relinking the nodes; used by the actor action list.

functions.name: Container_IntrusiveList_NotifyAll
functions.summary: Walks the intrusive list at +0x54/+0x58 and calls virtual slot +0x1C (notify/update) on every element, e.g. to broadcast a frame tick.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_SelectAnimEntry0
functions.summary: Shared animation reset: runs the common prologue 0x005E7818 and, when the object has a keyed animation list at +0x60, selects and immediately plays key 0.

functions.name: Container_IntrusiveList_RemoveMatching
functions.summary: Removes the given element from the intrusive list: calls its virtual slot +0x10 (detach), unlinks it with 0x10EBE4 and then slot +4 (release).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_Show
functions.summary: Makes a scene object visible: if it is currently hidden (f_10 == 0) it calls the renderer's slot 0x3C and its draw slot 0x54 with flag 0x20, calls slot 0x30 on every child in the intrusive child list and sets the visible flag. Together with 0x5E7A34 (Hide) this is the canonical show/hide pair used by every field prop, marker and model slot.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_ShowWhenIdle
functions.summary: When the node has no pending show requests (f_68 < 1) and the global attachment counter at work+8->+0x54->+0xD84 is also clear, shows its renderer (vtable +8, then +0xC with 1) and calls vtable +0x18 on every child.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_Hide
functions.summary: Hides a scene object: if it is currently visible (f_10) it calls the renderer's slot 0x40 with flag 0x20 and its 'render' slot 0x58 with 0x20, calls slot 0x34 on every child and clears the visible flag. Twelve call sites (marker, prop, model slots) make this the canonical hide.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_ReleaseRenderer
functions.summary: Tears the node's rendering down: notifies children (slot 0x10), unregisters the node from the UI core if it was registered (+0x36), sets the 'released' flags f_42/f_41 and releases the renderer object f_4C through its vtable slot 4.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_EndShowRequest
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_EndShowRequest(Field_SceneNode* Field_SceneNode, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Ends one pending show request on this node and on every child: restores the saved request count from +0x64 when it is still valid, decrements the pending count at +0x68, notifies the renderer at +0x4C through its +0xC slot (only while the scene node at (work+8)->f_40 is absent) and then recurses into each child through the same +0x14 vtable slot.

functions.name: Gfx_HandleSlot_DtorShim
functions.summary: Deleting-destructor shim for a slot-handle object: runs the real

functions.name: Gfx_HandleSlot_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor of a slot-handle object: releases every child through the child vtable, unlinks both intrusive lists, erases the red-black node and frees the object's slot in the global handle table (indexed by the 11-bit id at +4).

functions.name: Field_Object_SpawnEffectAtOffset
functions.signature: int Field_Object_SpawnEffectAtOffset(FieldObject* self, int effectArg, int arg3)
functions.summary: Spawns an effect at the object's position plus its local offset (f_9C..f_A4 + f_100..f_108) but only while the object is in state 1 or 2 and its ground/attach flag f_2A4 is negative; the effect id comes from f_2B4 and the call goes through the effect subsystem (0x62DBF0).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_GetMoveSpeedById
functions.summary: Looks up a field NPC motion parameter record by 16-bit ID in Game_GetDataManager via 0x0063E01C and returns its float movement speed at record+4 in VFP register s0.

functions.name: Field_Actor_SteerTowardTarget
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_SteerTowardTarget(void* outMoveDir, void* actor, float turnStep)
functions.summary: Queries the global target scene node's world position from ((*0x007BE300)->f_08)->f_48 via Field_SceneNode_GetPosition, forms the horizontal XZ delta from actor position (actor+0x9C..+0xA4), and steers actor via Actor_SteerMoveDirection(outMoveDir, actor, &deltaXZ, turnStep).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_GetScaledSpeedById
functions.summary: Looks up a field NPC motion parameter record by 16-bit ID via 0x0063E01C(*Game_GetDataManager(), motionParamId) and returns a scaled movement speed in VFP s0 based on tier byte record+0x10 (1->0.5x, 2->1.0x, 3->1.2x, 4->1.5x of *0x00728A44 = 7.0f, else 0.0f).

functions.name: Field_Actor_ConsumeLandingAnimId
functions.summary: Selects and consumes the landing/idle animation id from fieldActor->u8_310: 1 -> 7, 2 -> 6, otherwise 6 when the actor's status is full and the mode byte at ((work+8)->f_4C)->u8_12 is 0, else 7; always clears u8_310.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_GetJumpSpeedById
functions.summary: Looks up a field NPC motion parameter record by 16-bit id (Data_LookupSubRecord on the manager's +0x87C table) and returns a speed scaled by the record's kind byte at +0x12: kinds 1..4 multiply the base speed by 0.1, 0.3, 0.5 and 0.8; other kinds return the base speed unchanged.

functions.name: Actor_GetLookupField98
functions.signature: u8 Actor_GetLookupField98(u16 id, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Returns the byte at +0x98 of the DataManager entry for the given id (a

functions.name: Field_Actor_GetMoveSpeedAndFlag
functions.summary: Computes an NPC field actor's movement speed (float at out[0]) and animation-mode byte (out[1]) from the ((*0x007BE300)->f_08)->f_4C override table (when s8_26A is 1 or 2) or actor record 0x0063E01C size tier.

functions.name: Field_Object_GetWorldPosition
functions.summary: Copies an object's world position (words +0x9C/+0xA0/+0xA4) into out and returns true, but only if obj is a valid handle of the expected field-object class (checked through the handle table and the interface-chain class tag); otherwise returns false.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_IsStatusFull
functions.summary: Compares a per-id cost against a party limit: takes party member 0 through func_0035EB98, adds 10.0 when the work flags at +0x8AB1/+0x8AB2 are set, and returns whether (record f_C + record f_15) stays within that limit.

functions.name: maybe_Data_GetFirstRowA
functions.summary: Fourteen-instruction getter whose return value Ghidra dropped: resolves Game_GetDataManager and returns the first row of the manager's +0x884 sub-record table via 0x0063F7BC. One of four identical copies (0x005E889C/0x005E88B8/0x005E88D4/0x005E88F0).

functions.name: maybe_Data_GetFirstRowB
functions.summary: Fourteen-instruction getter with its return value dropped by Ghidra: resolves Game_GetDataManager and returns the first row of the manager's +0x884 sub-record table via 0x0063F7BC. Byte-identical to 0x005E889C and the other copies at 0x005E88D4/0x005E88F0.

functions.name: maybe_Game_DataManager_NotifyA
functions.summary: 28-byte thunk: takes an argument from r3, resolves the data manager through Game_GetDataManager and forwards the manager pointer to 0x0063F7BC. The two callers are unrelated (Anim_ClipSlot_InitArcMotion, Field_NpcAction_RunTowardTargetStart), so it is a shared notification helper rather than a field-object one.

functions.name: maybe_Game_DataManager_NotifyB
functions.summary: Byte-identical template copy of 0x005E88D4 at a second address: Game_GetDataManager followed by 0x0063F7BC(*manager), with the argument taken from r3. Same two unrelated callers.

functions.name: Actor_SteerMoveDirection
functions.signature: void Actor_SteerMoveDirection(float* out, Model* model, const float* targetDir, float maxTurn)
functions.summary: Rotates a movement direction toward a target direction by at most maxTurn radians this frame: builds the rotation quaternion from the model's current facing to the target, clamps the angle, applies it, writes the new unit direction to out and stores it as the model's desired rotation.

functions.name: Mem_CalcAlignedBufferRange
functions.signature: void Mem_CalcAlignedBufferRange(u32* out, u32 base, u32 size, u32 elemSize, u32 align)
functions.summary: Computes an aligned buffer description: aligns the base up to `align` (align 0 is treated as 1), rounds the element size up to at least 4 bytes, and writes {0, alignedBase, alignedBase + count*elemSize, elemSize} into out.

functions.name: Sound_SequencePlayer_UpdateVoices
functions.summary: Refreshes the live voices of a sequence player at a new playback position: if the current voice (f_18) is still inside the range of its 0x18-byte event it retunes/fades it with the sound core (0x1EE018), otherwise drops it; releases the pending stream (f_1C) once 0x63071C says it is done, and walks the 32-slot voice bitmask (f_28/f_24/f_30) updating each slot whose handle matches.

functions.name: Sound_SequencePlayer_Reset
functions.summary: Releases a sequence player slot: clears the pending event, stops all its active voices through 0x5E9A48 when any are live, resets the read/seek positions to -1 and returns 1 so the caller knows the slot is free.

functions.name: Sound_SequencePlayer_Init
functions.summary: Binds a freshly allocated sound file to a sequence-player slot: verifies the file is of the expected magic (g_005e9820), clears every position/voice field, zero-fills the 0x100-byte voice table and stores the file pointer plus its data pointer (+7 words).

functions.name: Sound_SequencePlayer_Seek
functions.signature: void Sound_SequencePlayer_Seek(SoundSequencePlayer* self, u32 position, int flags)
functions.summary: Moves a sequence player to a new playback position: keeps the previous position, binary-searches the 0x18-byte event table for the event containing the new position, clamps the slot index, then updates/stops the voices (0x5E94F0, 0x5E9968, 0x5E9A48) and processes the events between old and new position (0x5E9B6C).

functions.name: Sound_SequencePlayer_StopVoices
functions.signature: int Sound_SequencePlayer_StopVoices(SoundSequencePlayer* self, u32 voiceMask, int limit)
functions.summary: Stops every voice selected by the bitmask: for each set bit with a live slot it fades/stops the voice through the sound core (0x1EDF88), clears the slot, updates the three bookkeeping masks (f_28 active, f_38 fading, f_24/f_34 counters) and returns how many voices were stopped.

functions.name: Sound_SequencePlayer_ProcessEvents
functions.signature: int Sound_SequencePlayer_ProcessEvents(SoundSequencePlayer* self, u32 position, int arg3)
functions.summary: The sequence player's event pump: walks the 0x18-byte event records from the current index up to the position, and for every record whose type byte (record+0xC) and timing window match it allocates a voice slot (f_10..), starts the referenced stream with 0x1ECADC, updates the active/fading masks and dispatches the remaining event kinds through 0x5E9C6C/0x5EA194/0x5EA4B0. This is the code that turns a BGM track's event list into actual voices.

functions.name: Sound_PlayerSlot_Clear
functions.summary: Zero-initialises one sound player slot: clears the stream/archive handles, sets the two "no id" fields to -1 and memsets the 0x100-byte name/buffer tail. Called once per player slot by Sound_InitPlayers.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SignalStreamEvent
functions.signature: extern void Sound_SignalStreamEvent(unsigned arg1, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, maybe_Sound_SignalStreamEvent;
functions.summary: Signals the stream/sound event g_005ea728 with the caller's arguments

functions.name: maybe_Sound_ShutdownTailA
functions.summary: Secondary entry point inside sound system shutdown routine.

functions.name: Sound_PlayerSlot_ResetAll
functions.summary: Body of the sound shutdown: takes the sound lock (svc 0x24), walks the 16-entry player table between the read and write indices (+0x6C/+0x6E) and releases every active voice/stream, then signals the worker.

functions.name: Sound_PlayerSlot_ClearBusyBit
functions.summary: Inner block of the sound shutdown: after a slot's reference count drops to zero it calls 0x117E50 and clears the slot's busy bit (`1 << (slot & 0x1F)`) in the 32-bit mask at sound+0x2C.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_PlayerSlot_ClearFlags
functions.summary: Internal cleanup block of sound shutdown routine clearing player slot flags.

functions.name: Sound_StreamPlayer_Setup
functions.signature: int Sound_StreamPlayer_Setup(SoundHeap* heap, SoundStreamPlayer* player, u32 memberId, int loadBuffers)
functions.summary: Sets up a streaming sound player for one archive member: allocates the archive reader (0x194), the decoder (0x220) and the stream buffer (0x118), opens the member, then asks the archive layer for the decode memory sizes (0x65E608/0x65E660/0x65E7C4/0x65E7F4) and allocates one contiguous block for sample data. On any failure it calls the release path and returns 0.

functions.name: Sound_StreamPlayer_Release
functions.summary: Destroys a streaming sound player: frees the stream object (0x546220), the decoder (0x543484) and the archive reader (0x542B48), destroys the four 0x88-byte sub-buffers, then releases the two allocated sample blocks. Idempotent (all handles are cleared before use).

functions.name: Sound_StreamPlayer_CreatePlaybackState
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises a 0x2D4-byte playback-state object: zeroes the block, runs the 0x005430C0/0x0054317C sub-initialisers and memsets the embedded 0x88-byte scratch area; returns the new state or 0.

functions.name: Sound_SignalStreamEventNoArgs
functions.summary: Argument-less wrapper that signals the stream event (0x5EA54C) and

functions.name: Sound_FreeStreamSlot
functions.summary: One-instruction thunk that hands the stream-slot object to 0x10F6CC (the

functions.name: maybe_Sound_StreamPlayer_InitLock
functions.signature: void maybe_Sound_StreamPlayer_InitLock(SoundStreamPlayer* player, u32 mode, int channelCount, int arg4)
functions.summary: One-time start/lock setup for stream players, called from Sound_InitPlayers: if the player flag bit 0 is clear, a channel count was requested and the global lock is free, it initialises the critical section at 0x007C8650 and records a handle. The tail was lost to bad instruction data, so the unlock path is unknown.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_StreamPlayer_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of sound stream player servicing queued stream buffers.

functions.name: Sound_AllocStreamSlot
functions.summary: Allocates one of the owner's four stream slots: takes the first free bit of the 4-bit mask f_2CC, bumps the count f_2D0, and initialises the slot's 0x88-byte stream object at self+0xA8 with the owner's data pointer via Sound_Stream_SetSource. Returns null when the owner already has four streams.

functions.name: Sound_CommandQueue_Commit
functions.summary: Publishes the queue's write index: under the sound mutex, when the queue is active (flag f_20 bit 0) and a write is pending (f_6A != f_6E), sets f_6E = f_6A and wakes the consumer.

functions.name: Sound_CommandQueue_Push
functions.signature: u8 Sound_CommandQueue_Push(void* queue, u32 arg2, void* payload, u16 id)
functions.summary: Enqueues one sound command: under the mutex, takes the next write slot (16 entries of 0x44 bytes at queue->f_28), copies the payload (0x1261E8), stores the argument and command id, and advances the write index; returns 1 on success, 0 when the ring is full.

functions.name: Sound_CommandQueue_PushCommand
functions.summary: Enqueues a payload-less sound command (command id only, no argument) using the same 16-slot ring and mutex as Sound_CommandQueue_Push.

functions.name: Sound_StreamPlayer_Shutdown_2
functions.summary: Shuts a streaming (movie/voice) player down: cancels the pending stream handle, releases the mutex-protected buffer, resets the four Gfx layer states through maybe_Gfx_SetLayerStateA..D, frees the sub-buffers and finally calls Sound_StreamPlayer_Release on the player block.

functions.summary: Destructor of a threaded sound/stream object: installs vtable 0x784218,

functions.name: Os_Mutex_Unlock
functions.summary: Releases a kernel mutex (ARM11 svc 0x14 = svcReleaseMutex) and forwards negative results to the OS error handler 0x118100.

functions.name: Os_Mutex_Lock
functions.summary: Acquires a kernel mutex (ARM11 svc 0x24 = svcWaitSynchronization1, infinite timeout) and forwards negative results to the OS error handler 0x118100.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_EnsureCapacity
functions.signature: unsigned Sound_Stream_EnsureCapacity(Sound_StreamPool* pool, unsigned requirement, const unsigned* requirements)
functions.summary: Grows the stream pools to satisfy a requirement record: looks the requirement id up among the 5-word records in arg3 and reallocates the node, entry, list and packet pools through the allocator when their capacities are too small, relinking the existing entries.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_PopFreeNode
functions.summary: Takes one free 0x18-byte node from the stream pool: reuses the last node of the preallocated pool or allocates a new one and publishes it as the current node; returns 0 when the pool is exhausted.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_BuildChunk
functions.signature: unsigned Sound_Stream_BuildChunk(Sound_Stream* stream, unsigned arg2, unsigned arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Builds the next stream chunk: sums the sizes of the queued nodes (wrapping at the ring size f_34), asks the packet builder for a chunk of that size and copies the queued data into it with std_RingBuffer_CopyWrapped.

functions.name: MoLive_Stream_PopPacket
functions.summary: Moves the next pending packet slot into the stream's active packet vector and advances the read cursor; returns 1 when a packet was taken and 0 when none are pending. The 3DS sound driver calls it once per packet to walk a stream's queued packets.

functions.name: MoLive_BitReader_ReadBits
functions.summary: MSB-first bit reader: pulls bytes out of the stream until the 64-bit accumulator holds at least 'count' bits, then returns the top 'count' bits and drops them. Used by the MoLive packet/EP parser for its variable-length codes.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_CreateFilter
functions.summary: Allocates one 0x24-byte MoLive decoder/filter node through the factory's virtual allocator and tags it as decoder type 2 with sub-type 6 and the given owner argument.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_CreateFilterB
functions.summary: Second MoLive decoder factory helper: same 0x24-byte node, decoder type 1 with sub-type 0xC.

functions.name: MoLive_StreamTable_RegisterDefaultDecoders
functions.signature: void MoLive_StreamTable_RegisterDefaultDecoders(MoLiveStreamTable* self, u32 stream_type, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Populates the MoLive stream-descriptor tree with the built-in stream types (3, 2 and 4) plus the caller-supplied type, each pointing at its static descriptor/callback table. Called once when a reader is constructed.

functions.name: Container_AvlTree_Insert
functions.signature: bool Container_AvlTree_Insert(AvlTree* self, u32 key, u32 value, void* payload)
functions.summary: Inserts one key into the game's height-augmented (AVL) ordered tree, allocating a 0x1C-byte node from the tree's allocator and rebalancing through Container_AvlTree_InsertFixup. Returns true if the key was newly inserted, false if it already existed.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_CreateFilterC
functions.summary: Third MoLive decoder factory helper: 0x1C-byte node, decoder type 4 with sub-type 2.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_CreateFilterD
functions.summary: Fourth MoLive decoder factory helper: 0x30-byte node, decoder type 3 with sub-type 0xD, plus cleared filter state (type byte 6, four zero counters).

functions.name: MoLive_Reader_Process
functions.summary: Main per-call state machine of the MoLive streaming reader: scans the incoming buffer for the next packet, validates/changes the packet size, resets the bit reader, then decodes all Eps in the packet and returns a status code (0 = need more data, 2 = packet done, 0x42/0x43/0x44/0x49/0x80/0x100 = the error/again codes).

functions.name: MoLive_StreamTable_BeginPackets
functions.summary: Walks every stream in the reader's stream map and opens a new packet on it (MoLive_Stream_BeginPacket), marking the stream dirty so its data is re-read. Returns 0 if any stream could not allocate its packet.

functions.name: MoLive_StreamTable_FlushSegments
functions.summary: For every stream: appends the segment currently queued at stream+0x44 to the stream's segment vector (std_SlotVector_AppendRange), detaches it from its owner and marks the stream dirty. This hands the freshly parsed packet data to each stream's decoder.

functions.name: MoLive_StreamTable_ReleaseUnused
functions.summary: Erases from the stream map every stream that has finished (no pending packet at +0x68 and no queued bytes at +0x38); streams that are still active just have their pending flag cleared.

functions.name: MoLive_Reader_ParseEpHeader
functions.signature: u32 MoLive_Reader_ParseEpHeader(MoLiveReader* self, u8* buffer, u32* offset, u32 size)
functions.summary: Parses the leading EP header of a packet: the flags byte (bit0 = 'first', bit1 = 'last', bits2..7 = stream count), the 64-bit time base and the optional 16-bit packet counter, then advances the reader's time by (new_stream_count - old_stream_count) * stream_size. Returns 0 or a MoLive error code (0x43 truncated, 0x44 decode failed, 0x46 inconsistent stream count, 0x50 bad counter).

functions.name: MoLive_Reader_DecodePacket
functions.signature: u32 MoLive_Reader_DecodePacket(MoLiveReader* self, u8* buffer, u32* offset, u32 size)
functions.summary: Decodes one packet body: for each stream id found in the packet it looks the stream up in the reader's stream map, creates a 0x24-byte stream entry (with the MoLive allocator, 'MoLive::Allocator: not enough memory...') when the id is new, binds the per-stream decoder callback and feeds it the packet slice. Returns 0x100 when the packet is exhausted.

functions.name: MoLive_StreamTable_CommitPackets
functions.summary: Walks every stream in the reader's stream map and commits the packet segments gathered so far into that stream's bit-stream buffer (MoLive_Stream_CommitPacket). Returns 0 if any stream failed.

functions.name: MoLive_Reader_SetSource
functions.summary: Attaches a data source to the MoLive reader: detaches the previous one, stores the new interface at self+0x1478, opens it (vtable +0xC) and resets the reader state (time, bit reader, packet counters). Returns 0x41 if the source refuses to open.

functions.name: MoLive_Reader_DetachSource
functions.summary: Closes and forgets the attached data source, erases every stream from the reader's stream map, releases the segment vector and resets the time/bit-reader state. Used both by the destructor and when a new source is attached.

functions.name: MoLive_Reader_ReadEp
functions.signature: u32 MoLive_Reader_ReadEp(MoLiveReader* self, u8* buffer, u32* offset, u32 size)
functions.summary: Reads one EP (element) record out of the packet: a unary-coded stream id selects the stream in the reader's stream map, then that stream's data is appended. Emits the diagnostic messages 'ReadEp: cannot find stream %d', 'Ep goes beyond end of packet' and 'ReadEp: stream %d already disabled' through the reader's error callback.

functions.name: MoLive_Reader_Ctor
functions.signature: MoLiveReader* MoLive_Reader_Ctor(MoLiveReader* self, MoLiveAllocator* allocator, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructs a MoLive streaming reader: clears the time/packet state, installs the allocator, creates the two ordered maps (stream map at +0x141C and the secondary map at +0x507), the 0x10-byte slot vector at +0x143C and the two AVL trees, then registers the default stream decoders.

functions.name: MoLive_Reader_Dtor
functions.summary: Destroys a MoLive reader: detaches the source, clears both AVL trees, releases the slot vector and the tree node pool, and frees the map's backing store. Returns self.

functions.name: Save_CryptoContext_Destroy
functions.summary: Destructor of the save-data crypt context: installs the base vtable, releases the child key object and its buffers, tears down the embedded intrusive lists and nulls every pointer, returning the context.

functions.name: SaveCode_Decode
functions.signature: void SaveCode_Decode(int arg1, int arg2, u8 * arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: SaveCode_EncodeFixed20
functions.signature: u32 SaveCode_EncodeFixed20(const u16* ids, u32 count, u8* out)
functions.summary: Encodes a fixed set of 20 item/flag ids (each must be in 0x3000..0x30FC) into the compact 17-character Spell-of-Restoration record: maps ids through the 64-entry alphabet, delta-encodes the 6-bit indices, scrambles them with the LFSR stream, verifies the checksum and fills the caller's record.

functions.name: SaveCode_EncodeVariable
functions.signature: u32 SaveCode_EncodeVariable(const u16* ids, u32 count, u8* out)
functions.summary: Variable-length variant of the code encoder: maps `count` ids through the same 64-entry alphabet, packs the 6-bit deltas, appends a CRC-16 (poly 0x1021) and verifies it before filling the caller's record with type 2.

functions.name: SaveCode_DecodeAndVerify
functions.signature: u32 SaveCode_DecodeAndVerify(u32 codeA, u32 count, u32 arg3, u32 b, u8* out)
functions.summary: Validates a Spell-of-Restoration input: checks the character set (0x5EF474), decodes the 13-byte payload with the known SaveCode_Decode, verifies/decodes it (0x5F09A4) and unpacks the 3 output words plus the scrambled index into the caller's structure.

functions.name: Str_BitBuffer_ShiftRight
functions.signature: void Str_BitBuffer_ShiftRight(u8* buf, int size, u32 bits)
functions.summary: Shifts a byte buffer right by `bits` bits in place (the 32-bit chunk move is unrolled two bytes at a time), zero-filling the tail; used by the save-code bit packing.

functions.name: SaveCode_GenerateCheckDigits
functions.signature: void SaveCode_GenerateCheckDigits(int data, int len, int* out)
functions.summary: Builds the five check digits stored at the end of the encoded save code: seeds a small PRNG from the CRC-16/CRC-32 of the payload (0x5F08DC/0x5F0868), draws five distinct values, then insertion-sorts them into out[0..4].

functions.name: Save_CopyChecksumTable
functions.summary: Copies the static 512-byte save/check-digit table at 0x0072E93C through a stack buffer into the caller's buffer and returns it. Called from the save crypto context init and from both check-digit generation and verification, so the table is part of the save-code checksum path.

functions.name: std_Crc32_InitTable
functions.summary: Copies the static 1024-byte (256 x u32) CRC-32 lookup table into the caller's buffer and returns it; the table is then fed to the CRC update helper 0x5F0868.

functions.name: Save_Crypto_SetKeyFromString
functions.signature: bool Save_Crypto_SetKeyFromString(void* ctx, const char* key)
functions.summary: Sets the save-data cipher key from a NUL-terminated string: resets the context state and runs the Blowfish key schedule (0x5F0E64) over strlen(key) bytes, returning whether the key was accepted.

functions.name: Save_Crypto_SealBlock
functions.signature: u32 Save_Crypto_SealBlock(void* ctx, u32* block, u32* out, const u8* key)
functions.summary: Encrypts one 8-byte block of save data with the context's Blowfish key schedule, mixes in the key/MAC bytes and verifies the resulting MAC before copying the plaintext to out; returns 1 when the block is authentic.

functions.name: Save_Crypto_OpenBlock
functions.signature: u32 Save_Crypto_OpenBlock(void* ctx, u32* block, u32* out, const u8* key)
functions.summary: Inverse of Save_Crypto_SealBlock: decrypts one 8-byte block (0x5F19E8), applies the key bytes and MAC, and writes the 13-byte plaintext record to out when the MAC matches.

functions.name: Save_Crypto_Context_Init
functions.summary: Initialises a save-data crypt context: zeroes the header, clears the 0x48-byte P-array and the 0x1000-byte S-box storage, then copies the default CRC table (0x5F082C) into the context.

functions.name: Save_Crypto_ExpandKey
functions.signature: u32 Save_Crypto_ExpandKey(void* ctx, const u8* key, u32 keyLen)
functions.summary: Blowfish key schedule for the save data: XORs the key into the 18-word P-array, encrypts the running block with the current schedule nine times to rebuild P, then rekeys all four S-boxes the same way.

functions.name: Save_Crypto_EncryptBlocks
functions.signature: u32 Save_Crypto_EncryptBlocks(void* ctx, u8* data, u32 bytes)
functions.summary: Encrypts `bytes` of data in place, eight bytes per call to the Blowfish block routine (0x5F1040); rejects lengths that are not a multiple of 8.

functions.name: Save_Crypto_DecryptBlocks
functions.signature: u32 Save_Crypto_DecryptBlocks(void* ctx, u8* data, u32 bytes)
functions.summary: Inverse of Save_Crypto_EncryptBlocks: decrypts `bytes` of data in place eight bytes at a time using 0x5F153C; rejects lengths that are not a multiple of 8.

functions.name: Save_Config_ApplyParamToTree
functions.summary: Recursively applies one parameter value to a configuration tree: for the node it calls virtual slot +0x10 four times (indices 0..3) with the value and then recurses into every child of the list at node[5].

functions.name: Svc_HandlePool_Release
functions.summary: Releases one entry of a typed handle pool: copies the entry's two

functions.name: maybe_Save_Crypto_DecryptBlockCore
functions.signature: void maybe_Save_Crypto_DecryptBlockCore(void* ctx, int* arg2, void* b)
functions.summary: Block-cipher core mixing input words for save file decryption.

functions.name: Save_Crypto_Blowfish_EncryptBlockT
functions.signature: void Save_Crypto_Blowfish_EncryptBlockT(u32* state, u32* block, u32* block2, u32 mask)
functions.summary: Blowfish block round written with four 256-entry T-tables: repeatedly combines S0[b0]+S1[b1]^S2[b2]+S3[b3] with the P-array entry and the add/rotate constants, producing one 8-byte ciphertext block.

functions.name: Save_SlotTable_Init
functions.signature: void Save_SlotTable_Init(u32* table, void* allocator, u32 slotCount, u32 entryCount)
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises the save-data slot tables: entryCount 0x70-byte records plus a bit array, and slotCount 0x88-byte slot records each holding four 0x14-byte sub-records.

functions.name: Save_UpdateSlotEntry
functions.signature: void Save_UpdateSlotEntry(SaveTable* table, SaveSlotRecord* slot, int* newValues)
functions.summary: Applies four new values to an 0x88-byte slot record, tracking which of the

functions.name: Field_CollectIdsInRect
functions.summary: Collects the objects that overlap a rectangle: it normalises the query

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePool_Alloc
functions.signature: SpriteNode* Gfx_SpritePool_Alloc(SpritePool* self, int slot, Vec4* params, int arg4)
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x70-byte sprite node from the pool: finds the first free bit in the 32-bit occupancy words at f_18 (count f_1C, used f_20), marks it, stamps the node's id/owner fields, copies the four parameter words and a monotonically increasing sequence number, and returns the node (or null when the pool is exhausted).

functions.name: Svc_HandlePool_ResetSlot
functions.summary: Recycles a handle-pool slot: copies its transform data back to the

functions.name: Field_SortPartLists
functions.summary: Normalises and merge-sorts the per-cell lists of a 2D scene: it sorts each

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_CreateInstance
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_CreateInstance(Sprite* self, SpriteSpawn* spawn, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Creates the drawable instance of a sprite/scene-node: runs the node's base init (0x5E73A4), and when the spawn record requests it allocates a 0x178-byte animation instance named 'sprite', applies the sprite template (0x2D1F28 / maybe_Anim_Instance_ApplyTemplate) and links it into the node at f_B8; then resets the sprite's 0x11-word parameter block and frees the old instance slots.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_UpdateMapRecord
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_UpdateMapRecord(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Keeps a scene node in sync with its map placement record: looks the record up by self->f_70 and asks the record (virtual +0x0C) to reposition itself to the node's X/Y (self->f_98/f_9c+4.0).

functions.name: Container_FindObjectByTypeIdF
functions.summary: Lookup helper for the engine's type-tagged object registry: hashes the handle, walks the collision chain at g_005f2f44 and returns the object whose virtual type query equals g_005f2f48, or NULL.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Trail_PushPathNode
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Trail_PushPathNode(Trail * self, int cellX, int cellY, int force)
functions.summary: Adds a reached map cell to the trail's 16-entry path ring at +0xF0 (stride 0xC, index +0x1B0): if the cell differs from the current node it first validates/connects the step unless forced, then advances the ring index capped at 15.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Trail_CanAttach
functions.summary: Stub returning 0 in trail manager module indicating trail cannot attach.

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_BuildPath
functions.summary: Rebuilds the ribbon/trail of a scene object: converts the per-segment offsets into animator-local space, normalises the segment vectors, resamples the curve (0x6F511C/0x6F4FD8) and interpolates the width factor into f_1E4.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ClearPartFlag
functions.summary: Clears a bit in the scene object's part-flag byte (+0x52) and, when the object reports itself active (vtable+0x5C), hides the two child parts at +0x2F*4/+0x30*4 through their vtable+0x38 callbacks. Called by Field_SceneObject_ReleaseEffect.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SetModelSize
functions.signature: void Field_SceneObject_SetModelSize(FieldSceneObject* self, int modelId, int animId)
functions.summary: Sets the object's model and animation ids and recomputes its size: stores both ids, converts them into the two size floats (f_98/f_9C and f_E4/f_EC), resets the per-segment offsets to zero, clears the trail state and rebuilds the trail path with 0x5F308C.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SetPartFlag
functions.summary: Sets a bit in the scene object's part-flag byte (+0x52) and asks the two child parts at +0xBC/+0xC0 to show themselves (vtable+0x3C). Called by Field_SceneObject_ShowEffect.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_ForwardCommand
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_ForwardCommand(SceneNode* self, int command, int value)
functions.summary: Scene-node command entry point: for command 0xF it first terminates the pending prop/door action (0x219764 with 0), then forwards (command, value) to every child through 0x5E754C.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_PlayAnimation
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_PlayAnimation(void* node, u32 animId, int force)
functions.summary: Plays a named/derived animation on a field scene node: resolves the node's animator, converts the id through 0x2D1814, stores it in the node's animation byte (+0x20) and starts it through the virtual +0x68 / 0x2D1258 when the node's animator is ready.

functions.name: Model_SetMeshById
functions.signature: int Model_SetMeshById(ModelObject* self, int* ids, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Switches the mesh of a model object: resolves the model/anim core (0x62F0E0) and asks it to build the instance for the requested ids (0x62C3E0, or 0x62C420 with two extra components when arg4 != 0), applies the returned sub-mesh (0x62C388/0x62C3B0), publishes the shared node handle into the sprite instance (f_B8->f_128) and records the ids in f_AC/f_B0/f_B4.

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_Update
functions.signature: void Gfx_Trail_Update(Trail* self, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Per-frame trail update: when the node owns an animation instance (f_B8) it runs the trail path follower (0x5F41AC) and then calls vtable slot 0x20 on every child.

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_TryConnectCell
functions.signature: int Gfx_Trail_TryConnectCell(Trail* self, int* cell, int newX, int newY)
functions.summary: Validity test for the trail's path buffer: compares the candidate cell

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_AdvancePathNode
functions.signature: void Gfx_Trail_AdvancePathNode(Trail* self, int arg2, int arg3)
functions.summary: Moves the trail's leading path node toward the target cell: it reads the node's current cell (f_20/f_24 offset by the cell delta f_30/f_34) and repeatedly asks the map for the next walkable cell in the needed direction (0x2D7B1C / 0x2D7D24 / 0x2D7DDC / 0x2D7F20 / 0x2D80F8), rejecting blocked cells, then pushes the accepted cell with 0x5F2F8C and can recurse into itself to advance a second segment.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_RefreshModelAndCellVisibility
functions.summary: Recomputes the cached sprite size (f_98/f_9c) from the stored model/animation ids, re-applies the current motion/state through 0x5F36E0, and then re-tests the object's map cell: if the cell is missing or considered solid the object is marked hidden (f_1d1 = 0).

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ApplyLinkedHeightOffset
functions.summary: Refreshes the object (via 0x28E37C, which itself

functions.name: Gfx_Trail_UpdateFollowPath
functions.signature: void Gfx_Trail_UpdateFollowPath(FieldSceneObject* self, int frameStep, int flags)
functions.summary: Per-frame update of the model's ribbon/trail: advances the running parameter along the sampled curve, clamps it to the segment length, tests the map cell under the trail origin and updates the trail's active flag and cached width/length values.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Trail_ClampProgress
functions.summary: Trail update step: fetches the curve/sample array through the object's vtable +0x70, clamps the two progress floats, writes the clamped progress and rebinds the trail animator (Anim_Resource_Bind). The body is heavily damaged, so only the caller and the animator rebind are trustworthy.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Trail_UpdateInterpolated
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Trail_UpdateInterpolated(int unitIndex, u32 frame, int flags)
functions.summary: Second trail follow-path update variant: interpolates the trail origin between two key frames (with a cubic segment evaluation), recomputes the segment length and the active flag at f_1C5 and applies the result to the trail node's path.

functions.name: tP_
functions.signature: void tP_(int arg1, int arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: maybe_Anim_Resource_RebindCurrentFrame
functions.summary: Builds a frame parameter block with 0x0011FFD8, zeroes the three words after it and, when the object has an animation resource at +0xB8, binds that block to it through Anim_Resource_Bind. Six unrelated callers use it, so it is the shared re-attach path for a model's animation resource.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ForceVisible
functions.summary: Saves the current visibility flag (f_1d2 = f_1d1) and forces the object visible (f_1d1 = 1); field-action code calls this so an actor is always drawn while playing its action.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_SetSubObjectBc
functions.summary: Replaces the attached sub-object at +0xbc: removes the old handle from the child list at +0x54/+0x58, stores the new handle and inserts it into that list.

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_ApplyRenderPriority
functions.summary: Resolves the object's 2D actor through the Field2D manager (work+8->+0x88, helpers 0x0062C388/0x0062C3B0 on f_B4/f_B0) and, when it exists, stores the actor's sprite-priority byte into the object's render child at +0x128.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SetSubObjectC0
functions.summary: Swaps the second attached sub-object at f_C0: detaches the old one (0x005E785C), stores the new handle and attaches it (0x005E7650). Passing 0 clears the slot, which is what maybe_Actor_Dtor does.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SetAnimatorLastFrame
functions.summary: Freezes the object on the last frame of its current animation: when an animator is attached it takes the animation length (or 0xFFFFFFFF when the length is 0) and ticks the animator owner to that frame.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_SetSubObjectTableValue

functions.summary: Searches the attached sub-object's table at +0x5C for

functions.name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_SetSubObjectValueAndNotify

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_FreeModelAndTrail
functions.summary: Finaliser for the scene object: runs the base-class teardown and, when the object was initialised, drops the render model (f_b8) and frees the three trail buffers (curve, sample table, width table), zeroing the sample count.

functions.name: Gfx_TrailObject_Ctor
functions.signature: void Gfx_TrailObject_Ctor(u32 owner, void* desc, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Constructor of a trail/ribbon render object: creates the node via 0x5E7BE8 with flag 0x40000000, installs the trail vtable and defaults, and constructs sixteen 0xC-byte segment records plus the three bounding values.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DeletingDtorSimple
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor for Field_SceneObject: frees owned blocks at +0x1B4/+0x1B8/+0x1BC via 0x0010F69C, executes base destructor 0x005E7D84, and frees memory via operator delete 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_DtorSimple
functions.summary: Destructor for a scene object variant without a name map: installs the given vtable, frees the three owned resource blocks at +0x1B4/+0x1B8/+0x1BC and runs the shared scene-object base destructor.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectPart_ReattachAndApplyParams
functions.signature: extern void Gfx_EffectPart_ReattachAndApplyParams(GfxEffectPart* self, int first, int b, Gfx_EffectPart_ReattachAndApplyParams;
functions.summary: Puts the effect part into state 4, re-attaches it to the

functions.name: Gfx_SceneNode_LoadMeshByName
functions.summary: Loads and attaches a mesh to a scene node from a resource name: builds the "mesh" resource path, loads the 0x6E4-byte model/mesh object with the node's heap, applies the node layout config, stores the result at self+0x160 and notifies the node of the new child. Used by field NPCs, UI action windows, battle action windows and plain Gfx mesh nodes, so it is the shared mesh-attach entry.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_SyncChildInstances
functions.summary: Syncs all child scene nodes: calls virtual +0x24 on each, then if the node's map id changed, resolves the record, computes two position vectors via 0x669EB8 and calls the record's vtable+8, finally delegating to 0x5F6384.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectPart_BindByName
functions.signature: void Gfx_EffectPart_BindByName(GfxEffectPart* self, GfxNode* source, const char* partName, const unsigned* params)
functions.summary: Binds a named effect part: shares the source node's resource block, copies the part name (fixed 31-char string) into the part, resolves the node id for that name on the source model, copies the 12-word parameter block and resets the 4-word default block.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectPart_ResetToDefault
functions.summary: Resets an effect part back to its defaults: releases the shared source node when asked, clears the part name to the empty string, restores the default part id and copies the built-in default 12-word and 4-word parameter blocks.

functions.name: Container_FindObjectByTypeIdG
functions.summary: Second instance of the type-tagged registry lookup, using the table at g_005f5894 and the type id g_005f5898; returns the matching object or NULL.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectPart_ReleaseBuffers
functions.summary: Releases the two optional GPU buffers of an effect part

functions.name: Gfx_EffectPart_SetTargetObject
functions.summary: Points an effect part at the object identified by the handle: extracts the object's transform, converts it into the part's local space and applies it, then stores the handle and switches the part to follow mode 3.

functions.name: Gfx_EffectPart_SetTargetPoint

functions.name: Casino_AddJackpotPayout
functions.signature: void Casino_AddJackpotPayout(int variant, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Adds one payout step to the casino jackpot pool: refreshes the counters, takes the slot-0 stored value and advances it along the selected growth curve (clock +0x64/0x78/0x8C) with Casino_CalcJackpotPayoutAmount.

functions.name: Casino_RollJackpotChance
