functions.summary: Performs the random success roll that decides whether a jackpot pays out: chooses the tier from the current coin threshold (f_44..f_4A), multiplies by the slot rate and the game-mode multiplier, and compares against a random value scaled by the configured range.

functions.name: Casino_IsJackpotClockExpired
functions.summary: Returns true when any of the four stored jackpot timestamps (work+0x24A98 plus 0x31FC/0x3204/0x320C/0x3214) lies outside the current clock window, i.e. the cached jackpot state is stale.

functions.name: Casino_AddJackpotPayoutEx
functions.signature: void Casino_AddJackpotPayoutEx(int variant, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Second half of the jackpot curve advance: the same three-way branch as 0x00601320 but with the higher curve offsets (clock +0xE0/0x108/0x130) used for the bigger jackpot tiers.

functions.name: Casino_GetJackpotBunnyCoin
functions.summary: Bound native GetJackpotBunnyCoin: refreshes the jackpot counters and then picks one of three 'bunny coin' thresholds around the current value (respecting the Work flag bytes 0x27508/0x27509 that select the high/low table) and returns the amount reached.

functions.name: Casino_RollJackpotChanceForCoins
functions.summary: Rolls the casino jackpot probability for a machine slot and the number of coins bet, refreshing the jackpot counters first when the jackpot clock has expired; returns the roll result (0 = no jackpot).

functions.name: Casino_SpendJackpotPayout
functions.summary: Deducts a payout from the jackpot pool: clamps the new value against the current clock value, stores it back as the pool's current value and propagates the difference through the four history entries with Casino_RollJackpotPayout.

functions.name: Casino_GetJackpotCoinNum
functions.signature: u32 Casino_GetJackpotCoinNum(int slot, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Bound native GetJackpotCoinNum: refreshes the counters if needed and returns the 32-bit coin value of the requested slot from Work+0x27C94.

functions.name: Casino_GetJackpotState
functions.signature: u8 Casino_GetJackpotState(int slot, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Bound native GetJackpotState: refreshes the counters if needed and returns the state byte of the requested slot (the second word of the 8-byte entry at Work+0x27C98).

functions.name: BattleScene_SyncUnitModels
functions.summary: Reconciles the models of all battle units with the scene: for each of the four sides/rows it walks the unit list, resolves each unit's model id and adds/removes the corresponding model from the event model container (special-casing transformed and boss models).

functions.name: BattleScene_SyncUnitRenderResources
functions.summary: Builds/refreshes the render resources of all battle unit slots: caches the enemy-model handle per slot (12 slots at +0x504, stride 8), loads the battle-2D models, registers the extra resource entries (399/0x1A5/400/0x18E) and finally loads the background model set for the 400 case.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_AddAnimTrack
functions.summary: Appends animation curve track range to field object at +0x165 via Anim_TimeTrack_InsertRangeStart.

functions.name: BattleScene_ApplyMonsterScale
functions.summary: Copies the current monster's display size into the battle scene's shared layout object: looks the monster id (scene+0x5D0) up in the DataManager and stores 2*height and 2*(width+depth) plus the fixed 0x42200000/0x43A00000 constants at layout+0x1018..+0x1024.

functions.name: BattleScene_RebuildScene
functions.summary: Rebuilds the battle background: resets the resource lists, refreshes the unit render resources, resolves the background state (normal / battle / special) and loads the matching background models into the scene.

functions.name: BattleScene_ApplyBackgroundSize
functions.signature: void BattleScene_ApplyBackgroundSize(void* scene, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Applies background monster size attributes to the battle scene background model objects at scene+0x348 and scene+0x358, setting width 36.0f and copying attribute word from table record 0x0063DF60.

functions.name: BattleScene_ApplySceneModels
functions.summary: Attaches the animation sets to the two background models, syncs the unit models and marks the scene as ready (f_f2 = 1).

functions.name: BattleScene_SetBackgroundLayer
functions.summary: Switches which of the two background models is active: pauses the animation of the model that becomes invisible (f_6c = 0x80) and clears the pause on the one that becomes visible.

functions.name: BattleScene_GetUnitModelSize
functions.summary: Returns the display size used for a battle unit model: id 0x34A uses the global override, otherwise the unit table, then the model record's size word, then a category default (0..4) selected through BattleScene_GetUnitModelVariant.

functions.name: BattleScene_BuildUnitKeyframes
functions.signature: void BattleScene_BuildUnitKeyframes(Battle2DScene* self, int slot, int unitIndex, int variant)
functions.summary: For every unit in party/group slot `slot` (list at work+8->+0x5C + slot*0x1C), computes its width from the model size and record (+0x88) and writes position keyframes into the scene's time track (Anim_TimeTrack_SetKeyframe on self+0x594) and the part table (self+0x35C), laying units out side by side from `unitIndex`.

functions.name: Ui_CompositeWindow_ReleaseHandles
functions.summary: Destructor of a large UI composite (0x590+ bytes): releases 12 handles at +0x504, 4 at +0x578, the handle block +0x564..+0x578 and the handles at +0x588/+0x58C, then tears down the embedded widgets at +0x33C/+0x34C/+0x35C/+0x4EC/+0x594/+0x304.

functions.name: BattleScene_DispatchUnitVariant
functions.summary: Dispatches unit-variant setup from the battle work byte +0x4201: value 6 calls BattleScene_BuildKeyframes, 7 calls the variant-2 entry and anything else calls BattleScene_BuildUnitKeyframes_2.

functions.name: BattleScene_SyncAllUnitSlots
functions.summary: Synchronises all four unit slot lists with the scene's model container, adding missing unit models and finally advancing the battle action queue.

functions.name: BattleScene_AreUnitModelsReady
functions.signature: u32 BattleScene_AreUnitModelsReady(void* scene, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c)
functions.summary: Checks whether every unit model slot of the battle scene is loaded: validates the 12 side handles, the 4 extra handles, the 5-handle block and the two reserve handles all resolve to render objects in state 4; returns 1 when all are ready.

functions.name: BattleScene_SetSceneNodeFlag
functions.signature: void BattleScene_SetSceneNodeFlag(void* scene, u32 arg2, u8 flag)
functions.summary: Small setter: resolves the scene-node/model entry at scene+0x35C (Event_ActorModels_FindModelByHandle) and stores the flag byte in its +0x6D field; does nothing when the entry is not found.

functions.name: BattleScene_LayoutUnitModel
functions.signature: u32 BattleScene_LayoutUnitModel(void * scene, void * unit, u32 pos, int offset)
functions.summary: Places one battle unit's model on screen: picks the model track, resolves the unit's height and variant from the model table, writes the slide position and registers the keyframe track; returns 1 when a model was laid out.

functions.name: BattleScene_HasUnitAnimTrack
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the battle scene's unit animation track at self+0x594 holds at least one key for modelId (0xFFFF means 'no model', answer 0). The sibling at 0x006042F0 resets and re-primes that very list with the Anim_TimeTrack_* helpers.

functions.name: BattleScene_AdjustUnitModelHeightA
functions.signature: int BattleScene_AdjustUnitModelHeightA(void* scene, void* unit, u32 pos, int offset)
functions.summary: Shifts a unit model up by the unit's model height (0x63024 scaled by g_00604034), updates the keyframe track (0x43DAC4) and the slide position (0x4B8A14); returns the adjusted offset.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_RegisterChildObject
functions.summary: Battle scene child object initialiser truncated by mid-routine split symbol at 0x00604054.

functions.name: maybe_Data_MisparsedSeed00604054
functions.summary: Spurious function entry point in the middle of ARM routine 0x0060404C created by Ghidra.

functions.name: BattleScene_AttachSecondaryUnitModels
functions.summary: For every unit in the four battle lists whose vtable +0x1C check passes, attaches its secondary model to the scene (Event_ActorModels_AttachModelB) and starts animation 0x35.

functions.name: BattleScene_AdjustUnitModelHeightB
functions.signature: int BattleScene_AdjustUnitModelHeightB(void* scene, void* unit, u32 pos, int offset)
functions.summary: Second height-shift variant: same model-size lookup but moves the unit by twice the computed height, used for the mirrored/right-hand layout.

functions.name: BattleScene_AttachPrimaryUnitModels
functions.summary: Closes the previous battle scene (Battle_CloseBattleScene) and attaches the primary model of every unit in the four battle lists through Event_ActorModels_AttachModelA.

functions.name: Field_Object_ResetAnimTrack
functions.summary: Resets the object's anim time-track list at self+0x594 and immediately inserts one range-start entry {0x00782234, self->f_b8} for the object's own id. It is vtable slot +0x28 of the field-object class at 0x0077F7D0.

functions.name: BattleScene_SetUnitFadeFull
functions.summary: Sets battle unit fade opacity byte (+0x78) to 0xFF (fully opaque), either through unit handle at +0x8E4 (0x0031F204) or directly on model object at +0x8E8.

functions.name: BattleScene_SetUnitFadeNone
functions.summary: Clears fade opacity byte (+0x78) to 0 on a battle unit model, either via unit handle at +0x8E4 (0x0031F204) or directly through model object at +0x8E8.

functions.name: BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilities
functions.signature: u32 BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilities(void* scene, void* unit, u32 abilityId, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Validates monster ability entries (0x14 bytes each) from data manager table 0x006400B4 against registered actor abilities (0x001BBC0C); returns status predicate u32.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_TryUpdateUnitAttachments
functions.signature: int maybe_BattleScene_TryUpdateUnitAttachments(Battle2DScene* scene, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Retry wrapper for battle scene unit model attachments: calls BattleScene_UpdateUnitModelAttachments with trailing argument -1; if unsuccessful, retries with trailing argument 1, returning 1 on success.

functions.name: BattleScene_BuildUnitKeyframes_2
functions.signature: int BattleScene_BuildUnitKeyframes_2(Battle2DScene* self, int numSides, float* out, void* callback)
functions.summary: Default battle-2D unit setup: walks the unit lists, computes each unit's animation keyframes from the model size and the configured timing constants, writes them into the scene's time track and updates the unit model attachments.

functions.name: maybe_Data_MisparsedSeed0060488C
functions.summary: Spurious mid-routine symbol inside a battle-scene routine resulting in coprocessor instructions.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilitiesThumb
functions.signature: u32 maybe_BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilitiesThumb(u32 scene, void* unit, u32 abilityId, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Thumb implementation of the ability validation loop in 0x00604430: walks the unit's ability list and reports whether the requested ability id is present and usable.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilitiesC
functions.signature: u32 maybe_BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilitiesC(u32 scene, int index, int entries)
functions.summary: Ability validation loop reading entry IDs and querying Pack_HandleChain_IsReleased.

functions.name: BattleScene_RegisterUnitAbilities
functions.signature: void BattleScene_RegisterUnitAbilities(void* scene, void* unit, u32 abilityId, u32 ctx)
functions.summary: Registers matching monster abilities from data manager table 0x006400B4 into the actor's ability set via 0x001BBF84.

functions.name: BattleScene_UpdateUnitModelAttachments
functions.signature: int BattleScene_UpdateUnitModelAttachments(Battle2DScene* self, int side, unsigned additional, int additional2, int force)
functions.summary: Decides which battle units need their models (re)attached: for each unit it compares the unit's state/visible flag with the attached model's state, waits for the model's timer to expire and then adds or removes the model from the container.

functions.name: maybe_Data_VfpLiteral00604EA6
functions.summary: Literal-pool data misparsed by Ghidra as VFP coprocessor instructions.

functions.name: maybe_Data_VfpLiteral00604EBA
functions.summary: Literal-pool words decoded as VFP coprocessor instructions without independent control flow.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_UpdateUnitModelAttachmentsB
functions.signature: int maybe_BattleScene_UpdateUnitModelAttachmentsB(Battle2DScene* self, int side, unsigned* additional, int additional2)
functions.summary: Second (Thumb) decode of the unit-model attachment update: walks one side's unit list, resolves each unit's model record and compares the model's position against the unit's, breaking out when the sign of the difference changes.

functions.name: maybe_Data_VfpLiteral00604F16
functions.signature: void maybe_Data_VfpLiteral00604F16(u32* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Literal-pool fragment with three stores followed by halt_baddata.

functions.name: BattleScene_ReleaseUnitSlotHandles
functions.summary: Releases every packed handle held by the battle-2D unit slots: the 12 per-side handles, the 4 extra handles, the 5 slot handles and the two scene lists, resetting each handle to the null encoding.

functions.name: BattleScene_BuildUnitKeyframesVariant
functions.summary: Keyframe builder for scene variant 7: for every unit in the four lists records its base offset (self+0x35C) and, for body id 400 only, writes an extra keyframe (Anim_TimeTrack_SetKeyframe) with the global keyframe value.

functions.name: maybe_Scene_ActorModelStateStep
functions.summary: Scene state step that drives the actor-model group states: updates the actor-model manager at self+0x35C, then advances the state id at self+0x134 through -1 -> 0x5AE -> 0x5B9 -> 0x5BF, calling the resource node's vtable+0x1C/+0x24/+0x28 with the group arguments and playing SE 0xD13 and popup 0xE81 at the transitions.

functions.name: BattleScene_SetupUnitModel
functions.signature: u32 BattleScene_SetupUnitModel(int scene, int unit, u32 render, int fullPass)
functions.summary: Builds or repositions one battle unit's model: reads the monster id, applies the +0x28 height for ids 0x18F/0x1A5/0x350, and on the full pass allocates the model slot, loads the unit sub-resources and writes the model position from the monster record height.

functions.name: BattleScene_BuildKeyframes
functions.summary: Keyframe builder variant: for every unit in the four battle lists records an offset (40 for body ids 0x18F, 0x1A5 and 0x350, else 0) and the record's -f_88 height into the scene part table (func_004B8A14 on self+0x35C).

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_IsEntryRegistered
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the battle cutscene flag +0x4244 or the entry's +0x10 flag is set, else whether the entry is registered in the scene part table at screen+0x35C (func_004B98F8).

functions.name: Battle2DScene_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and initializes the Battle2DScene object instance, installing vtable 0x0077F7C8 and constructing 12 battle unit slots.

functions.name: Ui_LayoutWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a large UI layout window (vtable 0x77F7C8): unlinks the intrusive lists at 0x165/0x166/0x169, releases the layout handle at +0x163, then destroys the embedded pane objects/animations at -0x10/-0x24/-0x84/-0x9C/-0x1A8/-0x22C/-0x23C/-0x24C/-0x284/-0x304.

functions.name: BattleScene_ResetTimeTracks
functions.summary: Resets the four animation time tracks used by the party models.

functions.name: BattleScene_BuildMemberModel
functions.signature: int BattleScene_BuildMemberModel(BattleScene* screen, BattleMember* entry, unsigned flags)
functions.summary: Creates the render model for one party member from their equipment/style data: allocates the 0x240-byte model setup block, resolves the character style and grip slots, and builds the model with its animation slots.

functions.name: BattleScene_UpdateState
functions.summary: State machine of the battle scene: dispatches the per-state update/setup routines for states 0..7 and hides the two helper list widgets (work+0x4254/+0x4270) when a state does not need them.

functions.name: Container_ReleaseEntryListFrom
functions.signature: void Container_ReleaseEntryListFrom(void* owner, Container* list, int firstIndex, int context)
functions.summary: Releases the entries of an intrusive list either entirely (index 0) or from the given index onwards, releasing each entry's model handle and then the entry itself.

functions.name: BattleScene_RefreshModelHandles
functions.summary: Re-resolves the render-model handle of every party member in the two member lists and then rebuilds the per-slot models from the refreshed handles.

functions.name: BattleScene_LayoutUnitModel_2
functions.signature: void BattleScene_LayoutUnitModel_2(BattleScene* self, unsigned handle, int count, int index, int variant)
functions.summary: Places a battle unit model on screen: resolves the node (func_005F5818), puts it in state 4, computes its slot position from the entry count and index (staggering rows when several units share a slot) and writes the resulting transform through BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlideTransform.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_UpdateUnitModelsByState
functions.signature: int maybe_BattleScene_UpdateUnitModelsByState(BattleScene* self, BattleMember* member, * unsigned arg3, int index)
functions.summary: State-dependent unit model update: for the intro/idle states it delegates to the model rebuild, for the list-open state it walks the four unit lists and updates each unit's model and placement.

functions.name: BattleScene_StartSceneTransition
functions.signature: void BattleScene_StartSceneTransition(BattleScene* self, int forward, unsigned extra)
functions.summary: Starts the battle-scene transition: writes the transition state pair (3/2 for close, 2/3 for open) and pushes it to the scene-transition controller; the close path additionally requests the scene close and the open path loads the transition layout.

functions.name: BattleScene_ReleaseSceneModels
functions.summary: Releases everything the battle scene allocated: stops the battle, frees the nine per-unit model handles, the shared time track and the four animation tracks.

functions.name: BattleScene_RefreshCommandWidgets
functions.summary: Refreshes the battle command widgets: for every visible list item it enables/disables the widget's sub-elements, commits the equipment node changes of the displayed model and lays the units out again.

functions.name: BattleScene_LoadCommonModelResource
functions.signature: void BattleScene_LoadCommonModelResource(BattleScene* self, unsigned* outPair, int resourceIndex)
functions.summary: Loads the battle common model archive ('battlecmn.bch') once, retrieves the requested resource and writes its two values (e.g. model id and size) to the output pair.

functions.name: BattleScene_CalcUnitModelSize
functions.summary: Computes a battle monster model's effective size metric in VFP s0 by adding its size-variant base (1.0f..5.0f from BattleScene_GetUnitModelVariant) to MonsterRecord->f32_5C.

functions.name: BattleScene_WaitForModelHandles
functions.summary: Polls the six loading model handles: returns 0 while any handle is still incomplete, and once all are ready releases them and returns 1.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_SendTransitionCommand4
functions.summary: Sends command 4 with no argument to the scene-transition controller at work+8->+0x74. Slot 19 of the 22-slot battle scene vtable.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_UpdateExtraController
functions.summary: When the transition controller's state (+0x6C) is one of 2..6 and the object registry reports ready (func_0062B32C), switches the scene's extra controller (f_E4 vtable +0x14) on; returns 1.

functions.name: BattleScene_SetTransitionStateByEvent
functions.summary: Maps a scene event code to the pair of transition states (f_300/f_304) and notifies the scene node, used to drive the battle intro/outro animations.

functions.name: BattleScene_PlaySwitchbackAnimation
functions.summary: Starts the 'switchback_start' animation on the model of every unit: looks each unit's node up and plays the named animation with the switch-back flag set.

functions.name: BattleScene_IsModelSelectable
functions.summary: Returns whether the given model may be chosen/displayed for the current battle mode: mode 0 delegates to the unit check, mode 1 only accepts ids below 3, mode 2 uses the alternate check.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_SendTransitionCommand5
functions.summary: Sends command 5 with no argument to the scene-transition controller at work+8->+0x74. Slot 20 of the 22-slot battle scene vtable.

functions.name: BattleScene_IsCharacterOnSideOrAbsent
functions.signature: int BattleScene_IsCharacterOnSideOrAbsent(BattleScene* self, int characterId, int arg3, int side)
functions.summary: Searches the four battle unit lists for the unit whose character byte (+0x114) equals `characterId`; returns 1 if it is in list `side` or not present at all, 0 if it is in another list.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_InitAndUpdatePartyStatusFlags
functions.summary: 24-byte thunk: calls Battle_Initialize and then falls through into the party status-flag refresh at 0x00607B94 (0x385D38-style split symbol). The long body Ghidra prints here belongs to that sibling.

functions.name: maybe_Menu_UpdatePartyStatusFlags
functions.summary: For each party unit builds a three-bit mask from the unit's status tests (vtable +0x24 and +0xE8 with ids 0x6A/0x6B/0x1A) and refreshes widgets 1..3 whose bit changed.

functions.name: BattleScene_Finish
functions.summary: Ends the battle scene: finishes the battle and moves the scene state to 7 (finished).

functions.name: BattleScene_ShowUnitWidgets
functions.summary: Calls the scene's own show hook and then makes all four unit widget lists visible.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_ApplyUnitListFloatParams
functions.summary: Applies per-list float parameters to the four battle unit lists (+0x428C + i*0x1C) depending on the battle scene object (+0x4320/+0x404), the formation byte +0x4210 and the battle kind +0x4201 (3..7).

functions.name: BattleScene_LayoutEnemyFormation
functions.summary: Places the enemy models according to the current formation block: reads the 9-word formation descriptor (positions, counts, scale) and distributes the enemy units across the screen.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_CreateFormationWidgets
functions.summary: Creates one status widget per member of the current enemy formation (+0x4E90..+0x4E98) using the shared UI singleton and the render context.

functions.name: BattleScene_SelectMemberEntry
functions.summary: Highlights the member entry indicated by the battle's selection index: hides both helper lists, looks the entry up by index and starts its focus animation.

functions.name: BattleScene_ReleaseReserveHandles
functions.summary: Releases the model handles of the reserve (non-active) party members stored in the work list at +0x427C.

functions.name: BattleScene_ResetAndInitTimeTracks
functions.summary: Resets the four animation time tracks and, in the default battle mode, re-initialises them from the scene's start timestamp.

functions.name: BattleScene_ReleaseUnitHandles
functions.summary: Releases the model handle of every unit in all four battle sides.

functions.name: BattleScene_BuildEnemyModel
functions.summary: Creates an enemy unit's render model: fills the model descriptor (equipment/colour/style fields) and instantiates the model through the same path as the party member builder.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_StartTransitionBetweenScenes2And5
functions.summary: Starts a transition between scene ids 2 and 5: writes the pair in the order given by `forward` and sends command 0 with it, or, when going forward, builds a target through func_006074F8 and sends command 3.

functions.name: BattleScene_StartTransitionWithTarget
functions.signature: void BattleScene_StartTransitionWithTarget(BattleScene* self, int forward, int target, int useTarget)
functions.summary: Starts the battle-scene transition through the scene transition controller (work+8->+0x74): backwards with states 2/5, or forwards with an optional target resolved from the container at useTarget->f_11C (Container_FindEntryByKey).

functions.name: BattleScene_ReleaseMemberHandles
functions.summary: Releases the model handles of the active party members stored in the work list at +0x4260.

functions.name: BattleScene_LayoutPartyModels
functions.summary: Lays out the party member models: chooses the grid from the current screen state, then places every member of the active list (and possibly the reserves) at its slot.

functions.name: BattleScene_BuildPartyModel
functions.signature: int BattleScene_BuildPartyModel(BattleScene* self, BattleMember* member, int slot)
functions.summary: Builds (or rebuilds) the render model of one party member and adds it to the scene: creates the keyframe tracks for its body, applies the slot's position/scale and inserts the animation keys.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_UpdateScreenState0
functions.summary: Small entry point that flows into the battle-scene state-0 update at 0x00609498 (BattleScene_UpdateScreenState0Main); it shares the literal pool constant 0x00609988 with that function.

functions.name: BattleScene_UpdateScreenState0Main
functions.summary: Main update for battle screen state 0: recomputes each member's position/keyframes from the list layout and refreshes the time tracks.

functions.name: BattleScene_UpdateUnitSlots
functions.summary: Refreshes the battle unit slots: walks the four unit lists, assigns free model slots by unit variant, unlinks released actors and repositions each unit model for the current state.

functions.name: BattleScene_AdjustUnitModelTransform
functions.summary: Adjusts battle unit model transform offsets by monster model classification (types 100/0x7B/0x7C), reading the model record and updating the unit's node.

functions.name: BattleScene_PlaceUnitModel
functions.signature: void BattleScene_PlaceUnitModel(BattleScene* self, unsigned modelHandle, int count, int index)
functions.summary: Places a unit model in its row: computes the horizontal spacing from the row size and index and writes the position into the node's transform.

functions.name: BattleScene_UpdateScreenState1
functions.summary: Update routine for battle screen state 1: assigns a screen slot to every active party member (up to 5) and positions the model accordingly.

functions.name: BattleScene_UpdateUnitModel
functions.signature: int BattleScene_UpdateUnitModel(BattleScene* self, BattleUnit* unit, int arg3)
functions.summary: Per-state model refresh of one battle unit: skips units whose model is already attached, merges the animation tracks for the unit variant and builds/positions its member model.

functions.name: BattleScene_ValidateModelForUnit
functions.summary: Checks that a model id can be used by the currently displayed unit: walks the four unit lists, verifies the id's category and the corresponding animation track is present.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_StartTransitionBetweenScenes2And4
functions.summary: Writes the scene-id pair 2/4 in the order given by `forward` and sends command 0 with it to the transition controller. Slot 18 of the 22-slot battle scene vtable.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_HideDistantUnits
functions.summary: Releases the actor handles of battle units that pass a distance check and are not referenced by three battle-work lookups (func_00632778/func_00631E80/func_00631BA4).

functions.name: BattleScene_UpdateUnitModelTransforms
functions.summary: Per-frame update of every unit model's transform: computes the row/column offsets from the list counts, animates the arc keyframes and applies the animation scale to the sprite node.

functions.name: BattleScene_PreloadUnitModelVariants
functions.signature: void BattleScene_PreloadUnitModelVariants(BattleScene* self, void** entries, int count)
functions.summary: When the battle work's +0x4201 counter is above 2, walks the given scene objects and asks BattleScene_GetUnitModelVariant for the model variant of every entry that is not flagged at +0x10 and has a real body id, so the variants exist before they are needed.

functions.name: BattleScene_LoadTransitionLayout
functions.summary: Loads the resource archive used by the battle scene transition and resolves its entry values into the output; the same lazy-singleton pattern as the battlecmn.bch loader.

functions.name: BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlotTransform
functions.signature: void BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlotTransform(BattleScene* self, unsigned handle, int count, int index)
functions.summary: Writes the slot transform for a unit model: sets the scale fields from the slot constants, selects the position from the slot table and applies it.

functions.name: BattleScene_RefreshUnitLayout
functions.summary: Hides both helper lists and then re-places every unit model on all four sides according to the current slot table, refreshing the party visibility mask.

functions.name: BattleScene_ReleaseAndFinish
functions.summary: Releases every unit model handle and then tail-calls virtual slot +0x30 of the same object - 'release the units, then let the derived scene finish/tear down'.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_CountVisibleUnits
functions.summary: Counts the visible entries of the battle unit list at battle+0x4254 through Container_List_CountVisible; the remainder of the body is lost to a bad-instruction truncation.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawList_SubmitAll
functions.summary: Submits the per-screen draw lists: iterates the two intrusive lists at subsystem+0x4260 and +0x427C, calls virtual +0x24 (visibility) on each entry and forwards visible entries to 0x60CD5C with the list's screen id.

functions.name: BattleScene_PlaceTwoUnits
functions.signature: void BattleScene_PlaceTwoUnits(BattleScene* self, BattleMember* first, BattleMember* b)
functions.summary: Places exactly two unit models side by side (e.g. attacker and target of a battle action) using the shared slot placement helper.

functions.name: BattleScene_PlaceUnitArray
functions.signature: void BattleScene_PlaceUnitArray(BattleScene* self, BattleMember** members, unsigned count)
functions.summary: Places an arbitrary number of unit models side by side, used when several units act or are shown together.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_Step
functions.summary: Undecodable battle-scene step: only the game-work fetch survives before the decode hits bad instruction data. The name is a placeholder until the function is re-disassembled.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_DrawList_SubmitScreen
functions.summary: Draw-list submission routine for screen display truncated by bad instructions.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_LayoutPartyUnits
functions.summary: Fragment of the battle-scene placement routine: only the std_ConstructArray setup of a 780-byte stack block over four 8-byte elements survives at this entry point, so the party-layout reading comes from the vtable slot (0x0077F9AC+0x3C), not from the visible body.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_LayoutPartyUnits_Tail
functions.summary: Tail fragment of BattleScene_LayoutPartyUnits, created when Ghidra split the function at the non-returning std_ConstructArray call: normalises the placement vectors and sets the node direction from the g_battleUnitSlotPos4 table.

functions.name: BattleScene_UpdateUnitKeyframes
functions.summary: Rebuilds the per-unit keyframes for all four sides: resets the four time tracks and then writes each unit's model keys with the configured timing values.

functions.name: BattleScene_BuildUnitModelForAction
functions.signature: int BattleScene_BuildUnitModelForAction(void * self, void * member, int slot)
functions.summary: Builds the battle model used by one member for an action: special-cases body id 0x360 (a guest/boss form) and otherwise reuses the party/member model builder and places the result in the requested slot.

functions.name: BattleScene_AdjustUnitNodeTransformA
functions.summary: Model node transform adjustment for monster types 0x74/0x83/0x84: applies the per-type position and orientation offsets to the unit's model node.

functions.name: BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlideTransform
functions.signature: void BattleScene_ApplyUnitSlideTransform(BattleScene* self, unsigned handle, int step, int index)
functions.summary: Applies the slide-in transform used when a unit enters the battle: selects a position from the slide table and animates the node to it.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_UpdateUnitKeyframesB
functions.summary: Second keyframe/transform update pass for battle units: iterates units and advances time tracks via Anim_TimeTrack_Init.

functions.name: BattleScene_CanShowModels
functions.summary: Checks whether the battle scene may currently show the given model: verifies the unit exists and that the scene's four time tracks are free or expired.

functions.name: maybe_BattleScene_UpdateActionAnimation
functions.summary: Drives the per-action battle animation: when the action id changes to the attack code it plays the matching sound/effect for every unit and advances the animation.

functions.name: BattleScene_PositionUnitModelWithAnim
functions.signature: void BattleScene_PositionUnitModelWithAnim(BattleScene* self, float time, unsigned handle, int count, int index)
functions.summary: Advanced per-unit placement that also builds the movement arc: computes the interpolation between the current and target slot, appends the keyframes to the unit's track and applies the resulting transform.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSprite2D_ApplyAnimScale
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneSprite2D_ApplyAnimScale(FieldLevel* level, SceneSprite2D* sprite, AnimObject* anim)
functions.summary: Reads the scale triple of a 2D animation object and stores it on both the render node (f_9C/f_A0/f_A4) and the sprite record (f_750..f_758), normalises the negated XZ direction into the facing vector and copies the animation into the level's anim-track slot.

functions.name: BattleScene_AdjustUnitNodeTransformB
functions.summary: Model node transform adjustment for monster types 0x81/0x76: applies the position offset, updates the model node and stores the resulting position in the unit cache fields.

functions.name: BattleScene_AssignUnitAnimSlot
functions.signature: u8 BattleScene_AssignUnitAnimSlot(void* battle, int spriteIndex, int activeCount)
functions.summary: Chooses an animation slot (0..3, 4 = none) for each of the four 2D unit sprites by inspecting the active battle units at battle+0x428C and their model variants, so sprites sharing an animation do not collide; returns the slot chosen for the requested sprite.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneSprite2D_InitAnimSlots
functions.summary: Initializes four animation tracks of level 2D sprite objects: binds time track records and resets playback timers.

functions.name: Menu_WindowLayout_Teardown
functions.summary: Releases the window's animation sub-object and, when the lazily created menu singleton (0x007BE370, vtable 0x00782A98) has flag 0x2000, sets the battle-work byte +0x4251.

functions.name: BattleScene_UnitPlacement_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and constructs the BattleScene unit placement manager, installing vtable 0x0077F9AC and 4 sub-object descriptors.

functions.name: BattleScene_UnitPlacement_Dtor
functions.summary: Virtual destructor for the BattleScene unit placement manager (vtable 0x0077F9AC slot 0), destroying owned arrays and freeing memory.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_SetBothViews
functions.summary: Applies view setting to both 3DS screens by invoking vtable slot +0x28 with screen indices 0 and 1.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Screen_SetBothFades
functions.summary: Dispatches fade parameters to screen displays via screen selector helper 0x0060E7FC.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_IsVisibleBoth
functions.summary: Checks if both 3DS screens are visible by querying vtable slot +0x34 for screen indices 0 and 1; returns status predicate u32.

functions.name: Ui_Bar_StartFadeInThunk
functions.summary: Tail-calls Ui_Bar_StartFadeIn (0x0017BBFC) with arguments unchanged.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_IsEnabledBoth
functions.summary: Queries vtable slot +0x24 for screen indices 0 and 1, returning 1 if both screens are enabled; returns status predicate u32.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_IsFadingBoth
functions.summary: Queries vtable slot +0x30 for screen indices 0 and 1, returning 1 if both screens are actively fading; returns status predicate u32.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Screen_CreateTargets
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Screen_CreateTargets(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates the screen's two target objects (counts 2 and 5) with maybe_Gfx_Screen_CreateTarget and then allocates a 0x1D0-byte object from the UI heap.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Screen_CreateTarget
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_Screen_CreateTarget(int self, u32 count, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Creates one target object of the given count: bails out when the slot is already filled, otherwise allocates a 0x1D0-byte object from the UI heap.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Screen_DestroyTargets
functions.summary: Destroys per-screen rendering target objects.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Screen_BindTarget
functions.summary: Binds a per-screen rendering target.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_ForwardFadeOut
functions.signature: void Gfx_Screen_ForwardFadeOut(int self, u32 screenIndex, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Tail-call forwarder: picks the per-screen fade window (self+4 for screen 0, self+8 for screen 1) and jumps to its fade-out entry 0x0017BD1C (Ui_Bar_StartFadeOut).

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_ForwardSetAlphaVariant
functions.signature: void Gfx_Screen_ForwardSetAlphaVariant(int self, u32 screenIndex, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Tail branch of the identical 20-byte forwarder at 0x0060E7A0: selects the per-screen fade window and jumps to its alpha-variant entry 0x0017BDC8 (Ui_Bar_SetAlphaVariant).

functions.name: Ui_Screen_ReleaseBuffers
functions.signature: void Ui_Screen_ReleaseBuffers(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Releases both per-screen buffers through the UI core allocator (Ui_GetCore(...)+0xC, func_0021F8B8) and clears the two pointers.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_GetClearColor
functions.summary: Returns the clear/fade colour for one of seven colour modes after byte-swapping the stored RGBA word; selects screen object +4 or +8 from the index.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_GetClearColorByMode
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Screen_GetClearColorByMode(int self, u32 screenIndex, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Continuation of Gfx_Screen_GetClearColor (real entry 0x0060E7FC): reads the selected screen's fade value, then switches on colour mode 0..6 and returns the matching global colour word with its bytes swapped into the engine's RGBA order.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_SetBothFadesAlt
functions.summary: Dispatches alternate fade parameters to both 3DS screens by calling vtable slot +0x1C for screen indices 0 and 1.

functions.name: Gfx_Screen_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the per-screen object: installs vtable 0x77FB78 and releases the two screen buffers.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_CreateDefaultMesh
functions.summary: Creates the default 200x120 ('sprite') mesh for a 2D sprite object, stores it in self->f_b8 and registers it with the object so it is drawn.

functions.name: Sound_SceneBgmTrigger_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a scene-BGM trigger on a 2D object: accumulates dt; after 1 s switches to state 1, and after a further 0.4 s with the trigger touched resolves the scene BGM id (Snd_ResolveSceneBgmId) and commits it (Snd_CommitPendingBgmId).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneNode_SetupFourSpriteParts
functions.summary: Same record-copy head as 0x0061A5C4 (owner/palette ids at +0xAC/+0xB0/+0xB4, sprite actor creation and animation), but then builds four 0x48-byte sprite part sub-objects at +0x298 with Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild, taking the animation id straight from desc+0x18.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_BeginTouchEvent
functions.summary: Starts a touch/click event for a 2D field object: builds the event record from the object position and a type derived from the current screen, stores it in f_3b8..f_3c0 and resets the event timer.

functions.name: Field_SpriteSceneObject_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and constructs a 2D field sprite scene object, installing vtable 0x0077FBDC and constructing 4 sprite part components.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Truncated destructor of the sprite-object class: installs vtable 0x0077FBDC (+0x9C sub-vtable) and destroys the four 0x48-byte mesh entries at +0x298; the body then runs into data, so the base-class part is missing.

functions.name: Gfx_SpriteObject_Dtor_Part2
functions.summary: Second half of the sprite-object destructor at 0x0060EE9C: tears down the child object at self+0x24C, unlinks self from the list at self+0x234, runs the Field object base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Field_Level_ResetRuntime
functions.summary: Resets a loaded field level back to an empty state: clears the four 2D object pointers, releases the level3d/level2d data, the two resource handles and the five pack handles, resets the NPC tables and reinitialises the flags used by the loader.

functions.name: Field_Level_LoadResources
functions.signature: void Field_Level_LoadResources(FieldLevel* self, int packId, int subId)
functions.summary: Loads the level3d/level2d resource pair for a scene id: checks the handle generations in f_88/f_90, applies the sky/weather selection, then sets up the file path and handle through the resource manager.

functions.name: Field_Level_DestroyRuntime
functions.summary: Destructor counterpart of Field_Level_ResetRuntime: frees the level3d/level2d data, resource handles and pack handles and zeroes the loader flags.

functions.name: Field_Npc_Face_AdvanceFrame
functions.signature: void Field_Npc_Face_AdvanceFrame(NpcFace* self, unsigned char pattern, int snap)
functions.summary: Selects a facial/animation pattern for an NPC and advances its frame counter, exposing the normalised progress in f_28 (frame / total).  With snap != 0 the animation jumps straight to the last frame.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetPartVisible
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetPartVisible(SceneSpriteSet* self, int bit, int visible)
functions.summary: Sets or clears one bit of the part-visibility mask (f_30) and pushes the new fade state to every sprite entry in the group's table whose id matches.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_ApplyPreset
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_ApplyPreset(SceneSpriteSet* self, int presetIndex, int arg3)
functions.summary: Looks up a preset record (0xd4-byte stride) by index and applies it to both embedded sprite groups (f_98 and f_114); a negative or out-of-range index clears the record pointer.

functions.name: Field_Level_LoadMapData
functions.summary: Loads the level3d.bxon and level2d.bxon tables for the current map, resolves their record tables, and hands the 3D/2D object lists to the NPC-table loaders.

functions.name: Field_Level_InitFromRecord
functions.signature: bool Field_Level_InitFromRecord(FieldLevel* self, unsigned short* record)
functions.summary: Initialises a field level from a BXON/map record: stores the two map ids, resolves their packed names, sets the 3D/2D data handles and loads the two common .pack members, then resets the per-map flags.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_RefreshPreset
functions.summary: Re-applies the currently stored preset to both sprite groups (group B first, then group A) using the saved animation-index/type pair f_21/f_20.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetVisibleMask
functions.summary: Turns on every part whose bit is set in mask (bits 0..7), i.e. a convenience wrapper over SceneSpriteSet_SetPartVisible.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_Init
functions.summary: Initialises both sprite groups of a scene (loads their slot resources), applies the stored preset f_1f, and refreshes colours/fades of both groups.

functions.name: Field_LevelVisualData_Load
functions.summary: Loads the field level's visual data: opens level_mapType.bxon, level_weatherVisual.bxon and textures.bch from the PACK manager, validates their types (0xC) and stores the handles plus the 'encount2d' texture id used by the encounter effect.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetAnimType
functions.summary: Changes the sprite set's animation type byte +0x37 when the set is active and the value differs, then rebuilds the preset through Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_ApplyPreset so callers can switch between idle/action sprite sets.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetCharacterId
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_SetCharacterId(SceneSpriteSet* self, unsigned int characterId, unsigned int arg3, int force)
functions.summary: Selects the sprite set's active character id: stores it in f_1E, resolves the 0xD4-stride record and its redirect byte f_D1, then re-applies the preset with the (possibly redirected) id so the new character model/animation is built.

functions.name: Field_Level_Build2dPackName
functions.summary: Formats the 2D map pack path "level2d/%s.pack" for a level into a 32-character buffer and passes it with the record pointer to the wide-string formatter 0x707A58.

functions.name: Field_Level_Build3dPackName
functions.summary: Formats the 3D map pack path "level3d/%s.pack" for a level into a 32-character buffer and passes it to 0x707A58.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_UpdatePresets
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a scene sprite set's two layers: interpolates the first layer's cloud colours with Field_Sky_InterpolateCloudColors, blends the second layer's presets with Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_BlendPresets when f_35 is clear, and only under debug global 0x7A68E0 appends the active slot ids to a diagnostic string.

functions.name: maybe_Field_GetActiveSubObject
functions.summary: Accessor: returns self+0x98 when the embedded sub-object reports itself active through 0x0066A6BC, otherwise NULL. Callers use the result as an optional visual/effect object.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_GetGroupB
functions.summary: Returns a pointer to the second embedded sprite group (self+0x114) when its handle is valid, otherwise NULL.

functions.name: Field_LevelData_Reset
functions.summary: Resets the field level data to its empty state before loading a new map: clears the encounter texture id, the NPC/actor tables, the layout and resource handles, and restores the default light/time-of-day fields.

functions.name: Field_Level_InitSpriteSets
functions.summary: Initialises the field-level work record: clears its flags/handle words to the 0xFFFFF000 'none' sentinel, then creates the sprite sub-set and sprite set containers and three further embedded blocks, returning the base pointer of the constructed record.

functions.name: Field_LevelData_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of the loaded level data: releases the NPC data at +0x768 and then unwinds the message/UI sub-objects and their pack handles in reverse construction order.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_FindOrInsert
functions.signature: void* Container_HashMap_FindOrInsert(ContainerHashMap* self, ScriptValuePair* key, unsigned int* outBucket, int** outPrev, int allowInsert)
functions.summary: Open-addressing hash map lookup over reference-counted Squirrel values: hashes the key, walks the collision chain, and when allowInsert is non-zero grows the table and inserts a new entry.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_Resize
functions.summary: Reallocates the hash bucket array with the given size and re-inserts every existing entry, releasing the old array.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_Remove
functions.summary: Removes a key from the script-value hash map, unlinking it from its bucket chain and returning the entry to the free list; returns 1 when the key existed.

functions.name: Ui_Window_HideMembers
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_HideMembers(u32* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Clears visibility flag bit 0 on the three member child panes (self[1..3]+0x44) and updates text layout via 0x001A6680.

functions.name: Ui_Object_CtorWithBase
functions.summary: Constructor for a small UI object: zeroes the header, sets a default flag byte and id -1, constructs the base Ui_Object at +0x1c and installs vtable g_006110c4.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorWithBase
functions.summary: Destructor matching Ui_Object_CtorWithBase: destroys the embedded base object and returns the adjusted object pointer.

functions.name: Script_Iterator_NextIndex
functions.signature: int Script_Iterator_NextIndex(ScriptIterator* self, ScriptValue* value, ScriptValue* outIndex, ScriptValue* outValue)
functions.summary: Squirrel iterator step: converts the current value to an integer index, checks it against the container size (f_14), and writes back (index+1, element) as the next script key/value pair.

functions.name: Script_Registry_LinkObject
functions.summary: Registers a script-referenced object in the class registry/hash table and wires the object's back-link at f_C so it can be found from its script handle.

functions.name: Item_CompareEntryKey16
functions.signature: u32 Item_CompareEntryKey16(u32 arg1, u16* left, u16* right)
functions.summary: Less-than comparator for two u16 item ids: builds the key (ItemRecord+0xE << 16 | itemId), uses 0x270F for unknown items, and returns 1 when the left key is smaller.

functions.name: Item_CompareFieldKey16
functions.signature: u32 Item_CompareFieldKey16(u32 arg1, u16* left, u16* right)
functions.summary: 16-bit item comparator: orders two u16 item ids by Data_GetFieldById of their records, breaking ties by item id.

functions.name: Item_CompareEntryKey32
functions.signature: u32 Item_CompareEntryKey32(u32 arg1, u32 left, u32 right)
functions.summary: Same comparison as Item_CompareEntryKey16 but for 32-bit item entries: compares the (ItemRecord+0xE << 16 | itemId) keys and returns 1 when the left entry sorts first.

functions.name: Item_CompareFieldKey32
functions.signature: u32 Item_CompareFieldKey32(u32 arg1, u32 left, u32 right)
functions.summary: 32-bit item comparator: orders by Data_GetFieldById of each item record and breaks ties by item id.

functions.name: maybe_Item_SortEntryArray
functions.summary: Sorts a contiguous array of up to 87 4-byte {u16 itemId, u8 count, u8 flags} item entries (bounded by 0x15C bytes or sentinel key) using std_introsort_itemEntry and Item_CompareEntryKey16.

functions.name: maybe_ItemBag_SortEntriesByKey
functions.summary: Sorts the active 4-byte {u16 itemId, u8 count, u8 flags} entries in ItemBag (+0x2B8..+0x274C, up to 2,341 entries or sentinel key) using std_introsort_itemEntry and Item_CompareEntryKey16.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Equip_BuildItemGrid
functions.summary: For a valid item: chooses a grid layout by the record's kind (7..0xD) and allocates it.

functions.name: Item_SortEntryArrayBySortKey
functions.summary: Sorts an array of 4-byte {u16 itemId, u8 count, u8 flags} item-bag entries in place, up to the first 0xFFFF item id, by the item sort-order key (Data_GetFieldById) and then by itemId, using introsort plus a final insertion pass.

functions.name: ItemBag_SortEntriesBySortKey
functions.summary: Sorts the active 4-byte {u16 itemId, u8 count, u8 flags} item-bag entries in itemBag (GameWork + 0x24ACC, array at +0x2B8..+0x274C up to sentinel 0xFFFF) ascending by item sort-order key (0x0066C304), breaking ties by itemId ascending.

functions.name: ItemBag_DestroyEntries
functions.summary: Loops through all item entries up to self+0x274C in ItemBag storage, invoking virtual destructor on each entry.

functions.name: Ui_MessageStyle_SetLevelA
functions.summary: Stores a 0..4 message-style level in the window byte +0x31C1 and pushes it to the shared message-style object, which converts it to the target float (level * 0.25) in channel +0x1A90 and starts the fade.

functions.name: std_Str_Length16
functions.summary: Returns the number of UTF-16 code units before the NUL terminator. This is the shared string-length helper the list/panel code uses on its label buffers.

functions.name: Ui_MessageStyle_SetLevelB
functions.summary: Second style channel: stores the 0..4 level at +0x31C0 and applies it through the shared message-style object's other float channel (+0x1A94), with the same 0.25 scaling and fade start.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_DataPanel_SetTextRow
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_DataPanel_SetTextRow(WorkData* self, const void* src)
functions.summary: Installs a formatted text row into the work data panel: copies the 0x84-byte row block to self+0x86B4 and then processes the name field at +0x86C2.

functions.name: Ui_MessageStyle_ApplyLevelA
functions.summary: Re-applies the window's stored channel-A style level (+0x31C1) to the shared message-style object, used when a window is restored or reopened.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_GetRowNameLength
functions.summary: Returns UTF-16 character length of row label in the 50-entry table at self+0x5fe4 (row stride 0x8c) using wcslen (0x00100B74).

functions.name: Ui_MessageStyle_ApplyLevelB
functions.summary: Re-applies the window's stored channel-B style level (+0x31C0) to the shared message-style object (channel +0x1A94).

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_WriteControlTags
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_WriteControlTags(MessageBuilder* self, unsigned int flags, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Emits the markup/control tags for one attribute to the message builder by calling the builder's write-tag virtual four times (tags 0x20f, 0x210, 0x211, 0x213).

functions.name: maybe_GameWork_RemoveActiveRecord
functions.signature: void maybe_GameWork_RemoveActiveRecord(int self, int index, int count)
functions.summary: Removes an active record from the game-work table at +0x5FE4, shifting the following records with std_memcpy/memmove, clearing the tail record and resetting the flags at +0x7B34/+0x7B38.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_RemoveRowByOwner
functions.signature: void Ui_DataPanel_RemoveRowByOwner(WorkData* self, const u32* key)
functions.summary: Searches the 20-row table at self+0x7B3C for the entry whose +0x88 key equals *key, memmoves the following 0x8C-byte records down, clears the trailing record and resets the current-row fields.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_WriteItemInfoToBuffer
functions.summary: Queries item record from data manager (0x0011CB38) via 0x0063DF14 and formats metadata tags into UI buffer at +0x24A98.

functions.name: maybe_Save_SetNameBuffer
functions.signature: void maybe_Save_SetNameBuffer(SaveWork* saveWork, const u16* name)
functions.summary: Zeroes 0x80 bytes at saveWork+0x88FA via func_001113EC and copies the UTF-16 profile name string via tail call to wcsncpy (max 64 wchar_t).

functions.name: Save_SetNameBuffer_Tail
functions.summary: Tail branch of Save_SetNameBuffer (0x00613324): copies 0x40 bytes from src into self+0xFA and jumps to the CRT memcpy helper.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_InsertRowCopy
functions.signature: bool Ui_DataPanel_InsertRowCopy(WorkData* self, const DataPanelRow* row)
functions.summary: Inserts a copy of row into the first free row of the 50-entry table at self+0x5fe4 (row stride 0x8c) if key is valid.

functions.name: Field_LevelMap_AddCell_Part2
functions.summary: Continuation of Field_LevelMap_AddCell (real entry 0x006135E4): rejects names of 7 or more wchars and scans the 0x32 cell records at self+0x5FE4 (stride 0x8C) for a free slot.

functions.name: Field_LevelMap_AddCell_Part3
functions.summary: Rest of Field_LevelMap_AddCell: finishes the free-slot scan, memcpy's 0x84 bytes of the new cell record into the slot, copies the +0x84/+0x85/+0x88 fields and returns 1 (0 when the table is full). The 696-byte symbol also covers the unrelated routine that starts at 0x006136BC.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_ResetRowsByIndexList
functions.summary: Resets referenced rows in the 50-entry table at self+0x5fe4 based on an index list, zeroing 0x84 bytes and setting key to -1.

functions.name: maybe_Item_SortU16ListByItemKey
functions.signature: void maybe_Item_SortU16ListByItemKey(WorkData* work, WorkData* container, u32 sentinelKey)
functions.summary: Sorts a list of u16 item IDs starting at container+0x3C4 up to sentinel key or end bound using std_insertion_sort_u16_item and Item_CompareEntryKey32.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_CopyRowIntoCurrent
functions.summary: Copies a 0x8C row into the current-row block at self+0x8630 while preserving the eight 64-bit accumulators, records the row's owner key (+0x88) and mirrors the two source words.

functions.name: ItemBag_SortIdList
functions.summary: Sorts a list of u16 item IDs from panel+0x3C4 up to sentinel 0xFFFF using the global item sort order table.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_CopyFromWork
functions.signature: void Ui_DataPanel_CopyFromWork(WorkData* self, const WorkData* src)
functions.summary: Byte-for-byte copy constructor for the ~35 KB panel snapshot: mirrors the live work data into the screen's private copy up to +0x8A28 and masks two flag bytes.

functions.name: Math_RebuildBasis
functions.summary: Rebuilds a stored rotation basis: takes the two existing axes, builds the third by cross product, applies the angle pair at basis[6]/basis[7] and renormalises, writing a valid first axis back into basis[0..2].

functions.name: MessageWindow_Builder
functions.signature: void MessageWindow_Builder(int arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int arg4, int arg5)

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_MeasureAndLayoutText
functions.summary: Wraps and lays out the text of a message window: copies the pending 0xFF-terminated run, walks the glyph id array accumulating the fixed-point line width at f_40C, inserts the line break/escape pairs (codes 1 and 4) when the width exceeds 1.0 and returns 1 when at least one line was produced. Also advances the reveal counter f_41C so the typewriter effect can continue.

functions.name: Text_RemoveCharAndShift
functions.summary: Removes the character at the message cursor and shifts the remaining UTF-16 text left by one cell; returns true when the removed character was a line break (0 or 10).

functions.name: Ui_MessageBuffer_Init
functions.summary: Initializes a dual 512-byte text line buffer for a UI message window and resets cursor state.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetTextFromBuffer
functions.summary: Copies the UTF-16 text held at arg2+0x202 into the message widget (or into the window's own buffer, depending on the f_854 mode flag).

functions.name: Ui_RenderObject_Draw
functions.signature: void Ui_RenderObject_Draw(UiRenderObject* self, u32 pane, u32 draw, u32 draw2)
functions.summary: Draws one UI render element through the render-object API: binds the per-slot 0x414-byte render node (self + f_28*0x414 + 0x2C), resolves its resources, and only when the element is visible (f_C7C) and the current slot is valid submits the draw and releases the resources again.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_InitPanes
functions.summary: Creates the message window's panes: binds four named widgets from the layout table g_007AC464, then initialises the two text pane groups at +0x2C and +0x440 and hides them.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateOpen
functions.summary: Per-frame message-window update: when the opening counter expires it copies the text, applies the speaker/name argument and builds the message window on first use.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ChangeText
functions.summary: Switches the message window to a new text: resets the page counter, clears or copies the page text according to arg2->f_c, and resets the visible page.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_ClearText
functions.summary: Clears the two text pane groups and re-initialises the message buffer to the empty string.

functions.name: Ui_MessageDualBuffer_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and constructs a pair of message text buffers with vtable 0x006160E4 for UI window instances.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetText
functions.summary: Copies a UTF-16 string into both text pages of the message window, choosing the per-character or block setter from the window mode byte self->f_e84.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_UpdateScrollText
functions.summary: Main update of the scrolling message window: advances the scroll position, applies the two text pages, refreshes the cross-fade and rebuilds the window once the text is ready.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetTextOnly
functions.summary: Copies the current page text into both pages and clears the message argument, without touching the cross-fade state.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_InitScrollPanes
functions.summary: Creates the scrolling message window: builds the two text tweens ("scroll_txt1"/"scroll_txt2"), binds seven layout widgets and initialises the two page groups.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessageWindow_AdvanceTalkState
functions.summary: Advances talk state at +0xE90 based on speaker and text presence in TalkRecord.

functions.name: Ui_RenderObject_DrawWithTexture
functions.signature: void Ui_RenderObject_DrawWithTexture(UiRenderObject* self, u32 pane, u32 draw, u32 draw2)
functions.summary: Texture variant of the UI element draw: fetches the render context, binds the texture for the element's own size and for the full 400x480 screen rect, saves/restores the render target around the same prepare/submit/release sequence as 0x00615818.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_Reset
functions.summary: Full reset of the message window: clears both text pages, re-initialises the buffer and clears the message argument.

functions.name: Ui_MessageExtendedBuffer_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and constructs an extended pair of message text buffers with vtable 0x00617284 for UI window instances.

functions.name: Container_AvlTree_InsertFixup
functions.summary: Finishes an AVL insertion: makes the node a leaf (left/right point at the header), sets its height to 1, updates the tree's first/last and size counters and then walks up towards the root rebalancing with the rotate/update helpers.

functions.name: Container_AvlTree_EraseFixup
functions.summary: Repairs the height/minimum augmentation after a node was removed: decrements the node's stored height value, propagates the change to the parent while it improves the parent's value, then re-runs the balance/rotate helpers on the node and its parent. No-op when the node's value is already no larger than both children's.

functions.name: Container_AvlTree_Clear
functions.summary: Destroys every node of an AVL tree (post-order, calling the tree's node-release callback) and re-initialises the header so the tree is empty.

functions.name: Container_AvlTree_DestroySubtree
functions.summary: Recursively frees a subtree in post-order, invoking the tree's node-release callback (header+0x20) with (tree, node) for each node.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_CopyRecord
functions.summary: Copies a 0x50-byte field scene-object record (flags, two 18-byte strings, positions, scales and visibility bytes) from src to dst and returns dst.

functions.name: Ui_CheckListWindow_InitCheckIcons
functions.signature: void Ui_CheckListWindow_InitCheckIcons(UiCheckListWindow* self, UiPaneFactory* factory, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Creates the three check-mark panes shared by every check-list window ("icon_check_mark", "icon_check_base", "icon_rarity_gold"), stores them at +0x4C/+0x50/+0x54 and applies the window's visibility/anim bits (f_58) to them.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_Ctor_vt77FD38
functions.summary: In-place constructor: base Ui_Object ctor, install vtable 0x77FD38 and zero the four words at +0x4C..+0x58. No caller and no other reference to the vtable, so the class stays unknown.

functions.name: Ui_CheckListWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the check-list window: Ui_Object_DtorBase plus the shared free thunk 0x0010F6CC; the class init creates the three check-mark panes.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TextStyle_AppendDescriptor
functions.summary: Lazily builds the shared text-style descriptor table (flag 0x7BE30C, table 0x7BE310, 0xA24 bytes, constructor vtable 0x782990), resolves the 8-byte style record for a tag and appends its pointer to the caller's vector when the record has a payload.

functions.name: Container_SmallVectorInitFrom
functions.summary: Initialises inline small vector storage from a source container, delegating to Container_SmallVectorCopyConstruct (0x00617C80).

functions.name: Container_SmallVector_InitGroup
functions.signature: Container* Container_SmallVector_InitGroup(Container* self, MessageSpan* span, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises an inline (small-vector) container and copies up to four sub-vectors out of the source span at +0x18C..+0x18F using 0x00617990; the three inline buffers start at self+0x10, self+0x10 and self+0x24.

functions.name: Container_SmallVectorCopyConstruct
functions.summary: Copy-constructs a five-element small vector: installs the inline buffer at self+0x10 (begin = end = self+0x10, cap = self+0x24), then copies the source range and takes the standard length-error path when the source holds more than five elements.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_UpdateItem
functions.summary: Refreshes the equipment window for the selected item: sets the item model, resets the equipment animations and plays the item's motion, or clears the window when the item id is unknown.

functions.name: Ui_EquipRow_Activate
functions.summary: Activates one equipment row: for a party slot (< 0x1F) it removes the item at the row's slot with maybe_Member_RemoveItemAtSlot, notifies the item table at work+0x24ACC, pushes the row pane and plays the confirm animation (3 or 2 by the member's f_14); for the pseudo-slot 0x1F it toggles the bag count of the row's item and plays animation 0x10.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_HandleInput
functions.summary: Input handler of the equipment/forge window: maps the cursor to an item id, validates it against the equipment tables (0x66C1A8/0x66C434), plays the item/equip animation and updates the panes through the named Ui_EquipmentWindow_SetItemCode/SetItemPanes helpers.

functions.name: Ui_ItemUse_ConsumeSourceItem
functions.summary: Consumes one unit of the item referenced by an item-use context (itemId at +0x08, holder index at +0x0A, member slot at +0x0C): removes slot +0x0C from party member +0x0A when holder < 0x1F, or decrements 1 from the party bag (gameWork+0x24ACC) when holder >= 0x1F.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipRow_UpdateCompareText
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_EquipRow_UpdateCompareText(EquipRow* row, u32 memberId, u32 slot, int count)
functions.summary: Formats the member's item at the given inventory slot as message argument 6 and continues the equipment comparison; also reaches the equip animation and the member item-slot setters.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipRow_UpdateCurseMark
functions.summary: For the row's item: when ItemRecord flag +0x20 bit 0 is clear it pushes the pane at owner+0x120 and plays equipment-window animation 0x1D; otherwise it formats string id 0x1C into owner+0x1084 and pushes that pane instead.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentWindow_Close
functions.summary: Closes the equipment window: ends the item model animation and hides the pane group.

functions.name: maybe_Item_CreateViewModelDesc
functions.signature: void* maybe_Item_CreateViewModelDesc(void* self, u32 kind, u32 itemId, u8 variant, u32 extra)
functions.summary: Allocates and fills a view descriptor for an item row; the concrete descriptor class depends on the item kind (+0x11) and func_0066C3A0 (kinds 6/7).

functions.name: Container_ReleaseObjectRef
functions.summary: Releases a stored object reference: if the pointer is non-null it calls the object's destructor (vtable slot 0) and clears the slot.

functions.name: Ui_Casino_InitRouletteWheel
functions.summary: Initializes the 3D roulette wheel geometry, camera angles, and betting layout quads for the casino mini-game.

functions.name: Container_FindObjectByTypeId
functions.summary: Looks up a component/object in the handle registry by its class id and returns the first instance found in that handle's object list, or NULL.

functions.name: Container_FindObjectByTypeIdH
functions.summary: Registry lookup keyed on owner->f_28+0x2BC: hashes the handle into g_00619CE8/g_00619CEC and returns the chain element whose virtual type equals g_00619CF0.

functions.name: Monster_AiBehavior_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of a monster AI behaviour base object: runs the shared 0x19C8F4 constructor, installs vtable 0x77FDFC, clears the state byte at +0xB and the state word at +0x30.

functions.name: Object_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Scalar deleting destructor: resets the object's vtable to the base-class vtable 0x00758AE0 (0x00193E40) and frees the allocation through the engine allocator (0x0010F6CC).

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_AdvanceState
functions.summary: Chooses the next NPC action state: if the NPC's target is out of the interaction range it switches to the return/idle state, otherwise to the approach-player state, using the task timers and spawning the associated effect at the actor offset.

functions.name: Field_NpcAction_UpdateSightReaction
functions.summary: Per-frame NPC perception update: when the NPC can see the player (sight check) it switches the action state to 'notice player', otherwise it counts down and falls back to the patrol state.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NpcActionBehavior_Ctor
functions.signature: void* maybe_Field_NpcActionBehavior_Ctor(void* mem, void* parent, void* def, const char* name, int flags)
functions.summary: Constructor of the NPC-action behaviour object: base-constructs through Gfx_ObjectDesc_Ctor4, installs vtable 0x0077FE30 and sets the default interval 0.26f at +0x2C. Created by Field_SetupNpcActionScript with the packed action name.

functions.name: Object_DeletingDtorB
functions.summary: Second copy of the scalar deleting destructor (same body as 0x00619D28): base-vtable reset via 0x00193E40, then allocator free via 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_UpdateSlotProgress
functions.summary: Per-frame slot animation: when the part at +0x90 is visible it advances the progress float f_50 by 1/30, clamps t to [0,1] and lerps f_5C between f_54 and f_58, then pushes the sprite value into maybe_Ui_Part_SetColorAll.

functions.name: Ui_Part_SetColorAll
functions.summary: Writes packed RGBA colour to all four vertices of UI part via vtable+0x10 and updates colour fields +0x6C/+0x70.

functions.name: Ui_Window_CreateBlackPane
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_CreateBlackPane(UiWindow* self, UiWindowData* data, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Creates the window's full-screen backdrop by asking the layout object (data->f_AC->f_10) for the pane named 'black', stores it at self+0x90 and clears bit 0 of the pane's +0x44 flags so it starts hidden.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_Dtor_vt77FE68
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the plain backdrop-window class at vtable 0x0077FE68; its only class-specific virtual is Ui_Window_CreateBlackPane (0x0061A3FC, builds the 'black' full-screen pane). No class name exists in the binary, so the vtable-address suffix stays.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlot_CreateSprite
functions.summary: Creates the sprite used by a UI overlay slot: a 200x120 'sprite' mesh with a slot-specific extra parameter (0xd6), attaches it and sets draw priority 10.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Component_FindAndNotify
functions.summary: Finds the object of class 0x007C4C5C behind the handle at work+8->+0x48 +0x20 and calls its vtable +0xBC.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_SetupSpriteFromRecord
functions.summary: Configures a sprite child of a UI part from a record: copies the owner/palette ids (f_B4/f_B0/f_AC), creates the sprite actor and its priority, plays the record's animation (clamped to 0..6), builds the 9-slice/frame-colour descriptor from the record rectangle and adds the child through Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Component_FindAndSetFlags
functions.summary: Same lookup as 0x0061A4FC, then calls the object's vtable +0xB8 with an invalid handle and 0.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlotObject_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor for the overlay-slot object variant created by Ui_Overlay_CreateSlotWidget: installs vtable g_0061a864 on the object and on its embedded sub-object at +0x22c.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlotObject_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for the overlay-slot object: restores vtables, unlinks the object from its list and destroys the embedded field object before freeing.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_CreateSpriteWithArgs
functions.summary: Creates 200x120 sprite with custom vertex format via Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh for overlay display slot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_BeginStateTransition
functions.summary: Starts the overlay slot's exit/move transition from state 0x0B: activates or deactivates its children, places the slot at the player object position, spawns the transition effect and pushes the sound command.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlot_TryInteract
functions.signature: int Ui_OverlaySlot_TryInteract(Ui_OverlaySlot* self, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: In slot state 6 tests the slot's model part against the player (maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_ApplyAttribute) and on a hit sends gadget command 0x15 for the slot (Field_Gadget_AddAndTriggerCommand); returns the result.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_OverlaySlot_HandleCommandEnd
functions.summary: Completes an overlay-slot command: for command 4 it deactivates the slot, repositions it at the player, advances the actor state and allocates the transition effect, then switches to state 8; other commands fall back to state 6.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlot_SetupFromRecord
functions.summary: Initialises an overlay slot from its spawn record: copies position/scale, sets the sprite frame and draw priority, creates the child sprite through the sprite-actor factory and registers the slot with the UI system.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlot_UpdateStateMachine
functions.summary: Per-frame state machine for a UI overlay slot (states 0..11): fades it in, moves it toward the actor, applies the overlay colour/frame setup, plays the associated SE and finally removes it.

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlotObject_CtorB
functions.summary: Second overlay-slot constructor: installs vtable g_0061b6e0, sets state 0x0b and initialises the timers/ids (f_a6 = 0xff, f_a7 = f_a9 = g_0061b6dc).

functions.name: Ui_OverlaySlotObject_DtorB
functions.summary: Destructor for the second overlay-slot object variant (same unlink/destroy/free sequence as Ui_OverlaySlotObject_Dtor).

functions.name: Ui_SetNumberTextValue
functions.summary: Formats the explicit value into the global message buffer (*0x007AC834 + 0x848) and sets it as the widget's number text through the font-0x15 pane, so a gold/quantity display can be updated with one call. Unlike Ui_SetNumberText (0x003D2A8C) it takes the number as an argument instead of reading the widget's own f_58/f_5C fields, and writes a single pane.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetStatusTextByType
functions.summary: Chooses between two status strings (ids 0x21 and 0x15) depending on self->f_49, and mirrors the current value into a global UI name widget.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_InitStatusPane
functions.summary: Initialises the status/name pane: calls the widget constructor, binds the "txt_l" layout text and refreshes the status text.

functions.name: Ui_Window_CtorBaseB
functions.summary: Second window base constructor: runs the shared object constructor, installs the plain window vtable 0x78005C and clears the +0x49 state byte; unlike Ui_Window_CtorBase it attaches no layout child.

functions.name: Ui_MessageStatusPane_Dtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the message window's status pane: Ui_Object_DtorBase plus the shared free thunk 0x0010F6CC.

functions.name: Ui_TimeWindow_BindPanes
functions.summary: Binds the panes of the inn/time window layout: locates 'win_yadoya_time', attaches the second pane group, and registers the three text lines null_txt_l1..l3 with increasing draw order.

functions.name: Ui_TimeWindow_RenderClock
functions.summary: Renders clock widget on status window: runs window draw virtual (+0x2C) and renders time digits (f_25a..f_25c) via 0x001A60A0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_GetCursorState
functions.summary: Returns -1 when the embedded cursor at +0x138 is inactive (f_14C == 0), otherwise returns the cursor state byte queried via func_001D7E54; called by Ui_Layout_GetButtonState when focused.

functions.name: Ui_TimeWindow_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the clock/time window: installs vtable 0x007800C0, sets up the two intrusive list heads and chains the pane, text and node-list sub-object constructors, returning the window base.

functions.name: Ui_TimeWindow_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor for the time window: releases the text/child lists, destroys the embedded pane widgets and the base UI object.

functions.name: Item_LookupRecord
functions.signature: void Item_LookupRecord(ItemRef* out, u16 itemId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves an item id to its item-table record: stores the id in the reference struct and, when the id is below the table size, stores the record pointer looked up through the lazily created item table (0x0011CB38 + 0x0063CDD8); otherwise the pointer is null.

functions.name: Ui_Racing_InitLapNumberPanes
functions.summary: Copies racing mini-game UI pane names 'lap_num1' and 'lap_num3' into layout element descriptors.

functions.name: Font_SetGlyphTable
functions.summary: Selects the glyph/font table used for a font size class: stores the class at +0x5C, looks the table up by id through the shared 1024-entry table object (0xA24 bytes, vtable 0x782990) and rebuilds the per-glyph layout records. Falls back to "no table" when the font has no table flag (+0x5F == 0).

functions.name: Field_WeatherVisual_Load
functions.signature: u32 Field_WeatherVisual_Load(FieldWeatherVisual* self, u8 weatherType, u8 variant)
functions.summary: Loads the 2D time/weather visual set for a field level: opens level_2dtimeVisual.bxon, common2d_tex.bch, resolves the gradation texture, loads the 2D weather PACK (2d_weather_cs_weather.pack or 2d_weather_<name>.pack) and stores the handles on the object; returns 1 on success, 0 when the level data is missing.

functions.name: Bg2D_ApplyColorPreset
functions.summary: Applies a time-of-day/weather colour preset to the 2D background: converts the preset's float colours to 0..255 and uploads the two 4-colour sets (near/far and gradation) to device+0x10C8..0x10FD, enables each set through its flag byte and re-applies the three background layer presets.

functions.name: Field_Sky_InterpolateCloudColors
functions.signature: void Field_Sky_InterpolateCloudColors(int self, int stateA, int stateB)
functions.summary: Interpolates cloud color palette entries between two sky states and updates the current active sky palette.

functions.name: Font_Init
