functions.summary: Font initialiser (vtable slot +4): seeds the glyph table from the font's size class (argument 0 of the virtual +0x14) and from the byte at +0x79 of its descriptor, then builds the glyph table.

functions.name: Bg2D_ResetLayerPages
functions.summary: Resets the 2D background's four layer-page entries to empty (0xFFFF page ids, layer ids 1/2/3), disables the three distance-fade slots, drops the gradation texture and releases the two PACK handles.

functions.name: Bg2D_SetTexturePages
functions.signature: void Bg2D_SetTexturePages(Bg2DScene* self, int mode, Bg2DPageEntry* entries, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Switches the 2D background to a page set: binds the page texture held at self+0x13, resets the page cache, sets the layer-visibility bit and, for a supplied entry list, resolves each named entry and stores its scaled atlas cell (x<<3, y<<3) in the page table.

functions.name: Bg2D_ResolveLayerTextures
functions.summary: Resolves the four background layer texture pages: for each page entry it walks the fallback chain from g_0061CF50, takes the first page whose two texture names resolve in the 2D resource trie, and stores the two u16 texture ids; then copies the selected page into the four active layer slots.

functions.name: Font_ApplyGlyphMetrics
functions.signature: void Font_ApplyGlyphMetrics(Font* self, GlyphTableEntry* entry, u32 mode, int glyphIndex)
functions.summary: Writes the metrics of one glyph into the 0x40-byte glyph record of the current font page: reads the left/right/top/bottom and advance values from the BXON glyph table (Script_GetIntTable1) and stores them as either single values or (min+max)/2 pairs, selected by the one-byte mode fields at +0x4C.. +0x4F.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSubSet_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and constructs the auxiliary 2D scene sprite sub-set object with vtable 0x00780134.

functions.name: maybe_Fs_Resource_DerivedDtor
functions.summary: Non-freeing destructor of a class derived from Fs_Resource: installs the derived vtable, releases the three extra handle members at +0x48, +0x54 and +0x58, switches to the base vtable 0x0077F6C4 and releases the base handle at +0x3C, returning the base.

functions.name: Ui_MessageWindow_SetDateArgs
functions.signature: void Ui_MessageWindow_SetDateArgs(int self, int message, int arg3)
functions.summary: Substitutes the message text's date arguments: reads the day/month fields from the current date record, then sets message args 0..2 from the item/date tables and the "_day" suffix.

functions.name: Font_BuildGlyphPages
functions.signature: u32 Font_BuildGlyphPages(Font* self, FontResource* res, int isAlt)
functions.summary: Builds the glyph quads/pages for a font from its binary font resource: for every "…binst" entry it resolves the glyph descriptor from the shared resource table, allocates a 0x198-byte glyph object (0x57C7E0) and lets 0x6201C0 load the matching texture set. Returns 1 when the resource has no pages.

functions.name: Gfx_Sky_BindModelAndTexture
functions.summary: Binds the sky dome model and selects its texture: resolves the sky model resource by id, binds its first material (or the default when mode is 0), then picks the texture name for the current weather (sky_cloud / sky_ruin / sky_ruin_cloud / sky_zorude / sky_red / sky_dark) and enables the sky texture on the device.

functions.name: Font_ApplyTextToWindow
functions.signature: void Font_ApplyTextToWindow(u32 window, u32 text_handle, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Applies a font/text resource to a window: resolves the handle 0x71342C, resets the font object and rebuilds its glyph pages for the given text.

functions.name: Field_Level_LoadBackgroundSettings
functions.summary: Loads the level's 3D background environment: parses level_3dBGTime.bxon and level_3dBGFog.bxon, picks the enabled time/fog records, stores their handles on the level object and applies the resulting colours.

functions.name: Gfx_Sky_UpdateCloudEffect
functions.summary: Creates or destroys the cloud/weather effect drawn over the sky: with enable != 0 and sky type 2 (zorude) it spawns the effect and stores the handle, otherwise it releases both effect handles.

functions.name: Gfx_Sky_ApplyPreset
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sky_ApplyPreset(GfxSky* self, SkyRecord* rec, int arg3)
functions.summary: Applies a sky/weather preset record: spawns the named sky effect (rec->f_ce), interpolates the two sky/cloud colour pairs and writes the packed RGBA values and fade times into the render state.

functions.name: Model_LoadHitEffectResources
functions.summary: Loads the four weapon-hit effect resources for a model ("%s_chit.rcb", "%s_vhit.rcb", "%s_yhit.rcb", "%s_ehit.rcb") and caches their model data.

functions.name: Anim_Pose_SetupBlend
functions.signature: void Anim_Pose_SetupBlend(int self, int pose_a, int pose_b, u32* bones_a, u32* bones_b, float* min_a, float* min_b, u32* extra_a, u32* extra_b)
functions.summary: Sets up a 64-joint pose blend: copies eight 0x48-byte matrices from arg2/arg3 into the self arrays and four 0x48-byte blocks from arg4..arg7, then clamps the twelve per-joint weights to the minima in arg6/arg7.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_SetEffectNodesVisible
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_SetEffectNodesVisible(BattleUiEffectSet* self, int visible, int includeSlots)
functions.summary: Attaches or detaches the battle UI's effect nodes to the render device: the 0x20-byte nodes at +0x3BC go into device+0x2A4, and the three optional slot effects at +0x5DC go into device+0x2BC, hiding their colour when detached.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_BlendPresets
functions.signature: void Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_BlendPresets(int self, int presetA, int presetB)
functions.summary: Blends sky and weather parameters between two 0xD8-byte preset records and converts float colors into packed RGBA values.

functions.name: Font_LoadFontSlots
functions.summary: Loads the three font slots of the font manager (loop i = 0..2): for each slot it resolves the font resource at +0x174+i*8, creates the 0x168-byte font instance (0x57C7E0) with 0x57B308, calls 0x6201C0 to bind the glyph textures and flags the slot as loaded (+0x17B and +0x5ED).

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteGroup_Release
functions.summary: Releases a scene's sprite group: destroys the packed sprite handles, releases the three 0x20-byte sprite slots and their child objects, and clears the referenced pack/resource handles.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteGroup_RemoveEntries
functions.summary: Removes the four sprite-entry variants of a scene sprite from the scene by formatting '<name>_C', '_V', '_Y' and '_E' and deleting each one.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSprite_Release
functions.summary: Releases a 2D scene sprite: unlinks its draw node from the device layer list at device+0xE6C + layer*0xC and deletes its three sub-objects (texture, palette and geometry).

functions.name: Font_LoadGlyphTextureSet
functions.signature: void Font_LoadGlyphTextureSet(FontGlyphSlot* slot, FontAlloc* alloc, u32 fontEntry, u32 fontObject)
functions.summary: Binds up to three textures per font page: the main glyph atlas, the "%s_loop" companion page and the outline/shadow page. Each is looked up in the font's BXON table by the entry id, allocated as a 0x34/0x2C-byte texture object and registered with 0x57B988/0x57B9B0.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSprite_DtorThunk
functions.summary: Scalar-destructor thunk that releases the 2D scene sprite and returns its pointer, used from the sprite's vtable.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteGroup_Update
functions.summary: Per-frame update of a scene sprite group: advances the per-entry fade timers (fifth-power falloff into the entry alpha at +0x77), re-binds visible entries to the render panes and drives the three slot sprites' positions/alpha.

functions.name: Gfx_Sky_SetTextureByName
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sky_SetTextureByName(FieldSky* self, const char* textureName)
functions.summary: Sets the sky texture from a name (bound script native BG3DChangeFog): resolves the sky model resource, looks the texture name up in its resource table and enables it on the device; a null name falls back to the weather-based selection.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteGroup_SetEntryFade
functions.summary: Applies a fade-in/out target alpha to every sprite entry of the group except the one with the given id, setting the ramp rate from the requested duration.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpriteSet_Create
functions.summary: Allocates and constructs the primary 2D scene sprite set object with vtable 0x0078016C and 4 preset records.

functions.name: Gfx_SceneSpritePool_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a resource-owning scene-sprite container: writes the incoming vtable, destroys the three 0x20-byte sub-objects and the three handles, releases every 0x20-byte scene sprite in the page array, then restores the base vtable 0x0077F6C4 on the shared base.

functions.name: Ui_MapWindow_BindPanes
functions.summary: Binds all panes of the map window: map background, monster markers, nameplate, scroll arrows, player icons and the junon/global icons, and initialises the row table used by the map screen.

functions.name: Ui_MapWindow_UpdateVisibleFlag
functions.summary: Updates map visibility flag on model object f_128->f_44 bit 0 from query 0x002BBB1C and invokes draw virtual (+0x2C).

functions.name: Ui_MapWindow_SetAreaName
functions.summary: Sets the area-name text of the map window: with an explicit text id it is applied directly, otherwise the current region id is looked up in the region/area string table.

functions.name: Ui_MapWindow_SetIconVisibility
functions.summary: Refreshes which map-window icons are visible: hides the background map panes, shows the five icon handles and applies the per-mode visibility flag to the player/monster icons.

functions.name: Ui_MapWindow_ResetPageAnim
functions.signature: void Ui_MapWindow_ResetPageAnim(Ui_MapWindow* self, int page, int secondHalf)
functions.summary: Resets the animation refs of one map-window page (0x13c-byte stride), choosing the first or second pane group depending on the half flag.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MapWindow_ResolveTouchTarget
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_MapWindow_ResolveTouchTarget(int compared, TouchTarget* target, Ui_MapWindow* window, int not)
functions.summary: Unless the 2-D-mode check and the game-mode check both pass, asks the map window (vtable +0x24) for the object under the touch and stores it in target+4, bracketing the call with window[0x183].

functions.name: Ui_FadeWipe_Init
functions.summary: Initialises the screen-wipe/fade transition: clamps the wipe rectangle to the screen area using the hard-coded bounds (-148,148,-90,112,144) and sets the per-screen fade colours and offsets.

functions.name: Ui_WorldMap_CreateMarkerArray
functions.summary: Allocates and initializes the world map marker array container with 5 marker sub-objects.

functions.name: Ui_MapWindow_DeletingDtor
functions.summary: Deleting destructor of the map window: stores vtable 0x007801B4, destroys the four 0x13C-byte child objects at +0x204, releases the layout reference at +0x14C, destroys the embedded object at +0x14C and releases the refcounted handle.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ReleaseGpuBuffer
functions.summary: When the object's flag word at self+0x18 has bits 0x24 set, releases the sub-object at self+0x20 through func_0021F8B8 and clears the slot.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_CreateRegisteredObject
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_CreateRegisteredObject(u32* self, u32 vtable, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Installs the given vtable, registers the object in the UI node list (kind 2, mask 0x1FF), allocates a 0x11C-byte draw object with vtable 0x0075F974, binds it at node+0x1C and publishes the node through the global at 0x007A9AE8.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Widget_ReleaseGpuBufferEx
functions.summary: Installs the given vtable, releases the sub-object at self[8], clears the global at 0x007A9AE8, marks the field object's +0x94 sub-object with state 2 and calls func_0036B514 on self+4.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_ReleaseGpuBufferEx_Tail
functions.summary: Tail of the widget GPU-buffer release routine at 0x00621FB4: releases the sub-object at self+4 through 0x0036B514 and frees the allocation that starts 4 bytes before the returned pointer.

functions.name: Container_SetCountFromByteSize
functions.summary: Computes the element count for a container: divides byteSize by the element size reported by vtable slot +8, rounds up, stores it at +0x14 and returns the remainder flag used by the caller.

functions.name: maybe_Code_MisalignedSymbol0062209E
functions.summary: Misaligned symbol: the address falls inside the ARM instruction at 0x0062209C (`ldrlt r0,[r4,#0x10]`) of the string-append routine that starts at 0x00622038, so Ghidra's Thumb decode produced coprocessor garbage. There is no function here.

functions.name: Ui_TextListWindow_UpdateItemRects
functions.summary: Recomputes the source/destination rectangles of the list rows: takes the measured text width from virtual +0x8, adds the window padding and pushes both UV rectangles to the text renderer with the numeric formatter.

functions.name: Ui_TextListWindow_FormatItemRects
functions.summary: Formats text row rectangles using format helper 0x006F0E1C and submits text strings to panes via 0x001A6680.

functions.name: Ui_TextListWindow_StepItemRects
functions.summary: Scrolls a list window by one entry: first moves the row index by +1/-1 through func_0011CD80, then rebuilds both item rectangles with the g_006221C8 format pair and func_001A6680.

functions.name: maybe_ViewWork_AddRowsFromBuffer
functions.signature: void maybe_ViewWork_AddRowsFromBuffer(ViewList* list, ListHead* head, uint32_t heapTag)
functions.summary: Copies up to 0x20 row descriptors from the embedded 0x1C-stride buffer at list+0x100 into fresh 0x18-byte list nodes (skipping the 0x0FFFFFFF empty rows) and appends each to the given list head.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenView_ReleaseNamedObjects
functions.summary: For every name in the list, finds the matching entry among the 32 screen-view slots (0x1c stride) and releases that object.

functions.name: Ui_SceneEntry_AddWithOffset
functions.signature: bool Ui_SceneEntry_AddWithOffset(UiSceneEntryList* self, float* position, unsigned char type)
functions.summary: Adds an entry (3D position + type) to the first free slot of a 0x24-entry list based at self+0xb10, after also adding it to the list at self+0x54.

functions.name: Ui_SceneEntry_Add
functions.signature: bool Ui_SceneEntry_Add(UiSceneEntryList* self, float* position, unsigned char type)
functions.summary: Adds a 3D-position entry to the first free slot of a 0x24-entry list (0x2c-byte entries) and marks it active.

functions.name: Ui_SceneEntry_AllocSlot
functions.summary: Finds the first free slot of the 0x24-entry table at table+0xB10 (0x2C-byte entries, empty = flag 0 and byte1 0xFF), initialises it through 0x002B7BE8 and marks it used.

functions.name: Ui_SceneEntry_AllocFirstFreeSlot
functions.summary: Same free-slot search as 0x006225E8 for the table based at table+0, without the extra argument passed to 0x002B7BE8.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenView_ApplyFadeParams
functions.signature: void Gfx_ScreenView_ApplyFadeParams(GfxScreenViewSet* self, int slot, unsigned short* params)
functions.summary: Applies the fade in/out parameters (two 16-bit values plus two flags) to one screen-view slot.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenView_ReleaseAll
functions.signature: void Gfx_ScreenView_ReleaseAll(GfxScreenViewSet* self, int mode, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Releases or resets all 32 screen-view slots: mode 0 performs a plain reset, non-zero marks each object released with the given tag.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenView_ResetAll
functions.summary: Calls the reset virtual (+0x10) on all 32 screen-view slot objects that are present.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenView_UpdateAll
functions.summary: Iterates over screen view slots at self+i*0x1C+0x110, invoking update virtual (+0x10) on active slots.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenViews_InitBuffers
functions.signature: void Gfx_ScreenViews_InitBuffers(int self, int viewMode, int config)
functions.summary: Initializes render pass view buffers and projection structures for screen view collection.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenView_ResetCollections
functions.summary: Resets the three per-screen collections (16 quick slots, 32 screen views, 36 scene entries) when a menu view or the camera is reset.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenViews_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructor of the screen-views collection: builds three sub-arrays (16 x 0x10, 32 x 0x1C, 36 x 0x2C), installs the base vtable 0x00782234 at +0xAB0 with a 0xFF sentinel at +0xAB8, resets every entry and returns the base pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_ScreenView_DestroyCollections
functions.summary: Destroys the same three collections as Gfx_ScreenView_ResetCollections using std_destroy_range and returns self.

functions.name: Script_RegisterHook
functions.signature: bool Script_RegisterHook(ScriptVm* vm, ScriptValue* closure, ScriptFunction* fn, ScriptValue* out)
functions.summary: Registers a native/Squirrel hook: checks the requested signature tag, converts the closure to a callable, allocates a 0x40-byte hook object and links it into the VM hook list.

functions.name: Container_ReleaseTreeB
functions.summary: Generic container node release: marks bit 31, releases 8-byte entries of child arrays at +0x28 and +0x34 via 0x00245C80, then unlinks and appends the node to the owner free list.

functions.name: Sq_ObjectPtr_ReleaseTemp_Tail
functions.summary: Tail of the routine at 0x00623114 that assigns a null Squirrel value to self+0x28: releases the temporary SQObject - if its type word has the refcounted tag 0x08000000 it decrements the refcount at +4 and calls the object's vtable slot +8 when it reaches zero.

functions.name: Script_Object_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a script-bound object: installs vtable 0x00780258, detaches from the owner at self+0x14 (0x00245C40), releases the four Squirrel object members at self+0x34/+0x2C/+0x24/+0x1C, then installs the base vtable 0x0075A728 and unlinks the object from its list.

functions.name: Script_Value_Dtor
functions.summary: Destructor of a 0x14-byte script value: detaches the shared buffer at self+0x10 when the type word at self+0xC is refcounted, calls the virtual destructor in vtable slot 0, then frees the block with the sized deallocator 0x00147AEC(size 0x14).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CreateChildObject_75B260
functions.summary: Lazily creates the 0x12C-byte child object of a model/scene class (vtable 0x0075B260), stores the owner at +0x20 and constructs 0x20 eight-byte entries with ctor 0x006D2344; on failure it falls back to copying the 32-word default block at 0x0072D818. No GPU register access is present.

functions.name: Ui_CharaStatus_HideModelA
functions.summary: Hides 3D character preview model in status menu by clearing visibility and invoking hide virtual on model view +0x18.

functions.name: Ui_CharaStatus_HideModelB
functions.summary: Alternate variant of character model hide helper in status menu, clearing model view +0x1C.

functions.name: Container_ClearSlotRef
functions.summary: Releases object reference held at self+8 via vtable slot 1 (release) and zeroes the pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_LoadCommonShaderPacks
functions.summary: Loads the system-common pack and the two shader binaries ('syscmn.pack', 'ChipShader.shbin', 'DebugPrimShader.shbin') needed by the renderer, then enables the render path.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_CreateSlot
functions.summary: One-shot init of the 0x21C-byte UI scene object: allocates and zeroes it (vtable 0x007829E0), loads and attaches 'shader_bch', creates the 0x37C-byte state object, registers the system objects and marks f_c->f_a4; skipped while the loading screen is active.

functions.name: Ui_DataPanel_CreateGlobals
functions.summary: Lazily creates the three global UI objects behind a one-byte 'already created' flag: a small 0x1C-byte helper (vtable 0x782950), the 0x7F4F1C-byte UI manager (vtable 0x782928) and the 0x2FB28-byte data-panel window whose 31 slot records of 0x12EC are constructed in place (vtable 0x764B84), then resets the window state.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_ReleaseHook
functions.summary: Unlinks scene-flow hook via 0x006232CC, clears state at +0x18, and resets child object (+8) via vtable slot 6 (+0x18).

functions.name: maybe_Field_NotifyWorkSubObject
functions.summary: Per-frame hook: calls func_001A2F9C on the field work (work+8), which forwards to work->f_10->vt[3](work->f_10, 1, 0). Always returns 1. Slot 17 of a 22-slot update vtable.

functions.name: maybe_Field_NotifyWorkSubObjectB
functions.summary: Byte-identical twin of maybe_Field_NotifyWorkSubObject: calls func_001A2F9C on the field work and returns 1. Slot 13 of the same 22-slot update vtable.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MapWindow_RefreshEntry
functions.summary: Shows the current location banner: reads the area id at saveWork+0x2D2C (0xFF = none), resolves the area record with func_0063F21C and either hands its talk data to Ui_MessageWindow_ShowTalkData or builds the full display-param block (icon, label, colour, position, 0x3F4CCCCD scale) and calls Ui_MessageWindow_ShowFieldData; also applies the pending scenario jump and the window layout first.

functions.name: Camera_UpdateIfEnabled
functions.summary: If the current camera has work, recomputes its view and projection matrices; always returns true.

functions.name: maybe_Field_UpdateOwnerAndNotify
functions.summary: Calls maybe_Ui_Object_SetOwner on the field work (work+8) and, when work+8 byte +7 is set, calls the object's vtable +0x18; returns 1. Slot 12 of the 22-slot update vtable.

functions.name: Ui_WindowResource_ResetAndInit
functions.summary: Resets the shared UI window resource and reinitialises the panel node, used when a window is rebuilt.

functions.name: tEb
functions.signature: u32 tEb(int arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_ApplyWorkLayout
functions.summary: Builds a 0x40-byte work block (16 zeroed words, then a 17-wchar string copied from data-table row 0xF0 through 0x00640200 and std_wcsncpy) and installs it into the save work at work+0x24A98 with 0x00613F14. Called from a map-window refresh helper; the body does not rebuild a layout.

functions.name: Event_ApplyScenarioJumpSettings
functions.summary: Applies the current scenario-jump settings: when the map work's jump-active flag is set it (re)loads the event script, sets the book command params and initialises the scenario jump, then rebuilds the jump destination ids for the map work and refreshes the ten map-marker slots.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_Init
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_Init(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Initialises the smith/forge menu: creates the menu state object, clears the two mode bytes on the game state, sets up the category/detail slots and calls the initial update.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_GetGlobal
functions.summary: Returns the smith-menu singleton and refreshes its slot list (0x5F9828).

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_Reset
functions.summary: Resets the smith menu to its initial state: releases the menu singleton data and the 0x1C-byte state object, re-creating both through 0x626290/0x29398C.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_GetItemInfo
functions.summary: When input row has flag 1 or 4 set, closes the smith detail pane via Ui_SmithMenu_DetailClose and writes the two words at 0x00728580+4/+8 into the output buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_HandleDetailToggle
functions.summary: Toggles detail pane visibility for list row based on flag bit 2: hides widget via Ui_Widget_SetChildVisible and toggles detail panes via Ui_ListWindow_ToggleDetailPanes; decompiler truncates on bad instruction data.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Context_AllocAndInit
functions.summary: Low-level factory for the shared 0x98-byte context object (vtable 0x782A08): zero-fills the block, initialises the header, stores the object through the caller's pointer and sets its +0x25 word to 0xFFFF.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_HandleCommand
functions.summary: Smith-menu input/state handler: switches on the selected command (0..4) and drives the category list, detail list, page stack and detail open/close animations.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_SetupFromActorSprite
functions.summary: Mirrors an actor's two sprite objects into a UI part: marks both sprite objects dirty, initialises the part's two sub-objects at +8 and +0x2E from the actor, then stores the outfit/attachment bytes at +6, +7, +0x19, +0x1A and +0x1B, choosing between two byte patterns from the sprite sub-offset.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_GetSubObject
functions.summary: Notifies the owner pointer at self+0x2C (calls 0x003ECEEC with self when its +0x170 field is zero) and then returns the address of the sub-object at self+0x5A4. The epilogue is odd: `pop {r4,lr}` is followed by the return-value setup, so the exact return convention is not certain.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_DispatchInput
functions.summary: Dispatches an input/update event to the list window's active sub-widget: text builder, page stack or detail panel, depending on the current row/page counters.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_SelectEntry
functions.signature: void Ui_ListWindow_SelectEntry(UiListWindow* self, unsigned int index, UiPageStack* pages)
functions.summary: Selects the row at index in the list window: validates it against the page's entry count, copies the row style/vtable and updates the detail panes.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_InitState
functions.summary: Initialises list-window state structure from static templates 0x007285BC, zeroes flags, and memsets 0x60-byte block via 0x00116AE0.

functions.name: Ui_Window_ReleaseChildLists
functions.summary: Releases the two child object lists referenced by handles at +0xc4 and +0xac and returns self.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetStatusText
functions.summary: Shows a status/description line in the smith menu: maps the id arg2 (0xFF = empty) through 0x640684 and sets it on the message widget.

functions.name: Ui_Core_Init
functions.summary: Lazy one-shot initialiser of the global UI core: on the first call it creates the 0x12B0-byte Ui_System_Ctor sub-manager, the 0x37C-byte shared command buffer, the 0x50-byte panel object and the 0x1084/0x830-byte scene/slot arrays, then releases the embedded layout name and sets the done byte at +8.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_FinishTransition
functions.summary: Finishes a smith-menu state transition: releases the old talk-party panel, then releases the slot handles whose state bytes changed between the old and new records and finally the slots that the new state table marks as empty.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_ReleaseSlot
functions.summary: Releases one of the six smith-menu slot entries: destroys the widget at +0xC and frees the pack handle at +0x58 (index arg2).

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_ApplyWindowSetup
functions.signature: void Ui_SceneFlow_ApplyWindowSetup(UiSceneFlow* self, SetupRecord* rec, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Applies a scene setup record: binds the slot resources, updates the window parts from the record's mode byte and replaces the current child window.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_LoadWorldMapModels
functions.summary: Binds the scene-flow slot resources and, when the current window requests it, loads the world-map model set.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_BindSlotResources
functions.summary: Binds the eight slot resources of the current scene flow to their UI objects by resolving each slot's handle to the matching resource class.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_DestroyTalkParty
functions.summary: Releases the talk-party panel held by the scene flow and destroys the window object.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_ReleaseAllSlots
functions.summary: Releases every smith-menu/scene-flow slot handle (1..7) and slot object (0..5).

functions.name: Gfx_SetBottomScreenRect
functions.summary: Sets the bottom-screen 2D viewport: binds the root's +0x88 render target to the context's +0x1308 block in mode 3 and writes the rectangle 0,0..240,400 into +0x1318..+0x1324.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene2D_ResetScroll
functions.summary: Clears the 2D scene's scroll/offset pair at device+0x1308 and +0x130C.

functions.name: Ui_Core_GetOrCreateChild
functions.summary: Lazily creates and caches the 0xF4-byte child object at uiCore+0x10: allocates it from the core's heap, constructs it with class descriptor 0x00782234 and returns the existing instance on later calls.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_ApplySlotLayout
functions.signature: void Ui_SceneFlow_ApplySlotLayout(UiSceneFlow* self, SlotLayoutRecord* rec, char* extra)
functions.summary: Applies the per-slot icon/handle layout for a scene: picks the icon table for the record's slot type (0..7) and sets the corresponding slot handles.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetCategoryIcons
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_SetCategoryIcons(u32 self, u8* category, int index)
functions.summary: Sets the smith menu's category icons: two fixed slots (ids 3/4) plus a per-category icon selected by the switch on *arg2 (0..10).

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_ReleaseCategorySlots
functions.summary: Releases the smith-menu category widgets and then all six slot entries whose enable byte is clear.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetMaterialSlot
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_SetMaterialSlot(int self, u32 arg2, int material)
functions.summary: Shows the selected forging material in slot 5 using the material icon data at arg3->f_144/f_14c.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_RefreshParts
functions.summary: Refreshes the smith-menu widget tree: reactivates the effect widget and rebuilds the part list with the new index.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_InitShader
functions.summary: Loads the UI layout shader 'lyt_shader.shbin' (once, cached in a global) and binds its two shader handles to the object's render object, then rebinds the layout's slot object.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_Hide
functions.summary: Hides the smith menu: releases the category widget group (id 7) and slot 5 and clears the visible byte.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene2D_InitViewport
functions.summary: Initialises the 2D scene viewport: sets device+0x1328/+0x132C to 0, the viewport size to 400x240 (top 3DS screen) and configures the scroll region at device+0x1308 with the scene's layout object.

functions.name: Gfx_ResetDrawGroup
functions.summary: Resets the active draw group on the graphics context (a cheap flush of the current render pass), used by almost every UI-system destructor.

functions.name: Gfx_SystemModel_Load
functions.signature: void Gfx_SystemModel_Load(char* loadFlag, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Lazily loads the shared system model syscmn.bch once: allocates a 0x21C-byte holder, opens syscmn.bch from the PACK manager, verifies its type, then looks up a value in its resource table and binds it to the renderer.

functions.name: Ui_SceneObject_Release
functions.summary: Releases a UI scene object: makes sure its layout shader is initialised, releases the animation/motion/model resources and the extra render object, and plays the object's close sound effect. Used as the object's teardown/destructor body.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetSlotHandle
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_SetSlotHandle(int self, int slot, u32 name, u32 size)
functions.summary: Assigns a resource string (e.g. an icon path) to one of the smith menu's 16-byte slots at +0x18, releasing the previous handle.

functions.name: Ui_System_Shutdown
functions.summary: Shuts the UI system down: releases every UI subsystem object (screen members, layout, effects, pack) and clears both init flags.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetSlotHandleB
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_SetSlotHandleB(int self, int slot, u32 name, u32 size)
functions.summary: Second slot-handle setter used for the smith menu's per-slot text/icon strings (slots at +0x58).

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_BindSlotObject
functions.summary: Binds one scene-flow slot's handle to the UI object of the expected resource class.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_SetAllSlotHandles
functions.signature: void Ui_SmithMenu_SetAllSlotHandles(u32 self, int category, u32 size)
functions.summary: Assigns the five category icon handles at once, skipping slots whose enable byte in g_00627284+arg2*6 is clear.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_ReleaseSlotHandle
functions.summary: Releases the widget at +0xC and the pack handle at +0x18 for the given slot (the +0x18 variant of 0x625F1C).

functions.name: Engine_ResourceNode_CtorBase
functions.summary: Constructs the 0x98-byte tracked engine resource/actor base object: installs vtable 0x00780384, binds list pointer (*Engine_GetMemoryManager())+0x354 at self+4, constructs the 8-slot (+0x18) and 6-slot (+0x58) handle arrays, sets self->u16_94 = 0xFFFF, and returns self.

functions.name: maybe_Field_HandleList_Ctor
functions.summary: Constructs a small handle list: installs the local vtable 0x784304, allocates the 8-byte allocator wrapper (vtable 0x782B10) and a 0x94-byte reader object via func_0058C40C, so the list owns its allocator/handle pair.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ReleaseInstance
functions.summary: Releases a spawned field scene object: installs the base vtable, clears the sprite parts / frees the attached handle when +8 is set and runs the virtual +4 of the object at +4. Used on the failure paths of the Field_Scene_SpawnObjectsFromTable variants and by Ui3D_InitEffectPairFromRecord.

functions.name: Battle_FindFirstValidTarget
functions.signature: BattleUnit* Battle_FindFirstValidTarget(BattleCommand* cmd, unsigned int* groupIndex, unsigned int arg3)
functions.summary: Searches the battle unit groups for the first target accepted by the given command (all-target / single-target / random), first in the requested group and then in the other groups.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_ClearTargetFlags
functions.summary: Clears target selection flags and checks action row data via Game_GetDataManager (0x0011CB38) table lookup 0x0063FD24.

functions.name: Battle_IsTargetValid
functions.summary: Predicate used by the target search: returns true when the command's target mode accepts the unit (all enemies/all allies/single).

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_ValidateTarget
functions.summary: Validates a battle target: locates it in the unit array at self+0xE8 (stride 0x2C8), looks up its action record through Game_GetDataManager, and returns 0 (reject), 1 (accept) or 2 (needs another check) after comparing the unit's slot/group/stat fields with the action's target criteria.

functions.name: maybe_Math_ClampUnitRatio
functions.signature: float* maybe_Math_ClampUnitRatio(float* out, int record, int flags, int count)
functions.summary: Float ratio clamp helper that returns a pointer to the clamped value; the body is a 74-byte Thumb routine.

functions.name: Battle_HasUnitInState1C
functions.summary: Returns true when any battle unit (or queued action) is in state 0x1c, used to gate phase changes.

functions.name: Battle_HasUnitInStateField88
functions.signature: u32 Battle_HasUnitInStateField88(BattleUnit* self, u32 arg2, BattleUnitTable* table)
functions.summary: Scans 0x2C8-byte battle unit records in table up to 0x50, testing whether unit state word at +0x88 equals 0x219; returns predicate u32.

functions.name: Battle_HasUnitInState29
functions.summary: Returns true when a live unit that has finished its action is in state 0x29, used by the battle phase update.

functions.name: Battle_CheckActorCanAct
functions.signature: u32 Battle_CheckActorCanAct(Actor* actor, u32 stateWord, u32 entityId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 0 when the unit must be skipped: state bits 8 or 10 are set, the actor record's +0xe4 is 5, or the actor's behaviour byte 0xB108 is 7/8; otherwise 1.

functions.name: Actor_HasCommandByName
functions.summary: Returns true when the actor's model/command table (f_160->f_11c) contains a command looked up by name.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_SelectMimicEndCommand

functions.signature: void maybe_Field2D_ApplyActorVisualState(void* work, int arg2, int arg3, int arg4)
functions.summary: Almost empty in the decompilation: it fetches the game work, calls the game-mode query 0x0062AB3C and returns. Whatever it did with arg2..arg4 was lost, so the name is only a placeholder.

functions.name: Ui_PromptRef_IsFirstChoiceConfirmed

functions.name: Field2D_IsActorOffScreen
