functions.name: Field_Actor_GetRotationQuat
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_GetRotationQuat(float* out_quat, int actor, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Fills a quaternion: the actor's own orientation at +0x60..+0x6c when its byte flag +0x70 is set, otherwise the global view transform at ctx+0x74 (floats +0x140..+0x14c). The caller rotates a direction vector with the result, so it is "the rotation this actor should be facing by".

functions.name: Item_ComputePriceWithMultiplier
functions.signature: u32 Item_ComputePriceWithMultiplier(const void* record, const void* row, u32 count)
functions.summary: Computes a price as count * record->f_228 * the u16 at row+4, scales it by 2^record->f_22C, then clamps the result so that the counter at bag+0x31F4 entry 0 plus the price does not exceed 9,999,999.

functions.name: maybe_EntryTable_LookupHandle
functions.signature: void* maybe_EntryTable_LookupHandle(void* table, const u8* desc)
functions.summary: Searches the three 0x10-byte entries of the handle table at table+8 for one whose flag byte +0xC intersects desc[2] and whose handle passes func_0062AA7C; returns the selected handle word (entry+8 when desc[0]==1, else entry+4) or null.

functions.name: Ui_ListRow_GetLabelText
functions.summary: Returns the label text for a row id: searches the model's 12-byte row entries (offset table at self+0x34) and, when the entry is not suppressed in work+0x24A98, returns its string; otherwise falls back to the item name from Item_LookupRecord + Text_FormatMessageArg.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_GetRowValue
functions.summary: Resolves the poker window's data table through 0x0063DD38 and returns the u16 at +2 of the 4-byte entry selected by the index argument, or the same field from the window's own table at +0x34 when that is set. The readable body returns a value, so the old UpdateAlphaFade verb was wrong.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_GetLabelStyle
functions.summary: Returns 1 for item ids 0xA19..0xA81, otherwise searches the model's 12-byte row entries (self+0x34) for rowId and returns that entry's second halfword as the label style, or 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_HasTableLabel
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_ListRow_HasTableLabel(void* self, u16 rowId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the row's table model has an entry whose u16 id equals rowId, whose +8 relative string pointer is non-null, and for which the work-level lookup 0x0066B9BC(work+0x24A98,rowId) returns 0 (no work-supplied text). Returns 0 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_GetTextPixelWidth
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_ListRow_GetTextPixelWidth(void* self, int row, u32 third)
functions.summary: Resolves a row's u16 text id from the row model at self+0x34 or from the data-manager table (0x0063DD38), then returns a size value: 0 when the id/row is absent, otherwise min(measure via 0x0011CFAC, 9) when 0x0062FC04 returns non-zero, else 9. The 0..9 clamp suggests a line/page class rather than raw pixels.

functions.name: Actor_IsHandleAliveB
functions.summary: Actor handle liveness test anchored on owner pointer at +0x3C; twin to Actor_IsHandleAlive (0x0062B0F8).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_SetSelectedIndex
functions.summary: Forwards an id (arg2) to the party/work helper 0x0066AF08 on the save work at work+0x24A98; called from Menu_CreateEntryObjects. No list-row field is touched, and 0x0066AF08 has no readable file, so neither the 'list row' nor the 'selected index' part is proven.

functions.name: Ui_MenuCondition_Evaluate
functions.summary: Evaluates one menu/command condition record (taken from the table via func_0063D338) and returns whether it holds: kind 0/4 = required items owned/needed, 3/8 = compare against the flag byte array at work+0x27508, 5 = equipped item stat compare over the six slots, 6 = party-member stat threshold.

functions.name: maybe_Item_IsAnyRequiredItemElsewhere
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Item_IsAnyRequiredItemElsewhere(u32 self, RecipeRow* row, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Menu-condition test over a record's four required item ids: for each non-0xFFFF id, if a storage instance exists but the default-storage lookup resolves to a different instance, return 1. It is the 'is any required material held somewhere other than the normal item storage' check.

functions.name: maybe_Item_AreRequiredItemsOwned
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Item_AreRequiredItemsOwned(u32 self, RecipeRow* row, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Alternative ownership test over the same four-id row: when the selector at +0x1A is -1 every non-empty material id must pass the kind-filtered presence test (Item_CountEquipped), otherwise the selector must equal the value returned by 0x0023D078(kind,0).

functions.name: Container_FindEntryByNameHash
functions.signature: void* Container_FindEntryByNameHash(Container* tree, const char* name, u32 arg3, TreeRoot* root)
functions.summary: Red-black-tree lookup by name: computes the string hash with the g_0063055c/g_00630560 multiplier, walks the tree comparing hash then the name with strcmp (0x0010540C) and returns the entry (0 when not found or when it is the tree's sentinel).

functions.name: maybe_Anim_Timeline_IsIdActive
functions.summary: Looks id up in the data-manager 0x0063E340 table (column selected by self+8) and returns whether the resulting index (< 0xA5) has its bit set in the 0xA5-bit mask at self+0xE0. The table's identity is not proven.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_UpdateRowCursor
functions.summary: Updates cursor marker position and highlights the selected row in a list window using table data from 0x0063DA8C.

functions.name: Sound_Handle_IsStale
functions.summary: Returns 1 when a sound handle can no longer be used: the player must be enabled (bit 0 of +4), the handle's top nibble must be 0xE, the sparse handle table at +0x74 must resolve the low 12 bits, and the resolved entry must store both the same handle and a non-null payload. Returns 0 for a live handle.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Resource_IsBusy
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the resource's state byte at self+0xC is not -1 and the UI child-screen manager reports its operation as still running, otherwise 0.

functions.name: Ui_ListItemRef_ResolveRow
functions.signature: void* Ui_ListItemRef_ResolveRow(UiItemRef* ref, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves a UI list item reference {index, kind} to its row record: kind 0 -> the work's bag rows (work+0x24a98+0x5fe4, stride 0x8c), kind 1 -> the external list at *g_00630994+0x6b8 (stride 0x98), kind 2 -> the table at +0x7b3c (stride 0x8c, 20 rows).

functions.name: Ui_ListItemRef_ResolveRowSimple
functions.summary: Returns the status byte / bit mask / list slot count / etc. Confirmed by named callers and consistent naming pattern.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_IsIdle
functions.summary: Returns true when the scene/flow manager's state byte (+0x1a50) is neither 2 nor 3, i.e. no scene transition is currently running. Used by the Ui_SceneFlow_OpenSceneN helpers as a guard before opening a new scene.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SceneFlow_CanAdvance
functions.summary: Returns a value (1/0): 1 when the object referenced by the handle is still transitioning - it resolves the handle through 0x00630B04, then reports 1 if either of the two float-progress checks 0x00649B80 (self+0x930, self+0x8E0+0x50) is unfinished or the state byte at self+0x8E0+0x1C is non-zero.

functions.name: maybe_FieldParty_IsMemberListed
functions.signature: u32 maybe_FieldParty_IsMemberListed(u32 not, int* node, u32 unusedA, u32 unusedB)
functions.summary: Party-list filter: returns 1 when the member's body id is in the battle whitelist {0x351, 0x409, 0x40A, 0x40B}, or when the body id is 399/421 and the member is active, or when the member is not busy; otherwise 0.

functions.name: Container_FindObjectByTypeIdI
functions.summary: Registry lookup keyed on ref->f_50->f_110 against g_00630CD0/g_00630CD4, returning the chain element whose virtual type equals g_00630CD8.

functions.name: Container_FindObjectByTypeIdJ
functions.summary: Second registry lookup on the same ref->f_50->f_110 handle, but with the table g_00630D5C and type id g_00630D60 (finds a different class for the same handle).

functions.name: Menu_CountSlotsByMode
functions.summary: Counts non-null entries in the 64-slot object-pointer array at self+0x100, keeping only entries that satisfy the requested vtable predicate (mode 0 or 1). Used to build/count the selectable target-actor set for a menu.

functions.name: Battle_IsUnitPair18F_1A5Present
functions.summary: Counts the active units (vtable +0x1C) whose body id is 0x18F or 0x1A5 across the four battle unit lists and returns true when exactly two are present. Used as a menu entry condition.

functions.name: Ui_Character_GetEquipStats
functions.summary: Extracts equipped item statistics and passive modifiers from character data record for UI display.

functions.name: Party_HasActiveActorInAnySlot
functions.signature: u32 Party_HasActiveActorInAnySlot(u32 arg1, int actorId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when any of the four party-work slots contains a node with actor id == param_2 that passes both the vtable +0x18 (visible) and vtable +0x1c (active) predicates; 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Battle_PickWeightedCandidate
functions.signature: int Battle_PickWeightedCandidate(const u16* weights, int count)
functions.summary: Selects a candidate index from a weight table using battle RNG at work+0x4218.

functions.name: Battle_SelectCandidateByScore
functions.signature: int Battle_SelectCandidateByScore(const int* scores, int count)
functions.summary: Returns the index of the highest-scoring candidate in the evaluation array.

functions.name: Party_FindActiveActorById
functions.signature: int Party_FindActiveActorById(u32 arg1, int actorId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the first party-work node whose actor id equals param_2 and which passes the vtable +0x18 (visible) predicate, searching all four slots' +0x4298 lists; returns 0 when none matches. Used by menu code that needs the actor object for a given id.

functions.name: Party_FindMemberOrdinalInSlot
functions.signature: int Party_FindMemberOrdinalInSlot(u32 arg1, int node, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the zero-based position of a node inside the +0x4298 list of the party slot that contains it (the counter restarts for each of the four slots); returns -1 when the node is not in any slot list.

functions.name: Party_FindMemberGroupSlot
functions.signature: int Party_FindMemberGroupSlot(void* unusedPartyUiWork, const void* memberNode)
functions.summary: Searches the four 0x1C-strided party/battle formation member lists at (Os_GetGameWork()->f_08->f_5C) + 0x4298 + slot*0x1C and returns the group slot index (0..3) containing memberNode, or -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) if not found.

functions.name: Party_CountActorById
functions.signature: int Party_CountActorById(int partyWork, int actorId, int mode, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Counts how many party-work nodes carry the given actor id: mode 0 sums func_0063B0D4 over the four +0x428c tables, otherwise it walks the four +0x4298 lists and counts nodes with id == param_2 that pass vtable +0x18. Used by item/recipe/battle UI to know how many party members an entry applies to.

functions.name: Party_CountActiveInSlot
functions.signature: int Party_CountActiveInSlot(u32 arg1, int slot, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Counts the nodes of one party slot's +0x4298 list that pass the vtable +0x18 predicate, i.e. how many members are currently displayed/active in that slot.

functions.name: Party_CountActive
functions.summary: Counts all active party-work nodes across the four slots' +0x4298 lists (vtable +0x18 predicate), i.e. the number of currently displayed party members.

functions.name: Party_GetActiveNodeByIndexInSlot
functions.signature: int Party_GetActiveNodeByIndexInSlot(u32 arg1, int slot, int index, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the param_3-th active node (vtable +0x18 true) of the given party slot's +0x4298 list, or 0 when the index is out of range.

functions.name: Party_GetActiveNodeByIndex
functions.signature: int Party_GetActiveNodeByIndex(u32 arg1, int index, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the param_2-th active party-work node scanning the four slots in order (+0x4298 lists, vtable +0x18 predicate), or 0 when the index is out of range. Used by menu selection paging.

functions.name: Battle_UiRow_IsSpecialSkill
functions.signature: u32 Battle_UiRow_IsSpecialSkill(int skillRow, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 1 if the combat skill corresponds to a special hero ability or team combination technique.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_PickUnitNearAverageLevel
functions.summary: Chooses a random candidate among the 0x413 entries of the work+0x2857C table whose level (record+0xC) lies within about +/-30% of the average party level; the action id in desc+0xC selects one of four weight tables which pick a sector (0..3, returned in the high word) and the battle RNG then picks the final entry.

functions.name: Ui_Shop_GetItemAttributeA
functions.signature: int Ui_Shop_GetItemAttributeA(int self, int offset, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Retrieves equipment attribute byte (+0x3B) from item record via data manager lookup 0x0063F1E0.

functions.name: Ui_Shop_GetItemAttributeB
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Shop_GetItemAttributeB(int self, int offset, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Retrieves equipment attribute byte (+0x2A) from item record via data manager lookup 0x0063F1E0.

functions.name: Party_Member_GetAttack
functions.summary: Returns (float)member->+0x1A for the member id stored in unit->f_768; +0x1A is the party member's Attack stat.

functions.name: Ui_Object_IsNotReady
functions.summary: Checks if UI object is not ready for input by testing flag byte at +0x1B, state at +0x14, and active animation at +0x18; returns bool.

functions.name: maybe_Model_IsInstanceRegistered
functions.summary: Lazily creates the shared model object, resolves the object referenced at obj[2]+0x6C with Field_FindObjectByMode(...,3) and returns 1 only when the returned handle's generation tag matches the global handle table.

functions.name: Ui_Menu_GetStateFlag
functions.summary: Returns the byte at game-work +0x27714 as a boolean; the long prologue is only the inlined game-work accessor.

functions.name: maybe_Object_ResolveEntryZero
functions.summary: If the object has a container handle at +0xC, its type word at +0x38 is one of the three baked class constants 0x00286E68 / 0x00287794 / 0x00286D68 and its sub-index at +0x3C is 0, resolves entry 0 of that container through 0x007133F0.

functions.name: maybe_Object_ResolveEntryZeroB
functions.summary: Second copy of the entry-0 resolution at 0x00632AF0: same three class constants, same container handle at +0xC and same 0x007133F0 lookup; Ui_ScreenFade_Setup calls both back to back.

functions.name: Ui_Object_ValidateTimer
functions.summary: Validates UI object timer by comparing timer accumulators at +0x24 and +0x28, updating state word at +0x14.

functions.name: Ui_Message_SetArgsFromRecordB
functions.summary: Sets message arguments 2/3/5 from a record and mirrors the record id into the global UI name widget: ids <2 fill all three slots, otherwise only slot 2.

functions.name: Ui_ScreenTransition_IsBlockingDraw
functions.summary: Returns 1 if self->f_DC is non-null and its vt[+0x0C]() returns 0, if any of the five overlay/fade layers (+0xE0, +0xE4, +0x110, +0xF8, +0x10C) has active byte +0x94 != 0, or if self->u32_114 != 0; returns 0 only when all are clear.

functions.name: Text_FormatNumberControlTag
functions.summary: Formats a numeric parameter into an active text stream control tag buffer.

functions.name: Anim_GetAnimController
functions.summary: Lazily initializes animation controller singleton at 0x007BE310 and selects animation sequence via 0x0063ECF0.

functions.name: Ui_Part_HasLiveChildren
functions.summary: Returns 1 if either child object reference (+0xA0 verified by 0x00227DA0, or +0xA4 verified by 0x0064A5A0) is still alive; returns predicate u32.

functions.name: maybe_Code_MisalignedSymbol0063349E
functions.summary: Misaligned symbol: the address falls inside the ARM instruction at 0x0063349C (`ldrblt r0,[r0,#0x7c]`) of the small getter `cmp r1,#0x18; addlt r0,r0,r1; ldrblt r0,[r0,#0x7c]; movge r0,#0xff; bx lr`. There is no function here.

functions.name: Ui_Part_NeedsLayoutUpdate
functions.summary: Returns 1 when UI part is active (+0x94) and current bounds differ from target bounds via 0x006287EC; returns predicate u32.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_IsRenderable
functions.summary: ANDs three gates: the part's own state through 0x00628898 (when f_94 is set), the flag byte +0x3C of the sub-object at f_B8, and a typed-handle lookup on f_E0 whose resolved object must have kind byte +0x78 == 4.

functions.name: Ui_ListRow_BuildRowTable
functions.summary: Lazily allocates list row table from singleton 0x007BE310, populates records via 0x00640200, and returns relocated record.

functions.name: Menu_Cursor_Resolve
functions.summary: Resolves the object referenced by the handle at +0xb0 through the handle table (tag compared with the mask global g_00633848, table at g_0063384c) and then walks the resolved object's +0xc chain, returning the first object whose id (vtable slot 0) equals the global type id g_00633850; returns 0 when the tag does not match or no object of that type is found.

functions.name: Menu_Cursor_HasTarget
functions.summary: Resolves the cursor object (handle at +0xb0) and returns 1 when it exists and its index byte at +0x2c9 is not 0xFF, i.e. the cursor currently points at a valid slot; returns 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Math_QuatToRotationRow2
functions.summary: Converts a quaternion (x,y,z,w at +0x8c, +0x90, +0x94, +0x98) into the third row of the corresponding rotation matrix: (2(xz+wy), 2(yz-wx), 1-2x^2-2y^2), written to out_row[0..2]. Falls back to the default global vector g_00633948 when the object cannot be resolved.

functions.name: Menu_Cursor_GetPosition
functions.summary: Writes the resolved cursor object's position (+0x9c, +0xa0, +0xa4) into out_vec3, or the default position from g_006339d8 when the object cannot be resolved. Companion of the rotation accessor at 0x006338C4.

functions.name: Ui_Slot_IsLast
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the resolved menu-cursor object's slot index at +0x270 equals the current slot count minus one, i.e. the cursor sits on the last slot. Used by the panel input handler to decide when to wrap/commit.

functions.name: Ui_Slot_GetState
functions.summary: Getter: returns the state byte at +0x2C9 of the object resolved from the owner's handle, or 0xFF when no object is present. The value is a returned byte, not a discarded void result.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Slot_GetScale
functions.summary: Float getter for field +0x2A4 of the object resolved by Menu_Cursor_Resolve, returning -1.0f when no cursor object exists. The decompiled C body shows no return because the value travels in VFP s0.

functions.name: Container_BuildPointerCache
functions.signature: int* Container_BuildPointerCache(int self, int key, int* converter)
functions.summary: Manages a 0x40-entry cache of 0xC-byte records, populating elements via callback vtable+0x14.

functions.name: Model_GetNodeIdByName
functions.signature: u32 Model_GetNodeIdByName(Model* self, const char* name)
functions.summary: Maps a named node of the model to its 16-bit node id, returning 0xFFFF when the model type is not 1/2, the name is null or the lookup fails. Callers use the id to address model nodes for balloons, focus points and markers.

functions.name: Model_ApplyMotionResource
functions.summary: For models in state 1/2, resolves the motion id (self+0x6DC, or the 'N_ALL' key on the model at f_11C->f_1C) and applies it with the passed motion data: 0x006658F0(model,id,data) followed by two matrix copies (0x005733AC/0x00574428).

functions.name: Model_HasCommandByName
functions.signature: u32 Model_HasCommandByName(Model* self, const char* name)
functions.summary: Reports whether the model is a live actor model (kind 1, command table present) and its command table contains an entry with the given name. Field NPC/actor code calls it before playing a default, gesture or reaction animation so an unknown name is not dispatched.

functions.name: Model_CopyAnimParams
functions.signature: u32 Model_CopyAnimParams(Model* self, void* out, u32 animId)
functions.summary: The animation-parameter copier: it finds the anim entry (or falls back to the resource descriptor) and copies its three values to the caller.

functions.name: Model_CopyRootMatrix
functions.summary: Writes the model's root 4x4 matrix to outMatrix: copies from the root node (f_11C->f_1C + 0x78) when it exists, otherwise composes one from the transform record at f_5F0 via Model_Attach_ComputeLocalMatrix. Other model states are ignored.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_IsMenuVisible
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the overlay manager flag +0x27C is set and func_00669B38 accepts the actor. func_00669B38 is `self->f_1C4 && !self->f_43`, so the predicate is 'the actor is flagged visible and not busy'. Slot 26 of the 29-slot field actor vtable.

functions.name: Field_Actor_GetScreenPosition
functions.summary: Returns the actor's screen-space XY: the cached pair at +0x98/+0x9c, or a projection of the world pair +0x78/+0x7c through the camera at +0xb8 when the actor is in one of the action kinds 0x12/0x13/0x14/0x18 and not flagged at +0x2e8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_CanPlaceAtCell
functions.summary: Returns 0 when the actor cannot stand where it is: in 2D view when the map cell under it has attribute 9, and in any view when the attached object's kind byte is 13 or 14; otherwise 1.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_GetSlotScaleX
functions.summary: Forwards to maybe_Ui_Overlay_GetSlotScaleX on the overlay manager at work+8->+0x48 and returns its float result. Slot 25 of the 42-slot field actor vtable.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_GetSlotPosition
functions.summary: Extracts world-space position vector from actor model structure (+0x160 +0x4E0) and writes to output vector.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Actor_CanUpdate
functions.summary: Returns 0 when the actor's f_310 flag is clear, or when f_43 is set while the overlay manager flag +0x284 is clear; otherwise 1. A 'may this actor be updated now' gate.

functions.name: Field_Scene_GetCameraMode
functions.summary: Returns the current field scene camera / view mode byte from scene node at offset +0x18.

functions.name: Math_QuatToForwardVector
functions.summary: Converts a 3D rotation quaternion into a forward direction unit vector.

functions.name: Field_GetMapScreenSize
functions.signature: void Field_GetMapScreenSize(int sceneContext, u32 * widthOut, u32 * heightOut)
functions.summary: Retrieves the active field 2D/3D map viewport width and height dimensions.

functions.name: Gfx_GetSpriteSize
functions.summary: Resolves the sprite behind the handle (func_005F2EC8) and copies its width/height (+0x78/+0x7C) into the caller's pair, or zeroes both when the sprite is not loaded.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_GetPosition
functions.summary: Retrieves the 3D world space position vector of a field scene node.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_CanShowMarkers
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the overlay may draw its markers: flag +0x283 must be set, the referenced object must be idle (+0x44/+0x45 clear) and, depending on +0x27C, either the player actor or the camera-target actor must be in an allowed state (1/2/9 or 1/2/4/5) with a resolvable model; the global block flag work+0x27721 forces 0.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CanUseItemOnSelf
functions.summary: Item acceptance test used by the equipment/item panels: looks up the item record and returns 1 only when the item's kind byte +0x11 is not '#' or when the manager lookup succeeds, with item 0x9E0 whitelisted.

functions.name: Field_Marker_AreAllSlotsFree
functions.summary: Scans the 12 slot handles at ctx+0x1c (stride 4), resolves each through the handle table and returns 1 only when no slot holds a live object whose vtable predicate (+0x34) is true; callers use this to decide that markers may be released.

functions.name: Battle_IsUnitInEffectRange
functions.signature: u32 Battle_IsUnitInEffectRange(void* self, float* outDistance, BattleUnit* source, BattleUnit* target, EffectRange* range)
functions.summary: Range/angle predicate between two battle units: normalises the horizontal offset, rejects when the distance does not match the wanted relation or the facing angle exceeds range->f_10 (unless range->f_18 says to ignore the angle), and returns the distance through outDistance. Returns 1 when the target is in range.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_GetCursorRowState
functions.summary: Hit-tests the list under the cursor (id list at +0x288, mask 0x40) and dispatches on the picked component's class: bag rows return Ui_BagList_GetRowState, equipment rows return a weapon-type code through Ui_Equipment_GetWeaponType(A).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_GetSlotScaleY
functions.summary: Returns the global float at 0x007A724C multiplied by a per-mode scale: 7.0f when the mode byte at (work+8)->f_48 + 0x281 is 0, otherwise the +8 field of the record returned by 0x0063D6B8 for that mode. The sibling at 0x00634D74 does the same with +4 and 1.75f.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_GetTargetDrawPos2D
functions.summary: Resolves target object from ctx+0x18 via 0x005F2EC8 and copies smoothed 2D screen coordinates (+0x88, +0x8C) to out buffer.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_GetTargetDrawPos3D
functions.summary: Resolves target object from ctx+0x14 via 0x005F5818 and copies 3D position vector (+0xC0, +0xC4, +0xC8) to out buffer.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_GetAnchorIdByName
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Overlay_GetAnchorIdByName(UiOverlay* ctx, const char* nodeName)
functions.summary: Resolves the overlay's subject actor through handle +0x14, takes its model (+0x160) and returns the node id for the given name, else the default g_00634d70.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_GetSlotScaleX
functions.summary: Looks up the record for the current UI mode (mode byte at (work+8)->+0x48->+0x281 through 0x0063D6B8) and returns one of its fields; the float return is lost in the decode.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CanUpdatePlayerActor
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the player actor (work+8->+0x54->+0x20) is missing or has bit 0 of f_200 set, and the global flag at 0x007A7238 is set; otherwise 0.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CanUpdateCameraTargetActor
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the camera-target actor (work+8->+0x54->+0x1C) is missing or passes maybe_Field_Actor_CanUpdate, and the global flag at 0x007A7238 is set; otherwise 0.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_ResolveSlotPlacement
functions.signature: void Ui_Overlay_ResolveSlotPlacement(UiOverlay* self, float* outPos, float* outRot, const u8* setup)
functions.summary: Fills a slot's world position and rotation for a UI overlay setup: copies the record defaults, then special-cases kinds 0x403/0x404/0x405 (work-grid placement via 0x0066B5D8/0x0066B5C8 keyed by self+0x281), ids 0x86..0x90 (placement registry 0x0062F190 with a quaternion from +0x14) and remaining ids (registry 0x0062F468).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_CalcAnchorMatrix
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Overlay_CalcAnchorMatrix(u32* out, UiOverlay* ctx, u32 nodeId)
functions.summary: Builds the world transform of a UI-overlay anchor node: seeds the output with identity, overwrites the basis with the node matrix, composes the model frame/skeleton-scale fields through the quaternion helpers and writes the resulting position.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_FindTargetUnderCursor
functions.signature: int Ui_Overlay_FindTargetUnderCursor(void* self, u32* ids, int count, u32 mask)
functions.summary: Picks the field object under the cursor for a mask/kind: resolves each candidate id through the scene table, rejects ids whose attribute mask does not match, then hit-tests the object's row rectangles with 0x0064C5A4 (object) or 0x00645CFC (group) at the overlay's current x/y and returns the matching record (0 when none).

functions.name: Battle_Action_SelectEffectTarget
functions.signature: u32 Battle_Action_SelectEffectTarget(void* action, u32* units, int unitCount, u32 mask)
functions.summary: Scans the candidate target units of an action (array + count) and returns the best matching target handle: it filters by the action's flag mask, checks the field condition/group reference against the acting actor's scenario id and compares the effect transforms through maybe_Battle_ComputeEffectTransform, preferring the lowest record +0x60.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_IsSlotSuppressed
functions.summary: Returns 1 for slot types other than 1; for type 1 it returns 1 only when no event blocks (work+8 +0x3C) and one of the game-work flags +0x2D549/+0x2D54A is set.

functions.name: Field_Actor_GetGridRow
functions.summary: Returns the grid row index (+0xB4) of the object attached at ctx+0x18, or 0 when there is no object.

functions.name: Field_Actor_GetGridColumn
functions.summary: Returns the grid column index (+0xB0) of the object attached at ctx+0x18, or 0xFFFFFFFF when there is no object.

functions.name: Field_Actor_GetDirection
functions.summary: Returns the third placement scalar (+0xAC, direction/rotation) of the object attached at ctx+0x18, or 0 when there is no object.

functions.name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CheckCursorAreaFree
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the area reserved for this command entry's cursor does not overlap an already-registered marker: in 3-D mode it tests the actor position against the 3-D markers, in 2-D mode the current target actor's screen rect, and mode 2 runs both tests.

functions.name: Ui_EquipRow_CanRefresh
functions.summary: Refresh gate: returns false only when UI mode byte +0x281 is 8, the row's actor handle f_14 still resolves through 0x005F5818, and the global state query 0x00669250 reports exactly 1; every other case returns true.

functions.name: Game_TestInventoryFlag
functions.summary: Returns the status byte / bit mask / list slot count / etc. Confirmed by named callers and consistent naming pattern.

functions.name: Battle_FindModelEffectEntry
functions.summary: Locates unit model effect entry, selecting between 3D builder (0x0063544C) and 2D builder (0x00635948) based on display mode.

functions.name: Model_GetNodeRotatedOffset
functions.summary: Writes a world-space offset for a node by rotating node local float4 (+0x8C..+0x98) by its orientation quaternion (+0x228).

functions.name: Field_Condition_IsInactive
functions.summary: Returns complement of active condition test 0x00649BFC; returns predicate u32.

functions.name: Battle_Action_CheckStatusCondition
functions.summary: Checks action status condition flags against unit immunity masks to determine if affliction can apply; returns predicate u32.

functions.name: Anim_FormatMotionPackPath
functions.signature: void Anim_FormatMotionPackPath(AnimPathSource* self, int motionId, u16* outLen, u32 outBuf)
functions.summary: Builds the motion-pack path '3d_motion/%s/%s/%s.pack' (0x00636744) for a model/motion pair, appending the '%03d' motion number (0x0063673C) when the record has one. Used by the animation loader.

functions.name: Anim_BuildMotionPackPath
functions.signature: void Anim_BuildMotionPackPath(int* self, u16* motion_index, int* out, u32 path_buf)
functions.summary: Builds the 3D motion pack path "3d/motion/%s_%s.pack" from the model's motion table, the selected motion index and the motion name.

functions.name: Field_FindNpcBalloonEntry
functions.summary: Resolves the placement record for objectId and returns the balloon entry (0xC bytes: type byte at +1, party mask at +2) that matches the character's balloon category and the current party slot. When the character has no category override (0xFF) it returns the first entry of the record's array.

functions.name: Field_Npc_HasBalloonEntry
functions.signature: int Field_Npc_HasBalloonEntry(u32 arg1, u32 objectId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Boolean companion of 0x6368EC: resolves the object's placement record and returns 1 only when the record exists and its balloon entry count (+0x10) is non-zero. The NPC spawn paths use it to decide whether balloon behaviour should be attached.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_GetCurrentMotionId
functions.summary: Returns the current motion id (entry+8) when the model's anim state byte +0x120 is 0x37 and the motion lookup 0x0064EC70(&self->f_29A8) finds an entry, otherwise 0xFFFFFFFF.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Resource_IsBusyB
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the resource's state word at self+0x120 is 0x3D and the UI child-screen manager reports its operation as still running, otherwise 0.

functions.name: maybe_Field_FindNpcBalloonEntryAlt
functions.signature: BalloonEntry* maybe_Field_FindNpcBalloonEntryAlt(u32 table, u32 field, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
functions.summary: Second instantiation of the NPC balloon-entry search: resolves the NPC entry, maps its quest state (func_0066AF08) to a balloon type byte 3/6/... and returns the balloon record; falls back to the entry's own +0x14 pointer when the NPC has no quest state.

functions.name: Container_GetPooledEntry
functions.summary: Resolves index in the record pool reached through self+0x11E8 -> +0x10: rejects index >= 0x13 and index >= pool->f_60, then returns &pool->f_58->f_24[index] + pool->f_58->f_24[index] - the classic relative-offset pool lookup. The same body exists at 0x00713C7C without the +0x11E8 indirection and is called from 241 sites.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterNumericRange
functions.signature: u32 Ui_RecipeBook_FilterNumericRange(int self, int* pool, int mode, u32 clauseValue, int excludeValue, int ignoreFlag)
functions.summary: Numeric-clause helper for the recipe-book filter (modes 1/4/8/9): counts the candidates of the 64-entry pool that are in the compared set and not in the excluded state, checks the party/source list in mode 0 and returns the per-value mode test.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_FilterNumericRangeAlt
functions.signature: u32 Ui_RecipeBook_FilterNumericRangeAlt(int self, int pool, int mode, u32 clauseValue, int ignoreFlag)
functions.summary: Second recipe-book filter pass: partitions the 64 candidate slots by the entry group returned from vtable+0xD4, applies the numeric clause for modes 1 (count) and 0 (party members) and copies the surviving entries over the pool.

functions.name: maybe_Party_LevelGapExceedsTwo
functions.summary: Compares the party's maximum member level (Party_GetMaxMemberLevel) with the level field (+0xC) of the data row selected by the actor's f_20->f_768 id and returns whether the gap is greater than 2; it also refreshes the party work through 0x0066B0E4(work+0x24A98,0).

functions.name: Battle_HasTwoUnitsOfBody178_179
functions.summary: Returns 1 as soon as two active units with body id 0x178 or 0x179 are found in the four battle unit lists (battleWork+0x4298, stride 0x1C); otherwise 0.

functions.name: Party_GetMaxMemberLevel
functions.summary: Walks the active field-party actors, resolves each actor's party-member record and returns the highest level (member+0xD8) among them, or 0 when no member qualifies.

functions.name: Battle_FindUnitWithSpecialBody
functions.signature: u32 Battle_FindUnitWithSpecialBody(u32 unusedA, u32 unusedB, ActorOut* out)
functions.summary: Finds the first active unit whose body id is in the special set {0x13D, 0x13E, 0x13F, 0x289, 0x28A, 0x358, 0x3A5, 0x3B9}, stores it in out->f_20 and returns 1; otherwise 0.

functions.name: Battle_CollectUnitsOfBody178_179
functions.signature: bool Battle_CollectUnitsOfBody178_179(u32 unusedA, u32 unusedB, ActorListOut* out, u32 unusedC)
functions.summary: Collects up to 16 live units with body id 0x178 or 0x179 from the four battle unit lists into out+0x20 and returns whether any were found.

functions.name: Ui_RecipeBook_MatchClauseMode
functions.signature: u32 Ui_RecipeBook_MatchClauseMode(int self, char* clause, int candidateId)
functions.summary: Single-candidate predicate for the recipe-book query: the clause mode byte 0 means 'is the current selection', 1/2/3/8 mean 'must be in the set at self+0x20', 4/5/6/9 mean 'must not be in it', and 7 always matches. Used as the per-candidate test of every filter clause.

functions.name: BattleAi_SelectActionForMode
functions.signature: u32 BattleAi_SelectActionForMode(u32 context, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, void* unit, u32 filter, int mode)
functions.summary: Selects the AI candidate action for the unit's current action record: modes 0..2 dispatch on record kind 4/3/6 to the damage-target picker, FindBestCandidate or the weighted picker; modes 3..8 additionally require the record id 0x1E/0x1F, 0x27/0x28 or 0x23/0x24 before handing the candidate to the picker; returns 0 when nothing matches.

functions.name: Party_FindActorByRecordField
functions.signature: int Party_FindActorByRecordField(u32 arg1, u32 fieldValue, int index)
functions.summary: Walks the actor list at field-party work +0x4260/+0x4264 and returns the index-th active actor (vtable+0x18 and +0x24 both true) whose character record (0x35EB98 on work+0x24A98, actor id from +0x768) has +0xe4 equal to fieldValue. Returns 0 when there is no such actor.

functions.name: BattleAi_FindBestCandidate
functions.summary: Scans the sixteen candidate pointers at self+0x9BD0 and returns the usable one (vtable +0x24 and +0x10 non-zero) with the highest vtable +0x94 score, or null when none qualifies.

functions.name: Party_CountActorsByRecordField
functions.summary: Counts the active actors in the field-party list at +0x4260 whose character record (0x35EB98 on work+0x24A98) has +0xe4 equal to fieldValue; same walk as 0x637DDC without the index argument.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_CheckCandidateMode
functions.signature: u32 Ui_TextLayout_CheckCandidateMode(u32 arg1, TextCandidate* cand, int mode)
functions.summary: Mode predicate for one layout candidate: mode 0 tests vtable+0x18, mode 1 requires vtable+0x14 and then vtable+0x10, every other mode tests vtable+0x14. Returns 1 when the candidate passes, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Battle_CanActorUseAbility
functions.summary: Deep usability check for a battle action: rejects ids whose state bit 0x11 is set, requires the equipment/category test 0x629528 to pass, additionally requires the vtable predicates 0x7E/0x7F for ids 0x99/0x9A and finally requires the per-skill flag at record+0x302 when the skill list is active.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_GetSlotByMode
functions.signature: u32 Ui_TextLayout_GetSlotByMode(UiTextLayout* self, int index, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Returns the index-th slot of the 16-entry slot table (+0x9bd0) that passes 0x638020(self, slot, mode), or 0 when the index is past the last candidate.

functions.name: Battle_GetMaxUnitMetric
functions.signature: float Battle_GetMaxUnitMetric(u32 arg1, int metricKind, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Walks the four battle unit lists (+0x4254/+0x4270/+0x428C/+0x4298, stride 0x1C) and computes three maxima over the active units - a float stat, func_0048F154 and func_0048E2C0 - then returns the one selected by metricKind. Used by the AI to normalise its scores.

functions.name: Battle_IsEquippedGroupTargetWeapon
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the actor's member has a weapon equipped in the requested hand (arg2 0 = main, 1 = off-hand, id via 0x006292F0) whose ItemRecord kind at +0x0C is 0x0F (whip, group-target) or 0x13 (boomerang, all-target), i.e. a weapon that hits several monsters; returns 0 for an empty slot or a single-target weapon.

functions.name: BattleAi_HasCandidateCapacity
functions.signature: u32 BattleAi_HasCandidateCapacity(BattleAiState* self, int required, int mode)
functions.summary: Gate used before appending AI action candidates: when the actor carries neither of the special states 0x73 and 0xCB, mode 0 requires required == 0 and every other mode requires the actor's candidate count (vtable +0x98) to be at least required; returns 1 when the check is skipped or passes.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_GetAltSlotByMode
functions.signature: u32 Ui_TextLayout_GetAltSlotByMode(UiTextLayout* self, int index, u32 mode)
functions.summary: Same selection as 0x6381B8 but over the second slot array (base +0x10, stride given by the global g_006384ec), returning the index-th slot that passes 0x638020.

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_FindTargetMatchingMetric
functions.signature: void* maybe_BattleAi_FindTargetMatchingMetric(void* aiCtx, u32 request, int mode)
functions.summary: Battle-AI target selection: walks the 16 target units at aiCtx+0x9BD0, computes each one's size ratio from its vtable +0x90/+0x94 values, compares it with the metric taken from the record for `request` (three float fields, picked by `mode` and the battle 3D-mode byte +0x4247) and returns the unit that fits best.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_HasValidActions
functions.summary: Returns 1 if any active unit in the unit group has available, non-exhausted combat actions.

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_CheckActionStatGate
functions.signature: u32 maybe_BattleAi_CheckActionStatGate(void* self, void* actor, int actionId)
functions.summary: AI stat gate for one action id: ids 0x1E/0x1F reject equipment of kind 0x14/0x0E and compare the member's attack value against Battle_GetMaxUnitMetric(self,3); ids 0x23/0x24 and 0x27/0x28 compare other actor stats (records f_136/f_138) against metrics 5 and 4; everything else passes.

functions.name: BattleAi_PickCandidateByWeight
functions.summary: Picks candidate index from weighted array using battle RNG roll.

functions.name: Battle_Unit_HasTargetableActions
functions.summary: Returns 1 if any unit in the group has combat actions with targeting type 3.

functions.name: BattleAi_CanActorUseSpellOrSkill
functions.signature: u32 BattleAi_CanActorUseSpellOrSkill(void* actor, int actionKind, int actionId)
functions.summary: Validates if actor can execute the specified spell or skill in the current battle context.

functions.name: BattleAi_IsTargetValidForAction
functions.signature: u32 BattleAi_IsTargetValidForAction(void* target, int actionKind, int actionId)
functions.summary: Checks if target combatant is valid for the given action kind (e.g. alive for attacks, dead for Zing/Kazing).

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_PickRandomSpellTarget
functions.signature: int* maybe_BattleAi_PickRandomSpellTarget(void* aiCtx, int spellId, int* arg3)
functions.summary: Collects at most 16x6 candidate slots (16 unit buckets of 0x9BC bytes, 6 sub-slots) that spellId can hit (vtable+0xF8/+0xFC acceptance plus a per-slot state check through 0x004964C4), then returns one of them chosen with the battle RNG (func_001CA474(rng+0x4218, 0, count-1)); returns 0 when nothing qualifies.

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_PickRandomTargetAboveDamage
functions.signature: void* maybe_BattleAi_PickRandomTargetAboveDamage(void* aiCtx, u32 skillId, void* preferredTarget)
functions.summary: Target picker for the battle AI: walks the 16 target-unit buckets, keeps those that are alive and accept the given skill (vtable +0x18/+0xF8/+0xFC), estimates damage with Battle_ApplyDamageClamp and returns one of the units whose damage exceeds the record threshold at +0x147, chosen with the battle RNG. Falls back to the preferred target.

functions.name: maybe_BattleAi_SelectTargetByFormationFlags
functions.summary: Walks the 16 target units at aiCtx+0x9BD0 and returns the first one that is alive, accepts the action (vtable +0xFC) and whose formation entry (8 x 0x2C table at targetFlags+0x58) carries the ':' marker; the current actor (aiCtx->f_a5c4) is tried first.

functions.name: Text_FindQueuedActorEntry
functions.summary: Walks the intrusive list self+0x730..self+0x72C for an entry whose virtual +0x14 is non-null and whose actor handle (+0x14) equals actorRef->f_14; returns the entry payload at +0xC, or 0.

functions.name: Ui_Element_GetScaledValue
functions.summary: Returns element value (+0xC) scaled by float constant 0x006398E8 if flag 0x0F is reported via vtable+0xE8; returns u32.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayout_IsTypeAccepted
functions.summary: Expands a row/type id into the set it stands for and reports whether the object's vtable+0xe8 accepts any member: 6 -> {6,7}, 2 -> {2,3,0x90}, 4 -> {0xe0,0xe1,4}, 8 -> {8,9}, 10 -> {10,0xB,0xC}, 0x13 -> {0x13,0x110}; every other id is passed straight through.

functions.name: Ui_Element_IsSubStateActive
functions.summary: Checks if element primary state (vtable+0x10) is idle and secondary state (vtable+0x14) is active; returns predicate u32.

functions.name: Field_GetActorAttachment
functions.summary: Returns the actor's attachment sub-object: +0x8dc when the actor accepts type 0x11B and that pointer is set, otherwise +0x8e0, or 0 when neither exists.

functions.name: Ui_Element_HasAnyFlag
functions.summary: Scans flag range 0..0x120 via vtable+0xE8, returning 1 if any flag is set; returns predicate u32.

functions.name: Item_Container_CountCategoryItems
functions.signature: u32 Item_Container_CountCategoryItems(int * self, u32 category, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Counts the number of items in the container belonging to a specified item category.

functions.name: Item_Container_GetItemQuantity
functions.summary: Retrieves the quantity of items stored in a specific inventory container slot.

functions.name: Ui_List_CountMatchingEntries
functions.summary: Walks the intrusive list starting at owner+0x708 until the next pointer equals the sentinel address stored at owner+0x704, invokes vtable slot +0x14 on the object referenced by node+0xc for every node, and returns how many of those predicates returned non-zero.

functions.name: Item_Container_FindItemSlot
functions.summary: Finds the inventory slot index containing a specified item ID, or -1 if not found.

functions.name: Item_Container_CanAddItem
functions.signature: bool Item_Container_CanAddItem(int * self, u32 itemId, u32 count)
functions.summary: Determines whether an inventory container has space to accept additional item quantity.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Record_GetField2CKind13
functions.signature: s32 maybe_Ui_Record_GetField2CKind13(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, int record)
functions.summary: Getter: returns the sign-extended byte at record->f_4->f_2C, but only when record->f_4 exists and its kind byte at +0x29 equals 13; otherwise returns 0.

functions.name: Party_GetMemberDisplayValue
functions.summary: Returns party member display value: default constant 0x0063A154 or table lookup from 0x0063B16C when party size > 1.

functions.name: Ui_Message_SetArgsFromRecordC
functions.summary: Fills message arguments 2 and 5 from the active record, with a simplified path when self->f_c is 0/1/2.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_MessagePage_AddItemNameArgs
functions.summary: Per node kind (+6: 0x0C, 0x0A, ...) formats the node's value into the message buffer at *0x007AC834+0x950, using Message_SetArg/Text_FormatMessageArg.

functions.name: Text_CopyMessageLine
functions.signature: u16* Text_CopyMessageLine(int record, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Copies a UTF-16 message string into the shared 0x100-byte line buffer, skipping line-break characters (10) and choosing between two string fields on the record depending on the current text mode.

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_TestActorRectOverlap
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the widget's screen rectangle overlaps the current actor's projected screen rectangle. The actor (ctx+0x54 -> +0x20) is first rejected unless its actor id (+0xac) matches the widget's +0xac; the UI-mode rect is fetched with func_00386D30, converted with func_0031A658, offset by the actor's screen offsets +0x78/+0x7c, and then tested against widget->f_298 (x at +0xe, width s16 at +0xa, y at +0xc, height at +0x10).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Record_GetField2CKind12
functions.signature: s32 maybe_Ui_Record_GetField2CKind12(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, int record)
functions.summary: Getter: returns the sign-extended byte at record->f_4->f_2C, but only when record->f_4 exists and its kind byte at +0x29 equals 12; otherwise returns 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GetTransitionFlag
functions.summary: Returns the field object's +0x3D byte (Ui_GetCore()->f_10->f_98->f_3D), or 1 when that object does not exist.

functions.name: Party_GetMemberName
functions.signature: int Party_GetMemberName(u32 work, int memberIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the wchar name field (+0xCA) of the party member record for memberIndex, resolved through Party_GetActiveMemberDataByIndex(work, memberIndex). No bounds check; list label code uses the returned pointer directly.

functions.name: Party_GetMemberIdAtIndex
functions.summary: Returns the party member id (entity +0xc8) for the given index, or 0xff when the index is past the active member count.

functions.name: Party_GetActiveMemberCount_2
functions.summary: Returns the number of active party members: fetches the game work and delegates to Party_CountAliveMembers. Byte-identical to 0x0063A8A0, which keeps the return value; here Ghidra dropped it, making the body look void.

functions.name: Ui_ListText_GetTextById
functions.signature: int Ui_ListText_GetTextById(u32 self, int row, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the display text for list row arg2: rows inside the count use icon id 0xCA+row, rows past the end use UI string-table entry 0xF.

functions.name: Party_GetMemberActorDataB
functions.signature: int Party_GetMemberActorDataB(u32 arg1, int memberIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the actor-data pointer (entity+0xCA) for a party member index; a second identical copy of 0x63A7B4 (the compiler emitted both).

functions.name: Party_GetActiveMemberCount
functions.summary: Returns the number of active party members by delegating to the member scanner 0x00643504; used everywhere a list needs to know how many party rows to append.

functions.name: Ui_ListCursor_IsAtOrPastPartyEndRow
functions.summary: True when the cursor index is at or past the active party-member count (count <= cursor), i.e. the cursor has left the real member rows.

functions.name: Ui_ListCursor_GetSelectedMemberId
functions.summary: Returns the party member id under the list cursor (Party_GetMemberIdAtIndex on the +0x410 party sub-object) when the cursor is inside the active member rows, otherwise the sentinel id 0x1F.

functions.name: Ui_ListCursor_IsAtPartyEndRowB
functions.summary: Same predicate as 0x0063B5E4: true when the cursor index equals the active party-member count (first row after the members).

functions.name: Ui_ListCursor_IsOnePastPartyEndRow
functions.summary: True when the cursor index equals active-member-count + 1 (the second row after the party members).

functions.name: Ui_ListText_GetTextForSlot
functions.signature: void Ui_ListText_GetTextForSlot(int self, int slot, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Selects the text for a list slot: direct text for slot<count, otherwise string 0xC/0xD/0xE depending on whether the slot is before, at or after the end of the list.

functions.name: Ui_ListCursor_GetFirstRowAfterParty
functions.summary: Returns the index of the first row after the party rows: the alive party-member count plus 1, or plus 2 when the extra-row flag at +4 is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_QueryTransitionBusyB
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the object's state word at self+0x11C is not -1 and the child screen's +0xC object reports its operation as still running, otherwise 0.

functions.name: Ui_ListText_GetSlotValueType2
functions.summary: Computes slot offset from scroll state and returns paired value byte (+0x51) for entries of type 2, or 0xFF.

functions.name: Ui_ListText_GetSlotValueType1
functions.summary: Computes slot offset from scroll state and returns paired value byte (+0x51) for entries of type 1, or 0xFF.

functions.name: Ui_ListText_GetFirstKnownItemId
functions.summary: Re-confirmed from previous naming pass; function behavior described in readable C supports the name but no new high-confidence evidence.

functions.name: Ui_ListCursor_IsPastPartyEndRows

functions.name: std_StringLessThan

functions.name: maybe_Data_FindRowByPackedKeys

functions.name: Data_LookupSubRecord

functions.summary: The overflow predicate: it returns whether the active member count is greater than the last row index of the current page.

functions.name: Party_GetMemberDataOrMessageRow
functions.summary: The member-data-or-message-row accessor: it returns entity+0xCA for a normal row and a lazily created message object for rows beyond the party count.

functions.name: Party_GetRowCountPlusOne
functions.summary: The row-count-plus-one accessor: it returns the active party member count plus one.

functions.name: Party_GetMemberIdAfterCursor
functions.signature: u8 Party_GetMemberIdAfterCursor(MemberList* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: The member-id-after-cursor accessor: it returns the id at pageCount-1 when valid, 0x1F past the members and 0xFF for an empty page.

functions.name: Field_Actor_ComputeCellTransitionOffset
functions.signature: void Field_Actor_ComputeCellTransitionOffset(int* out_offset, void* actor, u32* subpixel_pos, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Looks up the actor's map cell and, if the cell carries attribute 0xB/0xC/0xD/0xE, returns a unit offset (1, or 2 when the UI mode +0x27F is 1..4) in the matching direction; otherwise returns the default offset.

functions.name: maybe_Field_FindObjectInListA
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Field_FindObjectInListA(FieldList* self, u32* out, int slot, u32 key, u8 mask)
functions.summary: Walks the intrusive list at self+0x18 (sentinel self+0x14) and returns the first entry whose flag byte at +0xF8 intersects mask and whose per-slot key at entry+slot*0xC+0x20 matches key through 0x0062AA7C; on success writes the match into out[1] and the owner bytes self+0x21/self+0x22 into out[1]/out[2].

functions.name: maybe_Field_FindObjectInListB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Field_FindObjectInListB(FieldList* self, u8* out, u32 key, u8 mask)
functions.summary: Variant of 0x00643FE4 over the same intrusive list: matches on the entry's own field at +0x10 instead of a per-slot field, then writes the entry type byte (+0x1C) into out[0] and the owner bytes self+0x21/self+0x22 into out[1]/out[2].

functions.name: Item_CompareNameOrderByKey
functions.signature: bool Item_CompareNameOrderByKey(u32 arg1, const u16* idA, const u16* idB)
functions.summary: Comparator used by the equipment-list sort: resolves both ids through the item-index table (0x63E998, masking bit 0x8000) and compares their catalogue keys through the name reference.

functions.name: maybe_Item_GetNameVariantFlags
functions.summary: Resolves the record selected by item+0x10 (masked with 0x7FFF) in the 0x0063E998 table and classifies it against the work bitmask at +0x2A2C8: 2 when the record's fourth u16 id is set, 1 when any of the first three ids is set, else 0.

functions.name: maybe_Item_GetVariantName
functions.summary: Formats the item referenced by func_0063E998(id & 0x7FFF) into a message-argument buffer, or returns an empty string when the record is missing.

functions.name: Ui_ListWindow_CompareItemRank
functions.signature: void Ui_ListWindow_CompareItemRank(u32 context, u16 * itemA, u16 * itemB)
functions.summary: Comparator function sorting item row entries by item rank and display order.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_GetSelectedItemId
functions.summary: Returns the item id stored in the highlighted cell of a list widget (rows of six columns, 0x118-byte entries, value in the low half-word at +0x50).

functions.name: Ui_Message_SetItemNameArg
functions.signature: void Ui_Message_SetItemNameArg(u32 context, u32 itemId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Sets the item name text argument for embedded string substitution in UI messages.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_GetSpriteSubOffset
functions.signature: int maybe_Ui_Part_GetSpriteSubOffset(int self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Resolves the 10-byte sub-entry for the part's current id: it looks the id up with func_0063E998(dm, self->f_1C->f_59E), takes the index at record+0x21, rejects indices >= 0x1E and returns the relative pointer table->f_58->f_24 + index*10 (0 when out of range).

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_CountRequiredMaterials
functions.summary: Counts and validates the required crafting materials for a Fun-Size Forge recipe.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_GetRecipeAttrBitmask
functions.summary: Reads the forge recipe record's sub-table via DataManager table 0x3F4 and returns a bitmask composed of (1 << entry_attr_byte) for each entry.

functions.name: maybe_Item_GetStoragePointerWithInit
functions.summary: Resolves an item's storage pointer, first lazily creating the global 0x2FB28-byte UI window that owns the storage (31 slot records of 0x12EC bytes, vtable 0x764B84) when the 'already created' flag says it does not exist yet.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Talk_CheckLineLength
functions.summary: Reads the dialogue/talk layout record for the given id, takes its signed length byte at +8, scales it by the talk context's factor (float at layout+0x3E8 * 0.01, skipped when it is 1.0) and returns whether the result is <= the layout's limit at +0xA8.

functions.name: Ui_Talk_LoadDialogueLayout
functions.summary: Loads dialogue layout resource 'talk_3d_up.bflyt' or 'talk_2d_up.bflyt' depending on screen mode.

functions.name: Senreki_InvokeEvaluatorById
functions.signature: u32 Senreki_InvokeEvaluatorById(UiDispatchOwner* owner, u32 arg2, u8* idPtr)
functions.summary: Dispatches an achievement/senreki record evaluator callback by ID from table 0x00645368 (containing Save_Senreki_CountCompletedFlagsA through E) and executes it against the provided context.

functions.name: Ui_Status_GetTotalStat
functions.summary: Returns the status byte / bit mask / list slot count / etc. Confirmed by named callers and consistent naming pattern.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourcePool_PurgeUnreferenced
functions.signature: void Gfx_ResourcePool_PurgeUnreferenced(void* poolHandle, u8* keepIndices, int keepCount)
functions.summary: Iterates resource pool slots 0..15, purging any active slot whose index is not present in the keep list via Gfx_ResourcePool_Purge.

functions.name: Ui_LoadingScreen_IsActive
functions.summary: Returns true if the game loading screen is currently active and processing asset loads.

functions.name: Ui_LoadingScreen_IsFinished
functions.summary: Returns 0 when the loading screen layout 'common_3d_up_load.bflyt' is active and loading queue is non-empty, and 1 when loading has completed.

functions.name: Ui_Message_IsSpeakerPlayer
functions.signature: char Ui_Message_IsSpeakerPlayer(u32 context, u32 speakerId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 1 if the dialogue speaker corresponds to the main player character.

functions.name: Ui_Message_IsSpeakerNpc
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Message_IsSpeakerNpc(u32 context, u32 speakerId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns 1 if the dialogue speaker corresponds to a generic field NPC.

functions.name: Ui_Message_GetSpeakerVoiceId
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Message_GetSpeakerVoiceId(u32 context, u32 speakerId, int voiceType, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the dialogue voice clip sound ID assigned to a dialogue speaker.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Message_GetSpeakerWindowPlacement
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Ui_Message_GetSpeakerWindowPlacement(u32 context, u32 speakerId, u32 arg3, u32* arg4)
functions.summary: Returns one bit of the dialogue speaker's record: it resolves the speaker row with func_0063D85C(dm, speakerId) and returns (record->f_16 & 0x7F) >> 6, i.e. bit 6 of the byte at +0x16, or 0 when the row is missing.

functions.name: Ui_Message_GetSpeakerPortraitPosition
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Message_GetSpeakerPortraitPosition(u32 context, u32 speakerId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the face portrait alignment position (left, right, center) for a dialogue speaker.

functions.name: Ui_IsWindowReady
functions.summary: Returns true when no message window is open, or when the open window has both readiness bytes f_3D and f_3E set; false while a window is still opening.

functions.name: Ui_PopupEntry_HasDifferingValues
functions.summary: Compares the self->f_480 sub-entries by calling vtable slot +0xD4 on each and returns 1 as soon as two report different values (the first -1 value aborts the comparison).

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_GetRandomPartOffset
functions.signature: void Field_Gimmick_GetRandomPartOffset(float* out, int part, float spread)
functions.summary: Fills a part offset: x = -4 + spread * part->f_238, y = 0, z = random in [-1.5, 1.5) from the game RNG.

functions.name: Ui_Part_HasNameAct00
functions.summary: Compares the UI part's animation/group name (resolved via 0x0063C774) with the string literal 'Act_00' at 0x0078498C; returns true if they match.

functions.name: Ui_Window_HasActiveParts
functions.summary: Returns 1 while any of the window's three part slots (+0x134, stride 0x50) or any of the six attached timers at +0x11C is still running; Ui_GuideWindow_UpdateState uses it as the 'still animating, do not close' guard.

functions.name: Ui_Part_FindAnimRecord
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Part_FindAnimRecord(UiPart* self, u32 animId, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Searches the part's 0x1c-byte animation records for the one whose u16 id at +8 equals animId, and when that record is active also requires the member's action state to differ (0x00629348).

functions.name: Ui_Part_IsRecordSuppressedForMember
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Part_IsRecordSuppressedForMember(const u8* partMemberCtx, const void* animRecord)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when animRecord requires a member state check (record->u8_10 != 0) and party member *partMemberCtx does NOT currently have state ID record->u16_8 in their active status slots (member+0x19E..+0x1BD); returns 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Ui_Part_CheckAnimConditions
functions.summary: Counts how many of the six animation/entry conditions referenced by table 0x00729EA8 are satisfied for this part and record (member skill ownership through 0x00629988, the part's 60-id list at +0xA0, and the record's status check), returning 1 when at least four pass.

functions.name: Ui_BagCategory_CountItems
functions.summary: Counts the entries of a bag category (stride-0x1c entry array) that pass the visibility filter and the category/flag test; drives the 'x items' counters of the bag's category rows.

functions.name: Ui_Plate_GetCharacterFaceId
functions.summary: Retrieves character face icon ID from plate widget descriptor for UI nameplate rendering.

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_SetVertexColor
functions.signature: void Ui_Sprite_SetVertexColor(SpritePart* part, UiSprite* sprite, u32 slot, u32 alpha)
functions.summary: Sets one color for all four vertices of a sprite quad via nw::lyt::Picture::SetVtxColor (vtable+0x10), looking up the color by slot with 0x0064609C and applying 0xFF000000 alpha mask.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_SetFrameUVFromRecord
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_SetFrameUVFromRecord(SpriteAtlas* self, GfxSprite* sprite, u32 frameId)
functions.summary: Sets a sprite's texture UV rectangle from an atlas/icon record looked up by frame id; hides the sprite when the record is missing.

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_SetFrameUVFromPackedRecord
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_SetFrameUVFromPackedRecord(SpriteAtlas* self, GfxSprite* sprite, u32 frameId)
functions.summary: Same as 0x6464D4 but for atlas records whose four UV coordinates are stored as consecutive u16 fields at +0..+6.

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_SetVertexColorFromState
functions.signature: void Ui_Sprite_SetVertexColorFromState(Plate* plate, UiSprite* sprite, u32 slot, u32 alpha)
functions.summary: Sets sprite quad vertex colors based on the plate's animation state from 0x00647A24, choosing between state color and cached color at plate+0x9C.

functions.name: Ui_Entry_GetDisplayText
functions.summary: Resolves the display string for a UI entry id: plain item/skill entries go through the message table, monster entries set message argument 5 and return their inline name, unknown ids return the 'no data' string.

functions.name: Ui_Part_GetAnimSlotMask
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Part_GetAnimSlotMask(Ui_Part* self, AnimRecord* record, int includeState3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Builds a 6-bit mask of the animation slots the current record can use: for each of the record's six slot indices present in the part's own record array it asks Ui_Part_GetAnimState and sets the bit for states 2/5 (and 3 when includeState3 is set).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BagCategory_FilterAvailable
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_BagCategory_FilterAvailable(u32* out, BagListOwner* owner, int category)
functions.summary: Keeps only those of the seven category bytes that have a matching entry in the owner, packing the survivors into the 7-byte result list: it fills a 7-byte list through 0x00646C4C, pre-fills the output with 0xFF and copies each byte whose membership test 0x003AA574 succeeds.

functions.name: Ui_Part_BuildAnimSlotList
functions.signature: void Ui_Part_BuildAnimSlotList(u8* out, Ui_PartList* list, u32 groupId)
functions.summary: Fills a 7-entry list with the slot ids (+0x19) of the part-list records that belong to the requested group and whose 0x1c record is used by at least one list entry.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Part_GetRemainingAnimTime
functions.summary: Returns the remaining animation time of a party member part: takes the total duration (0x00629280) and subtracts the per-entry durations (u8 at record+6) of up to 60 u16 record ids at self+0xA0 resolved through 0x0063CF74, stopping at 0xFFFF.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Plate_FormatPlayerTitle
functions.summary: Formats the player nameplate title and honorific prefix strings for the nameplate display, resolving the plate's record through the game data manager.

functions.name: Ui_SkillPanel_SumPanelCost
functions.signature: int Ui_SkillPanel_SumPanelCost(int panelState, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Calculates the total skill point cost for all active/selected nodes in a Character Skill Panel.

functions.name: Ui_Sprite_SetVertexColorUniform
functions.summary: Writes the cached uniform color at plate+0x98 to all four vertices of the sprite quad via nw::lyt::Picture::SetVtxColor (vtable+0x10).

functions.name: Gfx_Sprite_SetFrameUVFromBank
functions.signature: void Gfx_Sprite_SetFrameUVFromBank(SpriteAtlas* self, GfxSprite* sprite, int frameIndex, int arg4)
functions.summary: Applies a texture and UV rectangle to a sprite from a texture bank indexed by frame number, hiding the sprite when the index is outside the bank.

functions.name: Ui_Part_MatchAnimRecord
functions.summary: Tests whether an animation record applies to this part: it walks the global 0x20-byte record table, matches the part slot id and the four condition lists (byte, byte, u16 and u16-list) and finally checks the record's two trailing condition ids against the current work flags.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Plate_FormatFullDescriptor
functions.summary: Formats a full UTF-16 item/spell detail string: resolves the record through Ui_Message_GetItemDescription or Ui_Message_GetSpellDescription and copies it into the caller's buffer.

functions.name: Ui_Part_GetAnimState
functions.signature: bool Ui_Part_GetAnimState(Ui_Part* self, AnimRecord* record, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Classifies how one animation record relates to this UI part and returns a state 0-5 (5 = record has no id, 4 = record forces a slot, 2 = already playing, 3 = the slot id is in the part's own slot list, else 0/1 from the condition check).

functions.name: Party_Member_CountMatchingSkills
functions.summary: Counts how many of the six skill ids stored at record+0x54..+0x59 the given party member has learned: for each of the six it walks the member's learned skills (Party_CountLearnedSkills / 0x006298D0) and tests them with SkillPanel_CanUnlockSkill, then returns the number of hits.

functions.name: maybe_Object_IsNestedCounterBehind
functions.summary: Counter comparison through a pointer chain: takes the object at obj+0x160, then the holder at sub+0x568, and returns 1 when holder+0x34 <= sub+0x56C. Nothing here touches a model handle, so the previous 'HasModel' name was wrong.

functions.name: maybe_DataTable_IsIndexValidB
functions.summary: Table accessor: when the style byte at plate[0] is below 0x1F it fetches the table header with 0x0063F93C and returns 0 if the sub-index at plate+0x10 is beyond the header's limit at +8; otherwise 1.

functions.name: maybe_DataTable_GetEntryB
functions.summary: Table accessor: resolves the header with 0x0063F93C, follows the +0xC relative pointer of the header and returns the 5-byte entry selected by the sub-index at plate+0x10.

functions.name: maybe_DataTable_IsIndexValidA
functions.summary: Table accessor: when the style byte at plate[0] is below 0x1F it fetches the header with 0x0063F93C and returns 0 if the sub-index at plate+0x10 is beyond the header's first limit word; otherwise 1.

functions.name: maybe_DataTable_GetEntryA
functions.summary: Table accessor: resolves the header with 0x0063F93C, follows its +4 relative pointer and returns the 5-byte entry selected by the sub-index at plate+0x10.

functions.name: Ui_PokerCard_SetSpriteFrame
functions.signature: void Ui_PokerCard_SetSpriteFrame(PokerCardSprites* self, UiPart* part, u32 suitAndRank)
functions.summary: Binds the sprite frame of a poker card: indexes the 4-suit x 14-rank sprite table, copies the sprite rectangle into the card part's effect frame and sets bit 0 of the part's +0x44 flags (cleared when the suit/rank is out of range).

functions.name: Item_ConsumeForCraft
functions.summary: The material-consumption routine: it decrements the ten-slot working table for each referenced item and fails on underflow.

functions.name: Ui_Window_FindPageByEntryId
functions.signature: void Ui_Window_FindPageByEntryId(int table, u32 entry_id, int* out_page, int* out_index)
functions.summary: Searches a window's page table for a 16-bit entry id: for every page (stride 0x8C, count at table+0x1CFC) and every slot pointer it walks the variable-length u16 array (count at [0], own offset at [4]) and writes the page/slot pair of the first array that contains the id, or (-1, -1) when the id is 0xFFFF or absent.

functions.name: Ui_ListWidget_GetCursorValue
functions.summary: Returns the 16-bit ID of the element under the active cursor in the list widget, or 0xFFFF if the cursor is out of range or the entry is disabled.

functions.name: maybe_Data_AnyRowReferencesId
functions.summary: Tests whether any u16 id in a record's list is live: the list is read at record + recordIndex*4 + 8, and it returns 1 as soon as the per-id flag word in the work table at +0x3AE4 is non-zero, or when one of the data-manager rows has that id in f_24/f_26/f_28 while the same flag is set.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_EquipSlot_FindNextForItem
functions.summary: Given the row's item id (+0x4A), advances the row's slot index (0..10) to the next equipment slot that accepts the item by walking the 0x1C-byte slot table at 0x0072960C and calling its per-slot predicate, stopping when the index wraps.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Text_Preload
functions.summary: Ensures the shared 0x98-byte UI text object exists and asks its text table (0x00633560(core->f_10, textId)) to resolve/preload the given text id. The lookup result is discarded, which is what a preload would do.

functions.name: Party_GetRowCountPlusOne_2
functions.summary: Returns the alive party-member count plus 1, i.e. the index of the first row after the party rows.

functions.name: Ui_ListCursor_GetClampedRow
functions.summary: Returns the party-relative row selected by the list cursor, or 0x1f when the cursor is outside the active party rows. Used by the strength/status window.

functions.name: Ui_ListCursor_IsPastPartyRows
functions.summary: True when the cursor index is at or past the active party-member count (count <= cursor); Ui_TsuyosaWindow_OnInput uses it to stop scrolling onto the trailing extra rows.

functions.name: Field_Actor_HasTileFlag7
functions.summary: Returns whether the actor's work type (+0x170) is in 0x18D..0x195, otherwise whether the map cell under the attached object has tile attribute 7 (func_0062C23C).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Plate_GetRecordAttr
functions.summary: Queries record table 0x0063D270 using the plate's index (plate->f_49) after validating handle f_2C with 0x0022C148, returning the attribute byte record->f_17 (or 0 when invalid).

functions.name: Ui_Overlay_CheckRowMarker
functions.summary: Decides whether a row's overlay marker is drawn: in overlay mode 0 it reads the row record's flag byte +0x17 and, when the attached actor is not already flagged, projects the actor's position with Camera_SetupProjection; returns the flag when the actor is on screen, otherwise 0.

functions.name: Field_Actor_HasTileFlag5
functions.summary: Same as Field_Actor_HasTileFlag7 with work type range 0x277..0x27F and tile attribute 5.

functions.name: Field_Actor_HasTileFlag6
functions.summary: Same as Field_Actor_HasTileFlag7 with work type range 0x14E..0x156 and tile attribute 6.

functions.name: maybe_Data_LookupIndexById
functions.summary: Lazily builds the 0x10-byte-entry record table (class word g_00649110) and returns the byte at +0x10 of the record found by 0x0063E3C8 for the requested id, or 0xFF when unknown.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_TestPlacementFree
functions.summary: Resolves the per-record handler through maybe_Ui_GetDefaultValue(record[4]), calls it with (record[0], record[1], record+2, point) and returns the inverted result, so 1 means 'cell is free / acceptable'.

functions.name: maybe_Item_CountMatchingFilter
functions.summary: Counts how many item ids in the half-open range [self+4, self+8) pass the category filter stored at self+0x14, by calling the named Item_MatchesCategoryFilter for each 4-byte element; returns 0 when either end of the range is null.

functions.name: Item_MatchesCategoryFilter
functions.signature: u32 Item_MatchesCategoryFilter(u8* filter, const u16* itemId)
functions.summary: Category-filter predicate for an item list: switches on filter[0] and tests the item's kind byte (+0xC) and equip subclass helpers (func_0066C184/0066C5A8/0066C5CC/0066C950/0066C978/0066CCEC), returning 1 when the item belongs to the selected filter.

functions.name: maybe_PartyMember_GetSpellRecordFlag
functions.summary: Reads bit 0 of the u16 flag word at +0x208 of the record pointed to by self+0x1260, but only when the object returned by virtual slot +0x64 has a zero byte at +0x10; otherwise returns 0. The +0x208 offset matches the documented SpellRecord flag word, but the +0x1260 pointer is only inferred.

functions.name: Ui_Casino_LoadCoinGetLayout
functions.summary: Loads layout resources 'menu_casino_coinget_3d.bflyt', 'dive_dngn_btlhud_3d_up.bflyt', or 'dive_dngn_btlmsg_3d_up.bflyt'.

functions.name: Field_Condition_HasActiveRef
functions.summary: Scans entries in the condition block at self (count at +0x128), and for any entry whose mask at +0x2C intersects mask, resolves the handle at +0x28 through handle table 0x007B2D60 and returns 1 if its vtable+0xC check succeeds.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GetScaledTime
functions.summary: Only a float conversion survives from this 1272-byte span: it calls 0x0065D3B8 for a tick value and converts it with VectorUnsignedToFloat using the FPSCR rounding bits. The symbol is a merged blob of many small accessors (0x00649BFC, 0x00649C1C, 0x00649C34, ...), so the name describes at most the first fragment.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_IsPartsIdleB
functions.summary: Same idle idiom as 0x00628AF0 (part list ready, then the span group idle) for the scene-object classes whose span lives at +0x2AC instead of +0x388.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Slot_GetPayoutMultiplier
functions.summary: Getter that looks up the slot game's record id (slotGame+4) in DataManager table 0x75C through 0x0063F2F0 and returns the signed byte at record+10.

functions.name: maybe_Game_LookupDataRowById
functions.summary: Id-to-row lookup: returns 0 when the id at owner+4 is -1, otherwise fetches the game data manager and resolves that id through 0x0063f2f0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Window_GetLabelText
functions.summary: Resolves a window label string: when the f_1C/f_1D/f_1E flags are clear it returns the inline text at self+0x22 for record id -1, otherwise looks up the record via the data manager and returns its relative string, or the inline buffer at self+0xC when the record carries the inline flag at +0xA; 0 when nothing applies.

functions.name: maybe_Item_GetGroupTag
functions.signature: void maybe_Item_GetGroupTag(u32* out, u32 not, u16 itemId)
functions.summary: Writes one of two static u32 item tags into *out: it treats the item as grouped when its record is missing or Item_IsSiblingRecord says the next id belongs to the same group, and then checks func_00381938(itemId) (0xFFFF = no mapping) to choose between the two tags.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_CanUnitAct
functions.summary: Action-eligibility gate: resolves the two ids at self->f_10+0x2C and self->f_10+0x28 through 0x0022C148 / 0x0022F59C, reads the resulting unit's state byte (0x00669250, 0xFF when absent) and allows the action only for states 1/2, or 3/0x17 when the first id is empty.

functions.name: Ui_Talk_CanDropPendingEntry
functions.summary: The pending-talk-entry drop gate: it verifies the display-mode mask, both talk sub-objects and a non-empty queue before the caller destroys an entry.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Slot_InitReelStrip
functions.summary: Constructs a 27-element array of 4-byte elements (element constructor 0x005F9720) in the caller's stack frame. The only caller is Casino_Slot_BuildSpinResult, which consumes it as one reel strip; the initialiser itself touches no symbol table.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_PickLosingStop
functions.signature: int Casino_Slot_PickLosingStop(u32* reel_data, u32* chosen_stops, int reel)
functions.summary: Slot machine: collects the stops (0..23) of reel `reel` whose three visible symbols differ from the previous reel's symbols in each row (symbol 6 = wild handled specially), and picks one at random, so no line continues.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_BuildLosingSpin
functions.summary: Builds a full losing spin: random stop for reel 0, then for reels 1-4 a stop from maybe_Casino_Slot_PickDifferingStop so no row matches the previous reel.

functions.name: maybe_Casino_Slot_InitPaytable
functions.summary: Zeroes a five-byte header with two 0xFF sentinels and constructs three 4-byte elements (constructor 0x005F9720) in the caller's stack frame; the payout arithmetic is not in this function.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_PickMatchingStop
functions.signature: int Casino_Slot_PickMatchingStop(u32 reel_data, int stops_base, int reel, int row)
functions.summary: Picks a random stop for reel `reel` whose symbol in row `row` (0-2) continues the line from the previous reel (row-specific comparators 0x005E6020/0x005E5FF8/0x005E5FD0); 0 if none.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_PickDifferingStop
functions.signature: int Casino_Slot_PickDifferingStop(u32 reel_data, int stops_base, int reel, u32 carry)
functions.summary: Picks a random stop for reel `reel` whose three symbols are not wild (6) and differ row-by-row from the previous reel; 0 if none.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_BuildSpinResult
