functions.signature: void Casino_Slot_BuildSpinResult(u32* out_spin, int* reel_data, u8* decision)
functions.summary: Produces the reel stops for one spin: on a forced win it rolls a shift and asks 0x64BFC8 for five stops containing symbol 5, otherwise it rolls the 0..99 probability at reel_data[1]+0x16/0x17 and either builds the payout tables or falls through to the losing-spin builder; the 12-byte result goes to 0x672318.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_NudgeSymbolToAvoidWin
functions.signature: void Casino_Slot_NudgeSymbolToAvoidWin(u32* out_spin, u32 reel_data, u32* stops)
functions.summary: For every reel whose visible symbols contain no wild, tries alternative stops and keeps those for which the win check (func_0064AA5C) fails, then applies one, turning a would-be win into a loss.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol
functions.signature: u32 Casino_Slot_PickStopBySymbol(int* reelData, int reel, u32 symbol, int shiftMode, int matchEqual)
functions.summary: Collects the 24 stops of reel column 'reel' whose symbol equals 'symbol' (or differs from it when matchEqual is 0, skipping symbol 6), shuffles that candidate list with the slot-machine shuffle state and returns the chosen stop index, optionally rotated by one/two stops for shiftMode 1/2.

functions.name: Menu_Slot_GetOccupancyState
functions.summary: Returns the occupancy state of a menu slot: 0 if disabled (byte at +0x68 non-zero), 1 if empty (item pointer at +0x38 is null or item ID at +0xC is zero), 2 if occupied with a valid item.

functions.name: Ui_Equip_GetEquippedItemId
functions.signature: u32 Ui_Equip_GetEquippedItemId(UiBagList* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the item id currently equipped in one equipment slot of a member (func_006292F0), or the default constant g_0064C464 when the member id or the column (< 6) is invalid.

functions.name: Field_Actor_CheckRecordRectOverlap
functions.signature: u32 Field_Actor_CheckRecordRectOverlap(int self, int recordId, u32* rect)
functions.summary: Rect-overlap test against a scene record: resolves the record for self+0x5C through the scene sprite context, requires its first word to equal recordId, and tests the record's four u16 rect fields against the caller's rectangle, returning 1 on overlap.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_AdjustRectForScreen
functions.signature: void Field_Object2D_AdjustRectForScreen(int* outPoint, int obj2D, u16* srcRect)
functions.summary: Adjusts a 2D field object's bounding rectangle coordinates based on active screen orientation (orientation modes 0, 2, 6 via func_002D1814), mirroring coordinates around screen dimensions f_218 and f_21C.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_IsHandleStale
functions.summary: 2D field-object vtable slot 11: same generation check as 0x0064362C on the handle at +0x2E0 - 0 while the target is live (state < 4), 1 when it is missing or dying.

functions.name: Field_AnimObject_IsHandleStale
functions.summary: Anim-object vtable slot 11: identical generation check on the handle at +0x2CC - 0 while the referenced object is live (byte +0x78 < 4), 1 when the handle is absent/stale.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BagList_GetRowState
functions.summary: Maps the per-id state byte at work+0x2A4E6 + row->f_298 to a list-row state: 0 for values 1 and 4, otherwise 3. 0x2A4E6 is the quest-state array base (bag+0x5A4E, 0x138 entries), so the row id has to stay below 312.

functions.name: maybe_Field_GetSceneState
functions.summary: Returns 3 when the scene probe 0x006281C8 reports a live scene, otherwise 0. Almost the whole 0xBC-byte span is lost in the decompilation, so this is only the surviving tail.

functions.name: Item_ValidateAndCompactStorage
functions.summary: Rebuilds the item storage at work+0x24A98: builds the section list and then validates/compacts every stored slot.

functions.name: Save_ApplyRecordToWork
functions.signature: void Save_ApplyRecordToWork(WorkRecord* rec, u32 mode, int* table)
functions.summary: Applies one saved record to the game work (storage at work+0x24A98): copies the record through the func_0063F648 table and rebuilds the item/party sub-sections, destroying the old item-bag entries first.

functions.name: Save_LookupPackNameRecord
functions.signature: void Save_LookupPackNameRecord(int saveWork, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Looks up save parameter archive pack name metadata from the data manager using save work field +0x1C.

functions.name: Save_LoadWorkData
functions.summary: Applies a stored save record to the live game: validates and compacts the item storage, applies the record with Save_ApplyRecordToWork, replays the pending EXP delta through Party_Member_AddExp, resets the member HP/state, re-applies the five saved equipment ids (<100) with 0x0035EBB0 and then rebuilds the trailing u16 id list.

functions.name: Field_ActorAction_IsStickAligned
functions.summary: In 3D mode only, reads the analog stick direction, normalises it and returns 0 when the absolute dot product with the action's direction is below 0.2 (i.e. the stick no longer points along the action); otherwise returns 1.

functions.name: Casino_Poker_RollHandRankChance
functions.signature: u32 Casino_Poker_RollHandRankChance(int self, u32 rank, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Poker probability gate: for hand rank 1..9 rolls 1..100 on the game RNG (work+8 +0x98) and returns 1 when the roll is at most the rank's percentage (u16 at +8 of the 12-byte rank table at self+4).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_CountSelectableRows
functions.summary: Counts the ids in the list [self+0xB0, self+0xB4) whose 90-bit save flag (0x0066B534, mask at bag+0x89A8) is clear and whose per-id byte at bag+0x3165 is below 10.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_GetCellIndex
functions.summary: Converts the smith menu's row counter into the flat cell index of its five-column list, wrapping with &0xff.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_GetRowState
functions.summary: Row-state accessor: for mode byte +0x50 == 2 it returns the item object's byte at +0x50, for mode 3 the word at item+0x64, and 5 for any other mode; returns 0 when the item pointer at +0x54 is null.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_GetCellValue
functions.summary: Reads one byte of the smith-menu table for a row: resolves the item through 0x003813B0, computes the flat cell index as (row->u16_at_0xC + self->f_13*5 - self->vtbl[+0x68]()) and returns the byte at +0x40 for mode 2 or +0x54 for mode 3.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_IsRecipeRow
functions.summary: Row predicate: false when the sub-object at +0x14 reports state 1, the index at +0xC0 is valid and the 8-byte record it selects has an id other than the 0x306 sentinel; otherwise true only when the row's own virtual +0x54 reports ready.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_AllSlotsIdle
functions.summary: Checks the two slot windows at +0x278/+0x280: every slot must report idle through virtual +0x1C, the row's handle at +0x284 must still be registered in the global handle table, and the row itself must report ready through virtual +0x54.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_SmithMenu_IsMaterialValid
functions.summary: Same validity predicate as 0x0064D824 but applied to the sub-object at row+0x274: returns 0 when that sub-object reports state 1, its index at +0xAC is valid and the 8-byte record it selects has an id other than the 0x306 sentinel; returns 1 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_UnitModel_AreSubSlotsIdle
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the busy byte at +0xB0 is clear and all four sub-object pointers at +0x118..+0x124 are either null or report idle through virtual +0x7C; returns 0 as soon as one of them is busy.

functions.name: Actor_CheckVisibleFlags
functions.signature: int Actor_CheckVisibleFlags(Actor* actor, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Decides whether an actor may currently be shown/handled: asks the actor's sub-object (vtable +0x48 then +0x18), otherwise combines the actor flags at +0x4E1 and +0x1385, and when Work byte 0x27C57 is set additionally requires the actor id to pass the lookups 0x00669DD4/0x00669E24.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_IsRefRegistered
functions.summary: Scene-node vtable slot 11: returns 1 when the field subsystem (work+0x64) can resolve the node's field id at +0x297 through func_00649994, i.e. when the node's map/model reference is still registered.

functions.name: maybe_Actor_IsHandleAliveD
functions.summary: Fourth copy of the actor slot test: true when the owner at +0x34 is null (or its +0x94 reference is null, or the pointer at owner+0x1E18+0x28 is null), the reference at actor+4 is null and bit 0 of the word at actor+8 is clear.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_BagList_SetLabel
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_BagList_SetLabel(UiBagList* self, int row, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Labels one list row: when the row is below the active party-member count it takes the member's name through Party_GetMemberActorDataB, otherwise it emits the fixed label id 0xD (tool bag) or 0xE (equipment bag) chosen by the object's +5 flag.

functions.name: Ui_List_GetRowCount
functions.summary: Returns the number of rows a party list needs: the alive party-member count plus one when the extra-row flag at +4 is set.

functions.name: Ui_EquipmentList_GetClampedRow
functions.summary: Equipment-window twin of 0x648BFC: returns the selected party row, or 0x1f when the cursor points past the active party.

functions.name: Ui_List_IsCursorAtPartyEndRow
functions.summary: True when the list cursor index equals the number of alive party members, i.e. the cursor sits on the first row after the party rows. A duplicate of the Ui_ListCursor_IsAtPartyEndRow family at 0x0063B5E4.

functions.name: Ui_Window_IsTimerRunning
functions.summary: Checks whether a UI countdown timer or animating subpart is active: tests the timer countdown floats at +0x1680 and +0x1684, returning 1 if either is non-zero, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Actor_SkullRun_ComputeScreenVector
functions.summary: Computes camera-relative normalized 3D movement vector for the SkullRun actor action from analog stick input and camera orientation.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_List_GetScrollRowIndex
functions.summary: Turns the list's scroll state into an absolute row index: computes (u16 at row+0xC + f_13*5 - vtbl[+0x68]()), resolves it through 0x00650860 and 0x00648348, and returns 0xFFFFFFFF when the row array at +0x54 is null.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_GetGameModeAsFloat
functions.summary: Returns the game mode (func_0062AB3C on work+8) converted to float. The conversion is lost in the decode; only the declared float return type shows it.

functions.name: Model_Attach_CreateWeaponAttachment
functions.signature: int Model_Attach_CreateWeaponAttachment(void* arg1, const unsigned short* params)
functions.summary: Builds a 0x228-byte model-attachment object from a large default parameter block, gives it a unique id from a module counter, links it into the player actor's attachment chain (ctx->f_54->f_1C, list at +0x17C) and, if a matching attachment already exists in the class registry (class g_0064EC60), forwards the weapon and accessory ids to Model_AttachWeaponAndAccessory.

functions.name: maybe_Field_IsPlayerStateAllowed
functions.summary: Returns 1 when func_006281C8 allows it, the camera-target actor exists and is not busy (+0x312), and its state (func_00669250) is above 27 or allowed by the 28-byte table at 0x007272B8.

functions.name: Battle_Encounter_BuildConditions
functions.summary: Builds the battle-start condition flags for one field encounter: classifies the base enemy as weak/equal/strong against the hero's level and records touch-back side, group size, party size and the special 'reincarnation'/'LL enemy'/'first attack' conditions.

functions.name: maybe_Model_GetActorDisplayRecord
functions.signature: void maybe_Model_GetActorDisplayRecord(int self, unsigned short* out)
functions.summary: Resolves the player actor's display model id (work+8->+0x54->+0x1C, taking f_170, else f_428, else 1), looks its record up with 0x0063EF40 and writes the record's u16 and its byte +2 into the caller's struct; the default id is 0x534.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_QueryStatusPair
functions.signature: void maybe_Battle_Unit_QueryStatusPair(Actor* self, BattleUnit* unit, u8* outFlagA, u8* outFlagB)
functions.summary: Fills two status flags for a battle unit: writes (0, 0) while any entry of the unit list at +0x4C has a live byte at +0x54, while the actor virtual +0x50 is busy, or while the resolved enemy actor has no state byte; otherwise maps monster state 6 to (1, 0) and 7 to (0, 1).

functions.name: Ui_Text_LayoutIntoRecord
functions.signature: void Ui_Text_LayoutIntoRecord(TextOwner* owner, const char* text, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Looks up the layout/font handle stored on the owner (+0x34) and lays the given string into the game's shared text-layout object (ctx->f_4C) using Text_LayoutIntoRecord.

functions.name: Battle_UpdateEnemySleepMask
functions.summary: Recomputes the per-slot 'sleeping/disabled enemy' bitmask: for every enemy group entry it looks up the enemy parameter record and tests the 'sleep_enemy_check' flag of EnemyBaseParam, setting the corresponding bits in the slot bytes at group+0x54; slot 0 additionally mirrors the entry's own sleep flags.

functions.name: Actor_ComputePlayerSide
functions.signature: void Actor_ComputePlayerSide(ActorHandle* handle, unsigned char* out)
functions.summary: Uses the actor's forward vector and the player's position to decide on which side the player stands: writes 1 or 2 into out[1] (0 when the actor cannot be resolved), using the acos of the clamped dot product against the module threshold.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Unit_ResolveLinkedValue
functions.summary: For handles whose object side byte (+0x26A) is 1 or 2, resolves the linked record through the table at work+8->+0x4C (indexed by f_26C and f_2B4) and copies its +0x78 word into unit->f_6C.

functions.name: maybe_Field_FindFreePlacementPoint3D
functions.summary: Tries up to eight directions around the camera target/player position with sine/cosine sweep to find a collision-free placement point.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IsRefStaleA
functions.summary: Packed-handle liveness test (variant A): returns 0 only when the handle at +0x2F8 resolves through the global handle table to an object whose state byte +0x78 is below 4, and 1 otherwise; also gated by the enable byte +0x2F1 (returns 1 when it is clear).

functions.name: Ui_Menu_GetSubStateFlag
functions.summary: Returns the byte at game-work +0x2FB00; the long prologue is only the inlined game-work accessor, so this is a plain menu state-flag getter.

functions.name: Monster_Action_Dulneigh_IsReady
functions.summary: Returns whether the action may advance: the wrapped actor motion (0x669DD4 on self+0x28) must be finished, except that action id 0x1b is always reported ready.

functions.name: Party_GetSlotCountPlusPending
functions.summary: Returns the number of occupied item slots (0..24) of the member whose id is at ctx+4, adding one when the pending-item flag at ctx+5 is set; 0 when ctx+4 is 0xFF.

functions.name: Ui_HudTarget_GetLayoutRecord
functions.signature: int Ui_HudTarget_GetLayoutRecord(int hudTargetContext, int targetIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Retrieves the layout pane descriptor record from 'common_3d_up_hud_target.bflyt' for a target unit.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ArcListWindow_MatchesSelectedId
functions.summary: Returns 1 when work+8 byte +0x3C is 1 and the battle work byte +0x4201 equals the widget's f_1E0; otherwise 0.

functions.name: Battle_Ui_TargetGroup_CalcBounds
functions.signature: void Battle_Ui_TargetGroup_CalcBounds(float * boundsOut, int targetGroupManager, int groupIndex)
functions.summary: Calculates the 2D screen bounding rectangle encompassing all active battle units in a target group.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_ResolveHandle
functions.summary: Resolves a packed field-actor handle through the generational table at 0x007B80C0 and then accepts only objects whose virtual type identity is 0x007C359C (the gimmick type); walks the type chain at +0xc. Used by the gimmick slot lookup.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_IsPartsIdleC
functions.summary: Group idle query of a field actor-group scene object: after the part list reports ready it ANDs the idle state of 8x3 span groups and returns 1 only when all 24 have finished.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_FindSlotObjectById
functions.summary: Scans the owner's 0x1420 array of packed object handles and returns the first field object of class g_00650F30 whose id field (+0x224) equals the requested id.

functions.name: Field_IsPlayerDoingHellTackle
functions.summary: Returns 1 when field control is active (func_006281C8), the actor at work+8->+0x54->+0x1C is in state 0x17 and its current motion name equals "Hell_TackleLoop".

functions.name: Ui_Window_IsAnyChildActive
functions.summary: Returns 1 if any of the four 0x50-byte sub-parts at +0x120/+0x170/+0x1C0/+0x210 reports active through the shared ref test 0x649BFC; used as the 'children busy' guard by the guide window and the overlay hider.

functions.name: Effect_ActorTrail_ShouldFinish
functions.summary: End-of-life test for an actor trail effect: true only when an actor is bound (self+0x38), that actor is not in state +0x51, and the actor motion time from 0x669D38 is above the per-class threshold at 0x00651134. The trail is stopped when the actor has run far enough.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_DrawEquipComparisonA
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ListRow_DrawEquipComparisonA(void* row, u32 memberIndex, u16* itemEntry, u32 stack)
functions.summary: Equipment-comparison row renderer A: resolves the item through the 2H equip-category check 0x0066C5CC, builds the member stat context (Party_StatCalc_SetupMemberContext with 0x007C6F04) and formats the row with 0x0045A5A0(...,0) before tail-dispatching through the row-kind table at 0x00784318 indexed by row+4. No kind filter, unselected flag.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_PrepareSpriteContext
functions.summary: Prepares the scene flow's 0x80-byte sprite context once (lazy allocation through func_00384050), then returns 0 while the step helper reports it is still running and 1 when the ready flag at step+8 is clear.

functions.name: Ui_Widget_MatchesScreenMode
functions.summary: Returns whether the widget's required mode (f_C->f_3D: 0 or 1) matches the game mode: mode 0 matches game mode 0, mode 1 matches game mode 2.

functions.name: maybe_Party_GetInventoryCountByIndex
functions.signature: int maybe_Party_GetInventoryCountByIndex(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Returns the occupied-item-slot count (0..24) for the party record at index self+0x50, or 0 when that index is 0x1F or higher.

functions.name: Field_TryPlayerInteract
functions.summary: When field control is active (func_006281C8), no menu blocks it (work+8 +0x44/+0x45) and the player is in state 1 or 2, returns maybe_Field_CheckGridInteraction(request); otherwise 0.

functions.name: maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVector
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVector(void* owner, const float* from, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Starts interpolating the owner's +0x48 vector toward `from` through the manager at work+8->+0x4C, using interpolation mode 0. Slot 13 of a 24-slot vtable.

functions.name: Battle_MarkEnemySleepFlags
functions.summary: Additive variant of the enemy-parameter scan: sets the per-slot 'sleep/disable' bits for every enemy whose EnemyBaseParam record has the sleep_enemy_check flag, but never clears existing bits and has no slot-0 special case.

functions.name: maybe_Field_CheckGridInteraction
functions.summary: Resolves the grid cell under the player, classifies the four neighbouring direction entries of the cell table against the current map-object tables and then asks the camera-interaction test (0x00651954) to confirm the hit.

functions.name: maybe_Camera_TestPointOccluded
functions.signature: int maybe_Camera_TestPointOccluded(InteractRequest* request, const unsigned char* rgb)
functions.summary: Projects a field point with the camera helper and asks the camera system whether that point is hidden by an occluder; the request's virtual validator and the object table then confirm the hit.

functions.name: Field_FindFreePlacementCell2D
functions.summary: Searches the 2D grid around a target cell (8 candidate orientations) for a w*h footprint that is free of map chips, field objects and the collision set, then writes the found cell, its orientation and layer/height data into the placement record.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IsRefStaleB
functions.summary: Packed-handle liveness test (variant B): returns 0 only when the handle at +0x2D8 resolves through the global handle table to an object whose state byte +0x78 is below 4, and 1 otherwise (no enable gate).

functions.name: Ui_MapIcon_ShouldShowDirection
functions.summary: Determines if a map icon should show its direction indicator pointer: checks if the target object pointer at +0x29C is non-null and that func_0064D7C0 returns 0, returning a boolean.

functions.name: Ui_CheckObjectRefValid
functions.signature: int Ui_CheckObjectRefValid(RefOwner* owner, int unusedB, int unusedC, int unusedD)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the context check (x6_, the list-membership predicate) passes and func_00649994 accepts the owner's packed object reference at +0x2A0; otherwise 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IsRefStaleC
functions.summary: Packed-handle liveness test (variant C): returns 0 only when the handle at +0x2CC resolves through the global handle table to an object whose state byte +0x78 is below 4, and 1 otherwise.

functions.name: Field_PlaceModelAroundActor
functions.signature: void Field_PlaceModelAroundActor(ModelOwner* owner, float* outPos, float* outDir)
functions.summary: Computes a position/direction around an actor, either from its rotation or from a random angle drawn from the game RNG, so a model can be placed relative to it; also ray-checks the resulting spot against the scene.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_DrawEquipComparisonB
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ListRow_DrawEquipComparisonB(void* row, u32 memberIndex, u16* itemEntry, u32 stack)
functions.summary: Equipment-comparison row renderer B: resolves the item through the 1H equip-category check 0x0066C5A8, skips the row when the item record kind (+0x29) does not match the row's filter byte (+5), then builds the member stat context, formats with 0x0045A5A0(...,0) and tail-dispatches through 0x00784318. Unselected flag.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListRow_DrawEquipComparisonC
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_ListRow_DrawEquipComparisonC(void* row, u32 memberIndex, u16* itemEntry, u32 stack)
functions.summary: Equipment-comparison row renderer C (selected variant): requires the item record kind (+0x29) to equal the row filter byte (+5), resolves through the 1H check 0x0066C5A8, builds the member stat context, formats with 0x0045A5A0(...,1) and tail-dispatches through the table at 0x0078430C.

functions.name: std_compare_flagwords_by_bit
functions.signature: u32 std_compare_flagwords_by_bit(u32* ctx, u32* lhs, u32* rhs)
functions.summary: Ordering predicate for bit-mask sort keys: compares the 'primary class' of both keys (func_0055E6BC), and on a tie compares the index of the lowest still-unmasked set bit (*key & ~*ctx); returns 1 when the left key sorts after the right one.

functions.name: Battle2D_SyncUnitSlot
functions.summary: Synchronises one battle 2D slot: if the slot's virtual 'is ready' check passes it runs the layout test and then either reports a blocking state or drives the slot's virtual update.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_FindModel
functions.summary: Finds the model binding instance matching an actor handle across the primary, secondary, and tertiary model slots.

functions.name: Event_ActorModels_FindModelByHandle
functions.summary: Finds the active model work object matching an actor handle across all 16 scene actor slots.

functions.name: maybe_Event_ActorModels_IsSlotEmpty
functions.summary: Checks whether a specific model slot in the actor models manager is unallocated: it resolves the slot through virtual +0x64 and tests the resulting record.

functions.name: maybe_Battle_Ui_TargetGroup_ScaleBounds
functions.summary: Scales the target group's bounds: multiplies self+0x28 by the model scale at (self+0x2C)+0x15C and a constant, calls 0x00673DC8 with that float, then walks the float pairs of the bounds struct and divides each by the scale.

functions.name: maybe_Field_TestAreaOverlapA
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Field_TestAreaOverlapA(void* owner, void* point, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, float* offset)
functions.summary: Builds a four-corner box from a point (+0x4C/+0x50/+0x54/+0x58) plus the caller's offset and tests it against a list of field objects; the 4 x 8-byte corner array is constructed with the no-op constructor 0x006F56F4 and the test itself runs in this function.

functions.name: maybe_Field_ComputeGridMoveDelta
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_ComputeGridMoveDelta(int* out, GridState* grid, int unusedA, int unusedB, const int* origin, int dir, int unusedC, const int* size, int unusedD, const u8* maskA, const u8* maskB, const u8* maskC)
functions.summary: Calculates field movement delta across square grid cells, testing collision against four adjacent boundary boxes via Gfx_Scene_QueryRect.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_QueryRect
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_QueryRect(BoxQuery* query, const int* origin)
functions.summary: Submits an oriented rectangle query to the scene: expands origin by the query offsets (f_54/f_58), sizes it by f_4C/f_50, takes the layer from query->f_38->f_AC and calls the scene rectangle query (0x002E5898) with the query's callback (f_5C) and user value (f_9C).

functions.name: Field_QueryOccludersInBoxLayer
functions.signature: void Field_QueryOccludersInBoxLayer(void* query, int layer, int* origin)
functions.summary: Box query in an explicit scene layer: builds the rectangle from the query object's offsets and the origin and asks the scene (func_002E5898) for the occluders/objects in it.

functions.name: maybe_Field_QueryFourBoxes
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_QueryFourBoxes(QueryOwner* owner, int scene, int layer, int* rect, int* grow, int* grow2, u8* results)
functions.summary: Runs the owner's scene query callback four times with successively grown rectangles and stores the four boolean results in results[0..3].

functions.name: maybe_Field_TestAreaOverlapB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Field_TestAreaOverlapB(void* owner, void* point, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, float* offset)
functions.summary: Sibling of 0x00652F48: builds the same four-corner box from the point in argument 2 plus the caller's offset and tests it against a list of field objects; only the argument positions differ.

functions.name: maybe_Field_QueryFourPoints
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_QueryFourPoints(void* owner, int* origin, int* offsets, u8* results, u8* hitBytes)
functions.summary: Runs four one-unit scene probes at the given relative offsets, storing a boolean per probe and optionally the first byte of each hit object.

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_IsPartsIdleD
functions.summary: Two-span variant of the scene-object idle query: 1 only when the part list is ready and both span groups (+0x2C8, +0x388) are idle.

functions.name: maybe_Work_FindFirstFreeSlot
functions.summary: Returns the index of the first 0xFFFF terminator in the 90-entry u16 table at (work+0x24A98)+0x27C4, i.e. the first free slot of that table.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_GetRowFlag
functions.summary: Returns the flag byte of the row under the cursor of a list: index = (cursorTarget->f_C * 10 + rowIndex) - firstVisibleRow(vtable+0x68), read from the 10-byte row records at self+0x78.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_StoreManagerByte
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_StoreManagerByte(void* not, void* object, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Copies byte +0x72 of the manager at work+8->+0x50 into the object's +0x64.

functions.name: maybe_Item_CheckCraftRequirements
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Item_CheckCraftRequirements(u32 arg1, RecipeWork* recipe, u32 scratch, u32 scratch2)
functions.summary: Checks the six 10-byte requirement rows of a recipe: skips the check when the work bytes +0x2D549/+0x2D54A are clear, then for each non-empty row compares the item id and quantity range and stops at the first row whose extra status check fails.

functions.name: Battle_ClampEnemyGroupCounts
functions.summary: Normalises each enemy group entry: looks up the monster record, reads its category byte (+0x9A) and clamps the requested count (+0x3F) to 4, 2 or 1 depending on whether the record is a normal, strong or special enemy.

functions.name: Battle_DecideFirstStrike
functions.signature: void Battle_DecideFirstStrike(BattleParticipant* self, EncounterDesc* enc, int arg3)
functions.summary: Rolls the pre-emptive strike: asks the battle set-up object which side may strike first, builds the weighted condition string ('player_first_attack N s<dexterty_memberNum N equip' or 'enemy_first_attack N'), evaluates it through the 0x28B820/0x28B70C/0x28B71C condition evaluator and writes the winning side into enc->f_04.

functions.name: Battle_SetUnitModeFlag
functions.summary: Sets the unit's f_76 mode byte from the game mode: in game mode 2 it becomes (work+8 byte +0x46 != 1), otherwise the mode value itself.

functions.name: maybe_Field_IsOverlayFlagSet
functions.summary: Returns 1 when field control is active (func_006281C8) and the overlay manager flag +0x3B0 is set; otherwise 0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IsRefStaleD
functions.summary: Packed-handle liveness test (variant D): returns 0 only when the handle at +0x2F4 resolves through the global handle table to an object whose state byte +0x78 is below 4, and 1 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_IsRefStaleE
functions.summary: Packed-handle liveness test (variant E): returns 0 only when the handle at +0x2FC resolves through the global handle table to an object whose state byte +0x78 is below 4, and 1 otherwise.

functions.name: maybe_Pack_WriteWordQuadAt60
functions.summary: Serializes the four words at self+0x60..+0x6C by calling writer->vtbl[+0x10](writer, index, &value) for index 0..3. One half of a symmetric reader/writer pair for a fixed four-word record.

functions.name: maybe_Pack_WriteWordQuadAt50
functions.summary: Serializes the four words at self+0x50..+0x5C through writer->vtbl[+0x10]; the twin of 0x00654DA4 for the second fixed four-word record of the same object.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePane_SetTransform
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpritePane_SetTransform(SpritePaneNode* self, u8* paneArray, int paneIndex, int isPrimary)
functions.summary: Copies pane transforms into a two-pane sprite node: selects the pane record (0x9C stride), sets or clears bit 0 of the pane's +0x44 flag, then pushes either the two source frames + animation state (primary) or the three frames at +0x688/+0x6BC/+0x6F0 (secondary) through the effect helpers.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePane_SetFrame
functions.signature: void Gfx_SpritePane_SetFrame(u32 arg1, void* pane, void* frameData)
functions.summary: Applies animation frame data to a sprite pane by setting the primary material's frame via 0x0053E220, clearing dirty flag bit 0x08, and updating texture coordinates via Ui_PicturePane_SetTexCoords.

functions.name: maybe_Field_TryPlayerInteractGated
functions.summary: ANDs the global 'player ready' predicate 0x006281C8 with the grid interaction query maybe_Field_CheckGridInteraction(request), so the interaction is only allowed when both agree.

functions.name: maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVectorB
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVectorB(void* owner, const float* from, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Same as maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVector but with interpolation mode 1. Slot 13 of a 24-slot vtable.

functions.name: Camera_UpdateOcclusionAndProjection
functions.summary: Refreshes the camera for this frame: computes the player-state visibility gate, tests whether the camera's view of the player is clear, pushes the player position and the white colour to the camera projection and returns whether both checks passed.

functions.name: maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVectorC
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVectorC(void* owner, const float* from, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Duplicate of maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVectorB: interpolates the owner's +0x48 vector toward `from` with mode 1. Slot 13 of a different 24-slot vtable.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_GetMaterialCellRecordKey
functions.summary: Resolves the smith-menu material cell under the cursor (index into the widget's u16 cell table at +0x50) and returns the first u16 of the record that the Game_GetDataManager lookup yields.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_ResolveMaterialCellRecord
functions.summary: Material-cell accessor: computes the same cell index as Ui_SmithMenu_GetMaterialCellValue, resolves that cell id's record through 0x0063E998 and returns the record pointer used to fill the material rows.

functions.name: Ui_SmithMenu_GetMaterialCellValue
functions.summary: Returns the material id of the smith menu's selected cell: computes the flat index as (row * 6 + column offset), bounds-checks it against the material array and returns the u16 there, or 0xFFFF when out of range.

functions.name: Effect_ActorTrail_ShouldFinishB
functions.summary: Second trail-effect end test: adds a check on the child effect at self+0x50 (its byte +0x312) to the actor/motion-time test, so a trail stays alive while the follow-up effect is still running.

functions.name: maybe_Effect_ActorTrail_LiteralPool
functions.summary: Not a function: this address falls inside the literal pool that belongs to the trail-effect code before 0x006555E0 (float constants and PICA command words). Recorded so the batch stays complete; Ghidra mislabelled it as a Thumb entry and the body is halt_baddata().

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_CopyBlocks
functions.summary: Copies a run of 0x200-byte command-buffer blocks with std_memcpy, writing the 0x1FC-byte payload plus a masked header word per block; Ghidra lost the cursor registers, so the exact signature is unrecoverable.

functions.name: Fs_CompleteServiceRequest
functions.signature: void Fs_CompleteServiceRequest(FsResult* out, int* request, int* outValue, int value)
functions.summary: File-service request wrapper: rejects a request whose first two words are zero with error 0xE0A13882, issues the 0x00501F3C service command, writes its reply minus one to *outValue and reports the status through Fs_FormatResultCode.

functions.name: Svc_Object_GetFactoryChecked
functions.summary: Returns object+4 (the service factory pointer) after asserting non-null with fatal error 0xE0A046DA.

functions.name: Svc_Ipc_SendWithHandle
functions.summary: IPC convenience wrapper: reads the checked object handle (0x00655758) and sends it with one command word through Svc_Ipc_Send08040000; it is vtable slot 3 of object class 0x00780EAC.

functions.name: Svc_Object_GetHandleChecked
functions.summary: Returns object+4 (the service handle) after asserting non-null with fatal error 0xE0A046DA.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_GetMemberRange
functions.summary: Queries the physical offset/length of the currently opened sound archive member: masks off the stream's low flag bit (~1), calls 0x504F78 and on success stores the pair into stream[3]/stream[4] and into the caller's out pair; on failure the stored pair is zeroed.

functions.name: Gfx_Bch_EmitMaterialState
functions.summary: Appends the main material state block of a BCH material into the command buffer: depth/stencil register writes (0x000F029B/0x000F028F/0x000F02CB/0x000F02BF), the 0x000F0280 / 0x000F02B0 blocks with the material's colour words, texture-unit enables (0x00020229/0x00020253) and the two vertex-shader matrix copies. Returns the new cursor.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_CopyMarkedBlocks
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_CopyMarkedBlocks(uint32_t* dst, const uint32_t* src, int size)
functions.summary: Copies a run of 0x80-word command-buffer blocks, writing a 0xEAD0FEAD marker after every 0x1FC-byte payload and a length-tagged header for the tail block; returns the new write cursor.

functions.name: Gfx_Bch_FindShaderSymbol
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Bch_FindShaderSymbol(PicaCtx* ctx, ShaderSymbolRef* out, const char* name)
functions.summary: Looks a shader symbol up by name in one of the context's two symbol tables (ctx[4]/ctx[5], selected by out->f_1): walks the 8-byte entries, prefix-matches the name up to '.' and, on a hit, stores the resolved name pointer plus the entry's two index bytes, folding the raw code into one of four index pages (bases 0x10/0x70/0x78/0x87). Returns 1 when found.

functions.name: Gfx_Bch_EmitPassState
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_Bch_EmitPassState(PicaCtx* ctx, u32* buffer, u32 passIndex)
functions.summary: Appends the second (per-pass) material state block: the 0x000F0280 / 0x000F02B0 colour/depth words for the selected pass, the 0x00020229 / 0x00020253 texture-unit enables and the pass's matrix copy; returns the new cursor. Gfx_Bch_BuildMaterials calls it twice per material (pass 0 and pass 1) and stores both block lengths.

functions.name: Gfx_Bch_MaterialCommandSize
functions.summary: Computes how many bytes of command buffer a material needs: walks the material's sub-resources, counts 2 words per vertex attribute of kind 1 and 6 per kind 2, adds the per-pair and per-sub-resource 0x98 blocks (200/0xc0 for the attribute kinds) and the shared 8-word header. The caller uses it to allocate the block before the two emit functions fill it.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureUnits
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureUnits(GfxTextureUnitDesc* desc, u32* out, u32 unit_mask, int with_bind)
functions.summary: Appends PICA200 GPU command words that configure one or two texture units (size, param, LOD, address and the unit's register bind) from a texture description, returning the advanced write pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_Texture_Upload
functions.signature: void Gfx_Texture_Upload(TextureDesc* tex, CmdList* cmd, u32 stages, int needSync)
functions.summary: Uploads one texture level to the GPU: converts the source pixels to the PICA200 layout for the texture format (RGBA8 / RGB8 / RGBA4 / RGB565 / RGBA5551), computes the level size and emits the fill/copy commands.

functions.name: Gfx_Pica_EmitDrawElements
functions.signature: void Gfx_Pica_EmitDrawElements(int picaContext, u32 primType, u32 indexCount, u32 indexBuffer)
functions.summary: Emits the PICA200 draw-elements command packet: writes the index buffer address, index format and index count into the GPU command stream for indexed primitives.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Pica_WriteTextureStatePacket
functions.signature: u32* maybe_Gfx_Pica_WriteTextureStatePacket(char* enable, u32* cmdBuf, int append, int extended)
functions.summary: Encodes PICA200 texture environment register packet (header 0x00E40103, registers 0x8B and 0x130) with float color conversion into command buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_Pica_WriteTextureStateBlock
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_Pica_WriteTextureStateBlock(void* ctx, u32* out, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Emits one 14-word PICA200 texture-state command block derived from the texture-unit bytes at ctx+0x164..+0x191 (enable/format bits, registers 0x000F008F, 0x000F01C0, 0x000F01C2, 0x000F01C3, 0x000F01C6, 0x000F01D9) and returns the advanced command cursor.

functions.name: Gfx_Pica_WriteTextureUnitBlocks
functions.summary: For each of the eight texture units whose enable byte at ctx+i+0x164 is set, appends that unit's command block by calling 0x00657014 on its 0x2C-stride descriptor at ctx+i*0x2C+4, and returns the advanced cursor.

functions.name: Gfx_Pica_SetLightingModel
functions.summary: Emits the PICA200 register updates that configure the hardware lighting pipeline (ambient/specular mode and shadow attenuation).

functions.name: Gfx_Pica_WriteVertexAttrCommands
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_Pica_WriteVertexAttrCommands(const void* attrContext, u32* outCmd)
functions.summary: Emits PICA200 vertex-attribute loader and VSH input permutation GPU commands (registers 0x02B9, 0x0242, 0x02BB..0x02BC, 0x0200..0x0226 across 12 buffer slots at +0x160 stride 0x70, and fixed attributes 0x0232..0x0235 across 12 slots at +0x6A0 stride 0x14) into outCmd, returning the advanced command pointer.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureDescriptor
functions.signature: u32* Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureDescriptor(GfxTexture* tex, u32* out, int with_header)
functions.summary: Appends the full PICA200 texture descriptor block for one texture: size, param (format/mip/type bits), border colour, LOD, the up-to-four address registers and the final type/bind command, converting the float LOD bias to fixed point.

functions.name: Gfx_Pica_EmitTextureSamplerState
functions.signature: u32 * Gfx_Pica_EmitTextureSamplerState(u32 * samplerDesc, u32 * cmdBuffer, int isPassThrough)
functions.summary: Encodes and writes PICA200 GPU texture sampler configuration and wrap mode command words into the command buffer.

functions.name: Gfx_Pica_EmitModelTextureBindings
functions.summary: Emits PICA200 GPU command words configuring texture sampler bindings and combiner states for model rendering.

functions.name: Gfx_Pica_EmitTextureSamplerStateEx
functions.signature: u32 * Gfx_Pica_EmitTextureSamplerStateEx(u32 * samplerDesc, u32 * cmdBuffer, int isPassThrough)
functions.summary: Encodes and writes extended PICA200 GPU texture sampler, mipmapping, and wrap mode command words into the command buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Pack_ReadInline6A
functions.signature: bool maybe_Pack_ReadInline6A(void* dst, u32 arg2, u32* outSize, u32 avail)
functions.summary: Fixed-size record reader: when avail >= 6 it copies six bytes from the record pointer held in r12 (+4) to dst and reports 6 through outSize. The source arrives in r12 because this is an interior case-entry of the surrounding reader switch, not a standalone ABI function.

functions.name: maybe_Pack_ReadLengthPrefixedRecord
functions.signature: bool maybe_Pack_ReadLengthPrefixedRecord(InlineRecord* record, void* dst, u32* outSize, u32* avail)
functions.summary: Variable-size record reader: copies the five-byte inline header from record+5, then the payload whose pointer is at record+0xC and whose length is the u16 at record+8, and reports 5+length. The length-prefixed variant of the fixed 3/6-byte inline readers.

functions.name: maybe_Pack_ReadInline6B
functions.signature: bool maybe_Pack_ReadInline6B(void* dst, u32 arg2, u32* outSize, u32 avail)
functions.summary: Second six-byte inline record reader, identical to 0x006583E8. The duplicate exists because two record kinds share the same 6-byte payload but different type tags in the surrounding switch.

functions.name: maybe_Pack_ReadInline3
functions.signature: bool maybe_Pack_ReadInline3(void* dst, u32 arg2, u32* outSize, u32 avail)
functions.summary: Three-byte inline record reader: copies three bytes from the record pointer in r12 (+4) to dst and reports 3.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_FetchIcon
functions.signature: u32 Ui_IconCache_FetchIcon(u32 iconId, int destBuffer, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Fetches an icon graphic from the icon cache block archive into the destination memory buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Container_HashMap_LookupBySlot
functions.signature: void* maybe_Container_HashMap_LookupBySlot(void* self, unsigned int ignored, unsigned int slot)
functions.summary: Looks up the record that owns key slot 'slot' in the two-table container: in the small-table mode it returns the packed word at self+0x21C+slot*4; otherwise it builds the 8-byte key at self+0x564+slot*8, then linear-probes the buckets at self+0x3CC comparing each bucket's key at +0x20 until one matches.

functions.name: maybe_Container_HashMap_GetCapacity
functions.summary: Accessor for the global container fetched by func_00658548: returns the word at +4 (capacity/entry count), or 0 if the global instance is null.

functions.name: Ui_IconCache_WriteIndexTable
functions.signature: u32 Ui_IconCache_WriteIndexTable(SvcCacheIndex* index, int table, u32 file)
functions.summary: Writes one icon-cache index table to a file: for each of index[table].count entries (table 0/1 selects the +0x210/+0x3C0 cursor) it appends an 8-byte record - the entry timestamp or the literal 'ERROR   ' when the entry is missing - and returns the number written or -1.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_WriteWithRetry
functions.signature: int Svc_Cecd_WriteWithRetry(u32 arg1, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d, u32 e, u32 f, u32 g)
functions.summary: Calls Svc_Cecd_WriteRawFile with retry loop up to three times on busy status 0xC8A10BF0, sleeping 1 ms and setting global retry flag 0x007AE9E6.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_DeleteRawWithRetry
functions.signature: int Svc_Cecd_DeleteRawWithRetry(u32 arg1, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d, u32 e, u32 f)
functions.summary: Calls Svc_Cecd_DeleteRawFile with retry loop up to three times on busy status 0xC8A10BF0, sleeping 1 ms and setting global retry flag 0x007AE9E6.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Cecd_Command12
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Svc_Cecd_Command12(CecdSession* self, void* buffer, u32 size)
functions.summary: CECD command wrapper: zeroes a 0x60-byte buffer, sends command 0x12 with parameters (2, buffer, 0x60, &written, size) through the session virtual at +0x34, maps the 0xFDC00000 result pattern and returns error 0xC8810BEF when nothing was written.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_ContentObject_QuerySize
functions.summary: Queries one content object: reads a 2-byte attribute through vtable+0x2C, allocates a 0x36C0-byte work object (0x0050D708), initialises it, fetches the content info and returns 0 only when the cached size covers the queried value.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_WriteDispatchWithRetry
functions.signature: u32 Svc_Cecd_WriteDispatchWithRetry(u32 arg1, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d, u32 e)
functions.summary: Dispatches CECD command 1 with retry loop up to 3 times on busy status 0xC8A10BF0, sleeping 1 ms and setting the global retry flag.

functions.name: Svc_Cecd_DeleteDispatchWithRetry
functions.signature: void Svc_Cecd_DeleteDispatchWithRetry(u32 arg1, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d, u32 e)
functions.summary: Calls Svc_Cecd_DeleteDispatch and, when it returns the CECD busy/again status 0xC8A10BF0, waits once (0x00509D40(1,0)), sets the retried flag at 0x007AE9E5 and calls it a second time.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Blob_Serialize
functions.summary: Serialises a blob into a caller buffer: copies the 0x70-byte header, writes each of blob->f_130 entries as an 8-byte sub-header plus 4-byte-padded payload, then the main payload and the 0x20-byte trailer; returns the blob's size word.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Blob_SerializeTail
functions.signature: bool maybe_Svc_Blob_SerializeTail(u32 arg1, u32 value, u32* other, u32 src)
functions.summary: Continuation entry of the blob serializer at 0x00658B28: compares an 8-byte block at the pointer in r3 through 0x001009DC and returns true when they match. The leading in_ZR test depends on flags left by the caller, which confirms it is a continuation entry, not a fresh function.

functions.name: Field_Clock_ConvertTimestamp
functions.signature: void Field_Clock_ConvertTimestamp(u32* out, const u64* timestamp)
functions.summary: Converts an in-game timestamp (100µs ticks) into the game's packed date/time words: adds the epoch offset 0x7CFC8400, divides by 86,400,000 for the day and derives year/month/day plus weekday (mod 7 with a +6 bias) and hour/minute/second/millisecond.

functions.name: Field_Clock_GetMilliseconds
functions.summary: Converts a 64-bit field-clock tick into the millisecond part of the displayed clock (remainder modulo 1000).

functions.name: Field_Clock_GetDayOfMonth
functions.summary: Returns the day of month of a timestamp: divides by one day and asks the calendar helper 0x0050EB54 for the third output field.

functions.name: Field_Clock_GetHour
functions.summary: Returns the hour (0..23) of the field clock by shifting the tick value down and taking it modulo 24.

functions.name: Field_Clock_GetYear
functions.summary: Returns the year of a timestamp through the first output field of the calendar helper 0x0050EB54.

functions.name: Field_Clock_GetMonth
functions.summary: Returns the month of a timestamp through the second output field of the calendar helper 0x0050EB54.

functions.name: Field_Clock_GetMinute
functions.summary: Returns the minute (0..59) of the field clock (tick value shifted to minute resolution, modulo 60).

functions.name: Field_Clock_GetSecond
functions.summary: Returns the second (0..59) of the field clock (tick value shifted to second resolution, modulo 60).

functions.name: std_Int64MulDiv
functions.signature: int64_t std_Int64MulDiv(u32* factors, u32 arg2, u32 b, u32 c, u32 d)
functions.summary: 64-bit fixed-point helper: multiplies the 64-bit pair in factors by (a, b), adds a rounding term for negative c and divides by d. Used to convert tick counts to milliseconds/microseconds without floats.

functions.name: maybe_Svc_Blob_FindRecordByName
functions.summary: Searches the record array at self+0x18 (count at self+0xC->+8) for a record whose name string at self->f_10 + record->f_8 compares equal to name; returns the index or -1.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteTextureBind
functions.summary: Appends the two GPU commands that bind a texture unit to a texture object: the enable/bind word and either the physical texture address (func_00508114 converts the buffer to a GPU address) or an explicit address taken from the record.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteQuantizedFloat24
functions.signature: unsigned int* Gfx_GpuCmd_WriteQuantizedFloat24(GfxFloat24Spec* spec, unsigned int* out, float value)
functions.summary: Quantises `value` against the packed exponent/mantissa spec and appends it as a PICA200 FLOAT24 constant followed by register 0x000F004E. When the sign bit is clear the value is mapped into [lo,hi] taken from the spec and scaled by 128/2^exp; when it is set the value is divided by (2^exp)-1. A zero input is written as the raw mantissa or as 0.

functions.name: Model_LookupIdByKey
functions.signature: u32 Model_LookupIdByKey(Model* self, const void* key)
functions.summary: The model key-to-id trie lookup: it walks the packed 12-byte binary-search trie and returns 0xFFFF when absent/disabled.

functions.name: Gfx_ResourceTrie_Lookup
functions.signature: unsigned Gfx_ResourceTrie_Lookup(const ResourceTrie* trie, const unsigned char* bits, unsigned bitCount)
functions.summary: Walks the resource lookup trie (12-byte nodes, branch indices at +6/+8) using a packed bit array as the key and returns the node's u16 value unless the node's condition string rejects the lookup.

functions.name: Fx_DistributionTable_WriteEntry
functions.signature: void Fx_DistributionTable_WriteEntry(FxStateSource* self, FxStateTable* table, unsigned short id, void* curve)
functions.summary: Fills one 0x218-byte FX spawn record (table base + id*0x218): builds a 128-entry distribution table from self+0x28 with Fx_BuildDistributionTable, packs it through 0x00508C40, then writes the header (valid=1, self+0x29 bit 0, ids at +2..+4).

functions.name: Gfx_StateTable_EmitEntry
functions.signature: unsigned short Gfx_StateTable_EmitEntry(GfxStateSource* self, unsigned int** out, GfxStateSlot* slot, GfxStateTable* table, unsigned int boundId)
functions.summary: Appends one state-table slot to the PICA command list: always writes the 4-word header (enable/flag word, register 0x000F00?? pair, 24-bit id, trailing command word), and when the slot's id differs from the currently bound id it also copies the 0x210-byte cached payload (memcpy of 0x210). Returns the slot id so the caller can track what is bound.

functions.name: Gfx_MaterialState_WriteConstants
functions.signature: void Gfx_MaterialState_WriteConstants(GfxRenderContext* ctx, unsigned int** out, GfxMaterialDesc* mat, GfxModelInstance* inst)
functions.summary: Emits the per-material GPU constants for one draw: texture-stage indices (flag 0x400), a packed word (0x800), the 8-byte material block plus four 24-bit colour/uniform words (consecutive write 0x804F02C0), three float triplets (flag 0x8000), and the lighting/normal uniforms built from 1/255-scaled 24-bit colours (flag 0x200), finally the per-slot colour-modulation block (flag 1).

functions.name: Gfx_MaterialState_WriteAndCacheBlock
functions.signature: void Gfx_MaterialState_WriteAndCacheBlock(GfxRenderContext* ctx, unsigned int** out, GfxDrawRecord* rec, GfxModelInstance* inst)
functions.summary: Writes (or re-emits from cache) the 0x210-byte command block of one draw record. First call builds the block inline, stores its word offset/size back into the record and marks bit 0x80 'cached'; later calls just re-append the stored block and the eight per-slot strip headers. Also appends the tail buffers (ctx+200, ctx+4, rec+0xa0..+0xaa).

functions.name: Gfx_DrawRecord_WriteSubBuffers
functions.signature: void Gfx_DrawRecord_WriteSubBuffers(GfxRenderContext* ctx, unsigned int** out, GfxDrawRecord* rec, GfxModelInstance* inst)
functions.summary: For the eight slots of one draw record, appends the two optional sub-buffers (arrays at +0x238 and at +0x258 in the 0x278-byte instance record) as tagged DMA blocks, tagging them 0x800+slot*0x100 and 0x1000+slot*0x100.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawRecord_WriteSlotHeader
functions.signature: void Gfx_DrawRecord_WriteSlotHeader(GfxRenderContext* ctx, unsigned int** out, GfxSlotHeader* hdr)
functions.summary: Writes the fixed per-slot header: copies 24 bytes from ctx+0xa8, patches the two id fields (bits 8-10 of words 2 and 4 from hdr+0x19c/+0x19e), then emits one 8-byte tag+address pair for each of the six layer pointers and finally packs the six 'layer enabled' bits into the header's first word.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawRecord_ApplyColorModulation
functions.signature: void Gfx_DrawRecord_ApplyColorModulation(GfxRenderContext* ctx, unsigned int** out, GfxModelInstance* inst, GfxDrawRecord* rec)
functions.summary: For each of the eight slots of a draw record, multiplies the slot's 16-bit colour/UV components by the record's 8.8 multipliers (>>8) into the slot's packed vertex fields, then hands the slot to 0x00657124 to append its command block. The ctx flag bit 0x10 selects a variant that leaves the last three components unmodulated. Finishes by adding the record's offset to the packed RGB and clamping each channel to 0xff.

functions.name: Gfx_Mesh_ParseSections
functions.signature: void Gfx_Mesh_ParseSections(GfxModelInstance* inst, GfxMeshData* mesh, GfxMeshBuffers* buf, int baseOffset, GfxMeshChunk* chunkDesc)
functions.summary: Parses the chunked mesh header (sub-tables at +0x2c/+0x34/+0x3c, plus +0x44 for two-vertex-buffer meshes), allocates the vertex/index/BL-index arrays from those counts, fills them per part (pos + matrix from 0x001252E8), builds the part matrices (0x0065B038) and sets the 'has bone palette' bit when any part uses it.

functions.name: Gfx_Mesh_SetupTextureChunk
functions.signature: void Gfx_Mesh_SetupTextureChunk(GfxMeshData* meshData, GfxTextureInfo* texInfo, GfxMeshBuffers* meshBuffers, int baseOffset, GfxMeshChunk* chunkDesc)
functions.summary: Configures a texture chunk buffer for a mesh: copies texture data of (bitCount + 7) >> 3 bytes into the allocated chunk buffer, records buffer pointer and bit count, and marks the buffer descriptor active.

functions.name: Gfx_Model_BuildPartMatrices
functions.summary: Builds a 3x4 transform matrix for every model part from the part's Euler angles and scale, using the sine/cosine lookup table at 0x0065B304 and 2*pi wrapping, then multiplies in the part's pre-transform (0x0012515C) and marks the matrix slot dirty (bit 1).

functions.name: Gfx_Mesh_AllocSubmeshBuffers
functions.signature: void Gfx_Mesh_AllocSubmeshBuffers(GfxModelInstance* inst, GfxMeshData* mesh, GfxMeshBuffers* buf, int baseOffset, unsigned int dataOffset, GfxMeshChunk* chunkDesc)
functions.summary: Allocates and initialises the per-submesh 0x158-byte buffer records: clears each record, then reserves space for the vertex and index data (aligned to 16 bytes) from the submesh sizes in the chunk header and stores the word offsets into each record.

functions.name: Gfx_Mesh_SetupIndexBufferTable
functions.signature: void Gfx_Mesh_SetupIndexBufferTable(GfxMeshBuffers* out, GfxMeshData* mesh, GfxBufferTable* table, unsigned int dataOffset, GfxMeshChunk* chunkDesc)
functions.summary: Builds the per-part index-buffer table (stride 8: {pointer, count}) for a mesh: count = chunk size >> 3, each part gets an aligned block of part->count*0x18 bytes and the element count is size/24; returns the advanced data cursor.

functions.name: Gfx_Mesh_SetupVertexBufferTable
functions.signature: void Gfx_Mesh_SetupVertexBufferTable(GfxMeshBuffers* out, GfxMeshData* mesh, GfxBufferTable* table, unsigned int dataOffset, GfxMeshChunk* chunkDesc)
functions.summary: Builds the per-part vertex-buffer table (stride 0xC: {pointer, count, flag}) for a mesh: the vertex count is the packed half-word at part+0x14 plus the odd-vertex flag, and each part gets an aligned count*8-byte block; returns the advanced cursor.

functions.name: Math_ComputeNormalizedRatio
functions.summary: Normalises `value` against the {start,end} pair in `range` and returns the result in s0. Three modes: mode 0 returns the value unchanged (clamped by the caller's compare), modes 1 and 2 compute (value-start)/(end-start). Used by the keyframe evaluators.

functions.name: Anim_Curve_Dispatch
functions.summary: Normalises the curve time ratio (Math_ComputeNormalizedRatio) and tail-calls the per-type/per-mode evaluator from the 0x20-byte-stride table at 0x007AE7C8, index type*0x20 + mode*4.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_CullNodeWalk
functions.signature: unsigned int Gfx_Scene_CullNodeWalk(GfxVisibilityTree* tree, unsigned short* cursor, GfxNodeBounds* bounds, GfxCullPlanes* planes)
functions.summary: Walks the scene's node-visibility graph starting at *cursor and returns the next node that passes the plane tests. Each node keeps a 2-byte 'next/child' link table, a 0x18-byte AABB and a list of up to four planes (normal + distance); the walk follows links until a node is accepted or it wraps back to the start.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_SetNodePosFromArgs
functions.signature: void Gfx_Scene_SetNodePosFromArgs(SceneActor* actor, u32* scene, u32 actorIndex, int nodeIndex, u32 valueSource)
functions.summary: Writes packed fixed-point position data into a node record (stride 0x2C) within the scene actor matrix buffer (*scene + actorIndex * 0x278 + 4) based on actor mode bytes f_28 and f_29.

functions.name: Anim_UpdateTrackBitVisibility
functions.signature: void Anim_UpdateTrackBitVisibility(AnimTrackSet* self, unsigned char* bits, short* trackIds, float time)
functions.summary: For every track in the set, evaluates whether `time` falls inside a keyframe whose bit is set (tracks store a time range at +8/+0xc, a frame-bit array at +0x14 and a frame count at +0x18) and writes the yes/no answer into the output bit array — except for the special track kind 0x32, which is skipped, and the non-array case which writes a single flag byte.

functions.name: Gfx_BoneMatrix_WriteRows
functions.signature: void Gfx_BoneMatrix_WriteRows(GfxBoneSlot* self, unsigned int* matrix)
functions.summary: Fills the three translation components of a 3x4 bone matrix from the slot's source vectors, honouring the per-row flags at +8 (0x20/0x10 suppress, 0x4/0x2 read the vector directly instead of converting, 0x8 patches only the first row, 0x1 skips the third).

functions.name: Gfx_BoneMatrix_AppendCached
functions.signature: void Gfx_BoneMatrix_AppendCached(GfxBoneCache* self, unsigned int* out)
functions.summary: Re-appends a cached bone block: the prepared DMA words, optionally the per-bone palette range (skipped when the palette mode is zero), and the tail range — used to replay a bone matrix set without rebuilding it.

functions.name: Gfx_MeshChunk_DrawStrips
functions.signature: void Gfx_MeshChunk_DrawStrips(GfxMeshChunkDraw* self, unsigned int** out, GfxMeshBuffers* buf, GfxNodeBounds* bounds, GfxCullPlanes* planes, GfxDrawTag* tag)
functions.summary: Draws one visible mesh chunk: appends the node's prepared DMA block, binds the chunk's 0x30-byte matrix through a DMA record, then loops 0x0065B8C8 over the culled sub-nodes and emits one triangle-strip header per visible sub-node (start index, index count, three strip descriptors).

functions.name: Gfx_MeshChunk_DrawStripsWithPalette
functions.signature: void Gfx_MeshChunk_DrawStripsWithPalette(GfxMeshChunkDraw* self, unsigned int** out, GfxMeshBuffers* buf, GfxNodeBounds* bounds, GfxCullPlanes* planes, GfxDrawTag* tag, void* paletteSource)
functions.summary: Draws a mesh chunk's strips into the command buffer: appends the chunk's index block, converts the chunk's palette matrix (0x00125500) into a staging buffer and DMA-binds it (0x0012558C), emits the vertex/attribute commands, then walks the node's strip list with Gfx_Scene_CullNodeWalk writing a 0x12-word PICA strip header per visible strip, and finally appends the chunk's remaining index block.

functions.name: Gfx_MeshChunk_DrawPartList
functions.signature: void Gfx_MeshChunk_DrawPartList(GfxMeshChunkDraw* self, unsigned int** out, GfxMeshBuffers* buf, GfxDrawTag* tag)
functions.summary: Emits one draw for each of the chunk's 0x34-byte part entries: a single matrix bind, a multi-matrix block (several 0x30-byte matrices packed into the strip header), or a palette-transformed variant, followed by the optional secondary DMA block at part+0x2c.

functions.name: Gfx_MeshChunk_EmitPartMatrices
functions.signature: void Gfx_MeshChunk_EmitPartMatrices(GfxMeshChunkDraw* self, unsigned int** out, GfxMeshBuffers* buf, GfxDrawTag* tag, void* paletteSource)
functions.summary: Emits the per-part matrix commands of a mesh chunk: converts each part matrix from the external palette (func_00125500 + func_0012515C), appends the PICA 0x000F02C0 matrix block with the part's size, then appends the part's own DMA block and records its offsets in the draw tags.

functions.name: Gfx_MeshChunk_DrawStripsOnly
functions.signature: void Gfx_MeshChunk_DrawStripsOnly(GfxMeshChunkDraw* self, unsigned int** out, GfxNodeBounds* bounds, GfxCullPlanes* planes)
functions.summary: Cheapest chunk draw path: appends the node's DMA block and the chunk-index uniform, then emits only the triangle-strip headers for the sub-nodes that survive the cull walk (no matrix bind at all — the matrix was already bound by the caller).

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_MeshChunk_WritePartMatrices
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_MeshChunk_WritePartMatrices(GfxMeshChunkDraw* self, unsigned int** out, GfxMeshPartList* parts, GfxMeshBuffers* buf, GfxDrawTag* tag)
functions.summary: Writes part matrices into the draw command stream in one of three forms: a single 0x30-byte matrix DMA bind (no flags), a gathered multi-matrix block for every listed part id (bit 1), or a palette-merged matrix array (bit 0) appended as a raw DMA block.

functions.name: Gfx_SpritePane_GetPrimaryMaterial
functions.summary: Queries a 2D sprite or layout pane's material count via vtable +0x24 and, when non-zero, returns primary material 0 via vtable +0x28 (or NULL if none).

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Layout_BuildQuadTransforms
functions.signature: void maybe_Ui_Layout_BuildQuadTransforms(LayoutSet* self, u32 dst, u32 count, LayoutEntry* entries, float scale)
functions.summary: Turns the layout element's 0x14-byte sprite records into per-quad vertex coordinates (8 floats each), handling rotation through std_FastSinCos, the arbitrary-quad UV path and the 'use element transform' entry kinds, and caches the result (entry count at +100, built flag bit 3 of f_7C, flags f_65/f_66).

functions.name: maybe_Math_EvaluateAnglePair
functions.signature: void maybe_Math_EvaluateAnglePair(MathAngleCache* cache, float* angles, int force)
functions.summary: Evaluates and caches sine/cosine angle pairs: tests bitmasks in byte +0xD1 against force flag and invokes trig calculation func_00672DB4.

functions.name: Math_ApplyRotationToMatrix
functions.summary: Applies a cached 2D rotation to a 3x4 matrix: copies the source matrix (self+0x48), refreshes the angle pair via maybe_Math_EvaluateAnglePair, negates the Y row components and folds the rotated translation into column 3.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetPointer
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqParam_GetPointer(void * self, u32 id, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Resolves a sequence parameter through the base sequence object unless an attached extension claims it: when the extension's flag byte +4 is set and its vtable slot +0x0C returns non-zero, the base lookup is skipped.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetHeaderWord
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqParam_GetHeaderWord(SoundParamAccessor* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int out2)
functions.summary: Returns the parameter word from the base sequence (0x660AF8) OR-ed with the value produced by the extension's vtable slot +0x1C, or just the base value when no extension is attached.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqParam_GetRangePair
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Sound_SeqParam_GetRangePair(SoundParamAccessor* accessor, unsigned int paramId, unsigned int* outRange)
functions.summary: Returns the data range pair of a sequence parameter by combining base getter maybe_Sound_Seq_GetDataRange with extension vtable slot +0x28.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetVoiceParams
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqParam_GetVoiceParams(SoundParamAccessor* self, unsigned int id, SoundVoiceParam* out)
functions.summary: Fills a voice-parameter block (ids, flags and size bytes) from the base sequence (0x660C30) and lets the extension's vtable slot +0x18 overwrite/merge its own values.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_UpdateTracks
functions.signature: u32 Sound_ArchiveStream_UpdateTracks(SoundArchiveStream* stream, u32 channel, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Refreshes an archive sound stream: resolves the per-channel track entry and, when the optional channel object exists and is enabled, forwards the update to its virtual +0x20 with the caller's arguments, OR-ing both results.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetEntryTriple
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqParam_GetEntryTriple(SoundParamAccessor* self, u32 id, u32 out2)
functions.summary: Resolves a sequence-parameter entry: reads the base entry from the sequence object at self+4 (maybe_Sound_Seq_GetEntryPairBase) and ORs it with the attached extension's virtual slot +0x38 when the extension is enabled.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqParam_ApplyTimestamp
functions.summary: Reads the 64-bit track offset from the base sequence object via maybe_Sound_Seq_GetTrackOffsetBase and forwards it to enabled extension vtable slot +0x50.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_OpenRelativeFile
functions.signature: void Sound_ArchiveStream_OpenRelativeFile(SoundArchive* ar, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, const char* name, u64 offset, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: Resolves a relative member name against the archive's stored base directory (prefix at +0xC) and forwards the open to the archive virtual +0x14. The combined path is capped at 255 characters and absolute names (starting with '/') bypass the prefix.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqParam_GetTrackEventA
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_SeqParam_GetTrackEventA(SoundSeqParam* self, u32 trackIndex, u32 eventId)
functions.summary: Combines track descriptor event from base reader Sound_SeqTrack_ReadDescriptorA with enabled extension vtable slot +0x40.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetWaveRef
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqParam_GetWaveRef(SoundParamAccessor* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int out2)
functions.summary: Resolves a wave reference for a sequence parameter: takes the base reference from the sequence object, and when the extension object exists and is enabled, merges in its vtable+0x2C result.

functions.name: Sound_Wave_LookupEntry
functions.signature: int Sound_Wave_LookupEntry(SoundWaveTable* table, u32 waveId, u32* out)
functions.summary: Resolves a wave ID through the inner wave table (calling Sound_Wave_GetDataAddress), and if found and an active extension resolver is attached at table+8, invokes its virtual slot +0x30 to fill or adjust the output entry descriptor. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetTrackKind
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqParam_GetTrackKind(SoundParamAccessor* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int out2)
functions.summary: Returns the track-kind parameter block of the base sequence (value, offset, size byte, flag byte) merged with the extension's vtable slot +0x3C.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetTrackChannel
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqParam_GetTrackChannel(SoundParamAccessor* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int out2)
functions.summary: Returns the track/channel assignment {id, value, byte, flag} of the base sequence (0x660D5C, which only answers for entry kind 3) merged with the extension's vtable slot +0x48.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetPointerTriple
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqParam_GetPointerTriple(SoundParamAccessor* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int out2)
functions.summary: Returns a {word, word, address} triple for a sequence parameter (the base 0x660DC8 resolves an in-record offset to a pointer) merged with the extension's vtable slot +0x24.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_GetTrackInfo
functions.summary: Fills the caller's track-info block: reads the per-track header through 0x661324 for the stream's current record and, when the stream has an extra track object, lets its virtual +0x34 add the remaining fields. Returns non-zero when anything was written.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqParam_GetTrackEventB
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_SeqParam_GetTrackEventB(SoundSeqParam* self, u32 trackIndex, u32 eventId)
functions.summary: Combines track descriptor event from base reader Sound_SeqTrack_ReadDescriptorB with enabled extension vtable slot +0x44.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_OnEvent
functions.summary: Event dispatcher for a sequence player: first offers the event to the child object at +0x21C, then to the shared forwarder 0x00660414 on self+0xC, and only if neither handles it calls the class virtual +0x10. The standard chain-of-responsibility used by the sound players.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_GetVoiceSlotSize
functions.summary: Returns the size in bytes of the voice-slot table: 4 * 0x00660A78() + 4 (a count word followed by 4-byte slots). Used by the allocator that builds the sequence player voice array.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_CalcDecodeMemorySize
functions.signature: u32 Sound_ArchiveStream_CalcDecodeMemorySize(SoundArchiveStream* stream, u32 memberId, int extraPerChannel)
functions.summary: Computes the exact heap block size needed to decode one archive member: 0x5C-byte per-track records plus per-track sample buffers (0x40 header + aligned data), then the fixed per-channel tables (0x88/0x2D8/0x1E8/0x4C and 0x138) and an optional per-channel extra. Everything is 0x20-aligned, matching the allocator used by Sound_StreamPlayer_Setup.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_CalcAdpcmMemorySize
functions.summary: Returns the DSP-ADPCM sample buffer size for a member: the per-channel sample count from the track info multiplied by 0xA000 (the fixed ADPCM frame allocation).

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_GetChannelCount
functions.summary: Returns the channel/track count of a stream member from its track-info block, falling back to 1 when the block cannot be read.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_ReadFieldE
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_ReadFieldE(u32 infoBlock, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Reads a byte-sized field (default 0x40) from the wave info block at given offset via func_00661534 (tag 2); feeds output +0x0E in Sound_WaveInfo_ReadHeader.

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_ReadChannelConfig
functions.signature: void Sound_WaveInfo_ReadChannelConfig(u32 infoBlock, u8* outChannelCount, u8* outArray, u32 count)
functions.summary: Reads channel configuration from the wave info block via tag 8 (default 0x7F) and unpacks per-channel 2-byte descriptors into output buffers.

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_ReadDataPointer
functions.signature: int Sound_WaveInfo_ReadDataPointer(u32 infoBlock, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Resolves sample data pointer from the wave info block: queries 32-bit relative offset tag 9 and returns base + offset + *(int*)(base + offset + 4), or default 0x007B0048.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_ReadFieldF
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_ReadFieldF(u32 infoBlock, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Reads high byte of 16-bit tagged field (tag 2) from wave info block; feeds output byte +0x0F in Sound_WaveInfo_ReadHeader.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_ReadField4
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_ReadField4(u32 infoBlock, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Reads third byte of tagged field (tag 2) from wave info block; feeds output byte +0x10 (out[4]) in Sound_WaveInfo_ReadHeader.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_ReadFieldA
functions.signature: int maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_ReadFieldA(u32 infoBlock, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Reads signed byte from second byte of tag-0 field in wave info block; feeds output byte +0x0A in Sound_WaveInfo_ReadHeader.

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_ReadFormat
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveInfo_ReadFormat(u32 infoBlock, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Reads wave sample encoding format byte (tag 0, default 0x40) from wave info block; feeds format byte at out+9 in Sound_WaveInfo_ReadHeader.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetPointerByTag
functions.signature: void* Sound_SeqField_GetPointerByTag(SoundSeqRecord* rec, unsigned int fieldOffset, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Resolves a relative wave/sample pointer from tag 9 in the sequence record sub-table, returning base+offset+*(offset+4) or default 0x0065ECA8.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault40
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault40(SoundSeqRecord* rec, unsigned int fieldOffset, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads byte 0 from tag 2 of the sequence voice record sub-table, returning value & 0xFF or default 0x40.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi(SoundSeqRecord* rec, unsigned int fieldOffset, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads byte 1 from tag 2 of the sequence voice record sub-table, returning (value & 0xFFFF) >> 8 or 0 if tag is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault40B
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault40B(SoundSeqRecord* rec, unsigned int fieldOffset, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads byte 2 from tag 2 of the sequence voice record sub-table, returning (value & 0xFFFFFF) >> 16 or default 0x40.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault60
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault60(SoundSeqRecord* rec, unsigned int fieldOffset, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads byte 3 from tag 2 of the sequence voice record sub-table, returning (value >> 24) & 0xFF or default 0x60.

functions.name: Sound_SeqVoice_FillDescriptor
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqVoice_FillDescriptor(SoundSeqVoice* self, SoundVoiceDescriptor* out, int trackIndex, unsigned int rowIndex, unsigned int subIndex)
functions.summary: Resolves (track,row,sub) through three nested table lookups and fills a 0x17-word voice descriptor: the record id pair, the detune/volume floats, the six parameter bytes and the sample pointer, using the pre-packed record at 0x00663018 when available and the individual accessors otherwise.

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_ParseFormat
functions.summary: Parses the CWAV INFO block into a per-channel playback record: copies the sample rate/loop/format words and, for each of up to two channels, copies a 0x26-byte ADPCM coefficient set and stores the resolved data pointer and size at 0x30-byte stride.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_ArchiveStream_GetTrackField
functions.summary: Reads one type-1 field of the stream's track descriptor through the shared tagged-field lookup 0x00661534 on stream+4 and returns the value, or 0 when the field cannot be resolved.

functions.name: Sound_SeqResource_ResolveId
functions.signature: int Sound_SeqResource_ResolveId(SoundSeqResource* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Resolves a packed (table<<24 | index) id against the six sub-tables of a sequence resource and returns the field selected by `index` inside the record (via 0x00661534), or -1 when the table, the record or the field does not exist.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off08
functions.summary: Reads the low byte of the type-0 field in the sub-table at rec+8 through the shared tagged-field lookup 0x00661534, defaulting to 0x40 when the field is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off08
functions.summary: Reads bits 8..15 of the type-0 field in the sub-table at rec+8 through 0x00661534, returning 0 when the field is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetValue_Off08
functions.summary: Reads the full type-1 word of the sub-table at rec+8 through 0x00661534, returning 0 when the field is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetValue_Off0C
functions.summary: Reads the full type-0 word of the sub-table at rec+0xC through 0x00661534, returning 0 when the field is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off0C
functions.summary: Reads the low byte of the type-1 field in the sub-table at rec+0xC through 0x00661534, defaulting to 0x40 when the field is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetFlag_Off0C
functions.summary: Boolean accessor on the sub-table at rec+0xC: returns 0 when the field is absent or its high byte is zero, otherwise 1.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetWord18
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetWord18(SoundSeqField* self, u32 arg2, u32 key, u32 defaultValue)
functions.summary: Reads a 32-bit sequence field through the table accessor 0x00661534 at self+0x18, returning defaultValue when the field is absent. One of four typed field getters (+0x18 base, two word slots and two byte slots).

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetWord18B
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetWord18B(SoundSeqField* self, u32 arg2, u32 key, u32 defaultValue)
functions.summary: Word getter on the sequence field table at self+0x18: fetches accessor type 1 into the default and returns it (0 when the field is absent).

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByte18
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByte18(SoundSeqField* self, u32 arg2, u32 key, u32 defaultValue)
functions.summary: Byte getter for the sequence field table at self+0x18: returns defaultValue when the field is missing, otherwise the low byte of the stored value.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_TestByte18
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_SeqField_TestByte18(SoundSeqField* field, u32 arg2, u32 key, u32 defaultValue)
functions.summary: Field test on sequence record +0x18: reads accessor tag 0 via func_00661534 and returns 1 if present and (value & 0xFFFF) >> 8 equals 1, otherwise 0.
