functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off14
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off14(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads low byte of tag-1 field on +0x14 sub-table via func_00661534, returning 0 when absent; feeds voice param byte at out+5 in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off14
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off14(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads high byte of tag-1 field on +0x14 sub-table via func_00661534, returning 0 when absent; feeds voice param byte at +0x15 in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetInt_Off14
functions.summary: Reads the type-0x1F integer of the sub-table at rec+0x14 through 0x00661534, returning 0xFFFFFFFF when the field is absent.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetFlagBit0_Off14
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetFlagBit0_Off14(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads tag-0x11 field on +0x14 sub-table and returns bit 0 boolean flag, or 0 when absent; feeds voice param byte at +0x16 in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetPointer_Off14
functions.summary: Resolves a type-8 relative pointer inside the sub-table at rec+0x14 (result = stored offset + rec, without the extra dereference of the type-9 variant), returning 0 when the field is absent.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off14B
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off14B(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads high byte of tag-2 field on +0x14 sub-table via func_00661534, returning 0 when absent; feeds voice param word at out[2] in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off14B
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off14B(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Reads byte of tag-2 field on +0x14 sub-table, defaulting to 0x40 when absent; feeds voice param word at out[3] in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_FindRecordByName
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqParam_FindRecordByName(SoundSeqParam* self, const char* name, u32* outValue)
functions.summary: Name lookup in the sequence parameter table: treats self as a count word followed by (offset,value) pairs, compares name with the string at pair+0xc via 0x00123660, and returns the pair value through outValue. Used to resolve named sound parameters.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_Open
functions.signature: int Sound_ArchiveStream_Open(SoundArchiveStream* stream, u32 pathHandle, u32 size, u32 arg4, int seekPos, int arg6, int mode)
functions.summary: Opens one member of a sound archive stream: validates the stream state byte (+0x190) and the minimum size (0x7C), creates the archive file object (0x548488), seeks to the member start (0x548218 with seek positions -0x10/-8/+8 depending on the mode), then attaches the read/write buffers via 0x5496EC/0x549504.

functions.name: Sound_SeqParam_NotifyChange
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqParam_NotifyChange(SoundParamOwner* self, unsigned int id)
functions.summary: Dispatches a parameter-change notification by the id's high byte (1 = voice params, 3 = header word, 5 = wave ref, 6 = range pair) and lets the owner's vtable slot +0x10 react when the parameter exists.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetVoiceSlot
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_Seq_GetVoiceSlot(SoundParamOwner* self, SoundVoiceSlot* out, unsigned int trackIndex, unsigned int rowIndex)
functions.summary: Resolves the voice slot for a (track, row) pair: walks the sequence's track and row tables, bounds-checks the slot index and fills the output descriptor (two table words, a float, a tag pointer and four bytes) from the field accessors.

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_ReadHeader
functions.signature: u32 Sound_WaveInfo_ReadHeader(SoundCwavInfo* info, u32* out, u32 channel)
functions.summary: Reads the CWAV wave header for one channel into out, extracting sample format, channel config, data pointer, and volume parameters.

functions.name: Sound_Stream_ReadBlockAt
functions.signature: bool Sound_Stream_ReadBlockAt(SoundStreamHandle* self, void* dst, int blockIndex)
functions.summary: Seeks the underlying sound stream to blockIndex * blockSize + baseOffset (vtable +0x40) and reads exactly 0x100 bytes into dst (vtable +0x24); returns true only when the full block was read.

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_CopyDescriptor
functions.summary: Copies the 0x4C-byte wave descriptor (format bytes, sample rate, loop points, channel pointers) from the loaded wave info into the caller's buffer, with two fields swapped depending on a format-version constant (g_00660864).

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_CopySubBlock
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_WaveInfo_CopySubBlock(SoundParamOwner* self, unsigned char* out, int index)
functions.summary: Copies one variable-length sub-block of the wave info: 4 header bytes plus between 0 and 2 payload bytes taken from the length-prefixed area at header+8.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_GetSubBlockPair
functions.signature: bool maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_GetSubBlockPair(SoundParamOwner* owner, void* outBlock, void* outPointer, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Fetches and copies a 0x26-byte sub-block from the sound parameter object into outA and copies the subsequent pointer into outB, returning true if found.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_GetMemberOffset
functions.signature: int Sound_ArchiveStream_GetMemberOffset(StreamMember* self, int index, int base)
functions.summary: Computes the byte offset of member `index` in a sound archive stream: base + 8 + the member size word plus the archive header size from 0x0065F3C0. Used to position the stream reader on a member.

functions.name: Sound_Resource_CheckMagic
functions.summary: Verifies that the sound resource carries the expected magic word at the offset described by its own header (0x0065F420), returning 1 when it matches g_00660A34 and 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_GetChannelDataOffset
functions.summary: Calculates the data block byte offset for a channel within a CWAV info structure.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetPointerValueA
functions.summary: Returns the first word of the sub-table reached from self+0x3C through the relative-offset resolver 0x0065FB98 (self->f_3C + *(u32*)(self->f_3C + 0x34)). One of three pointer-getter variants that differ only in which sub-table they resolve.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_ResolveRecord
functions.summary: Returns a pointer to the record selected by the sequence's current id: resolves the id through 0x0065F87C, adds the record's own relative offset at +4 and then the entry offset at +8.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_NotifyChange
functions.summary: If the sequence-field sub-object at self+0x3C resolves through 0x0065F678, calls the record-kind getter 0x0065FF20 and discards the result. The 'notify' wording is only the previous guess: the body is a resolve-then-query pair with no visible side effect.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetHeaderWord
functions.signature: bool Sound_Seq_GetHeaderWord(SoundSeqData* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int* out)
functions.summary: Reads the first parameter word from the sequence record resolved by 0x0065F5D4, returning true if present.

functions.name: Sound_Wave_GetDataAddress
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Wave_GetDataAddress(SoundWaveTable* table, u32 waveId, u32* out)
functions.summary: Resolves where a wave's sample data lives: finds the entry and, depending on its storage kind, returns the embedded address/size pair or the streamed address; 0 when the wave is unavailable.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Seq_GetDataRange
functions.signature: u32 maybe_Sound_Seq_GetDataRange(SoundSeqData* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int** out)
functions.summary: Resolves the {pointer, length} range of a sequence entry: stores the entry id through out, then depending on the entry kind stores either the raw u32 at +8 (kind 0), clears the second word (kind 1) or reports failure (kind 2).

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase(SoundSeqData* self, unsigned int id, SoundVoiceParam* out)
functions.summary: Populates the voice parameter block from the base sequence record selected by 0x0065F678.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetPointerValueB
functions.summary: Second pointer-getter variant: returns the first word of the sub-table reached from self+0x3C through the relative-offset resolver 0x0065FBB0 (self->f_3C + *(u32*)(self->f_3C + 0x2C)).

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_GetTrackEntry
functions.signature: bool Sound_ArchiveStream_GetTrackEntry(SoundArchiveStream* stream, u32 arg2, u32* outEntry)
functions.summary: Queries the track entry at stream->f_3C via func_0065F840; on success writes the entry word and track field (via maybe_Sound_ArchiveStream_GetTrackField) into out and returns true.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetEntryPairBase
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_Seq_GetEntryPairBase(SoundSeqData* seqData, unsigned int id, unsigned int* outPair)
functions.summary: Base implementation of entry-pair query: locates record selected by func_0065F678, retrieves pointer via tag 8, and copies id, value, and flags into out, returning 1 on success.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Seq_GetTrackOffsetBase
functions.summary: Base implementation of the timestamp query: resolves the record through 0x0065F678 and tail-jumps into Sound_SeqField_GetInt_Off14, so the caller receives the record's +0x14 integer (0xFFFFFFFF when absent).

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetTrackChannelBase
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_Seq_GetTrackChannelBase(SoundSeqData* seqData, unsigned int id, unsigned int* outTrackChannel)
functions.summary: Base implementation of track-channel query: verifies record kind equals 3 via func_0065FF20 and extracts track ID, value, byte and nonzero flag into out, returning 1 on success.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetPointerPairBase
functions.signature: bool Sound_Seq_GetPointerPairBase(SoundSeqData* seqData, unsigned int id, unsigned int* outPointers)
functions.summary: Base implementation of pointer-triple query: extracts two header words from sequence record via func_0065FABC and computes relative pointer base + offset at +0xC, returning true on success.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetPointerValueC
functions.summary: Third pointer-getter variant: returns the first word of the sub-table reached from self+0x3C through the relative-offset resolver 0x0065FBC8 (self->f_3C + *(u32*)(self->f_3C + 0x1C)).

functions.name: Sound_SeqTrack_ReadDescriptorA
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqTrack_ReadDescriptorA(SoundSeqParam* self, u32 version, SoundTrackDesc* out)
functions.summary: Decodes a sequence track descriptor: for format versions around g_006610A0/A4 it fetches the track record and fills up to four 0xd-byte slot descriptors (u16 ids, RGBA bytes, key table pointers) plus the track header fields, selecting legacy or extended fields by version. Used by the sequence player to build its voice table.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetWaveRefBase
functions.signature: bool Sound_Seq_GetWaveRefBase(SoundSeqData* seqData, unsigned int id, unsigned int* outWaveRef)
functions.summary: Base implementation of wave reference query: extracts wave ID word, type-1 value via maybe_Sound_SeqField_GetValue_Off08, and byte flag from sequence record into out, returning true on success.

functions.name: Sound_SeqTrack_ReadDescriptorB
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqTrack_ReadDescriptorB(SoundSeqParam* self, u32 version, u8* out)
functions.summary: Compact variant of the track descriptor reader: writes the enable byte, a 32-bit value at +4 and a 32-bit value at +8, using the same version threshold g_006611A4 and the same legacy/extended record selection.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_FindEventOffset
functions.summary: Resolves a tagged sequence event (high byte 1, 2 or 3) to the byte offset of its payload: variant 2 looks up a sub-record, variant 3 a wave entry, and variant 1 scans the event table for a range containing the id. Returns 0 when not found.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetTrackKindBase
functions.signature: unsigned int Sound_Seq_GetTrackKindBase(SoundSeqData* seqData, unsigned int id, unsigned int* outTrackKind)
functions.summary: Base implementation of track kind query: verifies record kind equals 1 via func_0065FF20 and copies record value, size, byte and flag into out, returning 1 on success.

functions.name: Sound_ArchiveStream_GetTrackHeader
functions.summary: Reads the eight u16 track-header fields for the stream into the caller's array (widened to u32), forcing the last field to 1 when the stream version is below the header version.

functions.name: Sound_WaveInfo_CopyHeaderFixed
functions.summary: Copies the fixed 0x4C-byte wave-info header to the caller and always reports success.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_GetEntryPairByIndex
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Seq_GetEntryPairByIndex(SoundParamOwner* self, u32* out, int index)
functions.summary: Copies the first two words of entry `index` from the owner's 0x14-stride table (base at self+8) into out[0..1] and appends the value from 0x00661474 into out[2], returning 1.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_GetSubBlockPairAlt
functions.signature: bool maybe_Sound_WaveInfo_GetSubBlockPairAlt(SoundParamOwner* owner, void* outBlock, void* outPointer, unsigned int index)
functions.summary: Byte-identical twin of 0x0066092C: copies a 0x26-byte sub-block from the sound parameter object into outA and following pointer into outB; reached from MIDI event dispatch.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Stats_SumPending
functions.summary: Sums the integer counter at node-0x14 over an intrusive list, under the sound driver's monitor lock, and returns the total. Callers use it both from the frame profiler and from the sequence-player active-note update, i.e. it counts queued sound work.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_GetPlaybackInfo
functions.summary: Copies the player's current playback state (byte +0x90 plus the three position/count words +0x8C/+0x94/+0x98) into the caller's record under the driver lock; returns 1 when playing, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Sound_SeqPlayer_GetPosition
functions.summary: Returns one of the player's two playback positions under the driver lock: -1 when the player is not open, 0 when it is open but not playing, otherwise f_78 (which != 0) or f_74.

functions.name: Sound_Voice_CreateFromSeqRecord
functions.signature: SoundVoice* Sound_Voice_CreateFromSeqRecord(unsigned int owner, unsigned int accessor, SoundParamOwner* seq, unsigned int* args)
functions.summary: Starts a sequence voice: resolves the note row through 0x0065EDE0, looks up the wave/sample header, parses its format with 0x0065EF6C, allocates the voice with 0x00555E38 (top 2 channels) and then sets pitch, volume, pan, priority and sample pointers through the 0x0054xxxx sound-track helpers before starting the note (0x005561BC).

functions.name: Sound_Seq_ExecuteChannelCommand
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Seq_ExecuteChannelCommand(u32 arg1, int channel, u32 value, u32 volume, u16 arg5)
functions.summary: Executes one sequence command against a channel: a large switch over the command byte (0x80..0xCC and the 0xB0/0xC0 ranges) applies the operands to the channel's volume/pan/tune/envelope fields, calls the var-length reader for operands and the note start/stop helpers for the note commands.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_Seq_ExecuteChannelCommand_Tail
functions.summary: Continuation fragment inside Sound_Seq_ExecuteChannelCommand (0x00661974) resulting from Ghidra disassembling an ARM switch tail as Thumb.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_NoteOnThunk
functions.signature: void Sound_Seq_NoteOnThunk(u32 arg1, SoundSeqChannel* channel, u32 note, u32 velocity, u32 duration, u32 reuse)
functions.summary: Six-argument thunk that drops its first argument and forwards the rest straight to Sound_SeqChannel_StartNote; it exists so the sequencer can call the note starter through a uniform function-pointer signature.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_StepVoiceTrack
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Seq_StepVoiceTrack(int* cursor, SeqTrack* track, int mode)
functions.summary: Steps one track of a sequence: reads the next opcode from the track's byte stream (with the 0xA2..0xA5 extended prefixes), decodes its operands with Sound_Seq_ReadVarLenArg and dispatches note/parameter commands to the player vtable, returning 1 at the 0xFF end-of-track marker.

functions.name: Sound_Seq_ReadVarLenArg
functions.signature: u32 Sound_Seq_ReadVarLenArg(u32 arg1, u32* cursor, u32 b, u32 c, u32 kind)
functions.summary: Reads a variable-width operand from a sequence byte stream: kind 1 = u8, 2 = big-endian u16, 3 = 7-bit varint chain (continuation bit 0x80), 4/5 = wider fixed forms. Returns the decoded value and advances the cursor.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off04
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off04(SoundSeqRecord* rec, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 index)
functions.summary: Reads accessor type 4 from the field table at rec+4 and returns the high byte of the 16-bit value (0 when absent).

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetPointerByTag_Off04
functions.signature: void* Sound_SeqField_GetPointerByTag_Off04(SoundSeqRecord* rec, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 index)
functions.summary: Chases a relative pointer stored under accessor type 9 in the field table at rec+4: returns rec+offset+*(offset+4), or the shared default at 0x007B003C when the field is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault3C
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault3C(SoundSeqRecord* rec, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 index)
functions.summary: Byte getter (accessor type 0) on the field table at rec+4, defaulting to 0x3C when the field is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetFlag_Off04
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetFlag_Off04(SoundSeqRecord* rec, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 index)
functions.summary: Boolean field (accessor type 4 on rec+4): returns 1 when the field exists and its low byte is non-zero, else 0.

functions.name: m210b
functions.signature: u32 m210b(int arg1, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off04
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off04(SoundSeqRecord* rec, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 index)
functions.summary: Byte getter (accessor type 2) on the field table at rec+4, defaulting to 0x40 when the field is absent.

functions.name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault7F
functions.signature: u32 Sound_SeqField_GetByteDefault7F(SoundSeqRecord* rec, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 index)
functions.summary: Byte getter (accessor type 1) on the field table at rec+4, defaulting to 0x7F (the usual velocity/volume maximum) when the field is absent.

functions.name: maybe_Anim_Timeline_Advance
functions.summary: Advances an animation/interpolation timeline step; invokes type-indexed callback from table 0x007E8120 when current time reaches limit, returning scaled float in s0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Element_GetSlotIntValue
functions.summary: Calls virtual slot +0x0C of the element interface stored at self+0x24 and returns its integer result converted to float. The decompiled body drops the float return; the call and the VectorSignedToFloat conversion are visible.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Element_GetMetricA
functions.summary: Calls virtual slot +0x14 of the element interface at self+0x24 and returns the resulting float metric in VFP register s0.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Element_GetScaledHeight
functions.summary: Returns the element's vertical extent: calls virtual slot +0x10 of the interface at self+0x24 and multiplies the integer result by the holder's vertical scale at self+0x0C. The caller adds the value to the rect's y to form y1, so the result is a height, not an abstract metric.

functions.name: std_CopyBlock64
functions.summary: Copies a fixed 64-byte block with the optimised memcpy (0x00116C10) and returns dst+0x40 so callers can chain writes into a packed structure.

functions.name: Font_Atlas_GetGlyphPage
functions.summary: Font atlas virtual slot 0: asks the concrete atlas (virtual +0x40) for the packed glyph record and extracts the page index from bits 16..23. Two atlas implementations share this vtable shape at 0x00781DF0 and 0x00781F54.

functions.name: Font_Atlas_FindGlyphCell
functions.summary: Font atlas virtual slot 1: resolves a character code to a glyph cell by walking the range list at self->f_c->f_10 (ranges of u16 pairs, 3 bytes per glyph). Returns the 3-byte cell record or the atlas default cell when the code is 0xffff.

functions.name: Font_Atlas_BuildGlyphQuad
functions.signature: void Font_Atlas_BuildGlyphQuad(FontAtlas* self, GlyphQuad* out, u32 charCode)
functions.summary: Font atlas virtual slot 2: maps a character code to a cell and fills the 0x14-byte quad descriptor (texture offset, page, glyph width/height, UV scale and pointer to the atlas), including the lookup through the range list. Used by the text renderer for each glyph.

functions.name: Font_Atlas_BuildGlyphQuadDirect
functions.signature: void Font_Atlas_BuildGlyphQuadDirect(FontAtlas* self, GlyphQuad* out, u32 charCode)
functions.summary: Same quad builder as 0x00663714 but without the range-list search: it treats the argument as an already resolved glyph index. Used where the caller has just searched the atlas.

functions.name: Gfx_AtlasPage_GetSize
functions.summary: Fills a {0, width, height} triple: when the cell source's virtual +0x50 reports layout kind 1, the width and height come from the global atlas page descriptor at 0x0073BAE4 (+0x18/+0x1C); otherwise the triple stays zero.

functions.name: Font_Atlas_GetCellAt
functions.signature: unsigned char Font_Atlas_GetCellAt(AtlasPageSet* set, AtlasPage* page, int layer, unsigned int x, unsigned int y)
functions.summary: Samples one byte of an atlas page grid at pixel (x,y). It computes the cell address from the page's own scale/offset fields (u16 at +0x10..+0x16 divided by the record's +0x2C/+0x2E), bounds-checks it against the page rectangle (u16 at +8/+0xA and +0xC/+0xE) and returns the byte at that cell, or 0xFF when the coordinate is outside.

functions.name: Font_GetGlyphCell
functions.signature: int Font_GetGlyphCell(GlyphPageSet* pages, int page, GlyphLayout* layout, int subPage, int x, int y)
functions.summary: Maps a pixel offset to the 6-byte glyph cell entry of a font atlas page: when the page is already linearised it uses the row stride table, otherwise it computes the sub-cell indices through func_0011CD80 and validates the cell rectangle.

functions.name: Font_GetGlyphQuadUV
functions.signature: void Font_GetGlyphQuadUV(GlyphPageSet* pages, int page, short* u, short* v, int glyphIndex)
functions.summary: Fills the four U and V texture coordinates of one glyph, applying the eight rotation/flip cases encoded in the glyph entry's bits 9..11.

functions.name: Text_BuildCharTransform
functions.signature: float* Text_BuildCharTransform(TextRenderer* self, u32 charIndex, GlyphEntry* glyph, u32 styleId, float* out, int second, float* uvOut)
functions.summary: Builds the per-character 3x4 transform (and the optional 16-float UV quad) used to draw one glyph, applying the active rotation/scale/skew style and the glyph's 0x14-byte cell from the font table; returns the next free output pointer.

functions.name: maybe_Text_BuildCharTransform_Tail
functions.summary: Continuation fragment / mid-function tail of Text_BuildCharTransform (0x00663FB8); stores character transform quad registers.

functions.name: Model_Node_ComposeMatrix
functions.signature: void Model_Node_ComposeMatrix(ModelNode* self, float* outMatrix, float* outProjection)
functions.summary: Composes a node's 3x4 world matrix from its rotation data: mode 0 makes a look-at basis from the node's forward vector, mode 1 uses forward plus a reference up vector, mode 2 builds it from Euler angles with sin/cos; also emits the projection matrix when asked.

functions.name: Container_HashMap_FindByKey
functions.signature: void* Container_HashMap_FindByKey(u32* key, u32 keyLen, u32 arg3, u32 seed)
functions.summary: Looks an object up in the global hash map by a 0x40-byte key: hashes the first word, walks the bucket's intrusive list and compares the stored 16-word key with memcmp.

functions.name: Font_GetGlyphClass
functions.signature: unsigned char Font_GetGlyphClass(TextBlock* block, int x, int y)
functions.summary: Translates a local pixel position inside a text block into the 5-bit glyph class of the character covering it, or 0xFF when the position is outside or ambiguous.

functions.name: Font_Atlas_GetGlyphCellByte
functions.summary: Returns one byte of the current glyph-atlas page for a glyph code: initialises the 0x1348-byte global page table once, picks the active page (optionally indirected through +0xF84 when +0xFE4 is set), converts the code to a cell and samples the page grid with Font_Atlas_GetCellAt; 0xFF when the page or cell is missing.

functions.name: Font_Atlas_LookupCell
functions.signature: unsigned Font_Atlas_LookupCell(FontAtlas* atlas, unsigned x, unsigned y, unsigned unusedD)
functions.summary: Resolves the glyph/character cell value at pixel (x,y) of the current atlas page, returning 0xFF when the atlas has no page or the cell does not exist.

functions.name: Font_GetGlyphAdvance
functions.summary: Returns the horizontal advance of a glyph (falling back to 0x80) by looking the glyph up in the current atlas page.

functions.name: maybe_Font_Atlas_FindPageForGlyph
functions.signature: void maybe_Font_Atlas_FindPageForGlyph(FontAtlasSet* self, u32 target, char* outPage, u8* outCell)
functions.summary: Selects the page and cell whose stored byte is the nearest value at or below target (ties keep the current best), scanning every page's eleven values; with no pages it returns page 0 / cell 10 untouched.

functions.name: Font_MapCharToGlyph
functions.signature: int Font_MapCharToGlyph(FontMap* self, int charCode, u32 style)
functions.summary: Maps a character code to a glyph id through the atlas at self+4: applies the optional remap table at self+0x34 when flag +0x94 is set, then resolves the cell (0x006638D8) and the glyph (0x00663FAC). Returns 0x80 (the fallback glyph) on failure.

functions.name: Math_Obb_ContainsPoint
functions.signature: int Math_Obb_ContainsPoint(const float* obb, const float* point)
functions.summary: Tests a world point against an oriented box: the box stores centre (+0x10), inverted-free quaternion (+0x00) and half extents (+0x1C), so the point is transformed into box space and compared against the extents.

functions.name: Math_TransformOffsetPoint
functions.signature: void Math_TransformOffsetPoint(float* out, const float* record)
functions.summary: Rotates the local offset stored at record+0x0C by the record's quaternion and adds it to the record's base position, producing a world point.

functions.name: Math_BuildCombinedBounds
functions.summary: Builds the combined bounding volume of an object by unioning, in order, a set of spheres (centre+radius), oriented boxes (converted with 0x00574484 and offset by their own extents) and axis-aligned boxes (0x00573B6C), then writes the min/max corners, the centre and a radius computed from the half-extent diagonal. When bit 1 of +0x60 is clear it simply forwards to the cached bounds at self+0x10.

functions.name: Model_ComputeAttachmentAnchor
functions.signature: void Model_ComputeAttachmentAnchor(ActorView* view, float* outPos, float* outDir)
functions.summary: Computes the world anchor point and facing direction of a model attachment from the camera forward vector, the node matrix, the node offset and the two camera transition targets, clamping the height to the configured band.

functions.name: maybe_Field_IsUiMode9
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the field work and the overlay manager both exist and the UI mode byte (overlay+0x281) is 9; otherwise 0.

functions.name: Field_CheckCameraOcclusionGate
functions.summary: Combines three gates into one answer: the player-state allow table, the work's two mode bytes and Camera_IsPlayerViewClear(owner); returns non-zero only when all three pass.

functions.name: maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVectorD
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVectorD(void* owner, const float* from, int unusedA, int unusedB)
functions.summary: Duplicate of maybe_Field_InterpolateOwnerVector: interpolates the owner's +0x48 vector toward `from` with mode 0. Slot 13 of a 24-slot vtable.

functions.name: Camera_IsPlayerViewClear
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the player's position is clear for the camera: not inside an occluder, not blocked by the field collision, the camera projection accepts the point and the owner's virtual validator (or the object table) confirms it.

functions.name: maybe_Node_ComputeAttachedTransform
functions.signature: void maybe_Node_ComputeAttachedTransform(float* out, void* node, float* params)
functions.summary: Computes the transform of an object attached to a scene node: copies the parameter point, rotates the node basis (Math_TransformOffsetPoint), probes along the result with Gfx_Scene_FindEntriesAlongLine and writes the entry-relative position plus its base translation.

functions.name: Text_Style_IsPlainRecord
functions.signature: unsigned char Text_Style_IsPlainRecord(StyleOwner* self, unsigned int id, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Checks if the text style is plain (style byte == 1 when unlinked, or SkillRecord category byte +0xDC == 0).

functions.name: Text_Style_MatchesId
functions.summary: Style predicate: when the text owner has no record id it compares its stored style id directly; otherwise it maps the record's flag byte (1 -> id 2, 0 -> id 1) and tests the requested id.

functions.name: Text_Style_IsSpecialKind
functions.signature: unsigned int Text_Style_IsSpecialKind(StyleOwner* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Checks if the text style belongs to special kinds 8..11 or SkillRecord category +0xDC == 5.

functions.name: Ui_SelectHighestVariantCode
functions.summary: Queries UI object child via vtable+0x48 and tests variant codes 0x89..0x8F via vtable+0xE8, returning the first matching code or 0x88.

functions.name: Data_IsRecordOrderLess
functions.signature: bool Data_IsRecordOrderLess(unsigned int ignored, unsigned int idA, unsigned int idB, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Sort predicate over the data tables: looks both ids up with 0x0063DED4 and compares their sort byte at +0xB, returning true when A sorts before B.

functions.name: maybe_Data_ValidateGroupSlots
functions.signature: unsigned int maybe_Data_ValidateGroupSlots(char* groups, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Validates a group table: for every group it checks that none of the declared slots still holds the 0xFF 'unset' sentinel, returning 0 as soon as an unset slot is found (used to decide whether a recipe/party group is complete).

functions.name: Data_IsLastGroupIndex
functions.signature: unsigned int Data_IsLastGroupIndex(char* group, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the slot index stored at group+9 is the last slot of the table referenced by the id at group+8 (both must be set, i.e. not 0xFF).

functions.name: Data_FindIdByName
functions.signature: int Data_FindIdByName(DataOwner* self, const char* name)
functions.summary: Hashes the name (multiply/xor rolling hash) and scans the owner's name table (8-byte entries: hash + u16 id) for a matching hash and equal string, returning the stored 16-bit id or -1.

functions.name: Anim_IsInstanceBusy
functions.summary: Returns 1 while an animation instance still has work: true when the playhead has not reached the end time, or when any type-1 node still has active sub-animations/tracks.

functions.name: maybe_Work_GetIdValueIfAtLeast
functions.signature: u8 maybe_Work_GetIdValueIfAtLeast(u32 arg1, u8* query, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Conditional getter over the per-id 0x14-byte records at (work+0x24A98)+0x2D2D: query[0] is the id (0xFF means none), query[1] the minimum and query[2] the value; returns query[2] when record[id].byte0 >= query[1], else 0.

functions.name: MonsterBook_CompareSortIndex
functions.signature: bool MonsterBook_CompareSortIndex(u32 arg1, u32 lhsId, u32 rhsId, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Ordering predicate for monster-id sorts: resolves both ids through the monster/data table (0x0063E3C8) and returns lhs->+0x11 < rhs->+0x11 (the record's sort index).

functions.name: Skill_CompareSortPriority
functions.signature: int Skill_CompareSortPriority(void* unusedA, void* unusedB, int skillB)
functions.summary: Comparator for skill IDs: resolves SkillRecord for two skills via 0x0018C1B8 and returns 1 if skill A's sort priority key (+0xC2) is less than skill B's.

functions.name: Data_IsRecordSortBefore
functions.signature: unsigned int Data_IsRecordSortBefore(unsigned int ignored, unsigned int idA, unsigned int idB, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Sort predicate over the data tables: compares the sort key at +0x26 of both records (ties broken by id order), returning 1 when A should be listed before B.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Layer_GetField12
functions.summary: Returns byte +0x12 of the layer record at layer->f_04->f_298; the value is compared for equality across the 0x38-byte Field2D layer entries (collision, map build, layer update) and passed to the map-chip code in ResetWalkTrigger.

functions.name: Field2D_Layer_GetKindGroup
functions.summary: Maps the Field2D layer record's type byte (+0x13) to a coarse group: 1 for types 0/1/5, 2 for type 2, 3 for types 3/4/7, 0 otherwise; used by Field2D_Scene_UpdateLayers.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_PushTrailSample
functions.signature: void maybe_Field_Object2D_PushTrailSample(FieldObject2D* self, FieldUnit* unit, TrailHistory** history)
functions.summary: Shifts a 3-entry position/state history down and pushes a new sample from unit->f_4C8 for 2D field object movement trails.

functions.name: Field2D_DecodeChipWallType
functions.signature: void Field2D_DecodeChipWallType(ChipDirection* out, const unsigned* map, const int* cell)
functions.summary: Translates the map chip value (0xB..0x11) at the given cell into a direction/wall descriptor: out[0..1] are cleared and out[2] holds 0..6 for the wall kinds, or 0 for no direction.

functions.name: Data_PureVirtualStub
functions.summary: Unimplemented virtual slot: it builds the trap frame and calls the runtime's fatal handler (0x00100050, marked 'does not return' by Ghidra). Present in the vtable so a missing override fails loudly instead of jumping to garbage.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Object_ApplyAttribute
functions.signature: void maybe_Field2D_Object_ApplyAttribute(u32 ignored, u32 id, u32 arg3, u32 manager)
functions.summary: Resolves the 2D scene object with the given id through the shared scene-sprite context and applies attribute constant 0xC41 to its model part at +0x3C.

functions.name: Gfx_Scene_FindFirstEntryInRect
functions.signature: int Gfx_Scene_FindFirstEntryInRect(void* arg1, const int* pos, const unsigned* size, int listBase, int listCount)
functions.summary: Runs a rectangle query over the scene's 0x24-byte entry table and returns the address of the first matching entry (or the end of the list).

functions.name: Field2D_SpriteBlock_UpdateChipRange
functions.summary: Recomputes the map-chip span covered by a 2D sprite block: sets the block scale, starts the path movement of every 0xE8-stride line entry, converts the left and right edge (centre -2 / +2) into chip ids through Field2D_MapChip_PackLayerChipIds and reports the pair to the block's interface (vtable +0x24).

functions.name: Field2D_MapChip_ResolvePositionAtOffset
functions.signature: void Field2D_MapChip_ResolvePositionAtOffset(Field2DPosition* out, Field2DObject* obj, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Maps an offset along a 2D map object's walk path to a world position: adds the per-offset pixel delta to the object origin, starts the chip walk, traces one ray step and transforms the result; writes chip id, step result and x/y to out, or zeroes it when the trace fails.

functions.name: Field2D_MapChip_MapPointToCell
functions.signature: void Field2D_MapChip_MapPointToCell(Cell* out, Field2DActor* self, unsigned int point)
functions.summary: Maps a scene point to a 2D map cell: clamps it with Field2D_MapChip_GetColumnInfo against the actor's +0x78/+0x7C position and, when the point moved, transforms it through Field2D_Actor_TransformPosition; returns the cell or zero when the transform fails.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Object_NeedsUpdate
functions.summary: Returns 0 only when self->f_88->vt[+0x08](self->f_88, (char*)self + 8) returns 0 and self->f_08->f_B8 passes both idle checks 0x00669B68 (s8_F8 != 0) and 0x00669B7C (u32_138 == 0); otherwise returns 1.

functions.name: Field2D_MapChip_ResolvePositionAtOffsetAlt
functions.signature: void Field2D_MapChip_ResolvePositionAtOffsetAlt(Field2DPosition* out, Field2DObject* obj, u32 offset)
functions.summary: Maps a chip offset to a world position: takes the object's cell position, checks the neighbouring chip, adds the per-offset pixel delta from 0x005C0A30 and transforms the point through Field2D_Actor_TransformPosition; fills x/y or zeroes the output when the neighbour check fails.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_CalcScreenRectA
functions.summary: Computes 2D field object screen-space bounding rectangle using position at (object+8)->+0x78/+0x7C and constant 2x2 extent transformed via func_0031A658.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_CalcScreenRectB
functions.summary: Computes 2D field object screen bounding rectangle using position at (object+4)->+0x78/+0x7C and constant 2x2 extent transformed via func_0031A658.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Scene_GetStyleByte18
functions.summary: Getter for the byte at +0x18 of the style/theme record reached through self+4 -> +0x298. The value is consumed by the 2D map scene builder and tile renderer.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_IsPointInAreaRect
functions.summary: Directional hit test: takes the area record at (*(self+8))+0x2D4, builds its rectangle from the extents at +0x2BC/+0x2C0 plus the record's four u16 fields (+0x10..+0x16), and tests whether the point at +0x78/+0x7C shifted by -2/+2 in `direction` lies inside it; on a hit it delegates to 0x005CED04 with the same direction.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep
functions.signature: int maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep(Field2DSprite* sprite, const short* step, int arg3)
functions.summary: Chooses the next path step for a field-2D sprite: tests the target box overlap against the sprite position plus the step vector, then picks a random +/- extent from the sprite's 0x2B4 record and clamps it into the bounds.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep_Tail
functions.summary: Continuation tail of 0x00667EA4 (maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep); handles path-step branch stores.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_GetAnimField16
functions.summary: Returns u8 status/animation field at (self+8)->+0x2B4->+0x16 for a 2D field object.

functions.name: Data_NoOpStub
functions.summary: Empty virtual slot (immediately returns). Exists so the vtable has a valid target for an optional notification.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_NoOp
functions.summary: Empty virtual no-op (immediate return) used as a default callback in the 2D field-object animation tables.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_GetAnimField10
functions.summary: Returns u16 property at (self+8)->+0x2B4->+0x10 of 2D field object sprite component.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Object_NeedsUpdateB
functions.summary: Second Field2D object active-gate variant: identical to 0x00667AE8 except it dispatches through interface pointer self->f_A0 instead of self->f_88.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_GetAnimField1C
functions.summary: Returns u16 property at (self+8)->+0x2B4->+0x1C of 2D field object sprite component.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_CalcScreenRectC
functions.summary: Computes 2D field object screen bounding rectangle using position at (object+8)->+0x78/+0x7C and dimensions from object->f_c/f_10 transformed via func_0031A658.

functions.name: Field2D_MapChip_SelectEntry
functions.signature: void Field2D_MapChip_SelectEntry(u16* out, void* src, int useAlternate)
functions.summary: Selects one entry of the 2D map-chip style table: when the global override byte 0x007A6AE6 is not -1 it returns that fixed index, otherwise it scans the table for the first entry whose id differs from 0xFFFF and whose flag byte passes the 0x005BCA50 test, returning {u16 id, u16 index} (or 0xFFFF / -1).

functions.name: maybe_Container_AppendCheckedEntry
functions.summary: Appends an entry to an array builder: stores the pointer at build[2][count] and increments the count, then calls the builder's acceptance callback (through 0x0066846C and Field2D_Sprite_UpdateShadow) and rolls the count back when the callback rejects the entry.

functions.name: maybe_Text_SpanCursor_ClampLine
functions.signature: int* maybe_Text_SpanCursor_ClampLine(int* out, int span, int* cursor)
functions.summary: Clamps a text-span line index to the span's first/last line, writing 0 when the span starts left of the cursor position.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_StubFragmentA
functions.summary: Interior fragment of 2D field object accessor block at 0x006684F8; not an actual function entry.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_StubFragmentB
functions.summary: Second interior fragment of 2D field object accessor block at 0x006684F8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_StubFragmentC
functions.summary: Third interior fragment of 2D field object accessor block at 0x006684F8.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_StubFragmentD
functions.summary: Interior fragment of accessor stub at 0x00668598; not an actual function.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_StubFragmentE
functions.summary: Second interior fragment of accessor stub at 0x00668598.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_StubFragmentF
functions.summary: Third interior fragment of accessor stub at 0x00668598.

functions.name: maybe_Text_SpanCursor_PickRandomOffset
functions.signature: int maybe_Text_SpanCursor_PickRandomOffset(int spanOwner, int* cursor, int lineStart)
functions.summary: Picks a signed horizontal offset for a span: random width in [min,max+1] from Math_RandRangeInt, sign from a 0..2 roll, clamps the random/current/edge candidates, re-rolls once with the opposite sign if the result is zero, and returns the offset plus lineStart.

functions.name: Ui_Rect_IntersectsElement
functions.signature: unsigned int Ui_Rect_IntersectsElement(int* rect, UiElement* element)
functions.summary: Rectangle overlap test against an element: asks the element whether it is visible (vtable +0xC) and its bounds (vtable +8), then tests the two rectangles for overlap.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Scene_GetStyleByte15
functions.summary: Returns the signed byte at +0x15 of the style record reached through self+4 -> +0x298. Consumed by the 2D walk-trigger code, which branches on whether the byte is zero.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Scene_GetStyleByte14
functions.summary: Getter for the signed byte at +0x14 of the style/theme record reached through self+4 -> +0x298. Consumed by the 2D walk-trigger update and the map scene builder.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object2D_CalcScreenRectD
functions.summary: Computes 2D field object screen bounding rectangle using sub-object position at +4->+0x78/+0x7C and sprite frame extents at +0x298 (+4/+6) transformed via func_0031A658.

functions.name: maybe_Field2D_Layer_GetField12B
functions.summary: Second read path for byte +0x12 of the Field2D layer record at layer+4 -> +0x298; same body as 0x00667068, only the call site differs. The byte is compared across the 0x38-byte layer entries.

functions.name: Ui_AreAllSpanGroupsIdle
functions.summary: ANDs Ui_Span_IsIdle over the two span groups at +0x254 and the three at +0x14 (0xC0 stride each), so it returns 1 only when all five are idle.

functions.name: Ui_AreAllSlotSpansIdle
functions.summary: ANDs Ui_Span_IsIdle over the ten 0xC0-byte slot span groups starting at +0x88.

functions.name: Ui_AreAllIconSpansIdle
functions.summary: ANDs Ui_Span_IsIdle over the three 0xC0-byte icon span groups starting at +0x18.

functions.name: Field_Object2D_ResolveAndGetState221
functions.summary: Resolves a field handle through 0x007B80C0, accepts only the type-info at 0x007C3524, and returns the object byte at +0x221. A generic "actor exists and what is its state" query used by 2D field/gadget code.

functions.name: Camera_GetStereoEyePosition
functions.summary: Returns the world position of one stereo eye (0 = left, 1 = right) from the camera object selected by g_00668BAC[eye], with the eye offset added, or the module default when the camera is missing.

functions.name: Field_Gimmick_IsUiReactionFinished
functions.signature: int Field_Gimmick_IsUiReactionFinished(Gimmick* gimmick, int unusedB, int unusedC, int unusedD)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the gimmick's UI reaction can finish: the global battle/UI predicate passes, all three span groups are idle and the attached camera object's virtual 'done' query also returns true.

functions.name: Actor_ResolveReferenceObject
functions.summary: The compact actor-reference resolver: kinds 0/1 index the two 20-entry roster tables, kind 2 maps a u16 id, and kinds 3/4 return the two default objects.

functions.name: Model_Attach_ShouldUpdateRoot
functions.signature: int Model_Attach_ShouldUpdateRoot(AttachRoot* root, int unusedB, int unusedC, int unusedD)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the attachment root has pending updates (f_68 > 0) or the global attachment count (work+8->+0x54 +0xD84) is positive.

functions.name: Model_Attach_ShouldDrawRoot
functions.signature: unsigned char Model_Attach_ShouldDrawRoot(AttachRoot* root, int unusedB, int unusedC, int unusedD)
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the attachment root's draw flag (+0x6C) or the global draw flag (work+8->+0x54 +0xD88) is set.

functions.name: maybe_MoLive_Stream_ReadPcm
functions.signature: int maybe_MoLive_Stream_ReadPcm(MoLiveStream* self, u32* out, u32 outWords)
functions.summary: Copies decoded PCM out of the MoLive packet ring (f_30/f_34/f_3C) and the circular sample buffer (f_54/f_58/f_5C/f_60), memmove-ing the wrapped range and growing the buffer; returns the number of words written. The readable body is still damaged, so the ring-buffer reading is only partly verifiable.

functions.name: maybe_MoLive_Stream_ReadPcm_Tail
functions.summary: Continuation fragment / tail of movie audio stream decode routine 0x006693B0 (maybe_MoLive_Stream_ReadPcm).

functions.name: MoLive_StreamMap_Find
functions.signature: u32 MoLive_StreamMap_Find(MoLiveStreamMap* map, u32 stream_id, u32* out_value, u32 argument)
functions.summary: Looks a stream up by id in the MoLive stream map and, when found, invokes that stream's per-node decode callback (node+0x18) with the map context and arg4. Returns 0x51 when the id is unknown ('cannot find stream') and 0x44 when the callback fails.

functions.name: MoLive_Stream_BindPacket
functions.signature: void MoLive_Stream_BindPacket(u32 map_context, MoLiveStream* stream, MoLivePacket* packet)
functions.summary: Hands a packet to a MoLive stream: calls vtable+0x18 (attach), asks vtable+0x10 whether the stream accepted it and, if so, records the packet's time (+0x14) in the stream's field +0x14.

functions.name: Field_SceneNode_ComputeInstanceTransform
functions.signature: void Field_SceneNode_ComputeInstanceTransform(FieldSceneNode* node, float* outPos, float* outDir)
functions.summary: Computes the world position of a field scene node's child instance: starts from the node position, picks the model variant from the node's string name (with an 'N_ALL' special case), applies the model's local offset and rotates it by the node's quaternion.

functions.name: Field_GetCombinedMoveVector
functions.summary: Adds the two independent stick contributions (look stick and move stick) into one move vector and reports whether either exceeded the dead zone.

functions.name: Input_ReadDigitalMoveVector
functions.summary: Converts the four digital direction bits of the pad state into a 2-component vector (bits 0x88/0x44 for Y, 0x11/0x22 for X) and returns whether its squared length exceeds the dead zone.

functions.name: Input_ReadMoveStick3D
functions.summary: Reads the main analog stick (bits 1/2 -> X, 4/8 -> Z) into a 3-component vector and returns whether it leaves the dead zone.

functions.name: Input_ReadLookStick3D
functions.summary: Reads the second analog input (the +0x1C/+0x20 axes of the pad object) into a 3-component vector and reports whether it leaves the dead zone.

functions.name: maybe_Party_MemberFlagPairA
functions.summary: Tests the actor/leader flag word at +0x74 against a two-bit pair selected by the saved bytes at work+0x27C5A/+0x27C5B (0x10 or 0x20, and 0x1000 or 0x800). Camera_UpdateManualYaw uses it to decide whether the current leader belongs to the yaw-bias group.

functions.name: maybe_Party_MemberFlagPairB
functions.summary: Complement of 0x0066A604: tests the other two-bit pair (0x20/0x10 and 0x800/0x1000, selected by the same work+0x27C5A/B bytes) in the actor flag word at +0x74.

functions.name: Field_SceneTransition_IsBusy
functions.summary: Returns non-zero while the scene-transition controller (game work +8 -> +0x74) reports a busy mode slot, by forwarding it to Camera_IsModeSlotBusy. With 90 callers across messages, effects, field spawning and UI it is the project-wide 'is a transition running' poll.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_AllTransitionsDone
functions.summary: Returns 1 when both of the scene-flow's sub-objects (+0x98 and +0x114) are either inactive or report their transition finished.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_GetFieldState
functions.summary: Returns the field sub-object pointer at flow+0x98 if active according to 0x0066A6BC, or NULL (0) otherwise.

functions.name: Data_IsSlotEmpty
functions.signature: unsigned int Data_IsSlotEmpty(unsigned int* slots, int index)
functions.summary: Reports whether a slot in the 8-byte-stride pointer array is free: true when the slot holds no pointer, or (for index 0) when the lazily created slot manager reports fewer than two live users.

functions.name: maybe_Work_RowIdIsNamed
functions.signature: u8 maybe_Work_RowIdIsNamed(u32* work, const u32* id)
functions.summary: Predicate over the 20-entry 0x8C-byte row table: counts the leading rows whose wide name is shorter than 7 characters, whose u16 at +0 is non-zero and whose id at +0x88 is not -1, then scans those rows backwards and returns 1 when the u32 key matches *id, else 0.

functions.name: Party_FindEntryById
functions.summary: Linear search of the party/actor table (up to 50 records of 0x8C bytes starting at +0x5FE4) for the record whose id at +0x88 equals *idPtr, skipping empty records and records with an over-long name; returns the record pointer or null.

functions.name: Party_EntryMatchesSelectedId
functions.summary: True when the party entry found for *idPtr carries the same id that the current selection table holds for this list.

functions.name: Spirit_CountRosterEntries
functions.summary: Counts the leading valid entries of the fifty-entry spirit roster at savework+0x5FE4 (0x8C-byte records: wide name at +0, id at +0x88): the walk stops at the first entry whose name is 7+ characters, whose first character is 0, or whose id is -1, and returns how many were counted.

functions.name: Work_CountNamedRows
functions.summary: Counts the leading valid rows of the 20-entry 0x8C-byte table at work+0x24A98 (+0x783C): a row counts while its wide name is shorter than 7 characters, its u16 at +0 is non-zero and its id at +0x88 is not -1; the first failing row ends the count. Ui_ListData_BuildEntries modes 3 and 6 use it to size the list.

functions.name: Work_AreAllDataPanelRowsUsed
functions.summary: Returns true when none of the 50 rows of the data-panel table at work+0x5FE4 is free: it walks the 0x8C-byte rows, counts the ones with a short name, a non-zero key and a valid +0x88 word, and compares the count with 50.

functions.name: Work_AreAllNamedRowsUsed
functions.summary: Checks whether all 20 entries in the 0x8C-byte named character/roster row table at table+0x7B3C are active and non-empty.

functions.name: Item_IsSiblingRecord
functions.signature: bool Item_IsSiblingRecord(u16* entry, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 manager)
functions.summary: Checks whether an entry and the following record (id+1) belong to the same group: compares (id - groupBase(entry)) with ((id+1) - groupBase(next)), returning 1 when they match, using the item record table (ids < 0xB3B) for the next record.

functions.name: maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry8
functions.signature: void* maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry8(unsigned short* key, GroupRecord* group, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Resolves the record for key inside the group chunk: it follows the group's own relative offset at +8 and, when that is empty, falls back to the record found through the manager by (key - base byte), following its relative offset at +8 as well.

functions.name: maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry8OrTrap
functions.signature: void* maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry8OrTrap(u16* key, void* group, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Resolves an entry through a relative-offset link chain: follows key[2] (an offset relative to key+4), and when the chain is broken re-resolves the id through Game_GetDataManager + 0x0063CDD8 using key[0] minus the group's base id; every failure path calls 0x00707BD4 (the string-format assert) and returns the static default entry 0x0066C0A0+4.

functions.name: Data_FindRecordIndexById
functions.summary: Returns the index of the record whose leading u16 matches the entry's normalised id: it walks the table returned by 0x0063E998(manager, 0) (0x14-byte stride, up to 0x2E18 bytes) and divides the offset by the record size; returns the default at 0x0066C168 when not found.

functions.name: Data_GetFieldById
functions.signature: unsigned int Data_GetFieldById(unsigned short* entry, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Looks the entry's id up through 0x0063D96C and returns the first u16 of the found record, or the default value at 0x0066C330 when the lookup fails.

functions.name: maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry4
functions.signature: void* maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry4(unsigned short* key, GroupRecord* group, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Same relative-link resolution as 0x0066BF5C but for the +4 link of the entry record (the second parallel list in the same chunk format).

functions.name: Item_RollStatBoostDelta
functions.summary: Computes the randomized stat-boost amount for a consumable seed/stat item record (*((ItemRecord**)itemRecordRef + 1)): reads base gain u16 at +0x12 and variance u8 at +0x14, rolls uniform jitter in [-variance, +variance] via global RNG *0x007BE300, and returns base + jitter.

functions.name: Text_ExpandLineBreak
functions.signature: unsigned short* Text_ExpandLineBreak(unsigned short* text, GroupRecord* group, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
functions.summary: Normalises a UTF-16 control-code string into the shared scratch buffer at 0x0066C8E0, translating a raw U+000A line break into U+3000 (ideographic space) so the message renderer does not treat it as a hard break, and returns the scratch buffer.

functions.name: Text_FormatMessageArg
functions.summary: Formats a message argument / name reference into a static wide buffer, optionally stripping CR/LF, and prefixes the value with the unit or label selected by the reference type.

functions.name: Model_Attach_ApplyOverrideByName
functions.signature: int Model_Attach_ApplyOverrideByName(ModelOwner* owner, const char* name, int value)
functions.summary: Walks the owner's 0x20-byte attachment entries, resolves each entry's model id by the given key and applies the override value to the first entry whose model matches.

functions.name: Model_Attach_ComputeLocalMatrix
functions.signature: void Model_Attach_ComputeLocalMatrix(float* outMatrix, const AttachTransform* transform)
functions.summary: Builds a 4x4 matrix from an attachment record (position at +4/+8/+C, quaternion at +18/+20 and scale in +10) and multiplies it into the caller's matrix.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Scene_EnsureCreated
functions.summary: Lazily creates the shared 0x21C-byte UI scene object (vtable 0x007829E0, the same object type 0x00623914 creates) when the init byte is set, then returns the negation of Ui_LoadingScreen_IsFinished, i.e. 'the loading screen is still running'.

functions.name: Ui_IsCloseableDefaultTrue
functions.summary: Virtual default implementation that always returns 1, used by UI objects that are always closeable; the scene-flow state machine uses the result as its 'may close' decision.

functions.name: Ui_SceneFlow_CanOpenScene
functions.summary: Returns 1 when the pending scene object is ready and either it has no owner or its three-state check (func_006334D0) passes.

functions.name: Ui_TextLayerWindow_SetupDualLayers
functions.signature: void Ui_TextLayerWindow_SetupDualLayers(UiTextLayerWindow* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Thunk that forwards the dual-layer text setup call to Text_SetupDualLayersDefault with the window pointer biased back by 0x70 (the embedded text object lives at window+0x70). Vtable slot +0x1C of a UiWindow class.

functions.name: Ui_Window_DtorThunkBase
functions.summary: Adjustor/destructor thunk: subtracts 0x70 from the most-derived pointer and calls the UI base destructor, then releases the allocation.

functions.name: Battle_HpGaugeWindow_DtorThunkB
functions.summary: Second destructor thunk of the HP-gauge window: adjusts this by -0x70 and tail-calls the shared widget release 0x0029126C, which does not return. Slot 5 of the window vtable.

functions.name: Battle_HpGaugeWindow_CtorThunk
functions.signature: void Battle_HpGaugeWindow_CtorThunk(void* self, int arg2, int b, int c, int d)
functions.summary: Constructor thunk for the battle HP-gauge window: initialises the derived panes then chains to the base constructor with the adjusted pointer.

functions.name: Battle_HpGaugeWindow_DtorThunk
functions.summary: Destructor thunk for the battle HP-gauge window: destroys the panes, runs the -0x70-adjusted base destructor and frees the object.

functions.name: Ui_PagedTextWindow_InitRowsBase
functions.signature: void Ui_PagedTextWindow_InitRowsBase(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4, u32 arg5)
functions.summary: Initialiser for the window whose paged-text child sits at self-0x70: runs the base prologue on self-0x70 and hands the whole layout to Ui_PagedTextWindow_InitRows. The vtable slot is an init, not a destructor.

functions.name: Ui_Object_DtorThunk
functions.summary: Generic UI object destructor thunk that reuses the result of the base destructor call for the -0x70 adjustment.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_OnEvent_Subclass
functions.summary: Virtual sequence player event handler: offers event to child object at +0x210, forwards to sound router 0x00660414, and invokes class virtual handler +0x10.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DtorDelete_76AD28
functions.summary: Deleting destructor for UI object at vtable 0x0076AD28, adjusting this pointer by +0x20 and calling widget release.

functions.name: maybe_Field_Object_BindModelTransform
functions.summary: Resets field object transform at self-0x1330 and syncs actor model position (+0x9C/+0xA0/+0xA4) into the object transform when actor (+0xF24) is present.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_Node_InitInlineListA
functions.summary: Stores {owner, owner+0x18} in the first two words of a large graphics node, then runs the inline member at +0xE0F8 through 0x005761D8 (named Os_ThreadObject_Dtor) and frees the block that call returns, adjusted back by 0xE0F8.

functions.name: Field_Monster_EndAnimation
functions.summary: Ends the current field-monster animation: clears the state byte +0xa8, calls the animation stop 0x003F765C on self+0x144 and sets flag +0xf21 on the owning object. Slot 4 of the monster-object vtable.

functions.name: Ui_ItemWindow_UpdateSelectionById_Thunk
functions.summary: Wrapper thunk that calls Ui_ItemWindow_UpdateSelectionById (0x00421308) and returns.

functions.name: Field_Monster_OnEvent
functions.summary: Handles monster events 0x21b and 0x306: re-reads the model position, copies it into the animation controller at +0xf0/+0xf4 and clears the pending flag; other events just reset the state bytes. Slot 1 of the vtable.

functions.name: Field_Monster_StartAnimation
functions.summary: Starts the field-monster animation: if not already running, calls 0x003F765C on self+0x144 and sets the running flag +0x140. Slot 2 of the monster-object vtable.

functions.name: Monster_AttachAnimation
functions.summary: Loads the enemy animation for the given id and binds it to this monster model's node at +0x60.

functions.name: maybe_Sound_SeqPlayer_InitFromHandle
functions.summary: Looks up sound sequence player instance from handle via 0x00556C48 and initializes playback tempo and volume state fields.

functions.name: Fs_Worker_DtorThunkA
functions.summary: Destructor thunk of a file-system worker wrapper: runs the worker destructor and frees the allocation.

functions.name: maybe_Ui_Object_DestroyWithInlineThread
functions.summary: Destructor of a UI/field object that owns an inline thread object: destroys the thread object at self+0xE0F8 (0x005761D8 returns its argument) and then destroys the object itself through its virtual destructor slot +4. The two leading stores (owner, owner+0x18) are not explained by the destructor reading.

functions.name: Fs_Worker_DtorThunkB
functions.summary: Second destructor thunk of a file-system worker wrapper (identical body, different vtable slot).

functions.name: Field_Monster_CanEndAnimation

functions.name: std_Acosf

functions.name: std_Atan2f

functions.name: std_Ceilf
functions.summary: Single-precision ceiling: |x| >= 2^23 is already integral and returned unchanged; |x| < 1 returns 1.0 for positive x, -0.0 for negative x; otherwise it adds one fraction unit and clears the fractional mantissa bits. NaN passes through.

functions.name: std_Cosf
functions.summary: Single-precision cosine: reduces x by n*pi/2 using the round-to-nearest magic constant 2^23 and a three-part pi/2 (1.57031 + 0.000483751 + 7.54953e-08), then evaluates either the cosine kernel (1 - x^2/2 + x^4/24 ...) or the sine kernel and applies the quadrant sign from n mod 4. functions.name: std_Expf
functions.summary: Single-precision exponential: n = round(x * 4/ln2), r = x - n*(ln2 split into 0.173279 + 7.98655e-06), evaluates 1 + r + r^2/2 + r^3/6 + r^4/24 and multiplies by 2^(n/4) taken from a four-entry table {1, 2^0.25, sqrt2, 2^0.75} plus hi/lo correction terms; the integer part is applied in two halves (2^(n/2) * 2^(n-n/2)) to avoid exponent overflow. Over/underflow sets ERANGE and returns +/-inf or 0/0.

functions.name: std_Fmodf
