functions.summary: Initializes opaque 12-entry RGBA color table and writes metric constants into neighboring object at 0x007A5EF4 under guard 0x007BE2D0.

functions.name: Os_EnsureDefaultValueInit_006B7C0C
functions.summary: Outlined cold path of a function-local C++ static: under compiler guard 0x007BE2D0 it zero-initialises the shared 8-byte default value at 0x007BE2D4 and releases the guard through the 0x00101A94 veneer. Same body as the rest of the Os_EnsureDefaultValueInit_* family (e.g. 0x0068A520).

functions.name: Os_EnsureDefaultValueInit_006B7C74
functions.summary: Outlined cold path of a function-local C++ static: under compiler guard 0x007BE2D0 it zero-initialises the shared 8-byte default value at 0x007BE2D4 and releases the guard through the 0x00101A94 veneer. Same body as the rest of the Os_EnsureDefaultValueInit_* family (e.g. 0x0068A520).

functions.name: Os_EnsureDefaultValueInit_006B7CDC
functions.summary: Outlined cold path of a function-local C++ static: under compiler guard 0x007BE2D0 it zero-initialises the shared 8-byte default value at 0x007BE2D4 and releases the guard through the 0x00101A94 veneer. Same body as the rest of the Os_EnsureDefaultValueInit_* family (e.g. 0x0068A520).

functions.name: Os_EnsureDefaultValueInit_006B7D44
functions.summary: Outlined cold path of a function-local C++ static: under compiler guard 0x007BE2D0 it zero-initialises the shared 8-byte default value at 0x007BE2D4 and releases the guard through the 0x00101A94 veneer. Same body as the rest of the Os_EnsureDefaultValueInit_* family (e.g. 0x0068A520).

functions.name: Field_RegisterActorClass_Actor
functions.summary: Registers the base field-actor class Actor with the actor class registry at 0x007BE378: builds typeinfo node and links into registry.

functions.name: std_Scalbn
functions.summary: Multiplies *value by 2^exponent in place with C99 overflow/underflow handling: results that overflow become +/-infinity and results that underflow are flushed to signed zero, both with errno=ERANGE (2); NaN/inf inputs are left untouched. This is the scaling step of the C library's hexadecimal float parser.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_FlushTextureUnits
functions.summary: Emits the pending texture-unit commands: for texture units 0..2 whose 'dirty' bit is set it enqueues the texture setup command (via Gfx_GpuState_SetupTextureUnit or the multi-unit variant) and then appends the two trailing state words to the command buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GpuState_WriteScreenScale
functions.signature: void maybe_Gfx_GpuState_WriteScreenScale(u32 arg1, u32 arg2, u32 width, u32 height)
functions.summary: Emits the screen-scale GPU state: converts the two float arguments and the reciprocal of the requested screen size to PICA 24-bit floats and appends them as (value, command) pairs for registers 0x0041..0x0044 plus a packed 0x0068 write, then caches (arg1, arg2, width, height) in the pipeline-state record at 0x007AF058+0x20..+0x2C and sets its valid byte at +0x30.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_AllocStreamObjectA
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_AllocStreamObjectA(void** out, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x1C-byte movie/MoLive decoder sub-object through the replaceable allocator hook (function-pointer pair at 0x007AE5CC), zeroes the first five words and stores the two arguments at +0x14/+0x18. Returns 1 on success, 0 when no allocator is installed or the allocation fails.

functions.name: Gfx_Vram_SetAllocatorA
functions.summary: Registers one VRAM bank allocator: stores the allocation and free callbacks in the two-word global callback pair at 0x7AE5CC. Called from Gfx_InitVramBanks to install the default allocator.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_FreeStreamObjectA
functions.summary: Destroys a 0x1C-byte codec sub-object: when the free hook at 0x007AE5CC is installed it releases the sub-buffers (+0x0C, +0x00) and then the object itself. This is the 'release codec' step of the movie-stream wrapper destructor.

functions.name: Gfx_Texture_DecodeEtc1
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Texture_DecodeEtc1(GfxTextureDecode* self, u8* src, u32 size)
functions.summary: Decodes an ETC1-compressed texture into 16-bit RGB565 pixels: allocates/reuses the temporary and destination buffers, decodes each 8-byte block with the ETC1 block decoder and de-swizzles the 4x4 blocks into the destination with the requested stride.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_AllocSliceTable
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_AllocSliceTable(void** out, int arg2, int sliceCount)
functions.summary: Allocates the per-slice decode table of a video frame: a 0x18-byte header plus one 0x1D0-byte record per slice (zeroed) with each record's +0x1CC initialised to sliceCount*2. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: Gfx_Vram_SetAllocatorB
functions.summary: Registers a second VRAM allocator callback pair (global 0x7AE5BC), used for the texture bank set up by Gfx_InitVramBanks.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_FreeSliceTable
functions.summary: Releases a slice table created by 0x006B8A5C: frees the slice buffer at +0x04, then the header block, then the table, all through the hook at 0x007AE5BC.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_ConvertSliceRowsTo16bpp
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_ConvertSliceRowsTo16bpp(void* table, int src, int height)
functions.summary: Grows the slice table's staging buffer to height*row-stride (rounded to 0x200-byte rows) and then converts every slice of every row from the codec's planar format to 16bpp RGB565 via 0x00132D80 (maybe_Video_ConvertStripTo16bpp), advancing the source by 0x28 bytes per slice and the destination by one row per pass.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_SelectFrame
functions.signature: int* Gfx_Movie_SelectFrame(int* out, int* srcA, int* srcB, int arg4)
functions.summary: Selects decoded movie frame surface to present: compares frame descriptors and invokes Gfx_ConvertTextureTiles on selected surface.

functions.name: Gfx_Vram_AllocEntry
functions.summary: Allocates an 8-byte VRAM bookkeeping entry through the currently registered allocator callback, zeroes it and stores it in *out. Returns 0 (failure) when no allocator is registered or the callback fails.

functions.name: Gfx_Vram_SetAllocatorC
functions.summary: Registers the VRAM allocator callback pair at 0x7AE5DC that Gfx_Vram_AllocEntry/Gfx_Vram_FreeEntry use for small bookkeeping blocks.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_RenderCallback_Dispatch
functions.summary: Calls the runtime-installed callback word at 0x007AE5DC+4 with the node (and once more without arguments when node->f_4 is set). Both callers are teardown paths, so it looks like a 'this node is going away' notification, but the callback's contract is not recoverable.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_AllocStreamObjectB
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_AllocStreamObjectB(void** out, u32 arg2, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x28-byte codec sub-object through the hook at 0x007AE5C4, zeroes +0x10/+0x14/+0x18 and stores the arguments at +0x1C/+0x20. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: Gfx_ResetGlobalPair
functions.summary: Zeroes the two-word global at 0x007AE5C4. Called from the global render teardown maybe_Gfx_ShutdownGlobalManagers (0x001B6EF0) between the movie/VRAM/MoLive teardowns, so it clears one of the renderer's shared state pairs on shutdown.

functions.name: Gfx_Vram_SetAllocatorWithDefaults
functions.summary: Registers the VRAM allocator pair at 0x007AE5C4 after letting func_00146C60 publish the three default allocator words, so a later bank init can fall back to them.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_FreeStreamObjectB
functions.summary: Frees a 0x28-byte codec sub-object created by 0x006B9000: releases +0x10 through the hook and then the object.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_ConvertFrameRowsTo16bpp
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_ConvertFrameRowsTo16bpp(void* ctx, u32 src, int height)
functions.summary: Same staging-buffer growth as 0x006B8C38, then converts a decoded frame row by row: per row it calls 0x00146C88 on each 8-byte plane descriptor and 0x00146B10 (Gfx_DrawLine2D16) to blit 0x80-byte source strips into the 16bpp destination.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_AllocStreamObjectC
functions.signature: int Gfx_Movie_AllocStreamObjectC(void** out, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, int count)
functions.summary: Allocates the largest codec context (0x3C bytes) plus two count*4 scratch arrays through the hook at 0x007AE5B4 and initialises them through 0x0014ECF8; rejects count <= 5 and unwinds every partial allocation. Returns 1 on success.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_MovieQueue_Peek
functions.summary: Copies the next queued movie-frame descriptor out of the ring under the global movie monitor 0x007CF360: surface id, two converted addresses, three timestamp words and the per-frame words indexed by the read index, and returns 1; returns 0 when the queue is empty. The read index (f_34) is not advanced, so it is a peek.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieQueue_GetCount
functions.summary: Returns the number of decoded movie frames currently queued, copied out under the global movie lock.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_SetGlobalPair
functions.summary: Publishes two words into the global pair at 0x007AE5B4 and re-initialises the critical section at 0x007CF360 with flags 0x04000048.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieQueue_Pop
functions.summary: Consumes one decoded movie frame from the ring: advances the head index (wrapping at capacity) and decrements the queued count, under the global movie lock. Returns 0 when the queue is empty.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_FreeStreamObjectC
functions.summary: Frees the 0x3C-byte codec context from 0x006B9254: shutdown call 0x00155608, then the two scratch arrays at +0x2C/+0x28, then the object, all through the hook at 0x007AE5B4.

functions.name: Gfx_MovieQueue_Push
functions.summary: Adds a freshly decoded surface to the movie frame ring: converts the surface with 0x00152EA8, records the paired value from 0x0015D4A0, advances the tail index (wrapping at capacity) and increments the count. Returns 0 when the ring is full.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_Create
functions.signature: u32 MoLive_Decoder_Create(MoLiveDecoder** out, u32 value, u32 value2)
functions.summary: Creates a MoLive streaming decoder: allocates the small wrapper and the 0x14A0-byte reader through the global sound allocator (g_006B988C), constructs the reader, installs the callback table at +0x14C0 and attaches the source interface; maps MoLive status codes to the sound driver's error codes.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_SkipPackets
functions.summary: Discards all packets currently queued on the decoder's stream: resolves the stream through func_00669A40 and calls MoLive_Stream_PopPacket once per queued packet.

functions.name: Gfx_Movie_GetReadyFrame
functions.signature: u32 Gfx_Movie_GetReadyFrame(MovieStream* stream, u32 arg2, u32* out)
functions.summary: Queries the movie stream's current frame source: returns 0 with the ready surface pointer in *out, or 0xE (not ready) with *out cleared; a null stream returns 1.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_GetPacket
functions.signature: u32 MoLive_Decoder_GetPacket(MoLiveDecoder* self, u32 arg2, u32* out_buf, u32* out_size, u32* out_rate, u64* out_time)
functions.summary: Fetches the next decoded packet from a MoLive stream: pops a queued packet, copies its PCM into the caller's buffer (MoLive_Stream_ReadPcm), and returns the buffer pointer, size, format byte and timestamp. Returns 0x14 when no packet is ready and 0xe when the stream is gone.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_GetStreamInfo
functions.signature: u32 MoLive_Decoder_GetStreamInfo(MoLiveDecoder* self, u32 arg2, u32* info)
functions.summary: Looks up the MoLive stream record for the decoder's stream id (self+4) and unpacks its format fields into the caller's info array according to the record type: type 1/3 fills the full 16-bit field set (info[0]=0), type 2 fills four words (info[0]=1), type 4 fills two (info[0]=2). Returns 0 on success, 7 for an unknown record type and 0xE when the lookup fails.

functions.name: Gfx_Vram_SetAllocatorD
functions.summary: Registers the fourth VRAM allocator callback pair (global 0x7AE5D4) during bank initialisation.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_NextPacket
functions.summary: Advances the decoder's stream by one packet (MoLive_Stream_PopPacket); returns 0x14 when no packet is pending and 0xe when the stream cannot be resolved.

functions.name: MoLive_Decoder_Update
functions.summary: Pumps the decoder once (MoLive_Reader_Process) and translates the MoLive status code into the sound driver's error code (0/1/3/4/5/6/9/0xc/0xe/0xf/0x10/0x11).

functions.name: Gfx_Vram_FreeEntry
functions.summary: Releases an 8-byte VRAM bookkeeping entry through the registered free callback: first releases the wrapped block, then the two pointers, then the entry itself. Returns 0x12 when no allocator is installed and 1 for a NULL entry.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_CaptureScreen
functions.signature: void Gfx_GpuCmd_CaptureScreen(CmdList* cmd, u32 srcLeft, u32 srcTop, u32 srcRight, u32 srcBottom, u32 dest, u32 width, u32 height, u32 format, u32 screen, u32 flags, u32 bpp)
functions.summary: Emits a display-transfer (framebuffer capture) command: 0x500/0x501/0x502 select top screen, bottom screen or both, 0x10/0x18/0x20 select the pixel size.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_EnqueueTextureCopyRect
functions.signature: void Gfx_GpuCmd_EnqueueTextureCopyRect(GfxCmdQueue* self, u32 src, int x, int y, u32 dst, int width, int height, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Queues a rectangle texture copy / blit command: writes a type-4 command entry holding the source and destination addresses, the flags and the four rectangle coordinates scaled down by 16, then notifies the queue owner if this queue is the active one.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_CopyTexture
functions.signature: void Gfx_GpuCmd_CopyTexture(CmdList* cmd, u32 src, u32 dest, u32 size, int bpp, u32 srcStride, u32 destStride, u32 height, int heightBpp)
functions.summary: Emits a type-2 GPU copy descriptor (source address, destination address, size and stride, with the texture height encoded in the top bits for 16/24/32-bit formats).

functions.name: Gfx_CmdQueue_SubmitEntry
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdQueue_SubmitEntry(u32 queueId, u32 cmdType, u32 arg3)
functions.summary: Writes a 0x1C-byte command packet into the global GPU command queue slot and dispatches command execution.

functions.name: Gfx_CmdQueue_SubmitEntryDirect
functions.signature: void Gfx_CmdQueue_SubmitEntryDirect(void* self, u32 queueId, u32 cmdType, u32 arg4)
functions.summary: Directly formats and marks active a 0x1C-byte queue entry within the specified command queue object before triggering execution.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_Fill
functions.summary: Emits a memory-fill GPU command (six parameter words incl. the 0x12345678 fill constant and its mask) and patches the previous descriptor when the command list grew across a boundary.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_EnqueueMemoryWrite
functions.summary: Queues a type-1 command that makes the GPU write a small fixed block of state words (the three-word header emitted inline plus the caller's tag), aligning the inline data area and updating the queue's write offsets.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_FillSimple
functions.summary: Simplified variant of 0x6B9F2C without the previous-descriptor repair; emits the same six-word fill command and sets the entry type bit to 1 when cmd->f_3d is set.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuState_MarkDirty
functions.summary: Marks GPU state dirty: masks the requested change bits with the already-cached set (state[2]), ORs the matching shadow-register bits into state[0] and records the handled bits in state[1] (the dirty mask). Bit 0x40 also drops the two 0x84-byte cached blocks at state+0x10C and state+0x190.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuState_Invalidate
functions.summary: Central GPU state invalidator: for each dirty bit it calls the matching state rebuilder (material, texture units, texture stage, matrix/palette), clears the cached register bits and masks the dirty bits out of the shadow state.

functions.name: Script_Vm_CheckParams2
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_CheckParams2(ScriptVm* vm, u32 typeMask, u32 argIdx, int defaultVal)
functions.summary: Validates that at least two parameters exist on the Squirrel VM stack and verifies the argument against the required type mask.

functions.name: Script_Vm_CheckParams1
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_CheckParams1(ScriptVm* vm, u32 typeMask, int argIdx, int defaultVal)
functions.summary: Validates that at least one parameter exists on the Squirrel VM stack and validates the argument type or pushes null.

functions.name: Script_Array_Reverse
functions.summary: Squirrel API: reads the array passed as argument and reverses it in place, releasing the saved element afterwards.

functions.name: Script_Closure_BindEnv
functions.summary: Squirrel API: takes a closure argument and an environment argument, validates both ("the target is not a closure", "invalid environment") and builds a new closure object sharing the function, literals and outer values.

functions.name: Script_Vm_CallClosure
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_CallClosure(ScriptVm* vm, u32 paramCount, int returnVal, int raiseError)
functions.summary: Invokes a callable Squirrel closure or native function on the VM stack with the specified parameter count and return value handling.

functions.name: Script_Vm_IsInstance
functions.summary: Tests whether the object at the specified stack index is a class instance, checking type tag 0x8000040.

functions.name: maybe_Script_Object_Destroy
functions.summary: Destroys the script object at owner+0x8C: calls virtual slot +0x14 of its +0x50 sub-object, releases its tables through 0x00247D94 and removes it from the global object table (0x00147AEC is the remove tail of 0x00147AA4). What the 0x8C object is, is still open.

functions.name: Script_CreateNativeInstance
functions.summary: Squirrel API: creates a native instance wrapper for the VM's owner object and returns it to the script.

functions.name: Script_Vm_CreateNativeInstance
functions.signature: void Script_Vm_CreateNativeInstance(ScriptVm* vm, u32 classObj, u32 userPtr, u32 size, u32 hook)
functions.summary: Instantiates a native class object bound to the Squirrel VM with associated C++ user data pointer and hook.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetInstanceUserPointer
functions.summary: Retrieves the native C++ user pointer from a Squirrel class instance object on the stack.

functions.name: Sq_VmGetStackSlot
functions.summary: Fetches one stack slot by index and leaves it on the VM stack. A negative index counts from the top; when the index is out of range it raises the Squirrel error "the index doesn't exist" (0x006BD988) and returns the error value.

functions.name: Script_Table_GetSlot
functions.summary: Squirrel API: reads a table slot by key, with a special case for the root table's +0x44 member; reports "wrong index" when the key is not a valid slot.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetBool
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_GetBool(ScriptVm* vm, int stackIdx, int* outVal)
functions.summary: Extracts a boolean value from the specified stack slot, verifying Squirrel type tag 0x1000008 (OT_BOOL).

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetInstance
functions.summary: Validates and extracts a class instance object reference from the given VM stack position.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetInteger
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_GetInteger(ScriptVm* vm, int stackIdx, u32* outHigh, u32* outLow)
functions.summary: Extracts a 32-bit or 64-bit integer value from the specified Squirrel VM stack slot.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetFloat
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_GetFloat(ScriptVm* vm, int stackIdx, u32* outFloat)
functions.summary: Extracts a floating-point numeric value from the specified Squirrel VM stack slot, converting integer if needed.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetFloatDirect
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_GetFloatDirect(ScriptVm* vm, int stackIdx, float* outFloat)
functions.summary: Extracts a single-precision float directly from the stack slot into a float destination pointer.

functions.name: Script_Vm_ResolveStackIndex
functions.signature: int Script_Vm_ResolveStackIndex(ScriptVm* vm, u32 stackIdx, int offset, u32 flag)
functions.summary: Computes the absolute stack slot pointer from a positive or negative stack index relative to top or stack base.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetType
functions.summary: Returns the Squirrel object type tag (OT_NULL, OT_INTEGER, OT_FLOAT, OT_STRING, OT_TABLE, OT_ARRAY, etc.) at the specified stack index.

functions.name: Sq_VmReadStackSlot
functions.signature: u32 Sq_VmReadStackSlot(SqVM* vm, int index, SqValue* out)
functions.summary: Reads the Squirrel value stored at a stack/table index into *out (two words) without pushing anything. Negative indices count from the top of the stack.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetString
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_GetString(ScriptVm* vm, u32 stackIdx, int* outString)
functions.summary: Validates that the stack slot contains a string and returns a pointer to its character buffer.

functions.name: maybe_Script_Vm_GetSlotValue
functions.summary: Squirrel VM stack-slot accessor used by Script_Vm_GetInstance (0x006BB8DC): resolves the slot through 0x005B5C6C when the index is in range and falls back to 0x005B5C78 otherwise, then returns the slot's first word. The in-range test is not recoverable from the C.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetUserPointer
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_GetUserPointer(ScriptVm* vm, u32 stackIdx, int* outPtr, u32* outSize)
functions.summary: Validates and extracts a user pointer (OT_USERPOINTER) or user data reference from the specified stack slot.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetUserData
functions.summary: Extracts user data pointer and type tag from an OT_USERDATA object on the Squirrel stack.

functions.name: Script_Vm_PushStackSlot
functions.signature: void Script_Vm_PushStackSlot(ScriptVm* vm, int srcSlot, int dstSlot)
functions.summary: Duplicates an object from a source stack slot and pushes it onto the destination stack slot or top of stack.

functions.name: Sq_NewArrayFromStack
functions.signature: void Sq_NewArrayFromStack(SqVM* vm, int defaultKind, u32 count)
functions.summary: Allocates a 0x48-byte Squirrel array object, fills it with the `count` values currently on the VM stack (growing the element array by doubling, copying each value with reference counting), pushes it and updates the VM's temp-object list.

functions.name: Sq_SetTableSlot
functions.signature: u32 Sq_SetTableSlot(SqVM* vm, int index, u32 arg3, u32 flags)
functions.summary: Stores a value into a table/array slot: requires at least three stack entries, rejects a null key with the error "null is not a valid key", rejects float keys with the wrong tag, and otherwise creates the slot through 0x005B9B90. Returns -1 when the stack is too short.

functions.name: Script_Vm_ReleaseStack
functions.summary: Deallocates auxiliary stack structures and frees temporary slot arrays associated with the VM execution frame.

functions.name: Script_Vm_PushStackFrame
functions.summary: Initializes a new call stack frame for closure execution, capturing call stack state and allocating stack frame structures.

functions.name: Sq_NewTable
functions.summary: Allocates a Squirrel table/array of `size` bytes plus the object header, installs the table vtable, links it into the VM's object list, pushes it as a null-initialised reference and returns the value area.

functions.name: Script_Vm_Create
functions.summary: Creates and initialises a Squirrel VM: allocates the 0xB8-byte VM, sets up the tables and default delegates, allocates the 0xA8-byte call frame and seeds the stack.

functions.name: Sq_BindNativeMethod
functions.signature: void Sq_BindNativeMethod(SqTable* table, const char* name, void* fn, u32 paramCount, void* defaults, u32 arg6)
functions.summary: The single helper that every script class registration goes through: resolves the destination table, binds `name` to the native function pointer with `paramCount` parameters, copies the default-parameter block, wraps it into a closure object and stores it in the table, then pops the temporaries.

functions.name: Script_Vm_PushNull
functions.summary: Pushes one or more null values (OT_NULL) onto the top of the Squirrel stack.

functions.name: Sq_PushRefValue
functions.summary: Pushes either a reference-counted object (when value is non-null) or the shared default constant at 0x006BC834 onto the VM stack. The reference form bumps the object's user count before pushing and releases it after the push, so the VM owns one reference.

functions.name: Script_Table_RemoveKey
functions.signature: int Script_Table_RemoveKey(ScriptVm* vm, int argIndex, int keepValue)
functions.summary: Squirrel API: removes a key from a table (Sq_HashTable_Remove) and optionally pushes the removed value back onto the stack.

functions.name: Script_Vm_NewSlot
functions.summary: Sets a new key-value pair in a table or class object on the stack (popping key and value), matching `sq_newslot`.

functions.name: Script_Vm_Get
functions.summary: Pops a key from the stack and retrieves the corresponding value from the table/class at stackIdx, pushing the result.

functions.name: Script_Vm_SetDebugHook
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_SetDebugHook(ScriptVm* vm, code* hookFunc, u32 userData)
functions.summary: Installs a script debug or execution trace callback hook into the Squirrel VM.

functions.name: Script_Vm_Clone
functions.summary: Clones the table, array, or closure object at stackIdx and pushes the duplicate onto the stack, matching `sq_clone`.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetWeakRefVal
functions.summary: Dereferences a weak reference object on the stack, pushing the referenced object or null if expired, matching `sq_getweakrefval`.

functions.name: Script_SetSlotFromStack
functions.summary: Pops a value from the stack; if it is a string or a class instance it becomes the VM's current slot pair (+0x50/+0x54), replacing the previous value.

functions.name: Script_SetSlotFromStackAlt
functions.summary: Second variant that stores the popped value into the VM's +0x48/+0x4C slot pair instead of +0x50/+0x54.

functions.name: Script_BindNativeClosure
functions.signature: int Script_BindNativeClosure(ScriptVm* vm, int argIndex, unsigned refIndex)
functions.summary: Squirrel API: attaches a native closure to a reference-table object so the closure keeps the object alive; reports "the object is not a nativeclosure" for wrong arguments.

functions.name: Script_Vm_SetNativeClosureParams
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_SetNativeClosureParams(ScriptVm* vm, int paramCount, int typeMask)
functions.summary: Sets the expected parameter count and type mask descriptor for a native closure on top of the stack.

functions.name: Script_Vm_GetWeakRefTarget
functions.summary: Extracts the raw target object pointer from a weak reference without pushing a new stack slot.

functions.name: Script_Vm_SetTop
functions.summary: Adjusts the VM stack top: if newTop is smaller than current stack height, pops the excess objects off the stack.

functions.name: Script_Vm_CheckStackIndex
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_CheckStackIndex(ScriptVm* vm, int stackIdx, int* outSlot)
functions.summary: Verifies that a stack index is within valid stack allocated bounds, returning 0 and the slot address on success or 0xFFFFFFFF on out-of-bounds.

functions.name: Script_Vm_ThrowError
functions.summary: Sets the runtime error string in the VM shared state and marks the VM state with an active exception, matching `sq_throwerror`.

functions.name: Script_Vm_PushStackValue
functions.signature: void Script_Vm_PushStackValue(ScriptVm* vm, int stackIdx, u32* outValue)
functions.summary: Copies the object value from the specified stack slot into an output object pointer structure.

functions.name: Script_Vm_ToString
functions.summary: Converts the object at stackIdx into its string representation and pushes it onto the stack, matching `sq_tostring`.

functions.name: Script_ToStringPush
functions.summary: Converts the value at the given argument position to a string (using its tostring metamethod when present) and pushes the result.

functions.name: Script_Vm_Resume
functions.signature: u32 Script_Vm_Resume(SqVM* vm, int arg2, int arg3, u32 retVal, int arg5)
functions.summary: Resumes a suspended Squirrel VM: pushes the return value (or null), calls Sq_VmExecute with the resume flag and reports failure ('cannot resume a vm that is not running') when the VM is not suspended.

functions.name: Script_Vm_PushRootTable
functions.summary: Pushes the VM root table onto the stack or initializes root table links on a new execution context, matching `sq_pushroottable`.

functions.name: std_Sqrtf
functions.summary: Single-precision square root using the VFP vsqrt instruction; sets EDOM when the argument is negative (or NaN) and returns the NaN produced by vsqrt.

functions.name: Script_Table_RegisterNatives
functions.summary: Iterates over a table descriptor array, registering native function closures into the target script table.

functions.name: Sq_RegisterTableMembers
functions.summary: Finishes a table-style native registration: opens the member group with the descriptor at 0x0015C720, builds the member array from the stack with the descriptor at 0x0015C66C and closes the registration.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_EnqueueBlit
functions.signature: void Gfx_GpuCmd_EnqueueBlit(GfxCmdQueue* self, u32 src, int src_w, int src_h, u32 src_fmt, u32 dst, int dst_w, int dst_h, u32 dst_fmt, int mode, int scale, int opt)
functions.summary: Queues a type-3 blit/format-conversion command: validates the source and destination pixel formats (codes for RGBA8/RGB8/RGB565/RGBA4/RGBA5551), computes the source row stride and the size adjustment when scaling, and writes the rectangle and flags into a command entry.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuCmd_EnqueueTextureCopy
functions.signature: void Gfx_GpuCmd_EnqueueTextureCopy(GfxCmdQueue* self, u32 src, u32 src_fmt, u32 dst, int dst_fmt, u32 src_stride, u32 dst_addr, u32 size, int copy_mode)
functions.summary: Queues a type-2 texture copy command: writes the source and destination addresses plus the two 23-bit format fields, encoding the 0x10/0x18/0x20 selector as the corresponding flag bits in each word.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuState_SetupTextureUnit
functions.summary: Rebuilds one texture unit's cached GPU state: clears the unit's dirty bit, converts the unit's float coordinates/scale to fixed point and packs them into the shadow register words; returns 0 when the unit is up to date or not dirty.

functions.name: Gfx_GpuState_SetupTextureUnits
functions.summary: Multi-unit variant of the texture-unit state rebuild: checks whether units 1..5 still match unit 0 (same handle, size and format), and if a full rebuild is needed packs the unit's float coordinates and the shared address/format words into the shadow registers.

functions.name: maybe_Gfx_GpuState_WriteMaterialColor
functions.summary: Emits the material/colour GPU state: converts the current material's float colour and the light-scale values to the PICA 21-bit float format and appends them, together with the material, texture-env and light register writes (0x000F0040/41/43...), as (value, command) pairs to the command buffer at 0x007AED34.

functions.name: Field_ObjectFactory_Type1362
functions.signature: void* Field_ObjectFactory_Type1362(void* ctx, void* owner, u16 typeId, int is2D)
functions.summary: Factory used by the object-spawn loop to instantiate an object of type id 1362. It allocates one of two class variants depending on the global 2D-mode byte (system+0x4244): the 3D variant (0x1388 bytes, vtable 0x760C08), or the 2D variant (0x138C bytes); runs the matching constructor and stores the owning map/scene pointer at object+0x122C. This is one of the specialised classes, not one of the three default factories. The id space (0..1374 for the type table, 0..51 for the kind table) and the 32-bit owner back-pointer at +0x122C fit map/actor placement data, but the exact dataset (map objects vs. party/monster actor records) is not proven.

functions.signature: void Ui_WidgetStack_PushAt(WidgetHost* self, UiWidget* child, u32 x, u32 y)

functions.summary: Loads one resource file whose path is produced by a virtual method of `obj`: calls that method into a 264-byte path buffer, converts the multibyte path to UTF-16, splits the device path and reads the file into the caller's destination buffer through Fs_Object_ReadAll (this instantiation copies 0x14 bytes), releasing the temporary file object on every path.

functions.name: Fs_Object_LoadByVirtualPathB

functions.name: Path_BuildArcLengthTable
functions.signature: void Path_BuildArcLengthTable(void* self, u32 count, int nodeSize, int alignment, int poolId)
functions.summary: Builds the path's cumulative arc-length table: allocates nodeSize*0x30 bytes, evaluates the cubic curve between consecutive points (basis weights 0.125/0.25/0.5), accumulates the segment lengths and marks the path as built.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_LoadAndBind_Type6

functions.name: Ui_Layout_LoadAndBind_Type1

functions.name: Field_SceneObject_ReleaseResourceHandles

functions.name: Ui_Layout_LoadAndBind_Type4
functions.summary: Binds the type-4 screen layout: 59 named parts through the same resolve-validate-store block (validators 0x0057xxxx, sizes/type ids checked) into consecutive handle-pair fields.

functions.name: Ui_Layout_LoadAndBind_Type5

functions.name: Casino_Slot_UpdateWinLineA
functions.summary: One step of the slot win-line presentation: on the first call it hides the spinning symbols, resets the five payout rows and evaluates row A (reels from index 1, symbol array base +0x4D) for up to three paylines, playing a win SE when a line pays; afterwards it advances the two-state counter.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineA
functions.signature: u32 Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineA(CasinoSlotLine* self, CasinoSlotContext* ctx, int line, int symbolOffset)
functions.summary: Measures the longest run of equal symbols backwards from reel 1 of a payline, moves the three visible reel sprites (0x00445EDC) so the winning symbols line up, and plays the matching win SE: 0xE66 for a two-symbol win, 0xE67/0xE68/0xE69 for a 3/4/5-run, and 0xE72/0xE7E when the run ends on one of the two special pattern codes. Returns 1 when the line pays, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_UpdateWinLineB
functions.summary: Same two-state win-line presentation as variant A but for the next row group (symbol array base +0x4E), playing SE 0xE66 at 0x006E26C0 when a line pays.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineB
functions.signature: u32 Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineB(CasinoSlotLine* self, CasinoSlotContext* ctx, int line, int symbolOffset)
functions.summary: Row-group B twin of 0x6E23F8: measures the run from reel 2 (+0x4E), repositions the reel sprites and plays the win SE for the achieved run length. Returns 1 when the payline wins.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_UpdateWinLineC
functions.summary: Two-state win-line presentation for row group C (symbol array base +0x4F), playing SE 0xE66 at 0x006E298C when a payline pays.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineC
functions.signature: u32 Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineC(CasinoSlotLine* self, CasinoSlotContext* ctx, int line, int symbolOffset)
functions.summary: Row-group C twin of 0x6E23F8: tries the four-reel run first and falls back to the three-reel run at the row below, repositions the reel sprites and plays the win SE. Returns 1 when the payline wins.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_UpdateWinLineD
functions.summary: Two-state win-line presentation for the variable row group: it searches rows 4 down to 2 for the first run of three and plays SE 0xE66 at 0x006E2CD4. No sound is queued on this path.

functions.name: Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineD
functions.signature: u32 Casino_Slot_EvaluateWinLineD(CasinoSlotLine* self, CasinoSlotContext* ctx, int line, int symbolOffset)
functions.summary: Variable-row evaluator: walks the candidate rows from 4 downwards until a three-symbol run is found, then repositions the reel sprites and plays the win SE. Returns 1 when a row pays.

All cells are reached through the table at 0x007AE7C8 indexed by the curve's two type bytes (0x0065B890: 'fn = base[typeByte*0x20 + modeByte*4]; bx fn'), which is what makes the 4x8 split explicit. The curve object carries the key count (u16 at +0x0E), key array pointer (+0x20), duration (+0x18), the scale/bias pair (+0x10/+0x14) and the forward/reverse interpolation-mode bytes at +0x08/+0x09. The function locates the surrounding keys by binary search (or by advancing a cached index), computes the interpolated value for the requested normalised time in s0 and returns it in s0 (Eval) or stores the sampled channel values through the caller's out pointer (Sample).

functions.name: Event_BroadcastSlotMask

functions.summary: Broadcasts one float value to a selected set of up to 16 registered handlers. The mask is a 16-bit bitfield: for every set bit i the function loads the handler at self + 0x90 + i*4 and, when it is non-null, calls it with value in s0 and either the caller's arg or the member-function-adjusted arg (adjust&1 selects the member-pointer thunk). functions.name: Math_EaseCurve_Mode00
functions.signature: float Math_EaseCurve_Mode00(float from, float to, float dt, float duration)

functions.name: Math_EaseCurve_Mode01

functions.summary: Easing kernel 1 of the damped-follow helper (mode 1): t = dt/duration, eased through the libm routine 0x00673BC8, and applied as to*f + from, a smooth (sine/cosine shaped) approach.

functions.name: maybe_Math_EaseCurve_Vec2BackOut
functions.signature: void maybe_Math_EaseCurve_Vec2BackOut(float2* out, const float2* from, const float2* to, float t, float duration)

functions.name: Math_EaseCurve_Mode02
functions.signature: float Math_EaseCurve_Mode02(float from, float to, float dt, float duration)
functions.summary: Easing kernel 2 of the damped-follow helper (mode 2): normalises the time (dt * PI/2 / duration), calls the libm routine 0x00672E44 and blends from/to with the resulting factor - the slower 'ease in/out' variant.

functions.name: Script_Bind_IECheckOption
functions.summary: Script binding for `IECheckOption(int textId, xp::TalkDataOption option)`. The first argument is a plain integer id; the second must fit in 9 bits (`option >> 9 == 0`) and is otherwise rejected with the standard 'wrong type (%s expected, got %s )' message naming `xp::TalkDataOption`. Calls IECheckOption 0x0015A208 and pushes the bool answer, i.e. 'can this dialog option be chosen right now'.

functions.name: Script_Bind_EncountEventEx
functions.summary: Script binding for `EncountEventEx(xp::ScenarioBattleID battle, bool, int)`. It validates the scenario-battle id (<= 0x137, or 0xFFFF for 'none'), reads one bool and one further integer from the stack, and on a bad id builds a full type-mismatch message that also names the received type ('got %s' / 'got unknown'). Calls EncountEventEx 0x0014DA1C and returns the bool result - the script's 'did the encounter start' answer.

functions.name: Script_Bind_IECameraGetYaw

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetGlobalGameFlag

functions.name: Script_Bind_IEGetCount
functions.summary: Shared no-argument int trampoline (`int f()`). Seventeen script natives of that exact shape point at this one body - IEGetCount, GetMovieFrame, GetTargetActorID, GetEventExecCount, GetBattleActionCount, GetJackpotState, GetTimeElapsed, GetSoulSelectResult and more - each closure carrying its own C++ implementation. The stub fetches that pointer from the closure environment, calls it with no arguments and pushes the integer.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetActorIDFromUniqueID
functions.summary: Shared one-string int trampoline (`int f(string)`). Four natives use it - GetActorIDFromUniqueID, CreateEffect2D, GetTCSSceneFrame and AddDebugMenuItem. This is the only stub in the batch that marshals a script string: it converts the argument with 0x006BDA58 into a temporary C buffer, calls the bound implementation (GetActorIDFromUniqueID 0x0015D074 for the first registration) and pushes the integer result.

functions.name: Script_Bind_IEGetTextID
functions.summary: Shared one-int getter (`int f(int)`), used by IEGetTextID (0x001588AC) and GetGimmickTargetActor (0x0015BDB0). Converts the integer argument, calls the implementation carried in the closure and pushes the result. IE* natives read the info/event window that is currently on screen.

functions.name: Script_Bind_IEGetAtmarkCount
functions.summary: Shared one-int getter (`int f(int)`), used by IEGetAtmarkCount (0x0015EBCC) and GetTalkPartyPageSize. Returns the number of '@' substitution marks in the current info/event text.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetCountEquipedItem
functions.summary: Script binding for `GetCountEquipedItem(xp::PlayerID player, xp::ItemID item)`: a player id byte plus an item id (0xFFFF allowed), returning how many of that item the character has equipped, via GetCountEquipedItem 0x0015813C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetDaysElapsed
functions.summary: Shared no-argument int getter (`int f()`): GetDaysElapsed (0x00150900), GetGold (0x001633B4), GetJackpotCoinNum, IsTalkActive, GetLastMessageCursorIsNext and six more are registered here. The stub fetches the bound implementation and pushes its integer return.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetItemNumInParty
functions.summary: Script binding for `GetItemNumInParty(xp::ItemID item)`: returns how many of an item the party carries (0xFFFF = 'no item' passes through) via GetItemNumInParty 0x00154F90.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetTalkPartyID
functions.summary: Script binding for `GetTalkPartyID(xp::PlayerID player)`: validates the party-slot id (0..0x1E, 0xFF = none) and returns the actor id used for that character's party-talk, via the implementation at 0x0014DB80.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetGimmickGetGold
functions.summary: Shared one-int getter (`int f(int)`), used by GetGimmickGetGold (0x00154DFC) and GetInnPriceForOnePerson (0x0015E5AC): the argument is a gimmick id for the first and an inn id for the second.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetRand
functions.summary: Script binding for `GetRand(int max)`: returns a random value below the given bound from the script RNG, via GetRand 0x001633D4. Used for lotteries, AI dice rolls and sparkly-spot drops.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetGimmickItemNum
functions.summary: Script binding for `GetGimmickItemNum(int gimmickId, int itemIndex)`: two integer arguments; returns the remaining stock of one item slot inside a gimmick (shop chest, sparkly point) via GetGimmickItemNum 0x00154EAC.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PlayME
functions.summary: Script binding for `PlayME(xp::SoundMeID me, int, int, int, int)`: the five-argument jingle player. The ME id is range-checked (<= 0x20, 0xFF = none), the four trailing integers are loop/volume/pan/fade parameters, and the implementation PlayME 0x00163028 returns the channel handle.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetPartyMemberNumber
functions.summary: Script binding for the zero-argument getter `GetPartyMemberNumber()`: returns how many characters are currently in the party, via 0x001480A0. The stub narrows the return value to 16 bits before pushing, which tells us the C++ side returns a small integer.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GetPartyMemberMaxHP
functions.summary: Script binding for `GetPartyMemberMaxHP(xp::PlayerID player)`: takes a party-slot id and returns that member's maximum HP from 0x00158548, narrowed to 16 bits (HP is stored as u16).

functions.name: Script_Bind_MessageEnd
functions.summary: Shared zero-argument void trampoline (`void f()`). Twenty-five script natives are registered against this one body, among them MessageEnd (0x0014732C), CatchEvent, CSCameraStart, BattleEndToTraining, RuraPointReset, LoadRespawnJump, PlayerSetDefaultAction and EndDebugMenu. The stub calls the implementation stored in the closure environment and then drops the stack frame without pushing a value.

functions.name: Script_Bind_LoadCutScene
functions.summary: Script binding for `LoadCutScene(xp::CutsceneID id)`: rejects cutscene ids above 0x285 (0xFFFF = none passes) and starts loading that cutscene through 0x0014A158. Loading is asynchronous, so the script gets no useful return value.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SendTrgMapJump
functions.summary: Script binding for `SendTrgMapJump(xp::LevelMapID map)`: forwards a map id (0xFFFF allowed) to 0x0014E034, which requests a map jump through the trigger/event system.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PrepareBGM
functions.summary: Shared one-int void trampoline (`void f(int)`): PrepareBGM (0x001473CC), SetDefaultFieldBGM, ForceWaitPlayME, StartDelayFadeIn, IsEndShiftFadeColor and QuestCheckCondition are all registered here. The integer is a music/parameter id and the stub performs no extra validation.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetDisplayMode
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetDisplayMode(xp::DisplayMode mode)`: rejects mode ids above 2 and applies the display mode (2D/3D/stereo) via 0x0014E060.

functions.name: Script_Bind_RuraPointAdd
functions.summary: Script binding for `RuraPointAdd(xp::RuraPointID point)`: range-checks the zoom-point id (<= 0x18) and adds it to the player's unlocked rura (teleport) points via 0x0014A82C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PlayerSetVehicleType
functions.summary: Script binding for `PlayerSetVehicleType(xp::VehicleType type)`: rejects types above 0xB and switches the player's current vehicle (walking, horse, ship, whale, ...) via 0x0015A57C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_LoadEffect3D
functions.summary: Script binding for `LoadEffect3D(xp::EffectPlayID id)`: starts loading a 3D effect resource so a later Effect3DPlay is instant, via 0x0014A3DC. The id is only sanity-checked against 0x6A0 (max effect id).

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetRecordFlag
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetRecordFlag(xp::RecordFlagID flag)`: rejects record-flag ids above 0x54 and sets that achievement/record flag through 0x0014C8A4.

functions.name: Script_Bind_BookIDMessageSetup
functions.summary: Script binding for `BookIDMessageSetup(xp::RegionBookID book)`: rejects book ids above 0x45 and starts the message sequence for that readable book/bookshelf entry, via 0x001561A4.

functions.name: Script_Bind_FixedTimeZone
functions.summary: Script binding for `FixedTimeZone(xp::TimeZoneType zone)`: rejects values above 3 and pins the field clock to a fixed time zone (used while inside buildings/events), via 0x0014C214.

functions.name: Script_Bind_StartTutorialUI
functions.summary: Script binding for `StartTutorialUI(xp::UITutorialID id)`: rejects tutorial ids above 100 and opens that tutorial window through 0x0015086C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_LoadHorseRace
functions.summary: Script binding for `LoadHorseRace(xp::HorseRaceRank rank)`: rejects rank ids above 5 and preloads the resources for that horse-racing class, via 0x0014C3A8.

functions.name: Script_Bind_LoadPictureCard
functions.summary: Script binding for `LoadPictureCard(xp::PictureCardID id)`: rejects card ids above 0x27 and loads that picture-card texture/UI resource via 0x001500A4.

functions.name: Script_Bind_AddRecordCount
functions.summary: Script binding for `AddRecordCount(xp::RecordCountID id)`: rejects counter ids above 0x32 and increments the running record/statistics counter via 0x0014D574.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ScriptMessageSetup

functions.name: Script_Bind_SendFieldEventMessage
functions.summary: Script binding for `SendFieldEventMessage(xp::EventMessageID id)`: rejects ids above 6 and posts a field-event message (the small on-map notifications) through 0x0015C410.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetRevivalPointID
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetRevivalPointID(xp::RevivalPointID id)`: rejects ids above 0x15 and records the church/statue revival point the party returns to on a wipe-out, via 0x00155540 (the function Ghidra left unnamed).

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetRiremitoPoint
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetRiremitoPoint(xp::RiremitoPointID point)`: rejects ids above 0x26 and unlocks that 'riremito' (return-to-town) destination, via 0x00152DDC.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ScenarioMessageSetup

functions.name: Script_Bind_DialogOpen

functions.name: Script_Bind_ChangeUIMap

functions.name: Script_Bind_SQCommand

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetMessageArgDropVehicle

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorRemoveGadget
functions.summary: Shared one-string void trampoline (`void f(string)`): ActorRemoveGadget (0x001547CC), SetDebugMenuTitle, BG3DChangeFog and TCSJump are registered here. The stub converts the script string into a temporary C string before calling the implementation.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetActionInputEnable

functions.name: Script_Bind_StartTripDoorEffect

No type-specific validation is done beyond the integer conversion.

functions.name: Script_Bind_CameraReguralyShakeStop
functions.summary: Shared one-int void trampoline (`void f(int)`): CameraReguralyShakeStop (0x0015DCD8), CameraShakeStop, Camera2DShakeStop, Camera2DReguralyShakeStop and StopBGM are registered here - all of them take a channel/handle id to stop.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetLevelGroupEnable
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetLevelGroupEnable(xp::LevelGroup group, bool enable)`: rejects group ids above 0x11 and toggles the whole 3D level group (a block of map geometry) via 0x00158DD4 - the standard way scripts hide/show parts of a map.

functions.name: Script_Bind_LoadInnMapJump

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetScenarioFlag
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetScenarioFlag(xp::ScenarioID scenario, xp::ScenarioFlag flag)`: validates both arguments (bounds 0x35 and 0x22) and sets a story/scenario flag through 0x00150814.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PlayBGM
functions.summary: Script binding for `PlayBGM(xp::SoundBgmID bgm, int fadeMs)`: rejects BGM ids above 0x9D and starts the track with the accompanying parameter via 0x00163424.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PlayerSetVehicleTypeEx
functions.summary: Script binding for `PlayerSetVehicleTypeEx(xp::VehicleType type, xp::CharacterModelPattern pattern)`: bounds 0xB and 0x4D; switches the vehicle and the character model pattern shown while riding, via 0x0015D280.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetNelsenHopeFlag
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetNelsenHopeFlag(xp::NelsenHopeID hope, bool value)`: the hope id (<= 4) is read as an int and the flag as a byte, then applied via 0x00155508. Used by the Nelsen trial/hope quest line.

functions.name: Script_Bind_StartUI
functions.summary: Script binding for `StartUI(xp::UIScriptType ui, int param)`: rejects ui ids above 0x2E and opens that scriptable UI screen (shop, inn, casino, ...) with one parameter, via 0x001634C4.

functions.name: Script_Bind_BG3DSetVisible
functions.summary: Script binding for `BG3DSetVisible(xp::BGControlGroup group, bool visible)`: rejects group ids above 7 and shows/hides that group of 3D background objects via 0x0014D68C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetGlobalGameFlag
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetGlobalGameFlag(xp::GlobalGameFlag flag, byte value)`: validates the flag id against 0x2AD (0xFFFF = none) and writes the value through 0x001554A8 - the setter counterpart of GetGlobalGameFlag.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetScenarioWeather
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetScenarioWeather(xp::LevelMapAreaID area, xp::WeatherVisualType weather)`: bounds 0x7A and 0xB; forces the visual weather of a map area, via 0x00156E98.

functions.name: Script_Bind_BG2DSetVisible
functions.summary: Script binding for `BG2DSetVisible(xp::MapChipAreaFlg area, bool visible)`: toggles a 2D background chip group (used by the 2D overworld/2D battle modes) via 0x0014D59C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetBasicRespawnID
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetBasicRespawnID(xp::RespawnPointID respawn, xp::MapJumpEvent event)`: the respawn id is limited to 0x31 and the map-jump event id to 0x46; sets the fallback respawn point used when the party wipes, via 0x00155478.

functions.name: Script_Bind_LoadBattleFunc
functions.summary: Script binding for `LoadBattleFunc(xp::ScenarioBattleID battle, bool load)`: rejects battle ids above 0x137 (0xFFFF = none) and preloads (or releases) the resources for a scenario battle via 0x001471B0.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PlayerSetFieldEffect
functions.summary: Script binding for `PlayerSetFieldEffect(xp::PlayerFieldEffect effect, bool enable)`: effect ids are limited to 0/1; enables a persistent field effect on the player model (aura, glow) via 0x0015A524.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetWeather
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetWeather(xp::WeatherVisualType weather, bool immediate)`: rejects weather ids above 0xB and starts the weather transition, with the bool selecting an instant switch, via 0x00147640.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ScreenEffectChange
functions.summary: Script binding for `ScreenEffectChange(xp::CSScreenEffectType effect, int param)`: rejects effect ids above 2 and applies the cutscene screen effect (sepia, monochrome, ...) via 0x00156884.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetMessageArgMiniGameName

functions.name: Script_Bind_CameraResetFreeCam

functions.name: Script_Bind_AutoAddItemInParty

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetQuestFlag

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetQuestEnableFlag
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetQuestEnableFlag(xp::QuestID quest, bool enable)`: validates the quest id (<= 0x59) and marks the quest as available/completed via 0x00156E50.

functions.name: Script_Bind_InnMessage
functions.summary: Script binding for `InnMessage(xp::InnMsgID msg, int param)`: rejects ids above 9 and shows the inn dialog line (stay/rest/costs) via 0x00146F5C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_AddStatus

functions.name: Script_Bind_ChangePlayerVisual

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetDrawPlayerEquipment
functions.summary: Shared PlayerID+bool trampoline: SetDrawPlayerEquipment (0x0015D400) and SetZone are registered here. The first argument is a party-slot byte (Script_GetPlayerIdArg) and the second a bool (e.g. 'draw the equipped weapon or not').

functions.name: Script_Bind_AddPartyMemberHP

The second argument is accepted as an integer, a short or a float - the stub explicitly converts all three Squirrel numeric tags - and no value is pushed back.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PlayerResurrect
functions.summary: Shared PlayerID + int trampoline: PlayerResurrect (0x001506A8) and SetPartyMemberHP (0x00152D54) are registered here. The first argument is a party-slot byte, the second the HP value / resurrection flag.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetLevelWorkEnable

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetMessageArgNelsenBoss

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetMessageArgItemName
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetMessageArgItemName(xp::TextArgID slot, xp::ItemID item)`: text slot <= 0xF, item id with the 0xFFFF 'none' sentinel; writes the localised item name into that message argument via 0x0015C4D8.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetMessageArgNum

functions.name: Script_Bind_RegistThread

functions.name: Script_Bind_CameraChange

functions.name: Script_Bind_UpdateTripDoorEffect

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetBackFilmBlendParam

functions.name: Script_Bind_ChangeGimmickDoorType

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorSetEye

functions.name: Script_Bind_Actor2DTurn

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorResetPosAndDirBeforeEvent

functions.name: Script_Bind_SendGimmickMessage

functions.name: Script_Bind_Effect2DStop

functions.summary: Script binding for `ActorWarpToMapJumpLocatorID(int actor, xp::MapJumpLocatorID locator)`: rejects locator ids above 0xF4 and teleports the actor to that named locator via 0x00161B94.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PlayFootSE
functions.summary: Script binding for `PlayFootSE(xp::SoundStepChara character, xp::SoundStepType step, float volume)`: validates the character (<= 3) and step-type (<= 0x1A) enums and plays the matching footstep sound via 0x0014737C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ChangeFootStepVolume
functions.summary: Script binding for `ChangeFootStepVolume(xp::SoundStepFadeType fade, float volume, int frames)`: fade type 0/1, then a volume and duration; ramps the footstep volume via 0x00159E28.

functions.name: Script_Bind_IECameraEx
functions.summary: Script binding for `IECameraEx(xp::AccessDirectionType dir, int, float)`: extended info/event camera control - direction 0/1, an integer step and a float blend, applied by 0x00146DF4.

functions.name: Script_Bind_AddItemInPlayer
functions.summary: Script binding for `AddItemInPlayer(xp::ItemID item, xp::PlayerID player, int count)`: item id first (0xFFFF allowed), then the party-slot byte, then the count; adds the item to that character's bag through 0x0014F780.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ChangeEquipedItem
functions.summary: Script binding for `ChangeEquipedItem(xp::PlayerID player, xp::EquipPartType part, xp::ItemID item)`: validates the equipment slot (<= 5) and item id, then equips the item through 0x00154A60.

functions.name: Script_Bind_AddPlayerParam
functions.summary: Script binding for `AddPlayerParam(xp::PlayerID player, int, xp::PlayerParamType param)`: rejects parameter ids above 9 and permanently adds to one of the character's base stats via 0x0014D43C (seed/skill-point style bonuses).

functions.name: Script_Bind_DBOpenDialog
functions.summary: Script binding for `DBOpenDialog(string title, string message, string confirmText)`: three script strings; opens the debug-menu dialog box via 0x0014930C. Part of the shipped debug/script debugging API, not of normal gameplay.

functions.name: Script_Bind_TalkStart
functions.summary: Script binding for `TalkStart(string label, string partner, bool unk)`: starts a conversation defined by two script strings and a bool flag, via 0x00166164.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetLocatorOffset
functions.summary: Shared three-argument trampoline (`void f(string, int, float)`) used by SetLocatorOffset (0x00152A8C) and IECamera (0x00165254): a locator name string, an index and a float offset.

functions.name: Script_Bind_TalkZoomCameraEnable
functions.summary: Script binding for `TalkZoomCameraEnable(bool enable, int actor, bool instant)`: enables the close-up camera used during conversations, targeting the given actor, via 0x0015AA50.

functions.name: Script_Bind_StartFadeOut
functions.summary: Script binding for `StartFadeOut(bool wait, int frames, xp::FadeColor color)`: rejects colour ids above 6 and starts a screen fade-out with the given duration, via 0x0014A9AC.

functions.name: Script_Bind_CameraShake
functions.summary: Shared float + float + int trampoline for CameraShake (0x00147D3C) and Camera2DShake: amplitude, duration and a shake type; drives the camera shake effect.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ScreenEffectSetSepiaMul
functions.summary: Script binding for `ScreenEffectSetSepiaMul(byte r, byte g, byte b)`: three byte arguments, read with the byte converter, multiplying the sepia tone of the cutscene screen effect via 0x0015EF2C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorEmotionIcon
functions.summary: Script binding for `ActorEmotionIcon(int actor, xp::EmotionKind kind, float duration)`: rejects emotion ids above 1 and shows that emotion icon over the actor's head via 0x00150BA0.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorSetFace
functions.summary: Script binding for `ActorSetFace(int actor, xp::FacialKindID face, xp::MouseOrderID mouth)`: validates the face (<= 0xE) and mouth (<= 2) enums and applies both to the actor's face rig via 0x00148E40.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorPlayAddMotion
functions.summary: Script binding for `ActorPlayAddMotion(int actor, xp::AddMotionKind kind, float blendTime)`: rejects motion kinds above 3 and layers an additive animation onto the actor via 0x00155E38.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorSetCtrlOption
functions.summary: Script binding for `ActorSetCtrlOption(int actor, xp::ScriptActorOption option, bool enable)`: sets one of the script-visible actor control bits (AI, collision, turn control) via 0x00155F54.

functions.name: Script_Bind_GimmickDoorOpen
functions.summary: Script binding for `GimmickDoorOpen(int door, xp::AccessDirectionType dir, bool instant)`: direction 0/1 and an instant flag; opens/animates a door gimmick via 0x0014FD4C.

functions.name: Script_Bind_Actor2DWalkLocator
functions.summary: Script binding for `Actor2DWalkLocator(int actor, string locator, xp::Actor2DLocatorMoveType move)`: walks a 2D actor to the named locator using the given movement style (<= 2), via 0x001558DC.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorAttachGadget
functions.summary: Script binding for `ActorAttachGadget(int actor, string gadget, string bone)`: the gadget/model name plus a second string naming the attach bone/slot; parents the gadget to the actor's skeleton via 0x001543F4.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorSetTurnSpeedLocator
functions.summary: Script binding for `ActorSetTurnSpeedLocator(int actor, string locator, int speed)`: turns the actor towards the named locator at the given angular speed, via 0x0015F634.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorWalkTarget
functions.summary: Script binding for `ActorWalkTarget(int actor, float x, float z)`: walks the actor towards the given world coordinates via 0x0014F6E0. Both coordinates are read as floats.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PictureCardSetAlpha
functions.summary: Shared int + float + int trampoline for PictureCardSetAlpha (0x00158A84) and SetVolumeSE (0x001485F8): an id, a float value (alpha/volume) and a duration/flag.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetBackgroundDrawOffset
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetBackgroundDrawOffset(int bg, int x, int y)`: offsets a 2D background layer in pixels via 0x0015EF88 (used for parallax during cutscenes).

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorSetTurnSpeedTarget
functions.summary: Shared three-int trampoline for ActorSetTurnSpeedTarget (0x0015D958) and Camera2DChange: both take `void(int,int,int)` (actor/handle plus two parameters).

functions.name: Script_Bind_Effect2DMove
functions.summary: Script binding for `Effect2DMove(int handle, short x, short y)`: moves a 2D effect to the given screen offsets via 0x00157EB8; the stub reads the two coordinates as narrow integers, matching the callee's `short` parameters.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PartyTalk
functions.summary: Script binding for `PartyTalk(int group, int talkId, int flag)`: starts a party-chat (the optional camp conversations) via 0x00165F94.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SwapBasicRespawnID
functions.summary: Script binding for `SwapBasicRespawnID(xp::LevelMapID fromMap, xp::LevelMapID toMap, xp::RespawnPointID from, int to)`: four integers - two map ids bounded by the map-jump table sizes, a respawn point id limited to 0x31 and a second id limited to 0x46 - then swaps which respawn point is the default, via 0x00156EEC.

functions.name: Script_Bind_SetFadeExParam
functions.summary: Script binding for `SetFadeExParam(bool wait, xp::FadeColor color, float delay, int frames)`: a wait flag, a fade colour (limited to 6), a float delay and an integer duration configure the extended fade; forwards to 0x0014E084.

functions.name: Script_Bind_StartDelayFadeOut
functions.summary: Script binding for `StartDelayFadeOut(bool wait, int frames, int delayMs, xp::FadeColor color)`: like StartFadeOut but with a delay before the fade begins; forwards to 0x00155564.

functions.name: Script_Bind_CameraShakeEx
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for CameraShakeEx that validates parameter count and argument types from the VM stack and invokes native implementation CameraShakeStop/CameraShakeEx.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorSetFaceEX
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for ActorSetFaceEX that unpacks facial animation IDs and target actor handle from VM stack and dispatches to native ActorSetFaceEX.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ActorMeshShake
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for ActorMeshShake that extracts actor handle, shake intensity floats, and duration from the VM stack and invokes native implementation.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PictureCardMoveTarget
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for PictureCardMoveTarget that extracts picture card UI handle and target position parameters and dispatches to native picture card movement.

functions.name: Script_Bind_MessageFunc
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for MessageFunc that unpacks message window ID, cursor mode, and text parameters from the VM stack and dispatches to native message system.

functions.name: Script_Bind_Actor2DMoveSylviaShip
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for Actor2DMoveSylviaShip that extracts 2D ship actor movement parameters and invokes native movement sequence.

functions.name: Script_Bind_Effect2DAttachActor
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for Effect2DAttachActor that attaches a 2D particle/visual effect to an actor entity in 2D field mode.

functions.name: Script_Bind_Actor2DMove
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for Actor2DMove that parses 2D movement destination tile coordinates and initiates 2D actor path movement.

functions.name: Script_Bind_Actor2DWarp
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for Actor2DWarp that warps a 2D actor entity to specified tile coordinates and orientation direction.

functions.name: Script_Bind_BookIDMessageSetupEx
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for BookIDMessageSetupEx that configures dialogue/message parameters from region book entry and scenario progression flags.

functions.name: Script_Bind_ScenarioMessageSetupEx
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for ScenarioMessageSetupEx that configures scenario dialogue messages with scenario ID, event flags, and timezone conditions.

functions.name: Script_Bind_IEMessageSetupEx
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for IEMessageSetupEx that configures interactive event character dialogue messages based on NPC IDs and storyline flags.

functions.name: Script_Bind_PictureCardZoom
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for PictureCardZoom that applies zoom scale and animation duration to a picture card display widget.

functions.name: Script_Bind_CameraReguralyShake
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for CameraReguralyShake that starts periodic camera oscillation / tremor with specified frequency and amplitude parameters.

functions.name: Script_Bind_Actor2DMoveEx
functions.summary: Native Squirrel script wrapper for Actor2DMoveEx that initiates extended 2D actor navigation with custom speed and movement flags.

functions.name: Script_GetIntegerArg
functions.signature: int* Script_GetIntegerArg(int* outVal, HSQUIRRELVM vm, int stackIdx)
functions.summary: Core Squirrel script binding helper that extracts an integer argument from the specified stack slot, validating type tags and converting numeric representations.

functions.name: Model_IsInstance
functions.summary: Returns the object when its class chain (virtual [0] then +0xC base links) reaches the shared model class descriptor at maybe_g_modelClass, else null - i.e. the 'is this object a model instance' test.

functions.name: std_String_FormatInitA

functions.summary: Thin formatting helper: forwards arguments to std_vsnprintf (0x001001C4) writing into out+4 with 128-byte buffer capacity. Returns formatted length.

functions.summary: Thin formatting helper: forwards arguments to std_vsnprintf (0x001001C4) writing into out+4 with 32-byte buffer capacity. Returns formatted length.

functions.name: Str_InsertAt
functions.signature: void* Str_InsertAt(void* dst, unsigned int pos, const char* text, unsigned int max_chars)
functions.summary: Inserts text into the engine's small-string object at byte offset pos: saves the tail, truncates there, strncat's the new text (capped by max_chars and the 31/32-byte inline buffer) and re-appends the tail; a pos past the end behaves like a plain append.

functions.name: std_String_FormatInitD

functions.summary: Wide twin of std_String_FormatInit: forwards arguments to std_vswprintf (0x001001FC) writing into out+4 with 16-wchar capacity.

functions.signature: int std_WString_FormatInitC(std_WString* out, u32 capacity, const u16* fmt, ...)
functions.summary: Wide twin of std_String_FormatInit: forwards arguments to std_vswprintf (0x001001FC) writing into out+4 with 256-wchar capacity.

functions.name: Str_WStringInsert
functions.signature: WString* Str_WStringInsert(WString* self, int pos, const WString* sub)
functions.summary: Inserts one wide string into another at character position pos and returns self. The string object is the engine's UTF-16 string: +0x00 length, +0x04 inline buffer (up to 0x3F characters) that is used instead of a heap block while it fits. The function saves the tail after pos into a stack buffer, truncates the original at pos, appends sub and then re-appends the saved tail, growing through the heap when the inline buffer no longer fits. Used by the text/message system to splice words or markup into a line.

functions.name: Container_List_EraseAllNodes
functions.signature: void Container_List_EraseAllNodes(ContainerList* list, ContainerNode* first, ContainerNode* last)
functions.summary: Walks the intrusive node range and erases every node from the owning container through std_RbTree_EraseNode(node, list+4), advancing with the tree successor helpers.

functions.name: std_Vector20_Reserve
functions.summary: Grows a vector of 20-byte elements to at least count: allocates count*0x14 through allocator->vtable+8, copy-constructs the live elements, frees the old block through vtable+0x14 and fixes the end/capacity pointers.

functions.name: std_Vector40_Reserve
functions.summary: Vector growth for 40-byte elements, same copy-then-free scheme as std_Vector20_Reserve.

functions.name: std_Vector44_Reserve
functions.summary: Vector growth for 44-byte elements, same copy-then-free scheme.

functions.name: Container_List_ClearAndDestroy
functions.summary: Destroys every node of an intrusive doubly-linked list: walks the ring from list+0xC, unlinks each node through its +0x1C/+0x20 neighbours, releases the node's owned payload when the flag at +0x10 is set and frees the node.

functions.name: Container_List_ReleaseAll
functions.summary: Empties an intrusive list: walks from the sentinel, unlinks every node from both neighbours and frees it, leaving the payload untouched - the generic 'clear this list and free the nodes' helper used by menu views, screen views and the camera.

functions.name: maybe_Text_NormalizeKanaName
functions.summary: Wide-string normaliser over the kana table at 0x007C2204 (U+30F4/U+309B/U+3046/'%'): the callees are std_wcsncpy, std_wcsncat and Str_WcsStr, so it rewrites a name string in place. The readable body is truncated after one call, so the rewrite itself cannot be verified.

functions.name: std_vsnprintf
functions.signature: int std_vsnprintf(char* buf, u32 size, const char* fmt, u32* args)
functions.summary: The library's integer-only printf formatter: expands %c %s %d %i %u %o %x %X %p %n and %% with the ' ', '+', '-', '0' flags, width (digits or '*'), precision and the h/hh/l/ll length modifiers, never writes more than size bytes, and returns the length the full string would have needed.

functions.name: std_RbTree_AcquireNode

functions.name: Container_Node_ReleaseChain

functions.name: Math_Curve_GetTangent
functions.summary: Evaluates the derivative of a cubic curve segment (quadratic in the segment parameter t taken from s0) and normalises it to a unit vector, falling back to the static direction 0x00711238 when the length is zero.

functions.name: Math_Curve_GetPosition

functions.name: Math_Lerp2D_Evaluate

functions.summary: Evaluates a 2D two-point tween: returns the end point when progress[0] >= progress[1] (finished), the start point when the key has no easing callback, otherwise calls the key's easing callback with (start, delta, extra floats) and writes the interpolated position.

functions.name: Fs_Archive_FindDirectory
functions.signature: u32 Fs_Archive_FindDirectory(ArchiveDirTable* table, u32* outEntryOffset, u32* outEntryFields, ArchiveQuery* query, u32 nameHash, const u16* name, u32 nameBytes)
functions.summary: Looks a child directory up by name inside the archive's hashed metadata: bucket = nameHash % bucketCount selects a u32 in the directory bucket table, then the 0x18-byte directory entries of that chain are compared on parent id, name length and the UTF-16 name; a hit returns the entry offset and its three payload words.

functions.name: Fs_Archive_ReadDirectoryEntry
functions.signature: u32 Fs_Archive_ReadDirectoryEntry(ArchiveDirTable* table, u32* outParentId, u32* outFields, u16* nameBuf, u32* outNameBytes, u32 entryOffset)
functions.summary: Reads one directory entry at a known metadata offset and optionally copies its UTF-16 name; it is how the path walker obtains a directory's own id, which then seeds the hash for looking up that directory's children.

functions.name: Fs_Archive_FindFile
functions.signature: u32 Fs_Archive_FindFile(ArchiveFileTable* table, u32* outEntryOffset, u32* outEntryFields, ArchiveQuery* query, u32 nameHash, const u16* name, u32 nameBytes)
functions.summary: The file half of the archive lookup: picks the bucket with nameHash % bucketCount, walks the 0x20-byte file entries' sibling chain comparing parent id, name length and the UTF-16 name, and on a hit returns the entry offset and its five payload words (data offset, size and one spare field).

functions.name: Fs_Archive_ResolveChild
functions.signature: u32 Fs_Archive_ResolveChild(ArchiveDirTable* table, u32* outEntryOffset, ArchiveQuery* query, u32* outEntryFields, u32 dirOffset, const u16* name, u32 nameChars)
functions.summary: Resolves one named child below an already-known directory entry: it reads that directory entry to obtain its id (the hash seed), fills the query with the name span, and runs the hash lookup, so callers can resolve a component without re-reading the parent entry themselves.

functions.name: Fs_Archive_ResolvePath
functions.signature: u32 Fs_Archive_ResolvePath(ArchiveDirTable* table, ArchivePathSpan* outLast, u32* outEntryFields, ArchiveQuery* outQuery, u32 allowDotTail, const u16* path)
functions.summary: Resolves a UTF-16 archive path component by component: 0x0050DA68 rejects paths that do not start with '/', repeated separators are skipped, '.' is a no-op, '..' pops through the path stack, every other component is looked up with the hash lookup, and the resolved directory id, last component and payload are returned to the caller.

functions.name: Fs_Archive_LookupEntry
functions.signature: u32 Fs_Archive_LookupEntry(ArchiveDirTable* dirTable, u32* outEntryOffset, u32* outEntryFields, ArchiveQuery* query)
functions.summary: Computes the archive path hash of the query's name (hash = parentId ^ 0x075BCD15, then hash = ror(hash, 5) ^ each UTF-16 unit) and looks the name up as a directory first, retrying in the file table at dirTable+0x28 when the directory lookup reports 'not found' (FS error module 0x11, description 0x6F); returns FS error 0xC8804471 when neither table has the name.

functions.name: std_introsort_loop
functions.signature: void std_introsort_loop(SortRecord* first, SortRecord* last, int depth_limit)
functions.summary: Introsort core of the C++ std::sort used on 8-byte (u32 id, float weight) records: median-of-three quicksort partitioning with ascending float comparison, recursion on the right half, and a heapsort fallback once the depth budget is exhausted so the worst case stays O(n log n).

functions.name: std_quicksort_4byte_bytekey
functions.signature: void std_quicksort_4byte_bytekey(u32* first, u32* last, int depth)
functions.summary: In-place introsort/quicksort for 4-byte records whose primary key is the signed byte at offset +2, with median-of-three pivot and heapsort fallback.

functions.name: std_IntrosortLoop16BitRecords
functions.signature: void std_IntrosortLoop16BitRecords(unsigned short * begin, unsigned short * end, int depth)
functions.summary: std::__introsort_loop equivalent for arrays of 2-byte records: picks a median-of-three pivot by comparing the bytes at +0 and +1 of each 2-byte element, partitions in place, and recurses (calls itself) on the smaller half; the depth argument limits recursion before falling back to the insertion-sort driver.

functions.name: std_introsort_itemEntry

functions.summary: Introsort for 4-byte item rows {u16 id; u8; u8}: median-of-three pivot via maybe_Item_SortByEntryKey16, depth-limited recursion with a push-heap fallback and the 0x41-byte threshold; used by the two maybe_Ui_DataPanel row sorts.

functions.name: std_introsort_itemName4

functions.summary: Introsort for 4-byte item-bag entries: the median-of-three pivot and partition compare entries through Item_CompareFieldKey16 (item sort key, raw u16 id as tie-breaker), and the depth-0 fallback builds a heap with std_push_heap_itemName4.

functions.summary: Generic in-place introsort over a pointer range: median-of-three quicksort with a comparator callback, falling back to heapsort when the range is small or the recursion depth is exhausted.

functions.summary: Recursive merge of two priority-ordered widget runs (same rotation strategy as 0x7220A8 but without a scratch buffer), recursing until one element per run then swapping in order.

functions.summary: Second merge-sort driver for widget pointers by priority: splits recursively (half the range at a time) while depth is above the limit, sorts small ranges with 0x00722A50 and merges with 0x007220A8.

functions.name: std_merge_sort_with_buffer
functions.signature: void std_merge_sort_with_buffer(u32** first, u32** last, u32** buffer, int comparator_unused)
functions.summary: libstdc++ stable-sort building block (__merge_sort_with_buffer): insertion-sorts runs of 7 elements inside [first,last), then repeatedly merges runs of doubling length, alternating the destination between the caller-supplied scratch 'buffer' and the original range, so the caller's array ends up stably sorted. The sort key is Ui_Widget_GetLowestPriority (0x420CCC): it orders child widgets by their lowest draw-layer value.
